The Old Testament of the Holy Bible

Semtil 1

Pathen thil sem thusim

1 Semtil’ in Pathenin van le leiset ahinsemtai. 2 Ahin leiset chu alim le agong bei, twipi thuh tah a ki khang chule achungnga thim pi jingahin, twipi chu Pathen Lhagaovin a-opkhum’ e. 3 Pathenin, “kho hungvah hen,” atile, ahungvahtai. 4 Pathenin khovah chu avetle apha lheh jengin, muthim le khovah asep khentai. 5 Pathenin khovah chu “sun” asah-in, muthimchu “jan” asah-e. Jan akichaijin jingkah ahitan, nikhat alhingtai. 6 Pathenin, Twipi lah a chun vanthimjol hung kidal hen, Twipi chu alang langa dalten hen, atin; 7 Vanthimjol ajamdoh-in, twipichu chung le noiya adaltanin asepkhentai. 8 Twipi daltenna chu Pathenin “vanthamjol” asah-e. Jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, ni ni alhingtai. 9 Pathenin, “vanthimjol noiya twipi mun khat’a veikhom hen, tolgo hung doh hen,” atileh, aseibangin aumtai. 10 Tolgo lai chu Pathenin, “leiset” asah-in, twipi veikhom chengse chu “twikhanglen” asahtai. Aphatdan chu Pathenin amudohtai. 11 Pathenin, “leiset’in hampa, amunei hamphung, agathei thing, achi ding amunei cheh, ama amachi dungjui cheh-in hinsepdohhen, leiset chunga kehdohhen,” atileh ahung kehdoh tauve. 12 Leiset’in hampa ahinsep doh tan, hamphung ama ama chi dungjuiyin akehdoh-in, agathei amunei thingphung achi dungjuiyin ahung kehdoh tauve. Ahoidanchu Pathenin amudoh tai. 13 Jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, nithum alhingtai. 14 Pathenin, “sun le jan sepkhendin vanthamjol’a avah thei vahho hung kigol’u hen, kum kiheichin kum simtoh nan jong panguhen; 15 Vanthamjol’a konin leiset hinsalvah-u hen,” atileh, aseibang in aumtauve. 16 Pathenin vah len cheh ni asemin, nichang chu sun laiyin avahsah-e. Hiti hin ahsi ho jong asemdoh tai. 17 Pathenin, vah cheng chu leiset salvah ding le 18 Sun lai le jan laiya vah ding, muthim le khovah sepkhen din vanthamjol’a agoldohtai. Aphatje chu Pathenin amudoh tan ahi. 19 Jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, nili alhingtai. 20 Pathenin, “twi lah a ahon hona kijot le ding ganhing hiungdimset hen, “atin; 21 Pathenin twi lah acheng din ganhing lentah tah ho le adang dang ganhing tamtah asemin, akijot le nauva Twi, akidil chet chut jin, chule alha lengthei vachate aloi loiyin asemdoh-e. Aphat dan Pathenin amudoh tai. 22 Abonchauvin Pathenin phatthei aboh-in, “Hinphauvin, pungun, Twikhanglen le twi lah jouse dimset’uvin, chule vachate jong leiset’a pungu hen,” ati. 23 Hichun jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, ni-nga alhingtai. 24 Pathenin, “leiset’in ganhinglen le neo, ina vahthei le gamlah alha ding hinsep doh hen,” atileh, asei bangin aumtauve. 25 Pathenin leiset’a ganhing le sa jouse chule tol’a kithol ganhing jouse aloiloiyin asemdoh-in, avet le apha lheh jenge. 26 Chujouvin Pathenin, “Eiho lim le mel pun mihem semu hitin, ama ho twi lah anga jouse le chunga vacha te, leiset’a ganhing namkim, ina kivah le gamlah alha ho, alen aneo jouse chunga thunei vaihomin panguhen,” atin; 27 Ama lim le mel tobangin Pathenin mihem asemin, numei le pasal asemdohtai. 28 Pathenin ama ni chu phatthei aboh-in, “Chinphan pung lhonin, nason napah lhon leiset hung dimhen, twilah a nga, ju le vachate, leiset chunga ganhing namkim chunga hung vaihomu hen,” ati. 29 Pathenin, “ven, leiset’a muchi chivo, thingphung gathei jouse naneh lhon din kapen, 30 Leiset’a sa jouse le vachate, tol’a kithol ganhing ho le adang ho nehdin hamhing kapetai,” atin, hiti chun aumtai. 31 Hichun Pathenin athilsemsa chengse avet le ahoi behseh jengin pha asai. Hiti hin jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, nigup alhing tai.

Semtil 2

1 Hiti hin thilsem pumpi akijousoh tai. 2 Ni sagi lhinnin Pathenin Athilsem ajousoh-in anatoh acholdotan ahi. 3 Athilsem aboncha ajosoh a, ni sagi lhinnia acholdo jeh-in hiche nikhohi Pathenin Phatthei aboh-in asuthengtai. 4 Hitia hi thilsempumpi hung kisemdoh ahi.

Eden hon

Pakai Pathenin thilsem pumpi ahinsemdoh chun 5 Leiset chunga hampa louhing akeh hih laiyin, muchijong adondoh hih laiye. Ajeh chu Pakai Pathenin go ajuh sah hih laiyin, loubol ding mihem jongaum hih laiye. 6 Leiset’ konjoh chun meijun ajamdoh jin, chutengle leichung ahinle chapkotjie. 7 Pakai Pathenin leiset alan mihem asemin, anahhom sunga hintheina hu ahailut peh le, mihem chu mihing asohdoh paiten ahi. 8 Chujouvin Pakai Pathenin niso lam Eden mun’a chun hon khat asemin, hikomma hin amihem sempa chu akoitai. 9 Honsunga hin vetnomnom thingphung gapha tahtah Pakai Pathenin akesah-in, alailungtah a chun hintheina thingphung le se le pha hetna thingphung jong akeh-e. 10 Edan honlei chap nou din hnleiya konin vadung khat ahung lhongin, honkal’a lhalka lin alongkhenin, vadung li asohdoh paitai. 11 Vadung masapen chu pishonahin, Havilah gamkol vel’in alongin, 12 Hiche gama hin sana theng atamin, samphai chang le songval chang jong akimui. 13 Vadung nina chu Gihon ahin, Cush gamkol vel’a alongin ahi. 14 Vadung thumna chu Tigris ahin, Assyria niso lama alongin, chule vadung li lhinna chu Euphrates ahi. 15 Pakai Pathenin mihempa chu aleibol ding le angah din Edanhonsunga akoitai. 16 Pakai Pathenin mihempa jah a, “honsunga thingga jouse naneh thei ahinan, 17 Se le pha hetna thingga vang khu naneh thei louhel dingahi; naneh ni ni le nathi tei tei ding ahi, ati. 18 Pakai Pathenin, “Mihempa achangseh a aum hi anompoi, aki- thopi ding aki- angtopi thei khatsempeh inge,” atin; 19 Leiset alan Pakai Pathenin sa namkim le vacha jouse asemin, ipi asah ding vetnan mihempa henga abonchan ahin hoiluttai. Hichea hi mihempan aminsah pen pen chu aminu hijeng ahitai. 20 HIti hin mihempan vacha jouse le sa namkim aminvo chehtan, ahinla khat cha beh jong ama kithopi thei le aki-angtopi thie aumtapoi. 21 HIjeh chun Pakai Pathenin mihempa chu a-imut milsah-in, a-ihmut lanin anahgu khat aheh lhan, anung chu aphen atonjol’in, 22 Anahgua kon chun numei khat asemdoh-in, mihempa henga ahinpuilut tai. 23 Hichun mihempan: “ Hiche hi kagu kachanga kon, Kaphe kavouva kiladoh ahijeh aPasal’a kona kiladoh ahijeh a ‘Numei’ kiti ding ahi.” ati. 24 Hijeh a chu Pasal’in anu le apa alhakanga aji akol chah joh a, chule ama ni phe khat vou khat hilhonahi. 25 Hichepet chun mihempa le ajinu asagohkeo ahilhonin, ahivangin akijapi lhonpoi.

Semtil 3

Mihemin Pathen Thupeh apelkeh

1 Pakai Pathen thilsem ganhinglah a doha thuh pen chu gul ahi. Gul hin numei nu jah a,” Honsunga theiga ho khu naneh lhon louhel dia Pathenin akha mongham?” atile; 2 Numei nun,” Theiga dang vang kinetheiye; 3 Honlai lunga vang khu neh jong kaneh thie lhon lou ding, katoh khah lhon jongle kathi tei tei lhondin Pathenin eiseipeh lhon nai, “ati. 4 Hichun gul’in numienu jah a, Thi lhon hih hel’in nate. 5 Naneh lhon teng namitlam lhon kikeodoh a Pathen masap’a thilpha thilse nahetdoh lhonding jeh a Pathenin akha ahibouve, “ati. 6 Thingphung chu numei nu mitvet’ in ahoi lheh jengin, akineh le mi achihsah ding jeh-in jong aducha cheh jenge. Hijeh chun numei nun theiga chu akilon anen, ajipa jong apen, aman jong anetai. 7 Chutah-in amitlamlhon akikeodoh paiyin, asagohkeoahi ahedoh lhonin, theichang na akilmat mat lhonin kaipelengin akikai lhontai. 8 Nisa dailhah lamin honlei laiya Pakai Pathen va le husa aja lhonin, mihempa le ajinu hongsung thing lah a akisel lhontai. 9 Ahivangin Pakai Pathenin, “Vo Adam, hoiya um nahim?” tin ahinkouve. 10 Mihempan, “Honsunga nahusa kajah le, sagohkeo kahijeh a kichaa kisel kahi, “ati. 11 Pakai Pathenin, “kon sagohkeo nahi atim? Neh lou dia kisei thingga chu naneh hitanteong?”ati. 12 Mihempan, “Eilenkhompi dia neipeh numei nu hin thingga chu eipeh a kaneh ahitai,” tin aseiye. 13 “Ibol’a hitabangpi chu nabol ham?” tia Pakai Pathenin numei nu adoh le, amanun, ‘Gul chun eidohabol’a kaneh hichu me, “ati.

Pathen Thutan

14 Chuphat’in Pakai Pathenin gul jah a, “Nathilbol jeh a hi gaosap nachan a, ganhing jouse lah atalen namat ding, nahinkho lhumkeiya na-op’a kithol’a leivei naneh ding ahi. 15 Numei nu to kakidousah a, ama chilhah le nang chilhah kigal to ding ahi. Ama chilhah pan nalu avoh chip’a, nangin akhotaljum nachuhpeh ding ahi.”ati. 16 Pakai Pathenin numei nu jah a, “Na-naovop teng gim gentheiyanaum a, nat hahsa thot acha nahinding ahi. Hijongle najipa jeng lhangaiya nahin’a aman nachunga vai ahom ding ahi, “ati. 17 Mihempa jah aPakai Pathenin, “Naji nu thua nanun aneh lou dia kaseipeh thiega na neh jeh a leiset jeng jong hi gaosap chang ahitai. Nahinkho lhumkeiya tohgim genthei puma tol natuh a neh ding nakihol ding ahi. 18 Nakidoupi din leiset’a theimi ling le meithai seltho ling hung keh-in tin, chule tollhanga anche louhing naneh ding ahi. 19 Nakisemdohna leiset”a nakile kit kah a, namaiya ulsa long longa na natohgim a’neh le chah nakihol ding ahi. Leivuiya kisemdoh nahin, Leivui nalesokit ding ahi, “ati. 20 Mihem nankim penna nu ahiphat’in Adamin ajinu chu amin Eve asah-e. 21 Pakai Pathenin mihempa le ajinu din savun ponsil asemin asilpehtai.

Eden hon’a Pathenin Adamle Eve asoldoh

22 Pakai Pathenin, “Mihemhi ilah-uva khat bangin thilpha thilse hethieyin aumtan, hichea hi hinna thiega khu neh khahsah atonsot’a hinsah louhel ding ahi,” ati. 23 Hijeh chun akisemdohna leiset loubol’a kivah din mihempa chu Pakai Pathenin Edan honna konin asoldoh tai. 24 Hinna thingphung lampi ngah din hon niso lama Vantil lhanei chu akoiyin, chemjam deuje ju chu akipei kimvelsah tai.

Semtil 4

Cain le Abel

1 Adamin ajinu Eve akitimetpin, amanu agaiyin chapa khat ahinge; “Pakai panpi jal’a achapa kahin,” tin amin Cain asah-e. 2 Chujouvin asopipa Abel ahing kit’in ahi. Abel chu kelngoi chingin apangin, Cain chu loubol’in apange. 3 Khongnungin Cain chun alhosoh gan Pakaiya kilhaina abol’in, 4 Abel’ in jong akelngoi peng masapen, athaopen khat athat’in, kilhai nananeiye. Hichea hin Abel kilhaina chunga Pakai alung lhaiyin, athilbol asanpeh tai. 5 Cain thilto vangchu asangpon, ama jong akhohsahtapoi. Cain alunghang behseh-in akaiku jenge. 6 Pakaiyin Cain jaha, “Ibol’a lunghanga kaiku jeng nahim? 7 Thildih bol le chun kipah ding nahin, thilse nabol jeh-in chonsetnan kotphunga nachang lhi jinge; jotho dia nagot vangin, nangin najotei ding ahinai,” ati. 8 Cain chun asopipa Abel jah a, “Gamlah a che hite, “atin; gamlah agei lhon phat’in Cain asopipa chunga achun athattai. 9 Hichejeh hin, “Nasopipa Abel la em?” tin Pakaiyin Cain ahindongtai. Aman, “Kei kasopipa ching gun set ka hi ong?” ati. 10 Pakaiyin, “Ibol’a nahim? Tol’ a kona naopipa thisanin eihinsap sap khu me’. 11 Hiche leiset hi pohkhia nasopipa thisan achop lut tah jeh hin, nang jong gaosap chang nahitan, leiset jeng jong hi lou va na bol thei lou ding ahitai. 12 Muchi tujongle chun hung kehdoh louhelding, chen mun det beiya leiset chunga vah thai ding beiya leiset chunga vah thai ding nahitai” ati. 13 Chuphat’in Cain chun Pakai jah a, “Neipeh talen hi alen behseh tan kapoh jouhoi ahitapoi. 14 Na- angsunga kona neisoldoh a, chenmun det beiya leiset’a kavah thai le ding, eitoh khapen penin eitha ding ahitai,” ati. 15 Ahinla Pakaiyin, “Chutiponte, Cain hinthat pen pen chunga sagi vei phuki la ding ahi,” atin; atoh kha khan atha louhel na din Cain chalpanga melchihna khat akoi-peh e. 16 Pakai angsunga konin Cain apotdoh-in, Eden solam gamkai, “Vahthai gam” sunga achengtai.

Cain chilhah ho

17 Cain ajinu akitimatpi le agaiyin, chapa khat ahingin, Enoch asah-e. Cain chun khopi khat asemdoh-in achapamin aputsah -in, Enoch asah-in ahi. 18 Enoch chun Irad ahingin, Irad-in Mahuja-el ahingin, Mahuja-el chun Methusha-el ahingin, Methusha-el ‘in Lemech ahinge. 19 Lemech chun ji ni akop, in Khatnu Adah ahin, khatjonu Zillah ahi. 20 Adah hin Jabal ahingin, Jabal hi ponbuh achengte le gancha ching miho penna pa ahunghi. 21 Jabal sopipa chu Jubal ahin, semjang saite le theile mutte chengse penna pa ahung hikhai. 22 Zillah hin Tubal Cain ahingin, amahin sum-eng manchah ding alhan, thih khengin apange; Tubal Cain sopinu chu Naamah ahi. 23 Lamech chun ajite nijah a, “Adah le Zillah kasei ngai lhonin, Vo Lamech jie ni kisei hi melchih lhontan; Gollhang khat’in eiden jeh-in kathat tai. 24 Cain tha jeh a sagi vei phu aki lah ding le Lamech tha jeh a som sagi le sagi vei phukila ding ahi,” ati.

Seth le Enosh

25 Adamin ajinu akitimatpi kit le cha pa khat ahing kit’in, “Cain thapa Abel khel’a chi khai din Pathenin chapa khat eipekit tai,” tin anun amin Seth asah -e. 26 Seth-in chapa khat ahingin Enoch asah-e. Ama khanglaiya pat hin min ‘Pakai’ minin chibai ahinboh pantai.

Semtil 5

Adam chilhah ho

1 Pathenin Ama lim ma bang banga asem mihem- Adam khanggui thusim chu hiti ahi. 2 Numei le pasal asemin, phatthei aboh-in, amin jong ‘Mihem’ asah tai. 3 Adam kum ja khat le somthum alhinin ama lim le melto kilo tah chapa khat ahingin, Seth asah-e. 4 Seth pen nungin Adam kum jaget ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin, 5 Kum jako le somthum lhin kumin athitai. 6 Seth kum jakhat le nga ahin Enosh ahingin, 7 Enosh pen nungin Seth kum jaget le sagi ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin, 8 Kum jako le som le ni alhin kumin athitai 9 Enosh kum somko ahin kenan ahingin, 10 kenan pen nungin Enosh kum jaget le som le nga ahinben chanu chapa tam pi ahingin, 11 Kum jako le nga lhin kumin athi. 12 Kenan kum som sagi ahin Mahalalel ahingin, 13 Mahalalel pen nungin Kenan kum jaget le som li ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin, 14 Kumjako le som khat lhin kumin athi. 15 Mahalalel kum somgup le nga ahin Jared ahingin, 16 Jared pen nungin kum jaget kum jaget le somthum ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin, 17 Kum jaget le somko le nga lhin kumin athi. 18 Jared kum jakhat le somgup le ni ahin Enoch ahingin, 19 Enoch pen nungin Jared kum jaget ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin, 20 Kum jako le somgup le ni lhin kumin athitai. 21 Enoch kum som gup le nga ahin Methuselah ahingin, 22 Methuselah pen nungin kum jathum jen Pathen to akivop jingin, chanu chapa tampi ahinben, 23 Kum jathum le somgup le nga lhingin ahinge. 24 Enoch ahinkho lhumkeiyin Pathento akivop jingin, Pathenin ahing laiya alah phat’iin akiholmotai. 25 Methuselah kum jakhat le somget le sagi ahin Lamech ahingin, 26 Lamech pennungin Methuselah kum ja sagi le somget le ni ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin, 27 Kum jako le somgup leko lhin kumin athi. 28 Leamech kum jakhat le somget le ni ahin chapa khat ahingin, 29 “Pathen gaosapsa, ikhut’ uva itoh gim nau hiche leiset’a kona hi hiche naosen hin eitha-ol sah diu ahi,” tinan amin Noah asah-e. 30 Noah pen nungin Lamech kum janga le somko le nga ahinben, cha tampi ahingin, 31 Kum ja sagi le som sagi le sagi lhin kumin athitai. 32 Noah kum janga ahin chapa thum ahingin; Sem, Ham chule Japheth ahiuve.

Semtil 6

Namtin vaipi gitlouna

1 Leiset chunga mihem hapunin apungin, cha le nao tampi ahing tauve. 2 Van miten mihem chanu hoitah tah ho amudoh phat’un adei dei ji din akipuiyui. 3 Ahivangin Pakaiyin, “Kalhagao mihem sunga tonsot’ in chengden deh ponte; mihem hi tahsaphe bou ahin, ahinkho jong kum jakhat le som ni bou hiding ahi, “ati. 4 Mihem chanu ho le van mite chihlhah ho hi chulai le khonung geiya leiset’a mihatte chu ahiuvin, khanglui laiya mihat minthang ho chu amaho ahiuve. 5 Leiset’a cheng mitin gitlu le niseh a thilse jeng agel’u Pakaiyin amudoh tan, 6 Mihem asem’a leiset’a achensah akisih-in, alung na behseh tai; hijeh chun kasemsa jouse, mihem geiyin leiset’a konin sugam tange, : tin Pakaiyin aseitai. 7 Noah chunga vang Pakai alung lhainai.

Noah

9 Noah hinkho chu hiti ahi: midih, akhang sunga nolnabei, Pathen to kivop jing mihem ahi. 10 Noah chun chapa thum ahingin, Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahiuve. 11 Pathen mitmun leiset mihem abonchan aphamon, asegamtan, muntin’a pumhat jengin akinotauve. 12 Leiset’a cheng mihemte lam hilouva akihei gamtauvin, Pathenin avet le leiset asetsoh hel chu amudohtai. 13 Pathenin Noah jah a, “Leiset pumpi hi mihemte thilse bol dimsoh ahitan, hijeh a chu abonchauva kasuhgam’a, chitin namtin leiset puma kasuhgam ding ahitai. 14 Gopher thingin kong innei khat kisuiyin, kong sunga chu adan danin khah tanin, asung le apo begon loijol’in. 15 Kong innei chu adung tong jathu, avai tong som nga chule atun tong somthuma nasem ding. 16 kong innei chu inchung nakhua, alhung khu tongkhat bou len ding, kong kotpi asih lama nahon a, lhong danthuma nadoa, achungnungpen, aban’a chule anoinungpen nado ding; 17 leiset chunga haitheiya hing jose sumang dia keiman twiksang kaletsah ding, leiset’a ganhing namkim thisoh hel ding ahi. 18 Nangto vang kitepna khat kaphudoh a, naji le nachapte chule namoute chengtoh kong innei sunga nalut diu ahi. 19 Chule achikhai dinga ganhing namkim- anu khat le achal khat-kop khat cheh kong sunga napui lut ding ahi. 20 Vacha hihen ganhing dang hileh, tol’a kithol ho geiya ama ama jat dungjuiya chikhai dia nakoma hung kitol lut diu ahi. 21 Neh thei jouse nalo khoma, nang ho le ganhing namkim neh dia nakhol khom ding ahi,” ati. 22 Pathenin aseipeh bang bangin Noah-in aboltai.

Semtil 7

Twisang let

1 Pakaiyin Noah jah a, “Hiche khanga midih nang bou kamui, na-insung mite toh kong sunga luttan. 2 Satheng jat khat’a konin kop sagi-anu khat le achal khat cheh to, saboh jat khat’a konin vang kop khat bou-anu khat achal khat cheh lan, 3 Vacha jat a konin kop sagi cheh leiset’a achikhai din kong sunga kai lut’in. 4 Ni sagi lhinteng nisom le jan som li sunga go kajuh sah-a, kasemsa ahing thei jouse kasuh mang hel ding ahitai,” ati. 5 Pakaiyin aseipeh chan abang bangin Noah-in aboltai. 6 Leiset chunga twisanglet chun Noah kum jagup alhingtai. 7 Twisanglet’a hoidoh na din Noah le ajinu, achapte le ajiteu kong sunga alut tauve. 8 Pathen thupeh bangin satheng le sangboh kop khat che-anu khat le achal khat cheh toh, vachate le tol’a kithol ho geiyin, 9 ni nin Noah to kong sunga akijot lut tauve. 10 Ni sagi jouvin leiset’a twisang alentai. 11 Noah kum jagup lhin kum, lha ni na, nisom le sagi lhin nin twinah jouse ajal tan, van a gokot jouse jong akihong tai. 12 Chutah-in ni som li jan som li sung in go aju ju jenge. 13 Hiche nikho le lea chu Naoh le ajinu, achapate-Shem, Ham chule Japheth le ajiteu kong sunga lut ahiuve. 14 Ganhing namkim, insa le gamsa, alen aneo, vacha namkim, 15 Akop kop’in kong sunga alut’un, 16 Anu khat achal khat cheh, Pathenin Noah to akijot lut tauve. Noah alut phat’in Pakaiyin kongkot akhah tai. 17 nisom li le jan som li sungin leiset’a go ajun, twi apomtou tel tul’in Leiset sanga sang jon kong alet doh tai. 18 Leiset chung twi adimtel tul jengin, along matsoh tan, kong jong twi chunga akitol le lei. 19 Twi atamval’in van noiya molsang jouse geiyin achupsoh tai. 20 Twi chu akhang tou tou nalaiyin, molsang jouse sangin tongsom le ngan asangjoi. 21 Hijeh chun leiset ganhing namkim-ju le va, ahon honin, mihem geiyin athisoh heltauve. 22 Tolgoa cheng ganhing nah hai thei jouse athisoh tauve. 23 Leiset’a hing thei mihem le ganhing namkim, ju le va, tol’a kithol ho le chunga leng jouse Pakaiyin asugamin, Noah le kong sunga aumpi chengse chubou asoh chauve. 24 Ni jakhat le som nga sung geiyin twi akemsuh hih laiye.

Semtil 8

Twisanglet kichai

1 Noah le kong sunga aumpi ganhing chengse Pathenin agel khoh jingin, Leiset chunga hui anun sah le twi akemsuh pantai. 2 Twinah jouse le van’a go-kot chengse akikhah-in, go ahaiyin kho aphan, 3 Ni jakhat le som nga sungin leiset’a twi akang hei hoitai. 4 Lha sagi lhin na, nisom le ni sagi lhin nin Ararat lhanga molvum khat’a kong aki-ngamtai. 5 Twi vang akemsuh jing jengin, lha som lhinna, ni masapen nin molvum jouse akimu theitai. 6 Nisom li lhin nin Noah- in kong bangkot khat ahongin, 7 va-ah khat alha leh, leiset’a twi akanloulai jeh-in adung avaiyin alenglenahung kile kit tai. 8 Twi kan le kan lou hetnan Noah-in vakhu khat alha kit leh, 9 Leiset pumpi twiyin achup nah laijeh-in vakhu chun touna ding aholmon kong lama ahung kile kit;in, Noah-in agahsang lhan kong sunga achoilut tai. 10 Noah ni sagi akho ngaiyin, vakhu chu alha kit leh, 11 Nilhah lamin vakhuchun amuh a olive thing nathah khat ahinpon, ahenga ahung kile kit’e. Hichea hin Noah-in leiset’a twi kan ahe-tai. 12 Noah-in ni sagi ma a-ngah -in vakhu chu alhadoh kit leh, hichea vang hin vakhu chu ahenga ahung kile kit tapoi. 13 Noah kum jagup le khat (601) lhin kum, lha masapen, ni masa nin leiset’a twi akangsoh-in, Noah-inkong in chung khu ahodoh aavet leh, leiset chung twi akangsoh heltai. 14 Lha ni na nisom ni le sagi lhin nin leiset chung twi akang goheltan ahi. 15 Pathenin Noah jah a, 16 “Najinu le nachapate chule ajiteu toh kong sunga konin potdoh tauvin. 17 Naumpi ganhing namkim-ju le va, tol’a vah tahsaa hing jouse, apunjal’uva leiset adimsetna diuvin hinkai doh tan,” ati. 18 Hijeh chun konga konin Noah le ajinu, achapate le ajiteu apotdoh tauve. 19 Ganhing ho jong, tol’a kithol ho le vachate, leiset’a lhale jouse kong sunga konin akop kop’in ahung potdoh tauve.

Noah Kilhaina

20 Noah-in Pakai din maicham khat asemin, gancha theng le vacha theng lah akonin khat cheh adongkhomin, maichamphunga pumgo thilton agouvamtai. 21 Amuinam chun Pakai alung lhiayin alung sunga, “Aneocha pat mihem lungthim hi asesa kahet jeh-in, mihem thilse bol man a tukal leiset hi kagaosap kit lou hel ding ahitai. Tua kasuhgam banghin ganhing ho jong sumang ta ponge. 22 Leiset aum laisea muchi tuphat, lho lhun phat, gamsat le gamdap phat, nipi laile phalbi lai chule sun le jan um jing ding ahi,” ati.

Semtil 9

11 Itih hijongle ganhing namkim twiya kisumang talouding, a-itih geiya jong twisanglenin leiset asuhmang lou ding ahitai. 12 Nangho le ganhing namkim dinga mantih neilou kitepna kaphudoh het jingnan, 13 Meilhang lah a kathalpi kakoiye; hiche hi vannoito kakitep het jingna hiding ahi. 14 Vanthamjol’a meilhang kajinsah teng thalpi chu kimudoh ding, 15 Chule ganhing namkim-ahing jouse twilenin asuhmang louna dia nahenguva kakitepna kageldohji dingahi. 16 Hitia chu meilhang lah athalpi ahung kilah teng, leiset chunga ganhing jouse le kei kah a mantin neilou kitepna chu kageldoh ding ahi. 17 Thalpi hi ganhing namkim to kakitepna malchihna ahi,” ati.

Noah le achapate

18 Kong sunga hung potdoh Noah chapate chu Shem, Ham chule Japheth ahiuvin, Ham hi Canaan pa ahi. 19 Hiche Noah chapa thum ho hi leiset chung cheng mihem chitin namtin penna pului ahitauve. 20 Noah hi loubol mi ahin, leiset’a lengpilei bol masapenin apange. 21 Noah-in lengpitwi adon le akhamin, aponbuh sunga del cheng louvin alumtai. 22 Canaan pa Hamin apa Noah del cheng louva lum amun, polama asopite ni agaseipeh-e. 23 Shem le Japhet-in ponsilchol khat ala lhonin, alengkouva akhai lhonin, apa del chenglouva um chu mu lounadin akihei mangin, anunglam ngan pnonbuh sunga atoi lut lhonin, apa lhon chu agakhu khum lhone. 24 Noah lengpitwi kham alimdoh phat’in achapa neopenin abolna chu ahedoh-in, 25 Hijeh chun, “Canaan hi gaosap chang hen, Asopite nin soh-in nei lhon hen. 26 Pakai, Shem Pathen vang vahchoiyin umhen, Shemin Canaan hi soh-in hinneihen. 27 Pathenin Japheth punsah hen, Achilhahte Shem chilhahto hung chengkhomu hen; Canaan vang Japheth soh-in hung pang hen,” ati. 28 Twisanglet nungin Noah kum jathum le som nga ahing nalaiyin, 29 Kum jako le som nga lhin kumin athi.

Semtil 10

Noah chate sonle pah

1 Noah chapate Shem, Ham chule Japheth chilhah ho khanggui thusim chu, twisanglet nungin athum’uvin chapa tampi ahing cheh-ui. 2 Japheth chapate chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech chule Tiras ahiuve. 3 Gomer chapate chu Ashkenaz, Riphath chule Togarmah ahiuve. 4 Javan chapate chu Elishah, Spain, Cyprus chule Rhodes ahiuvin; 5 Twikhanglen pang dunga hung cheng ho penna pului ahiuve. Hicheng hi Japheth chilhah ahiuvin, aphung phungin agamkai sung cheh a akichen’uvin, ama pao cheh akithouve. 6 Ham chapate chu Cush, Egypt, Libya chule Canaan ahiuve. 7 Cush chapate chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah chule Sabteca ahiiuve. Raamah chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahi. 8 Cush-in Nimrod kiti chapa khat ahingin, leiset’a gal-hat masapenin apange. 9 Pakai panpi jal’in Nimrod hi sathat thei tah ahin, hijeh chun mihon, “Nimrod bangin Pakaiyin sathat thei nahisah hen,” akitijiuve. 10 Nimrod lenggam chun Babylon, Erech chule Accad, Babylon gamsunga um chengse ahopsoh keiye. 11 Hiche gama kon hin Nimrod Assyria gama achen, Nineveh khopi, Rehoboth Ir khopi, Calah khopi, 12 chule Nineveh khopi le khopi minthang tah Calah kikah a Resen khopi aphutdoh-e. 13 Egypt chapate chu Lydi, Anam, Lehab, Naphtuh, 14 Pathrus, Casluh chule Caphtor ahin, Caphtor hi Philistine mite penna pului ahi. 15 Canaan chapate chu amasan apeng masapen Sidon le Heth ahi lhonin, 16 chule Canaan chilhah chu Jebus mite, Amor mite, Girgash mite, 17 Hiv mite, Ark mite, Sin mite, 18 Arvad mite, Zemar mite le Hamath mite ahiuve. Khonung in Canaan insung kon chengse gamtin’a akithe chan soh keiyun, 19 agamgiu Sidon a pat Gerar lang jonin Gaza geiyin akilhung lut peh-in, Sodom lang jonin akilhungin, Gomorrah aphan, Admah ahinphan, chuin Zeboiim ahopan Lasha geiyin akilhung lut peh-e. 20 Hicheng hi Ham chihlhah ahiuvin, aphung phungin agamkai sung cheh a achengun, ama pao cheh akithouve. 21 Japheth upa Shem chu Hebrew mite penna pului ahi. 22 Shem chapate chu Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud chule Aram ahiuve. 23 Aram chapate chu Uz, Hul, Gether chule Meshkek ahiuve. 24 Arpachshad chapa chu Shelah ahin, Shelah chapa Eber ahi. 25 Eber hin chapa ni ahingin, khatpa khanga hi leiset mite paocheh jeh a akikhen jeh-un amin Peleg akitin, khatjo pa chu Jokatan ahi. 26 Joktan chapate chu Almodad, Shelph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, 27 Hardoram, Uzal, Diklah, 28 Obal, Abimael, Sheba, 29 Ophir, Havilah, chule Jobab ahiuvin, abonchauva Joktan chapa jeng ahiuve. 30 Joktan chapate gamgi chu Mesha a pat Sephar lang jonin solam thing lhang gamsung geiyin akilhung lutpeh-e. 31 Hicheng hi Shem chilhah ahiuvin, aphung phungin agakai sung cheh a achengun, apao cheh akithouve. 32 Hiche miho hi ama ama jat dungjui le akondoh nau insung dungjuiya kisimtoh Noah insung kon cheh ahivin, twisanglet nunga leiset chung mihem hijat hi amahoa kondoh jeng ahiuve.

Semtil 11

Babylon Insung

1 Hiche laichun leiset miten paokhat seh athon, thu cheng jong tha khat amanguve. 2 Mihemte chu niso lama akitol leu leh Babylon gama phaicham khat’a ahung lut’uvin, hikoma chun achengtauve. 3 Amaho khat le khat akihouvun,” Hungun, cheh dengu hitin goutah lhengu hite,” atiuvin; song panna pangdin cheh adenguvin, song lou din leingan amangui. 4 Mihon,” khopi khat semu hitin, insang, atingvum vanto kibang khat sau hitin imin kithansah-u hite, achutiloule leiset chunga ikimoh thethang gam diu ahi,” atiuve. 5 Mihemte khopi sem le insang sah chu vedin Pakai ahung kum lhai. 6 Hichea hin Pakaiyin, “Mihemte hijat khat bou ahin, pao khatseh bou athouve; athilbol’u hi tua bana aboldiu apatna bou ahinalaiyin, tukal abolnom nom abol jeng diu dol ahitai’ 7 Kum lhau hitin apaovu gasucheh leu hen khat le khat kihou mon um’uvin tin atohban haitauvinte,” ati. 8 Hitia hi Pakaiyin miho chu leiset chunga ahtecheh soh phat’in akhopi sah ban ahaitauve. 9 Hikoma kona hi Pakaiyin mihemte pao asuh cheh a, leiset chunga athe chehsoh hel jeh-in akhopi min Babylon akisah lot tai.

Shem chilhah ho

10 Shem chilhah ho thusim hiti ahi. Twisanglet nung kum ni lhin kum, Shem kum jakhat ahin achapa Arpachshad ahinge. 11 Arpachshad pen nungin Shem kum ja nga ahingin, chadang tampi ahinbei. 12 Arpachshad kum somthum le nga alhinin achapa Shelah ahingin, 13 Shelah pen nungin Arpachshad kum ja li le thum ahingin, chadang tampi ahinbei. 14 Shelah kum somthum alhinin achapa Eber ahingin, 15 Eber pen nungin Shelah kum ja li le thum ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi ahinbei. 16 Eber kum somthum le li alhinin achapa Peleg ahingin, 17 Peleg pen nungin Eber kum ja li le somthum ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei. 18 Peleg kum somthum alhinin achapa Reu ahingin, 19 Reu pen nungin Peleg kum ja ni le ko ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei. 20 Reu kum somthum le ni alhinin achapa Serug ahingin, 21 Serug pen nungin Reu kum ja ni le sagi ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei. 22 Serug kum somthum alhinin achapa Nahor ahingin, 23 Nahor pen nungin Serug kum ja ni ahing nalaiyin, cha dang tampi jong ahinbei. 24 Nahor kum som ni le ko alhinin achapa Terah ahingin, 25 Terah pen nungin Nahor kum jakhat le som le ko ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei. 26 Terah kum som sagi alhinin Abram le Nahor chule Haran ahinge.

Terah chilhah ho

27 Terah chilhah ho khanggui chu hiti ahi; Terah-in Abram le Nhor chule Haran ahingin ahi. Haran hin Lot ahinjou, 28 Apa Terah hinpet’ in Babylon gamsung achena khopi Ur a athitai. 29 Abramin Sarai akichenpin. Nahorin Haran chunu Milcah akichenpi: Haran hin Iscah jong ahingin ahi. 30 Sarai achingin cha neilouvin aumtai. 31 Terah hin achapa Abram le amou nu Sarai-Abram jinu, atupa Lot-Hanran chapa akipuiyin, Babylon gama Ur khopi dalhan Canaan gam jonin achetauve. Amahon Haran ahinphauvin, hikoma chun achengtauve. 32 Haran a chun Terah kum ja ni le nga alhinin athitai.

Semtil 12

Pathenin Abram akou

1 Pathenin Abram jah a, “Nagam leiset le na phung na chang, na- insung mite dalhan, keiman kavetsah got gam jonin chen. 2 Keiman nachilhah tampi kahisah a, nam lentah kaso ding, phatthei kaboh a min thang tah a ka koi ding, chu teng nangma phatthei bom nihi ding ahi. 3 Nangma phatthei na boh te phatthei kaboh a, Nagaosap jouse kagaosap thuh ding; Nang jeh achitin namtin phatthei kaboh ding ahi,” ati. 4 Abram kum som sagi le nga ahin, Pakaiyin aseipeh bangin, Haran akonin akipatdoh- in, Lot chun akilhonpi. 5 Abramin ajinu Sarai le asopipa cha Lot akipuiyin, Haran a alamdoh goujouse pon, soh chengse to kilhonin Canaan gam jonin achatauve. Canaan gam ahung lhun phat’ un, 6 Shechem muntheng lai, Moreh muna gangpi theng phung ahinphah kahsen Abramin gamsung chu akhol khol jenge. Hichepet hin gamsunga Canaan miho anachenguve. 7 Abram henga Pakai ahungkilah-in ajaha,” Nason nachilhahte kapehgot gam chu hiche hi ahi,” ati. Hichun ahenga hung kilah Pakai din Abramin maicham phung khat hikoma chun asemdoh tai. 8 Chujouvin Bethel khopi nisolam, lhanglam thinglhang gam manon Abram achen, nilhum lama Bethel le niso lama Ai kikah a ngahmun akisemtai. Hikoma jong hin maicham khat asemin Pakai minin ataove. 9 Hiti hin Abram muntin’a avah len, Canaan gamsung lhanglam gamkai sung ajontai.

Eygpt gama Abram

10 Canaan gamsunga kel lhah jeh a ahhsat behseh phat’ in Abram puhsuiya khopem din Egypt gam jonin achesuh-e. 11 Egypt gamsung alut ding konin Abramin ajinu Sarai jah a,” Veteh, mitvet’a numei mel-hoi tah nahi kahei. 12 Egypt miten namu tengu keiji nahi heuvintin, kei eithauva, nang nakihoi diu ahi. 13 Nang jeh a eihing hoijuva eibol phatna diuvin kei naovin kiseiyin,” ati. 14 Abram Egypt gamsung alut phat’ in Egypt mite mitvet’ in jong ajinu chu numei mel- hoitah ahi nget’e. 15 Pharaoh leng chapaten amudoh-un, Sarai mel- hoi dan lengpa jah a aseiyui; hijeh chun Sarai chu leng inpia apuilut tauve. 16 Sarai jal’ in lengpan Abram abol phan, kelngoi hon, kelchate, bong hon, sa-ngante, soh le kol chule sangonsao tampi apei. 17 Ahinla lengpan Abram jinu Sarai akipuijeh-in, Pakaiyin lengpa chung le a-insung mite chunga nat khoh tah alansah tai. 18 Hichun Pharoah- in Abram agakousah-in ajah a, “Idia hita neibol ham? Hiche nu naji hitaa idia naseida ham? 19 Ibol’ a nanao ahi na tia, jia naipuisah mongham? Hin hin naji hi, kipuiyin potdoh loiyin.” tin anotai. 20 Pharaoh-in amite aseipeh-in, amahon Abram le ajinu chule athil keo alokeo pumin gamsunga konin akaidoh tauve.

Semtil 13

Abram le Lot kikhen

1 Abramin ajinu akipuiyin, anei jouse apon, Lot to kilhonin, Egypt’ a konin Canaan lhanglam jonin achetai. 2 Abramin kelngoi le kelcha, bong chule sana dangka tampi aneiyinmihao tah ahitan ahi. 3 Canaan lhanglam gamkaiya konin akholjin len, muntin achonin, Bethel lang ahinjon’e. Masanga ngahmun asemna Bethel le Ai kikah ahinphan, 4 Masanga maicham asemna muna chun Pakai min ataove. 5 Lot’ in jong atumtah-in kelngoi le kelcha chule bong tampi le soh tampi aneiyin, a-insung mite toh ahiuve. 6 Abram le Lot’ in gancha tamtah gel anei lhon phat’in, ganchate neh ding gam aneo behseh tan acheng khom thei lhon tapoi. 7 Abram gancha ching ho le Lot gancha ching ho akinahso tauvin, akitohmo tauve. hichepet hin Canaan gamsunga Canaan mite le Periz mite acheng nalaiyui. 8 Abramin Lot jah a, “Insung khat kihi, namite le kamite kina thei pouvinte. 9 Kikhenta hite. Na- angsunga gam ongmo ngap lou, nadei dei lai kilhenin; jetlam nalhen le veilama cheng ting, veilam nalhen le kei jetlama chenge,” ati. 10 Lot akhodaa avet leh, Jordan phaicham pumpi, Zoar geiyin agah mun, twi atha lhingin, Pakai honsung le Egypt gamsung abang jengin ahi. Hichepet”a chu Pakaiyin Sodom le Gomorrah asuhmang loulai ahi. 11 Hi jeh chun Lot’ in Jordan phaicham pumpi akilhenin, nisolam jonin akitoldoh tai. Hitia cuh Abram le Lot kikhen ahilhon’e. 12 Abram Canaan gama acheng denin, Lot chu Jordan phaichama khopi ho lah a chun apansan, Sodom koma ngahmun asem’e; 13 Sodom kho mite chu a- engseuvin, Pakai dounan achonseuve.

Abram Hebrona achaolut

14 Lot’in adalhah nungin Pakaiyin Abram jah a,” Nadin mun laitah akonin najet navei, sah le lhang vegolsoh keiyin; 15 Gam hitepi nang le nason napah kapeh ding, tonsot’a nagamu hiding ahi. 16 Nason nachilhah hapuna kapunsah ding, tam behseh jenguva leivui jat pha diu koman asim jou lou ding ahi.’ 17 Keiman agam pumpia kapeh tah ding jeh-in, kipatdoh-in abonchan gakholsoh keiyin,” ati. 18 Chuphat’in Abram jong achen, Hebron a Mamre thingphung theng ho koma chun apansan, hikoma chun Pakai din maicham khat asemtai.

Semtil 14

Abramin Lot ahuhdoh

1 Hiche lai hin Babylon lengpa Amraphel le Ellasar lengpa Arioch, Elam lengpa Chaedorlaomer le Goiim lengpa Tidal 2 Akon’ uvin Sodom leng pa Bera le Gomorrah lengpa Birsha, Admah lengpa Shinah le Zeboiim lengpa Shemeber chule Bela ahiloule Boar lengpa chunga gal agabol tauve. 3 Tulaiya Twikhanglen thisa, Siddim phaichama hiche leng nga ho hi anapangkhom’ uve. 4 Kum somle ni sungin leng nga h hi Chedorlaomer lengpa noiya alut lo tauvin, nah nha- in kum som le thum kumin ahindou pan thie bep’ ui. 5 Ahin la kum som le li lhin kumin Chedorlaomer le apanpi leng ho ahung kon’ uvin, Ashteroth Karnaim a Rephaim mite ajouvun, Ham mun’ a Zuzim mite ajouvun, 6 Edom molsang lhanga Hor mite ajouvun, nelgam pamchim a Elparan geiyin agadel jampeh-uve. 7 Chua konin ahung kile kit’ uvin, masanga ‘Enmishpat kiti, tulai Kadesh mun akhun ahunguve. Hikoma hin Hazazon Tamar a cheng, Amor mite le Amalek mite ajouvun agam pumpi alauve. 8 Hichun Sodom le Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim chule Bela leng ho akikhom’ un Siddim phaiya galbol din akigotauve. 9 Leng nga hin Elam le Goiim, Babylon, Ellasal- leng li dou din agouve. 10 Siddim phai hi bon- ngan bol adimset’ in, Sodom le Gomorrah lengpa galmun’ a kona ajam lhon le bolsunga alha lut lhontan, leng dang thum vang chu molsang lama ajamdoh tauve. 11 Leng li honSodom le Gomorrah khopi sunga thilkeo ijakai, anneh geiyin akichom’ un achetauve. 12 Amahon Sodom khoa cheng, Abram sopipa chapa, Lot jong gal- hingin akaiyui, athilkeo jouse jong akipoh thauve. 13 Gal’ a hung jamdoh mi khat’ in thilsoh chengse hi Hebrew mi Abram jah a ahung seitai. Hichepet hin Abram hi Amor mi Mamre thingphung theng ho koma anachenge. Mamre’n sopi Eshcol le Aner aneiyin- Abram to pangkhom cheh ahiuve. 14 Asopipa chapa min gal- hinga akaimang jeng ajah phat’ in Abramin ainsung mi galbol thei cheh akhop le, jathum le som le get alhingun, ama lamkai nan leng li ho chu Dan geiyin agadel peh-ui. 15 Abramin asepaite chu aloi loiyin ahomkhenin, agalte chu janlaiyin anokhumin ajoutai, chu leDamascus sah lam, Hobah geiyin agadel jampeh-uve. 16 Abramin asopipa chapa Lot le numei chapang joouse ahin puiyin, athilkeo anei agou chengse le athil chomdoh-u abonchan ahin nungpoh kit’e,

Melchizedek-in Abram phatthei aboh

17 Chedorlaomer le leng dang ho agajao ahung kile kit chun ‘ lengpa phaicham’ kisah Shaveh phaiya Sodom lengpan Abram analamtoi. 18 Chu le Pathen Chungnungpen Thempupa, Salem lengpa Melchizedek chun Abram din changlhah le lengpitwi ahinchoipeh- in, 19 Phatthei boh nan ajah a, “van le leiset sem, Chungnungpen Pathenin Abram phatthei boh hen’ 20 Nagalte josah Chungnungpen Pathen chu vahchoiyin um hen.’” ati. Abramin athil chomdoh jat hopsom a hop khat cheh Melchizedek apei. 21 Sodom lengpan Abram henga, “Nathil chomdoh chengse chang denin lang, kamite vang neipen,” tin athum’e. 22 Sodom lengpan jah a Abramin, “Van le leiset sem, Chungnungpen Pathen, Pakai angsunga khut tunga kihahselsa kahi, 23 ‘Abram kahaosah-e,’ nati louna din, patse jang cha hihen, kengchot khao jang cha hijongle, nang thil pou pou laponge. 24 Golhang ho nehdoh le kalhonpi ho lahdoh tilou adangima ding katipoi; kapanpi Aner le Eshcol chu le Mamre’ n vang achan ding dol kilah cheh-u hen,’ ati.

Semtil 15

Pathenin Abram to Kitepna asem

1 Hicheng nung hin Abramin mu anei pet’in Pakaiyin ajah a, “Kicha hih-in Abram, nang dial um a kisung kahin, kipaman tampi namu tei ding ahi,” ati. 2 Abramin, “Thaneitah Pakai, cha le nao neilou kei tobang dinga kipamaan chu ijajong phachom ding ham? Kagou jeng jong hi Damascus khoa Eliezerin alo ding dan ahibouve. 3 Cha la neihinsah pon, kasohte khat hin kanei le kagou jouse alo ding ahitai,” ati. 4 Hichun Pakaiyin ajah a, “Hiche soh Eliezer khun nanei nagou alo louhel ding, nachapa mong mongin nagou alo ding ahinai, “ati. 5 Pakaiyin inpo lama apuidoh-in, “Van a ahsite khu gahsim gotemin; nason nachilhah jong hijat khu hung pha diu ahi, ;ati. 6 hichea khen beihel’a Abramin Pakai atahsan jeh chun, Pakai alung lhaiyin, them achansah tai. 7 Pakaiyin Abram jah a, “Babylon gam Ur khopia pat hinpuiya hiche gam nape goa Pakai chu Keima kahi,” ati. 8 Abramin, “Thaneitah Pakai, hiche gam keiya ahiding chu iti kahet ding ham?” tin adonge. 9 Adonbut nan Pakaiyin, “kumthum lhingsa cheh bongla khat le kel la khat chule kelngoi chal khat hinkaiyin, chule vakhu khat le vapal khat hinchoiyin hungin,” ati. 10 Abramin gancha ho chu Pathen henga din ahinkaikhomin, athat’in ahapsat cheh-in, ahap Langton ajamin, vachate ni vang chu asemkeh poi. 11 Sa ho chu muthongten ahinvel tengu Abramin adeldohjie. 12 Nisa lhumsuh lamin Abram nguijen juntah-in a-ihmutsoh tan, chule tijat umtah muthim lhangkhal’in ahinjin khumtai. 13 chutah-in Pakaiyin Abram jah a, “Nason nachilhahte gam hi loubeh, kholgam khat’a khopem diu, gasoh changuva kum ja li sunga min genthei hesoh tah a abolgim diu ahi. 14 Nachilhah ho soh a vul nam mite chu ken talen kapah a, nachilhah hon nei le gou tampi kipoh a migam chu adalhah diu ahi. 15 Nangin hinkho nomtah naman’a, nateh thia kivui ding, napu napate heng najot ding ahi. 16 Nachilhahte hi khangli channa a hikoma hung kile kit diu ahi; ajeh chu tu chan geiyin Amor mite gitlouna akichai hih laiye,” ati. 17 Hiche chu photlot louvin sahap kisat ho kah a chun ahung lengjap jengin ahi. 18 Hiche nikho hin hikoma chun Pakaiyin Abram to kitepna asemin, “Keiman nason nachoilhahte chu hiche gam, Egypt gamgia pat Euphrates luipi dung gei, 19 Ken mite gam jouse pum, keniz mite gam gei; e Kadmon mite gam puma, 20 Hit mite gam jong, Periz te gam, Rephaimite gam, 21 Amor mite gam gei, Canaan mite gam, Girgash mite gam le Jebus mite gam jouse puma kapeh dia kitep kahitai,” ati.

Semtil 16

Hagar le Ishmael

1 Abram jinu Saraiyin cha ahinpeh tapon, ahin Sarai hin Egypte numei Hagar chu soh-in anavul’e. 2 Hijeh chun Abram jah a, “Keila Pakaiyin cha neilouvin eikoitan, cha eihinpeh khat leh, kasoh nu-nugah khutoh galumkhomin,” ati. Sarai sei chu Abram anomtai. 3 Hiti hin Saraiyin asohnu Hagar chu Abram thaikem din apetai. Hiche hi Abram kum som jen Canaan gama achen nunga thilsoh ahi. 4 Abramin Hagar agaluppi le amanu agaitai. Hagarin agai akihet phat’in akiletsah-in Sarai anoise boltan ahi. 5 Chuphat’in Saraiyin Abram jah a, “Hibanga eikinoisena gu hi nachunga chuhen! Kenba nakikoipi din kasohnu kapen, aman agai akihet phat’in eihiti noisetai. Koijoh moa dih am Pakaiyin ikah lhona thu hintan jeng hen!” ati. 6 Abramin la Sarai jah a, “Nakhut’a um nasohnu chu me, nadei deiyin bol jeng tang-em,” atipeh-e. Hijeh chun Saraiyin Hagar chu thohda daa abolgim leh, ajammang lo tai. 7 Shur jotna lampia twisam phung khat’a Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in Hagar akimupin, 8 ajah a, “Sarai sohnu Hagar, hoiya kona hoilam jon ding nahim?” tin adong e. Hagarin, “Kapi Sarai dalha hung jam kahi,” ati. 9 Vantil chun, “Napi henga kile kit’in asoh-in gapang kittah,” ati. 10 Pakaiya kon Vantil’in Hagar jah a hitin jong aseiye, “Keiman koima cha simsen lou son le pah kapeh ding na hi. 11 Chapa khat nahin ding ahin, hesoh a nataona Pakaiyin asanjeh a amin Ishamael nasah ding ahi. 12 Nachapa vang chug am sa-ngan ngol’a ngol ding, mitin adouva, mijousen ama aledou diu; ainsung mite to kikhena chang chen ding ahi,” ati. 13 Hagarin ajah a thusei Pakai chu aminin akouvin, “Mi mudoh thei Pathen nahi,” ati. Ajeh chu, “Tahbeh monga ken Pathen kamua ahivanga hing nalai kahim?” ati. 14 Hijeh a hi mihon Kadesh le Bered kikah a twikul chu, “Eimudoh a Hing jing Pa twikul,” atiu ahi. 15 Hagarin Abram chapa khat ahinpeh-in, Ishmael asah-e. 16 Hichepet hin Abram kum somget le gup alhing tai.

Semtil 17

Kitepna hetna Cheptan

1 Abram kum somko le ko alhinin ahenga Pakai ahung kilah-in ajah a, “Keima Hatchungnung Pathen kahi, kathunnungin thildih bol’in. 2 Nangto Kitepna kasema, nachilhah hapuna kapunsah ding ahi,” ati. 3 Hichun Abram tol’a abohkhup jengle, Pathenin ahenga, 4 “Hiche hi nahenga kakitepna ahi: Chitin namtin penna pa nahi ding; 5 namin jeng jong Abram hitalouva Abram* hiding ahi, ajeh chu chitin namtin penna paa kasem nahi. 6 Nachilhah mihem hapuna kapunsah a, abang bang jong leng le lal hung chang diu, nason napah tam behseh jenga nam lentah tah hungsoh diu ahi. 7 “Nang le khonung geiya nachilhahte, akhang khanga, tonsot teiya kakitepna chu kanit jing ding ahi. Nang Pathen jong kahiya, nachihlhahte Pathen jong kahi ding ahi. 8 Tua nakhopemna gamsung hi nang le nachilhahte kapeh ding; Canaan gam pumpi hi chilhah mite changuva, tonsot geiya apua pang diu, chu le Keima a-pathenu kahi ding ahi, “ati. 9 Abram jah a Pathenin, “Nahenga kakitepna hi nang nahin, khonunga nachilhah ho hijongle nanit soh kei diu ahi. 10 Nang le na chilhah ten na lah-uva pasal jouse chep natan cheh diu ahi. 11 I-kah lhon a kitepna het jingna dia nangin chep natan ding, 12 nakhang lhumkeiyuva, nachilhah insunga pengden mong hihen, suma kicho soh-midang hijongle, pasal jouse chu niget lhin nia chep natan cheh diu ahi. 13 Insung pengden hihen soh a kicho hijongle pasal jouse chap natan diu ahi. Hitia hi kakitepna chu natahsa vuna naput’uva, tonsot’a um jing jeng ding ahi. 14 Keito kitepna suhkeh a chep tanlou pasal koi hileh kamite lah a kisimtha louhel ding ahi,” ati. 15 Abraham jah a Pathenin, “Najinu min Sarai tilouva, tukal Sarah natijohding ahitai. 16 ama hi ken phatthei kaboh teng, chitin namtin penna nu hung hi ding, chule achilhahte lah a leng le lal jong hung pengdoh ding ahi,” ati. 17 Abraham tol’a aboh khup’in, “Kum jakhat lhingsa pasal’in cha anei mong ding hiya, kum somko nunga Sarah-in cha anei thei mong ding ham?” tia agel le, amoh nuijat lo tai. 18 Abrahamin Pathen koma, “Ishameal chu kagou nalosah jengle iti-am?” ati. 19 Ahinla Pathenin, “Ahipoi. Najinu Sarah hin chapa khat nahinpeh tei tei ding, amin Issac nasah ding ahi. Kakitepna chu ama le achilhahte dinga, tonsot geiya kanit jing ding ahi. Hichu kitepna guitan mo ahi. 20 Ishamael ding nasei jong kahenai, phatthei kaboh a cha le nao son leh pah tampi kapeh ding, lengvai pothei cheh pasal som le ni ahin ding, achilhah mite nam lentah kaso ding ahi. 21 Ahinla khovei tulai phat’a Sarah-in ahinding nachapa Issace chunga bou kakitepna kaphudoh ding ahi,” ati. 22 Abraham jah a thu aseisoh phat’in Pathen chu akaltoutai. 23 Abrahamin Pathen thusei anit’in achapa Ishmael leh a-insung mi pasal jouse, a-insunga pengden hihen suma achoh ho hijongle, soh pasal geiyin, hiche nikho le le chun chep atanpeh soh keiye. 24 Chep akitan chun Abraham kum somko le ko alhingtai, 25 achapa Ishmael kumsom le thum alhinge. 26 Anilhonin nikhat’in chep akitan lhonin, 27 Abraham soh pasal jouse jong ahiuve.

Semtil 18

Abraham chapa neiding Kiteppeh

1 Mamre thingphung theng mun achenna a, nisa hahsat jeh a ponbuh kotphungbul’a atoupet’in Abraham henga Pakai ahung kilah-in, 2 Abramham akhodaa agahvet leh, pasal thum anadinguve. Amu mun alamdot din alhaidoh paiye. Tol’a aboh khup’in, 3 “Kapu, nang jen dia hikoma ki-uma, ka-in hopa louvin neijot pai hih beh-in. 4 Nakeng dopna diu twi hindom ing ting, hikom thingphung noiya hin kicholdo’uvin. 5 Ka-in hinhopa ngal tauva, ikhat beh jong bolpeh ung ting, najin nauva natha nei theina diuvin na kamkhat beh jong nehsah unge,” ati. Miho chun, “Kipa aume, naseibangin hinboltan,” atiuve. 6 Lungkin tah-in Abraham ponbuh sunga alut’in Sarah jah a, “Nachangbonh neldi phapen dip’a konin atena thum tedoh-in, changlhah phabep hinkang loi temin,” agatin; 7 chuin bonghon lah a alut’in bongnou hoisel athao khat amanin, sohpa khat apen, aman jong athat’in ahon min loutai. 8 Abrahamin bongnoi le theilhum kihal, bongnoi twi chule bongnousa minsa chutoh ahindomin, miho angsunga aluiyin, thingphung noiya chun aneh laiseuvin amatah ajenlen apange. 9 Amahon Abraham jah a, “Najinu Sarah la?” atiuleh; aman, “Ponbuh sunga khun aum nai,” ati. 10 Jinpan, “Khovei tulai phat, nahenga kahung kit teng le najinu Sarah-in chapa khat ahinding ahi,” ati. Anung, ponbuh kotpunga chu Sarah uma angai lhih ahi. 11 Abraham le Sarah ateh lheh lhontan, Sarah chu athinei jong atangtai. 12 Hichun Sarah-in Alungthimin, “The nung voi nunga kitimatna ki nei jongle anopje jong imlou ding, kajipa jong tehse voisa hilou haimo?”ati. 13 Hichun Pakaiyin Abraham jah a, “I-bol’a Sarah nuiya, ‘The nung voi nunga cha kaneibeh ding hinam?’ati ham? 14 Pakai dia ipi ahah sa um am? Kaseisa banga khovei tulai phat le ka hung teng Sarah-in chapa khat ahin ding ahi,” ati. 15 Chuphat’in Sarah akichan akilep’in, “Nuibon kinui louva,” ati. Ahinla Pakaiyin, “Ahinpoi, nanui nai,” ati.

Sodom khopi dia Abraham taona

16 Amaho akipatdoh-un Sodom khopi gah vetsah theina mun khat ajon’uve; Abraham jong alhadoh diuvin amaho akilhonpi. 17 Pakaiyin, “Kathil bolgot hi Abraham impehda tange. 18 Ajeh chu ason achilhah mite nam hattah le nasatah hung hiya, amajeh a chitin namtin ken phatthei boh ngal ding chu. 19 Acha anao, ason achilhah miten kathu angaiyuva thildih le akitoh abol theina diuva hil dinga ama kilhengta. Achilhahten kathu angaivu le ken kathutep aboncha kabolpeh ding ahi,” ati. 20 Hiti chun Abraham jah a Pakaiyin, “Sodom le Gomorrah dounan thuse akihasei behseh tan, achonset nau jong aval thanghoitai. 21 Chesuh ing ting asset nau kisei chengse atah ajou gapho chen tange,” ati. 22 Mi nin chukom adalhan Sodom lang ajon lhontai; Pakaiyin vang Abraham aumpi. 23 Hichun Abrahamin Pakai anailut’in ajah a, “Mona beiho chu chonsete toh nasuhgam tha tahbeh ding ham? 24 Ijemtia khopia khun themmona bei mihem som nga um jongle akho pumpin nasugam nah nah dem? Mihem som nga um jongle akho pumpin nasugam nah nah dem? Mihem som nga huhdohna khopi chu na hinghoi lou ding ham? 25 Nangin midih le migilou kibanga nabol’a nathagel ding, akikhetna beiya nabol ding vang bolda hel le chun kadeiye! Leiset pumpi thutan Pan adih a atan lou ding ham?” ati. 26 Pakaiyin, “Sodom khopia themmona bei mihem som nga bang kamudoh joule, amaho jal’a kho pumpi kahinghoi ding ahi,” ati. 27 Abrahamin asei kit’in “Pakai, imacha lou, leivui le meivam bep ken ngamtah a na henga thu kaseijom kit ding jeh-in nei-ngaidamin. 28 Khosunga chun themmona bei mihem som nga lhing lel hen som li le nga she umta leh, midih nga lhahsam jeh chun kho pumpi nasugam jeng dem?” ati. Pakaiyin, “Midih som li le nga ka mudoh le khopi chu sugam ponge, “tin adonbut’e. 29 Abraham, “Ijemtin somli she hile la?” tin adonge. Pakaiyin, “Som li she um jongle khopi chu sumang ponge,” ati. 30 Abraham, “Pakai, lung himo hih beh-in, kasei kit nom’e. Ijemtin somthum sehseh umta leh?” ati. Pakaiyin, “Somthum jeng kamu jongle bolda tange, “ati. 31 Abrahamin, “Pakai, imacha lou, leivui le meivam bep ken ngamtah a nahenga thu kaseijom kit ding jeh-in nei-ngaidamin. Ijemtin midih som ni seh bou umta leh?” tin adong kitleuve. Pakaiyin, “Som ni she kamudoh jongle khopi chu sumang ponge,” ati. 32 Abrahamin, “Lung hang hih beh-in Pakai, khatvei seh bou gah sei kit tading’e. Midih som khatseh bou kimudoh le la?” ati. Pakaiyin, “Midih som khatseh um jongle sumang ponge,” ati. 33 Abraham to akihou jouvin Pakai chu achemangtai, chule Abraham jong in lama ahung kile tan ahi.

Semtil 19

Sodom khopi chonsetna

1 Vantil te ni chu Sodom khopia ahung lhun lhon le lot chu khopi kelkot phunga anatouve. Amani amu phat’in Lot chun agalamtoi. A-ang sung lhona aboh khup’in, 2 “Pu te ni, hikoma nangni kinbol dia umah kahi; ka-in a hung lhung lhonin. Keng kisil lhonin natin nage khovah thei lhon ahi. Jingpi tah-in thou lhonin natin chepai lhon nan nate,” ati.Amani adan, “Ahipoi, kholai dunga geh khovah lhon tange, “ati lhontai. 3 Lot ín amani chu ahajolten phat’in anom lhonin, Lot in lam ajontauve. Maljin te ni dinga changlhah kanpeh a anneh tuitah sempeh din Lot’in alhacha ho asol’in ahi. Lhachahon neh asem jou phat’uvin an anetauve. 4 Maljin ten in lupna ajot masangin, khopi sung mihon in chu ahin-umtauve, In umho lah a khosung gollhang upa apang soh keiyuve. 5 Amahon Lot ahinkouvun, “Tujan na-in a geh dia hung te ni chu hoiya um lhon tam? Hinpuidoh loiyin, numei bol’a kabol diu ahi!” tin asamtauve. 6 Lot apotdoh-in kotpi anungkhan, 7 miho jah a, “Golle paite, hitobang lom hin khang gilou hih beh-uvin! 8 Veuvin, pasalto kitimat louhel lai chanu nu kaneiyin, anin hinpuidoh peh-uving ting nanop nop’in bol jengun, maljin te ni vang imacha lodauvin, ka-in a hung lhung kamaljin ahilhon bouve,” ati. 9 Ahinla amahon ahoh lhauvin, “nei ot’un khopempa! I-tobang mi nahiya keiho toh ding neihil leu ham? Nei ot’uvin, ajo le amani sanga melse cheh a nang kabol lo diu ahi,” ati tauve. Hiti hin Lot chu anung sot’un, kotpi phung phujal ding akigotauve. 10 Chuphat’in insunga um ten in Lot chu akailut loi lhonin, kotpi akhah lhontai. 11 Kotphunga um mi alen aneo abonchauva Vantil ten in amit’u achotsah lhon leh, suhna ding helouvin akimaitho gamtauvin ahi.

Lot’in Sodom kho adalhah

12 Mi ten in Lot jah a, “Hiche khosunga hi heng le kom-chanu chapa, tu le cha-adang koi koi nanei nah laiyam? Abonchauvin puidoh loidoh loiyin; 13 ajeh chu hiche mun hi kasuh mang lhon ding a hitai. Hiche miho dounaa thuse melse tah kisei chengse chu Pakaiyin ajadoh tan, hijeh a chu Sodom sumang dia eihinsol lhon ahi,” ati lhone. 14 Chuphat’in achanu te nit oh kitepsa pasalte henga Lot achen, “Kapat’un hikoma konin jamdoh loiyun; mun hi Pakaiyin asuhmang ding ahitai,” agate. Ahinla amanin atot danin anagel lhon’e. 15 Jingkah khovah lhah-in Vantil te nin Lot anoloi lhonin, “Khopi hitoh nakisuh mang tha louna diuvin, nachanu te ni le najinu kipuiyin jamdoh loiyun,” ati lhon’e. 16 Lot akinomsot nah lai vangin, Pakaiyin akhohsah jeh-in, Vantil te nin akhut’in akai lhonin, ajinu le achanu te ni pumin khopi pamlama alhoh doh lhontai. 17 Hichun Vantil khat chun, “Nathi louna diuvin jamdoh loiyun! Kinung hei hih-un, phaicham dunga jong kibangpa hih hel’uvin, thinglhang gam a jamlut’uvin,” ati. 18 Lot’in adonbut’in, Ahipoi kapu, thing lhang lama neisol dauvin. 19 Khohsah tah a kahinkho bon huhhing ta, thing lhang lam agamla behseh-in, kalhun masanga manthah nan eihin lap den’a kathi den ding ahibouve. 20 Ven hiche khopi khu, naicha bou ahi, hikoma khun neijamlut sah-in, khopi neocha ahivanga hoidohna thei ahinai,” ati. 21 Vantil chun, “Aphai, hiche khopi khu suhmangda tange. 22 Man-gangin! Lhaiyin! Khukom nalhun ma imacha kabol thei l ou ding ahi,” atipeh-e. Khopi neo tinaa amin Zoar kisah ahitai.

Sodom le Gomorrah kisuhmang

23 Lot Zoar kho alhunin nisa ahung soh tai. 24 Phot lot louvin van a Pakaiya konin, Sodom le Gomorrah chunga Pakaiyin Kath le meikong goju bangin ajuhsah-in, 25 phaicham pumpi le khopi te ni, asunga cheng mihem jouse le tol’a keh thingna louna jouse geiyin asugamhel tai. 26 Hichun Lot jinu agah kinunghei leh, chilhang asoh-in, songkhom bangin akitungdentai. 27 jingkah matah-in Abraham alhaijel’in, Pakai masanga anadin na muna chun agadingin, 28 Sodom le Gomorrah gamkaise se agah vetsuh patep leh, hol kilhut khu bangin meikhu ahung kitungdoh jen jun jengtai. 29 Pathenin Lot chenna, phaicham akhopi te ni asuhmang jeng vangin Abraham agel khoh jeh-in Lot chu ahindohna thei muna ajamdohsah nai.

Moab mite le Ammon mite penna

30 Zoar khoa chenden ding akichan, achanu te nit oh Lot thing lhang gama acheuvin songko sung khat’a achengtauve. 31 Lot cha au-nun anao nu jah a, “I-pa la atehtan, hiche gamsunga eini kichenpi ding pasal dang jong aumpon, 32 i-pa hi ju donkhamsah hitin, luppia chi khaipeh din bol hite,” atin; 33 hiche jan chun ju adonkhamsah lhonin, au-nun apa akitimetpi leh, ju akham behseh jeh-in apan ima abollam ahephapoi. 34 Ajingin au-nun anaonu jah a, “Jan nilhah-in i-pa to kalumkhomtan, tujan jong ju donkhamsah hitin, nangin galuppin; chute leh i-pa to cha inei cheh lhon ding ahi, “ati. 35 Hijeh chun chuche janin jong apa ju adonkhamsah kit lhonin, acha neojo nun apa aluppin akitimatpi tai. Apa ju akham behseh jeh-in ima abollam ahephapoi. 36 Hiti hin Lot chanu ten in apaa konin nao avop gel lhontai. 37 Au-nun chapa khat ahingin amin Moab* asah-e. Moab hi tulai Moab mite penna pului anahi. 38 Anao nun jong chapa khat ahingin amin Benammin* asah-e. Ama hi tulaiya Ammon mite penna pului anahi.

Semtil 20

Abraham le Abimelech

1 Hichea kon hin Abrahamin Canaan lhanglam gam ajonsuh-in, Kadesh le Shur kikah a chengtai. Khonunga Gerar a achenlaiyin, 2 Abrahamin ajinu Sarah chu anao nun alep’in, hijeh chun Gerar lengpa Abimelech chun Sarah hi aji din anapui man’e. 3 Jan khat Abimelech mangin Pathen ahung kilah-in, “Nangin mi jisa hiche numei hi nakipui jeh a nathi tei tei ding ahi,” ati. 4 Abimelech vang chu Sarah koma analut kha loulai ahinai; hijeh chun aman, “Pakai, nangin themmona bei miho jong natha jeng ding ham? 5 Abraham jengin jong anaonua aseiya chule aman jong chutimaa asei ahi. Hijeh a chu lung thengsel’a kabol’a, thil dihmo kabol loulai ahi, “ati. 6 Amangin Abimelech chu Pathenin adonbut’in, “Adih-e, lung thengsel’a nabol ahi kahenai;hijeh achu kadoumah ten chonsetna chu bolsah louva, tugeiya hiche nu hi tongkha louva kakoi nahi. 7 Tun vang ama hi ajipa nungpeh tan. Hichepa khu Themgao ahin, aman nataopeh teng thi tapon nate. Nanungpeh lou vangle, kagih dim demsa nahi, nang jong namiten jong nathilo tei tei diu ahi,” ati. 8 Ajing jingkah matah-in Abimelech chun alhacha chengse akoukhomin thilsoh jouse abonchan aseipeh leh, akinlih leu jengui. 9 Hijeh chun Abimelech-in Abraham akouvin, “I-neilou ham? Ipi adih louva kabolpeh khah a kei le kalenggam chunga hitobang manthahna hi nahinpoh lut jeng ham? Eikibolna louhel ding khat’a neibol ahi. 10 Idinga hita chu neibol mong mong ham?” tin adongtai. 11 Abrahamin adonbut’in, “Hikoms Pathen tahsan mi aum dingla kagel loujeh a kajinu deichatnan eitha louvinte kati ahi. 12 Atah beh a jong ama hi kasopi ahinai. Kanu hin mong ahilou vangin kappa chanu ahin, jia kanei jeng ahibouve. 13 Hijeh a chu Pathenin kappa insung dalhaa gam choma eihinsoldoh a pat, ‘Nei ngailut phot chetnan mijouse henga nasopin neiseiyin’tia kahilsa mong jong anahi, “ati. 14 Abimelech-in Sarah chu Abraham anungpeh-in, kelngoi le gancha dang chule soh te jong apeh thai. 15 Abraham jah a, “Ven, namuphah chan hi kei gamsung ahi, nadei lai laiya chengin, “ati. 16 Sarah jah a Abimelech chun, “Ven, nasopipa dangka sang khat kapen, hiche hi nakoma um chengse mitmua jum ong huhna kapeh ahin, japi angsunga them nakichan ahitai,” ati. 17 Chuphat’in Abrahamin pathen henga ataopeh le, Abimelech le ajinu adamsah-in, soh numei ho geiyin adamsah-in amahon cha ahingtauve. 18 Ijeh-inem itile Abraham jinu Sarah jal’a abimelech insung numei jouse chu Pathenin chahingmoa anakoi ahi.

Semtil 21

Isaac Pen

1 Sarah chu ateppehsa bangin Pakaiyin phatthei ahungboh-in, 2 Abraham ateh nungin Sarah agaiyin chapa khat ahinpeh tai. Achapa chu Pathenin ateppeh dontah a chu hung peng ahi. 3 Abrahamin amin Isaac asah-in, 4 Pathen seibangin apenjou niget lhin nin Abrahamin achapa Isaac chu chep atanpeh-e. 5 Isaac pen chun Abraham kum jakhat alhingtai. 6 Sarah-in, “Pathenin eikipehsah a einuisah ahitan, ajapha chan nuiya eikipapi ding ahitai,” ati. 7 Aman, “Sarah hin cha le nao hinga nao noi chepsah dia koipenin Abraham anaseipeh ngam dem? Ahin la atehset nungin keiman Abraham chapa khat kahinpeh tai,” tin jong aseiye. 8 Isaac akhondoh a noichep aban phat’in Abrahamin naolop golvah loupi tah abol’e.

Hagar le Ishmael Abrahamin asolmang

9 Nikhat Egypt numei Hagar chapa Ishmael le Sarah chapa Isaac akichem lhon’e. 10 Akichep lhon aven Sarah-in Abraham jah a,” Sohnu le achapa hi solmang tan. Sohnu chapa hi kachapa Isaac chan ding nagou halcha jong chang theiponte,” ati. 11 Ishmael jong achapa ahijeh-in Abraham din Sarah thusei hi anommo lheh-e. 12 Ahin la Pathenin Abraham jah a, “Sohnu le chapa din lung gimdan. Sarah sei sei chu boltan, Isaac a kona nachilhah kisimjo ding ahibouve. 13 Nacha ahijeh chun sohnu chapa konin jong nam khat semdoh nange, “ati. 14 Jingpi tah-in Abraham athouvin changlhah alan, twipaiya twi akhumin Hagar apen, achapa akipohsaah-in asolmangtai. Hagar achen Beersheba gamthip laiya avah le lei. 15 Twipaiya twi adon jou lhon phat’in Hagarin Ishmael chu hampa nang noiya aleh lut’in, 16 meer jakhat jen gamlan ache paiyin, atouvin, “Kanao thi ding kave ngampoi!” ati. Hichepet tah chun anao chu ahung kaptai. 17 Nao kagin chu Pathenin ajan, Pathena kon Vantil’in Hagar jah a, “Hagar, i-bol’a lung gim nahim? Kicha hih-in, nao kagin chu Pathenin ajatai. 18 Chen lang nao khu gadomin, kipomin, lhembi loiyin, keiman ama chilhah akona nam lentah kasemdoh ding ahi,” ati. 19 Pathenin Hagar mit ahasah leh, aman twikul khat amudoh paiyin, achen savun twipai dimin twi agathal’in, nao chu themkhat adonsah tai. 20 Nao chu akhangtou touvin, Pathenin akivoppi jinge, Paran gamthip noi jenga apansan, sadel themtah ahin, 21 anun Egypt numei khat jin apuipehtai.

Abraham le Abimelech kinoptona

22 Hichelai hin Abimelech asepai lamkaipa phicol toh Abraham henga achen, “Nang hi natohna chan a Pathenin napanpi. 23 Khopema nahung chenna hiche gamsunga kei le kachate, kason kalhah chengse chunga hepina neiya naum’a, ken kabolna bang banga nabol’a neijou bol louhelna din Pathen maiya kitep masan,” ati. 24 Abrahamin, “Kakitep’e, “ati. 25 Twikhuh khat asohten alahpeh jeh-un Abimelech henga Abraham akiphin le, 26 Abimelech-in, “Twikhuh lahpeh a chu koipen hiuvam kahe hih beh-e. Seila neiseipeh pon, tua chu bou kajah ahi nalaiye,” ati. 27 Hichea hin Abrahamin kelngoi phabep le bongchal phabep Abimelech apen, kinoptona asemdoh lhontai. 28 Abrahamin akelngoi lah a konin kelngoi sagi agahoidoh leh, 29 Abimelech chun, “Idia nagahoi khen ham?” tin adonge. 30 Abrahamin, “Hiche twikhuh hi kei semsa ahi nanop phot chet nan hiche kelngoi sagi hi kilah-in,” ati. 31 Hikoma chu ama nin kitepna anasem lhonjeh a Beersheba kisah ahi. 32 Hitobang kihoutohna asem chai phat’un Abimelech le Phicol Philistine gama akilekit lhontai. 33 Beersheba muna chun Abrahamin chah thing khat aphut’in, Pakai tonsot Pathen henga ataove. 34 Philistine gamsunga sottah Abraham akhopem dentai.

Semtil 22

Isaac kilhaina aneidia Pathenin Abraham thu apeh

1 Phat chom khat nungin Pathenn Abraham apatep’in ajah a, “Abraham!” tin akouve. Aman, “Hikoma ka-um’e!” tin ahouve. 2 Pathenin, “Na-ngailut tah nachapa chang khat seh Isaac chu Moriah gama puiyin, kahinko peh ding molsang khatpen pen chunga pumgo thilto kilhai nan ganeitan,” ati. 3 Ajing jingpi tah-in Abraham athouvin, pugo thiltoa manchah din thing achomin sangan apohsah-in, alhacha mi nit oh Isaac apuiyun, Pathenin aseipehna mun jonin achetauve. 4 Nithumjen ajot nungun Abrahamin ajot nau mun chu gamla tah-in agah mupha bep nalaiye. 5 Lhachate ni jah a Abrahamin, kei le boipu hilampeh a khun gatao lhon ing ting, nahenguva hung kit lhon nange,” ati. 6 Pumgo thiltoa tiding thinglom chu Abrahamin Isaac aputsah-in, meicho na ding song meihol le chemcha aman achoiye. Achepet lhon hin 7 Isaac-in, “Hepa!” atileh; aman, “I-ham kanao?” ati. Isaac-in, “Hepa, meicho na ding song meihol le tiding thinglomla aumtan, kilhaina ding kelngoi hoiba ham?” ati. 8 Abrahamin, “Pathenin kelngoi hin ki-ngaito nante,” atin, akijotpai lhontai. 9 Pathenin akipehna mun alhun lhon phat’in, Abrahamin maicham khat asemin, maicham chunga thinglom agolchan akoiyin, Isaac akantumin, maicham chunga thinglom chunga chun alupsah-e. 10 Hichun chemcha asatdoh-in achapa tha din agotai. 11 Vana Pakaiya hungkon Vantil chun, “Abraham, Abraham!” tin ahinsamtai. Abrahamin, “Hikoma ka-um’e!” tin ahouve. 12 Vantil chun, “Chapang chu ima lodan, supop hih beh-in, Pathen nagin jeh a nachapa chang khatseh tha na dia jong khut kih louva napan kahetai,” ati. 13 Abraham akiheile leh, kelngoichal khat hampa nangtom lah a kit e nia kihen amudoh-in, agakailut’in achapa khel’in pumgo thilto kilhai nan aneitai. 14 Hichelai mun chu Abrahamin, “Pakaiyin thilto aki-ngaitona mun,” asah-in, hijeh chun tuni geiyin mihon, “Pakai molvuma aman thilto aki-ngaitona mun,” ati jingui. 15 Vana Pakaiya hungkon Vantil chun anivei nan Abraham ahinkou kit’in, 16 Pakai amatah kihahsel’a asei chu, “Neigin jeh a nachapa chang khatseh chunga jong khut kih louva napan hin kei kitep’ah kahitai. 17 Nangman phatthei kaboh a, nason nachilhah van a ahsite jat le Twikhanglen panga neldi jat hungpha ding, namelmate ahinjosoh hel diu ahi. 18 Kasei nanit jeh a nason nachilhah phatthei kaboh banga hi phatthei kaboh ding deiya chitin namtin kahenga hung tao diu ahi,” ati. 19 Alhachate ni henga Abraham ahung kile kit’in, Beersheba geiyin ahung kilhon’un, hikoma chun Abraham achengtai.

Nahor chilhah ho

20 Phat chom khat nungin Milcah-in asopipa Nahor chapa get jen ahinpeh thu mihon Abraham ahung seipeh tauve. 21 Nahor chate aping masapen pa Uz ahin, anaote chu Buz, Aram pa kemuel, 22 Chesed, Hazo, pildash, Jidlaph chule Bethuel- 23 Rebecca pa ahiuvin, abonchan Abraham sopipa Nahor chapate, Milcah hin chengse get ahiuve. 24 Nahor thaikem nu Reumah-in jong Tebah ke Gaham, Tahash le Maacah ahinge.

Semtil 23

Sarah thi, Abraham lhanmol choh

1 Sarah chu kum jakhat le som ni to sagi ahingin, 2 Canaan gamsung, Kir-iath-arba kiti, Hebron khoa athin, Abrahamin ajinu pul adouve. 3 Ajinu thilong phung dalhan Abraham achen Hit mite jah a, 4 “Keima maljin, nahenguva hung khopem kahin, kajinu long kavuina din gam leiset mun khat neichohsah-uvin,” agate. 5 Hit miten Abraham jah a, 6 “Ngaitemin kapu, kalah-uva nangma Pathen tun lamkai lentah hiya, kalhan semsau phapen khat’a khun najilong vui jengin; koi hijongle naji vuina din kipah tah-in lhan khat pejeng ung kate,” atiuve. 7 Hit mite masang tol’a Abraham abohkhup’in, 8 “Hikoma kaji neivuisah nomu ahinah leh, Zohar chapa Ephron henga khun, 9 aloupam chin a Machpelah songko khu neithumpeh-uvin. Hiche khu lhanmol’a kanei den din, nang ho maiya leiman lhingset’a eichohsahna din neiseipeh-uvin, “tin angeh-e. 10 Kelkot phung, mipi kikhopnaa hi Hit midang ho chutoh Ephron jong toukhom ahiuvin; mi jouse jah din ahindonbut’in, 11 “Kapu ngaitemin, lou pumpi le asunga songko pumin napenge. Najilong navuina din loumun le songko chu kamite angsung laitah a pejeng ing’e,” ati. 12 Ahivang in Hit mite angsunga Abraham akunin, 13 Ephron jah a chun mipi jah thei din, “Nei ngai themin ikhat dong inge. Loumun pumpin chotange, aman alhingin kilah-in, chule kajilong jong vui inge, “ati. 14 Ephronin Abraham jah a, 15 “Koi-ngaiyin kapu, dangka shekel ja li man bep leimun chu nang le kei kah a ipi tahpi ham? Najilong chu kivuina jengin,” ati. 16 Abraham anomin, Hit mite jah changtah a Ephronin aseidohsa dangka shekel ja li chu, kivei miho thiltena dungjuiyin atedoh peh tai. 17 Hitobanga hi Mamre niso lam Machpeleh mun a Ephron loumun le asunga songko lhan toh, loupam ching geiya keh, loulai thing jouse jong Abraham changkha ahitai. 18 Kikhopna hung pang Hit mi jousen jong loumun Abraham kipehdoh chu ahetpehsoh keiyui. 19 Canaan gamsung, chulai songko lhan sunga chun Abrahamin ajinu Sarah avuitai. 20 Hiti hin Hit mipa loumun le asunga songko pumin lhan din Abraham achan thatai.
