Potdoh 1

Egypt a Israelte kibol genthei

1 Egypt jon a Jacob to kilhon achate chu, ainsung cheh to lhon a che 2 Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, 3 Issachar, Zebulun, Benjamin, 4 Dan, Naphtali, Gad, chule Asher ahiuve. 5 Jacob inkonse se abonchauvin som sagi alhingui. Achapa Joseph vang Egypt lhungsa ahitai. 6 Phat chom khat nungin Joseph le asopite, chule hiche khanga mite chu athisoh taove; 7 hijongle achilhah-u Israelte chun cha le nao tampi ahingun, apung lheh jenguvin, Egypt gamsung dimset’in ahunei lhehtauve. 8 Egypt a Joseph phatna hephalou lengthah khat ahung laltai. 9 Amahin amite jah a, “Hiche Israelte hi atamval’un ahunei behseh jeh-un eiho din kihol lel aumtai. 10 Galbolna khat um kha le melmate ajop’uva eisat’uva pang thei, gamsunga kona jamdoh diu ahi. Apunbe be louna diuva alonaje khat het ding ahi,” ati. 11 Hijeh chun Egypt miten Israelte na hahsa tohsah a suhgepsit set din ahunguva toh vaipo akoiyun, lengpa thil kholna munpi din Pithom le Rameses khopi asah sah ui. 12 Ahivangin Egyptten Israelte ahabol hesoh cheh-ule ahapun cheh-un, akithejao cheh jengun, gamsung alobe be jengui. Hiti hin Egypt ten Israelte akicha tauvin, 13 gim genthei thoh-in natongin agoiyun, 14 ada acham louvin soh goiyin agoiyun, voujang nalouhel’in insa loubol’in agoiyuve. 15 Egypt lengpan Hebrew numeite naodoma pang numei ni Shiphrah le Puah akihoupin, 16 “Hebrew numei ho nao nadop teng, pasal cha cha that’in, numei ho hinghoi lhonin,” ati. 17 Ahinla naodom ten in Pathen agin lhon jeh-in lengpa thu anit lhonpoi, pasal ho geiyin ahinghoi lhontai. 18 Lengpan naodomte ni agakousah-in, “Idia kasei ngai louva Hebrewte cha pasal ho nathada lhon ham? tin adonge. 19 Naodomte nin, “Hebrew numei ho hi Egypt numeiho tobang ahipouve, anaopen’u abaiyin, khatjoh sang kalhun masang lhonle aping lhaji tauve,” ati lhon’e. 20 Pathenin naodomte ni akhoton, Israelte apunbe be jengun, ahat lheh tauve. 21 Naodomte nin Pathen agin lhonjeh-in Pathenin ainsung lhon phattheina apei. 22 Akhonnan Pharaoh-in amite jah a, “Hebrewte cha naosen pasal peng jouse man khom’un Nile luidunga sep lut’un, naosen numei ho vang hung hoi peh-un,” tin thu apei.

Potdoh 2

Mose pen

1 Hiche lai hin Levi pasal khat’in Levi chanu khatma akichenpi. 2 Ajinu hin cha pasal khat aneiyin, mel-hoi tah ahijeh-in ait behseh-in lha thum jen aseltai. 3 Asel lel hel phat’in, pumping nanga kisa pocha khat’a naosen chu akoiyin, twi lut thei louna din gom aloiyin, luipang pumping lah a chun akitolsah tai. 4 Naosen u-nun gal’a pangin ave vei. 5 Lengpa chanu luidunga kisil din ahungin, vapanga achele len, pumping lah a pocha amudoh phat’in, nu-ngah khat agalahsah-e. 6 Lengpa chanun pocha ahondoh le naosen pasal hoitah chu amun, ahung ka phat’in avoujang anan, “Hebrewte cha hitei ding ahi,” ati. 7 Hichun naosen u-nun lengpa chanu jah a, “Naosen hi navahpeh dia Hebrew numei ho khat kagakoupeh ding ham?” ati. 8 Aman jong, “Neigakoupeh nget-o,” ati. Naosen u-nun anu ma ma chu agakoutai. 9 Hichenu jah a chun lengpa chanun, “Naosen hi neivah peh-in, nachol man penange,” ati. Aman jong akilah-in avah-in apangtai. 10 Naosen chu akikhan lhit phat’in lengpa chanu henga apuile, aman chapan akisimtai. Lengpa chanun, “Twi lah a kalahdoh jeh-in amin Moses ah ing’e,” ati.

Mose Midian gam a ajamlut

11 Mose akhanlhit phat’a amite vea ache le, gim hesoh thoh a na hahsa atoh-u agamui. Egypt mi khat hin Hebrew mi khat atha geiyin agamudoh-in, athapa chu Mose insung mite khat ahikhai. 12 Mose’n jet le vei, sah le lhang avegol’in, koima amu lou phat’in Egypt mipa chu athah’in nellei lah a avuilut tai. 13 Ajinga ache kit le Hebrew mi ni kina kibon agatoh khai. Athemmo jep pa jah a chun Mose’n, “I-bol’a na-Hebrew mi hipi chu navoh ham?” tin aphoh-e. 14 Aman ahin donbut’in, “Kon nang vaipo le thutan a natun em? Egypt mipa natha banga tha neigot ham?” ati. Hichun Mose jong akichan, “Kamitha hi mihon ahetdoh ahitai,” ati. 15 Pharoah-in ajahdoh phat’in Mose chu tha din aholtai. Mose ajamin Midian gamsugna cheng din achetai. Nikhat Mose chu twikul panga atoupet’in 16 Midian Thempupa Jethro chanu sagi jen chu apa kelngoite le kelcha te don ding twi thal’in ahungui. 17 Ahin kelngoiching midang phabep’in Jethro Chanute chu anodoh-un, hichea hin Mose’in akithopin, nu-ngahho ganchate chu twi achipsahsoh keiye. 18 Nu-ngah ho apa henga ahung lhun phat’un, apauvin, “I-atile tunia matah a hung nahiuvam?” tin anadonge. 19 Nu-ngahhon jong, “Egypt mi pasal khat’in kelngoi chingho eideljam peh-un, ganchate don ding twi geiyin eithalpeh-un ahi,” atiuve. 20 Apauvin, “Hoiya umtam? I-bol’a nahin dalhah-u ham? Gakouvun an beh nekho’u hite,” ati. 21 Mose chengden din akigon, Jethron jong achanu Zipporah to akichensah-in, 22 Zipporah hin chapa khat ahinpeh-e, . Mose’n jong, “Hiche gam a khopem kahin, amin Gershom kiti ding ahi,” ati. 23 Kum phabep nungin Egypt lengpa athitan, ahivangin Israelte sohchang hesoh genthei thoh-in, panpi ngaichan apeng peng jengui. Aka apen’u Pathen kom alhungin, 24 Pathenin Abraham, Issac chule Jacob to akitepna chu ageldoh-e. 25 Pathenin Israelte sohchan, gim hesoh thoh amun athoh lel pi.

Potdoh 3

Pathenin Mose akou

1 Nikhat Mose’n anupa pa Jethro, Midian Thempupa, kelngoite le kelchate chingin, gancha honte hoiyin, lhang theng, Sinai molsang aphatai. 2 Sinai molsanga Pakaiya kon valtil chu hamboh lah a meikouvin ahung kilah-in, hamboh meiya kouva, kavam thei louva um chu Mose’n amui. 3 Aman jong, “Akidang nah-e! Iti hamboh khu kavampai lou ham? gave tem’inge,” ati. 4 Mose’n anailut Pakaiyin amu phat’in, hamboh lah a kon chun “Mose! Mose!” tin ahinkouve. Mosen’n, “Hoi, ka-um nai,” ati. 5 Pathenin, “Hin nailutbe tahih-in. Nakengchot kisut’in, munthenga ding nahitai. 6 Kei hi napu napate-Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob Pathen kahi,” ati. Pathen avet ngam lou phat’in Mose’n amai akitomtai. 7 Hichun Pakaiyin, “Egypt gamsunga kamite engse tah a abol’u kamun, tohvai pote bolsetnaa kon huhdoh ngaicha akau kajatai. Ahesoh genthei nao kahesoh tai. 8 Hijeh a chu Egypt mite khut’a kona amaho huhdoh dia hung kumlha kahin, mun lentah, gam phatah, Canaan mite le Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite chule Jebus mite chenna gamsunga puilut ding kagot ahi. 9 Kamite ka le pen kaja mong mongin, Egypt miten abol hesoh nau kamudoh tai. 10 Agamsunga kona kamite puidoh dia Egypt lengpa koma kasol nahi,” ati. 11 Ahinla Mose’n Pathen kom a, “Kei bep hi iti Egypt lengpa koma chea Israelte kagapuidoh thei ding ham?” ati. 12 Ahivangin Pathenin, “Ken nalhonpi nange, Egypt a kona Israelte nahinpuidoh teng hiche molsang chunga hi neihou diu, hichu kei sol nahi phat chetna hi ding ahi,” ati. 13 Ahinla Mose’n adonbut’in, “Israelte henga cheng ting ‘Napu napateu Pathenin eihinsol ahi,’ gati jong leng, ‘Ama chu amin ipi ham?’ tin eina dongun tin, chuting ipi kaseipeh thei diing ham?” ati. 14 Pathenin, “Kei chu Kei kahijingin, naseipeh tei ding chu-‘KEIMA kiti chun nahenguva eihinsol ahi’ nati ding ahi, 15 Israelte jah a apu apateu Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Jacob Pathen chun ahenguva nasol’a naseipeh ding ahi. Hiche hi tonsot’a kamin ahin, khang nu-nunga miten hiche a hi eikou diu ahi. 16 Israel lamkaite gakoukhomin lang, apu apateu Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen chule Jacob Pathen chu nahenguva hung kilah a anseipeh ding ahi. Egypt miten abolsetnau kamu jeh a avil’uva hung kahi hi seipeh-in. 17 Egypt’a kona puidoh kagot ahitai, gim genthei thoh a aum nauva kona puidoh a gam phatah-Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite chule Jebus mite gamsunga puilut ding kagot ahi. 18 “Naseipeh chan chu kamiten angai diu ahi. Chuteng Israel lamkaite to Egypt lengpa henga nacheuva, ‘Pakai Hebrew te Pathen kahenguva ahung kilah-in, hiche Pakai ka-Pathenu koma chu kilhaina kabolna diuvin nithum sung din gamthip’a neisol’un,’ nati diu ahi. 19 Ada achamlouva akibol ngal loule Egypt lengpan nalhadoh lou diu kahenai. 20 Hijongle agama chu tijat um thil datmoa, katha hangsan a Egypt mite talen kamatsah ding ahi. Chuteng Egypt lengpan nalhadoh diu ahi. 21 “Egypt mite naginsah ungting, kamite akitoldoh tengu, khutgoh keova nalhadoh lou diu ahi. 22 Israel numei jousen achenpi le aheng akom Egypt numeiho koma nihchen ponsil le sana dangka, sanajem athum diu ahi. Athumdoh chengu chu Israelten achateu numei pasal jouse jepna aneiyuva, Egypt gamsung nei le gou apoh mang diu ahi,” ati.

Potdoh 4

Pathenin Mose thahat kidang apeh

1 Mose’n Pakai adonbut’in, “Israelten eitahsan dau hen kasei ngai hih leu, chule nang chu kahenga hung kilah louvin sei taleu ikati ding ham?” ati. 2 Hichea hin Pakaiyin, “Nachoi chu ipi ham?” ati. Mose’n “Kakiphu tenggol ahi,” ati. 3 Pakaiyin, “Tol’a seplha temin,” atile; Mose’n ase lhah lhah chun gul asoh paiyin, Mose’n ajamsan tai. 4 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Bungin lang ameiyin kimat temin,” atile; Mose jong bunga akimat le, kiphu thei tenggol asoh kittai. 5 Pakaiyin, “Pakai apu apateu Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isacc Pathen chule Jacob Pathen nahenga hung kilah phot chetna dia hiche hi Israelte koma nabol ding ahi,” ati. 6 Pakaiyin Mose jah a asei kit’in, “Napon noiya nakhut koilut’in,” ati leh; Mose’n akoiyin, agah lah doh chun akhut josue anaphah-in, buhbang banin anabangtai. 7 Pakaiyin, “Napon noiya nakhut koilut kit’in,” atin, Mose’n jong akoiyin, agah lah doh phat’in anadamsel’in ati dang bang bang ahitai. 8 Pakaiyin, “Israelten thil kidang mai maiya natahsan dauva alung nachim louvu jongle, hiche geiya vang lung nachim tei diu ahi. 9 Hiche thil kidang te ni geiya jong natahsan dauva nasei angai dau le, Nile vadung twi phabep thaldoh-in tol’a sung lhan. Twi chu thisan soh jeng ding ahi,” ati. 10 Ahivangin Mose’n, “Ahipoi, Pakai neisol da tan. Thusei them la kahipon, neikihoupia jong hi kam kipeh lou kahi neihet hi-me. Mi paomo, pao gang thei lou, ngongkai chet chot kahi,” ati. 11 Pakaiyin ajah a, “Mihem kam sempeh koi hiya, na ngong le paomoa koiya koi ham? Kho musah le mit chotsah thei loi ham? Kei-Pakai hi kahi. 12 Tun che jengin! Thusei kithoping ting, nasei ding hil nange,” ati. 13 Ahivangin Mose’n, “Ahipoi Pakai, midang khat soljo tan,” ati. 14 Hiche hin Pakaiyin Mose alhunghan khumin, “Nasopipa, Levi chilhah Aaron chula em? Athusei themla kahenan. Nakimupi dia hungtah bah a khu, nakimupi teng kipah lheh veh ta. 15 Sei ding jouse nahil masah thei ahi. Sei ding kithpi lhon ing ting, nasei lhon ding hil nange. 16 Nakam sanga panga, nathalhenga mipi akihoupi ding ahi. Nangin Pathen banga asei ding chan nahil ding ahi. 17 Kiphuthei tenggol kichoiyin, hichea hin melchihna kidang nabol ding ahi,” ati.

Mose Egypt’a akile kit

18 Mose, anupa pa Jethro henga agache masan ajah a, “Egypt’a ka inkote dam le bit a um nauvem, gavil kit tange, neisolin,” agate. Jethron jong pha asan, lung lhaisel’in asoltai. 19 Mose chu Midian gamsunga asum nalaiyin, Pakaiyin ajah a, “Than ago jouse athisoh tai, Egypt a kile kit tan,” ati. 20 Mose’n ajinu le achapate sanga chunga atousah-in, Egypt jonin akitolpin, Pathenin ahil bangin kiphu thei tenggol chu akichoiye. 21 Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseikit’in, “Egypt gam nalejot kit ahitan, Egypt lengpa angasunga, boltheina tha kapeh banga, thil kidang chengse chu nabol tei tei ding ahi. Hijongle lengpa lung katahsa a, mipi alhadoh louhel ding ahi. 22 Chuteng kei Pakai thusei hi naseipeh a, ‘Israel hi kachapa masapen ahi. 23 Kachapa nalhadoh dia kasei ahi. Eihou dia kasol ahin, nalha doh poi. Hijeh a chu nachapa masapen khatha peh ding nahi,’ tin aseiye, tia nahil ding ahi,” ati. 24 Lampia gebuh khat’a Pakaiyin Mose akimupin tha din agotai. 25 Mose jinu Zipporah chun songhemkhat’in achapa chep atanin, Mose kengphanga aloiyin, “Cheptan chonchan dungjuiya jia kanei nahi,” ati. 26 Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Mose ahing hoiye. 27 Pakaiyin Aaron jah a, “Gamchang noiya Mose gakimupin,” tin asol’e. Aaron jong Mose kimupi din molsang theng lama achei; akimupi phat’in achop chuh chuh jengin ahi. 28 Hichun Mose’n Egypt gama kile kit dia Pakaiyin asol’a aseipeh chengse abonchan aseipehson tai; thil kidang bolsah dia ahil chengse jong aseitai. 29 Mose le Aaron chu Egypt’a ache lhonin, Israel lamkai jouse akhom lhontai. 30 Mose jah a Pakai thusei chengse Aaronin Israel lamkaite aseipeh-in, mipi angsung laitah a Mose’n thil kidang chengse chu abolsoh keiye. 31 Israelten atahsan’un, min engse tah a abolset nau amu jal’a avil’uva Pakai hung ahi ajah doh phat’un boh khup’in chibai aboh tauve.

Potdoh 5

Egypt lengpa angsunga Mose le Aaron

1 Mose le Aaron Egypt lengpa koma achen, “Pakai Israel Pathenin, ‘Gamchang noiya kut bola eihou theina diuvin kamite sol’in’ tin aseiye,” agate lhone. 2 Egypt lengpan, “Pakai kitipa chu koi hiya, athu kangaiya, Israelte kasoldoh ding ham? Pakai la kahepon, Israelte la soldoh ponge,” tin aseitai. 3 Mose le Aaronin adonbut’in, “Hebrewte Pathen chu kahenguva ahung kilahtai. Nithum lampi peh a Pakai ka-Pathenu gahouva, kilhaina kabolna diuvin neisolun. Kabol louvule natset ham, gal ham khat jo sanga eithagam diu ahi,” ati lhone. 4 Egypt lengpan Mose le Aaron jah a, “Mipin tohban iti ngah hen nati lhon ham? Soh ho khu na tohsahkit’un! 5 Nangho Egyptte sanga jong natamjoh tah-u khu! Aban jop’a na tohda nagot’u ahi-ong!” ati. 6 Hiche nikho chun Egypt lengpan sohte chunga tohvai pote le Israel lah a toh lamkai ho thu apen, 7 “Mipi hi cheh a sem ding changpol peh dauvin, amaho gakiholsah-uvin. 8 Chuti jongle changpol napeh pet’uva asemdoh-u cheh sanga khat cha jong lhasam deh louhel ding ahi. Toh ding aneilou phat’uva potdoh a a-Pathenu houva kilhai dinga kahenga tao tao ahiuve! 9 Na hatohsah-un, ong manlouvin lhauvin, chutile thujou kisei hoihi ngai manlouvin umtauvinte,” ati. 10 Sohte chunga tohvai pote le Israelte toh lamkaite acheuvin Israelte jah a, “Lengpan changpol napeh lou diuvin aseitai. 11 Namu thei thei nauva changpol nahol thu’uva, ahivanga niseh a nasemdoh jat’u chu lhasem thei louhel ding ahi,” atiuve. 12 Hichea hin mipi changpol holin Egypt gamsunga akithe chansoh jengui. 13 Sohte chunga tohvai poten changpol apeh laiyuva asemdoh jat’us cheh asemdoh theina diuvin ada acham louvin ano no jengui. 14 Egypt mi, sohte chunga tohvai poten Israelte toh lamkai ho chu adeng deng jengui. “I-bol’a masanga nasemdoh jat jat cheh semdoh jou louva um nahiuvem?” atiuve. 15 Israel toh lamkaite Egypt lengpa koma acheuvin, “Vo lengpa, idia hita neibol jengu hitam? 16 Changpol la eipetapouvin, cheh kasemdoh jat jat’u semdohsah eigouve! Tun eivo vo jengun, hiche hi nang thusah mong ahibouve,” atiuve. 17 Egypt lengpan adonbut’in, “Thasea natohda jal’a Pakai henga kilhaina boldia kilepdoh dia kahenga kithum thum nahiuve. 18 Na gatong loiyun! Changpol nakipe lou diu, ahivanga cheh nasemdoh jat jat lha louva nasemdoh diu ahi,” ati. 19 Israelte toh lamkaiten cheh asemdoh jat jat asemdoh diuva aseipeh phat’un abolset nom mong mongu ahedoh tauve. 20 Lengpa adalhah phat’un, amaho ngah jinga ana-um Mose le Aaron to akimutouve. 21 Mose le Aaron jah a, “Nathilbol lhon Pakaiyin amusoh tai, lengpa le avaitpote neihotsah jeh-uva Pakaiyin talen namatsah lhon ding ahi. Pansatna neiya eitha lo na diu nabol doh lhon ahitai,” atiuve.

Pakai koma Mose kiphin

22 Pakai lam ngan Mose akiphinin, “Pakai, idia namite nabolset ham? Ipi bol dia neisol ham? 23 Namina Lengpa henga thuseiya kache chea pat, Israelte engse sen aboltai. Nangin imacha kithopi din nagopon!” ati.

Potdoh 6

1 Hichun Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Lengpa khu i-kalom, hinmu nan nate. Tahbeh a kasei ahi-Israelte khu Egypt a kona adeldoh tho dingjoh ahibouve,” ati.

Pathenin Mose akou

2 Pathenin Mose jah a aseiyin, “Kei hi Pakai chu kahi. 3 Abraham le Isaac chule Jacob henga Hatchungnung Pathenin kakilah-in, ahivangin kamintheng, Pakai hin kakihetsah hih laiye. 4 Amaho to kitepna kaneiyin, akhopem nau gam, Canaan gamsung khu peh din kakitep’e. 5 Tun Egyptten soh a avul, Israelte ka le mao ogin kajan, kakitepna kageldoh tai. 6 Hijeh chun Israelte dia kasei hi ajah-uva seipeh-in, ‘Kei hi Pakai chu kahi, nasohchan nau Egyptte khut’a nahuhdoh ung ting kajalen sah ding nahiuve. Kaban-gol jeng ting Egyptte talen kamatsah a, nang ho kahuhdoh diu ahi. 7 Kamiten nasem ung ting, na-Pathenu kahi ding; Egypt gam sohchanna muna kona kalhadoh tengu, Pakai na-Pathen kahi hetauvin nate. 8 Abraham le Isaac chule Jacob koma giltah a kakitep’a, peh dia kakoisa gamsung kalhut diu, leiset gou dia kapeh ding nahiuve. Kei hi Pakai chu kahi,’ tin aseiye, tin,” ati. 9 Hiche hi Mose’n Israelte aseipeh-in, ahivangin angaipouve, sohchan hesoh valjeh-in lhung lhalhop’in aum gamtauve. 10 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, 11 “Chen lang Egypt lengpan Israelte khu agamsunga kona asoldoh tei tei din gaseiyin,” ati. 12 Ahinla Mose’n adonbut’in, “Israelte bon kathu ngailou, lengpan kathu iti angai ding ham? Mi paomo kei tobang hi!” ati. 13 Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron thu apen, “Israelte leh Egypt lengpa jah a chun anng hi Egypt’a kona Israelte puidoh dia kasol ahi seipeh lhonin,” ati.

Mose leh Aaron insung mite

14 Jacob chapa masa pen Ruebenin chapa li aneiyin-Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, chule Carmi ahiuvin; Reuben chilhah phungkhaiya upa cheh ahiuve. 15 Simeonin chapa gup ahingin, Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar chule Canaan mi numeito ahin lhon-Shaul ahiuvin, Simeon phungkhaiya upa cheh ahiuve. 16 Levin chapa thum ahingin, Gershon, Kohath chule Merari ahiuvin; Levi phungkhaiya upa cheh ahiuve. Levi hi kum jakhat le somthum le sagi ahinge. 17 Gershon hin chapa ni ahingin, son le pah tampi anei lhone. 18 Kohath hin chapa li ahingin, Amaram, Izhar, Hebron chule Uzziel ahiuvin, Kohath hi kum jakhat le somthum le thum ahinge. 19 Mararin chapa ni ahingin, Mahli le Mushi ah. Hiche hi phung khai khaiya kisim Levi chilhah ahiuvin, achilhah chengu to ahi. 20 Amaram hin apa sopinu Jochebed akichenpin Aaron leh Mose ahinge. Amram kum jakhat le somthum le sagi ahinge. 21 Izhar hin chapa thum ahingin, Korah le Nepheg chule Zichri ahiuve. 22 Uzziel’sin chapa thum ahingin, Michael, Ezaphan chule Sithri ahiuve. 23 Aaronin Amminadab chanu, Nahshon sopinu, Elisheba akichenpin, Nadab le Abihu, Eleazar chule Ithamar ahinge. 24 Korah in chapa thum ahingin, Assir, Elkanah chuleAbiasaph ahiuve; Korah phungkhai sung kihom khenna a amaho hi phung upa cheh ahiuve. 25 Aaron chapa, Eleazar chun Putiel chanu akichenpin, Phinehas ahinge. Hichengse hi Levi phunga ama ama insung dola phungkhai upa cheh ahiuve. 26 Pakaiyin, “Egypt’a konin Israelte puidoh lhonin,” tia asol teni chu Mose le Aaron ahi lhone. 27 Mose le Aaron hin Egypt lengpa chu Israelte lhadoh dinga asollhon ahi.

Mose le Aaron dia Pakai thupeh

28 Egypt gama Pakaiyin Mose jah a thu asei chun, 29 “Kei hi Pakai chu kahi. Kasei jong Egypt lengpa seipeh-in,” ati. 30 Ahinla Mose’n adonbut’in, “Kei mi paomo kahi nahet chume, lengpan iti kathu angai ding ham?” ati.

Potdoh 7

1 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Lengpa koma chu Pathen tobang kahisah a, nasopipa Aaronin lengpa koma nathemgao tobanga thu asei ding ahi. 2 Kaseipeh chengse hi Aaron hilsoh keiyin, aman lengpa chu agamsunga kona Israelte asoldohna din seipeh nante. 3 Amavang lengpa lung kasuhtah ding ahin, Egypt gamsunga itobang tijat um thil kidang bolkhum jong leng nathu ngaiponte. 4 Chuteng Egypt gamsunga talen gihsa tah chuhsah ing ting, agamsunga kona kamite kapuidoh ding ahi. 5 Kaban-gol kajet’a agamsunguva kona Israelte kapuidoh teng, Egypt ten Pakai kahin hedoh tauvinte,” ati. 6 Msoe le Aaronin Pakai thupeh peh chu abol lhon nai. 7 Lengpa koma thu aseilai lhonin Mose kum som get alhing tan, Aaron kum som get le thum alhingtai.

Aaron tenggol

8 Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron jah a, 9 “Nathanneina lhon phot chetna dia Pharaoh-in thil kidang nabolsah got lhon le, Aaron chu atenggol lengpa angsunga selhah sah in, gul hungsoh ding ahi,” ati. 10 Pakai thupeh bangin Mose le Aaron lengpa koma chen agabol lhontai. Lengpa le avaipote angsunga Aaronin tenggol aseplhan, gul ahungsoh tai. 11 Lengpan jong miching mithemte, mitpheldoi them ho akouvin, amahon jong hitobangma chu abol theiyui. 12 Atenggol’u aselhah-ule, gul asohgamtai. Ahivangin Aaron tenggol gul chun amahoa avallhum soh keiye. 13 Ahivangin Pakai sei bangin, lengpa alungtah den nalaiyin, Mose le Aaron sei angai deh poi. 14 Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseiyin, “Lengpa alungtah cheh in, Israelte sohdoh ding adai. 15 Jingkah teng Nile vadung ajotsuh phat le gakimupin, gul soh theiji tenggol chu choiyin, luipanga ana ngah-in. 16 Ahung teng ajah a, ‘Pakai, Hebrewte Pathenin amite nalhadoh a, gamchang noiya Ama agahouna diuva seipeh dia eihinsol ahi. Ahivangin tu geiyin kasei nangaipoi. 17 Vo lengpa, tua hi Pakai chu itobang ahi athilbol’a nahetdoh ding ahi. Ven hiche tenggola hi luidung twi jouse thisan soh ding ahitai. 18 Nga jouse thisoh a, twi jouse names ding, Egypte miten adon thei louhel ding ahi,’ tin gasei peh tan,” ati. 19 Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseiyin, “Aaronin hiche tenggol chu luidung jouse le twilam jouse, Egypte gamsunga twikul jouse chunga adop sang din seipeh-in. Twi jouse thisan soh ding, gamsung pumpi thisan soh a, thinghom dungle songko dung geiya thisan veisoh ding ahi,” ati. 20 Mose leh Aaronin Pakai thupeh bangin abol lhontai. Lengpa le avaipote angsung tah a Aaronin tenggol alamin, luidung twi ajep le twi josue thisan asoh gamtai. 21 Nga jouse athigamin, Egypt miten adon thei tapouve. Egypt gamsung thisan adimsoh jenge. 22 Egypt lengpa mitpheldoi themten jong chutobangma abol thei thouvun, lengpa jong angai bep’in alung tah cheh-in, Pakai seisa bangin Mose le Aaron thu angai deh poi. 23 Lunghei tah sangin leng inpi akijot’in, thilsoh ho chu nahsah in jong aneipoi. 24 Luidung twi adon thei lou phat’un Egypt miten luipang dung twichim holnan alhaiyun don ding ahol’ui. 25 Pakaiyin Nile vadung asuh nehna ni sagi alhing tai.

Potdoh 8

Egypt gamsunga thoh hahsa

1 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Egypt lengpa koma chen, Pakaiyin hintin aseiyin, ‘Eihou theina diuvin kamite sultan, 2 nada le nagamsung dimset’a uphoh kalha ding ahi. 3 Nile luidung uphoh dimset’a, na-leng inpi geiya hung kitol lut diu, nalupna indan, najalkhun, navaipote in jouse, namite in dung, nathuh phung le nakhangbel sung geiya dimset diu ahi. 4 Nang chung, navaipote chung le namite chung geiya hung chomdoh diu ahi,’ ati, tin gaseitan,” ati. 5 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Aaronin luidung jouse le twilam dung, twikul dung tenggol ajap a, Egypt gamsung dimset’a uphoh hungdoh din bolsah in,” ati. 6 Hiti chun Aaronin twi umna jouse tenggol ajapkhum jengle, uphohte ahungdoh-un gamsung adimset tauve. 7 Mitpheldoi themten jong chutiman abolun, gamsung uphoh adimsettai. 8 Egypt lengpan Mose le Aaron akouvin, “Uphohte asuh gamna din Pakaiya neitaopeh lhonin, Pakaiya kilhaina abol theina diuvin namite lhon solpeh tange,” ati. 9 Mose’n adonbut’in, “Kipah tah in taopeh nange, nang le navaipte, namite itih teng kataopeh ding phat chubou neiseipeh lhonin, chuting u-phoh ten dalhan natin, Nile luidung tilouva khatcha jong um taponte,” ati. 10 Egypt lengpan, “Jing teng neitaopeh-in,” ati. Mose’n, “Nasei bangin taopeh nange, chuting Pakai ka-Pathenu tobang pathen dang umlou hedoh tan nate. 11 Nang, navaipoho, chule namite u-phohten dalhauvin tin, Nile luidung tilouva u-phoh khat cha jong um lou ding ahi,” ati. 12 Mose le Aaronin lengpa adalha lhonin, lengpa chunga alonvuh sah u u-phoh te sumang din Pakaiya Mose atao tai. 13 Mose ngeh bang bangin Pakaiyin abol’in, in dung le thupi tanna in dung chule loujao dunga u-phohte athitam tauve. 14 Egypt miten u-phoh ho chu alhuh lhuh in aseuvin, gamsung khangngam leuvin alhauve. 15 U-phohte gamsoh amu phat’in lengpa angaiyin alungtah kit’in Pakaiyin asei bangin aumtai, Mose le Aaron thusei jong angaideh tapoi. 16 Pakaiyin Mosel jah a, “Aaron khu atenggol’in tol jepsah le chun, Egypt gamsung leivui jouse thousi vaibong soh diu ahi,” ati. 17 Hijeh chun Aaronin tenggol’in tol ajep le, Egypt gamsung leivui jouse thousi vaibong asoh-in, mipi le gancha jouse atomjol soh keiyui. 18 Mitpheldoi themten thousi vaibong sosah agot vangun abol thei tapouve. Muntin thousi vaibong adimsoh tai. 19 Chule mitpheldoi them hon lengpa jah a, “Hiche hi Pathen bol mong mong ahibouve,” atiuve. Ahivangin Pakai seisa bangin lengpa alungtah jingin, Mose le Aaron sei angai dehpoi.

Thoulhe ho

20 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Jingkah jingpi tah a lengpa luidunga ache teng gakimupin, ajah a Pakaiyin, ‘Eihou theina diuvin kamite sultan. 21 Kagih masah dim dem nahi-thu na-ngailou le nangle navaipote chule namite ka-engbol ding ahi. Egypt mite insung thoulhe dimset ding, toldung jouse dimsoh diu ahi. 22 Kamite chenna Goshen gamsung vang tongkha ponge, thoulhe khat cha lengle ponte, chuting Kei Pakai hi hiche gamsunga natong thilbol kahi hedoh tan nate. 23 Kamite le namite kah a lamdanga kabol’a hitobang thil kidang hi jing teng hungsoh ding ahi,’ tin aseiye gatin,” ati. 24 Pakaiyin thoulhe ahon honin leng inpi sungle avaipote insung dimset set’in alhalut tai. Egypt gamsung pumpi thoulhe dimset’in gamsung in amanlo tai. 25 Chuphat’in lengpan Mose le Aaron akouvin, “Cheuvin lang hiche Egypt gamsunga hin na-Pathen kom’uva gakilhai tauvin,” ati. 26 Mose’n, “Dih ponte, Pakai ka-Pathenu houna katha diu gancha ho chu Egypt miten alunghanlo diu ahi. Hiche ganchate hi Egypt miten amu phahna diuva that ung lunghanlo taleu, songa eise lih jeng diu ahi. 27 Ethupeh bang banguva nithum lam kajot’uva, gamchang noiya Pakai ka-Pathenu koma kilhai ding kahibouvui,” ati. 28 Egypt lengpan, “Nache gamlat behseh lou pouvule gamchang noiya Pakai na-Pathenu koma kilhai din sol nauvinge, neitaopeh pou pouvin,” tin angeh tai. 29 Mose’in, “Kapotdoh doh le Pakaiya taoving ting, jing teng nangle navaipote, chule namite thoulhe hon dalha taovin nate, amavang neilhep kit lou diu, Pakaiya kilhai dia mipi nasuh tang lou ding ahi,” ati. 30 Lengpa dalhan Mose Pakaiya ataovin, 31 chule Mose ngeh bangin Pakaiyin aboltai. Thoulhe ten lengpa le avaipote chule amite adalhan, khatcha jong aumtapoi. 32 Hichan gei jong hin lengpa alungtah nalaiyin, mipi soldoh deh louvin aum nalaiye.

Potdoh 9

Gancha pul

1 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Egypt lengpa koma chen Pakai, Hebrewte Pathenin, ‘Eihou din kamite soldoh-in. 2 Nasolda leh, 3 ka-engbol’a naganchate –sakolte le sa-ngan ho, sa-ngongsang ho le bong jouse, kelngoite, chule kelcha ho pul kalha khum ding ahi. 4 Israelte gancha ho le Egyptte gancha ho kasekhen a, Israelte gancha khatcha jong thi lou diu ahi. 5 Kei-Pakaiyin jing teng hiche hi abol kagot ahitai,’ tin aseiye gatin,” ati. 6 Ajingin Pakaiyin asei bangin aboltan, Egyptte gancha ho athigamin, Israelte a vang khat cha athipoi. 7 Lengpan thilsoh umchan adongtoh-in, Israelte gancha khatcha thilou aseipeh tauve. Ahivangin alungtah nalaiyin Israelte asoldehpoi.

Uilut lan

8 Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron jah a, “Thuh phunga vutvam khut dim khattou gaham lhonin, Mose’n lengpa angsunga vanlam ngan thethang hen. 9 Egypt gamsunga leivui khu banga leu ding, muntina uilut jangtea panga, mihem le gancha pomchet chut a alha ding ahi,” ati. 10 Mose le Aaronin vutvam phabep ahamdoh lhonin, lengpa angsunga adingin, Mose’n chunglama athe thangle, uilutjang asoh-in, mihem le ganchate pomchet chut in alhaitai. 11 Mitpheldoi themho geiyin, Egypt mite dang banga uilut avei jeh-in, Mose masanga ahung thei tapouve. 12 Ahivangin Pakaiyin lengpa lungthim atahsah-in, aseisa bangin lengpan Mose le Aaron sei angaidehpoi.

Gellen lhah

13 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Jingpi tah le lengpa kimupin, Pakai Hebrewte Pathenin, ‘Eihou din kamite sultan. 14 Tua vang navaipote le namite keo ka-engbol lou ding, vannoiya Kei tobang pathen umlou nahetna dia nang geiya ka-engbol ding nahi. 15 Nangle namite natset lhunkumsah dia khut kalapsa hile, nathigam diu ahitai. 16 Kathahat vetsahna, vannoi pumpi kaminthanna dia kahinsah nah lai nahi. 17 Hichan hin nahoithon, kamite soldoh ding nadai. 18 Jing teng tuphat don le, Egypt miten ahet khah louhellai, huise kalansah a, gellen kalhahsa ding ahi. 19 Tun ganhing jouse le tollhanga um thil jouse lim a kilhoh lutsoh loiyin. Tollhanga um ganchate le mihem ho gellenin aselih soh ding ahi,’ tin aseiye gatin,” ati. 20 Pakai thusei chu lengpa vaipote phabep’in akichan, asohteu le ganchaho in lima ahoilut’uve. 21 Adanghon Pakai migihna chu nahsah louvin, asohteu le gancha ho tollhanga amoh lhauve. 22 Hichun Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Vanlam sangin, Egypt gam pumpia gellen hung lha ding-mihem le gancha chule loulai muchi jouse avoh lih ding ahi,” ati. 23 Mose’n tenggol’a vanlam ako le, Pakaiyin van athingin, gel alhahsah-in, tollhang dung keh-in aseptai. Pakaiyin, 24 huise hattah le gellen alhahsah-in, kol phelah lah jengin alhahsah-in, kol aphelah lah jengin ahi. Hitobang huise lang hi Egypt thusima kisei lah a akhohpen ahi. 25 Egypt gam pumpia tolhanga umtapou, mihem le ganchate geiyin, gellenin aseplih jenge. Loulai muchi jouse la avo mat tep jengin, thingphung jouse jong aseplhusoh tai. 26 Israelte chenna Goshen gamkol sung seh seh a chun gellen alhapoi. 27 Lengpan Mose le Aaron agakousah-in, “Tua vang chonse kahitai; Pakai adih-in, kei la kamite themmo kahitauve. 28 Pakaiya tao lhonin! Van kithin ka-ngai chimun, gellen kadou lel tauve! Nachetei diuva katep ahi; hi koma chenda jengun,” ati. 29 Mose’n ajah a, “Khopi kadalhah teng Pakai lam sangin tao ving ting, van ging talou ding, gellen lha lou ding ahitai. Chuteng leiset geiya Pakaiya ahi nahet ding ahi. 30 Hinla nangle navaipoten Pakai Pathen nagging hih laiyui,” ati. 31 Sakolchang minlai avoheosoh tan, patbo jouse jong avoheosoh tai. 32 Suhlou chang vang agei jep jeh in asuse behseh poi. 33 Mose’n lengpa adalhan, khopi polama achen, Pakai lam sangin ataove. vAn gin athip’in gellen atangin, go ajutapoi. 34 Thilsoh, kho phat amudoh phat’in lengpa achonse kittan, ama ti avaipote ti angai bep’in alung tah-un, 35 Pakaiyin Mose aseipeh masah bangin, lengpan Israelte asoldoh deh tapoi.

Potdoh 10

Khakhote

1 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Lengpa gakimupi kit’in. Lengpa le avaipote lungtah sah-a thil kidang hicheng hi bol kagot ahin, 2 nangin jong natu nachate khang geiya jong hitobang thil kidang bol’a Egypt mite lung jinga kalha hi nasei theina ding kati ahi. 3 Hiti hin Mose le Aaron Egypt lengpa koma ache lhonin, “Pakai, Hebrew mite Pathenin, ‘Itih chanpi kasei ngailouva naum ding ham? Eihou theina diuvin kamite sol tan. 4 Kasei na-ngai louhel le jing teng nagamsunga khaokhote kalhah lut ding ahi. 5 Khakho jamah hung lhaa, nagamsung atomjol diu, gellen vohlih mooh chengse, thingphung geiyha aneh chaidiu ahi. 6 Naleng inpi le navaipote, chule namite insung khaokhote dimsoh diu ahi. Napu napaten anamusah thilse josue sanga khohjo ding ahi,’ tin aseiye gati lhonin,” ati. 7 Lengpa vaipoten ajah a, “Iti hichepa hin eidolgim gim jeng diu ham? Pakai a-Pathenu akihou theina diuvin Israelte hi soldoh tan. Egypt gamsung kichai pai ding ahi helou tahbah nahim?” atiuve. 8 Mose le Aaron chu Egypt lengpa koma agapui lut kit’un ajah lhona, “Pakai na-Pathen chu gakihou thei nauvin nate, ahin ache ding pen chu koi koi ham?” atiuve. 9 Mose’n, “Kabonchauva, numei chapang, tehse geiya che ding kahiuve. Kachateu numei pasal, kelngoite le kelcha ho, bong jouse geiya kapui diu ahi, Pakai choi-atna kut lentah bol ding kahiuve,” ati. 10 Egypt lengpan, “Pakai min panna kasei ahi-itih hijong le numei chapang geiyin sol tha hih hel inge! Edou dia kigo nahiu akichentai. 11 Hithei lou hel ding ahi. Pakai hou nom mong nahiule, pasal chengse chethei ahi,” ati. 12 Hichun Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Khakhote hung dimsetna din Egypt gamsunga nakhut jah-in, Khakhote hungun tin, Egypt gamsunga hampa louhing gellen voh lih moh geiya aneh chaisoh diu ahi,” ati. 13 Mose’n tenggol ajap khum jengle, Pakaiyin niso lama pat sun nilhum jan khovah geiyin hui anunsah-in, jingkah-in khaokhote ahung kitol tai. 14 Ahon honin ahung kitolun, gamsunga alop lop’in atolchai jengui. Khaokhote tamje chu kimu kha loulai hel, mu jong kimu kit louhel ding ahi. 15 Leiset atomjolsoh keiyun, avom leouve; gellen vohlih moh, thing na dum ho geiyin ane chai jengui Egypt gamsung pumpia thingna dum khat’a khat jong akimu tapoi. 16 Egypt lengpan Mose le Aaron agakousah loiyin, “Pakai na-Pathenu le nangni doumah bol’a chonse kahitai. 17 Tun kachonset ngaidamna din neitaopeh loi lhonin, gamlhahna hel thei talen eimatsah hi lahdoh sah din thum lhonin,” ati. 18 Lengpa dalhan Mose Pakaiya atao le, 19 Pakaiyin nisolam huipi chu lhumlam khohuiyin akhel’in, khakhote abonchan Suez twikola alhoh lutsah soh tai. Egypt gamsunga khaokhote khat cha akimudoh tapoi. 20 Pakaiyin Egypt lengpa lung atahsah-in, lengpan Israelte alhadoh kit tapoi.

Mujin lhun

21 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Vanlam sang le chun, Egypt gamsung tomjol khopset mujin hung lhung ding ahi,” ati. 22 Mose’n vanlam asanle, nithum sungin Egypt gamsung mu athimsoh hel’e. 23 Egypt mite khat le khat jong akimu thei tapouvin, insung dalha a potdoh jong aumtapouve. Israelte chenna sungsea vang kho avah jingnai. 24 Egypt lengpan Mose akouvin ajah a, “Pakai gakihou thei tauvin nate; numei chapang geiyin che jengun. Kelngoi le kelcha, bong ho geiyin vang pui dauvin, hikoma dalhauvin,” ati. 25 Mose’n, “Achutile Pakai ka-Pathenu houna dia pumgo thilto dia tha ding gancha neipeh diu ahi. 26 Achutilou vangle gancfha aboncha kapui diu khat cha jong kadalhah lou diu ahi. Ganchate lah a Pakai ka-Pathenu houna dia lom kalhehdoh diu ahi nalaiye. Kilhaina ding mun lhun masanga itobang gancha thapeh ding kihe thei loulai ding ahibouve,” ati. 27 Pakaiyin Egypt lengpa lung atahsah jing jeh-in, Israelte asoldoh deh tapoi. 28 Lengpan Mose jah a, “Kakoma konin potdoh loiyin! Mu jong neikimusah kit hih-in! Kamu ni ni le nathi ni kitoh ding ahi!” ati. 29 Mose’n jong, “Naseidih bouve, neimu kit louhel ding ahitai,” ati.

Potdoh 11

Cha peng masa thi ding Mose’n aphon

1 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Egypt lengpa le amite bolsetna ding talen khat bou kahentai. Hiche talen amat jou teng nalhadoh tauvinte. Nasol nom lot’uva nadeldoh tho diu ahi. 2 Tun Israelten aheng akomuva sana le dangka, sanajem pahvui akithum diuvin seipeh tan,” ati. 3 Pakaiyin Egyptte chu Israelte ajabolsah lheh jenge. Ahingmongin vaipote le mipin Mose chu mi nasatah a agel’u ahitai. 4 Mose’n Egypt lengpa koma, “Pakaiyin, ‘Jan khangkim teng Egypt gamsung kakholsoh ding, 5 chapa peng masa jouse, leng chang ding, lengpa chapaa pat sumheiya chang goi soh numei chapa geiya, Egypt gamsung chapa jouse thisoh diu ahi. Gancha peng masa jouse jong thigam ding ahi. 6 Egypt gamsung ka le mao ogin thongsoh ding, hitobang hi kija kha loulai, jajong kija kit lou ding ahi. 7 Israelte lah a vang uicha hamgin le ganchate uhpoh jong kija lou ding ahi. Chuteng Kei-Pakaiyin Israelte le Egyptte kadat khen dol nahetdoh ding ahi,’ ati, tin gaseiyin,” ati. 8 Achainan Mose’n, “Navaipote ka-angsunga hung bohkhup a, kamite kapuidoh dia hung tao diu ahi. Chutah le kadalhah ding ahi,” ati. Hiti hin lung hang tah-in Mose’n Egypt lengpa adalhai. 9 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Egypt gamsunga thil kidang hijat hi kaboldohna thei dia Egypt lengpan nasei angai deh loulai ding ahi,” ati. 10 Mose le Aaronin Egypt lengpa angsunga thil kidang hijat pi hi aboldoh lhonin, Pakaiyin Egypt lengpa lung asuh tah jeh-in Israelte Egypt gama konin asoldoh deh poi.

Potdoh 12

Kalchuh Kut

1 Egypt gama Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron jah a, 2 “Hiche lha hi kum sunga lha kipatna nasim diu ahi. 3 Israel pumpi hitin hilchah lhonin; hiche lha nisom lhin ni le a-inson a sungsa tha dia kelngoi ham kelchagol ham khat naki-ngaito cheh diu ahi. 4 Koi tobang insung chun sungsa kithat aneh lel dingle, a-inhengte to sa chu kihomuva, aneh khop bep dia chang thei ahiuve. 5 Kelngoi ham kelcha ham natha theiyu ahin, hoijoh hile kum khat lhingsa, nolnabei achal hiding ahi. 6 Hiche lha nisom le ni li lhin ni, nilhah lam teng Israel pumping an atha diu ahi. 7 Aganthau sa anehna diu in tin a, kotpi chung inkama thisan aloinat soh kei diu ahi. 8 Hiche jan hile sungsa chu ago min’uva, anche kha le cholsolou changlhah to ame diu ahi. 9 Asel’a jong, hon thota jong naneh lou diu, apumchang, alu pum, akeng pum, asungsa jouse puma gomin thoa naneh diu ahi. 10 Neh moh imacha jong jingkah khovah geiya nakoiden lou diu, neh moh pou pou nagovam jeng dingu ahi. 11 Kholjin dia gotsa, tenggol choiya, kengchot busa, chule dinmun pum le kinotah a naneh diu ahi. Hiche hi Pakai-Kei jabolna Kalchuh Kut ahi. 12 “Hiche jan hileh Egypt gamsung kakholsoh hel’a, mihem hihen gancha hile, apeng masa chengse kathagam ding, Egypt gamsung doi le kao jouse kasuhgama talen kamatsah ding ahi. Kei hi Pakai kahi. 13 Kotpi inkam chunga thisan kiloi chun nachen nau in eihetsah ding-melchihna ahi. Hiche thisanchu kamu teng kalchuh ing ting, Egypt mite talen kapehna nangho suse ponge. 14 Hiche nikho hi, Kei-Pakai thilbol geldohna, sakho kut a nanei diu ahi. Akhang khangin bol jinguvin,” ati.

Cholsolou changlhah kut

15 Pakaiyin, “Ni sagi sungin cholkiso changlhah nehhih hel’un, cholsolou changlhah bou neuvin. Kut kipatni le insunga chol kikoi chengse napai diu ahi, ajeh chu kut sung ni sagi sunga chol sa changlhah nekha chan chu kamite to kisimtha lou ding ahitai. 16 Kut kipatni le ni sagi lhin nia Pathen lhai dia nakikhop diu ahi. Hiche nikho te ni le anhon tilou thildang toh dang nabol thei lou diu ahi. 17 Hiche nikhoa hi Egypt’a kona kahin puidoh-u melchihna a hiche kut hi nabol jing diu ahi. Khonung jongle, akhang khanga hiche kut hi naman jing dingu ahi. 18 Hiche lha masa nisom le li lhin nilhah a pat, nisom ni le ni khatna nilhah geiya cholsosa changlhah naneh thei lou diu ahi. 19 Ni sagi sunga koimacha insunga cholsosa changlhah kikoi thei lou ding, cholsosa changlhah koi pen pen gamsung mi hihen, khopem hile-Israelte Houbunga kisimtha lou ding ahi. 20 Cholsosa changlhah him him naneh lou diu, na umna jouseuva cholso lou changlhah bou naneh diu ahi,” ati.

Kalchuh Kut masapen

21 Mose’n Israel lamkaite akousoh keiyin ajah-uva, “Kalchuh Kut bolna dia na-inko kouva kelngoi ham kelgol ham nakitha cheh diu ahi. 22 Naganthau thisan chu hyssop ponin deovin lang, kotpi khom le inkam jol’a loisan soh keiyun. Jingkah masanga koiman insung nakhokal thei lou diu ahi. 23 Egyptte sugam dia Pakaiyin Egypt gamsung achot teng, kot khom dungle inkam dunga thisan kiloi muntin, mi sugam Vantil na-insunguva alutsah daa, nahinghoi diu ahi. 24 Nangho le natu nachateu geiyin, hiche Dan hi a-itih a jong anit jing diu ahi. 25 Pakaiyin peh dia na teppeh nau gamsung nalhun tengu jongle hiche houdan hi najui diu ahi. 26 Nachateuvin, ‘Idia hiche Houdan ho hi kijui ham,’ atiu leh; 27 ‘Egypt gamsunga Pakaiyin Israelte in josue akalchuh jeh a Pakai jabolna kimang Kalchuh kut kilhaina gantha ahi, Pakaiyin Egypt mite athaa, eiho eihing hoiyu ahi,’ tia naseipeh diu ahi,” ati. Israelte kunin Pathen alhai cheh-ui. 28 Acheuvin Mose le Aaron jah a Pakai thupeh chu aboutauve.

Cha peng masa thi

29 Jan khangkim laiyin Egypt gamsung lengpa goulo ding chapa masa pen apat kulsunga kihen sohchang chapa masapen gei Egypt gamsung chapang masa jouse gancha peng masa ho geiyin Pakaiyin athath gamtai. 30 Hiche jan hin lengpa le avaipote athouvun, chapa thi louna in khat beh jong aum tah lou phat’in, Egypt gam pumpi ka le mao o athongsoh hel tai. 31 Ajan janin lengpan Mose le Aaron agakousah-in, “Na-Israelte toh potdooh loi lhonin! Kagam sung dalhauvin, Pakai chu nadei bangin kihou tauvin. 32 Nakelngoi, nakelchau, nabong jouse kikaihyun, cheloiyun, keijong vang neithumpeh-un,” ati. 33 Egypt miten Israelte chu Egypt gam dalha loi din angeh-un, “Nachedoh vah louvule kathigam pai diu ahitai,” atiuve. 34 Israelten umle bel akigot’un, cholsolou changbong ponin achun’uvin, lengkouva pun akitol tauve. 35 Israelten Mose sei bangin abol’un, Egypt mite koma sana le dangka, sanapah jem, chule ponsil akithum’uve. 36 Pakaiyin Israelte chu Egypt mite aginsah-in, athum chan’u apehsah-e. Hiti hin Egypt mite gou jouse Israelten apodoh tauve.

Potdoh 13

Chapa masa katdoh

1 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, 2 “Chapa peng masa le gancha peng masa achal josue kakoma nakatdoh diu ahi, ajeh chu Israelte chapa masa achal jouse kei ding ahi,” ati.

Cholsolou changlhah kut

3 Mose’n mipi jah a, “Nasoh chan nau mun, Egypt gamsung nadalhah nikhou hiche nikho hi Pakaiyin abangol thahat’a nahin puidoh-u ahi. Cholsosa changlhah naneh htei lou hel diu ahi. 4 Lha masa, Abid, hiche nikhoa hi Egypt nadalhah-u ahi. 5 Canaan mite le Hit mite, Amor mite, Hiv mite, chule Jebus mite gamsung napeh diuva napu napateu koma Pakai giltah a kitepsa ahi. Hiche gampha sunga nahin puilut tengule, kum seh a lha masa pena hiche kalchuh kut hi naman jing diu ah. 6 Ni sagi sunga cholsolou changlhah naneh diu, ni sagi lhin ni le Pakai choi-atna kut nabol diu ahi. 7 Ni sagi sunga cholsolou changlhah naneh lou diu, nagam sunguva chol le cholsosa changlhah nakoi da diu ahi. 8 Kut kipat teng, Egypt nadalhah-uva Pakaiyin thil nabolpeh jal’uva hiche thil nabol’u chu nachateu hilchen’un. 9 Kalchuh kut kinit hi khut’a chao kibut bang le chalpaunga sum-eng kikhai banga nanei diu, Pakaiyin ban-gol hat’a Egypt a nahin puidoh jal’uva, Pakai Danthu sim le lungchina seije nahil jing diu ahi. 10 Akitep phat chan kumseh le hiche kut hi mang jing jengun.

Cha peng masa

11 “Giltah a napu napateu koma napeh diuva akitepnasa Canaan mite gamsunga Pakaiyin nahin puilut tei diu ahi. Gam chu apeh tengu 12 cha peng masa jouse Pakai napeh diu ahi. Gancha peng masa achal jouse jong Pakai chan ding ahin, 13 sa-ngan peng masa achal chu kelngoiya nakile chohson diu ahi. Sa-ngan chal chu nalechoh nom loule, alol heh-bongun. Nachau pasal peng masa jouse nakile choh cheh diu ahi. 14 Khonung teng nachauvin ibol’a hich ekinit ahi nadoh tengu, ‘Kasohchan nau Egypt gamsunga kona Pakaiyin ban-gol hat’a eihin puidoh-u ahi. 15 Egypt lengpa alungtah a eisolda phat’uva, Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga chapang peng masa jouse mihem hihen gancha hile athagam a, hijeh a chu gancha peng masa achal jouse Pakaiya kilhaina kithat’a, mihem peng masa ho kile chohson ahi. 16 Hiche hi chao kibut bang le chalpang a sum-eng kikhai banga milmao kinut jign ahi; Pakaiyin ban-gol hat’a Egypt a kona eihin puidoh-u geldohna kinei jing ding ahi,’ tia nahil chen ding ahi,” ati.

Meilom le meikou

17 Egypt lengpan Israelte asoldoh phat chun, lampi gompen ahivangin, Philisitia twipang lampia Pathenin apuipouve. Pathenin “Galsatpa ding amudoh tengu Israelten lung khel’a Egypt a kile kit agot diu kadei poi,” ati. Israelte chu 18 Lampi kolvel lam, Twipi san lam joh, nelgam lama apuijoi. Israelte chu galsat pa dia kigosa ahiuve. 19 Joseph-in Israelte giltah a akitepsah dungjuiyin, Mose’n Jospeh long apoi. Joseph chun “Pathenin nahuhdoh tengu hiche mun a kona kalong napoh doh tei diu ahi,” anati. 20 Israelten Sukkoth dalhan nelgam pamchin, Etham a kingauve. 21 Sun teng achunguva Pakai meilomin akisongin, alekhun, jan teng amasanguva meikouvin akidal’in asalvah-e; hijeh chun sun le janin lam ajot theiyu. 22 Sun nilhumin Israelte chunga meilom akidal’in, jan khovah vah-in meikouvin akitolpeh-e.

Potdoh 14

Twikhanglensan agalkaiyu

1 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, 2 “Israelte akiletol’uva, Baal Zephon kom, Migdol le Twikhanglensan kikah, Pi-Hahiroth gal a ki-nga din seipeh-in. 3 Egypt lengpan Israelte chu gamsunga vah thai leuva, nelgam hung naidol’in ngaiton tin, 4 ken alung tahsah ing ting kahin nungdel sah diu, asepaite le ama kajo teng kamin thang ding ahi. Chutah le Pakai kahi Egyptten hedoh tauvinte,” ati. Aseipeh banguvin Israelten abol tauve. 5 Israelte jamdoh thu Egypt lengpa aseipeh-u le, ama le avaipoten lung akhel’un, “I-bol kheltauve. Israelte isoldoh-u hi soh a inekhah lou diu ahitai!” atiuve. 6 Egypt lengpan agalsatna kangtalai akigot’in, asepaite jong akigotauve. 7 Lengpa kangtalaiyin akitol’in, sepai them cheh jagup le alamkaiteu to alhone. 8 Pakaiyin Egypt lengpa lung asuhtah-in, lengpan Israelte nomtah a kitol ho chu, adel del jenge. 9 Egypt sepaiten sakolte le kangtalai ho, kangtalai tolte pumin adel del jengun, Pi-Hahiroth le Baal Zephon kom, Twikhanglensan a aki-ngah nauva aphapa tauve. 10 Egypt lengpa le asepaiten ahindel khum amu phat’un, Israelte akichauvin Pakaiya panpi ngaichan ataotauve. 11 Israelten Mose jah a, “Egypt gama kivuina lhankhuh beiya nabol’a, nel gama lup kamsah dia neihin puiyu ham? I-khoh tah a Egypt a kona nei hin puidoh mongu ham! 12 Hiti dia hi ihung kipatdoh masanguva pat kasisau hilou ham? Neidon dauva Egyptte soh a pang den dia kaseipeh sau nahi. Gamchang noiya lup kam sanga Egyptte soh a pan phajo ta dinga,” atiuve. 13 Mose’n, “Kicha hih-un, pangdet’un, nahuhhingna diuva ahi. Hiche Egypt mite hi namu kit louhel diu ahi. 14 Nangho sat ngailouva Pakaiyin gal nasatpeh diu ahi,” ati. 15 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “I-bol’a kithopi ngaiya toa nahiuvem? Mipi chu malam nodin seipeh-in. 16 Twikhanglen chunga natenggol jah-in. Twipi kikehson tin, akah tolgoa Israelte kijotdoh diu ahi. 17 Egyptte lung katahsah a Israelte adel lut diu, Egypt lengpa le asepaiteu, kangtalai ho le atolte kasuhgam a minthang ding ahi. 18 Amaho kajosoh teng Pakai kahi Egypt ten hedoh tauvinte,” ati. 19 Pathen Vantil, Israel gal lamkaipa chu anung lam’uva achen, meilom jong chu akiletol’in, 20 Egyptte le Israelte kah a akidaltai. Meilom chun Egyptte alejingin, Israelte din avah-e. Hiti hin sepaiho chu jan khovah-in akinailut thei pouve. 21 Mose’n Twikhanglen chunga akhut ajah le, Pakaiyin Twikhanglen chu niso lam khohui asemkhensah-in akiting kih tai. Hui anung khovah hel’in, Twikhanglen lai lung tolgo asoh tai. Twipi skihom khenin, 22 Israelten ajet aveiya twipi bangdan a kisung, Twikhanglen lailung tolgon ajotdoh tauve. 23 Egypt miten sakolte le kangtalai jouse chule atol ho pumin Israelte nung adel’un, Twikhanglen lailung ageitauve. 24 Khovah konchan Pakaiyin meilomle meikouva konin Egypt sepaite ahinven, ameidoisah soh hel tai. 25 Kangtalai velkol jouse a-odensah-in, atolchal tapouve. Egypt miten, “Pakaiyin Israelte panpi eikisatpi tauve. Jamdoh jengu hite!” tin aseitauve. 26 Pakaiyin Mose jah a, “Twikhanglen chunga khut jah le chun, twipi hung kichia, Egyptte le kangtalai ho chule atolte achupden ding ahitai,” ati. 27 Mose’n Twikhanglen chunga akhut ajah jengle, khovah lhah-in twipi ahung kichin, aveina ngai ngaiyin aveitan, Egyptte chu twi lah a kon jamdoh agot vangun Pakaiyin twi lailunga laeh lut soh tauve. 28 Twipi akichin kangtalai ho le atolte, Egypt sepaite, Israelte nung del Twikhanglen lailunga lutsa ho chu, khat beh jong khen louvin achup lihsoh hel’e. 29 Israelte vang chu jet le veiya twipi bangin akisungin, alailung tolgoa akijotdoh soh hel’uve. 30 Hiche nikho hin Egypt mite khut’a konin Pakaiyin Israelte ahuhdoh-in, Twikhanglen pamchin a Egyptte thilong akijamchap leu chu Israelten amutauve. 31 Pakaiyin tha hangsan taha Egyptte asuhgam amudoh phat’un, Israelten Pakai aging cha tauve.

Potdoh 15

Mose la

1 Mose le Israelten Pakai vahchoi nan hiche la hi asauve: “Pakai vahchoi la sange, Aman gal ajoutai! Sakolte le achunga toute Twikhanglen lailunga aleh luttai. 2 Kakulpi detpen Pakai ahin, Eihuhhinga Ama ahi. Ka-Pathen ahi vahchoiyinge, Kapa Pathen loupije sachoi lenge! 3 Pakai gal-hang ahin, Amin jong Pakai ahi. 4 “Egypt sepaite le kangtalai jouse Twikhanglena alehlut soh tai. Egypt sepai vaipo them josue Twikhanglensanin achupsoh tauve. 5 Twikhanglen thuh alut lhumun, Songtum kileh lutbangin lito ageitauve. 6 “Naban thahat akidange Pakai, Melmate nabottelsoh tai. 7 Loupi chung nungin Namelmate najoutai; Nalunghan chun abonchauvin changpol meiya kileo nabahsah tai. 8 Twikhanglen namut le Twipi alhuh lhuh-in akinongin; Banglai kksung abangin, Twito thuhpen jong leitah asoh jenge. 9 Melman, ‘Kadel’a kamuat ding; Agouvu kadei dei kachom ding, chemhem hat’a anei jouse kalah ding ahi,’ ati. 10 Vo Pakai nakisem husan Egyptte twiyin ahcuptai; Twithuh lailunga ngenchang kilehlut abangui. 11 “Vo Pakai Nangto tethei pathen koi ham? Thengpentah Nang tobang koiham? Nabol tobang thil kidang datmo boldoh ding koi ham? 12 Nakhut jetlam najahle leiyin namelmate aval lhumtai. 13 Kitepna Molson nahuhdohsa mite napuidohtai. Nathahat’in puiyin nagamtheng nalhut tai. 14 Namtin vaipin ajauvin akihot lhulsoh tauve; Philistine mite kicha lih pai diu ahitai. 15 Edom mite lamkai ho atijauvin, Moab mihatte akihot hot’ui. Canaan gam mite amei doi gamtauve. 16 Tijat kichat’in adimtauvin, Vo Pakai nathahat amu soh tauve; Sohchang nalhadoh namite kitoldoh soh kahsen atinaje helouvin lungdongin adingden tauve. 17 Nahin puilut’in nagamsung Mol le lhang natomjolsah-in; Nang-Pakaiyin nalhendohsa mun, na-in Houin-nasahsa dung nalhutsohtai. 18 Vo Pakai nangma, Tonsot tonsot’a leng chang ding nahi,” atiuve.

Miriam Labol

19 Israelten Twikhanglen lailung tolgon ajotdoh tauve. Egypt mite kangtalai ho le sakolte chule kangtalai tol ho puma Twikhanglen lailung agei phat’un Pakaiyin twipi akichisah kit’in achupsah soh tai. 20 Aaron sopinu Miriamin khutbeh akipat’in, numei dang sen jong ajop’un khutbeh bengin alamtauve. 21 Numeiho lamkaiyin Miriamin la asan: “Pakai vahchoiyun, Minthangtah-in gal ajoutai. Sakolte le achunga tou mihem josue Twikhanglen a aleh luttai,” atiuve.

Twikha

22 Israelte chu Mose’n Twikhanglensan apat Shur gamthip lama apuitai. Nithum sung nelgam jeng ajot’u le, twi him him amu tapouve. 23 Marah kiti lai ahinphauvin, chukoma twi chula akhan adon theipouve. Twikhat jeh a Marah asah lo’u ahi. 24 Mipi Mose koma akiphin’un, “Ipiba kadon diu ham?” tin anotauve. 25 Mose jong lunggil tah-in Pakaiya ataovin, Pakaiyin thing hal khat avet sah-in, hichu twikha lah a lelut le donthei asohtai. Hikoma hin Pakaiyin achonna diu Danthu apen, pajong apate’e. 26 Pakaiyin, “Thildih a kagel chu thakhen louva nabol’uva, kathupeh chengse nanit jingule, Egypt mite kathagamna nat ho khatcha nachunguva chuhsah ponge. Kei hi nadamsah-uva Pakai chu kahi,” ati. 27 Abanin Elim ahung lhungun, hikoma hin twinah phung som le ni aumin, chahthing hung som sagi akeh-e; twipanga chun aki-ngauvin ahi.

Esther 1

Vashti lengnun Lengpa Xerxes ajumso

1 Persia gam munpi Susa khopi laltouna muna konin lengpa Xerxes hin India gam a pat Sudan gei, 2 gam ja khat le somni le sagi chunga vai ahom’e. 3 Alengvaipoh kal kumthum nan avaipote le vaihom chengse to nehkhom golvah abol’e. Golvahnaa hin Persia le Media gamhop sung sepaite le gamvaipote, milen milalte, akimsoh keiyui. 4 Lhagup lhungkeiyin lengpan lenggam haosatna le aloupi minthanje avetsah-e. 5 Ijakai avtsah soh phat’in, Susa tolpi sung mite din lengpan golvah chom khat bol’in, mihao mivai akousoh keiye. Golvah chu leng inpi hohnsunga hapta khat sungin abol’uve. 6 Leng inpi leitol chu pondum le ponkang adal khum’un, songval khom kiphut hoa chun tupat ponnemin dangka kol’a kitom abol-hom dunga akanbehuve. Leitol pumpia chun touna din sana le dangka kisem jeng akidon, song mantam, akang le asan, songval vahsel jeng, chule a-eng thipjet’in akitomjolsoj hel’e. 7 Donthei donna khon jouse sana jeng ahin, chule khon khat le khat kilo lou, lengpan leng inpi sung juneng jel’in ahom’e. 8 Judon tan phat umlou, lhacha ho chu min aduchan a donthei dia lengpan thu apehsah ahi. 9 Hiche sung hin leng inpi sunga lengnu Vashtin numeite din golvah abol’e. 10 Golvah vol kal ni sagi nin lengpan ju adonva set’in lung nomsel’in aumin, sole lhacha, nukiso sagi-Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar chule Carkas akoulut’in, 11 Lengnu Vashtin lallukhuh puma akimupi ding agakousah tai. Lengnu hi numei hoitah ahin, lengpan avaipote le maljin ho chu amel-hoi vetsah agot ahi. 12 Solle hon lengpa thupeh lengnu Vashti koma aseipeh-ule, ahung nompoi. Hijeh hin lengpa alung hang hangtai. 13 Umchan chondan thudol’a thuh le phah hethem ho doh hi lengpa umdol khat ahin, hijeh chun lengnu i-loa pha ding dol doh toh-din thumop themho akouve. 14 Lengpan thu adohnom miho chu-Carshenam Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, chule Memucan ahiuvin, Persia le Media leng gamsunga vaipo thunei chungnung pen vaipo cheh sagi ahiuve. 15 Hiche ho jah a hin lengpan, “Lengpa Xerxes ken, Vashti lengnu kouva sole kasol le, kathu angaipoi! I-ilo diuva danthun aseiyam?” tin adonge. 16 Hichun Memucan hin lengpa le avaipote koma-“Lengnu Vashti hin lengpa keo noi lhah louva, avaipote geiya einoi lhah-u ahitai; tahbeh-in gamsunga pasal jouse jong anoi lhah ahi! 17 Lengnu thilbol ja masa numei tinin jipa noisena aneithu thu diu ahi. Numeihon, ‘Lengpa Xerxes-in bon lengnu Vasti kouva, koudoh jou lou,’ ati diu ahi. 18 Persia le Media leng inpia vaipote lengnu kisah hi ajahdoh tengu, nilhum masanga ajiteu houna aneipai diu ahitai. Chuteng muntin a numei hon ajabol lou diu, pasal jouse ajite chunga lung hang ding ahiuve. 19 Lengpan nadei dingle, lengpa masanga Vasti hung kilah kit louhel din thuphon khat kiso jengle phante. Khel kit thei louhel dia Persia le Media danthua jih lut dia thu napeh din aphai. Chule lengnu khel’in numei hoijo khat lhengdoh le chun ahijenge. 20 Hiche thupeh phondohna hilenggam lentah sunga akihetsah soh hel teng, hao hen vai jongle pasal jouse ajiten ajabol cheh diu ahi,” ati. 21 Lengpa le avaipoten thu kiseidoh chu pha asauvin, Memucan seibangin lengpan aboltai. 22 Leng gamhop sunga gamkai tin a, apaovu le lekhajem cheh-in hiche thuphon chu ajihdoh-un, pasal jouse hi a-insunga apua pang, aman thu chaina asei dingin alhahsah tai.

Esther 2

Esther lengnu chan

1 Lengpa alungdam nung geiyin jong Vashti chonchan, chule adouna thupondoh abol chu agel jing nalaiye. 2 Lengpa kinaipi, thumop phabep’in akoma, “Lengpan nu-ngah thah mel-hoi tah nahol’a phalou ham? 3 Lenggam sunga gamkai vaipoten nu-ngah mel-hoi lai jouse, hikom munpi lai, Susa khopi leng inpia ahinpui diuvin seipeh-in, Nu-ngah jouse chu numeite vetup’a nakoi, nukiso Hegai noiya umsah-in, abonchauvin kisemhoisah phat pen. 4 Chuteng nu-ngah hoipen chu Vashti khel’in lengnun pansah-in,” atiuve. Aseiyu hi lengpan thilphan agel’in aboltai. 5 Susa khopi a chun Juda mi Jair chapa Mordecai achenge. Mordecai hi Benjamin phunga mi, Kish le Shimei son ahi. 6 Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzarin Judah lengpa Jehoiachin le sohchang dang Jerusalema kona akaimang chun alah-uva Mordecai jong apange. 7 Mordecai hin asopite chanu khat achanu banga akisem, Hebrew paova amin Hadassah kiti Esther, nu-ngah mel-hoi tah le gongso hoitah khat aneiye. Anule apa thi phat’a mordecai hin achanu bang banga avopdoh ahi. 8 Lengpan nu-ngah jouse khop dia thuphondoh abol phat’in, Susa khopia nu-ngah ahinpuilut nauva Esther jong apangkhai. Esther jong leng inpia, leng numeiho in vaipo Hegai thu noiya akoitauve. 9 Hegaiyin Esther adeiyin, Eshterin jong hegai along lhaisah lheh-e. Hegaiyin man gangtah-in Esther semhoina ding le atahsa thaosah lai din na atongpanin, neh le chah pha pha apetai. Esther chu leng inpi numeiho umnaa mun nompen apen, akibol din leng inpia numei sagi jen apansah tai. 10 Mordecaiyin ahilchah masah jen-in, Estherin Judah mi ahi chu aseidoh poi. 11 Niseh le Esther chu itobanga, achunga ipi soh ding ti hetdoh gon, Mordecai chu leng inpi numeiho umna maiya adung avaiyin achelejie. 12 Numei semhoina phat chu angaiya kum khat ahin, lhagup ma myrrh kinua tahsa mehnou chet ding, chule balsam thao nu na lhagup ma lutbe ding ahi.Hichengse akichaisoh hel teng nu-ngahho chu khat khat a lengpa Xerxes anga puilut ding ahi. 13 Numei inpia pat leng inpi ajot teng nu-ngah chun ipi hijongle adei dei akivon ding ahi. 14 Nilhah teng lengpa henga lut ding, jingkah teng numei inpi chom khat’a apuilut’uva, lengpa thaikemho vaipo, nukiso Shaashgaz noiya um ding ahi. Hiche a lutsa chu lengpan adeiya amin a akou kit loule lengpa koma lut kit lou ding ahitai. 15 Amupha chan seiphat, Abihail chanu, Mordecai chagavopnu, Esther lengpa henga lutna ding phat ahitai. Esther alut phat’in, numei inpi vaipo, nukiso Hedgaiyin von dia aseipeh bangin akivontai. 16 Hiti hin Xerxes lengchan kal kum sagi na, lha som lhin, Tebeth lhan, leng inpia Xerxes lengpa angsunga Esther apuilut tauve. 17 Lengpan Esther chu nu-ngah dang dang sangin adeipenin, nu-ngah dang sangin aman lengpa sei abol’in angailotai. Lengpan lallukhuh akhuhpeh-in, Vashti khel’in lengnun asemtai. 18 Esther jabolnan lengpan golvah abol’in, vaipo vaibol chengse akousoh keiye. Lenggam pumpia choldo nikho aphongdoh-in leng khat peh lomtah thilpeh tampi ahomdoh-e.

Mordecaiyin lengpa ahuhhing

19 Hichepat hin lengpan Mordecai chu vaipo khat’in apansah tai. 20 Esther in Juda mi ahi aseidoh hih laiye. Mordecai hin koimacha aseipeh lou dia ahiljeh a, aneocha lhah thu anun jing banga, athua nunga aseidoh lou ahi. 21 Mordecaiyin leng inpia na atoh pet hin, lengpa indan sunga lutna kelkot ngahte ni-Bigthana le TEresh-in lengpa Xerxes adou lhonin, tha din ago lhontai. 22 Athilgon lhon hi Mordecaiyyin ahetdoh doh-in Esther ahil le, Mordecai thil het chu Estherin lengpa aseipeh tai. 23 Phatah a akholchil’u le, thudih ahin, mithat gote ni thingchunga akhailih tauve. Aumdol hi lenggam thusimbua jih lut din lengpan thu apetai.

Esther 3

Hamanin Judate suhmang agot

1 Chom khat jouvin lengpa Xerxes-in Haman kitipa chu Semang pipun atung lentai.Haman hi Agag chilhah, Hammedatha chapa ahi. 2 Akinbol vaipo jouse kun cheh a Haman jabolna chibai aboh cheh diuvin lengpan aseitai. Abonchan abol cheh-un, Mordecai seh she adai. 3 Leng inpia vaipo dangsen, lengpa thupeh anit louna jeh Mordecai adongun; 4 niseh-in anit teina din asol sol jengun, amala anom naisaipoi. Aman, “kei Juda mi kahin, Haman noiya kun a chibai kaboh thei lou ding ahi,” ati.Vaipoten athusoh hi Haman aseipeh-un, Mordecai umchan angaidam ding le angaidamlou didng along dong lheh-ui. 5 Akoma Mordicai kun a chibai boh ding nop lou ajah phat’in Haman alung hang behseh jengin; 6 chule Mordecai m aJuda mi ahi ahetdoh phat’in, Mordecai she talen matsah sanga khoh cheh bolagoi. Hiti hin Persia gamsung pumpia Juda mi jouse thagam ding thil agongtai. 7 Lengpa Xerxes lengchan kal kum somle ni lhinna, lha masa, Nisan lhan, athilgon molsona ding nikho pha le lha kitoh holdoh didng deinan Haman hin Purim phun san ding aseitai. 8 Hiti hin Hamanin lengpa jah a, “Naleng gamsunga hin mihem nam khat kithecheh a, gamkai jousea chegnsoh kei aum’e. Hiche nam mite hin midangto kitoh louhel chonchan dan aneiyui. Akhoh cheh-in, amaho hin gamsung danthu jong anit pouvin, hijeh a chu amaho hinghoi hoi ding nan gdin hung phaponte. 9 Nadeile thugahna khat sunin lang hiche nam mite hi kithatgamle phante. Nanop pou poule, leng gamsung kivaipohna manchah din dangka talent sangsom peng ting, leng thil kholnaa koiyinge,” ati. 10 Lengpan khutjem mohor a kisem, thuphondoh jouse kinamkhumji chu asut lhan, Judate melmapa, Agag chilhah Hamandatha chapa Haman apetai. 11 Haman jah a, “Judate le asum jouseu nanga ahitan, pha nasah lam lamin bol jengin,” ati. 12 Lha masapen nisom le nithum nin Hamanin lengpa lekhajihho jouse akoukhomin, leng gamsunga kimang lekhajem jouse le pao jouse aledoh a jih ding, chule vaipote l egamvaipo chengse thotsoh hel din, thuphondoh khat ajihsah tai. Lekha chu lengpa Xerxes min a kijih, amohor kinamkhum ahi. 13 Solle hon hiche lakha chu gamsunga ahomsoh tauve. Asunga kisun chun-nikhatseh sung, Adar lha nisomle nithum ni le-Judate abonchauva, ateh akhang, numei chapang thagam hel dia asei ahi. Hepi beihel’a thagam ding, anei agou chengseu chomsoh ding ahi. 14 Nikho alhin teng miho kigingsa aum theina diuva gamkai jouse thuphondoh chu phonjalsoh ding ahi. 15 Lengpa thupeh-in thugahna chu munpipen khopi Susa a aphongdoh-un sole hon athu ho gamkai jouse alhutsoh tauve.Susa khopi sung mipi lung donga kihel lei loi pet hin lengpanle Hamanin nomtah-in toumun ju adon lhon’e.

Esther 4

Mordecaiyin Esther panpi angeh

1 Thilsoh jouse Mordecaiyin ajahsoh phat’in lung gimin aponsil chengse abottelsoh tai. Khaodip pon asil’in, lujanga leivui kiloiyin, khopi lailunga avah len, lhase tah-in othongje jun akap’in, 2 leng inpi kulpi kotphung geiyin ahunge. Khaodip ponsil koima lut ding aphal loujeh-un leng inpia alut poi. 3 Lengpa thuphondoh kisseidohna gamkai jousea, Judate lah a lunghem ka ogin thong akijai, Judate an ngol le kap le lunghemin aum’un, atamjonkhaodip pon dil’in vutvam lah a akijamtauve. 4 Mordecai umchan hi nukiso ho le Esther aseipeh phat’un, alung gim lheh jenge. Khaodip pon kheldohna dia Mordecai hi ponsil athot vangin, Mordecaiyin akilah dehpoi. 5 Hichun Estherin alhacha dia lengpan akoipeh, leng inpia nukiso, Hathach chu akouvin, ipi jeh a Mordecai chute chon ahidol photoh din asoltai. 6 Hathach chu Mordecai umna, khopi ningkoi, leng inpi lutna kotphunga achei. 7 Thilsoh chengse Mordecaiyin aseipeh-in, Judate akithagam le leng inpi thil kholnaa Hamanin akoilut nom sum jat jong aseithai. 8 Judate kithagamna dia Susa khopia kona kihomdoh thuphondoh lekha jong pheng khat Hathach apei. Mordecaiyin Hathach hin lekha chu Esther koma apeh a, aumdol hilchet’a, chule Esther asol’a amite chunga lengpan hepina anei theina dia ngeh didn aseipeh-e. 9 Hathach chun asei bangin abol’in, 10 Estherin ma Mordecai henga thu lethah kit dingin asol’in, 11 “Numei hihen pasal hile, kou louva leng inpi sung gil’a lut tapou chu thi jeng ding ahi. Hiche hi Danthu ahin, lengpa thumop ho apat gamkai mitinin ahet cheh ahi. Hiche danthu peldohna ding lam khat aumin, lengpan aleng tenggol adop khumpa vang sohcha ding ahi. Ahinla lengpan eikou louna hi lha khat jen alhingtai,” ati. 12 Mordecaiyin Esther thu thot amu phat’in, 13 gihsalna thu alethot’in, “Leng inpia naum vangin Juda dang sangin hoidoh nang tin kinep dan. 14 Hitobang phat’a hi naum thim le van a konin Judate kithopi ding hunga, huhhinga um tei diu nang vang nathi tei ding, napa khanggui bei ding ahitai. Kon ija ahet’em, ijem itile hitobang phat hung lhun ding jeh alengnua napan khat jong hithei tah ahi!” ati. 15 Estherin hiti hin Mordecai adonbut’in, 16 “Susa khopia Judate gakhomin lang, kei din an ngol’in neitaoeh-un, nithum l ejanthumin neh le chan bolda jengun. Kalhacha nu-ngahho le kenjong chutima kabol diu ahi. Chujoule, Danthu to kikal hijeng jongle, lengpa koma kalut ding, kahtilo jeng idng hijongle kathi mai ding ahi,” ati. 17 Mordecai akipatdoh-inEsther sei jouse aboltai.

Esther 5

Esther lengpa le Haman annea akou

1 A-an ngol nithum lhin nin Estherin leng pochol sil’in, leng inpi sunggil’a lut’in, laltouna indan sung, laltouna touvin, kotphung lam ana ngai. 2 polam a lengnu Esther ding amudoh phat’in alung lhaiyin, sana leng tenggol agadop sangpeh tai. Esther ahung lut paiyin, tenggol muh agah thamtai. 3 Lengpan, “Ipi hitam lengnu Esther? Nadei dei seiyin kapeh ding nahi, kalenggam keh khat hijongle it poge,” tin aseiye. 4 Estherin, “Lengpan pha nasah le, tuni lhah teng lengpa le Haman nehkhom golvah kabolpi nom’e,” ati. 5 Hichun Esther golvah ankong umpi din lengpan Haman kinloitah-in agah kouve. Hiti chun lengpa le Haman Esther gaovahna ache lhontai. 6 Ju anop thim phat’in lengpan Esther jah a, “Nadei dei kapeh ding nahi, seiyin. Kalenggam keh khat geiyin thum jongle chun penange,” ati. 7 Estherin, 8 “Lengpa nalung lhai dingle, jing teng jong le hitobang golvah khat bol kit ing ting, Haman to neihung lhah peh kit lhonin. Chuteng kadei chu sei nange,” ati.

Hamanin Mordecai tha dia agot

9 Haman kipah tah-in golvah mun dalhan achedoh tai. Ahin leng inpi kulpi kot phunga Mordecai ajotpa teng, jabolna dingdoh louva aumji le along hang behseh jengin ahi. 10 Hijongle akitim nah nah-in in lam ajon’e. In a aloi agolte akoukhomin, ajinu Zeresh geiya pang din akouvin ahi. 11 Amaho hi ahao natsatje avetsah-in, hoitho tah-in chapa tampi aneile, lengpan panmun lena akhandoh thu, lengpa vaipote lah a thupipen ahidol jouse seiyin akiletsah-e. 12 Hamanin, “Ipi dang ngai nalaiyem? Lengnu Esther geiyin kei le lengpa bou golvah ankong um din eikou lhonin, jinga din jong eikou kit nalai lhon’e. 13 Ahivanginla leng inpi kulpi kotphunga Juda mi Mordecai tou kamu jing laisen, hichengpi jong hi imacha ahipoi,” ati. 14 Hichun ajinu le aloi agolten, “Ahi, thingpel metre somni le ni sang khat nasema, jingkah teng lengpa koma Mordecai khailih dia naseile iti-am? Chutile lung nom a golvah ankong naum thei ding ahi,” atiuve. Aseiyu chu Hamanin thilphan agel’in, thingpel chu asemtai.

Esther 6

Lengpan Mordecai thupi tah a abol

1 Janin lengpa ihmu mon aumtan, hijeh chun leng gamsung lekhabu jouse asimpeh diuvin angeh tai. 2 Asimpeh nauva chun lengpa indan kotpi ngah a pang, leng inpia nukiso te ni, Bigthana le Teresh-in lengpa athagot lhon, Mordecaiyin aphondoh thusim jong apangkhai. 3 Hichun pengpan, “Hiche aboljeh a chu itobang gunchena le kipaman Mordecai hi kipetam?” tin adongtai. Asohten, “Mordecai imacha jong akibolpeh khapoi,” tin aseiyui. 4 Lengpan, “Leng inpia hi kavaipote khatbeh um’uvam?” tin ahol’e. Hichepet tah hin Haman leng inpi hongcha ahung keiye; Haman hi asemsa thingpel chunga Mordecia khailih ding thu lengpa koma sei dia hung ahi. 5 Asohten, “Haman aumin, kimupi din na-ngah-e,” atiuve. Lengpan, “Hinpui lut’un,” ati. 6 Haman ahung lut chun lengpan, “Jabol dia kadeitah mi khat aum’e. Hitobang mi chu i-kalo ding lom ham?” tin adonge. Haman akigeltoh masan, “Lengpan hibanga ajabolnom hi koi ahidm? Kei hitei veh tang, ati. 7 Hiti hin Hamanin lengpa jah a, “Nangin nasilji mong mong leng ponsandup chol chu galahsah-in lang, 8 leng kijepna sanajem ho chu nasakol jepan, 9 chuteng namihat lah a hatpen khat’in hitobang mi chu jem hen lang, sakol chunga toudohdah hen, aman sakol kaile hen, khopi dung lhungsoh keiyin mihatpa hin, ‘Veuvin, veuvin, lengpan jabol’a kipaman apeh pa hi!’ tin sam le le hen,” ati. 10 Chutah-in lengpan Haman jah a, “Leng ponsandup chol galan, sakol gakai loiyin, chule hiche Juda mi Mordecai khu hitobang chun jabolna neiyin. Nasei jouse chu ama din bol jengin. Leng inpi kulpi kotpuhnga tou jing ahi,” ati. 11 Hiti chun Hamanin leng ponsandup chol alan, sakol agakaiyin, ponsandup chol Mordecai asilpeh-in, sakol chunga Mordecai atouvin, Hamaninkhopi dung lhungkeiyin akailen, achepum lhonin mipi jah din, “Veuvin veuvin, lengpan jabol’a kipaman apehnom mi chu iti abol hitam!” tin asamle lei. 12 Haman jum behseh a mai pon a jel’a in lam ajot chun, Mordecai leng inpi kulpi kotphunga ache kit’e. 13 Haman chun thilsoh jouse ajinu le aloi agolte koma aseitai. Ajinu le aloite michingtah tah hon, “Mordecaiyin nathaneina achulhah pan ahitai. Juda mi ahin, najo louhel ding ahi. Aman najotei ding ahi,” atiuve.

Haman athau

14 Amaho akihou nalaiyun, leng inpia nukisoho, Esther ankong um dia Haman pui din ahung paitauve.

Esther 7

1 Hiti hin lengpa le Hamanin Esther to 2 aniveina nakong aumkhomtauve. Ju anop thim phat’in lengpan Esther adongkit’in, “Lengnu Esther, ipi nadei ham, tun seitan? Seiyin kapeh ding nahi. Kalenggam keh khat hijongle penge,” ati. 3 Lengnu Estherin, “Lengpan neinop peh dingle nemhaova ka-ngeh nom chu kei le kamite hinghoina ding kadeiye. 4 Kei le kamite hi thagam dia johdohsa kahitauve. Soh a kijohdoh mai hiuving, ima dang thu umlou hile, umthim a nang suboi lou didng kahi; tua vang hi kabonchauva suhgam a, suhmang ding kahitauve!” ati. 5 Chutah chun lengpa Xerxes chun, “Hitobang thil bolngam ding chu koi hiya, ama chu hoiya um ham?” tin adongtai. 6 EStherin, “Eihehseuva kamelmau, hiche migiloupa Haman hi ahi!” ton akoh tai. 7 Lengpa lung hangval’in akipatdoh-in, indan sung dalhan, leng inpi polam honleiya agavah lei. Lengpan talen amatsah tei ding amudoh phat’in Haman aumdenin, lengnu Esther koma ahinghoi teina din atao tao jenge. 8 Ahepi teina dinEsther jalkhuna akisep lhun ataove. Hichepet tah chun honleiya konin lengpa ahung nungkit’in insung ahunglut’e. Aumchan amudoh phat’in lengpa akisenjah jengin, “Hichepa hin kaleng inpi sung jenga jong, kamitmu changtah a lengnu geiya suhset aot hitam?” tin aseitai. Lengpan asei jou lou laiyin nukiso hon Haman luchang atom paitauve. 9 Nukiso ho lah a Harbonah chun, “Nahuhhinga Mordecai thana din Haman hin thingpel semsan a-in a akoiye. Thingpel lentah, metre somni le ni jen sang ahi!” ati. Lengpan, “Ama khailih nan ganeiyun!” ati. 10 Hiti hin Mordecai khailihn adinga asemsa thingpel a chun Haman akhailih-un, lengpa jong alungdamtai.

Esther 8

Judate kihonna galsat ding aseipeh-u

1 Hiche nikho chun lengpa Xerxes chun Judate melma Haman thille lo, neile gou abonchan Esther apetai. Mordecai apa-ngah ahichu Estherin lengpa aseipeh-in, hichea pat hin Mordecai lengpa koma alut theitai 2 Lengpan Haman khut’a anunglah, akhutjem, mohor umna chu asut lhan Mordecai apetai. Estherin Mordecai chu Haman neile gou jouse chingtup din akoitai. 3 Esther lengpa khophangbul;a lhun akap’in, Agag chilhah Haman thilse gon, Judate thagam dia agot chu suhtangna dia thil khatbeh bolsah din a-ngeh tai. 4 Lengpan Esther din leng tenggol adop khumin, amanu dingdoh-in aseitai, 5 “Lengpan pha nasah a, kei thi ding nadaa, dih nasah le, Agag chilhah, Hammedatha chapa Haman thupeh, leng gamsunga Judate thagam dia thupeh aneisa suh tangna din thuphondoh khat sodoh le chun kati. 6 Hitobang manthahna kamite chunga lhunga ka-inkote geiya kithagam ding chu iti kathoh ding hitam?” ati. 7 Hichun lengpa Xerxes-in lengnu Esther le Juda mi Mordecai jah a, “Ve-lhonin, Hamanin Judate thagam agotjeh-in kakhailih-in, anei agou jouse Esther kapetai. 8 Lengpa min a thuphondoh kisema leng mohor kinam khum vang chu kikhel theiponte, Judate vang chu nadei deiya lekha nathot thei lhon ahi; kei min a najih lhon a leng mohor nanamkhum thei lhon ahi,” ati. 9 Lha thum lhinna, Sivan lha, nisom ni le nithum nia hiche hi soh ahi. Mordecaiyin lengpa lekhajih ho akoukhomin, Judate le gamvaipote, vaibolte, India pat Sudan gei gamkai ja khat le somni le sagi sunga athot’ui. Lekhaho chu agamkai pao le lekhajem cheh, Judate din jong Judate lekhajem le apaovun ajihsoh keiyui. 10 Mordecaiyin lekha thot ho chu lengpa Xerxes minin ajihsah-in, leng mohor anamkhumsoh keiye. Lekha thot jouse chu leng sakolbuh a kihen, sakol jangkhai cheh mangin mi atousah-in agahopsah sohkeiye. 11 Hiche lekha thot hoa kisei chu-khopi jousea cheng Judaten akihuhdoh na diuva pangkhom thei din lengpan aphalpeh-e. Gamkai hoilai hihen, itobang manchah choi min hindel khum’u jongle, asat thuh-uva, numei chapang geiya athagam diu, khatcha hing hoi louva, anei agou jouseu geiya akichom diduvin aseiye. 12 Hiche thugahna hi lha somle ni lhinna, Adar lha, nisom le nithum ni, Judate thagam pumpia manchah dia kisei ahi. 13 Athu hi pondoh a Danthua pang ding, gamkai jousea mitin hetsah ding, hiche nikho chule Judate amelmateuva akihuhdoh theina diuva, kigingsa aumna diuva seipeh ding ahi. 14 Lengpa thupeh-in sakol themte leng sakol chunga atouvun, jangkhai vel’in alhaitauve. Thugahna chu munpi pen Susa khopia jong japi ahetsah-ui. 15 Mordecaiyin leng inpi dalhan, leng pon loupe, adumle akang, tupat ponnem sil’in, lallukhuh loupe tah khuh-in akondodh tai. Susa khopi sung kipa ogin athongsoh hel’e. 16 Judate din kipa lung olle, nopna chule galjona lungthin aumdoh tai. 17 Khopi jouse le gamkai jouse, lengpa thuphondoh kisimphah na jousea, Judaten toh bangin kipa golnop abolsoh keiyui. Dihtah-in midang tampi jong Juda mi asoh gamtauve. Ajeh chu mijousen aginlo tauvin ahi.

Esther 9

Judaten melma asuhgam

1 Leng thuphondoh manchahna ding, Asar lha, nisomle nithum ni amelmateuvin Judahte matchom agot niu ahung lhungati. Ahinla Judahten amaho ajolotauve. 2 Leng gamsung, Judate chenna mun jousea, asat diuva kigochanto kisat jeng din Judate akikhomtauve. Muntin a min Judate akichauvin, koiman adehjou tapouve. 3 Tahbeh-in, Mordecai aginjeh-un, gamkai vaipote le, gamvaipo ho, vaibol ho chule leng thalhenga antong jousen, Judahte apanpi cheh tauve. 4 Lenggam pumpia, leng inpia Mordecia thenai, aneibe cheh cheh thudol akithangsoh tai. 5 Hijeh chun Judahten amelmateu alo nom nom alo thei tauve. Chemjam choiyin adekhum’un, asat chap jenguve. 6 Munpi pen Susa khopi sung jenga jong Judahten mihem ja nga athat’uve. 7 Amitha lah-uva Judahte melma, Hammedatha chapa Haman chapate som khat jong apangun, 8 Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha, Parmashta, Arisai, Asidai, chule Vaizatha ahiuve. 10 Thilkeo ima vang achomtapouve. 11 Hiche nikhoa Susa khopia mihem kithah jat chu lengpa aseipeh-uve. 12 Lengpan lengnu Edther jah a, “Susa khopi sung jenga jong Judahten mihem ja nga athat’un, Haman chapa som khat jong apangtai. Gamkai dang danga ijat i-alo dda diu ham! Ipi nadeibe nah laiyam? Namu thei ahi. Seiyin, namu jeng ding ahi,” ati. 13 Estherin, “pha neisah peh dingle, thunia abol banguvin Judahten jing jongle bol kit tadiu hen. Chule Haman chapa som khat chu thingpel a khaisang din noppeh-in,” ati. 14 Lengpan hiche jong hi aphalpeh-in, Susa khopi sunga thuphondoh khat ahomjaltauve. Haman chapa som khat long chu japi vet din aphoujah tauve. 15 Adar lha nisomle nile nin, Susa khopia Judahte akikhom’un, khosunga mihem jathum jen athabe kit’ui. Thilkeo vang achomdeh kit pouve. 16 Gamkai jousea Judahte jong akikhom’un, akihuh cheh tauve. Avetdauva pang mihem sang som sagi le sang nga athat gam’un, amelmateuva konin aongthol tauve. Thilkeo ima vang achompouve. 17 Hicheng chu Adar lha nisomle nithum nia thilsoh ahi. Ajing nikho, nisomle nili nin vang mi athabe tapouvin, kipa golvah nikhon amangjo tauve. 18 Susa khopia Judahten vang nisomle nithum, nisomle ni nga nia ahaijeh-un, nisomle ni nga ni choldo nin amanguve. 19 Hijeh a chu khote dunga cheng Judahten Adar lha nisomle nili ni hi kipa nihtnega amanjiu ahin; golvah bolna le khat le khat neh le chah kipetou ahi.

Purim kut

20 Mordecaiyin thilsoh hicheng hi ajihdoh-in, Persia gam pumpi, gamla naiya cheng Judahte jouse athot’in, 21 kumseh le Adar lha nisomle nili ni, nisomle ni nga ni nithenga anit diuvin aseipeh-e. 22 Hiche nikhote nia hi Judahten amelmateu athagamu ahi; hiche lha hi lung gim hesoh a kona kipa nopna kiheidohn alha ahi. Hiche nikhote ni hi golnop kut le anlhung nehna, neh le chah kithah toa, vaichate anthahna nei din aseipeh tai. 23 Judahten Mordecai thupeh ajuiyun, hiche golnop hi kum vanlhah kut’in aumdoh lo tai. 24 Judahte melma, Agag chilhah, Hammedatha chapa Hamanin Judahte suhgamna din Purim kiti mangin phun anasanin, nikho hoipen a suhgam didn ahol’in, thagam hel din anagoi. 25 Ahivangin Esther lengpa koma alut’in, lengpan thugahna asemin, Judahte bolna sia thilgon chu Haman chungjoh a achuh lon, amati acahpate ti thingpel a akhaisoh tauve. 26 Hijeh a chu hiche nithengte ni hi Purim kisah lo ahitai, Mordecai lekha thot ho jeh le achunguva thilsoh ho jal’in, 27 Judahten Dan akisem lo’uvin, amaho tah le atu achateu, koi hile Judah mi hung hithei, Mordecai thupeh dungjuiya kumseh le aphat phat cha hiche nikho teni ho nit jing din aboltauve. 28 Kinoptona asem’un, Judah insung mite jousen, akhang khanga, gamkai jouse le khopi jousea, ahung lhun phat tin a, Purim nikho te ni hi geldoh a nit jing din aseitauve. 29 Lengnu Esther, Abihail chanu le Mordecaiyin jong lekha ajih lhonin, masangjep a Mordecia sutse Purim thudol asei chu, thalhingset’in namdetna anei lhontai. 30 Hiche lekha chu Judahte jouse athot’un, atobng cheh chu Persdia lenggam gamkai ja khat le somni le sagi sunga athotsoh hel’ui. Lekhaa chun Judahte lah a cham le lungmon len ding akiseiyin, 31 Lungkham lunghem a an ngol’a nit dia kisei bang banga, aphat phat cha Purim nikhote ni chu amaho le atu achateu geiyin anit diuvin aseipeh lhon’e. Hiche thupeh hi Mordecai le Estherin asei cheh lhon ahinai. 32 Estherin Purim nit dol Dan kisem namdetna anei chu lekhajol khat’a akisuntai.

Esther 10

Xerxes le Mordecai loupina

1 Lengpa Xerxes hin gamgil lama chengho hihen, Twikhanglen pang dunga cheng ho hileu-agamsung pumpia elbol natoh tohsah ding abol cheh-e. 2 Thil loupe le mingthang abol ho, Mordecai tohmun len a akhandoh thusim lhingkeiyin Persia le Media lengte thusimbua akijihsoh keiye. 3 Judah mi Mordecai chu lengpa Xerxes bantah ajauvin adei cheh-ui. Anam mite phatna dingle atu achateu lungmon theina ding jeng anatonge.

Job 1

Satanin Job apatep

1 Uz gamsunga Pathen ginga tahsan Job anachengin, chondih tah ahin, thilse bol louhel ahi. 2 Job’in chapa sagi le chanu thum aneiye; 3 kelngoi sang sagi le sa-ngonsao sang thum, bongchal sang khat le sa-ngan ja nga aneiyin, soh tampi avul’in, niso lama mihao pentah ahi. 4 Job chapate aban banin kilhan golvah abol jiuvin, adang ho hung lhasoh kei ahiuvin, asopiu numei thum jong akou jiuve. 5 Golvah boljou jingkah teng Job jingpi tah-in athouvin, achate suh theng nadin kilhaina aboljin ahi. Job geldol’a achate khattouvin hetoh louva Pathen a-enghoukah diu agin mo ahi. 6 Ni khat van mite Pakai anga ahung kikhop nauva Satan jong alah-uva apange. 7 Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Hoilam galhah nahim?” atileh, Satanin, “Leiset chung kalhah len, dung le vaiyin kachon len, tua hikoma hung kahi,” ati. 8 Pakaiyin, “Kalhacha Job chu namum? Ama banga kitah le pha leiset chunga midang aumpoi. Aman chibai eiboh jingin, thilse pou pou bol louhel ahi,” ati. 9 Satanin, “Job’in ajeh beiya Pathen agin beh ham? 10 Nangin ama le a-insung mite chule anei jouse vettup peh jing chu. Anatoh jouse phatthei naboh-in, gamsung pumpi agancha nadimsah tai. 11 Tun ijemtin anei jouse lah peh le chun namai change nagaosap ding ahi!” ati. 12 Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Aphai, anei jouse khu nanop nop gallon, ahinkho vang nasuhset thei lou idng ahi,” atileh, Satan akondoh paitai.

Job chate le aneijouse kisuhmang

13 Ni khat Job chaten a-upa pen’u in a golvah abol pet tah-un 14 solle khat Job henga ahung lhaijel’in, “Bongchal hon lou kakaiyun, akoma sa-ngante kavah-un, 15 het man louhel’in Sabea miten eihin del khum’un gancha jouse akitol mang tauve. Kei tilou nasohte jouse jong athat gam’un, kachangseh a hung jamdoh a hiche kaseipeh nahi,” ati. 16 Solle pan thu asei chai hih laiyin, lhacha khat ahung lhung paiyin, “Kelngoite le kelngoi ching ho keh’in asep lihsoh tan, kachangseh a hung jamdoh a kahungseipeh nahi,” ati. 17 Aman asei chai hih laiyin, lhacha chomkhatma ahung lhungin, “Chaldea sepai loi thum jenin eidel khum’un, kei tilou nalhachate athat gam’un, sa-ngongsao jouse akai mangun, kachangseh a jamdoh a nang kahung seipeh nahi,” ati. 18 Aman jong asei chai hih laiyin, lhacha khat ahung lhung pai kittan, “Nachaten a-upa pen’u in a kut abol laitah-un, 19 gamthip laiya konin khopi hui ahung langin, ain asem lhun, nachate adel lih soh tai, kachangseh a hung jamdoh a, nang kahung seipeh nahi,” ati. 20 Chutah chun Job akipatdoh-in, aponsil jouse abottel’in, asam avou chaiyin, tol’a amai asulut’in ataotao. 21 Job’in, “Sagoh keova peng kahin, sagoh keova kathi ding ahi. Pakaiyin eipeh ahin, Aman akilah kit ahitai! Nun nom hen Pakai min!” ati. 22 Thilsoh hijat jeh hin Job achonse deh pon, Pathen jong amosopoi.

Job 2

Satanin Job apatep kit

1 Pakai angsunga van mite ahung kikhop kit phat’uvin, Satan jong alah-uva apange. 2 Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Hoilam galhah le nahim?” ati. Satanin, “Leiset chung kalhah len, dung le vaiyin kachon len, tua hikoma hung kahi,” ati. 3 Pakaiyin, “Kalhacha Job chu namun? ama banga kitah le leiset chunga midang aumpoi. Chibai eiboh jingin, thilse pou pou bollouhel ahi, ajeh beiya suhmang dia nagot’a nabolset soh tah vangin, Job alung lha hih laiye,” ati. 4 Satanin, “Mihemin ahinna ding pou pou ahileh imacha dalhah lel neiponte. 5 Tun atahsa khu natsah temin, namai changtah a nagaosap jeng ding ahibouve!” ati. 6 Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Aphai, Job khu nanop nop nalo theiye, thavang that thei pon nate,” ati. 7 Pakai koma konin Satan apotdoh-in, Job chu apum alongin aphahsah soh hel tai. 8 Job akipatdoh-in vutbouva agatouvin, bel hal khat’in atipat lai ho akhot khot jenge. 9 Job jinun ajah a, “Tugeiya jong lung lhadeh lou nahi ong? Pathen chu gaosap’in lang thidoh jeng tam-em!” ati. 10 Job’in ajinu jah a, “Na-ngol thubuh nasei ham! Pathenin thilpha eipeh laisea ikipaa, thilse eipeh teng akiphin ding ham?” ati. Genthei hesoh chujat athoh vangin, Job’in Pathen dounan thu cheng khat cha aseipoi.

Job golte hung

11 Job hin gol thum aneiyin, amaho chu Teman khoa Eliphaz, Shuah gama Bildad, chule Naamath gam a Zophar ahiuve. Job hesoh genthei khohje ajah phat’un, alha mon din ahung kontauve. 12 Gal’a pang a Job ahin mu vangun, alim amel ahedoh thei tapouve. Ahetdoh phat’un aponsil abottel jengun, lung natah-in aluvum lam’uva leivui aleh thang’un, othongje jun akaptauve. 13 Anat hesoh behseh jeng amudoh phat’un, ni sagi sungin sun le janin atoupiuvin, a-uhpoh apaosa aumpouve.

Job 3

Job Pathen koma kiphin
