1 Akhon nan Job apengjah-in apen nikho agaosap tai. 2 Job’in, 3 “Kapen nikho gaosap chang hen, Kakijil jan chu gaosap chang hen! 4 O Pathen, hiche nikho chu thimpi jinsah-in, Sumil del’in, kho vahsah da hel’in! 5 Muthim lhangkhal kiheh hen, Mei jing hen, nihu kilah da hen! 6 Kakijil jan chu kum sungin simtha dan, Kisimtha kit da hel hen! 7 Jan lunghem jan hisah-in, Lhaset jan hihen! 8 Kapen nikho chu gaothem hon gaosap hen, Levithan phin hang thei hon phin hang hen! 9 Jing valpa vahsah dan, Hiche jan chu khovah mon um hen! 10 Hiche jan hin eipensah jeh-in gaosap’in, Genthei hesoh eithohsah jeh-in gaosap’in 11 Kanu oisunga kathiden a, Kalong damsa ahung penlhah leh itim? 12 Idia kanun pheichunga eina pom’a, Idia noitwiya einavah ham? 13 Chulaiyin anathi ta leng, Tua kicholdo taing! 14 Leng inpi sapha leng le lalte to Lumkhom tange! 15 Chutileh sana dangka indim dim akoi, Leng le lal chapate toh lumkhom inge! 16 Nimel lhamel mu manlouva Chalam a eikipai tading! 17 Vuikhuh a migilou agilou tapon, Thacholte acholdotai! 18 Lhankhuh a sohchangte jong a-oltan, Songkul ngahpa hutot jong ajatapouve! 19 Milen mineo aumkhomsoh keiyun, Sohho jong achamlhat tauve. 20 Idia mihem hesoh gentheiya hinga, Lung nguiyan khovah amu ham? 21 Thikal angah lel lheh jengun, athimo hel’ui; Neile gou sangin buikhuh adeijo’uve! 22 Thia akivuidoh masangsen Nom asadeh pouve! 23 Akhonung thuu Pathenin aimpeh-in, Jet le veiya aumkimsoh tai! 24 Neh le chah khel’in lunghemin ka-umin, Gim genthei kathoh jinge! 25 Kaginpen thil’in eiphan, Katijatna penin eilhun dentai! 26 Lungmon le choldona kaneipoi, Kagentheina abei thei tapoi!

Job 4

Kihoulimna masa

1 Eliphaz-in Job jah a, “I-khat kiseileh ngaidan natem? 2 Paopoh louva umna thei la Nahitapon! 3 Mi tampi nahildoh-in, Lhasamte bantha nahatsah-e! 4 Cholle nanga kisep lhu jouse Natilkhouvin nahatsah me! 5 Genthei nan naphah phat’in Imacha dou thei louvin na-um’e! 6 Pathen ginga manabei nahin, Kisonna le kinepna nanei ding dol ahi! 7 Phate chan gel temin, Hoikom pen a midih-in manthahna atom? 8 Keihet’in vang thilse louma gut’a gut, Thilphalou muchi tua tun aga akilo teiye. 9 Hitobang mite chu Pathenin khopihui semmang abahsah jie. 10 Migiloute sakei banga akisenlet lut vangun, Pathenin ameh thipjin ahau avopusoh jie. 11 Neh ding sahing kimat jou lou sakeite thigam, Anoute vahcheh bangin aum’uve! 12 Thip beh chan thu khat ahung lhungin, Guh thim chan kajai! 13 Ihmutlan a singdel bangin Kahung kinkhangin; 14 Kakicha behseh jengin, Kapum changing kakithing thinge! 15 Kamai ahung kijep dap hoiyin, Katimul athousot’e! 16 I-khat ahung ding jang keiyin, Kavet vangin kamuchen theipoi. Athip del jengin, Chuin ogin khat kajai! 17 “Pathen mitmua them chang ding koi hiya, Asempa angsunga theng jou ding koi ham? 18 Pathenin vanmi alhachate jong aging chapon, Avantilte themmona jongaphoh jie! 19 Leiset a kisemdohho aginchat dia nabol’a, Nget banga thin lhah thei leivuiya kisem chu aginchat ding ham? 20 Jingkah a damseh mihem chu, Hetman louva nilhah kah a thi thei ahi. 21 Ahinlose akilahpeh teng, Ngoljeh-in mihem athiji tai,” ati.

Job 5

1 “Kouvin Job, koiham nahou ding? Nakiheina ding Vantil hoipen ham? 2 Lung gim hesoh nathipi ding vang, Pannabei ngol hoitah ahibouve. 3 Mi-ngol lungmong tah a um kamun, Hetman louvin ka-in gapsah jie! 4 Achapateu ameidoi gam’un, Thutann aphunga ding ngam jong aumpouve. 5 Lingle khao lah a keh jongle, gilkelten mingolte lhoga akilon; Midang chahten agou adei chauve. 6 Thilse hi tol’a hungkeh ddoh ahipon, Gentheina jong Leiset’a hungpeng ahipoi. 7 Meilhum sunga kona meisi alentou banga, Gentheina hi mihemin akiboldoh ahibouve. 8 Kei hivang leng Pathen heng jon ing ting, Kachung thu akoma sep lhang’e! 9 Athilbol loupitah tah ihekhen pouvin, Thil kidang abolla simjou ahitapoi. 10 Leiset chunga go ajuhsah jin, Loulai dung twi achap jie. 11 Miham domsanga, Lunghemte lhamon chu Pathen ahi. 12 Aman doha thuh ho htilgon asunoh-in, Imacha amolso sah hteipon; 13 Kichihsah ho achih nauvin amanin, Angaito jouseu asubei loijie. 14 Sun chang laiyin khon ajinden’un, Janlai bangin akimai leuve! 15 Pathenin vaichate ahinson, Bolset’a um milhasamte ahuhdoh jie! 16 Migiloute aphoh thip’in, Vaichate akinepsah-e! 17 Pathenin asuhdih thei mihem chu anun nom’e, Napho teng nagida hih-in! 18 Pathenin mi amavona atomjol jin, Navohna chengse aboldam jinai! 19 Gupvei jen hahsatnaa nahuhdoh ding, Sagi geiyin vang thilsen phapon nate! 20 Kel lhah teng jongle nahinso ding, Gal’a jong nathisah ponte! 21 Pathenin koima houset sah pon natin, Manthahnan phajongle chun huhdoh nannate! 22 Pumhat le kel nanuisat ding, Gamsa hang jong ging pon nate! 23 Hollei lah lhou khapon natin, Gamsa hangin jong sesepon nate! 24 Naponbuh a lung monga nachen ding, Nakelngoite jong ima tilou ding ahi. 25 Nason napah biha phaiha ja pha ding, Nacha nanao jong hampa jat pha ding ahi. 26 Chang minset akoi tobanga, Tehkem geiya nahin ding ahi. 27 Job kasei hi phat sotpi kasimtohsa ahi. Adih ahin, tun kisanin!” ati.

Job 6

1 Job’in adonbut’in, 2 “Ohe, kanat thoh genthei jouse Kitetoh thei leh, 3 Twikhanglen a neldi jat sangin gihjon tin, Hibanga kahansetna hi datmo pon nate! 4 Hatchungnung Pathen thalpin eikap paiyin, Athalgun eichansoh tai; Pathenin tijat jatnan eibol jenge! 5 Sa-nganin hamhing akimu teng along lhaiyin, Bongchal’in an aneh teng athip’e! 6 Koiham chiso lou anche tamne nom? Ahtui pokang khu almong nam? 7 Chu tobanga anneh kaduchapon, Kaneh jongle kaloh asoh-e! 8 Idia Pathenin kadei eipeh da a, I-bol’a kataona eihou lou ham? 9 Akhut’in eituh hen Eijep lih le ahijenge! 10 Eitha ding heleng kichom jeng inge, Itobang nat genthei thoh jong leng, Pathen thenje kahe jingin, Athupeh peh nel ponge! 11 Hinjouna ding thala kanei tapon, Athive ve ding ibol’a kahin hin ham? 12 Song tah a tah kahiya, Sum-eng lhouva lhou kahim? 13 Kihinsona thei tha kaneitapoi, Bel ding jong kaneitapoi. 14 Pathen heng he hih leng, Hitobang gim genthei teng golpha ka-ngaiye! 15 Kagol kapaiten la neilhem chavaiyun, Gotwi bei teng lhanghoh go neibahsah-ui! 16 Lhanghoh dunga buhbang alhang lhangin akisen, Thop chet chut’in akikhol’ui. 17 Kholum teng leh ajun lhan, Alon mang teng lhanghoh akeovin aumji tai. 18 Kholjin miten twi aholmo’uvin, Nelgam save vu lah a athidenji tauve. 19 Tema kon kholjinten twi ahol’un, Sheba a hungkonten mutei akinem’ui! 20 AKinepnau abei phat’in alhaseuvin, Lhanghoh go lah a akisudong’ui! 21 Keidin hiche lhanghoh gosa tobang nahiuvin, Kagenthei namu phat’un na-nung kin’ui! 22 I-khat neipeh diu kathumbeh ha, Khattou sumguh neigapeh peh diduva katem ham? 23 Melmapa akona neihuhdoh diu kasei ha, Mibolsepa a kona neilha doh diuva kasei ham? 24 Aphai, kamona iham neihil’un, Thip beh-in nasei ngaiyinge! 25 Thutah-in mi athu nuntei me, I_bol’a manlou thujeng naseiyu ham? 26 Ajeh beiya moh pen pen a neigel’um? Itiba gentheiya kasei neidonbut’u ham? 27 Chaga soh chang ho pou vang san a kihom, Nagol ngaitah tah kiveina nei nahiuve ong! 28 Neive changmel’un Jou sei ponge! 29 Naval behseh tauve, adihlou bolda jengun; Mo neichan hih-un, kadih nai! 30 Jousei bep’in neigel’un, Adih amo hekhen louva neigel mongum?

Job 7

1 Leiset mihem hinkho hi namnah a kisol sepai tobang, Thalah soh goiya kigoi tobang; 2 Che phat ni kihei ngah jing soh, Atohman ki-nga jing natong tobang ahi. 3 Lha hijat sung hi kahinlo aumpon, Jansim she-in gim genthei kathoh be be! 4 Kalup nah vnagin ihmu mon ka-umin, Khovah kal ngah lel’in kakipeh peh jie! 5 Katichung tinakhemdimin athansoh tai, Katinakhem akikhodoh leh vousan jeng ahi! 6 Kahinkho patphei kilham sangin achaljon, Kinepna beiyin abeiloi jitai. 7 O Pathen, kanopna abeitai, Kahinkho chomdan geldoh jingin! 8 Tua neimu vangin neimukit pon nate, Neive jongle chunbeipai tange! 9 Meilhang kitol mang banga Mihem athi teng hung kile kit lou ding, 10 Ama hesa jousen jong Asuhmil loi diu ahitai. 11 Ahipoi, moh umthim thei ponge, Hibanga gentheiya kilung hang Thu kasei tei ding ahibouve! 12 Twikhanglen ngapi ngap a neibol ham, Nei nga jing jeng ding? 13 Choldo din lum ing ting, Kanat ol domna ding gel’inge! 14 Hinla mangse se neimat sah-in, Mu nei neisah-in, sing neidelsah-e! 15 Hitobang nat genthei kathoh sangin, Kikhailih leng katijoi! 16 Kachim’e, kahin nompoi; Kahinlo jong aumpoi, neilimsah dan! 17 Mihem hi ija nabol’a hibanga thupia nagel’a, Idia abol chan namelchih keo ham? 18 Jingkah she-in nakholtoh-in, Phatseh-in napatep’e! 19 Kachil beh kaval manna dia Neivetda a nakihei mangle iti-am? 20 Vo mihemte Chingpa, kachonset nang dia ipi khoh am? Idia bidoiya neinei ham? Nang dia pohgih hahsa mong kahim? 21 Kachonset na-ngaidam joulou mong hiya, Kasuh khel nachulnam mo ham? Keila lhankhuh akijam loi tang ting, Neihol hol jongle chun Neiholmo tan nate!” ati.

Job 8

1 Shuh mi Bildad-in adonbut’in, 2 “Hamve vua nasei na-ngah lou li ham? 3 Patheninthudih aletun ngaipon, Itih-in jong adihlou abol ngaipoi! 4 Nachate jong chonsea hitei diu, Hijeh a chu Pathenin asuhamng ahi! 5 Hijongle hung kiheiyin, Tun Pathen henga taovin! 6 Lung theng lungdih nahileh, Pathenin hung panpin tin, Nadih man’a nanei kiledoh a Na-in kisah phat namu loi ding ahi. 7 Nanei mangjat hi imacha hilou, Pathenin napeh ding chuto tethei hilou ding ahi. 8 Golui lai chihna ho ven, Pule paten dih asah-u hi gel temin! 9 Kum lhomcha, imacha helou, Ihinkhou jong nilim kihei mang bep ahi. 10 Hijongle khanglui lai mite chihna kihilsah-in, Aseiyu nagi phan! 11 Sitwi nomna louva pengthei akeh pon, Dop lah louva akimu ngaipoi. 12 Sat lhuh amanchah thei ahi masangin jong, Twi kan teng agop masan apang’e. 13 Pathen heloute jong chu che pengthei tobang ahiuvin, Pathen asuhmil tengu akinepnau abeijitai! 14 Akinepnau achavai jin, Akison nau maimom panjang bep ahi. 15 Maimon pan a kingai leu adou jouva, Patjanga kikhaileu atuh jou ding ham?’ atiuve. 16 Migiloute sunlai loudong abangun, Honsung anche dongpha abangui. 17 Ajung kikhon song ho aveichah-in, Songpi khi kah dunga akigol dettai. 18 Hinla kibotdoh leh, Koiman akena lam jong heponte! 19 Migiloute nopna chu hiti bep chu ahin, Midangin amun alahpehji tai! 20 Mi kitah vang Pathenin adonda khapon, Migiloute apanpi khah poi. 21 Nolnabei hile chun nui heovin lhan natin, Kipa othongin thu seiyin nate! 22 Nahote vetdan tin, Migiloute in-gap diu ahi,” ati.

Job 9

1 Job’in adonbut’in, Hitin aseiye: 2 “Nasei jouse hi masanga kajahsa ahinai, Hinla Pathen maiya them chang ding koi ham? 3 Koiham Pathen to kinel thei ding? Koima adonbut joulou asang sang thudoh nei ding chu! 4 Pathen chu chingtah le hattah ahin, Koiman kidintepi theiponte. 5 Hetman louvin molsang ho atolmang jin, Alunghan teng asumangji tai! 6 Pathenin ling akihosah-in leiset akilinge; Leiset bulpi khom jouse ahot lingjin ahi. 7 Nisa athimsah jouvin, Janteng ahsite athimsah theiye. 8 Pathein van buhsona ason chun koima panpi angaipon, Twikhanglen ngapi achotphan koima athalah poi. 9 Vanlaijol ahsite, Ngambom uichal le Ngambom lungthu, bombel le Lhanggam ahsi jouse Pathen semsa ahicheh-e. 10 Athilbol loupe ho hejou poutin, Thil kidang abol jong akhonbei ahi. 11 Pathenin eihin hopa nan Kenla kamu thei hih beh-e! 12 Adei dei akilah thei, Aphoh tang ding umlou; ‘I-bol nahim? Ti-ngam koi ham? 13 Pathen alunghan teng Amelma amal tel jin; Adouva Rahab gulpi panpi jouse Asugoiyin asugam jitai! 14 Hiti ahijeh hin, Ipi seiya Pathen kadonbut thei ding ham? 15 Monabei hijong leng, Kachung thu tan ding Pathen henga chu Eilungset dia katao tho didng ahibouve! 16 Eipaosah mong jong le, Kasei ngaidin katahsangpoi. 17 Ajeh beihel’in jong eisuse din, Gopi huipi eidel khumsah bouve. 18 Hing gentheiyin eihinsah-in, Haisa theiyin eikoipoi. 19 Pumhat’a kano dingle, Koiham Pathen pumhat’a noding? Kihehpi ding kitijongle, Koiham Ama koulut jou ding? 20 Kitahle monabei kahinan Kasei chan thusen akilan, Kapaodoh chanin Kamona kaseidoh loi! 21 Monabei hijong leng khoh kasapoi, Hinjong kahin nom tapoi; 22 Moleng mohih leng imachom ahipoi, Pathenin hoijoh akhendeh poi. 23 Monabei mi hetman louva athi teng Pathenin anuisat’e. 24 Pathenin vannoi hi agiloupa apedoh tai. Vannoi thutan vaihomte mit achotsah-in, Pathen tilou koidangin Hitia abol thei ding ham? 25 Kahin nikho akitol jeng jungin, Thilpha mu man louvin ka-um’e. 26 Kahinkho kong kitol hattah abangin, Jucha man dia mu manlouva hung lenglha muvanlai abange! 27 Nui heova kanatna suhmil kagot vangin, Kagimna apong jitan; 28 Pathenin mo eichan kahen, Kichan gim genthei kathoh thou thouve. 29 Them channa chom deh lou, Ipi kakhohsah ngaiyam? 30 Buhbang twiyin kisil ing, Cha-ngel’in kisop jong leng, 31 Pathenin eh-khul sunga eileh lut’a, ponse nen sanga kibohjo ding! 32 Pathen hi mihem hileh Ddonbut’a kihehpi thei kahi. 33 Hijongle Pathen le kei kah thusei ding aumpon, Thu eitanpeh lhon ding aumpoi. 34 Talen neimatsah datan Pathen! Neihoh kichat chat datan! 35 Kalungthimin kamona kahepoi, Gin beiyin ngampel’in seiyinge!

Job 10

1 Kahin nom tapoi, Kiphin ing ting kanop nop seiyinge! 2 Themmo neichandan Pathen! Neiseipeh jon iham mo neichanna? 3 Giloutah anasemsa neidonda, Migiloute thilgon phasah hi dih nam? 4 Keiho mihem thilvet banga Nangin jong navet ngap hitam? 5 Kahinkhou chom banga Hinkho chom nahim? 6 I-bola kachonset jouse nakholsoh keiya, Kasuh khel chan namelchih ham? 7 Kathemmo loula nahen, Nakhut’a kona koiman eichulhah lou ding jong nahei! 8 Nakhuttah a neisemsa chu Nakhutma maa seisuhmang ahitai! 9 Geldoh-in leivuiya neisemdoh ahin, Leivui sosah kit neigot hitam? 10 Kapa thisan a neilhoh lhah a, Kanu naobu sunga neikijilsah ahi. 11 Kagu kachang kalhintwi nasemin, Kaguho phe le cunin natomjol’e. 12 Neihinsah-in nei ngailui, Neikhohsah jal’a ihngbou kahi. 13 Hina hichanpia hi kathemmo le, Thadoh dia guhthimcha neigot kahetai. 14 Kachonset leh ngaidam louva Suhmang din neichang lhi jinge. 15 Kachonset tih tih neibolgim jin, Thilpha bol jong leng kaphatchompi deh poi. Gin genthei leh jum le Jachat kathoh bep’e! 16 Kadinkang khen khe leh, Sakei mibolna bangin neichon lhun, Datmo mo neibol khum jin, Neimavo lo jitai! 17 Eihehse ding nanei jingin, Neilunghan jingin suhsetna thei khat nagong jinge! 18 Pathen, i-bol’a neipensah ham? Koiman eimu thei masanga thidoh hitave leng! 19 Chutileh hing man louhel’a, Naobua kona lhankhuh jonpai ta ding! 20 Thi ding koncha kahitai, Chomkhat beh nom sange, neidondan! 21 Hung kile kit lou din chevah tange, Mithim lhangkhal monmo nagam jon tange! 22 Muthim lungdon, noimigam, Khovah jeng jong muthim bep hina gam chu!

Job 11

1 Hichun Na-amath mi Zopharin adonbut’in: 2 Ngol-thubuh hijat donbut louva kikoiya, Kamtam man a mi them chang mong nam? 3 Kadonbut mou nahim, Job? Neidai chatvaiyu hi kamoh thip diu ham? 4 Nangsei bou dih nasan, Pathen vet dia thengin nakiseiye! 5 Pathen hung paodoh hen, Nahin donbut jengle katitave! 6 Pathenin chihna nahil’in tin, Mihem hetdoh theilou giltah tah aum’e. Nathoh ding sanga jangkhaijoa Pathenin talen napeh ahinalaiye! 7 Pathen thahat loupije athuh je le agilje Naholdoh jou mong ding hinam? 8 Van sangin asang jon naholdoh jou ahipon, Noimigam sangin athuh jon nahetthei ahipoi. 9 Pathen loupina leiset sanga lenjo, Twikhanglen sanga lenjo ahi. 10 Pathenin thutanna phunga kailut le chun Kon phoh lha theiyintem? 11 Pathenin pannabei jouse amun, Athilse bol chengseu amusoh-e. 12 Gamlah sa-ngan nou akivah ngoi teng Mi-ngol jong chingjep tante! 13 Lungdih pun, Job, Pathen lam sangin! 14 Thilpha lou chengse paidoh-in, Thil dihlou na-insunga koidan, 15 Chuteng mai lhaisel’a Hangtah a napan ding ahi. 16 Nagimna chengse sumil’in natin, Hohtwi kitolmang bep’a nagel ding ahi. 17 Nahinkho sunlai nisa sanga vahjoa, Muthim jeng jong jing khovah bang ding ahi. 18 Namelmate nagin lou ding, Mi tampin nang panpi ngai chante. 20 Migilouten jet le vei veu jongle Jamdohna ding lampi mupon tin, Akinepnau pen tah chu Laicha haisam chubou hitante.

Job 12

1 Hichun Job’in adonbut’in: 2 Nangho tamjo jongleur chun Nathi tengu nachihnau jong beitante. 3 Keijong nahetchanu hea, lhasam deh kahipon, Nasei jouseu min ahesoh keinai. 4 Tunvang kagol kapaiyin einuisat’un, Nolnabei adih hijong leng einuisat bep’ui; Hinla phat khat teng Pathenin kataona sang nante. 5 Hahsatna neilouva neidai thangu ahin, Thi dingkonsa kei neijep beuve ong! 6 Athahat nau Pathen banga songte Gucha le pathen heloute mongtah-in aum’ui. 7 Hetbe nom chanin ju le va kidoh-un, Chunga leng vachate le ganhing hon hil nauvinte. 8 Tol’a ganhing ho le Twikhanglen ngate Chihna kidoh-un, hil nauvinte. 9 Hiche ganhing jouse hin Pakai semsa ahiu akihet cheh-ui. 10 Asemsa chengse hinsah Pathen ahin, Mihem hinkho jong ama khut’a um ahi. 11 Naleiyin antui atekhah cheh bangin Nakhangin thu angai nom’e. 12 Tehsete aching theiyin, Ahingsot ten ima ahekhen theiye. 13 Chihna le thahat hi Pathena ahin, Thu mopthem, thil hekhen them ahi. 14 Pathenin aphet lhah teng kon asah phat’a, Pathenin songkul’a ahen teng kon alhadoh jou idng ham? 15 Pathenin twinah asipbing teng Gotwi akang jin; Twinah ahondoh teng Twisang alen ji’e! 16 Pathen hi hattah, gal lel ngailou, Mihema le alheppa ajotho cheh-e! 17 Vaihomte chihna alamangin, Lamkaite angolto abahsah-e! 18 Leng ho asu-lha jin, Sohchangin ahenji tai! 19 Thempute jong apui chavaiyin, Thahatte jong asu nemjie. 20 Son umtah miho aphoh thip’in, Upate chihna alamangjie! 21 Thuneite ajumson, Vaihomte hatna asubeijie! 22 Muthim lhangkhal kiheh lai ahoh doh-in, Muthim jinglah avahsah theiye! 23 Namtin vaipi achoi-an jin, Chuteng gal alelsah-in asu mangjie! 24 Alamkaiteu angolsah jin, Lung dongin avamangsah jie! 25 Muthim lah a akimai le leuvin, Jukham bangin alonle leuve!

Job 13

1 “Ven, hijatpi hi kamun, Kajan kahekhensoh nai. 2 Nahet jat’u kahen, Nang ho sangin kalhasamjopoi! 3 Pathen koma kiphin a Kinelpi hel ding nom kahi! 4 Joule nal’a kilep them, Panna bei Thempu jeng nahiuve! 5 Umthim beh leu chun Khattouvin michingin geljo’uvinte! 6 Ngai phauvin tun, Kachung chang thu seiyinge! 7 Idia thujou naseiyu ham? Najouthuu hi Pathen dia thilpha nagel’um? 8 Pathenchu huh dia go nahiuva, Thutanna in a kinelpi go nahiuvam? 9 Pathein nakholchil’u leh thilpha mun tem? Mihem lhep’a Pathen nalhep jou diu ham? 10 Guh thimin gingmo jongleur chun Patheninnaphosal tei diu ahi. 11 Pathen lal loupina naginlou diu hiya, Ama nakichat lou diu ham? 12 Nathuchih jouseu vutvai bep, Nakihon nau jong leipal chimbep ahi. 13 Thip chet’un kadei kagot seiying ting, Asoh soh soh jeng hen! 14 Thilo hel ding hijong leng Kagel gel kasei jeng ding ahi! 15 Kakiholpoi, Pathenin eitha thei ahi, A-angsunga kakihonna seiyinge! 16 Migilou bon Pathen angsunga pao ngamlou, Hangtah-in pang leng kahinlo thei ahi! 17 Kasei jouse ngai phauvin, Kaphondoh chan lung nachangin ngaiyun! 18 Kadih kahetjeh hin, Kachung thu sei ding kigoa kahi. 19 Mo neichan ding ham Pathen? Mo neichan dingle kihon dang ting thi tange! 20 Vo Pathen kachunga thil ni neibolpeh dan, Chutile namai kamu ngam ding ahi! 21 Talen neimatsah dan lang, Neihoh kichatsah dan! 22 Neikou masan Pathen, nahouvinge! Ahiloule ken seiyinge neihouvin! 23 Kachonset ipi pi hiya bolkel i-kanei ham? Mo neichanna ipi ham? 24 I-bol’a neidon da a, Melma banga neigel hitam? 25 Thingna bep kei hoh kichat neigot’a, Changpol gosa beo neisel khum got ham? 26 Kaneo lai chonset geiyin neiphul’in, Giloutah tah-in eihehsei! 27 Kakeng thihkhaovin nasomin, Kakho-lhah nave-lhi keiyin; Kakho-ni nung Namelchih jing jenge! 28 Hijeh chun thingmot kiloilhu kabangin, Nget nehsa ponsil kabangtai!

Job 14

1 “Mitin lhasam le panpi ngaiya peng, Hinkho chomcha, gim hesoh dimset ahicheh-e! 2 Pahcha banga pah a pulloiji, Nisa lim banga kihei mangloiji ahi! 3 Hitobang bep mi hi neivet chil’a, Neikhol’a kathu natan ding ham Pathen! 4 Mihem banga thilboh lah a Thil theng khatcha kiloidoh ponte! 5 Mihem hinkho kitepsa, lha jat kisimsa, Khelmo hel dia nasuhtohsa ahitai! 6 Ahithei le gim hesoh hinkho hi nom asahna din, Vet vet dan, limsah datan! 7 Thingphung phuhsa din jong kinep aum nalaiyin, Mit-thah kit’a hingdoh thei ahi! 8 Akungbul apkai hen, Leichunga ajung go jong leh, 9 Gotwi lhah teng akeh thah bangin dondoh-in tin, Thingtoi thah banga abah jemdoh didng ahi. 10 Mihem athi teng akichai ahitan, Athi teng hoiya um jim? 11 Twi long lai vadung kantan le Damvei lai twi kang bangin, 12 Mihem athi teng athoukit ji poi, Van kitolmang kah a mihem ihmut’a kon thou lou diu ahi. 13 Noimigama neiselmanga, Phat khat teng geldoh kit dia Nalunghan beikah a Neiselmang ding kadei lheh-e! 14 Mihem athi teng hingkit theiyam? Kenvang hesoh phat kichai, Phat pha hung lhun ding ngah jing inge! 15 Chutia neihin kou teng houving ting, Neisemsa kachunga Lung lhaitan nate! 16 Chuteng kakho-lhah melchih jong le chun Kachonset him him holdoh pon nate! 17 Mudoh jongle chun ngaidamon natin sumangtan nate, Kabol khel abonchan theh ngaim nate! 18 Molsang jouse chimsoh a, songpi lentah tah kitolmang ding; 19 Song jouse twiyin lhoh a, Songpi lentah tah tah kitolmang ding; Mihem hinkhoa kinepna jong Sumangin nate Pathen! 20 Mihem nasu-nemin, itih a din nasolmang jin, Athin amai molsoh ji tai! 21 Atu achaten gunche mujongle ahepon, Jum le ja toh jongleu ahetapoi! 22 Atahsa nat thoh lel bou ahen, Alung gim hesoh bou ahei!” ati.

Job 15

Kihoulim Nina

1 Hichea hin Teman mi Eliphaz chun adonbut’in: 2 “Michingin hita hi ahomkeova Khohui nung banga thu asei ding ham? 3 Miching koiman nasei bang aseipon, Lah theilouvin kihonna aseipoi. 4 Nadih mong le koiman Pathen ging pontin, Akoma tao nom jong umponte! 5 Nathuseiya nagitlou akilangdoh-in, Kilepdohna ding jeng thu naseiye! 6 Ken themmo kachan ngailouvin, Nasei chanin themmo nakichantai! 7 Mihem lah a peng masapen a kibol nahim? Mol le lhang hijat sanga kisem masa nahim? 8 Asemdoh masanga Pathen thilgon najah lhih ham? Mihem chihna nan gbou chang nahim? 9 Kahet louvu imacha nahepon, Kadat khen thei louvu imacha nadat khen thei deh poi. 10 Upa tehse tah a kihil ching, Napa sanga upajo koma kihil them kahiuve! 11 Pathenin nalhamon chu ida nadonda a, Lung geltah a kaseiyu nadonda ham? 12 Nalung phamo pai jengin, Mitdih mitchangin neive pouve! 13 Pathen nalunghan khumin, Nahouse se jenge! 14 Mihem hi theng jou mong ding hiya? Pahenkoma themchang jou um mong ding ham? 15 Pathenin Avantilte jong aging chapoi, A-angsunga them achangjou pouve. 16 Mihemin thilse twidonin adonin, Asea le ahomkeobou ahi! 17 Ngaiyin kahet chan Kamu chan seipeh inge! 18 Im beihel’a apu apateuvin ahil them, Thutah jouse eiseipeh tauve! 19 Agamsunguva gamchom mi alut theipon, Pathen a kona pui mang thei koima aumpoi. 20 Midang bolsea migilou chu Ahinkho lhumkeiya genthei ding ahi! 21 Tijat jatna thu jeng ajan, Nom asah pet tah-in guchan achomjie! 22 Muthima jamdoh din akinempon, Chemjam a lou dia um ahitai! 23 Muthongten athilong neh din angah jingun, Akhonung thu hahsat akihet’e! 24 Leng hattah bangin, Manthah nana del khumgoi! 25 Pathen douna khat lam a, Hatchungnung seisea Mihem chu chutobang ding ahi. 26 Hi tobang mihem chu, Kiletsah-in doumah mah abol’in, 27 Gal-lum choiyin Pathen jeng jong anakhumjie! 28 Amahin khopi jouse alan, In jouse alo teng aneiho ajam’un, Hinla hiche khopi ho le in ho hi Gal’in alah peh doh kei ding ahi. 29 Aneila umsot lou ding, haosot lou ding; Nisa lim bangin kihei mang loitante! 30 Muthima jamdoh lou ding, Mei hulgotsa thingphung le Apah jouse hui mutmang Thingphung to bang ding ahi. 31 Thilsea ngolman a kinem chun Thilse akisan ding ahi. 32 Aphat lhin kah-in gop lhan tin, thingbah gop bangin nou kit ponte. 33 Aga min masanga puljou lengpigui tobang, APah pulsa olive thing tobang ahi. 34 Pathen helouten son le pah neiponton, Nehguh a kisa in meiyin kante! 35 Thilse bol’a baotam pandoh chu hitobang ahiuvin, Lhep lhah ding bou agel’ui!

Job 16

1 Hichun Job’in adonbut’in: 2 “Hitobang hi kajahsa ahin, Neilhamon’u jong gimna bep ahi! 3 Nasei sei jeng ding ham? Ipi lunghimona neiya neidonbut kit ham? 4 Kei tobangin, nang ho tobang leng, Kalu peikhum ing ting Thu tampi kasei den ding, Nasei seiyu kasei thei ding ahi. 5 Nalhamonna diu seiya, Kamchah leuva katilkhou diu ahi. 6 I-kisei jongle aphachompon, Umthim jong leng kanat a-olpoi. 7 Ka-insung mite la nasubeisoh tan, Neichaisoh ahitai Pathen! 8 Neimanin kamelma nasoh tai, Kagu –lheng lhol bou aumtan, Hiche hi kachonset photchetnan Mihon agelsoh tauve! 9 Lung hangtah-in Pathenin einoigep’in, Midih michangin eivepoi. 10 Mihon anop agot eiseikhum’un, Eiumchah-un ka-ngeiphe abengun ahi. 11 Pathenin Pathen hephaloute eipedoh-tan, Migiloute khut’a eisep luttai! 12 Thei nop’a ki-umpet eileh kadah-in, Kalol’in eimanin eijep goiyin, Eive lhi jingin, Mitt hip tenin eibol’e! 13 Jet le vei sahle lhanga konin thalpi eikap’in, Athalchangin eidotpai jeng vangin eivoujang natpipoi. 14 Avel vel’in eimavon, Sepai ngol bangin eidel khumtai. 15 Lunghemin khaodip pon kasil’in, Leivui lah a katoutai! 16 Maisan hel’in kakap tan, Kamit kamai apomsoh tai! 17 Hinla thilse kabol pon, Kataona jong athenge! 18 Vo leiset! Kathisan vuhmang dan, Thudih ka-ngeh jong suthip hih-in! 19 Van a eidinpia Eipanpi ding khat aumnai! 20 Kagol kapaiten eihouse seuvin, Pathen koma ka-mit lhi alonge! 21 Min agol apai ding aseipeh banga Pathen henga eitaopeh ding ka-ngaiye! 22 Kakum abei hei hoitan, Thina gam kajonpantai!

Job 17

1 Haisam a thipai ding kahitan, Lhankhuh tilou imadang kaneipoi! 2 Ka-kiheina lam lam a Eidaithangun kadoujou tapoi! 3 Monabei kahi kasei neilahpeh-in Pathen! Eiseihu ding koima aumtapoi! 4 Alungthimu sumoh tajongle chun Kachunga noplensah hih hel’in! 5 ‘Agol apai lhep lhahna sumguh kilah chu Achaten mitchot lonte!’ kiti 6 Hiche thuchih hi kei housetnan amangun, Ahungun kamaiya chil eiset khum’ui. 7 Lunggim lhilonin kamit athimlon, Kakhut kakeng gu-lheng lhon keo ahitai! 8 Lungthenga kigel hi atijauvin, Pathen hephalou bangin eiboltauve! 9 Gin le ja akigel hon Themjo danin akigel cheh cheh jengui! 10 Hinla kamasanga hung idngu jongleh Alah-uva aching khat beh mudoh ponge. 11 Kanikho abeihei hoiyin, kathigon ho athontan, Kakinepna jong abeitai! 12 Kaloi kagolten janlai jong sun abahsah-un, Muthim jong kho vah loi din aseiyui! 13 Noimigam bou kakineppi ahitan, Hikoma chun muthim lah a kijam tange! 14 Lhankhuh chu pan neiying ting, Thante chu kanu le kasopinun bol inge! 15 Kakineppi ding hoikoma um a, Kakinepna thei kon amun? 16 Noimigam kajotsuh teng Kinepna neitaponge!

Job 18

1 Shuh mi Bildah-in adonbut’in: 2 “Job nang tobang nathip jengle iti-am? Sei ngaile chun kahil thei diu nahi! 3 Nangin keiho cheng hi Gancha ngol neibahsah-u ham? 4 Nalunghan chu nanatlo bep ahi. Nalunghan jeh a leiset kidonda a, Nalungdamna dinga Pathenin molsang jouse atolmang ding ham? 5 Migilou meivah kimut mit ding, Kongdoh kit lou ding ahi. 6 Migilou insunga mu athimin, Thaomei vah jong akimut mittai. 7 Golkha tah a kal ason jongle achomtan, Athilgon chengsea akipaltai. 8 Thangkol achonlut’in, Khuh sunga avah lut tai! 9 Akeng thanga a-oh den tan, thangkol a akihen-oh tai! 10 Alampia thang akikamin, Leivui akivuh khum’e! 11 Jet le vei sahle lhanga tijatna jengin, Akho-nung ajui jinge! 12 Mihao tah chunk el athoh tan, toset to akikhen tapoi! 13 Thina khop hel’in atipat’in, Akhut le akeng amonpai gotai! 14 Amonpi insunga alhop lhan, Thina angsunga akailuttauve! 15 Kat meiya akisuh theng teng, A-insunga apu louhel mi chengtante. 16 Abulbal ajung agop panin, Abah jouse agopantai! 17 Khosungle gamsunga amin thang tapon, Koiman ageldoh him him tapoi. 18 Son le pah la aneipon, Achilhah jong abeitai! 20 Niso le nilhuma ahinkho thusim japha chan, Tijan akihot lhul soh tauve! 21 Migilou, Pathen hephalou chu Hiti chih cheh ding ahi,” ati.

Job 19

1 Job’in adonbut’in: 2 “Idia neisuh lung jing jing uva, Neiseithan gdeh jengu ham? 3 Neiphin phin jengun, Neihousetnau jong najahcha pouve. 4 Bol khel nei mong jong leng, Nang ho dia i-khoh ham? 5 Keisanga phajoa kigel’a, Kagimna hi kachonsetgaa nagel’um? 6 Pathen bol kahi namu louvu ham? ka-o na ding thang eikampeh chume! 7 Pumhat’a eibol kanel vangin koiman angaipon, Thudih kakhohsah vangin koiman angaipoi! 8 Pathenin kalampi akhah-in kachepai theipon, Kalamlhah jouse asuchotai! 9 Kagou jouse eilahpeh tan, Kaminthanna asubeisoh tai! 10 Jetle vei sahle lhanga eijep chinton, Kakinepna thingboh abotdoh tai! 11 Pathenin lung hangin eidel khumin, Amelma giloupen abngineiboltai! 12 Asepaite eidelkhumsah-in, Ka-inkima apangun eiumchah tauve! 13 Pathenin kasopite eijamsan sah-in, Eihesa chengsen het louvin eiboltauve! 14 Kasopi, ka-insung mite, kagol ngaitah tah ten Eijamsansoh tauve! 15 Ka-in alhung jing maljin hon eisumilsoh tan, Kasoh numeiten hetphah lou maljin bangin eibol’ui! 16 Lhacha khat kakou jongle eihoupon, Kamdama katao jongle eidonpoi! 17 Kajinun jong kakam-ui ajanompon, Kasopiten jong einailut nompouve! 18 Chapangten nahsah mon eibol’un, Nuijat nopnan eineitauve! 19 Kagol ngaitah tah ten eivet dauvin, Ka-ngaipen tah hon eidoutauve! 20 Kagu le kavun keobou um ahitan, Kapao paojeh a hingdan kahibouve! 21 Pathenin eijep lhuh ahitai! Neivoujang natpiuvin kagolle kapaite! 22 Pathenin eibolna kah a idia neibolgim’u ham? Neibol gim nau chimlou nahiuvem? 23 Khattouvin kaseiho hi melchih din Lekhabua jihlut leh katitave! 24 Ahiloule songpheng chunga kijih pol’a Aman louna dia kajihvomsoh hel hileh! 25 Ahinla akhonna kheh a eihung panpi ding Van a khat um kahei! 26 Kavun jouse patsoh tajongleh Katahsaphea Pathen kamutei ding ahi! 27 Kamit tah a kamutei ding, Lamdang louhel ding ahi. kemeidoi lo hel tai, 28 ‘Keihon iti kabolgim beh-um?’ natijeh-un. Neidel khum theina diuvin Kamona ding nahol thu’ve! 29 Pathenin chonset satgamna alap Chemjam chu ginguvin! Thutah a khat aumdol nahetna diuva Chemjam alapji ahi!” ati.

Job 20

1 Naamath mi Zopharin adonbbut’in: 2 “Job, neilung hansah tan Kadonbut tei ding nahitai. 3 Miphinna thusei nahin, Adonbutje kahenai! 4 Khanglui laipeh, Leiset’a mihem kichensah a pat, 5 Mi phinse migilou ahingsot pon, Pathen helou jong anopsot lou nahei! 6 Migilou minthang hen, van pha ding, Van a meilah nol’in sang jongleh, 7 Huiya leivui kithe-mang banga, Ahesahon jong ageina lam ahetlou diu ahi. 8 Jan-mang banga leng mang ding, Jan-mang banga kimukit lou ding ahi. 9 Amusan jong mukit pontin, A-in mun a jong kilulah kit ponte. 10 Achaten vaichate henga thumin tin, Apau bat jouse choltah a asah diu ahi. 11 Atahsa nouchet jongleh Thia leivui sohvah ding ahi. 12 Gitlouna thu ngeitah-in sei hen, Thutah seilep le le hen, 13 Seidoh da hel hen Im mang jeng jongleh; 14 Agilpi sunga aneh jouse sentin, Gulse gu banga sesoh hel ding ahi. 15 Migilouvin aguchat gou lodoh-intin, Agilpi sung geisa jong Pathenin akhodoh peh ding ahi. 16 Migilouvin aneh chu gutwi tobang, Gul gu tobanga athipi ding ahi. 17 Olive thao luiya long amu lou ding, Khoiju le bongnoiya long vadung amu lou ding ahi. 18 Atohga chengse apehdoh soh ding, Aneile agou nopsahna anei man lou ding ahi. 19 Ajeh chu vaichate achomgamin, Nam nan mi in alahpeh-e! 20 Lung nachim tih la aneipon, Gouthil khat cha jong kholdoh ponte! 21 Aneh teng nehmoh la akhenpon, Tua hi agou beiloi didng ahitai! 22 Alolhin pet tah a hi Manthah nan atupai ding ahi. 23 Adu angai jouse nehen, Pathenin save vun hinbol nante! 24 Chemham masanga jamdoh jongle, Sum-eng thalchangin kap khante. 25 Thalchangin akap paiya athinkha akapjah teng, Thin long kangin tin, thi ding tija kihot ding ahi. 26 Agou kholsa aboncha mangthah a, Ama le a-insung mi meiyin akah vam ding ahi. 27 Vanin achonset jouse phongdoh-intin, Leiset’in adouna thu seiyinte. 28 Pathen chun lung hangtah a Agou chengse asuhmang ding ahi. 29 Hitobang thilse hi Pathenin migilou chan dia akoipeh chu ahi,” ati.

Job 21

1 Job’in adonbut’in: 2 “Kasei hi phaten ngaiyun, Chutileh neilhamon nau hijonte! 3 Kasei ngai lhauvin Chuteng atot nom nom tot’un! 4 Thi thei mihem to kinel kahipon, Umthim theihoi kahipoi! 5 Neivet’uva hi kam kisip a Thip beh a umma kahilou ham? 6 Kachunga thilsoh kagel teng, Kati ajan kithingin kakihotjie! 7 Idia Pathenin migiloute ahing hoiya, Ahaosah a ateh thisah ham? 8 Cha le tu anei jong jon’un, Akhan lhit geiyun ahingui! 9 Tijat kichat la anei khapouvin, A-in-gap kh apouve! 10 Aganchau aphat chan ajangmanin, Hahsa louhel’in anousoh jingui! 11 Atu achateu kelngoi noute bangin Alamkai le jengui! 12 Semjang kisaigin le Theile kimut gingin alam’uve! 13 Cham le lung mongin ahing lhumkeiyun, Nat genthei thoh louvin athijiuve! 14 Migiloute Pathen hohdal din agon, Ahinkhouva adeilam het ding anompouve! 15 Pathen kinbol phatchom nan agelpouvin, Ahenga tao jong iman agel pouve! 16 Athahatsan a pachangin akigel’un; Kenvang alunggel’u kadeipoi. 17 Migilouvin hahsa atojing monga, Manthah nan aphah jing mong am? Pathenin migilou chu Talen apeh jing mong ham? 18 khopi huiya changpol kithe bang le Chimpeiyin leivui apoh mang bang mong ham? 19 Apa chonset jeh a Pathenin achapa talen apeh-in naseiyin, Ahipoi, achonset akihetna diuvin amaho joh talen pejo hen! 20 Chonseten achonset mankipoh-u hen, Hatchungnung Pathen lungsat toh khau hen! 21 Mihem athi teng leh Atu acha akhohsah mong em? 22 Lengle lalte thutan ji Pathen chu Mihemin ahil thei ham? 23 Mihem abang khat nei le nga lhing, Tahsa dam theiyin, 24 Tahsa damthei leh hat’in, Adong hoi theiyin, chuteng athin; 25 Abang khatma gim genthei thoh-in, Lung gentheiyin hingin, chuteng athi. 26 Hinla hoijoh chu ahin athin akivuiyin, Thanjangten atomlhah deh-un aneuve. 27 Nalung gel’u kahen, Themmosah tei neigot’u ahibouve! 28 Nang hon, ‘Thilse bol, Milen milalpa in hoilam ham?’ natiuve. 29 Kholjinte toh nalhon khah-um? Ipi thu ahinpoh-u nahet lou ham? 30 Pathen lung hanga talen apeh nil eh, Migilo a-ongtholjo ji bouve! 31 Migilou chu athilse bol housea Lethuh ding koima aumpoi! 32 Athia phate cha ki-ngahtup Lhanphung jon a akiput teng, 33 Japi asang sangin akijot’un, Along jeng jong leiset’a ol heovin akijam’e. 34 Achutileh nanghon iti chutobanga Kahenga lhamonna thu naseiyuva, Jouthu jenga neidonbut’u ham?” ati.

Job 22

Kihoulim Thumna

1 Teman mi Eliphaz chun adonbut’in: 2 “Mihem aching chungnungpen jong Pathen dinga phachom ding hinam? 3 Nathildih bol chu Pathen dia phachom a Naphatna chu Pathen dia phachom mong nam? 4 Nakitah jeh a Pathenin talen napeh hiya, Nahougut jeh a Hatchungnungin nathu atan ham? 5 Ahipoi, nachonset val jeh leh Nathilse boljeh ahibouve! 6 Asum betjeh-in nasopi ponsil nahoh lhan, Sagoh keovin dap nathohsah-e! 7 Gilkel la an napepon, Dangchah la twi napepoi! 8 Nanei nathahat namangin, Gam pumpi chohdoh nagoi. 9 Meithaiho la nakithopi pon, Chagate jong nachom gamtai! 10 Hijeh a chu nakiheina lam lam nalhuhna ding jeng, Hetman louva kichat tijat dimset nahitai! 11 Mu athimin kho namutapon, Twisoh—innalonvuh tai! 12 Pathenchu chunglampeh a cheng hilou ham? Sangtah a kigel ahsite chunga cheng ahi! 13 Nangin, ‘Pathenin i-het’em? Meilhangin tomchah a, i-thuu tanthei ponte,’ nati. 14 Van le leiset kah a ava le nah a, Meilhangin tom a kho mulou ding nagel’e! 15 Migiloute nung nung jui dia Kigo mong mong nahim? 16 Migiloute chu athi phat lhin masangun Twisoh-in atolmangji tauve. 17 Hitobang ho hi Pathen nahsah loute, Imacha alo thei diuva tahsan lou ho ahiuve! 18 Aphat theisah-ula Pathen ahi-ngal’in, Migiloute lung gel hi kahethei hih beh-e! 19 Migilouten talen amat teng Miphale monabeite kipah-in anuiyui! 20 Migiloute nei akisumangtan, Amoh chengse meiyin akavamtai. 21 Job, Pathento kichamin lungmongle chun, Aman phatthei boh tan nate! 22 Nahilna chengse ngaiyin, Aseiho nalungthimin chingin! 23 Lungnem tah-in Pathen hinjon kit’in, Na-insung athilse kibol jouse sebeiyin! 24 Nasana jong pai mang jengin, Nasana lupen nelgum lah a vui mangtan! 25 Hatchungnung Pathen chu nasanan gel’in, Ama chu dangka kisevum bangin ngaiton! 26 Chuteng Pathen jenga ki-ngaiyin natin, Amaa kipana jeijing tan nate! 27 Natao teng nahouvin tin, Nakitepnasa nit jing tan nate! 28 Natoh jousea lolhingin natin, Nalampia khovah jingtante. 29 Kiletsahte Pathenin asu-lhan, Kineosahte achoisangjie! 30 Thildih nabol’a monabei nahileh Pathenin huhdoh tei nante!” ati.

Job 23

1 Job’in adonbut’in: 2 “Tugeiya lung himoa Pathena kiphin, Kanat thoh lel cheh cheh kahi! 3 Pathen umna kahet hihen lang, Aheng jotna lam kahet hitave leh! 4 A-angsunga kathu lhut’ing ting, kadeilamin kachungthu kisei tange! 5 Ipi eiseipeh a, Iti eidonbut ding kahenom lheh-e! 6 Hangsangin einel mong dem? Ahipoi, kasei nagijonte! 7 Monabei kahin, Pathenti kihoutoh ing ting, A-itih a monabeiyin eikoiteiyinte. 8 Pathen chu niso lam la kaholmon, Nilhum lama jong kamudoh poi! 9 Sah le lhanga na atoh jing vangin Chulama jong Pathen kamudeh poi! 10 Hinla Pathenin kakho lhah ahe jingin, Eipatep jongle kamona muponte! 11 Akhoni nung kajui jingin, Alampi ka-lho khel ngaipoi! 12 ASeichan kabol jing jengin, Ama lung lam jeng kabol’e! 13 Kikheltih neilou, nel theihoi ahipon, Abolnom suhtang thei ahipoi! 14 Eigonpeh chu amolso tei ding, Eigonpeh chu tamtah lah a khatbou ahi! 15 Hijeh chun Ama angsunga Gingkhen chan ka-um jinge! 16 Pathenin eisugim behseh jengin, Hatchungnungin eimeidoisah tai! 17 Pathenin mu eithim khumsah-in, Muthimin kamit chotlo tai!

Job 24

1 Idia Pathenin thutanna ding phat atepda a, Akinbolte them chan nikho akoida ham? 2 Migilouten gamgi song achon’un gam akeh-un, Kelngoi agu’vin akelngoihon lah a alhauve! 3 Chagate sa-ngan akai mangun, Meithai bongchal chu thilman din atunsah-ui! 4 Vaichate chan ding lom akhapeh-un, Tahlelte adeljam’un akiseltauve! 5 Hijeh hin vaichaten gamlah a sa-ngan bangin neh akihol’un, Achateu neh ding amujou tapouve! 6 Milouva neh lon chang a-at’un, Migiloute lengpiga alopeh-ui! 7 Janteng ponsil beiyin alum’un, Kihuilumna ding imacha aneipouve. 8 Molsanga kitatjal gotwi akotsoh tauvin, Songpi lim dung bel din ahol’uve! 9 Migiloute pabei naosen soh-in asem’un, Vaichate chate thilman din alauve. 10 Vaichate ponsil beiyin aumsah-un, Kel thoh pumin chang a-atsah-ui. 11 Olive thao alhoh-un, lengpiga achil’un, Amaho la dangchah athohsah-ui! 12 Khopi sunga mapua thi dingkon ho ataovun, Hinla Pathenin ataonau imab agelpoi! 13 Khova deimo mihem aum’un, Het din jong agel pouvin, jui din jong akhohsah pouve! 14 Tolthat chu jingpi tah-in athouvin, Tha din vaichate ahol’in, jan teng aguchai! 15 Numei jonpi chun khomut ave-lhin, Min amumo na din amai akitom’e! 16 Jan teng guchaten inbang aphevangun, Sun khovah teng akiselji tauve! 17 Sun khovah agingun, Muthima akichapouve!”ati.

Zophar

18 “Migilou chu twisoh-in alhoh-in, Agam leisset’jong Pathenin agaosap-in, Alengpi leiya jong Natong din akontapoi! 19 Buhbang nisan ajolsah a huiyin atolmang bangin, Chonsete jong mihing gamsunga abeijitai! 20 Anu jengin jong agelpha tapon, Thinglong lung neh bangin thanjangten anejouji tai! 21 Meithaite abolgima, chabei numei akhoto loujeh a Achunga hitobang thil shoji ahi! 22 Pathenin athanei nan mihat jong asumangin, Pathenin abol teng migilou athijie! 23 Pathenin ahinghoiya alungmon sah thei, Hinla avet lhih jing jeng ahibouve! 24 Migilou akhantou vangin, Changpal kisih tan le hampa bangin agop loiji tai! 25 Hiche hi kon aseilep theiya, Kasei ho adih louna seichen thei koi ham?”ati.

Job 25

1 Shuh mi Bildad chun adonbut’in: 2 “Pathen chu thanei tah ahin, Japin gin cheh ding ahi; Van a Alenggam sunga jong Cham alensah jinge! 3 Pathen kinbol Vantilte simjou ding koi hiya, Pathen khovah-in asalvah loukom hoilai ham? 4 Pathen angsunga dihjou ding koi hiya, Numei sung peng akoma thengjou ding koiham? 5 Pathen mitmun lha jong avah chenpon, Asite jong avah thengpoi! 6 Achutileh thanjang le lungtol tobang Mihem hi Pathen angsunga ipi hintem?” ati.

Job 26

1 Job’in adonbut’in: 2 “Vaicha le lhasam tah keima Neikithopi nau apha behseh jenge! 3 Keitobang mi-ngol hi nahetna neihil’in, Phatah-in thu neimop tai! 4 Koipen nagijou dia chujat naseiya, Kon nathumop’a hitobangpi hi nasei ham?” ati.

Bildad

5 “Lei noiya twito jouse akithingin, Twipi le asunga cheng jouse akichauve! 6 Pathen maiya noimigam jong akihongsa, Husih beiya akeova kijam ahi! 7 Pathenin sahlam vanthamjol ajamdoh-in, Leiset jong onghoma akhaithoi! 8 Pathenin twipi hi meilhangin ajeldoh-jin, Aki-ngapna meibol jeng jong apojalsah hih-e! 9 Lha jong atomjol jin, Meilhang abol khumsah jie! 10 Pathenin twipi chunga velkol ajel’in, Sun le jan ahomkhen’e! 11 Pathenin apho tengleh Vanthamjol khompi jouse kichan akithing jiuve! 12 Athahat’in Twikhanglen aphoh thip’in, Achihnan kiletsahte asu-thip’e! 13 Vanthamjol amut thengsel jin, Akhut’in gulpi kithol janglai athil paiye! 14 Hicheng hi athahat kihetna them khat, Athusa kijamai mai bou ahin, Pathen lal loupin akon ahetjou jai ding ham?” ati.

Job 27

1 Job’in aseiban ajop paiyin: 2 “Adih a thu eitanpeh nomlou, Hin gentheiya eihinsah Hatchungnung Pathen min a kitep kahi! 3 Hai theina hinna hu eipea Pathenin eihinsah laisen, 4 Thu gilou seipong ting, Thujou him him seiponge! 5 Nangho la dihsah naisai pong ting, Kathi ni geiya monabeiya kisei ding kahi! 6 Kadihna la lhaso pong ting, Lung opkaina him him jong kaneipoi! 7 Eidouva eikinahpi jousen Migilou midih lou bangin talen man cheh hen! 8 Pathenin ahinkhou athum teng Pathen hephaloute dia kinepna i-um am? 9 Gentheina hung lhun teng Pathenin atao nau ngai nantem? 10 Pathen kipana ngai chaiuvin tin, Ahenga tao jing teiyunte! 11 Pathen thahat thilbol thei hil’ung ting, Hatchungnung Pathen thilgon hilchen unge! 12 Amavang namusa cheh-u ahitan, I-bol’a ngolpao pao nahiuvam?

Zophar

13 “Migilou, pumhat’a mino chu Pathenin hitin bol’inte: 14 Chapa tampi nei jongleur galmuna thisoh ding, Ason apah jouseu vaicha tahlel jing diu ahi. 15 Ahingdoh cheng jong natset’a thia, Ajiteu meithaihon aka man lou diu ahi. 16 Migilouvin dangka simden lou nei hen, Ponsil alhuh lhuh-in sejong leh; 17 Aponsil chu miphahon kisil bep’in tin, Milungdih ho adangka chang bep’inte! 18 Migilou insah chu maimom pankai beep, Loubuh kisong bep ahibouve! 19 Haotah-in kitalle le jongleh, Athodoh teng vaichat’in tunte! 20 Tijatnan alonvuh jeng diu, Jankah a khohuiyin alhoh mang diu ahi. 21 Solam khopi huiyin A-inmun’uva konin atolmangtai! 22 Jamdoh ding agot vangun, Voujang nalouvin akhup athal’in aleh-in alhoh mangtai! 23 Ajamna lam lam’uvah asemlon len, Manthahna thei hel’in ahoh kichai!” ati.

Job 28

Chihna pachat

1 Leithao lah a dangka akilaidoh jin, Sana lhahjolna mun jong aum’e! 2 Min leiset’a thih alaidoh-in, Song a konin dah-thih asoldoh-e! 3 Min muthim lah a leinoi langpeh alaiyin, Muthim lah a songpi alaidoh doh-e! 4 Ganhing lenna lou, mihem kithahna khoh lou, Mihemin leithao lah alaiyun, Khuh sunga khaovin akikhaiyun Nunglen machop thon na atongui! 5 Leicuhnga neh thei chah thei ake vangin, Leinoi lam vnag meikouva kileo abange! 6 song lah a hin songmantam sapphire akimun, Asongdi jong sanadia jeng tobang ahi. 7 Leithao kilhaina lampi chu mubongin amukhapon, Muthong jong aleng lut khapoi. 8 Chukom lamthip’a chun Sakei hihen sahang dnag hijongleh alengkhapoi. 9 Mihemin hitobang songtah lah hi alaiyin, Molsang bulpi jong akalkang theiye. 10 Songpi lah avi nauva hin Song mantam jong alaidoh-ui. 11 Twisamphung luinah dung jong alaidoh-un. Itobang thilguh um jong ahedoh-ui. 12 Ahile Chihna hoiya kimun tin, Hetkhen themna hoiya kisimdoh tantem? 13 Mihem lah a chihna kiholdoh ponte, Koiman chihna gilje ahepoi. 14 Twikhanglen le twipi lithuh laiyin jong, Twithuh laiya chihna kimudeh lou aseibouve. 15 Chihna hi sana le Dangka chohjou jong ahipoi. 16 Ophir sana le onyx, sapphire song mantam Hicheng tojong hin chihna kilheh theiponte. 17 Sana sanga jong chihna manlujo, Sana dangka sanga jong mantamjo ahi. 18 Chihna hi song mantam carol. crystal chule twikohchang sanga manlujo ahi. 19 Chihna hi song mantampen topaz le Sana thengsel tojong tepi thi ahipoi. 20 Chihna hi hoiya hungkonba ham? Hoilaiya ihet khen them diu ham? 21 Ganhing khat chan amukhapon, chungleng vachan jong amupoi. 22 Thinale manthah nan jong Chihna thu thang ajah thon asei lhon’e. 23 Chihna lampi Pathenin bou ahen, Hoiya chihna kimu ding jong amun ahei. 24 Ajeh chu Pathenin van mong geiyin amudoh-in, vannoi thil jouse amusoh-e! 25 Pathenin huipi anunsah-in, Twikhanglen atetohsoh keiyin; 26 Go juhna ding mun asemtoh-in, Kolphe lampi asemjange. 27 Chuteng chihna umna aphongdoh-in, Angai nom jouse din aseiphonge. Akholtoh chet’in, Aphudet tai! 28 Chuin miho jah a Pathenin: “Chihna dia Pakai chibai boh ding, Hetkhen themna dia thilse bolda ding ahi,” ati.

Job 29

Job’in achungthu asei chaina

1 Job’in aseiban ajop kit’in: 2 “OPathenin eina khohsah lai Kahinkho chu kile kit thei leh kati! 3 Pathenin einalhonpi jingin, Muthim lah jot jong leng eisalvah jinge! 4 Chulai chu kaphat thei lai nikho ahin, Pathento kakijol’in ka-insung avengtup jinge! 5 Hatchungnung Pathenin eina umpin, Kachaten eina-um chah kheh-ui. 6 Kabongpi le kakelpi ho noitwi alhingin, Song-hol lah jenga jong ka-olive thing aphattheiye. 7 Khosung upate kikhopna chan a Ken jong tou mun kalon kapang jinge! 8 Khangdong hon lam ei-ot teiyun, Eija nan upate adin gdoh jiuve. 9 Japi lamkaite geiyin athip chet’un, 10 Athupipen ho jeng jong paopoh uhsa aumpouve. 11 Ka-umchan ja ho hihen eimu ho hileh, Abonchauvin katoh phat sei ding anei cheh-ui. 12 Vaichate atao tengu kapanpi teiyin, Suhna ding helou chagate kapanhui. 13 Genthei chungnung ten eipah Chauvin, Meithaite kakithopin along mongui. 14 Kitoh tah le dihtah-in Thil kabol’in thu katanjie. 15 Mitchote mit’in kapangin, Elbaite kengin kapange! 16 vaichate pan kapangin, Maljin gentheiho kakithopi. 17 Mi-engsete kasu-lhan, Amibolseteu kahuhdoh jie. 18 Sottah hinga inlum a Thi din bou kakinem’e. 19 Nanou jing jeng thingphung, Twi nomna leipha lah a keh tobang kahi. 20 Mitinin eivah choiyin, Katha alhasam kha hih hel’e. 21 Mi thu kamop teng, japi athip chet’un, Kasei phaten angai cheh-ui. 22 Kasei chaisoh tengleh seibe ding aneipouvin, kathusei gobah lha abngjie. 23 Chavang laiya loubol min gotwi ahomtho bangin, Mitinin kaseiho adei cheh-uve. 24 Kinepna aneilou tengu nuiheuvin kaven, Kamail lhaisel chun atilkhouji tauve! 25 Thu neitah-in atoh diu kasempeh-in, Lengpan sepaite alamkai bangin kalamkaiyin, Alung lhahna chan’uva kalhamonji’e!

Job 30

1 Hinla kasanga dongjo chengin eidai thangun, Apateu jong pannabei jeng, kelngoi chinga kikoi Uichate toh kivop dia jong kadeimo jeng ahiuve. 2 Mi meisan mithabei jeng ahiuvin, Imacha eibolpeh thei jong aumppouve. 3 Akelthi diu tengleh Janlaiyin gamlah munthip’a thing jungmot pou aket’uve. 4 Gamthip laiya hamjung pou, Tuile al neilou longlao bal pou akibo’uvin aneuve. 5 Gucha kihoh dal bangin, Amupha chanin ahohdal’un adeljam’ui. 6 Songko dunga achengun, Songpi pang dunga akisel’ui. 7 Gamlah a ganhing bangin a-aocheh chuh-un, phaiphung noi dung pouva ageh-ui. 8 Pannabei, minbei, imacha hilougol, Gamsunga nodohsa jeng ahiuve. 9 Tun eihung nuisat leuvin, Atot nopna diu bep kahi-ong! 10 Imacha sah louvin eibol’un, eijamsan’un, Kamaichanga chil eiset khum jengui. 11 Pathenin eisuh lhah a panpi beiya eikoijeh hin, Lung hangtah-in eidoutauve! 12 Hite ho pi hin sel del’in eidel’un, Nokhong kheh din eidel del jenguve. 13 Kajamdohna ding lampi akhah-un suhmang din eigouve; Aphoh tang diu jong koima aumpoi. 14 Kapal vangkah dunga ahung lut’un, Tolte eichil that ha jengui. 15 Kakicha behseh tan, kaloupina la abeitan, Kanei kagou jouse meilhang kitolmang bep ahi. 16 Tua vnag thi ding kahitan, Kanat oldomna ding jong aumtapoi. 17 Jan teng kagu kachangin eichip’in, Kanat jong a-oldom deh poi. 18 Pathenin kalochangin eimanin, Kaponsil eivei-lhop peh tai. 19 Bon-ngan lah a eileh lut’in, bonlhoh beh kahitai! 20 Vo Pathen nahenga kataovin, Nangin neihoupoi! 21 Engse tah-in neibol’in, Nathanei sunin neibolgimtai. 22 Huipi neilhohsah sah jengin, Khopihuiya neileh lenglei. 23 Athi dia neibol kahenai. Mihem thina jon’a neipui ahi. 24 Manthahna geisa, thildang beiya lungset thum bep Hitobang mihem hi idia nadel khum khum ham? 25 Akapte kakapi dam? Angaichate kapehda khah am? 26 Lung navah a nopna kakineppin, Lung jinna le muthimin eilhundentai. 27 Nat lung gim a thipai ding kahitan, Ani nin kanat akhoh cheh cheh jenge! 28 Lung navahna bei, lung jingin kavah len, Japi lah a kadingin panpi kathum’e! 29 Kagim behseh tan kamkei hamin kahamin, Va-ngongsao maovin kamaove! 30 Kagu kachang nan kakhosih-in, Katicuhng adupsoh tai! 31 Kipana tumging thei gin ka-ngai ngaiya, Tun vang lunghem a kagin bou kajatai!

Job 31

1 Nu-ngah him him jonlunga kavet louna din Kalung giltah-in kakitep’e. 2 Hatchungnung Pathenin i-eilo jiuva, Mihem tohman ipi apeh jim? 3 Thildih lou bolte chu Hamsetna le manthahna alhunkhumsah-e. 4 Kabol katoh Pathenin ahesoh keiyin, Kakalsonna chan jong amu jinge! 5 Thilse bolloudia kihahsel kahin, Midang jou lhep loudia kihahsel kahi. 6 Pathenin kitoh chet’in tetoh leh Monabei kahi mudoh tante. 7 Lamdih kapeldoh ham, Thilse kabolnom ham Kakhutte ni jong Thilse kibolnasa ahikhah leh, 8 Kamuchi tusa gamlha jeng hen, Kasemsa an midangin nehen! 9 Ka-inhengpa jinu kadeichat’a, Akptphunga kachan lhih khah leh, 10 Kajinun pasal dang an honpeh hen, Achunga pasal dang lum hem! 11 Ajeh chu hitobang chonset hi Thina thei tale peh dia lom mong ahi. 12 Talen chu damun meikong, Kanei kagou kavam thei manthahna ahi. 13 Lhacha kiphin aum jongleh Ka-ngaiyin phaten kabolpehjie. 14 Bolpeh da leng Pathen iti kamua, Pathenin kathu atan teng iti kihon tang-em? 15 Keima eisema Pathen chun Kalhachate jong asem ahi. 16 vaichate la kakithopi jingin, Meithai khatcha jong lung lengvaiyin kakoipoi. 17 Keiman kaneh laisen la Chagate nelouvin kakoipoi. 18 APenlhah a anun adalhah a pat, Apau bangin kahinvah khange. 19 Vaicha lhasam, Nihchen ponsil cholel kamu leh, 20 Keima kelngoi kul’a kisem mong mong, Samulpon kasilpeh teng eivahchoi cheh-ui. 21Thutamna phunga kajotho ding hesaa Chaga khattou kalep boll eh, 22 Kabanjangte ni kivobang jeng hen, Kalengkoute nia koin kisat lha hen, 23 Pathenin talen eipeh ding kagingin, Hitobang thilse hi bol ponge. 24 Neile gou, sana dangka Kakisonpi ngaipon; 25 Kahaona chengse jong hi Hoithonan kanei khapoi. 26 Nisa vah jong kahou khapon, Lha mel-hoi jong chibai kabohpoi. 27 Nisa lhathah hou din eikilhem lhapon, Ni le lha hounan kakhut kachop khapoi. 28 Hita bolna hin Hatchungnung Pathen ataitomin, Abol’a chu thina thei talen matsah lom ahi. 29 Kamelmate genthei kakipapi khapon, Hamset atotengu nom kasa khapoi. 30 Kamelmate thina dia taova, Hitobang chonset chu bol louhel kahi. 31 Maljin ho kalhunsah jing hi Kanatong jousen ahesoh keiyui. 32 Kholjin jouse in a kalhunsah jin, Kholai dung tol-lhanga alum khapouve. 33 Min achonset asel cheh-un, Kenvang kasel ngaipoi. 34 Japin eidem ding jong kagingpon, Mihouset ginnan kot kal lhah louvin kaumthim ngaipoi. 35 Koiman kasei eingaipeh lou ding ham? Adih cheh kaseiye, Hatchungnung Pathenin eidonbut hen! Min eiheh nau hi kasim thei dia Kijihdoh soh keiya kikoi hileh, 36 Kiletsahpi tah a kalengkouva kaput ding, Kalua lallukhuh banga kakhuh ding ahi. 37 kabol chan Pathen seipeh ing ting, A-angsunga kalu kadosangsah le ding ahi. 38 Kaloumun leiset hi Aneipaa kona kaguh thoa, 39 Hiche lousoh gilkel kathohsah leh, 40 Suhlou chang le sakol chang khel’in Lingle khao hung keijo hen!” ati. Job thusei akichaitai.

Job 32

Elihu thusei

1 Job chu ama them akichansoh hel phat’in, akinelpi pasal thum chun donbut louvin akoitauve. 2 Ahin akihouvu ngaiya pang, Ram phunga Buz insunga Barakel chapa, Elihu chu along hangtai. Ajeh chu Job’in Pathen mo apeh a amajoh them akichan hi nom asapoi. 3 Job golte mi thum chunga jong along hange; ajeh chu Job anel lhah thei louvu hin Pathen chu themmo dol’in akilange. 4 Alah a chun Elihu hi adongpen ahin, midang seichaisoh angah-in ahi. 5 Mi thumin Job adonbut thei lou phat’un, along hangtan, 6 thu aseipantai.

Elihu

“Nang ho upa nahitauvin, kei khangdong kahi nalaiye, Hijeh hin kalunggel sei ding jong kati ajai. 7 UPa domin naseiyuva, Khanglui dominchihna nahil diuva kagel ahi. 8 Hinla Hatchungnung Pathen Lhagao chu Mihem chunga hung chua chihna apeh ahibouve. 9 UPat man a mi chinga jong ahipon, Kum tam man a ima kihethem deh jong ahipoi. 10 Chapang jong leng kasei ngai leu chun kadeiye, Kalunggel seipeh-unge. 11 Naseiyu ka-ngai nagi jengin, Thu ngei ngei nahol’u jong ka-ngah-e. 12 Phatah a ka-ngai vangin, Khat chan jong Job nanel lhapouve. 13 Iti kachinge nati thei diu ham? Nanel lel’u ahitan, Pathenin Job donbut nante. 14 Job chu nang ho to kihou nahiuvin, kei eihoupoi; Hijongle nang ho donbut bangin donbut ponge. 15 Thu asei khel soh tauve, Job; Nadonbut thei pouve! 16 Sei din gbon neitalou ka-nga nah lai ding ham? Sei ding helouvin amoh dintauve. 17 Kenjong donbut ing ting, kalunggel kasei ding ahi. 18 Seikal ka-nga lel thotan, Kalungin kadoljou tapoi. 19 Kho-ngaisot leng, lengpitwi thah-in Savun peng atumkeh banga kapojal thei ahi. 20 Ka-ngah jou tapoi.Seijeng tange! 21 Langkaina jong nei pong ting, Koima jong lhemlha ponge! 22 Mi lhep lhahje jong kahepon, Lhem jong leng Pathenin eisuhmanglo ding ahi.

Job 33

1 Ahile tun Job, Kasei ding hi lunglut tah-in nagiphan. 2 Ipi hijongle kalunga akgel hi Seidoh jeng dinga kigoa kahitai. 3 Lung thengsel’a Thudih tah sei kahi. 4 Pathen Lhagoavin einasemin Eina hinsah ahi. 5 Naki-nga chat le neidonbut’in, Neinelna ding kigeltoh chet’in. 6 Pathen mitmua nang le kei thakhat ihin, Leivuiya kisemdoh cheh ihibouve. 7 Neiginna ding jong aumpon, Kenjong jothon bol ponge. 8 Nangin naseipen tah Kajahsa chu hiche ahi: 9 ‘Bol khel kaneipon, kathemmopoi; Monabei, chonsetna neilou kahi. 10 Pathenin eidouva, Melma banga eibol ahibouve. 11 Kakeng thih khaovin ahenin, Kakal chalna ave-lhi keove,’ nati. 12 Naseikhel heltai, Job: Pathen chu mihem sanga chungnungjo ahi. 13 Idia mihem kiphinna nahsah loudan a Pathen na-oimo ham? 14 Pathenin avel vel’a asei vangin Asei koiman nagisah-in aneipouve. 15 Mihem jan ihmut lanin jong Pathenin amangule Themgao thilmua thu aseiye. 16 Athusei mihemte ajahsah teng, Agihsaln aho jal’in atijauve. 17 Achonset jom louna diuva Pathenin asei ahin, Akiletsahda na diuva apho ahi. 18 Amanthahsah nom lou ahin, Thina theiya kona huhhing agot ahi. 19 Mihem adih dohna din Pathenin anatsah jin, Ati pumpi adammosah jie. 20 Adam louvin ima aduchapon, Antui tah mu jongle achil pulpoi. 21 Atahsa agongte tul’in, Agu aching keobou ahitai. 22 Lhankhuh sung jon ding kon, Mithigama kumsuh ding kon ahitai. 23 Mihemte toh ding hiljia Pathen Vantil asang sang lah a Khattouvin vang ahung panpi thei ahi. 24 Ahepi jeh a Vantil chun, ‘Lhadoh tan, Alhatdoh man aumnai, mithigam jotsuhda ta hen,’ ati thei ahi. 25 Chuteng ati noudoh kit’a, Atha hung kiledoh kit ding ahi. 26 Atao teng Pathenin houvintin, Kipah a Pathen ahou ding, Pathenin ijakai aboltoh peh ding ahi. 27 Aman japi lah a, ‘Kachonsen, thil dihlou kaboltai;Hichan jong hin Pathenin eihing hoiye. 28 Pathenin mithigam a eisol loulai jeh-in, Tugeiyin kahing nalaiye.’ 29 Hichengse hi Pathenin Mihem chunga avel vel’a abolji ahi. 30 Mikhat ahuhhing jin nomtah-in ahinsahjie. 31 Job, kasei hi ngaiyin lang, Umthimin ken seiyinge! 32 Seiding nanei vang leh seiyin, Them kachansah nom lheh nahi. 33 Seiding nanei loule ngai thimin, Chihje nahil inge,” ati. 33.11: Job 13.27 33.15: Job 4.13

Job 34

1 Elihun asei pai kit’in: 2 “Naching them thei lheh-ui, Tun kei sei ding hi ngaiyun! 3 An tui le tui lou kamsungin atep bangin, Thu ngei le ngei lu nabengin angaiye. 4 Hijeh chun thildih lhengu hitin, Thilpha datkhen temu hite. 5 Job them akichan nah vangin, Pathenin them achan nompoi. 6 Job’in, ‘Monabon kinei lou Jouseiyin bou eikigeltan, kachonset lou vangin Talen hah tah eikipetai,’ ati. 7 Pathen jabol louhel Job tobang mihem umkham? 8 Migiloute to bou akivop’in, Chonset toh akijot lei! 9 Pathen lungdei juigot hi A-itih a thilphan aseipoi. 10 Ima hethem nang hon kasei ngai phauvin, Hatchungnung Pathenin thil dihlou abol ngaiyam? 11 Pathenin miho atohman apeh cheh a, Achan diu lom achansah ahi. 12 Hatchungnung Pathenin itih-in thilse abolpon, Koima adih louvin abol ngaipoi. 13 Pathenin athaneina hi koi koma apalah ham? Kon Pathen chu vannoi poh theina tha apeh theiyam? 14 Pathenin mihema konin alhagao kilah hen, Hat theina hu kinung lah kit leh; 15 Mihing jouse thin tin, Leivui lesokit diu ahitai! 16 Miching nahileh Kasei ngaiphan! 17 Pathen dihtah chu mo nachansah a, Thudih ahot banga nagel ham? 18 Agitlouva aphatchom lou tengu Pathenin leng ho le vaihomte themmo achansahjie. 19 Mitin sempa ahijeh-in Pathenin Vaihomte panpia vaichate douna mihao panpi ahipoi. 20 Mihem hi jan ihmut lan a thi thei. Pathenin aden teng dihlhuh a mangthah thei, Mihat lai lai jong Imacha louhel’a atha thei ahi. 21 Pathenin mihem kho-lhah Kalson amelchih jinge. 22 Chonse kiselna din Khojin muthim jong ajingpoi. 23 Itih tah le mihem thu atanpeh ding Pathenin phat tep angaipoi. 24 Lamkaite haisah a akhel diu holna din, Het khel kholtoh khoh angaipoi. 25 Pathenin mi natoh ahe cheh-in, Jan kah-in akhup athal’in aleh-in asugoijitai. 26 Michonsete chu japi mitmun Pathenin ajep cheh jin ahi. 27 Ajeh chu Pathen nung ajui tapouvin, Athupeh chengse adonda tauve. 28 Vaichate Pathen henga akasah-un, Pathenin ataonau asangin panpi agoi. 29 Pathenin ima bolda agot teng Kon a-oimo theiyam Akihei mang tengleh Mihemin suhna ding heponte. 30 Pathen hephaloute achunguva avaihom teng, Namtin vaipin jong alonaje hepouvinte. 31 Job, nachonset jouse Pathen koma naphondoh a, Chonse kit loudia kitep nahitah em? 32 Namona chengse Pathenin navetsah dia nathuma, Thilse bol loudia nom nahitah-em? 33 Pathen thilbol bon deilou, Nadei nabolpeh ding kinam nahi nah em? Nathu thu ahi, kei kahipoi; nagel gel seidoh jengin! 34 Lung gel thei jouse nomteiyin tin, Kasei ngaiya miching jousen: 35 ‘Job hin hetoh louva asei ahin, Asei jouse lah thei aumpoi, tinte. 36 Job sei jouse hi geltoh chet’un, Asei jouse hi migilou thusei tobang ahi. 37 Achonset besen Pathen doumah abol’in, Imaichanguva Pathen ataitom jenge!” ati.

Job 35

1 Eluhun aseibe nalaiyin: 2 “Job, Pathen angsunga monabeiya Nakisei jeng hi nadihpoi! 3 Chule Pathen koma, ‘Kachonset loule ipi phachom a, Kachonset le na—ilou ham?’ nati hi adihpoi. 4 Nang jong donbut ing ting, Nagol napaite jong kahouset ding ahi. 5 Vanthamjol khu vetemin, Meilhangho khu vena sang thei lheh-e! 6 Chonse jongle chun Pathen din ima aloupoi. Thil bol khel jongle chun Pathen asuh khah am? 7 Dih lheh le chun Pathen ahu theiyem? Nanga konin Pathenin imacha angaichapoi. 8 Nachonset teng namihem chanpin athoh lel’in, Thilpha nabol leh aphatchompi, 9 Mihemin bolset ato teng na asauvin, Ahuhhing diu akouvui! 10 Agenthei pettah-uva kinepna pathei ASempau Pathen heng ajonpouve. 11 Ju le va, ganhing sanga eichihsah thei Chihna eipeu Pathen heng ajonpouve. 12 Agit louva akiletsah jeh-un, Panpi angeh vangun Pathenin adonpouve. 13 Pannabeiya kap a peng nahiuve; Hatchungnung Pathenin ajapon angaipoi. 14 Job, Pathen namuthei louvin seidan, Lung nengtah-in ngah-in a-ang sunga nathu alhungtai. 15 Pathenin chonset khohsah louva, Talen amatsah louvin nagel’e. 16 Napao pao jong pannabei ahi, Hetoh louva thusei nahi akichentai,” ati.

Job 36

1 Elihun aseibe kit nalaiyin: 2 “Lung nengtah-in kho-ngai jep’in, Pathen thalhenga kasei hi ngaiphan. 3 Kahetna ajaovin, Eisempa dihje Vetsahnan kahet bangin seiyinge, 4 Najah a jou khatcha kaseipoi; Namasanga miching tahbeh namutai. 5 Pathen itihat hitam! Koima anahsahmo pon, Ahet lou thil khatcha aumpoi. 6 Chonsete ahinghoi ngaipon, Vaichate adih-in abol jinge. 7 Midihte ahong jingin, leng bangin vai apohsah-in, Tonsot’in jabol achansahjie. 8 Hinla miho achonna dungjuiya Thihkhaova kihen amudoh tengleh, 9 Pathenin achonsetnau leh Akiletsah nau avetsah jie. 10 Thilsea kona akihei mangna diuvin Miho chu agihsal jin ahi. 11 Pathen thu angaiyuva alhacha apan’u leh, Ahao theiyun along mongui. 12 Achutilou leh khopho louvin athiuvin, Mithigam jonin luipi agalkaiji tauve. 13 Pathen heloute chu along hang jingun, Talen amat’u jongle panpi ngaiyin atao pouve. 14 Khangdong lai laiyin athiuvin, Mi maiya jumle ja thoh-in aum’ui. 15 Pathenin vang thoh gimna hi mihil nan amangin, Gentheina hi kho muthei nan amange. 16 Pathenin gimna konin napuidoh-in lang mongin nakoiyin, Nadokhang chung neh le chah adimtai. 17 Tun nachan ding lomin Talen namantai. 18 Nehguh jeh alhep chatvaiya naum louna ding, Hao deichat jal’a navamang louna din ching theiyin. 19 Panpi ngaiyin peng jongle chund phachom pontin, Nathahat’in jong ima boldoh peh theiponte. 20 Namtin vaipi manthahna ding, Jan hung lhun ding kinem hih-in. 21 Thilse nabol louna dia genthei kithohsah nahi. 22 Pathen thanei loupije geldoh-in, Ama mihil them chungnungpen ahi. 23 Pathen chu thilse bol’a moso thei le Abol ding hil masa thei koi ham? 24 Atohna chung aseiphat aching jingin, Nangin jong navahchoitei ding ahi. 25 Mitinin athilbol amucheh-in, Koiman vang ahejou jaipoi. 26 Aloupina kihechen joupontin, Akum jong kisim thieponte. 27 Leiset’a kona twi chopdoh a, Gotwiya hinjuhsah kitji Pathen ahi. 28 Mitin namtin dia hung ju-lha din, Meilhang lah a konin gotwi ajuhsah-e. 29 Pathen chenna vanpi kinim le Meilhang kitolle koiman ahetheipoi. 30 Vanthamjol’a kol aphetsah nan, Twikhanglen lithuh laila athim jing theiye. 31 Hitia hi Pathenin mipi avah jinga Neh le chah neng jeng junga apeh ahi. 32 Akhut’in kehchang achoiyin, Adoina mun sepkha din alhai. 33 Khopihui hung ding teng van akinimin, Ganchaten ahung ding aheuve.

Job 37

1 Hichea hin keijong kalung ling laovin, kalungchang achomdoh deh deh jenge. 2 Nabonchan Pathen ogin khu ngaiyuvin, Akamsunga kon van kinimpi khu! 3 Leiset mong langa kon lang khat geiyin, Vanthamjol’a kol aphetsah-e. 4 Chuteng a-ogin akijan, Van-gin kithong chutoh keh kisep akimui. 5 Pathen thusah jal’in datmo umtah thil asoh-in, Ihet thei louvu thil kidang asoh-e! 6 Leiset chunga buhbang alhahsah-in, Gobah le gose ajuhsah jin ahi. 7 Pathen natong jing ahi ahetdohna diuvin, Mihemte natoh avohaijin ahi. 8 Gamsa jousen jong abusing Akosung, age na akijot cheh-ui. 9 Lhanglama konin khopihui ahung nungin, Sahlama konin phalbi dap hui ahung nunge. 10 Pathen nahlai husan twipi amut leh, Twiho chu geltwi asohjie. 11 Pathenin meilhang lah ameilom asel’in, Meilom ho apokeh teng kol pheji ahi. 12 Meilhang ho hi Pathen deiyinakitol len, Vannoi gamtina Pathen lungdei abol’ui. 13 Leiset chapnou dia Pathenin go ajuhsah ahin, Mihem bolgimna le lungsetna go amanchah thei ahi. 14 Chomkhat kho-ngaiyin phaten nagiton-in. 15 Pathenin thu apeh a kol aphetsah Hiti ho hi nahet chet mong nah am? 16 Pathen thilbol kidang tah, Vanthamjol’a meilhang kitol dan nahet the-em? 17 Lhanglam khohuiyin leiset ahinsem hoh teng Gamsa nathoh lel ding chubou nahei. 18 Pathen banga nangin vanthamjol Phatvet banga dumje ju khu najamdoh theiyam? 19 Lungthima ima kicop pouvin sei idng kaneipouve. Pathenkoma kasei diu neihil’un. 20 Pathen to kihou ding ka-ngap chapoi, I-bol’a kakisuhmangsah ding ham? 21 Vanthamjol avah behseh-in kave-ngampouve, Khopihuiyin amut thengsel’e. 22 Sahlama sana vah chansel bangin akimun, Tijat umtah Pathen loupina vah chun eisalvah-ui. 23 Pathen thahat anasan kanai ngampouve, Adih-in thudih jengin mi abol’e. 24 Mitinin agin cheh ding mong ahi, Kichihsah ho vang iman agelpoi,” ati.

Job 38

Pakaiyin Job adonbut

1 Khopihui chimpei lah a konin Pakaiyin Job ahindonbut’e:

Pakai

2 “Kichihna song lel nang koi nahiya, Khopho louva thu hijat sei nahim? 3 Pasal nahileh dingdoh-in, kadoh chan neidonbut ding ahi. 4 Vannoi kasemdoh a chu naum am? Hijatpi nahet leh neiseipeh temin! 5 Vannoi itea sem ding kon aboltoh a, Kon atetoh ham nahet le seiyin! 6 Leiset khonpiho ipi chunga kitunga, Vannoi bulpi ning songkhom koi phu ham? 7 Chuche ni jinglah chun ahsi ten la asauvin, Van miten kipah-in asem’ui. 8 Twikhanglen twipi akoa kona alonjal ding teng Akotpi kamkhuma ting bingjia koi ham? 9 Twikhanglen meilhanga tomjol a, Muthim lhangkhal a sel chu Kei kahi! 10 Twikhanglen gamgi kasempeh-in, Kulpi kot kakam khumtai. 11 ‘Hichan gei hin veiyin lang, Hichan a bou natwidil ka-nga ding,’ katipeh-e. 12 Job, mahinkho sunga hi Nikhat beh jong jinglah khovah dia naseipeh-em? 13 Leiset pumpia kho vahsah a, Migiloute kiselna muna deldoh dia naseipeh khah am? 14 Sun khovah hin mol le lhang akimun, Ponsil kijal bang le leingan a mohor kinam bangin akimui. 15 Sunlai khovah hi migiloute din akichen behseh-in, Pumhat change thilbol angampouve. 16 Twikhanglen laigil twisam putna nache khah a, Twikanglen tonoi lama navale khah tah-em? 17 Noimigam mithikhul kotpi Kelkot pung dung navetsah tah-uvem? 18 Vannoi hi ite pham? Nahet leh neiseipeh-in. 19 Hoiya kona kho hungvah a, Muthim kipatna bulpi nahet-em? 20 I-chan geiya nasol theiya, Nalesol kit thei ding ham? 21 Vanno kisemdoh a bon anaumta a, Hibanga upate bol theiteiyin nate! 22 Buhbang le gelchang kakholna Hiche kikholna chu namu khah tah-em? 23 Gim hesoh ni le gal nikhoa Manchah dia kakhol khom ahi. 24 Nisa hung konna nagavet khah a, Solam khohui hung nun patna navet khah hitam? 25 Gotwi lonna ding kon asempeh a, Kehchang lhahna ding lampi kon asem ham? 26 Mihem chenna louhel nelgam geiya Go juhsah jing thei koi ham? 27 Hampa louhing hin theina dia Tolgo lah chapnouna dia go juhsah koi ham? 28 Geltwi le daitwi hin Ahinga Pa anei ngap lhon ham? 29 Geltwi le daibang Hinga anu lhon koiham? 30 Geltwi le daibangin twi chu song asosah-in, Twikhanglen chunga akidalsah jie. 31 Ahsi bombel ho khu nakan gom theiya, Ngambom lungthu ahsi khu nalhap kang theiyam? 32 Kum kiheichin hetna dia ahsi nalamkai theiya, Ngambom uichal ahsi len le neo nahil thieyam? 33 Vanthamjol’a kimang Danho nahet’a, Hiche Dan ho hi leiset’a naman theiyam? 34 Meilhang ho nahohsal theiya, Twi napehna dia nakou lhah theiyam? 35 Kol naphetsah thei leh Najah a, ‘Nathun kanunge,’ ati ding hinam? 36 Nile vadung twilet ding vachate seipeh koi hiya, Gojuh ding ahchal hilmasa koiham? 37 Meilhang simna theiya ching koi hiya, Gotwi sosah theiya ching koi hiya, Gotwi sosah theiya choh chamthei, 38 Gotwi chu leivui chapnou sah a, Bon ngan sosah thei koiham? 39 Sakei te ding neh le chah namupeh a, Sakeinou gilkelte navahna khah em? 40 Akosunga akisel’uva, Akhuh sunga an anga tengu leh! 41 Va-ahte gilkel nahol teng vahva koi hiya, Anouten an athum teng pejia koiham?

Job 39

1 Lhangvuma kolsa nou so phat nahet’a, Sakhi nou so phat nahet-em? 2 Itih chan nou akolpi nahet’a, Anouso ding phat nahet-em? 3 Itih tah leh kol’uva Nousoh diu nahet hinam? 4 Gamlah a anoute akhangdoh-un, Avah mangun ahung kile kitji pouve. 5 Koiham gam sa-ngante jalensah a, Lhathanga vathangsah a khu? 6 Gammang lah a chensah a, Chikhuh dunga lhatsah a Kei kahi! 7 Khopi husa kijah phah louna aum’un, Koiman vah a natohsah din ajoupoi. 8 Lhang sang dunga alhauvin, Neh din hamhing dum ahol leuve. 9 Gambong chal’in na natohpeh theiya, Nabongbuh a geh mong nam? 10 Khao nakhia lou nakaisah a, Naloulaiya langkon nakaisah theiyam? 11 Bongchal thahat nason a Na hahsa natohpeh ding naginchat am? 12 Changphal nalo khom peh a Cahngphol a nakaipeh dia nagel ham? 13 Va-ngonsaovin lha ijatvei ajap’a, Patva len alengthei nam? 14 Va-ngongsaovin tol’a tui aop’in, Leihu ahulsat sah theiye. 15 Ikhat’in achotkeh peh ding ahephapon, Gamsan aholgoi peh thei jong ahepoi. 16 Ama tui lou bangin agel’in, Hahsa tah a athah lhah jong khohsah lou bangin aum’e. 17 Hibanga ngolsah a Chihsah lou chu Kei kahi. 18 Hinla adin janga kithinga alhai leh, Sakol adeljamin achunga toupa geiyin akichai! 19 Hibanga sakol hatsah a, Angongmul bah kesah hi nang nahim Job? 20 Sakolte khaokhopi chop a chopsah a, Nah khon gin hamdeldul sah hi nang nahim? 21 Phaicham tolgo akhot’in, Galmun thal le teng lah anolut jeng jie. 22 Kichat tijat ahepouvin, Chemjam masanga gingdan ahipouve. 23 Sakol chung touho gal manchah Thal le tengkol nisan akhoval lah lah-e! 24 Lung hangtah-in sakolten maanouvin, Sumkon kimut teng adding thim theipouve. 25 Sumkon gin chai tengleh ahamin, Galmun aphah masangin Galvui nam ajan, Gal lamkaiten mano dia Lhang asap’u ajauve. 26 Mu khu lenje nahil hiya, Lhanglam nga leng thei ham? 27 Muvanlai khu molvum sang laiya Bu asahna dinga nang thupeh anga ham? 28 Songpi vum a bu akisen, Songpi khi kah chu kulpin aneiye. 29 Songpi chunga konin gamtin aven, Ganhing thaa neh ding ave-lhi. 30 Thilong phunga muthong akikhomun, Anoute thisan achop’ui,” ati.

Job 40

1 Pakaiyin Job jah a aseitei: 2 “Job, Nangin Hatchungnung Pathen nachouve, Na-ngah didng ham ahiloule nadonbut ding ham?” ati.

Job

3 “Ka-ngol thu kasei ahitai Pakai, Ipia kadonbut thei nah lai ding ham? 4 Ima ma jong keiman Seida tang’e! 5 Kasei ding abonchan kaseisoh tai, Velsei kit taponge,” ati. 6 Hichun huipi le gopi, chule chimpei lah akonin Pakaiyin Job jah a ahinseiyin:

Pakai

7 “Pasal nahileh dinginkadoh chengse neidonbut’in. 8 Kei hi moso ding neigot’a, Nang kithemsah a Kei mosah neigot ham? 9 Kei banga nahat am? Kei banga na-oginin van akithisah jouvam? 10 Najo leh, kilsetsah le gunche tah-in dingin, Minthangna le loupe nan kivontemin. 11 Mi kiletsahte khu ven lang, Lung hankhumin su-lha temin. 12 Ahi, ven lang loilhu, Migiloute adin muna noigep’in. 13 Leiset’a vuimangin lang, Mithigam a kanchahsan koiyin. 14 Chuteng Ken pahcha masapen ing ting, Najona thu sei masa pen inge. 15 Behemoth twisai khu vetemin, Ama jong nang jong kasem cheh ahin, aman bong bangin hampa anei. 16 Atahsa khi ichan geiya hat, Aphe avouva itobang thahat kisel ham! 17 Amei atun teng cedar thing tobang ahin, Amalphe ho jong atah cheh chuh jenge. 18 Agu aching jouse sum-eng tobang ahin, Akeng ho la thiljol abange. 19 Kathilsem lah a datmo umpen, Asempa Kenbou kajouve! 20 Hamhingin kavah khangin, Thinglhang gamsa lah a alhai, 21 Lingnang noi dunga akol jin, Si lah a pumpeng lah a akiseljie. 22 Lingnangho le luipanga huisum phung ho hi Ama din limin apangui. 23 Luidung soh jongle aging ppon, Jordan luipi soh jongle iman agelpoi. 24 Koipen hin amit chotsah a amat theiya, Nah vupeh a nahkhao avopeh ding ham?

Job 41

1 Leviathan khu ngakoiya nakoidoh theiya, Alei khu khaova nakan theiyam? 2 Anah hom sunga khao nathil lut theiya, Akhanoi jong thihtul’a nadotvang theiyam? 3 Nalhadohna dia nahenga taova, Nahepina dia nakoma tao ding ham? 4 Nakoma kitep’a aitih a nakinbol dia Kinoptona abol dia nagel ham? 5 Vacha banga nakhi theiya, Nalhacha nu-ngah ho kichepna napeh thei ham? 6 Nga manhon aman jat kidehna aneiyuva, Kiveihon joh dia ahoptel diu ham? 7 Alip khu ngatenga nasut theiya, Aluchang khu tenghema nasut thei ham? 8 Gaphin patep’in, bol kit ngampon nate; Kisatpi kit nom hih hel’in nate. 9 Leviathan mit a mu mai main jong Kinlih leova tol’a kisep lhu jeng ahi. 10 Akiphin hang teng akhoh a khoh, Koima kithahna ngam ahipoi. 11 Levithan kisatpia ahoidoh aumpon, Vannoi mi koiman thajou ponte. 12 Leviathan keng let dan le hatdan Naseipeh ing kate. 13 Athivun jeng jong koiman sukoh joulou, Aopvun jong kisunvang thei lou ahi. 14 Ahatu chalset sot khubang khu Kon akam akeh peh jou ding ham? 15 Atungtun vun la lumpho tobang ahin, Kimatsoh keiya songtum tobang ahi. 16 Alip jouse akijopmat soh keiyin, Alipkah a heojang cha jong lut theilou ahi. 17 Alip jouse akikilmat cheh-in, Imachan abokhen theidol ahipoi. 18 Anahhai teng meisi apahlah lah-in, Amitchang teni ma ninousoh tobang ahi. 19 Akamsunga meisi apah lah lah jengin, Meisi ahung kithotdoh jeng junge! 20 Anahhom sunga meikhu akitunglet lut’in, Beltoa tumbo kilhut khu abang jenge. 21 Ahai leh meikouvin alengin, Akamsunga mei akouve! 22 Alolchang atahbel bul’in, Akitopi akinlih deh deh-ui. 23 Avun la anemkom abeihel’in, Thihjol hekon lel hel abange. 24 Gin beihel’in alungchang tah-in, Sumhei song tah-in atah-e. 25 Adindoh teng mihat tah tah jong akichan, Kichat’a thigam pai diu ahi. 26 Asatbut ding chemjamla aumpon, Tengcha hihen thalchang hileh asunbut ding aumpoi. 27 Thihjong changpol danin agel’in, Sum-eng jong thingmot bangin agel’e. 28 Akap kina thei thalchangla abeitan, Songin kisep jongle changpol’a kisep dol’in ahei. 29 Mol jong changpol tobangin angaiton, Tengcha akikho jongleh akidai danin agel’e. 30 Aoinem lai lip ho jong bel-hal tobang ahin, Leiset chu thih-kangkuiya kihet abahsah-e. 31 Twikhanglen belphul abahsah jin, Belsunga twi sou toh abahsah-e. 32 Akhoni nung akichen veng vungin, Twikhanglen phonbem bumin alhai. 33 Leiset thil atepi thei aumpon, Gin neilouhel ganhing ahi. 34 Sahangtah jong imachan agelpon, Gamsa jouse leng ahi,” ati. 41.1:Ps 74.14; 104.26; Is27.1

Job 42

1 Job’in Pakai adonbut’in aseitai:

Job

2 “Thaneipen nahi kahei Pakai! Nangin nadeichan nabol theiye! 3 Khopholou ken Nang chihna Iti kasonlel ding ham? Kahet chet lou jeng kaseitan, Het dia nasaval ahi kei din! 4 Nasei sunga ka-ngai din neihil’in, Neidoh ho kadonbut din naseiye! 5 Hinla midangin eihil bep bou kahen, Tun vang kamit tah-in kamutai! 6 Kasei jouse kakijapin, Leivui le vutvam tobang hin lung kaheitai!” ati.

Thuchai khumkha

7 Pakaiyin Job jah a thu asei chai phat’in, Eliphaz jah a, “Kalhacha Job banga, nang le nagol te nin kachung thu nasei loujeh-in nachunguva kalung hange. 8 Tun bongchal sagi le kelngoichal sagi Job henga kaiyun lang, kilhaina gabol’uvin. Job’in nataopeh-un tin, vetda lom hijongle chun, ataona chu sanpeh-uvinge. Ama bangin nang hon kachung thu adih-in naseipouve,” ati. 9 Eliphaz le Bildah chule Zopharin Pakaiyin ahilnau bangin abol’un, Pakaiyin Job taona asangtai. 10 Job’in agolte thum ataopeh nungin Pakaiyin ama ahaodoh sah kit’in, masanga aneisanga ajat nia tamjon ahaosah tai. 11 Job sopi pasal ho le numei ho, chule agol lui ho ahungun, a-in a golvah abolpiuve. Pakaiyin abolgimna jouse chung thudol’a Job din lungmonna thu aseiyui. Mi khat khat’in sum phabep le sana khutjem khat cheh apeuve. 12 Ahinkho kipatna lam sangin ahinkho kichailam chu Pakaiyin Job phat thei ahaboh cheh-e. Job’in kelngoi sangsom le sang li avul’in, sa-ngongsao sanggup avul’in, bong sang ni avul’in, sangan sang khat avul’e. 13 Chapa sagi aneiyin, chanu thum aneiye. 14 Achanu lenpen Jemimah asah-in, aban a nu Keziah asah-in, alhumpen nu Keren Happuch asah-e. 15 Job Chanute tobanga numei mel-hoi vannoi leiset’a anaumpoi. Apauvin asopi pasalte toh gou ahop peh soh keiye. 16 Job chu kum ja khat le som li ahinbe nalaiyin, tu le tuson anei geiyin ahingin ahi. 17 Job ahing lhumkeiyin ateh thitai.

BU MASA (Labu 1-41)

Labu 1

Nun nop dihtah

1 Migiloute thumop sang lou, Chonsete umchan jomlou, Pathen taitom nomte jop lou chu Mi nun nom tah ahin; 2 Pakai Danthu nit akipapi jon, Danthu chu sun le janin asim jinge. 3 Hitobang mi hi luipanga thingphung keh, Aphat cha hung gatheiya, Anan goptih neita lou tobang ahin, Atoh lam jousea alolhing theiye. 4 Migiloute vang chuti ahi pon, Huiya vai kithe bep ahiuve. 5 Chonset jong Pathenin themmo achan a, Midihte kikhopna lha thei lou diu ahi. 6 Midihte chu Pakaiyin apuiyin ahoidamin, Migilouten vang manthahna lam ajontauve.

Labu 2

Pathen lhentum lengpa

1 Idia namtin vaipin galguh agon’uva, Pannabei thilsea pangkhom hiuvam? 2 Leiset lengten gal abol’un, Avaihomteuvin Pakai adouvun, Pathen lhentum lengpa Adoutauve. 3 “Avaihom nauva konin kiteldoh-u hitin, Eigah nauva konin kisut lhamute,” atiuve. 4 Van alaltouna konin Pakaiyin anuisat’in, Panna beiya agon jouseu adaithange. 5 Lung phamon Pakaiyin agihsal’in, Lung hangin ahoh kichasoh tai. 6 “Kalhang theng Zion a, Kalhentum leng laltouna katousah-e,” ati. 7 Lengpan, “Pakai thugahna phongdoh ing ting, Kajah a, ‘Nang hi kachapa, Tunia kahinsa nahi; 8 Thumin, namtin vaipi gou losah inge, Leiset pumpi nang ding ahi. 9 Namtin vaipi hi thih tenggol a najep cheh a, Leibel banga navohgoi ding ahi,’ tin aseiye,” ati. 10 Tun hiche thugahna hi leng hon gelphauvin, Hiche kahilna hi leiset vaihomten hethem’uvin. 11 Gingkhen chan Pakai kinbol’un, 12 Kithing thingin ahenga boh khup’uvin. Ajo le lung hang loi ding, Namanthah lo jeng diu ahi. Pakaiya kisel jingte chu Anun nom’ui.

Labu 3

Panpi ngaicha Jingkah taona

1 O Pakai, eidouva atamcheh cheh-in, Kamelma atam behseh jengtai! 2 “Pathenin panpi taponte,” tin Kamelmaten aseiyui. 3 Hijongle O Pakai, Kalumdal nahin, gal neijosah jin; Khodah ngamin neilha jingnai. 4 Othong leuvin Pakai henga kataovin, Alhang thenga konin eihouve. 5 Kalup’a ka-ihmut teng, Pakaiyin eihoidam jeh-in kathoukit jie. 6 Kamelma asang sangin eium jongleh Kagingtapoi. 7 Hung-o Pakai, neihuhhingin ka-Pathen! Kamelmate khagu suchip’in, Hapou loubangin koiyin! 8 Jo na chu Pakaiya kon ahin, Aman a mite phatthei boh jing hen! 3 Title: 2 Sam 15.13-17.22

Labu 4

Panpi ngaicha nilhah a taona

1 O them eichan a ka-Pathen, Kahung taove neihouvin! Kagimpet’in neihu jinge, Neikhoton kataona sangin! 2 Vo mihemte phat aichan geiya neijumsouva, Ichan geiya pannabei nahol’uva jouthu najui diu ham? 3 Hethem’uvin Pakaiyin midih akilhendoh tai, Ahenga katao teng eisanpeh jie. 4 Gingkhen chan um’un chonse hih-un, Janteng thip beh cha nalup naa hiti hi giltah-in gel’un. 5 Thil thengin kilhaiyun, Pakai henga ki-ngaiyun. 6 Mi tamtah atao teng, “O Pakai hamphatna neipeh beuvin, Lungset le khoton neiveuvin,” atiuve. 7 Ahinla neipeh kipana hin Neh le chah don ding haotah ho sangin Eikipasah joi. 8 O Pakai, damsel’a neihoijeh-in, Kalup teng nomsel’in ka-ihmui.

Labu 5

Hoidamna dia taona

1 O Pakai kaseiho neingaipeh-in, Katao gin ngaiyin! 2 Kithopi ngaicha kap kahi, Ka-Pathen le kalengpa! O Pakai nangbou kataona nahi! 3 Jingkah seh le kapengin najan, Nisa so teng neihou ding kinemin kataove. 4 Thilse kipahji Pathen nahipon, Thil phalouto umkhom thei nahipoi. 5 Mi kilsetsahte navetdan, Mi phaloute nahoi. 6 Jousei hatte nasu mangjin, Pumhatte le lepchete nakidah-e. 7 Nalungset kidang jeh-in Keivang nahouin a hung theiying ting, Nahouin theng sunga boh khup’ing ting Nangma jatah a kahou ding nahi. 8 O Pakai, kamelma atam behseh-e! Nadei bol din neipuiyin lang, Nalampi neijot jangsah-in. 9 Kamelmate thusei tahsan thei aumpon, Mi suhmangna ding bou adeiyuve. 10 O Pathen, mo sonlang talen pen, Athilgon’uvin kipalsah-in, manthahsah jengin. Nang douna chonset tampi aboljeh-un Na-angsunga konin delmangtan. 11 Nalim’a kiselte vang kipah jing hen, Phat tinin kipala sau hen. Nangma jeh a nom sa ahijeh-un, Na-ngailute chu hoidam jingin! 12 Pakai, nathu nit chu phatthei naboh jin, Na-ngailut chu lumbangin nadalpehjie.

Labu 6

Ginpat’a panpi ngehna

1 O Pakai, lung phamo jongle chun nei-eng boldan, Lunghang jongle chun talen neimatsah hih-in! 2 Abeipai ding kahitai, neikhoton Pakai! Kagu kachangin eichip’e, neidamsah-in! 3 Kapumpin kana behseh jenge, Kithopi louva itih chan neikoi nah lai ding ham? 4 Hungin neihuhhingin Pakai, Neikhoton thinaa konin neihuhdoh loiyin! 5 Mithi gama nangma geldoh jong aumpon, Navahchoi theiya jong aumpouve. 6 Kaha nat behseh jeh-in veipai ding kahitan, Janseh a kaka kanan ka-ulsan kajalkhun alhop jin, Kalukhap jeng jong Kamit lhin alhop jitai. 7 Kamelmaten eikasah sah nauva konin Kamit athimlon, kho kamuchen theipoi. 8 Pakaiyin kataona asangtai, Kakoma konin migiloute potdoh jengun! 9 Panpi ngaicha kakouna ajatan, Kataona asan ding ahitai. 10 Kamelmaten thina khop’a jum le ja athoh diu, Kinloi tah a kisudonguva Pathenin adelmang diu ahi.

Labu 7

Thudih deina taona

1 O Pakai ka-Pathen, neihoidam din naheng kahinjon’e, Kanung hindeltea konin neihuhdoh-in! 2 Neihuhdoh loule sakei sakai bangin eikai mangun tin, Koiman eihuhdoh joulou ding, katel kadah a eijanlo diu ahi. 3 O Pakai ka-Pathen, keiman thilse kabol khah a, 4 Kagol thilpha bol chu thilsea kathuh a, Ajeh beiya melma kachom leh; 5 Kamelmaten eihindel del jeng hen eiman hen, Eisat lih jengu hen lang, Kalong damsa tollhanga jamu hen! 6 O Pakai, lung soutenin hung kipatdoh-in, Kamelmate to kidinten, nangin neipan hun! Nangin thudih na-ngeh jinge, 7 Mitin mitang koukhomsoh-in Van a konin achunguva vaihomin. 8 Namtin thutan vaihom nangma nahi, Kadih dungjuiyin Thu neitanpeh-in O Pakai, Themmona bei kahi nahenai! 9 Pathen dih nahi, Kadeiyu le ka-ngaiyu kholtoh-in. Migiloute phatmona sutangin Miphate kipaman pen. 10 Pathen chu eihoidampa ahin, Athu nitte ahuhhing jie. 11 Pathen chu dihtah a thutan ahin, Niseh-in migilou chunga alung hange. 12 Migilouvin lung ahei louleh, Achemjam akinol hem jin; Thalpi aloiyin kamsalsan akoiyin, 13 Thal’an behsa thalchang kipat’in, Thalpi chang lheleh lah chun adoijie. 14 Ven, migilouten itobang thilse agel’u hitam!
