Gim gantheina ding agongun jou aseiyui. 15 Ahinla mi o-na dia thang akam nauva Amaho a-oh lih jiuve. 16 Athilse bol’uvin amaho asukhan, Ahusetnauvin amaho amavo lotai. 17 Adih jeh-in Pakai kathangvah-in, Chungnungpen Pakai vahchoi la kasai.

Labu 8

Pathen loupina, mihem gunche na

1 O Yahweh ka-Pakaiyu, Leiset pumpia naminthangtai! Navahchoina ogin van a akithongdoh tan, 2 Chapangte la naosen geiyin lan asauve. Namelmate dounan kulpi nakaiyin, Nadou jouse nasutang soh tai. 3 Nasemsa vanthamjol le Nagoltohsa lha le ahsi ho kavet teng, 4 Mihem hi ipi hiya hibanga nagel khoh a, Mihem chapa hi ipiham hibanga nakhohsah? 5 Nang ban tah a nakoiyin, Loupi tah-in lal lukhuh nakhuhpeh-in jabolna napei. 6 Nasemsa thil jouse chunga vai nahomsah-in, Thilsem aboncha ama noiya nakoiye: 7 Kelngoite le gancha dang ho, gamsa ho geiyin, 8 Vachate le nga jouse Twikhanglen a ganhing ho geiyin. 9 O Yahweh Ka-Pakaiyu, Leiset pumpia naminthangtai!

Labu 9

Adih jeh a Pathen thangvahna

1 Pakai, kalungthim pumpin vahchoiying ting, Nabolsa thil kidang ho seichoi lenge. 2 Nangma jal’in kipa la sang ting, Hatchungnung Pathen navahchoi la sange. 3 Nangma nahung kilah teng kamelmate anung jam’un, kisep lhun athidentauve. 4 Kitah le thudih-in thu natanin, Keijong them neichantai. 5 Namtin vaipi naphohsal’in, Migiloute nasumangjin, Geldoh kit louhel dingin Nanoi mangsohjitai. 6 Kamelmateu akichaisoh tan, Akhopi jouseu nasumangin, Koiman amaho ageldoh kit tapoi. 7 Pakai chu tonsot din alengchang tan, Thutan din laltouna atoutai. 8 Thudih-in vannoi vai apon, Namtin vaipi thu adih-in atanpeh-e. 9 Bolgentheiya umte dia Pakai hi kiselna kulpi ahin, Hesoh genthei pet’a hoidohna mun ahi. 10 Pakai, namin hesaten ki-ngai nan naneiyun, Naheng hinjon chan nadonda ngaipoi. 11 Zion a vaihom Pakai vahchoila sauvin, Athilbol namtin gaseipeh-uvin. 12 Phula them Pathenin gentheite agel jingin, Aka ginu asumilpon, abolseteu talen amatsahjie. 13 Neilungset’in O Pakai, Ven, kamelmaten eibolset nau hi! O Pakai, thinaa konin neihuhdoh loiyin! 14 Jerusalem mite masanga kadin a, Kavahchoina jeh jouse kaseipeh theina din. Neihuhhing jal’a kipah thanom ding kahitai. 15 Namtin vaipin khuh alaiyun, Akhuh laisauva alhalut’un athangkam’uva a-oh tauve. 16 Pakai chu adih a thu atanjal’in akiphongdoh tan, Migiloute vang athangkamsauva a-ohden soh tauve. 17 Pathen hephalou jouse, Migiloute aboncha thisoh hel diu ahi. 18 Angaichate donlouva kikoi koi lou ding, Vaichate kinepna jong kisumil deh lou ding ahi. 19 Hungin Pakai, mihem kijosah dan, Na-angsunga namtin vaipi koukhomin themmo pen. 20 Mihemte kiginsah-in Pakai, Thi thei mihem ahiu kihetdohsah tan.

Labu 10

Thudih deina taona

1 O Pakai, idia kidal khin khin a, Ngaichat pet leh kiselmang nahim! 2 Migiloute kiletsah-in vaichate abolseuve, Athang kamsauva osah-in. 3 Migilouvin thilse atup akiletsah pin, Mi kilosen jong Pakai ataitomloi. 4 Migilouvin Pakai aholpon, Akiletsah jeh-in Pathen agelkhohpoi. 5 Migilou chu atoh lam lama akhangtouvin, Pathen thutanna hephalouvin, amelma ahohdal thoi. 6 Migilouvin, “kelel bei hel ding, Gentheina katolou hel ding ahi,” tin agel’e. 7 Gaosap le jousei toh chule hutot to thon thu aseiyin, Geldet det louvin, thuse hotlam jeng aseiye. 8 Venglai golchih kah dudnga touvin Monabei miho that din achanglhi. Atha nom miho chu Amit lhi lhan aching jinge. 9 Sakei sachan bangin kisel’in Miho achanglhi le len, Tahlelte achang le len, Athanga a-o khah teng amanin akaimangjitai. 10 Panpaibei mi chu anoigep jin, Thahat changing avo-lhun ajamdenjitai. 11 Migilou chun, “pathenin bon khohsah lou, amit singta, eimutaponte,” ati. 12 O Pakai migiloute talen pen, Gentheite gelkhoh-in! 13 Migilouvin iti Pathen adonda a, “Talen eimatsah ponte,” ati thei ding ham? 14 Ahinla nangin namu na, Gim gentheile thoh hahsa namelchih jingin; Kithopi dinga kigosa jing nahi, Panpibei min nahinbel jin, Ngaicha geova um chu nakithopinai. 15 Migilou thilse bolte banjang vobongin, Abolkit louna diuvin thilse bolte talen pen. 16 Tonsot tonsot’a Pakai chu leng ahin, Doihoute chu agamsunga kona mangthah diu ahi. 17 O Pakai, mi lhasamte taona na-ngaiyin, Natilkhoujin nahatsah jie. 18 Bol gentheiya umte le chagate kagin na-ngai lhin, Mihemin asuh genthei kit louna diuvin athuu natan’e.

Labu 11

Pakaiya kisong

1 Kei-Pakaiya kisonga, I-atileh kajah a, “Vacha bangin molsang lama leng touvin, 2 Migilouten thalpi akamsal’un, Muthim laiya mipha ho kap din Thalchangin adoitauve. 3 Kulpi achimsoh teng Miphan ipi abol thei nah lai ding ahm?” natiu ham? 4 Pakai ahouin thenga achengin, Van a laltouna akidoi. Muntin a mitin aven, Athilbol anatoh-u ahesoh keiye. 5 Pakaiyin midih le migilou akholtoh jin, Pumhat mang ho vang alungthimin ahoi. 6 Pakaiyin migiloute chunga Kat le meikou asun khum ding, huipi savevu chu adousah ding ahi. 7 Pakai chu adih-in thildih angailui; Thildh bolte chu a-angsunga um jing diu ahi.

Labu 12

Panpi ngaicha taona

1 Neipanpiuvin Pakai, Pathen gingmi abeitan, mi kitah jong aumtapoi. 2 Jouthu jengin akihouvun, Muh them kamthemin akilhemto touve. 3 O Pakai, muh them kamthema thusei ho sutangin, Sutangin kiletsah tah a thuseiya, 4 “Kamthema ideichan kisei thei, Inop nop kiseididng, kon rikham thei diu ham?” tiho hi. 5 Ahinla Pakaiyin, “Ngaichat neiho nabol gentheiyuva, Nabolsetteu nasatah a aka jeh-un, Hung ing ting amaho hi lungmon kapeh ding ahi,” ati. 6 Pakai thutep jouse tahsan thei ahin, Dangka kisou jolsel, meiphunga kiloidoh, Vel sagi jen kisoujol tobang ahi. 7 Muntin amigilou jeng aumin, mitinin thilse bou aseiphauve O Pakai neihoidam jingun, Hiche khang mitea kon hin neihong jingun. 8 Neihoidam jingun Pakai, Hitobang mitea kon hin neichingtup’uvin.

Labu 13

Panpi ngaicha taona

1 O Pakai, itih chan nei donda a, Ichan geiya vet louva neikoi ding ham? 2 Itih chan genthei kathoh a, Ichan gei sun le jan a lung hesoh a ka-um ding ham? Ichan geiya kamelmaten eikichepna diu ham? 3 Neiven Pakai ka-Pathen, neihouvin, kamit hasah-in, neithisah hih laiyin. 4 Kamelmate chu, “Kajoutauve,” tisah dan, Kahamset hi amaho kithang-atna hisah hih-in. 5 Nalungset long louvin kaki-ngaiye, Neihuhhingna kipa pinge. 6 O Pakai, kadia naphat jal’in Navahchoi la sange.

Labu 14

Mihemte gitlouna

1 Mi-ngol’in alunga, “Pathen aumpoi,” atin ahi. Mihem jouse asesa ahiuin, Melse tah tah thil abol’un, Thildih bol’a khat cha aumpoi. 2 Van a koin Pakaiyin Cingtheiya Pathen hol’a um’am, Tin mihem chate ahinvei. 3 Mihemte lam dihlouva achesoh tan, Aphatmo nau akibang cheh-e. Thildih bol khat cha aumpon, Khat a khat cha jong aumpoi. 4 Pakaiyin, “kamite bahgam get gut’a Thilse jeng bolte hin hetna aneilou mongu hiya, Kahenga jong hung tao louhel hiuvam?” ati. 5 Pathen ngailute vang Pathenin aumpin, thilse bolte hi kichat tijat’a mah thah diu ahi. 6 Thilse bolten mi nun nem thilgon dunoh jongle, Ama chu Pakaiya kisel jing ahinai. 7 Ohe Zion akona kon Israel ahuhhing ding ham? Pakaiyin amite apuikhom tengleh Jacob dia iti kipa uma, Israel dia nun nop iti um ding hitam?

Labu 15

Pathen thil dei

1 Pakai, koiham nahouin a lut thei? Koiham, nalhang theng Zion a Nangma houtheiya? 2 Ijakaiya Pathen thu nit’a, THildih bol jing jeng; Thudih le thutah jeng seiji, 3 Midang house louhel mi, Agol apaite alam louva bol lou, Aheng akom seise lou, 4 Pathen isah loumi not thap theiya, Pakai gingte jabol jing, Itobanga hahsa hi jongleh Akitepna tuhcha a khel kit lou mi hiding ahi. 5 Amahin akan beiyin sum aphal jin, Themmonabeite hehnan nehguh akilahpoi. Koi hileh hitobanga chona thilbol mi chu Imachan asuh long louhel ding ahi.

Labu 16

Lung ngamna dia taona

1 Kahinbel’e Pathen, Neihoidamin! 2 Pakai koma, “Ka-Pakai nahin, Thilpha kanei jouse nangin neipeh ahi,” kati. 3 Pakai dia kitah mite apha thei lheh jengun, alah-uva jao ding kakipana pen ahi. 4 Doihouten gimna tampi akiboldoh-un, Akithoinauva pang pong ting, Adoiyu jong houpeh ponge. 5 Pakai, kagoulupen nang nahin, ka-ngaichat abonchan neipei; Kakhonung thu jong nakhut’a aum’e. 6 Neithilpeh chengse akidang theiyin, Abonchan apha thei lheh jenge! 7 Eithumop jing Pakai kavahchoiyin, Jan teng jongle kalunggil’in eihil chah jinge. 8 Pakaiyin eiumpi jing kahen, Naicha aumjeh-in iman eisulong ponte. 9 Hijeh hin kakipah-in katha nom’e, Chule lung mongtah-in ka-um’e. 10 Thina thahat’a konin neichudoh tan, Na-ngailut mi chu noimigama nadalhapoi. 11 Hinna lampi neihil ding, Nei-umpi kakipah-in, a-itih, a din eilung lhaisah tai.

Labu 17

Monabei mi taona

1 O Pakai, thudih lenna dia katao ngaiyin, Panpi ngaicha kakougin khohsah-in! Lung thengsel’a kataona ngaiyin. 2 Thildih nahetjeh-in Them neichanin. 3 Kalungthim nahei. Janteng neihung vil jin, Neikholchil soh keiyin, kalung sunga thilse namudoh deh poi. 4 Midang bangin thuse ka seipon, Nathupeh kanit jingin, Hutot le pumhat kamangpoi. 5 Nalampi kajui jingin, kapampot kha hih laiye. 6 Neihouji kahen nahenga kataove Pathen! Hung kihei kit’in kasei neingaipeh-in! 7 Nalungset kidangtah hinphongin neihuhhingun, Nakoma ka-um tengu kamelmateuva konin kahoidoh theiyui. 8 Namit chang bangin neihuh-in, Nalhaving noiya neisel’in; 9 Migiloutea konin neihuhdoh-in. Mithat ngam melmaten eiumchah tauve; 10 Khotona bei, kiletsah tah a thusei ahiuve. 11 Eiumchah kheh tauvin, kakiheina lam lama voh lhuh din eichanguve. 12 Sakei sachan bangin eichanguvin, Boteljeng din eigouve. 13 Hungin Pakai, kamelmate kadintepin, Akhup athal’in leh-in jouvin! Nachemjam hemhat panin Migilotea konin neihuhdoh loiyin! 14 Vannoi leiset mihaotea konin neihuhhingin, Athoh diuva nagonsa gentheina chu achate diuvin jong thoh khop hihen, Atuteuvin jong hin thoh khopset’u hen! 15 Ken vang adih lou kabol pon, Namu tei nange; Ka-ihmut khahlo teng, nei-umpi jing kipa pinge.

Labu 18

David Gal jo la

1 Vo Kahatna Pakai, Nangma ka-ngailui! 2 Pakai chu eihoidam Kakulpi dettah bang ahi. Ka-Pathen chu eihoidam ahin, Eiumpi teng kalung monge. Keidin lungdal’in apang jin, Eihuh-in eihoidohjie. 3 Pakai kakouvin kamelmatea konin eihuhdoh-e. Vahchoiyun Pakai chu! 4 Thina khaovin eikanchalsoh tan, Manthahnan lui bangin eilonvuh tai. 5 Noimigam khaovin eihenchalsoh tan, Kamasanga thina thang akikamtai. 6 Kagenthei teng Pakaiya kataovin, Eipanpi din ka-Pathen kakouve. Ahouin a ka-ogin angaiyin, Kithopi din ka-kagin ajatai. 7 Leiset akilingin akihottai; Molsang bulpi jouse akithingsoh tai. Ajeh chu Pathen lung hang ahi. 8 Pathen nahhoma meikhu akitungdoh-in, akamsunga konin mi leolih thei maikoule mei-am ahungdoh-e. 9 Vanthamjol aphetkeh-in, Meilhang jinglet lut chotphan ahungkumlhai! 10 Cherub chunga touvin hamvil’in alengin, Khopihui lhavingin mangin akilhohsah-e. 11 Meilhang thimlai akitomsah-in, Twi dimset meilhang thimket kut akitomsah-e. 12 Meilhang thimlaiya konin gel alhan, Meisi apah lah lah-in kol aphelah lah-e. 13 Pakaiyin vanthamjolpi akithinsah-in, Hatchungnungpen ogin thong akijai. 14 Thalpi chang akap’in amelmate adeljamsoh tai; Kolphe vahlap lap’in alhan amelmate anojam’e. 15 O Pakai, namelmate naphoa, Lung hanga nahohsal tengleh; Twikhanglen tochin geiyin akimun, Leiset bulpi jouse geiyin akimudoh-e. 16 Chunga konin Pakaiyin eisangin eituh-in, Lithuh laiya konin eikaidoh jie. 17 Kadoulel hel melma thahat tah, Hot le mah a eibol chengsea konin Pakaiyin eihuhdoh tai. 18 Kagenthei pet’a einokhum vangun, Pakaiyin eihoidam jingnai. 19 Kichat tijatnaa jong eipanpin, Eilung lhaijeh-in eihuhdoh tai. 20 Thildih kaboljeh-in Pakaiyin kipaman eipen, Themmonabei kahijeh-in phatthei eiboh-e. 21 Pakai Danthu kanit jingin, Pathena konin kakihei mang khapoi. 22 Adanthu kanitsoh keiyin, Athupeh kanit lou aumpoi. 23 Monabei kahiya, adihlou bol lou kahi Pakaiyin ahesoh keinai. 24 Thildih kaboljeh leh themmonabei kahijeh a Pakaiyin kipaman eipeh ahi. 25 O Pakai nadia kitahte hcunga nakitah-in, Achamkimte chunga nachamkimsoh-e. 26 Alung thengte din nalung thengin, Agiloute vang doumah-in nabol’e. 27 Mi nun nemho nahuhdoh jin, Kiletsahte vang nasuneove. 28 O Pakai, nangin thaomei neivah peh-in, Kavel’a muthim nasalvah soh tai. 29 Kamelmate nokhumna thei thaneipen, Akulpiu chop khup theina thahat neipei. 30 Hitobang Pathen, atoh jousea chamkimsoh! Asei jouse ki-ngaina thei! Ama belte dinga Lumdal apang ahi. 31 Pathen kiti chu Pakai bou ahin, Ikiselnau Songpi Pathen bou ahi. 32 Hiche Pathen hi eihetsah a, Kalampi suhong jing ahi. 33 Kakengto jong sakhi kengto abahsah-in, Molvuma dettah-in eidinsah theiye. 34 Kakhutte ni galbolje ahil’in, Kaban thahat’in sum-eng thalvhang kaheh kontheiye. 35 Pakai, neihuhhingin neihoidamtai; Nabanjet’in neituh jingin, Nathahat chun neichoi-an’e. 36 Kachotna ding lampi jaotah-in nasemin Kakisap lhu khapoi. 37 Kamelmate kadeldel jengin kamanten, Kasuhgam kahsen kahai hih-e. 38 Kasat chap soh keiyin athou thei tapouve; Ka-angsunga akijam’uvin akchotphai. 39 Galsatna ding thahat neipen, Kamelmate jona neipetai. 40 Kamelmate nadeljamin, Eihotbolte kasumangtai. 41 Kithopi ding akou vangun koiman ahuhdoh poi; Pakai henga atao vangun adonbutpoi. 42 Kachilgoisel’in, hui lhoh mang thei Leivui kabahsah tai. Kholai dung bonlhoh bangin Kakengton kachil thang thange. 43 Pakai, doumah boltea konin neihuhdoh-in, Namtin vaipi chunga vaihomin neipansah tai; Kahetphah louhel mite jong Kalhachan napansah-e! 44 Gamchom mite ka-angsunga akun’un, Kasei seiyin achon jengui. 45 Ameidoi soh tauvin, Akulpiuva konin kihotset sut’in ahung potdoh-ui. 46 Hing jing Pakai, kakiselna Songpi chu vahchoiyun! Eihuhhing Pathen loupina phongjal leuvin! 47 Aman kamelmate eijosah tan, Kadougalte eijosah-in, 48 Namtin kanoiya alutsah soh tai! O Pakai, kamelmate neijosah tan, pumhat mitea konin neihoisamtai! 49 Namtin jalah a nachoi-an ing ting, Navahchoi la sang’e. 50 Lenga atun chu Pakaiyin minthangtah-in gal ajosah-in, Adeilhenpa chu anailu jing jenge! Ddavid le ahilhahte tonsot’in angailui.

Labu 19

Athilsem’a Pathen loupina

1 Van mun jousen Pathen loupina aphongin, Vanthamjol’in jong akhutsoh aseidoh-e! 2 Tunin jing nikho aseipeh-in, Tujanin jingnilhah aseison peh-e. 3 Hetthei thucheng amansauva, Jah thei oginga apao lou vangun; 4 Ahusau vannoiya akithangsoh tan, Leiset kolkimvel’a min ajasoh tai. Vanthamjol’a Pathenin nichang din ponbuh asonpeh-in, 5 Jingkah teng jinei thah pa kipah tah bangle Kilhaitetnaa pang dingpa bangin ahung soh dohjie. 6 Vanmong lang khat’a pat Van mong lang khat ajon’e. Nisa satnaa hin thil akisel thei aumpoi. Pakai Danthu 7 Pakai Danthu hi achamkimsoh-in, Tha akidosah jie. Pakai thupeh ho hi tahsan lomtah ahin, Lungthimbeite achihsah jie. 8 Pakai Danthu chengse adih cheh-in, Hicheng nit jing hin nom asauve. Pakai thupeh chengse akicheh-in, Lungthim sunga hettheina apetheiye. 9 Pakai hou hi thilphapen ahin, Beitih anei louhel ding ahi. Pakai thutan jouse adih cheh-in, Itih-in jong aphasoh keiye. 10 Sanathengsel sanga dei umjo ahin, Khoiju thengsel sanga lhumjo ahi. 11 Hiche ho hin nasoh keima ima eihetsah jin, Kanit jeh hin kipaman kasang’e. 12 Koiman ama themmona akihetdoh loujeh-in, Kathemmona kisel chengsea konin neisil thengin Pakai! 13 Hettoh lou chonset chengsea konin neihoidoh-in, Hiche ho chu neijotho sahdan! Chuteng chonset thilsea ongthol ing ting kachamkimsoh ding ahi. 14 Kasei ding chengse le kalunggel jouse hi Nang din santhei hihen, O Pakai, Kasongpi le Eilhandampu!

Labu 20

Galjona dinga taona

1 Nagenthei nin Pakaiyin nalhamon hen, Jacob Pathenin nahoidam jing hen! 2 Amunthenga konin panpi hinsolpeh hen, Zion lhanga konin nahu ding hinsol hen! 3 Nathilto chengse sanpeh hen, Nakilhaina chengsea lung lhai hen! 4 Pakaiyin nadeichan napehen, Nathilgon jouse lolhinsah hen! 5 Chuteng keihon nagaljo kipa piuving ting, Pathen vahchoiya naminthan kalop diu ahi. Nathum na-ngeh jouse Pakaiyin nape bukimsoh hen! 6 Pakaiyin alhentum lengpa gal ajosah kahen, Avan munthenga konin ahouvin, Minthangtah a galjona ding Thahat nasatah tah apei. 7 Mi kon khat’in galsatna kangtalai ho akisonpin, Abangin asakolteu akisonpiuve; Keiho vang Pakai Ka-Pathenu thahat’a kisong kahiuve. 8 Thilmanchah a kisongte kipal’uva lhu lham diu, Keiho vang kipatdoh ung ting kadin jang diu ahi. 9 O Pakai, kalengpau gal josah-in, Kakou tengu neihouvun!

Labu 21

Galjo jeh a vahchoina

1 O Pakai, nahatsah jeh-in Lengpa akipah-in; Gal najosah jeh-in atha nom’e. 2 Ataona nasangin, Alungdei napetai. 3 Phattheina tampi nahinpon, Sana lallkhuh nakhuhpeh tai. 4 Lengpan hintheina athumin, Nangman napetai, tonsot tonsot’a hinna! 5 Napanpi jal’in aloupi lheh jengin, Leng loupe minthangin nalhai. 6 Tonsot’in naphatthei boh achangin, Naumpi jing akipapi lheh jenge. 7 Lengpan Hatchungnung Pakai atahsanin, Pakai lungset longlou jal’in phatseh-in along monge. 8 Amelmate lengpan mankhom-in tin, Ahoa pang jouse amatsoh idng ahi. 9 Ahung kilah teng Meisi kijep cheh banga ajep cheh ding ahi. Pakaiyin lung hanga abahgam diu, Meiyin ahalvamsoh diu ahi. 10 Lengpan athagama Achi abo’u kiholmo hel didng ahi. 11 Akihoutoh-un lengpa douna asem’un, Ahivanga ajodeh lou du ahi. 12 Lengpan ajalah-u thalpia akap’a, Anocheh a adeljamsoh diu ahi. 13 Nahat jal’in kavahchoiyui Pakai, Nathahat vahchoiya lakasah diu ahi.

Labu 22

Gentheiya kana leh vahchoila

1 Ka-Pathen, ka-Pathen! I-bol’a neidalhah hitam? Napanpi ngaichan kasam sam jengin, Neipanpi deh hih hel’e! 2 Ka-Pathen, sunlaiyin kakouvin Neidonbut deh poi; Jan khovah-in kakouvin, Olnaneipe deh poi! 3 Hijongle Nangma nathengin, Laltouna natouvin Israelten navahchoiye. 4 Kapu kapateuvin naki-ngai nauvin, Nakisonpi jeh-un nahuhhingtai. 5 Nahenga ataovun ahoidoh jiuvin, Nakisonpi jeh-un alungthoi khapouve. 6 Keivang mihem tobang kahitapoi, Lungtol bep kahitai.Kidah lenotthap’in kaumin, Mitinin eihouse se jengui. 7 Eimupha chanin eidaithangun, Lei eilhah khumun, lu eithin khum’ui. 8 “Pakaiya kisong nahine, Iti Aman nahuhhing lou ham? Pakai dei nahileh Idia napanpi da hitam?” atiuve. 9 Pakai, damsel’in neipensah-in, kasenlaiyin jongkanu noitwiyin neivah jinge. 10 Kapen a pat kisonna kanei, Ka-Pathen nahi jinge. 11 Genthei anaiye neidalha hih-in, Eipanpi ding aumpoi! 12 Basan phaiya bongchal hattah ho bangin, Kamelmaten eiumkimsoh tauve. 13 Sakeiyin asatha akisenpia abotel bangin, Kam homlet lut’in eikisen khumtauve. 14 Twi kisung lha bangin katha alhasamin, Kagu kachang alhoiyin, kalungthim khoiluijol abange. 15 THi dia leivui lah a neidalhah jeh-in, kalolbuh nelgo abangin, kadanga kalei abeh dentai. 16 Uihon bangin thilse bol hon eiumkimsoh tan, Kakhut le kakengphang. asunchen chentauve. 17 Kagu kachang adohsoh tan, Nehgam ding bangin kamelmaten eive changmel mol’ui. 18 Kaponsil chang ding vang asan’un, kavon chengse akihomtauve. 19 Neidalha loujen O Pakai, Neihuhdoh louyin! 20 Chemjam masanga neihuhhingin, Ui tobang hoa konin neihuhhingin. 21 Sakeite tobang hoa konin neihuhdoh-in, bongchal hang ho tobangte masanga kapang joupoi. 22 Nathilbol kamite seipeh ing ting, Akhoppiuva navahchoila sange! 23 “Pakai lhachaten Ama vahchoiyun, Jacob chilhahten choi-an’uvin! Israel miten Pakai chibai boh cheh-un! 24 Pakaiyin vaicha gentheite Donlou le kidah-in aneipon; Ahenga atao chan’un ahouvin, Akiheimang den khapoi.” 25 Pakai, nathilbol chengse jeh-in, Houbung khoppia vahchoiyinge Nahou dia kikhomho angsunga Katepsa kilhaina chengse penge. 26 Vaichaten aduchan aneh diu, Aheng hinjon jousen Pakai avahchoi diu ahi. Alungthimu khangtou jing hen! 27 Chitin namtinin Pakai ageldoh-uva, Leiset kolkimvel’a Pakai henga ahinjot diu, Namtinin Pakai chu achibai aboh diu ahi. 28 Pakai hi leng achangtan, Namtin chunga vai ahom’e! 29 Mi kilsetsahte Pakai angsunga kun a, Thi theimihem jouse angsunga kun cheh diu ahi. 30 Khang nununga miten Pakai kin abol’uva, Khang masan khang nukhah jah a Pakai thu asei diu ahi. 31 Apeng loulai ho geiya “Pakaiyin amite ahuhhingtai,” ti kiseipeh diu ahi.

Labu 23

Kelngoi chin a Eichingpau Pakai

1 Pakai chu kelngoi chin a Eichingpa ahin, Keima lhasam ponge; 2 Aman hamhing dum lah lah a kelngoi kol’in Eikolsah jin, Kiling louva twi veina pang dunga eipui lei. 3 Pakaiyin katha akidosah kit’in, Akitepsa bangin lamdih jenga eipuiye. 4 Thina phaicham jinglah jotpa jong leng Neilhonpi jeh-in Ima kaging tapoi, Pakai Natenggol’in neihong in, namoljol’in neilha mon nai. 5 Kamelmate masang jenga jong, Kaneh ding dokanga neiluipeh-in; Kalua thao neinu peh-in, Kadon ding khon alet lhai. 6 Phatna le hepi nan Kahinkho lhumkeiyin eijuiyin tin, Kahin kumkhoa Pakai in a kachen den ding ahi.

Labu 24

Leng loupi

1 Vannoi leiset le asunga um thil jouse Pakaiya ahin, Leiset le achung chengte Abonchauva Pakaiya ahi. 2 Pakaiyin twipi lailunga leiset asemdoh a, Twikhanglen chunga atundoh ahi. 3 Pakai lhangvuma kalthei koi hiya, Ahouin thenga lut thei koiham? 4 Thilse bol lou, milung theng, Doi houlou, jouthua kitep lou mi ahi. 5 Amaho hi Pakaiyin phatthei boh-in tin Ahuhhing diu; Themmonabei ahinau Pathenin phongdoh inte. 6 Hitobang mi chu Pathen henga hunguva, Jacob Pathen angsunga lut diu ahi. 7 Vo kotpi, nang ho kihong len’un, Kotpilui cheng kihongun; Loupi leng hung lutna din! 8 Hiche Leng loupe hi koi ham? Pakai Hatchungnung, Galjousoh Pakai ahi! 9 Vo kotpi, nang ho kihong ken’un, Kotpilui cheng kihongun; Loupi Leng hung lutna din! 10 Hiche Leng loupe hikoiham? Galjousoh Pakai, Ama leng loupe ahi!

Labu 25

Puihoina le hoidamna dia taona

1 O Pakai nahenga kataove! 2 Nachunga ki-ngai kahi ka-Pathen, Neijumso dan, kamelmate kipasah hih-in! 3 Nanga kisongten ima alel khapon, Nadoumah bolloi minbou aleljie. 4 O Pakai, nalampi neihil’in, Abonchan neihetsah soh-in! 5 Ka-Pathen nahin, neihuhhinge; Nadih ddudngjuiya hinje neihil’in, Nanga ki-ngaijingkahi. 6 O Pakai, akhang khanga naphondohsa Namikhoto l enalungset long lou geldoh jingin! 7 Khangdon lai kachonset ho le katoh khel ho Nei-ngaidam tan. Lungset long lou le naphatna jal’in Neigeldoh jingin Pakai! 8 Pakai adih a aphat jeh-in Chonsete achena diu lampi ahil’e. 9 Mi nun nemte lamdoh a a puiyin, Alungdei ahiljie. 10 Lungsetnan kitah tah-in apuiyin, Akitepna le athupeh nit ho apuiye. 11 Pakai, nakitepna nit’in, Neingaidamin kachonset atam behseh tai. 12 Pakai thu nit hon amaa kona Achena diu lampi akiholdoh diu ahi. 13 Hitobang miho hikhagntou diu, Achateuvin gamsung ahinlo diu ahi. 14 Pakai chu athu ngaite jol ahin, Amaho din akitepna asudet jie. 15 Phat tinin panpi ngaichan Pakai kaven, Aman tijat kichatna eihuhdohjie. 16 Hung kiheiyin neikhoton Pakai, kachangin lhasam tah-in ka-ume! 17 Kalung gimna cheng subeiyin, Kagentheina chengsea konin neihuhhing! 18 Gentheiya kalunghemna neigel peh-in, kachonset jouse ngaidamin! 19 Kamelma ijat pham, vetemin! Vetan itobang loma eihot’u hitam! 20 Neihongin neihuhhingin, Hoidohna din kahinjon’e. neijumsah dan. 21 Nang kisonna kanei ahin, Kaphatna le kakitahnan eidamsah hen! 22 O Pakai namite Israel khu Agentheina chengseuva konin huhhingin!

Labu 26

Mipha taona

1 Nanga kisonga thildih bol kahi, O Pakai them neichanin! 2 Neikholtoh-in neipatep’in Pakai, kadei le kagel chengse photoh-in! 3 Nalungset long louvin eipui jinge, Nakitahnan eilamkai jing ahi. 4 Phatchomna bei mito kakiloipon, Miphalhemho toh kakivoppoi. 5 Mi phalouto kakiloi nompon, Migilou kapeldoh jinge. 6 Monabei kahi tin khut kasop’in, Katao teng namaicham kaveljie. 7 Thangvah la kasan, Nathilbol kidang chengse kaseiphonge. 8 O Pakai, naloupina ngahmun, Nachenna In chu ka-ngaiye! 9 Chonsete tih neisuhmang tha dan, Tol thatte toh neitha thadan! 10 Thilse bol jingte, Nehguh kilah jing jengte toh. 11 Kenvang thildih kabol’e, Neikhoton neihuhhingin! 12 Tijatna jousea kaoidoh-in, Amite khoppi lailunga Pakai kavahchoiye.

Labu 27

Vahchoiya taona

1 Pakai hi kameivah le eihuhhing ahin, Imacha kagingpoi. Tijatna chengsea Pakaiyin eihoidoh tai, Kicha kit taponge. 2 Migilouten einokhum’a eithagot vangun, Akipal’uvin alhutauve. 3 Sepai hon khat’in eium’u jongleh Kicha deh ponge.Melmaten eidel khum jongle Pathena ki-ngai jing nange. 4 Pakaiya thil khatseh ka-ngeh-in, Hiche thilkhat kadei chu: Kahinkhoa a-Houin a chen ding, Aphatna kidangsa a, ama kipuisah ding ahi. 5 Hahsat teng Aman eisel’in tin, Ahouin sunga mongtah a eikoiya, Songpi chunga eikhandoh ding ahi. 6 Hitia hi kavel’a um kamelmate kajoa, Ahouin sunga kipa otongin kilhaiying ting, Pakai vahchoi la sange. 7 Kakouna ngaiyin Pakai! Khoto tah-in neihouvin! 8 Kalungthima, “Hungun neihouvun,” nati teng, 9 “Pakai kahunge, kisel hih-in,” katijie. Neilung hand an, Neidel mang hih-in nalhacha. Eipanpi Nang nahin, Neidalhan neidonda hih-in, O Pathen Eihuhhhingpa! 10 Kanu le kapan eidalha jongleh Pakaiyin eiching nante. 11 Nalampi neihil’in Pakai, Kamelma atame, lampheiya neipuiyin! 12 Jouthua eihutot midel khum, Kamelmate kichepna din neidalha hih-in! 13 Mihing gansunga Pakai phatna kamuding kahei! 14 Pakaiya ki-ngaiyin, Tahsanin, lung lha hih-in, Ahi, Pakaiya ki-ngaiyin!

Labu 28

Panpi ngaiya taona,

1 O Eipanpia Pakai kahung taove Ngaiyin kataona! Neihouda leh Noimigam jonte toh kajotsuh ding kahitai. 2 Panpi ngaicha nahenga kataova, Nahouin Theng lam kasan teng, 3 Thilse bol migiloute, Kamthem, lungthima hotna jeng dimte Amaho chutoh themmo neichantha dan! 4 Thilse bolte chu Abolset jeh-un talen pen. Athilse boljeh-un talen matsah-in, Achandiu dol chansah jengin! 5 Pakai natoh iman agelpouvin, Athilsem jong ima asah pouve; Pakaiyin talen amatsah a Asuhmang hel ding ahi. 6 Panpi ngaiya kataona eihoutai, Vahchoiyun Pakai! 7 Pakaiyin eipanpin eihoidamtai, Ken Ama katahsan’e. Pakaiyin eipanpin eikipasah-e, Kipah thanomin Ama kavahchoiye! 8 Pakaiyin amite ahoidamin, Alhentum lengpa apanpin ahuhhinge! 9 Pakai namite huhhingin! Namite phattheiboh-in! Kelngaoi chinbangin chingin, Lha louvin ching jingin!

Labu 29

Hui le go kitho lah a Pakai ogin

1 Van miten Pakai vahchoiyun, Athahat loupina vahchoiyun! 2 Pakai min loupe vahchoiyun, Ahung kilah teng Athengpa anga boh khup’uvin! 3 Twipi chunga Pakai ogin akijan, Loupi Pathenin van athingin, Twikhanglen chunga a-ogin akithonge. 4 Thaneitah le loup tah-in Pakai ogin akijai. 5 Pakai ogin husan ceder thing ho alhun, Lebanon lhang ceder thing geiyin alhutai. 6 Pakaiyin Lebanon lhang bongnou chom abahsah-in, Hermon lhang bongchalnou kinunkho abahsah-e. 7 Pakai ogin husan Kol aphetsah-e. 8 Pakai oginin nelgam ahot lhingin, Kadesh nelgam akilingsoh hel’e. 9 Pakai oginin gangpi thing jouse athingsoh-in, Athingna jouse amut lhasoh tan, Houin sunga um hon, “Pathen loupe hen,” tin asam’ui. 10 Twipi chunga Pakaiyin vai ahomin, Tonsot’in leng achangtai! 11 Pakaiyin amite ahatsah-in, Phatthei aboh-in along mongui.

Labu 30

Thangvah a taona

1 Neihuhhinga kamelmate neikichepna sah loujeh-in Nangma kavahchoiye Pakai! 2 O Pakai ka-Pathen, neipanpi din kataovin, Nangin neidamsah tai! 3 Moimigama neisol tapon, Thikhul’a lut kon kahitan, Nangin neihinsah kit tai! 4 Pakai vahchoi la sauvin Amithengte jousen! Amithengpa thilbol gel jingun, Ama thangvah jinguvin! 5 Alunghan phat chomcha bou, Aphatna hinkho lhumkeiya ahi. Kana jamkhat kal hilou, Kipana jing nikho asohjitai! 6 Lung mongtah-in ka-umin, “Iman eijouponte,” kati. 7 Keidin naphai Pakai, Molsang bangin kadin kulpi nahi. Kadia nakiselmang teng Kakichan katijai! 8 Kahin kouve Pakai, Napanpi ka-ngaiye! 9 “Thi leng nangdia i-phachom a? Thilkhul lut leng i-nakan em? Mithin navahchoiya? Nakitahje aphonjal thei diu ham? 10 Neihouvin Pakai, neikhoton! Neipanpin O Pakai!” kati. 11 Kagimna kon kipah-in neilamsah tan, Kagimna ponsil khel’in kipana neidip tai! 12 Hijeh chun umthim louvin Navahchoi la sange. Pakai, nangma ka-Pathen nahin, Itih-in thangvah tange!

Labu 31

Pathen tahsan a taona

1 Neihoidam din kahinjon’e Pakai! Neijumso lou jen-o! O Pathen dihtah, Kataove, neihuhhingin 2 Neihouvin, neihuhhing tun! Kakiselna songpi kahoidamna hin, Eihongin neihuhhingin! 3 Kakiselna kulpi nahi, Nikitep bangin neipuiyin neilamkaiyin. 4 Min thang eikampehnaa nei-osah dan, Kichatnaa neisel’in! 5 Kahinkho nakhut’a kapei, Neihuhhing din, O Pakai! Kitah jing Pathen! 6 Doihou ho nahon, Kenvang nang katahsan’e. 7 Nalungset long loujeh-in Kipah thanom ing’e. Kathohna namusoh tan, Kagimna nahesoh tai. 8 Kamelmate neimatsah pon, Jalentah-in kanopna chana neichesah tai. 9 Kagentheiye, Neikhoton Pakai! Kaka kanan kamit chopai ding ahitan, Abeipai ding kon kahitai! 10 Genthei lih pai ding kahitan, Kap lih didng kahitai! Hesoh-in kacholtan, Kagu kachang alhoisoh tai! 11 Kamelma, kaheng kakom chengin Noise tah-in eiboltauve; Eihesa hon eiginguvin, Kholai dunga eimutengu ajamji tauve. 12 Athisa bangin eisumil’uvin, Leibel keh pai mangsa kabange. 13 Melmate kihou lhih, Kavel’a tijatna jeng kajai. Kei dounan thil agongun, Tha din eigouve. 14 Nanga ki-ngai kahi Pakai, O Nang ka-Pathen! 15 Nakhut’a um jing kahi, Kamelma, eibolsetea konin neihuhdoh-in! 16 Khoton neiven nalhachapa, Nalungset long louvin neihuhhingin! 17 Pakai tin kakouve, Neivetda loujen-o! Migilou vetda chang hen, thildel’in noimigam jonsuh-u hen! 18 Jousei, kiletsah, kithang-at Midihte noisea thusei jouse phoh tangin. 19 Najabolte dia nakoipeh Thilpha chu iti kidan hitam! Natahsante mongtah a nahoidama Naphatje mitinin ahei. 20 Min asuhsetna dia jong Naumpin mongsel’in nakoiye; Amelmateuvin aphin loh louna din Kiselna phalaiya nasel jinge. 21 Vahchoiyun Pakai! Min einokhuma eiumchah-in jong, Kidangtah-in Pakaiyin eilungset’e! 22 Pakaiyin akoma kona eidelmang ham, tin Kakicha lheh jengin; Eipanpi dia kataoteng, Aman eihou jing nai! 23 Pakai ngailu’vin amitheng jousen, Pakaiyin mi kitah ahoidamin, Aumchan dungjuiyin kiletsahte Talen amatsah jie. 24 Pakaiya kinem jouse Het’uvin hanguvin!

Labu 32

Chonset phondoh, ngaidam

1 Achonset chengse ki-ngaidama Asuhkhel jouse kichulnam mi chu anun nom’e! 2 Lepche lou, Pakaiyin mo achan lou Mi chu anun nom ahi. 3 Kachonset kaphondoh lout eng, Genthei thoh-in kapeng nilhum lhumjie. 4 Sun le janin talen neimatsah-e Pakai, Nipi lai nisan daitwi akahgot bangin katha abeitai. 5 Pakai, nahenga kachonset kaphon teng, Kasuhkhel jouse ka-imjipoi. Aboncha phondoh kadeiyin, Kachonset chengse nei-ngaidamtai. 6 Nigingte ngaichat chanin nahenga taohen, Gentheina twipi kinong bang jongleh Amaho hinpha ponte. 7 Kakiselna nahi, Gentheina konin neihuhhingin! Neihoisamjeh-in Nahuhhhingna othongin lan sange. 8 Pakaiyin, “Nachena ding lampi hil ing ting, Kathumop a kahilchah ding nahi. 9 Sakol ham sakolpol ham bangin ngol hih-in, tuhngoina dia kamdal kibupeh bang khun!” eiti. 10 Migilouvin genthei athoh-in, Pakaiya ki-ngaite vang lungset’in ahoidam’e. 11 Vo them change, Kipah thanom’uvin! Pakai thu ngaite, Kipa la sauvin!

Labu 33

Vahchoina la

1 Vo themchangte Pakaiya kipah-un, Athua nung jousen vahchoiyun! 2 Semjang saiyin Pakai thangvah-un, Tumgingto thon Ama vahchoiyun! 3 Semjang ngeitah saiyin, othongin, Akoma kipa Lathah sauvin! 4 Pakai thusei atah cheh-in, Anatoh nganse thei cheh ahi. 5 Pakaiyin adih le atah adeiyin, Alungset longlou leiset adim’e! 6 Pakai kamchengin van mun chengse akisemin, Athuseiyin Ni, Lha, Ahsite akisemdoh-e. 7 Twipi lai munkhat’a aveikhomsah-in, Twikhanglen lithuh lai jouse akhol khom’e. 8 Leiset pumpin Pakai gingun, Vannoi miten Pakai jabol’un! 9 Pakai thuseiya konin vannoi akisemdoh-in, Athupeh akonin thil ijakai aumdoh tai. 10 Namtin vaipi lunggel Pakaiyin asunoh-in, Athilgonu toh doh louna din asutange. 11 Pakai thilgon vang tonsot’a um jing Angaito aboncha beitih neilou ahi. 12 A-Pathenu Pakai hikha nam mite Anun nom’ui; Pakaiyin amite dia alhendoh mite Anun nom’uve! 13 Vana konin Pakaiyin ahinven, Mitin mitang amusoh keiye. 14 Alaltouna phunga konin ahinven, Leiset’a chengte amusoh-e. 15 Mihem lungthim Sempa ahijeh-in Athilbol jouseu jong ahesoh-e. 16 Asepaite hat jal’in lengpan gal ajoupon, Hat vangin sepaiyin gal ajoudeh poi. 17 Jo na dia sakolte jong pannabei, Athahat’un huhhing pouvinte. 18 Pakaiyin athu nitte aching jingin, Alungset long louva ki-ngaite akivettup jinge. 19 Amaho hi thinaa jong ahuhdoh jin, Kel le chah a jong ahinsoi. 20 Keiho Pakaiya kinem kahiuvin, Eipanpiuva eihoidamu Amabou ahi. 21 Pakai al’in kakipah-un, Amintheng katahsan’ui. 22 Pakai, Nanga kinem kahiuve, Nalungset long louvin eiumpi jingun!

Labu 34

Aphat jal’a Pathen vahchoina

1 Pakai thangvah jing ing ting, Avahchoi la sachim ponge. 2 Eikhoto jal’in Pakai vahchoiyinge, Bolganthei thoh ten ngaiyun kipah-uvin! 3 Pakai loupe phongja’u hitin, Amin choi-an’u hite! 4 Pakai kahol len Aman eihoutai, Kagin jousea konin eihuh tai. 5 Lengvai gentheiten ven akipah-un, Lungthoi kit louhel diu ahi. 6 Panpi beite ataovun Aman ahoutai, Agimna chengseuva anopsah tai. 7 Pakai thunitte chu Avantil a-ngasah-in, Kichatna tijatnaa kon ahuhdoh-e. 8 Pakai phatje kholtoh-in, Akoma hoidamte chu anun nom’ui. 9 Amithengten Pakai thu ngaiyun, Ama thu ngaiten adei chan amui. 10 Sakeiten jong an mulouvin kel athoh-un, Pakai thu ngaite vang thilpha alhasam khapoi. 11 Hung ngaiyun chate, Pakai ginje nahil’unge! 12 Hin noma hin ding nadeiya, Hin nomsel’a the thiding nadeileh, 13 Thuse sei dan lang, Tuhjou seisan. 14 Thilse dalhan thilpha bol’in, Nalungthim pumpin chamna hol’in! 15 Midihte Pakaiyin aching jingin, Ataonau angai lhi jinge. 16 Thilse bolte vang avetdan, Leiset’a koima ageldohsah poi. 17 Midihte Pakaiya atao teng Aman ahouve, Agim gentheinauva konin ahuhdohjie. 18 Lung kisihte henga Pakai aneiyin, Chonset gimpite ahuhhinge! 19 Miphan gimna tampi ato vangin, Hichengsea jong hin Pakaiyin ahuhdoh-e. 20 Midih chu Pakaiyin ahoidamjeh-in Agu aching khatcha jong akiheh bongpoi. 21 Migilou chu thilsen atha ding, Midih vetda chanin talen amat ding ahi. 22 Pakaiyin amite ahuhhing ding, Alim belte ahoidam ding ahi.

Labu 35

Panpi ngaichaa taona

1 Einel’a chu nel’in lang, Eidouva xhu kidoupin Pakai! 2 Nalum le napho kengin Neihung huhdoh loiyin! 3 Nateng lung leh-in Eihindelte khu khon! neihuhhing din seiyin! 4 Tha dia eigo chengse chu Noinunin lang jumson! Kathina ding ngaito ho chu Nungjam hen kisulongu hen! 5 Pakaiya kon Vantil’in deljam hen, Khohuiya changse kithe bangu hen! 6 Alampiu muthim hen nal hen, Pakaiya kon Vantil’in del jing jengu hen! 7 Ajeh beiyin thang eikampeh-un, Kalhan lutna din khuh alaiyui. 8 Hinla ahet lou kah-uva manthahnan aphah diu, Athangkam’uva oh didu, manthahna chu diu ahi. 9 Chuteng Pakai jal’in kipah ing ting, Eihuhhing jeh-in nomsange! 10 Kalunggil’in Pakaiyah, “Vo Pakai Nang banga, Mi huhaman kona tahlel chulha aumpoi,” tinge, Abolsetea kona tahlel chulha aumpoi,” tinge. 11 Migilouten eidounan thu aseiyun, Kahet phah lou thilse ei-ngoh-ui. 12 Thilpha jeng jong thilsen eithuh-un, Kadatmo behseh jenge! 13 Adammo tengu lungkhama khaodip pon sil’a, Adamna diuvin an ka-ngol jin; kunin kataopeh peh jie. 14 Kasopi le kagol ngaitah banga taopeh a, Nu pul dou banga Kaikua vah le le jia kahi. 15 Kei genthei phat’in akipah jo’uvin, Kavel’a akikhom’uvin eidai thangun; Hetphah louhel mijengin Eideng deng jenguve. 16 Elbai nuisat bangin einuisat’un, Mitt hip tenin ha eigel khum’uve. 17 Pakai itih chan namohvet ding ham? Sakei tobangtea konin neihuhdoh-in, Neihuh hing loiyin! 18 Chuteng Houbung kikhopnaa thangvah ing ting, Amasanguva Nangma vahchoi tange! 19 Kamelma, jouseiho khu Kalelna chunga kipasah dan; Ajeh beiya eihote khu Kachunga kipa thanopsah hih hel’in! 20 Odamin thu aseipouvin, Cham deite chunga jouthu jeng asemthu’ve. 21 Akambem bemin eisam’un, “Chi, nathilse bol kamutauve!” atiuve. 22 Pakai, Nangin hiche hi namutan, Otdoh dsn, umthimdan Pakai! 23 O Pakai, kipat’in neihung hun, Ka-Pathen keidin hung pangin! 24 O Pakai dih, Nangin them neichanin, Kamelmate kachunga kipasah dan! 25 “Idei bangun ama khu isumangtauve,” tin Kachunga kipasah hih hel’in! 26 Kagenthei jal’a kipah thanomte hi Lel’u hen kijumso cheh-u hen, Kasanga phajoa kigel ho chu Jum le ja thoh-in umu hen! 27 Kei themchan didng dei jousen Kipa othongin samu hen lang, “Pakai aloupin, alhachapa lolhin along lhaipi,” tin samu hen! 28 Chuteng nadihna phongjal ing ting, Nilhum lhumin vahchoiyinge.

Labu 36

Mihem gitlouna

1 Setnan migilou lunggil’a thu aseiyin, Hijeh chun Pathen adondan ajabolpoi. 2 Ama akigel sang val tan, Asetna Pathenin mudoh louva them chang din akigel’e. 3 Thuse aseiyin, jou jeng ahi, chihna le thilpha abolpoi. 4 Alupna jalkhun jenga jong thilse agon, Thilpha ima bol louvin, thilse jeng abol’e.

Pathen phatna

5 Pakai, nalungset longlou vana akilhungdoh-in, nakitahnan vanthamjol aphai! 6 Nadihna molsang bangin akikhangin, Nathutandih Twikhanglen thuh abange Sa le mihem nakhohsah gel’e. 7 O Pathen, nalungset longlou akidangin, Nalhalim noiya kahoidam’ui! 8 Neipeh-u an nengtah-in kaneuvin Naphatna twidonin don’uvinge! 9 Hinna twinah phung nahin, Navah-in khovah kamu’ve! 10 Nahete chu lungset jingin, Midihte thilpha bolpeh jingin! 11 Mi kiletsahte neidelkhumsah dan, Migiloute neino mangsah hih-in! 12 Hikoma khun migiloute akisep lhun, Thou thei louvin akijamtauve.

Labu 37

Mipha le migilou lhunna

1 Migiloute jeh-in lungkhamdan, Thil dihlou bolte jong thangset dan, 2 Amaho hampa banging op lhan tin, Hamhing banga gop’a thi loi diu ahi. 3 Pakaiya ki-ngaiyin thilpha bol’in, Lung mongin gamsunga chengin. 4 Pakaiya kipah thanomin, Aman nalunga nadei chan napeh ding ahi. 5 Pakaiya kipen, Ama tahsanin Napanpi ding ahi. 6 Pakaiyin nadihna khovah abahsah a Sunlai nisa abahsah ding ahi. 7 Thoh hat’in Pakai natoh ngah jingin, Mihao lungkhampi dan, Thilse bol’a lolhing ho jong Lungkhampi hih-in. 8 Lungkham lunghan boldan, Gentheina bou nalhut ding ahi. 9 Pakaiya ki-ngaiten gamsung alo diu, Migiloute vang kideldoh diu ahi. 10 Migiloute beiloi ding, Hol jongle chun mupon nate. 11 Mi nun nemin gamsung lontin, Haotah le mongtah a um diu ahi. 12 Migilouvin mipha adouvin, Vetdan ha agel khum khum’e. 13 Hinla abeivah diu ahetjeh-in, Pakaiyin migiloute anuisat’e. 14 Tahlel vaichate, thildih bolte thana din Migilouten chemjam satdoh-in thalpi akamsal’ui. 15 Achemjam’uva amaho thi diu, Athalpiuvin amaho akap lih ding ahi. 16 Miphan themcha anei chu Migiloute gou sangin aphajoi. 17 Pakaiyin migiloute thahat asuhbei ding, Midihte apanpi ding ahi. 18 Pakaiyin athu nitte agel khoh-in, Gamsunga tonsot’a cheng diu ahi. 19 Phat phatmo teng jongle genthei lou diu, Kel lha jongle nehkhop anei diu ahi. 20 Migiloute vang mangthah diu, Pakai melmate pahcha banga pul’a Meikhu banga leng mang diu ahi. 21 Migilouvin bat din alan alesah kitpon, Miphan vang hongphal’in thil ahom jinge. 22 Pakai vangboh changten gamsung alo diu, Agaosapte kidel doh diu ahi. 23 Mi achena lampia Pakaiyin apuiyin, Alung lhainate ahoiddam jinge. 24 Kiseplhuu jongle kijamden lou diu, Pakaiyin aphoh ding diu ahinai. 25 Tun katehtan, kahing sot lheh tan, Mipha Pakaiyin adonda jong kamu khapon, Achaten jong khutdonneh ahol ngaipoi. 26 Miphan manbeiyin thil ahom jingin, Bat din jong ahom thouve; Achate jong vangbohna ahiuve. 27 Thilse jamsanin thilpha bol’in, Chutile nachate gamsunga cheng jing diu ahi. 28 Ajeh chu Pakaiyin thildih angailun, Amithengte adalha khapoi. A-itih-in ahoidam jingin, Migilou chate vang adelmang ding ahi, 29 Midihten gamsung alo’uva, Achenpha jing diu ahi. 30 Miphan chihhoi thu aseiyin, Itih-in jong akampha jinge. 31 Alungthima a-Pathen Danthu aching jingin, Anitda ngaipoi. 32 Migilouvin mipha aching lhin, Tha din agojie. 33 Hinla Pakaiyin midih chu Migilou kichepnan aneisah pon, Patepna achuh khah tah jongle Themmo achansah ngaipoi. 34 Pakaiya kinemin athupeh chengse nit’in, Aman lungset’a gamsunga nachensah ding, Migiloute kideljam namu ding ahi. 35 Thoh lel aum migilou khat kahen, Lebanon a Cedar thing bangin mi chungvum a akikhang sange. 36 Chomkhat jouva kajotpa leh aumtapon, Kahol vangin kamudoh joupoi. 37 Mipha melchih-in, midih ching jingin; Cham dei min son le pah aneiyin, 38 Chonset vang asu amangun, Ason apah-u jong asubeihel tauve. 39 Midihte Pakaiyin ahuhhingin, Gentheipet jongle ahoidam’e. 40 Apanpin ahuhdoh-in, Akom abeljeh-un migiloutea konin ahuhhinge.

Labu 38

Mi hesoh taona

1 O Pakai, nalunghan teng Neibolgim hih-in! 2 Nathalpichangin neikap khan, Neikap lhutai! 3 Neilunghan jeh-in hatah-in kanan, Kachonset ho jeh-in katahsa aveisei. 4 Kachonsetnan eilonvuh tan, pohgih hahsa tah-in akneiye. 5 Ka-ngol behseh jeh-in Katina anaikolsoh-in akomsoh tai! 6 Kakaiku ku jengin kijel lhop pai ding kahitan, Nilhum lhumin lunghem kathoh-e. 7 Khosih-in kanan Thipai ding kon kahitai! 8 Beipaiya kijel lhop pai ding kahitan, Nat thoh lel’in kalung gimtai! 9 O Pakai, kadei ka-ngai nahen, Kataona najasoh keiye! 10 Kadip aphu phu jengin kathabeitai, Kamit jong athim tai! 11 Hengle kom, golle paiyin einai ngampon, Katinaho jeh-in ka-insungmi jong akidalseuve. 12 Eithat nomhon thang eikampeh-un, Eisuse nomten suhmang din einokhum’ui. Suhmang din eigo go jenguve. 13 Na-ngong bangin kho la kajapon, paomo bangin thujong kasei theipoi. 14 Khojalou mihou lou bangin Keijong ka-umtai! 15 O Pakai Nang katahsan’e, O Pakai ka-Pathen, nangin neihouvin! 16 Kagimnaa kamelmate kipasah dan, Kalhahsamnaa kamelmate kithang-atda hen! 17 Kana na jengten, Lhulham pai ding kahitai! 18 Kachonset chengse kaphongin Kakisih lheh jenge! 19 Kamelmate damtheiyin ahat theiyui, Ajeh beiya eihoa atam lheh-e. 20 Thildih kabolgot jeh hin Thilpha jeh a thilsea eidouvah atam’e. 21 Neidalha loujen-o Pakai, Kidal khin khin hih-in ka-Pathen! 22 Tun neipanpin, O Pakai eihuhhingpu!

Labu 39

Mi hesoh chonset phondoh

1 Keiman, “Ching theiyin na tong ing ting, Kakamin chonset thu seiponge; Kavel’a migiloute umlaidsen Imacha sei ponge,” kati. 2 Kathip beh-in imacha kaseipoi, Thilpha jeng jong kaseipoi! Hinla kathohgim akhoh cheh cheh-e. 3 Kalung jongle kagimbe cheh-e; Hijeh chun paolouvin ka-umthei tapon: 4 “Pakai, ichan kahin a itih kathi ding ham? Kahinkho itih bei ding ham neihil’in,” kati. 5 Iti kahinkho hichanseh a neisempeh ham! Navetdanin kahinkho imachan namupoi. Tahbeh mongin mihem jouse hi Haikhat kah a hingbou ahi. 6 Nilim kahei bep, Anatoh jouse pannabei, Neile gou apokhom khomin Koipen chang ding ahepoi. 7 I-baham Pakai kakineppi ding? Nanga kinem jing kahi! 8 Kachonset chengsea neihuhdoh-in, Mi-ngolte neinuiaat sah hih-in! 9 Nangin gim genthei neithohsah-e, Paopoh louvin umthim tange! 10 Mihem chonset chengse naphoh-in talen napen, Adeipen jong nget neh bangin nasubeijitai. Tahbeh mongin mihem hi Haikhat kah a hingbou ahi. 12 Kataona ngaiyin Pakai, kakagin ngaiyin; Kakateng neipanpin. Kapu kapate banga chom khat kholjin le khopem bou kahi. 13 Kathi kah beh a nopna kaneina din Neidondan neichanglha tan!

Labu 40

Vahchoina La

1 Thoh hattah-in Pakai panpi ka-ngah-in, Aman eikhohsah-in kataona asangtai. 2 Tijat umtah khokhuh a konin eikaidoh-in, Bolsung bon-ngan lah a eiloidoh tai. Songpi chunga mong tah-in eikhangdoh-in, Lung mongin eikoitai. 3 I-Pathenu vahchoina la Lathah sahje eihil’e. Amupha chan tijauvin tin Pakai atahsanlo didu ahi. 4 Doihou lou, pathen lhem houte jop lou Pakaiya ki-ngaite chu anun nom’e. 5 O Pakai ka-Pathenu, Thil tampi neibolpeh peh jengun, Nang tobang koima aumpon, Kadiuvin thilgon kidang tah tah nagong’e. Atam behseh jengtan Ajat mong kaseijoupoi. 6 Kilhaina gantha le thilpeh na-ngeh pon, Maicham phunga gan pumgo jong natipoi; Chonset ngaidamna pumgo thilto na-ngeh dehpoi, Kasei chan phate chan neingaipeh joi. 7 Hijeh chun kenjong, “Hikoma ka-umin, Neihilchahna jouse Danthubua akisunin, 8 Nalungdei bol ding kadeiye ka-Pathen! Neihilna kalungthima kachinge,” kati. 9 Houbung kakhopnaa neihuhhingnau Thupha kaphongdoh tai Pakai! Tang louhel’a kasei jing ding Nangman nahei. 10 Huhhingna Thupha chu ka-impon, nakitahna le napanpi kasei jinge. Houbung kakhopnaa ka-umthimpon, Nalal loupina le nalungset longlou kaseiye. 11 Pakai neikhoto jing ding kahei, Nalungset le nalal loupinan eihoidam jinge.

Panpi ngaichan taona

12 Simsen lou hahsatnan eiumkimsoh tan, kachonset hon seimantan kho kamutapoi. Kalujangsam sangin atamjon Kameidoilo tai. 13 Neihuhhingin Pakai! Neipanpin keima tun! 14 Tha dia eigote chun Gal lel’u hem kisudongu hen! Kahahsatna kipah thanomte chu Nungjamu hen jahchau hen! 15 Tot nopna eineiho chun Gal lel’u hen jum’u hen! 16 Naheng jin jouse kipah thanom hen! Nahuhhhingna thangvah ten, “Pakai chu loupe tah ahi,” Tin sei jing jengu hen! 17 O Pakai, vaicha kalhahsam vangin Nangin neisumil deh poi! Eihuhhingpa ka-Pathen nahi Neipanhu loiyin!

Labu 41

Mi dammo taona

1 Vaicha khotote anun nom’ui! Hahsa atokhah tengu pakaiyin apanpi. 2 Amaho chu Pakaiyin achingin ahoidam’e. Gamdsunga anomlensah jin. Amelmatei kichepnan aneisahjipoi. 3 Adammo tengu pakaiyin kithopin tin, Adamsah kit ding ahi. 4 Keiman, “Nang dounan kachonsetai Pakai, Neikhoton neidamsah-in,” tin kataove. 5 Kamelmaten setah tah-in eihouvun, kathia suhmil’a kaum ding adeiyui. 6 Eihungve ho along thengpon, Kaphatmoa chengse achingun, Apot tengu gamtin a Aseithangsoh tauve. 7 Eivetda chengse keithu akihou lhiuvin, Kachunga thilse cheh cheh agel’uve. 8 Amahon, “Amahi athinattan, Damdoh kit taponte,” atiuve. 9 Kaginchat tah, kagol phapen Kaneh khompi geiyin eidoutai! 10 Pakai, neikhoton neidamsah-in, kamelmate chunga phu lange! 11 Kachunga nalunglhai kahei, kamelmate neijosah hih-in, 12 Thildih kabol jinge, neipanpin nate; Na-anga neikoi jing ding ahi. 13 Pakai Israel Pathen vahchoiyun, Tonsot tonsot’in Ama Vahchoiyun! Amen! Amen!

BU NINA (Labu 42-72)

Labu 42

Sohchang mi taona

1 Sitwi votjen lha-ngai sakhi bangin, O Pathen Nangma ka-ngaiye! 2 Vo hing jing Pathen ka-ngaiye! Itih leh na-anga chibai kaboh ding ham? 3 Sun le janin kakap’in, An neh khel’in kalhi along longe! Kamelmaten, “Na-Pathen hoiba ham?” tin Ei dodng dong jengui! 4 Phat chesa kageldoh teng kalungnai. Japi toh lhonin Pathen HOuin kajonin, Mipi kijot kalamkaiyin, Thanomtah-in Pathen cahvhoi la san asam’ui! 5 Idia hibang lung nommo Gentheiya um kahim? Pathen jenga kinem leng, Eihuhhing ka-Pathen vahchoi kit nange. 6 Lunghel le lhachomtah-in, Mizar molsang, Hermon molsang Jordan dung lonna gamsunga kadingin, Namikhoto themje kagel jinge! 7 Na-ogin komtong te ni kah a athongin, Natwipi dil kinong laiyin eilonvuh tai! 8 Sunteng jongle Pakai neilungset’in, Janteng kahinna Pathen henga la sang ting taovinge! 9 Eipanpi jing Pathen henga, “Idia neisuhmil’a, kamelmae gitlouna chengse Kadou dou jeng ham?” kati. 10 Melmaten ei-enghou hou jengun, “Na-Pathen hoiba ham?” tin eidongui!

Labu 43

Sohchang khopem taona

1 O Pathen them neichanin, pathen heloute neidouhun, Migilou jouseitea konin Neihuhdoh-in! 2 Kakiselna Pathen nahime, Idia neidonda ham? Iti kamelmate gitlouna chengse kadou dou jeng ding ham? 3 Salvah-in nadihan phongin, Nalhangtheng Zion aeipui hen Nachenna Houin eilhut lhon hen! 4 Chuteng namaicham phung jontange Pathen! Nangbou kanopna nahi. Kasem jang saiyin navahchoi la sange. O Pathen ka-Pathen! 5 Idia hibang lung nommo Gentheiya um kahim? Pathen jenga kinem leng Eihuhhing ka-Pathen vahchoikit nange.

Labu 44

Hoidamna dia taona

1 O Pathen, khanglui lai, Kapu kapateu nikho laiya Thil kidang nabol chengse eiseipeh-un, kamit’in kamu’vin kanan kajatauve! 2 Namtin vaipi nadelmangin Namite gamsunga nachensah-e. Namite nakhantousah-e. 3 Gamsung hi chemhem hat’a namiten alah-u ahipon, Athahat man’uva ajo’u jong ahipoi; Na-ngailut jeh le naumpi jeh, ahibouve. 4 Nang kalengpa le ka-Pathen, Namite gal najosah-e. 5 Nathahat kengin Kamelmateu kajoutauve! 6 Kihinsona din kathalpi jong kasongpon, Kachemjam jong kasongpoi. 7 Kamelmateuva konin neihuhdoh tauvin, Eihot bolteu najoutai. 8 Nangma kavahchoi jing diu, Tonsot’a kathangvah diu nahi! 9 Hinla neipaiyun gal neilelsah tauve, Kasepaiteu to jong gal nakonkhompoi! 10 Kamelmateu masanga neideljam’un, Kathil jouseu amahon akilah tauve. 11 Kelngaoi kisatchap neibahsah-un, Vannoi gamtina neithecheh doh tauve. 12 Man lhomchan nagel’in, Namite man baitah-in najoh mangtai. 13 Neibolnau kaheng kakomun amun, Eidaithangun einuisat tauve. 14 Namtin vaipi seichah din neibol’un, Lu eithin khumun einuisat tauve. 15 Vetda jengin ka-umin, Jum le ja kathot-e! 16 Eihotbol kamelmate houset le ohin Ka-ngai ngai jengin ahi! 17 Neitepnau kasuh keh dauva, Nang kasuhmil lou vangun Hichengse hi kachunguva Alhungsoh tai. 18 Nangla lheptol’in kabol pouvin, Nathupeh chengse kanitda pouve. 19 Ahinla gamsahang lah a neidalhauvin, Muthim lhangkhal jing lah a neidondauve. 20 Ka-Pathenu chibai kaboh dauva, Doi kahoutah-u jongleh, 21 Nahetdoh tei ding ahi, Ajeh chu kalungthim jouseu nahesoh-e. 22 Tunla Nang kahoujeh-un thading salhemin eikikoiyun, Tha dia koisa kelngoi bangin eikiboltauve. 23 Thouvin Pakai! Idia na-ihmut ham? Kipat’in, donda hel din neigel hih-un! 24 Idia kiselmang nahim? Kagenthei hesoh nau sumil hih-in! 25 Tol’a eichit thangun, Kalel jeh-un leivui lah a kalumden tauve. 26 Neihung panpiuvin, Nalungset long loujeh-in neihuhhingun!

Labu 45

Lengte ji neina La

1 Kalungthima thu ngei adimtan, Lengpa kalachoiye! Lekhasunpa lekhamol gonsa bangin Labol din kalei akilehgotai. 2 Pasal mel-houpen nahin, Thusei nathemin, Pathenin vang naboh jinge! 3 Nachemjam kikon, Vo leng thahat! Naminthangin nalal loupi! 4 Adih a panga adih a thutan din Galjou din sakol chunga hung touvin! Nathahat chun minthangtah-in Gal jouvin nate! 5 Nathalpi chang ahem theiyin, Namelmate lungchang akap pai jel jel’e; Namtin vaipi Nakhomuh a aboh khup’ui! 6 O Pathen, nalenggamin beitih neipontin, Thudih-in namite vai nahoppeh-e! 7 Nangin thilpha nadeiyin thilse nahoi; Hijeh chun Pathen, na-Pathenin lengdin nalhenge. Leng dang joouse sangin Kipa nopna napei! 8 Naponsil jouse myrrh le aloe gimvui anamin, Saihaa kijem leng inpia lathemhon nalem’ui! 9 Naleng inpia lhacha numeiho jong Lengte chanu jeng ahiuvin, Nalaltouna jetlama lengnu adingin, Ophir gama sana hoipenin akijem’e! 10 Kasei ngaiyin lengpa jia kipuinu! Namite le na-insung mite geldatan! 11 Namel-hoi jeh-in lengpan deichan natin, Napu jong ahijeh a athu na-ngai ding ahi. 12 Tyre gam miten thilpeh ding thil hinpon tin, Mihaoten nalung lhaina ahinhol diu ahi! 13 Leng inpia leng chanu aumin, amel-hoi lheh-e! Sana monkenga kijem poncho asil’e. 14 Aponchol jempah pumin lengpa henga apuiyun, Alhacha nu-ngah hon ajuiyun, abonin lengpa henga apuitauve. 15 Kipah thanomin ahungun, Leng inpia alut tauve. 16 Vo nangama kalengpa, Chapa tampi hingin, Leng changu hen napate khel’u hen, Leiset pumpi vaihomin pansah-in! 17 Kalabol hin naming seithang jingin tin, Akhang khanga min navahchoi diu ahi!

Labu 46

Pathenin eiumpiuve

1 I-kiselnau le ihatnau Pathen ahin, Genthei teng kithopi din eigo jingui. 2 Hijeh chun leiset pumpi kihot ling hen, Molsang jouse Twikhanglena kileh lut jongle I-kichat lou diu ahi. 3 Twikhanglen kidil hen kinong hen, Thinglhang jouse hotjal jongle kichapoute. 4 Vadung khat alongin, Pathen khopi Chungnungpen Houin thenga kipana ahinlhut’e. 5 Khopia chun Pathen apansan, Koiman khopi chu sumangponte; Jingkah matah a hungkona Khopi chu Pathenin akithopi ding ahi. 6 Namtin vaipi akichauvin, Lenggam jouse akilingsoh tauve; Pathenin lhang asamin, Leiset ajol lhatai! 7 Thaneipen Pakaiyin eiumpiuvin, Jacob Pathena kisel ahiuve. 8 Hungun Pakai natoh hung veuvin, Veuvin itobang datmo thil abol hitam! 9 Vannoiya gal kisat jouse avotangin Thalchang aheh bongin, tengcha avobongin, Lum jouse ahal vamsoh tai! 10 “Umthim’uvin, heuvin Pathen kahi; Namtin vaipi lah a chungnungpen, Vannoiya thanei chungnungpen kahi,” ati. 11 Thaneipen Pakaiyin eiumpiuvin, Jacob Pathena kisel ahiuve!

Labu 47

Vaihom Chungnungpen-Pathen

1 Mitin vaipi kipah-in khut bengun! Othongin la san Pathen vahchoiyun! 2 Ginpen ding Hatchungnungpen Pakai ahin, Leng loupe ahin, vannoiya vai ahom’e! 3 Mitin vaipi eijosah-un, Namtin vaipi chunga vai eihomsah-ui! 4 Chemun gam eipeuvin, Angailut amite hoithopi gam anapei. 5 Pathenin alaltouna ajontouvin, Kipana kholhang akisamin sumkon akimut’e! Pakai akitol toutai! 6 Sauvin Pathen vahchoi la! I-Lengpau vahchoi la sauvin! 7 Vannoi pumpi leng Pathen ahi, Sauvin avahchoina La! 8 Pathen alaltouna thenga atouvin, Namtin vaipi vai ahompeh-e! 9 Namtin vaipi vaihomte Abraham Pathen mite toh akikhom’ui! Gal-hat jouse sanga hatpen Pathen ahin, Minthengtah-in vai ahom’e!

Labu 48

Pathen khopi Zion

1 Aloupi Pakai chu, I-Pathenu khopi, Alhang theng chunga Loupi tah a vahchoi ding ahi! 2 Pathen molsang Zion, Asangin ahoiye; Leng loupipen khopi Vannoi dia kipana ahi. 3 Akhopi kulpi sunga Pathen amatah Kulpidet’a apandan aphonge! 4 Leng jouse akikhom’un Zion mol nokhum din ahungtauve! 5 Ahin Zion molsang amuphat’un akichauvin, Atijauvin ajamtauve! 6 Kichan akihot lhulsoh tauvin, Numei naosoh ding bangin na asalheh-ui! 7 Tarshish kong innei Khopihui kinonglai toh kha abangui! 8 Thaneipen Pakai i-Pathenu khopi sunga Pathen natoh thu kanajauvin, Tun mit’in jong kamutauve; Pathenin akhopi ahoidam jing ding ahi. 9 O Pathen nahouin sunga Nalungset long lou kageldoh-ui! 10 Muntina min navahchoiyin, Leiset chunga naminthangsoh tai! Thudih-in vai nahomin, 11 Adih-in thu natan’e Zion mite kipah hen! Judah gam khopi jouse kipah hen! 12 Pathen mite Zion kimvel’in kijot’un, Insang lai jouse simtoh-un! 13 Khopipal malchih-un, Akulpi kholtoh-un! Khangkit’a mite naseipeh diu ahi. 14 “Hiche Pathen hi tonsot’a i-Pathenu ahin, Phat jousea eilamkai diu ahi,” tiuvin.

Labu 49

Haova kison ngolna

1 Hiche hi ngaiyun mitin vaipin, Muntin aching, 2 Alen aneo, ahao avaiyin Ngai cheh-uvin! 3 Thuh tah-in lung kagel’in, Chihna thujeng kaseiye. 4 Thuchih jeng ngai phang ting, Semjang saito thon hilchen inge! 5 Melman eiumchah a, Aneile agouva kisong ho 6 Ahao kiletsah piten eium jongleh Hitobang phatsea jong hin kakichapoi! 7 koila ama kilhatdam theipon tin, Ahinkho manjat Pathen apeh jou deh lou ding ahi. 8 Mihem man akisim joupon, Ijat kipejongleh lhing ponte; 9 Tonsot’a hing jinga Thina lhankhuh ajotda lou ding ahi. 10 Mi-ngol mivaichate thi bangin Michingte jong athin, Anei agou jouseu jong Midang adalhah pehji tauve. 11 Mihem gampi le pua anapan vangun Alhankhuh-uva akijamji tauvin, Hikoma hin aumdenji tauve. 12 Mihem aloupinan ahinso joupon, Ganchate thi bangin athi thouve. 13 Ngol-han a anei angaa kisongte Manthah ding dan chu, 14 Thadia koisa kelngoite bang diu, Thinan kelngoi chin a achin’uva Thiuva tahsa monloi ding, Noimigama cheng sen diu ahi; Midihte vang khovah a vah diu ahi. 15 Keivang Pathenin eihuhdoh ding, Thinaa kona eihuhhing ding ahi. 16 Mi khat ahaodoh a Gou alambe jongleh thangsen tijat dan, 17 Mi athi teng agou apothei pon, Aloupinan jong lhansunga ajuilut theipoi. 18 Ahinlaiya nomsa jing mi, Athilpha boljeh a pachat chang jong 19 Tonsot muthim thina geisa Apu pate henga chetai ding ahi. 20 Mihem aloupinan ahinso joupon, Ganchate thi bangin athi thouve.

Labu 50

Pathen houdih

1 Pakai, thaneipen Pathen apaovin, leiset pumpi, so le lhuma konin Mi akou kou jenge! 2 Khopi hoi chamkimsoh Zion a Pathen avah emsel’e. 3 I-Pathenu ahungin athongje jui, Amasanga mi halvam thei mei akongin, Huipi le gopi kithon atomsoh keiye! 4 Amite thu atanna hettohsah a pang din Pathenin van le leiset akouve, 5 “Kilhaina bol’a keito kitepna semdoh, Tansan umtah kamite hung kikhom’un,” tin akouve. 6 Pathen dihtah ahile thutanpa ahi Van mun jousen aphongdoh tai. 7 “Ngaiyun kamite thu seiyinge; Nang douna kasei ding ahi-Israel, Keima hi Pathen, Na-Pathen kahi. 8 Kilhaina hijat naboljeh le Tang louva pumgo thilto neipeh jeh a Them kachansah ding nahipoi. 9 Na-insoh bongchalte kaseipon, Nakel-hon lah a kelchate jong kadeipoi. 10 Ajeh chu gamsa jouse keiya ahin, Mol le lhang san gkhat’a lha Gancha jouse keiya ahi. 11 Vacha jouse jong keiya ahin, Gamlah ganhing namkim keiya ahiuve. 12 “Kel jong leng nahenga thum ponge, Leiset pumpi le adunga um jouse keiya ahi. 13 Bongchal sa kaneh monga, Kelcha thisan kadon mong-em? 14 Pathen koma nakilhai sangin Thangvah jon lang, Hatchungnung Pathen henga Nakitepna jat molson, 15 Nagenthei teng hung taovin, Nahuhhing ing ting neivahchoi ding ahi,” ati. 16 Mihilou jah a Pathenin, “Idia kathupeh chengse chinpha naseiya, kakitepna chu naseile ham? 17 Kahilgot le nadan, Kathupeh chengse napaitai. 18 Gucha namuphah chanto nakiloiyin, Mi jonbolte to nakivop’e. 19 “Thuse nasei nom jingin, Kho-ngai louhel’in joujeng naseiye. 20 Nasopite douna jeng naseigo jingin, Athemmo nau hodoh nago jingjie. 21 Hicheng hi nabolten, Kalimsah hih laiye; Hijeh chun nang tobang din neigel’in ahi. Tua vang kaphoa kahilchet nahi. 22 “Einahsah louten hiche hi ngaiyun, Achutiloule kasuhmanguva Koiman nahuhhing jou lou diu ahi. 23 Thangvahna neiyan kilhaiya eijabol ahin, kasei ngai jouse kahuhhing tei ding ahi,” ati.

Labu 51

Ngaidam thuma taona

1 O Pathen neikhoton, Nalungset longlou ahi; Namikhotona alene, Kachonset jouse theh ngimin! 2 kagitlouna jouse sop lhan, Kachonset’a kon neisuthengin! 3 Kamona jouse kahen, kachonset ho kahejinge! 4 Nang douna mong monga chonsea, Nahotpen kabol ahitai! Hijeh chun dihtah-in neibol’in, Mo neichanjeh-in nadih tai. 5 Chonsesa kajil’a Themmosa hung peng kahi! 6 Nangin kitahna le thutah nadeiyin, Hiche ding hin chihna kalunggil’a neikhumpeh-in! 7 Kachonset sumangle chun theng tange. Neisop le chun buhbang bangin bang jonge! 8 Neimehgep a neisuhgoisa hijongleh Kipana la thanopna ogin neijahsah kit’in, Chuteng kipah thanom kit tange! 9 Kachonset ho neivetpeh dan, Kagitlouna chengse theh ngimsoh-in! 10 O Pathen, kalungsung semthah-in, Kasunga tomngaina lhagao thah neikhumpeh-in! 11 Nakoma konin neisel mang dan, Kachunga na-Lhagao Theng lamang hih-in! 12 Namihuhhing kipana neipekit’in, Thanom tah-in nathua neinunsah-in! 13 Chuteng chonsete nathupehho kahil’a, Nahenga hung kilekit diu ahi. 14 O Pathen, neihuhhingin neilhing hoiyin, Chuteng kipah-in nadihna seichoi lenge! 15 Pakai kathusei neipanpin, Chuteng nangma vahchoiyinge! 16 Kilhaina jong nadeipon, Toh jeng jong leng pumgo thilto jong nadeipoi. 17 O Pathen, lung lengvaiya kisih hi Kilhaina sangin nadeijon; Hijeh chun lung lengvaiya kisihte Nahsah mo pon nate! 18 O Pathen, Zion khopi khoton panpin, Jerusalem kulpi jouse kaiphan! 19 Chuteng adih a kilhaina kibol’in tin Nalungna chim ding; Namaicham phunga pumgo thilto kipea, Bongchaltea kilhaina kinei ding ahi.

Labu 52

Pathen thutan le alungset

1 Vo mihatpa, idia nathilse bol Nakiletsahpi ham? Pathen mingailut hi tonsot’a ahibouve. 2 Midang suhmangna ding jeng nagon, Namuh themsiu seucin; Semthu jouthu jeng naseiye. 3 Thilpha sangin thilse nadeijon, Thutah sangin jouthu nadeijoi. 4 Mijoupa, midang suhgetna jeng naseiyem ong! 5 Pathenin nang nasuhmang hel ding, Namat’a na-ina kona nakaimang ding ahi; Mihing leiset’a kona Napaidoh ding ahi. 6 Midihten amuteng tijauvintin, Nanuisat’uva, 7 “Ven, Pathena kisong loupe, Anei anga jenga kisonga Athilse bol chengse Kisonnaa neipa pi khu,” tiuvinte. 8 Keivang Pathen Houin sunga Olive thing hing kabangin, Atonsot atonsot’a din Pathen lungset long louva kakisonge. 9 O Pathen, nathilbol ho jeh a Nangma kathangvah jing ding, Namite angsunga Naphatna kahonjal ding ahi.

Labu 53

Mihem gitlouna

1 Mi-ngolten, “Pathen aumpoi,” atiuvin, Nehguh a kivah jeng, Thet umtah tah bol ho, Thildih bol khatcha aumpoi. 2 Miching, Pathen hol aum khat leh, Tin Vana konin Pathenin mihemte ahinvei. 3 Hinla akiheimangsoh keiyun, Kibang cheh-in aphamouvin, Thildih bol khatcha aumpon, Khat’a khat jong abeihel’e. 4 “Kamite chomgama, Kahenga tao kha louhel, Hiche thilse jeng bolte hi Kho helou khat hiuva, Imacha jong ahetlou tah bah-u ham,” Tin Pathenin aseiye. 5 Anasoh kha louhel Pathenin Amite kidoupi ho gu le chang Athethangsoh tengleh Abonchauva tijat thi diu ahi. Pathenin adonlou ahitan, Amaho mangthah diu ahitai. 6 O Ziona konin Pathen hung hen Israelte gal josah tave leh! Pathenin Isarel ahaodohsah teng Jacob insung iti kipa thanop diu hitam!

Labu 54

Melmatea kona houbitna dia taona

1 Vo Pathen naminin neihuhhingin, Nathahat’in neihongin! 2 O Pathen kataona ngaiyin, Kasei neigelpeh-in! 3 Mi kiletsahten eidel khumun, Pathen ginglou engseten thadin eigo! 4 Hinla eipanpia Pathen ahin, Eihuh a Pakai ahi. 5 Kagalte hi Pathenin thilsen lethuh hen, Kitah tah Pathen ahijeh-in abonchan sumang hen! 6 O Pakai, naphat jal’in Kipah tah-in nahenga kilhiaying ting, Nangma thangvah tange! 7 Kagimna jousea neihoidoh tan, Kamelmate nasuhmang kamutai!

Labu 55

Agol’in alhep lhah mi taona

1 O Pathen kataona ngaiyin, Kathum nungsun dan! 2 Ngaiyin neihouvin, Lunggim lih pai ding kahitai! 3 Kamelmaten kindot dot’in eilhan, Migilouten einehgep pai diu ahitai. Gimna jeng eilhut khumun, Eilunghan’un eiho’uve! 4 Kakicha behseh jengin, Kathillo paiding ahi! 5 Kichan kakithing thingin, tijalih pai ding kahitai! 6 Ohe, vakhu bangin lhaving neiying, Leng mangin choldo mun gahol leng! 7 Gamla tah aleng ing ting, Gamthip laiya cheng tange! 8 Huipi le gopi masanga jong Kiselna mun muloi tange! 9 O Pakai, kamelmate kihoutoh mon lhan! Khopi sunga kinah l ekidou kamun, 10 Sun le janin khopi aum’uvin, Adihlou le hesohna jeng abol’uve. 11 Muntina thil le lo asuseuvin, Kholai dung jousea mi abolseuvin abolgentheiyui! 12 Melman eidaithang hileh Kathoh thei ding, Kakidoupin kiletsahna einei hileh Kakisel mang thei ahi. 13 Kadoulel hila kahetsa, kaloi kagol ngaitah nang nahibouve! 14 Thu ngei ngei iseikhom jin, Houin ikaikhom ji lhon me! 15 Kamelmate hi aphat lhon masangin thiu hen, Ahing laiyin noimigam jon’u hen; A-insunguva jong thilse jeng, Alunguva jong thilse jeng aum’e! 16 Hinla eipanpi din Pakai Pathena kataove, eihuhhing nante. 17 Jingkah nalhah sunin Kagimna le kakiphinna aheng alhung jinge, Aman ka-ogin janante. 18 Melma hijat kidoupi kanei vangin Galmuna konin jong Kitup keiyin eihinle pui kit nante. 19 Tonsot’a vaihom Pathenin Kataona ngaiyintin amaho ajo ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon lung aheipouvin, Pathen jeng jong agingpouve. 20 Masanga kagol’in aloite adelkhumin, Akitepna jouse asukeh tai. 21 Athuseiho khoiyu sangin analhumjon, Alungthima vang mi avetdan ahoi; Asei jouse thao bangin anal’in, Hinla chemjam hem banga mithat thei ahi. 22 Nagimna jouse Pakai chunga sep lhan, Aman nakhankho gel nante; Aman itih-in jong midih Gal alelsah ngaipoi. 23 O Pathen, tolthatte le mijouho khu, Hinkho bang khaiyin kokhuh a leh lut’in! Keivnag hi Nanga ki-ngai jing inge!

Labu 56

Pathen kisonpia taona

1 O Pathen neikhoton, Nilhum lhumin kamelmaten Eibolgentheiyun, Kengton eichil chil jengui! 2 Nilhum hel’in eidel khum khum jengun, Eidouva atam behseh jengtauve. 3 Kakichat phat hin Nanga kakingaiye, O Hatchungnung Pakai! 4 Kicha louvin Pathena kakisongin, Athutep jal’in kathangvah-e! Tahsa mihem mai maiyin I-eilo thei idng ham? 5 Kamelmaten nilhum lhumin eibol gentheiyun, Kei dsuhsetna ding jeng agong’ui, 6 Kiselna thei channa akikhom’un, Eithana diuvin kabolchan amelchih-ui! 7 O Pathen, akhanset jeh-un engbol’in, Lung soutenin mitin vaipi tolse nan neiyin! 8 Kagimna nahesoh keiyin, Kamit lhilon namelchih jingnan, Abonchan nalekhabua najih lutsoh tai! 9 Nahenga katao ni nil eh Kamelmate nungjamsoh diu, Hijeh hin Pathenin eipanpi kahei! 10 Hiche Pakai hi Athutep chengse kathangvah-in; 11 Kison nan kaneiyin ima kagingpoi, Tahsa mihem mai maiyin I-eilo thei ding ham? 12 Vo Pathen, kakitepna jat napeng ting, Kathangvahna thilto peng’e! 13 Ajeh chu thi idngsa neihuhdoh tan, Gal neijosah tai. Hijeh chun Hinna khovah Pathen angsunga kavah lei. 56 Title: 1 Sam 21.13-15

Labu 57

Panpi ngaichaa taona

1 Neikhoton O Pathen neikhoton, Naheng kahinbel’e! Khopihui le gopin eidalhah kahsen Nalhaving noiya kakisel’e! 2 Chungnungpen Pathen, kangaichat chan eipethei Pathen henga kataove. 3 Vana kon eihouva eihuhhing ding, Eibolsete asuhnem’a kitahtah le Long louva eilungset ding ahi. 4 Mihingnea sakeite bangin Kamelmaten eiumkimsoh tauvin; Ahau tengham le thal-hem abange, Aleiyu jong chemjam hemtah abangin ahi. 5 Vo Pathen, vanthamjol’a nalalna phongin, Leiset pumpi chunga naloupi phongin! 6 Kamelmaten lenpel eisonpeh-un, Hesoh lih pai ding kahi. Kalampi khuh alaiyun, Hinla amahojoh alhalut tauve. 7 Vo Pathen, lung dettah-in kapange, Navahchoila sange! 8 Thouvin kalhagao, Kipat’un selangdah le kasemjang, Nipilai jeng jong Kahoh khah lo ding ahi. 9 O Pakai, namtin vaipi laiya Nangma thangvah inge; Namtin japi lah a Navahchoi la sange! 10 Nalungset longlouvin van aphan, Nakitahnan vanthamjol aphai! 11 Vo Pathen, vanthamjol’a nalalna phongin, Leiset pumpi chunga naloupi phongin!

Labu 58

Migilou chunga phula dia pathena taona

1 Vaihomten adih a thu natanu hinai, Mitin thu kitoh a nabolpeh jiu hinam? 2 Ahinaisaipoi, thilse jeng nagel’un, Leiset’a pumhat’in asejeng nabol’u! 3 Migiloute chu ahinkho lhumkeiyin Lamdih lou jenga acheuvin, Apen niuva pat Thujou jeng aseiyui! 4 Gul banga gu nei jeng ahiuvin, Gulsum na-ngong bangin akolseh-ui. 5 Gulsumin gulsaiho theile gin ajapon, Guldoi choiho phunsam jong ajapoi. 6 O Pathen sakei tobangte ha subongin, Sakeinou tobangte tenhem sunil’in Pakai! 7 Hohtwi long mang bangu hen, Hampa kichonthang bangu hen! 8 Dahdeng goden bangu hen lang, Ni mulou naosen pengsol bangu hen! 9 Ahet masnagun hampa kisattan bangu hen, Ahing laiyun Pathenin alunghan teng mu tmang hen! 10 Chonseten talen amat teng Midihte kipah diu; Midihten chonsete thisan kengtoa achil thang diu ahi. 11 Mihon, “Midih-in kipaman akisanin, Leiset thutan Pathen aum monge,” ati diu ahi.

Labu 59

Hoidohna dia taona

1 Kamelmatea konin neihuhhingin Pathen, Eisel khumtea konin neihuhdoh-in! 2 Migiloutea konin neihuhhingin, Tolthattea konin neihuhdoh-in! 3 Ven, tha din eichang lhiuvin, Eidou din migiloute akikhom’ui! Chinsetna le bolkhel kaneijeh jong ahipon, 4 Themmona kaneijeh jong ahipoi Pakai, Hibanga akinothe thu vangun! 5 Kipantan Pakai thaneipen Pathen, Keima neipanpin; Vo Israel Pathen! Namtin vaipi talen matsah tan. Joulhep hat thilse bolte Khatcha jong khoto dan! 6 Nilhah teng ahung kit jiuvin, Khopi sunga akijot’un uichate bangin apengset dot’ui. 7 Mi aphin’uva a-enghou nau ngeiyun, Aleiguiyu chemjam hem hat abangin, Athuseiyu koiman ajah loudin agel’ui! 8 Amaho khu nuisat’in Pakai, Namtin vaipi khu daithangin! 9 O Pathen kakisonpi Kakiselna nahi! 10 Eingailua ka-Pathenin eihung vil ding, kamelmate gal lel eimusah ding ahi. 11 Amaho hi thadan Pathen, Achutiloule kamiten sumil’unte; Nathahat’in thethangin lang Sunemdoh-in eihuhhingu Pakai! 12 Chonset thujeng aseiyun, Asei jouseu chonsetna jeng ahi. AKiletsah nauva kipal’u hen, Mi agaosap’un jou aseiyui. 13 Lung hangin sumangin, Abonchauvin sugamhel’in! Chuteng Israel chunga Pathen vaihom Mitinin ahetsoh ding, Leiset pumpia avaihom hi Kihedohsoh hel ding ahi. 14 Kamelmate nilhah teng ahung kit jiuvin, Khopi sunga akijot’un uichate bangin apengset sot’ui. 15 Ui anholmo helbangin Kholai dunga akijot le leuve. 16 Genthei nikhoa kakiselna kulpi Nang, Nathahat vahchoi la sang ting, Jingkah she leh nalungset longlou Jailan oiyinge! 17 Eingailua Pathen, Kakiselna Pathen, Eipanpi jing Nangma vahchoila sange!

Labu 60

Huhdohna dia taona

1 Neilunghan jeh-un, Kagalpal jouseu phe lhan lang, Neipaidoh ta jongleur chun Tun neihungvil kit’un Pathen! 2 Leiset lingpin hot’in lang, Akeh lhapai ding ahitai Tun kichisah kittan! 3 Namite neibolgim behseh-un, Jukham bangin kalonle letauve! 4 Amanthah louna diuvin Natahsante nahilchah masajie. 5 Namingailutte hoidohna din, Kataonau sangin lang Nathahat’in neihuhhingun! 6 Amunthenga konin Pathenin, “Kajothoa Shechem kahop khen ding, Sukkoth phai kamite kahoppeh didng ahi. 7 Gilead le Manasseh keiya, Ephraim kathih lukhuh, Judah kaleng tenggol ahi. 8 Moab kakengto sop ding, Edom kachotpha ding; Philistia hanla kasha den sing ahi,” ati. 9 Vo pathen, koiham kulpia eikailut’a, Edom a eikai ding koi ham? 10 Neipai mongu hitam Pathen? Kasepaiteu gal nakonpi lou ding ham? 11 Mihem kithopi pannabei ahi, Kagalteu neidou hu’vin! 12 Pathenin eipanhu leh kajotei diu, Aman kagalteu ajo ding ahi.

Labu 61

Hoidohna dia Taona

1 O Pathen kataona ngaiyin, Kathum neijah peh-in! 2 Ichan gama um jong leng Genthei teng Nangbou kakouve! Hoidohna kulpisa neisel’in! 3 Melmate dia kagalpal detpen, Eihoidohsah Nang nahi Pathen! 4 Kahinkho lhumkeiyin Munthenga neichensah-in; Nalhaving noiya neihoidamin! 5 O Pathen kakitepna chengse najan, Najabolte chanlom thil neipetai. 6 Lengpa hinkho sotsah-in, Tonsot kumkhon hing jing hen! 7 O Pathen, na-angsunga lengpa vaihom jinghen, Kitah a nangailutna long louvin hong jingin! 8 Chuteng niseh a kakitepna kapeh teng Tang louvin navahchoi la sange!

Labu 62

Pathen hoidamna kisonpi

1 Eihuhhing din Pathen ka-ngah jingin, Amabou kakingaina ahi! 2 Pathen bou eihuhhinga eipanpia ahin, Eipanpi jeh-in koiman eijouponte. 3 Pal kison chimsa sanga lhasamjo Mihem hi itih chan geiya naboncha nadelkhum diu ham? 4 Suh minset dia bou nabol’u ahin, Nop nop’in jou naseikhum’ui! Phattheina thu jeng naseiyun, Nalungthimun nagaosap sap’ui. 5 Pathen jenga kakingaiyin, Amabou kakineppi! 6 Pathen bou eihuhhinga eipanpia ahin, Eipanpi jeh-in koiman eijouponte. 7 Huhhing le jabol kachanna ding Pathen bou ahi; Eihoidam hattah, Kakiselna Pathen ahi. 8 Itih-in Pathena ki-ngaiyun kamite, Nagim nau hetsah-un Ambou ikiselnau ahi. 9 Mihemte hi hu haikhat tobang, Alen aneo pannabei cheh ahiuve; Thiltena tedin jong ima aleppon, Huijang sangin ajangjoi. 10 Pumhat kisonpi sauvin, Guhchat’a hao ding kinem hih-un; Haotel tul jongle chun Kison nan nei hih hel’in! 11 Thaneipen Pathen ahidol Aman aseina kaja jinge. 12 Pathen lungset long lou ahi, O Pakaim, mitin atoh dungjuiyin lethuh-in!

Labu 63

Pathen lhangaiya um

1 O Pathen, ka- Pathen nahin, Nangbou ka-lha ngaiye! Kahinkhon ka-ngai jingin, Twi bei, leigo Twi ngaicha geo leiset bangin Kahinkhon nangbou ka-ngaiye! 2 Munthenga neikimusah-in; Nahatje le naloupije neimusah-in! 3 Moh hinsangin nalungset long lou aphajon, Hijeh a hi kavahchoi ding nahi. 4 Kahinlaisen thangvah ing ting, Nangma kasan a katao ding ahi. 5 kalhagao vahvan natin, Kenjong nahenga vahchoiya kipala kasha ding ahi. 6 Kalup teng Nangma kageldoh jin, Jan khovah-in Nangbou kagel’e! 7 Eipanpi Nangbou nahi, Nalhaving noiya kipa la sange! 8 Nangma kakolchah jingin Nakhut’in eihoidam nai. 9 Eithatgote chu Noimigama kijotdsuh-u hen! 10 Gal’in thatgamu hen, Alongu se-alten ne hen! 11 Pathenin lengpa gal ajosah tai, Lengpa kipah thanom hen! Pathen mina Kitepten Pathen avahchoi diu; Jouseite vang apomoa um diu ahi.

Labu 64

Hoidohna dia taona

1 Kagentheiye Pathen, Kataona ngaiyin! Kagalte kakichai, Neihuhhingin! 2 MIgiloute thilsea konin neihoidoh-in, Mi-engsete thilgona konin neiselmangin. 3 Aleiguiyu chemjam hem abangin, Athuseiyun thalchang bangin mi adot’e. 4 Jum le ja helouvin jouthu aseilouyun, thusen miphaho asuminseuve. 5 Thilse boldin akitil touvin, Thang kamna mun ahol’un, “Koiman eimupouvinte,” tin agel’ui. 6 Thilse jeng agongun, “Thilse tahbeh igongui,” atiuvin; Mihem lungthim le lunggel vang Het theihoisan ahipoi. 7 Hinla Pathenin thalpin ahinkap’in, het manlouvin amvosoh tai. 8 Athusei jeh-uva Pathenin asuhmang ding, Amupha chan tija lu ahih khum diu ahi. 9 Abon a kichasoh diu, Pathen natoh agel’uva aseile diu ahi. 10 Pakai natoh chu Midihten akipapi diu; Midihte Pakaiya hoidoh diu Miphaten Pakai avahchoi diu ahi.

Labu 65

Vahchoi le Thangvah

1 Vo Pathen, Zion lhanga vahchoi lom nahin, Kakitepnau pehdoh lom nahi. 2 Nangin kataonau nasangin, Muntina min naheng ahinjon’e. 3 Achonset jal’un nahinhol’un, Kathemmo nauvin rijothouvin, Hinla nangin miho chonset Na-ngaidamjie. 4 Nadeilhen mi, munthenga nahinpui chu Minun nom ahi. Na-insunga thilphaho Nahou-in theng vangbohnan kalungnau chimsah tante. 5 Gal neijosah-un neihouvun, Eihuhhingna diuvin thil kidang dang nabol’e! Leiset kolkimvel mite leh TWikhanglen gal’a miten na-kingainai. 6 Nathahat’in mol le lhang natungdoh-in, Nathahat loupe mi namusah tai. 7 Twipi kinonglai naphoh thip’in, Twi kidil lai nasuhaitai; Mipi kinonglul lul jong navohaiye. 8 Nathildbol loupiho jeh hin Leiset pumpi akichatai; Nathilbol ho hin Leiset kolkimvel’a kipana alhut’e. 9 Leiset khohsah nan go najuhsah-in, Nachap nouvin leipha nasoi. Luidung jouse twi nadip’in, Leiset ga napunsah-e! Nathilbol dan chu: 10 Leichang tuhnemsa go najuhsah-in, Twiyin nachap nouvin, Go naphinsah-in leiset nachap nouvin, Hamthah louthah nadotsah-e. 11 Naphat jal’in lhoga nalhinsah tan, Nakithahna lam lama Neng jeng jungin nalhai! 12 Lungdong lah a kelngaoihon ademset’in, Mol le lhang pang dung vetnom nom aum’e. 13 Jaolah jouse kelngoite adimin, Phaicham jouse chang adim’e. Thil ijakaiyin Kipa thanop la asauve!

Labu 66

Vahchoina le thangvah La

1 Mitinin kipa othongin Pathen vahchoiyun! 2 Amin loupe lan sauvin Loupi tah-in vahchoiyun! 3 Pathen koma, “nathilbol iti kidan a, Nathahat iti let hitam! Namelmate kichan Na-anga aboh khuptauve. 4 Leiset’a cheng jousen chibai naboh-in, Navahchoila asauvin, naming vahchoila asauve. 5 Hungun mihemte lah a Pathen thilbol kidangtah hung veuvin! 6 Pathenin Twikhanglen taolgo asosah-in, Ipu ipateuvin vadung longlai tolgo ajotdoh-ui! Hiche aboljeh hin Eiho ikipah thanom’ui! 7 Pathenin athahat’in lengvai apon, Namtin vaipi avelhi jingin, Doumah bolten jong adou-ngampouve. 8 Namtinin i-Pathenu vahchoiyun, Navahchoinau kithong hen! 9 Pathenin eihing hoi nalaiyun, Eikipal lhuhsah hih laiyui! 10 Vo Pathen, Nangin keiho neipatep’un, Sana meiya kilhatheng bangin neipatep tauve! 11 Pel’a neilhah sah-un, Pohgih hahsa tah neipohsah-ui! 12 Melmate neichil thangsah-un, Meipi le twipi kapal galkaiyui! Tunvang hoidohna mun a neipuilut tauve! 13 Nahouin thenga pumgo thilto hinchoiying ting, Kakitepna chengse penge! 14 Kagimpet’a kaseisa Kakitepna jat lhingin penge! 15 Maichama pumgo din kelngoi peng ting, Bongchalte le kelchatea kakilhai ding, Akigona meikhu vanlai jol’a Kitungdoh ding ahi. 16 Pathen gingten hung ngaiyun, Itobang thil loupe eibolpeh deiyinge! 17 Pathena panpi kathumin, Vahchoilan kathangvah-e! 18 Kachonset ho khohsah da leng, Pakaiyin kataona sang ponte. 19 Tunvang pathenin eihouvin, Kataona asangtai! 20 Long louva eilungset jeh le Kataona asanjeh-in Pathen kavahchoiye!

Labu 67

Thangvahna La

1 Neikhoton phatthei neiboh-un Pathen! Hepitah-in neiveuvin! 2 Chuteng vannoiyin nadei hentin, Namtinin nahuhhingna hente! 3 O Pathen, mitinin navahchoi hen, Mitin vaipin navahchoi cheh hen! 4 Mitin thu adih a natanpeh a, Namtin vaipi nalamkaijeh-in Namtin vaipin kipa nop la sau hen! 5 O Pathen, mitinin navahchoi hen, Mitin vaipin navahchoi cheh hen! 6 Pathen, i-Pathen’un phatthei eiboh-un, Leiset ga alhung tai. 7 Pathenin phatthei eiboh tauve, Muntina miten Ama jabol cheh hen!

Labu 68

Nampi galjo La

1 Pathen akipat’in amelmate anocheh tai, Ama hotbolten alel’un ajamtauve! 2 Meikhu kimut mang bangin, Melmate Pathenin adelmangtai; Meihul’a khoilu jolmang bangin, Pathen masanga migiloute amang thah tai. 3 Midihte vang Pathen angsunga akipah thanom’un, Kipah thanomin a-aovui! 4 Pathen la sauvin, amin vahchoila sauvin; Meilhang chunga tou Pathen lampi semjangun, Amin Pakai ahi, a-angdsunga kipah-un! 5 Ahouin thenga pansa Pathenin Chagate le meithaiho akhohsah-e! 6 Pathenin chenmun beite chenmun apen, Sohchangte kipah a nomlen din alhadoh-e. Pathen doumah bolte vang Hollei lah a achensahjie. 7 O PAthen, namite napuidoh a, Nelgam najot galkaipi chun; 8 Sinai pathen ahungin, Israel Pathen ahung jeh-in, Ling akihot’in, go ajui! 9 Pathen, nengtah-in go najuhsah-in, Nagam leiset gosa nachapnouve! 10 Hikoma chun namite achengun, Naphat jal’in caichate natoi! 11 Pakaiyin thu aphongin, Numeiho geiyin aphongjal leuvin, 12 “Lengho le asepaiteu ajamtai,” atiuve. Akichomdoh ho in’a numeiho akihom’ui. 13 Vakhu lim sana kitomjol, Alhaving geiya sana thengsel’a kiloijol jong ajaove. Galpi nikhoa chu, Ibol’a kelngoi honga moh tou nahiuvem? 14 Zalmon lhanga thaneipen Pathenin Lengho athecheh nin, buhbang alhah sah-e! 15 Vo molsang vum sangtah, Pathenin chenmun dia alhenna, Iti thangset um nahim? Chua Pakai tonsot’a cheng ding ahi! 17 Akangtalai thaneiteh asang sang pumin, Sinaiya pat Pakaiyin muntheng ahinjon’e! 18 Gal-hing tampi akaiyin, Munsang lam ajontouve! Doumah bol jongleur mihemtea konin Thilpeh tampi akisanin; Pakai Pathen chu Hikoma cheng ding ahi. 19 Niseh a pohgih eipoh hu Pakai vahchoiyun, Eihuhhinguva Pathen Amabou ahi! 20 I-Pathenu hi huhhing Pathen ahin, Pakai ama hi thinaa kona eihuhdoh-u Pakai ahi. 21 Amelmate lu Pathenin atantei ding, Chonset lam jenga chete lu atan ding ahi. 22 Pakaiyin, “Bashan a kona namelmate kahinpuiya, Twikhanglen thuh laiya kahinpuidoh ding; 23 Chuteng athisan lah-u nanoh a, Uichaten athisanu ava va ale diu ahi,” ati. 24 Vo Pathen galjouva nahung kitol, Kalengpa Pathen Amuntheng phung jona hung Mintinin amusoh tai! 25 Lathemho alamkaiyin, Tumging themte anukhah-ui; Alailunguva Nu-ngah hon khatbeh abengui! 26 “Amite kikhopnaa Pathen vahchoiyun, Jacob chilhah jousen Pakai vahchoiyun!” atiuve. 27 Phung lhumpen Benjamin alamkaiyin, Abanin Judah lamkaihon aloiho aloiyun; Zebulun le Naphtali lamkaiten Anung ajuiyuve! 28 Vo Pathen, keho khel’a namanchah nathahat, Hiche nathahat chu phongjal’in! 29 Lengle lalten thilto tampia nahou nau, Jerusalem khopia nahouin a phongin! 30 Pumpeng lah a lhale gamsa tobang Egypt mite phoh-in lang, Bongchal hon anoute lah a kinomsah tobang Namtin vaipi khu phoh-in; Adangkai choiya nahenga aboh khup Kahseuvin khu the cheh doh keiyin! 31 Egypt’a konin palai hungun tin, Sudan mite Pathen lam Sanga tao diu ahi. 32 Leiset lenggam jousen Pathen pachat la sauvin, Sauvin Pakai vahchoi la! 33 Khangluiya vanthamjol, Hiche vanthamjil’a toupa Pathen sei ngaiyun Othongje jun sam’uvin! 34 Pathen thahat phongjal’un, vanthamjol’a athahat akilangin, Israel chunga alal loupitai! 35 Amunthenga ahung potdoh chun Pathen akidang behseh-e! Hiche Israel Pathen khu! Amana mite tha le jung apei! Pathen vahchoiyun!

Labu 69

Panpi ngaicha Kap

1 O PAthen neihuhhingin, Twiyin ka-ngong gei achuptai! 2 Bon-ngan lah a kalha lhum cheh cheh-in, Leitah kachon kha tapoi! Lithuh lai kageitan, Twidil’in eilonvuh pai ding ahitai! 3 Panpi kakou kounan kacholtan, kalolbuh apeh-in anai! Eipanpi didng kavet vet nan kamit thim pai ding ahi! 4 Ajeh beiya eihotbolte Kasamjang sangin atmjo’uve! Melmaten joujeng eiseikhum’un, Ahat’uvin tha din eigo’uve! Thil kaguh louhel jong Eisah sah-uvin ahi. 5 Vo Pathen, kachonset ho nakoma akiselpom, Ka-ngoldan nahesoh keiye! 6 Thanei chungnungpen Pakai, Nachunga kisongte neijumsisah san; Vo Isreal Pathen, Nangma chibai bohte neujumsosah hih-in! 7 Nangma jal’a jumle ja kathoh a, Min a-eng alouva eihou ahi. 8 Kasopite lah a kholjinmi kabangin, Ka-insung mite lah a gamchom mi kabange! 9 Nahouin dia katom ngaival jeh-in Kalungsung meikouva kileu abgnin, Min na-enghouna jouse Keichunga achuh lo tai! 10 An ngol’a kakineosah vangin, Mihon enghou nan eineibep’ui! 11 Lunghema khaodip pon kasil jongle Nuijat nopnan eineiyui! 12 Kholai dunga seichah-in eineiyun, Jukhamhon la-lhangin ei-oiyui! 13 Hijongle nahenga katao jinge Pakai! Nadei phat phat’in neihouvin Pathen! Nalungset anasan, huhhing dia nakitepna nanit jinge Neihouvin Pathen! 14 Bon-ngan lah a neiloidoh-in, Kamelmatea konin neihoidoh-in, Twithuh lah a neiloidoh-in! 15 Twisoh neichupsah dan, Twitoa neilhahsah dan lang, Lhankhuh a neilhah lutsah dan! 16 Phaten a lungset long lou nahi, Neihouvin Pakai! Namikhotona alen’e Neihung vil’in Pakai! 17 Nalhacha keidin kiselddan, Neihouvin kagim behseh tai tun! 18 Neihung huhhingin, Melmatea konin neichu-lhan! 19 Kamelmate namusoh-in, Iti eivetdauva eijumsou, Ei-enghouna jouseu nahei! 20 Ei-enghou nau kalung naval’in, Alha lhop pai ding kahi! Eidip dappeh diu kakinepna la abeitan; Lungmonsah kahol vangin Khatcha eilungmonsah ding aumpoi. 21 Kakel teng thinagu eipauvin, Kadangchah teng lengpitwi thuh eipeuve! 22 Agolvah bol’u manthahnan neiyu hen, kuttheng abol’u lhuh lhamnan neiyu hen! 23 Amit’u suchon! Ating akongu doisen tu hen! 24 Lunghan khum jingin, Nalungsat nan lonvuh-u hen! 25 Ingapsih she-u hen lang, Agam ngah diu kaholmo hen! 26 Talen namatsahho abolgentheiyun, Namavote genthei seichah-in aneiyui! 27 Achonset jouseu melchih-in, Them chansah hih hel’in! 28 Hinna lekhabua aminu kinoi mang hen, Midihte lah a kisimtha hih beh hen! 29 Kenvang na kasan kalhasam’e, O Pathen, neiphong dingin neihuhhingin! 30 Pathen vahchoila sang ting, Aminthan phongjal ing ting kathangvah ding ahi. 31 Hiche hin bongchal a hou sangin Pakai lung lhingset sangin Pakai lung lhaijonte! 32 Bolgenthei thoh ten amuteng kipah diu, Pathen chibai bohte kitikhou diu ahi! 33 Angaichat taona Pakaiyin angaiyin!
