Amite sohchangho asumilpoi! 34 Van le leiset, Twikhanglen le Asunga cheng jousen Pathen vahchoiyun! 35 Pathenin Jerusalem ahuhhinga Judah khopi jouse asah phat ding; Amite chenguva gamsung alo diu, 36 Alhachate chilhah hon alo’uva, Pathen ngailuten achenpha diu ahi.

Labu 70

Panpi ngaicha Taona

1 O Pathen, neihuhhingin, Neipanpi loiyin Pakai! 2 Eithatgote chu kisudong hen Gal lel’u hen! Kagenthei kipapite chu Nungjamu hen vetdan umu hen! 3 Eidaithengle hon Agal lel jumpiu hen tijau hen! 4 Nahinjon jouse kipah thanom hen, Namihuhhing kipapi jousen, “Pathen aloupi ngeiye,” Tin seijing jengu hen! 5 Lhasam le geochaovin ka-ume, Hung louyin O Pathen! O Pakai Eihuhhingpu Neipanpi loiyin!

Labu 71

Tehsepu Taona

1 Eihuh din kahinbel’e Pakai, Gal neilelsah hih-in! 2 Nangbou adih nahi! Neipanpin neihoidoh-in; Ngaiyin neihuhhing loiyin! 3 Kakiselna mundet, Kahoidohna kulpi detpen Kakiselna le kagalpal nahi. 4 Migilou, engse, thilse bolte Thaneinaa konin neihuhdoh-in Ka-Pathen! 5 Kakinepna nahi Pakai, Kaneo laiya pat kakisonpi nahi! 6 Kahinkhoa kakingaina nahin, Kapen lhah a pat neihoidam jinge; Phat tinin nangma vahchoiyinge! 7 Hattah a neipanpi jeh-in Mihon kahilnan aneitauve! 8 Nilhumkeiyin Nang kavahchoiyin, Naloupina kaphongjal lei! 9 The jong leng neidondan hih-in, Kachamo phat’in donlouvin neikoidan! 10 Kamelmaten eitha nom’un, Kei dounan akihousom’ui! 11 “Pathenin adondatai, Gamandoh jongleur hen Ahuh ding aumpoi,” atiuve. 12 Neilhakang hih-in O Pathen, Ka-Pathen neipanpi loiyin! 13 Eidelkhumten gal lel’u hen mangthah-u hen, Eisusegote kijumsou hen vetda changu hen! 14 Kakineppi jinga Kavahchoi jing ding nahi! 15 Naphatna kasei lea, Nilhumkeiya nahuhhingna kasei ding; Hekim hih jong leng kasei ding ahi. 16 Thanei chungnungpen Pakai, Nathahat pah chang ting, Naphatna kaphonjal ding ahi. 17 Kaneo laiya pat neihil jingin, Nathilbol kidang ho kasei jinge! 18 The a kasam kantah vangin, neidonda hih-in O Pathen! Ahung ding akhang khanga Nahatna thuneije kaphon teng nei umpin! 19 Vo Pathen nadih nan vanthamjol aphan, Thil nasatah tah nabol’in, Nakibahpi koimacha aumpoi. 20 Hesoh gentheiya neilha vangin, Neithahsem kit’in natin, Thina lhankhuh neimusah pon nate. 21 Mi neijabolsah cheh a Neilhamon kit ding ahi. 22 Semjang seiyin vahchoiying ting, Ka-Pathen, nakitahna vahchoiyinge! Vo Isreal Pathen Theng, kasemjang saiyin navahchoi la sange! 23 Neihuhhingtai, kalung pumpin Navahchoi la sange! Kipa othongin nathangvah nan Semjang saito thon la sange! 24 Eisuse nomte najothoa vetda nachansah jen-in Nilhum lhumin nadihna thu seichoi lenge!

Labu 72

Lengpa dia Taona

1 Vo Pathen, nadih banga thutanje lengpa hil’in, Adih a nathutanje lengpa hinpen! 2 Chuteng namite adih a avaihom ding, Bolgentheite adih a avaipoh ding ahi. 3 Gamsung mi haohen nom hen, Adih umdol hedoh hen! 4 Lengpan vaichate rhu dih-in tan hen, Pumhatte sunem hen ngaichate kithopi hen! 5 Nipi noi lhapi noiya, Ni le lha vah laisen namiten chibai naboh jing hen! 6 Lengpa hi jaolah a gophin bang hen, Gamsunga gobah lha bang hen! 7 Lengpa damlai sen adih leng hen, Ni le lha um laisen hao jing hen! 8 Alenggamin Twikhanglen jouse khokhong hen, Euphrates luiya pat kolmong gei hen! 9 Nelgam chengte lengpa anga boh khup hen; Amelmate tol’a boh khup’u hen! 10 Spain lente le twikol lengthen Lengpa kai peu hen! Arabia le Ethiopia lengthen jong Lengpa kei peu hen! 11 Leng jouse a-angsunga boh khup’u hen, Namtin vaipi alhachan pangu hen! 12 Donlouva um, angaicha geo, vaicha Ahenga tao chan lengpan ahinsoi! 13 Lhasam le vaicha akhoton, Angaicha chan ahinsoi! 14 Pumhat’a mibolgentheitea konin Ahuhhing jin, ahinkhou akhohsah-e! 15 Lengpa hingsot hen! Arabia gamma sana jouse chang hen; Phat tinin japin taopeh hen, A-itih-in achunga Pathen vangboh chu jing hen! 16 Gamsunga chang le min pung hen, Mol le lhang neh pha hen; Lebanon lhang chang phat bangin pha hen! Hampa loudong pha bangin Khopi jouse mihem dimsoh hen! 17 Lengpa min thang jing hen, Ni le lha man kahsen minthang hen! Namtinin pahcha hen Pathen vang thumpeh jingu hen Lengpa nopna ding khohsah-u hen! 18 Pakai Isreal Pathen vahchoiyun! Thil kidang dang bol Amabou ahi! 19 Tosot’in amin loupe vahchoiyun! Aloupinan vannoi losoh hen! Amen! Amen! 20 Jesse chapa David taona Abonchan akichaisoh tai!

BU THUMNA (Labu 73-89)

Labu 73

Pathen thudihna

1 Israel ding, Milungthengte din Pathen apha mong monge! 2 Kenla kakisonlelpi deh jengin, Tahsan kalhaso deh chet’e! 3 Kiletsahte umchan kathangsen, Migiloute phatthei kamuteng ka-otchai! 4 Natla athoh pouvin, Adamtheiyun ahat’ui! 5 Midang bangin genthei athoh pouvin, Adang bangin hesoh athoh khapouve! 6 Kiletsah-in ngong avaiput’un, Pumhat jengin thil abol’ui! 7 Lungthimin thilse jeng agel’un, Agilou bolna ding bou angaitouve. 8 Midang adaithangun ahouseuve; Akiletsah-un midang bolsetna ding agong’ui! 9 Van Pathen ahouseuvin, Leiset mite ahohsal’ui! 10 Pathen gingte geiyin ajuitan, Aseiyu angai jengjiuve. 11 “Pathenin hepha pontin, Hatchungnungin umdoh ponte,” atiuve. 12 Migiloute hitobang hi ahiuve, Akhopset aneiyun, aneibe jingui. 13 Chonselou thengsel’a ka-um hi Kei dinga pannabei mong ham? 14 Vo Pathen, nilhum lhumin neibolgimin, Jingkahseh leh neiphonsel’e! 15 Thilse kaseikhah tah leh Namite chon kajomlou hinte. 16 Gelchet tei kagon vangin keidin ahah behseh jenge! 17 Nahouin thenga kakai phat’in Migiloute manthahna ding kahedoh-e! 18 Migiloute khu kilindet’a nadinsah a Alhu lham ding salem a nakoi ahi! 19 Mitphet kah louvin amangthah jiuvin, Vet ngamlouvin abeiji tauve! 20 Jingkah teng janmang beibep ahiuvin, Nahung teng akilep mangji tauve Pakai! 21 Lunggim le lung donga Ka-um teng leh, 22 Gancha ngol bangin Pathen Nangma kaheji tapoi! 23 Nanginla nei-umpi jingin Kakhut’in neituh jinge! 24 Akhon nileh loupia neilahna din Neihilchah-in neilamkai jinge! 25 Vana jong nang tilou adang kaneipon, Nang kaneitan leiset’a idang ka-ngaichat ding ham? 26 Kalungle katahsa lhasam jongle Eihatsah jing Pathen ahi; Ka-ngaichat jing Amabou ahiye! 27 Nangma dalhate mangthah tei diu, Nahenga kitahloute nasuhmang ding ahi. 28 Keidin vang Pathento kinaiya, Hatchungnung Pakaiya kisel, Athilbol kidang ho seiphong hi Thilphapen ahiye.

Labu 74

Nampi hoidohna dia taona

1 O Pathen, idia neidondau hitam! Kelngoi vah a navahsa Namite chunga Iti neilung han jing diu ham? 2 Goulo dia nalhatdamsa phung mite, Khanglui laiya pat nakihensa Namite hingeldoh jingin, Napansatna Zion molsang geldoh jingin! 3 Khogem kisong lah a hin vah len, Houin thenga thilkeo jouse Kamelmateuvin asumang tai! 4 Nahouin thenga namelmaten hanla asauvin, Galjona ponlap atungdoh tauve! 5 Sahlam kelkotjol jouse Heichan atu lhu’vin achonpeh gamtauve! 6 Tingkhom kijempah jouse She-in avobongun heichan achen goi tauve! 7 Nahouin theng susen meiyin ahal’un, Nakihouna mun jeng jong asuboh tauce! 8 Chilgep hel din eigouvin, Gamsunga muntheng jouse ahalvam’ui! 9 Melchihna thil theng jouse abeitan, Themgaoho jong abeisoh tai; Itih chan hitia kiumding Koiman aseithei tapoi! 10 Vo Pathen, kamelmateu nakinuisat sah sah ding ham? Iti naming ataitom tom diu ham? 11 Idia neipanpi nom louvu ham? Idia khut kikhoitum nahim? 12 Semtil’a pat Kalengpau nahi Pathen! Tamtah vei neihuhhingsau jong ahitai! 13 Nathahat’in Twikhanglen navotanin, Twikhanglen dragonte lu navokeh-e! 14 Sampi Leviathan luchang navokeh-in, Atahsa gamsa vahnan naneiye! 15 Twisan nasemdoh-in twinah nason, Luipi lentah tah nakansah-e! 16 Sun le Jan nasemin, Ni le Lha natungdoh-e! 17 Leist kolkimvel najih jol’in, Phalbi le Nipi nasemdoh-e! 18 Vo Pakai, namelma, Pathen helouten Nanuisat’a nanotthapnau hi gel temin! 19 Melma gilote kichepna din Panpibei namite hi dalha hih-in! Bolgenthei thoh a um Namite dumil loujenin! 20 Neikiteppi nau geldoh-in, Gamsung thimlai jousea pumhat’in mi akinon ahi! 21 Bolset thohte jumso dan! Tahlelte le vaichaten navahchoiyu hen! 22 Hung kipanin nading kiseiyin Pathen! Pathen helouten nilhum lhumin nanuisat’ui! 23 Namelmate kisen gin, nakidoupite pocheichoi Sumil loujenin!

Labu 75

Thutanpa Pathen

1 Nangma kathangvah-ui Pathen, Nangma kathangvah-ui! Naloupije le nathilbol kidang ho Kaphongjal leuve! 2 Pathenin, “Kateppeh phat teng Kitoh chet’a thu katan ding; 3 Ganhing nam kim kithing thinga, Leiset kihot ling soh jong leh Leiset khompi katuhdet ding; 4 Migilou kiletsah kaphoa, 5 Kiletsah angah na diuva Kaseipeh ding ahi,” ati. 6 Nisolam ham nilhum lam ham, Sahlam ham lhanglam ham a Them channa hungsoh doh ding ahipon; 7 Them le themmo chansah ding Thutan Pa Pathen bou ahi. 8 Pakaiyin khon khat achoiyin, Alunghanna juthuh adimset’e; Ahinsun lhah teng Migilouten adousoh keiyuva Achim ava adon cheh diu ahi. 9 Kenvang Jacob Pathen thu kasei jinga, Avahchoila kasah jing ding ahi. 10 Jacob Pathenin migilou tha asuh beiya, Midih vang hat cheh cheh ding ahi.

Labu 76

Galjou Pathen

1 Judah gama Pathen akihen, Israel lah a amin akijabol jinge. 2 Jerusalem Pathenin chen munin aneiyin, Zion molsanga apansai. 3 Zion mol’a Pathenin Melmate thalchang jouse, Alum jouseu leh chemjam ho Abonchan aheh bongin asumangtai! 4 O Pathen naloupi ngeiye! Nagalte najona molsanga kona Nahung kilekit chun Nalal loupe ngeiye Pathen! 5 Melmate gal-hang jouse Khut keovin aumsoh tan; Alongu akijamchap’in, Ahatnau le athepnau pannabei ahitai! 6 Vo Jacob Pathen, melmate nahohsal chun Sakolte le achung touho akijamchap tauve! 7 Pakai, mitinin nagingin, Nalunghan teng nakoma koima apang ngampoi! 8 Vana kon thu natan jin, Vannoi mite a-uhsa ngampouve! 9 Leiset’a bolgentheita umte huhhing din Thutan din nahung kipanjitai! 10 Mihemte lunghan chun navahchoina asojon, Gal’a hingdoh chengin kut bolnan aneiyui! 11 Nakitepna jat Pakai na-Pathen peuvin, Naivel’a namtin vaipin thilto peuvin! Pathenin mite akiginsah-in, 12 Kilatsah leng chapate asu nemin, Leng loupitah tah ho Akinlihsah deh deh-e!

Labu 77

Hesoh pet’a kilungmon

1 Othongje jun pathen kakouvin, Oginglet lut’a katao teng eihoujie! 2 Gim genthei teng Pakaiya kataovin, Ama kasana katao khovah vah vangin, Kalung mong thei deh poi. 3 Pathen kageldoh teng na kasan, Kakigel gel teng katah asei! 4 Pathenin jan ihmu mon eilhan, Kagim behseh-in kapaomo loi! 5 Ni masa lai kagel teng Kum masa lai jong kageldoh jie. 6 Jan khovah-in kagel jin, Ka-ngaito chu hiche hi ahi: 7 “Pakaiyin eidondan jinguva, Eilunglhai kit louhel diu hitam? 8 Eivetdauva Akitepna bei ngap hitam? 9 Eikhoto diu Pathenin asuhmil’a, Voujang natpi sanga lung hangjo hitam?” kati. 10 “Kalung natna pen chu, Pathen thahat abeitai,” kati. 11 Pakai, nathilbol loupe tah tah geldoh ing ting, Masanga thil kidang nabol ho geldoh inge! 12 Natohsa chengse ngai tong ting, Thil nasa nabolsa ho gel inge! 13 Vo Pathen, nabolchan athengin, Nang banga loupe Pathen dang aumpoi! 14 Thil kidang bol Pathen nangbou nahin, Namtin vaipi nathahat navetsah tai! 15 Nathahat’in namite Jacob le Joseph son ho nahuhhinge. 16 Vo Pathen, twipin Nangma namu Phat’un, Lithuh tah tah ho jong kichan akidil’ui! 17 Meilhanga konin go ajun, Vanthamjol pohlhong lhongin agingin, Kolkimvel’a kol aphelhap lhap’ui. Van ging akitoljul jul’in, Kolphen vannoi asahvah-in; Leiset a kilingin akihotnemtai! 19 Twipi kinong lai najot paiyin, Twikhanglen thuh lai nagalkai vangin Nakhochotna nung akimudoh poi! 20 Kelngaoi chingpa bangin namite napuiyin, Mose le Aaron namangin Napuilen ahi!

Labu 78

Pathen le amite

1 Kahil ngaiyun kamite, kasei gal khoh-un! 2 Thulem kaseiya, Khanglui lai thu kisel ho 3 Ipu ipateuvin anasei, Ijah-uva ihetsau kahilchet ding ahi. 4 Pakai thahat le anatoh loupi tah tah, Thil kidang abol ho, ichate diuva jong i-impeh lou diu Khangkit’a jong iseipeh diu ahi. 5 Pakaiyin Jacob to kitepna aphutdoh-in, Israelte Danthu anapei; Danthu hi achateu ahil din Ipu ipateu anaseipeh-e. 6 Danthu ho hi khangkit’a miten Kihilna aneiyuva achate ahilson diu ahi. 7 Hichea hi amahon Pathen atahsan’uva, Athilbol asuhmil lou diu, Athupeh chengse anit jing diu ahi. 8 Apu apateu banga Pathen tahsan det lou, Pathena ki-ngai lou, Thu nung lou Doumah mah a chonte hilou diu ahi. 9 Ephriam mihon thalpi le thalchang apat vangun, Gal nikhon ajamtauve! 10 Pathento akitepnau anit pouvin, Adanthua jong anung pouve! 11 Thil kidang abol amusau jong Anatoh ho geiyin asumiltauve. 12 Egypt gam Zoan phaiya, Pathen thil kidang bol ho Apu apateuvin anavet vet jengu ahi. 13 Pathenin Twikhanglen avotanin, Apu apateu apui galakiyin, Twipi bang bangin akitinsah-e. 14 Sun teng meilhangin apuiyin, Janteng meikongin apuiye! 15 Gamthip laiya songpi apokhitsah-in, Leinoi lampeh a twi amaho adonsah-e. 16 Songpia konin tei aputsah-in, Luidung lonin alonsah-e! 17 Hinla amahon chonset abol jingun, Gamthip laiya jong Chungnungpen Pathen doumah jen gabol’ui! 18 Henasa san Pathen apatep’un, Akel lung changun An neh ding athum’ui! 19 Pathen dounan, “Gamthip laiya Pathenin Neh ding eipeh mong diu hinam? 20 Songpi avokhin, twi aputsah a Luibanga alonsah vangin; Amite eiho hi bu le sa eipeh thei diu hinam?” atiuve. 21 Aseiyu ajah hin Pakai along hangin, Alungna behseh-in Amite chu meiyin ahalvamtai! 22 Ajeh chu Pakai la atahsan pouvin, Amaho huhhing jou din jong Anatahsan pouve! 23 Hinla pathenin Vanthamjol Kotpi chengse kihong din aseiyin; 24 Vana konin buneh aneh thei Manna ahinsung lhai! 25 Pathenin aduchat jouseu apen, Israelten vantilte an aneuve. 26 Pathenin athahat’in sah le lhanga kon Huipi anunsah-in; 27 Amite din luipanga neldi jat leo Vachate ahinlhon lutsahin; 28 Vahchate chu abonchan Ngahmun lailung ponbuh veldung adimset’e! 29 Pathenin aduchat’u apen, Israelten vachate kithan anetauve! 30 Hinla agilkel chim masangu, A-an neh laitah-uvin; 31 Achunguva Pathen along hangin, Israel mi, pasal lhentum Mi thahat lai lai athat tai! 32 Hitipia aboltah vangin Israel achonse jingun; Thil kidang chujatpi abol vangin atahsanpouve. 33 Hijeh chun ahinkhou asuchomin, Kimlih leo leovin alhai! 34 Alah-uva mi phabep atha teng Adang ho ahenga ahungun, Lung aheiyun ahenga Lung laigil’in ataovui! 35 Chuteng apanpiuva ahoidamu chu Hatchungnung Pathen ahi ahedoh jiuve! 36 Amavang joujeng aseiyun, Lung thengsel’in imacha aseipouve! 37 Pathen din akitah pouvin, Akoma akitepnau jong alolhing pouve! 38 Pathenin vang amite ahepi jingin, Amaho sumang louvin asetnau angaidam’e; Alunghan tamtah vei adamin, Alungset akitim nah nah-e! 39 Khohui kitolmang banga Thi thei mihing ahiu ahe jinge! 40 Gamthip laiya ijat vei Pathen adouvuva, Ijat vei lung himoa alhau hitam! 41 Avel vel’in Pathen apatep’un, Israel Pathen theng chu aphinseuve! 42 Amelmateuva kona ahuhhing nia Pathen thahat loupije asumil’ui! 43 Egypt gam Zoan phaiya thil kidang abol, Anatoh nasatah tah chu asumil tauve. 44 Luidung jouse thisan asosah a Egupten don ding ahet lou asumil’ui. 45 Egypt thousi vaibong alha khumin, Asugenthei lheh jengun, Uphohte alhan Agamsungu asugam geiyin ahepouve. 46 Aloujaovuva khaokhopite alha a, Muchi chivo asuhgam jong ahaitauve! 47 Alengpigau gel avohchaisah a, Atheichangu daibang athasah asumil tauve. 48 Aganchau gel avoh lihsah a Kelngoi hon jouse keh aselihsah ahetapouve, 49 Egypt alunghan a mithat Vantil asol’a Athasah a alunghemu ahetapouve. 50 Alung han gpaiyin, Gamna alha khuma athagam asumil’ui. 51 Egypt insung jouse Pasal peng masa cheng athagam ahaitauve! 52 Kelngoi chingpa banga amite apuiya, Gamthip laiya apuidoh asumil’ui! 53 Kichatsah louvin amite apuiyin, Amelmateu twipi achupsah asumiltauve. 54 Gal’a alahsa molsang vum, Amunthenga amite apuidoh jong ahetapouve. 55 Amite kitol chun agamsunga chengte adelmangpeh-in, Agam’u Israelte ahoppeh a, a-in’uva amite Achensah geiyin asumiltauve. 56 Hinla Pathen Hatchungnung adou jingun, Apatep jiuvin athupeh ho anit pouve. 57 Kisonpi mo thalchang kon bang le Kitahna bei apateu bangin Doumah abol jingui! 58 Doiphung tampi asemdoh-un Pathen aphin lung hangun, Doilim tamtah asemjeh-un Hatah-in along hansah-ui! 59 Athilbol’u amujeh-in Pathen along hangin, Israelte apaimangtai. 60 I-lah-uva achenmun Shiloh a Aponbuh geiyin Pathenin adondai. 61 Athahat le aloupi melchihna Kitepna thingkong chu imelmateu amatsah-e. 62 Amite alunghanin, Amelmateu athagamsah-e. 63 Golhang jouse gal’a athitan, Nu-ngah hon ji ding aneitapouve! 64 Thempuho gal’in athat’un, Ajiteu jong akasah theipouve! 65 Ihmut’a kon thoudoh bangin Pakai ahung kipattan; Jukham pasal hattah bangin Pakai ahung kisentei! 66 A—itih a gal lel a jum din, Amelmate anung non adeljamtai! 67 Joseph chilhahte jong apaiyin, Ephriam phung jong alatapoi! 68 Adeipen Zion lhanga Juda phung joh alhengtai! 69 Zion lhanga van a a-in bangin Ahouin Theng akisah-e! Itih geiya kilong kit loudin, Leiset bangin asedettai! 70 Alhacha Davih alhengin, Akelngoi chinnaa akoudoh-e! 71 Kelngoi chingbanpi chu Israel lengpan atungin, Pathen mite chu kelngoi chinin achinsah tai! 72 David ama ki-itcha louvin Khut them to thon amite alamakaite!

Labu 79

Nampi huhdoh dia Taona

1 Vo Pathen, namdangten Nagam ahindel khumtauve! Nahouin theng asuhboh-un, Jerusalem asuchimsoh tauve! 2 Nalhachate muthong vah nan aneiyun, Atahsa longu sahang vah nan aneiyui! 3 Namite thisan tei kisung lha abahsah-un, Jerusalem kholaiya thisan teiyin alonge! thilong vui ding jong Mihem khatcha beh aumtapouve! 4 Kavel’uva chengten eng houle Daichatvai, nuisat’in eineiyui! 5 Neilunghan jing diu ham Pakai! Nalungset meibang kou jing ding ham? 6 chibai naboh lou, nahenga tao lou Namtin vaipi chunga lung hang jon! 7 Namite athat gam’un, Nagamsung asumangtauve! 8 Kapu kapateu chonset jal’a Telen matsah sangin, Tun neihepiuvin, Akinemlel gam kahitauve! 9 Vo Pathen, jabol nachan jingna din Kachonset’u ngaisamin, Neilhatdoh-un, neihuhhingun! 10 Ibol’a namtin vaipin, “Hoiba ham na-Pathen?” ati diu ham? Nalhachate thisan so jeh a Namtin vaipi telen namatsah Neimusah tauvin! 11 Tha dia kikoisate, Songkul lute kagin ngaiyin; Nathahat loupitah chun Amaho hi lhadoh-in jalensah tan! 12 Pakai, naphin phin a namdangte hi Sagi veijenin lethuh ten! 13 Chuteng, nakelngoihon tobang Namite keihon thangvah jing ung ting, Akhang khanga Nangma Kavahchoi jing diu ahitai!

Labu 80

Nam semphatna dia Taona

1 Ongiyin, Israel kelngoi chin a chinga, Joseph chilhah kelngoihon hoiya hoile Pa! Cherubim chunga touva, 2 Ephriam, Benjamin chule Manasseh phung hoa hung kiphongin, Thaneo tah-in hungin neihuhhingun! 3 Vo Pathen, huhhing kachan na diuvin, Neihepiuvin, neitahsemkit’un! 4 Vo, Pakai, thaneipen Pathen! Itih geiya namite taona nalunghan khum ding ham? 5 Neh le chah khel’in lungdon neipeuvin, Don ding khel’in mitlhi longin neikoitauve! 6 Jet le veiya namtinin gal eibol khumun, Melmaten eiphin phin’uve! 7 O thaneipen Pathen, Huhhing kachan theina diuvin Neihepiuvin, neithah semkit’un! 8 Egypt’a konin Lengpiphung nahinpon, Namtin vaipi nadeljamin, Agamsunguva lengpiphung chu naphuttai! 9 Lengpiphung phuna din tol nalaiyin, Ajung leigil’a alut’in abah-in gam leiset alosoh tai! 10 Alimin mol le lhang alen, Abahhon cedar thing sangtah tah ho akhui! 11 Abahho ajam jamin, Mediterranea Twikhanglen aphan, Euphrates luipi dung geiyin ajam’e! 12 Idia atho naphat lhah a, Atohkha chanin aga jouse akiguh ham? 13 Gamvohten achonpeh gamtan, Gamsaten kivahnan aneiyui! 14 Hung kihei kit’o thaneipen Pathen! Vana konin hinven, namite neihuhhingun! 15 Naphusa, hiche lengpiphung thah, Hoitah a nakhandohsah hi hinson! 16 Kamelmateuvin ahalgep’un aphuh lhutauve! Lunghan khumin sumang jengin! 17 Natundoh a nahatsah nalhensa namite vang Hoidamin vengtup jingin! 18 Nakoma konin kihei mangkit tapou vinge, Neihing hoiyun vahchoi jing unge! 19 Vo Pakai thaneipen Pathen! Huhhing kachan theina diuvin Neihepiuvin neithah semkit’un!

Labu 81

Kut La

1 Eipanpi Pathen, Jacob Pathen Vahchoi la othongin sauvin! 2 Tumging tumin khutbeh bengun, Tumging ngeito thon semjang le Selangsan saiyin vahchoiyun! 3 Lhathah ni le lhalih nin, Kut bolna din sumkon mut’un! 4 Hiche hi Israelte lah a Danthu, Jacob Pathen thupeh ahi! 5 Pathenin Egypt gam adelkhum chun Hiche dan hi Israelte anapei! Keiman mi kihelou thusei ogin kajan: 6 “Keiman napohgih-u kadom lhan, Chehtum gihtah jouse ka-ngahsah tai. 7 Nagenthei pet’a neikou chun Kanahuhhingtan; Meivom lhangkhal kakiselnaa konin Kahin donbut’e! Meribah twisam phunga jong Kanapatep’in ahi. 8 Kahilchahna ngaiphan kamite, Israel, kasei nangai ding kadei lheh-e! 9 Doi semthu nakoi dauva, Houjong nahou thei lou diu ahi! 10 Egypt’a kona nahinpuidoh, Pakai na-Pathen chu kahi; Kam kan, an nabah inge! 11 “Hinla kamiten kasei angaipon, Israel kathua anungpoi. 12 Hijeh chun along katahsah-in, Adei deiyu kabolsah-e! 13 O kamiten kasei ngai tavuo leh ! Kathua anun diu iti kadei hitam! 14 Chutileh amelmateu kajoa, Agal jouseu kajopeh ding ahi. 15 Eihot bolte kichan ka-anga kun’un tin, Tonsot’a hesoh genthei athoh diu ahi. 16 Nangho vang an thuipen kapeh-uva, Gam khoiju jadonsah diu ahi,” ati.

Labu 82

Vaihom pipen Pathen

1 Vanmite kikhopna a Pathenin vai ahomin, Pathen mite lailunga thu lhuhna asem’e! 2 “Ddih louva thutan ngauvin, Agiloute din lang neidauvin! 3 Cahgate panpiuvin, Panpibei, lhasamte phat bol’un! 4 Migiloute khut’a konin Lhasamle geochaote huhsoh-un! 5 “Lungthimbei mi-ngolte! Khosuh khotou helougam nahiuve! Vannoi leiset’a Thudih khatcha aumtapoi! 6 ‘Chungnungpen chate, Pathen mite nahiuve,’ kati ahi; 7 Hinla mihem thia nathiuva, Haosa chajeng jong athibanga nathi diu ahi,” ati. 8 Vo Pathen hungin leiset vaipon, Namtin vaipi namite jeng ahiuve.

Labu 83

Israel melmate jona dia Taona

1 Umthim loujen-o Pathen! Moh umthim hih hel’in! 2 Ven, namelmaten gal ahinbol’un, Nahoten doumah ahinbol tauve! 3 Namite dounan guh-in thil agongun, Nahon jingte ahindoutauve! 4 “Hungun, Israel kiphah poh kit louna din, Hiche nam hi sumanghel’u hite,” atiuve. 5 Nang dou din akihoutoh-un, Nadouna thil agongkhom’ui! 6 Edomte, Ishmaelte, Moab mite leh Hagar mite; 7 Gebal mite, ammonte leh Amalekte, Philistiate leh Tyre mite; 8 Assyria miten jong apanpin, Lot chilhah gal-hang jouse apangkhom’ui! 9 Midia mite le Kishon luiya Sisera le Jabin nabol bangin bol’in! 10 Amaho chu Endor a nathah’in, Tolgoa atahsau amonsah tai! 11 Alamkaiteu Oreb le Zeeb nabol bangin bol’in, Zebah le Zalmunna najo bangin Avaihomteu jousoh keiyin! 12 Hicheho hin, “Pathen gam leiset chu Kilah-ute,” anatiuve. 13 Vo Pathen, abonchauvin Vutvai kithe leh Changpol hui mutmang bahsah-in! 14 Gamkang kaa molle lhang Lhutvamhel bahsah jengin! 15 Khohui semjamsah-in lang Nahuise lhoh mangsah tan! 16 Mitjum maijumin lhan, Nathahat hetdoh sah-in! 17 Aitih-in kiphatlam le meidoiyin um’u hen, Jumle jan thigamu hen! 18 Leiset’a vaihom chungnungpen, Pakai nangbou nahi heu hen!

Labu 84

Pathen Houin ngaichat

1 O thaneipen Pakai! Nahouin theng dei le ngai aumin; 2 Chua lhah ding kanom’e! Pakai Houin ka-ngaiyin, Kahinkho pumpin hing jing Pathen ah Kipa la kasai! 3 O thaneipen Pakai, Kalengpa le ka-Pathen! Nahouin a vatoute le pelpalep jengin jong Bu asauvin, namaicham phung vel’a nou a-op’ui! 4 Nahouin apansaa, Navahchoi la sajingte anun nom’ui! 5 Zion jon a kijot’a, Nathahat’a kisongte anun nom’ui! 6 Kana Baca phaicham jot jong leu, Go masan twikul adipsoh a Kipana twisam phung ho tobang ding ahi. 7 Akijot nauva ahat cheh cheh-un, Zion a Van mite Pathen chu Agamu tei diu ahitai! 8 O Pakai thaneipen Pathen! Kataona ngaiyin lang, O Jacob Pathen! Neihouvin! 9 Vo Pathen, nathaonusa Kalengpau hi phatthei boh-in! 10 Mundanga ni sangkhat um sangin, Nahouina nikhat um aphajoi! Migiloute innom a chen sangin, Ka-Pathen inpi kotnga kanomjoi! 11 Pakai chu eihoidam’uva, leng loupe, Jabolna le hepina vang eiboh pau ahi! Aman thildih bolte din Thilpha a-itpeh khah poi! 12 O thaneipen Pakai, Nanga ki-ngai jingte anun nom’ui!

Labu 85

Nam phatna dia Taona

1 Pakai, nagamsung nahepin, Israel nahaosah kittai! 2 Namite toh khel jouse nachulnamin, Achonset chengseu na-ngaidamtai! 3 Achunguva lungsat nahaiyin, Nalunghan na-ngatai! 4 Vo Eihuhhingu Pathen, Neilungdamun neithahsem’uvin! 5 Neilunghan jinguva, Lungdam louhel dng nahin? 6 Neihatsah kitleu chun, Namiten vahchoi ki tnau vinge! 7 Pakai, longlouvin neilungset’un, Neipenpin neihuhhinguvin! 8 Pakai Pathen houlim ka-ngaiyin, Chonset ibol kit dau leh, Amite eiho chunga Cham leng din aseiye! 9 Ama jabolte huhhing nom jing, Huhhing dia igam’uva um jing ding ahi! 10 Ngailut le kitahna kilamtoa, Adidh le chamna kikoi ding ahi! 11 Leiset’a kona gunchuna kitungdoh a Van a kona adih kikhai lha ding ahi. 12 Pakaiyin eihaosah diu Gamga pungding ahi. 13 Adih masantin, Pakai lampi anasem ding ahi.

Labu 86

Panpi ngaicha Taona

1 Ngaiyin Pakai neihouvin! Lhasam le geo chaovin ka-um’e! 2 Neihuhhingin nadia lepthol bei kahi, Nanga ki-ngai nalhacha kahi neihuhhingin! 3 Neihepin ka-Pathen nahi, Nilhum lhumin nahenga kataove! 4 Kataona naheng ahunglhung tai, O Pakai nalhacha neikipahsah-in! 5 Neibol phauvin nei-ngaidam’ui, Nahenga taote dia lungset chamkim nahi! 6 Kataona nagiyin O-Pakai! Neihouvin panpi ka-ngaiye! 7 Neihouji jeh-in, Kagim nin Nangma kakouve! 8 O Pakai Nang tobang Pathen dang aumpon, Nabol tobang bol’a khatcha aumpoi! 9 Nasemsa namtin vaipi nahenga kun cheh diu, Namin achoi-at diu ahi! 10 Thahat tah, thil loupe pi boldoh, Nangbou Pathen nahi! 11 Neibolsh nom neihil’in Pakai, Nathu ngai molsonge! Lung sa-ih louhel’a Nakin bolje naihil’in! 12 O Pakai ka-Pathen, kalungthim pumpin vahchoiying ting, Nalal loupina tonsot Tonsot’in phongjal lenge! 13 Neingailutna aloupi ngeiye! Thina lhankhuh geisa neichohing tai! 14 Vo Pathen, ija nagel lou, Mi kiletsah engse loiyin tha din eidel khum’ui! 15 Pakai Nang vang hepi le ngailut them, Thoh hat jing, khoto them katah tah nahi! 16 Hung kiheiyin neilungset’in, kanu banga nakinbol kahi; Neihatsah-in neihuhhingin! 17 Nahot bolte jumsona din, Naphatje neimusah-in Pakai! Neipanpia neilhamon amu tengu jahchau hen!

Labu 87

Jerusalem choi-atna

1 Lhang theng chunga Pakaiyin akhopi aphutdoh-e! 2 Israelte khopi dang sangin, Pakaiyin Jerusalem akhohsah-e! 3 Vo Pathen khopi! Nachung thu loupin akiseiye! 4 “Kathu ngai nam mite lah a, Egypt le Babylon kisim than; Jerusalem tolkon lah a Philistiate, Tyre mite le Sudante kasim thai,” ati. 5 Zion thudol’a vang, Hatchungnungin phutdet’in tin, Namtin vaipi kikhol diu ahi. 6 Pakaiyin namtin vaipi asimtoh a, Abonchauva Jerusalem Khosung mia asim didng ahi. 7 Amahon,” I-phatheina jouseu Zion a hungkon ahi,” tia Lam’uva la asah diu ahi.

Labu 88

Panpi ngaiya Taona

1 O Eihuhhinga Pakai Pathen! Sun nilhum jan khovah-in na-anga kakap’e! 2 Kataona ngaiyin lang, Panpi ngaicha kakagin ngaiyin! 3 Gentheina ten eibomin, Thipai ding kahitai! 4 Alaichat chat ho kabangin, Thabei pai ding kahitai! 5 Don louva thilong lah a kijam, Thasaa lhankhuh a lum tobang kahi; Napanhu phah lou, Nasuhmilsa ho tobang kahi! 6 Kochong tong lai thimsung, Lhankhuh sunga neileh lut tai! 7 Neilunghan anasa behseh jengin, Natwipi kidil’in eichup tai! 8 Kagolte neidalhah sah tan, Avetda dauvin neisemin, kikul khup’a jamdoh thei lou kahitai! 9 Lung gimin kamit athimlon, Niseh-in kakoujin, Nangma sangin kataove Pakai! 10 Thilong damsa hi thil kidang bolpeh le chun, Thoudoh a navahchoi diu hinam? 11 Lhan’a lumsa nalungset long lou seiya, Manthahna geisan nakitahna aseimong-um? 12 Muthim gama thil kidang nabol amu’uva, Ihmut milna gama naphatna kihedoh nam? 13 Pakai, napanpi ngeh-in, Jingkah she-in nahenga kataove! 14 O Pakai idia neidonda a, Velouva kiheimang nahim? 15 Kaneocha lhah gim genthei kathoh-in, Thi ding konchan ka-um jinge; Neigimbolna cheng kathoh na a Apang joulou kahitai! 16 Nalunghan kadimtan, Neibolgimnaa mangthah pai ding kahi! 17 Hicheng hin twibang eichup nilhum lhumin, Jet le veiya eiumchah soh tai! 18 Kagol ngaitah tah jong neidalhah sah ten, Muthimlah a kalengtai!

Labu 89

Nam gentheipet’a La

1 Vo Pakai, nalungset long lou Tonsot jailan oiying ting; Nakitahna hi itih-in Phongjal lenge! 2 Nalungset beitih neilou kahen, Nakitahn avan banga kidal jing ahi. 3 Nangin, “kadeilhen mitoh kitepna kasemin, kalhacha David henga kakitep’in; 4 ‘Nachilhah khat leng chang jing ding, Nalengvai neina koipeh jing ding kahi,’ tin,” naseiye. 5 Pakai, thil kidang nabol ho Vanin lan asan; Nakitahna jalan a-oiyui! 6 Vana jong natobang aumpoi Pakai, Van mite khatcha jong Nangto kibang aumpouve! 7 Van mithengte kikhopna kijapen nahin, Nang gin nan adding cheh-ui! 8 Pakai thaneipen Pathen, Nahat kibahpi aumpon; Ijakaiya kitahpen nahi Pakai! 9 Twikhanglen huneitah chunga vai nahomin, Twipi kinong lai naphoh thip jie! 10 Gul- lhempi Rahab nachilgoiyin, Naban thahat’in namelmate najoutai! 11 Van la nanga, leiset jong nanga; Vannoi le asunga um jouse nasemsa ahi. 12 Sah le lhang nasemin, Tabor lhangle Hermon mol’in nahenga kipa la asai! 13 Nakhut tha aham lheh-in, Naban-gol tha ahat’e! 14 Nalaltouna adih le kitahna chunga akidon, Natohna chan a ngailut le kitahna akimui! 15 O Pakai, namaivah a vah lea, Kipa la sa chibai nabohte anun nom’ui! 16 Naphatna avahchoiyun, Nilhum lhumin nachunga akipah-ui! 17 Minthangtah tah-in gal neijosah-un, Neingailut jal’un hanla neisah sah-ui! 18 O Pakai, eihoidam diu nalhengdoh-in, Vo Israel Pathen theng, kalengpau napansah-e!

David henga Pathen thutep

19 Malaiyin nalhacha tahsan umte gaochannaa, “Sepai minthang khat kapanpin, Mipi lah a kalhendoh Mikhat chu laltona kapei, 20 Kalhacha David chu thao theng kanun, lengin katungdoh tai. 21 Kaban thahat’a katuh jinga, kaban-gol tha kapeh ding ahi. 22 Amelmaten adou joulouhel ding, Migilouten jong jouponte! 23 Agalte kasuhgep’a, Ahotbol chan katha ding ahi. 24 Ka-ngailut’a adia kakitah jing ding, Gal kajosah jing ding ahi. 25 Alenggam Mediterranea Twilen apat Euphrates luipi geiya kakeh let ding ahi. 26 Aman kajah a, ‘Kapa le ka-Pathen, Eihoidama le Eihuhhingpa nahi,’ tinte. 27 Chapa masapena kaneiya, Leng jouse sanga kachoi sang ding ahi. 28 Adin kakitepna nit jing ing ting, kakiteppina tonsot’a um ding ahi. 29 Alengvai neina Vanthamjol um jing bang ding, Achilhah khat leng chang jing ding ahi. 30 “Achilhahten ka-Danthu anitdauva, Kathupeh ho banga chon lou, 31 Kahilchahna cheng nahsah moa, Kathupeh chengse anitdau vangleh, 32 Achonsetnau jeh a talen kapeh a, Abol khel jal’uva genthei kathohsah ding ahi. 33 David vang kangailut jinga, Adia kakitepna kanit jing ding ahi. 34 Kakiteppina palkeh pong ting, Kateppeh khatcha bolda ponge! 35 “Kamitheng pan itih a dia kitepsa kahitan, David joulhep ponge! 36 Ason apah um jing ding, Ni le lha umlaisea alenggam kavettup jing ding ahi. 37 Vanthamjol’a hettohsah phatseh a kanei, Lha banga alenggam um jing ding ahi,” nati.

Lengpa gal lel lunghempi

38 Tunla nalhentum lengpa nalunghan khumin, Donlouvin napaidoh tai! 39 Nalhacha toh kitepna nasukeh-in, Alallukhuh vutbol lah a nasep luttai! 40 Akhopi pal jouse naloilhun, akulpi abonchan naloiphei! 41 Ajotpa chanin athilkeo akiguh-un, Aheng akom jousen anuisat’ui! 42 Agalte najosah tan, Agalte kipah thanomin naumsah-e! 43 Agal manchah jouse manmo nason, Galmuna gal nalelsah tai! 44 Aleng tenggol nasat lhan, Alaltouna toljepnan naneiye! 45 Gollhang manlouvin nalhan, Jumle ja thoh-in nakoiye!

Huhdohna dia Taona

46 Pakai, nakisel thip beh ding hitam? Itih chan nalungsat meibanga kou jing ding ham? 47 Kahinkho chomdan geldoh-in Pakai! Ngaiton, thi theiya neisem cheh-u ahime! 48 Thi lou ding koima aumpon, Lhana kivui lou didng jong aumpoi! 49 Masanga neingailut nau hoiham Pakai? David dia nakitepna ho hoiba ham? 50 O Pakai, nalhachapa eiphin nau, Melmate gaosap kathoh hi gel jingin! 51 Nalhentum lengpa aphinseuve Pakai! Achena chana aphin phin jengui! 52 Tonsot’in Pakai vahchoiyin um hen! Amen! Amen!

BU LINA (Labu 90-106)

Labu 90

Pathen chule Mihem

1 O Pakai, akhang khanga Kakiselnau kulpi nahi! 2 Vannoi naphudoh a mol le lhang nasem maa jong, umjingsa Pathen, um jing ding Pathen nahi! 3 Nangin mihem akisemna kile kit’a, Leivui nungso kit dingin naseiye! 4 Nang din kum sang jong hi Nikhat bep ahin; Janhi kitolmangloi bep, Jan mangkal khat bep ahi! 5 Twisoh milhoh bangin neilhoh mangun, Jan mangkal khat bep bou kahiuve! Jingkah daitwiya Hamdong noudoh bep kahiuve! 6 Akhangdoh loiyin apah-in, Nilhah lam teng agop jin athijitai! 7 Nalunghanin kamagnthah tauvin, Nalungsat’in kakihot lhul tauve! 8 Kachonsetnau nave jingin, Guh thima kasetna jouseu namu jinge! 9 Nalunghanin kahinkhou achomlon, Hai khat’in abeiji tai! 10 Kum somsagi bep kahing jiuvin, Damthei lheh jongleur, Kum somget bang bou kahingui! Kahin laiyun chol le nangin ka-umun, Hinkho alhing loi jin, kabeipaitauve! 11 Nalunghan khohje hea koi hiya, Nalungsat’in itobang kichatna ahin lhut ding kon hem? 12 Kachih theina diuvin, kahinkho chomjeu neihil’un! 13 Itih chan neilung han diu ham? O Pakai, nalhachate neikhotaouvin! 14 Kahinkho lhum’uva kipa nopla sa din, Jing khovah she leh long louvin neilungset’un! 15 Gentheina kum sunga neigimsahna jat mauvin, Kipan thanomin neilhauvin! 16 Nathilbol nasatah ho nalhachate neimusah-un; Nathahat loupi chu kachateu musah-in! 17 Pakai ka-Pathenu, phatthei neiboh-un; Kabolchan neilo lhinsah-un!

Labu 91

Eihoidam’uva Pathen

1 Chungnungpen Pakai kulsunga lut’a, Hatchungnung limdam noiya kisel chun 2 “Eipanpia eihoidam, ka-Pathen Ka-kingaina nahi,” atitheiye. 3 Chuteng Pakaiyin thangkol sung le Thihel theina natna konin jong hoidoh nante! 4 Alhavingin nakhuntin nasel nante; Akitahna luma nadalpeh ding ahi. 5 Jan teng kichapon natin, Sun teng gal nagin lou ding; 6 Muthima hise lang hihen, Sun laiya mithat hijongle gingpon nate! 7 Nakoma sangkhat din lhuh hen, Navel’a sangsom kijam jongle ima tipon nate! 8 Vele chun migilou Talen kimatsah chu namu ding ahi. 9 Ajeh chu Pakaiya kisel nahin, Hatchungnungin nahoidamtai! 10 Hatsahnan napha pontin, Na-insunga manthahna lut ponte! 11 Nachena lam lama nahoidam din Pathenin Avantilte nganse nante! 12 Songhoa nakeng kisuh khah louna din, Vantilten domkhang nauvin nate! 13 Sakeihole gulte, sakei hangtah ho, Gulse ho geiya nachotpeh ding ahi! 14 Pathenin, “Pakai kahi eihea nagilute chu Kahuhhinga kahoidam ding; 15 eikou tengu houving ting, Agim tengu ka-umpi ding; Kahuhdoh a kachoi-at ding; 16 Kahuhhinga sot tah tah kahinsah ding,” ati.

Labu 92

Vanchoina La

1 Vo Pakai Chungnungpen Pathen, Nangma thangvah le najabol lasah aphai! 2 Jingkah seh le nalungset long lou phon a, Nilhah she a nakitahna phon ding; 3 Tumging thei jouse le Semjang gin ngeito tho hi aphai. 4 Vo Pakai, nathilbol loupe hon eikipasah-e; Natoh thil nasa hojeh-in kipa la kasai! 5 Pakai, nathilbol anasan, Nalungel agil’e! 6 Mingol het the idol ahipon, Lungthimbei hetkhen hoi ahipoi! 7 Migilou hamdong pha bang hen, Bol khel neiho khangtou jongleh; Aboncha kisumang diu ahi. 8 Tonsot’a thahat jing nahi Pakai! 9 Namelmate thigam’a, Migiloute kithecheh soh diu ahi. 10 Keivang gambongchal bangin neihatsah-in, Vang neiboh-in neinopsah tai! 11 Kamelmate kisuhgep kamun, Migiloute kagin kajai! 12 Midih chu chahthing nanou bang ding, Lebanon lhang cedar thing bang diu ahi! 13 Pakai insunga kiphut thing phung bang diu, I-Pathenu Houin thenga thing nanu bang diu ahi! 14 Hitobang thing hi ateh geiyin agatheiyin, Anou jingin atah jingin ahi! 15 Hiche hin Pakai thudih aphongin, Eihoidampa monabei aseidoh-e!

Labu 93

Pathen Leng ahi

1 Pakai chu Leng ahin, Lal loupina kijem, thaneitah ahi. Leiset phudetsan akoiyin Kibotkang kit lou ding ahi. 2 Vo Pakai, nalaltouna long lou, Tonsot’a um jing jeng nahi! 3 Vo Pakai, Teikhanglen lithuh ho aging lul lul’un, Nangma choi-anin akithongje jui! 4 Van a Pakai thaneitah-in vai ahomin, Twikhanglen kithong sangin ahatjon, Twikhanglen kithong sangin ahatjon, Twipi kidil sangin jong ahuneijoi! 5 Pakai, Nadanthu ho abang ahijingin, Tonsot tonsot’a um jing ding ahi.

Labu 94

Ijakai Thutah Pathen

1 Vo Pakai, phulah them Pathen! Nalunghan hinphongin! 2 Namtin vaipi thutan nahi, Kipat’in kiletsahte achanlom pen! 3 Vo Pakai itih chan migiloute nakipasah a, Ichan geiya nakichoisang sah ding ham? 4 Kiletsahten lhajeng jungin thu aseiyun, Athilse bol’u kiletsah hoithonnan aneiyui! 5 Ven Pakai na-ngailut namite, Abolgimun achilngem ngem jengui! 6 Meithai ho le chagate athat’un, Kagamsunguva kholjin ho athat’ui! 7 “Pakaiyin la eimu pouvin, Israel Pathenin ahephapoi,” atiuve. 8 Vo hitobangloma ngol mihem ho, Itih ba nachih doh diu ham? 9 Nakhang sem Pathen chun ajah moa, Mit sem a Pathenin amu mom? 10 Vaipi vengtup Pan talen apeh moa, Mitin thumop chun ahetmo ding ham? 11 Miho ngaito Pakaiyin ahen, Athil ngaitou moh ahi ahei! 12 Vo Pakai, nahilchah mihem, Nadanthu nahilthempa chu anun nom’e! 13 Migiloute lhah lhumna ding khuh kilai kah, Gim genthei nikho sungin jong nacholdoh dah-e! 14 Pakaiyin amite dalha pontin, Agoulo mite donda ponte! 15 Thutanna in a thudih lenga, Midih jousen pha asah diu ahi! 16 Migiloute eidouhu ding koi hiya, Thilse bolte eidouhu ding koiham? 17 Pakaiyin eipanpi lou hileh, Lhan muthim noiya lum tange! 18 “Vo Pakai, kalhutai, nalungset long louvin Neiphong dingin! 19 Lung gim genthei kathoh teng, Neilhamonin neikipasah-e! 20 Thudih loud an asem, Dan dih louva thutante napanpi pon; 21 Miphate tha dia gong, Monabeite tha dia thutante napanpi poi! 22 Pakaiyin eipanpin, Ka-Pathenin eihoidam nai! 23 Pathenin agitlou jal’uva talen apeh ding, Achonset jal’uva asuhmang ding ahi; Pakai i-Pathen’un Amaho sumang nante!

Labu 95

Vahchoina La

1 Hungun Pakai vahchoiyute! Eihoidam Pathen a kipa la sauté! 2 Thangvah to thon a-anga lut’utin, Avahchoi la kipah-in sauté! 3 Ajeh chu Pakai hi Pathen loupe ahin, Semthu pathen dang sanga Leng hat ahi. 4 Pathenin van le leiset pumpi, Leiko tongpen a pat lhang sangpen geiyin vai apoi. 5 Asemsa Twikhanglen le atundohsa Leiset chunga vai ahom jinge! 6 Hungun, Eisempau Pakai anga kunin, Boh khup’in chibai boh cheh-ute! 7 Ajeh chu ama i-Pathenu ahin, Eiho avahsa amite, akaile kelngoi hon ihiuve! Tunin asei ngaiyun! 8 “Meribah a napu napateu bangin lungtah dan, Massah gamthip a bangin lungtah dauvin, 9 Hikom dunga hin kathilbol munasan Napu napateuvin eipatep leuvin; 10 Kum somli sungin kagim kathang anam leovun, ‘Itijong hiti lepcheuva, Kathupeh jouse anitdau ham’ kati. 11 Kalungsan giltah-in kakitep’in, ‘Nacholdo mun diuva kapeh Gamsunga nalut louhel diu ahi,’ kati,” ati.

Labu 96

Leng loupi Pathen

1 Pakaiya lathah sauvin! Sauvin vannoi pumpin Pakaiya! 2 Pakai vahchoi la sauvin amin choi-an’un; Eihuhhingnau Thupha nitinin phongjal’un! 3 Chitin namtin lah a aloupina phongun, Athilbol kidang ho mitin lah a phongleuvin! 4 Aloupipen Pakai, minthangtah a vahchoi lom ahi; Semthu pathen dang sanga jabol ding ahi. 5 Namdangten Pathen ahisah-u hi semthu bou ahin, Pakai vang hin Vanmun geiya asem ahi. 6 Pakai kimvel’a lal loupina jana dim, Amuntheng phung thahat le mel-hoi adem’e! 7 Leiset miten Pakai vahchoiyun! Vahchoiyun aloupi le athahat! 8 Pakai min loupe vahchoiyun! Thilto choiyin a-inpia hung lut’un! 9 Hinkho theng mel-hoiyin Pakai chibai boh-un; Pakai anga leiset pumpi tijau hen! 10 Namtin vaipi jah a, “Pakaiyin lengvai apoi; Leiset akiphutdettai killing ponte; Thudih manga vannoi thu atan ding ahi,” tiuvin! 11 Lei le van kipah hen! Twikhanglen le asunga chengten Othongin oiyu hen! 12 Loujao ho le asunga keh jouse kipah hen! Gammang thing jousen kipa la sau hen! 13 Leiset vaihom dia Pakai hung teng, Thudih le thuphaa vannoi mite thu atan ding ahi!

Labu 97

Thunei Chugnung Pathen

1 Pakai aleng changtai! Leiset kipah hen! Kipah-un twikol gam jouse! 2 Pakai, meilhang jinglei loiyin atomin, Thudih le atah mangin vai apoi! 3 Amasang meikouje jun alengin, Akimvel’a melmate ahalvamsoh tai! 4 Keh alhahsah teng vannoi asalvah-in, Leiset’in amun akihot lhul’e! 5 Lhangsang jouse Pakai anga khoilu bangin ajol’in, Leiset pumpi Pakai anga ajolsoh tai! 6 Vanmun jousen Pakai dihna aphongin, Namtin vaipin aloupi amui! 7 Doi hou chan ajah chan, Semthu pathen dang ho Pakai anga akuntauve! 8 Vo Pakai, nathutan dih jal’in, Zion mite akipah-in, Judah khopi ho athanom’ui! 9 Thaneipen Pakai, leiset pumpi vaipo nahi; Semthu pathen dang ho sangin naloupi ngeiye! Amite ahoidamin migiloutea konin ahuhdohjie. 11 Midihte din khovah tan, Miphate din kipana ahune! 12 Midihte Pakaiya kipah-un, Amintheng vahchoiyun!

Labu 98

Vannoi vaihom Pathen

1 Pakaiya lathah sauvin! Pakaiyin thil kidang dang aboltai! Aban-gol ajen athahat’in Gal ajousoh tai! 2 Pakaiyin galjo aphongdoh tan, Namtin vaipi athahat ahetsah tai! 3 Israelte dia kitah dingle longlouva Lungset dia akitepna amolsoi! Leiset kolkimvel’a min I-Pathenu gakjo amusoh tai! 4 Leiset pumpin Pakaiya kipa la sauvin! Vahchoiyun kipa lan, oiyun thanomin! 5 Semjang saigin to thon Pakai vahchoi la sauvin! 6 Sumkon le saki mut’un, Kipah-in oiyun Pakai i-Lengpau! 7 Twikhanglen le asunga chengten oiyun! Leiset le achung chengten sauvin kipa la! 8 Luidung jousen khut bengun! Mol le lhang jousen Pakaianga kipa la sauvin! 9 Leiset vaihom din Pakai ahunge! Thudih le apha vannoi mite vai ahom ding ahi!

Labu 99

Leng Chungnung Pathen

1 Pakaiyin lengvai apoi, Mitin vaipi tijau hen! Cherubim chunga laltounna atouve, Leiset killing hen! 2 Zion a Pakai alaltai, Chitin namtin chunga achungnungpen’e! 3 Mitinin amin lal loupe vahchoi ding, Amabou atheng ahi! 4 Thaneitah Leng, adih ngailu, Israel lah a thudih tungdoh, Thudih le apha napolut’e! 5 Pakai i-Pathenu vahchoiyun, Alaltouna maiya chibai boh-un, Amabou atheng ahi! 6 Athempu lah a Mose le Aaron akisim than, Amina tao lah a Samuel jong apange; Thempuho Pakaiya atao tengu Aman adonbut jie! 7 Meilom lah a konin Thempuho akihoupin, Danthule thupeh apeh hi Thempuhon amit’ui! 8 O Pakai ka-Pathen, namite taona nasangin; Achonset nau talen namatsah vangin, Namite din mi-ngaidam pathen nahi namusah-e! 9 Pakai i-Pathenu vahchoiyun, Alhang thenga Ama chibai boh-un! Pakai i-Pathenu hi athenge!

Labu 100

Vahchoina La

1 Vannoiyin Pakaiya la sauvin! 2 Kipah-in Pakai chibai boh-un, Kipa la san a-ang sunga Hung lut’uvin! 3 Sumil loujen’un Pakai chu Pathen ahi. Asemsate, Amaa ihiuve; Amite ahiuvin, akelngoihon ihiuve! 4 Thangvah-un Ahouin kelkot’a lut’un, Vahcoi pumin a-inpia lut’un; Thangvah-un amin choi-an’un! 5 Pakai nun nem ahi; Alungset longlou, Akitahna um jing jeng ahi!

Labu 101

Leng khat Kitepna

1 Nakitehna le nathudihje Pakai ken lan sange! 2 Nolnabeiyin chon nange! Kahenga itih nahung dem? Ka-insunga lungthengin um ing ting, 3 Thilse umsah ponge. Kipalna neisaho natoh kahon, Hiche ho hin eisuboh ponte. 4 Lung thengmon um pong ting, Thilse tongkha pong! 5 Guhthima aheng akom house chu Kasuhmang ding; Mi kiletsah hoitho chu Nom lensah ponge! 6 Gamsung mi kitahho hebol ing ting, kaleng inpia kachensah ding; Lung thengsel ho chu Semang pachonga kapansah ding ahi. 7 Mijou kaleng inpia cheng lou ding, kakoma miphalhem um theilou ding ahi. 8 Igamsunguva migiloute Niseh a katha tha jeng ding; Migilouse se Pakai khopia kona kadelmang ding ahi.

Labu 102

Gollhang hesoh taona

1 Kataona ngaiyin O Pakai! Najah din kakap’e! 2 Kahesoh teng Neinungsun loujenin! Ngaiyin, kakou teng neihou loiye! 3 Kahinkho la meikhu bangin abeihei hoiyin, Kagu kachang meisa bangin Akihul let lut jenge! 4 Hamgo kinoigep bangin kalungthim agon, Anjong kaneh nompoi! 5 Kapen pen nan Kagu lheng lhon bou aumtai! 6 Gamthip laiya songthoi ham kabangin, Khogem lah a simbupi ham kabange! 7 Kalup vangin ka-ihmu thei pon, Intingvuma vacha chang khat tou kabange! 8 Kamelmaten eiphin nilhumkeiyun, Eidaithang hon kamin agaosap’ui! 9 Anneh khel’in vutvam kaleh-in, Twidon khel’in kamitlhi kaval’e! 10 Ajeh chu lungphamon neilunghan khumin, Neidom sangin neipai mangtai! 11 Kahinkho la nisa kihei bep ahin, Loudong gopsuh bep kahi! 12 Hinla O Pakai, Nangma tonsot Leng nahin, Akhang khangin naminthang jinge! 13 Hung kipat’in Zion khoton, Zion khoto phat alhingtai; 14 Kisumang ta jongleh NalhachatenZion angailun; Khogemsa ahitah vangin, Zion chunga avoujang nauve! 15 Namtin vaipin Pakai gingun tin, Leiset leng jousen athahat gingunte! 16 Pakaiyin Zion asemphat teng, Alal loupina phongdoh tante! 17 Donlousa amite taona ngaiyin tin, Athum chanu bulhitpeh tante! 18 Apeng loulaiho geiyin avahchoi thei nan, Pakai natoh hi khatkit’a te din sundoh-in! 19 Pakaiyin chunglam aumna muntheng Van a koninleiset ahinvei! 20 Songkul lute taona angaiyin, Tha dia thutansate alhasoh-e! 21 Zion a Pakai kiseiphongsoh ding, Jerusalem a Aman kivahchoi ding ahi! 22 Lenggam jousea chitin namtin kikhom’uva Pakai chu chibai aboh cheh diu ahi! 23 Kahat laiyin Pakaiyin katha asubeiyin, Aphat louvin kahinkho asuchom’e! 24 Vo Pathen katahman neithisah dan! Tonsot kumkhoa hing jing nahi Pakai! 25 Semtil’in leiset nasemin, Van mun jouse nakhuttah-in nasemdoh-e! 26 Nasemsa jouse mangsoh ding, Nang vang um jing ding nahi; Nasemsa ho ponset’a sea, Pon banga naseimoa, mangsoh diu ahi! 27 Nang vang abang nahi jingin, Nahinkho beitih aumpoi! 28 Kachateu lung monga chenguva, Achilhah teu na-anga hoidam diu ahi.

Labu 103

Pathen mi-ngailut

1 Ka-lhagaovin Pakai vahchoiyin, Kahinkho pumpin amintheng choi-anin! 2 Ka-lhagaovin Pakai vahchoiyin, Aphat kidang ho sumil loujenin! 3 Pakaiyin kachonset jouse angaidamin, Kaveiset adamsah soh tai! 4 Lhankhuh gei dingsa eicho hingin, Lungset le hepitah-in phatthei eiboh-e! 5 Kahinkhon thilpha jengin eingoichon, Haljingin muvanlai bangin kahat jinge! 6 Bolset thohte Pakaiyin akhoton, Thu adih lamin atanpeh-e! 7 Pakaiyin athilgon Mose henga aphongin, Athilbol kidang ho Israel chate amusah-e! 8 Pakai chu hepi le lungset them, Lunghangvah lou, lungset longlouhel ahi! 9 Mi apho jing lou ding, Lung jong lung hang jing ponte! 10 Ichan diu dol talen eipepouvin, Ichonset nau le bolkhel ho jat’in eilethuh pouve. 11 Angailua jabolte din Pakai mingailut van chanin asange! 12 Ichonset jouseu Niso le nilhum chanin atolmangtai! 13 Ajabolte hi Pakaiyin Mipa chate hepi bangin ahepi! 14 Pakaiyin ikisemdol’u ahen, Leivuiya kon ihiu ahejinge! 15 Ihinkhou vang hampa bep, Hampa khan a khang chomcha pah bou ihiuve! 16 Hui nun teng hampa amut mangin, Koiman amuphaji tapoi! 17 Pakai jabolte din vang Alungset guitanmo, akhang khanga aphatna um jing ahi! 18 Athutep’a tah pante, Athupeh chan nit themte dia chute ahi. 19 Pakaiyin van a laltouna akidon, Ijakai chunga lengvai apoi! 20 Vantil hat, thaneitah hon vahchoiyun Pakai! Athupeh nit themten asei ngaiyun! 21 Alhacha adei bol, van a thaneitah hon Vahchoiyun Pakai! 22 Alengvai neina chan a asemsaten Vahchoiyun Pakai! O ka-lhagao Vahchoiyin Pakai!

Labu 104

Eisempau vahchoina

1 Ka-lhagao Pakai vahchoiyin! O Pakai ka-Pathen naloupi ngeiye! Jabolna le Lal loupinan Nakijem’e! 2 Khovah loupin nakivonin, Pondal bangin van nasungin; 3 Twipi chunga in nasan, Meilhang kangtalaiyin namange’ Huipi chunga natouvin ahi. 4 Khopihui solchah-in nanaeiyin, Lhacha kolphe namange! 5 Leiset bulpi naphutset’in, Kilong kit ponte! 6 Leiset chu Twikhangin nakhun, Molsang ho jong twiyin achup’e! 7 Napho teng twipi akinongin, Na-ogin ajah tengu akitol tol jiuve! 8 Mol le lhang akhotan’un phaichama ahung longun; nasemna mun jousea alongui! 9 Leiset achup kit louna din Akhokal lou diu gamgi nasempeh-e! 10 Phaicham dunga twisam naputsah-in, Lhang le lhang kah a luidung nalonsah-e! 11 Luidung hao hin gamsaten twi adon’un, Gamlah sa-nganten dang noun an aneiyui! 12 Vapang thingphung dunga Vachate busan kipah-in la asauve! 13 Van a konin mol le lhang gotwi nachapsah-in, Leiset hi navangboh adimset’e! 14 Gancha neh din hamhing napousah-in, Mihemin avatchaiya muchi tuna aneidin hampa nakesah-e! 15 Akipana din lengpitwi napensah-in, Athanopna din olive thao napen; Akithadona din anneh napei! 16 Pakai phusa thingphung, Lebanon lhanga Cedar ho Gotwi nengtah-in adou jingui! 17 Cedar thing chung dunga vachaten bu asan, Chahthing phung dunga vakangten bu asai! 18 Molsang dunga gamkelte achengun, Songkol khikah dunga kolsate akisel’ui! 19 Kum kiheichin melchihnan Lha nasemin, Nisa alhum phat akihet’e! 20 Jan nasemin, khojin teng Gamsa jouse alhadoh jiuve! 21 Sakei noute sadel’in akisen sen’un; Neh ding Pathena akithum’ui! 22 Nisa so teng changsunga akileuvin, Akhosung dunga alum jiuve! 23 Hiche kah hin mihem avaikon’un, Nilhah geiyi na atongui! 24 Pakai, thil hijatpi hi chingtah-in nasemin, Nasemsa leiset adimtai! 25 Twikhanglen lentah le jaotah, Asunga ganhing len le neo adimset’ui! 26 Twipi chunga kong innei akitol’un, Nasemsa Leviathanin alamtinjie! 27 Ganhing hijat kel le chah khoto din, Abonchannasanglam avecheh-ui! 28 Aduchanu napen, aneuvin; Anneh napen, anevaiji tauve! 29 Nakihei mang teng akichauvin, Nahaisam sah teng athiuvin leivuiya akilekitji tauve! 30 Nalhagao napeh teng semdoh ahitauvin, Leiset’a amaho hi hinkho thah napei! 31 Tonsot’in Pakai loupe jing hen; Asemsa chunga pakai kipah jing hen! 32 Pakaiyin leiset avet teng akilingin, Molsang dung athamleh akhulet lut’e! 33 Kahin laisen Pakai choi-at la sang ting, Hinlai damsungin ka-Pathen vahchoi la sange! 34 Pakaiyin kipah thanom kahi, Kalasah chunga lung lhai hen! 35 Leiset’a chonsete kisugam hen, Migilou kilulah kit da hen! Ka-lhagaovin Pakai vahchoiyin! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 105

Pathen chule Amite

1 Thangvah-un Pakai, aloupina phongjal’un; Namtin lah a athilbol seichoi leuvin! 2 Pakai vahchoiyun, Thil kidang abol ho sei leuvin! 3 Kipah-un Amaa ahiuve, Ama chibai hoh jouse kipah hen! 4 Pakai panpi hol’un, Ama chibai boh jinguvin! 5 Thil kidang abol ho jeh leh Athutan dih jeh hin, 6 Alhacha Abraham chilhahte le Alhenchom Jacob chilhahten Pakai gel jingun! 7 Pakai hi i-Pathenu ahin, Athupeh ho vannoi pumpi ding ahi! 8 Akitepna nit jing ding, Athutep ho khang sang sanga anit ding ahi! 9 Abraham to akinopto na, Isaac athutep anit tei ding ahi! 10 Pakaiyin Jacob to kitepna asemchu, Tonsot tonsot’a um jing ding ahi! 11 “Canaan gam napeng ting, Nagoulo gam hiding ahi,” ati. 12 Pathen mite lhomcha ahi laiyun, Canaan gama akhopem’un; 13 Agam gama avah leuvin, Lenggam khat’a konin achom khat’a acheuve! 14 Hinla Pathenin koima abolgenthei sah pon, Ahoidamna diuvin keng ho agihsal jie! 15 “Kalhentum lhachate suse hih-un, Ka-Themgaote bolse hih-un!” ati. 16 Pakaiyin gamsunga kel alhan, Neh le chah asumangtai! 17 Soh joh a ajoh-u Joseph chu Israelte masanga asol masan; 18 Joseph chu akenga thih khaovin ahen’un, Alol’a thih-kol’in ahen’ui! 19 Pakai thun athemna aphondoh a, Aseidohsa guilhun kahsen ahen’uve! 20 Chuin Egypt lengpa, namtin vaipo pan Joseph alhadoh-in achamlhatsah tai! 21 Agamsunga apipun apansah-in, Anei jouse chunga vaipon akoitai! 22 Lengpa natong ho hithei leh Athumopte hilchah thei din apansah-e! 23 Jacob jong achen, Egypt gamsunga achengtai! 24 Pakaiyin amite cha le nao apunsah-in, Akidoupiteu sangin tha aneisah-e! 25 Amite chu Egypt mite ahotsah-in, Alhachate khut thah lhau nan aneitauve! 26 Hichun alhacha Mose le Alhendoh Aaron asol’e! 27 Mose le Aaronin Egypt gama Pathen vangin thil nasatah tah le kidang abol lhon’e! 28 Pathenin Egypt gama thim ajinsah-in, Hinla Egypt miten athu angaipouve! 29 Aluidung twi jouseu thisan asosah-in, Nga jouse jong athatgamtai! 30 Agamsungu uphoh adimtan, Leng inpi geiyin adimtai! 31 Pathenin thu apeh leh Thou vaisi ahung langin gamsung adimtai! 32 Gotwi khel’in kol aphetsah-in Agamsunguva gel alhahsah tai! 33 Lengpigui le theichang phung ho, Thingphung ho asumangsoh tai! 34 Pathenin aseile, simsen lou Khaokhote ahung langin; 35 Gamsunga hamdong jouse le Lhosah ga jouse anechaitauve! 36 Pathenin Egypt mite insunga Chapa peng masa jouse athatai! 37 Hichun Israelte apuidoh-in, Amahon dangka le sana akiph-un Ahao theiyun ahat lheh tauve! 38 Egypt miten akichauvin, Israelten adalhah-u akipapaive! 39 Pathenin sun teng amite Meilhangin adal jin, Janteng meikong asalvah sahjie! 40 Israelten athumjeh-un vanmite alhalut peh-in, Van akonin anneh apei! 41 Songpi ahongdoh-intwi aputsah-in, Nelgama vadung bangin alonsah-e! 42 Alhacha Abraham henga Akitepna theng chu agel jinge! 43 Hiti hin alhenchomte apuidoh-in, amahon kipa la san a-oiyui! 44 Pathenin amaho hi midang ho gam alosah-in, aloumun jouseu atouphasah tai! 45 Amiten Adanthu ho le ahtupeh chengse Anit jingna diuva hitia abol ahi. Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 106

Amite dia Pakai phatna Vahcoiyun Pakai!

1 Vahchoiyun Pakai! Thangvah-un Pakai nun nem, alungset longlou ahi! 2 Pakai thilbol loupiho seijou ding hiya, Kithuh bep a vahchoi jou ding koi ham? 3 Pakai thupeh ho nit’a Thildih bol jing mi anun nom’e! 4 Namite napanhu teng neigeldoh-in Pakai! Amaho nahuhhing teng keijong neipansah-in! 5 Namite hamphat neimusah-in, Nagoulo mite kithang-at a anopnauva neipansah-in! 6 Kapu kapateu bangin kachonseuvin, Migiloule mi-engse kahiuve! 7 Egypt’a Pathen thilbol kidang ho chu Kapu kapateuvin ahethem pouvin; Analungset jingo chu asumil’un, Twisan phunga Hatchungnung dounan achon’ui! 8 Pakaiyin vang akitepna bangin ahuhhingin, Athahat loupe musah din abol’e! 9 Twisan dung aseipeh leh akangin, Amite tolgoa apui galkaiye! 10 Ahotbolteuva konin ahuhhingin, Amelmateuva konin ahuhdoh tai! 11 Amelmateuva vang twiyin achuptan, Khatcha beh akhenpoi! 12 Hichun amiten athutep ho atahsan’un, Pakai vahchoi la asauve! 13 Ahin Athilbol asumil loiyun, Athumop ngah louvin anopchon tauve. 14 Gamthip laiya adu du athum’un, Pathen apatep’uve! 15 Gamthip athum chanu apen, Gamna hise jong vang alansah-e! 16 Gamhtip laiya Pakai lhacha theng Mose le Aaron chunga athangset’u chun 17 Leiset apoh khin Danthan achop lut’in, Abiramle ainsung mi achup’e. 18 Aseijuiteu chunga meikou achun, Migiloute chu akavamsoh tai! 19 Sanan bangchal lim asem’un, Hiche semthu doi chu ahoutauve! 20 Pathenloupina chu hamhing nea Gancha limsemthun akheldoh-ui! 21 Egypt gama thil nasa tah tah bol, Ahuhhingpau Pathen asumil tauve! 22 Egypt gama datmo thil itobang abol’a, Twisan phunga tijat um itobang abol hitam! 23 Pathenin amite suhmang dia asei chun, Alhendoh lhacha Mose’in Pathen akidintepin; Miho asuhmang louna din Alungdamsah nah nah-e! 24 Lungtup gam chu aseiseuvin, Pathen thutep atahsan pouve! 25 Aponbuh dunguva aphun phun’un, Pakai thusei angaipouve! 26 Pakaiyin khut ajah-in agihsal’in, Ganthip laiya athagam a, 27 Achilhahteu gamtin athecheh a, Gamchoma athigamdah din aseiye. 28 Peor a jong Ba’al ahouvun, Doi thisa houna sa aneuve! 29 Athilbolu hin Pakai aphin hangun, Alah-uva gamna hise alangtai! 30 Phinehas akipat’in themmona neiho talen apen, Hichun gamna hise ahaitai! 31 Hiche abol hi Phinehas din Them channan akisimpeh-in itih a het jing ding ahitai! 32 Meribah twisam phunga mihon Pakai alunghansah-un, Hijeh chun Mose’n Genthei hesoh anathoh-e! 33 Mose alungna behseh-in, Thu ngeimo tah tah anaseiye! 34 Pakai thupeh bangin Chidang namdangte athat’un; 35 Hinla akichengtouvin, Adoihouvu ajomtauve! 36 Pathen miten doi demthu ahouvun, Amanthah lo tauve! 37 Canaan gam semthu doi hounan Achateu numei pasal atoh jengui! 38 Themmonabei chapang ho athat’un, Atoltha jeh-un gamsung asuboh-ui! 39 Anatoh-un akisuboh-uvin, Pathena akitah tapouve! 40 Hijeh hin Pakai amite chunga along hangin, Agoulo mite alo-lhatai! 41 Chidang namdangte khut’a ahenin, Amelmateu achunguva vaihomin apangui! 42 Amelmateuvin gantheitah-in abol’un, Khut thah lhau nan aneiyui! 43 Pakaiyin amite avel vel’in ahuhdoh nan, Amahon adoumah jeng abol’un chonset’a alha lhumjitauve! 44 Hichan geiyin jong Pakaiyin ataonau angaiyin, Ahesoh nau akhohsah jing nalaiye! 45 Akhohsah jal’in akitepna ageldoh-in, Alungset longlou jeh-in lung aheijie! 46 Soh a hente mitmun Voujang nat nat aumsah jie! 47 Neihuhhingun, Pakai ka-Pathenu! Namtin vaipi lah a konin neilongkhomun, Chuteng kipah-in Namintheng vahchoiyunge! 48 Pakai Israel Pathen vahchoiyun! Tule tonsot’in vahchoi jingun! Mitinin, “Amen!” tiu hen! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

BU NGANA (Labu 107-150)

Labu 107

Pathen Phatdan vahchoina

1 Thangvah-un Pakai nun nem chu, Alungset longlou ahi! 2 Gim gentheiya kon Pakai lhatdamsaten hitin seiyun; 3 Gamtin so le lhum a kon, Sah le lhanga kon kikhomho seiyu hen! 4 Abang bang nelgama avah thaiyun, Chen mun khopi kimu louvin aum’ui! 5 Kel le chah athoh-un, Alhasamden gamtauve! 6 Ahesoh teng Pakaiya ataovun, Agenthei nauva kon Pakaiyin ahuhdoh tai! 7 Achenna theiyu khopi jonin Lamjang keiyin Pakaiyin apuiyuve! 8 Lungset longlou jeh a thil kidang abolpeh jal’a Pakai chu athangvah lom mongu ahi; 9 Dangchahte adang nousah-in, Gilkelte anpha phan avah-e! 10 Abang muthim lah a mai nguiyin atouvun, Sohchangte gentheiyin thihkhaovin ahen’ui! 11 Ajeh chu thaneipen Pathen thupeh ho adouvun, Ahilchahna anahsah pouve! 12 Toh hahsat jeh-in chol thi ding ahitauvin, Adin lhuh tengu panpi ding aumpoi! 13 Agenthei tengu Pakaiya ataovun, Pakaiyin agenthei nauva kon ahuhdoh tai! 14 Muthim lah, mai nguiya atou nauvah apuidoh-in, Akihen nau thihkhao abotanpehsoh tai! 15 Lungset longlou jeh a thil kidang abolpeh jal’a Pakai chu athangvah lom mongu ahi! 16 Sum-eng kotpi jouse aphujal’in, Thih kotgol chengse atumbong tai! 17 Mi-ngol phabep chonset jeh-in, Abang bang gitlou jeh-in ahesoh-ui! 18 Anhim him la alo-lha jengun, Athi tah bah ding ahitauve! 19 Agenthei tengu Pakaiya ataovun, Agenthei nauva konin ahuhdoh tai! 20 Pakaiyin athu neinan adamsah-in, Lhankhuh gei dingsa achohingtai! 21 Lungset longlou jeh a thil kidang abolpeh jal’a Pakai chu athangvah lom mongu ahi! 22 Thangvah kilhai diu, Athilbol jousekipa la asah diu ahi! 23 Abang Twikhanglena kong ineiyin akitolsuh-un, Twipi chunga kiveina abol’uve! 24 Amaho hin twithuh tolama Pakai thilbol kidang dang amudoh-ui! 25 Pakaiyin asol leh huipi anungin, Twipi akidil paiye! 26 kong inneiho van vum vuma aleh-in, Twito lama alhalut kit’un; Hitobang kichat tijatnaa Miho kichan ameidoi gamtauve! 27 Jukham bangin asuh atouvin alon leuvin, Athepna jouseu manmo asoh tai! 28 Agenthei teng Pakaiya ataovun, Agenthei nauva kon ahuhdoh tai! 29 Huipi aphoh tangin, Twipi kidil athip del tai! 30 Athip del phat’in akipah-un, Ajotnau kong kaimun bitkeiyin apuiluttai! 31 Lungset longlou jeh a thil kidang abolpeh jal’a Pakai chu athangvah lom mongu ahi! 32 Mipi khoppia Pakai loupe aphonjal’uva, Lamkaiho kikhopnaa avahchoi diu ahi! 33 Pakaiyin luidung jouse nelgo ason, Twisam phung jouse asing bingtai! 34 Gamsung mite gitlou jal’in Leipha lai jouse hollei-chikhuh asotai! 35 Nelgum lah a dim aveisah-in, Sephou lah atwisam aputsah-e! 36 Neh ding beite chukoma achensah-in, pansatna ding khopi akisem’ui! 37 Muchi chivo tun lengpigui aphut’un, Lhoga tampi pi akilo’uve! 38 Amite vang apen cha le nao tampi ahingun, Agachau kemlouvin akoiye! 39 Thoh genthei le hesoh jal’a Pathen mite lhasam a aum teng, 40 Abolseteu chunga athangtomin, Nelgama avathaisah jitai! 41 Genthei thoh amite vang ahuhsoh-in, Ainsungu jong kelngoihon bangin apunsah-e! 42 Midihten amun akipah-un, Migiloute vang athip chel chul’ui! 43 Michinghon hiche hi geltoh hen, Pakai lungset longlou phongdoh- hen!

Labu 108

Kidoupi toh kisatna panpi ngeh a taona

1 Vo Pathen Nanga dettah a kisong kahi; Thouvin ka-lhagao Pathen vahchoi la sange! 2 Kipat’un sempi le semjang gin, Nipi lai suthong inge! 3 Vo Pakai, namtin vaipi laiya thangvah ing ting, Mitin jalaiya vahchoiyinge! 4 Nalungset longlou van chan aphan, Nakitahna vanthamjol ageoye! 5 Vanthamjol’a naloupi phongin, Leiset’a nalalna tah langin! 6 Nabanthan neihuhhingun, Kataona sangin! Hiti hin nangailutte Huhhingin um’u hen! 7 Muntheng phunga konin Pathenin, “Gal’a kajoa Shechem kakehsoa, Sukkoth phaicham Kamite kahoppeh ding ahi. 8 Gilead Manasseh keiya, Ephraim kathih lukhuh, Judah kaleng tenggol ahi. 9 Kanei kisilna konga Kaman ding; Philistinete hanla kasah khum ding ahi!” ati. 10 Vo Pathen, kulpi kikaikhum khopia eipuilut ding koi hiya, Edom a eipui ding koi ham? 11 Neidonda mongu hita a, Kasepaiteu gal nakonpi lou ding hitam! 12 Mihem panpi pannabei ahi, Kamelmateu neidou hu’vin! 13 Pathenin eipanpiu leh kajotei diu, Aman kamelmateu ajo ding ahi!

Labu 109

Gim thohpa kiphin

1 Kavahchoi jng Pathen, Umthim loujenin! 2 Migilou jouseihon eidel khumun, Kachunga jouthu jeng aseiyui! 3 Kachunga ase se aseiyun, Ajeh beihel’in eidel khum’ui! 4 Adiu kakhohsah a kataopeh vangin Eidou doujengui! 5 Kaphatna asen eileuvin, kangailutna eihot bol’ui! 6 Athutan din migilou pansah-in, Amelma khat hehset sah-in! 7 Athu kitannaa mochang hen, Ataona jong chonset’in kisimpeh hen! 8 Kithidoh loi hen! Midangin agou lo hen! 9 Achate chaga soh hen! Ajinu meithai hen! 10 Achate in le lou beiyin khut dou hen! Achen nau ingem lah a min deldoh-u hen! 11 Athil khol anei jouse kilah hen, Kholgam min atohga kilo’u hen! 12 Koiman khotoda hen, Adalhah chaga ho khohsah da hen! 13 Achi abo gamhen, Khangkit teng min lutoa panda hen! 14 Apu apate thilse bol Pakaiyin gel jing hen, Anu chonset chengse ngaidam da hen! 15 Achonset jouseu Pakaiyin gel jing hen! Leiset’a kigeldoh kit da hel’u hen! 16 Mi bolse, vaicha, tahlel panpibei thatgam Khoto ding gelpha louhel pa, 17 Hansepa-gaosap chang hen! Mi phatna deiloupa koiman vangboh da hen! 18 Gaochoi choijengpa, Agao jouse apum alongin dim hen! Thaotwi bangin Aguhom kah kah a long lut hen! 19 Gao chun pontomin tom hen, Konggah kikanchal bangin kan hen! 20 Eihouse sea kamelmate chu Pakai, hitobang hin talen pen! 21 Nathutep bangin keivang neipanpin, Nalungset hoidam jal’in neihuhdoh-in Pakai ka-Pathen! 22 Vaicha le lhasam kahin, Kalung laigil’a Na kasa behseh jenge! 23 Nilhah nilim bang kihei mang pai ding kahitan, Ganhing kimut man gbanga eikithing lha ahi! 24 Kel kathoh thoh nan kakhup alhoiyin, Kagu lheng lhonkeo kahitai! 25 Eimupha chanin einuisat’in, Lu eithin khum khum jengui! 26 Vo Pakai ka-Pathen neipanpin! Nalungset long louvin neihuhhingin! 27 Eihuhhingpu nahi Kamelmate hetsah-in! 28 Eigaosap jongleur vang neiboh-in, Eibolseten gal lel hen, Nalhacha kei vang kipah inge! 29 Kamelmate vetda chang hen, Pon akijel bangin Jum le jan tomjolsel’u hen! 30 Othongin Pakai thangvah ing ting, Japi kikhopnaa Ama kavahchoi ding ahi! 31 Pakaiyin vaichapa apanpin, Tha dia thutansa chu ahuhhinge!

Labu 110

Pakai le alhentum lengpa

1 Pakaiyin ka-Pakai jah a, “Namelmate chotpha kaneisah masangsen Kajet lam a tou jingin,” ati. 2 Pakaiyin Zion a thaneitah a Leng tenggol nachoisah a, “Namelmate chunga Vai homin,” ati ding ahi! 3 Namelmate toh nakisat nil eh Namiten manbeiya napan hu diu; Lhang thenga jingkah daitwi banga Gollhang ho nahenga hung kikhom diu ahi! 4 Khelkit lou din Pakai giltah-in kaitep’in, “Malchizedek Themput bana Tonsot Thempu ding nahi,” ati. 5 Pakai najetlama atou jinge, Athangtom tengleh Leng jouse asuhmang ding ahi! 6 Namtin vaipi thu atan’a, Galmuna thilong ajamchap ding; Leiset leng jouse Ajosoh ding ahi! 7 Lengpan lampam luidunga twi donin tin, Tha kidoa, gal ajo ding ahi!

Labu 111

Pakai vahchoina

1 Vahchoiyun Pakai! Amite khoppia kalungthim pumpin, Pakai thangvah inge! 2 Pakai thilbol jouse akidangin, Adei jousen het khentei agoi! 3 Abolchan ja aum cheh-in Alal loupe ta ngeiye! Aitih-in adih jing jenge! 4 Pakaiyin athilbol ho eisuhmilsah pouvin, Khoto them, hepi lhingset ahi! 5 Agingte anneh apen, Akitepna ahaipoi! 6 Athanei vetsah nan Midang gam jouse amite apei! 7 Abolchan a akitah-in adih-e! Athupeh chengse kisonpi thei ahi. 8 Athupehho adih le atah a kipe, Tonsot’a umdet jing ahi! 9 Amite ajalensah-in Tonsot’a din kitepna asempi! Athengle ahat Pakai ahi! 10 Pakai gin hi chih kipatna, Athupeh nit chanin ima ahekhen theme; Tonsot’a vahcoi ding Amabou ahi!

Labu 112

Mipha nopna

1 Vahchoiyun Pakai! Athupeh lung lhaisel’a nit jing Pakai jabol jing chu anun nom’e! 2 Mipha chate chu gamsunga thanei ding, Achilhahte hampha diu ahi! 3 Ainsunga nei le nga adimin, A-itih-in ahao jinge! 4 Mipha, khoto them chule midih din Muthim lah jenga jong Kho avah jinge! 5 Hongphal tah a thil hom, Lungthengsel’a natong chu anun nom’e! 6 Mipha thon lou ding Kigeldoh jing ding ahi; 7 Miphan thuse kithang agingpon, Tahsan det’in Pakaiya aki-ngaiye! 8 Tijat lungdon abolpon, Amelmate gal lel ding ahekeove! 9 Angaicha chan hongphal tah-in apen, Mi khoto achim hih-e! Ahunei lheh jengin Min ajabol cheh-e! 10 Miilouten hiche hi amuteng along hangui! Mitsat lhap lhap’in akilep mangun; Akinepna jouseu abeihel tai!

Labu 113

Pakai phatje vahchoina

1 Vahchoiyun Pakai! Pakai lhachaten amin vahchoiyun! 2 Tu le tonsot’in Pakai min Vahchoiyin um hen! 3 So le lhum a min Pakai min vahchoiyun! 4 Pakaiyin namitn chunga lengvai apoi, Aloupina van sangin asangjoi! 5 Pakai i-Pathenu tobang aumpon, Vanchung sanga cheng ahi! 6 Ahung kunjin, Van le leiset avei! 7 Leivui lah a konin vaichate akaithouvin, Angaicha chan agimnaa konin aphong dinge! 8 Amaho chu leng le lalte toh akijolsah-in, Amite milen milal ho toh akivopsah-e! 9 Numei ching nao neilou inching theiyin alhan, Cha aneisah-in kaipasah tai! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 114

Kalchuh Kut La

1 Israel chaten Egypt adalhah a, Hammah paomah gama Jacob chate apotdoh chun; 2 Judah chu Pakai mitheng ahin, Israel chu agoulo gam ahi! 3 Twisan dungin aven ajamtan, Jordan lui alelontai! 4 Mol le lhang ho kelchal chop’in achomin, Lhang sang jouse kelngoi chop’in achom’ui! 5 Vo Twikhanglen, ipi kichaa jam nahim? Vo Jordan lui ibol’a lelon nahim? 6 Vo Molsang ho, idia kelcha chop’a kichom nahiuvam? Lhangsang hon idia kelngoi chop nathou ham? 7 Vo leiset, Pakai ahunge, Jacob Pathen masanga kithingin! 8 Songpi ho twikul sosah Songpi khikah a twisam putsah Pathen!

Labu 115

Pathen dih khatseh

1 O Pakai, keiho joh hilouvin, Nang jeng bou Lungset longlou le nakitahna jal’in Namin choi-anin! 2 Ibol’a namtin vaipin, “Na-Pathenu hoilam hitam?” atidiu ham? 3 Ka-Pathenu van a cheng, Adei dei bol jeng ahi! 4 Mihon pathen ahisah vang, Sana le dangkaa kisem, Mihem khut’a kisemdoh ahibouve! 5 Semthu honk am aneiyun apao thiepoi, Mit aneiyun kho amupoi! 6 Nabeng aneiyun kho ajapon, Nahhom aneiyun gimnam ajapoi! 7 Khut aneiyun thil atham theipon, Keng aneiyun ache theipoi! Hujong ahusa theipouve! 8 Hicheng sem a tahsan ho chu Asemsau doilim ho tobang cheh-u hen! 9 Israel chaten Pakai tahsanun, Aman napanpiuvin Nahoidam jingui! 10 Pathen Thempua pang hon Pakai tahsanun, Aman napanpin nahoidam jingui! 11 Pakai ginten Ama tahsanun, Aman napanpin nahoidam jingui! 12 Pakaiyin eihejingun phatthei eiboh diu ahi; Israelte le Pathen Thempuho phatthei aboh ding ahi! 13 Alen aneo ama jabol chan Phatthei aboh ding ahi! 14 Pakaiyin nang ho le nachilhah teu Cha le nao punsah jing hen! 15 Van le leiset sempa Pakaiyin vang naboh-u hen! 16 Van hi Pakaiya ahin, Leiset hi mihem apei! 17 Mithisa lhanthip alutsan! Pakai avahchoiji poi! 18 Eiho mihingin vang tu le tonsot’a Pakai ithangvah jing diu ahi! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 116

Athisa ahuhhingin Pathen avahchoi

1 Kataona sanga kathum eipe jing Pakai ka-ngailui! 2 Kakou chanin Pakaiyin eihou jinge! 3 Kavel’a thi theina adimin, Lhankhuh kichan ka-umtai! 4 Hichun Pakaiya kataovin, “Neihuhhingin Pakai,” kati. 5 Hepi them pakai pha! Eidipdappehjiu ka-Pathenu! 6 Panpibeite hoidam Pakai, Kakichat teng eihuhhinge! 7 Pakai phatah kaneiye Kalungthim linglao loujenin! 8 Thita dingsa Pakaiyin eicho hingin, Gal eijosah-in ka-lhi atheh ngimtai! 9 Mihing chenna vannoiyah Pakaito kalhon jingnai! 10 “Eikinehgep hel ahitai” kati geiyin katahsan jing nai! 11 “koima kisonpi thei aumpoi,” aktin jong Katahsan jing thei nai! 12 Pakaiyin eibolphatna ho hi Ipia kalethuh jou ding ham? 13 Eihuhhing thangvah jal’in Pakaiya lengpitwi thilto penge! 14 Amite khopi lailunga Kakitepna jat Pakai penge! 15 Amithengte thi hi Pakaiyin avelel lheh jenge! 16 Nalhacha kahi Pakai, Thi dingsa neichohing jal’in Kanu toh bangin Ken jong nakin bol jing nange! 17 Thangvahnan kilhaiying ting, Nahenga tao vinge! 18 Pakaiya kakitepna chengse, Namite khoppi lailung, 19 Jerusalem kholai Pakai Inthenga kato ding ahi! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 117

Pakai vahchoina

1 Namtin vaipin Pakai vahchoiyun! Ami janel’in choi-an’un! 2 Eiho din alungset anasan, Akitahna abang ahijinge! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 118

Galjo thangvah Taona

1 Thangvah-un Pakai nun nem, Tonsot kumkhon alungset jinge! 2 Israel chaten, “Tonsot kumkon alungset jinge,” tiu hen! 3 Pathen Thempuhon, “Tonsot kumkhon alungset jinge,” tiu hen! 4 Pakai ging jousen, “Tonsot kumkhon alungset jinge,” tiu hen! 5 Pakai genthei pet’in Pakaiya kataovin, Eihuuvin eichamlhatsah tai! 6 Pakaiyin eilhonpin ima kagingpoi, Kon i-eilo thei ding ham? 7 Pakaiyin eipanpi, kamelmate jo ding kakat jinge! 8 Mihem kisonpi sangin Pakaiya ki-ngaidet aphajoi! 9 Mihem lamkaite kisonpi sangin Pakaiya ki-ngaidet aphajoi! 10 Melmaten eiumkimsoh nan, Pakai thahat’in kasumangsoh tai 11 Kavel’a adimset’un, Pakai thahat’in kasumangsoh tai! 12 Kavel’a khoilhah kai abangun, Gamkang ka bangin adeuje ju’vin, Pakai thahat’in kasumangsoh tai! 13 Eilonvuh jenguva eijotho phat’un Pakaiyin eipanpi! 14 Pakaiyin hatjou paojouvin eilhan Eihuhhing tai! 15 Ngaiyun Pathen mite ponbuh dunga galjo la kisa! “Pakai thahat loupin gal ajouvin, 16 Athahat’in gal eijopeh-un, Galmang gal asat chaitai! 17 Thilou ding, kahin jinga Pakai thilbol kaponjal ding ahi! 18 Pakaiyin eibolgim lheh vangin Eithisah deh hih nai! 19 Houin kelkot ho neihonpeh-in, Lu ing ting Pakai thangvah ing! 20 Hiche hi Pakai kotpi ahi, Midih bou lut theiyinte! 21 Kataona sanga gal neijosah jeh-in Nangma kathangvah-e Pakai! 22 Insahon deimoa apaiyu song chu Inning songpi khomdet penin apangtai! 23 Hiche hi Pakai thilbol ahin, Vet din akidang lheh-e! 24 Hiche hi Pakai galjo ni ahi, Kipah thanomin lengkhomu te! 25 Neihuhhingun Pakai, neihuhhingun! Neilo lhinsah-un O Pakai! 26 Pakai min a hungpa anun nom’e! Pakai Houin akon vang kaboh-ui! 27 Pakai chu Pathen ahin, adiuvin aphai! Thingna kichoiyin kut bolpan’un! Maicham kimvel’in kijot’un! 28 Ka-Pathen nahi, thangvah inge! Naloupina phongjal lenge! 29 Thangvah-un Pakai nun nem, Tonsot kumkhon alungset jinge!

Labu 119

Pakai Danthu

1 Nolnabeiya chon, Pakai Danthu jui Mihem chu anun nom’e! 2 Athupeh jouse juiya Alungthim pumpia asei ngai chu anun nom’e! 3 Amaho hin bolkhel aneipon. Pakai Danthu jeng ajuiyui! 4 Pakai, nangin Danthu neipeuvin, Kitah tah a jui din neihil’ui! 5 Nahilchahna nit’a Kitah tah ajui ding iti kakinep hitam! 6 Nathupeh chengse khohsah leng Jumna muponge! 7 Dih tah a thu natan ho kasim teng Lungthengsel’in Nangma vahchoiyinge! 8 Neidalha loujenin! Nadanthu ho nit nange!

Pakai Danthu nit

9 Gollhang hi itileh chontheng thei ding ham? Nathupeh ho anit leh hitheiyinte! 10 Kalung pumpin nakin bol kagoi, Nathupeh ho bangin neichonsah-in! 11 Nang douva kachonset louna din Kalungthimin Nadanthu kaching jinge! 12 Kavahchoiye Pakai! Nachondan jouse neihil’in! 13 Neipeh Danthu jouse Othongin velseiyinge! 14 Gou tampi neisangin Nathupehho jui kathanomjoi! 15 Nahilchahna ho kasimin, Nathuhil ho kakholtoh-e! 16 Nadanthuho kakipapin, Nathupeh changse sumil ponge!

Pakai Danthua nopna

17 Nalhacha kei niphatbol’in Pakai, Dam’a nathuhil kanitna din! 18 Nadanthua thudih kidang ho Kamutheinan kamit hasah-in! 19 Leiset’a chomchabou hing kahi, Nathupehho nei-impeh dan! 20 Phat tinin nathutan ho kahet nomin Kalungthimin ka-ngaicha lheh-e! 21 Mi kiletsah naphohsal jin, Nathupeh nitloute gaosap achangui! 22 Nadanthu kanit jingnai, Hiche ho hi neiphinsah dan neihousetsah dan! 23 Vaipoho geiya kei douna akikhop vangun, Nasanthu ho kagel jing ding ahi. 24 Nahilchahna ho kadeiyin, Eithumop’in apangui!

Pakai Danthu nit dia dindet

25 Kalel’in leivui lah a kakijam’e! Natepsa bangin neisuhal kit’in! 26 Kachonna jouse kaphongin neihouve, Nachondan ho neihil’in! 27 Nadanthuho neihetsah-in, Nathuhil kidang ho gel jing inge! 28 Kagim behseh tai, Natepsa bangin neihatsah kit’in! 29 Lam hilouva neisol dan, Lungset’in Nadanthu neihil’in! 30 Thua nung tange, Nathutan ho kakhohsah tai! 31 Nahilbangin kachon nai Pakai, Neijumso loujenin! 32 Neihetsah be ding jeh-in Nathupeh cheng kipah tah-in nit nange!

Hetkhen themna dia Taona

33 Nadanthuhoa ipi kisei ham neihil’in Pakai! Abonchan nit jing jeng nange! 34 Nadanthu neihilchenin nit ing ting, Kalungthima ching jing nange! 35 Nadanthuho kakipana ahi Anit themje neihil’in! 36 Nei le nga sangin Nadanthuho nit ding neithanopsah-in! 37 Pannabeiya neithanopsah dan, Natepsa bangin neihepin! 38 Nasei ngaite dia nathutep, Hiche nathutep chu nalhacha keidin sudet’in! 39 Nei-engboldan kaginge, Nathutan ho akidang theiye! 40 Nathupehho kanit nom’e, Hinkhothah neipen, nangma dihtah nahi!

Pakai Danthua kisong

41 Neingailut gilje neimusah-in Pakai! Natepsa banginneihuhhingin! 42 Nathua kisong kahin Eiphinse ho kadonbut thei ding ahi! 43 Nachondanhoa kinem kahi, Thutah neiseisah jingin! 44 Tonsot tonsot’in Nadanthu nit jing nange! 45 Nahilna jui ding kagoi, Kachamlhat tahbeh ding ahi! 46 Jahcha louhel’a leng ho koma Nathupeh chengse kaphondoh ding ahi! 47 Nathupeh chengse kadeiyin Kanit nom jing nai! 48 Nathupeh ho kajan kadeiye, Nahilchahna ho gel jing nange!

Pakai Danthu kisonpi

49 Nalhacha kahenga nakitepna geldoh jingin, Hiche hin eikinepsah jinge! 50 Kagimpet jengin jong eilhamonin, Nathutep chun eikhou khah ahi! 51 Kiletsahten eihou kha cheh chuh jongle Nadanthu nahsah mon kabolpoi! 52 Malaiya nathutanho kagel leh, Hiche ho hin eilhamon’e Pakai! 53 Migilouten nadanthu apalkeh teng Kalung hang lheh jie! 54 Kaleiset hinkho chomcha sungin Nathupeh ho kalachoiye! 55 O Pakai janteng Nangma kagel jin, Nadanthu umdol ka-ngaitoi! 56 Nathupehho kanit teng Kipana kaneijie!

Pakai Danthua lunglut

57 OPakai Nangbou kadeipenin! Nadanthu nit ding kakitep’e! 58 Natepsa banga neihepi din Kalungthim pumpin kataove! 59 Ka-umchan khankho kagel’in, Nahilna juidin kakitep’e! 60 Nathupeh chegnse nit didn kinomsot louvin kakinotai! 61 Migilouten thang eikampeh jongle Nadanthu kasumil poi! 62 Nathutan ho dih jal’in, Nang vahchoi din jankimin kathouve! 63 Nathupeho nit’a nakinbolte toh loi le gol’in ka-um jinge! 64 O Pakai, leiset hi nalungset longlou adim’e, Neihil’in nachondan ho chu!

Pakai Danthu manlutje

65 Vo Pakai, nasei dungjuiyin Nalhacha kei neikhotoi! 66 Nathupehhoa kisong kahi, Chihna le hetna neipen! 67 Talen neimatsah masangin kachon khel jin, Tun vang nathu ka-ngaiye! 68 Mihepi khoto them nahi! Nachondan ho neihil’in! 69 Kiletsahten jouvin eidem jongleur kalungthim pumpin neihilna ka-ngai jinge! 70 Kiletsahten ima hetna aneipon, keivang nadanthua kipah kahi! 71 Eikibolgim chu keidin aphai, Hichun nadanthu eihil’e! 72 Leiset sum jouse sangin Danthu neipeh hi amanlujoi!

Danthu dihje

73 Neisemin, neihoidamin, Nadanthuho kahetna din hetna neipei! 74 Nathutep akisong kahijeh-in Jatah a nabolten eimuteng kipah-unte! 75 Pakai nathutan jouse adih cheh-e, Nakitah jal’a neibolgim ahi! 76 Nalhacha neiteppeh bangin Nalungset longlouvin neilhamonin! 77 Nadanthua kipah jing kahi, Kadamtheina din neihepin! 78 Jouva eiheh kiletsahte kijumdsou hen, Kenvang neihilna kachin jing ding ahi! 79 Nathupehho hephachan, Jatah a nabol chan kahegna hungu hen! 80 Gal kalel a kajum louna din Nathupehho lhingkeiyin juithei tave leng!

Lhatdamna dia taona

81 Nathu kineppin neihuhhing ding Ka-ngah lel lheh tai Pakai! 82 Neiteppeh kavet vetnan kamit akhamtan, “Itih tah le neipanpi dem,” kati! 83 Meiya kihulgo lengpitwipai savun go kabangnan, Nachondan ho vang kasumil deh poi! 84 Itih chan ngah leng Eibolse ho talen namatsah dem? 85 Nadanthu nit lou kiletsah ten Kalhah lutna din khuh alaiyui! 86 Nathupeh chengse kisonpi thei cheh ahin, Min jouthun eidem dem’ui, neipanpin! 87 Eithapai tahbah diu ahitan, Hinla nadanthu ho kapaipoi! 88 Nadanthuho kanit theina din Long louvin neilungset’in!

Pakai danthu tahsan

89 O Pakai nathu hi tonsot’a ding, Van aum jing ding ahi! 90 Akhang khanga kitah jingnahin, Leiset naphutdet’in aum jinge! 91 Naseipeh bang bangin thil ijakai tuni geiyin aumun, Abonchan namanchah-in apang cheh-ui! 92 Nadanthua kipah jing lou hileng, Genthei thoh a kathiden ding ahitai! 93 Neihinsona ahijeh-in Nathuhil ho nahsahmo hih hel’inge! 94 Nanga kahi, neihuhhingin! Nathupehho nit tei kagoi! 95 Migilouten thadin eichang jingun, Kenvang nadanthu kagel jinge! 96 Thil jousen kikhonna anei cheh-in, Nang thupeh vang chamkimsoh ahi!

Pakai Danthu ngailut

97 Pakai nadanthu kadei lheh jengin, kagel nilhum lhum’e! 98 Nathupeh kachin jing jeh-in Kamelmate sangin eichihsah tai! 99 Nahilna kachin jing jeh-in Eihil ho sangin kahethemjoi! 100 Nathupehho kanit jeh-in Upate sangin jong kachingjoi! 101 Nasei kanit nom jeh-in Chon gitlou khatcha kabolpoi! 102 Eihilpa Nangtah nahijeh-in Nahilna nahsah mon kabolpoi! 103 Namihil angei behseh-in, Khoiju sanga lhumjon kabol’e! 104 Nadanthu chihnan kaneiyin< Chonphat lou kahoi!

Pakai Danthua khovah

105 Nathu hi kakalsena thei thaomei ahin, Kalampi salvah a pang ahi! 106 Nahilna dihtah ho nitna dia Giltah a kakitepna molsonge! 107 Kathoh lel behseh tai Pakai! Natepsa bangin neicho hingin! 108 Thangvah a kataon asangin O Pakai! Nathupehho neihil’in! 109 Thi ngam a pang jing kahin, Nadanthu kasumil poi! 110 Migilouten thang eikampeh nan, Nathupehho kanitda deh poi! 111 Nathupeh chengse katonsot gou ahin, Kalungthima kakipana ahi! 112 Kathi ni geiya Nachondan ho jui din ka-umtai!

Pakai Danthua hoidohna

113 Lung tho neiho kahon, Nadanthu kadei lheh jenge! 114 Eipanpea eihoidam nahin, Nathutep kakineppi! 115 Chedoh-un michonsete, Ka-Pathen thupeh chengse ni tnange! 116 Hinso dia neitepna bangin tha neipen, Kakinepna subei loujenin! 117 Neituh le chun hing jouving ting, Nathupeh chengse khohsah jing nange! 118 Nadanthu nit lou ho napamsen, Jouva athilgonu pannabei ahi! 119 Leiset migiloute iman nasimpon, Kenvang namihilna hi kadeipen’e! 120 Nang gin nan kakithing thingin, Nathutan ho pi kakichai!

Pakai Danthu nit

121 Adih le apha kabolnai, Kamelmate kachepna din neidalha hih-in! 122 Nalhachapa neipanpi din seiyin, Pathen heloute neibolgimsah dan! 123 Huhdoh dia nathutep ngah a Namihuhhing kavet vetnan kamit akhamtai! 124 Neilungset jing jengin, Nathupehho neihil jingin! 125 Nalhacha kahi, namihilna ho kahet theina din, Hetkhen themna neipen! 126 Pakai, migilouten nadanthu apalkehtai! Phoh-in lang sutang loiyin! 127 Sana thengsel le hoitah sangin Nathupehho kadeijoi! 128 Nahilna chengse kajuiyin, Lamdih lou jouse kahoi!

Pakai Danthu nitnomna

129 Namihilna ho akidang lheh-e, Kalungthim pumpin kajuiye! 130 Namihilna hilchet hikhovah tobang, Khopolou chihsah jeng thei ahi! 131 Nathupehho deichan Kakahel hol jenge! 132 Na-ngailute nabolna bangin, Hung kiheiyin neihepin! 133 Natepsa bangin neilhuhsah dan, Thilse neijosah hih-in! 134 Nathupehho kanit theina din Eibolsetea konin neihuhdoh-in! 135 Namaivah-in neisalvah jingin, Nadanthu ho neihil jingin! 136 Mihon nadanthu anit loujeh-un Ka-lhi twilonin alonge!

Pakai Danthu dih dan

137 O Pakai Nangma nadidh-in, Nadanthu akitah cheh-e! 138 Dan nasemsa ho hi Achamkimin, adih-in aphai! 139 Kamelmaten nathupehho anahsah loujeh-in, Kalung hang behseh jenge! 140 Nathutep thon mo ahin, Kadei lheh jenge! 141 koi isah loule ima kahi lou vangin, Namihilna ho kadonda poi! 142 Itih a dih jing nahin, Nadanthu jong adih jinge! 143 Lung gim genthei kathoh nan Nathupehhon eikipasah jie! 144 Namihilna ho adih jinge, Kahin theina din hetkhen themna neipen!

Huhdoh dia Taona

145 Lungthim pumpin nahenga kataove, Neihouvin Pakai, nathupehho nit nange! 146 Nahenga kataove, neihuhhingin Nadanthuho nit nange! 147 Niso man neipanpi din kataovin, Nathutep kakineppi! 148 Namihilna ho kagel gel nan Jan khovah-in mitsing mon ka-um’e! 149 Guitan mon neilungset’in, neihouvin O Pakai! Neihepin, neihoidam sel’in! 150 Nadanthu nit lou, Giloutah a eibolsete ahung naiye! 151 Hinla kakoma naum jing nan, Nathupehho kilonglou ahi Pakai! 152 Masangin jong namihilna ho kasimtan, Tonsot’a um jin gdia nasei ahi!

Panpi ngehna

153 Kathohna ven neihuhhingin Pakai! Nadanthu kasumil khapoi! 154 Neipanhun chamlhat neimusah-in, Natepsa banginneihuhhingin! 155 Nadanthuho nit lou, Migiloute huhhingin umponte! 156 Neilainatpina alen’e Pakai! Neihepin, neihuhhingin! 157 Mibolse melma kahao lheh nan, Nadanthuho kanitdapoi! 158 Nathupehho la nit lou Mi lhemchavai ho kamuteng kalung ana behseh-e! 159 Namihilna ho kadeidan vetan Pakai! Milungset jing nahi neihuhhingin! 160 Nadanthu migil chu atah ahin, Dihtah a thu natanho ho tonsot’a ding ahi!

Pakai Danthua kiphal theng
