161 Mi huseten alam louvin eidel khum jongle Nadanthu kaging jingnai! 162 Goukhol mudoh pa kipa bangin Nathutep ho kakipapi lheh-e! 163 Jouthu pou pou kalohsoh-in kahoi, Nasanthu vang kadei lheh-e! 164 Nathutan ho dih jal’in Niseh-in sagi vei vei kathangvah jinge! 165 Nadanthu ngailute lung mongin aumun, Akipal lhuhna diu imacha aumpoi! 166 Eihuhhing din ka-ngah-in Nasei sei kabol’e Pakai! 167 Nasei jouse kanit’in, Kalungthim pumpin kadei lheh-e! 168 Nathupehho le nahilna ho kajuiyin, Kabol katoh chan neimui!

Panpi ngaicha Taona

169 Panpina kathum’e ngaiyin Pakai! Neiteppeh bangin hetkhen themna neipen! 170 Kataona ngaiyin lang, Nathutep bangin neihuhhingin! 171 Nadanthu neihil jeh a Kavahchoi jing ding nahi! 172 Nathupehho adih jeh-in Nadanthu lachoiyinge! 173 Nathupehho kajui jinge, Eipanpi din kigo jingin! 174 O Pakai neipanpia neihuhhing ding ka-ngaiye! Nadanthua kipah thanom kahi! 175 Nang kavahchoina din neicho hingin! Neihilna hon eikithopiu hen! 176 Kelngoi vah mang banga kava mang vangin, Nadanthuho kasumilpoi, nalhacha keima neiholdoh-in!

Labu 120

Panpi ngaicha Taona

1 Gim hesoh teng Pakai kakouvin, Aman eihoutai! 2 Mijoute le lhemchavaitea konin Neihuhhingin Pakai! 3 Mijouho, Pathenin inalo diu? Itobanga nabolgim diu ham? 4 Galkappa thalcahng hemtah le Longlaobal meiya kito-am leng lung ducha nahiuvam? 5 Nalah-uva chen hi Meshech a chen le Kedar mite lah a chen nommo bep ahi! 6 Cham deimote lah a kacheng sot behseh tai! 7 Chamna thu kisei teng Gal asohji tauve!

Labu 121

Eihoidamuvah Pakai

1 Molsang dunga kona Eipanpi hung dia kagaldot ding ham? 2 Van le leiset Sempa pakaiya kona Eipanpi hung ding ahibouve! 3 Nachingpan nave jing nai, Nakipal lhuhsah ponte! 4 Israel chingpa chu Kisep lhun akijamden ngaipoi! 5 Pakaiyin na-ngah jingin, Nahuh din najet’a adding jinge! 6 Sun teng nisan sang ponnatin, Jan teng lhavah-in sal pinnate! 7 Pakaiyin thilse jousea daldoh intin, Nahoidam jing nante! 8 Tua pat tonsont geiyin Pakaiyin Navaikon navailhunin ching jing hen!

Labu 122

Jerusalem choi-atna

1 “Pakai Houin a cheute” atiu chun Kakipah lheh jenge! 2 Tun Jerusalem kulpi sunga Kadingsoh tauve! 3 Hoitah le kitoh chet’a kisem Jerusalem khopi! 4 Athupeh ddungjuiya Pakai thangvah dia Israel phung namkim kijot touna! 5 Israel lengte ahungun, Mipi thutan din atoutauve! 6 Jerusalem cham lenna din taovin; “Nakhohsah mite khangtou hen; 7 Nakhosung cham leng hen, Naleng inpi dunga lung mon um hen,” tiuvin! 8 Ka-inkote le kagolte khohsah jal’in, Jerusalem jah-a “Nasunga cham leng hen,” kati. 9 Pakai i-Pathenu Houin khohsah jal’in Naphatna din katao jinge!

Labu 123

Hepi ngaicha taona

1 O Pakai, van a nalaltouna lam Dah-in kahinvei! 2 Sohpan apu aki-ngainaa Sohnun api aki-ngaina bangin, O Pakai ka-Pathenu, neihepi masang seuvin Naheng lam jeng kaveuve! 3 Neihepiuvin O Pakai, neihepiuvin! Hitobang hin min eihot bol’ui! 4 Mihaote eihouse se jengun, Kiletsah gilouten eihou thanguve!

Labu 124

Amite hoidama Pathen

1 Pathenin eipanpi dau hileh I-atiding nahet’um Israel? 2 “Pathenin eipanpi dau hivangleh Melmaten eidel khumu chun, 3 Eilunghanjeh-uva Eibahgam hel theiyu ahi; 4 Twipin eichup’uva Twisoh chun eilhoh manghel theiyu ahi. 5 Lhanghoh ongje jun Eichupsoh hel diu ahi,” tiuvin! 6 Melmate eisuhmang sah dau Pakai chu thangvah jingute! 7 Vacha thangkol’a toldoh bangin Eiho jong i-toldoh tauvin; Thangkol akibottoan tan, I-ongdoh tauve! 8 Van le leiset Sempa Pakaiyin eipanpiuve!

Labu 125

Pathen mite lungmonna

1 Pakaiya ki-ngai jingte chu Zion molsang bangin suh linghoi hiponte! 2 Jerusalem khopi molsangin akol khum bangin, tu le tonsot’in Pakaiyin amite aumchan jinge! 3 Migilouvin midih gamsunga Vai ahom louhel ding; Ahomuleh midih chun Thilse abol lo diu ahi! 4 Pakai, nathupeh nit jing miphate Phatbol jingin! 5 Migilou talen napeh teng Nadanthu dondate jong talen pen! Israel lah a cham leng hen!

Labu 126

Huhdohna dia Taona

1 Pakaiyin Jerusalem eihin lhut kit phat’un Mang lheh lheh ahibouve! 2 Kambem bemin kanuiyun Kipa la kasauve; Chuin namdangten, “Pakaiyin thil loupitah abolpeh tauve,” atiuve! 3 Pakaiyin thil loupitah eibolpeh nauve, Iti kipa um hitam! 4 Luidung kangsa twi dimkit bangin, Kagam lamuva neipui kit tauvin Pakai! 5 Mit lhi puma muchi tuten Kipah tahnomin aga kilo’u hen! 6 Kap puma muchi tua vaikon chu Lhoga pon kipa la san hung kile hen!

Labu 127

Pathen phatna vahchoi

1 Insaa Pakai apan louleh Insa hon pannabeiya asah-u ahin, Pakaiyin kho a-nga louleh Kho-ngah ho mohseh a janhah ahiuve! 2 jingpi tah a nathouva Jan khangkima nalup’uva Hitobanga na nahatoh-u hi Pannabei ahibouve! Ajeh chu Pakaiyin aphatcha Amite acholdohdah nom ahi! 3 Chate hi Pakai thilpeh ahin, Pakaiyin vang abohna ahi! 4 Khangdong laiya pasal’in chapate aneihi Gal-hangpa thalvhang ho tobang ahi! 5 Thalchang banga chapa tampi neipa anun nom’e, Thupi phunga melmate akidintepi teng lel pote!

Labu 128

Pakai thua nun kipaman

1 Pakai thu achon a athupeh Nit jing ho anun nom’ui! 2 Natohga nakivah teng Nahaova nom nasah ding ahi! 3 Insunga najinu lengpigui gaphatah bang ding, nachapate olive bah lha banga Na-ankong dokhang vel’a tougol diu ahi! 4 Pakai thu nitpa chu Hitobanga hi phatthei chang ding ahi. 5 Zion konin Pakaiyin phatthei naboh hen, Nahinkho lhumkeiyin Jerusalem phatna mun! 6 Nangman vang Natuson geiyin hin mun! Israel lah a cham leng hen!

Labu 129

Israel melmate douna Taona

1 Nakhangdonglaiya pat namelmaten naabolgim nau seiyin Israel! 2 “Kakhangdon laiya pat kamelmaten Engse tah-in einabolgim’un; Hinla eijoudeh pouve. 3 Katungtun ko cheh chuh-in a-at’un, Kangkuiya kikai abahsah-ui! 4 Hinla Pakai dihtah chun Kihenna kul’a konin eilhadoh tai!” tin! 5 Zion hotbol chanin Gal lel hen nungjam hen! 6 Inchunga hamhing keh, Akikhanlhit masanga gopden tobangu hen! 7 Chang-at pan amaimoa Changphal kanpan som ding aholmo bang hen! 8 Ajotpa ho khatchan jong, “Pakaiyin phatthei naboh-u hen, Pakai minin vang kaboh-ui,” tida hen!

Labu 130

Panpi ngaicha taona

1 Kokhuh sunga konin Kahin kouve Pakai! 2 Kataona ngaiyin lang O Pakai, Panpi ngaicha kakou ngaiyin! 3 Kachonsetnau melchih ding hile chun Themmo chang lou ding aumpoi! 4 Kajabol chehna diuvin Neingaidam’uvin! 5 Kinemtah-in Pakai panpi ka-ngah-in, Athu katahsan jinge! 6 Jan ngahhonkhovah nga lel sang chun Pakai ka-ngah lel joi! 7 Pakai chu lungset longlou Huhhing nom jing ahi, Tahsanin Israel Achonset chengeuva konin huhhinginte!

Labu 131

Chapang banga Pakaiya ki-ngai

1 Pakai, kiletsah kabangin, Hoitho ka-ngatai! Thil loupe tah tah jong kagelpon, Ahahsa behseh jong kadonpoi! 2 Naosen anu pheichunga atip del bangin, Lung ol-heo, lung mongin ka-umjoi! 3 Israel, tu le tonsot’in Pakaiya ki-ngai jingin!

Labu 132

Houin choi-atna

1 Pakai, David gim gantheina ho Sumil loujenin-o! 2 Vo Hatchungnung Jacob Pathen, Nahenga David kitepna chu geldoh-in Pakai! 3 “In jon lou, Jalkhun jon louvin um ing ting; 4 Choldo louleh Ihmu louhel’in um inge; 5 Hatchungnung Jacob Pathen dia Mun kamua Houin kasah peh masangsen,” anati. 6 Bethlehem a Kitepna thingkong thu kajauvin, jearim loujaova kamudoh-uve! 7 “Pakai Houin a cheutin, Alaltouna maiya chibai boh-uhite,” katiuve. 8 Kitepna thingkong to lonin, Nathahatna kihetna pumin Tonsot’a um jing din Houn sung hinjontan Pakai! 9 Nathempute chondih jing hen, Namithengten kipa othongin samu hen! 10 Nalhacha David henga nakitepme, Nalhensa leng chu pai loujenin Pakai! 11 David henga giltah-in nakitep’in, Suhmil louhel dia nakitep chun: “Nachapate khat leng kachansah ding, Naban’a hung vaihom ding ahi. 12 Nachaten Kakitepna anit’uva, Kathupeh chengse ajuiyu leh; Achateu geiya tonsot’a Nang banga leng chang diu ahi,” nati. 13 Pakaiyin Zion alhengin, Pansatna din adeiye! 14 “Hikom hi tonsot’a kapansatna ding, Hilaiya hin vai kahom nom’e. 15 Zion khopi adeichan nengtah a kapeh a, Asunga vaichate kavahva ding ahi! 16 Athempute abolchan phatthei kaboh a, Amiten kipah othonga la asah diu ahi! 17 Hikoma hi David chilhah khat lal loupe kahisah a, Kalhentum lengpa vai neina ka-umsah ding ahi. 18 Amelmate jumsong ting, Ama lenggam vang khangtouva kithang jing ding ahi,” ati.

Labu 133

Sopi cha banga kipumkhat pachatna

1 Vetan, sopi le sopi kipum khat’a Achenkhom teng Iti phat’a pha Lunglhai um hitam! 2 Lua thao mantam kinua Khamul geiya jolsuh peh, Aaron khamul’a jolsuh a Asangkhol chol ngongkol geiya longsuh tobang ahi! 3 Hermon mol’a kikhol daitwi, Zion lhang geiya hung phinlha tobang ahi! Zion khopi dia Pakaiyin phattheina, Tonsot hinna atepsa ahitai!

Labu 134

Pathen vahchoi dia temna

1 Jan khovah a Ahouin theng kinbol’a, Pakai lhachate hungun vahchoiyun! 2 Houin sunga Pakai lam sangin, Taovun vahchoiyun! 3 Zion khopia van le leiset Sempa Pakaiyin phatthei naboh hen!

Labu 135

Vahchoi La

1 Vahchoiyun Pakai! Amin vahchoiyun Pakai lhachaten! 2 Pakai i-Pathenu Houin sunga Lhacha ding jing nang hon! 3 Vahchiyun Pakai nun nem chu, Mi khoto them ahi amin vahchoila sauvin! 4 Pakaiyin Jacob akilhenin, Israelte agou din akisem’e! 5 I-Pakaiyu loupije kahen, Pathen dang jouse sangin aloupi! 6 Lei le van, Twikhanglen le asunga Pakaiyin adei dei abol jinge! 7 Leiset monga konin gose huise ahintol’in, Gose lah a keh alhahsah jin, Khohui jouse jong Akholna ina konin ahintoldohjie! 8 Egypt gamsunga chun Mihem le gancha peng masa ho athat gam’e! 9 Egypt lengpa le avaibolte talen matsah nan Thil kidang datmo tah tah anabol’e! 10 Namtin vaipi asumang jengin, Leng hattah tah ho anthah’e! 11 Amor leng Sihon, Bashan leng Og, Canaan leng jouse anathattai! 12 Hiche leng ho gam jouse hi, Amite Israelte anapei! 13 Pakai, nangbou Pathena kithang ding, Akhang khanga miten nageldoh jing inte! 14 Pakaiyin amite panpin tin, Alhachate voujang natpinte! 15 Namdangte pathen ho sana dangka kisemthu ahin, Mihem khut’a kisemthu ahibouvui! 16 Kam aneivangun apaothei pon, Mit aneivangun amuthei pouve! 17 Nakhang aneiyun kho ajapon, Haijong ahaisa theipouve! 18 Hiche ho semdoh a tahsan jouse Adoi semthuu hito bang chih cheh-u hen! 19 Israelten Pakai vahchoiyun! Pathen Themputen vahchoiyun! 20 Levite vahchoiyun, Ama chibai boh jousen vahchoi cheh-un! 21 Zion khopia Pakai vahchoiyun, Ahouin, Jerusalem a vahchoiyun! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 136

Thangvahna La

1 Thangvah-un Pakai nun nem chu, tonsot’in alungset jinge! 2 Semthu pathen jouse Pathen thangvah-un, Tonsot’in alungset’jinge! 3 Leiset pakai jouse Pakai thangvah-un, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 4 Thil kidang bolthei Amabou ahin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 5 Achih nan vanmun jouse asemin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 6 Twipi chunga leiset ajal’in, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 7 Ni le Lha asemin, tonsot’in alungset jinge! 8 Sunlai vaihom din Nisa asemin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 9 Janlai vaihom din Lha le ahsite asemin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 10 Egyptte cha masa jouse athat nan, Tonsot’in alungset jingnai! 11 Egypt’a konin Israelte apuidoh-in, TOnsot’in alungset jinge! 12 Aban-gol hatsanin apuipeh-in, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 13 Twilensan dung avotanin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 14 Twi lailunga amite apui galkaiyin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 15 Egypt lengpa le asepaite twi achupsahnan, Tonsot’in alungset jingnai! 16 Nelgama amite apui galkaiyin, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 17 Leng hattah ho athat nan, Tonsot’in alungset jingnai! 18 Leng minthangtah tah atha vangin Tonsot’in alungset jingnai! 19 Amorte leng Sihon atha vangin Tonsot’in alungset jingnai! 20 Bashan leng Og atha vangin Tonsot’in alungset jingnai! 21 Hiche leng ho gam amite apeh vangin Tonsot’in alungset jingnai! 22 Lengho hi alhacha Israel apehdoh vangin Tonsot’in alungset jingnai! 23 Gal i-let tengu eisumil deh pouvin, Tonsot’in eilungset’ui! 24 I-melmateuva konin eilhadoh-un, Tonsot’in eilungset jingui! 25 Ganhing jouse neh ding apen, Tonsot’in alungset jinge! 26 Thangvah-un Van Pathen! Tonsot’in alungset jinge!

Labu 137

Babylon a sohchangte lunghemna

1 Zion khopi kageldoh phat’un, Babylon luipanga touvin kakaptauve! 2 Huisum phung dunga Kasemjangu kakhaiyui! 3 Soh a eihenteuvin lasan eisol’un, Nopsahna anei diu, “Zion la neisahpeh-un,” Tin eisol’uve! 4 Namdangte gamsunga Pakai vahchoila iti kasah diu ham? 5 Vo Jerusalem, Nang kasuhmil leh Khutngoiyin semjang saimon umtange! 6 Kakipa chungnungpenna kagel louva Nang kasuhmil khah leh, Hinkhoa lasa mon um jeng tange! 7 Vo Pakai, Jerusalem kilah nia Edom mite thilbol chu geldoh-in! “Phe lhasoh hel’uvn,” Atiu chu geldoh jingin! 8 Vo Babylon, nakisumangtei ding ahi! Neibolnau to kithuh a nabol chu nun nom hen! 9 Nachasen jouse geiya chomkhoma, songpia jepgoi jeng chu nun nom hen!

Labu 138

Thangvah a Taona

1 O Pakai kalungthim pumpin kathangvah-in, Semthu pathente maiya navahchoi la kasai! 2 Nahouin theng lamngan bohkhup ing, Nalungset long lou le nakitahna jal, Nathupeh gilje leh nathaneije namusah jal’in, Namin kavahchoiye! 3 Kakou nin neihouvin, katha nakidosah tai! 4 Vo Pakai leiset lengthen nathutep ho ajatauve, Nangma vahchoi tauvinte! 5 Nabol chengse le naloupi kidanje La asah diu ahi! 6 Lal loupitah nahivangin Lhasamte kho naton, kiletsahte nakoma akisel theipoi! 7 Gim hesohna kadimset vangin, Neihoidam jingin; Kamelmate lunghan nadoudal’in, Naban thahat’in neihuhhingtai! 8 Natepsa aboncha nabolsoh ding ahi O Pakai tonsot’in nalungset toh ban chu Suchamkimsoh teiyin!

Labu 139

Hesoh musoh mikhohsah Pathen

1 O Pakai neikholchil’in Neihesoh tai! 2 Kabol katoh jouse nahen, Gamla tah a konin kagel nahenkhen theiye! 3 Chatloh in gcholdo jong leng namun, Kabolchan nahesoh keiye! 4 Kapaodoh masang leh Kasei ding nahesohji tai! 5 Nei-umkimsoh keiyin, Nathahat’in neihoidam’e! 6 Neihegil behseh jengin, Kagelphah hoidan ahipoi! 7 Nakoma kona iti kajamdoh a, Na-angsunga iti kajam mang ding ham? 8 Vanna kaldoh jong leng umin natin, Noimigama kumlha jong leng umin nate! 9 Niso kalpeh a leng mang ing, Nilhum kalpeh acheng jong leng; 10 Chukoma neilamkaiya, Chumun jenga jong neipanpi ding ahi! 11 “Mun neithim khum jengin, Kavel’a khovah thimtan,” tijong leng; 12 Nang din muthim jong ajingpon, Jan jong sunlai bep ahi; Nang din jin le vah akibange! 13 Kahalsi sia neisemsoh keiya, Kanu oisunga neijopmatsoh ahibouve! 14 Ginpen ding nahijal’in, kavahchoiye! Nabolchan kidanje le datmo umkalunggil’in kahei! 15 Kagu kachang kisemdoh chun, Kanu oisunga kitup keiyin eikijopmat’in; Het thei louva kahung khandoh chun, naobua ka-um nahejinge! 16 Kapen lhah masangin neimutan, Kahinpat man kahin nikho jat najihdoh tai! 17 Vo Pathen nageldoh het hahsa kasai, Ijat mong nagel hitam! 18 Simjou mong jong leng neldi sangin tamjon tin, Kakhahlo geiyin jong kakoma na-um jinge! 19 Vo Pathen migiloute nathadoh ding kadeiyin, Pum hat miten eidonda theileh kati! 20 Naseise seuvin, Namin soudal nan thilse jeng aseiyui! 21 Vo Pakai nang hotbolte kahon, Nadoumah bolte kakidah lheh jenge! 22 Hot’a tin kahon, kamelma bang banga kagel ahi! 23 Vo Pathen, neikholchil’in kalungthim hen; Neipatep’in kagel jouse mudoh-in! 24 Kalunga agilou aumleh holdoh-in, Tonsot lampia neipuiyin!

Labu 140

Hoidam ngaicha Toana

1 OPakai migiloutea konin neihuhdoh-in! pumhattea konin neihoidanin! 2 Thilse abol bol jengun, Kiboina jeng asodoh-ui! 3 Aleiguiyu gul gunei lei abangin, Athuseiyu gulse gu abange! 4 O Pakai migilouten thang eikampeh-un, Eisumang gotea konin neihoidamin! 5 Kiletsahten thang eikampeh-un, Ka-ona din lenpel eisonpeh-ui! Lam dung lhungin thang eikampeh-uvin ahi! 6 Pakai koma, “ka-Pathen nahi,” kati. Ngaiyin panpi kathum’e Pakai! 7 Pakai ka-Pathen, eipanpi huneitah, Galpi ninneihoidamtai! 8 Migiloute deichat peh dan Pakai! Thilse agonu jong lolhinsah dan! 9 Kamelmate kasangin hatsah dan, Eigihsalna jouseu achunguvah chuhsah-in! 10 Achunguva mei-am kisunkhum hen, Khuhsunga lhalut’uhen potdoh mohel’u hen! 11 Jouva mihehsete lolhing lel jing hen, Pumhatte thilsen lhunkhum hen sumang hen! 12 Pakai vaichate napanhu a, Tahlelte dihna napanpi kahei! 13 Midihten navahahoitei diu, Na-angsunga pansa diu ahi!

Labu 141

Nilhah aTaona

1 Nahenga kataove neipanpin Pakai! Ngaiyin kakouteng! 2 Kataona gamnamtui bangin sangin, Khut’a kasan hin nilhah kilhaina bangin gel’in! 3 Pakai kamdal neikoipeh-in, Kakam simbingin paosah dan! 4 Thildih lou boldana le Migiloute kiloipidanna lung neipen! Migiloute golvahna a Pangkit hih hel’inge! 5 Miphan eikhoto jal’a eiphoa talen eipeh thei, Migilou phat lhemna vang iding katipoi. Athilse bol jouseu dounaa Tao jing jeng kahibouve! 6 Avaibolteu themmo akichansah teng, Kasei kitahdol miten hedoh tauvinte! 7 Thingtum ki-eh keh a ahal hal’a lenglha bangin, Lhankhuh dunga agu achangu thang ding ahi! 8 Kenvang Nangbou kakisonpi Pakai ka-Pathen! Kiselnan kaneiye neithisah dan! 9 Athanguva nei-osah dan, Thilse bolte thangkol’a neisut lhan! 10 Keima kitoldoh ing ting, Migiloute athangkam’uvah oh-u hen!

Labu 142

Panpi ngaicha Taona

1 Pakaiya panpi kathumin, Ahenga kataove! 2 Ahenga kakiphinin Kagimna chengse kaseikhum’e! 3 Kalhah dah teng jongle Pakaiyin kakiheina ding ahen; Kachena lampia chun Kamelmaten thang eikam khum’ui! 4 Kakiheile le vangin Eipanpi ding kamupoi; Eihoidam ding aumpon, Eikhohsah jong aumpoi! 5 Neipanpin a-Pakai! Eihoidampa Nang nahi Pakai! Kahillai damsungin Nangbou ka-ngaichai! 6 Alha lhoppai ding kahi, Ngaiyin panpi kathum’e! Kamelmate ahatval’ui, Neihuhhingin! 7 Kagimnaa konin ol neipen; Kadia naphat jal’in Namite khoppia navahchoiyinge!

Labu 143

Panpi ngaicha Taona

1 Kataona ngaiyin Pakai! Nadihna jal’in kathum neigelpeh-in! Kitah tah nahi neihouvin! 2 Neipatep loujenin nalhacha! Namit mua themchangjou aumpoi! 3 Kamelman eidel’in Toljepnan eineitai! Songkul thim sunga eikhumin, Thilong damsa kabange! 4 Kalel behseh-in lhasam pai ding kahi! 5 Ni masa lao kageldoh-in, Nabolsa natohsa chengse ka-ngaitoi! 6 Gotwi ngai leiset pohkhi bangin Nang ngaichan kasangin kataove! 7 Kakinemlal tai, Tun neihouvin Pakai! Thia mithigam jon ding kahitai, Don louvin neikoidan! 8 Kaki-ngaina nahi, Jingseh le nalungset longlou neihetsah-in! Kataona naheng alhung jinge, Neihil’in hoilam kajot ding! 9 Neihoidam din kahinbel’e Pakai, Kamelmatea koninneihuhdoh loiyin! 10 Ka-Pathen nahi, Nadeilam bolje neihil’in! Nalhagao nun nemtah chun HOidohna lampia neipuiyin! 11 Natepsa bangin neihuhdoh—in Pakai, Nadih jal’in kagimna jousea neihuhhingin! 12 Neingailut jal’in kamelmate that’in, Nalhacha kahi eidoubolte sumangin!

Labu 144

Galjo jeh a lengpan Pathen athangvah

1 Eihoidama Pakai vahchoiyun! Galbolje eihil’in galkon din eigonge! 2 Eipanpia eihoidampu, Kakiselna le huhhing, Hoidamna dia kaki-ngaina ahi! Namtin vaipi eisotkunpeh tai! 3 Pakai, mihem ipi hiya hibanga nagelkhoh, Mihem chapa mai mai jong hibanga nakhohsah? 4 Mihem hi haikhatseh bang hing, Ahin nikho jong nilim kihei mang bep ahi! 5 Pakai vanthamjol loikunin hung kumlhan, Molsang ho thamle chun meikhun len gmangunte! 6 Keh kisesah-in namelmate nocheh-in! Nathalchang kap’in deljamin! 7 Chunga konin twithuh lah a neiloidoh-in, Namdangte ban thahat’a neichu lhan! 8 Amahon thudih la aseipouvin, Akihahselnau jong aseilepji tauve! 9 Vo Pathen kipa lathah sang ting, Semjang saiyin nahenga la sange! 10 Lengte gal najosah jin, Nalhacha David nahuhdoh-e! 11 Kamelma engsetea konin neihuhdoh-in, Namdangte ban thahat’a konin neihuhdoh-in! Amahon thudih la aseipouvin, Akihahsaelnau jong aseilepji tauve! 12 Kachateu gollhang ho Thingtoi dong khanpha bangu hen! Kachateu nu-ngah ho Leng inpi jepna khompah bangu hen! 13 Kachangpangu chang chichom chom dim hen! Kaloujaovuva kelngoiten nou snagsom cheng hingu hen! 14 Bongpite nou pengsol le athol lha beiyin Neng jeng jungin pungu hen! Kakholai dunguva Ka le mao ogin kija hih beh hen! 15 Hitobang vangphat chang Nam mi chu nun nom hen! A-Pathenu Pakai hikha Nam mi chu nun nom hen!

Labu 145

Vahchoina La

1 Nachoi-an inge ka-Pathen, kelengpa! Tonsot’in thangvah jing tange! 2 Niseh le thangvah ing ting, Tonsot’in vahchoi jing tange! 3 Pakai loupipen, loupitah a vahchoi lom ahi! Aloupije kholsoh dan ahipoi! 4 Nathilbolsa akhang khangin vahchoi ding, Nathilbol loupije phongjal’unte! 5 Mihon nalal loupije seiyun tin, Keiman thil kidang nabolsagel jing inge! 6 Mihon nathilbol natsatje seiyuntin, Keiman naloupije phongjal inge! 7 Naphatna jouse seiyun tin, Namikhotoje lan sauvinte! 8 Milungset khoto them Pakai, Lungset thingset lung hangvah lou! 9 Mitin dia phasoh, Asemsa jouse lainatpi cheh! 10 Nasemsaten vahchoiyune Pakai! Namiten thangvah-un nate! 11 Nalal loupe thaneije seiyuntin, Nathahat seichoi leuvinte! 12 Chuteng mitinin nathilbol natsatje, Nalenggam lal loupe seichoi leuvinte! 13 Tonsot’a vaihom jing, Tonsot len gloupi nahi! Pakai-atepsa jousea akitah jingin, Abol jouse aphasoh keiye! 14 Gim genthei thohte apanpin, Alhute akaidinge! 15 Ganhing jousen kinemtah-in naveuvin, Aduchat jouse nape jinge! 16 Bulhingin nape jingin, Gilkel jouse navahva cheh-e! 17 Pakai hi abolchan a adih-in, Atoh chan a mi ahepi! 18 Pakai chu akoma lungthengsel’a Taote henga anai jinge! 19 Ajabolte ngaichat chan apen, Ataonai ngaiyin ahuhhingjie! 20 Ama ngailu chan ahoidamsel’in, Migiloute vang sumanginte! 21 Pakai vahchoi jing inge; Asemsaten amintheng vahchoi cheh-un!

Labu 146

Huhhinga Pathen vahchoina

1 Vahchoiyun Pakai! Kalhan Pakai vahchoiyin! 2 Kahinlaisen vahchoiying ting, Kahinkhon ka-Pathen vahchoi la sange! 3 Lengle lalte kisonpi dan, Mihemin huhhing joupon nate! 4 Mihemte athi teng vut asoh jin, Athilgon jouseu athi ni hin abeitai! 5 Jacob Pathen panpi chu anun nomin, Jacob Pakai Pathena ki-ngai chu anun nom’e! 6 Aman van le leiset, Twikhanglen le Asunga um jouse asemin; Atepsa jouse abulhit jinge! 7 Bol hesohte khotonan thu atanin, Gilkelte neh ding an apei! Sohchangte Pakaiyin alhadoh-in; 8 Mitcho kho amusah-e! Alhute akai dingin, midihte angailui! 9 Igamsunguva cheng gamchom mi ahoidamin, Meithai chaga akhoton, migiloute thilgonho asumange! 10 Pakai chu tonsot leng ahin, Vo Zion, na-Pathenintonsot din lengvai apoi! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 147

Hatchungnung Pathen vahchoina

1 Vahchoiyun Pakai! I-Pathenu vahchoi la sah thilpha ahin, Avahchoi hi thildih, lung nachimna ahi! 2 Pakaiyin Jerusalem asemphan, Sohchang bulpute ahinlepuitai! 3 Lung kisihte adamsah-in, Amahau atomjolpeh tai! 4 Ahsi jat asimtoh-in, Amin cheh-in akouve! 5 Loupitah a thanei i-Pakaiyu ahin, Achihna tejou ahipoi! 6 Mi nun nen ho achoisangin, Migiloute tolgoi nan aneiye! 7 Pakai vahchoina la asauvin, I-Pathen diuvin tumging thei semjang saiyun! 8 Vanthamjol’a mei ajamsah-in, Gotwiyin leiset achap nouve! Mol le lhanga hamhing apousah-e! 9 Gancha hing jouse neh ding apen, Va-ah nouten an athum teng Avahva soh keiye! 10 Sakol hattah ho akipapi pon, Sepai hangtah jong along lhaipi poi! 11 Alungset longlouva ki-ngaiya, Ama jabolte chunga bou akipah-e! 12 Vo Jerusalem Pakai vahchoiyin! Vo Zion, na-Pathen vahchoiyin! 13 Nakulpi kotgol alhousah-in, Namite phatthei aboh jinge! 14 Nagamgi jouse ahongbit’in, Suhlou chang tuipenin navah-e! 15 Leiset’a thupeh aneiteng, Aseibangin akitongdoh jenge! 16 Buhbang ponphan aphan, Daibang vutvai kithejal abahsah-e! 17 Gel songchang kisunglha abahsah-in, Adapsah teng koima thoh jouhoi ahippoi! 18 Chuteng agahsei leh gel ajun lhan, hui anunsah le twiyin alonge! 19 Amite thu aseipeh-in, Danthu le ahilchahna Israelte Amahon jong Adanthu ahepouve! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 148

Pakai vahchoi dia vannoi temna

1 VahchoiyunPakai! Van miten Pakai vahchoiyun, Chunga chengten vahchoiyun! 2 Vanmi janel, Avantil jousen Vahchoiyun Pakai! 3 Ni le lhan vahchoiyun, Ahsi vahtah tahhon vahchoiyun! 4 Van chungnung penin jong vahchoiyin, Van vuma twipin jong vahchoiyin! 5 Abonchauvin Pakai min vahchoi cheh-u hen! Ama thusah a kisem jeng ahiuve! 6 Pakai thusah a tonsot’a dia amun cheh akigol, Apalkeh lou diu gamgi kisempeh ahiuve! 7 Leiset’a konin vahchoiyun Pakai! Lithuh lai jousea ngapi len lai jousen; 8 Kolphe le gellen, buhbang le meilhang ho, Athupeh a nung huise jousen vahchoiyun! 9 Molle lhang sang jouse, Gammang thing gathei jousen vahchoiyun! 10 Vahngoisa le gamlah sanamkim, Tol a vah le chunga leng jousen vahchoiyun! 11 Mipite le leng jouse, Leng le lal, vaibol jousen; 12 Nu-ngah gollhang, The le khang jousen vahchoiyun! 13 Abonchan Pakai min vahchoi cheh-u hen! Amin loupipenin, aloupinan van le leiset akhokheltai! 14 Adeitah amite Israel ahatsah jal’in, Abonchan Pakai avahchoitauve! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 149

Vahchoina La

1 vahchoiyun Pakai! Pakai vahchoina lathah sauvin, Tahsan nei amite khoppi sunga vahchoiyun! 2 Nasempa chunga kipah-in Israel! Nalengpa chunga kipah-un Zion mite! 3 Lamin amin vahchoiyun! Avahchoi nan khong bengun semjang saiyuvin! 4 Pakai amite chunga akipah-in, Mi nun nemte choi-atnan gal ajosah tai! 5 Gal ajoteng Pathen mite kipah hen, Jan khovah-in kipa la sau hen! 6 Chemjam hemtah choiyin, Othongin Pathen vahchoiyu hen! 7 Namtin jousoh a Mitin talen matsah din; 8 Alengtau somkonsoh a, Alamkai jouseu thih khaova hen din; 9 Pathen thusah a namtin talen matsah dingin! Hiche hi Pathen mite galjona ahi! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Labu 150

Vahchoiyun Pakai

1 Vahchoiyun Pakai! Ahouin a Pathen vahchoiyun! Van a jong ahatna vahchoiyun! 2 Athilbol minthang ho jeh-in vahchoiyun! Aloupina seithei loujal’in vahchoiyun! 3 Sumkon gin to thon vahchoiyun! Theile mut le selangdah saiyin vahchoiyun! 4 Khong beh le lam to thon vahchoiyun, Semjang sai le kuli gin to thon vahchoiyun! 5 Khutbengun vahchoiyun! Hamlah lah-in khut bengin vahchoiyun! 6 Ganhing namkimin Pakai vahchoiyun! Vahchoiyun Pakai!

Proverbs 31

Thuhilpa 1

Hinkho pannabei

1 Jerusalem khopia leng chang, David chapa, michingthempa thusei ho chu hicheng hi ahi. 2 Michingthempan thil ijakai hi pannabei jengin aseiye. Hinkho jong pannabei, ijakai hi pannabei ahi. 3 Hinkhon cholle nangin na natongun, ahivangin ipi phatchomna vetsah ding naneiyum? 4 Mihem khang akichaiyin khang chom chom ahungin, leiset la baep’in aum jinge. 5 Nisa la asona ngaiya asoh jingin, alhumna ngaiya alhumin, chille nangin ahung kipat kitna ding mun a akile kit’in ahi. 6 Hui jong sahle lhang, simle mal, kolkimvel’a avel vel’in anung kimvel vel jenge. 7 Vadung jouse Twikhanglen la along lut’in, Twikhanglen la adim deh poi. Twi chu luidung nah dunga ahung kipanlit’in, avel’in ahung kitol kit’e. 8 Thil ijakai cholna jeng ahin, chol aum behseh jengin seijou jai ahipoi. Mit la vet achimpoi. 9 Asohsa thil chu hung soh kit ding ahi. Akibolsa thil chu kibol kit ding ahi. Vannou pumpia hin thil thah aumpoi. 10 Mihon, “ven, hikoma thil thah aum’e!” atiuve. Ahivangin hiche jong hi masang, ipen masangpeh-uva sohsa ahitai. 11 Masanglai thilsoh chu koiman ageldoh pon, tulai min jong khonung thilsoh ding le tukah a thilsoh ding geldoh ponte.

Thuhilpan tahsa ahetsa thil

12 Michingthempa kei hi Jerusalem khopia, Israel chunga, leng kana change. 13 Vannoi leiset’a kibol kitong thil jouse hi kholchil ding, phot chet din kakiteptai. Pathenin mihem abolna vang hi nopna him him ahipoi. 14 vannoi leiset’a kibol thil jouse kamun, kaseipeh nahi, aboncha pannabei jeng hai. hui leng lai mat ding go bep akihi. 15 Akonsa le sujang theipon natin, aum loula simtha theipon nate. 16 Kalungthimin, “kaminthang lheh tan, kamasanga Jerusalem a lengvaippote jouse sangin kachingjoi. Chihna le hetna jong ipi mong mong kiseina ahi kahetai,” kati. 17 Hetna le ngolna kibah lou je, chih le ngol kibah louje hetdoh kagoi. Hichea jong hin hui lenglai mat godol’in kakihei. 18 Nachih cheh le nalung gimbe cheh, nahetbe jep le nalung natbe cheh ding ahi.

Thuhilpa 2

1 Nom satah a uma, nopna hi hatchet tei kagoi. Ahinla hiche jeng jong hi pannabei ahi kamu dohtai. 2 Nui ngolna ahiya, nopsah nan thilpha aso sah lou jong kahe dohtai. 3 Kachih nom behseh jeh-in, kisuh lipna din ju kadonin nom um ding kagoi. Leiset hinkho chomcha sunga hitia umding hi mihem dia thil phapen din kanegel’e. 4 Thil loupe tah tah katongdoh tai: in tampi kakisah-in, Lengpilei tampi kakibol’e. 5 Hon le pahcha lei kabol’in, thei gathei jouse kaphut’e; 6 achap nouna ding twikul kalaiye. 7 Soh tampi kachon, ka-insunga peng den soh jong tampi kavul’e. Kamsasanga Jerusalema leng ho sangin kahaojon gancha tamjo kaneiye. 8 Kavaipohna gamsunga leng inpi thil kholna chengsea konin sana dangka kapokhomin kasevum leove. Kei nopsahna din numeiyin la asauvin, pasal deichat lom numei chamkim keiyin kaneiye. 9 Kaloupi lheh jengin, kamasanga Jerusalema cheng leng ho sangin loupin kaumdoh tan, kachihna athon ngaipoi. 10 Kadeichan kamun; nopsahna thei kalhaso ngaipoi. Katohdoh chan kahoithopin, hiche hi katohman ahimaiye. 11 Hicheng tohdohna dia hahsa kathoh chengse kagel le imacha pang din aumdoh theipoi. Pannabei hui lenglai mat go bep kahi. 12 Akhonna kheh a leng khat’in abol thei chu leng masa ho bolsa chubou ahi. Hijeh chun hcihna le chihgil chule ngolna umdol hi kagel pantai. 13 Hiche vang hi kahetai—“Chihna hi ngolna sangin aphajon, muthim sanga khovah phatchom tobang ahi. 14 Michingin kaselna ding akihet’in, mi-ngol’in kho amupoi,” kati. Chule iboncha ithi cheh diu jong kahe dohtai. 15 Kalungin, “Mi-ngol ho banga kathitei ding ahi. Achutile hibanga kahcih hi ipi kaphat chompim?” kati. Kei le ken, “Thil imcha cha phat chompi kaneipoi,” tin kaseiye. 16 Miching geldohna jong aumppon, mi-ngol geldodhna jong aumppoi. Khonung tengle koiman eigeldoh pouvinte. Miching mi-ngol iboncha itih cheh diu ahi. 17 Hijeh hin mihem hinkho hi imacha ding katipoi, ajehc hu hinkhon gim hesoh tilou adang ima eipetheipoi. Pannabei hel ahin, hui lenglai man go bep kanahi. 18 Katohsa le kabolsa chengse phatchom nan kaneipon, kakhel’a pang dinga dia kadalhah ding kahei; 19 ama chu miching hithei, mi-ngol hithei-kon ija ahet’em? Hoijoh hile katohsa, kachihnan hiche leiset’a atohdoh chengse, aman alo ding ahi. Aboncha pannabei jeng ahibouve. 20 Hibang hahsa na katoh chu kakisih lheh jenge. 21 Nachihna le nahetna, nathepna mangcha natohdoh chengse chu atong louhel khat nadalhah peh didng ahi. Pannabei hel, thil dih lou ahi! 22 Hinkhoa lung gim hesoh a na natoh a, ipi tohman nasan ding ham? 23 Nahinlai damsunga natohdoh chengsen thil dang sodoh pontin, lung gimna le lung natna bou asodoh ding ahi. Janin jong lung ol’in naum thiepoi. Aboncha pannabei jeng ahi. 24 Mihem toh thei thilpha pen chu-atohga neh a don ding, nomsa tah aum didng hi ahi.Ahinla hiche jeng jong hi Pathen peh a kimubou ahi kahedoh tai. 25 Hiche tilou chu thil dang ipi neh a nomsa naum thei ding ham? 26 Pathenin adei bolte chu chihna, hetna chule nopna apeh ahi; chonsete vang natong sumhol’a apansah a, alodohsah a akholsah kit’a, Pathen lungtohte peh dia akoisah ahi. Aboncha hi pannabei bep, hui lenglai man dia kigo bep ahibouve.

Thuhilpa 3

Thil ijakaiyin phat anei cheh

1 Hiche vannoi leiset a thilsoh jouse hi Pathenin asosah nom phat dungjuiya soh cheh ahi. 2 Pen phat aumsah-in, thi phat aumsah-e; Thing phu phat aumin, thing bodoh phat aum’e. 3 Suhlih phat aumin, boldam phat aum’e. Sahdoh phat aumin, phet lhah phat aum’e, 4 Gim phat aumsah-in, nop phat aumsah-e; Lunghem phat aumin, lam phat aum’e. 5 Kidei phat aumin, kihotphat aum’e; Kichopto phat aumin, kichop lou phat aum’e. 6 Thil holdoh phat aumsah-in, thil mansah phat aumsah-e; Loidoh phat aumin, semang phat aum’e. 7 Bo-eh phat aumin, khuibit phat aum’e; Umthim phat aumin, paopoh phat aum’e. 8 Ki-ngai phat aumsah-in, kihot phat aumsah-e; Kisat phat aumin, kicham phat aum’e. 9 Itoh gimchengseuva kona ipi imudoh-um? 10 Pathenin pohgih hahsa eipohsah-u kahei. 11 Aman thil ijakai din phat kitoh che’tin akoiye, Khonung thu ding hetnomna eipeuvin, ahivangin athilbol lhingset’a het’a lung nachimpi ding eiphalpeh pouve. 12 Hijeh chun ihinlai damsunguva itoh thei chan toh a nopsah pi ding hi toh thei penin kahei. 13 Ibonchauva itohga neh a don ding, nopsah pi ding ahi. Hiche hi Pathen thilpeh ahi. 14 Pathen thilbol jouse beitih neilou ding kahei. Bolbe thei jong hilou, lahdoh thei jong hilou ahi. Pathen thilbol khat chu-ibonchauva Ama eiginsah got’u ahi. 15 Thilsoh ho le asoh ding ho hi asohsa ahitai. Asohsa chu Pathenin avel vel’a asosah ahibouve.

Vannoiya thudih lou

16 Achung chonin, vannoiya hin thudih kiseiya thildih bolna dinga gitlouna namudoh ding kahetai. 17 Kachangseh-in, “Thilsoh jouse le thil kibol chengse hi aphat dungjui cheh a soh ahijeh-in, Pathenin midih le migilou thu kibanga atan ding ahi,” tin kagel’e. 18 Eiho hi ganchate sanga phajo deh lou ihiu vetchetna dia Pathenin eipatep dol’un kahei. 19 Hoi hileh-mihem hihen gancha hileh thei cheh ding ahi. Khat thi banga jong thi thou ahi.Ahoi hoi hiya thilsem gel ahi. Mihem jong gancha sangin aphachom dehpoi, ajehc hu hoijoh ding ahin hinlo aumpoi. 20 Mun khat ajot lhon a, leivui sohgel ding ahi. Leivuiya kisemgel, leivui sohgel ding ahi. 21 Mihem lhagao van a akaldoh mongin, gancha lhagao lei noiya ache monge, ti kon asei thei dang ham? 22 Hijeh chun thilpha pen a kagel chu itohsa chunga lung nom a um ding hi ahi. Bol thei dang ineipouve. Ithi nung tengu ipi aso ding hetdoh theina lampi ineipouvin ahi.

Thuhilpa 4

1 Vannoi leiset’a thil dihlou kibol chengse kavei. Bolsetna thohte aka vangun koiman apanpi deh poi. Abolsetau chu thanei thu neiloi ahijeh-un koiman apanpi nagmpoi. 2 Thia mangsa ka-otchajo tai; ahing nalaiho sangin amaho chun nom asajouve. 3 Athi le ahing sanga phajo cheh kit chu-apen a peng lou, vannoiya thil dihlou kibol mukha louhel ho chu ahiuve. 4 Mihon hibanga kihanlhoten a na atoh-u jong kahe dohtai; midang tohna thangset jal’a abol’u ahi. Hijongle hiche jong hi pannabei ahibouve.Hui lenglai mat ding kigo bep ahi. 5 Amahon khut kikhoitum a an ngol’a thia chu angol’in bou aseiyui. 6 Dih khat nante, ahivnagin khut ong man louhel’a hui lenglai mat ding goa kiseimo jeng sangin, lung ol heocha themcha bou nei aphajoi. 7 Ken hinkho sunga pannabei khat jong kamudoh-e. 8 Pasal khat hi achangseh-in achenge. Cha la neipon, sopi jeng jong aneipoi; ahivangin umthim thei louvin na atongin, anei chasun along lhaipipoi. Koi ding bep ngaitoa kicholdoh man louhel’a hibanga na atoh ham? Hiche hi pannabei, hinkho hahsa tah ahibouve. 9 Khatseh sangin mi ni aphajoi, ajeh chu mi ni akitho theiye. 10 Khat joh sang lhu lhon jongle khat’in aphong ding theiye. Mi khatseh vang chu lhu ta le aphong ding aumtapoi. 11 Adap teng mi nin lumkhom alum asah thei ahin, nachangseh a iti lum nasah diu ham? 12 Mi khat nan lel chu mi nin ananjou tei ding ahi. Khao jang thum kihel lhop botan hahsa ahi. 13 Leng tehse mi-ngol, thumop sang lou hisangin, vaicha khangdodng miching hi aphajoi. 14 Hitobang gollhang chu songkul lutsa leng hung chang hijongle, vaicha chaga cha peng hijeng jongle aphajo nalaiye. 15 Vannoiya cheng mihem jouse kagel’in, hoikom ham alah-uva gollhang khat pen chu lengpa mun hilo ding umkahedoh tai. 16 Lengin vai apohna sunga hin mipi simsen lou unman tin, lengpa athi teng atohsah koiman gelpha ponte. Hiche hi pannabei, hui lenglai mat dia kigoa tobang ahi.

Thuhilpa 5

Geltoh louva kitepna sem

1 Houin kaidol ching theiyin. Kho pholou mi-ngolten abol’a kilhaina thil moh to to jeng sanga, thu ngaiya kihil them dia Houin kai aphajoi. 2 Napaodoh masangin geltoh masan, chule geltoh louvin Pathen koma kitepna bol jeng dan. Pathen van a um, nang leiset’a um bou nahin, nasei dia lombep kalval’in imacha sei hih-in. 3 Nalung gim cheh le mangse naneibe cheh thei, thu nasei tam chan a ngol-hoi thu naseidoh be thei ahi. 4 Pathen koma kitepna naneikhah le, tong doh loi jengin, Pathenin mi-ngol adeipoi, bol dia naseisa chu bol jengin. 5 Kitepsa bolda sangin, kitepna him him boldan aphajoi. 6 Naseisan kipal dan, Pathen Thempu jah a geldoh louva nabol’in seidan. Idia Pathen nakiphin lung hang ding ham? Nabolse chu i-bol’a nasuh mangsah ding ham? 7 Mangle bul ijat neiyin lang, pannabei na ijat tongin, thu ijat sei jongle chun, Pathen nagin tei tei ding ahi.

Hinkho pannabei

8 Leiset vaipoten vaichate abol hesoh a, thu dih tanpeh louva, achan diu lom apeh d anamu jongle datmo hih-in. Vaihom thunei jouse chu asanga lenjo khat cheh-in ave-lhi, alenpen jong chu alen cheh khat’in avet lhi jing ahi. 9 Lengpa jong alalna lhosoh chunga ki-ngam ahibouve. 10 Sum nadei behseh le, itih-in jong lung nachimna neipon natin; hao lung nagul le, nadei chanmusoh pon nate. Pannabei ahibouve. 11 Nahao cheh le naneh peh ding jong tambe cheh ahi. Naphat chompi pen chu nahao nahet tho chu ahibep’e. 12 Natong jing vang chun neh kham kimu hen kimu hih jongle nomsel’in a-ihmu theiyin, mihao vang chu anei lung jin pin ihmu mon akhovah jitai. 13 Vannoiya thil melse tah khat kamui; mihon khonunga nom neh dingin sum akhol khol’un, 14 ahivangin hamsetna khat jeh hamin amoh suh mang hel jiuvin, atu acha ding khen louhel’in aumlo jitauve. 15 Imacha polut louva vannoiya ihung lut bangun, pohdoh neilouvin adalhaji tauve.Tong gim lheh jong leu hen ipohdodh theiyu khat cha aumpoi. 16 Dih louhel ahi! Ihung lut banguva potdoh kit ahiuve. Itong gim’un, hui lenglai mat ding geiyin igo’uvin, ipi ikimu’vem? 17 Mitsin khojin le gim hesoh thoh-in ihingun, lung gim le lung phamo chule nat hesoh ithoh-ui. 18 Hiche hi kamudoh bep’e. Thilpha pen chu min Pathenin apeh ahinkho chom cha sunga hi atohga alhosoh ne le don a nop sahna anei hi ahi; hiche hi mihem chan ahibep’e. 19 Pathenin mihem chu haole gou pehen, nop sahnan neisah le atoh lo chu kipa pinte. Hiche hi Pathe thilpeh ahi. 20 Pathenin nomsan akoiyin, hinkho chomje chu khohsa behseh ponte.

Thuhilpa 6

1 Vannoiya hin thil dihlou kibol khat kamui. 2 Pathenin mihem khat nei le gou, jabolna, ijakai adeichan apen, ahivangin hicheng chu nop sahnan aneisah hih beh-e. APeh louhel khat’in nopsah nan aneijie.Hiche hi pannabei hel, thil dih lout ah ahi. 3 Mihem khat’in cha ja khat jen nei hen sotpi hing hen, itih chan ahin vangin nop sahna neikha louhel le phate keichan kivui hihle, apenlhah lhah a thipai jeng naosen ma aphajoi, tin kagel’e. 4 Hiche naosen chu apenlo vang umlou, mitsin khojin gam alut kit, koiman geldoh kit lou ahitai. 5 Nisa vah jong mupha lou, mihem hinkho umje jong helou ahin, kichol dona beh vang akimui. 6 Kum sangni jen hing jongle hin nopna hephalou mihem sangin aphajoi.Anigel lhon’a mun khat jon a che lhon ahi. 7 Mihemin atoh chan kamsung ding ahin, chimla achimdeh poi. 8 I-atile mi-ngol sanga miching phajo ham? Mi vaichan hinkho manje ahet them chun ipi aphat chomsah mong ham? 9 Pannabei she, hui lenglai mat go bep ahi. I-khat ngaicha jinga um sanga nanei lung lhaipi chu thil phajo ahi. 10 Thilsoh jouse hi aso masanga gontohsa ahitan, mihemin asanga hatjo akinelpi thei lou jong ihecheh-ui. 11 Nakinelpi sot chan a pha mo cheh ahin, phatchom nan naneideh poi. 12 Nisa lim banga kihei mang loi, hiche pannabei hinkho chomcha sunga hi mihemin ahinkho dia thilpha iti akihet thei ding ham? Athi nung teng leiset’a thilsoh ding kon ija ahet thei ding ham?

Thuhilpa 7

Hinkho dia lunggel

1 Min phat hi thao namtui sangin aphajon, napen nikho sangin nathi in aphajoi. 2 Golvah na in a lhah sangin lunghemna in a che aphajoi, ajeh chu mihing jousen athi ding sumil louvin aum theiye. 3 Nui sangin lungkham aphajoi; maiso hoimo sah jongle, lungthim he themna apetheijoi. 4 Nopsah ding jeng gel mihem chu a-ngol’ah ahi. Michingin thina bou agelkhoh-e. 5 Mi-ngolten navahchoi la sah sangun, naphoh ding miching nanei aphajoi. 6 Mi-ngol nuigin chu linghema belto kihet tobang ahin, ajeh apol beihel ahibouve. 7 Michingin mi alepthol teng ngolchon ahitai. Nehguh nalah teng naming phat kisuhmang nahi. 8 Thil ijakai akipatna sangin akichina aphajoi. Kiletsah sangin thoh hat aphajoi. 9 Lung han gloi hih-inl lung ul jing hi ngol thubuh bou ahi. 10 Itih-in jong, “Itia tulai sanga masanga thil phajo ham?” tin sei hih hel’in. Hiche hi chih hoi thudoh ahipoi. 11 Mihing jouse chih lom tah ahi; chihna hi gou kilamdoh tobang ahin, 12 sumin asemdoh thei banga lungmon napethei ahi. Chihnan nahoidoh sah thei ding ahi-hiche hi hetna phat chomna ahi. 13 Pathen thilbolsa gel’in.Pathenin asemkonsa chu kon ahejang thei ding ham? 14 Thil ijakai aphat thei pet le kipah-in, gim hesoh hung lhun teng, nopna le gimna Pathen a kon gel ahi geldoh-in; akit teng thilsoh ding ipi ahi nahepoi. 15 Pannabei kahinkho sung hin thil ijakai kamusoh tai; mipha thi thi jeng thei, migilou hing hing jeng thei ahi. 16 Hijeh chun phat behseh le chih behseh bol dan-idia nang le nang nakitha ding ham? 17 Engset val le ngol val jong boldan-idia naphat masanga nathi ding ham? 18 Chonval tho dan. Hougut nahile lolhing thouvin nate. 19 Vaipo som khat’in khopi khat akithopi sangin, chihna hin mi ahatsah joi. 20 Leiset’a hin bol khel neilou thildih bol jing koima aumpoi. 21 Mi sei jouse ngai hih-in, nasoh pan nahoutom na jong jadoh get’in nate. 22 Nangin jong tamtah vei midang nahoutom nakihet chu me. 23 Chihnan hicheng hi kapatep soh tai. Chih ding kago lheh nan sophan hoi ahipoi. 24 Hinkho umje dol hedoh jou ding koiham? Eiho din athuh val’in, hetdoh hahsa tah ahi. 25 Hijongle het ding gultenin sim kagon; chihna holdoh tei kagon, kahetnom cheng donbutna mudoh a, ngolna phatmo dan mong mong photchet ding kagoi. 26 Hichea hin thina sanga khohjo khat kamudoh-e. Hichu numei ahi. Numeiyin nadeichat teng thangkam kilhopel khah le khaova kihen nabah ding ahi; numeiyin nakoichah den teng thih khaova kihen bang bang hin nate. Pathen lung deiya chonpa vang jam doh nan tin, chonsepa vang oh den ding ahitai. 27 Michingthempan aseiyin, thil ijakai kakhol tohnaa kona hiche hi athem thema kamudoh ahi, tin aseiye. 28 Thildang kahol vangin khatcha jong kamudohpoi. Pasal sang khat lah a jabol theidol khat bou kamun, numei khatcha jong kamupoi. 29 Hicheng hi kasimdoh ahi; Pathenin baikhen cha eisemdoh-u ahin, eiho le eiho kisunoh den ahiuve.

Thuhilpa 8

1 Michingin bou thil ho umdol ahethem’e. Chihnan mail lhaisel’in aumsah-in, amelse aselpeh theiye.

Lengpa thun nungun

2 Lengpa sei sei bol’in, geltoh louvin Pathen koma kitepna neiloi hihin. 3 Lengpan abolnom nom abol thei ahi, hijeh chun a-angsunga konin potdoh loiyin, tijat umtah mun ahin umsot dan. 4 Thuneina neiya lengpa thil bol ahin, athilbol phoh ngam aumpoi. 5 Athupeh nanit chan a nadia pha, michingin bou itih a ipi bol ding akihet thieye. 6 Thil ijakai hi adih a bol phat umcheh ahi, eihon imacha ihepouve! 7 Thil hungsoh dingla ihepouvin, eiseipeh theiyu jong koima aumpoi. 8 Koima thilou thei aumpon, nathina ding nikho vochon thei jong aumpoi. Hiche hi ijamdoh thei lou nau galmun ahi; lepthol’in jamdoh theipoute.

Migilou le midih

9 Vannoiya thil kibol n akitong chengse kagel gelle hicheng hi kamudoh-e, vannoiya hin mihem thanei phabep noiya adangsen gim hesoh athoh-e. 10 Ahimonge, migiloute thia lhana akivui kamun, lhanphunga konin in lam jot pet’in, masanga thilse tampi abolnau khopia mihon, migilou kavuisa ho pachatna thu aseiyui. Hiche hi mohseh mong ahi. 11 Ipi dia mipin thilse amoh bol bol jeng ham? Thilse bolte talen kimatsah vah vah loujeh ahi. 12 Chonsen thilse ja khat cheng bol jongle ahing thei thei nalaiye. Hiche hon asei kahedoh tai, “Pathen thu nanit pou le ima tiponte, 13 amavang migilouvin hoidohna neiponte. Ahinkhou la nisa lim kihei bep, Pathenthu angai loujeh-uva donthi diu ahi,” atiuve. 14 Ahinla hiche hi ngol thubuh ahi. Vannoiya ipi soh tam; abang kom le midih-in migiloutalen mat ding amanin, migilouvin midih kipaman san ding asange. Hijeh chun pannabeiyin kaseiye. 15 Min nom asah ding bou dihjon kageltai; ajeh chu ahinkho lung nopna pen chu aneh a adon a nomsa um ding hi adeipen ahi. Hiche beh hi vannoiya Pathenin apeh hinkho anei laisunga abol thei ahi. 16 Kichihsah a vannoiya thilsoh hetdoh kagot chanin, sun le jan a hah khovah vah, tou nilhum thei nahi, 17 Pathen thilbol khat beh nahetdoh thei louhel ding kahedoh tai. Itobanga khohsah-in gut jongle chun mudoh jou deh pon nate. Michingten het go nauvin tin, hedeh pouvinte.

Thuhilpa 9

1 Hiche thudol hi sopi le giltah-in kagel’in, Pathenin michingte le midihte natoh thilbol jouse athu nunin, angailut nau le amihot nau geiyin athu thun ahei theiye. Mihem koiman amsanga thilsoh ding ahepoi. 2 Imacha akikhenna aumpoi. Midih le migilou, mipha l emiphalou, hougut le houbei, kilhaina thilto pe jingle pelou-kibanga thi cheh diu ahi.Mi chonse sangin mipha aphachom deh pon; kihahsel bolpa jong abol loupa sangin apha dehpoi. 3 Mi jouse kibanga thi cheh diu ahin, hiche jeng jong hi vannoiya thilsoh lah a dih lou thou thou ahi. Mihemte ahin leisen alung sungu thilse le ngolna dim, het man louva thiji ahiuve. 4 Amavang mihing gamsunga cheng chun kinepna phabep aneiteiye; uicha hin ghcu sakei thisa sangin aphachom’e. 5 Ahing’an thi ding akihet’in, athisan vang ima ahetapoi. Kipaman san ding jong anei tapouvin, koiman ageldoh tapouve. 6 Angailutnau le ahotnau, alung gul’u aboncha thi tha ahitauve. Hiche vannoiya thilsoh lah a pang kit louhel ding ahitauve. 7 Chen kipah thanomin an kineh-in;lengpitwi kidonin lang kisuhal’in. Pathen din aphanai. 8 Halpel’in thanom jing jengin. 9 Vannoiya Pathenin pannabei hinkho naneisah sungsen nadeitah naji to nomsa lhonin. Pannabei nikho ho hi nomsan mangin, hibou chu nacholman ahibep’e. 10 Natoh chan thakhen louhel’in tongin, ajeh chu nachena ding noimigama chun toh dingle lunggel, hetna le chihna jong abeitai. 11 Kahetdoh kit thil khat chu-vannoiya hin lhai hatpa jengin jong kilhai tet ajoudeh pon, gal-hangpan jong gal ajo jing ahideh poi. Michingin neh le chah akimuchom a, lungthim chingin haona anei chom a, atongthempan tohmun sang alo chom deh ahipoi. Mitinin toset atoh cheh theiye. 12 Itih a i-nati ding phat nakihetpoi. Hetman louva vacha thang-oh bang le, nga len a kijeldoh tobanga igel loupet tah-uva phat gilou khat’a oh denji ahiuve.

Chle ngolna thua lunggelihna

Thilchom beh khat, vannoiya chihna itidol’a kigel vetkah phatah khat jong kamudoh-e. 14 Mihem tam beh lou chenna, khopi neo thim khat aum’e. Leng thanei tah khat hin adel khumtai. Khopi chu aum chah kheh-in, pal voh chim din agoi. 15 Khopi sunga hin mi vaicha, ahivanga khopi huhdoh theina khop a ching khat acheng’e. Ahinla koiman ama chu iman agelpoi. 16 Ken kaei jing chu-chihna hi thahat sanga phachomjo ahin, hijongle koiman vaichapa chu michingin agelpon, asei jong koiman ngaisah-in aneippoi. 17 Mi-ngolte kikhopnaa lengpa kisen gin ngai sangin, thip beh cha miching houlim ngai aphajoi. 18 Chihnan gal manchah kimang sangin na ahatoh jon, ahin chonse khat’in thilpha tampi bolsa asuse theiye.

Thuhilpa 10

1 Thicheng phung thoulhen thao namtui kithe jong a-uisah theiyin, ngolna them khat’in chihna loupitah tah asumang hel theiye. 2 Michingin thildih bol’a, mi-ngol’in thildih lou bol hi chon ngai dol mong ahi. 3 Mi-ngol ngolna chu hephah lou lampi dunga akitopin jong ahedoh theiye; aman angol chu mitin ahetsah jin ahi. 4 Nachunga vaipon nalung han teng, haina lekha peh dan; umthim beh le chun bol khel melse tah geiya ngaidam um thei ding ahi. 5 Vannoiya hin thil dohlou-vaihomten thil dih lou tah abol’u kamudoh tai. 6 Mi-ngolte panmun len lai lai apeuvin, mihao ho nahsah louvin aumsah tauve. 7 Soh ho sakol chunga touvin, milen milal ho kengin acheuvin ahi. 8 Khuh laile chun nang lhalut’in natin, pal tumjal le chun gul’in nachuh ding ahi. 9 Songtum tangle chun songin nasekhah ding ahi. Thing ehle chun thinghal’in nasekhah ding ahi. 10 Naheicha mol’a nol-hem louvan hatuh a natuh ngai ahi. Thil ijakai gontoh masah chu chihna joh ahi. 11 Gul nakihcuh masah sah thei le nagul saithemlo aumpoi. 12 Michingin thu aseiteng min agin lon, mi-ngol vang aseisaa thi ahibouve. 13 Chapang thu jeng thupat nan aneiyin, ngol thubuh-in achaiye. 14 Mi-ngol’in thuchaije helouvin asei sei jengjie. Khonung thilsoh ding koiman ahepon, ithi nung tengu thilsoh ding eihil theiyuva jong koima aumpoi. 15 Mi-ngol inlam jotle jong kihet lou mi chu natoh achimvah jin ahi. 16 Lengpa achapan behseh a, lamkaiten jan khovah vah agolnop abol teng gamsungin hahsa athoh lo jie. 17 Ama chamtah a thu ngahna semdoh thei leng le aphat cha neh le chah kijon thei, kitim them a jukham lou lamkaite neikhaa gamsung chu ahampha ahiuve. 18 Mihem athaset behseh a inchungse lai tholbit nom lou chu, go vantin, in lhuh lo ding ahi. 19 Golvah hin nakipasah-in, judon hin nalipsah chom nai; ahivangin sum beiyin khat’a khat jong nabol theipoi. 20 Guh thim hijongle lengpa seiset dan, najalkhun thip sung hijongle mihao chu seise hih-in. Naseidoh chu vacha khat touvin pontin agaseipeh thei ahi.

Thuhilpa 11

Miching thilbol

1 Gamchom mito kiveikhom nan sum toh le chun, tu tiphat khat le sumkan namu tei ding ahi. 2 Muntin gamtin a sum koisoh keiyin, ajeh chu hiche vannoiya hi itobang hamsetna nato ding nakihet masahpoi. 3 Thingphung chu hoilam pen ngan lhu jongle, alhuhnaa chu kijam den jeng ding ahi. Meilhang ajin teng go ajuijie. 4 Huile go khophat kito phat ngah a natong louva naumle lho lhung ding neipon nate. 5 Numei naobu sunga naosen hinkhothah hung kipat nahet thei lou banga thil ijakai sem Pathen natoh thilbolje nahet thei lou ding ahi. 6 Jingkah nilhah-in muchi tun, natulut chan pha, khangdoh doh ding ham, alah a khatseh bou khangdoh ding ham nahepoi. 7 Sunlai khovah hi nomsahna dinga nomtah ahi. 8 Nahinkhon kum lhunseh le kipah-in. Itih chan hing jongle chun sot louva nathi ding geldoh jingin. Kinemtah a nga jing ding jong aum sampoi.

Gollhang hilchahna

9 Vo khangdong, nakhangdon kipapin! Nakhangdon pat’in kipah jingin. Nabolnom nom bol’in, nadei deiyin chonin. Amavnag ipi hile nabol chan chu Pathenin thu natanpeh ding geldoh jingin. 10 Imacha lung gimpi dan, thoh lel jong nei hih-in. Khangdong sot ding naihpoi.

Thuhilpa 12

1 “Kahin nomtapoi,” natina ding-ni le lha kum ho hunglhun masang, nakhangdon pet hin Nasempa geldoh jingin! 2 Nateh teng-nisa vah le lha vah, ahsite vah geiyin nang din thimtan tin, namaiya meibol jing tobang dingahi. 3 Chuteng nakihonna banjangte ni kithingin tin, tua hatna lai nakengte ni hung thabei ding, naha pulsoh a, lhom behseh ding-an nalhaimo ding, namit thim a namu chen thei lou ding ahi: 4 Na-ngongin natin, kholai dung husa jatapon nate. Sumheiya chang kigot gin le tumging thei kitum jacheo cheovin natin, ahivangin vacha hamin kinkhangin nate. 5 Khousang laiya kaldoh ngam pon natin, chele vale jong tijat umtante. Nasem kangin tin, kisuh hei kitouhei hahsa nasah a, imacha lung gul naneilou ding ahitai. Ngahmun jon a che ihitauvin, kholai dunga ka le lunghem umtante. 6 Dangla khang kobottan ding sana thaomei hung lhaa keh ding twikul’a twi thalna khao tan a twibel lenglhaa kitatjal ding ahi. 7 Itahsapheu leiset’a kile kit’a leivui soh ding, hinna hu hi eipeuva Pathen henga kile kit ding ahi. 8 Pannabei seh-in michingthempan aseiyin, aboncha hi pannabei hel’in aseiye.

Thu kaigop

9 Michingthempa hi achih jal’in mipi chu ahet jouse ahil jing jeng theiye. Thuchihho kihilna aneiyin, adihjeu apatep cheh-e. 10 Michingthempan lungmonna thuh holdoh agon, asutdoh thucheng ho hi thu kitah jeng ahi. 11 Michingte thusei ho hi kelngoi chingten kelngoi hoikhomna aman’u tenggol lhoutah tobang ahin, thuchih kidong khom ho jong thilkil’a kikhendet kheh banga umsot ding ahi.Hicheng hi kelngoi chin a Eichingpau Pathen thilpeh ahi. 12 Kachapa, kichih theina ding khat auim nalaiye. A-ngahbu ajobu um louva lekha kijih jing ahi, hasim behseh hi nacholsah bep hinte. 13 Hijat kalval hin seibe ding thil khat aum’e: Pathen gingin, athupeh chengse nit’in; ajeh chu hiche dinga hi mihem asemdoh ahi. 14 Thil ijakai-apha hihen ase hileh, guh thima kibol ho geiya Pathenin ibol ho’u cuhnga ithuu atan cheh ding ahi.

Hosea 1

1 Judah gama Uzziah le Jotham, Ahaz chule Hezekiah lal lai le Israel gamsunga Jehoash chapa Jeroboam lal laiya Beeri chapa Hosea kama Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.

Hosea jinu le chate

2 Pakaiyin Hosea henga thu asei masah chun akoma hitin aseiye, “Ji gakipui le chun numei chavai soh-in tin, nachateu jong anuu to bangunte. Kamiten jong eidalhah-uva kitah lou, chavai soh ahitauve,” ati. 3 Hiti hi Hosea’n Diblaim chanu, Gomer chu akichenpi. Chapa khat anei nung lhonin 4 Pakaiyin Hosea jah a, “Apu Jehun Jezreel phaiya tol atha jeh a Israel lengpa talen kamatsah vah ding jeh-in nachapa min hi ‘Jezreel’ sah-in. Jehu leng vai neina kasuh bei ding ahi. 5 Chuteng Jezreel phaiya Israel sepai tha neina kasuh bei ding ahi,” ati. 6 Gomerin cha numei khat aneikit’in ahi. Pakaiyin Hosea jah a, “Israelte ngailu louva, achonset nau jong ka-ngaidam tah lou sing jeh-in nachanu hi amin ‘Ngailutlou’ sah-in. 7 Judah mite vang ngailu nange. Kei-Pakai, a-Pathen’un amaho huhhing ing ting, galmun a chemjam le thalpi, chule thalchang ham sakolte ham le sakol touthemte ham manchah a bol kagot ahipoi,” ati. 8 Gomer chanun noi aban nungin Gomerin nao avop kit’in chapa khat ahing’e. 9 Hosea jah a Pakaiyin, “Israelte hi kamite ahitapouvin, keijong a-Pathenu kahitapoi, hiijeh chun nachapa hi amin ‘Kamite-hilou’ sah-in,” ati. Israel Pathenin asemphat ding 10 Israelte hi mihem simsen lou le tejou lou, Twikhanglen panga neldi jat pha diu ahi. Tun Pathenin ajah-uva aseiyin, “Kamite nahitapouve,” atin; hijongle, “Hingjing Pathen chate nahiuve!” atina ding nikho hung lhung ding ahinalaiye. 11 Chuteng Judahte le Israelte kigom kit diu ahi. Achunguva lamkai khatseh kilhen’untin, agamsunguva phatheiya khongtou diu ahi. Ahi, Jezreel nikho chu lamdang tah hinte!

Hosea 2

1 Hijeh chun name Israelte chu, “Pathen mite, Pakai ngailut ho,” tin minvon.

Numei chavai Gomer-Kitahlou Israel

2 Vo kachate, kaji bangin umta hih hen lang, keijong aji hita hih jong leng, nanuu gajol’un. Notia apan a mito ajon jon khu jol lhauvin ngahsah-un. 3 Angah louhel le avon jouse lahpeh ing ting, apen nikho banga akeova kalha ding ahi. GAmkang golah bahsah ing ting, dangchah a kathisah ding ahi. 4 Achate jong khohsah-in hepi ponge, ajeh chu jum helou noti cha ahibouvui. 5 Amapi jong, “Kadongmate koma lut leng, neh le chah eipeuvin tin, samul pon le tupat ponnem eipeh-uva, olive thao le ju eidonsah diu ahi,” ati. 6 Hiche nu hi lingle khao kaikhum ing ting, pal kaget khum ding, alampi kakha bing ding ahi. 7 Adongma ho delle le jongle, maipha pon tin, gahol hol jongle muponte. Chuteng, “Kaji masapa henga kile kit tenge, tulai sangin chulaiyin nom kasajoi,” tinte. 8 Baal hou nan nei jongle, sana la dangka, olive thao, lengpitwi le chang pejing hi Kei kahilam ahedoh hih hel’e. 9 Hijeh a chu lho lhun tengle kathilpeh-chang le lengpitwi kile lah ing ting, samul pon le tupat ponnem kapehsa jong kalahpeh a ponsil beiya kakoi ding ahi. 10 Adongmate angsunga akeovin jam ing ting, koiman kakhut’a eichu lhah jou louhel ding ahi. 11 Kumhei golnop abol chengse, kumlhun kut hihen, lha lhin kut hile, Choldo nikho kut ahiya, houthua kikhopna abol jouse kasuh tang hel ding ahi. 12 Ama deichat sum a adongmaten apeh a asei, alengpigui ho le atheichang phung ho kasuhgam peh ding ahi. Alengpilei ho le apahcha lei jouse gammang lai kasosah ding, gamsaten achil thang diu ahi. 13 kei eisuh mil a Baal houna gimnamtui ahalnam a, sanapah a kijem a adongmae adelle le lai, chuche phat angolna jeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Pakaiyin aseisa ahitai.

Pakaiyin amite angailutna

14 Hiche nu hi gammang noiya pui lut ing ting, onem heova houva kathu nun ding ahi. 15 HIche nu hi alengpilai nungpeh ing ting, gimna phaicham jong kinepna kotpi kasosah ding ahi. hikoma hin anu-ngah laiya bangin kasei ngai nante, Egypt’a kona ahung doh til’a abol bang chun. 16 Chutengle ajinpan eikou kit’in tin, ama dinga Baal eiti kit louhel ding ahitai. 17 Baal min him him kaphah pohsah lou didng ahi. 18 Hiche tengle kamite asuh khah louna diuva gamsate le vachate ti kitepna kasem ding ahi. Gamsunga gal manchah pou pou, chemjam jouse le thalpi jouse kasuhmang ding, kamite lung ol le lung monga kachensah ding ahiuve. 19 Vo Israel, jia kanei ding, Nadia kitah tah le dihtah kahiya, Long louvin lungset ing ting, kahepia Katonsot gouva kasem ding kani. 20 Kakitepna nit’a Keiya kasem ding, Nangin Pakaiya nei nei ding ahi. 21 Hiteng chule kamite Israel taona sang ing ting, Leiset’a gotwi kanensah ding, 22 Leiset’in gaphatah tah, Changle lengpiga, olive apunsah ding ahi. 23 Gamsunga kamite chensah ing ting, Kaphat tousah ding ahi. “Ngailut lou,” kitiho ngailung ting, “Kamite hilou,” kiti ho chu “Kamite,” tia kasei ding, Amahon, “Ka-Pathenu,” tia eidonbut diu ahi.

Hosea 3

Hosea chule numei kitahlou

1 Pakaiyin kajah a aseiyin, “Akideipi to chonse jing numei khat gahel’in. Doichom chom houvu hen, milimdoi ho hounan lengpithei changlhah toh jingo jongle Israelte ka-ngailut jing banga, hiche numei chu na-ngailut tei tei ding ahi,” eiti. 2 Hijeh chun hiche nu man din dangka som le nga kapen, sakol chang kilogram ja le som nga pen kagachoi. 3 Hiche nu hin sotpi ei-nga, notia jong pang lou ding, pasal dangto jong jong lou din kaseipeh-e. Kenjong ama ka-nga jing din kaseiyin ahi. 4 Hitobanga chu Israelte jong phat sotpi leng le lamkai bei, kilhaina gan that lou, doikhom song jong phut lou, phunsanna dinga milimdoi ho le milim sem louva um diu ahi. 5 Israelte hi Pakai a-Pathenu henga ahung kihei phat khat hung lhungin tin, David chilhah leng khat koma hung kikhom diu ahi. Chuteng Pathen ging’un tin, thilpha apeh chengse kisan tauvinte.

Hosea 4

Pakaiyin Israel ahehna

1 Hiche gamsunga chengte douna Pakaiyin hehsetna khat apohdoh ahi. Ngaiyin Israel Pakai thusei hi: “Gamsunga kitahna l engailutna alengpoi, amiten jong Kei hi Pathenin eigel pouve. 2 Kitepna abol chengseu la apal keh jiuvin, jou aseiyun, tol athat’un, aguchauvin, chule akijonbol’ui. Chonval la apung cheh cheh-in, tol la akithat that jengtai. 3 Gamsung hung go-lhan tin, ijakai gopsoh ding ahi; gancha jouse le ganhing ho, ju le va, nga ho geiya thigam ding ahiuve,” ati.

Pakaiyin Thempuho ahehset

4 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Mipi kinah dau hen kihehto dau hen: vo Thempuho, nang ho bou kahehset nahiuve. 5 Sunle jan a nakipal lhuh lhuh jeng diu, Themgao ho jong phachaom deh lou diu ahi. Ken nanu Israel hi kasuhmang ding ahi. 6 Kei eihet loujeh-uva kamite mangthah ahitauve. Nang ho Thempuhon neihe pouvin, kahil nasang pouve, hijeh a chu kapaidoh diu, nachateu jong Thempua kapansah lou ding ahi. 7 “Thempu natambe cheh-u le Kei dounan chonset nabolbe cheh-ui, hijeh a chu min najabolnau chu vetdana kaheidoh peh diu ahi. 8 Kamite chonset bol chu nanghon haodoh nan naneiyun, hijeh chun chonset nabolsah sah nom’ui. 9 Mipi thoh gim banga nanghon jong genthei hesoh nathoh diu ahi! Thilse nabol jal’uva talen kamatsah a kahtohsah ding ahiuve. 10 Nachan diu kilhaina gantha sa nejong leu chun, gilkel thoh a naum jing diu ahi. Cha tam neina din doiphunga notin pang jong leu chun, doichom chom nahoujeh-uva cha nanei deh lou diu ahi.

Doihou Pakaiyin amah

11 “Ju lui jut hah don’in, kamite angol gamtauve! 12 Kungbul phung pou phunin asan’uvin, tenggol chun ahetnom’u aseipeh bangin agel’ui! Eidalhatauve. Notia pang numei bangin, doichom chom kom ajonsoh tauve. 13 Molvum doiphung dunga kilhaina abol’uvin, lhangvum vum, thingphung dang nou dunga kithoina gimnamtui ahal’un, ali nom sah jeh-in theoboh adah-uve. “Hiche kon hin nachanu jouseu notin apangun, namouteu mito ajong tauve. 14 Hijongle athilbol jeh-u hin amaho talen matsah ponge, ajeh chu nangho tah jong doiphunga kijoh noti ho to kijot manga chonse, chule kilhaina thil toh khomji nahiuve. Thuchih-in, ‘Lungthimbei mite chu mangthah diu ahi’ ati bang diu ahi. 15 “Kei dia Israelte nakitah lou vangun, Judahte vang hitobang thil hin athemmo pouve. Gilgal le Bethel mun a jong doihou din hung dauvin, hikoma chun hing jing Pathen minin kitepna jong bol sauvin. 16 Lahlou sakol pol bangin Israelte vang alouchal behseh jengui. Hamhing lah a kelngoi vah banga iti kivah vah ding ham? 17 Israelte hi doihouvin angol tauve. Anop nop’in um jengu hen. 18 Ju adon khamset’un, notin apangun, jabol sangin jachatna adeijo’uve. 19 Hui lhoh mang bang diu, doichom chom houjeh a jahcha diu ahi.

Hosea 5

1 “Vo Thempuho, ngaiyuvin! Ngai phauvin Israelte! Leng insung miten ngaiyuvin! Adih a thutan dia kigelte, nachunguva thu kitan lo ding ahitai! Mizpah a chun kipalnan napangun, Tabor lhanga lenpel’in nakisongun, 2 Acacia khopia thuh tah khuh kilai nabanguivn, hijeh a chu nabonchauva talen kamatsah ding nahiuve. 3 Israel itobang ahi kahenai, kakoma kisel theiponte. Numei kitahlou tobang ahi, amite jong eihou din alolhing pouve,” ati.

Hosea’n milimdoi adeh

4 Mipi thilse bol hin a-Pathen komu ahin jot lutsah thei lou ahitai. Milimdoi ahou nom behseh-un, Pakai ahepha tapouve. 5 Mipi kiletsahna chu amaho douvin apangtai. Achonset nauvin akipalsah-in alhuhsah tai, Judah te geiyin alhuh tha tauve. 6 Pakai koma kilhaina din kelngoite le bong ho akai nauvin, ahivangin phatchom nan aneippouve. Pakai amudoh jou pouve, ajeh chu Aman adalhatauve. 7 Pakaidin akitah pouvin, achateu jong Pakaiya ahipouve. Hijeh a chu amaho jong agamsungu jong kisubei ding ahitai.

Judah le Israel kah a Gal

8 Gilead a gal konna din sumkon mut’un! Ramah khoa gal khongpi vouvin! Bethel khoa galsat din kho-lhang sam’un! Gal kon’uvin, Benjamin chilhah ho! 9 Talen matna ding nikho ahung lhunge, Israel mangthah ding ahitai. Vo Israelte, hiche hi soh tei ding ahi! 10 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Judah lamakien Israel asat’uva, agamsung alahpeh jeh-un kalung ahange. Hijeh a chu achunguva talen twipi kisunglha kabahsah ding ahi. 11 Israel hi min abolsen, achanlom tah gamsung geiyin, panpi phachom louhel ho akineppi jal’in, min alahpeh tai. 12 Israel sumang ing ting, Judahte manthahna kalhut khum ding ahi. 13 “Israel’in aveiset akimudoh a, Judah-in amaput akimudoh teng, Israel’in Assyria gam kumpipa henga panpi gathumin tin, amanla damsah a amaput boldam peh thei deh lou ding ahi. 14 Israelte le Judahte chu sakei midel khum banga kadel khum ding, atel adah-uva kajan a kadalhah ding ahi. Kakai mang teng koiman eichu lha theiponte. 15 “Achonset jeh-uva athoh khopset’uva, eihung ho kahseuva, kamite hi kadonda ding ahi. Athoh gim behseh tengu eimudoh thei maiyu ahi,” ati.

Hosea 6

Lungtheng louva mipi lunghei

1 Mipin aseiun, “Pakai koma kile kit taute! Eibolgimu ahitan, damjong eidamsah teiyunte; eimavosau ahitan, imahau eitompeh tei lou diu ham? 2 Ni ni nithum jou teng eisuhal’un tin, a-angsunga inom hin diu ahi. 3 Pakai het tei din goute. Jing kho avah tei tei bangle, chuh lai gotwiyin leiset achap nou banga, ihenguva hung tei ding ahi,” atiuve. 4 Ahivangin Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Israel le Judah, i-kalo didng ahiuvam? Jingkah daitwi kang loi bangin, nei ngailutnau abeiloiji tai, sun nisa daitwi kanghei hoi bep ahi. 5 Hijeh a chu thutanna le suhgamna thu pohsah a ka-Themgao te kahinsolpeh nahiuve. Nahenguva ka-ngeh hi akichen jenge; 6 kilhaina gantha sangin ngailutna kadeijon, pumgo thilto eipeh sangun kamiten eihet diu kadeijoi. 7 “Ahinla gamsung ahung lut lut’un Adam mun a kakitepna asukeh tauve. 8 Gilead khopi sung mihiloute le tolthat ho adimset’ui. 9 Thempuho jong mi changlhi jing gucha hon abangui. Shechem mun theng lampi jenga jongmi athat’uve. Thilse hijatpi hi henasa saa abol’u ahitai! 10 Israel sunga kidah dah um kahitan, milimdoi houvin kamite akisubohsoh tauve. 11 “Vo Judah mite, nathilbol chengseu jeh a nang ho talen pehna ding phat khat kakoinai.

Hosea 7

1 “Kamite Israel damsah a, haodoh sah kit kanop phat phat le, agitlou nau le thilse abol ho’u kamudohji tai. Khat le khat akilhem to’uvin; bang aphujal’un, aguchauvin; kholai dunga mi achom’ui. 2 Thilse hijat abol’u kagel jing didng hi lungin jong agel phapouve. Achonset nauvin avuh tauvin, kamu khel aumppoi.”

Leng inpia kibaona

3 “Mipin thilse bol’in lengpa le avaipote geiyin alhem lhauve. 4 Mijong jeng le mi kitahlou jeng ahiuve. Mi ahotnau meilhum sung meisa abangin, kan ding changlhah kigon jou kah a changlhah kangpan mut kou hih jongle deoje ju tobang ahi. 5 Lengpa gaolvah nin lengpa le avaipote ju atul kham’un, asu-ngolsoh tauve. 6 Athilse bolnom danu meilhum abangin, along hang khovah vah-un, jingkah teng meikou deojah jeng abangui. 7 “Alunghan val jeh-un avaihomteu athat’un, alengteu aban banin athat’un, ahivangin kahenga taova aum hih hel’ui.

Israel le Numtin vaipi

8 “Israelte hi changlhah alang kan minlou tobang ahiuve. Akimvel’uva namtin vaipi akison piuvin, 9 hitobang gamchom mite chunga kison hin athahat alah mang ahilam helouvin aum’ui. Amanna didu nikho dimtohsa ahitan, amahon la ahedoh pouve. 10 Israelte kiletsahna amaho douna thu aseitai. Thil hijatpi soh tajongle kahenga hung kile kit ding agel pouvin, Pakai a-Pathenu eihol pouve. 11 Israel hi lungthimbei vakhu tobang ahin, amasan amiten apanpi diuvin Egyptte akouvun, chuin Assyria lam asel’ui! 12 Ahivanga achenna chan’uva lenpel kason a vacha banga kamatdoh ding ahiuve. Thilse abol chengseu jal’a talen kamatsah tei ding ahiuve. 13 “Ohe ada ahiuve! Eisalhauvin eidou tauve! Kasuhgam ding ahiuve. Kahuhhing nom vangin, jou jouvin eihouvui. 14 Lungtheng sel’in kahenga atao pouve, chiding namdangte umchan bangin tol dunga akipehle leuve. Chang le lengpitwi athum tengu jongle chiding namdangte umchan atho’uve. Vo doumah bolte! 15 Kavahdoh a kahatsah vangin, kei douna jeng abol’uve. 16 Eida lhauvin, thabei, semthu pathen abel’ui. Kisonpi theilou thalchang kon tobang ahiuve. Alamkaiteu kiletsah thusei jal’a thisea thisoh diu, Egypt miten anuisat diu ahi.

Hosea 8

Milimdoi ahoujeh-uva Pakaiyin Israel mo achan

1 “Gal sumkon mut loiyun, melmaten kagamsung chu, muvanlai lengsuh bangin ahindelsuh tauve! Kamiten amaho to kakitepna asukeh-un, kahilna thuhil adoutauve. 2 A-Pathena eiseiyuva, kamitea akiseiyuva, eihet banga asei vangun, 3 thilpha apaitauve. Hijeh a hi amelmateuvin adel del jeng diu ahi. 4 “Kamiten leng ho akilhen vangun, acham cham a abol’u ahibouve. Kei phatsah louvin lamkai akilhen’ui. Amanthahna diuvin, sana le dangka adongkhom’un milimdoi akisem’ui. 5 Samaria kho sung miten sanaa kisem bongchal lim ahouvu kahoi. Acunguva kalung hange. Itih tah le milimdoi ahouda diu ham? 6 Israel mi khut them khat’in asemdoh ahin, pathen ahinaisai poi. Samaria khopia kihou sana bongchal lim chu kisugep ding ahi. 7 Huise tu ahiuvin, khopihui aki-at diu ahi. Chang min louna louma changlhah ding kilamdoh ponte. Kilamdoh mong jongle gamchom min nedoh bep’unte. 8 Israel jong namdang bep ahitan, pannabei bel kehsa tobang ahitai. 9 Lahlou sa-ngan banga louchal Israelte anop nop’in akihei tauve. Assyria mite panpi ngai chan acheuvin, ahuh diuvin namdang ho tohman apeuve. 10 Ahivanga abonchauva kakhop ding, talen kamatsah ding ahiuve. Assyria kumpipan abolset tengu nasa asah behseh jeng diu ahi. 11 “Chonset suh beina dia Israelten maicham asembe vangun chonsetna ding mun tampi aneibe cheh-ui. 12 Mipi hilna ding simsen lou kajih doh tan, ahivangin datmo le thilchom beh-in agel’un apaitauve. 13 Kahenga gam athat’un asa aneuve. Hijongle Kei-Pakai hi achunguva kalung lhaipoi. Hijeh a chu achonset’u kageldoh a, talen kamatsah ding, Egypt gama kanungsol kit ding ahi! 14 “Israelten leng inpi tampi asemdoh-un, ahivangin Asempau asumil tauve. Judahten kulpi kikaikhum khopi tamtah asadoh-un, ahivanga leng inpiho le khopi chengse chu kahal lhahding ahi,” ati.

Hosea 9

Israelte talen mat ding Hosea’n aphondoh

1 Vo Israelte, doihou ho banga kut nabol chengseu hi ngauvin. Na-Pathenu dalhan navah mangun, Ama din kitahna nanei tapouve. Gamsung pumpia Baal koma noti bangin nakijoh tauvin, aman napeh-uva nagel’u chang nadei lheh-ui. 2 Ahivanga nachangu beivah ding, olive thao beisoh a, lengpitwi jong lhasam ding ahi. 3 Pakai gamsunga Israelte chengsot lou diu, Egypt gama kile tol kit’uva, Assyria gamsungaanboh aga neh diu ahi. 4 Hiche migam sunga chu Pakai koma lengpitwiya kilhai thei lou diu, kilhaina gan jong atha thei lou diu ahi. Aneh chah-uvin anechan asuh boh a, thi-opsa kine tobang hiding ahi. Oivana dia kinebou hi ding, Pakai Houin a kitoh banga kisei thei louding ahi. 5 Pakai choi-atna kut bol phat hung lhun teng ipi abol diu hitam? 6 Manthahna hung lhun a mipi kithecheh teng, Egypt miten achop khom diu, alhoh khom’uva Memphis a vui diu ahi! Agouvu dangka le ain mun jouseu chu lingle khao dimset’a hung keh ding ahi. 7 Talen matsah phat ahung lhung tan, athoh ding mipin athoh phat ahunglhungtai. Hiche hi asoteng Israel’in hanante. Nanghon, “Hiche themgaopa a-ngol’in, Pathen hu-lha khumpa hi atanangtai,” natiuve. Nachonset behseh jeh-un mipin hibang hin neiho’uve. 8 Pathenin amite Israel gihsal dia eihinsol ahi. Ahivangin kachena chan a vacha thang kikampeh bangin kipalsah neigo’uve. Pathen gamsung nah nah aching miten Themgaopa adouvuve ong! 9 Gibeah a aumchan bangun, kinepna beihel thilse jeng bol ahitauve. Pathenin achonsetnau gel jingintin, talen amatsah tei ding ahi.

Israel chonset man

10 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israel kamudoh til chun gammang laiya jam lengpigui tobang ahi. Napu napate kamu til chun, aphatcha theichang ga min mudoh kabangin ahi. Ahinla Peor molsang ahung geiyun Baal doi ahou pan’un, aseichat’u doiho bangin kidah dah aumdoh tauve. 11 Israel loupina vacha banga leng mang loi ding, cha le nao jong aneikit lou diu, numei naovop l aumpon tin, nao peng jong umbe ponte. 12 Cha le nao vahdoh jongleu kathagam a khat beh kahoipeh lou didng ahi. Hiche mite kadalhah teng achunguva datmo umtah thil soh ding ahi,” ati. 13 Vo Pakai, achateu min athagam peh kamui. 14 Hiche mite hi ipi nabolpeh dia ka-ngeh ding ham? Anumeite jouseu chinsah-in, vah ding chasen neisau hen! Israel chunga Pakai thutan 15 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Athilse bol chengseu hi Gilgal a hung kipan ahi. Gilgal a pat kahinvet da pan ahitauve. Thilse abol jeh-uva kagamsunga kona kadeldoh ding ahiuve. Alamkai jouseuvin eidouvun, lungset kit taponge. 16 Israelte hi ajung gosa, gathei lou thingphung tobang ahiuve. Cha le nao nei tapouvinten, nei mongu jongle a-it tah tah-u achateu kathagampeh ding ahi,” ati.

Themgaopan Israel thu asei

17 Alhacha kapan Pathenin amite paiyinte; ajeh chu amahon athu ngaipeh aneipouve. Namtin vaipi lah a vah thai ding ahiuve.

Hosea 10

1 Israelte hi lengpigui ga phatah bang ahiuve. Ahao cheh-ule maicham asembe cheh-ui. Agam gau apun cheh le, doikhom song asemhoi cheh cheh-un chibai aboh-uve. 2 Lungthima lepche jing miten achonset man athoh gim tei diu ahi. Pathenin amaicham jouse susen tin, doikhom dong jouse sumanginte. 3 Hetman louva hiche mite hin, “Pakai igin loujeh-un leng inei tapouve. Neijong leu hen leng chun eiho dia ipi aboljou nah ding ham?” tiuvinte. 4 Thu homkeo aseiyun, jouva kitepna asem’un, chule pannabei kigahna asem’ui. Thudih thudihlou asouvin, lou laiya lounamse pungtel tul jeng abange. 5 Samaria khopia chengte kichauvin tin, Bethel a sana bongchal lim kisem manjeh a lungthoi diu ahi. Amaho le milimdoi limbol’a pang Thempuho kap diu ahi. Sana giltah tah akikhodoh teng kapsoh diu ahi. 6 Hiche sana milimdoi hi Assyria gam kumpi minthangpa kaiya peh dia apoh mang diu ahitai. Thumop ajui ho jal’a Israel min avetda a, jumle ja athoh ding ahi. 7 Twichunga thinghal kilap banga, alengpau min akai mang ding ahi. 8 Aven lhangvum doiphung, Israelten milimdoi ahou nau mun chu min asuhmang ding ahi. Amaicham phunguva ling le khao hng keh ding, mipin molle lhang sang ho jah a, “Neisel’un, neikhu’vin,” tia asap diu ahi.

Israel chung thutanna Pakaiyin aphondoh

9 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Gibeah a achonset’uva pat Israelten Kei douna chonset atang tapouve. Hijeh a chu Gibeah agal’in alap den diu ahi. 10 Hiche mi chonsete hi delkhum ing ting talen kamatsah ding ahi. Amaho dou din namtin vaipi pangkhomin tin, achonset chengseu jal’a talen amat tei diu ahi. 11 “Israel hi phat khat’in bongla gol lahngoisa, chang chil ding gosadema um ahin, angong jolsel’a namkol pohsah a natoh hahsa jo hil kagot anahi. Judah chu lou kaiyin kamangin, Israel thingtum kakaisah-e. 12 Keiman, ‘Louthah thah kaiyun lang, thudih muchi tun tu’uvin, kahenga nakipeh lut jal’uva vangboh chu lhosoh ga bangin kilo’uvin. Na-Pakaiyu Kei henga nahung phat’u ahitai, kahunga vangbohna kabuh lhah khum ding nahiuve,’ kati. 13 Ahinla thilsejo muchi tun natu’vin, aga nalou tauve. Najouseiman naneh-u ahitai. “Ajeh chu nakangtalaiho le nasepai tampi nakison piuvin, 14 ahinla namite gal’in hindel khumin tin, nakulpi chengseu asuhamng ding ahi. Shalman lengpan Betharbel khopi gal a asuhmanga, nu nao chapang jouse asuhgam hel nikho chutoh bang dingahi. 15 Vo Bethel mite, nathilse bol’u melset veng vung jal’a hitobang thil chu nachunguva soh ding ahi. Gal kisat pat pat le Israel lengpa thipai jeng ding ahi,” ati.

Hosea 11

Doumah bol mite Pathenin alungset

1 Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Israel asen laiyin kalungsen, Egypt’a konin kachapa kakoudoh-e. 2 Kahakou cheh le alhai gamla cheh-ui. Kamiten Baal kilhaina abol’un, milimdoi hou nan gimnamtui alhut’ui. 3 Ahinla Israel lamjotje hil’a kahin, Kamite ka-angjangin kapomin; Ahivangin amaho kakhou khahna Amahon ahepha hih hel’ui. 4 Hepi le ngailun kakou lut’in, Kabengto kasip beh jingin; kabungin aneh diu an kapei. 5 “Ahivangin kaheng ahinjon nom pouvin, hijeh a chu Egypt’a kile kit tei tei diu, achunguva Assyria mite vaihom ding ahi. 6 Akhopi chengseu galten lonvuh-in tin, kulpi kelkot chengse atumboh diu ahi. Thilpha pena agel’u thil jeng abol jal’uva gal’in kamite asuhmang ding ahi. 7 Kakoma kona jamdoh dingbou aseiyun, apoh-u namkol jeh a peng peng diu, koimanla asut peh deh lou diu ahi. 8 “Vo Israel, iti kapaidoh jouva, Iti kadonda thei ding ham? Admah bol’a kabol theiya, Zeboiim banga kabol thei nahim? Kalungthimin hiti chu eibolsah ponte, Ka-ngailutna asang behseh bouve. 9 Lunghan vangin talen matsah dang ting, Israel suhmang kit da tange. Pathen kahin, mihem kahipoi, Naumpi jing Athengpa chu kahi. Lung hangin hung kit taponge. 10 “Amelmateu chu sakei kisen banga kakisen khum teng, kamiten eijui kit tauvinte. Lhumlam a konin eihin del del jengunte. 11 Egypt’a konin vacha len hin thouvin tin, Assyria gama kona vakhu len ahintho diu ahi. Keiman a-inlum’uva kahin puilut kit ding ahi. Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai,” ati.

Israel le Judah themmo chan

12 Pakaiyin aseiuin, “Israelten kajet kavei, kasha kalhanga joule nal jeng eiseikhum’un, Judahte la tugeiyin kitah tah le Atheng Pathen-Kei doumah bol’in apang jingui.

Hosea 12

1 Jingkah a pat nilhah geiya Israelten abol’u hi pannabei le manthahna bou ahi. Lepthol le pumhatna alah-uva apung jinge. Assyria mite toh kitepna asem’un, Egypt mite to kiveikhom din akihouvui,” ati. 2 Pakaiyin Judah mite douna sei ding aneiye: Israel jong amite umchan khan chah jal’a talen amatsah ding ahi. Athilbol dungjuiyuva alethuh cheh ding ahinai. 3 Apuluiyu Jacob jong chu apenkhoppi a-upa Esau toh anu oisung, naobua aumlai lhonin akisato lhone; Jacob akhandoh phat’in Pathen to akibon’e. 4 Vanil to akibonin ajouve, akap’in vangboh athum jenge. Bethel muna ipuluiyu Jacob henga pathen ahungin akihoupi. 5 Hiche hi Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung ahi. Pakai kiti min ahin Ama chibai boh ding ahi. 6 Chuti ahile tun Jacob son ho, na-Pathenu tansan’un lang adih-in chon’un, na-Pathenu panpina chu thoh hat tah-in ngah jinguvin.

Thutanna kiseibe

7 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israelte jong Canaan mite bangin alepthol’ui; nahenguva thilcho ho lepthol’in, adih lou thilte nan atepeh-uve. 8 Amaho pin, ‘Ikivei kan’un haodoh ihitauve, lepthol’a ihaodoh- hi koiman eihehse thei pouvinte,’ tin aseiyui. 9 Hichea hi Kei-Pakai na-Pathenu, gamthip laiya nahung vil pau, Egypt a kona hinpuidoh pan, ponbuh a nachen banguva kachensah kit ding nahiuve. 10 “Themgaote jah a thu tampi kaseiyin, mu tampi kaneisah-e, chule Themgaote mangchan kamite kagihsal jinge. 11 Ahivangin Gilead a milimdoi pou ahouvun, hiche houchengse chu thigam diu ahi. Gilagal a Bongchal ho kilhainan aneiyun, chukoma maicham ho jong chu a-onglai jousea songtum alhuh lhuh-in aseuve,” ati. 12 Kapuluiyu Jacob Mesopotamia gama jamlut din aumin, hikoma chun ji kilo nan mi na tongin akelngoite achinpeh-e. 13 Pakaiyin Egypt gama sohchang Israelte puidoh avetup din Themgao khat asolpeh-e. 14 Israelten Pakai asulung hang lheh jengun, achonset jel’un thi din akilom’uve. Pakai asuh jum jal’uva Pakaiyin talen amatsah tei diu lom ahi.

Hosea 13

Israel chunga thutan chaina

1 Masang laiya Ephraim phung miten thu asei teng, Israel phung dang ho akichauve; mihon Ephraim phung chu jatah-in aveuve. Ahinla amahon Baal ahouvun achonsetauve, hijeh a chu athilo tei diu ahi. 2 Chonset abol jom jingun, hou din milimdoi, dangka akhengun, mihem lung suhtoa kigel doh, mihem khut’a kisem ho pou ahouvui. Amahon, “Hiche ho hi kithoinan neiyun,” tin aseiyui. Hitobang milimdoi ho hi min iti achop theiya, bongchal lim a kisemthu chu iti kitahsan theiding ham! 3 Hiche mite hi jingkah daitwi banga leng mang diu, sunlai nisa kahgot bang ding ahiuve. Changphol a changpol hui lhoh mangbangle, meikhu longa meikhu kitungdoh tobang bep hi ding ahiuve. 4 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “kei hi Egypt a kona nahinpuidoh-u Pakai na-Pathenu kahi. Kei tilou Pathen dang nanei pouve. Keibou nahuhhingpu kahi. 5 Nelgam go lah a kakhou khah-un ahi. 6 Ahivangin gampha nalut phat’un naming lhingun na-oiva tauvin, kiletsah hoithon neisumil tauve. 7 Hijeh achu sakei mibokhum banga kabokhum diu, lutnu michan banga nalampiuva kachan lhih ding nahiuve. 8 Anou mansah savom midel le kabah ding, kabotel ding nahiuve. Sakei mibolna banga amun akaval lhum jeng diu ahi, chule gamsa hang mibolna banga natel nadah a kajan diu ahi. 9 “Kasuhmang ding nahiuve, Israelte! Kon nakithopi jou ding ham? 10 Leng khat nathum’un, lamaki ding mi tampi na-ngeh-ui, hiche ho hin najet’u iti ahuhhing jou ding ham? 11 Lung phamosa sa kapeh leng ho chu kalunghan phat’in kasumangtai. 12 “Israel chonset le themmona lekha ajihdoh soh tan, phate chan akikoihe tai. 13 Israel hin kihinsona thei phat pha khat aneiyi, angol behseh jeh-in akisan thiepon, naosen penglha din naobua hungdoh ding ada tobang bep ahitai. 14 Hiche mite hi noimigama lutna dia konin huhdoh pong ting, thina thahat’a konin jong huhdoh ponge. Vo thina namidena hinpo lut tan! Vo noimigam, manthahna hinlhut loiyin! Hiche mite hi voujang natpi kit taponge. 15 Israel hi pumping bangin nalhasil sel jongle, nelgama kon niso lama kon huisave vuhung nungin tin, teinah phungle twikul jouse asemgot ding ahi. Thil manlu jouse alhoh mang ding ahi. 16 Eidou jal’a Samaria khopin talen amat tei ding, amite galmuna thia, naosen ho tol’a chil thang diu, numei gai akhedoh diu ahi,” ati.

Hosea 14

Hosea’n Israel a-ngehna

1 Vo Israelte, Pakai na-Pathen henga hung kile kit tauvin. Chonset jal’a kipal lhu nahiuve. 2 Pakaiya kile kit’un, ahenga hitin taovun: “Kachonset’u ngaidamin, katao nau sangin, kakitepsau bangin navahchoi unge. 3 Assyria miten eihuh joupontin, galsat them dakolten eidal jou pouvinte. Milimdoi kasemho’u chu ka-Pathen danun sei kit hih hel unge. O Pakai Nangin bel ding neiloute nahepiji mong ahi,” toiuvin.

Pakaiyin Israel dia hinkhothah ateppeh

4 Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Kamite kinungpui kit ing ting, Lung giltah a kalungset ding, Achunguva lung hang kit taponge. 5 Israelte dia gamgo lah a Gotwi julhah kabah ding; Pacha banga pah diu ahi. Lebanon lhang thingphung banga jungkho det chet diu ahi. 6 Thing nanou banga hingdiu, Olive thing hoiya hoi ding ahiuve. Lebanon lhang cedar thing banga Muinam jen jun diu ahi. 7 Kahoidamna kulpi sunga cheng kit’uva, Honlei phatah bang diu; Lengpigui ga phatah banga, Lebanon lhang lengpiga pha minthang bang diu ahi. 8 Israelten milimdoi ahoukit louhel diu, Ataonau sanpeh a kahoidam ding, Thingna dum jing banga kanou sah ding, Vangbohna amu jouseu Keiya kon ahi,” ati.

Joel 1

1 Pathuel chapa Joel koma Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.

Andong kisuhgam mipi lunghemlo

2 Ngaiphauvin upate, Judah gama chengten ngaiyuvin! Nangho khang hihen napu napateu khang hile, Hitobang thil hi soh khan am? 3 Nacha nanaoteu seipeh-un lang, Amahon jong acha anaoteu aseipeh diu, amahon jong khang kit kit’a Mite aseipehson son dingu ahi. 4 Khaokhopiten ahon honin andong aneuve, Khaokhopi masaloi neh moh aban banin anetai. 5 Vo jukhamho, thouvun kap’un pangun julop ho. Lengpitwi thah thah semna ding Lengpiga chengse asumangtauve. 6 Khaokhopi hon jamah-in igamsungu alonvuh tan, Ahuse behseh jengun simsen jong ahipouve. Ahau jong sakei ha bangin ahemtheiye. 7 Ilengpiguiyu asumangsoh-un, Itheichangna anechaisoh tauve. Ana anechaisoh-un abah agosh tai. 8 Nuh-ngah-in adongma thilong aka bangin, Mipi nabonchan kap jenguvin. 9 Houin a to ding chang le lengpitwi abeisoh tai, Pakai koma toding beijeh-in Thempute along dongtauve. 10 Loujao la akeovin akijamtan, Chang kisuhgam leiset geiyin adoulel’e. Cahngdong kisuhgam phat’in Lengpigui jouse agop soh tai.
