Olive thing jouse agamtai. 11 Lunghem’uvin loubol jouse, Lengpilei bolte kap’uvin; Suhlou change sakol chang, Cahngdong mimdong asugamhel tauve. 12 Lengpigui le theichang phung agosoh tan, Agathei thing jouse aheovin athitai. Hijeh chun mipi kipana jong abeitan ahi. 13 Khaodip pon sil’in kap’un, Maicham phung lhacha Thempuho! Houin akitol touvn jan khovah-in lung gim’un, Na-Pathen napeh diu chang le lengpitwi abeitai. 14 Japi khom’un lang an ngol ding deiyun, Lamkai chengse le Judahte khomsoh-un, Pakai na-Pathenu Houin sunga Kap’un ahenga thum’uvin! 15 Pakai Nikho ahung naiye, Hatchungnungin manthahna abol ding Nikho chu ahung naitai; Hiche hikhon itobang tijatna aso ding hitam! 16 Ka-andong jouseu kinechai jeng kamoh vet’un, Ka-Pathen Houin a jong kipana abeitai. 17 Leigo lah a muchi athi thu thun, Changsal’a koi ding changla abeitan, Cahngsal keosa ho hi alhenglhona kijam ahitai. 18 Neh ding hamhing umlou jal’in, Gancha jouse, bong le kelngoi hon Akel lel soh gamtauve. 19 Vo Pakai, meikah banga hamhing le Thingphung jouse got jeh a nahenga tao kahi. 20 Luidung joouse akan jeh-in Gamsa ho geiyin nahenga ataovui.

Joel 2

Khaokhote hi Pakai Nikho dinga gihsalna

1 Sumkon mut’un, Pathen lhang theng Zion a kiginna khongpi vouvin. Kithing thing jengun Judahte, Pakai Nikho hung lhungvah ding ahitai. 2 Muthim khojin nikho, Muthim lhangkhal kiheh ni hinte. Molsang meilomin atom bangin, Khaokhote ahon honin ahung kitol’ui. Hitobang thil hi soh kha loulai ahin, Sohjong soh kit lou ding ahi. 3 Hamhing jouse meikah bangin anechaiyun, Alut masanguva Eden hon tobang gamsung chu Adalhah nungle akeohel’in, Imacha cha pou louhel’in, aumtai. 4 Sakolte lheh lheh ahiuvin, Galsat sakolte lhaiyin alhaiyui. 5 Molvuma akichop doh tengule Kangtalai kitagih abangun, Gamkanglai meikah abahsah-un, GAlsat dia kigoltoh sepai hon jamah abangui. 6 Ahung neitel tul’ule mitin akichan, Mitin mai anguisoh heljie. 7 Gal-hangho midel khum abngun, Sepaite bangin pal dunga akal’ui. Malam non akitol tol jengun, Ajotnau khel louhel’in acheuvin, 8 Khat masanga khat asingpoi. Tho kikaiho jong adelpeh jengun, Imacha chan asutang joupoi. 9 Khopi alonvuh jengun, Palvum vuma akaldoh-uvin; Intingvum geiya akaltouvun, Guchate bangin in bangkot Sung dunga alut lut jengui. 10 Ahung kitol tengu leiset akiling leuvin, Vanthamjol geiyin akithing jin ahi. Nisa le lha athim leuvin, Ahsite jong avahji tapoi. 11 Pakaiyin asepaite kolphe bangin thu apen, Athu ngai sepaite tamtah le hattah ahiuve, Pakai Nikho itobanga kichat um hitam! Ahingdoh thei idng koiham?

Lunghei dia kouna

12 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Tu hijeng jongle, Thangsel’in lung heiyun lang, Kap le lung kisih chule an ngol thon Kahenga hung kilt kit’uvin. 13 Nakisih nau chun nalung gim phongdoh-un, Ponsil botel maimaiyin alhingpoi. Pakai na-Pathen heng hinjon kit’un. Mi khoto them, hepina lhingset ahi; Athoh hat’in akitepna anit jinge; Talen matsah louva ngaidam go jing ahi. 14 Pakai na-Pathen’un lung akhel’a, Changle mim phatheiya nalha theiyu ahi. Chuteng nang hon chang le Lengpiteiya Ama nahou theiyu ahi. 15 Zion lhanga sumkon mut’un lang, An ngol ding seiyun, japi khom’uvin! 16 Japi koukhom’uvin, Houbung kikhopna sem’uvin; Upa cheng koukhom’un, Chapangho le naosen ho koukhom’un. Kichengtil hon jong Indan sung dalha hung diu ahi. 17 Houin hongchal le maicham kah a Pakai kinbol Thempu ho kap a tao diu: “Pakai namite khoton, Namdang ho totna le daithangin neikoi dauvin, ‘Na-Pathenu hoilamba hitam?’ tin seidau hen,” atiuve.

Pathenin gam leiset asemphat

18 Pakaiyin agamsung khohsahna aneitan, Amite ahepitan ahi. 19 Ataonau adonbut’in aseiye: “tua vang change lengpitwi olive thao Kapeh ding nahitauvin, Lung nachima nanei diu, Namdang miten totna le Daithanga nanei lou diu ahitai. 20 Sahlama hungkon khaokhote sugam ing ting, phabeppi nelgam sunga kadel lut’a, Amasa chengse Twimanga kalelut ding, Anunung chengse Mediterranea Twikhanglena kalelut ding ahi. Athilongu uijen jun ding, Athilongu uijen jun ding, Athilongu uijen jun ding, Athilbolset chengseu jal’a kasuhmang ding ahi. 21 “Vo loujaoho kicha hih hel’un, Pakaiyin nabolpeh thil ho jeh-un kipah thanomjo’uvin. 22 Gancha ho, kicha hih hel’un, Hamhing adumsoh tan, Gathei thingphung ho agatan; Theichangle lengpithei tampi agatai. 23 “Vo Zion mite, Pakai na-Pathenu Thilbol jal’in kipah thanom’uvin. Chavang go nengsel’in napeuvin, Phalbi gotwi le khallai gotwi nengtah-in napeuve. 24 Changphol jouse chang dimsoh ding, Lengpitwi le thao chilna khuh ho let lha ding ahi. 25 Khaokhoten na-andongu anehgam kum sunguva Namansah chengseu kapeh kit diu ahi. Khaokhote hinsol’a jong Keima kahi. 26 Neh le chah nengtah a naneiyuva, Lung nachimtah a naum diu ahi. Pakai na-Pathenu navahchoi diu, Thil kidangtah nabolpeh Pau nathangvah diu ahi. Kamite kidaithang kit louhel diu ahi. 27 Chuteng nalah-uva ka-um jing hetauvin nate, Israel, Koidang umlou Kei-Pakai na-Pathenu kahi hateuvin nate. Kamite daithanga kikoi kit louhel ding ahi.

Pakai Nikho

28 “Khong teng mitin chunga ka-Lhagao bung lhang ting, Nachateu numei pasal’in kathu asei pong diu; Na-upateuvin mang aneiyuva, Nalhagaoteuvin mu anei diu ahi. 29 Chutengle lhacha numei pasal chunga Ka-lhagao kabuh lhah ding ahi. 30 “Nikho hung lhung ding jeh a hi Vanthamjol le leiset’a hilchahna kapeh ding; Thisan hung longa, mei ka ding, Meilhang meikhu banga jing ding ahi. 31 Nisa hung thim a, Lha jong thisan banga san ding; TIjat kichat umtah Pakai Nikho Hung lhun masanga hicheng hi soh ding ahi. 23 Chuteng Pakai panpi holchan huhinga um ding, Pakaiyin asei banga, Jerusalema um phabep jamdoh a, Kalhendohsa cheng hingdoh ding ahi,’ ati bang,” ati.

Joel 3

Pathenin namtin vaipi thu atan ding

1 Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Hicheteng chule Keiman Judah gam le Jerusalem Hamphatna kasem phat peh ding ahi. 2 Namtin vaipi khom ing ting, Thutanna phaicham kalhutsoh ding; Hikoma chu kamite abolnau jal’a Athuu katanpeh ding ahi. Israelte gamtin a athe thenguvin, Kagamsung, Israel akihomtel tauve. 3 Sohchangho angsanin akihom’un, Noti l eju chohna din nu-ngah gollhang soh-in ajoh-ui. 4 “Vo Tyre, Sidon chule Philistia gam pumpi, ilo neigot’u ham? I-khat khat lethuh neigot’u ham? Neigot’u le mangangtah a kalethuh ding nahiuve! 5 Kasana dangka nachomgam’un, kagou chengse nahouin sunguva napolutsoh tauve. 6 Judah gam le Jerusalem mite chu agamsunguva konin gamla tah a nakai mangun, Greekte koma soh-in najoh mangtauve. 7 Tua hi najohna muntin chenguva kona kahinpuidoh kit ding ahitai. Amaho nabol bang banguva nangho kabol ding nahiuve. 8 Nachateu numei pasal jouse Judah mite koma soh dia kajohsah diu; amahon gamla tah, Sabea mite koma ajohson diu ahi. Kei Pakaiyin kaseisa ahitai. 9 “Hiche thupeh hi namtin lah a gaphong leuvin, ‘Galkon din kigouvin, gal-hang jouse koukhom’un, Nasepaiteu abonchan khom’un, Galsat din kijot’uvin! 10 Langkon tupeh chu chemjamin kikhen’uvin, Thih kangkui chu teng chan khengun, Mi thabei geiyin dal asat ding ahi. 11 Kinoloiyun hunguvin, Jetle vei, sah le lhanga kon namtin vaipi Phaichama hung kikhom loiyun,’ tin seiyun,” ati. Vo Pakai, hiche ho sat din Nasepaite hinsol lhan! 12 “Namtin vaipi kigouva, Thutanna phaichama hung kikhom diu; Hikoma chu jetle vei, sahle lhang Namtin vaipi thutan dia Kei-Pakai katou ding ahi. 13 Agilou behseh jengui, Chang-at’in at’un lang; Lengpitwi let lhah geiya Lengpiga chilna khuh akichil bangin chil’uvin,” ati. 14 Mi asang sangin thutanna phaiya akitit’un, Hikoma hi Pakai Nikho hung lhung loi ding ahi. 15 Nisa le lha athimtan, Ahsite jong avah tapoi.

Pathenin amite vang aboh

16 Zion mol’a konin Pakai akisenin, Jerusalema konin othong leuvin thu aseiye; Lei le van a kithing leuvin, Pakaiyin vang amite ahuh ding ahi. 17 “Chuteng Pakai na-Pathen kahi nahet ding ahi Israel. kalhang tehng Zion cheng kahi. Jerusalem chu khopi theng hintin, Gamchom miten gal’a ajo kit louhel diu ahi. 18 Chuteng molsang jouse lengpilei dimsoh a, Molle lhanga gancha dimsoh ding; Judah gam luidang twi dimsoh ding; Pakai Houina kona luiding khat hung longa, Acacia phaicham achapnou didng ahi. 19 “Egypt gam nelgam soh a, Edom gam ahomkeova kijam ding; Judah gam adelkhum’uva Themmonabei mi athagam jeh-uva chute ding ahi. 20 Amithengteu phu kalah ding, Themmona nei chu kakhen lou ding ahi. 21 Judah le Jerusalem tonsot chenna kineiya, Kei- pakai hi Zion molsanga cheng ding kahi,” ati.

Amos 1

1 Hiche ho hi Tekoa khoa kelngoi ching mi Amos thusei ho ahi. Ling kiho masang kum ni na, Judah gama Uzziah lal lai, Israelgama Jehoash chapa Jeroboam lal laiyin, thil hijat hi Pathenin Israel thudol’in aphongdoh tai. 2 Amos’in aseiyin: “Zion lhanga Pakai akisenin, Jerusalema konin a-ogin akithonge. Hamhing jouse agopsoh tan, Carmel molsang hampa ageosoh tai,” ati.

Pathenin Israel kinaipiho thu atan

3 Pakaiyin asiyin, “Damascus kho mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a hi talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Galead mite sei theilouvin abolseuve. 4 Hijeh a chu Hazael sahdoh leng inpia mei kahal’a, Benhadal lengpa kulpi jouse akahvam ding ahi. 5 Damascu khopi kelkot jouse tumbong ing ting, Aven phaiya chengte le Betheden a vaihompa kadeldoh ding ahi. Syria gama chengte chu Kir gama sohchanga min akai diu ahi,” ati. 6 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Gaza mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Mihem nam khat apumpin Edom langa soh-in ajoh chai hel’uve. 7 Hijeh a hi Gaza kulpi pal jouse kahal’a, akulpi jouse akah lhah ding ahi. 8 Ashdod khopi le a Ashklon khopia vaihom ho kalahdoh ding ahi. Ekron khopi talen kamatsah a, Philistinete amoh chengse thigam ding ahiuve,” ati. 9 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Tyre mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Mihem nam khat apumpin soh-in Edom gama ajoh chai hel’uvin, jol le gol’a kitepna asemsau jong anit pouve. 10 Hijeh a hi Tyre khopi pal jouse kahal’a, akulpi chengse akah lhah ding ahi,” ati. 11 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Edom mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Asopiteu Israelte chu sadel’in adel’un, voujang natpina aneipeh pouve. Alung hang han gjengun, lung damlou hel’in aum’uve. 12 Hijeh a chu Teman khopi kahal’a, Bozrah kulpi chengse akah lhah ding ahi,” ati. 13 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Ammon mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah teiding ahi. Gam keh letna dia gal asat laiyun Gilead nupi gai geiyin ache jengui. 14 Hijeh a chu Rabbah khopi pal jouse kahal’a, akulpi chengse akah lhah ding ahi. Chuteng gal kisat khosam kithonga, kisatgin chu huise le gose kitho bang ding ahi. 15 Alengpau le avaipote chengse sohchang dia kitol diu ahi,” ati.

Amos 2

1 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Moab mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Noise manjen she-in Edom lengpa gabuh jouse ahalvam’un vutdi asohsah-ui. 2 Moab gamsung kahal ding, Kerioth kulpi jouse kalhasoh didng ahi. Sepaiten sumkon mut’a kholhang asap tengu, Moab mite chu gal husa thigam diu ahi. 3 Moab gamsung vaihomte le gamsung lamkai jouse katha ding ahi,” ati. 4 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Judah mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Kahilna la angaipouvin, kathupehho jong anit pouve. Apu apateu hou Pathen dihlou hon apui chatvaiyu ahitai. 5 Judah gam kahal’a, Jerusalem kulpi jouse akahvam ding ahi,” ati.

Israel chunga Pathen thutan

6 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israelte achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Abat salel milungdih ho le kengchot to khat man jeng jong lepeh joulou vaichate soh-in ajoh-uve. 7 Mi lhasam le panpi ngaite chotphan aneiyun, vaicahte lampia aneh doh-ui. Apa le achapan soh-nungah khat akitimatpi gel lhonin, hitobang hin kamintheng asuboh tauve. 8 Pathen lhaina muntin a vaichate thil tun man a alah-u pon sil’in alum’ui. A-Pathenu Houin sunga jong sum batman a alah-u ju adon jiuve. 9 “Ahivangin kamite, nang ho khohsah jal’a, gangpi tah a tah, cedar thing san a sang Amor mite geiya kasuhmang ahi. 10 Egypt’a konin kahin puidoh-un, kum som li sungin gamthip noiya kapuilen, Amor mite gam chu nangho kapeuve. 11 Nagollhangteu phabep Themgaovin kapanssah-in, adang phabep jong Nazirin kapansah-e. Kasei hi dih lou ham Israel te? Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai. 12 Ahinla Nazir ho ju nadonsah-un, Themgaoten kathu aseiphong diu nakhah-ui. 13 Tua vang toljepna kanei diu, changing kangtalai adelnem kabehsah ding nahiuve. 14 Mi kaljangtah jong jamdoh lou ding, thahat’a jong thabeiya, sepaite jong kihinso jou lou diu ahi. 15 Thal thempa jong pang jou lou ding, kaljang jong jamdoh man louva, sakol touthemho jong kihinso jou deh ponte. 16 Hiche nikho chule sepai hangpenin jong manchah paiya jamding ahi,” ati.

Amos 3

1 Vo Israelte, Egypt’a kona ahinpuidoh nam pumpi, nachung changuva Pakaiyin asei thu hi ngaiyuvin. 2 “Leiset namtin vaipi hijat lah a kahet le kakhohsah-nang ho bou nahiuve. Hijeh a chu nachonsetnau jong khoh deh a kigel, hicheng jeh tah a chu talen kamatsah tei ding nahiuve,” ati.

Themgaopa natoh ding

3 Kihoutoh masa louva mi ni kholjin khom nam? 4 Sa manlou gamthip’a sakei kitum nam? Mat khah neilou sakei nou akosunga kithol lem? 5 Thang kampeh louva vacha thanga oh ngaiyam? I-toh khah louva thang jangkam kipel ngaiyam? 6 Khopi sunga gal sumkon kimut teng mipi kicha louva um theiyem? Pakai sol tilouva khosunga manthahna lut ngaiyam? 7 Alhacha Themgaoho koma phongdoh masa louvin Hatchungnung Pakaiyin athilgon ima atongdoh ngaipoi. 8 Sakei kisen teng kicha lou didng koi ham? Hatchungnung Pakaiyin thu asei teng, athusei phongdoh lou ding koi umngaiyum?

Samaria manthahna

9 Egypt le Ashdoh khopi leng inpi dunga chengte koma gaphongun, “Samaria kimvel lhang sang joudsea hung kikhom’un, akhosunga kinahla le kitonona, thilse kibol chengse khu veuvin,” tiuvin. 10 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche miho hin ain jouseu pumhat le dih louva kichom doh thilkeo adip’un, lungthenje jong ahepouve. 11 Hijeh a chu melma khat’in agamsungu umchah-in tin, akulpi chengseu asuhmanga, a-in ho’u jong achomgam ding ahi,” ati. 12 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Kelngoi chingpan sakei nehmoh kelngoi keng ni ham ahiloule abilkol khatseh ham amudoh banga, tua insung choldo mun nomtah tah a aning anop’a chon Samaria khosung mite amoh themcha bou hingdoh diu ahi. 13 Tun ngaiyuvin, Jacob chilhah ten, Thanei Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiyin, 14 ‘Israel achonset jal’uva talen kamatsah ni le Bethel a maicham sumang ing ting, maicham ningli saki chengse kiheh bonga tol’a lhamang diu ahi. 15 Phalbi lai le nipi lai in jouse jong lhu lhama inngem soh diu, in len chengse jong kisumang ding ahi,’ tin aseiye,” ati.

Amos 4

1 Hiche hi ngaiyuvin Samaria khosung numeiho, Bashan phaiya kivah thao bongpi banga kivah thao ho, tahlelte bolsea, vaichate sugenthei, najipateu henga jut hum jing jeng ho! 2 Hatchungnung Pakai hi athen bangin akihahsel’in, “mihon thihkoiya nakoiyuva, amichang cheh thihkoiya nga kiman banga namatna diu nikho hung lhung ding ahi. 3 Pal chim anaipen koma nakailut’uva polama napai mang diu ahi,” ati.

Israel’in kihilna asanda

4 Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Israelte, Bethel a namuntheng phunguva cheuvin, deilheh nahiule gachonsetau! Gilgal’a cheuvin najochanin chonseuvin! Cheuvin, jingkah seh a kilhaina din dancha hintol tol jengun, nithum lhinseh le hopsom toh toh jenguvin1 5 Kipat’un thangvahna din changlhah thilto toh toh jengucin, chule natoval jeh-un kithang-at at jengun! Hitobang thil ho holnom nahiuve. 6 “Nakhopi jouseu kel lhahsah Kei kahin, ahivangin kaheng nahin jon deh pouve. 7 Na-anche louhingun gotwi lhahsah lou Kei kahi, Khopi khat din go kajuhsah-in, achom khat din kavotangin, loujao khat din go kajuhsah-in, achom khat din kavotange. 8 Dangchah a thi din naum’un, khopi tam tah a min kho chom khat’a twi thal ding kinemin acheuvin, donkham cha jong amupouve. Hichan geiyin jong neihin jon deh pouve. 9 “Nalhosoh ga chengseu semheo din huise kalansah-in, nahonlei jouseu le nalengpi lei jouseu, natheichang phungu, chule olive thingna jouse khaokhoten anegamtan, hichan gei hin jong neihinjongpouve. 10 “Egypt s kalansah tobang gamna hise kalansah-in, nagollhangteu galmuna kathat gamin, nasakolteu kalahpehsoh hel’in, na-ngahmun dunguva thilong monsa uithe thu kanahsah-un, ahivangin neihin jondeh pouve. 11 “Sodom le Gomorrah kabolna bangin abang bang kasumangun, ahingdoh cheng jong gamkang ka akiloidoh mei leoheosa molkang nabangun, hichan gei hin jong neihinbel deh pouve,” tin Pakaiyin aseiyin; 12 “Vo Israelte, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah ding ahiuve. Hita kabolgot’u ahitan, kathutanna thoh din kigo jengun,” ati. 13 Pathen hi molle lhang huile go sempa ahin, Alunggel mihemte ahetsah jin; Senlai nisa jong jan asohsah theiye. Leiset sanglai molvum vuma kengto angam’e. Pakai Pathen thaneipen kiti hi Ama min ahi!

Amos 5

Lung heina dia kouna

1 Vo Israel, hiche thivui la kasha khumu hi ngai tem’un: 2 Nu-ngah tobang Israel alhutai, Kiphongdoh kit louhel ding ahi! Donlouvin tol’a akijamtan, Akaithou ding abeitan! 3 Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israel sung khopi khat’a galkon sepai sang khat soldoh thei chun, ja khat bou ahung kile kit’e. Khopi khatman jakhat asoldoh le som khat she ahung kilei,” ati. 4 Pakaiyin Israelte jah a aseiyin, “kaheng hinjon’un kihinsouvin! 5 Pathen hou didn Beersheba a chedauvin, Bethel’a jong neihung hol dauvin, Bethel chu mohseh soh iddng ahi. Gilgal’a che dauvin, amite min gal-hinga akai mang diu ahibouve,” ati. 6 Pakai kom jon leu chun hinlo jo’uvin nate. Nache daule Israelte chunga mei-am kisunkhum hung bang ding ahi. Hiche meiam chun Bethel khosung mite kavamin tin, aphelmit jou umponte. 7 Mipi achan ding lom lepthol’a, thudih dunghei vaihei tho loi ada nahiuve! 8 Pakaiyin ahsi hijat asemin, Bombel le ngambom lungthu jong asem’e. Muthim jinglai avahsah-in, Sunlaipi mu athimsah theiye. Twikhanglen twi achopdoh-in Leiset tolhanga aphi lhai. Amin jong Pakai ahi. 9 Ahat apaote le akulpi jouseu asumangtai. 10 Vo thutanna phunga thudih seite hotbol’a, thudih lou nelkal ho kidintepi jing ho! 11 Mi vaichate bolsen, aching jouseu inhoi tah tah nasah-uva cheng thei louva, lengpilei hoitah tah a naphusau lengpitwi nadon lou diu ahi. 12 Nachonset melsetjeu le naboljat’u thilse kahe jinge. Mipha bolsen, nehguh nalauvin, thutanna phunga vaichate themchan ding napheltan’ui. 13 Hitobang phat pha lou laiya umthim beh chu chihhoijo ahitai. 14 Nahin theina diuvin thilse boldan, thilphajoh bol’uvin. Chutile nasei bangun Pakai Pathen thaneipen chun naumpi tahbeh diu ahi. 15 Thilse hotbol’un, thilpha boljo’uvin, chule thutanna phunga thudih lensah-un. Chutile tegeiya hingna lai hiche nam mite hi Pakaiyin ahepi thei mai ahi. 16 Hiti hin Pakai thaneipen Pathenin aseiyin, “Kholai dung jousea ka le mao o-thong ding. Thi-opte lunghempi dinga loubolte geiya kikoulo ding ahi. 17 Lengpilei lai tina mi kap’intin, nangho talen kamatsah ding jeh a hicheng hi soh tei ding ahi,” ati. Pakaiyin aseitai. 18 Akineppite din Pakai Nikho chutijat umtah ahi! Hiche Nikho chun ipi thilpha nasodoh peh diu ham? Nangho din khovah hilou, muthim khojin nikho ahibouve. 19 Sakei ginna jam’an savom ato tobang ahibouve. Insunga jamlut tobang atuhnaa gul’in achuh tobang ahi. 20 Pakai Nikhoa chu mu thim ding, kho vah lou ding ahi; lung navah bei, lung jin nikho ahi. 21 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Nakut bol jouseu kahon, kathoh nampoi! 22 Pumgo thilto bol’un, changing kilhai jongleur chunsang ponge; kahenga to dia navah thaochet’u ganchate jong sanpeh pouvinge. 23 Thumje jua la nasah-u jong ngauvin, naselangdah gin’u jong kangai nompoi. 24 Chusangin thudih chu vadung twilong bahsah-un, adih chu kantih bei vadung long bahsah tau. 25 “Vo Israelte, kum somli sunga gamthip laiya kapui leu chun kilhaina gantha le thilto ka-ngeh poi. 26 Ahinla tua doilim kisem Sakkuth Pathen leng le ahsi pathen Kaiwam milimho nahou phat’un, 27 Damascus khopi kalpeh a gal-hinga kakai tengu nakipohle diu ahitai,” tin asieyin ahi, Pakai, amin thaneipen Pathen kiti chun.

Amos 6

Israel kisuhmang

1 Ohe nadau ahi-Zion lhanga nomtah a chengte, Samaria khopia lung mongtah a um, hiche nam lentah Israel milen milalte, mipin akithopi dia angaichat jing ho! 2 Calneh khopi gaveuvin. Hamath khopi minthang gaveuvin, kitolsauh-un Philistinete khopi Gath gaveuvin. Hicheng hi Judah le Israel lenggam te ni sanga phajo mong am? Agamu khu nang ho gam sanga lenjom? 3 Manthahna nikho hung lhung lou din naseiyun, nathilbol chengseu hinla anaisah tel tul’e. 4 Ohe nadau ahi-saihaa kisem jalkhun chunga kijaole lea, kelngoi thao lailaiya kivah ho! 5 David boldan danin la nabol’un, semjang saiyin nasaiyuve ong! 6 Khon letlha hel hel ju nadon’un, gimnamtui pen nakinu’vin, Israel manthahna lung gimpi louvin na-um’uve. 7 Hijeh a chu min gal-hinga akai masah pen ding nahiuve. Chuteng nakut’u le golvah kibol kit lou ding ahitai. 8 Thaneipen, Hatchungnung Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Israelte kiletsah hi kahoi, a-in’u loupe tah tah jong imacha ding katipoi. Akhopiu le asunga thil jouse amelmateu kapeh ding ahi,” ati. 9 Insung khat’a mi som hingdoh nah nah jong thi thou thou ding ahi. 10 Mithipa hengle kom, thivuiya pang chun alongu insunga akaidoh thoding ahi. Thivui pan insunga umpen pen jah a, “Khatbeh to naumkhom lou ham?” ati ding ahi. Chuteng ogin khat’in, “Aumtapoi,” tinte. Chutah le thivuipan, “Paopoh hih-in! Pakai min geiya iphah poh lou diu ahi,” tia asei ding ahi. 11 Pakaiyin suhmang dia asei teng ni lentah tah hihen neocha cha hijongle ahalsi sia leng mang jeng thei ahi. 12 Songpi chunga sakolte lhai theiya, min Twikhanglen langkon a akai theiyum? Nanghon akaleh beh-in thudih gutwi nasouvin, thildih dih lou nasouve. 13 Lodebar khopi nalah-u nahoithopiuvin ahi. Kiletsah tah-in, “Karnaim khopi ilah jengu iha lheh-ui,” natiuve. 14 Pakai thaneipen Pathenin, “Vo Israel nagamsungu lo dia gamchom mi sepaite kahinsol ding ahi. Hicheho hin sahlam Hamath lamlen a pat lhanglam Arabah phaicham geiya nabol hesoh diu ahi,” ati.

Amos 7

Themgaopan khaokhote amu

1 Hatchungnung Pakaiya konin mu kaneiye. Kathilmu naa hi-lengpan hamhing a-at nung, hamdong thah hung kepat dontah-in Pakaiyin khaokhote simsen lou asemdoh tai. 2 Hiche mu kaneinaa hin-khaokhoten gamsunga ipi hile adong lai lai-hamhing jouse anechaiyun, hijeh chun kenjong, “Hatchungnung Pakai, mipi hi ngaidam jengin! Athigam lo diu ahitai! Alhom’un lhasam tah ahibouvui,” tin kaseiye. 3 Pakaiyin lung aheiyin, “Namu bang hin kabolda tante,” ati.

Themgaopan Mei amu

4 Hatchungnung Pakaiya kon thil khat kamu kit’e. Hichea hin Pakaiyin amite maiya halgam agoi. Meipi hin vannoi Twikhanglen lentah geiyin akavam jengin, gam leiset jong akapantai. 5 Chuphat’in kenjong, “Vo Pakai Pathen, namiten iti addoujou ding ham, nga jengin-alhom behseh-un lhasam tah ahiuve!” tin kataove. 6 Pakaiyin lung aheiyin, “Hiche jong bolda ding hitante,” ati.

Themgaopan songkhai intena amu

7 Pakaiya kon mu khat kanei kit’e. Hichea hin Pakai chu songkhai intenaa kitetoh a kigen bang koma adingin, songkhai intena chu achoiye. 8 Pakaiyin kajah a, “Ipi namun, Amos?” tin eidonge. Kenjong, “Songkhai intena khat,” kati. Hichun Aman, “Bang onsa tobang kamite tetohna dia hiche songkhai intena hi Kaman ahi. Amaho talen matsah kagot hi lung hei lou ding kahi. 9 Isaac chilhahte doiphung jouse suhmang ding ahi. Israel muntheng geiya ahomsa kijam ding ahi. Jeroboam lengpa leng vai neina kasuhbei ding ahi,” ati.

Amos le Amaziah

10 Bethel a Thempu Amaziah hin Israel lengpa Jeroboam henga thu athot’in, “Mipi jalah a Amos hin nang demna jeng aseiyin, athusei hi gamsungin adou jou tapoi. 11 Amos sei chu, ‘Jeroboam galmuna thi ding, Israelte hi agamsunga thi ding, Israelte hi agamsunguva kona min gal-hinga akai mang diu ahi,’ tia asei ahi,” ati. 12 Amaziah hin Amos aphoh-in, “Vo mitva neipa navaltai! Judah gam a kile kit’in chukoma thu gaseitan. Chule mihon tohman penauvinte. 13 Bethel a vang thu hung seikit hih-in. Nampi Houin, lengpa pathen houna mun ahi,” ati. 14 Amos chun, “Kei hi tohman neiya gaothusei Themgao kahipoi. Kelngoi chingmi, theipi na kivei kahi. 15 Ahinla Pakaiyin kelngoi ching kahinaa eikoudoh a amite Israelte koma gaothusei dia eisol ahi. 16 Hijeh chun Pakai thusei ngaiyin. Israelte kaphoa, gaothu kasei ding najah dai. 17 Ngaiyin Amaziah Pakaiyin hiche hi naseipeh ahi, ‘Najinu kholai dunga notia panga, nachate galmun a thisoh diu; nagamsung kihomtel tel’a midang kipedoh ding, nangtah jeng jong chiding namdangte gamsunga nagathi ding ahi. Thon louhel’a Israelte hi agamsunguva kona min gal-hinga akaimang tei diu ahitai,’ tia asei ahi,” ati.

Amos 8

Theiga paipeh dimset

1 Hatchugnung pakaiya konin mu khat kanei kit’e. Hichea hin theiga dimset paipeh khat kamui. 2 Hichun Pakaiyin, “Ipi namun, Amos?” tin seidonge. Ken jong, “Theiga dimset paipeh khat,” kati. Hichun Pakaiyin, “Kamite Israel beina ding ahung lhungtai. Talen matsah kagot hi hai taponge. 3 Hiche nikho chuleh leng inpia la kisa jouse lunghem kana kaheidoh ding ahi. Muntin a thilong jeng thilong jeng akijam ding, min thip beh cha apai pai jeng diu ahi,” ati.

Israel manthahna

4 Gamsunga vaichate sumanga, neilelte kengchotpha neihom hiche hi ngaiyuvin. 5 Nangho pin, “Choldo nikho ho beivah vah hen chang kijoh leu hen. Choldo Nikho beivah hen thil kijoh loi leh. Thil manval val lah a, thiltena lhem a te ding, thil cho le thiljoh ho lepthol’a thiltena dih lou kimang ding ahi. 6 Suhlou chang manmo jong manlu tah a kijoh a, a bat salel, kengchot to khat man jeng jong pejou lou vaichate chu soh dia ikichoh diu ahi,” natiuve. 7 Pakai Israel Pathen kahisel’in aseiyin, “Thilse abol chengseu sumil ponge. 8 Ling kihot’a gamsung mi abonchauva lung hesoh diu ahi. Gam pumpi kihot ding . Nile va dung banga kinuh lap lap ding ahi. 9 Sun laiya nisa kalhumsah a, khovah laiya leiset kathimsah ding phat hung lhung ding ahi. Kei-Hatchungnung Pakaiyin kasei ahitai. 10 Golnop kut nabol jouseu thivuina kaheidoh a, kipa la nasah chengseu lunghem kana kaehidoh ding ahi. Sam vouchaiya khaodip pon kasilsah diu, chapa khatseh thi kapi minu le mipa kabahsah diu ahi. Hiche nikho chu a chai ni geiya thoh lel hi ding ahi. 11 “Gamsunga kel kalhahsahna ding phat ahung lhunge. Mipi kel thoh ding chu neh le chah ngaichat hipontin, twi ducha dangchah jong hipouvinte. Pakai thusei ngaicha gilkel le dangchah hiuvinte. Kei-Hatchungnung Pakaiyin kasei ahitai. 12 Mipi hin sah le lhang simle mal adel le jeng diu ahi. Muntin a Pakai thusei del leuvin tin, mu la mudoh deh pouvinte. 13 Hiche nikho tengle numei pasal khangdong thahat lai lai jong dangchah a lhu lham soh diu ahi. 14 Samaria khopia milimdoi pan a kihahsel ji, ‘Dan a pathen jeh, Beersheba pathen jeh,’ tia sei chengse chu dinlhuhsoh hel diu, thou kit lou diu ahi,” ati.

Amos 9

Pakai thutanna

1 Maicham phunga Pakai din jing kamun, thu apen, “Houin khompi chengse luvum chu havoh voh-in von lang, in pumpi kilingsoh hen. Vojal’in mipi luvum a kitajalsah tan. Athimoh chengse galmun a kathagam ding ahi. Ahin gdodh ajamdoh beihel ding ahi. 2 Noimigam geiyin jamsuh jongleur, kamatdoh tei tei ding, vanchung geiya kaldoh jongleur, kaloi lhahsoh ding ahi. 3 Carmel molvum a kisel jongleur, kaholdoh a kamasoh didng ahi. Twikhanglen noiya kisel jongleur gul-lhempi sol ing ting kachuhsah ding ahiuve. 4 Amelmateuvin gal-hinga akai tengle, athagam diuva kaseipeh ding ahi. Kithopi daa suhgam kagot mong mong ahitai, “a ti. 5 Hatchungnung, thaneipen Pakaiyin Leiset atham leh ling akihot’in, Leichung chengte alunghemsoh tauve. Leiset pumpi Nile vadung bangin akinuh lap lap’e. 6 Pakaiyin van a in asan, Leiset chunga vanthamjol adal’e. Twikhanglen twipi achopdoh-in, Leiset chapnou nana mange. Ama hi amin Pakai ahi! 7 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Israelte, nangho hi midang to ichomin kagelpon, Sudan mite bangin kagel’e. Nangho Egypt a kahin puidoh bang hin Crete a konin Philistinete kahinpuidoh-in, Kir a konin Syria mite kahin puidoh-e. 8 Kei-Hatchungnung Pakaiyin hiche chonset dimset Israel lenggam hi kave vei, leiset chunga kasuhgam hel ding ahi. Jacob chilhahte vang abonin sugam ponge. 9 “Israelte hi tengsa changchi kiloh chil banga kalosah ding, namtin vaipi lah a kalothangsoh a, pannanbei chengse kapaidoh ding ahi. 10 Kamite lah a chonset chengse galmun a thiden diu- ‘Pathenin thilse eiphahsah pouvinte,’ ti jouse thisoh diu ahi,” ati.

Khonunga Israel kisemphat ding

11 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Ingemsa tobang David lenggam kasemphatna ding Nikho khat ahung lhunge. Apal jouse semphang ting, katundoh kit ding ahi. Kasah phat’a masang laiya tobang kahisah ding ahi. 12 Chutengle Edom gamsung jolou chengse Israelten ajo diu, Keiya hisa namtin vaipi ajotho diu ahi,” ati. Hiche sosah ding Pakai chun aseitai. 13 “Nikhoho chu ahunglhunge,” tin aseiye Pakaiyin; Loukaipan chang-atpa aphah thu ding, Lengpitwi childo pa Lengpiga loupan aphah thu ding ahi. Mol le lhang jouse lengpitwi dimsoh a, Alhang lhganga hoh a long ding ahi. 14 Kamite agamsunguva kahin puilut kit’a, Khopi gemsa jouse sephaa cheng kit diu ahi: Lengpilei bol’a kivah diu; Honlei bol’a kivah ding ahiuve. 15 Kapehsa gamsunga kamite kachensah ding, Kikalkang kit lou diu ahitai,” ati. Pakai na-Pathen’uvin aseitai.

Obadiah 1

1 Obadiah gaothusei chu hiche hi ahi: Edom mite chung thudol’a Hatchungnung Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.

Pakaiyin Edom talen amatsah ding

Pakaiyin asolle chu namtin henga asol’in, keihon athusei kajatauve: “Kigouvin, Edom sat din kontaute,” atiuve. 2 Pakaiyin Edom jah a seiyin, “Lhasamin nalhang ting, Namtinin nanoise ding ahi. 3 Nahoi tho nan nalhem lhan, Nakhopi kulpi songthum jeng ahin, Molvum a in kisah nahi; Hijeh hcun naseiyin, ‘Eisu lhu jou ding koi ham?’ nati. 4 Na-in chu muvanlai bu banga sangtah a nasah a, Ahsite to akivet chep jeng vangin, Kaloilhah a kakai lhah ding nahi. 5 “Janteng gucha ahungle alahnom bou alai. Mihon lengpiga alo teng them khat asalhateiye. Nang vang namelmaten nasuhgam hel ding ahi. 6 Esau chilhahte, nagou jouseu min achomsoh tai. 7 Napanpi ten nalepthol’un, nagamsunga konin nadelmangtauve. Chamdel’a nalenpiten gal’in nabol’un najoutauve. Ankong khat naso khompiten kipalna thang nakampeh-ui. Amahon nathudol aseiyun, ‘Achihna hoiya um hitam?’ atiuve. 8 “Edom talen kamatsah ni leh amichingteu kasuhgam a, achihnau aboncha kasuhbei ding ahi. 9 Teman gal-hangte tija lih diu, Edom gamsung sepaite aboncha min athagam ding ahi.

Edom talen matna jeh

10 “Nasopite, Jacob chilhah ho nachomgama natha jal’a, nakisugam hel ding, a-itih a jum thoh a na um ding ahi. 11 Melmaten akelkot jouse aphutjal nikho, nangin jong napeldoh ni leh, Jerusalem gou jouse pomanga kihomsoh gamchom miho chutoh nabah ding ahi. 12 Judah gama nasopite hamset chu nakipapi lou ding dol ahi. Ahamset nikhouva chu nakipa lou ding, agim nau chu nuisat hoh a nanei lou ding ahi. 13 Kamite khopi sunga chu agenthei hesoh nau nuisat a, ahamset nikhouva agou jouseu chomgam dia nalut lou diu dol ahi. 14 Ajamdoh go ho mantan dia lamsom ajong nadin lou ding ahi. Ahamset nikhouva amaho hi amelmatau khut’a napehdoh lou ding ahi. Pathenin namtin vaipi thu atan ding 15 “Kei-Pakaiyin namtin vaipi thu Katanna ding nikho anaiye. Vo Edom, mi nabol banga nakibol ding ahi. Napehsa chu nachan kit ding ahi. 16 Kamiten talen ju kha tah adontauve, ka lhang theng chunga chun, ahinla akimvel’a cheng namtin vaipin akhacheh talen ju adon diu ahi. Ju donchimset’untin leng mang jel diu ahi.

Israel galjo

17 “Zion molsanga phabep hung jamlut’un tin, alhang jeng jong muntheng soh ding ahi. Jacob chaten agoulo gamu chu alo kit diu ahitai. 18 Jacob chate le Joseph chate chu meikou bang jeng diu, meiyin changpol akah banga Esau chate asuhgam diu ahi. Esau chilhah khatcha hingdoh ponte, Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai. 19 “Judah gam lhanglama chengten Edom gamsung alo diu ahi. Lhumlam thinglhang bul’a chengten Philistia gam alah diu ahi. Israelten Ephraim le Samaria alah diu, Benjamin chaten Gilead alah diu ahi. 20 Israel gam sahlam a sohchang sepaite hung kile kit’untin Phoenicia alah diu, Zarephath geiya alah diu ahi. Sardis a sohchang Jerusalema umten Judah gamsung lhanglam khopi chengse alah diu ahi. 21 Jerusalema galjouten Edom delkhumintin achunga vaihom diu, Pakai amatah leng chang ding ahi,” ati.

Jonah 1

Jonah Pakai thua anunda

1 Ni khat hi Amittai chapa Jonah koma Pakaiyin thu aseitai. 2 Aman, “Khopi lentah, Nineveh a chen lang, khopi dounan thu gaseitan; khosung mite gitlou engsetna jouse kahetai,” ati. 3 Ahivangin pakai thupeh peldohna din Jonah lamchom beh a akiheitai. Joppa achen, Spain gam jon ding kon gkhat amudoh-in, Pakaiya kona gamlat ding ngaoti nan, kong touman pen, Spain gam jon din gkong tol ho to akilhontai. 4 Ahin Pakaiyin Twikhanglen chu huise hattah anunsah-in, huise chu ahat behseh jengin, kong inneichu apeichip pai ding ahitai. 5 Kongtol ho atija lih gamtauvin, amichan cheh-in ama ama pathen kom cheh a ataovun, panpi athumtauve. Chujongle kong innei chu ajandomna din kong sunga thilkeo chu apaidoh doh tauve. Hichepat tah hin Jonah chu kong tolam indan sunga alut’in khomang meiyin a-ihmui. 6 Jonah chu kongtol lamkaipun amudoh-in ajah a, “I-atileh hitobanga ihmu a nahim? Thouloiyin na-Pathen henga panpi thumin tao loi tang-em. Chutile eilungset’uva eihinso theiyu hichu men,” ati. 7 Kongtol ho akihouvun, “hitobang hamset itolo nau hi koipen ahiding vang san’uhitin holdoh temu hite,” akitiuve. Hitia abol’u le Jonah min ahung potdoh tai. 8 Hijeh chun amahon jong ajah a, “Ngoh thei mong nahim neihil’un. Hikoma ipi bol’a jong hung nahim? Hoiche gama hungkon, ipi jat mi nahim?” tin adongtauve. 9 Jonah-in adonbut’in, “Kei Hebrew mi kahin Twikhanglen le leiset Sempa Pakai Van Pathen hou mi kahi,” ati. 10 Pakaiya kona jam ahijong chu Jonah hin aseipeh tai. Kongtol ho chu atija lih jel jengun ajah a, “Tijat umtah thil nabol hita chu men!” atiuve. 11 Huise Chula akhoh cheh cheh jengin, hijeh chun kongtol hon, “Huise thipna dia nang hi i-kalo diu ham?” tin adongui. 12 Jonah-in adonbut’in, “Twikhanglen a neisep lut leu chun huise hi thip tante. Kei jal’a hiche huise nato khah-u kahenai,” ati. 13 Hijongle kongtol hon kong inneichu twi pamchin a toldoh tei din thahangsanin apangui. Ahinla huise chu akhoh cheh cheh tan, suhna ding ahetapouve. 14 Hijeh chun Pakai henga akap jengun, “Vo Pakai, hichepa tha nagot jeh-in keiho jong neitha tha dauvin! Hitobangpi hi Nang bol ahin, Nang mopohna bou ahi,” tin ataovui. 15 Hiti hin Jonah chu Twikhanglen a aselut’u le, apet pet’in huise chu athip del tai. 16 Hiche hin Kongtol ho akichatsah tan, pakaiya akilhaiyun, Ama kinbol din akitep lo tauve. 17 Pakai thupeh jal’in ngapi lentah khat’in Jonah aval lhumtai, chule ngapi oisunga hin Jonah nithum le janthum aum’e.

Jonah 2

Jonah taona

1 Twito lam ngapi oisunga konin Jonah chu Pakai a-Pathen koma ataovin: 2 “Vo Pakai, kagimpet’in kakouvin, Nangin jongneihouve. Noimigama konin kahin kouvin, Panpi ngaiya katao najai. 3 Twikhanglen tothuh laiya neileh lut’in, Twipin eichupsoh tan, Natwipi kinonglaiyin Eilonvuh soh tauve. 4 Na-angsunga kona paidoh a um, Na-Houin theng mukit dia kinem lou kahitai. 5 Twipin wichuptan, akichisoh tai, Twikhanglenin eichupsoh hel ahitai, Twipi kidil’in eilonvuh tai. 6 Molsang bulpi kaheitan, Kot kihontih umlou Gamsung kageitai. Hijongle vo Pakai ka_pathen, Lithuh laiya konin kahingin neipuidoh-in ! 7 Kahinkho beihel kahetan, Hijeh chun nahenga kataovin, Na-Houin theng sunga Kataona ogin najai. 8 Pananbei milimdoi houten, Nang dia akitahnau apaitauve. 9 Kenvang navhachoi la sang ting, Nakoma kilhaiying ting kakitepna molsonge. Huhingna chu Pakaiya kon bou ahi!” tin ataove. 10 Hijeh chun Pakaiyin ngapi chu Jonah lodoh din asol’in, ngapin jong aseipeh bangin twi pamchin a alodoh tai.

Jonah 3

Jonah-in Pakai thu angai

1 Pakiyin Jonah koma thu asei kit’in, 2 “Kaseipeh thu hi Nineveh khopi minthang tah dudnga gaseitan,” ati. 3 Hijeh chun Jonah hin Pakai sei angaiyin, Nineveh khopi lentah, nithum sunga jong jotdoh lel a chun achei. 4 Jonah hin khopi chu ajot panin, nikhat lhumkei ajot nungin lhang asamin, “Nisom li sunga hiche Nineveh khopi hi kisumang ding ahitai,” ati. 5 Nineveh khopi miten Pathen thusei cu atahsan tauve. Hijeh chun alungheiyu vetsahnaa mitinin an ngol’a, alen aneo aboncha khaodip pon sil cheh din pha asatauve. 6 Nineveh khopi lengpan ajahsoh phat’in alaltouna akipatdoh-in, aponchol hoh lhan, khaodip pon sil’in, leivui lah a atoutai. 7 Nineveh khopi mite koma phonjal ding thu khat alhan, “Hiche lengpa le avaipote thupeh ahi Koimacha cha, mihem hihen bong ho hile, kelngoiho geiya an nei twidon um thei louhel ding ahi. 8 Mihem jouse le gancha jousen jong khaodip pon asilsoh hel ding ahi. Mitinin thilse bol angah a, chonthanghoi angah diu, lung giltah a Pathen henga tao cheh diu ahi. 9 Chutile Pathenin lung aheiya, eihinso theiyu jong ahi!” ati. 10 Lungheiya athilbol’u hi Pathenin amutai; achon gitlou nau angah jengu chu amudohtan ahi. Hijeh chun Pathenin lung aheiyin, aseisa bangin talen amatsah tapoi.

Jonah 4

Jonah lunghan Pathen mihepi

1 Jonah hin nommo san along hangtai. 2 Hijeh hin ataovin, “Vo pakai, hitia hi nabol dia kaseisa hilou ham? Hijeh a chu Spain langa jamsoh tei kanagot ahi! Milungset them le mihepi them, thoh hat jing, khoto jing lunghei ding go jing talen matsah lougo nahi kahei. 3 Vopakai tunvang kahin sangin neithat le chun phajonte,” ati. 4 pakaiyin adonbut’in, “nalunghanpi thei ipi ham?” ati. 5 Jonah chu apotdoh-in khopi niso lama agatouve. Hikoma hin lim kisonin alim noiya atouvin, Nineveh khopia e-aso ding ve-lhi jingin aum’e. 6 Hichun Pakaiyin Jonah limbel din umphung khat akesah-in ahi. Jonah-in umphung akipapi lheh jenge. 7 Ahinla ajing khovah lhah-in umphung chu Pathen thusah-in lungin anen athitai. 8 Nisa son Pathenin niso lam huisa alansah-in, nisan aluchang asah peh behseh phat’in Jonah chu alhu lham pai ding a hitai. Jonah chuathi nom leo jengin, “Thi leng kadeijoi,” tin aseitai. 9 Ahivangin Pathenin ajah a, “Hiche umphung jeh a lunghanna thei ipi naneiyem?” ati. Jonah chun adonbut’in, “Lunghang dia kilom mong, thi geiya lung hang thei kahi!” tin aseiye. 10 Pakaiyin ajah a aseiyin, “Hiche umphung hi jankah a hung kehdoh, ajinga thi kit ahin, nang kesah jon ghilou nathisah hilou-ahivangin nalung natpi lheh-e! 11 Achutile Nineveh khopi lentah khu Ken ichan geiya ka-itjoh ding hitam! Ahimongin jong akhosunga khun monabei chapang mai mai jong milhing sang ja khat le sang som ni lahingin, gancha simsen lou to aumthai!” ati.

Micah 1

1 Judah gama Jotham le Ahaz chule Hezekiah lengvai poh laiyin Moresheth khoa cheng Micah henga Pakaiyin asei chu hiche hi ahi. Pakaiyin Micah henga Samaria le Jerusalem khopi te ni chung chang thudol abonchan aphongdoh-e.

Samaria le Jerusalem kachamna

2 Namtin vaipin ngaiyuvin; Leiset chung chengten jasoh keiyun! Hatchungnung Pakaiyin nangho douna aseiye. Ngaiyun, avan Houin a thu aseitai! 3 Pakai amunthenga konin ahungin, Hung kumlhan, molvum jouse achot ding ahi. 4 Achot ten gmolsang jouse jolsoh din g, Molsang jouse molvuma twilhaisuh banga phaichama longlha diu ahi. 5 Pathen douna Israelte chonsea doumah abol jal’uva thil hicheng hi hungsoh ding ahi. Israel doumah bol hi koipen mochang ding ham? Akhopiu Samaria ngoh ding ahi! Judah gamsunga milimdoi kihou hi koi themmio ding ham? Jerusalem khopi themmi ding ham? Jerusalem khopi ngoh ding ahi! 6 Hiti hin Pakaiyin aseiye, “Samaria khopi hi khogem kaso ding, lengpileiya bol thei kahisah ding ahi. Khopi sung thilse jouse phaicham khat’a kasun lhah ding, khopi bulpi khom jouse alheng lhol’a kajam ding ahi. 7 Milomdoi manlu tah tah ho kasuhgoiya, Houin a noti ho kipe chengse chu kahalvam ding, amilimdoi chengse alhuh lhuh a kise ding ahiuve. Semaria khopin hicheng hi leiphatna dia kithoina amanu ahin, tua vang melmaten munchom a doi hou dia akaimang diu ahitai,” ati. 8 Micah hin aseiyin, “Hichejeh hin kap’in maovinge. Kalung gim vetsahna sagohkeo le kengto keova kavale ding ahi. Kamkei penin peng ing ting, va-ngongsao hamin ham ing’e. 9 Samaria maha kiboldam thei lou ding, Judah jong hitobanga chu genthei thoh ding koncha ahitai; kamite chenna Jerusalem kelkot phunga manthahna ahung lhungtai,” ati.

Melman Jerusalem anailut

10 Gal ilel’u hi Gath a kamelmateu gaseipeh dauvin: nakau jong musah hih-un. Beth Leaphrah mite, nalung gim chu vetsahnan leivui lah a kilih leuvin! 11 Vo Shaphir mite, sagoh keo, jum le ja thoh-in ohchangin kitol’uvin. Zaanan khoa chengte akhopiuva konin apotdoh ngam tapouve. Bethezel kho mite lunghem najah tengu, kiselna aum loudol hetauvinnate. 12 Pakaiyin manthahna Jerusalem kom ahinlhut phat’in Maroth miten onthol ding angah lel lheh tauve. 13 Lachish a chengten sakolte kangtalai to tolloiyun. Israelte nachonset nakom’un, Jerusalem geiyin nachonset sah tauve. 14 Hijeh chun tun Judah tan Moresheth Gath lhadoh tauvin. Isdrael lengthen Achzib khopia konin panpina imacha mutapouvinte. 15 Vo Mareshah mite, nakhopiu toupha din gmelma khut’a Pakaiyin naoehdoh diu ahitai. Israel lamkai loupe the the ho jong Adullam songkoa gakisel diu ahi. 16 Vo Judahte, na-it lai lai yu chapang ho lung gimpin sam kivochai jengun. Muthong bangin lutol’in um’uvin, nachateu akikaimangin sohchangin atol tauve.

Micah 2

Vaicha bol gentheite tohman

1 Jalkhuna mitsing louva thilse jeng gel jingte ada nahiuve! Jingkah khovah vah-in, agonsau thilse chu amasapenin abol pan jengui. 2 Loumun adei le alauvin, mi thil imacha cha abit’a aum theipoi. 3 Hijeh chun Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hahsatna lhun khumsah kagot nahiuvinm jamdoh theipouvin nate. Gim hesohna nato diu, hoi tho tah a lam najot lou diu ahitai. 4 Hiti hi ahung lhun teng, nathoh nai mihon gim hahsa khohje kihilna hiche anoiya la hi asah diu: Amangthah hel kahitauve, Kagamu Pakaiyin alamangtan, Soh a eihenteu apedoh tai,” tiuvinte ati. 5 Hichea hi Pakai mite agamsung hi akilepeh ki tphat jongle nangho chan ding umponte. 6 Mihon eihil’un kajah a, “kakom’uva thu seiphong hih-in. Nasei phong ho chengse seiphong phong dan. Pathenin eihot louhel diu ahi. 7 Israelte hi gaosap chang a nagel ham? Pakaiyin lung alhaso hitam? Hitobangpi hi abolmong ding ham? Thildih bolte dia thilpha khoto to um asei lou ham?” atiuve. 8 Pakaiyin adonbut’in, “kamite nadel khum’un, inluma choldo nom a galmuna hung kile kit ho geiyin ponsil nihchen lahpeh kit din nachang lhiuve. 9 kamite numeiho inluma konin nadeljam’un, achateu chu kavangboh changkit louhel din nahcom gamtauve. 10 Kipatdoh-in chen, hikoma lungmon abeitai. Nachonsetnauvin hiche mun jeng jong hi manthahna achuhsah ding ahitai. 11 “Hiche miten adeiyu Themgao chu jouthu le lepthol thu jeng seile lea, ‘Lengpitwi le ju nadon jing theina diuvin gaopeh nange,’ ti ho chubou ahi. 12 “Kenvang kaikhom ung ting, Israel amoh chengse kachop khom ding ahi. Akulsung jon dia kihoikhom kelngoi hon banga kahoi khom ding nahiuve. Hamdong lah kelngoite dimset banga nagamsungu hi mihem tamtah hung dim kit ding ahi,” ati. 13 Pathenin lampi semdoh-in tin, amaho hi sohchanna muna konin puidoh-inte. Khopi kelkot phujal’un tin, jalen diu ahi. Alengpau –Pakai Amatah-in apuidoh diu ahi.

Micah 3

Micah-in Israel lamkaite adem

1 Ngaiyuvin Israel vaipoten! Thudih khohsah dia kigel nang hon, 2 thilpha naho’uvin, thilse nadeijo’uve. Kamite vun nalip’un, apheu na-at lhauvin, 3 kamite nanegam tauve. Avun’u nalipdoh-un, aguu naheh bongun, aphe avouvu belsunga hontheiyin na-atpan pan’ui. 4 Pakai henga natao phat’u hung lhung ding, Aman la nahou lou diu ahi. Thilse nabol jal’un natao nau sang ponte. 5 Sum apeh tengu chamna um ding seipeh a, apeh da tengu gal hung kon jeng dia thusei Themgaoten kamite alhemlha gamtauve. Hiche Themgaoho jah a hin Pakaiyin aseiyin, 6 “Vo themgaoho, hingsot tapouvin nate! Nisan nalhum khum diu ahitai. Kamite lam hilouva napui jal’uva, Themgao thilmua jong ima namu lou diu, thilsoh ding imacha jong nasei thei lou diu ahitai,” ati. 7 Khonung thilsoh ding seiho chu aguilhun lout eng mi vetda chang diu ahi. Pathenin adonbut lout eng min avet neo diu ahi. 8 Keivang Pakaiyin A-Lhagaoeidip’in, thahat eipen, thudih le hanna eipen, Israelte chonsetna chengse kaseipeh ngamin ahi. 9 Ngaiyuvin Israel vaipote, thudih deimoa, thildih chu adih louva kheldoh ho! 10 Jerusalem khopi chu tolthana ke thudih louva natousah-u ahitai! 11 Khopi sung vaipoten nehguh akilah-un, Themputen Danthu chu tohman neiyin ahilchen’un, themgaohom sum lo nan thu aphonguve. Abonchauvin Pakaiyin aumpi dol’in akiseiyuve. “Pakaiyin eiumpiuve,” ati cheh-ui. 12 Nangho jal’a Zion lhang hi loukaiya kikaiya, Jerusalem hi khogem doh ding, Houin kisahna lhang hi gammang thim lai soh ding ahi.

Micah 4

Vannoiya Pakaiyin chamna lengvai apoh

1 Houin kisahna molsang hi Molsang pen ahina ding nikho hung lhunga, Molle lhang jouse sanga Sangjo ding ahi. Namtin vaipi simsen louvin Hiche molsang chu hinbel’in tin, 2 Amiteuvin jong asei diu, “Pakai molsanga kal’u hitin, Israel Pathen Houin a cheute. Eibolsahnom’u eihil diu, Asemsa lampia iche diu ahi. Pakai hilchahna Jerusalema hungkon ahin, Zion a konin Pakaiyin Amite jah a thu seiye,” tiuvinte. 3 Pakaiyin gamla naiya thaneitah tah Namtin vaipi kidou thu seichaminte. Agal chemjamu langkonin khengun tin, Tengcha jouse kangkuiya akhen diu, Namtin vaipi gal kon kit louva, Galsat dia jong kigo lou didu ahi. 4 Mitin lung monga um diu, Alengpilei le theichang leiya chenguva, Ahoh kicha ding beihel ding, Hiche Thaneipen Pakaiyin atepsa ahitai. 5 Mi anam namin adoi-apathen cheh ngaiyintin, akihou cheh diu, eihon vang tonsot tonsot’a Pakai i-Pathenu ihouvuva athua inun diu ahi.

Sohchanna kona Israel hungkile kit

6 Pakiyin aseiyin, “Talen kamatsah a, sohchang genthei thohte kakhop khomna din gphat ahung lhunge. 7 Elbai chatmoa, in a kona gamla tah gei ahitauvin, ahingdoh amoh chengse to abul kapatdoh a thah a, nam lentah kasosah ding ahi. Hichea pat hi Zion a pansa, tonsot tonsot geiya achunguva vai kahomding ahi,” ati. 8 Vo Jerusalem, kelngoi chingpa banga Pathenin amite achin jingna mun, nalenggam dinga khopi lenpen mun nahi kit tei ding ahi. 9 Idia hibang othonga peng nahim? Iti namei naoso nat nabah ham? Leng beiya nauma, thumop them jouse thigam jeh ham? 10 Vo Jerusalem mite, tua khopi dalha gamchang noiya nachen ding jeh-in, numei naoso nat bangin, na san kipehle le jengin. Babylon gam najot din gahitan, hijongle namelmatea konin pakaiyin nahuhhing nante. 11 Nadelkhum din namtin vaipi akikhomtauve. Amahon, “Jerusalem hi suhmang tei tei ding ahi! Hiche khopi hi alheng alhol’in jam jengu hite,” atiuve. 12 Ahivangin hiche nam mite hin Pakai lunggel ahepouve. Cahngphal kipukhoma kichilngem banga Pakaiyin talen matsah dia apuikhom lam akihet phah pouve. 13 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Jerusalem mite, cheuvin namelmateu talen matsah-un! Aki thih to bang, atin sum-eng tobang bongchal hat’a kahatsah diu, namtin vaipi nasuhgep’uva, pumhat’a achomdoh-u neile gou chengse chu, Vannoi pumpi Pakai-Kei neipeh diu ahi,” ati.

Micah 5

1 Vo Jerusalem mite, sepaite khomsoh loiyun! Galmin eiumchah tauve! Israel lamkaipu adelkhum tauve!

Bethlehema vaipo hung dia Pathenin atep

2 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Bethlehem, Ephrathah, Judah gamsunga kho neo pen hijongle chun, nasunga kona Israel vaipo ding khat kapensah ding, aphunggui jong khanglui laipeh a to kisut mat ding ahi,” ati. 3 Hitia hi chapa nei ding nu nao pen masangsea pakaiyin amite hi amelmateu khut’a pehdoh a donda dingahitai. Chujou teng agamsung mite, gamchoma sohchangte chu amiteu tik igom kit diu ahi. 4 Ama ahung teng, Pakai thahat mangcha amite chunga vaihom ding, Pakai Pathen loupina jal’a vaihom ding ahi. Amite lung mongtah a cheng mitinin alal loupina aphondoh a, 5 aman chm alensah ding ahi.

Huhdohna le Talen matsah

Assyria miten igamdsungu adel khum’uva, i-gal pal jouseu atumboh tengu, i-lamkaiyu hat tah tah kisatpua isol siu ahi. 6 Gal manchah thahat a Assyria mite ajo diu, Assyria miten i-gamsungu adel khum tengule eihuhdoh diu ahi. 7 Israel mi ahingdoh amoh chengse chu, namtin dia Pakaiyin alhahsah daitwi dapjen le hamhing chunga gophin tobang hi diu ahi. Pathen kisonpia, mihem chunga ki-ngai lou diu ahi. 8 namtin vaipi lah a dalhah chengse chu gammang noiya hamjing lah a sakei neh hol bang diu; sakeiyin kelngoi amat khah teng, abokhum jenga, atel adah a ajan a, huhdohna thei beihel’a alha tobang hi diu ahi. 9 Israel’in amelmate jothon tin, aboncha asuhgam diu ahi. 10 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiteng chule nasakolteu le kangtalai chengse kaimang in gting kasuhgam ding ahi. 11 nagamsunguva khopi chengse sumang ing ting, nakulpi pal jouseu kaphet lhahsoh ding ahi. 12 Namanchah jingo mitphel doi lathem sumang ing ting, phunsan them khat beh khenpeh pouvinge. 13 Namilimdoi jouseu le doikhom song jouse kasuhmang ding, nasemsau thil ho chibai boh kit tapouvin nate. 14 Angamsunguva nanungjai nuu-Asherah milimdoi loilhung ting, nakhopi chengseu kasuhgam dingahi. 15 Kalunghan behseh teng kathu nit lou namtin vaipi chunga phu kalah ding ahi,” ati.

Micah 6

Pakaiyin Israel adou

1 Ngaiyin Pakaiyin Israel adouna thu hi! Vo Pakai, kipat’in Israel nadouna thu seiyin; molle lhang jousen nasei ngaiyu hen. 2 Vo molsang ho, tonsot leiset bulpi khom ho, Pakai thusei hi ngai tem’un! Pakaiyin amite douna thu khoh tah aneiye. Israel hehna thu alhut ding ahi. 3 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo kamite, ipi kabolpeh um? Itobang pohgih kahim? Neidonbut’un. 4 Egypt’a konin kahinpuidoh-un; sohchanna konin kahuhdoh uvin; nalamkai diuvun Mosea le Aaron chule Miriam kasol’e. 5 Vo kamite, Moab lengpa Balak chun i-nalo got’uva, Beor chapa Balaamin iti adonbut’em geldoh tem’un. Acacia ngahmun a pat Gilgal gei lampi dunga thilsoh chengse chu geldoh tem’uvin. Hicheng hi geldoh-un chuteng nangho huhhingna kabol chengse chu hedoh tauvin nate,” ati.

Ipiham Pakaiyin angeh

6 Pakai van Pathen hou dia kahung teng ipi kachoi ding ham? Pumgo thilto dia bongnou hoipen kapeh ding ham? 7 kelngoi asang sang kaiying, olive thao kanglou luiyin lonsah leng Pakai lung lhaiyin tem? Kachonset thoina kachapa peng masapen kapeh ding gam? 8 Ahipoi, thilpha chu Pakaiyin eihil tauve. Aman eibolsah nomu chu hiche hi ahi: thilsih bol ding, tantih neilouva lungset umsah ding, kneosah nun nemtah a i-pathenu to kiloikhom jing ding ahi. 9 Pakai gin chihna ahi. Aman khopi akouvin, “Ngaiyuvin khopi sunga kakhomhon! 10 Migiloute insunga chun lepthol’a alah-u gou akikhol’e. Kamah tah thiltena dih lou amangun, 11 hitobang thiltena dih loule kicheh lou mang ho hi iti ka-ngaidam thei ding ham? 12 nalah-uva mihaohon vaichate kichepnan aneiyu, naboncha mijou jeng nahiuve. 13 Nachonset jal’uva namanthahna diu thil kagon pan ahitai. 14 An nejongleu chun valou ding, kel nathoh thoh jongleur chun kheh doh nei pouvin nate; nakhendoh chengu jong galmun akasuhmang ding ahi. 15 Chang tujongleu chun na-at lou diu; olive thing thao chil jongleur chun mang thei deh pouvin nate. Lengpitwi kisem joungleu chun nadon lou diu ahi. 16 Omri lengpa le achapa Ahab thilse bol chengse najom jal’uva hicheng hi soh tei ding ahi. Ama ni umchan thilgon najop jal’uva kasuhmang diu, japi hot’a naumdoh diu ahi. Muntin a min navetda soh hel diu ahi,” ati.

Micah 7

Israel chon chatvai

1 kakinem tapo! Gilkel pet’a theichang ga holmo le lengpiga holmo kabangtai. Lengpiga jouse le thiecahngga ph alai jouse min alouheo tai. 2 Gamsunga milungdih khatcha beh aumtapoi, Pathen dia kitah a abeitai. Toltha ding changlhi geh cheh ahiuve. Mitinin agamsung mi chanpi tha din ago’uve. 3 Thilse bolthem jeng ahiuve. Vaihomte le thutan hon nehguh athum thum’un, mi thu nun theihon jong adei dei adeiyun, hiti hin akihoutoh toh-uve. 4 Apha pen le lungdih pen a kiseiho jong pannabei nangtom lah tobang bou ahiuve. Themgaote kama agihsal banga Pathenin mipi talen amatsahna ding nikho ahung lhuntai. Tun akisudong tauve. 5 Naheng nakom tahsan dan, nagol jong gingcha hih-in. Naji koma thusei jeng jong ching theiyin. 6 Tulai hin mi chapaten apateu jeng jong a-ngol bol’ui, cha numei hon ma anuteu adouvun, mouthah geiyin atehpi chengseu to akinauve; min melma anei chu a-insung mite ahiuve. 7 Kenvang Pakai ve-lhi jing ing ting, tahsan tah-in Pathen ngah jing inge, Aman eihuhhing nante. Ka-Pathenin kataona ngaiyinte.

Pakaiyin huhhingna apohdoh

8 Imelmateu ichunguva akipana diu aumpoi. Lhua ihitauvin, hingjongle ithodoh kit tei diu ahi. Tun muthima um jongleur hen Pakaiyin kho vahsah kit nante. 9 Pakai dounan ichonseuvin, chom khat vang alunghan ithot tei diu ahi. Akhonna vangle eihuh-un tin, dih louva min eibolnau chu asuhdih ding ahinai. Khovah eilhut’untin, eihuhhingu imu diu ahi. 10 Imelmateuvin hiche hi amu teng kijumso diu, “Pakai, na-Pathen hoilam hitam?” tia eidonguva melma ho chu ahiuve. Gal lel’uva min keng chotpha aneiyu, kholai lamlen dunga achil thang thangu imu diu ahi. 11 Vo Jerusalem mite, khopi pal ho semphatna ding phat ahung lhunge. Hiche tengle nagamgiu jong kikeh len ding ahi. 12 Muntina konin namiten nahengu hinjon intin, niso lam Assyria gama kon, lhanglam Egypt tama kon, Euphrates luipang dunga kon, Twikhnglen gamla tah tah a kon le molle lhang sang lai laiya hung kon diu ahi. 13 Leiset vang hi achung chengte gitlou jal’a gamthip soh ding ahi.

Israel dia Pakai dipdap

14 O Pakai, nalhensa namite hi kelngoi chingpa kelngoi chin bangin chingin! Gamthip laiya cheng jongleur, ajet aveiyuva gampha lah tampi aum’e. Masanglai aum banguvin, Gilead le Bashan hamhing phalaiya kivah-u hen. 15 Vo Pakai, Egypt’a kona neihin puidoh niu bangin thil kidang bol’in. 16 Thahat lheh jongleur namtin vaipin amu tengu kisudong diu ahi. Dongman a nakhang kisip’a kam kihup diu ahi. 17 Leivuiya gul bangin kithol’un tin, akulpi dung tin’uva hung potdoh-uva, kicha kithing thing diu ahi. Kichat jeh a Pakai i-Pathenu ahinbel diu ahi. 18 Vo Pakai, nang tobang pathen dang aumpoi; namite ahingdoh ho chonset na-ngaidamin; lunghan jing louvin, tantih beiya lungset din neideiyui. 19 Neihepi kit tei diu ahi. Kachonsetnau chotphan, Twikhanglen noilam a sonlhan nate. 20 Nakitahna le nalungset longlou namite, kapuiluiyu, Abraham le Jacob chihlhah ho hi, masanglaiya nakitepna bangin musah-in.

Nahum 1

1 Hichea kisun cheng hi, Elkosh khoa mi Nahumin Nineveh khopi thudol’a themgao thilmua amu thu kisun ahi.

Nineveh khopi chunga Pakai lunghan

2 Pakai Pathenin kidoupi koima anop lensah pon, Adouva pangte talen amatsah cheh-e. Alunghan tengleh Alethusoh keiye. 3 Pakai chu along hangvah pon, Hinla thahat tah ahin, Themmona nei chengse Talen matsah louvin akoipoi, Pakaiyin lam ajot teng leivui akitungin, Meilhang jouse jong Ama chot khut leivui ahi. 4 Aman asei teng Twikhanglen jong kang jeng, Luiddung jouse jong twi bwiya alupsah ahi. Bashan phaiya lou ho tei kanga, Carmel molsang jong go jeng, Lebanon lhanga pahcha jouse Gosoh hel jeng ahiuve. 5 Pakai angsunga molle lhang jouse killing jeng, Lhang sang jouse amasanga jolsoh jeng ahi. Pakai hung kilah teng leiset kithinga, Leiset le amite kithing jeng ahi. 6 Pakai lunghanna hingdoh jou ding koiham? Alungset tijat umtah a hingdoh thei koi ham? Alunghan mei-am kisunglha abangin, Amasanga songpi ho geiyin leivuiyin aleng’ui! 7 Pakai hi anun nemin, Gim hesoh nikhon amite ahoidamin; Aheng jon chan avetup theiye. 8 Amelmate chu twisoh laiyin atolmang abhsah-in, Ama doute chuathagam jin ahi. 9 Ibol’a Pakai douna nagonu ham? Aman nasuhmanglo diu ahi. Adou chan chu khatvei she a asuhgam ding ahi. 10 Lingnang kihel lhop le changpol gosa banga Meiya nahalvam diu ahi. 11 Vo Nineveh, nakhosunga hi thilse jeng bol mi, Pakai dou khat hun gpeng doh ding ahi. 12 Pakaiyin amite Israel jeh a asei chu hiche hi ahi: “Assyria mite hi hat hen lang tam jong leu, kisugam a amngthah diu ahi. Vo kamite, hesoh genthei kathohsah nahiuvin, avel’in bol kit taponge. 13 Nachunguva Assyria mite tha neina su lhang ting, nakan nau thih khao kabotan ding ahi,” ati. 14 Assyria mite gahna Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi: “Amin pu siu son le pah anei lou diu ahi. Adoi hounau houin dunga milimdoi ho kasuhmang ding ahi. Hing dia kilom ahitapouvin, Assyria mie din lhan kalaipeh tai,” ati. 15 Ven, molsanga hung sole pa khun kipana thupha ahinpoi! Ama hi gajo thu phongdoh dia hung ahi! Vo Judate, kut bol’uvin lang, giltah a nakitepnau chu Pathen peuvin. Migilouten nagamsungu gal’a abol kit lou diu ahitai. Abonchauva kisugamsoh ahitauve!

Nahum 2

Nineveh khopi chim

1 Vo Nineveh, min nahindel khumtai! Nasucheh ding thaneipa ahungtai! Kulpi geiya mi pansah-in, Lamlen dung nga sah-in! Galte to kisat din kigon! 2 Israelte hi min achomgam, masang laiya aloupina tobanga semphat kit din Pakaiyin agotai. 3 Melma sepaiten lumsan achoiyun, Avon jouseu jong asan jeng ahi. Hindel khum jeng din ago’uvin. Asakol kangtalaiyu Meisi pah lah lah abangin, Asakolteu kengto jaten ten ahiuve! 4 Kholai dunga kangtalai eijon junin alhaiyun, Kholai sunga adung avaiyin akitol’uve. Meikap bangin avahjep jep’in, Kholphe bangin akikhojen jun’e! 5 Vaihomte akoukhom’un, Malam noa kijotna kisep lhun alhuh lhuh-in alum’ui. Ahindelkhumten pal lam ajon’un, Lumho leiyin ado’uvin ahi. 6 Luipanga kelkot phung ho atumjal’un, Leng inpi sung tijat lungdon aumtai. 7 Lengnu soh-in akai tauvin, Alhachate vahui maovin amaovui. Chule dip le lai kidop’in aumtauve. 8 Twito kiting phujal abngin, Nineveh khopia konin ajam cheh tauve! “Kho ngaiyun! Kho ngaiyun!” tin akisam nan, Akinungheiya koimacha aumpoi. 9 Dangka sana kichoi’uvin! Khopi sunga gou dimset’in akikhol’e. 10 Nineveh khopi asumangun, min adalhan, akeovin akijamtai! Mihem lung kichat’in anemsoh tan; Thabeiyin khupbuh kithing thingin, Mihem mai adangsoh tai! 11 Sakei kokhuh tobang khopi hoiba hitam! Sakei noute tobang ho kivahna, Sakei challe pi kijot le na, Anoute mong tah a umtheina khopi chu! 12 Sakeichal’in sa athat jin, Sakeipi le anoute ahal hal’in aoppeh-in, akosung chu athasa Agu aphe adimset’in ahi. 13 Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Nakidoupi Kei kahi. Nakhangtalai jouse hall hang ting, naseipaite min galmun a athagam diu, midang nalahpeh thil aboncha kalahpeh ding nahi. Vannoiya nahusa hin hin kijadoh ki tlouhel ding ahitai,” ati.

Nahum 3

1 Vo thisan sohat khopi nada ahi! Nanei nagou mi kichomgam ding bep ahitai! 2 Ngaiyun, sakol kijep gin, Kangtalai kitah gin, Sakolte lhai gin le kangtalai kipei gin pi khu! 3 Sakol tou themten adel chum’un, Chemkol aval lah lah-in tengkol aphelap lap’in, thilong akisevum the thu jengin, Mithi long simsen ahitapoi. Thilong chunga mi akipal thu thu jenguve. 4 Noti tobang Nineveh khopin talen amantai! Manthahna lam a mijol heo hou nu! 5 Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Nineveh khopi, talen kamatsah ding nahi! Nakeovin jam ing ting namtin vaipi kavetsah ding, Najamo jouse amudoh diu ahi! 6 Noise se le kidah dah a kabol’a Thilboh jouse kanot khum ding nahi. Namupha cham mihem chu Tija kinlih leu leu diu ahi. 7 namudoh chan nungjam a, Nineveh khopi khogem asoh tai! Voujang natpia koi ham? Alhem lung mong nom koi ham?’ tia asei diu ahi,” ati. 8 Vo Nineveh, Egypt khopi Thebes sanga naphatjoh beh am? Thebes chu Nile luidung alongin, pal’in akikhang’e. 9 Sudan le Egypt chunga vai apon, athahat akhonbei ahi; Libya jong akigolpi. 10 Ahivangin Thebes kho mite jong sohchangin min akaitauve. Kholai lamkon tin a achateu minavo lih lih jengin ahi. Alamakiteu thihkhaovin akaiyun, sohchangte lah a ahomthanguve. 11 Vo Nineveh, nang jong ju khamin ngol’in natin, melmatea konin jamdoh gon nate. 12 nakulpi chengse jong theichang ga minsa tobang ahin, theichang phung chu loh le chun aga nakamsunga lenglut jel ding ahi! 13 nasepaite jong asildap soh tan, namelmate masanga pang jou ding abeitai. Nakelkot gol jouse meiyin akahvam ding ahi. 14 Min naumchah teng don ding twi kikhol’in, nakulpi chengse kaiphan! Leingan ho chu cheh a den din chilgoi loiyin, cheh denna ding gonsan koiyin. 15 Hinla ipi bol’in tong jongle chun meiyin halvaminnatin, ahiloule galmun a min that teiyin nate. Khaokhote banginnapunge! 16 Van a ahsite sanga tamjo kivei mi nasepdoh tai! Tunla khaokhoten lhaving jah a alen mang hel bangin, abeisoh tauve. 17 Navaibolte jog khodap nikhoa bang dunga kibemchal chul khaokhote ahiuvin, nisa sat ten glen gmang jel’a, hoilam agei koiman ahet lou tobang bep ahiuve! 18 Vo Assyria kumpipa, nagam vaipote athisoh tai, namilen milalte jong akijamddap soh tauve. Namite molle lhanga akithe thangsoh-un, in a puilut jou koima aumtapoi. 12 Namaha a nu didng damdoi aumpon, namaha damtheiponte. Namanthah thusim japha chan kipah-in khut abeng beng jengui. Tang louhel’a thilse nabolnaa hoidoh jou koi ham?

Habakkuk 1

Habakkuk 2

Habakkuk 3

Zephaniah 1

1 Judah gama Amon chapa Josiah lengpa khanga Pakaiyin Zephaniah henga asei thu hiche hi ahi. (Zephaniah hi Hezekiah lengpa son ahin, Hezekiah cha Amariah ahin, Amariah cha Gedariah, Gedaliah cha Cushi, chule Cushi cha chu Zephaniah ahi.)

Pakai thutan nikho

2 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Keiman leiset thil jouse kasuhmang ding ahi. 3 Mihem jouse, ganhing jouse, vachate le nga namkim, migiloute manthahna didng kabol ding ahi. Mihem namkim kasuhgam a, hinghoi kanei lou didng ahi. Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai. 4 “Jerusalem khosung mite le Juhdah gamsung mite abonchauva kasuhgam ding ahi. Baal doi houna halsi sia kasuhmanga, koiman Baal kinbol Thempuho jong ageldoh louhel ding ahi. 5 Intingvuma kaldoh a nisa, lha chule ahsite chibai boh ho jong kasuhgam ding ahi. Kei eihouva, Kei dia tahpan dia kihalsel, chujou teng Milcom pathen mina kihahsel chan jong kasuhmang ding ahi. 6 Nungjam a hung kile kit lou, kaheng hinjon lou, apui hoi diuva kahenga taolou jouse jong kasuhmang ding ahi,” ati. 7 Pakai Nikho anaitai, Pathenin thil bola got nikho chu; hijeh chun thip beh chan um’in. Pakaiyin amite hi kilhaina gamtha banga athagot ahi. 8 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Mi kathagam got nikho le vaipote le leng chapate chule namdangte chonchan jop jouse talen kamatsah ding ahi. 9 namdangte doi houva le adoi houvu in dimset dia miho that gama anei chasun chomgam ho chengse chu talen kamatsah soh ding ahi,” ati 10 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche nikho le chun Jerusalem khopi nga-kelkot’a ka ogin kija ding ahi. Khopi sah thahna mun a jong ka le mao ogin kija a, thinglhanglama jong ogin husa nasa tah kija ding ahi. 11 Kivei mi ho thigam ahijeh-in, ka le mao ogin najah tengu, khoto lama change kap’uvin! 12 “Hiteng chule thaomei devah a Jerusalem khosung kakhol ding, kisongtah a aning anop’a paova, ‘Itilam lam ahin Pakayin ipi abol ngaipoi,’ tia seiho chu talen kamasah soh ding ahi. 13 A-in jouseu kisuchim a, anei chengseu kichomgam ding ahi. Asah sau in a cheng lou diu, abolsau lengpi leiya lengpitwi adon louhel diu ahi,” ati. 14 Pakai nikho loupe tah chu anaitai-anai behseh jengtan, ahung kitol jel jul jengtai! Thohmo hel nikho, sepai hangpen jong lha lhop’a kap a pengjah ding ahi. 15 Hiche nikho chu lungsat nikho, gim gentheina, manthahna le mah thahna, muthim lung jinna, mitsin khojin, 16 galkon dia sumkon kimut ni, kulpi kaisa khopi ho le inchungsang ho delkhum dia gal-lhang kisap nikho hi didng ahi. 17 “Namtin mihem chunga hitobang manthahna kalhut khum ding jeh hin mitin mitcho banga kimail ele diu ahi. Kei dounan achonseuvin, tua hi athisanu teisih kisung lha bang ding, athilong, monsau tol’a kijam chap ding ahi,” ati. 18 Pakaiyin lungsat amusah nikho le asana dangkauvin jong ahuhhing lou diu ahi. Vannoi pumpi hi alunghanna meiyin akahvam ding ahi. Leiset chung cheng jouse hetman louva haisama alha ding ahi.

Zephaniah 2

Lungheina dia ngehna

1 Vo jumle ja helou nam mite! Hung kikhom loi tau, 2 pahpul’a napul kah-u, pakai lunghan deoje jun naphah masangu, Pakaiyin lunghan aphondoh masang hin! 3 Pakai thupeh nit jing, gamsung mi nun nemte, Pakaiya hung kiheilut loiyuvin. Thildih bol’un, pakai angsunga kineosah-uvin, chutile ijem tia Pakai lunghan nikho teng talen man louva nahoidoh theiyu ahi.

Israel kimvel’a vaipi manthahna

4 Gaza kho sung a koima kikhen lou didng ahi. Ashkelon kho min dalha soh- intin, Ashdod kho mite nilanga kiseljamsoh ding ahiuvin, Ekron khosung mite khosunga kona kinodoh ding ahiuve. 5 Vo Twikhanglen pamchin dunga cheng Philistinete ada nahiuve. Pakaiyin nachung thuu atantai. Khat beh jong khen neilouva nasuhgam hel diu ahi. 6 Twikhanglen pang dung gam nanei joouseu gamchangnoi soh a, kelngoi chingho ngahmun sonna le kelngoite dia neh thei hamhing dimset ding ahi. 7 Judah mi ahingdoh hon nagamsung alo diu, kelngoihon vahna aneiyuva, Ashkelon khosung in hoa jan geh diu ahi. Pakai a-Pathen’un umpintin, ahaodohsah kit diu ahi. 8 Thaneipan Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Moab le Ammon miten kamite aphin’uva ahoutom nau kajan, agamsungu jong lahpeh dia hoitho tah a hamhoi tho’u kajai. 9 Kikhel lou Hing jing Israel Pathen kahinaa kihahsel kahi-Moab le Ammon hi Sodom le Gomorrah banga kasuhgam ding ahi. Akhomun jouseu jong chikhuh soh didng, tonsot khogem a kijam a, lingle khao keh dimset ding ahi. Kamite ahingdoh chengin amaho hi chomgam’untin, agamsungu alahpeh diu ahi,” ati. 10 Thaneipen Pakai mite aphin’uva, kiletsah hoitho abol jal’uva Moab mite le Ammon mite hitobanga hi talen kimatsah ding ahiuve. 11 Pakaiyin hoh kichantin, leiset mite doihou jouse imacha lou aso ding, chutah l enamtin vaipin Pakai bou houva, agamsung cheh a chibai aboh diu ahi. 12 Pakaiyin Sudan mite jong athagam ding ahi. 13 Pakaiyin Assyria suhamngna din tha jedoh-intin, Nineveh khopi chu khogem lah asosah a, twi bwina nelgam ahisah ding ahi. 14 Kelngoite le bong ho chule satinin kolle na bou anei diu ahi, khogem lah a hin simbupi hung chengin tin, bangkot dunga ham ham diu ahi. Kotpi phung dunga va-ahte hung hamlah lah-uvinte.Inthing cedar thinga kimang jouse jong alheng lhol a kijam a, akeova um ding ahi. 15 Athahat kisonpia hamhoitho, lung mongtah a kigel khopi chu hitia hung um sing ahi. Khosung miten akhopiu chu vannoiya lengpen le minthang penin agel’ui. Itobang melsea gamsate kititna le gamthip lai hungdoh ding hitam! Ajotpa jouse kinleh leu leu diu ahi.

Zephaniah 3

Jerusalem chonset chule lhatdamna

1 Ohe ada ahi-chonset le doumah bol, mite bolgim khopi! 2 Pakai thu la angaipon, gahna jong asangpoi. Pakaiya ki-ngai lou, apanpi jong ngeh lou ahi. 3 Avaibolte sakei kisen abngun, thutan ho jong kamkei gilkelte nehmoh dagu khovahsah lou tobang ahiuve. 4 Themgaoten la khohsah neilou, mi lhem chavai bep; Thempuho jong thil theng suboh a, Pathen Danthu geiya adeilama kihei jen gahiuve. 5 Ahinla khopi sunga Pakai pansaa itih a jong thildih jen gbol ahi. Niso she le amite din thudih-in na atong jingin ahi. Hiche jong hin midih louten kumle ja helouvin thildih lou jeng abol jinguve. 6 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Namtin vaipi kasugamin, akhopiu l ekulpi pala ho, intingvum sang jouse kasumangtai. Khopi jouse akamsel’in lamlen ho keovin akijamin, mihing abeihel tai. 7 Kabol gimna hi kamiten gel jinga, kagahna asan diu, chuteng eija lheh diuvin kanagel’e. Ahinla chomkah louvin chavai bubah-in alamkittauve,” ati. 8 Pakiyin aseiyin, “Namtin vaipi hehse dia kakipat ngah-un. Kalunghan husa thamsah dia namtin vaipi le lenggam jouse khop khom dia kagel lhuh ahitai. kalunghanna meikouva leiset pumpi kahalvam ding ahi. 9 “Chuteng namtin vaipi lung heidah ing ting, kei tilou Pathen dang koma tao louhel ding ahiuve. Kei thubou ngaitauvinte. 10 Sudan gam lang peh a thechehsa kamiten jong kahenga kilhaina thilto ahinchoi diu ahi. 11 hiteng chule neidou jal’uva mit le maim oh aum lou din gnahitauve. Kelietsah hoitho chengse tolmang ing ting, kalhang theng chunga neidou kit louhel diu ahi. 12 Mi nun nem le kineosah chengse khen in gting, kahenga panpi ngaiya hun gjing diu ahi. 13 Israel ahin gdoh chengin mi koima dih louvin bol pouvintin, jou sei lou ding, lhep lhah thu jong sei pouvinte. Lung mong le khangtouva um a, gin nei lou didng ahiuve,” ati.

Kipana La

14 Vo Israelte, kipa la sauvin! Vo Jerusalem nalungthim pumpin kipah-in! 15 Pakiyin nathohna asubeitan, Namelmate atolmangdoh tai. Pakai, Israel Lengpan naumpiuve, Kichatna ding him him aumtapoi. 16 Phat ahung lhunge mihon Jerusalme jah a, “Kicha hih-in Zion khopi! Ban-gol jesal jingin! 17 Pakai na-Pathenin naimpi jinge, Athahat’in gal najosah tai. Pakaiyin kipapin natin, Alungset jal’in hinkhothah pen nate, Nachung change kipa la santé. 18 Kut laiya kipah ho bang ding ahi,” ati diu ahi. Pakaiyin aseiyin: “hutotna ka-ngatan, Vetda nachan kasubeitai. 19 Phat ahung lhungtai! Nabolse talen matsah ing ting, Elbai chengse kahuhdoh ding, Sohchangte inlama hin puiyinge. Jumle ja athohna chengseu Ginle jabolna kaheidoh a, Vannoi miten apachat diu ahi. 20 Phat ahung lhunge! Namite cheh chaosa puikhom ing ting, Vannoi minthang kihisah ding, Naphat theiya nahaodoh kit ding ahi,” ati. Pakaiyin aseitai.

Haggai 1

Houin sah phatna dia Pakai thupeh

1 Darius Persia gamvaipoa apan kal kum ni lhinna, lha gupna, ni masapen nin Haggai Themgao kamin Pakaiyin thu ahinseiye. Athusei hi Judah gam vaipo Zerubbabel, Shealtiel chapa le Thempu chungnung Joshua, Jehozadak chapa ding ahi. 2 Thaneipen Pakaiyin Haggai jah a aseiyin, “Hiche ho hi Houin sah phatna ding hilou laiyin aseiyui,” ati. 3 Hijeh chun Pakaiyin mipi dingin hiche thu hi Haggai Themgao kamin aseiye: 4 “Vo kamite, idia nang ho, in phatah tah a chenga, Kei Houin asesa kijam ham? 5 Nachunguva thilsoh mulou nahiuvem? 6 Muchi tampi natu vangun lhosoh ga themcha bou namu’uve. Neh ding nanei vangun oivana kham ahipoi. Lengpitwi don ding naneiyun, chimna kham ahipoi! Ponsil naneiyun, lum nasahpi khamu ahipoi. Natong’an oivana amujoupoi. 7 I-tile hiti ho hi soh ahi namudoh louvu ham? 8 Tun thinglhang lama kaltouvun; inthil gajongun Houin saphauvin; kalung lhai ding, eikihou dol’a eikihou ding ahi. 9 “Lhoga tampi mu ding nakinem’un, amala lhomcha ahiji. Lhosoh in a nahinpoh lut tengu jongle kamut mangpehjitai. Idia kabol ham? Ka-Houin sesa um a, nading cheh bolna nakisah lel jal’u ahi. 10 Hijeh a chu gotwi lha louva muchi chivo phalou-keh lou ahi. 11 Gamsunga gotwi kang a, molle lhang gosoh, bulei le lengpilei jouse go a, olive honlei jouse gosoh, muchi chivo jouse gotwi ngai, mihem le gancha chule thil ijakai gotwi ngaiya umsoh ahitai,” ati.

Mipin Pakai thupeh angaiyu

12 Babylon a sohchang hung kile kit-Zerubbabel le Joshua chule mipin Pakai a-Pathen’un bol dia aseipeh-u chu aboltauve. Pakai sole Themgao Haggai chu aging cheh-un asei angaiyui. 13 Hichun Haggaiyin Pakai thusei chu mipi aseipeh-in: “Kakitep ahitai-kaumpi jing ding nahiuve,” ati. 14 Sohchang hung kile kit-Zerubbabel, Judah gam vaipopa, Thempu chungnung Joshua, chule mipi abonchauvin Houin sapha din Pakaiyin atildoh tai. Hijeh chun thaneipen Pakai a-Pathenu Houin asapantauve. 15 Asah patnau chu Darius gamvaipoh kal kum nina, lhagup lhin, nisom ni le li ni ahi.

Haggai 2

Houin thah loupije

1 Darius leng chankal kum ni lhinna, lha sagi lhin, nisom ni le khat nin Pakaiyin Haggai Themgao kamin thu ahinsei kit’e. 2 Aman Haggai chu Judah gam vaipo Zerubbabel le Thempu chungnung Joshua, chule mipi jah a thu sei din asol’in, 3 “Houin loupije chu geldoh theiya nalah-uva mihem khat beh umlou ham? Itobanga namujiu vem? Tunvang imacha ahitapoi. 4 Hijongle khatchan jong lungthoinan neidauvin. Tongpan’un, Ka-umpi jing nauve. 5 Egypt’a kona nahungdoh-u chun ka-umpi jing diuvin kakiteptai. Tunjong kaumpi jingui kicha hih-uvin. 6 “Phat chomkah louva van le leiset, Twikhanglen kaholingsoh ding ahi. 7 Namtin vaipi lehkhup soh ing ting, anei agou chengseu hikoma kahin poh khom ding, Houin hi nei le gou dimset ding ahi. 8 Vannoiya sana dangka jouse aboncha Keiya ahi. 9 Houin luipa sanga Houin thah loupijo cheh ding, chuteng kamite chamle lungmon, haona kapeh ding ahi,” ati. Thaneipen Pakaiyin asei ahitai.

Themgaopan Thempupa akihoupi

10 Darius gamvaipoh kal kum ni na, lha ko lhin, nisom ni le ni li lhin nin thaneipen Pakaiyin Haggai Themgao kamin thu ahinseiyin, 11 “Aban a kisei thudol’a hin Thempuhon ilo ding agot’um dong temin: 12 Mihem khat touvin kilhaina sathenga kithat sahal khat tou aponsil’in kichundoh hen, hiche ponsil hin ipi thil hijongle: changlhah ham, an minsa ham, lengpitwi ham, olive thao ham, khat pen pen tongkha le, atoh khah pen pen chu sutheng theiyin tem?”a ti. Hiche thudoh hi adoh phat’un thempuhon, “Theng theiponte,” atiuve. 13 Haggaiyin adong kit’in, “Mihem khat’in thilong tongkhan kisuboh taleh, aman atoh khah khah neh le chah ho chu boh thei ding ham?” ati. Thempuho, “Boh theiyinte,” atiiuve. 14 Haggaiyin aseiyin, “Pakaiyin aseiyin, hitobanga chu hiche nam mite chunga jong chuti ding ahin, atohdoh aboldoh chengseu jong chuti ding ahi; hiti hin maicham phunga atodoh chengseu jong abohsa jeng ahibouve,” ati.

Pakaiyin avangboh ateppeh

15 Pakaiyin, “Nachunguva thilsoh hi nahetdoh thei louvu ham? Houin sah phat napat masangun, 16 chang kilogram ja ni jen tedoh din che leu chun kilogram jakhat bou umintin, lengpitwi litre jakhat thaldoh din lengpitwi bel gave leu chun litre som li bou um ding ahi. 17 Ke dohsah tei dia natu anche louhing jouse semchai din khohui hamve vun kalansah-in, lungnaheideh pouve. 18 Tuni hi lha ko na, nisom ni le ni lhin na, Houin inmun kilaijou nikho ahi. Tua pat ipi hungsoh ding vetem’uvin. 19 Changsal keosoh hen, lengpiga heosoh hen lang, theichang ga heo hen, kolbuthei le olive thing ga heo ta jongle, tua pat vang phatthei kaboh diu ahitai,” ati.

Pakaiyin Zerubbabel thu ateppeh

20 Chuche lha, nisom ni le ni li lhin nin Pakaiyin Haggai kam a, thu asei kit’in, 21 athusei hi Judah gam vaipo, Zerubbabel ding ahin, “Ken Van le leiset kaholing a, 22 lenggam jouse le athaneina chengse akhup athal’a kakoi ding ahi. Kangtalai ho le atol ho akhup athal’a kale a, sakolte thigam a, achung toute kithat to diu ahi. 23 Hiche nikho tengle kalhacha Zerubbabel, nang hi kamin a vaihom dia kalhendoh ding nahi. Kalhendohsa nahitai,” ati. Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseitai.

Zechariah 1

Hung kile kit dia Pakaiyin amite akou

1 Darius hin Persia gamvai apoh kal kum ni na, lha get nan Iddo tupa, Berechiah chapa, Zechariah Themgao henga Pakaiyin hiche thu hi aseiye. 2 Thaneipen Pakaiyin Zechariah hi mipi aseipeh din aseiyin, “Kei-Pakai hi napu napateu chunga lung hang kahi, 3 hijongle nang ho hi, ‘hung kit’un, Keijong nahenguva hungkit nange.’ 4 Napu napateu umchan jop dauvin. Masangin themgao hon thilse boldin ail’un, chonse lou din asei peh-ui.Ahivangin kasei ngailou, kathu nit louvin aum’ui. 5 Napu napateu le Themgao ho chu abeisoh tai. 6 Kalhacha Themgao ho mang chan-napu napateu thu kapen, kagisaljie, ahivangin nahsah mon aum’un gim genthei athoh lo’uve. Chutah le thaneipen Pakai Ken talen matsah lom ahi banguva kabol hon, lung aheiji tauve,” ati.

Themgaopan Sakolte mu neiya amu

7 Darius gamvai poh kal kum ni na, lha som le khat, Shebat lha, nisom ni le ni li lhin nin, jan a mu kaneinaa Pakaiyin sei ding thu khat eihil’e. 8 Pakai Vantil khat hi sakolsan chunga atouve. Vantil chu phaicham a huisum thing lah a adingin, anunga hin sakol dang-asan le abong, akang tampi aum’uve. 9 Kenjong, “Pu, hiche dakolte hi ipito tekah ham?” tin kadonge. Aman, “Nahilchen nange. 10 Leiset gakholtoh dia Pakaiyin asol ho chu ahiuve,” ati. 11 Hiche ho hin Vantil jah a thu ahinlhut’un, “Vannoi leiset kagakhol soh keiyun, vannoi pumpi panpibei le mi noiya umkamu’ve,” tin aseiyui. 12 Hichun Vantil’inaseiyin, “Vo Thaneipen Pakai, Jerusalem khopi le Judah gamsung khopi jouse chungakum som sagi sungin nalung hangin, itih tah le ba nahepi ding ham?” ati. 13 Pakaiyin Vantil chu lungmon na thun adonbut’in, 14 Vantil chun thaneipen Pakai thusei phongjal din eihil’in, “Kakhopi theng, Jerusalem ka-it behseh jengin, 15 chamle lungmonga nomtah a um nam mite chunga kalung hangtai. Kamite chunga chom khat lung dam kabol kahseh-in jong, hiche nam mite hin kamite melse cheh-in abolgentheiyui. 16 Hijeh a chu Jeruslem khopi hepi dia hungkile kit ahi. Jerusalem khopi kisapha a, Ka-Houin kisemthah didng ahi,” ati. 17 Vantil’in kaphonjal din aseiyin, “Thaneipen Pakaiyin akhopi jouse khangtou kit’a, Jerusalem jong akithopia, Ama khopi mong monga asei din aseiye,” ati.

Saki ho Themgao thilmua kimu

18 Kagao chan naa bongchal ki li jen kamui. 19 Kakoma thusei jing Vantil chu kadongin, “Hiche bongki ho hi ipi to tekah ham?” kati. Aman, “bongki ho hi leiset thaneina-Judah le Israel chule Jerusalem mite nocheh ho chutoh tekah ahi,” ati. 20 Pakaiyin thih khengthem she choiya pasal li eivetsah-e. 21 Kenjong, “Hiche ho hi Judah gamsung sugam a amite nocheh nam vaipi deljam a akhup athal’a leh dia hung ahiuve,” ati.

Zechariah 2

Themgaopan Thiltena jol amu

1 Kagaochan na a thilte-na jol choi pasal khat kamui. 2 Kenjong, “Hoiche ding nahin?” tin kadonge. Aman, “Jerusalem khopi let le neo, asaodol tetoh didng kahi,” ati. 3 Hichun kajah athusei jing Vantil chun eihin nailut’in, Vantil chom khat man ahinjonin akitoh lhon’e. 4 Vantil masan khatjoh jah a, “Thilte-na choi golhangpa khu gaseipeh-in, Jerusalem khopi sunga mihem l egancha tamval’a kulpin adol lou ding ahi. 5 Pakai Amatah kitep’a, khopi kimvel’a chu Ama meikou banga pal a kigen ding, Aloupina hunei tah apanga khopi a-nga ding ahi,” ati.

Sohchangte In jon dia kouna

6 Pakaiyin amite jah a aseiyin, “Nabonchauvin sahle lhang, simle mal’a kathecheh-un, 7 tunvang sohchang chengse Babylon a kon jamdoh loiyun, Jerusalem hinjon tauvin. 8 Min najepnau hi kamitchang kikaldoh tobang ahi,” ati. Hiti hin amite chomgam namtin vaipi henga hiche thu hi seipeh din Pakaiyin eisol’in: 9 “Pakai Amatah-in nadouvuntin, khatvei soh a navulteuvin nachomgam diu ahi,” ati. Hitobang thil hi aso teng, thaneipen Pakaiyin eisol ahi-mitinin hedoh tante. 10 Pakaiyin, “Vo Jerusalem mite, kipa la sauvin! Nalah-uva cheng din kahunge!” ati. 11 Hiteng chule namtin vaipi Pakai henga hungun tin, amite hi diu ahi. Nalah-uva chenga, nahenguva eihinsol nahetdoh diu ahi. 12 Agamtheng sunga Judah hi agou lhantum hiya, Jerusalem hi angailut pen khopi hi didng ahi. 13 Achenna munthenga konin Pakai ahunge, amasanga mitin thip chet’in um’uvin.

Zechariah 3

Themgaopan Themgpu chungnung amu

1 kagaochanna khat’a Pakaiyin Thempu chungnung Joshua, Pakai Vantil masanga ding eivetsah-e. Joshua koma chun Satan adingin, ahehse din gonsan aum’e. 2 Pakai Vantil’in Satan jah a, “Vo Satan, Pakaiyin mo nachan hen! Jerusalem ngailua Pakaiyin themmo nachan hen! Hichepa hi meilhum sunga kiloidoh tenggol tobang ahi!” ati. 3 Joshuan ponsil nen sil’in hikoma chun adinge. 4 Vantil’in Vanmi lhachate jah a, “Hichepa ponsil nen ho hi sut lhauvin,” ati. Hichun Joshua jah a, “Naconset kalamangtai, sil ding ponthah kapeh ding nahi,” ati. 5 Chuin lhacha hon Joshua chu delthah akop peh diuvin aseiye. Lhacha hon asei bangin abol’un, Pakai Vantil dinpet hin ponthah jeng asil peh atauve. 6 Vantil chun Joshua jah a 7 Thaneipen pakaiyin aseitai, “Kadanthu nit’a nganse na cheng natohdoh le, Ka-Houin lhachan pangin natin, hongcha dung limbol’a napan ding, chule kamasanga um jing Vantilte taona kasan banga nataona kasan ding ahi. 8 Ngaiyin Joshua, nang thempu chungnung nahin, chule a Themputpi dang hon jong ngaiyun-khonung hamphatna ding dol’a um nang hon: kalhacha-Abah kiti chu kaphondoh ding ahi! 9 Joshua masanga maisagi jen a kisem song khat kakoiye. Song chunga hin lekhajem jih in gting, nikho khatseh sunga hiche gamsung chonsetna kasuhmang ding ahi. 10 Hiche nikho chu ahung lhun teng, nanghon nahenga nakom kouva, lengpilei le theichang ga thalhingset chu kipa lungmon pi dinga natem didu ahi,” ati.

Zechariah 4

Gaochanna thaomeikhom kimu

1 Kajah a thusei Vantil chu ahungin, a-ihmu kibolna bangin eihung suthouve. 2 Chule kajah a, “Ipi namun?” tin eidonge. Kenjong, “Sanaa kisem thaomeikhom kamun, achunga khun thaokhon khat akikoiye. Thaomeikhom chunga khun thaomeikhom chunga khun thaomei sagi aumin, thaomei khat khat’in meijang sagi cheh aneiyui. 3 Thaomeikhom koma hin olive thing phung ni cheh akeh-in, ajet aveiya khat khat’in akeh-e,” kati. 4 Vantil chu kadongin, “Hiche ho hi ipito tekah ham, kapu?” kati. 5 Aman, “Nahet lou ham?” eiti. Kenjong, “Kahepoi,” tin kadonbut’e. 6 Hichun Vantil’in Pakaiya konin hiche hi Zerubbabel seipeh din eihil’in, “Sepaite le thahat vang hilouva, Ka-Lhagao vanga najo tei ding ahi. 7 Kisuhmona ding molle lhang kikhangsang bang jongle, namasanga kitol mangsoh diu, Houin nasah phat’a, Inmun song nukhah pen nakoiteng, mipin sam’untin, ‘Ahoiye, ahoiye!’ tia aseidiu ahi,” ati. 8 Pakaiya konin kahenga thu khat ahung lhung kit’in, 9 Zerubbabel’in Houin mun asep joutai, Houin jong asah jou ding ahi. Asah jou teng kamiten ahenguva nang sol’a Kei kahi hedoh tauvinte. 10 tohban chalmo jeh-in lung himon aum’un, Zerubbabel’in Houin sah ban ajop jing amudoh tengu kipah thanom lheh-unte,” ati.
