Vantil chun kajah a, “Thaomei sagi hileiset pumpi musoh hel Pakai mit sagi ahiuve,” ati. 11 Kenjong, “Thaomeikhom jet le veiya olive thingphung te ni khu ipito tekah ba ham? 12 Chule olive thaotwi lonna sana-long te ni kom a olive thing bathe ni khu ipito tekah ham?” tin kadonge. 13 Aman, “Nahet lou ham?” tin eidonge. Kenjong, “Pu kahepoi,” kati. 14 Hichun aman, “Hiche te ni hi, leiset pumpi Pakaiyin alhachaa pang dia alhendoh te ni chu ahi,” ati.

Zechariah 5

Lekhajol lengthei kimu

1 Kagah vet kit le, vanlaijol’a leng lekhajol khat kamui. 2 Vantil chun ipi kamu eidonge. Kenjong, “Vanlaijol’a lengle, metre ka sao, metre li le keh len, lekhajol khat kamui,” kati. 3 Aman kajah a aseiyin, “Hichejol’a khu leiset pumpi chunga thejal ding gaosapna kisun ahi. Lekhajol lang khat’a khu gamsunga gucha jouse nodoh ding kisun a, alang khat’a khu jou pan a kihahsl chengse tolmang ding kisei ahi. 4 Thaneipen Pakaiyin hiche gaosapna lhadoh ding aseiyin, gucha jouse le jou pan a kihahsel’a thusei jouse insunga lut didng ahi. A-insunguva pansan tin, asuhgam hel’a adalhah ding ahi,” ati. Pocha sunga numei khat gaochanna kimu 5 Vantil chu ahung kilah kit’in, “Ven, thil chom beh khat ahungdoh kit’e!” ati. 6 Kenjong, “Ipi ham?” tin kadonge. Aman, “Pocha khat ahin, gamsung pumpi chonset to tekah ahi,” ati. 7 Pocha sin chu hahngeh a kisem ahi. Kavet le asin ahongdoh-un, pocha sunga chun numei khat atouve! 8 Vantil chun, “Hiche numei hi gitlouna to tekah ahi,” ati. Hichun numei nu chu pocha sunga asonlut’in asinkhumtai. 9 Kagah vet le vasai lhaving tobang neiya, numei ni kaheng lam ngan ahung leng lhone. Pocha chu akhaidoh lhonin, alen mangpi lhontai. 10 Kenjong Vantil chu kadongin, “Hoilam lhut agot lhon ham?” kati. 11 Aman eodonbut’in, “Houin asahna diuva Babylon gama apoh mang lhon ahitai. Houin chu asah jou tengu, pocha chu koiyuntin, chule hichu ahou diu ahi,” ati.

Zechariah 6

Gaochanna Kangtalai li kimu

1 Gaochan nan mu kanei kit’e. Sum-eng molsang ni kah a konin kangtalai li ahung kitoldoh-e. 2 Kangtalai masapen chu sakolsan in akaiyin, anina chu sakolvomin akaiyin, 3 thumna chu sakolvomin akaiyin, li lhinna chu sakolpol’in akaiye. 4 Vantil jah a hin kenjong, “Pu, hiche kangtalaiho hi ipito tekah ham?” tin kadonge. 5 Aman, “Amaho hi kolkimvel ning lia khopihui ahiuvin, leiset pumpi Pakai ang sunga hung kondoh ahiuve,” ati. 6 Sakolvom ho kai kangtalai chun sahlam Babylon lang ajonin, sakolkangte kaiyin lhumlam ajonin, sakolpolte kaiyin lhanglam gamsung ajon’e. 7 Sakolpolte akijotdoh phat’in leiset gakholtoh loi ding a-ngah lel’ui. Hijeh chun Vantil’in, “Leiset gakhol loiyun!” tin aseiye. Hiti chun agakhol tauve. 8 Hichun Vantil’in eihin kouvin, “Sahlam Babylon lang jon sakolten Pakai lunghan asuthip tauve,” ati.

Joshua lallukhu khuhpeh dia solna

9 Pakaiyin hitin thu eiseipeh-e, 10 “Sohchang mi Helsai le Tobijah, chule Jedaiah thilpeh ho hi choiyin lang, Josiah, Zephaniah chapa koma gache loiyin, Amaho hi abonchauva Babylon gama sohchang hung kile kit ahiuve. 11 Athilpeh-u dangka le sana ho hin lallikhuh khat semin, Thempu chungnung, Joshua, Jehozadak chapa khu khuhpeh-in. 12 Ajah a Thaneipen Pakai thusei seipeh-in, ‘Abah kitipa chu hung phattheiya, Pakai Houin asah phat ding ahi. 13 Ama hin Houin saphan tin, leng khat chanlom tah change, amite chunga vaihom ding ahi. Alaltouna koma Thempu khat ding jingin tin, lung khat le chamnan na tong lhoninte,’ tin. 14 Lallukhuh hi Helsai le Tobijah, chule Jedaiah le Josiah het jingna dia Pakai Houina kikoi jing ding ahi,” ati. 15 Muntin le gamtin a chengte hunguntin, Pakai Houin sapha hung pan gdiu ahi. Houin kisah phat jou teng, nahenguva Thaneipen Pakaiyin eihinsol hi nahetdoh diu ahi. Pakai na-Pathenu thupeh chengse nanit’u le thil hijetpi hi guilhung ding ahi.

Zechariah 7

Dihlouva an ngol Pakaiyin amah

1 Darius lengvaipoh kal kumli na, lha ko, Kislev lha, ni li nin Pakaiyin thu khat eiseipeh-e. 2 Bethel kho miten Sharezer le regemmelech chu amiteu to Pakaiya vangboh thum din, Thaneipen Pakai Houin a asol’un, 3 chule Thempuho le Themgaote chu thu gadonga, “Kum hijat sunga kahinbol jingo, lha nga lhin she le houin kisuhmang jal’a an ngol’a lunghem kabol’u hi kajom nah lai diu ham?’ ti din asol’uve. 4 Pakaiyin kajah a sei thu chu hiche hi ahi. 5 “Gamsung mite le Thempuho seipeh-in, kum som sagi sunga, lha nga le lha sagi lhinseh le an ngol’a lunghem athoh jui khu, Kei jabolna abol’u ahipoi. 6 Aneh-uva adon tengu jongle oiva na dinga nea don ahibouvui,” ati. 7 Jerusalem khopi phatthei lai, khosung dimset’a mihem chen lai, khopi kimvel kholen dunga mihem chen dimset, lhanglam le lhumlam thinglhang bul dung geiya mihem chen dimset laiya Themgao masate koma Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.

Thu ngai loujeh a sohchanlo

8 Pakaiyin Zechriah jah a aseiyin, 9 “Masanglaiyin kamite kaseipeh-in, ‘Thildih bol’uvin, khat le khat khoton kihepi to cheh-un. 10 Meithai le chagate, nalah-uva cheng gamchom mi, chule koi hile neilel tapou bolse hih-un. Khat le khat kisuhsetna ding thil gon dauvin,’ kati. 11 Ahivangin kamiten lungtah tah-in ajadauvin ahi. Lungkot hong louvin aum’un, 12 alungthimu songtah-in atahsah-ui. Masang lai Themgaote kama kaseisa thu ho angai loujeh-un kalung hangtai. 13 Thu kaseipet’a angai loujeh-un, atao tengu jongle kasangpoi. 14 Twisoh thil lhoh bangin abonchauvin gamchom a cheng din kalhoh mangtai. Gam phatah hiche gam hi ahomkeovin akijamin, koimachan chennan aneitapoi,” ati.

Zechariah 8

Jerusalem semphat dia Pakaiyin atep

1 Thaneipen Pakaiyin Zechariah jah a hiche thu hi aseiye. 2 “Kamite kakhohsah beh seh, khohsah val jeh a amelmate chunga kalunghan lo nah in Jerusalem kithopi nom jinga um kahi. 3 Kakhopi theng, Jerusalema hung cheng kit ding kahi. Khopi kitah, Thaneipen Pakai lhang chu lhang theng kiti ding ahi. 4 Numei pasal tehse kembet net, tenggol phut’a lamjot ho chu kholai nin gkoi dunga hung tou kit diu ahi. 5 Kholai lemlen dunga kichem ding nu-ngah golhang hung dimset ki tdiu ahi. 6 “Hitobang thilsoh ding hi tua amoh cheng na mite lah a hingdoh ho gel din soh dia kilomlou hel ding ahin, Kei didn imacha ahimo poi. 7 Kamite min ahen nau gamsunga konin huhdoh ing ting, 8 Jerusalema cheng dia niso le nilhum a kona kahinlepui kit ding ahiuve. Kamite hiuvintin, a-Pathenu, kitah le dih tah a chunguva vaihom kahi ding ahi. 9 “Hanguvin! Ka-Houin sah phatna dia inmun kiset phat laiya themgaote thusei ho ma ma chu najah kit’u ahi. 10 Hiche masang chun mihem hihen gancha hile thalah didng akimujoupoi, melmate masanga hoidoh thei jong ana umpoi. Ken miho chu khat le khat kakisousah-e. 11 Tunvang hiche nam mite lah a ahingdoh chengse hi lamchonbeh-in kaboltai. 12 Chamle lung mongin vaikon’untin, alengpiguiyu gatheiya, leiset’in muchi chivo asemdoh ding, gotwi nengsel sing ahi. Kamite ahingdoh chengse vangbohna hijatpi hikapeh ding ahi. 13 Vo Juddah le Israel mite! Malaiyin gamchom mite khat le khat akigaosap’un,’Hitobang hamsetna Judah le Israel lhunkhum hin nang jong lhun khum hen!’ akitiuve. Ahivangin nahuhhing ung ting, hiche gamchom mite chu khat le khat,’Judah le Israel chunga lhung vangbohna cheng nang jong changing,’ kiti diu ahi. Hijeh chun hangtah-in pangun, kicha hih hel’un,” ati. 14 Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Napu napateuvin eiphin lung hang phat’un, sumang din kagon, khelchom louvin kasumangtai. 15 Tua vang Jerusalem le Judah mite vang boh kagot ahi. Hijeh chun kicha hih-un. 16 Hitobanga hi naum diu ahi: Khat le khat thutah-in kihouvun. Thutanna phunga thudih mong mong, cham len theina seiyun. 17 Khat le khat susuhsetna ding thil gon dauvin. Jouvin kihahsel dauvin. Jousei le thudihlou, pumhat kahoi,” ati. 18 Thaneipen Pakaiyin Zechariah jah a hiche thu hi aseiye; 19 “Lha li, lha nga, lha sagi, chule lha som lhin na an ngol kibolji ho hi Judah mite dia kipa thanopna kut akiheidoh ding ahi. Thudih le chamna khohsah-uvin,” ati. 20 Thaneipen Pakayin aseiyin, “khopi tina miten Jerusalem ahinjotna diu phat ahung lhunge. 21 Khopi khat’a hung kon hon khopi choma hung kon ho jah a, ‘Thaneipen Pakai xhibai boh a ahenga vang thum ding kahiuve. Hungin kilhonute,’ ati diu ahi. 22 Namtin a mi, nam hunei tah tah ho thaneipen Pakai chibai boh dia Jerusalema hung diu, ahenga vang athum diu ahi. 23 Hiteng chule gamchom mi som jen Judah mi khatseh koma hunguva, ‘Patheninnaumpiu kajauvin, Najotna mun’uva din kihon jengute,’ tia asei diu ahi,” ati.

Zechariah 9

Khonel dung nam mite chunga thutanna

1 Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi: Hadrach gamsung le Damasus khopi talen man din akoitai. Israelte khopi maiseh hilouvin, Syria khopi maiseh hilouvin, Syria khopi jong Paakiya ahibouve. 2 Hadrach to kigamgi Hamth jong Pakaiya ahin, Tyre le Sidon chule athepna chengseu jong Pakaiya ahi. 3 Tyre hin kulpi akisemin, dangka sana ahao behseh-in imalou bangin aumtai! 4 Hinla anei chasun Pakiyin alah mangpeh ding ahi. Anei agou jouse Twikhanglen a leh lut’intin, akhopi kavamhel ding ahi. 5 Hiche thilsoh hi Ashkelon khopin amudoh teng tija ding ahi. Gaza khopin mudoh-intin, a thoh lel lheh ding ahi. Ekron khopi jong chute ding, akinepna chengse beisoh ding ahi. Gaza lengpa thi ding, Ashkelon khopi ahomkeova um ding, 6 Ashdod khopi jong nam choplop hung chengkhom diu ahi. Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche Philistine mi kiletsahte hi kasuhnem ding ahi. 7 Sa jong thisan puma aneh lou diu, nehmo ho jong aneh da diu ahi. Ahingdoh amoh cheng chu kamite lah a kisimtha a, Judah phungbah khat banga um diu ahi. Ekron jong, Jebua mite banga kamite to kisimtha diu ahitai. 8 Kagamsung ki-ngang ting, sepaite kajotpa sah lou ding ahi. Vaipo giloute kamite bol gentheisah ponge. Itobanga kamiten ganthei hesoh athoh kamudoh tai,” ati.

Kho-nunga Leng chang ding

9 VO Zion chate, hachangpan kipah-un! Kipah-in khosam’un, Jerusalem mite! Ven, nalengpau ahunge! Galjo minthangin ahungin; Nun nemtah-in sa-ngan chunga touvin, Sa-ngan nou lagol chunga touvin ahung! 10 Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Israelte galsatna kangtalai jouse sumang ing ting, Jerusalema sakolte kakai mang ding; Galmuna manchah thlpi kaheboh doh ding ahi. Nalengpauvin namtin vaipia chamna semintin, Twikhanglen lang khat’a pat langkhat geiya vai ahoma, Euphrates luipia pat leiset mong geiya vai ahom didng ahi,” ati.

Pathenin mite semphatna

11 Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Kilhaina thisan a mohor namkhumsa Eikitepnau jal’a, Namiteu chamlhatsah ing ting, Twi beina sohchanna muna ongthonl diu ahi. 12 Vo Sohchang kinem jing ho, hung kile kit’un; Nalungmonna mun hinjon’uvin! Nathohgim nau jat nia vangboh dia Tua hi kateppeh nahitauve! 13 Judah hi sepai Thalpin mang ing ting, Isdrael hi Thalchanga Kaman ding ahi. Zion mite chamjam banga kaman’a, Greek mite satna kanei ding ahi,” ati. 14 Pakai amite chungvuma kitahdoh-intin, Athalchang kolphe banga alensah ding; Hatchungnung Pakaiyin sumkon mut’in tin, Lhanglama pat go le huipia hung kitol ding ahi. 15 Thaneipen Pakaiyin amite ngah-intin, Amahon amelmateu asuhgam diu ahi. Galmuna jukhan pen-ohjen jun banguntin, Amelmateu thisan alonsah diu; Kilhaina gan thisan long banga, Maicham phunga khona kisunglha bang ding ahi. 16 Hiche nikho hi haung lhun teng. Pakaiyin amite ahuhhing ding; Kelngoi chingpan akelngoite Thidingsa ahuhdoh bang ding ahi. Lallukhuh a sum-eng pah banga Agamsunga vah jing diu ahitai. 17 Gamsung phat ding le hoi ding je chu! Cahngle lengpitwi vanga khangdong thahat diu ahi.

Zechariah 10

Huhdoh dia Pakai thutep

1 Chavang laiya go juhna din Pakaiyin taovun! Mei kaisah, dai lhahsah chule go juhsah Pakai ahin, mitin dia louma phatsah Amabou ahi. 2 Mihon doi asan’un, phunsan ho pou adongun, jouthu le ngol thubuh bou akimu’ve. Abang bangin mang aleuvin, lam hilou lama napuitauve; nalhamon nau jong pannabei ahi. Hijeh chun mipi hi kelngoi mangsa bangin suhna ding helouvin avah le leuve. Lamkai beiyin hesoh genthei athoh tauve. 3 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Kamite chunga vaipo gamchom miho chunga kalung hange, amaho khu talen kamatsah ding ahi. Jusahte kami ahin, Kei-thaneipen Pakaiyin kivet tep nange. Galsatna sakol hattah banga kanei ding ahiuve. 4 Kamite chunga vaipo ding alah-uva vaihom le lamkai, sepai lamkai sing hung pengsoh ding ahi. 5 Kholai dunga amelmateu bon-ngan lah a chil thang thang sepaite banga Judah miten gal ajo diu ahi. Pakaiyin apanpi jeh-uva gal asat diu, melma sakol touthem ho geiya ajo diu ahi. 6 “Judahte hatsah ing ting, Israelte kahuhdoh ding ahi. Abonchauvin voujang natping ting, In a kahinlepui doh kei ding ahiuve. Kapaidoh khah louhel bang diu, Pakai a-Pathenu kahi, atao nau sang inge. 7 Israel sepai hattah bang diu, Lengpitwi donchima kipah ho bang diu ahi. Hiche agaljo’u hi ason apah-un geljingun tin, Pakai thilbol hi akipapi diu ahi. 8 “Kamite kakoukhom ding, Huhdoh ing ting angaiya katamsah didng ahi. 9 Namtin vaipi lah a thecheh jong leng, Gamla tah a kona eigeldoh diu ahi. Amaho le achateu ahingdoh cheng, In a hung kile kit diu ahi. 10 Egypt le Assyria kona In a kahinpui ding, Agamsunguva kachensah ding ahi. Gilead gam le Lebanon a chensah ing ting, Gamsung pumpi midim ding ahi. 11 Gim hesohna Twikhanglen kinong bangin jot’u jongle, Kei-Pakaiyin twi kinonglai kaphothip ding ahi. Nile lithuh geiya kansah a, Assyria hoitho tah nemlhan tin, Egypt hunei tah jong thabeiya um ding ahi. 12 Kamite hatsah ing ting, Chibai boh a kathua nung diu ahi,” ati. Pakaiyin asei ahitai.

Zechariah 11

Vaipo husete lhuh

1 Vo Lebanon, cedar thing jouse halvamna din Nakotpi chengse hongdoh loiyin! 2 Kap’in maovin, thinggi jouse le Cedar thing ho alhusoh tai; Thing minthangtah tah ho asugamtauve. Bashan phaiya gangpi thing hokap’in maovun! Gammang thimlai atuchaitauve. 3 Vaipote lunghemin akap’ui, aloupi nau amangtai; Sekeie kisen ginpi khu ngaiyun; Achen nau gammang lai Jordan pang atuchaitauve!

Kelngoi chingte ni

4 Pakai ka-Pathenin kajah a, “Thangam dia kikoi kelngoi hon chingpa bangin umin. 5 Aneihon kelngoite thatgam’untin, talen man louva umdiu ahi. Asa kijoh-untin, ‘Vahchoiyun Pakai, ihaodoh tauve!’ tiuvinte. Kelngoi chingho jengin jong adipdappi pouve,” ati. 6 Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Leiset mi khat cha jong khoto taponge. Mihemho hi achunguva vaipote noiya kalutsah ding ahi. Hiche vaipoe hin leiset sugamhel’untin, akhut’uva konin chu-lha ponge,” ati. 7 Kelngoi choa joh hon eithalah-un, thadia kikoi kelngoite kachinge. Tenggol ni kalan, khat chu, “Deichom,” katin, khat chu, “Kipumkhatna,” kati Chuin kelngoi hon kachinge. 8 Kelngoi chingma ma midang thum, eiho jing chunga kalung hangjah-in, lha khat sungin athum’un kasumangtai. 9 Hichun kelngoihon jah a, “Ken naching tapouvinge. Athi thi ding kithi hen. Suhgam ding ding kisugam hen. Amoh ahing cheng jong khat le khat kisumangu hen,” kati. 10 Chuin “Deichom,” kisah tenggol chu kalan, Pakaiyin namtin vaipi to akitepna suhkehna din kahehbongtai, 11 Hiti hin hiche nikho hin kitepna chu akisuhkeh tai. Kelngoi choa le joh hon eive lhi jingun, kathilbol chu Pakaiyin thuseina anei ahe jingui. 12 Ken ajah-uva, “Nanop’u le katohman neipeuvin, nadaule kikoitauvin,” kati. Hijeh chun katohman din dangka somthum eipeuve. 13 Pakaiyin kajah a aseiyin, “Sum chu Houin goukholnaa koiyin,” eiti. Hijeh chun sum dangka somthum hi-manlu tah a agel’u chu-Houin goukholnaa kakoitai. 14 Chuin tenggol nina, “Kipumkhatna,” kiti chu kahehbongin, Judah le Israel kipumkhatna akehtai. 15 Pakaiyin kajah a aseiyin, “Kelngoi chingin pang kit’in, tua napan vang hi pannabeiya napan ding ahi. 16 Mi khat kakelngoite ching din kakoiyin, ahivangin aman mangthah goa kelngoite akithopi poi; amangla ahol pon, mapu jong aboldam poi; ahing cheng jeng jong avahva pon ahi. Athao lai lai akithan, atin kikah abottel kelngoi chingpa chu adana-e! Kelngoi hon adalhatai! Athaneina gal’in asuhbei hel ding, aban tha ngoiya, amitchang jetlem cho ding ahi,” ati.

Zechariah 12

Khonunga Jerusalem lhatdohna

1 Mihem hinsah a, Leiset semdoh, vanthamjol jaldoh Pakai, hiche Pakaiyin Israel thudol asei chu hiche hi ahi. 2 “Jerusalem hi judonna khon tobanga kasemdoh ding ahi; akimvel’a namtin vaipin don’un tin, jukham banga lonle le siu ahi. Jerusalem khopi aumchah tengu, Judah gamsung khopi dang jouse jong min aumchah ding ahi. 3 Hiche phat hi ahung lhun teng, Jerusalem hi songtum gihtah kabahsah a, dopkhang dia doa nammite chu kisanchat diu, vannoi namtin vaipi kithouva adel khum didu ahi. 4 Hiteng chule asakolteu hoh kin ing ting, achunga toute ka-ngolsah soh didng ahi. Judahte vetup ing ting, amelmateu sakolte mit kachotsah ding ahi. 5 Chutah le Judah phunga miten, ‘Jerusalema cheng Thaneipen Pakai Pathenin amite thahat apei,’ ati diu ahi. 6 “HIteng chule Judah phunga mite hi gamkang le changkung go lah a kihal meikou kabahsah a, akinel’a namtin vaipi asuhgam ding ahi. Jerusalem kho mite vang khosunga lung monga cheng diu ahi. 7 “Kei-Pakaiyin amasaa Judah sepaite gal kajosah a, David son le pah, chule Jerusalem sn lom jabolna chu, Judah gamsung san ding sanga thupijo deh lou ding ahi. 8 Chutengle Jerusalema chengte Pakaiyin ngah-intin, alah-uva lhasampen jong David hat’a hat ding ahi. David chilhahten miho chu Pakai vantil, Pathen tah tah banga alamkai diu ahi. 9 Chuteng Jerusalem delkhum dia kigo namtin vaipi koi hile kasuhmang ding ahi. 10 “David chilhahte le Jerusalema cheng midang ho jong hepina le taona Lhagao kasipsoh ding ahi. Mihem asutlihoh chu veuvintin, cha khatseh thijal’a laina tah a kap ho banga alainatpi diu ahi. Chapa peng masapen thi jal’a kap ho bangin lhase tah-in kap’unte. 11 Hiteng chule Jerusalem lunghem ka le mao chu, Migiddo phaiya Hadadrimmon dia lunghema kap ho kagin husa bang ding ahi. 12 Gamsung miten a-inko koa pul adou didu, David insungin a-insung pul adouva, ajiu numeihon pul adou diu; Nathan insungin Nathan insungpul adouva, numeihon jong adou diu; 13 Levi insungin jong Levi insung pul adouva, ajiu numeihon jong adou diu; Shimei insungin jong Shimei insung pul adouva, ajiu numeihon jong adou diu: 14 insung dang dangin jong hitobanga hi ainsung cheh-u pul adouvuva, anumeiteuvin jong pul adou cheh diu ahi.

Zechariah 13

1 “Hiche phat hi ahung lhun teng, David chilhahte le Jerusalem mite chonset le doi houva kona sop theng dia twsam hung put ding ahi. 2 Chuteng gamsunga milimdoi min him him kaphahpoh sah lou ding ahitai. Ki-Themgaosah ho kasuhmanga, milimdoi hou nomna kasuhamng ding ahi. 3 Gaothu seitei tei aumle, Pakai thu seiya kigel’a, ou jeng seipan atilo tei ding chu anule apan aseipeh ding ahi. Gaothu aseipet tah a anule apan asutlih jeng ding ahi. 4 Hiteng chule mu nei Themgaovin ahoithopi lou ding, themgao umchan thoa, mipi lhep lhahna dia Themgao von jong avon lou ding ahi. 5 Hisanga chu, ‘Themgao kahipoi, loubol mi, kahinkhoa lou natong kahibouvin, ‘Na-op le natungtuna mapon ho chu ipijeh ham?’ tia adoh khah le; ‘Kagol kapaite in a eivohnau ahibouve,’ ti hen,” ati.

Pathen kelngoi chingpa tha dia kisei

7 Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo chemjam, thouvin kakelngoi chingpa delkhumin. Thet’in, kelngoite kithe cheh nante. Kamite delkhum ing ting, 8 gamsung mi hop thuma hop ni thigam diu ahi. 9 Chuteng hop khat hingdoh chengchu, meiya dangka kilhatheng bangin, sutheng inge. Sana kipatep bangin patep ing ting, chuteng kahenga hung tao diu, ataonau kasan ding ahi. Kamite ahiu seipeh ing ting, a-Pathenu kahi phongdoh tauvinte,” ati.

Zechariah 14

Jerusalem chule namtin vaipi

1 Thupi tannaa Pakai touna ding nikho anaitai. Chuteng Jerusalem khopi min chomgamintin, namit mu tah a thil chomdoh kihom diu ahi. 2 Jerusale sat din Pakaiyin namtin vaipi koukhomintin, khopi alah diu in jouse achom’uva, numeiho abol thang diu ahi. Mipi keh khat hel sohchanga kitol diu, adangse vang khopi sunga konin kaidoh pouvinte. 3 Chuteng Pakai kipat’a hiche namtin vaipi ho chu asat ding, gollui laiya asat banga asat ding ahi. 4 Chuteng olive molsang, Jerusalem niso lama hung pansantin, olive molsang chu pohkeh a, akah a phaicham lentah umdoh ding ahi. Molsang keh khat sahlama kitolsuh ding ahi. 5 Molsang kehni soa phaichama hi najamdoh diu; Judah lengpa Uzziah khanga ling kihopet’a napu napateu jamdoh banga najam diu ahi. Pakai ka-Pathen chu Vantilto lhonna hung ding ahi. 6 Hiche phat hile dap lou didng, geltwi kai lou ding, 7 mujong thimponte. Janteng jongle khovah jing ding ahi. Itih phat le hitia um ding hi Pakaiyin bou ahei. 8 Hiche teng hile Jerusalema kona twitheng hung longa, akeh khat Twikhanglen twimang dunga lon glut’a keh khatma Mediterranea Twikhanglena long lut ding ahi. Kum lhung hel, chuh le khal’a jong long jing jeng ding ahi. 9 Chuteng leiset pumpia Pakai leng chang ding;mitinin Ama Pathen ahina bangin chibai boh-umtin, min khat’a ahet diu ahi. 10 Sahlam Geba pat lhanglam Rimmon gei, gamsung pumpi kilai Jerusalem kikhang sangpen ding; khopi chu Benjamin kelkot’a pat, masanga kelkot kisem nasa, inning kelkot phungpeh gei ding, Hananel intingvuma pat lengte lengpitwi chilna phung gei ding ahi. 11 Hikoma hi manthah ding ging louhel’a, mipi ho lung mongtah a cheng diu ahi. 12 Jerusalem khopi sat namtin vaipi chunga Pakaiyin natset alansah a, ahing laiya atahsau natset’a monlha ding ahi. Amit’u le aleiguiyu vang monponte. 13 Hiteng chule Pakaiyin abonchauvin kisuh dongsah-intin, kichatmana min akinaipi pen pen abokhum jeng diu ahi. 14 Jerusalem huhna Judahten gal abol diu ahi. Namtin vaipi neile gou-sana, dangka, chule nihchen ponsil-thalhingset’a akichomdoh diu ahi. 15 Sakolte le sakolte, sa-ngongsaote le sa-ngante, melmate ngahmun a gancha jouse chunga tijat umtah natsat lang ding ahi. 16 Jerusalem delkhum namtin vaipi lah a hingdoh amoh chengsen, kumseh le Thaneipen pakai, Leng chu Jerusalema chibai ahung boh diu, lhambuh kut ahung manji diu ahi. 17 Koi to bang nam min Thaneipen Pakai, Leng chu chibai ga boh ding adaule, agamsunguva gotwi lha lou ding ahi. 8 Egypt miten lhambuh kut abol dau le, Jerusalem ache nomlou namtin vaipi chunga lang natseh chu Pakaiyin achunguva alhunsah ding ahi. 19 Lhambuh kut abol daule Egypt mite le namtin vaipi chunga bol hesohna dia hiche natset chu chucheh ding ahi. 20 Hiche nikho chule sakolte khaova jong, “Pakaiya kikatdohsa,” tia kijih cheh ding ahi. Houin sunga anhonna bel ho jeng jong, maicham a khon ho banga theng ding ahi. 21 Jerusalem le Judah gamsunga anhonna bel ho geiya Thaneipen pakai chibai boh teng man dia kikhen ding ahi. Mipin kilhaina sa honna aneidiu ahi. Hiche teng hileh Thenneipen Pakai Houin a kiveimi umlou ding ahitai.

Malachi 1

1 Pakaiyin Israel mipi seipeh dia Malachi jah a asei thu chu hiche hi ahi.

Pakaiyin Israel angailutna

2 Pakaiyin amite jah a, “nangho ka-ngalu jingui,” ati. Amahon, “Iti nei-ngailut’u ham?’ atiuve. Pakaiyin adonbut’in, “Esau le Jacob sopi ahi lhonin, ahivangin Jacob le achilhahte ka-ngailun, 3 Esau le achilhahte vang kahoi. Esau chenna thinglhang gamsung kasuchaiyin, gamsate chenna din kapetai,” ati. 4 Esau chilhah, Edom miten, “Ka-khopi jouse kisuse jongle kisah phat kit tauvinge,” tijongleu; Pakaiyin donbut’intin, “Sapha kit’u hen, kaphet lhah peh diu ahi. Mihon, ‘Migiloute gam,’ atiuve, ‘Tonsot’a Pakai lunghan nam mite,’ ati diu ahi,” tin te. 5 Israelten hiche hi amit tah a amu diu, chuteng amahon, “Israel gam kalpeh a jong Pakaiyin eilunghan’u ahi!” tiuvinte.

Pakaiyin thempuho aphosal

6 tahneipen Pakaiyin thempute jah a aseiyin, “Chapan apa ajabol teiyin, soh-in apu ajatei me. Na Pau Kei idia neijabol dau ham? Nahsah mon neibol’un, ‘Iti nahsah moa kabol’um? Pou neitiuve. 7 kamaicham phunga manmo thil jeng nato jeh-uva nei nahsahmou ahi. Nangho pin, ‘Iti nang jabol louva kakoi diu ham?’ natiuve! Kamaicham thang le dol’a nabol jeh-uva neija louvu ahi. 8 Kakoma kilhaina dia gancha mitcho ham, dammo ham, elbai ham khat nahin kaiyu hi thildih bol’a kigel nahiuvam? Hitobang gancha hingmo hi gam vaipo katnan ganeitem’un! Nakipia nathum thum napeh ding hinam?” ati. 9 Tun themgaopuho, ichunguva Pathen lung lhaina din taovun. Nataonau asan lout eng, nang ho themmo ahibouve. 10 Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Pannabeiya akamaicham phunga mei natikou kou sangun, khattouvin Houin kotpi jouse gakamchah le katitave! Nachunguva kalung lhaipoi; neithilpeh-u sang ponge. 11 Vannoi kolkimvel lhungsoh min eijabol cheh nauve. Muntin a gimnamtui alhuntan’un, santhei dol tah kilhaina thil atoh nauve. Abonchan eijabol cheh-uve! 12 Nanghon vang kamaicham isah louva nabol’uva, deimosa neh le chah todohna nanei jeh-un nahsahmon neikoitauve. 13 Nanghon, ‘Thilto to jong kachimtai!’ natiuvin, nanah neikhon khum’uve. Kahenga to dia nahin kaiyu jong gancha naguh thou ham, adammo ham, a-elbai ham ahi. Hitiho hi kasan peh dia nagel’um? 14 kei peh dia tepsa kelngoi hon lah a kelngoi hoitah tah sel’a, kelngoi hingmoa kilhina boljia eilhem ho chu gaosap chang hen! Ajeh chu Leng loupe tah kahin, namtin vaipin eiging cheh-uve!” ati.

Malachi 2

1 Thaneipen Pakaiyin thempuho jah a aseiyin, “Hiche thupeh hi nangho ding ahi. 2 Natoh nabol chan’uva neijadiu ahi. Kasei na-ngai louvu le kagaosap ding nahiuve. Nachan diu thil ho geiya kagaosap ding ahi. Kathupeh nagel khoh loujeh-uva kagaosapsa jong nahitauve. 3 Natu nachateu telen matsah ing ting, namaiyuva kilhaina gan nathau eh kaloikhum diu-gancha eh puma kakaidoh ding nahiuve. 4 Chutah l ethempuho le Levite to kakitepna suhkeh louna dia hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahetdoh diu ahi. 5 “Kakitepnaa hin hinnop le damtheina kateppeh-in, eijabolna diuva hiche chu kapeh ahi. Hiche lai chun eigingun eijabol nauve. 6 Mi thudih ahil’un, adih lou ahil pouve. Keito kitoh del’in aum’un; amaho she-in thildih abol pouvin, midang ho geiyin thilse abolsah dauve. 7 Min Pathen adih a ahet ding hi thempuhon ahil diu ahi. Kalungdei chu mipin Thempuho koma agahetdoh diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho hi Thaneipen Pakai sole ahiuve. 8 “Tunla Thempuhon lamdih napel tauve. Namihil’un mi tamtah apuisei. Nanghon kakitepna nasukeh tauve. 9 kalungdei nadondauve, kamite nahil tengu langkaina nanei jeh-un, Kenjong ISraelte nahsahmoa ka-umsah ding anhiuve,” ati.

Pathen koma mipi kitahlouna

10 Pa khat lhah ihi louvu ham? Pathen semcheh ihi louvu ham? I-bol’a kha le khat kitepna isuh keh-uva, ipu ipateu le Pthen kitepna nahsahmoa ibol’u ham? 11 Judahten Pathento kitepna asukeh-un, Jerusalem le Judah gam pumpia tijat umtah abol tauve. Pakaiyin a-it pen Houin asuhboh tauve. Pasal hon douhou numeiho akichenpiuve. 12 Hitobang thil bol jouse Pakaiyin Israel lah a konin kaidoh hen, Thaneipen Pakai dia thilto inam miteu lah a pang hih hel’u hen. 13 Hitobang jong hi nabol’ui. Nathilto chengseu asan lou phat’in kap le maovin na-um’un, Pakai maicham phung chu lhi le nap nadiptauve. 14 I-atile nathiltou asanlou nadatmo’uve. Nasenji nakikhenpi jal’uva asan lou ahi. Najinu hcu natibah ahin, Pathen angsunga achunga kitah jing dia kitep ngalta, nakitepna nasukeh tai. 15 Pathenin hiche numei chuto tahsa le lhagao khat’a nagopsa hilou ham? Ipi ngaitoa abol hitam? Pathen midih tah hidia cha le nao naneipi ding ahi. Hijeh chun koiman ajinu kikhenpida hen. 16 Pakai Israel Pathenin, “Nupa kikhen hi kamah ahi. Pasal’in abol thang jong kaseipoi. Hijeh chun najinu chunga kitah jing dia nakitepnau sukeh hih hel’un,” tin aseiye.

Thutan nikho ahungnaiye

17 Nakam tam behseh-un Pakaiyin ajadai. Nangho pin, “Iti eithei chim diu ham? Thaneipen Pakaiyin thilse bolte mipha agel’a, amaho chubou adeijoh ahi,” natiuve. Chuma le, “Thildih bol dia kigel Pathen chu hoiba hitam?” tin nahol’ui.

Malachi 3

1 thaneipen Pakaiyin, “Kalampi semtoh din kasolle sol nange. Chutah le nahol jingo Pakai chu hetman louva a-Houin hun glut jeng ding ahi. Na-nga jingo sole chu hunga kakitepna aphonjal ding ahi,” ati. 2 Ahinla hiche nikho hunglhun tang thoh jou didng koi ham? Ama hung kilah ten ghingdoh ding koi ham? Ama chu ponsop theng dabon hattah le thih gojolna mei-am hatah tobang ahi. 3 Dangka goujol’a suthengpa banga thutam dia hung ding ahi. Thih-khengpan dang ka le dana agojol banga, Pakaiyin thildih apha ato theina diuva, Pakai sole pan Thempuho asuh theng ding ahi. 4 Chuteng masang laiya banga, Judah gam le Jerusalem miten Pakai dia thilto ahinchoiyu chu lung lhaina anei ding ahi. 5 Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Thutan din nalah-uva hung kiphong ing ting, mitpheldoi themho le numei jonpi ho, jouva hettohsah ho, mi tohman lepthol ho, meithaiho le chagate, gamchom mi maljin ho-kinopsahna nei ho, Kei jalou chengse kahehset ding ahi.

Hopsom pehdol

6 “kei hi Pakai, kikhel lou kahi. Hijeh chun nnangho Jacob chilhahte namangthah hel hih laiyui. 7 Malai napu napateu bangin nan ghon jong Kadanthu jouse napeldoh-un nanit tapouve. Hung kile kit’un, nahengu hinjon inge. Nanghon, ‘Naheng kahinjot theina diuva ipi kabol diu ham?’ tin naseiyui. 8 Kadoh nahiuve, min Pathen alepthol theiyam? Alhem ngaipoi, nang hon vang neilhem’ui. Nanghon, ‘Iti kalhep’um?’ natiuve. Hopsoma hop khat le htilto peh dol’in neilhem’ui. 9 Nam pumpin neilepthol jeh-un nabonchau chunga gaosapna achutai. 10 houin a neh le chah lhingset’a koi din hopsom ahop khat lhingkeiyin hinchouyun. Neive patep’un, van a bangkot chengse hongdoh ing ting thilpha jouse nang jeng junga kasun lhah peh ding anhiuve. 11 Nachangdong laiyu ganhingte duhmang sah pong ting, nalengpiguiyu gaboh keikoi ding ahi. 12 Chuteng nagamsungu chen mun pha soh a, namtin vaipin min nun nom nahisah diu ahi. 13 “Kachung change tijat jat um thu naseiyui,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Ahivangin nanghon, ‘Nathudol ipi kaseibeh-um?’ natiuve. 14 Nanghon, ‘pathen kinbol jong pannabei ahi. Asei sei bol jong i-phachom a, i-bolse chunga thaneipen Pakai koma kisih thusei jong ipi phachom ham? 15 Mi hoithote anompen a pang imuukhu me. Migiloute la hao thei keo hilouvin, Pathen phinna monga thilse abol’u jongle ahoidoh thouvui,’ tin naseiyui,” ati. 16 Pakai gingte akihou lim’un, aseiyu Pakaiyin ajatai. Pakai angsunga, Pakai ginga jabolte thudol lakhabu khat’a ajih luttauve. 17 Thaneipen pakaiyin aseiyin, “Amaho hi kamite hi diu, kachaloh ni nil eh, kalhentum chom beh hi di ahi. Akinbol jing chapa chunga mipa hepina dingahiuve. 18 Chuteng kamiten avel’a, midih le migilou kibah louje, kakinbol pa le bol loupe kah a thilsoh amudoh ki tdiu ahi,” ati,

Malachi 4

Pakai Nikho hung lhung

1 Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “mi kiletsah le giloute changpol kavam banga halvamna ding nikho ahung lhunge. Hiche nikho chule kavam’untin, khendoh beihel diu ahi. 2 Nangho kathu nit chengse vang, kamihuhingna thahat nachunguva nisa banga vah-in tin, nisalum midamsah banga nadomlo diu ahi. Bongnou kul’a kilhadoh navah banga najalen diu ahi. 3 Kachaloh ni nil eh migiloute najotho’uva, leivui banga nachotpha diu ahi. 4 “Israelte jui ding Sinai mongsanga kalhacha Mose kapeh kihilna chengse le Danthu ho chule thupeh chengse chu geldoh jingun. 5 “Amavang tijat umtah Pakai ni loupe hung lhun masangin, Elijah Themgao hinsol peh nauvinge. 6 Elijah hin pate le chate akichamsah din gahi; achutiloule nagamsungu kasumanglo ding ahi,” ati.

The New Testament of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ

Matthew 1

Jesu Christa pendol

1 Abraham chilhah David guiya peng Jesu Christa khanggui thusim hitia kisun ahi. 2 Abrahamin Isaac ahingin, Isaac chun Jacob ahinge; Jacob hin Judah le asopi pasal dang ho ahinge. 3 Judah hin Tamara konin Perez le Zerah ahingin, Perez hin Hezron ahinge; Hezron chun Ram ahingin, 4 Ramin Aminadab ahinge; Aminadab chun Nahshon ahingin, Nahshonin Salmon ahinge; 5 Salmonnin Rahab’a konin Boaz ahingin, Boaz hin Ruth a kon in Obed ahinge; Obed hin Jesse ahingin, 6 Jessen David lengpa ahinge. David hin Uriah jinua kon in Solomon ahingin, 7 Solomonin Rehoboam ahinge; Rehoboamin Abijah ahingin, Abijah chun Asa ahinge; 8 Asan Jehoshaphat ahingin, Jehoshaphat’in Joram ahinge; Joramin Uzziah ahingin, 9 Uzziah chun Jotham ahinge; Jothamin Ahaz ahingin, Ahaz chun Hezekiah ahinge; 10 Hezekiah hin Manasseh ahingin, Manasseh chun Amon ahinge; Amonin Josiah ahingin, Babylon lama gal-hinga akai laiyun Josiah chun Jechoniah le asopi pasal dang ho ahinge. 12 Babylon lama gal-hinga akai nungun Jechoniah chun Shealtiel ahingin, Shealtiel chun Zerubbabel ahinge; 13 Zerubbabel hin Abiud ahingin, Abiud chun Eliakim ahinge; Eliakimin Azor ahingin, 14 Azor chun Zadok ahinge; Zadok hin Achim ahingin, Achimin Eliud ahinge; 15 Eliud chun Eleazar ahingin, Eleazarin Matthan ahinge; Matthanin Jacob ahingin, 16 Jacob chun Joseph ahinge; hiche Joseph hi Messiah kiti Jesu hingnu Mary jipa ahi. 17 Hiti hin Abraham a pat Davin gei khang som le khang li ahin, David a pat Babylon lama gal-hinga akai mang geiyu chu khang som le khang li ma ahi kite’e; chule Babylon lama gal-hinga akai manguva pat Messiah pen gei chu khang som le li ahi.

Jesu Christa pen

18 Jesu Christapen um chan chu hiti ahi. Anu Mary cu Joseph to kicheng dinga kitepsa ahinm ahinla akigop masang lhonin Lhagao Thenga kona agai chu Mary hin akihet doh tai. 19 Ahin ajipa joseph hi midih tah ahijeh-in Mary hi lhangphonga mipi seithanga umsah ding a nompon, guh thim cha akitepna lhon suh keh a kikheni din agoi. 20 Joseph-in hitobang lung agel laitah hin Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in mangin akimusah-in, “David chilhah Joseph, Mary khu kipuiya jia nei ding tija hih hel’in; ijeh-inem itile Lhagao Thenga kona gai ahibouve. 21 Chapa khat ahinding, amin Jesu nasah ding ahi; ajeh chu amatah hin amite achonset’uva klna ahuhhing ding ahi,” tin aseipeh-e. 22 thil chicheng hi Pakaiyin Themgao kama aseisa gui lhun theina dinga soh ahin, asei chun, 23 “Ven, nu-ngah chu gaiyin tin chapa khat ahin ding, amin ‘Emmanuel’ kiti ding ahi, Amin hi, ‘Pathenin eiumpiuve,’tina ahi” ati. 24 Joseph a-imut khah phat’in Pakaiya kon Vantil’in ahil bang bangin abol’in, Mary chu ji dingin akipuitai; 25 ahin Maryn chapa ahinahin masangsen nupaa kitimatpina vang aneipi khah hih hel;e, Naosen ahung pen phat’in amun chu Jesu asah tai.

Matthew 2

Niso lama naosen Jesu vea hung ho

1 Judah gama Herod lengpa lal laiyin Bethlehem khopia Jesu ahung pengin, niso lama ahsi umdol hethem mihoJerusalem khopia ahungun, 2 “Judate chunga leng chang dia hung peng naosen chu hoiya um tam? Ama pen jeh a niso lama ahsi hung kilah kamu-va naosen chu chibai boh dinga hung kahiuve,” tin aseiyui. 3 Athudoh-u ajah phat’un Herod lengpa ti Jerusalem mite ti along jing lheh tauve. 4 Hejeh chun Herod’in Thempu pipu ho leh mipi lah a Danthu lekha them ho akoukhom loiyin, “Messiah chu hoiya hung peng ding ham?” tin adonge. 5 Amahon, “Judea gamsung Bethlehem khopia peng ding ahi; ajeh chu Themgaopan hitin asun’e” 6 ‘Vo Judea gama Bethlehem! Judah vaipote lah a itina ma jongleh aneopen nahipoi; Nanga kona kamite Israel lamkai ding khat Hung peng doh dong ahi,’ ati.” Atiuve. 7 Chuphat’in Herod chun ahsi umdol hethem miho chu atimin akimupinm itih phat tah a ahsi hung kilah chu aphochentai. 8 Chujouvin amaho chu Bethlehem lama asol’in, “Cheuvin lang naosen che phat chan gahol doh-un, keijong ka chea chibai kagabohna dinginm namudoh tenguleh neihung seipeh tauvin,” tin athu lhah-e. 9 Lengpa thsei ajah pha’un akipatdoh paiyun, ahin mupeh sau niso lama ahsi chu amasanguva achepeh-in, naosen umna chung aphah phat’in aki-ngai. 10 Ahsi amudoh kit phat’un akipah behseh jenguve! 11 Chuin insunga agalut’u leh naosen chu anu Mary toh agamu thauvinm boh khip cheh-in chiabi aboh tauve. Chujongle agoubomu hongin thil manlu cheh-sana, bego chule myrrh atoh-un, thilpeh hicheng hi apetauve. 12 Herod henglam ahopa kit louhelna diuva Pathenin amanguva ahilchah phat’ in lamchom khat ajuiyun agam olanguva akile kit tauve.

Egypt’a Jesu ajampiu

13 Ahsi umdol hethem miho che nungin, Pakaiya kon Vantil khat Joseph manga akilah-in, “Thouvin, naosen le anu puiyin lang Egypt langa jampinm kahinkou masangsen ta-umpi tan; ajeh chu herod’in naosen hi suhmang din angaiton ahol’e,” ati. 14 Joseph jong athouvin naosen le anu apuiyin janlaiyin Egypt langa ajampin, 15 Herod thi kahsen aga-umpitai. Hitobang thil hi Pakaiyin themgao kama aseisa, “Egypt’a konin kachapa kakoudoh tai,” ati chu guilhunna dinga soh ahi.

Herod’in naosente athagam

16 Ahsi umdol hethem mihon alhim lhah ahetdoh phat’inHerod along hang behseh jeenginm mi asol’in ahsi umdol hethem mihoa kona naosen pen ahetdoh phat chutoh kitoh chet’in asimin, Bethlehem khopi le khovel dunga naosen pasal kum nia lhah noi lames se athagam sah tai. 17 Hechea hin Jeremiah Themgao kama kiseia- 18 “Ramah koa lhaset lunghem Ka le mao ogin nasatah akijan, Rachel in achate aka ka jengin, Athigam tah jeh-un lhepbi jou ahita poi,” kiti chu agui lhung tai.

Egypt gama kona Jesu ahinle puiyu

19 Herod thi nungin Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in, Egypt gama aumna a Joseph chu amangin kimusah-in, 20 “Thouvin, naosen le anu puiyin lang Israel gam jontan, naosen tha dinga hol ho athigam tauve,” ati. 21 Joseph athoupaiyin, naosen le anu apuiyin Israel gamsung jonin ahung kile kit tai. 22 Ahin Judea gama apa Herod khel’a Archelaus leng chan ajah doh phat’in Judea gama chenden ding Joseph akichanm amang ma akihil chah jeh chun Galilee gamsung joh ajonin, 23 Nazareth khopia achengtai. Hiche hi Themgaohon, “Nazareth mi kiti ding ahi,” atiu gui lhunna dia chute ahi.

Matthew 3

John Baptist thuhil lhangsap

1 Hiche lai hin John Baptist thu ahil lhang len, 2 “Nachonset lung khel’unm ajeh chu van a lenggam chun hikom ahinpha tai!” tin asam’e. 3 John hi Isaiah Themgaovin anaseisa; “Gamthip laiya khosam ogin khat’in, “Pakai lampi semtoh-un lang, Alamlen semjangsan koiyinm tin aseiye,” ati chu ahitai. 4 John pon-ah chu sa-ngongsao mul ahin, akonggah savunm a-anneh khaokhote le gam khoiju ahi. 5 Jerusalem khomite leh Judea gam pumpia mi, chule Jordan gamkol sung pimpia konin miho John henga acheuvin, 6 achonset nau aphong cheh-un, Jordan vadunga john khut’in baptize achangtauve. 7 Pharisee ho leh Saducee ho tamtah ama khut’a baptize chang dia hung amu phat;in Johnin ajahuva, “Vo gulse son ho, kho nunga hung lhung ding Pathen lungsatnaa kona jamdoh dia thu namop’u koi peh ham? 8 Nalung khel’u natohgan phongdoh-un; 9 ‘Abraham son kihina chu,’ tin nalah-uva kiholim nan neidauvin; kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathenin hiche song ho geiya Abraham chilhah a asemthei ahi. 10 Thingphung bul tin’a heicha aki phutsoh tai, aga pholou chengse kiphuh lhua meilhum sunga kileh lut ding ahi. 11 Nalung khel’u phot chetna twiya baptize kachansah nahiuvinm kei bana hungpa vang khu keisanga gamchenga chungnung jo ahinm kei hi akengchot te I sut dinga kilom jong kahipoi; ama chun Lhagao Teng le meikonga baptize nachasah diu ahi. 12 Akhut a chang japna achoiyin, phola chang jap ngimsel;in tin, chuteng achangtah ho changsal’a akhum tip ding, asi chengse vang mit thie lou meilhim sunga agovam ding ahitae,” ati.

Jesu Baptize chan thu

13 Hichepet hin Glilee gama konin Jesun Jordan lui ahin jonin, John khut’a bapize chang din ahung tai. 14 Ahivangin John anathu phan, ‘Keijoh nang khut’a baptize kachan dingsih a kei henga nahung tan’e!” anati. 15 Jesun adonbut paiyin, “tun hit hin molso pou pouvinm ajeh chu hitobanga hi Pathen dei chan ibol bulhingsoh ding ahi,” ati, Hichen John jong anomtai. 16 baptize achan jouva Jesu twiya kona apotdoh chunm ama din van akihongin Pathen Lhagao vakhu bang a hung kumlha achunga chu amui. 17 Chuin van a konin o-khat ahung ginginm “Ama hi kachapa deitah ahinm achugna kalung alhai ta ngeiye,” ati.

Matthew 4

Satanin Jesu alhep patep

1 Hiche jou hin Diabol lhep patep dingin Jesu chu Lhagaovin gamthip’ah apui toutai. 2 Nisom li le jan som li geiya an ngol’a aum jouvin Jesu agilkeltai. 3 Hichun alhempatep chu ahungin ajah a, “Pathen chapa nahileh hiche song ho hi changlhah so na dingin seipeh-in,” ati. 4 Jesun adonbut’in “Pathen lekhabua kisun chun Mihem hi changlhah keova hing theilou ding, Pathen kamsoh thuhoa bou hing dinga kisei ahi,” ati. 5 Hichun Diabol’in Jesu khopi thenga apui yin, Houin tingvum asang laiya adinsahin, 6 “Pathen chapa nahileh keleh lha jengin, ‘songa nakisuh khah louna dingin Pathenin a-Vantilte thu pentin akhut’uvin nadom nauvinte,’ tin Pathen lekhabua akisun nai,” ati. 7 Jesun aseipeh paiyin, “Hitin jong, ‘Pakai na-Pathen patep a na -lhep chatvai louhel ding ahi,’ tin akisun’e,” ati. 8 Chujouvin diabol chunmolsang tah khat chunga Jesu apui touvin vannoi leiset lenggam jouse le aloupina chengseu avetsah soh keiyin 9 ajah a, “Kahenga naboh khup’a chibai neiboh le hichengpi hi peng kate.” ati. 10 chutah chun Jesun ajah a, “Chedohin Satan! ‘Pakai na-Pathen chu chibai naboh a, ama jeng bou nahou ding ahi,’ tin Pathen lekhabua akisun bouve!” atitai. 11 Chuphat’in Diabol chun adalhatai. Hichun Vantilte ahungun Jesun angaichatna jouse ahung jenle tauve.

Galilee gama Jesun na atoh pat

12 John songkul a akhum’u ajah phat’in Jesu jong Galilee gam langa akikhindoh tai. 13 Amavang Nazareth kho dalhan achen, Zebulun le Naphtali gamsung, Galilee dillen pang, Capernaum khoa apansai. 14 Hitia aum hi Isaih Themgao kama kiseisa; 15 “Zebulun gam le Naphtali gam, Jordan gal’a Twikhanglen lampi; Namtin vaipi chenna Galilee, 16 Muthim lah a chengten Khovah vah tah amutauvin; Thina muthim gama chengte chunga Kho ahung vah tai,” kiti chu gui lhunna dinga chuti ahi. 17 Hichelaiya pat chun Jesun thu ahil lhanglen, “Van a Lenggam chun ahinphatai, nachonset lung khel’uvin,” ati.

Jesun nga man pasal li akou

18 Galilee dillen panga Jesu ava le le pet’in nga man mi ni Peter kitipa Simon le anaopa Andrew Twikhanglen a lensep pet amui. 19 Chuin ajah lhona, “Neijui lhonin mihem matje hil lhon inge,” atileh; 20 alen lhon dalhan Jesu ajui pai lhontai. 21 Ache kit leh ucha chom dang ni, Jacob le anaopa John kiti Zebedee to len anakhui phat pet’u amun, amani jong akouve. 22 Jacob le Johnin kong le apa Zebedee dalhan nung ajui lhontai.

Jesun jai kin abolpeh

23 Galilee gam pumpia Jesu ache le len japi houkhomna in tin ah thu ahil len, Lenggam Kipana Thupha aseiphong len, mipilah a nat jat chom choma na ho aboldamin ahi. 24 Chutah chun Syria gam pumpia achung chang thu athangsoh tan, nat jat chom choma naa, natthoh lel, thilhavop, buh thi chule langthi ho jouse Jesu henga ahinpuiyun aman aboldamsoh keitai. 25 Chutjongle Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea gam le Jordan gal langa konin mipi tamtah-in Jesu nung ajuitauve.

Matthew 5

Molvuma Jesu thuhil

1 Mipi amu phat’in Jesu molvuma akaltouvin atou leh aseijuite ahenga ahung kikhomtauve. 2 Hichun Jesu apaodoh-in mipi thu ahil’in hitin aseiye:

Nopna tahbeh

3 “Lhagaova chimthih neilou ho anun nom’ui, Van a Lenggam chu amahoa ahi! 4 Lung lengvai ho anun nom’ui, Pathenin alhamon diu ahi! 5 Milung neng ho anun nom’ui, Amahon leiset alo diu ahi! 6 Pathen dei holna gilkel dangchah thoh ho anun nom’ui, Pathen deiya lung nachim diu ahi. 7 Mi hebol ho anun nom’ui, Pathenin amaho ahebol ding ahi. 8 Milung theng ho anun nom’ui, Amahon Pathen amu diu ahi. 9 Mi sucham ho anun nom’ui, Pathen chate kiti diu ahi. 10 Pathen dei boljeh a bolset thoh ho anun nom’ui, Van a Lenggam amahoa ahi. 11 “Keima jal’a min nabolset, nahouset’uva chule nang ho douna jouthu le thu gilou ijakai naseikhum tengu leh anun nom nahiuve. 12 Hitobang tah a hi nang ho sanga masajo Themgao ho jong anabol setsau ahitai! Kipah-un tha nom’un, van a nasan diu kipaman tampi akikoiye.

Chi le meivah

13 “Nang ho leiset chi nahiuve. Chi khu tamtah le ipia ki-alsah kit ding ham? A-al lou teng panna bei ahitan, akipai mang jin, min keng chotphan aneijitai. 14″Nang ho vannoi salvah nahiuve. Molchunga khopi kisem chu akisel theipoi. 15 Koiman thaomei avah-in lo akhu khum ngaipoi, thaomei khom chunga atungin insunga um jouse asalvahsoh keijie. 16 Hitobang chun navah-u miho masanga kilang hen, chutileh min natoh phat nau muntin, van a um na-pau avahchoi diu ahi.

Jesun Danthu umdol ahilna

17 “Kei hi Mose Danthu l eThemgao ho thuhil sumang dia hungin neigel hih hel’un, asumang ding hilouva amolso ding joh a hung kahibouve. 18 Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, van l eleiset man kahse le thil jouse bei kah sea Danthu kisun lekhajem neopen le ahalsi khat jeng jong mang lou ding ahibouve. 19 Hijeh a chu hiche thupeh lah a aneopen khat susea, midang jong chu tibol dinga hilchan chu van a Lenggama aneopen a pang ding, chu tobangma a anit them le midangin anit themna dinga hilchan chu van a Lenggama alen a kisei ding ahi. 20 Chuti ahijeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, Danthu them ho le Phrisee ho sanga nathem chan nau achung nun joh loule van aLenggamma nalut louhel diu ahi.

Lunghan thudol’a Jesu thuhil

21 “‘Tol natah lou diu ahi, koi hijongle tol that chu achung thu kitan ding kicha jing ding ahi,’ tia malai mite jah a kiseisa chu najtauve. 22 Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hijongle asopi chunga lung hang chan chu achung thu kitan ding kicha jing ding ahi; chu jongle koi ahi asopi jah a, ‘Pananbei’ tia house jouse chu hou vaipoloi kikhopnaa athu kitan ding kipha lam jinga, chule asopi jah a, ‘Panabei mi-ngol’ tia house chan jong damun neidil’a lut ding kicha geova um ding ahi. 23 Hijeh chun maicham phunga thiltoh din hung t ajongle chun, chua chu nasopi nachunga lung himona nageldoh leh, 24 maicham maiya nathilto ding dalhan, nasopi chutoh gakicham masan, chujou teng hung kit’in lang thil chu Pathen koma toh-in. 25 “Naheh pan thutanpu heng nalhut masangin lampia kichampin, achuti loule thutanpa koma nakai lut’in tin, thutan pan songkul ngah pa pehdoh-in natin, aman songkul’a nakhum lo ding ahi. 26 Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, paisa nongnai geiya napeh theng hel masangin songkul’a koin potdoh thei pon nate.

Numei le pasal kijonbol thua Jesu thuhil

27 “‘Mito najon lou ding ahi,’ tia kisei chu najatauve. 28 Ken vang kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hijongle numei jon lung gul’a vea chun alungthima ajonpi ahitai. 29 Hijeh chun namit jelamin nachon setah l ekaldoh-in lan gpai mang jengin; tahsa pumpia damun a nakile lut sangin, natibah khat lhin lel ding aphajoi. 30 Nakhut jetlamin nachonset sah jong le sat lhan pai mang jengin, tahsa pumpia damun a nakile lut sangin natibah khat lhin lel ding aphakoi.

Kida thudol’a Jesu thuhil

31 “‘Koi hileh ajinu daa chun jida na lekha pehen,’ kitisa ahi. 32 Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, mito ajonjeh tilouva jida chan chun ajinu ajonso ahin, dasa numei kichenpi jong chu mito jong-ah ahi.

Kihahsel thudol’a Jesu thuhil

33 “Chukit leh, ‘Nakitepna sukeh hih-in, nakitepna jat chu Pakai koma molson,’ tia malai mite kiseipeh chu najatauve. 34 Kenvang nahihahsel louhel diuva kaseipeh nahiuve; van panin kihahsel dauvin, Pathen laltouna mun ahi, 35 Leiset panin jong kihahsel hih-un Pathen kengto ngapna ahi, Jerusalem panin kihahsel dauvin, Leng loupi khopi ahi, 36 naluchang jong panin kihahsel dauvin, nasamjang khat jeng jong nakansah navomsah theipouve. 37 Naseiyu chu ahile hijeng hen, ahida l ehida jeng hen; hiche kalval vang hcu Agiloupaa kon ahibouve.

Phulah thudol’a Jesu thuhil

38 “‘Mit khel’a mit, ha khel’a ha,’ tia kiseisa chu najatauve. 39 Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, Agiloupa chu lethuh hih-un, chusangin nangeiphe jet lem benga chu naveilam jong dopeh-in. 40 Hehset’a nasongkhol sung nung lah peh ding gopa chu nasangkhol ponungalenpa geiyin peh than. 41 Koi hile nada nacham louva mile khat napuigoa chu mile ni geiyin kilhonpin. 42 Nahenga thil thuma chu pen, bat ding deiya jong peh louvin koidan.

Melmate ngaitlut ding

43 “‘Naheng nakom ngailut’a melma vang nahot ding ahi,’ tia kiseisa chu najatauve. 44 Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, Namelmateu ngailu’vin, nabolse jouseu taopehun; 45 chutilh van a um na-Pau chate nahi theidiu ahi. Ajeh chu Aman migilou le mipha chunga kibangin nisa asat sah gel’in, midih le midih lou chunga go ajuhsah gel’e. 46 Ahimonga jong na-ngailute bou na-ngailut’u leh ipi kipaman namu diu ham? Kaidong chonse hon jong chutia abol’u hi louham? 47 Chule nasopi bou nasalam’u leh midang sanga nachungnun nau ipi um am? Pathen heloute jengin jong chutia abol’u hilouham? 48 Hichejeh chun vana um na-Pau chamkimsoh banga naphat chamkimsoh diu ahi.

Matthew 6

Pathen thilto thua Jesu thuhil

1 “Houva nakitah nau miho mu ding deina nabol louna diuvin ching theiyun. Chutia nabol vangu leh van a um na-Pava kona kipaman nanei lou diu ahi. 2 “Mi thil napeh teng, mipha lhem hon pachat deinaa Hou thua kikhopna in tin le lam lhong tin’a abol bangun, namasang sanga sumkon kimut bahsah hih hel’in. Dihtah a kaseipeh nahiuve, amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai. 3 Mi thil napeh tengleh, nathilpeh chu guh thim ahi theina din nakhut jetlama napeh chu veilam jeng jong hetsah dan. 4 Chutileh guh thima vejing na-Pan kipaman napeh tei ding ahi.

Taona thudol’a Jesu thuhil

5 “Natao tengu leh mipha lhem ho toh bang hih-un, amahon mi mu ding deinan Hou thua kikhopna in tin a dindoh a tao le kholai lamkon dunga din a tao ding bou adeiyui. Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai. 6 Nang vang natao teng, na-indan sunga lut’in, kotpi kikam khumin, mit’a mu thei lou na-Pa hengah guh thimin taojon; chutileh guh thima vejing na-Pan kipaman pejon nate. 7 “Natao tengu le chidang namdang ho bangin tampi kisei chu ajah chom ding ngaiton thu hom keo tamtah seidauvin. 8 Amaho umchan tho hih-un; ajeh chu nathum masanguva jong na-pauvin na-ngai chat jouseu ahetsa ahitai. 9 Hijeh chun hiti hin taovun: ‘Van’a um ka-Pau, namintheng kijabol jing hen, 10 Nalenggam hung lhung hen, Van’a bangin leiset’a nalungdei kim soh hen; 11 Tunia kaneh khop diu an neh neipeuvin, 12 Eibolseteu ka-ngaidam bangun, Kasuh khelnau ngaidamin; 13 Chonset lona thei patepna neilhut dauvin, Agiloupaa konin neihuhdoh jo’uvin,’ tin. 14 “Ajeh chu mi suhkhel na-ngaidamu leh van a um naPauvin jong nasuh khel nau ngaidamin te. 15 Mi suh khel na-ngaidam lou vanguleh, na-pauvin jong nasuh khel’u ngaidam ponte.

An ngol thudol’a Jesu thuhil

16 “An na-ngol tengu mipha lhem ho bangin ki-nguisah dauvin. Mipha lhem hon vang an angol’uvin, mi het ding deinan amaisou achom sah jiuve. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai. 17 Nangin vang an na-ngol teng nalu thao kinujol’in, namai kiphet ngimjon; 18 na-anngol chu miho hetsah louvin, guh thima um, na-Pa hetsah in; chutileh guh thima vejing na-Pan kipaman pejon nate.

Van gama goukhol

19 “Nget le thih-eh suhmang theina, guchan aphet vanga aguh mang theina leiset chunga gou khol hih-in; 20 chusangin nget le thih-eh suhmang thei louna, guchan jong aphet vanga aguh mang thei louna van a gou khol jo’uvin. 21 Ijeh-inem itile nagou umnaa chu nalung cheng jing ding ahi.

Mihem tahsa meivah

22 “Mit hi tahsan meivah ahin, namit chim leh natahsa pumpi vahsoh ding ahi. 23 Namit aphat lou vang leh natahsa pumpi thim jeng ding ahi. Hijeh chun nasunga vah thim taleh iti khoh ding hitam!

Pathen chule nei le gou

24 “Soh koiman Pakai ni kin abolkop joupoi, kop taleh khat hotbol’in tin, khat joh alungset ding, ahiloule khat’a hakaiya khat joh anahsahmo lo ding ahi. Hijeh chun Pathen kinbol le sum hol kop thei pouvin nate. 25 “Hichejeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, hinkhoa neh le chah chunga lungkham bol dauvin, tahsa sille chen dingin jong lungkham hih-un; anneh twidon sanga hinkho thupi joa, nihchen ponsil sanga tah sa khoh jo hilou ham? 26 Vanlai jol’a akhol sampouvin, hijongle changsal’a akhol sampouvin, hijongle van a um na-Pauvin avah nauve. Vachate sanga khu nang ho manlu jo nahi louvu ham? 27 Nalah-uva lungkham hat’a ahinkho tong khat jopbe thei koi nahiuvam? 28 I-bol’a nihchen ponsil jal’a lungkham nahiuvam? Gamlah apahcha ho khu iti khandoh ham gel phauvin, na la atong pouvin, sil ding patse bol’a ponkhong jong ahipouve; 29 ahinla kaseipeh nahiuve, Solomon jeng jong ahao dungjui tah akijep vangin hiche pahcha ho khat hoi bangin ahoi joupoi. 30 Gamlah hampa tunia kimu, jing teng gop’a meilhum sunga kileh lut ta ding bon Pathenin achuti jep hoi leh, Aman hiche ho sanga najep hoijoh lou diu ham? Vo tahsan lhomho! 31 Hijeh chun, ‘Ipi kanehuva ipi kadon diu, ipi kasil’uva akchen diu ham?’ tin lungkham dauvin. 32 Hicheng hi Pathen hepha louten ahol’un, Nang hon na-ngai chat’u jong van a um na-Pauvin ahesoh keiye. 33 Hijongle amasan Pathen dei le alenggam hol masauvin, chuteng adang ho chengse hi nakipehbe dingu ahinai. 34 Jing dingin lungkham hih-un, jing chun anikhoa ding hinkigel nan e. Nikho khat cheh-in agimpi khop cheh anei nai.

Matthew 7

Midang oimoa athu khol

1 “Oimo nachan louna diuvin midang oimo dauvin; 2 mithu nakhol bang banga nathu kikhol cheh ding ahin, midang nabol nau dan dungjuiya kibol ding nahiuve. 3 Ipi dinga nasopi mit’a bohsi chu namelchih keova, nang mit’a thing long tejen chu mulouva um nahin? 4 Iti jong nasopi jah a, ‘Namit’a bohsi chu neilahdoh sah-in,’ tia nasei ngam a, nang mit’a thing long tejen chu don louva um nahim? 5 Vo mipha lhem, namit’a thinglong tejen chu kilahdoh masah l echun nasopi mit’a bohsi chu muchenin natin, ladoh thei tan nate. 6 Thil theng chu uichate peh dauvin, hung kiheiya nape lou diu ahi; vohchate masanga jong natwikoh chang sep lha hih-un, akengtoa achil thang bep diu ahi.

Thumin, hol’in, kiuvin

7 “Thum’un kipauvin nate, hol’un namudiu ahi; kiuvun nakihonpeh diu ahi. 8 Ijeh-inem itile athum chan kipe ding, ahol’an amuding akiuva kihonpeh ding ahi. 9 Nalah-uva achapan neh ding changlhah athum l esong pea, 10 nga athum leh gul peding koiham? 11 Migiloutah nang hon bon nachateu thilpha pehje nahet’uleh, van a um na-Pauvin ahenga thumte chu itobang tah a thilpha apeh ding hitam! 12 Hijeh chun min iti nabol le nadeiyum, nang hon jong hitobnagma chun bolpeh-uvin, hitia bolding hi Danthule themgaote thuhil to kitoh ahi.

Kotjim

13 “Kot jim a lut’un, ajeh chu manna lam chu akot lentah ahin, alampi alenin, mitamtah hichea chun alut’ui. 14 Hinna lam chu akot jong akichin, alampi ahah-in, hijeh chun alut’a mi lhomcha ahiuve.

Thingphung agan akihei

15 “Kelngoi phat’a kiphatsah, asung lam ngeihang tah tobang Themgao lhem nahenguva hungji ho koma kichih theiyun. 16 Itobang ahiu atohgauva nahet diu ahi.Ling phunga lengpi theiga kilouva, meithai seltho linga theichang ga ikilou ngaiyam? 17 Hitobang hin thing phung phalou ga aphapoi. 18 Thingphung phaa ga pha lou ga ngai lou, thing phung phalouva jong ga pha ga ngai lou ahi. 19 Aga phalou thingphung jouse chu akiphuh lhun meilhum sunga akileh lutjitai. 20 Hijeh a chu mi atohgauva nahetdoh diu ahi.

Ken kahekhapouve

21 “Pakai, Pakai eiti chan chu van a lenggam lut lou ding, van a um ka-Pa deilam bol’a bou lut ding ahi. 22 Hiche Nikho chuleh mi tamtah hunguva, ‘Pakai, Pakai, keiho namin a gaothu seisa, thilha nodohsa chule thil kidang bolsa kahilouuvu ham? ati diu ahi. 23 Chuteng ajah-uva phong tah a, ‘Vo Dan dih lou bolte, kakoma konin potdoh louyun, nang ho kahe kha hih hel’ui,’ kati ding ahi.

Bul kiphu gotni

24″ Chuti ahijeh chun kathusei hiche hi ja a bol’a chu mi lungthim pha, song chunga in kisah to kitekah ding ahi. 25 Gon ajuh khuma, vadung in aso den a, huipin ahin mut vangin, hiche in chu aluden poi; ajeh chu a-inbul khom songpi chunga kiphut det chet ahi. 26 Kathusei hicheng hi ja abol lou vang chu milungthimbei, nellei chunga in kisah toh kitekah ding ahi. 27 Gon ajuh khuma, vadungin aso den a, huipin amut tengleh in chu alhujitan, alhuh chu melse tah ahi,” ati.

Jesu thanei dol

28 Jesun chujat asei chai chaiyin mipin athuhil chu kidang asa lheh jenguvin ahi. 29 Ijeh-inem itile aman Danthu themho hil banga hil louva thunei tah banga ahil jeng thei ahi.

Matthew 8

Jesun miphah khat asuh theng

1 Jesu molvuma ahung kumsuh chun mihonpin ahin juiyui. 2 Hichun miphah khat ahungin akoma bohkhup’in, “Pakai, nalung ahileh neidam theng sah thei ahi,” ati. 3 Jesun athamin, “Kalung ahinai damthengtan,” ati leh, apettah chun aphahnat adamthengtai. 4 Chuphat’in Jesun ajah a, “Koimacha henga seidoh hih hel’in, amavang chen lang Thempu gakivetsah-in, nadamtheng hi phot chetna din Mose thu peh dungjuiyin nathilto ding lom gatoh tan,” tin ahil’e.

Jesun sepai jalamkaipa lhachapa adamsah

5 Jesu Capernaum khoa alut chun sepai jalamkai khat ahenga ahungtaovin, 6 “Pakai, in a um kalhacha chapang khat langthin agen thei lheh jenge,” ati. 7 Jesun, ajah a, “Hung damsah nang e,” atileh; 8 jalamkaipan adonbut’in, “Pakai, nang hi kei in sunga lut dinga kilom nahipoi, thu mai mai sei jong le chun kalhacha chapang chu dam jeng thei ahinai. 9 Ajeh chu kei jong thunei ho noiya um kahin, kei noiya jong sepaite aum’uvin, khat pen pen jah a, ‘Chen,’ katile achen; achom dang khat jah a, ‘Hungin,’ katil eahunge; chule kalhacha jah a, ‘Hiche hi bol’in,’ katileh, abolji nai,” ati. 10 Athujah hi Jesun kidang asa behseh jengin, anunga hung ho jah a, “Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Israelte lah jenga jong hitobnag tahsan len kamudoh hih laiye. 11 Hi jeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, niso lam le nilhum lama kon a mitamtah hung kikhom’uva van a Lenggam a Abraham le Isaac chule Jacob toh ankong aumkhom diu ahi. 12 Ahin lenggam chate dia kigel ho joh chu polam muthim lah a kileh lut diu, hikoma chu ka le hagel um ding ahi,” ati. 13 Chuin Jesun jalamkaipa jah a, “Chetan, natahsan banga lhung ding ahinai,” atipeh-e.

Jesun Peter nupanu adamsah

14 Jesu Peter insunga alut leh, Peter nupanu nat lhut’a na a lum agatoh khai. 15 Jesun akhut agah tham leh anat lhut chun alhan, amanu ahung thoudoh paiyin ajen len apangtai. 16 Nilhah lamin thillhavop mi tampi Jesu henga ahin puiyun, Aman thu cheng khatseh seiyin thilhaho anodoh-in, damloute adamsah soh keitai. 17 Hitobang kiseisa, “Aman inatna jouseu le iveiset chengseu akilah-in apomangtai’” kiti chu guilhunna dinga chutiso ahi.

Jesu seijui lom

18 Akimvel’a mipi kikhom amudoh phat’in Jesun dil gal lang khat’a galkai ding asomtai. 19 Hichun Danthu lekha them khat ahungin ajah a, “Houhil, nache che naa juiyinge,” ati. 20 Jesun ajah a, “Gam-uiten ko aneiyun, chunga leng vachaten bu aneiyui; mihem Chapan mun aneipoi,” ati. 21 Seijuiho lah a khat’in, “Pakai amasan kapa vui din neisol tadin,” ati. 22 Jesun ajah a, “Neijui jengin, mithi hon athilongu kivui nauvinte,” ati.

Jesun dil kinonglai aphothip

23 Jesu kong sunga alut’in aseijuiten akilhonpiuve. 24 Hetman louva dilpi chu khopihui hattah-in ahin nuh leh, twi kinongin kong chu achup pai ding ahitai. Jesu vang aihmu nalaiye. 25 SEijuiten agasukhang loiyun, “Pakai neihuhhing loiyun twiyin eichup lih diu ahitai!” atiuve. 26 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Vo tahsan lhom ho idia chuti kichat nahiuvem?” atin, athoudoh-in khopihui le dillen chu haphoa apho leh athip del jenge! 27 Mihon adatmo soh keiyun, “Ipi mi bep hiya hui l edillen geiyin athu angai jeng hitam!” atiuve.

Jesun thilhavop mi ni adamsah

28 Jesu agalkaiya Gadara gamsung alhunin, lhankhuh lah a hung kon thilhavop mi nin akimutopi lhon’e. Thilhavop te ni chu kichat aum behseh jeh-in aumna lhon lampi chu koiman ahopa ngampoi. 29 Amani apengjah lhonin, “Vo Pathen Chapa, ilo ding neitiu ham? Akitep Phat lhin masanga keiho bolgentheiya hung nahim?” ati lhon’e. 30 Akom’uva kon chun muphah don khat’a hin vohcha tampi hon khat alhai. 31 Thilhahon ahenga, “Neikaidoh tei diu leh hiche vohchate sunga khun neisol’uvin,” tin ataovui. 32 Jesun “Lut tauvin,” ati phat’in, ahung potdoh-un vohchate sunga aluttauve. Chutah chun Vohhonpi chu ha-lhaiyin alhaiyun, kol’ah a alhai lhauvin, dil sunga achomlut soh hel’auvin, twi lah a athidentauve. 33 Chuphat’in vohcha ching ho kho sunga ajamlut’un, thilhavop te ni chunga thusoh le athilmu jouseu agaseisoh tauve. 34 Chutah chun kho sung mite abonchan Jesu henga ahungun, Ama chu agamsunguva kona potdoh din ajoltauve.

Matthew 9

Jesun pasal langthi khat aboldam

1 Jesu konga alut’in, ahung kile tol galkaiyin khopi sung ahung lhungtai. 2 Hichea hin mihon pasal langthi khat alupna pumin Jesu henga ahinpuiyui. Jesun atahsanu amuchet phat’in langthipa jah a, “Kihol lel hih-in chapa, nachonset jouse ki-ngaidam ahitai,” ati. 3 Hichun Danthu lekha them phabep’in, “Hichepan Pathen ataitom’e,” tin agel’ui. 4 Alung gel’u Jesun ahen, “Idia hitobang thilse nagel’u ham? 5 ‘Nachonset aki-ngaidamsoh tai,’ ti leh “Thouvin lam jottan,’ ti hoijoh seibai jom? 6 Leiset chunga Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna tha anei kavetsah nahiuve,” atin, lang thipa jah a, “Thouvin, nalupna kilah-in na-inlam jontan,” ati. 7 Langthipa akipatdoh paiyin inlam ajontai. 8 Mipin hiche hi amu phat’un akichauvin, ahinvangin mihemte chunga hitobang thaneina pea Pathen avahchoitauve.

Jesun Matthew akou

9 Jesun hikom chu dalhan ache leh Matthew kiti mi khat a kaidonna mun a tou amun, ajah a, “Neijuiyin,” atileh; Matthew akipatdoh-in ajuitai. 10 Matthew in a Jesun ankong aum phat’in kaidong ho tamtah l ethet umtah tah miho ahungun Jesu le aseijuite toh ankong aumkhom’uve. 11 Pharisee hon hichu amuphat’un aseijuite jah a, “I-bol’a na Houhil pauvin kaidong ho le thet um tah tah ho to an aneh khom ham?” tin adongui. 12 Jesun aseiyu ajan, “Midamin louthem angaipon, adam louvin bou angaiye. 13 Keiman hepina bou kangeh-in, kilhaina ka-ngeh poi,’ kiti hi ipi kiseina ham gakhiltoh-un. Ajeh chu midohho kouva hung kahipon, chonset kouva hung joh kahibouve,” ati.

An-ngol thudol’a kidohna

14 John seijuite Jesu henga ahungun, “I-atileh keiho le Pharisee hon an-ka-ngol mat chet juva, nang seijuiten an ngol khah louvu ham?” tin ahung dongui. 15 Jesun adon but’in, “Kichen golvahna hung lha ho chu aji neipan alenkhomi laisea lunhham ngaiyam? Amavang aji neipa akom’uva kona akipui mang nikho hung lhung ding ahin, chutengleh kichen golvah a hung lha hon an ngol diu ahinai. 16 “Koiman sopnem loulai ponhal’in ponlui abeh ngaipoi, beh leh abehnan pon lui chu bot-eh jontin, haset cheh lo ding ahi. 17 Chujongle min savun peng lui sunga jong lengpitwi thah akhum ngaipoi, khum ta leh alengpitwi pen gchu tumkeh intin, lengpitwi long jal’a apeng jong mang lo ding ahi. Hijeh chun lengpitwi thah chu savun peng thah a akikhum jin, lengpitwi le apeng anigel’in ahoidoh theiye,” ati.

Vaihompa chanu le jesu pon thamkha numei

18 jesun hiche hi asei nalaiyin, vaihom pasal khat akom’a ahung bohkhup’in, “Tutah chun kachanu athitai, hinla hungin achunga na khut ngamle chun hingkit teiyinte,” tin ataove. 19 Jesu akipatdoh paiyin vaihompa to akilhon phat’in aseijuiten jong ajuitauve. 20 Lampia chun kum som-le kum ni thi longa dammi numei khat hi Jesu nunga ahungin apon mong kai atham’e. 21 Amanu kigel’a chu, “Apon mong jeng jong thamkha len gdam inge,” ati ahi. 22 Jesu agah kihei leh numei nu chu amun, “Kihol lel hih-in chanu, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai,” ati. Hiche pet tah chun ama nu adamsel tai. 23 Jesu vaihompa in a alut leh thi-opna akuli mut h leh mipi poh chei choiya um amun, 24 “Nabonchan potdoh-un, chapangnu hi athi-ah ahipoi, a-ihmu ahibouve,” atileh amahon amoh nuisat atauve. 25 Hinla mipi adeldoh phat’in Jesu insunga alut’in, chapangnu chu akhut’a akaileh chapangnu athudoh tai. 26 Hiche thusoh hi chuche gamsungse sea akithangsoh tai.

Jesun mitcho ni kho amusah

27 Chukom dalha a Jesu acheleh, mitcho mi nin ajui lhon’in, “Vo David chapa neilungset’in,” tin asam lhontai. 28 Insung khat’a agalut phat’in mitcho tenin jong ajuilut lhontai. Hichun Jesun ajah lhon’a, “Namit lhon hahsah thei ding monga neitahsan lhon ham?” atileh; amanin jong, “Henge Pakai!” ati lhon’e. 29 Chuphat’in Jesun amit lhon athampeh-in, “Natahsan lhon bang in mit hah lhontan,” atileh; 30 hichun amitlhon ahah paitai. Jesun amani akham chah kheh-in, “Koima hetsah-lhon hih beh-in,” ati. 31 Mitchote ni chula apotdoh lhonin chuche gamkol sungse seah Jesu thudol athechansoh lhontai.

Jesun paomo khat apaosah thei

32 Agah potdoh-u leh thilhavop mi paomo khat Jesu henga ahinpuiyui. 33 Jesun thilha anodoh peh phat’in paomopa apaothei paitai. Chutah chun mipin kidang asauvin, “Israelte lah jenga jong, hitobang thil akimu kha hih laiye,” atiuve. 34 Pharisee hon vang, “Thilha lengpa vanga thilhate adeldoh hichume,” atiuvin ahi.

Jesun mipi akhoto

35 Jesun khopi jouse l ekhoneo jouse achonsoh keiyin, Houthua kikhopna intin a thu ahil len, Lenggam Kipana Thupha ahil lhangin, veise dammo jouse aboldamin ahi. 36 Jesun mipi avet leh alainatpi lheh-e. Ajeh chu achingbei kelngoite bangin gim le da athoh-un, apan hu diu aumpoi. 37 Hijeh chun Jesun aseijuite jah a, “Chang-at ding atam lheh nan, natonga alhom’e, 38 chang-at ding mi ahinsol be na din chang-at thunei Pakai henga taovun,” ati.

Matthew 10

Solchah som le ni

1 Jesun aseijui som le ni chu akoukhomin, lhagaoboh ho deldohna ding le dammo veiset jouse boldam theina tha aei. 2 Solchah som le ni ho min chu: amasapenin Peter kisah Simon le asopipa Andrew ahin, adang Zebedee chapa t eni Jacob l easopipa John, 3 Philip l eBartholomew, Thomas, kaidongpa Matthew, Alpheus chapa Jacob, Thaddaeus, 4 Canaan mi Simon, chule Jesu matsah a pang Judas Iscariot-hicheng hi ahiuve.

Seijui som le ni kisol lo na

5 Som le ni asoldoh chun Jesun hitin ahilchah-e: “Chidang nam dangte gamsung le Samaria mite khoi ho jot dauvin. 6 Kelngoi mang sa tobang Israel insung mite henga chejo’uvin. 7 Nache pum pum’un, ‘Van a Lenggam chun hikom ahin phatai,’ tin samleuvin. 8 Ana damsah-un, mithi kaithouvun, aphah suthengun, thilha nodoh-un, manbeiya nakisanu ahi, manbeiyin homjal’un. 9 Nasum dip sunga sana, dangka sumsan kipoh sauvin; 10 cholam ding sum thumna din sakhao jen gjong kendauvin, sangkhol tho ni ah hih-un, kengchot hihen tenggol hileh kendauvin. Ajeh chu natong’an aneh ding amu lom ahi. 11 “Khopi hihen khoneo hileh naphah phah nauva nalhunsah nom miu holdoh-un, chukom nadalhah kahseuvin umpiuvin. 12 Nalut lut nau insung jah a, ‘Lungmon leng hen,’ tin salam cheh-uvin. 13 Insung khattaouvin lamtoa nalhunsah-u leh salam’un lang, nalhunsah nom lou vangu leh salam datauvin. 14 Insung khattou le khopi khattouvin lamto loule lhunsah da akop’uva, nathu seiyu jong angaidau leh, nakengphanguva leivui geiyin thin lhah khum’un dalhauvin. 15 Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, Thupi tan nikho leh chuche mun mite thoh ding sanga Sodom le Gomorrah khopi thoh baijjo ding ahi.

Bolsetna hung lhung ding

16 “Veuvin, ngeihon lah a kelngoi kilha lut banga kasol nahiuve. Hijeh chun gul bangin ching theiyun, vakhu bangin lung nem’un. 17 Chingtheiyun, mihon man’uvin natin Hou vaipoloi kikhopna nakai lut diu, Houthua kikhopna in dunga najep diu ahi. 18 Keima jal’in vaipote le leng ho anga kailut’un tin, hinla amaho le chidang namdangte henga kathupha hettohsah a napan diu ahi. 19 Hitia nakailut tengu leh nasei diu le nasei ding dol’un lung kham hih-un, apettah leh kipenauvin nate. 20 Ajeh chu nalunggel mai mai nasei diu ahipon, nasunguva cheng na-Pau Lhagao chun naman chah-uva asei ding ahibouve. 21 “Pasal’in asopite aheh lih a, mipaten achate chutima abol diu, chaten jong anu apa adouva athiso cheh diu ahi. 22 Keima jal’a mitin hot le paiya na-um diu, hinla akhon ni geiya thoh lhumpa bou huhhinga um ding ahi. 23 Khopi khat’a nabolset tengu khopi chom khat’a jam lut’in, tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve. Mihem Chapa hung kah a Israelte khopi jouse nachotsoh louhel diu ahi. 24 “Seijui chu ahilpa sangin achungnungjo pon, soh jong apu sangin achungnung ngaipoi. 25 Seijui chu ahilpa tobang bep ahiya, soh apu toh abah joule aphaset ahi. Ainneipa bon Beelzebul ahisah ngamu leh a-insung mite ipi ahisah da diu ham?

Gin ding pen koiham

26 “Mihem kichah hih-un. Ajeh chu phondoh louva sel mang ding aumpon, hetdoh louva im-mang ding jong aumpoi. 27 Muthima kaseipeh-u hi khovah a naphonjal diu, guh thima kahil’u hi intingvuma naphonjal diu ahi. 28 Tahsa sunmang thei jongle lhagao that thei lou chu kichat dauvin, chusangin tahsa le lhagao akop’a damun a sol a sumang thei Pathen joh ginguvin. 29 Vasah ni paisa khatseh man a kijoh ji lou ham? Ahivangin na Pau phatsah louva khat jeng cha jong tol’a kimoh selhah lou ding ahi. 30 Nang ho jong nalujang sam jouseu geiya simtohsa kikoi ahitai. 31 Hijeh chun kicha hih-un, vahsah ho sanga manlujo nahiuve.

Mihem maiya Christa phondoh

32 “Koi hile japi lah a Christa mi ahi kiphongdoh chan chu Ken jong van a um ka-Pa angsunga kaphondoh ding ahi. 33 Koi hi leh Christa mi ahina japi lah a immang chan chu Ken jong van a um ka-Pa angsunga kaseilep ding ahi.

Chamna thu hilouva chemjama kidouna

34 “Leiset chunga chambol’a hungin neigel dauvin, chambolma lah chemjama kidouna dinga hung kahibouve. 35 Ajeh chu pa le chapa kidohsah a, nu le chanu kidohsah ding, tehpi leh mounu kidohsah dinga hung kahibouve. 36 Mihem dia amelma khohpen tahchu a-insung mi ma ma hiding ahi. 37 “Koi hile Kei sanga anu apa lungset jo jong kaseijui lom ahipoi. 38 Athingpel kiput’a kanung jui lou chu kaseijui lom ahipoi. 39 Koi hile kihinso nom chun athilo ding, keijal’a thilo chanin kihinsona anei ding ahi.

Kipa man ho

40 “Koi hileh nang ho lem a lhunsah chanin Kei eilem a lhunsah a kila ding, Kei eilem a lhunsah jouse chu Eisolpa lema lhunsah a ahi. 41 Pathen Themgao lem a lhunsah chun Themgao kipaman akihoppi ding ahin, mipha lem a lhunsah jong chu mipha kipaman amuding ahi. 42 Dihtah a kaseipeh nahiuve, kaseijuite lah a aneopen khat hijong leh seijui ahina jeh a twidap khon khat pejeng jong chu kipaman akisan tei ding ahi,” ati.

Matthew 11

John Baptist misol-ho

1 Jesun aseijuite som le ni ahilchahsoh phat’in chukom dalhan, naivel khopi dunga thuhil’a seiphong le din achetai. 2 Akihenna songkul’ah Messiah natoh thilbol kithang ajan, John chun aseijui phabep Jesu henga asol’e. 3 Amahon Jesu jah a, “Hung dia kisei chu nahim, achom dang khat ka-nga nah lai diu ham” atiuve. 4 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kile kit’un lang najah chengseu le namu chengseu hi gaseipeh tauvin; 5 mitchon kho amun, elbaiyin lam a jot tan, miphah suhthengin aumin, na-ngongin kho ajan, mithi kaithouvin aumtai, chule vaichate Kipana Thupha akiseipeh tai. 6 Kachunga lung opkaina neilou chu anun nom’e,” ati. 7 John seijuite kile phat’in, John thudol mipi jah a Jesun aseiyin; “Gamthip laiya ipi vetnom’a che nahiuvem? Hui mut ling peng venom nahiuvam? 8 Ipi vedia che mong nahiuvem? Kile lah ponsil mi ham? Pon kikhel sil miho leng inpia achengbouvui! 9 Ipi vetnoma cheba nahiuvem? Themgao ham? Ahinai, Themgao mai mai ahi poi, thupitah Themgao ahi. 10 Pathen Lekhabua Pathenin, ‘Nalampi sem toh din namasanga kasolle kasol masai,’ tia asei chu John hi ahitai. 11 Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, numei sung peng cheh ahivangin John Baptist sanga lenjo mihem apeng kha hih laiye; hinla van a lenggama neopen jong ama sangin alenjo nalaiye. 12 John Baptist thuseiphong nikhoa pat tuni geiyin van a lenggam hi min pumhat jengin anon, mi huseten pumhat’a lah din agouve. 13 John khang geiya Themgao jouse le Mose Danthun Lenggam thudol aseiyu ahin, 14 nakisan nom’u leh John hi hung dia kisei Elijah chu ahitai. 15 Nakhang neiyan ngai hen! 16 “Hiche khang mite hi ipi to kitekah theiyin tem? Kailhang dunga tou chapang ho loikhat’in adang ho jah a, 17 Kipana kuli kamut vangun nalam pouvin, thi lhah la kasah-u jongle nakap pouve,’ tia kihouho tobang ahiuve. 18 Ajeh chu John hi muhem neloule midon don louva aumle ‘THilhavop ahi,’ atiu vin; 19 mihem Chapan mineh ngai aneh a midon ngai adon vangin, Neh het le lengpitwi lop, kaidong ho le chonsete jol le gol,’ tin asei kit’ui. Hoi hileh chihna chu atohgan them achan ahibouve,” ati.

Atahsan lou khopi ho da na

20 Jesun thil kidang ahabol dehna mihon lung ahei loujeh-un aphohsal’in, 21 “Ohe Chorazin khopi nada ahi! Ohe Bethsaida khopi nada ahi! Nakhosunga thil kidang kibol chengse hi Tyre le Sidon kho sunga kibol hileh, khomiten kisihin khaopon sil’a vut kinu’vintin achonset lung heisoh tauvinte. 22 Tahbeh a akseipeh nahiuve, thupi tan nikho le nang ho thoh sanga Tyre le Sidon kho mite thoht oljo ding ahi! 23 Chule Capernaum nang hi! Van geiya kichoisang go nahim? Noimigam a nasot lhah diu ahibouve. Nakho sunga thil kidang kibol sengse hi Sodom kho sunga kibol leh mangthth hih laiyinte. 24 Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, thupi tan nikho leh nang thoh sanga Sodom thoh oljo ding ahi,” ati.

Kahenga hungin choldo’uvin

25 Hichepat hin Jesun, “Pa van le leiset Pakai! Michingte le mi themte dia na-impeh chengse mimol ho naseipeh jeh-in kathangvah-e! 26 hiti dinga hi nadeimong hinte he-Pa! 27 “Ka-Pan thil ijakai eippedoh tai. Pa tilou koiman Chapa ahepon, Chapa le aman aphondoh peh nom ho tilou koima dangin Pa ahepouve. 28 “Tong gimte leh pohgihte kahenga hungun, Keiman choldoh sah unge! 29 Kanamkoljon kilah-un pouvin, Keiya kihil’un, Keima lung nengtah le nun nemtah kahi, Keiya hinjouna nanei diu ahi. 30 Ijeh-inem itile kanamkoljon apoh anop’in, kapoh jong ajang’e,” ati.

Matthew 12

Choldo Nikho thudol’a thudoh

1 Chom khat jouvin Choldo nin Jesun bulei lai ajotpai. Aseijuiten gilkel jeh-in changvui asih pantauve. 2 Athilbol’u hi Pharisee hon amu’uvin Jesu jah a, “Ven, naseijuiten Choldo nin dan ngailou abol’ui!” atiuve. 3 Jesun adonbut’in, “David l ealoite agilkel’uva chu ipi abol’u nasim khah louvu ham? 4 I-atileh Pathen Houin a lut’a, Thempu tilou neh ngai louhel, Pathen um jing hetna kitohsa changlhah aloite toh aneh jengu ham? 5 Ole Choldo niseh leh Houin sunga lutji Thempu hon Choldo nikho asuhkeh vanguva themmo achanda diu Danthu chu nasim khah louvu ham? 6 Kaseipeh nahiuve, Houin sanga thupijo khat hikoma aum’e! 7 Pathen lekhabua, ‘Gan alhai ka-ngeh poi, hepina bou kadeiye,’ kiti chu heleu chun monabei miho themmo nachan lou diu ahi. 8 Ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa hi Choldo nikho Pakai ahi,” ati.

Khut lang ngoipa damdoh

9 Hikom chu dalhan Houthua kikhopna in khat’a Jesu aluttai. 10 Kikhopn ain a chun pasal khut lang ngoi khat ana umin, alah-uva chun Jesu thilbol dihsah lou jeh a hehse nom mi phabep jong aum’e. Amaho hin, “Choldo nikhoa damlou boldam hi Danthu to kikal hilou ham?” tin adongui. 11 Jesun adonbut’in, “Choldo nikhon nalah-uva koiham khat kelngoi kokhuuh a lahlut taleh aneipan agakaidoh lou ding ham? 12 Mihem hi Kelngoi sanga gam chenga mantamjo ahi! Hijeh chun i-Danthuu hin Choldo nikhoa mi kithopi ding aphal’e,” ati. 13 Hijeh chun Jesun khut lang ngoipa jah a, “Nakhut langin,” ati. Khut ngoipan alhandoh jen gleh adamtan, adamlang bep bep ahitai. 14 Chuphat’in Pharisee h apotdohun Jesu thana ding akihousomtauve.

Pathen lhentum Lhachapa

15 Ama than ding akihousomu ahet doh phat’in Jesu chukom dalhan apotdoh le japin ajuitauve. ana jouse aboldamin 16 Ama thusim chu midang aseipeh da diuvin ahilchah-e. 17 Hitobang thil hi Isaiah Themgao kama kiseisa: 18 “Ven, kalhentum lhacha deitah, Kadeitah le kalung lhaina pen! Achunga ka-Lhagao chensah ingting, Chitin namtin lah a kathutan aphondoh ding ahi! 19 O-sanga mi anelkal lou ding, Kholai dunga jong lhang asap lou ding; 20 Tahlelte dia nun nem ding, Panpibeite akhoto ding ahi! Dan dihtah a thu akitan kahsea Adou dou jeng ding ahi! 21 Chule namtin vaipin akineppi diu,” kiti chu guilhunna dia soh ahi.

Jesu chule Beelzebul

22 Hichepet hin thilhavop mitcho paomo mi khat hi Jesu henga ahin puiyun, Jesun aboldam phat’in apao theiyin kho amutai. 23 Jesu thil kidang bol hi japin adatmo behseh jengun, “Hichepa hi David Chapa hi-ngap ding hitam?” akitiuve. 24 Pharisee hon ajahdoh phat’un, “Thilha lengpa Beelzebul thahat’a thilahte anodoh hichu me!” atiuve. 25 Alunggel’u ahet phat’in Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kilang khen a kidouto lenggam tapou mangthah ding, ki lang khen a kidouto khopi hihen insung hi jong le mangthah vah ding ahi. 26 Satanin Satan anodoh leh akilangkhen ahitauvin, alenggam beivah ding ahitai. 27 Thilha lengpa Beezebl thahat vanga thilhate nodoh a neiseiyu leh naseijui teuvin koi thahat vanga anodoh-u ba ham? Namo nau phongdoh a naseijuiteu pang diu ahi. 28 Pathen Lhagao vanga thilhate nodoh kahi vang leh Pathen Lenggam chu nalah-u lhung ahitai. 29 “Mihat insunga lut chun ama somkon masa louva kon anei achom thei ngaiyam? Inneipa asomkon jou tengle bou anei achompeh ding ahi. 30 “Koi hileh eipanpi lou chu eidou mong ahin, eilhoh khomhu lou mi chu athecheh a pang ahibouve. 31 Hijeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, mihemte chonsetna le Pathen ataitom nai itobang hijongl eki-ngaidam thieyin tin, Lhagao Theng taitom vang ngaidam chang louhel ding ahi. 32 Mihem Chapa douna thusei jong ki-ngaidam thieyin tin, Lhagao Theng taitom vang hcu itih chan a jong ngaidam chang louhel ding ahi!

Thingphung chule Aga

33 “Thingga pha deiyan thing phung pha nei angaiye, nathing phung aphat loule thingga phalou nanei ding ahi. Ajeh chu thingphung hi agan akihei. 34 Gulse guiya peng ho, gitlou puma iti thupha nasei theidiu ham? Ajeh chu lungsung alet teng kamsunga hungpotdoh ahibouve. 35 Miphan athilpha kholna lung sunga konin thipha asodoh jin, misen athilse kholna lungsunga konin thilse asodoh jie. 36 “Kaseipeh masah nahiuve, thupi tan Nikho leh mintinin manlou thu asei jouseu geiya asuhto soh kei diu ahi. 37 Naseisau thu hoa chu nathem namo nahcung thu kitan diu ahi,” ati.

Khang gilouten melchihna ahol’u

38 Danthu them phabep le Pharisee phabep’in Jesu jah a, “Houhil, thil kidang nabol kavetnom’ui,” atiuve. 39 Jesu a-eojah-in, “Pathen hephaloute leh khang gilouva miten melchihna nahol’um? Jonah Themgao melchihna itlou melchihna dang kipelou ding nahiuve. 40 Ngapi oisunga Jonah nithum le janthum athamden banga Mihem Chapa jong leiset Lailunga nithum le janthum thamden ding ahi. 41 Thupi tan nikho leh Nineveh kho mite chu hiche khang mite toh hung ding khom’uva themmo achan diu ahi; ijeh-inem itile Nineveh kho miten Jonah thuseu ajah phat’un chonset lung aheiyui; hinla veuvin Jonah sanga lenjo khat hikoma aum’e! 42 Thupi tan nikho leh Sheba lengnu chu hiche khang mite toh idng khoma themmo achan ding ahi; ajeh chu leiset kolmang lang peh a konin Sheba lengnun Solomon chih thusei ahung ngai gunset theiye; tunla veuvin Solomon sanga lenjo khat hikoma aum’e!

Lhagaoboh hung kilekit

43 “Lhagaoboh hi mihem sunga apotdoh teng gamgo lah a avah len choldo mun ahol lelen, mu la amuji poi. 44 Chutengleh, ‘Kahung potdoh namun ma ma a lut kit tange,’ atin, ahung kile kit leh, mihem chu sagoh keova kithen ngimsel’a um amun, 45 ache kit’in ama sanga khohjo lhagaoboh sagi ma agapui ben, mihem sunga chun alut’un achenpha tauve; chutah chun mipa umchan hi amasa sangin akhoh cheh tai. Hiche khanga migiloute jong hung chuiti diu ahi,” ati.

Jesu nu le Jesu sopite

46 Jesun mipi jah athu asei nalaiyin anu le asopite ama to kihou nomin ahungun inpo-ah angah-ui. 47 Hijeh chun mi khat hin Jesu jah a, “Ven, nanu le nasopite nang to kihou nomin ahungun inpo-ah na-ngah-ui,” atipeh-e. 48 Ajah a thuseipa jah a Jesun, “Kanu koi hiya, kasopite koi koi hiuvam?” atin, 49 aseijuite akoh-in, “Ven kanu l ekasopite hi! 50 Ajeh chu koi hileh van a ka-pa lungdei bol’a chu kasopipa, kasopinu chule kanu ahiuve,” ati.

Matthew 13

Muchi thepa thulem

1 Hiche nikhoa hi Jesun in dalha dil pang lama chea atou phat’in 2 mipi ahung kikhom’un, Ama kong sunga alut’in atouve. Mipi vang va0kam a adingui. 3 Hichun Jesun mipi ajah a thu tampi thulemin aseiye: “Pasal khat muchi the din akontai. 4 Muchi athephat’in abang lamsih a achun, vachaten akilogam tauve. 5 Muchi phabep jong song lheo chung, lepatnaa achun, aleiphat jeh-in ahung keh doh loiye. 6 Hinla nisan asah phat’in leipat jeh a ajungkho thuh loujeh chun asang gop jitai. 7 Muchi phabep ma ling lah a achukhan, ling ho akhandoh phat’in adep lih jin ahi. 8 Muchi phabeppi vang leipha laiya achun, akhangdoh-in agatan, abang jakhat cheng, abang somgup cheng chule abang som thum chengin apunge, 9 “Nakhang neiyan ngai hen.” ati.

Thulem kiseilona

10 Seijuiten anailut’un Jesu jah a, “I-bol’a mipi koma thulem jenga thu nasei ham?” atiuve. 11 Jesun adonbut’in “Nang ho hi van a lenggam thuguh hetna kiseipeh nahitauvin, amaho vang kisepeh nailou lai ahi. 12 Aneiya chu anei let setna dia kipeh be ding, aneilou vang themcha nei jongle kilahpeh ding ahi. 13 Ijeh-inem itile amaho hin veu jongle muthei lou ding, ngai jongle ajah thei lou diu ahi jeh a thulema kisei ahi. 14 Hichea hin Isaiah Themgao seisa: ‘Ja jong leu nahet khen thei lou diu, Ve jong leu chun namu chet thei lou diu; 15 Ijeh-inem itile hiche nam mite hi alungthimu amoh-in, Akolseh gam’un, amit’u achosoh tai; Chutilou leh mit’in mu’vin tin naa ajah diu, kadamsah diu ahi,’ ati chu guilhung ahitai. 16 “Nanghon vang namu’va najah tah jeh-un hampha tah nahiuve! 17 Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, namu chengseu hi Themgao tampi le midih tam tah-in amu nom vangun amupouvin, ajah nom lheh vangun ajapha pouve.

Jesun muchi thepa thulem ahilchet

18 “Hijeh chun muchi thepa thulem hi ngaiyuvin. 19 Lenggam thu kiseipeh la ja a hekhen thei lou miho chu lamsih a chu muchi tobang chu ahiuve.
