Hichun anung jui 16 Danthu them ho le Phariseehon, chonse ho le kaidong ho toh an anehkhom amu’vin aseijuite jah a, “Itidana Aman kaidong ho le chonsete toh an aneh khom ham?” atiuve. 17 Jesun hichu ajah phat’in ajah-uvah, “Atidamten louthem angaipoi, adamlouten bou angaiyui; Keijong adih ho kouva hung kahipon, chonse ho kouva hung kahi bouve,” ati.

An ngol thudol’a Jesu adoh-u

18 John seijuiho le Pharisee hon an angolji jeh-un miho Jesu henga ahungun ajah a, “Itidana John seijuiho le Pharisee hon an angol jiuva, nang seijuihon angol ji louvu ham?” tin adongui. 19 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kichen golvahna hung lha ho chu ajinei pan alenkhompi laisea an ngol’a um theiyum? Aji neipan alenkhompi dung seuva an ngol thei lou diu ahi. 20 Amavang alah-uva kona aji neipa akipui mang nikho hung lhung ding ahin, hiche teng chuleh amahon an angol diu ahi. 21 Koiman sopnem loulai pon hal’in ponlui abeh ngaipoi; beh leh abehna chun ponlui chu kaieh jon tin haset lo cheh ding ahi . 22 Chujongle min savun peng lui sunga lengpitwi thah akhum ngai poi; khum taleh lengpitwi peng chu tumkeh intin, alengpitwi le apeng ho geiya manlo ding ahi. Hijeh a chu lengpitwi thah chu peng thah a khum ding ahi,” ati

Choldo nikhoa seijuihon changvui asiu

23 Choldoh nikhon Jesun bulei lai ajotpa naa aseijuiten ache pum pum’un changvui akisiuve. 24 Hichun Pharisee hon ajah a, “Ven, hiche ho khun itidana choldo nikhoa bol ngailou abol’u ham?” atiuve. 25 Jesun ajah-uvah, “David le aloite gilkel’a an ngaicha aum pet’uva chu ipi abol’u nasim khah louhel’u ham? 26 Abiathar Thempu chungnung ahilaiyin David chu Pathen Houin sunga alut’in, Thempuho tilouvin aneh ngailou, Pathen umjing hetna changlhah katdohsa chu anen aloite jong apei,” ati. 27 Chujongle ajah-uva aseiyin, “Choldo nikho hi mihem khohsahnaa kisem ahin, Choldo nikho khohsahnaa mihem kisem ahipoi, 28 hijeh chun Mihem Chapa hi Choldo nikho Pakai jong ahi,” ati.

Mark 3

1 Jesu houthua kikhopna ina alut kit leh, pasal khut langthi khat anaume. 2 Mihon ahehset theina diuvin langthipa chu Jesun Choldo nikhoa aboldam got le got lou aching lhiuve. 3 Jesun khut langthipa jah a, “Alailunga hung dingin,” atin; 4 miho jah a, “Choldo nikhoa thilpha bol ngai ha, thilse bol ngai ham? Hinkho huhhing ngai ha suhmang ngai ham?” atileh; Amahon la athip chet jengui. 5 Jesun miho chu lung hang pumin avegol’in, alung tah jeh-uvin alung gimpeh jon, lang thipa jah a, “Nakhut lhangdoh-in,” atileh, akhut alhandoh phat’in adamhel’e. 6 Chutah chun iloa Jesu suhmang theina ding Herodian ho toh kihou som din Phariseeho apotdoh paitauve.

Twikhanglen panga mipi

7 Jesu le aseijuite twikhanglen jona acheu lah, Galilee gama hung kon mipin jong ajuiyui; Judea gama hung kon, 8 Jerusalema kon, Idumea gam le Jordan lui gal’a kon, chule Tyre le Sidon gamkol sunga hung kon mipin anatoh ho ajah jeh-uvin ahenga ahunguve. 9 Mipi atam behseh jeh chun aneh chinto louna diuvin Jesun aseijuite chu kongneo khat gotsa anakoipeh diuvin aseipeh-e. 10 Mi tamtah aboldam ahitah jeh-in dammona nei jousen Ama chu toh khah tei ding dei nan ahindel jengun ahi. 11 Lhagaoboh ho hin Jesu amu tengu leh amasanga aboh khup’un, “Nangma Pathen Chapa nahi,” tin asamu’vin; 12 ahin la Ama aphondoh louna diuvin Jesun hakhamin akham chah-e.

Jesun mi som le ni alhendoh

13 Jesu mol chunga akaltouvin angaichat chengse akouleh, amaho ahenga achetauve. 14 Hichun mi som le ni alhengdoh-in, aminu solchah asah-in, akoma aum jingu va chule thuhil lhanglea jong asol doh theina dingin, 15 thilha ho nodoh theina tha jong apei. 16 Hitia alhendoh som le ni chu: Peter tia aminvo Simon ahin, 17 Zebedee chapa Jacob le John, ‘Van gin chate,’ ti naa amin lhon Boanerges asah te ni ahin, 18 Andrew le Philip, Bartholomew le Matthew, Thomas le Alphaeus chapa Jacob, Thaddaeus le Canaan mi Simon, 19 chule ama matsah a pang Iscariot Juda toh ahiuve.

Jesu chule Beelzebul

20 Jesu ina ahung lut tai; mipi ahung kikhop kit phat’un an jeng jong anethei tapouvve. 21 A-inkoten ajahdoh phat’un mat tho jeng din ahung kon’ui; ijeh-inem itile a ngol’a agel’u ahi. 22 Jerusalema kona hungsuh Danthu themhon jong Beelzebul vop hiya, thilha ho anodoh jong chu avaihompau thahat vanga anodoh-in aseiyui. 23 Jesun amaho akouvin ajah uvah thulemin aseiyin, “Satanin satan iti anodoh thei ding ham? 24 Gamsung khat atum apaiyin kikhentel hen kidouto taleh, hiche gamsung chu dingdoh thei lou ding ahi. 25 Insung khat jong kikhentel leh ding jou lou ding ahi. 26 Hijeh chun Satanin Satan adouleh akikhentel ahitan, ding jou louva bei ding ahiye. 27 Koiman mihat ina lut’a ama kan masa louvin anei achom theipoi, akan jou teng le ain achom ding ahibouve. 28 Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, mihemte achonsetna chengseu le Pathen ataitom nau aboncha ngai dam chang diu ahin, 29 Lhagao Theng taitom vang chu ngaidam chang louhel ding ahi; tonsot’a chonset themmo changa um ding ahitai,” ati. 30 Lhagaoboh vop a aseijeh-uva chutia asei ahiye.

Jesu nu le asopite

31 Jesu nu le asopite ahunguvin inpo’ah adingun, mi asol’uvin Jesu agakousah-ui. 32 Akimvel’a tou mihon ajah a, “Ven, nanu le nasopite polama adingun nahol’ui,” atiuve. 33 Jesun miho chu adonbut’in, “Kanu chu koi hiya chule Kasopite chu koi koi hiuvem?” atin; 34 akim vel’a tou chengse avegil’in, “Hiche ho hi kanu chule kasopite ahiuve. 35 Koi hijongle Pathen lungdei bol jouse chu kasopipa kasopinu chule kanu ahiuve,” ati.

Mark 4

Muchi thepa thulem

1 Jesun dil pang’a mi ahilpan kit leh, mipi ahung kikhomun, Ama dil laiya um kong khat sunga alut’in atouve. Mipi chengse vang twipam chin tol’a atouvui. 2 Jesun mipi chu thu tampi thulem jengin ahil’in, athuhilnaa chun ajah-uva aseiyin: 3 “Ngaiyun! Muchi thepa chu muchi then akondoh tai. 4 Hitia muchi athe naa hin muchi phabep lamsih a achun ahileh vachaten akilogam tauve. 5 Muchi phabep ma songlheo chung, leipatnaa achun, leiset asa loujeh-in akedoh loi vangin 6 nisan ahinsah teng jung anei lou jeh-in agopjitai. 7 Muchi phabeh jong ling lah a achun, ling ho ahung khandoh teng adep lih jin, ga louvin aumlo jitai. 8 Muchi phabepse vang leipha laiya achun, akehdoh paiyin, akhangin, agan, somthum cheng, somgup cheng, chule ja khat chengin agai,” ati. 9 Chuin aman ajah uva, “Angai na ding na neiyan ngai hen,” ati.

Thulemho kiseilo na ajeh

10 Jesu achangseh a aum pet’in athuhil ja ho phabep le seijui som le ni chun thulemho thudol adongui. 11 Aman ajah-uvah, “Nang ho vang Pathen lenggam thuguh chu kiseipeh nahitauvin, polama umte vang ijakai thulem jenga kisei ahi, 12 hitia chu ‘Ve jong leu amu chet thei lou diu, Ja jong leu ahet khen thei lou diu, chutilou hileh hung kihei kit’uva ngaidam chang ding ahiuve,’ tia kisei ahi,” ati.

Jesun muchi thepa thulem ahilchet

13 Jesun ajah-uva, “Hiche thulem hi nahet khen louvu ham? Achutile thulem dang ho iti nahet thei diu ham? 14 Muchi thepan Thu athe ahi. 15 Thu kithea lamsih a chu kiti ho hi thu ajah tah-u leh Satan ahung pai jenin asunguva lutsa thu chu alah mang pehji tai. 16 Chule songlheo chunga chu muchi kiti ho hi, thu ajah tah-u leh thanom tah a kisan jeng ho ahiuvin; 17 ahinla jung neilou ahiuvin apangsot pouve, athujah jeh-uva gim genthei nan ahinphah tengu leh akipal thu paiji tauve. 18 Chujongle linglah a chu muchi kiti ho hi, thu ajatauvin 19 amavang hiche hinkho lungkhamna le hao ding deina, chule thil dang dang deichat nan thu chu adep lih jin, gadoh louvin aumloi. 20 Leipha laiya chu kiti ho vang hi, thu jaa kisan ho ahiuvin, abang somthum cheng, phabeh ma somgup cheng chule phabeh jong ja khat chengin apunguve,” ati.

Thaomeikhom noiya thaomei vah

21 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Thaomei kivah khu pocha kikhu khum ngai lou, jalkhun noiya jong kitung ngai lou hilou ham? Thaomeikhom chunga tun dia kivahji hilou ham? 22 Phondoh lou dinga kiselguh aumpon, chule hodoh lou dinga kikhu khum jong aumpoi. 23 Koi hileh a-ngaina ding nakhang neiyan ngaihen,” ati. 24 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Nathujah u hi melchih-un. Nate bang banguva nakitepeh diu, akhohjoa bon nakibol diu ahi. 25 Ajeh chu aneiya kipehben tin, aneilou vang aneilou vanga aneichasun jong kilahpeh ding ahi.

Muchi khantou pet thulem

26 Jesun aseiyin, “Pathen leng gam chu min loulaiya muchi athe tobang ahi; 27 jan leh a-ihmun, sun teng athouve; ahin muchi chu anakeh-in akhangdoh tai, aman vang iti kea iti khan ahi ahepoi. 28 Leiset’in acham chamin ahin gasah jin, amasan ananou ahin, abanin avui, chujou kit leh avuiya konin achang lhingjie. 29 Achang chu amin phat leh a-at phat ahitah jeh-in koiten a-at paijitai,” ati.

Ankammu thulem

30 Jesun aseiyin, “Pathen leng gam chu iti itekah-uva, ipi thulema isei diu hitam? 31 Ankammu tobang vang ahi, leiset’a akithe teng vannoiya muchi dang jouse sangin aneo pen’e; 32 ahin akithe jou teng akehdoh-in, akhangin muchi dang sangin alenjoi, abah lentah tah asepdoh jin, chunga leng vachate jong aboh lim noiya ageh theiyui,” ati.

Jesun thulem jenga thu asei

33 Hitobang hin miho het thei kham khamin Jesun ajah-uva thu ahil’e. 34 Thulem louvin vang ajahuva imacha asei khapoi; aseijuitevang atumin ijakai ahil chensoh nai.

Jesun twipi kinonglai apho thip

35 Hiche ni hin nilhah ahiphat’in Jesun aseijuite jah-a, “Dil gallang khat’a galkaiyu hite,” ati. 36 Hijeh chun mipi adalhauvin, Jesu umna konga alut’uvin akitolpi tauve; hia chun kong dang jong aumin ahi. 37 Chuin khopihui hattah ahung nungin, kong sunga twi akinong lut mat chattan ahileh, kong sung twi dim mai ding ahi tai. 38 Jesu la kong meilama lukhap khap’in a-ihmui. Seijuiten asukhangun ajah a, “Houhil, keiho thigam ding kihita, khoh nasah lou ham?” atiuve. 39 Jesu athoudoh-in khopi hui chu haphon aphoh-in, twikhanglen jah a “Thip hel’in, umthimin,” atileh; huipi athip hel’in aumthimbeh tai. 40 Hichun ajah-uva, “Ibol’a chute kichat nahiuvam? Tahsanna nanei loulai hel’u ham?” ati. 41 Amaho la akicha behseh jengun, khat le khat akihouvun, “Hichepa hi hoi koibep hitaa, huipi le twikhanglen geiyin athu angai jeng ham?” atiiuvin ahi.

Mark 5

Jesun Gerasenes gama lhagaoboh vop mi khat aboldam

1 Amaho twikhanglen gal langa Gerasa gamsung’ah ahung tauve. 2 Jesu konga kona apotdoh doh-in lhan lah a hungkon lhagaoboh vop mikhat’in akimutopi paijen’e. 3 Lhagaoboh vop pa hi lhan lah jenga pansa ahin, koiman thih khaova jong ahen jou lou ahitai. 4 Bul akituh a thih khaova akikan vangin, thih khao jouse atumtan jin, bul ho aphukeh jin, koiman abol ngoi jou lou ahi. 5 Sun le janin lhan lah a avah len mol chung dunga a-ao le a-ao len, songin aki-at chen chen jengin ahiye. 6 Gamla tah a konin Jesu ahin mun, ahung khaiyin a-ang’ah aboh khup tai. 7 Chuin going tah-in asam in, “Pathen chungnugnpen Chapa Jesu, ilo ding neitiu ham? Pathen mina ka-ngeh nahi neisu genthei hih beh-in,” ati. 8 Jesun, “Mipa sunga kon chun hung potdoh-in, lhagaoboh,” atijeh a chutia asei ahiye. 9 Chuin Jesun, “Namin ipi ham?” atileh; aman, “Tamtah kahijeh-un kamin, ‘Janel,’ ahi,” atin; 10 chuche gamsunga kona asoldoh louna dingin hataovin ataove. 11 Akoma lhang panga chun vohcha tampi honk hat alhan, 12 lhagai ho chun, “Hiche vohchate sunga khu kalut theina diuvin nei sol tauvin,” tin Jesu henga ataovui. 13 Jesun asol tai. Chuin lhagaoboh ho apotdoh-un vohchate sunga alut’u leh vohcha sang nijen, hon khat chu kol’a alhai lhauvin, twilena alha lut’un athi gamtauve, 14 Vohcha ching ho chu ajam uvin thusoh hi khopi sung le loujao dunga aglhutsoh tauve. Hijeh chun athilsoh umchan vedin miho ahung uleh, 15 Jesu kom ahung lhun’un thilha janel voppa pon kisil’a lung lima anatou amu’vin, akicha lheh jenguve. 16 Thilha voppa le vohchate chunga thilsoh amit tah a muhon ahung ho chu aseipeh-uvin ahi. 17 Chuphat’in mihon Jesu chu agamsunguva kona potdoh din ajoltauve. 18 Jesu konga alut pet’in ma sanga thilha voppan akoma aum jing na ding athume. 19 Jesun ajadan, “Na-ina chen lan gPakaiyin nakhotoa thil nasatah nabolpeh chu na-inkote gasei peh tan,” atipeh-e. 20 Hijeh chun ama achen Jesun thil nasatah abolpeh chu khopi som sunga aphongjal len, ajapha chanin kidang asasoh keiyuve.

Jairus chanu le Jesu ponsil thamkha numeinu

21 Jesu konga akile tolgalkai kit phat’in, ahenga mipi ahung kikhop jeh-un Ama twikhanglen panga aumden’e. 22 Hichun houthua kikhopna in vaipo ho lah a Jairus chu ahungin, Jesu amu phat’in akhomuh a aboh khup paiyin, 23 “Kachanu thi ding koncha ahitai, adamdoh a ahinthei teina din, hungin achunga nakhut hung ngamin,” tin ha-ngeh-in angeh tai. 24 Jesu amato kilhonin achei. Ahin mipin ajuiyun, ajet aveiya aneh chinto jenguve. 25 Numei khat hikum som le kum ni jen athi longa damlou, 26 louthem mi tamtah akijensah a, anei chasun asuh mangsoh ahitan, ahivanga damdoh louva khoh cheh cheh jo ahi. 27 Hiche nu hin Jesu thudol ajan, mipi lah a Jesu nung’ah ahungin aponsil athamtai. 28 Ijeh-inem itile, “Aponsil ho jeng jong tham kha leng damteiyinge,” ati ahi. 29 Athi long chu akang heltan, aman jong atahsa natnaa kona adamtheng chu akihet paitai. 30 Apet tah chun Jesun atichunga kona thaneina apotdoh ahe paiyin, mipi lah avekimvel’in, “Kaponsil ho thamkha koiham?” tin ahol’e. 31 Aseijuiten ajah’a “Mipin naneh chinto jing mua iti, ‘Eithama koiham?” natiham,” atiuve. 32 Hichun Jesun aponsil tham mi chu muleng tin ave-lei. 33 Numeinun achunga thilsoh chu ahen, kichasa san ahungin kithing thingin a-anga aboh khup’in adih tah aseidoh tai. 34 Chuphat’in Jesun ajah a, “Chanu, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai, lung mongin chen lang nanat genthei naa konin damtan,” ati. 35 Jesun thu asei nalaiyin, houthua kikhopna in vaihompa ina konin mi phabep ahungun, “Nachanu athitai, ibol’a Houhilpu nasuh lung gim ding ham?” atiuve. 36 Jesun aseiyu chu ijasep louvin, houthua kikhopna in avaihom p ajah a, “Olmo hih-in, tahsan poutan,” ati. 37 Jesun Peter le Jacob chule Jacob naopa tilou midang akijuisah nompoi. 38 Houthua kikhopna in vaihompi in ahung lhun phat’un miho akap amao pohchei choiya um amun, 39 asung lhan ajahuvah, “Ibol’a pohchei choiya kap nahiuvem? Chapangnu hi athi ahipoi, a-ihmu ahibouve,” ati. 40 Mihon anuisat tauve. Ahi vangin abonchauvin adeldoh-in, chapangnu nu le pa toh akilhonpi chengse toh chapangnu um naa alut tauve. 41 Chapangnu chu akhut’in atuh-in ajah a, “Boinu thouvin kati nahi, tinan, “Tilitha koum,” ati. 42 Chapangnu chu athou paiyin lam ajottai; ama hi kum som le ni chapang ahi. Hichun mihon adatmo behseh jenguve. 43 Hichun jesun koimacha ahetsah louna diuvin akham chah kheh-in chule, “Chapangnu chu neh ding peuvin,” tin aseiye.

Mark 6

Nazareth khoa Jesu asandau

1 Jesun chukom dalhaa achenna khoa ahung leh, aseijuiten ahin juiyui. 2 Choldo nikho lhin phat’in houthua kihopna ina thu ahil’in athuhil ngaiya mi tampin adatmouvin, “Hichepan hichengpi hi hoiya alah hi-nga na? Ama kipea hi itobang chihna hiya, hibanga bolmo kidang abol ham? 3 Jacob le Joseph, Judas le Simon sopipa, Mary cha thingthembolpa chu hilou ham? Asopi numeiho jong ilah-uva aching meu?” atiuvin, kipal nan aneilo tauve. 4 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Themgao chu mun dang danga akijabol vangin agamsung le amite lah chule a-inkote lah a kijabolji lou mong ahi,” ati. 5 Hikoma chun ana damlou phabep chunga khut angap’a adam sah tilouvin, thil kidang ima abol thei tapoi. 6 Atahsan louvu chu kidang asa lheh jenge.

Seijui som le ni kisol lo na

Jesu anaivel kho hoa achen thu ahil le tai. 7 Seijui som le ni chu akouvin, lhagaoboh nodohna thei tha apen, mini nin asoldoh panin ahi. 8 Amaho chu lamkah a dinga tenggol tilou changlhah hihen, sakhao hijongle, sumdip sunga jong sum apoh lou diuvin aseipeh-e. 9 Kengchot vang aseuva sangkhol chol tho ni aki-ah lou diuvin aseiye. 10 Ajah-uva aseiyin, “Hoikom hijongle nalhun nauva kona napotdoh kahseuvin chukoma umden jingun; 11 hoimun hijongle min nalhunsah dauva nathu jong angai louvu leh, dalhauvin lang, ahettohsah nan nakengphanguva leivui thin lhah khum’uvin,” ati. 12 Amaho apotdoh-uvin min chonset lung ahei teina din ahil lhang leuve. 13 Thilha tampi anodohun, adamlou tamtah thao anu’vin, aboldam tauve.

John Baptist thi

14 Gamtina Jesu min kithang hi Herod lengpan ajadoh tai. Mi phabep’in, “John baptist chu thinaa kona thoukit’a hitobang thil kidang bol theina thahat hi anei hiya chu,” atiuvin; 15 kon khat’in, “Elijah ahi,” atiuvin; adangsen vang, “Malai Themgao ho tobang khat hinah ta,” atiuve. 16 Herod vang chun, “Alu katansa John chu hiya thoudoh kit hichu,” ati ahi. 17 Ijeh-inem itile Herod hin asopipa Philip jinu Herodias aki chenpi ahin, hiche nu jal’a hi mi asol’a John hi amasat a asongkul’a anakhum ahi. 18 Ajeh chu Johnin Herod jah a, “Nasopipa ji nakichenpi hi dan ngai ahipoi,” tia aphosa ahi. 19 Hijeh a hi Herodias hin John ahot’a athanom jing ahin, athat theipoi; 20 ijeh-inem itile Herod’in John hi midih le atheng ahi ahetjeh-in akichan apanpijitai. Athuhil ajah jongle along akichiah lheh jin, ahivangin kipah tah-in angaipehji nai. 21 Chuin nikho gomkom cha khat ahung um khan, Herod so nikho lhin nin golvah abol’in, amite lamkaiho le sepai vaipo ho chule Galilee gama milen milalte akouve. 22 Hichun Herodias chanu ahung lut’in alam leh, Herod le a-ankong umpi chengse akitaisah lheh-e. Lengpan nu-ngah jah achun, “Nadei jouse kahenga thumin, Peng, kate,” atitai. 23 Herod akihahsel’in, “Kahenga nathum jouse kagamsung keh khat geiyin penge,” ati. 24 Nu-ngah chu apotdoh-in anu henga, “Ipipen kathum dingham?” agatileh; “John Baptist luchang,” tin aseipeh-e. 25 Apet tah chun nu-ngah jong lengpa henga ahungin, “Tutah hin John Baptist luchang ankong khat’a neipe le chun kadeiye,” ahung ti. 26 Lengpa chu alung gim lheh jengin, ahivangin a-ankong umpi ho ansunga akihahselna jeh chun adathei tapoi. 27 Hiti hin lengpan a-ngah a pang sepia ho khat John lu la dingin asoltai. Ama achen songkul’a John lu agatanin, 28 ankong sunga ahindomin nu-ngah chu apetai. Nu-ngah chun anu agapen ahi. 29 Athu hi John seijuiten ajah phat’un along ahung pu’vin lhan’a avuitauve.

Jesun mi sang nga avahva

30 Solchah ho Jesu henga ahung kikhom’un, athilbol jouseu le athuhil’u aseipeh soh keiyui. 31 Mi ahung le ache le atam behseh phat’in an jeng cha jong ane man tapouvin, hijeh chun Jesun, “Abung in hung kikhin doh-un lang munthip lai khat’a kicholdouvin,” ati. 32 Hijeh chun kongin akitol’un gam thip lai khat ajontauve. 33 Mi tamtah-in acheu amu’va ahet phat’un akimvel khopi jousea konin kengin anacheuvin, amaho sangin analhung masatauve. 34 Jesu kong ahung potdoh le mipi kinonglul lul chu amun, achingbei kelngoite toh abah jeh-uvin alungset’in thu tampi ahil pantai. 35 Agei behseh phat’in aseijuite ahungun, “Agei behseh tan, ium nau ma gamthip lah ahin, 36 miho hi cheuva akimvel loujao ho le kho dunga neh le chah akichohna diuvin soltan,” ahung tiuve. 37 Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uvah, “Nang hon neh ding peuvin,” ati. Amahon, “Kacheuva changlhah denarii ja ni man kachoh-uva mipi neh dia kapeh diu ham?” atiuleh; 38 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Changlhah pheng ijat naneiyum, gaveuvin,” ati. Agavet chet phat’un, “Pheng nga le nga ni ahi,” atiuve. 39 Hichun mipi chu hamhing chunga aloi loiya tousah din aseijuite aseipeh-e. 40 Miho chu agol gol’in ja khat cheng som nga chengin atoutauve. 41 Chuin changlhah pheng ngale ngani chu alan, van lam aven, phatthei aboh jouvin aheh bal bal’in mi ang’a luipeh din aseijuite apen, nga ni jong ahoppeh soh keiye. 42 Mipin aneuvin avasoh keiyui; 43 changlhah chu anong nai amoh paipeh som le ni dim le nga nong phabep toh aloh doh-uvin ahi. 44 Changlhah ne ho chu Pasal sang nga alhinguve.

Jesun twichunga lam ajot

45 Jesun mipi alhah dohpet chun agallang khat, Bethsaida ache masa din aseijuite kong sunga alutsah loi jengin ahi. 46 Amaho hi alhah doh soh phat’in tao din molchunga akaltoutai. 47 Nilhah ahi phat’in kong la dil lai lung ageitan, ama changseh-in tol lhaga aum nalaiye. 48 Seijuite dil’a akitol nauva huiyin ale lama anuh jeh-uva alung gimu ahin mun, jingkah nidan li donin dil’a twi chunga kengin lam ahinjot’in, amaho khel din agoi. 49 Twi chunga lam jot’a ahung amu phat’un joumi danin agel’un a-aosot jengui. 50 Ajeh chu Ama amu cheh-uva kichasoh kei ahiuve. Chutah chun Jesun ahinhou paiyin ajah-uva, “Olmo hih-un, Kei kahi, kicha hih-uvin,” ati. 51 Aum nau kong sunga Jesu akaldoh phat’in hui athip del’in ahileh adatmolheh jenguve. 52 Ijeh-inem itile changlhah chunga thilsoh jong gelpha talouva lungmoh chehjo ahiuve.

Jesun Gennesaret khoa anaho adamsah

53 Agal kaiyuva tolgo agei phat’un kong angauvin, Gennesaret lam ajontauve. 54 Kong adalhah lhah-uvin mipin Jesu anahepai jenguvin, 55 agamsunga alhai leuvin, Jesu aumna ajah phahna chan’uva adamlou jouse alupna pumin ahin pupu jenguve. 56 Khote sung hihen, khopi sung hijongleh, loujao dung geiyin, ache na chan’ah kailhang dung jenga jong adamlou ho alupdsah-uvin, apon mong kai beh atham sah din angeh-uve. Ama tongkha chan vang adamsoh keiyui.

Mark 7

Puchon pachon

1 Jerusalema konin Pharisee ho le Danthu them phabep Jesu henga ahungun ahi. 2 Jesu seijuiten khutnen sil lha louva an aneh-u amutauve. 3 Ijeh-inem itile Pharisee ho le Judaten puchon pachon amangun, khut phatecha silngim masa louvin neh le chah abol ngaipouve. 4 Kailhang dunga kona ahungkile tengu jong le kisil lha louvin an anepouve. Chondan dang, khon ho, belcha ho, sum-eng bel ho, lupna ho geiya sop theng ding Dan tampi aneiyui. 5 Hijeh chun Pharisee ho le Danthu them hon, “Itidana naseijuiten puchon pachon jui louva khut sil masa louva an aneh jiu ham?” tin Jesu adongui. 6 Aman ajah-uva, “Mipha lhem nang ho thudol hi Isaiah-an kitoh chet’a gaothu aseiya, hitia kisun ahi: ‘Hiche nam mite hin akamsung’uvin eijabol’un, Alungthimu la keiya konin agamla lheh jenge; 7 Athuhil’u jong mihem thupeh jeng ahil jeh-un, Eihouvu jong hi mohseh ahi,’ tia asei chu. 8 Pathen thupeh napaiyun, mihem chondan joh nanit’uvin ahi,” ati. 9 Hiti jong hin ajah-uvah, “Pathen thupeh phatah-in napaiyun, nachondanu joh nitna ding na-ngaitouve ong? 10 Ajeh chu Mose’n ‘Nanu napa jabol’un,’ chule ‘koi hile anu apa douna thuse sei jouse chu thihel hen,’ ati ahin, 11 nang hon la, ‘Mi khat touvin nu ham pa ham jah a, ‘Keivanga naphat chomna ding thil ho chu Pathen dinga thilpeh ahi,’ atileh, 12 ama hin nu hihen pa hileh akithopi lou akhoh poi,’ tin 13 akhang khanga nahin juipeh-u puchon pachon jeh chun Pathen seisa nathaimil’uve. Hitobang hin thil tampi nabol’uvin ahi,” ati.

Mi suhboi thei thil ho

14 Jesun mipi chu ahenga akou kit’in ajah-uvah, “Nabonun kasei ngaiphauvin, hetoh-un. 15 Thil imacha polama kona mihem sunga lut’a ama suboh thei aumpoi, asunga kona potdoh bou chun asuhbohji ahi! 16 (Angaina ding nakhang neiyan ngaihen, “) ati. 17 Jesun mipi adalhah a insunga alut chun aseijuiten hiche thulem hi adong chen’uve. 18 Hijeh chun Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho jong midang banga hetna lhasam nahiuvam, polama kona mihem sunga lut chun ama asuboh poi, 19 ijeh-inem itile alung sunga lut louvin, a-oi sunga lut’a aposo naa ahung potdohji dol hekhen theilou nahiuvem?” ati. (Hichea hin neh thei jouse athengin aseiye.) 20 Aman, “Mihem sunga kona hung potdoh bou chun mi asuhboh ahi. 21 Ajeh chu mihem lung sunga konin lung gilou, jon thanhoi, guchatna, tolthana, 22 mito jonna, papsetna, gitlou, engsetna mi doha bol, huhna, 23 thilse hichengpi hi misunga kona hung potdohjia mi asuhbohji ahi,” ati.

Syrophoenicia numeinu tahsan

24 Jesun hikom chu adalhan Tyre gamkai jonin achetai. In sunga alut’in, koimacha akihetsah nompoi. Ahinla akisel thei dehpoi. 25 Achanu lhagaoboh vop numei khat’in ajahdoh phat’in ahungin akhomuh-a aboh khup jenge. 26 Numei chu Greek mi ahin, Syria gam Phoenicia khoa peng ahi; aman achanu sunga thilha nodoh peh dingin athume. 27 Jesun ajah-a, “Chate va masa ta diu hen, chate neh ban lahpeh a uichate se-lhah peh ding aphapoi,” ati. 28 Aman adonbut’in a jah a, “Pakai, uichaten jong dokang noiya anmal lhathang aneh jiu khu me,” ati. 29 Numei nu jah a hin Jesun, “Hiche nasei jeh chun chetan, nachanu sunga konin thilha chu apotdohtai,” atipeh-e. 30 Numei chu acheleh anao jalkhuna lum agatoh-in, asunga konin thilha anapotdoh tai.

Jesun na-ngong le paomo aboldam

31 Jesun Tyre gamkai ajot’in, khopi som ajotpeh-in, Galilee dillen ahung lhung tai. 32 Ahenga mi na-ngong paojong paochen theilou khat ahinpuiyun achunga khut angap din ataovui. 33 Jesun mipi adalhan achangseh-in apuidoh in akhut jungin anakhang te ni akhoipeh-e; chuin chil aphikhumin aleigui jong athampeh-in, 34 chujouvin van lam aven, akhoisan, ‘Kihongin,’ ti nan ajah a, “Ephphatha,” ati. 35 Apet tah chun ana avangin, aleigui akilhamin, oh louhel’in thu asei theitai. 36 Hichun koimacha jah a aseidoh louna diuvin akham chah kheh-e; ahinla ahakham cheh le ahaseiphong cheh-un ahi. 37 Ajapha chanin kidang asa behseh jengun, “Ijakai abol phasoh keiyin, nangong la kho ajah sah tan, paomo jong apaotheisah tai,” atiuve.

Mark 8

Jesun mi sang li avahva

1 Hichelai chun mipi nasa tah ahung kikhop kit leh neh ding anei lou phat’un Jesun seijuite akouvin ajah-uvah, 2 “Mipi kakoma nelou chalouva aumnao hi nithum alhingtan, kalungset lheh jenge. 3 Abang hi gamla tah a hung ahuvin, gilkel dangchah pumin kisol jengleh lampi dunga lha lhop pe tei diu ahi,” ati. 4 Aseijuiten adonbut’un, “Hikom gamthip’a mi hichengpi vahna kham changlhah kon hoiya alah ding ham?” atiuve. 5 Jesun “Changlhah ijat naneiyum?” atileh; :P heng sagi atiuve. 6 Hichun mipi tol’a tou din asol’in, changlhah pheng sagi chu alan, phatthei aboh jouvin mipi ang’a luipeh din aseijuite apetai. 7 Amahon nga phabep jong anei yun, hijong chu phatthei aboh jouvin miho ang’a luipeh din aseipeh-e. 8 Mihon anevasoh keiyuvin, aneh moh-u anong longkai sagi dim aloh doh-uve. 9 Anea pasal sang li jen ahin, Jesun amaho chu alhadoh tai. 10 Chuin aseijuite toh konga alut paiyun Dalmanutha gamsung alhung tauve.

Pharisee hon melchihna angeh-u

11 Pharisee ho ahungun thu adong pan’uvin, apatep nan van’a konin melchihna ahol’uve. 12 Jesu along gil’in nasa tah-in akhoisan, “Ibol’a hiche khang mite melchihna ahol’u ham? Ddih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche khang mite hi melchihna kipe louhel ding ahi,” ati. 13 Chuin miho adalhan konga alut kit’in gallang khat’a achetai.

Pharisee ho le Herod chol kiso

14 Seijuiten changlhah apo haiyun, kong sunga neh thei dan gneilouvin, changlhah pheng khat she bou aneiyuve. 15 Jesun ajahuvah, “Ching theiyun, Pharisee ho le Herod chol lah a kihong phauvin,” ati. 16 Seijiute akihou lhiuvin, “Changlhah inei pouve,” akitiuve. 17 Hichu Jesun ahen ajah-uva, “changlhah nanei lou jeh-uva ibol’a kihou lhi chet chut nahiuvem? Tugeiya hejong hekhen louva lungmoh gam nahiu hitam? 18 Mit nineiya namu thei lou, nakhang nineia najah thielouvu ham? Gel jong nageldoh lou mong uham? 19 Mi sang nga lah a changlhah pheng nga kahoppeh a chu anong paipeh ijat nalodoh um?” atileh; “Paipeh som le ni,” atiuve. 20 Mi sang li lah a changlhah pheng sagi kahopeh a Chula anong longkai dim ijat nalodohuvem?” atileh; amahon, “Longkai sagi” atiuvin, 21 hijeh chun ajah-uvah, “Nahet khenu hitam?” ati.

Jesun Bethsaida mitcho mi khat kho amusah

22 Bethsaida ahung lhung rauve. Hichun mitcho mi khat Jesu henga ahinpuiyun, atham din ataovui. 23 Jesun mitchopa chu khopam langa apuidoh-in, amit te nia chil aphin achunga khut angapjouvin ajah a, “Ipi pi na mun?” tin adonge. 24 Ama adah-in, “Mihem kamun, thingphung holheh lheh ahin, ahivangin ava leu kamui,” ati. 25 Amit te ni thampeh leh kichentah-in kho amutai. Ama jong adamin gamla tah a thil ho geiyin kichentah-in amutheitai. 26 Hichun, “Khosunga lutda tan,” tin, ainlama asol mangin ahi.

Peterin Jesu aphondoh

27 Jesu le aseijuite Casarea Philippi khoneo hoa ache leuvin, lampia Jesun aseijite jah a, “Mihon Keima hi koi ahi, eitiuvem?” tin adonge. 28 Amahon, “Mi phabep’in, ‘John Baptist ahi,’ atiuvin; pha bep’in ma, ‘Elijah ahi,’ atiuvin; kon khat sen vang, ‘Themgao ho khat pen ninah ta,’ tin aseiyui,” atiuve. 29 Jesun adongin, “Nang hon la koiba ahi neitiuvem?” atileh; Peterin adonbut’in ajah a, “Nangma Messiah chu nahi,” ati. 30 Hichun aman koima jah a asei louna diuvin hakhamin akham chah-e.

Jesun athia athodoh ding asei masah

31 Jesun ajah-uva Mihem Chapan genthei hesoh tamtah athoh a upate le Thempu pipu ho, Danthu them hon asan dauva, atha diu chule nithum jouva athodoh kit tei ding thu ahilpanin, 32 ajah-uvah phongtah-in aseiye. Hichun Peterin atumin apuidohin abelhatai. 33 Jesu akiheiyin aseijuite aven Peter chu haphon aphohin, “Kinung le jengin Satan, ajeh chu nangin Pathen gel bang gel louvin mihem lung gel jeng na gel’e” ati. 34 Jesun aseijiute le mipi akou vin ajah-uva, :Koi hile eijuinom chu amatah kisumil hel’a athingpel akiput’a eijui ding ahi. 35 Ijeh-inem itile koi hile akihinso nom chun athi o ding, amavnag Keijal le Kipanathupha jal’a thi lo jouse kihinso na anei didng ahi. 36 Ajeh chu min vannoi leiset pumpi neihen lang ahinkho kisuh mang ta leh ipi phat chompin tem? 37 Chujongle min ahinkho lhenga ipi apeh ding ham? 38 Ijemtia mikhat touvin hiche chonse lekitah lou khanga hi Kei le kathuho ajachat pi leh Mihem Chapan jong Vantil thengte toh Apa loupinaa ahung teng leh ama chu ajumso ding ahi,” ati.

Mark 9

1 Jesun ajah-uva, “Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, hikoma ding ho lah ahin Pathen lenggam thu neitah a hung amu kah seuva thina tep kha lou ding aum’uve,” ati

Jesu vou kikhel

2 Nigup jouvin Jesun Peter le Jacob chule John toh achanguvin molsang chunga apuitouve. Chuin a-ang sunguvah avou akikhel’in, 3 aponsil ho chu abanlot lot’in alhelah alh jengin, leiset’a koiman hitobangin asop bang theipoi. 4 Hichun Elijah le Mose ahenguva ahung kilah lhonin Jesu toh akihou lim’uve. 5 Hichea hin Peterin Jesu adonbut’in, “Rabbi, hikoma ium’u hi anome, Nang ding khat, Mose ding khat chule Elija ding khat, lhambuh thum song ung kate,” ati. 6 Akichat behseh jehuva sei ding hetmoa asei ahibouve. 7 Chuin meilhang khat’in ahile khu’uvin, meilhang lah a kon chun ogin khat hin, “Hiche hi kachapa deditah ahi, athu ngaiyun,” ati. 8 Akimvel’u avetu leh koima dang amu tapouvin, Jesu le amaho changseh bou aumtauve. 9 Molchunga kona ahung kumlhah pet’un Jesun amaho chu akham chah-in, “Mihem chapa thinaa kona thodoh kit kahsen nathilmu hi koimacha jah a seidoh hih hel’un,” ati. 10 Asei chu amelchih jingun, “Thinaa kona thodoh kit ati hi ipi aseina hintem,” tin akidong touve. 11 Hijeh chun Jesu adongun, “Ibol’a Danthu them hon Elijah hung masatei ding ahi, tia aseiyu ham?” atiuve. 12 Jesun adonbut’in, “Elijah chu ahungin ijakai got tohsan ahung koiye; ahile i-atileh, Mihem Chapa chun gim genthei athoh a hot le paiya kibol ding ahi, tia asumchan ding dol kisun hintem? 13 Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, Elijah chu ahungtan, aumchan ding kisun bangin miho aning anop’in aboltauve,” ati.

Jesun chapang lhagaoboh vop khat aboldam

14 Seijuite henga ahung phat’un mipin seijuiho chu ana umchah kheh-un, Danthu them phabep’in anakinelpiuve. 15 Mipin Jesu amu phat’un abonchan kidang asauvin, ahenga alhai lut’uvin chibai aboh tauve. 16 Jesun seijuite jah a, “Amaho khutoh ipi kinel nahiuvem?” atileh; 17 mipilah a khat ‘in, “Houhil, kachapa paomo lhagaoboh vop khat nahenga kahinpuiye. 18 Ama hi lhagaoboh in amat khah na chan’ah aheh lhujin, achilphon alhan, aha geljin, atahsa jong agongsuh suh jenge; naseijuihon einodoh peh diuva kasei leh ajoupouve,” ati. 19 Jesun amaho ahousal’un “Vo tahsan bei khang mite! Itih chan ka-umpi dding nahiuva, itih chan geiya kakho ngai ding nahiuvem? Chapng chu kahenga hinpuiyun,” ati. 20 Mihon ahenga ahinpui phat’un, lhagaoboh-in Jesu amun, chapang chu avei ngol’in aheh lhu pai jengin, achil phon alhan, tol’a chun akilih le le jeng tai. 21 Jesun apa jah a, “Ahitina itih chan hitam?” tia adoh leh; “Aneova pat ahitan, 22 hiti hin suhmang din agon, abang le meilhum sung, abang le twi lah a aleh lut jin ahi. Alo naje khat nahet le neikho ton neikitho piuvin,” tin aseiye. 23 Jesun ajah, a “Alo naje nahet leh! Atahsan din ijakai ahitheisoh keiye,” ati. 24 Chutah chun chapangpa pa chun ahinsam jengin, “Katahsan’e, kalhahsamna neikithopin,” ati. 25 Mipi ahenga hung lhaikhom amu phat’in Jesun lhagaoboh chu haphon aphoh-in, “Lhagao paomo le na-ngong, amaa konin potdoh-in lang lut kit lou hel dia kaseipeh nahi,” ati. 26 Hichun hatah-in apengin, chapang chu avei ngoiyin apotdoh tai. Chapang chu athi abang jengin ahileh, mi atamjon athi tahbehin agel’uve. 27 Jesun atuh-in akaithou leh adding jang tai. 28 In’a ahung lut phat’in aseijuiten guh thim chan adongun, “I-atileh keihon kanodoh jou louvu ham?” atiuve. 29 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Hitobang hi taona tilouvin akinodoh theipoi,” ati.

Jesun athi ding asei masah kit

30 Hikom chu adalhauvin Galilee gam ajot’un ahi; Jesun aumna mi ahetsah nompoi. 31 Ajeh chu aseijuite ahilpeh-in, ajahuva, “Mihem Chapa hi miho khut’a kipedoh ding,, amahon athauva, atha jouvu nithum nung leh toudoh kit ding ahi,” tin aseiye. 32 Seijuiten asei chu ahethei pouvin, doh ding la akichauve.

Alenpen koiham

33 Capernaum ahung lhuna insunga aumpet’un seijuite jah a, “Lampi dunga chu ipi kinelji nahiuvem?” atileh; 34 amaho chu lampi dunga alenpen koi hiding thu kinel ahijeh-uvin athip chet jenguve. 35 Jesu atouvin som le ni chu akouvin ajah-uva, “Koi hileh amasapen hinoma chu nukhah pen a, japi lhacha pang ding ahi,” ati. 36 Chuin Jesun chapang khat akeiyin amasanguva adinsah-in, akoiyin ajah-uvah, 37 “Kamin a hiche cha pang tobang khat sanga chun Eisan ahi; Eisang chan chun Kachanga Eisan ahipon, Eisolpa geiya asana hi,” ati.

Eidoulou chu Eipanpiu ahi

38 Johnin Jesu jah-a, “Houhil, naming a thilha nodoh pasal khat kamu’vin eiho lah a apanda jeh-in abolda din kaseipeh tauve,” ati. 39 Jesun ajah-uva, “Kham dauvin. Kamin a thil kidang bol’a koiman eiseise loi ponte. 40 Ajeh chu eidoulouva chu eipanhu-vah ahi. 41 Phatah a kaseipeh nahiuve Keiya nahijeh-un don ding twi khon khat na pechanin kipaman asantei ding ahi.

Chonsetlona thei lhepna

42 “Hiche chapang tobang ho khat eitahsanda sah chan chu a ngonga sum hei song kikhai hen Twikhanglen a kileh lutle phajonte. 43 Hijeh chun nakhut’in nakipalsah le tanbongin! Khutni neiya damun nalut sangin, khut lang beiyin hinna lutle chun aphajoi. 44 Damun chu alungla thimo meikong jong mitmo ahi. 45 Nakengin nakipalsah le, tanbongin! Kengni neiya damuna nalelut sangun, keng lang beiya hinna nalut aphaajoi. 46 Damun chu alongtol jouse la thimo, amei kong jong mitmo ahi.) 47 Namit’in nakipal lhuh sah le kaldoh jengin, mit ni neiya damuna nalelut sangin mit lang beiya Pathen leng gama lut nang din aphajoi. 48 Ddamun chu alungtol jouse la thimo, ameikong jong mitmo ahi. 49 “Mi jouse meiya chisoa kiso cheh ding ahi. 50 Chi hi aphai; ahin chi hi alta hih leh iti naalsah kit diu ham? Nasunga chi nei cheh-un, kichamdel’in um’uvin,” ati.

Mark 10

1 Jesun chukom dalhan Judea gama ahungin Jordan lui agalkaitai. Mipi ahenga ahung kikhop kit phat’un, angaiyin thu ahil kittai. 2 Pharisee ho ahenga ahungun apatep nan, “Pasal’in ji ada hi Dan ngai hinam?” atiuve. 3 Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uvah, “Mose’n ipi thu napeh-uvem?” atileh; 4 amahon, “Mose’n kidana lekha sutpeh a da sing aphel’e,” atiuvin ahi. 5 Jesun ajah-uvah, “nalung tah jeh-uva Mose’n hiche thupeh chu anasut ahibouve. 6 Amavang semtil’a pat Pathenin amani pasal le numeiya a semsa ahitai. 7 Hijeh a chu min anu le apa adalhah a aji toh kigom ding, 8 pum nimi ni hita louva tikhat pum khat hi-lhon ding ahitai. 9 Hijeh chun Pathen gopdsa chu mihemin sukhen hih hen,” ati. 10 Insung alut kit phat’un aseijuiteen hiche thudol hiJesu adongui. 11 Aman ajah-uvah, “Koi hile aji daa numei dang kichenpi jousen aji ajonkhum ahi; 12 numeiyin jong aji adaa pasal dang akichenpi le ajong’ah ahi,” ati.

Jesun chapang neoho phatthei aboh

13 Hichun atham din mihon chapang phabep Jesu henga ahin puiyui. Ahin sseijuiten ahinpuiho chu haphon anaphoh-ui. 14 Jesun amudoh phat’in along phamon ajah-uvah, “Chapang ho chu kahenga hungsah-un, jada hih-uvin; ijeh-inem itile Pathen lenggam chu hitobangte hoa bou ahiye. 15 Tahbeh a akseipeh nahiuve, koi hi jongle chapang thilsan banga Pathen lenggam kisan lou chu asunga lut louhel ding ahi,” ati. 16 Chuin chapang ho chu apomin, achunguva khut angamin phatthei aboh tai.

Mihaopa

17 Jesu lampia ahug pet’in pasal khat ahenga alhai touvin, a-ang’ah aboh khup’in ajah a, “Houhil pha, tonsot hinna kanei theina dia ipi kabol ding ham?” tin adonge. 18 Jesun ajah a, “Ipi dia apha neiti ham? Pathen tilou koimacha apha aumpoi. 19 ‘Tol that hih-in, mitoh jong hih-in, gucha hih-in jouthun hettohsah-in pandan, dohan mi boldan, nanu napa jabol’in,’ kiti thu peh chengse nahet chume,” ati. 20 Mihaopan ajah a, “Houhil, hichengse hi kaneocha pat kahin nit jingsa ahitai,” ati. 21 Jesun avechen chet’in ahileh alungset’in, “Bat khat nanei nalaiye, van’a gou naneina din chenlang nagou abonchan gajohin, sum chu vaichate hoppeh tan; chutengle hungin neijuiyin,” ati. 22 Mihaopan achutisei ajah phat’in amai thimkut jengin, gou haotah ahijeh chun lung himo tah-in ache mangtai. 23 Jesun aseijuite avegol’in ajah-uvah, “Gou haoho dia Pathen langgama lut hahsa lheh ding ahi!” ati. 24 Jesu thusei ho jeh chun aseijuite along dong lheh jengui. Ahivangin Aman adonbut’in ajahuvah, “Chate, Pathen lenggama lut ding chu iti hahsat hitam! 25 Mihao Pathen lenggam alut sangin heobil hom sunga sangongsao lut ding abaijoi,” tin aseikit’e. 26 Amahon kidang asa cheh jenguvin, “Achutile koi huhhinga umjou ding ham?” tin akihoutauve. 27 Jesun amaho aven, “Mihem din vang hitheihoi ahipoi, Pathendin ahimopoi, ajeh chu Pathen din ijakai ahithei sohkeiye,” ati. 28 Peterin, “Neiveuvin, keihon ijakai dalhaa Nang kijuitaa,” tin aseipantai. 29 Jesun adonbut’in, “Tah beh a kaseipeh nahiuve, Leima jal le Kipana Thupha jal a in, sopi pasal numei jouse, nu le pa, chate, gam leiset ham dalhaa 30 bolsetna jouse jong thoh ham ham a chun tukhang jenga jong ajat jaa in, sopi numei pasal, nu, chate, chule gam leiset kimube lou ding koima aumpoi; chujongle ahung lhung ding khanga jong tonsot hinna chang louvin umponte. 31 Amavang amasa tamtah nukhah ding, chule anukhah tamtah masa ding ahi,” ati.

Thumvei lhinna Jesun athi ding asei masah

32 Jerusalem jon’a acheuleh lampi dunga Jesu amasapen-e. Hijeh chun amahon kidang asauvin. Chule anung jui ho jong akichauve. HIchun aman som le ni chu atumin apuidoh kit’in ama chunga thilsoh ding aseipeh masah-in, 33 Ven, Jerusalem jona che ihiuvin, Mihem chapa hi thempu pipu ho le Danthu them ho apehdoh diu ahin, amahon thana dia themmo achan’uva chiding namdangte apehdoh diu ahi. 34 Chidang namdang hon tot nopna aneiyuva chil asset khum diu, hijongle Ama nithum jou teng thoudoh ding ahi,” ati.

Jacob le John thil thum

35 Zebedee chapa te ni Jacob le John Jesu henga ahung lhonin ajah a, “Houhil, nahenga kathum chan neibolpeh ding kadeiye,” ati lhone. 36 Aman, “Ipi bolpeh leng nadei lhon em?” tin adonge. 37 Amanin ajah a, “Naloupinaa anjet naveiya neitousah-in,” ati lhone. 38 Jesun amani jah a, “Nathum hi nahe lhonpoi. Kadon ding khona nadon ngama, kachan ding baptize nachan ngam lhon nah em?” atileh; 39 amanin, “Kangame,” ati lhontai. Ahivangin Jesun amani jah-ah, “Kadon ding khona chu nadontei ding, kacha ding baptize jong nachantei lhon ding ahinai, 40 kajet kaveiya tousah ding vang Keima peh thei ahipoi, akigonpeh ho dinga kikoi ahibouve,” ati. 41 Seijui som khat’in hichu ajah phat’un Jacob le John chungah along phamo tauve. 42 Jesun akouvin ajah-uvah, “Chidang namdangte lah a vaihoa kigel hon achunguva thunei tah-in vai ahomun, amilen amilalteu jong khun achunga atha neinau ajedohuve. 43 Nang ho lah a vang vhutilou ding ahi; nalah-uva alen hinom chu nalhachauva pang ding, 44 amasapena pan nom chu mi jouse soh apang ding ahi. 45 Ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa jeng jong jen dia hung ahipon, ajena pang ding le mi tamtah lhatdohna dia ahinkho tohdoh dinga hung joh ahibouve,” ati.

Jesun mitcho Bartimaeus kho amusah

46 Amaho Jerichoa ahung tauve. Aseijuite le mipi nasatah toh kilhona Jesun Jericho adalhah chun Timaeus chapa mitcho Bartimaeus khutdopa chu lampama antouve. 42 Mitchopan Nazareth Jesu ahi ahetdoh phat’in apengjah jengin, “David chapa Jesu, neikhoton!” tin asamtai. 48 Mihon umthim beh din aphohsl cheh-un, ahinla ama ahapen chehjengin, “David chapa, neikhoton,” tin aseiye. 49 Hichun Jesu adingin, “Gah kouvun,” atileh; mihon mitchopa akouvun ajah a, “Kinemin, kipatdoh-in nakouve,” atiuvin ahi. 50 Chutah chun apon aleh lhan, akichom jang khaileh-in Jesu henga ahung tai. 51 Jesun adonbut’in ajah’a, “Ipi neibolpeh-in nati ham?” atileh; mitchopan, “Rabboni, kho neimusah-in,” ati. 52 Jesun jah a, “Chetan, natahsanin nadamsah tai,” ati. Chutah chun aman kho amu paiyin lampia chun Jesu ajuitai.

Mark 11

Loupi tah a Jesu Jerusalem khopia alut

1 Jerusalem kho koma Olive mol’a Bethphage le Bethany ageiyun Jesun aseijui mi ni asol’in, 2 ajah a, “Nagah galmu kho sunga khun lut lhon le chun mitouna khah lou sa-ngan nou kihen khat namupai lhon ding ahin, hinsut lhan hinkai lhonin. 3 Mi khat touvin, ‘Idia nabol lhon ham?’ ati leh, ‘A-Pakaiyin manna nom aneiye, hinthah vahkit tante,’ tin seipeh lhonin,” ati. 4 Amani ache lhon lehkot polam, khopi dsung lamlena sa-ngan nou kihen chu amun asut lhontai. 5 Chukoma ding ho khat’in, “Ibol nahiya sa-ngan nou chu nasut lhon ham?” ahinti. 6 Amanin Jesu ahil banga asei lhon leh alhatauve. 7 Chuin sa-ngan nou chu Jesu henga ahinkai lhonin, achunga pon aphauvin, Jesu atoutai. 8 Mihon phabep’in loulaiya theoboh alhamun lampia aphauve. 9 Chuin anung le ama kijot chengsen: “Huhhing hen! Pakai min a hungpe anun nom’e! 10 I-Pao David lenggam hung lhung chu nun nom hen!” tin asamtauve. 11 Hichun Jesu Jerusalem khopi alut’in Houin a aluttai. Thil ijakai avetgolsoh leh nilhah lam ahitan, som le ni chutoh Bethany jonin apot dodh tauve.

Jesun theichang phung agaosap

12 Ajinga Bethany a kona ahung ki le kit phat’un Jesu agilkeltai. 13 Gamla thima theichang phung dod nei khat amun, aga um ding ging cha nave din achei. Ahinla aga phat ahiloujeh-in ado tilou ima dang amudoh tapoi. 14 Jesun theichang phung chu, “Tukal’in koiman naga nekit hih hel hen,” atileh; hichu aseijuiten ajauve.

Jesun Houin asuh theng

15 Jerusalem ahung lhungun Jesu Houina alut’in asunga thiljoh le thil cho ho anodoh-in, sum lheng ho dokhang joouse le vapal joh ho touna alikhup peh-in, 16 Houin sunga koi ma thil apoh le sah tapoi. 17 Miho ahil’in, “Ka-in chu namtin dia taona in kiti ding ahi,’ tia kisun hilou ham? Nang hon gucha michomho kikholnan nasemdoh tauve,” ati. 18 Thempu pipu ho le Danthu them hon ajauvin, suhmangna ding lampi aholtauve. Ahinla amihil chu mipin kidang asah cheh jeh-un akichauvin ahi. 19 Nilhah ahi phat’in Jesu le aseijuite khopia konin apotdoh tauve.

Theichang kigaosap thua kihilna

20 Jingpi tah-in thiechang phung chu ahinho paule, ajung ajaa agop jeng chu amu’uve. 21 Thilsoh chu Peterin agel doh phat’in Jesu jah a, “Rabbi, ven, theichang phung na gaosap chu agoptai,” atileh; 22 Jesun ajah-uva, “Pathen tahsanun. 23 Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hile alungthima ginchat lelna beihel’a hiche mol khu ‘Kitol’in twikhanglen’ah kileh lut jengin,’ tia asei banga soh tei dia tahsan chun, asei bang banga soh ding ahi. 24 Hijeh a chu najah-uva kasei ahi, nataovuva thil nathum jouseu namusen gel leu chun namu diu ahi. 25 Tao dia nadin pet le van’a um na-pan Jong nasuh khel jouseu angaidam theina din, koi itobang hijongle nalungdou chu ngaidamin. 26 (Nang hon mi na-Pauvin jong nasuh khel’u angaidam lou ding ahi).

Jesu thuneidol adoh-u

27 Jerusalema ahungkit tauve. Jesu Houin sunga ava le pet’in Thempu pipu hole Danthu themho chule upa ho ahenga ahungun ajah-ah, 28 “Ipi tha neina a hiti ho hi nabol ham? Hicheng bolna ding hi kon tha napeh ham?” tin adongui. 29 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Nang ho thu khat dong inge, neidonbut’un, chutengleh ipi tha neinaa hiti ho hi kabol seipeh nauvinge. 30 John Baptist chu van’a kon ha mihema kon ham? Neidonbut’un” ati. 31 Amaho akinelden tauvin,” ‘Vana kon ahi,’ tileu hen la, ‘Ahileh ibol’a natahsan louvu ham?” tin tin; 32 Mihema kon ahi,’ iti diu ham?” akitiuve. Ahinla mipin John hi Themgao dih a agel jeh-in akichauvin ahi. 33 Hijeh chun Jesu jah a, “Kahepouve,” atiuve. Chuphat’in ajah-uva, “ken jong ipi tha neinaa hichenghi kabol ahi naseipeh pouvinge,” atitai.

Mark 12

Lengpilei le aleilhouho thulem

1 Jesun ajah-uvah thulemin thu aseipanin, “Pasal khat’in lengpilei abol’in, tho akaikhumin, lengpiga chilna din khuh alaiyin, thing chung buh asan, chuin aleilhouho apedodh-in khol’a achetai. 2 Lengpiga lhun phat donin achan ding lengpiga la din aleilhouho henga soh khat asol’e. 3 Aleilhou hon sohpa chu amanun avouvin khutgoh keovin asoltauve. 4 “Ahin asoh khat asol kittai. Hichepa hi aluchang mapun alhauvin, jachat umtah-in anbol’ui. 5 Soh, chom khatma asol kit leh, amahi athat tauve. Hitobang hin soh tampi, abang avouvin, adangse athat’ui. 6 Aman Chapa chang khat bou aneitai. Akhon nan, ‘Kachapa hi anajabol khat’u leh,’ tin ahenguva asol tai. 7 Ahinla lengpilei lhou ho chun, ‘Hichepa hi agoulopa ahi, hungun that’u hitin agoulo ding eiho change hite,’ akitiuvin; 8 amanun atha jou phat’uvin lengpilei polam’ah apaidoh tauve. 9 Lengpilei neipan ipi bol tantem? Ama hung kona aleilhouo ho asuh mang ding, lengpilei chu mi chomdang apeh ding ahi. 10 Nang ho, ‘In sahon adeimouva apaiyu song chu, In ninga khomdetpenin apangtai; 11 Hiche hi Pakai bol ahin, Imit vet’uva thil kidangtah ahi,’ tia kisun Pathen lekhabua chu nasim khah lou laiyu ham?” ati. 12 Amahon athulem sei chu agot nauva asei ahi aheuvin, mat din agouve; ahinla mipi agin jeh-un ada lhauvin ache mangtauve.

Kaipeh thudol’a Jesu adoh-u

13 Jesu chu kinelpia gaman din Pharisee loi phabep le Herodias loi phabep ahenga asoltauve. 14 Amaho chu ahungun ajah a, “Houhil, midih tah nahin, koi mai jamana thilbol jong hilou Pathen lamdih bou nahilji kaheuve. Caesar henga mikai kapeh-u Dan ngai hi na hilou ham? Kapeh diu ha kapeh da diu ham?” atiuve. 15 Jesun akiphat lhemsah-u ahen ajah-uvah, “Idia neilung lah-u ham? Denarius khat hinchoiyun venge,” ati. 16 Ahinchoi phat’un, “Hiche hi koi lim le koi min ham?” atileh; amahon, “Caesar’a,” atiuve. 17 Hichun Jesun ajah-uva, “Caesar thil chu Caesar pauvin, Pathen thil chu Pathen peuvin,” ati. Hichun amah on adatmo lheh jengui.

Mithisa thokit thudol Jesu adoh-u

18 Mithisa thokit tahsan lou sadducee loi Jesu henga ahungun ajah a, 19 “Houhil’ Mose’n ‘Pasal khat’in cha anei masanga aji athi le asopipan meithaini chu avet’a asopipa chu akhaipeh ding ahi,” tin ei sut peh-ui. 20 Sopi pasal sagite aumun, a-upapen ajinei jouvin chikhai louvin aumtai. 21 Anichanna pan avetpeh kit leh amajong chikhai louman athin, chuin athum lhinna pa jong chutiman aumtai. 22 Hiti hin khat chan jong chu akhai apouve. Achainan numeinu jong athitai. 23 Mithi thikitnaa athodoh tengu leh hiche nu hi koipen ji hitan tem? Ajeh chu asagiuva jia anei cheh-u ahi,” tin adongui. 24 Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uva, “Pathen lekhabu le athahat nahetjoh sangu aum loujeh a hiba nakheljiu hilouham? 25 Ijeh-inem itile mihem thinaa kona athodoh tengleh kichen abol paovin, kicheng din jong akilato tapouve; van’a Vantilte tobang ahitauve. 26 Mithi thokit thudol kisutna, Pathenin, ‘Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac pathen chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ atina nasim khah lou laiyu ham? 27 Ama mithi ho Pathen ahipon, mihing ho Pathenjoh ahi. Nagel khel lheh-ui,” ati.

Thupeh nasatah

28 Danthu them ho khat ahung leh akinel’u ajan, Jesun kitoh tah a adonbut amun ajah a, “Thupeh lah a amasapen ipi ham?” atileh; 29 Jesun adonbut’in, “Thupah masapen chu, ‘Ngaiyuvin vo Israel, Pakai i-Pathenu chu Pakai khatseh bou ahi; 30 hijeh a chu nangman pakai na-Pathen chu nalungthim pumpia, nahinkho pumpia, nalung gel jouse leh natha neina jousea na-ngailut ding ahi,’ kiti ahin; 31 anina chu, ‘Nangma naki-ngailut banga naheng nakom na-ngailut ding ahi,’ akiti. Hiche te ni sanga thupijo thupeh dang aumpoi,’ ati. 32 Hichun Danthu thempan ajah a, “Adih-e Houhil, Pathen khatseh tilou adang aumpoi, nati hi adih-in, 33 Ama chu lungthim pumpi le hetna pumpia chule tha neina jousea ngai lut’a chule eima ki-ngailut banga heng le kom ngailut kiti ho hi pumgo thilto le kilhaina gantha jouse sangin athupijoi, nati hi naseidih lheh-e,” ati. 34 Hetoh thema adonbut hi Jesun ahen ajah a, “Pathen lenggam to nakilat poi,” ati. Chukal’in koiman thu adong ngam tapoi.

David Chapa thudol Jesu adoh-u

35 Houin a thu ahil pet’in Jeun, “I-atileh Danthu themhon Messiah chu David guiya peng ding ai atiu ham? 36 Lhagao Thenga konin David amatah-in, ‘Pakai chun ka-Pakai jah a, Keiman namelmate nakeng chotpha kakoisah masangsen, Kajet lama tou jingin,’ atin; 37 David amatah-in ‘Pakai’ asah leh, iti ama guiya peng hithei ding ham?” tin adonge.

Jesun Danthu themho ahousal

Mipin Jesu thuhil chukipah thanom tah-in angaiyui. 38 Jesun athuhilnaa chun, “Ching theiyun, thepna sangkhol chol ki-ah a vah le nom kailhang dunga min asalam ding deiya, 39 Houthua kikhopna in dunga touna pipen dei, golvahna mun jousea munpha hola ho, 40 mei thaiho bahgama, mi mu dia sottah tah taoji hoa konin kihong phauvin, amaho hithemmo chugnnung chang diu ahi,” ati.

Meithainu thilto

41 Jesu Houin sum kholna maitah a atouvin, mihon sumkholna sunga sum alhah-u chu avei. Mihao hon sum tampi pi alhah lut’ui. 42 Meithai vaicha khat ahungin, paisa kha ttoh kikot sumsan nongsi ni alhah lut’e. 43 Jesun aseijuite akouvin ajah-uvah, “Tahbeh a akseipeh nahiuve, hiche meithai vaichanu hin midang jouse sangin sumkholna sunga atoh tam pen’e. 44 Ajeh chu mihon aneival’u atou ahin, hiche numei hin avaichat lheh vangin akivah hingna ding anei chasun aboncha ato ahitai,” ati.

Mark 13

Jesun Houin suhmang ding asei masah

1 Jesu Houina apotdoh pet’in aseijuite khat’in ajah a, “Houhil ven, ipi song kimanga hitobang inhoi kisa hitam!” ati. 2 Jesun ajah a, “Hiche in loupitah kisa hinamu ong? Kisumanga song khat chunga song kise-thom him him umlou ding ahi,” ati.

Gim genthei kipat

3 Houin to kigalsai Olive mol’a Jesu atoupet’in Peter le Jacob, John le Andrew’in guh thim chan adongun, 4 “Naseiho hi itih le hung lhunga, hichengse kichaisohna ding hi amelchihna ipi hiding ham, neiseipeh-un,” atiuve. 5 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Koiman nalhep chatvai louna diiuvin ching theiyun. 6 Mi tampi kamin’a hunguva, ‘kei ama chu kahi,’ tia mi alhep chatvai diu ahi. 7 Gal kisat husa le thuthang najah tenguleh kicha hih-un. Hichu soh tei ding ahi, achaina hilou lai ding ahi. 8 Ajeh chu nam le nam hung kidouva, lenggam le lenggam kidou ding; muntin’a ling kihot’a, kel lha ding, hicheng hi gim genthei kipatna ahitai. 9 “Nang ho ching theiyun; min namat’uva houvaipoloi kikhopna nakailut diu, Houthua kikhopna in dunga navoh-uva, gamvaipo ho le leng ho ang sung jenga jong hettoh sah-a pang dinga nakidinsah nalai diu ahi. 10 Amavang namtin vaipia Kipana Thupha kiseiphong masa tei ding ahiye. 11 Min namat’uva napeh doh tengu le ipi sei ding lung kham masa hih-un, amavang apettah a nakiseipeh pen pen sei jengun; ijeh-inem itile aseiya nang ho hilouvin Lhagao Theng ahibouve. 12 Sopin asopipa, pan acha tha dia ahinpeh doh idng, chate anu le apa chunga chungsoh a atha lo diu ahi. 13 Keima min’jal’a mi jousen nahot diu, hi jongleh akhonna geiya thoh lhumpa bou huhhinga um ding ahi.

Thoh gen thei hahsa tah

14 “Misumang thet umtah chu adinna dol louva ding namu tengule (asim sim’an he hen), Judea gama um ho thinglhang lama jamu hen; 15 intingvuma umpa jong kum lhah da hen, a-insunga thil kilah din jong galut da hen; 16 loujaova um jong avon kilah din kile kit hih hen. 17 Ohe, chulaiya numei gai le nao noichep neiho ada ahiuve! 18 Hiche phat hi phalbi lai ahilouna din taovun, 19 ajeh chu hiche hi hesoh gen theina nasatah hiding ahin, hitobang hi Pathenin vannoi asemtil’a pat soh khalou lai ahin, soh jong soh kit lou idng ahi. 20 Pakaiyin aphat hi asuh chomlou hileh mihing koima sohcha louhel ding ahi, hijeh a chu alhenchomte jal’a aphat asuh chom ahi. 21 “Hiche phat hileh khat touvin najah-uva, ‘Ven, hikomah Messiah aume,’ atia, ‘Ven khukomah aume,’ atijongle tahsan hih-un. 22 Ijeh-inem itile Messiah lhem ho le Themgao lhem ho hungsoh dodh-un tin, mi lhep lhahna ding le ajochan a lhen chomte geiya lhep lhahna dia melchihna tampi le thil kidang tampi abol diu ahi. 23 Ching theiyun ijakai kahil masah dem nahitauve.

Mihem Chapa lung ding

24 “Chulaiya gim genthei kichaijou tah le, ‘Nisa thimin tin, Lha jong vah lou ding, 25 vanlaijol’a ahsite pul lhantin, Van’a thaneina chengse kihot lingsoh ding ahi,’ akiti. 26 Chutah le Mihem Chapa tha neitah le loupe tah a meiloma hung mihon amudiu ahi. 27 Chuteng Aman a-Vantilte sol’in tin kol kimvel ninglia leiset monga pat van mong geiya alhen chomte akhop khom diu ahi.

Theichang phung thulema kihilna

28 “Theichang phunga konin thulem kihil’un: abah adot’a ajih akilhap teng nipi nai naheuve. 29 Hitobanga chu thilsoh hicheng hi namu tengu le phat anaiya kotbul ahung gei nahet diu ahi. 30 Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, thil hichengse hi aso kahsea tukhang hi kichai lou ding ahi. 31 Van le leiset mang ding ahin, kathusei ho vang mang lou ding ahi.

Koiman anikho le anidan ahepoi

32 “Pa tilou anikho le anidan tah chu va’a Vantilte le Chapan jong, koiman ahepoi. 33 Aphat nahet loujeh-uvin ching theiyun, kiging jingun. 34 Hiche hi mikhat’in asohte atoh ding cheh a ngansea, kotngah pa jong kiging jing dia seipeh a, chujouva a-insung dalhaa kholgamla tah a che mang tobang ahi. 35 Hijeh chun kiging jingun, in neipa itih le hung ding nahepouve; nilhah ham, khangkim ham, ah-khon ham, jingkah ham a hung thie ahi. 36 Photlot louva hunga na-ihmut pet’u atokhah louna dia 37 najah-uva kaseipeh hi mi jouse kaseipeh ahitai, kigingun,” ati.

Mark 14

Hou lamkaihon Jesu athagot’u

1 Kalchuhkut le cholsolou changlhah kut bolna ding ni nibou aumtan, Thempu pipu ho le Danthu themhon Jesu chu doha bol’a mat’a chule thana thei ding aholtauve. 2 Amahon, “Ajo le japi lah a boina um get’inte, kut sung hida hen,” atiuvin ahi.

Bethany khoa Jesu thao anu

3 Bethany khoa Simon miphahpa in’a Jesun ankong aumpet’in numei khat’in songval hai kaht’in nard thao namtui man tamtah ahin choiyin, ahai avokeh-in thaotwi chu Jesu luchunga asun khume. 4 Alah-uva mi kon khat along himouvin, “Ibol’a hitobang thao namtui hi komoh suh mang ham? 5 Denarii jathumval a joh a mivaichate peh thei khula ahin,” atiuvin, amanu chunga aphuntauve. 6 Jesun vang, “Hiche nu chu limsah dauvin, ibol’a nasuh lunggimu ham? Aman thilpha tah eibolpeh ahi. 7 Ajeh chu vaicha gentheite nakom’uva aum jingin, nagot chan’a thilpha nabolpeh theiyu ahi, Keivang nakom’uva um jing ponge. 8 Aman ajokham kham ahung bol’a, kalong hi vui dia thao einu masah ahi. 9 Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, vannoiya Kipana Thupha kiseiphongna chan’a athilbol hiamanu het jingna dia kisei thapeh ding ahi,” ati.

Jesu pehdoh ding Judas anop

10 Seijiu som le nil ah a khat Judas Iscariot chu Jesu pedoh din Thempu ho henga achetai. 11 Amahon ajah phat’un akipah-un sum peh din atep’ui. Judas chun amat theina din agomkom aching lhi’e.

Jesun seijuite toh kalchuhkut an anehkhom

12 Cholsolou changlhah kut ni masa kalchuhkut gantha nin Jesu seijuiten ajah a, “Kalhchuhkut an naneh na ding hoikom mun gago leu veng nadeiyem?” tin adongui. 13 Aman aseijui mi ni asol’in ajah lhona, “Khopi sunga lut lhon le chun twibel pua pasal khat toh lhonin natin, ama chu jui lhonin, 14 alutna in-neipu jah a, ‘Houhil’in, “Kaseijuite toh kalchuhkut an kanehna ding ka-indan chu hoilai ham?” tin ahol’e,’ gati lhonin. 15 Chuteng aman inching dan lentah, suhngimsa gotsa kikoi khat navetsah lhonin tin, hikoma chun ibonchauva din anagong lhontan,” ati. 16 Seijuite ni achen, khopi sunga alut’in, thil ijakai asei bangin agatoh-in, kalchuhkut anagong lhone. 17 Nilhah ahiphat’in Jesu som le ni chutoh ahungtai. 18 Chuin touva an aneh laitah-un Jesun, “Tahbeh a akseipeh nahiuve, nalah-uva khat, kaneh khompipa tah hi eipedoh a pang ding ahi,” atitai. 19 Hichun alungkham pantauvin, khat khat’in ajah-ah, “Keivang kahilou ahinai ong?” tin adonguve. 20 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Som le nilah a khat, lhenga changlhah kadekot khompi pa hi ahi. 21 Miihem Chapa vang chu aumchan didng kisun banga chetei ding ahin, ahivangin amajeh a Mihem Chapa kimat lo dingpa chu, ohe, ada na’e! penglou hileh ama dia phajo ta dinga!” ati.

Pakai anjon kiphudoh

22 An aneh laitah-un Jesun changlhah alan phatthei aboh jouvin aheh bal bal’in amaho apen, “Kilah-un, hiche hi katahsa ahi,” ati. 23 Khon jong chu alan athang vah jouvin amaho apen, abon Chauvin khona chun adonsoh keiyui. 24 Chuin ajah-uvah, “Hiche hi mi tamtah dinga kilhoh lha, kathisana kitepna ahi. 25 Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen lenggama athah kadon kit ding nikho hung lhun kahsea lengpiga twi hi kadon lou ding ahitai,” ati. 26 Chuin la asah jouvun Olive mol lam jonin achedoh tauve.

Peterin aseilep ding Jesun asei masah

27 Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho nakipal lhuhsoh diu ahi, ajeh chu, ‘kelngoi Chingpa kavoh lhuh a kelngoite chehgam diu ahi,’ tin akisune. 28 Hijongle kathodoh jou teng Galilee gam lhung masajo ding kahi,” ati. 29 Peterin adonbut’in “Khat khat’in kipal lhu jong leu keivang kipal lhu ponge,” ati. 30 Jesun ajah a, “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, tujanle lea ah nivei akhon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi,” ati. 31 Ahinla Peterin, “Nang to kathi tha tei ding, kaseilep louhel ding ahi,” atichang mel’e. Abonchauvin achutisei cheh-uve.

Gathsemane hon’a Jesu tao

32 Gethsemane kiti mun ahinphah phat’un Jesun aseijuite jah a, “Kagatao sungsen hikom’ah anatou jingun,” ati. 33 Chuin Peter le Jacob chule John apuiyin, kidang asa behseh-in nasatah-in alunghem pantai. 34 Hijeh chun ajah-uvah, “Thina khop hel’in kalung hesoh tai, hikoma umun kiging jinguvin,” ati. 35 Chule masang lama phabep ache chonin, tol’ah akhup boh-in alhun, ahitheile hiche phat chu akoma kona kitol mang din ijakai ahitheiye, hiche khon hi keiya konin tolmang tan; hinla Kei dei hilouvin Nang deijoh hihen,” ati. 37 Ahung phat’in khatte ho a-ihmut lhuh-u atoh khan, Peter jah a, “Simon, na-ihmut hitam? Nidan khat jeng jong kiginga umjou lou nahim? 38 Lhepna nalhah louna diuvin kigingin tao jingun. Lhagaovin ago lheh nan, tahsa alhasame, “ati. 39 Achedoh kit’in asei ngai bang seiyin agataove. 40 Chuin ahungkit leh a-ihmut lhuh-u ahung toh khan, mit phah chet’a anaum jeh-un adonbutje jong ahetapouve. 41 Thumvei channa ahung chun ajah-uvah, “Ihmua kicholdo nalai nahiu ong? Aphasettai! Nidan alhinge! Mihem Chapa hi michonsete khut’a pehdoh a um ahitai. 42 Kipat’un chetaute. Ven, eipedoh pan eihin phatauve,” ati.

Jesu apehdoh-u le amat’u

43 Jesun thu asei nalaiyin, som le nil ah a khat, Judas chu Thempu pipu ho le Danthu themhoa kona, chemjam le moltum thoa hung miho chutoh ahung paitai. 44 Apedoh pan miho melchihna ahil masan, “kachop pen pen chu Ama ahi, manun lang kitup keichan kai mang tauvin,” ati. 45 Judas ahung lhunin Jesu ajon paiyin, “Rabbi,” tin achoptai. 46 Mihon achung’ah khut alhauvin amantauve. 47 Akoma ding ho khat chun chemjam asatdoh-in Thempulen sohpa asat jeng leh abilkol asat lhai. 48 Hichun Jesun ajah-uvah, “Gucha michom man ding banga, Kei man dia chemjam le moltum thoa hungkon nahiu ong? 49 Niseh a Houina thu kahil chunla neiman pouvin. Ama vang Pathen lekhabua kiseisa thu guilhung hiya hi,” ati. 50 Chutah-in aloiten adalhauvin ajamtauve. 51 Tupat ponnem khatseh sil gollhang khat jesu nungjui ahin, ama hi amat’u leh, 52 tupat ponnem chu dalhan asagoh keovin ajam mangtai.

Hou lamakaiho anga Jesu

53 Jesu chu Thempulen henga apuiyun, Thempu pipu ho le upa ho chule Danthu them chengse akikhomsohkeiyui. 54 Peterin galkanga ajuipeh-in Thempulen leltol geiyon ajui luttai. Chuin lhacha ho to atoukhomin mei a-oiye. 55 Thempupipu hole Hou vaipoloise sen Jesu thana thei hehsetna hettohsah ahol’un amu joupouve. 56 Ajeh chu mitampin Jesu hehsetna hettohsah asei vangun, akitoh hih-ui. 57 Chuin miphabep adingdohun jouthun ahehseuvin, 58 “Amahin, ‘Hiche khut’a kisa Houin hi suseng ting, nithum sunga khut’a sah lou achom khat katundoh ding ahi,’ tia asei kajaove,” atiuvin ahi. 59 Hichea jong hin akitoh kit pouve. 60 Chuphat’in Thempulen chu alah-uva adingdoh-in Jesu adongin, “nadonbut lou ding ham? Hite hon nahehset nau hi ipiba ham?” atileh; 61 Jesu athip behin, adonbut poi. Thempulen chun adong kit’in ajah a, “Nangma nun nom Chapa, Messiah chu nahim?” atileh; 62 Jesun, “Kahi; Nang hon Mihem Chapa chu Tha neipen jet lama touva, Vanlaijol meilom lah a hung namu diu ahina laiye,” ati. 63 Chutah chun Thempulen chun athemputna sangkhol abot eh-in, “Hettohsah dang iding ititah diu ham? 64 Pathen ataitom na naja cheh tauve. I-lo ding natiuvam?” atileh; abonchauvin athi dia lomin athemmosah tauve. 65 Abangin chil asset khumin, chuin amai atomun avouvin, ajah-ah, “Gaovin,” atiuvin; chuin lhachahon amanun angeiphe abengun, hiti hin abolpan tauve.

Peterin Jesu aseilep

66 Peter noiolam leitol’ah aum nalaiyin, Thempulen soh nu-ngah khat ahungin 67 Peter mei oi chu amui. Peter aven, “Nang hi Nazareth Jesu toh kiloisa nahi,” ati. 68 Peterin aseilep tan, “Kahepoi, ipi nasei ham kahe chenpoi,” atin, leitol maiya apotdoh le ah akhongtai. 69 Soh nu-ngah chun amudohin avel’a ding ho jah din, “Hichepa vang hi amaho loi khat ahi,” ati pan kitai. 70 Paterin aseilep kit’e. Chomkhat jouvin akoma ding hon Peter jah a, “Nang hi amaho loi khat mong mong nahibouve, ajehchu Galilee gam mi nahi,” atiuve. 71 Ahivangin Peterin kigaosap le kihahsel athopanin, “naseipau hi kahekhpaoi,” ati. 72 Chutah-in ah lailha akhongpaitai. Hichun Peterin, “Ah nivei akhon kah a thumvei neisilep ding ahi,” tia Jesun asei chu agel doh-in alungna behseh-in hakan akaptai.

Mark 15

Pilate anga Jesu

1 Jingpi tah-in Thempuho le upaho, Ddanthu them ho le Hou vaipolai chengse akihoutoh paiyun, Jesu akan’un Pilate henga akaitauve. 2 Pilate chun Jesu adongin, “Judate lengpa nahim?” atileh; Aman adonbut’in ajah a, ‘Nangsei ahi,” ati. 3 Thempu pipuhon jong thu tampin ahehse se jengui. 4 Pilate chun adong kit’in, “Nadonbut lou ding ham? Ven, nahehset set jengu khu?” 5 Jesun adonbut louhel phat’in Pilate’n adatmo lheh jenge.

Jesu tha dia thu kitan

6 Kut sunga mihon athumpen pen sohchang khat Pilate’n alhadoh pehji ahi. 7 Kivaipoh deimoa galbol mithah ho toh songkul’a kihentha amin Barabbas kiti anaume. 8 Mipi akitol touvun Pilate’n sohchang alhadohpeh nagi banga bolpeh din angeh pantauve. 9 Pilate’n adonbut’in ajah-uva “Judate lengpa hi lhadoh peh leng nadeiyum?” ati. 10 Ajeh chu Thempu pipuhon thangset suma apehdoh-u ahet ahi. 11 Ahinla Thempu pipuhon Barabbas joh alhadoh pehna diuvin mipi atilseuve. 12 Pilate chun adonbut kit’in ajah-uva, “Acutile Juddate lengpa ahi natipau hi i-kalo ding ba ham?” atileh; 13 “Thingpel’a khenbeh-in!” tin asamtauve. 14 Hichun Pilate’n ajah-uvah “Ib0l-inem? Ipi suhset aneiyem?” atileh; amahon, “Thingpel’a khen beh-in!” tin ahasap cheh tauve. 15 Mipi along lhaisah nom jeh-in Pilaate’n Barabbas alhadoh peh-in, Jesu joh chu ajep jouvin thingpel’a khetbeh din apedohtai.

Sepaihon Jesu totna aneiyu

16 Sepaihon Jesu chu gamvaipopa inpi thutanna lhong laiya akailut’un, sepia hon pumpi akoukhom tauve. 17 Chuin Jesu chu ponsandup asilpeh-un, ling lukhuh apheh’un akhuh peh-uvin, 18 salam abol’un, “Hingsot’in Judate lengpa!” atiuve. 19 peng tenggol khat’in alu avouvin, chil asset khum’ui; a-anga dilsun akun’uve. 20 A-el el-a tot nopna anei jouvun ponsandup chu ahoh lhauvin Ama pon asilpeh tauve.

Jesu thingpel’a akhetbeh-u

Jesu chu thingpel’a khetbeh din apuidoh tauve. 21 Loujaova kona hintoh kha, Cyrene gam mi, Alexander lle Rufus pa, simon chu sepaihon acham louvin aman’un Jesu thingpel aputsah-ui. 22 Jesu chu “Lugu mun” Kiti Golgotha alhut tauve. 23 Myrrh le lengpitwi kihal apeh vangun Jesun adonpoi. 24 Hichun thingpel’a akhenbeh-un aponsil jouse chu koi ipi chang dingahmtin vang asanun akihomtauve. 25 Thingpel’a Jesu akhetbeh nau chu jingkah lam nidan ko ahi. 26 Achung thu hehsetna kisun chu, “Judate lengpa,” tia kijih ahi. 27 Gucha hi, Jesu jet le veiya akhetbeh thauve. 28 (Hichea hin, “Aman Dan sukeh ho toh akisim thatai,” tia kisei Pathen lekhabu thuchu aguilhung tai.) 29 Ajotpa jousen akhasuh khumun, a-engkal nan, ‘Kadah, Houin susea nithum sunga tungdoh ding pa, 30 kihuhhingin lang thongpel chunga koin hung kumlha tang-em!” atiuve. 31 Hitobang hin Thempu pipu ho le Danthu themhon kidai naa aneiyun, “Midang la ahuhingnan, Ama akihuhing joupoi, 32 Kamu’uva katahsan theina diiuvin Israel lengpa Messiah chu tutah hin thingpel chunga konin hung kumlhan tem hen,” atiuve. Ama toh thingpel’a kikhetbeh tha te ni geiyin ahouse lhontai.

Jesu thi

33 Nidan som le ni sunkima pat nilhah nidan thum geiyin leiset pumpi chunga mu athimtai. 34 Nilhah nida thum chun Jesu hapenin apengin, “Ka-Pathen, Ka-Pathen, ibol’a neilha hitam?” tinan “Eloi, Eloi lema sabachthni?” atileh; 35 akoma ding ho phabep’in ajauvin, “ven, Elijah akouve,” atiuve. 36 Hichun mikhat alhaijel’in lengpitwi thuh lah a twichoppon ase-lhop’in, peng tenggol leh a atah-in adon din agah pen, ‘Limsah hih-un, adomlha dia Elijah hung nam veu hite,” ati. 37 Hichun Jesu hapenin apengin atantai. 38 Chutah chun Houin pondal len chu ahunga pat anoi geiyin kehni akison, a-eh lhangtai. 39 Akoma ding sepia jalamkaipan hitobanga athi amun, “Hichepa hi Pathen Chapa mong mong ah!” tin aseitai. 40 Numei phabep’in jong galkanga pat’in aven, alah-uva Magdalene Mary le Jacob neojo le Joseph nu Mary, chule Salome apangin, 41 Jesu Galilee gama alenlaiya juilea alhacha ho ahiuve; Chule numei dang tampi Jesun Jerusalema ahin lhontoupi hojong ahiuve.

Jesu avuiyu

42 Nilhah lam ahitan, Choldo nikho dia kigot ni ma ahin, 43 Arimathea khoa vaipo gin le ja umtah, Pathen lenggam ngah jinga um Joseph chu achen, Pilate henga ngampel’in alut’in Jesu long chu agathume. 44 Athivah jeng chu Pilatein kidang asan, sepia jalam kai chu akouvin, athina sottam tin adonge. 45 Sepai jalamkaipaa kona het chet phat’in Pilatein Jesu long chu Joseph apetai. 46 Josephin tupat ponnem khat achon, Jesu long chu adom lhan, atomin songlhan kilao dsunga chun alupsah-in, lhankot achun song khat atang lut’in asingtai. 47 Magdalene Mary le Joseph nu Mary Jesu alupsahna chu avelhi jinglhone.

Mark 16

Jesu thodoh

1 Choldo ni akichai phat’in Magdalene Mary l eJacob nu Mary chule Salome hicheng hi chea Jesu long nu nam din lou namtui achouve. 2 Hapta ni masa ni, jingpi matah, nisa so-thin thenin numeiho chu lhan phung’ah ahungui. 3 Numei ho chun, “Lhankot sin song kon eitahdoh peh diu ham?” tin akihouvun ahi. 4 Song chu lentah ahin, agah vet’u leh tahsohsan aumtai. 5 Lhan sung a agalut’u leh ponbang sil’a gollhang khat jet lama anatouvin, akinlih deh jenguve. 6 Ama chun ajah-uvah, “Kicha hin-un, thingpel’a kithahsa Nazareth Jesu nahol’u ahin, Ama athoudoh-in hikom’ah aumtapoi. Ven, hikoma hi alupsah-u ahi. 7 Chule kile kit’un langa aseijuite le Peter jah a, “Ama nang ho sangin Galilee gam alhung masatai. Najah-uva aseisa banga chua Ama namu diu ahi,’ tin gaseipeh-un ati. 8 Amaho lhana konin ahung potdoh-un helouvin ajamtauve. Atijat behseh jeh-un koima imacha aseipeh pouvin ahi.

Jesu Magdalene Mary henga akilah

9 Hapta ni-masapen ni, jingpia athodoh jouvin masanga asunga thilha sagi anodohnanu Magdalene Mary henga Jesu akilah masapen’e. 10 Amanu achen Jesu kiloipisa, ahijeh a lunghema kapte ho agaseipeh-e. [Mi abang in 16:9-10 gei hi apaiyin, abangin vang akoiyin hintin asune:] 9 “Numeihon gollhangpa sei chengse chu Peter le aloite akaigop’in aseipeh-ui. 10 Khonungin Jesun amaho amang chan atheng le suhmang theilou huhhing thu chu solama pat lhumlam geiyin athutsah tai, Amen!” 11 Amahon Jesu ahindoh a Mary akimusah ajah vangun atahsan pouve.

Jesu seijui ni henga akilah

12 Hiche nung hin Jesun alah-uva mi ni gamlang jon’a ache na lhona lim chombeh pun akimusah-in ahi. 13 Amani chea adang ho agaseipeh lhon vangin, amani thusei geiyin atahsan deh pouve.

Jesun seijui som le khat thu apeh

14 Chujouvin som le khat’in ankong aum laitah-un Jesu ahenguva akilah-in, athodoh jouva amuho thusei atahsan loujeh-u leh alungtah jeh-un aphoh-in ahousal’e. 15 Aman ajah-uva, “Vannoi gamtin’a cheuvin, Kipana Thupha gaseiphongun. 16 Atahsan baptize chang jouse huhhinga um ding, atahsan lou vang chu them changa kikoi ding ahi. 17 Atahsante chu melchihna hicheng hin ajuiya; Keima min a thilha anodoh diu, paochom chom athouva, 18 khut’a gulte adop sang diu; thina thei gutwi don jong leu imatilou diu ahi; ana dammo chunga khup angap’u leh dam ding ahi,” ati.

Jesu van’a akaltou

19 Pakai Jesun ajah-uva thu asei chai phat’in van’a lah touvin aumtan, Pathen jet lama atoutai. 20 Miho vang chu acheuvin muntin’a alhangsam leuvin, athuseiyu chu Pakaiyin akithopin, melchihna tampin aphu det peh-e.

Luke 1

Theophilus henga pehdoh

1 I-lah-uva hung guilhung chengse sutdohna mi tamtah-in abol pan banguvin, 2 athilsoh kipat’a pat amit tah a mua athu lhachaa pang hon eihil bangun, 3 michungnung Theophilus, thilsoh ho hi ken jong kahet themsa banga ban neicha le kitoh tah a hinsut doh peh ding kaseiye; 4 chutileh nakiseipehsa thilsoh ho hi nahet chet thei ding ahi.

John Baptist so ding kisei masah

5 Judea gama Herod lengpa vaipoh laiyin Abijah themput dol’a thempu, Zechariah kiti khat aume. Ajinu chu Aaron chilhah ahin, amin Elizabeth akiti. 6 Anupa lhonin Pathen vet dia midih gel, nolnabeiya Pakai thupeh jouse le chondan chengse nit bukimsoh ahilhone. 7 Elizabeth achinjeh-in cha vang anei lhonpon, teh la atehse lheh lhontai. 8 Thempu chon ngaiya Zechariah loiho panna ding nikhon, Pakai Houin thenga lut’a gimnamtui lhutnam na dia 9 vang kisan chu Zechariah chunga achuh khah jeh-in aman Pathen angsunga themput kin anabol’in ahi. 10 Gimnamtui kilhutnam laisen mipi polama adingun ataovui. 11 Hichun Zechariah henga Vantil khat ahung kilah-in, gimnamtui kilhut namna maicham jet lama chun ahung dinge. 12 Vantil amu phat’in Zechariah alungkhamin kijong akichai. 13 Ahinla Vantil chun ajah a, Zechariah, kicha hih-in, nataona akisangin, najinu Elizabeth in chapa khat ahin’a, amin John nasah ding ahi; 14 kipah thanom lheh in natin, chule ama penjal’a mitampi kipah diu ahi. 15 Ajeh chu ama hi Pakai mitmua nasatah hiya, lengpitwi hihen khamna thei ju hijong leh adon louhel ding, apenlhah a pat Lhagao Theng dimset ding ahi. 16 Chule Israelte tamtah Pakai a-Pathenu henga alepui lut kit ding ahi. 17 Elijah Themgao Lhagao le thahat aken’a, Pathen sol lea panga, mipate lunggel chate lama aheidoh a, thua nung loute chihna thudih agelsah-a Pakai dia miho kigosadema akoipeh ding ahi,” ati. 18 Zechariah chun Vantil jah a, “Keila kateh lheh tan, kajinu jong tehsesa ahitan, cha kanei mong lhon ding chu iti kahet thei ding ham? atileh; 19 Vantil’in, “Keima hi Pathen angsunga ding jing Gabriel kahin, hiche thupha hi najah a seipeh dia eihinsol ahi. 20 Ven, hichengse hi akitep phat cha hung guilhung tei ding ahin, kaseipeh natahsan loujeh a aguilhun nikho geiya paomoa naum ding ahitai,” ati. 21 Mipin Zechariah chu a-ngah jingun, munthenga achuti sotden adatmo lheh jengui. 22 Ahungdoh phat’in apaomo tan, muntheng sunga mu nei ahi mihon aheuvin, aman jong thilsoh umchan chu akhut’in athon, paomon aumtai. 23 Chuin thempu kin abol chaisoh phat’in Zechariah in lama ahung kile kittai. 24 Nikho phabep nungin ajinu Elizabeth chun nao avop tan, lha nga sungin akiselgun, hiti hin, 25 “Teh nunga Pakaiyin nao eivopsah a, japi maiya kajachatna lahmang peh eigot ahi,” ati.

Jesu pen ding kisei masah

26 Elizabeth gai kal lhagup lhin nan Vantil Gabriel chu Pathena konin Galilee gam Nazareth khoa 27 David chilhah Joseph toh kicheng dia kitepsa nu-ngah Mary henga akisol’e. 28 Vantil chu alut’in ajah a, “Nun nomin sah chungnung nu, Pakaiyin naumpi jinge!” ati. 29 Mary chu alung kichi-ah lah jengin, ipi thudol’a kilemna ahiding giltah-in agel’e. 30 Hichun Vantil’in ajah a, Mary kicha hih-in, Pathen lungdei namui. 31 Na gaiya chapa khat nahin ding, amin Jesu nasah ding ahi. 32 Ama thupi tah hiya Chungnungpen Chapa kitia, Pakai Pathenin apu David laltounaa atousah ding ahi. 33 Jacob chihlhah te chunga lengvai pontin, alenggam chun beitih neita lou ding ahi,” ati. 34 Ahinla Maryn Vantil jah a chun, “Iti cha kanei thei ding ham, keila pasalto kakitimat khapon?” atileh; 35 Vantil’in ajah a, Lhagao Theng nachunga hung chun tin, Chungnungpen tha neinan nahinlekhu ding, hijeh a hi apeng ding naosen theng chu Pathen Chapa kiti ding ahi. 36 Nanulamnu Elizabeth-in jong teh nungin chapa khat avop’in, achinga kiseinu agaiyin lhagup alhingtai; 37 ajeh chu Pathen dingin imacha ahimopoi,” ati. 38 Chuphat-’in Mary, “Ven, Pakai nalhachanu kei, nasei bangin kachunga guilhung hen,” ati. Hichun Vantil’in Mary adalhatai.

Maryn Elizabeth agavil

39 Hichelai hin Mary akipat paiyin Judea thinglhang gam khopi khat’ah thanom tah-in achei. 40 Zechariah in’a alut’in Elizabeth salam agabol’e. 41 Mary salam chu Elizabeth-in ajah pet tah-in aoisunga naocha akichomin, Elizabeth chu Lhagao Theng adimtai. 42 Chuin Elizabeth chun othongin asamin, Numei jouse lah a nunnom nu, nanaobu sunga um jong anun nome! 43 I-atile ka-Pakai hungnu lomlom kahenga hung jeng hitam! 44 Ajeh chu salam thu nasei kajah jah chun ka-oisunga naocha kipah-in akichom jenge. 45 Ahenga Pakai thusei guilhung ding tahsan nu anun nome,” ati. Maryn vahchoi la asah 46 Hichun Maryn aseiyin: “Kahinkhon Pakai kachoi an’in, 47 Eihuhhing Pakai Pathen chunga Kalhagao akipah-e. 48 Ajeh chu alhacha nu lhasam tah eigeldoh-in, Ven, tua pat akhang khanga miten Nun Nom nua eisei diu ahitai. 49 Ijeh-inem itile Hatchungnungin thil nasatah eibolpeh-in, Amin jong athenge. 50 Ama gingte chu akhang khangin alungset jinge. 51 Aban thahat ajesal’in thanei tah-in thil abol’in, Alunggel’uva kiletsah hoithote athecheh soh tai. 52 Vaihom thanei tah ho alaltouna konin aloilhan Tahlel chagate achoisangtai. 53 Agilkelte antui tuiyin avah van, Mihaote khutgoh keovin asolmang’e. 54 Alhacha Israel henga akitepna, I-pu i-paute Abraham le achilhahte henga aseisa, 55 Tonsot kumkhoa alungset long lou chu Ageldoh jing jenge,” ati. 56 Mary chu Elizabeth koma lha thum jen anichongin, chuin in lama akile kittai.

John baptist pen

57 Elizabeth naoso phat alhingin chapa khat ahingtai. 58 Aheng akom ho leh aphung gol hon Pakaiyin nasatah a Elizbeth alungset hi ajauvin akipapi cheh-uve. 59 Niget lhin nin naosen chep tan din ahungun, apa min putsah a Zechariah hisah ding agouve. 60 Ahinla anun ajadan, “Amin John kiti ding ahibouve,” ati. 61 Amahon Elizabeth jah a, “Naphung sunguva chutobang minneikha bon um louva,” atiuve. 62 Chuphat’in mihon apan ipi asah nom chu mit heiyin adongui. 63 Zechariah chun asutna ding pheng khat athumin, “Amin John ahi,” tia ajih leh abonchan adatmo soh hel’uve. 64 Hichepet tah chun Zechariah apaodoh jeng theiyin, Pathen avahchoiye. 65 Aheng akom jouse akichauvin, hiche thusoh hi Judea thinglhang gamsung athangsoh tai. 66 Athusoh japha chanin alungthim’ah, “Hiche naosen khu ipi hungsoh ding ham?” ati cheh-ui. Ajeh chu Pakai ban thahat’in naosen chu aumpi jinge.

Zechariah gaothusei

67 Naosen Pa Zechariah Lhagao Theng adimin gaothu aseitai: 68 “Pakai, Israel Pathen vahchoiyute, Aman amite akithopin jalenna amusah tai. 69 Alhacha David insunga konin Huhhing hattah khat saki bangin atungdoh tai. 70 Hiche hi masang laiya Athemgao theng ho kama aseisa ahi. 71 Imelmateu le eihot bolteu khut’a kona Eihuhdoh jing diuva thu atepsa ahin; 72 I-Pu i-Pateu alungset tei tei ding, Akitepna theng suhmil lou dia aseisa ahi. 73 I-Pu luiyu Abraham henga kihahsel’a, Imelmateu khut’a kona eihuhdoh diu, 74 Gin neilouva Ama kin ibol theiyuva, 75 Ihinkho lhumkeiyuva dih tah a akin ibol diu ati ahi. 76 Naosen nang jong Chungnungpen Pa Themgao nakitia, Pakai masanga chea alampi nasempeh ding; 77 Amite hi achonsetnau ki-ngaidama Huhhingna chang dia naseipeh ding ahi. 78 I-Pathenu hi lung nemtah lungset them ahin, Thina muthim jing lah a touho chunga 79 Nisa loupi tah avahsah a, chamna lampi jon’a akijotsah diu ahi,” ati. 80 Naosen chu ahung khang khangin tahsa le lhagaova hattah ahitai. Israelte henga lhang phonga akilah masangsen gamthip lah jenga apansai.

Luke 2

Jesu pen

1 Hiche lai chun Caesar Augustus in leiset chung cheng mijouse simtoh a min sutdoh din thu apei. 2 Hiche hi min kisim masah pen ahin, hichepet hin Quirinius Syria gamvaipon apange. 3 Mihem jouse ama ama khopi cheh a min kisut din acheuve. 4 Joseph jong David insung chilhah ahijeh-in Galilee gam Nazareth khoa konin Judea gam David khopi, Bethlehema achetouve. 5 Min kisut dia ache hin ajihol Mary gai hamset chutoh alhon’e. 6 Chukoma aum pet lhonin Mary navah phat alhing’in, 7 achapa masapen ahingtai. Jin lhun in’a amani ding mun onlou jeh-in Maryn naosen chu ponin ajel’in gan ankong-ah alupsah-e.

Kelngao ching ho le Vantilte

8 Hiche gama chun kelngoi ching phabep loujaova ageh-un, janin kelngoi hon ngah akilha lhauve. 9 Chuin Pakaiya kon Vantil khat akom’uva ahung dingin, Pakai loupi nan akimvel’u asalvah soh jenge; amaho akicha behseh jengun ahi. 10 Vantil chun ajah-uvah, “Kicha hih-un, ajeh chu ve, nang ho dia hachangpa kipana Thupha kahinpoh peh nahiuvin, mi jouse kipana hi ding ahi. 11 Ijeh-inem itile tunin nang ho din David khopia huhhingpa Pakai Messiah chu apengtai. 12 Naphot chetna diu chu: naosen pon’a kijel’a gan ankong sunga lum nagamu diu ahi,” ati. 13 Phot lot louvin Vantil chutoh vanmi janelten Pathen avahchoiyun hiti hin, 14 “Chungnungpena Pathen loupi hen, Leiset’a alungdei mite chunga cham leng hen,” atiuve. 15 Vantilte chu van lam jona akile kit phat’un kelngoi ching ho khat le khat akihouvun, “Bethlehema cheu hitin Pakaiyin eihetsah-u hiche thilsoh hi gaveu hite,” akitiuvin ahi. 16 Kinloi tah a acheu le Mary le Joseph toh naosen gan ankonga lum chu agamu’ve. 17 Amu phat’uvin naosen chung chang thudol ajah-uva kisei chengse chu miho aseipeh tauve. 18 Ajah-uva kelngoi ching ho thusei japha chanin kidang asa lheh jengun, 19 Maryn vang hichengse chu achingin alung gil’in agel jinge. 20 Kelngoi ching hon akiseipeh banguva thil amu jeh-un Pathen choiat le thangvah thon akile kittauve.

Jesu min asah-u

21 Niget lhin nin naosen chep tan phat ahitan, naobua akijil masanga Vantil’in amin asahsa Jesu asah tauve.

Houin’a Jesu apuiyu

22 Mose Danthu dungjuiya kisuh theng phat alhinin Jesu chu Pakai henga din Jerusalema ahinpui touvui. 23 Pakai Danthua, “Naobu tumkeh masa pasal tapou Pakaiya atheng ding ahi,” tia kisei bangin, 24 chule Pakai Danthua kisei, “Vakhu kop khat ahiloule vapal nou ni ham,” kiti dungjuiyin kilhaina bol din agouve. 25 Ven, Jerusalema chun amin Simeon kiti pasal khat, midih le hougut tah, Israel kilhatdoh ding ngah jinga um ahin; Lhagao Theng vop, 26 Pakaiya kon Messiah amu kahsea thilou dia Lhagao Thengin aphondoh mi khat aume. 27 Simeon chu Lhagaovin Houin’a ahinpui lut’in, Danthua kisei banga naosen Jesu kin abolpeh lou khoh ho bolpeh dia anu le apan ahinpui lut lhon phat’in 28 Simeonin naocha chu akipomin, Pathen vahchoiyin aseiye: 29 “Pakai* tua hi nasei banga Nalhachapa lung monga neilhadoh ahitai; 30 Ijeh-inem itile kamit tah-in Nahuhhingna kamutai. 31 Hiche hi namtin mitmua Gontohsa nakoi, 32 Chidang namdangte henga nadei chu vah a kiphongdoha Namite Israel loupina dia nabol ahi,” ati. 33 Naosen chung changa Simeon thusei chu anu le apan adatmo lheh jeng lhone. 34 Simeonin amaho phatthei aboh-in, anu Mary jah a, “Ven, hiche naosen hi Israel sunga mi tamtah kipal lhuhna ding le hindohna dia kitung, nahsah moa kikoiji ho khel’a melchihna pang ding, 35 nang jeng jong nalung chang chemjama kidotpai abahsah a, mi tamtah lunggil selguh geiya aphondoh ding ahi,” ati. 36 Asher phunga Phanuel chanu Anna themgaonu chu aji nei nunga ajipa toh kum sagi seh bou cheng khom lhona, tehse lheh jeng, 37 kum som get le li meithaiya um, Houin dalha kholou, sun le jan’a Pathen kinbol’a pang anngol’a tao jing jeng ahi. 38 Hichepet tah hin ahungin Pathen athangvah-in, Jerusalem lhatdoh ding kat jingte jah a naosen thudol hi aseipeh tai. Jesu Nazareth khoa ahung kile kit 39 Pakai Danthua kisei kinkhoh jouse abol chai phat’un Galilee gama akhou Nazareth a ahung kile kittauve. 40 Naosen chu akhang khangin ahatdoh tan aching lheh jengin, Pathen phattheinan aumpi jinge.

Jerusalem Houin’a chapang Jesu
