Ijeh-inem itile ven, Pathen lenggam chu nalah-uva aumtai,” ati. 22 Jesun seijuite jah a, “Nikhatle Mihem Chapa nikho namu nom lheh diu, ahivanga namu thei lou diu ahi. 23 Mihon najah-uva, ‘Ven, khu koma aume,’ atiuva, ‘Ven, hikoma aume,’ atiu jongle chesauvin, anung del hih-in; 24 ajeh chu kolphen kolmong lang khat’a pat kolmong lang khat geiya vanthamjol asalvah jeng banga Mihem Chapa hung ni jong leh chuti ding ahi. 25 Amavang amasa hesoh genthei tampi athoh a, hiche khang mite not thap’a um tei ding ahi. 26 Noah nokholai bang a Mihem Chapa nikho ho jong chuti ding ahi. 27 Mihon aneuvin adonun, akichengun, Noah kong sunga alut ni geiyin kicheng din akipetouvin, chutah-in twisang ahung lenin abonchauvin asumangtai. 28 Hitobang hin Lot nikho laiyin jong mihon aneuvin adonun, thil achouvin, hon abol’uvin in asauvin, 29 Sodom khoa Lot apotdoh nikhon vang vana koin meikou l ekat ahung julhah abonchauvin asumangtai. 30 Mihem Chapa kiphondoh nikho jong chuti ding ahiye. 31 Hiche nikhoa chu inchunga uma inusunga thilkeo kilah din kumlhah da hen, chule loujaova um jong hung kile kit da hen. 32 Lot jinu chu geldoh-un. 33 Koi hile kihinso noma chun athilo ding, athiloa chun hinna aneiding ahi. 34 Kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche jan chuleh jalkhun khat’a lumkhom te ni jong khat kilaa khat kidalha ding ahi. 35 Numei chang goikhom teni jong khat kilaa khat kidalha ding… 36 (Loujaova bung pasal te ni jong khat kilaa khat kidalha ding ahi)” ati. 37 Amahon adonbut’un ajah a, “Hoikom hintem Pakai?” atiuleh; aman ajah-uva, “Thilong lupnaa chu muthong kikhom ding ahi,,” ati.

Luke 18

Meithainu le thutanna thulem

1 Lhadah louhel’a tantih neilouva atao jing theina din Jesun aseijuite chu thulem khat ahil’e. 2 ″Khopi sung khat’ah Pathen ging lou mihem jong jalou thutan khat aume. 3 Hiche khopi sunga hin meithainu khat jong acheng’in, thutanpa henga ahung jin, ‘Kakihehpi sangin them neichanin,’ atijie. 4 Phat chom khat chun aman don louvin akoinan, chom khat jouvin, ‘Pathen kagin daa mihem kajabol lou vangin 5 hiche meithainun eisuhgim jing jeh hin athem channa ding gelpeh tange, achutilou le hung jingin tin eisuh lung gim jing ding ahi,’ tin aseiye,” ati. 6 Pakaiyin aseiben, “Midih lou thutanpan ipi aseiyem ngaiyun. 7 Sun le jan’a ahenga tao jing jeng alhenchomte chu Pathenin kithopi ding ngongkai louhel’a achunguva thu adih a atanpeh lou ding ham? 8 Najah-uva kasei ahi, aman ngongkai louhel’a amaho them achansah loi ding ahi. Hijongle Mihem Chapa ahung teng leiset chunga tahsan hung toh nantem?” ati.

Pharisee le Kaidong thulem

9 Jesun mi ama bou them kichana midang jouse isah lou ho din hiche thulem hi aseiyin: 10 “Mi ni Houin a tao dingin achetou lhonin, khat chu Pharisee ahin, khat chu Kaidong ahi. 11 Phariseepa adingin chamtahin hitin ataove, ‘Pathen keima midang banga milop, kitahna bei, chonthanghoi, chule hiche Kaidong pa tobang khu kahi loujeh-in Nangma kathangvah-e. 12 Hapta khat sungin nivei an ka-ngol jin, kalamdoh jat hopsom hop khat kape jingin ahi,’ ati. 13 “Kaidongpa vang chu gamla thimtaha adingin, dah a van lam jong ve-ngam louvin, adip alai akidop’in ‘Pathen neilungset’in keima michonse kahibouve,’ ati. 14 Kaseipeh nahiuve, Phariseepa sangin hichepa joh hi them achangin a-inlama achesuh tai; ajeh chu koi hileh ama kichoi sang chu kisunem ding, ama kisunem chu kichoi sang ding ahi,” ati.

Jesun chapang neocha ho phatthei

15 Miphabep’in achateu chunga Jesun khut angap din ahinpuiyui Seijuien amun aphoh-uve. 16 Ahinla Jesun chapang ho akouvin, “Chapang ho chu kahenga hungsahun, kham dauvin, Pathen lenggam chu hitobang ho ding bou ahi. 17 sumil hih-un, chapang thilsan banga Pathen lenggam sang lou chu lut lou ding ahi,” ati.

Mihaopa

18 Judate vaihom khat’in Jesu adingin, “Houhilpha, tonsot hinna kanei theina dia ipi kabol ding ham?” atileh; 19 Jesun ajah a, “Ibol’a ‘Apha’ neiti ham? Pathen tilou apha aumpoi. 20 Thupeh chengse nahet chu me. ‘Mito jong hih-in, tol that hih-in, gucha hih-in, jouthun hettphsah-in pandan, nanu napa jabol’in,’ kiti chu,” ati. 21 Aman, “Kakhangdong laiya pat hichenghi kanitsa ahitai,” ati. 22 Jesun hichu ajah phat’in, “Nalhah samna khat aum nalaiye, nanei chengse joh-in lang sum chu vaichate petan, chutile vana gou nanei ding ahi; chuteng hungin neijuiyin,” ati. 23 Hiche hi ajah phat’in mihao tah ahijeh-in alung nom mo lheh jenge. 24 Jesun alung himo natsatje amu phat’in, “Sum haoho dinga Pathen lenggama lut ding iti hah sat hitam! 25 Mihao Pathen lenggama lut sangin heobil homa sangonsang lut idng abaijoi,” ati. 26 Hiche thu ja hon, “Achutile koi huhhinga umjou ding ham?’ atiuve. 27 Jesun, “Mihem dinga himo thil jouse dalhaa nang kijuita,” ati. 28 Peterin, “Ven, keihon kanei jouseu dalhaa nang kijuita,” ati. 29 Jesun ajah-uva, “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hijongle Pathen lenggam jal’a in le lou ji le cha, sopi u le nao, nu le pa dalha jouse 30 koi ahin tukhanga ajat tamjo cheh mu lou ding le ahung lhung ding khanga tonsot hinna kimu lou idng aumpoi,” ati.

Jesun athi le athodoh ding asei masah thumveina

31 Jesun som le ni atumin apuidoh-in ajah-uva, “Ven, Jerusalem ijon touvun, chule Mihem Chapa thudol’a Themgao ho lekhabu kisun chengse guilhung ding ahi; 32 ajeh chu Ama chidang namdangte khut’a pehdoh a um ding, tot nopna aneiyuva, a-eng eng a abol diu, chule chil aset khum diu ahi; 33 avoh-uva atha diu, ahivanga nithum ni leh thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati. 34 Seijuiten aseiho hi khat cha jong ahechen theipouve. Ajeh chu akisei ho hi amaho dia kiselguh ahin, hijeh chun ipi kiseipen ahiding ahedoh theipouve.

Jesun mitcho khutdo khat aboldam

35 Jesu Jericho khopi ahung naichun, lamlen panga mitcho khat touvin khut adoi. 36 Mitchopan lampia mipi kitol husa ajah phat’in ipithu ahi ding adonge. 37 Mihon Nazareth Jesun ahinjotpa ahi, aseipeh-uve. 38 Aman ahinsamin, “David Chapa jesu, keima neilungset’in,” ati. 39 Amasanga chehon umthip beh dia haphoa apho vangun aman ahasap cheh-in, “David Chapa, neikhoton,” ati kit’e. 40 Jesu ading denin mipa chu ahinpui diuvin aseiye. Mitchopan ahin naiphat’in ajah a, 41 “Ipi eibolpeh le nati ham?” atileh; aman, “Pakai, kho neimusah-in,” ati. 42 Hichun Jesun ajah a, “Mu tan. Natahsanin nadamsah ahitai,” ati. 43 Apettah chun mitchopan kho amutan, Jesu ajuiyin Pathen athangvah tai. Mipin hichu amuphat’un Pathen athangvah chehuve.

Luke 19

Jesu chule Zacchaeus 1 Jesu Jericho alut’in kho sung ajotpeh-e. 2 Khosunga hin Zacchaeus kiti kaidong pasal khat ahengin, ahaova hao ahiye. 3 Amahin Jesu chu amu nom lhehin, ahinla mi nem ahijeh-in mipin alen amupha poi. 4 Hijeh chun analhai masan, amuteina din ahung na ding lampia chun theiba chung khat’a anakaldoh-e. 5 Jesun hikom chu ahinphah phat’in agada doh leh amun, “Zacchaeus, hung kumlha loiyin, tunia na-in’a kalhun tei ding ahi,” ati. 6 Zacchaeus, chu kinloi tah-in ahung kumlhan kipah tah-in Jesu alamtoi. 7 Mipin amu’uvin, “Hiche michonsepa in’a khu lhung din ache teget’e,” tin aphuntauve. 8 Zacchaeus vang chu adingin Pakai jah a, “Ven, Pakai kanei chengse akeh khat vaichate peng ting, ada acham louva mi kalahpeh aum jong leh ajat lin leng’e,” ati. 9 Hichun Jesun ajah a, “Tunin hiche insunga huhingna ahung lhungtai, ama jong hi Abraham chilhah ahiye. 10 Ijeh-inem itile amangsa holdoh a huhing dia Mihem Chapa hung ahi,” ati.

Sum som khat thulem

11 Jesu Jerusalem ahung lhung deh deh tan, mihon ma Pathen lenggam hung lhung jeng dia agel jeh-uvin Aman thulem khat ahil’in, 12 ″Milun tah khat leng tha neina gakisana hung kile kit din kholgamla tah a cheding agon; 13 asohte som khat akouvin Mina khat cheh apen ajah-uvah, Kahung kile kit kah-in kivei nan anamangun,’ ati. 14 Ahinla agam miten ama ahot bol’in anunga palai asol’uvin, ‘hichepa hi kachunguva leng chang din kadeipouve,’ agati sah-ui. 15 “Aman leng tha neina kenga ahung kile kit phat’in kivei dinga apeh asohte chengse ijat cheng aveikan’u ahet nom jeh-in gakou khom din thu apei. 16 Ahung ma sapan,’Pakai, nang Mina khat chu Mina som kalhinsah-e,’ ati. 17 Aman ajah a, Nabolpha lheh-e, sohpha nahi! Themcha chunga tahsan thei nahijeh-in khopi som chunga tha neiyin pang tan,’ ati. 18 Anilhinnapa ahungin,’Pakai, nang Mina khat chu nga kasosah-e,’ ati . 19 Aman, ‘Nang jong khopi nga chunga vaipo ding nahi,’ ati. 20 “Thumnapa ahungin, ‘Pakai, nang Mina chu ponin kajel’in kakoi hen hiche hi ahi, 21 ajeh chu nakoin alouva loi doh theiya, natuna louva atdoh thei, acham louva milahpeh jeng nahijeh-in nangma kakichai,’ ati. 22 Aman, ‘Soh gilou! Nakamsoh a nathu katan ding ahi. Kakoina louva kalahdoh theiya, katunalouva ka-at theiya, acham louhel’a mi kalahpeh thie nahet ahiyeong? 23 chuti-an ibol’a kasum chu sumkholpungnaa nakoida ham? Koile chun kahung kile teng ken apung puma kilah thata dinga!’ ati. 24 “Akoma ding ho jah a chun, ‘Mina khat chu lahpeh-un lang, Mina som neipa chu gapeuvin, ati. 25 Mihon,’Pakai, aman Mina som khat jen neina chu,’ atiuleh; 26 aman,’Kaseipeh nahiuve, aneiya chu kipeh ben tin, aneilouva chu anei chasun jong kilahpeh ding ahi. 27 chule achunguva lengvaipo dinga eideimo hiche migilou melmate hi kakoma hinkai lut’uvin kamitmun that gam’uvin,’ tin aseiye,” ati.

Jesu loupitah a Jerusalem alut

28 jesun hiche aseijou hin amasan jerusalem ajon toutai. 29 Olive thinglah kiti mol’a Beth phage le Bethany aphah koin seijui ni asol’in, 30 “namasang jon lhona kho’a khun lut lhon le chun komacha tou khahna louhel sangan nou kihen khat namu lhon ding ahi; sut lhan hinkai lhonin; 31 mi khattouvin najah lhona, ‘Ibol’a nasut lhon ham?’ atileh; ‘Pakaiyin aman nom’e,’ ti lhontan,” ati. 32 Solle te ni ache lhon leh ijakai asei bangin agatoh lhone. 33 Sa-ngan nou chu asut lhon leh aneiten, “Ibol’a sa-ngan nou chu nasut lhon ham?” tin adongui. 34 Amanin, “Pakaiyin aman nom’e,” ati lhone. 35 Hichun Jesu henga ahinkai lu tlhonin, chiin sangan nou chunga aponsil jouseu aphasoh phat’un Jesu chu achunga adom doh tauve. 36 Jesu ahung chun lampi chunga aponsil jouseu aphauvin ahi. 37 Jesun khopi ahinphah ding kon, Olive mol’a kumlhahna huang geiin seiyui mipin abonchauvin tha neitah a thil kibol amu chengseu jeh chun ogin sang tah-in asamun kipah thanom tha-in Pathen vahchoinan 38 hitin aseiyui: “Pakai min a hung lengpa anun nom’e; Van’a cham leng hen, chung nungpena loupina hihen,” atiuve. 39 Mipi lah a Pharisee mi phabep chun Jesu jah a, “Houhil, naseijuite phoh-in,” atiuve. 40 Jesun adonbut’in, Najah-uva kasei ahi, hite ho thip leu song ho aojah jeng diu ahi,” ati. 41 Ahung naijep jep’a khopi amu phat’in Jesun akachamin, 42 “Ohe, nangin tunia hi lung monna thei ngaichat nakihet hitave leh! Tunla namuthei tapoi! 43 namelmaten nahin umkhuma, galpal nakai khum’uva, akimvel lhung keiya natin chah niu hung lhung ding; 44 huhhing dia nakivil nikho nahet loujeh a nangle nasunga nachate kisugam ding, song khat chunga khat kise-thom beihel’a alha diu ahi,” ati.

Jesun Jerusalem Houin asuh theng

45 Jesu Hoiin a alut’in thiljoh ho anodoh panin ajah-uvah, 46 “Hiti hin, ‘Ka-in chu taona in kiti ding ahi,’ tin akisun me, nang hon la gucha michomho kikholnan nasemdoh tauve,” ati. 47 Jesun niseh-in Houin a thu ahiljin, Thempu pipu ho le Danth themho, chule mipi lamkaihon vang ama suhmangna ding ahol jingui. 48 Ahivangin la angai lhihgeh jeh-un alonaje ding aholdoh thei pouve.

Luke 20

1 Nikhat jesun Houin a mipi thu ahila Kipana THupha aseiphong pet’in, Thempu pipu ho l eDanthu themho chule upaho ahungun, 2 ajah a, “Ipi thu neinaa hicheng hi nabol’a, kon hiche thu neina hi napeh ham, neiseipeh tem’un?” atiuve. 3 Jesun ajah-uva, “Kenjong thu khat dongunge, neiseipeh-uvin; 4 John Baptist chu van’a kon ha mihema kon ham?” atileh; 5 amaho akihouvun, “Eihon, ‘Van’a kon ahi,’ tileu hen la, ‘Chuti-an ibol’a natahsan louvu ham?’ tiget’in tin, 6 Mihema kon ahi,’ tijong leu hem, mipin John chu Themgao khat’a atahsan cheh jeh-un, songin eiselo bep’un tin,” atiuve. 7 Hijeh chun, “Hoiya hung kon ham kahepouve,” atiuve. 8 Hichun Jesun ajah-uva, “kenjong ipi thu neinaa thil hicheng kabol seipeh pouvinge,” atitai.

Lengpilei le aleilhouho thulem

9 Jesun mipi chu hiche thulem hi ahil panin, “Mi khat’in lengpilei abol’in, aleilhouho abolsah-in phat sotpi um din kholgama achetai. 10 Aga lhun phat donin lengpitga ahinpohsah diuvin aleilhouho henga soh khat asol’e; ahinla aleilhouhon sohpa chu avouvin khut gohkeuvin asolmang tauve. 11 Soh khatma asol kit leh; ama jong hi avouvin, noise tah-in abol’un khut goh keman asolmang kit tauve. 12 Soh thum lhinnapa asol kit leu leh, amahon amavouvin ahi nleh doh kit tauve. 13 Lengpilei neipan, ‘Ipi kalo ding hitam? Kachapa chang khat seh hi sol tange, amahi jabol teiyunte,’ ati. 14 aleilhouhon achapa amu phat’un akihou lhiuvin ‘Hichepa hi agoulo dingpa ahi, agou ichan theina diuvin ama hi thatdoh jengu hite,’ akitiuve. 15 Hijeh chun ama chu lengpilei polama alehdoh-un athat tauve. Hiche lengpilei neipa chun amaho hi i-lotan tem? 16 Ama hunga hiche lengpilei chu midang apeh ding ahi,” ati. Hichu ajauvin amahon, “Achuti louleh!” atiuve. 17 Jesun amaho chu aven, “Ahile, ‘Insa hon deimoa apaiyu song chu, In ning khomdet penin apangtai,’ tia Pathen lekhabua kisun chu ipikiseina ba ham? 18 Koi hileh hiche song chunga chukha chan chu kitah ngem’a chule songin alhah den jong chu adelngem ding ahi,” ati.

Kaipeh thudol Jesu adoh-u

19 Hiche thulem hi amaho gotna asei aheuvin Danthu themho le Thempu pipu hon hichepet tah a chu Jesu chunga khut lhah din agouvin, ahinla mipi akichauve. 20 Amahon Jesu chu athuseiya kipalsah a, mat ding gamvaipo tha neina le athu noiya peh thiena dingin phat kitup kom achang lhiuvin, chonpha lhemin changlhi phabep achinsah-ui. 21 Changlhi ho hin Jesu jah a, “Houhil, nathusei le namihilna hi adih-in, maipha velouvin Pathen lampi dihtah a nahil kaheuve; 22 Caesar kai kapeh-u hi dan ngai himong nam?” tin adongui. 23 Jesun alungthim bol’u ahen ajah-uvah, 24 “Denarii khat neivetsah temun, koi lim hiya koimin chong am?” atileh; 25 amahon, ‘Caeasar’a,” atiuve. Hichun Aman “Chuti ahile Caeasar’a chu Caesar peuvin, Pathena chu Pathen petau,” ati. 26 Mipi maiya athuseiyin man thei tapouve; adonbutna ma chu adatmo lheh jengun athip beh tauve.

Mithi thokit thudol Jesu adoh-u

27 Mithi thokit tansan lou Sadducee phabep ahungun Jesu jah a, 28 “Houhil, Mose’n ‘Pasal khattou ji neiya cha hing man louva athi leh, ajinu meithai chu asopipa akichenpia asopipa chi akhai peh idng ahi,’ tia eisutpeh-u ahi. 29 Pasal sagite aum’un, aupapenin ji aneileh cha hing louvin athitai. 30 Ani lhina pan jong, 31 thum lhinna pan jong, aban banin amanu chu jin anei cheh-un, asagiuvin cha hinglouvin athisoh tauve. 32 Achaina keiyin numeinu jong thu athitai. 33 Chuti ahijehchun mithi thokitnaa hiche nu chu koipen ji hiding hitam?” tin adongui. 34 Jesun amaho jah a, “Hiche khanga mite hi akichengun, kicheng din jong akipeuve, 35 thinaa kona thudoh, ahung lhung ding khang mu dia kilomho vang chu akicheng pouvin, kicheng din jong akipeto tapouve. 36 ahimongin amaho chu athi thei tapouvin, Vantilte tobang ahiuvin, thinaa kona thoudoh kit’a Pathen chate hiuva ahitai. 37 Chule mithiho thodoh tahbeh hi Mose, n lhambuh thua chun Pakai chu Abraham Pathen, Issac Pathen chule Jacob Pathen ahidol kichentah-in aphong. 38 Pathen chu mihtiho Pathen ahipon, mihing ho Pathen ahibouve; ijeh-inem itile ama koma mi jouse ahing cheh-e,” ati. 39 Danthu themho phabep’in, “Houhil nasei dih lheh jenge,” atiuve. 40 Ajeh chu thu dang adoh ngamlouvu ahitai.

Jesu David chapa ahidol thudol

41 Jesun ajah-uva, “I-atileh mihon Messiah chu David guiya pen gidng ahi, tia aseiyu ham? 42 David jengin jong labua chun, ‘Pakaiyin ka-Pakai jah a Kajet lama tou jingin 43 Namelmate chengse Nakeng chotpha kaneisah masangsen,’ tin aseibouve. 44 David amatah-in ‘Pakai’ asah leh iti aguiya peng hithei ding ham?” ati.

Jesun Danthu themho aphosal

45 Jesun mijouse jah din aseijuite henga, 46 “Ching theiyun, Dan thepna sangkhol chol ki-ah a vah le nom, kailhang dunga mi salam ding deiya, Houthua kikhopna in dunga touna phapen, golvahna mun’a munpha pen lo nom, 47 meithaiho thil le lo bahgam, mimu dia sottah tah taoji hoa konin kihong phauvin; amaho hi themmona chungnung chang diu ahi,” ati.

Luke 21

Luke 22

Luke 23

Luke 24

John 1

Thu chu tahsa ahungsoh tai

1 Semtil chun thu anaumtan, thu chu Pathento umkhom ahin, chule thu chu Pathen masap ahi. 2 Thu chu semtil’a Pathento umkhom ahi. 3 Ama jeh a thil jouse hung umdoh ahin, Ama louva um dohkhat cha aumpoi. Aumdoh chengse jong hi 4 Ama hinkhoa hingson cheh ahiuvin, hiche hinkho chu mihem dia khovah ahi. 5 Vah chun muthim lah ahinsaltan, muthimin anahe joupoi. 6 Pathena kona hung kisol amin John kiti khat aumin, 7 ama hi hettohsah a hung pang, ama jeh a mitinin atahsan theina dia vah thudol hettohsah ahung ahi. 8 Ama chu vah ahipon, vah thudol hettohsah a hungjoh ahibouve. 9 Vah tahbeh mitin salvah chu vannoi leiset’a hung ahitai. 10 Ama jeh a vannoi leiset hung umdoh ahin, Ama vannoiya ahungin, ahinla vannoiyin anahepoi. 11 Agamsunga hung ahin amitenla Ama anasang pouve. 12 Ahin amina tahsana Ama kisan chengse chu Pathen chate hitheina thu apetai. 13 Amaho chu mihem thisan gui le tahsa dei chule mihem deiya peng hilouvin, Pathen guiya peng joh ahibouvui. 14 Thu chu tahsaphe ahungdsoh-in, i-lah-uva ahung chengin, keihon aloupina, Paa kon Chapa chang khatseh loupina chu lungset le thutah lhingset’in kamutauve. 15 Johin Ama thudol hettohsah nan lhang asamin “Keiman kaseipa, ‘Kanunga hungpa khu aum Jingsa ahijeh-in kei sangin achungnung joi,’ kiti chu Ama hi ahi,” ati. 16 Ama bulhinset ahijeh-in eihon kinon jel’in lungsetna imutauve. 17 Ijeh-inem itile Danthu chu Mosea hung kipe ahin, lungsetna le thudih vang Jesu Christa jeh a hung umdoh ahi. 18 Koiman Pathen amu khapoi, Pathen hingjing khatseh chu Pa op’a beh jingpan bou aphondoh ahi.

John Baptist hettohsah

19 Hiche hi John thu hettohsah chu ahi, Jerusalema hung kon Juda hon, “Koi nahim?” tia dong dia thempu hole Levi ho asol’u chun 20 aman seilep louhel’in phongtah in, “Keima Messiah kahipoi,” ati. 21 Hijeh chun amahon adongun, “Koiba nahim? Elijah nahim?” atiuleh; aman, “Kahipoi,” ati. “Themgao nahim?” atiu jongleh, “Kahipoi,” tin adonbut’e. 22 Chu phat’in ajah a, “Koiba nahim? Eihinsol teu kaseipeh theina dinguvin, koi kahiba nakitim?” atiuleh; 23 aman, “Kei hi “Gamthip’a khosam ogin khat’in, Pakai lampi semjangun,’ ati tia Isaiah Themgaovin aseipa chu kahi,” ati. 24 Pharisee phabep jong ahinsol’un, 25 amahon ajah a, “Messiah nahi louva, Elijah jong nahi hih a chule Themgao jong nahidrh lou leh ibol’a baptize nachansahji ham” tin adongui. 26 Johnin amaho adonbut’in, “ken twiya baptize kachansahji ahin, nalah-uva nahet louvu khat adinge; 27 kanunga hunga chu Ama ahin, Keima akeng chot khao sut lham didnga jong kilom kahipoi;” ati. 28 Thil hicheng hi Jordan luigal Johnin baptize achangsahji na, Bethany khoa thu soh ahi.

Pathen kelngoi nou

29 Ajing nikhon Jesu ahenga hung amun Johin, “Ven, Pathen kelngoi nou vannoi chonset pamang khu. 30 Keiman, ‘Kanunga hung khu aum jingsa ahijeh-in keisangin achungnung joi,’ katipa chu Ama hi ahi. 31 Ken jong ama hi kahepoi, Israel lah a Ama akikhon doh theina dinga hung twiya baptize chansah kin kabol ahi,” tin 32 Johnin ahettohsah-in, “van a kona lhagao vakhu banga hung kumlhaa achunga chu kamui. 33 Ken Ama kahepon, twiya baptize chansah dia eihonsolpan, ‘Lhagao hungkhumlhaa achunga chu namuna chu lhagao Thenga baptize chan sahpa ahi,’ ati. 34 Hichu keiman kamutan Ama hi Pathen Chapa ahi, tia kahettohsah ahi,” ati.

Seijui masaho

35 Ajing nikhon John aseijuite mi nit oh adidngin, 36 agahvet leh Jesun lam ajotpet amun, “Ven, Pathen kelngoi nou khu,” ati. 37 Aseijuite nin John thusei hi aja lhonin Jesu nung ajui lhontai. 38 Jesu akihei leh amanin ahinjui lhon amun ajah lhona, “Ipi nahol lhon ham?” atileh amanin ajah a, “Rabbi (Hichu Houhil tina ahin,) hoiya nalhun em?” tin adong lhone. 39 Jesun ajah lhona, “Hung in hung ve lhonin,” ati. Hijeh chun amani ache lhonin alhunna agamudoh-in, hiche ni chun amatoh aum khomtauve. Aphat hi nilhah lam nidan li don ahiye. 40 John thusei jaa Jesu nungjuite ni lah a khat chu Simon Peter naopa Andrew ahi. 41 Aman asopipa Simon akimupi masah-in ajah a, “Keinin Messiah (hichu leng chang dia thao nusa kiti) chu kamudoh lhontai,” ati. 42 Andrewn Simon chu Jesu henga ahinpuiye. Jesun Simon chu aven, “Nang hi John chapa Simon nahin, nangma Cephas Peter nakiti ding ahi,” ati.

Jesun Philip le Nathaniel akou

43 Ajing nikhon Galilee gama che ding akigon, Philip amudoh-e. Jesun ajah a, “Neijuiyin,” ati. 44 Philip hi Andrew le Peter chenna Bethsaida khoa mi ahi. 45 Philip’in Nathanael amun ajah a, “Achung thu Mose’n Danthua asut, Themgaohon jong autpa chu keihom kamu’uvin, Nazareth khoa Joseph chapa Jesu ahi,” ati. 46 Nathanael’in ajah a, “Nazareth khoa thilpha soh thei ding ong?” atileh; Philip’in ajah a, “hungun hung ven,” ati. 47 Nathanael aheng lama hung Jesun amun, achung thu aseiyin, “Ven, Israel midih tah, phat lhem nabei mi khu,” ati. 48 Nathanael’in ajah a, “Hoiya kona iti neihet ham?” atileh; Jesun adonbut’in ajah a, “Philip’in nakou masang, theichang phung noiya naum pet’a chu kamu nahitai,” ati. 49 nathanael’in adonbut’in, “Rabbi, Nangma pathen Chapa nahin, Israel lengpa nahi!” atitai. 50 Jesun adonbut’in ajah a, “Theichang phung noiya naum pet’a kamu nahitai katijeh a chu natahsan ham? Hiche ho sanga lenjo cheh nahin muding ahi,” ati. 51 Chujongle ajah a, “Kichen tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, van kihonga Mihem Chapa chunga Pathen Vantilte kaltou le kumsuh namu diu ahi,” ati.

John 2

Cana khoa moupui golvah

1 Nithum lhinin Galilee gama Cana khoa moupui golvah akibol’in, Jesu nu jong apange. 2 Jesu le aseijuite jong hiche moupui golvahnaa chun akouvui. 3 Lengpitwi alhahsam phat’un Jesu nun ajah a, “Lengpitwi anei tapouve,” atileh; 4 Jesun ajah a, “Numei, nang le Kei i-kin um am? Kaphat lhing loulai chu,” ati. 5 Anun lhacha ho jah a chun, “Najah-uva asei chan bol jengun,” ati. 6 Hikom chu Judate chonna ngaiya kisuh thengna ding tia songbel twi atena ni ham thum ham dol cheh bel gup kitung ahi. 7 Jesun ajah-uvah, “Bel ho chu twi sung dim’uvin,” ati. Amahon abelgei let cheh-in asung dim’ui. 8 chujouvin Jesun ajah-uva, “Tun phabep thal’un lang golvah lamkaipa henga dom’un,” atileh; amahon adomtauve. 9 Golvah lamkaipan twisih lengpitwi kiso sah chu atep’in, hoiya kila ham, ti ahepon, twi hinthal’a hindom lhachahon vang ahenauve. Hijeh chun aman aji neipa chu kouvin, 10 ajah a, “min lengpitwi chih ahom masan, mi achim tengleh tugeiyin lengpitwi chih nakoi nalaiye,” ati. 11 Jesun hiche hi Galilee gam Cana khoa melchihna abol patna ahin, aloupina aphongdoh tai; hijeh chun aseijuiten Ama tahsanlo tauve. 12 Hiche jou hin Jesu le anu chule Jesu seijuite Capernaum khoa achesuh-un, hikoma chun nikho phabep anichonguve.

Jesun Houin asuh theng

13 Judate kalchuh kut anai phat’in Jesu Jerusalema achetoutai. 14 Houina bong le kelngoi chule vapal joh ho, sumlheng ho agol gol’a tou agatoh khai. 15 Chuin Jesun khao alan ajepna ding akisemin abonchauvin Houin a konin bong ho le kelngoite pumin ajepdoh than, sum nong lhenga pang ho anocheh-in, adokhangu alekhup peh-in, 16 vapal joh ho jah a, “Hiche ho hi hikoma konin podohun, ka-pa in chu kiveina mun naso lou diu ahi,” ati. 17 Aseijuiten, “Na-in din katompanin einechaiye,” tia kisun chu ageldoh tauve. 18 Hichea hin Judaten adonbut’in, “Thil hicheng nabol theina ding hi melchihna ipi neivetsah diu ham?” atiuleh; 19 Jesun adonbut’in aj ah-uva, “Hiche Houin hi sumangun, nithumin tungdoh inge,” ati. 20 Hichun Judahon aseiyun, “Hiche Houin sahnaa kum som li le gup jen lut chu nangin nithuma natundoh ding ong?’ atiuve. 21 Jesun Ama tahsa chu Houin dol’a aseina ahibouve. 22 Jesu thinaa kona athodoh chun aseijuiten hiche asei hi ageldoh bep’ui; hijeh chun Pathen lekhabua thu le Jesu thusei chu atahsantauve.

Jesun mitin lungthim ahesoh-e

23 Kalchuh kut sunga Jerusalema aum sungin melchihna abol ho amu’vin mi tampin Ama atahsantauve. 24 Jesun vang mitin lung thim ahetoh-in amaho chu akisonpi poi; 25 mi lung sunga ipi um ahet sa ahijeh-in mihem chu hitobang ahitia min ama ahettohsah angaipoi.

John 3

Jesu le Nicodemus

1 Pharisee ho lah a amin Nicodemus kiti Judate vaipo mi khat 2 janin Jesu henga ahungin ajah a, “Rabbi, Nangma Pathena hungkon Houhil nahi kaheuve, ajeh chu Pathento kivoplou min melchihna nabol ho hi abol theipoi,” ati. 3 Jesun adonbut’in ajah a, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahi, peng kit louvan koiman pathen lenggam amu theipoi,” ati. 4 Nicodemus chun ajah a, “Mi ateh teng iti pen thei ding ham? Anu oisunga lut’a anivei nap eng theila ahipon?” ati. 5 Jesun adonbut’in, “Kichentah-a kaseipeh nahi, koi hileh twi le Lhagaova peng lou chu Pathen lenggam alut thei poi. 6 Tahsaphea kona peng chu tahsaphe ahin, Lhagaova kona pengchu Lhagao ahi. 7 Najah a, “Abul’a kona napentei tei diu ahi,” kiti chu dat mo hih-in. 8 Hui khu anun anomna lam lam’ah anungjin, nangin agin naja nan hoiya hungkon hoilama kitol ahi nahepoi; Lhagaova peng tapou chuti chu ahiuve,” ati. 9 Nicodemus chun adonbut’in ajah’a, “Hiche ho chu iti hithei ding ham?” atileh; 10 jesun adonbut’in ajah a, “Israel Houhil khat hiya hiche ho hi nahet lou ham? 11 Kichen tah a kaseipeh nahi, keihon kahettohsah-u hi nasangpouve. 12 Najah-uva leiset thil umdol kaseiya nahet thei louvu le vana thil umdol seipeh-u leng iti natah san diu ham? 13 Vana kona hung kumlha Mihem Chapa tilou koima vana akaltou khapoi. 14 “Gamthip noiya Mose’n gul adop sang banga Mihem Chapa hi kidom sang ding ahin, 15 atahsan chanin Amaa tonsot hinna anei ding ahi. 16 Ajeh chu Pathenin hi banga hi vannoi angailut ahin, Koi hijongle atahsan chan chu mangthah louva tonsot hinna anei theina din a-Chapa chang khat chu apetai. 17 Ijeh-inem itile vannoi themmosah ding hilouvin, Ama jeh a vannoi huhhinga aumtheina dia Pathen Chapa chu vannoiya ahinsol ahbouve. 18 Ama tahsanna chu themmo chang louva, atahsan lou vang chu Pathen Chapa chang khat min a tahsan loujeh a themmo kichansah ahitai. 19 Themmo channa chu hiti ahi, vannoiya khovah ahungtan, anatoh-u aphat loujeh-in mihon khovah sangin muthim adeijo’uve. 20 Ajeh chu thilse bol jousen khovah ahoi, athilse bol chu akiphonjal louna didngin khovah a ahingji poi; 21 thildih bol’a vang chu abolchan Pathen dia bola hi, ti akiphondoh theina din khovah a ahungjin ahi,” ati.

Jesu chule john Baptist

22 hicheng nung hin Jesu le aseijuite Judate gama ahungun, hikoma chun amahotoh aumkhom in baptize achansahjie. 23 Salim koma Aenon kiti laiya chun twiatam jeh-in Johnin jong mi baptize aboljin, miho ahungun baptize achangjiuve. 24 ijeh-inem itile John chu songkul’a akhum hih laiyuve. 25 John seijui phabep le Juda mi khat houthua kisuh theng thudol’in akineltauve. 26 Amaho John henga ahungun ajah a, “Rabbi, Jordan gal’a naumpi, athudol nahettohsahpa khu ve, baptize achan sah jin, mihon Amah eng ajon cheh tai,” atiuve. 27 Johnin adonbut’in, “vana kona akipeh loule min ima akilah theipoi. 28 Keiman, ‘Kei hi Messiah kahipoi, ama sanga eihung kisol masa kahibouve,’ tia kasei chu nang ho tah ahettoh nahiuve. 29 Mou change chu aji neipa ahin, aji neipa jol, a koma dinga athusei ngaiya chun a-ogin ajah leh hachangpan akipahjie. Keijong kakipahna achamkimtai. 30 Ama thupi cheh cheh ding, keima lhasuh jep jep ding kahi.

Vana hungkon Jesu

31 “Chunga hungkon chu mi jouse sanga chungnungpen ahin, leiset’a kon vang chu leiset ahin, leiset thubou aseiye. Vana hungkon vang chu achungnungpen ahi. 32 Aman ajahsa le amusa ahettohsahji ahin, ahinla koima athu hettohsah asangpoi. 33 Ama hettohsah kisan chun Pathen chu adih-e tia anamdet ahitai. 34 Pathen hinsolpan vang Pathen thuho aseiye; ijeh-inem itile Pathenin tepten Lhagao apepoi. 35 Pan Chapa angailun thil ijakai akhut’a apetai. 36 Chapa tahsana chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai; Chapa thu ngai lou vang chun tonsto hinna chu amu louhel ding, Pathen lungsatna achunga umden ding ahi,” ati.

John 4

Jesu chule Samaria mi numei

1 John sangin Jesun seijui atam semjon baptize abol’e, ti Pharisee hon ajah-u chu Jesun ahedoh tan, 2 (Jesu mongin baptize abolpoi, aseijuiten bou abol’ui). 3 Judea gam dalhan Galilee lama akile kittai. 4 Hichea hi Samaria gam ajotpa tei ding ahin; 5 Samaria gama Sychar kiti khoa chun ahungtai; hikom chu Jacob’in achapa Joseph lou mun khat apehna kom ahiye. 6 Hilaiya hi Jacob twikul um ahi. Sunkim don ahitan, Jesu chu alamjot thachol’in twikul koma atouve. 7 Samaria mi numei khat twi thal din ahunge. Jesun amanu henga, “Twi don ding neipen,” ati; 8 ajeh chu seijui ho ma neh cho dinga khopi sung lama cheuvah ahitai. 9 Samaria mi numeinun ajah a, “Iti Juda mi nangin Samaria mi numei kei koma don ding twi nathum ham?” ati. (Ijeh-inem itile Juda mi le Samaria mi ima kimangto lou ahiuve). 10 Jesun adonbut’in ajah a, “Pathen thilpeh hen lang chule nahenga, ‘Don ding neipen,’ tipa chu kihet le chun, nang joh-in ahenga thuma, Ama hinna twi pe ta dinga,” ati. 11 Numeinun ajah a, “Pakai, athalna dingla naneipon, twikul ma thuh tah ahin, hinna twi chu hoiya nalah ding ham? 12 Hiche twikul eisempeh-uva, ama jengin jong anadon, achate le aganchad ho geiya donsah, kapuu Jacob sanga chung nungjo nahim?” ati. 13 Jesun amanu adonbut’in ajah a, “Koi hileh hiche twi don chan chu dang-chah kit ding ahin, 14 Ken kapeh ding twi dona vang chu dangchah kit louhel ding, kapeh ding twi chu asunga tonsot hinna twinah soh doh ding ahi,” ati. 15 Numeinun ajah a, “Pakai, kadangchah louna ding leh hichan geiya twi thal’ kahung louna din hiche twi chu neipen,” ati. 16 Jesun ajah a, “Chen najipa gakouvin hikoma hung kit’in,” atileh; 17 Numeinun adonbut’in ajah a, “Keiman ji kaneipoi,” ati. Jesun ajah a, “Nangin, ‘Ji kaneipoi,’ nati chu naseidih nai; 18 ajeh chu ji nga jen nanei ahitan, tua naneipa khu naji ahipoi, hichu nasei dih-e,” ati. 19 Numeinun ajah a, “Nangma Themgao khat nahi, ti kahe-tai. 20 Kapu kapateuvin hiche molchunga hin Pathen ahoujiuvin, nang hon ‘Jerusalem muna bou min ahou ding ahi,’ natiuve,” ati. 21 Jesun amanu jah a, “Numei neitahsanin, anng hon Pa chu hiche molchung jong hilou Jerusalem jong hideh louva nahou theina diu phat ahung lhunge. 22 Nang hon nahet lou nahouvu ahin, keihon vang kahet kahouvu ahi; ajeh chu huhhingna hi Judate lah a konbou ahi. 23 Ijeh-inem itile Pa chu ahou tahbeh hon lhagao le thutah a ahouna diu phat ahung lhungtan, tun hikomah aume; ajeh chu Pan hitobang miho chu bou Ama hou dia ahole ahiye. 24 Pathen chu Lhagao ahin, Ama houten Ama hina Lhagao va ahou mong diu ahi,” ati. 25 Numeinun ajah a, “Keiman, ‘Thao kinu kiti,’ Messiah hung ding vang kahenai. Ahung teng leh ijakai eiseipeh nauvinte,” atitai. 27 Hichepet hin Jesu seijuite ahungu leh numei khat toh anakihou chu adatmo lheh-un, ahivang in, “Ipi nadoh hiya,” ahiloule, “Hichenu khutoh ibol’a kihou nahim?” tia khat cha aumpouve. 28 Numeinun atwibel dalhan khopi sunga chen miho jah a, 29 “Hungin kathilbol kachonna jouse eiseidoh peh jeng mi khat hung veuvin, hiche hi Messiah hikhat ding hi tam?” agati. 30 Miho khopia konin apotdoh-un Jesu henga ahungui. 31 Hiche kah lah a hin seijuiten, “Rabbi, an nen,” tin a-ngeh-ui. 32 Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang hon nahet louvu neh ding an kanei nai,” ati. 33 Hichun seijuite khat le khat akihouvun, “Mi khattouvin neh ding ahinchoipeh ham?” akitiuve. 34 Jesun ajah-uva, “Keima anneh chu Eihinsolpa dei bol’a natoh molso ding hi ahi. 35 Nang hon, ‘Chang atna ding lha li aum nalaiye,’ natiji hih-um? Ven najah-uva kasei ahi, khodahun loujao dung veuvin, agusoh-in aminin a-at phat ahitai.

Tahbeh-in

36 atupa le a-atpa akipa khom theina didngin a-atpan tohman akisanin aga ronsot hinaa akhol’e. 37 Hijeh chun khat’in atun chom khat-in a-atji kiti hi adih-e. 38 Ken natoh gim lou nauva at dia kasol nahiuve, midangin atoh gim aatohgauva lut mahiuve,” ati. 39 Chuche khopi sunga Samaria mi tamtah-in jong, “Kathilbol kachonna chengse eiseidoh peh-e,” tia nameinun ahettohsah jeh chun Jesu atahsantauve. 40 Samaria miho ahungun akom’uva nichong din angeh u leh, Aman chukoma ni ni aninchonge. 41 Ama thusei jal’in mi tampin atahsan beuvin, 42 numeinu jah a chun, “Nangma thusei keova katahsanu ahitapoi, keiho tah-in kajauvin, chule hiche Pa hi Vannoi huhingpa ahi, kahetauve,” atiu vin ahi.

Jesun vaibolpa chapa adamsah

43 Ni ni jouvin Jesu chukom dalhan Galilee gama achetai. 44 Ajeh chu Jesu amatah-in Themgao achenna gama akijabol lou thu ahettohsah ahi. 45 Galilee gam ahung lhun leh agam miten anasang cheh-ui; amaho jong kut a che ahijeh-un, kut laiya Jesun Jerusalema thil abol jouse amusoh keiyu ahiye. 46 Galilee gama twisih lengpitwi asosahna

Cana khoa chu Jesu ahung kit leh, hikoma chun lengvaipoa pang loi mi khat anaumin, achapa chu dammoa Capernaum khoa um ahi.

47 Hichepa hin Judea gama kon Jesu Galilee gama hung ajah phat’in ahenga achen, achapa athipai ding phat chun, hungsah a achapa dam sah din a-ngeh-e. 48 Jesun ajah a, “Melchihna le thil kidang namu lousen tahsan pouvin nate,” ati. 49 Lengvaipoa pangpan ajah a, “Pakai, kachapa thi kah-in hungsuh jengin, “ati. 50 Jesun ajah a, “Chetan, nachapa ahingtai,” atileh; aman ajah a Jesu thusei chu atahsanin achetai. 51 Ama achesuh nalaiyin asohten ahung lamton achapa hindoh thu aseipeh tauve. 52 Aman achapa itih don tah a phadom ahi adoh leh, amahon ajah a, “Jan hi nil hah lam nidan khat chun khosih-in alhatai,” atiuve. 53 Hichun apan, “Nachapa ahingtai,” tia Jesun ajah a aseipeh pet tah chu ahi, ahedoh tan, ama le a-insung pumpiuvin atahsan tauve. 54 Hiche hi Judea gama kona Galilee gam ahunglhun kal’a Jesun melchihna abol aniveina ahi.

John 5

Bethzada twikul’a Jesun chatmopu aboldam

1 Hicheng nung hin Judate kut khat aumin, Jesu Jerusalema aga chetouve. 2 Jerusalema chun kelngoi kotphunga Hebrew paova, “Bethzada” kiti twikul khat aumin, leibuh nga aume. 3 Hiche dunga hi ana damlou mitcho, elbai, nakong chatmo tampi um ahiuve.(Amaho hin twi kilin angau ahi; 4 ijeh-inem itile phat khat khat leh Vantil twikul’a hi hung kumlhaa twi chu ahinsuh lingjia, hiche twi kicholong joutah leh chomlut masapen pen chu itobang hiveiya na hijongleh damhelji ahi.) 5 Hikoma hin mi khat kum som thum le get jen na chatmo aume. 6 Ama chua alup Jesun amun, phat sotpi hichea hi lum ahi, ahen ajah a, “Nadam nom em?” atileh; 7 anapan adonbut’in ajaih a, “Pakai, twi hung kicholoh teng twikul sunga eidomlut dingla koima kaneipon, kacheleh kalhun kah-in min eikheljin achimlut masajitai,” ati. 8 Jesun ajah a, “Thouvin nalupn apheh kilah-in lamjot tan,” ati. 9 Apettah chun mipa chu adamhel’in alupna akijeldoh-in lam ajottai. Hiche nikho chu Choldo ni ahi. 10 Hijeh chun Judah on adamdohpa jah a, “Tuni hi Choldo ni ahin, nalupna nakiput jeng chu dan ngai ahipoi,” tin aphoh-ui. 11 Aman adonbut’in, “Eidam sahpan kajah a, ‘Nalupna pheh kilah-n lam jottan,’ eiti chume,” ati. 12 Amahon, “Najah a, ‘Nalupna kilah-in lang lam jot’in,’ tia chu koipen ham?” tin adongui. 13 Ahinla adamdohpan amuna mi atam beheh phat’a, Jesu ache mang tah jeh-in, aboldampa chu koiham ahetapoi. 14 Hicheng nung hin Jesun ama hi Houin a amudoh-in ajah a, ‘Ven, adam nahitai; akhoh chehjo nachunga achuh louna din chonse kit ta hih-in,” ati. 15 Mipa chu achen Judda miho jah a adamsah chu Jesu ahi agaseitai. 16 Hitia agaseidoh phat hin Choldo nikhoa hitiho aboljeh chun Judah on Jesu abolsetauve. 17 Jesun amaho hi adonbut’in, “Tu chan geiya hi ka-Pan na atoh jing jeh a Ken jong katoh ahi,” ati. 18 Hichea hin Juda hon Jesu chu tha din ahahol cheh tauve; ijeh-inem itile aman Choldo nikho asuhkeh keo ahipon, Pathen chu Amaseh Paa aseiya, pathento kibanga akiseijeh ahi.

Pathen Chapa tha neina

19 Jesun miho chu adonbut’in ajah-uva, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Chapan achamin ima abolpoi, Pa bol amuchan abol ahi; ajeh chu ipi hileh Pan abol chan chu Chapan jong abol ahi. 20 Ijeh-inem itile Pan Chapa angailun, atoh chan avetsah jin, nadatmo helna diuva hicheng sanga thupijo jong ahinvetsah ding ahi. 21 Pan mithi ho athodoh a ahinsah banga, Chapan jong ahinsah nom chan ahinsah ahi. 22 Pan koima thu atanpoi, thutan ding jouse apumpia Chapa apehdoh ahitai; 23 hitia min Pa ajabol banguva mitinin Chapa ajabolna ding ahi. Chapa jabol lou mi chun asol’a Pa geiya ajabol lou ahi. 24 “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, kasei ngaiya Eihinsolpa tahsan chun tonsot hinna anei ahitan, thupi tan naa lut louva thinaa kona hinna galkai ahitai. 25 Kichentah akaseipeh nahiuve, mithihon Pathen Chapa ogin ajah-uva, ajaph chanin hina aneidiu phat ahung lhunin, tun hikoma aume. 26 pa Amatah hinna bulpi ahibangin, Aman Chapa jong hinna bulpi hina apetai. 27 Mihem Chapa ahijehin jong Pan thupi tanna apetai. 28 Hiche hi datmo hih-un, ajeh chu lhankhuh dung alum mithihon aogin ajahna diu phat ahung lhunge, 29 mithiho lhankhuh hoa kona hung potdoh-uva, thilpha bol chengse kikaithouva hing diu, thilse bol chengse vang kikaithouva athuu kitan ding ahi,” ati.

Jesu thudol hettohsah ho

30 “Keiman kachamin ima kabolpoi; pan eihil banga thu katanjeh-in kathutan adih-e; ijeh-inem itile keima dei khohsah louva Eihinsolpa lungdei kaholjoh ahi. 31 “Keiman kachung thu kakiseihileh kathu hettohsah chu dih lou ding ahi. 32 Kei chung thu hettohsah achom khat aumin, ama hettohsah chu adih kahei. 33 Nang hon John henga mi nasol’un, aman adih ahettohsah-e. 34 Ken mihem hettohsah chu kison nan kaneipoi, huh hinga naum theina diuva kasei ahibouve. 35 John chu thaomei kivah vahchansel ahin, ama vah a chun nang hon chom khat nomsah ding nadeiyui. 36 Keima hettohsah vang hi John’a sanga thupijo ahi, ajeh chu ka-pan molsa dinga eipeh toh ding ho katoh chengse hin pan eihinsol kahi thudol ahettohsah ahi. 37 Eihinsol’a Pa chun kachung thudol ahettohsah ahin, nang hon a-ogin jong najapouvin, alim jong namupouve. 38 Ahinsolpa natahsan loujeh-un nasunguva jong athu achengpoi. 39 Pathen lekhabu hoa chu tonsot hinna neithei din nagel’un nasim jiuvin, hiche ho chun Kei thudol ahettohsah-u ahibouve. 40 Nahinna diuvin kakoma nahung nompouve. 41 “Keiman mihem choi-at kakisonpipoi, 42 nalung sunguva Pathen na-ngailut louvu kahenai. 43 Keima ka-pa min’a hung kahin, nang hon neisang pouve; achomdang khat ama le ama minin hung le amajoh chu sangun nate. 44 Nang hon mihem choi-at kisonpiuva Pathen khatseh pachat didngjoh holl ou chu iti natahsan thei diuba ham? 45 Ama vang Keihin Pa henga kaheh-in gel hih-un, nang hon nakineppiu Mose chu naheh-uva pang ahi. 46 Mose natahsanu le Keijong neitahsan tei diu ahi, ajeh chu aman kei thudol asut ahibouve. 47 Aman asut thuho natahsanlou vangu leh kathuseiho jong natahsan lou diu ahi,” ati.

John 6

Jesun mi sang nga avahva

1 Hicheng nung hin Jesu Tiberias dillen kiti, Galilee dillen agal kaitai. 2 Jesun adammo ho aboldama melchihna kidang tampi abol amujeh-un mupin ajuitauve. 3 jesu mol chunga akaltouvin, aseijuite toh atouve. 4 Hichun kalchuh kut kiti Judate kut anaitai. 5 Jesu akhoda leh mipi ahenga hung amun, Philip jah a, “Mipi hicheng neh khop ding hi changlhah hoiya ichoh diu ham?” ati. 6 Hiche hi Aman patepna asei ahi; ajeh chu ipi abol ding Aman akihetnai. 7 Philip chun adonbut’in, “Denari ja ni man changlhah kicho jongleh them kha khat’in jong chang pouvinte,” ati. 8 Aseijuite lah a khat, Simon Peter sopipa Andrewn ajah a, 9 “Hikoma hin pasal chapang khat’in sap change kisem changlhah pheng nga le nga ni vang aneiyin, mi hijat lah a ipi khama pang ding ham?” ati. 10 Jesun “Miho chu tousah-un,” ati. Hikoma chu hamhing tampi umah ahin, miho chu atouvu leh amijat sangnga bang ahiuve. 11 Jesun changlhah pheng ho chu alan athangvah jouvin miho chu atou nauva ahoppeh-in, nga te nijong chutiman abol’in, amahon agot chanin aneuve. 12 Mihon anehva soh phat’un Jesun aseijuite jah a, “Nehval anong nai geiyin, amang thah beihel’in loh khom’uvin, “ati. 13 Hiti chun aloh khomun ahileh, sap change kisem changlhah pheng ngaa kon mihon anehmoh nong siu chu paipeh som le ni aloh dim’uve. 14 Thil kidang abol mu hon, “Hichepa vang hi vsnnoiya hung dia kisei Themgao chu ahimong mongtai,” atiuve. 15 Hichea hin mihon hunga achamlouva leng chansah din ago’uve, ti Jesun ahen, achangseh-in molchunga akitheh doh tai.

Jesun twichunga lam ajot

16 Nilhah ahiphat’in Jesu seijuite dillen lama achesuh-un, 17 kong khat’a lut’in Capernaum join dillen chu apal’uve. Kho ajing lheh tan, Jesu la ahenguva ahung hih laiye; 18 chule huipi hattah ahung nungin twipi akinong sang tul tul jenge. 19 Kilometer thum le li ham akitol’u leh Jesun twichunga lam ajot’a kong lang ahinjot amu’vin akicha lheh jengui. 20 Jesun ajah-uva, “Kei kahibouve, kicha hih-un!” ati. 21 Hichun Ama kong sunga puilut ding agot’u leh, kong chun ajotnau tol aphapaitai.

Mipin Jesu ahol’u

22 Ajing nikhon dillen gal lang khat’a um mipin chukoma kong dang beiya khatseh um chu amu’vin, chule hiche konga chun Jesu seijuite toh lut khom louvin, asdejuite achanguva chea Ama adalhah-u aheuve. 23 Pakaiyin athangvah jouva changlhah aneh nau mun kom, Tiberias a kona vang kong dang jong hung ahinai. 24 Hijeh chun Jesu le asei juite chukoma aumtapouve, ti ahet phat’un mipi chu acham chamin kong sunga alut’uvin Capernauma ahungun Jesu ahol’uve.

Jesu hinna changlhah ahi

25 Mihon Jesu chu dillen gal langkhat’a amudoh phat’un ajah a, “Rabbi, itih a hikoma hung nahi tah em?” atiuve. 26 Jesun amaho adonbut’in, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve. Nang hon melchihna ho namu jeh-uva neihol’u ahipon, changlhah nachan’uva nanehva jeh-uva neihol’u ahibouve. 27 Amangthah ji anneh holnan tong gim hih-un, Mihem Chapan napeh diu a-itih a um jing, tonsot hinna thei anneh holnan tong gim jo’uvin, ajeh chu Pa Pathenin Chapa chu tha neina mohor anamkhum ahi tai,” ati. 28 Amahon jah a, “Pathen na katoh thiena diuva ipi kabol diu ham?” atiuve. 29 Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uva, “Pathen na toh ding kiti chu ahin solpa natahsan diui hi ahiye,” ati. 30 Hichun amahon, “Nang katahsan theina diuva melchihna ipi nabol’em? I-ham nabol? 31 Ka pu kapateuvin Pathen lekhabua kisun, ‘Aman aneh diuvin vana koin changlhah apei,’ kiti dungjuiyin gamthip noiya Manna anneuvin ahi,” atiuve. 32 Jesun ajah-uva, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Mose’n vana konin Manna napepouve, ka-Pan vana kon changlhah dihtah chu napeh-u ahibouve. 33 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen changlhah chu vana kona hung kumlhaa vannoi dia hinna pepa chu ahi,” ati. 34 Amahon Jesu jah a, “pakai, hiche changlhah chu neipe jing jengun,” atiuleh; 35 Jesun ajah-uva, “Kei hi hinna changlhah kahin, kaheng hinjon jouse gilkel lou ding, chule Keima eitahsan chu dang chah kit lou hel ding ahi. 36 Amavang kaseipeh nahiuve, nang hon neimu tauvin, neitahsan pouve. 37 Pan eipeh chengse kahenga hungin tin, kaheng hinjon chu koi hileh kaledoh lou ding ahi, 38 ajeh chu Keima chama vana kona hung kumlha kahipon, Eihinsolpa lungdeiya hung kahibouve. 39 Eihinsolpa lungdei chu Aman eipeh chengse khat cha mansah louva, phatchai nikhoa kakaithou ding hi ahiye. 40 Ijeh-inem itile ka-pa dei chu Chapa mu jousen atahsan’a tonsot hinna anei ding, phat chai nikhoa Keiman kakaithou ding hi ahi,” ati. 41 Jesun, “keima vana kona hung kumlha changlhah kahi,” atijeh chun achunga Judate aphun’un, 42 “Hichepa hi Joseph chapa, anu apa i-hetsau Jesu chu hilou haimo? I-tileh aman, ‘Vana kona hung kumlha kahi,’ ti ham?” atiuve. 43 Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uva, “Kihou lhi chet chut’in phun dauvin, 44 Eihinsol’a Pan aloilut lou chu koiman kaheng ahinjon theipoi; ahunga chu phat chai nikhoa Keiman kakaithou ding ahi. 45 Themgaoho lekhabua chun, ‘ Abonchauva Pathenin ahil diu ahi,’ tin akisun’e. Pa thu ngaiya Amaa kihilna neichan kahenga ahungjie. 46 Mi koiman Pa chu amukhapoi, Pathena kona hungpa, amanbou Pa chu amu ahi. 47 Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, atahsana chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai. 48 Keima hinna changlhah kahi. 49 napu napateuvin gamthip’a Manna aneh vangun athigam tauve. 50 Vana kona hung kumlha cahnglhah chu min aneh teng thi lou ding ahi. 51 Keima vana hung kon changlhah hing kahi, min hiche changlhah hi aneh leh tonsot’a hing jing ding ahi; Keiman kepeh ding changlhah chu katahsa ahin, vvannoi hina dinga kapeh ahi,” ati. 52 Judaho lung phamo tenin akihouvun, “Hichepa hin neh dia atahsa iti eipeh didu ham? Atiuve. 53 Jesun ajah-uva, “Kichen tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, nang hon Mihem Chapa sa naneh louva athi nadon louvu leh nasunguva hinna naneipouve. 54 Kasa nea kathi don’a chun tonsot hinna anei ahitan, phat chai nikhoa Keiman kakaithou ding ahi. 55 Ajeh chu kasa hi neh ding mong ahin, kathi hi don ding mong ahi. 56 Kasa nea kathi don’a chu kasunga aumin, keima ama sunga kaume. 57 pa hing jing chun eisol’a Keijong pa vanga kahin banga, Keima einea jong chu Keivanga hing ding ahi. 58 Vana kona hung kumlha changlhah chu hiche hi ahi: pute paten aneh-uva thi khemlouva aum nau tobang ahipoi, hiche changlhah nea vang chu tonsot’a hing ding ahi,” ati. 59 Jesun hicheng hi Capernaum khosung Houthua kihopnaina thu ahilpet’a asei ahi.

Tonsot hinna thu

60 Jesu seijui tampin hiche hi ajah phat’un, “Asei hi ahahsa behseh jenge, kon angai thei ding ham?” atiuve. 61 Aseijuite hiche thua aphun chu Jesun along gil’in ahen ajeh-uva, “Kasei hin nakipalsah-u hita ong? 62 Mihem Chapa hi masanga aumna ngaiya akaltou muleu chun iti tauvin natem? 63 Hinna pea Lhagao ahin, tahsaphen ima atahpoi; najah-uva kathuseiho hi Lhagao le hina ahi. 64 Ahinla nalahuva atahsan lou jong naum’uv,” ati. Ijeh-inem itile Jesun abul’a pat atahsan lou ding koi koi hiuva chule Ama matsah dingkoiham, ahet jingsa ahi. 65 Aman aseiyin, “Hichejeh a chu, ‘Pan aphalpeh tilouvin koiman kaheng ahinjon theipoi,’ ti najah-uva kasei ahi,” ati. 66 Hichea pat hin Jesu seijuitampi akinung leuvin, Amatoh akilhon le tapouve. 67 Hichun Jesun som le ni jah a, “Nang ho la nakinungle nom louvu ham?” atileh; 68 Simon Peterin adonbut’in, “Pakai koiheng kabel diu ham? Nangin tonsot hinna thu hijat neiya; 69 chule Pathena hung kon Athengpa chu nahi katahsan kihe ta chu,” ati. 70 Jesun amaho adonbut’in, “Nang ho som le ni kalhen chil hilou ham? Nalah-uva khat Dia bol nanalai ong?” ati. 71 Jesun Iscariot Simon chapa Judas aseina ahi; ajeh chu som le nil ah a apan vangin Jesu matsah a pang ding chu ama ahi.

John 7

1 Hicheng nung hin Juda lamkai hon tha dia aholjeh-un Jesu Judea gamsunga avahle nom tapon Galilee gamsunga bou akholjin lei. 2 Juda ho lhambuh kut ding phat anaitai. 3 Hijeh chun asopiten Jesu jah a, “Nathilbol natoh ho hi naseijui hon jong amu theina diuvin hikom dalhan Judea gama chetan. 4 Ijeh-inem itile minthan dei mi koiman guh thimin thil abol ngaipoi. Thil hicheng nabol ahileh vannoi kimusah ngal’in,” atiuve. 5 Ajeh chu asopite jengin jong atahsan pouve. 6 Hijeh chun Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho didnga phat ahijing vangin Keidin phat ahi hih laiye. 7 Anatoh chengse phat louna kahettohsah jeh-in vannoiyin Keima eihon nang ho vang naho pouve. 8 Nang ho kut’a chun chetauvin, Keivang kaphat alhin loulai jeh-in hiche kut’a hin cheponge,” ati. 9 Hicheng hi aseiyin Ama Galilee gamsunga aumdentai.

Lhambuh kutlaiya Jesu

10 Asopi kut’a dia ache nungun Jesu jong lhang phong hilouvin guh thimin achetouve. 11 Kut laiyin Judah on Jesu ahol’uvin, “Ama chu hoiya um ham?” atiuve. 12 Japi lah a chun Jesu thudol’a kinel baotamna asoh-in, loi khat’in, “Ama hi mipha ahi,” atiuvin; abangin, “Ahipoi, mipi apui chavai boue,” atiuve. 13 Juda ho agin jeh-un koiman vang athudol lhang phongin asei ngampouve. 14 Kut lai tah-in Jesu Houina achetouvin thu agahil’e. 15 Hichea hin Judah on adatmo lheh jengun, “Hichepan kahilna bon nei louva iti lekha hiti thep hi nga na?” atiuve. 16 Jesun amaho adonbut’in, “Kathuhil hi Keiya ahipoi, Eihinsolpaa ahibouve. 17 Eihinsolpa lung dei bolnom mi chun thu kihil hi Pathena kon ha, kachama kasei ham, ahet didng ahi. 18 koi hileh achama thuseipan Ama kichoi atna ding bou aholjin, ahinsolpa choi tana ding holpa vang chu adih ahin, ama sunga chun adih lou aumpoi. 19 Mose’n danthu napeh-u hilou ham? Ahinla nang ho khat cha beh-in danthu chu namangpouve. I-bol’a tha dia neihol’u ham?” ati. 20 Mipin adonbut’un, “Nang hi thilhavop nahi. Kooiham tha dia nahol’ah?” atiuve. 21 Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uva, “Ken na khat katongin nabonchauvin nadatmouve. 22 Amaa kon ahilou vangin pu le patea konin Mose’n chaptan ding thu napeuvin, hijeh chun Choldo ni jeng jongleh mihem chep natanjiuve. 23 Mose Danthu suhkeh louna dia Choldo mikhoa mikhat chep akitan leh, Choldo bikhoa mikadamthengsah hel jeha i-bol’a kachunga lung hang nahiuvam? 24 Polam mitvet’a thu tan louvin adih bangtah-in tan’uvin,” ati.

Jesu chu Messiah ham

25 Jerusalem Kon miphabep’in “Mihon tha dia ahol’u chu hichepa hi hilou naimo? 26 ahinla ve, aman lhang phongtah-in thu asiyin, amahonla ajah a imacha aseipouve. Vaipoten ama hi Messiah ahi tia ahet chet mongu hitam? 27 Keihon hichepa ahung kina kihea, Messiah ahung teng vang leh koiman akonna ahet lou ding ahi,” atiuve. 28 Jesun hitea Houina thu ahilpet hin asamin, “Nang hon Keima neiheuvin, kahung konna geiyin naheuve. Ahinla Keima kachama hung kahipoi, Eihinsolpa chu dih tah ahin, nang hon Ama nahepouve. 29 Kenvang Ama kahei, ajeh chu Amaa hung kon Ama sol kahi,” ati. 30 Hichun mihon mat dingago’uvin, aphat lhin loulai jeh-in koiman achunga khut alhapouve. 31 Mipilah a tampin Ama atahsanun, “Messiah hung teng jongle hichepa bol sanga tamjo melchihna abol mong ding hinam?” atiuve.

Vaibol hon Jesu man ding asol’u

32 Jesu thudol’a mipi akinel baotam nau chu Pharisee hon ajauvin, hijeh chun thempu pipuho leh Pharisee hon Jesu man din lhacha ho asoltauve. 33 Jesun, “Phat chomcha ka-umpiuva, chutengleh Eihinsolpa henga kache ding ahitai. 34 Nang hon neihol’uvaneimu lou diu, Kei umnaa la nahung thei lou dingu ahi,” ati. 35 Judaho akihouvun, “Hoiya che idng kigo hiya, eihon i-hol’uva imu lou diu ham? Chi dang namdang lah akithecheh Judate lah a chea, chiding namdang h gahil ding agot kha tham? 36 Athusei, ‘Neihol’uva neimu lou diu, Kei umna la nahung thei lou dingu ahi,’ ati hi ipi atina mong ham?” atiuve.

Hinna twidung

37 Kut kichai ni, ni loupe nin Jesu adingin o-ging tah-in asamin, “Koi hileh adangchah a chu kahenga hung hen lang don hen, 38 Pathen lakhabun, ‘Keima eitahsana chu along sunga hintwi put’a luiya long ding ahi,’ ati banga um ding ahi,” ati. 39 Jesun Ama tahsanhon Lhagao akisan diu aseina ahi, ijeh-inem itile Jesu choi-at a aum loulai jeh a hiche ni geiya hi Lhagai kihom loulai ahi.

Mipi kikhente

40 Hiche aseiho hi mipi phabep’in ajauvin, “Hichepa hi Themgao tahbeh ahibouve,” atiiuvin ahi. 41 Adang hon ma, “Hichepa hi Messiah ahi,” atiuvin, konkhat’in vang, “Galilee gama Messiah sohdoh din gong?” 42 Pathen lekhabun, ‘Messiah chu David guiya kona Bethlehema hung sohdoh ding ahi,’ ati lou ham, David chenna khopia chu?” atiiuve. 43 Hijeh chun Ama jehin mipi akibung khentauve. 44 Abang bangin mat din ago’uvin, koi manla achunga khut alhapouve.

Thu neihon Jesu atahsan lou

45 Lhachaho chu Thempu pipu ho le Pharisee ho henga ahung phat’un amahon, “I-bol’a nahin kaidiu ham?” tin anadongui. 46 Lhachahin adonbut’un, “Khu cheap thusei tobangin koiman thu asei khapoi,” atiuve. 47 Pharisee hon adonbut’un, “Doha nalhah-u hitalou ong? 48 Vaipo ho lah a khat beh le Pharisee mikhat beh-in atahsan em? 49 Danthu hetoh lou hiche mipi vang hi sapset chang hiuva khu,” atiuve. 50 Alah-uva mikhat, masanga Jesu henga hungsa, Nicoddemua vang chun ajah-uva, 51 I-danthu’vin mi athu ngai masa loule athilbol muchen louva achung thu eitahsanji nah um?” ati. 52 Amahon adonbut’un ajah a, “nang jong Galilee mi nahim? Hol’in vetang, Galilee kona Themgao sohdoh ngai lou chu,’” atiuve. 53 Mihon inlam ajon cheh-un,

John 8

Ajon pettah a kiman numei

1 Jesu chu Olive mol lama achei. 2 Jingkah matah-in houina agache kit’e. Ahenga mipi abonchan ahung kikhomun, Ama atouvin miho thu ahiltai. 3 Danthu them ho le Pharisee hon ajon pettah a kimandoh numei khat ahin kailut’un, Jesu to akah-uva adinsah-un, 4 ajah a, “Houhil hiche nu hi ajon petah a kimandoh ahi. 5 Danthua chun Mose’n hitobang numei ho songa selih dinga asei ahi. Nangin iti na-ngaitom?” atiuve. 6 Ama hetsahna theiya akipalna dia aseiyu ahin, ahinla Jesu abungin akhut jungin tol ajih tai. 7 Amahon adoh tei tei jeng phat’un Jesu adding jangin ajah-uva, “nalahuva chonsetna neilou pen chun amanu hi songin sep masapen hen,” atin; 8 abungin tol ajih kittai. 9 Hiche hi ajah phat’un a-upapen hoa pat’in khat khat’in adalhauvin Jesu le numeinu chubou alailunga aumtai. 10 Hichun Jesu adahdoh-in ajah a, “Numei, hoiya umtauvem? Koiman themmo nachan lou hitam?” tin adonge. 11 Amanun, “Pakai, koiman themmo eichan tapoi,” ati. Jesun, “kenjong themmo kachan poi, chen lan gchonse kit ta hihin,” ati.

Jesu Vannoi Vah

12 Jesun ajah-uva aseikit’in, “Keima vannoi slvah kahin, kanung juiya chun muthima lam’ajot lou ding, hinna khovah anei idng ahi,” ati. 13 Pharisee hon ajah a, “Nangin nachung thu nahettohsah jeh-in nahettohsah chu adihpoi,’ atiuve. 14 Jesun adonbut’in jah-uva, “ken kachung thu hettohsah jong leng kahettohsah hi adih-e; ajeh chu hoiya hung kona hoi lam kajot kakihet’in, nang hon hoiya hungkona hoi lam kajot nahepouve. 15 Nang hon tahsa dol’in thu natan jiuvin, Ken koima thu katanpoi. 16 ijehtin tan jeng jong leng kathutan adih-e, ajeh chu kachang kahinpon, Eihinsol’a pa chun eiumpi. 17 Ajeh chu nadanthu va jong mini thu hettohsah chu adihna akisune. 18 Kachung thu hettohsah a pang Kei kahin, chule Eihinsol’a panjong kachung thu ahettohsah-e,” ati. 19 Amahon ajah a, “Napa hoiya um ham?” atiuleh; Jesun adonbut’in, “Nang hon Keila neihepouvin, ka-pa jong nahepouve; Keima neihetsau hileh ka-Pa jong nahet diu ahi,” ati. 20 Hicheng hi Jesun Houina athuhil pet’a thil kholna muna asei ahin, Ama phat ahung lhun loulai jeh-in koiman aman pouve.

Kache naa hung theipouvin nate

21 Jesun ajah-uva asei kit’in, “Keima che mang ing ting, nang hon neihol diu, ahinla nachonset’a nathiden’uvaa kache naa nahung thei lou dingu ahi,” ati. 22 Juda hon, “Ama le ama kithat ngap ding ham, ‘Kache naa nahung thei lou diu,’ ati khu?” atiuve. 23 Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho hoiya kon nahiuvin, Keima chunga kon kahi; nang ho hiche vannoiya nahiuvin, Keima vang hiche vannoiya kahipoi. 24 “Hichejeh a chu nachonset ho’uva nathi diu ahi, tia kasei ahi; nang hon Kei hi, ‘Ama chu ahi,’ tia natahsan louvu leh nachonset ho’uva nathi tei diu ahi,” ati. 25 Hichun amahon ajah a, “Nang koi nahim?” atiuleh; Jesun ajah-uva, “Atil’a pat koi kahi kaseipeh-u chu la? 26 Nachung change thu Pathena siya tan ding tampi kaneinan, Eihinsolpa amatah Adih ahijeh-in Amaa kona kajah cheng chu Vannoi mite kaseipeh ahibouve,” ati. 27 Pa thudol’a ajah-uva asei chu ahdoh thei pouve. 28 Hijeh chun Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang hon Mihem Chapa hi nakhai san gtengu leh Kei hi Ama chu kahi nahetdoh-uva, imacha kachama bol louva, hicheng kaseiho jong hi Pan eihil’a kasei ahi, nahet diu ahi. 29 Chule Eihinsolpa chun alungdei kaboljeh-in eiumpin, kachangin eidalhapoi,” ati. 30 Aman hicheng hi asei nalaiyin mi tampin ama atahsantauve.

Adih chun najalensah diu ahi

31 Ama tahsan Jusa hojah a Jesun, “Nang hon kasei najom jingo leh kaseijui tahbeh mong nahiuvin, 32 chuteng atah chu nahet’uva, atah chun najalensah diu ahi,” ati. 33 Amahon adonbut’un ajah a, “Keiho Abraham chilhah kahiuvin itih-in jong koima koma soh-in kalut khapouve; ati dan a nangin ‘Najalen diu ahi,’ natiham?” atiuve. 34 Jesun amaho chu adonbut’in, “Kichen a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh achonsea chu chonset’a kihen soh ahi. 35 Soh chu tonsot’in in’a acheng pon, Chapa vang acheng jinge. 36 Hijeh chun Chapan jalensah leu chun najalen tahbeh diu ahi. 37 Abraham chilhah nahiu kahenai; ahinla nasunguva kathun mun anei lou jeh-in tha din neigo’uve. 38 Ka-pa koma kamu chukasei ahin, nang hon jong na-pauva kaona najah chan nabol’u ahi,” ati.

Napau Diabol ahi

39 Amahon Jesu adonbut’un ajah a, “Ka-pau Abraham ahi,” atiuleh; Jesun ajah-uva, “Abraham chate hileu chun Abraham thilbol ho nabol diu ahi. 40 Tunla Pathenna kona thutah ja a nahenguva sepia Kei hi tha din neigo’uve, Abrahamin hitobang hi abolpoi. 41 Nang hon napau thil bol nabol’u ahi,” ati. Amahon ajah a, “Keiho bolam kahipouve, ka-pau khat Pathen ahi,” atiuve. 42 Jesun ajahuva, “Pathen na-pau hile Kei nei ngailut diu ahi, ajeh chu Kei hi Pathena hung kon hikoma um kahi, kacham hung kahipon, Aman eihinsol ahi. 43 Idinga kasei nahet khen thei louvu ham? Kahil hi-na-ngai jou loujeh-u ahibouve. 44 Nang ho napau Diabol’a nahiuva napauva hung kon alungdei chu namolso namu ahi. Ama chu semtil’a pat tolthat ahin, thutah aum loujeh a atah a pang ngailou ahi. Aman thujou asei teng along chama aseiji ahi; ajeh chu jousei ahin, jou penna pa ahi. 45 Kenvang atah kasei ahin, ahinla neitahsan pouve. 46 Michonse ahi eiti thei ding koipen nahiuvem? Atah kasei ahileh ibol’a neitahsan dau ham? 47 Pathena kon chun Pathen thu angaiyin, nang hon thu na-ngailouvu hi Pathena kon nahilou jeh-u ahi,” ati.

Abraham masanga umsa kahi

48 Judahon adonbut’un ajah a, “Nangma Samaria mi nahin, thilhavop nahi katiu hi dih lou ham?” atiuve. 49 Jesun adonbut’in, “Keima thilhavop kahipon, ka-Pa kajabol ahin, nang hon Keima neijabol pouve. 50 Keiman kaloupina ding kaholpon, ahol’a athutan khat aum nai. 51 Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, kathu nit chun itih chan hijongle thina atep khah lou ding ahi,” ati. 52 Juda hon ajh a, “Thilhavop nahi tun kahetauve. Abraham athitan, Themgao jouse jong athitauvin, ahinla nangin, “Kathu nit chun itih chan hijongle thina atep khah lou ding ahi,’ nati. 53 Kapu luiyu Abraham athitan, asanga lenjo nahim? Themgao jouse jong athigamtan, koipenba kahi nakitim?” atiuve. 54 Jesun adonbut’in, “Kei kichoi-an kahileh kaloupina chu ima ahipoi, nang hon, “Ka-pau ahi,’ natiu hiche ka-Pa chun eichoi-at joh ahibouve. 55 Ama chu nang hon nahe hih laiyun, Kenvang kahenai; Ama chu kahepoi tileng nang ho banga jousei kahi ding ahi, Ken ama kahen athu kanit’e. 56 Na-pau Abraham chu Keima nikho mu ding athanomin, amun akipah lheh jenge,” ati. 57 Juda hon ajah a, “Nakum som nga bon lhing lou laiya Abraham namusa hiya ong?” atiuve. 58 Jesun ajah-uva, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Abraham pem masanga jong um jing Keima kahi,” ati. 59 Amahon ase na didng song akilo phat’un Jesu achamin akiseldoh-in, Houina kon chun ache mangtai.

John 9

Jesun apena mitcho khat aboldam

1 Jesu ache naa mi apen’a pat mitcho khat amui. 2 Aseijuiten ajah a, “Rabbi, hichepa mitchoa apen hi ama chonset jeh ha anu le apa chonset jeh ham?” tin adongui. 3 Jesun adonbut’in, “Hiche hi ama chonset vang jong ahipon; Pathen natoh ho kiphondoh theina dinga ama hi mitchoa peng ahibouve. 4 Sun ahipet’a Eihunsolpa na i-tih tei diu hiveh ta, koiman na atoh thei louna ding jan hung lhung ding hita hi. 5 Vannoiya kaum laisea vannoi salvah kahi,” ati. 6 Jesun hiche hi aseiyin, tol’ah achil aset lhan, achil’in bonlhoh asemin, mitchopa mit te nia aloiyin 7 ajah a, “Chen lang Siloam (Siloam hi ‘sol’ kiti ahi) twikul’a gakiphet lhah tan,” ati. Ama achea agakiphet lhah leh kho amun ahung kile kittai. 8 Mitchopa heng le kom ho, khutdoa apan lai musa hon, “Touva khutdoji chu ama hi hilou haimo?” atiuve. 9 Abangin, “Ama ahinai,” atiuvin, kim khat’in, “Ahipoi, amato lim kilo ahibouve,” atiuve. Mitchopa ama tah-in, “Kei ama chu kahinai,” ati. 10 Amahon ajah a, “I-atileh namit te ni hah hitam?” atiuve. 11 Aman adonbut’in, “Jesu kitipa khun bonlhoh asemin, kamit te nia aloiya, ‘Siloam a chen gakiphet lhah tan,’ atia, kachea kagaphet lhah leh kho kamu ahitai,” ati. 12 Amahon ajah a, “Ama hoiya umtam?” atiuleh; aman, “Kahepoi,” ati.

Pharisee hon mitchopa damdol akhol’u

13 Amahon masanga mitchopa chu Psarisee ho henga apuitauve. 14 Jesun bonlhoh asema mitchopa mitt e nia aloiya ahasah ni chu CHoldo nikho ahi. 15 Pharisee hon amapan kho amu thudol chu akhol kit’uvin ahileh aman ajah-uva, “Aman bonlhoh asemin kamit te nia aloiya kagasop lhah phat’a kho kamuthei ahi,” ati. 16 Pharisee ho phabep’in, “Choldo ni anit loujeh-in hichepa hi Pathena kon loujeh-in,” atiuvin; abangman, “Michosen hitobang thil kidang ho abol thei ngai ong?” tin, hitobang hin alah-uva kibung khenna asohtai. 17 Amahon mitchopa jah a avel’in, Amahon namit ahasah jeh a chu nangin Ama chu koi ahiba natim?” atiuleh; aman, “Themgao ahi,” ati. 18 Juda hon ama chu mitchosa ahi kho amu kit hi anu le apa kouva, 19 amani jah a, “Hichepa hinachapa lhon, amitchosa peng niti lhonpa lhon, amitchosa peng nati lhonpa chu himong nam? Ahileh iti kho amu kitham?” tia adoh masang seuvin atahsanpouve. 20 Anu le apan adonbut lhonin, “Amahi kachapa lhon ahiya chule mitcho anahi chu kahe lhon nai; 21 i-atileh kho amu kit’a, koipenin amit te ni ahasah ham vang kahe lhonpoi. Ama dongun, upa hita chu achung thu aman kisei nante,” ati lhone. 22 Judaho aginjeh lhona anule apan hiche hi asei lhon ahi; ajeh chu Jesu hi Messiah ahi tia phongdoh pen pen Houthua kikhopna ina kona pamse ding tia Judahon dettah a kilolna aneisau ahi. 23 Hichejeh a chu anu le apan, “Upa hita chu ama dongun,” ati lhon ahi. 24 Anivei nan amahon masanga mitchopa chu akouvun ajah a, “Pathen choi-atnan adih seiyin, hichepa vang hi michonse ahi, keihon kahei,” atiuve. 25 Ama adonbut’in, “Michonse ahi ahilou kahepoi; masang chun kamit achon tun kho kamui, tibou kahei,” ati. 26 Amahon ajah a, “Aman i-nalom? Namit te ni iti ahasah ham?” atiuleh; 27 Aman amaho adonbut’in, “Nakiseipeh tauva na-ngaipouvin, i-bol’a najah nom kit’u ham? Ama seijuiya napan nom’uvem?” ati. 28 Hichun ama ahouseuvin, “Nang chu ama seijui nahi Chula em, keiho Mose seijui kahiya chu. 29 Pathenin Mose henga thu asei kihea, hichepa hoilam kon ahibon kahepha lou,’ atiuve. 30 Mipa chun adonbut’in ajahuva, “Aman kamit te ni geiya hasah taa, hoilam kon ahi nahet louvu chu datmo aum lheh-e! 31 Pathenin michonse ho thu angaipon, amavang khattouvin houguttah a Pathen lungdei abol leh athu a-ngaipehjie, ti ihesoh keiyui. 32 Semtil’a pat koiman mi mitchoa peng mit ahasah-w, ti akija khapoi. 33 Hichepa hi Pathenna kon ahilouleh imacha bol theiponte,’ ati. 34 Amahon adonbut’un, “Napum changa chonsea peng nangin keiho neihil’um?” atiuvin, anoddoh tauve.

Lhagaova mitcho

35 Hichepa chu anodoh-u ahen Jesun akimupi kit phat’in, “Nangman Mihem Chapa chu natahsanem?” ati. 36 Aman adonbut’in, “Pakai, katahsan thei ding ama chu koiham?” atileh; 37 Jesun ajah a, “Ama chu namutan, najah a thu seiya hi Ama ahi,” atipeh-e. 38 Aman adonbut’in, “Pakai katahsane,” atin; a-angsunga aboh khup’in chibai aboh tai. 39 Chuin Jesu, “Khomu louhon kho amu a, khomu ho mit chotna dinga vannoiya thutana hung kahi,” ati. 40 Asei hi avel’a um Pharisee hon ajauvin, “Keiho mitcho kahilouvu hinai?” atiuleh; 41 Jesun ajah-uva, “mitcho hileu chun chonsetna nanei lou diu ahi, tun vang, ‘Kho kamui,’ natijeh-un nachonsetnau aum cheh-e,” ati.

John 10

Kelngoi hong thulem

1 “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, kot’a lut louva mundanga kal’a kelngoi hong sunga lut mi chu gucha le michom ahi. 2 Kot’a lut’a vang chu kelngoiho chingpa ahi. 3 Kotngahpan ama chu kot ahonpeh jin, akelngoite chu amin cheh a akouteng kelngoiten a-ogin aheuvin, abonchan apuidoh jin ahi. 4 Aboncha ahoidoh soh teng ama alamkaiyin, a-ogin ahet jeh-uvin kelngoiten anung ajuiyui. 5 Midang nung vang ajui louhel diu ahi, a-ogin ahet loujehuva akoma kona jamming jo diu ahibouve,” ati. 6 Jesun hiche thulem hi miho aseipeh-in, ahinla ipi aseipeh-u chu amahon ahepouve.

Jesu kelngoi chingpa

7 Jesun asei kit’in, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Keima kelngoite hongkot kahi. 8 Keima masanga hung jouse chu gucha le michom jeng ahiuvin, kelngoiten jong athuu a-ngaipouve. 9 Keima kot chu kahi; Keiya hung lut chu huhhinga uma, lut le pot lea neh thei ham hing akimu ding ahi. 10 Gucha chu agu ding le athat ding chule asumang ding tilouvin ahung ngaipoi; Kei vang hinna aneiyuva, bukim keiya aneina diuva hung kahibouve. 11 Keima kelngoi chingpha chu kahin, kelngoi chingpha chun kelngoite din ahinkho aphal ngam’e. 12 Thalah mi, kelngoi chingpa hilou, aneipa jong hilou mi nei chingpa chun ngei hung amu teng kelngoite dalhan ajamjitai; chutah l engeiyun kelngoi akimat’in athechehjitan ahi. 13 Thalah ahijeh chun kelngoite ding ima agel khoh poi. 14 Keima kelngoi chingpha chu kahin, kakelngoite kahen, amahon jong eiheuve. 15 hitobanga chu Pan keima eihet’a, kenjong Pa kahet ahin, chule kelngoite dinga chu kahinkho kaphal jeng ahi. 16 Hiche hong sunga pang lou kelngoi dang kanei nalaiye; hicheng jong chu kahin puilut tei ding, amahon kaogin ahet’uva, kelngoi honkhat aching khat hidoh ding ahi. 17 “Kahinkho hi kalah kit theina dinga kaphal doh jeng jehin Pan keima eingailui. 18 Khattouvin eilahpeh thei ahipon, kachamtah a kaphaldoh ahibouve. Phaldoh a chule kilah kit theina thu kaneiyin, hiche thupeh hi ka-Paa kona kalah ahi,” ati. 19 Jesun thu chucheng aseijeh chun Judaho abung bungin akikhen lo kit tauve. 20 alah-uva mi tampin, “hichepa hi thlhavop l emi-ngol ahibouve! I-bol’a asei na-ngaiyu ham?” atiuve.

Judahon Jesu asandau

21 Adangsen, “Aseiho hi thilhavop thusei ahipoi; thilhan mitcho ho mit ahasah ngaiyem?” atuve.22 Phalbi ahitan, Jerusalema Houin thenso kut phat ahung lhungtai; 22 Jesu chu Houina Solomon hongcha chun avah lei. 24 Hichun Judahon ahin umkimvel’un ajah a, “Itih chan lung gima neilha got’u ham? Messiah nahileh phongtah-in neiseipeh-un,” atiuve. 25 Jesun amaho chu adonbut’in “Nakiseipeh tauva neitahsan pove; ka-Pa min a thil kabol ho hin Kei koi kahi ahettohsah ahin, 26 nang ho kakelngoi lah a nahiloujeh-un natahsanpouve. 27 Kakelngoiten ka-ogin ajauvin, Kenjong amaho kahen, amahon eijuiyui 28 Ken amaho tonsot hina kapen, a-iti a mang thah lou diu, ka-khut’a kona koiman jong eilahpeh theilou ding ahi. 29 hicheho eipe ka-Pa chu ima jouse sanga chung nung jo ahin, Pa khut’a kona koiman alahmang thei louhel ding ahi, 30 kapa le Kei khat kahi lhone,” ati. 31 Chutah chun Judahon Jesu se na ding song akilo kittauve. 32 Jesun amaho chu adonbut’in, “Pa thusah a konin natohpha tampi kavetsah tauvin, hiche kabol ho hoipen jeh a chu songa sedinga neigot’u ham?” atileh; 33 Juda hon adonbut’in, “Thilpha boljeh a seding kagot’u ahipon, mihem hiya Pathen nakihisah a Pathen nataitom jeh a kasegot’u ahibouve,” atiuve. 34 Jesun amaho adonbut’in, “Nadan lekhabu’va, “Nang ho pathente nehiuve kati ahi,’ tia kisun lou ham? 35 Pathen thu lhunna mai maiho bon Pathente akitiu jouthei lou ahin, 36 pan athensoa vannoiya ahinsol Keiman, ‘Pathen kataitoma naseiyu ham? 37 Keiman ka-Pa na katoh lou leh neitahsanda jengun; 38 katoh vang leh Keima neitahsan hih jongleu chun Keisunga Pa apansat’a chule Keima Pa sunga kapansat hi nahet chet vang nadiuvin, na kitong chengse beh hi tansan’uvin,” ati. 39 Hichun amahon mat din ago kit’un, Ama la akhut’uva konin atoldoh tai. 40 Jesu Jordan luigal lam, amasa Johnin mi baptize abolna muna chun achen, hia chun agathamtai. 41 Mi tampi ahenga ahungun, “Johnin melchihna ima abol hih nan, ahin hichepa chung thudol’a John thusei jouse vang adih soh keiye,” atiuve. 42 Chukoma chun mi tampin Jesu atahsantauve.

John 11

Lazarus thi

1 Mary le asopinu Martha chenna Bethany khoa amin Lazarus atiu chu adammoi. 2 Anapa chu, Pakai thao nua asama akeng thehgim nu, Mary sopipa Lazarus ahi. 3 Asopi numei ten in ahenga mi asol lhonin, “Pakai, ven nalungset nagolpa asammoi,” agatisah lhone. 4 Jesun hichu ajah phat’in, “Hiche nat hi thina ding ahipoi, Pathen Chapa choisanga aumnadinga Pathen loupina ding ahi bouve,” ati. 5 Jesun Martha le asopinu chule Lazarus chu alungset lheh-e. 6 Lazarus dammo thu ajah vangin aumnaa chun ni ni anichonbe nalaiyin; 7 chujouvin aseijuite jah a, “Judea gama gachekit tauhite,” ati. 8 Seijuiten ajah a, “Rabbi, tutah a Judah on songa sedia nahol’uva, hikoma chu nagache kit ding ham?” atiuve. 9 Jesun adonbut’in, “Nikho khat sunga nidan som le ni um hilou ham? Sun laiya vah le mi chun vannoiya khovah amujeh-in akisunpoi; 10 jan laiya vah le mi vang amasanga khovah aum loujeh-in akisuijie,” ati. 11 Hicheng hi aseiyin, hiche jouchun ajah-uva, “Igolpau Lazarus chu a-ihmutai, ahin ama sukhanga che ding kahi,” ati. 12 Seijuiten ajah a, “Pakai aihmuttah le damtante,” atiuve. 13 Jesun la athitai tia aseina ahin, amahon angaiya ihmut aseinan agel’uve. 14 Hichun Jesun ajahuva aseichanin, “Lazarus, chu athia ahitai; 15 natahsan theina diuva chukoma ka-umlou chu nang ho din kakipah-e, ahenga gacheu hite,” ati. 16 Apengkop ahi, tia Thomas kitipan aseijui chanpi ho jah a, “Eiho jong amatoh i-thi than a diuva gacheu hite,” ati.

Jesu thokitna le hina

17 Jesu ahung leh Lazarus lhana alupsah nau chu ni li alhingtai ti aphotoh tai. 18 Bethany chu Jerusalem komcha, kilometer thum tobang ahi. 19 Asopipa lhon chung change lhamon dingin Juda hotampi Martha le Mary henga ahungui. 20 Jesu hung ajah phat’in Martha chu alamdot din achen, Mary vang in’a atouve. 21 Marthan Jesu jah a, “Pakai, nangma hikoma um hile chun kasopipa thi lou dinga, 22 tujengin jong ipi hileh Pathen henga nathum chan Pathenin peteiyin nete ti kahei,” ati. 23 Jesun ajah a, “Nasopipa thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati. 24 Marthan ajah a, “Achai nikhoa thokitnaa athodoh ding chu kahenai,” ati. 25 Jesun ajah a, “Keima thokit na le hinna kahin, keima eitahsana chu thijongle hing ding ahi; 26 chule mihing eitahsan chan a-itih a thilou hel ding ahitai; hiche hi natahsan em?” ati. 27 Amanun, “Henge Pakai, Nangma Pathen Chapa Messiah, vannoiya hunga chu nahi katahsane,” ati.

Jesu akap’e

28 Marthan hiche asei jou hin achen asopinu Mary guhthimin akouvin, “Houhil chu hikoma aumin nakouve,” agate. 29 Maryn ajah phat’in akipatdoh loiyin Jesu henga ahungtai. 30 Jesu chu khosung hung lut loulai, Marthan aga lamdotna muna chu um nalai ahi. 31 In’a Mary umpia lhamon Judah on ama kinloitah a achedoh chu amu’vin, lhanphunga gakap ding hinte, tin ajuitauve. 32 Mary chu Jesu umna ahung lhuna Ama amu phat’in akengbul’a aboh khup’in ajah’a, “Pakai, nangma hikoma umle chun kasopipa thi lou didnga!” ati. 33 Jesun Mary lunghem amun, ahin lhonpi Juda ho ma alunghem cheh-u leh, adip alai adap jengin ahimsan, 34 “Hoiya navuiyum?” atileh; amahon, “Pakai, hungin hungven,” atiuve. 35 Jesu akaptai. 36 Hichun Juda hon, “Ven, iti alungset hitam!” atiuve. 37 Alah-uva phabep’in vang, “Mitchopa mitt e nibon hasah thei hichenpan ama hi athida sah thei lou ham?” atiuvin ahi.

Jesun Lazarus ahindohsah

38 Jesu adip adap kit jengin, lhanpunga ahung le lhan chu songko ham khat ahin, akot chu song khat’in akisinge. 39 Jesun, “Song khu tangdoh-un,” atileh; Mithipa sopinu Marthan ajah a, “Pakai, ni li alhingtan uitante,” ati. 40 Jesun ajah a, “Natahsan le Pathen loupina namuding ahi, tia kaseipehsa hilou ham?” ati. 41 Hijeh chun song chu atangdoh tauve. Hichun avan dah-in, “Panangin kataona nasanjeh-in kathangvah-e. 42 Kenvang kataona nangai jinge, ti kahenai, ahin hiche kavel’a ding mipi hin Nangma sol kahi atahsan theina diuva amaho khohsahna akasei ahi,” ati. 43 Hiche hi aseiyin hatah-in asamin, “Vo lazarus, hungdoh-in,” ati. 44 Hichun mithipa chu akhut akeng kitoma, amai ultheh pon, a kijel pumin ahungdoh tai. Jesun ajah-uva, “Lhamun lang chesah-un,” ati.

Jesu thana ding agonu

45 mary henga hung Juda ho tampin Jesu thilbol chu amu’vin Ama atahsanlo tauve. 46 alah-uva kimkhat vang acheuvin Jesu thilbol chu Pharisee hojeh a agaseitauve. 47 Hijeh chun Thempu pipu ho le Pharisee hon Houvaipoloi kikhopna khat asomun, “Hichepa hin melchihna tampi abol’e, ipi i-bol diu ham? 48 Hitin ama khu amoh lhaleu hen mi jousen tahsanin tin, Rome mite hungkona imunpiu le ijat’u asumang diu ahi,” tin aseiyui. 49 Alah-uva chuche kuma Thempu chungnunga pang Caiaphas kiti pan ajah-uva, “Imacha nahepouve; 50 vaipi amanthah louna dinga khat thi chu nang ho dinga thilphajo ahi, tijong nagel hih hel’uve,” ati. 51 hiche hi ama chama asei ahipon, chuche kuma Thempu chungnunga pang ahijeh a vaipi khel’a jesu thi ding thu gaomasa ahi; 52 vaipi keo ding jong hilouva akithechehsa Pathen chate pum khat’a akhop tupna ding jong ahiye. 53 Hiche nikhoa pat chun Jesu tha nadin Judate akiloltauve. 54 Hijeh chun Jesu jong Juda ho lah a lhangphongin avahle tapon, chua konin gamthip lam naiya gambih sunga Ephriam kiti khopia chun achen, hikoma chun seijuite toh aum jing tauve. 55 Juda ho kalchuh kut anai phat’in agam gama konin mi tampi kalchuh kut masanga kisutheng din Jerusalema achetauvui. 56 amahon Jesu ahol’un, Houina adinguvin amaho akihouvun, “Ipi nagel’um? Ama chu Kut a hung lha louhel ding ham?” akitiuve. 57 Thempu pipu ho le Pharisee hon Amachu amat theina diuva, aumna hepen penin ajah-uva seipeh dinga thu apeh-u ahitai.

John 12

Bethany khoa Jesu thao anu

1 Kalchuh kut ding nigupp aum nalaiyin Jesun thinaa kona akaithou Lazarus chenna kho Bethanya chun Jesu ahungtai. 2 Hikoma chun Jesu din anneh asemun, Martha ajen leuvin apangin, ankong umho lah a Lazarus jong apange. 3 Maryn halpi beihel nard a kisem thao namtui man tamtah kilogram keh ahin domin Jesu kengphang tenia anun asamin akengphang teni atheh ngim’e; thao namtui gimnam chun insung achansoh jengin ahi. 4 Jesu seijuiho lah akhat, ama matsah a pang dingpa Judas Iscariot chun, 5 “I-bol’a hiche thao namtui hi denarii jathun man’a kijoh a vaichate kipelou ham?” ati. 6 Hiche asei hi vaichate khohsahna asei ahipon, sumdip ma avop le asunga kikoi chu akiguhji jeh ahi. 7 Jesun, “Hiche nu hi limsah dauvin, kakivui nikhoa din amanun kikoi nante; 8 ijeh-inem itile vaichate chu nang ho toh umkhom jing ahin, Keivang a-itih a nang ho toh umkhom lou ding kahi,” ati.

Lazarus tha dia agot’u

9 Juda ho tampin chukoma Jesu um aheuvin, Jesu keoseh hilouvin thinaa kona athodoh Lazarus jong vetnomin ahunguve. 10 thempu pipu ho chu Lazarus jong tha din akilol tauve, 11 ajeh chu Lazarus jeh a Juda ho tampin alamkaiteu adalhah-uva Jesu atansanlo’u ahi.

Loupi tah a Jesu Jerusalem khopia alut

12 Ajing nikhon Kut’a dia hung mi tamtah-in Jesu Jerusalema hung aajauvin, 13 Iusuna akidop’un alamto din achauvin; “Huhhing hen! Pakai min a hungpa Israel lengpa chu anun nome,” tin asam sam jenguve. 14 Jesun sa-ngan khat amun achunga atouvin, Pathen lekhabua kisun, 15 “Kicha hih-in Zion chanu, Ven, nalengpa sa-ngan nou chunga touvin ahunge,” kitibangin abol’in ahi. 16 Hiche hi amasan aseijuiten ahepouvin, Jesu choi-at’a aum phat chun Ama thudol’a kisunsa hi chengse abol’u ageldoh tauve. 17 Jesun lhana kona Lazarus akouva thina kona athodoh pet’a aumpi mipi chu athu hettohsah-in apangtauvin ahi. 18 Hiche melchihna abol ajah jeh-uva jong chu mipin aga lamtou ahi. 19 Pharisee ho khat le khat akihouvun, “Veuvin ima nalo thei louvu ahitai! atiuve.

Greek mihon Jesu amunom

20 Kut laia Pathen hou dinga Jerusalema hung lah a chun Greek mi phabep jong apangui; 21 amaho hi Galilee gama Bethsaida khoa hungkon Philip henga acheuvin adongun, “Pu, keihon Jesu kamu nom’ui,” atiuve. 22 Philip achen Andrew jah a aseiyin, Andrew le Philip ahung lhonin Jesu jah a asei lhontai. 23 Jesun amani adonbut’in, “Mihem Chapa choi-at’a aumna ding nidan ahung lhungtai. 24 Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, chang hum khat tol’a alhah a athi lou le chang khat chun aum jingin, athivangleh tampi ahinsep doh jin ahi. 25 Ahinkho it chan chun asumang lon, hiche vannoiya ahinkho hotbol vang chun tonsot’a hinkho anei ding ahi. 26 Kakin bolnom chun eijui hen, Keima umnaa chu kalhacha jong um ding ahi; koi hile Keima kinbol’a pang chu Pan apachat ding ahi.

Mihem Chapa kidom sangtei ding

27 “Tun kalung agimtai. Ipi kasei ding ham? Pa, hiche nidan akon hin neihuhdoh-in ong? Ahin la hiche ding hi hiche nidan a hung lut kahi. 28 Pa, naming, choianin,” ati. Hichun vana kona ogin khat’in, “Kachoi-an’e, kachoi-at kit ding ahi,” ahinti. 29 Akimvel’a ding mipin hichu ajauvin, “Van aginge” atiuve. Adang hon, “Vantil’in aki houpi ahibouve,” atiuvin ahi. 30 Jesun adonbut’in, “hiche ogin hi Keima ding ahipon, nang ho ding joh a hung ging ahi. 31 Hiche vannoi hi tua athu kitan ahitan, vannoiya vaihompa chu tua kidelmang ding ahitai. 32 Leiset’a eikitah sang teng mitin kahenga kaloikhom ding ahi,” ati. 33 Jesun hiche hi itobanga athi ding dol aseina ahi. 34 Hijeh chun mipin adonbut’un, ‘Keihon la Messiah chu tonsot’a um jing ahi, ti danthua kisei kajauvin, i-atileh nangin Mihem Chapa chu kikhaisang ding ahi nati ham? Hiche Mihem Chapa chu koiba ham?” atiuleh; 35 Jesun ajah-uva, “Phat chom khat nalah-uva khovah um nalai ding ahi, muthimin najin den louna diuvin, khovah umpet’in vah leuvin; muthima vah le min che na ding akihetpoi. 36 Khovah nanei pet’un khovah chate nahi theina diuvin, khovah chu tahsan’un,” ati.

Judaten Jesu atahsanlou

Jesun hicheng hi aseiyin apotdohin amahoa konin akiseldoh tai. 37 amasang tah-uva melchihna chujat abol vangin atahsan deh pouve; 38 hiche hi Isaiah themgao seisa: “Pakai keiho thujah tahsan’a koi hiya, Koipen henga Pakai ban thahat kiphongdoh em?” ati chu guilhun na dinga chute ahi. 39 Hijeh chun amahon atahsan theipouve; ajeh chu Isaiah themgaovin asei kitnaa chun; 40 “Pathenin amit’u asuchon, Alungthimu amohsah tai; amu’uva alungthima ahetkhen diu, Hung kile kit’uva kadamsah ding ahi,” ati. 41 Isaiah chun hiche asei hi Jesu loupina amujeh a Ama thu dol’a asei ahi. 42 Achuti vangin vaipoloi lah a jong mi tampin Jesu atahsantauve; amabou Pharisee hon Houthua kikhopna in’a eikaidoh khauvinte, tin atahsanu chu aphongdoh 43 Ijeh-inem itile amahon Pathen pachat sangin mihem choi-at addeijo’uve.

Jesu thuseiya thu kitan

44 Jesun hatah-in asamin, “Keima eitahsana chun Keibou eitahsan ahipon, Eihinsolpa geiya atahsantha ahi; 45 Keima eimua chun Eihinsolpa jong amu ahi. 46 Keima khovah kahin, eitahsana chu muthima aumden louna dinga vannoiya hung kahi. 47 Mi khattouvin kaseiho hi ja naa anit lou jongleh achung thu katanpoi; ajeh chu vannoi thutana hung kahipon vannoi huhhinga hungjoh kahibouve. 48 Koi hile eidei louva kaseiho jong sang lou chun athutan ding anei nai; kasei hi phat kichai nikhoa athutana pang ding ahi! 49 Ijeh0inem itile Keiman kachama kasei ahipon, Eihinsol’a Pa ama tah-in ipi iti kasei ding ham ti thu eipeh ahibouve. 50 Ama thupeh chu tonsot hinna ahi kahei. Hijeh a chu kasei hi Pan eiseipeh banga kasei ahi,” ati.

John 13

1 Kalchuh kut masangin Jesun vannoia kona Pa henga ache na ding phat ahung lhun ahen, vannoiya um amite chu alungset’in akhon ni geiyin angailui. 2 Jan an aneh laitah-un Diabol chun Simon chapa Iscariot Judas lungthima Jesu matsahna ding akhumtan, 3 Jesun ijakai Pan akhut’a apehdoh a, Pathena kona hung ahiya Pathen henga kilekit ding ahi ahen; 4 ajan ankonga konin akipatdoh-in, aponsil len ahoh lhan tinot ponin kong akigahtai. 5 Chuin kisilna konga twi alheiyin, seijuite keng asilpeh-in, konga akivei tinot pon chun atheh pantai. 6 Simon Peter kom ahin phai. Peter chun ajah a, “Pakai, nangin kakeng neisilpeh ding ong?” atileh; 7 Jesun adonbut’in, “Tupet tah-in kabol hi ipi ahi nahepoi, ajo teng henan nate, “a ti. 8 Peterin ajah, “Nangin a-itih a jong kakeng nasil louhel ding ahi,” ati. Jesun adonbut’in, “Nangma kasil louleh Keiya nangin chan naneipoi,” atipeh-e. 9 Simon Peterin ajah a, “Pakai, kakeng te ni keo hilouvin kakhut te ni le kalu jong’e,” ati. 10 Jesun ajah a, “Akisil’a chu akeng tilou adang angaipoi, ajeh chu apumpin a-ngim nai; nang ho nangim nauve, nabonchau vang ahi poi,” ati. 11 Ijeh-inem itile aman apedoh dingpa chu ahetsa ahin, hijeh a chu, “Nabonchauvin vang na-ngimpouve,” ati ahi. 12 Jesun akengu asil jou phat’in aponsil len akilah-in, atou kit’in chuin ajah-uva, “Ipi kabolpeh-u nahet nah um? 13 Nang hon, ‘Houhil,’ le ‘Pakai,’ neitiuvin, naseiyu hi apha lheh-e, ajeh chu kahinai. 14 Achutile Keima ‘Pakai’ le ‘Houhil’ pan bon nakengu kasilpeh leh nang ho khat’in khat keng nakisilpeh to diu ahi. 15 Ijeh-inem itile Ken nang ho kabol banga nang hon jong nabolna dinguva kalampat peh nahiuve. 16 Kichen tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, soh chu apu sangin achungnungjo pon, asol’a sangin solchah achungnungjo poi. 17 hiche hi nahetdoh-uva natoh molsou leh anun nom anhiuve. 18 Nabonchauva thudol’a kasei ahipoi; Keiman kalhendohsa chu kahenai; ahinla Pathen lekhabun, ‘Kachanlhah ne pan kachunga akengto alamtai,’ ati chu guilhung jo hen,” ati. 19 Ahung guilhun teng leh Kei hi Ama chu kahi nahet’uva natahsan theina diuva ahung lhun masang tupet pet’a kaseipeh nahiuve. 20 Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, kamisol sanga chun Keima eisan ahin, Keima eisanga chun Eihinsol pa asan ahi,” ati.

Min ajohdoh ding Jesun asei masah
