21 Hicheng h aseiyin Jesu along agim behseh-in ahettohsahin, “Kichentah a akseipeh nahiuve, nalah-uva khat eipehdoh a pang dingahi,” ati. 22 Seijuite chu khat le khat akivetouvin, koipen asei ham ti adetmo lheh jengui. 23 Aseijuiho lah a Jesun a-ngailutpa chu Jesu jetlama atouve. 24 Simon Peterin ama chu koipen aseina ham aseipeh diuva adoh din agah khasuh-e. 25 Ama jong Jesu chunga aki ngai bang bangin akinung ngaiyin ajah-a, “Pakai kon namatsah ding ham?” ati. 26 Jesun adonbut’in, “hiche changlhah hi lhenga kadekot’a kapeh penpa chu ahi,” atin; chang lhah hal asekot’in, a;alahdoh phat chun Simon chapa Judas Iscariot apetai. 27 Hiche aneh neh chun asunga Satan alut’in, Jesun jong ajah a, “Nabol ding chu ipiham bol loiyin,” ati. 28 I-bol’a Jesun amapa jah a hiche hi aseiham ti ankonga touho khat chan jong ahepoi. 29 Kim khat’in Judas chun sumdip avop jeh a Jesun kut’a manchah ding khat tou choa asol ham, ahiloule vaicha genthei thil pea asol danin agel’uve. 30 Judas chun changlhah hal akilah-in apotdoh paitan, ahinla jan ahi.

Thupeh thah

31 Judas chedoh phat’in Jesun, “Tun Mihem Chapa choi-at’in aumtan, Ama jeh-in Pathen jong choi-at’in aume. 32 Ama jeh a Pathen choi-at’a aumleh, Pathenin jong Ama achoi-at ding, apettah a choi-at ding ahi. 33 Chate, phat chomcha bou kaumpi ding nahitauve, nang hon neihol diu, ahinla Juda ho jah a, ‘Kei che naa nang ho nahung thei lou diu,’ kati banga, tupet tah ajong kaseipeh nahiuve. 34 Nang ho khat le khat naki-ngailutto na diuva thupeh thah kapeh nahiuve, khat le khat naki-ngailutto chehna diuva Keiman nang ho kangailut nahiuve. 35 Khat le khat naki-ngailutto cheh-u leh kaseijui nahiu mijousen ahet ding ahi,” ati.

Peterin aseilep ding Jesu asei masah

36 Simon Peterin ajah a”Pakai hoiya nache ding ham?” atileh; Jesun adonbut’in, “Hoiya che jong leng tun nangin neijui theipon nate, khonung teng neijui nan nate,” ati. 37 Jesun adonbut’in, “keijlal’a nahinkho naphal ngam ong? Kichentah a kaseipeh nahi, thumvei neiseilep masanga ah khong lou ding ahi,” ati.

John 14

Jesu Pathen heng jotna lampi

1 “Nang ho lungkham hih-un, Pathen tahsanun, keijong neitahsanun. 2 Ka-Pa in’a chena mun tampi a-ong’e, umlou hileh seipeh pouvinge. 3 Nang ho ding mun kagon jouteng hung kit ing ting keima umna naum thei diuva kahenga dinga kahung pui ding nahiuve. 4 Nang hon kachena didng lampi nahenauve,” ati. 5 thomas chun ajah a, “Pakai, nache na ding bon kihe louva alampi iti kahet diu ham?” ati. 6 Jesun ajah a, “Keima hi Lampi le Atah chunle Hinna chu kahi, Keiya kona chelou chu koima Pa kom alhung theipoi. 7 Keima neihe leu chun ka-Pa jong nahet diu ahin, tukal’in vang Ama chu namutauvin hejong nahetauve,” ati. 8 Philip’in ajah a, “Pakai, Pa chu neimusah-un, chutileh kalungnau chim ding ahi,” ati. 9 Jesun ajah a, “Vo Philip, hitih chan nang ho ki-umpia neihet loulai ham? Keima eimua chun Pa chu amu ahitai; iti nangin, ‘Pa neimusah-un, nati ham? 10 Keima Pa sunga ka-uma, kei sunga Pa aum hi natahsan lou ham? Ken najah-uva kasei hi kachamtah a kasei ahipoi, kasunga cheng pa chun atoh ding dol kin abol ahibouve. 11 Keima Pa sunga ka-uma Pa kei sunga aum hi tahsan’un; ahilou jongleh na kitong chengse jeh beh hin tahsan’un. 12 Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Keima eitahsan chun katoh chengse hi atoj thei ding, Pa henga kache ding jeh hin eitahsana chun hisanga lenjo jong abol thei ding ahi; 13 Pa chu Chapa jal’a choi-at’a aum theina dinga kamin a nathum chan’u chu kabolpeh ding nahiuve. 14 Ipi hijongle Keima min a nathum chan’u kabolpeh ding nahiuve.

Lhagao Theng kiteppeh

15 “Nei-ngailut’u leh kathupeh chengse nanit diu, 16 Keiman Pa henga kathuma Aman naumpi jing diu Kithopi khat nahinpeh diu ahi, 17 hichu kicheh tah lhagao, vannoiyin sang thei lou, mu jong mukha lou ahi. Nang hon ama naheuvin, aman na umpiuvin nasunguva acheng’e. 18 “Nang ho dalhan chaga bangin koi pouvinge, nahenguva kahung kit didng ahi. 19 Chom khat jouteng vannoiyin eimu diu ahinai. Ajeh chu Keima kahingin nang jong nahin diu ahiye. 20 Hiche nikhoa chu Keima Pa sungankachen chule nang ho Kei sunga nachen’uva, nang ho sunga Kei kachen nahetdoh diu ahi. 21 Kathupeh chengse neiya nit’a chun eingailut ahi, eingailua chu ka-Pa ngailut’a chenga Kenjong ama ka-ngailut’a ahenga kakiphondoh didng ahi,” ati. 22 Iscariot hilou Judas chun ajah a, “Pakai, iti keiho henga nakiphon’a vannoi mite henga nakiphondoh lou ding ham?” atileh; 23 Jesun adonbut’in ajah a, “Mi eingailua chun kathusei anit ding, ka-pan ama angailut’a ahenga kahunguva kachenpi dingu ahi. 24 Eingailu lou vangin kathuseiho anitpon; nathujah-u hi Keikeo thu ahipon, Eihinsol’a Pa thu ahibouve. 25 “Nalah-uva ka-umpet’a hi cheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve; 26 amavang Pan keima mina ahinsol got Kithopi lhagao Theng chun kaseipeh chengseu hi aboncha nageldoh kitna diuva ijakai nahilsoh kei dingu ahinai. 27 keima chamna mong kapehuva, chamna kadalhah peh nahiuve; kapeh-uhi vannoi mi peh tobang ahipoi; nalungu donsah hih-un, kijong kicha dauvin. 28 Dalha jong leng nahenguva kahung kit ding ahi,’ tia najah-uva kaseipeh chu najatauve. Pa chu Keisanga chung nung jo ahijeh-in, neingailut mongu leh Pahenga kache hi nakipa thanoppi diu ahi. 29 Hichengse hi ahung guilhun teng natahsan theina diuva aso masanga tua kasiepeh masah dem nahiuive. 30 Najah-uva tampi sei taponge, ajeh chu vannoi vaihompa ahunge; ahinla aman kachunga ima tha aneipoi; 31 hijongleh Keiman Pa ka-ngailut jeh a eithupeh chan kabolji hi vannoiyin ahet tei ding ahi.

John 15

Jesu lengpigui tahbeh ahi

1 “Keima lengpigui tahbeh kahin, ka-Pa aleilhou ahi. 2 Aman Keiya keh abah galou chengse vang chu ahaga chehna din amal ngimjin ahi. 3 Najha-uva kathusei chengse jeh a nang ho a-ngimsa nahitauve. 4 Kasunga cheng jingun, keijong nasunguva cheng jing inge. Lengpibah achanga aga thei lou banga, keisunga nachen louvu leh nang ho jong napun thei lou diu ahi. 5 Keima lengpigui kahin, nang ho abahho nahiuve. Ama sunga kacheng banga keisunga cheng mi chu apung lheh jie; ajeh chu kei louvin nang hon ima nabol theipouve. 6 Mi keisunga cheng lou chu thingbah kiheh lhaa kipaidoh agopji bangin akipaidohji; abah gopsa chengse chu akichom khomjin meiya akileh lut’in akavamjitai. 7 Keisunga nachen’uva, kasei chengse hi nasunguva achenleh nagot chan thumun kibolpeh ding nahiuve. 8 Kaseijui kicheh nahiuva hapun’a napun’u leh ka-Pa choiat’a umah ahi. 9 Ka-Pan eingailut banga kenjong ka-ngailut nahiuve; ka-ngailut sunga cheng jingun. 10 Ka-pa thupeh chengse kanit’a a-ngailut’a kachen jing bang hin kathupeh chengse nit leu chun ka-ngait’a nachen diu ahi. 11 Nanguva kakipana achen jinga apilhinsetna dia hiche hi najah-uva kasei ahi. 12 Kathupeh chu ken ka-ngailut banguva nang ho khat le khat naki-ngailutto cheh diu hi ahi. 13 Agol apaite dinga ahinkho phaldoh sanga lenjo ngailutna koiman aneipoi. 14 thu kapeh cheng seu hi nabol’u leh kagol kapai nahiuve. 15 Soh kati louding nahitauve, ijeh-inem itile soh chun apu thilbol ahepoi, gol le paite katijoh ding nahiuve, ajeh chu Paa kona kajah chengse ijakai kahetsah soh keiyu ahi. 16 Nang hon neilhenu ahipon, nacheuva napunbe na diu leh, apungdoh chengse alhou theiya kamin’a nathum chan’u Pan napeh theina diuva keiman kalhen’a kapansah nahibouvui. 17 Nang ho khat le khat naki-ngailutto chehna diuva thu hicheng hi kapeh nahiuve.

Vannoi mite hot

18 “Vannoiyin nahot’u leh, nang ho nahot masanguva Keima eihot masahsau ahi heuvin, 19 vannoiya hileu chun vannoiyin amite alungset dingdol ahin, Keiman kalhendohsa, vannoiya nahilou phat’uva vannoiyin nahot’u ahiye. 20 Najahuva, ‘Soh apu sangin achungnungjopoi,’ kati chu geldoh jingun. Mihon Kei eibolset’u leh nang ho jong nabolset tei diu ahi, kathu nit leu nang ho thujong anit diu ahi. 21 Eihonsol Pa ahet loujeh-uva Keima min jal’a hicheng hi nachunguva abol diu ahi. 22 Hunga ajah-uva kaseipeh lou hileh themmona aneilou diu ahin, tunvang achonset’u paomea akilepna diu aumtapoi. 23 Keima eihoa chun ka Pa jong ahoi. 24 Alah-uva koima bol khah lou thil kabol lou hileh themmona anei lou diu ahin, tunvang kanatoh chengse amu nasauva Kei le ka-Pa eihot thau ahitai. 25 Ahinla adanthu bu’uva, ‘Ajeh beiyin eiho’uva,’ tia kisun chu guilhung tei ding ahi. 26 “Paa hung kon Lhagao theng, Keiman Paa kona kahinsol ding Kithopi chu ahung teng leh kachung chang thudol ahettohsah ding, 27 akipat til’a pat neikivop piu ahijeh a nang ho jong kathu hettohsah a napan diu ahi.

John 16

1 “Nakipal lhuh louna diuva hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve. 2 Houthua kakhopna in’a nakaidoh diu, nathat’uva pangpa chu Pathen natong’a aki-ngaito phat hung lhung ding ahi. 3 Pa le Kei eihet loujeh-uva amahon hicheng hi ahinbol diu ahi. 4 Hicheng so na ding phat hi ahung lhun teng athudol’u kahilchah masahsau nageldoh theina diuva najah-uva thil hi chenghi kaseipeh nahiuve.

Lhagao Theng natoh

“Kaumpi jing jeh-uva atil’a thil hicheng hi kanaseipeh lou nahiuve. 5 Tua vang Eihinsolpa henga che ding kahitan, koiiman, ‘Hoiya che didng nahim?’ tia dong’a jong naumpouve; 6 amavang hicheng kaseipeh jeh-uva hi lunghem gam nahitauve. 7 Koi hileh atah kaseipeh nahiuve; nang ho phat chomna dia Keima che mang ding kahi; kache louva ahileh Kithopi chu nahenguva hung lou ding, kachea ama chu kahinsolpeh ding nahiuve. 8 Kithopi chu ahung teng vannoi mite hi chonset thudol, adih thudol chule thutan thudol ahettohsah ding; 9 chonset thudol chu keima eitahsan lou thu’u ahin, 10 adih thudol ahileh Pa henga kachea nang hon neimu lou diu thu ahin, 11 thutah thudol chu hiche vannoi vaihompa thu kitan hi ahi. 12 Najah-uva sei ding tampi kaneiyin, ahinla nang hon tuta din nadol joupouve; 13 ahin atahbeh lhagao chu ahung teng, ama cham chama thu seilouva, ajah cha cha asei ding, kitahna lampi jenga napui hoiyuva, ahung lhung ding thil ho geiya naseipeh diu ahi. 14 Aman Keiya chu alah a nahenguva aphondoh ding jeh chun Keima eichoi-at ding ahi. 15 Pa nei changse chu Keiya jong ahijeh a Keiya chu alah a nahenguva aphondoh ding ahi kati ahiye.

Gimna chu kipana soh ding

16 “Chom khat jou teng neimu lou diu ahin, chom khat jou teng vang le neimu kit diu ahinai,” ati. 17 Aseijuite lah a mi phebep, khat le khat akihouvun, “Aman, ‘Chom khat jou teng vang le neimu kit diu ahinai, ijeh-inem itile keima Pa henga che ding kahi,’ ati hi ipi aseina ham?” akitiuve. 18 Hijeh chun amahon, “Aman, ‘Chom khat jou,’ ati hi ipi aseina ham? Ipi aseina ham ihepouve,” akitiuve. 19 Adoh nomu hi Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho le nang ho ipi kidongto nahiuva, ‘Chom khat jou teng neimu lou diu ahin, chom khat jou teng vang le neimu kit diu ahinai,’ kati chu 20 Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, nang ho nakauva namao diu, vannoi mite vang kipah diu ahi; lunghem jong leu chun nalunghem chu kipana soh ding ahinai. 21 Numei naosoh ding khu aso phat alhin teng athoh gim lheh jin, nao aso lhah teng vang leh vannoiya mihem khat penlhah jeh a kipa jal’in athot gimna chengse chu asumiljitai. 22 Tun nang ho jong nalunghem’un, ahinla keiman kahung vilkit diu ahinai, chutengle nalungthimu kipah a, nakipanau chu koiman nalahpeh thei lou diu ahi. 23 Hiche nikhoa chu nang hon ima neidoh lou dingu ahitai. Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, ipi hijongle keima min pan’a Pa henga nathum chan’u napeh diu ahi. 24 Tugeiyin kaminin ima nathum hih laiyui; nakipanau achamkimsohna din thumun namu diu ahi.

Keiman vannoi kajoutai

25 “Najah-uva hicheng hi alem’a kasei ahin, Pa thudol chu alem hilouva kichentah a kaseipehna diu phat khat hung lhung ding ahi. 26 Nang ho thalhengin Pa henga taopeh nauvinge kati ahipoi, hiche nikhoa chu Kei min pan’a natao diu ahi; 27 ijeh-inem itile Keima neideiyuva Pathena hungkon kahi natahsan jeh-un Pa amatahin nadeiyu ahi. 28 Keima Paa hung kon vannoiya hung lut kahin, vannoi kadalhan a Pa henga che kit ding kahi,” ati. 29 Chutah-in aseijuiten, “Vent un nangman alem’a thu seilouvin phongtah-in naseidoh tai. 30 Tun kahetauve Nangin ijakai nahen, koiman ima nadoh ding angaipoi, hichea hin Pathena hungkon nahi katahsantauve,” atiuve. 31 Jesun amaho chu adonbut’in, “Tubep’a natahsan’um 32 Ven, nang ho nakithecheh-uva, na-inlam cheh nakijot’uva kachangseh a neidalhahna diu phat chu hung lhung ahitai; hijongleh Pa chun ei umpi jing jeh-in kachangseh kahi dehpoi. 33 Keima sunga nachen’uva chamna nanei theina diuva hicheng hi najah-uva kasei ahi; vannoiyah gim genthei nathohui; amavang hangtah-in pangun Keiman vannoi kajoutai,” ati.

John 17

Jesu aseijuite dia atao

1 Jesun hicheng hi aseijouvin akhodah-in vanlam aven, “Pa, phat chu ahung lhungtai; Chapan nachoi-at theina din na Chapa choi-anin; 2 Ama napeh chengse chu tonsot hinna apeh theina dia Nangin Ama chu tahsan hing mihem jouse chunga thu neina napeh ahi. 3 Pathen tah khatseh Nang le nahinsol Jesu Christa ahet diu hitonsot hinna ahi. 4 Leiset chunga toh ding neipeh chengse kachoisoh-in Nangma kachoian tai. 5 Pa, tun Nangin vannoi umdoh masanga ineisa Nangma loupina mong mongin neichoianin. 6 “Vannoiya kona neipeh miho henga naming kaphongdohtai. Nangman neipeh amaho hi nang mi ahiuvin, amahon nathu anit tauve. 7 Tunvang, Nangman neipeh thil chengse hi Nanga hungkon ahi ahetauve; 8 ijeh-inem itile neithupeh chengse amaho kapen, amahon hicheng chu akisanun, Nanga hungkon kahi kichen tah-in aheuvin, Nangmannei sol ahi atahsantauve. 9 “Nangman neipeh ho hi namite ahijeh-uva amaho dia tao kahin, vannoi dinga tao kahipoi; 10 Keiya chengse Nanga ahin, Nanga chengse jong Keiya ahi; hijeh chun hiteho jal hin choi-at’in ka-ume. 11 Keima nahenga hunga vannoiya umlou ding kahitan, amaho vang vannoiya um nala ahiuve. Pa Theng, eini tobanga amaho pumkhat ahi theina diuvin neipeh naming chun amaho hi hongin. 12 Amaho ka-umpilaiyin neipeh naminin amaho kahongin, ka-ngah tup’in, Pathen lekhabu thu gui lhunna dia amang thah dia pengpa tilou, alah-uva khatcha amangthah poi. 13 Tua vang nahenga hung ding kahitan, asunguva kakipana anei chamkim soh theina diuva leiset’a hicheng hi kasei ahiye. 14 Amaho hi nathu kapeh leh vannoiyin ahotauve; ajeh chu Keima vannoiya kahilou banga amaho jong vannoiya ahitapouve. 15 Amaho hi vannoiya kona nalahdohna dia tao kahipoi. Agiloupaa konin hongbit’in katijoh ahibouve. 16 Keima vannoiya kahi lou banga amaho jong vannoiya ahi pouve. 17 Atah chun amaho hi suthengin; nathu hi atah chu ahi. 18 Nangin vannoiya neisol banga amaho hi vannoiya kasol ahin; 19 amaho jong atah a chu akiphal theng theina diuva amaho jal’a keijong kiphal theng kahi. 20 “Hite ho keo dia tao kahipoi, amaho thuseiya kona eitahsan ho didnga jong, 21 Pa, nang Kei sunga nachen’a, Nang sunga keima kachen banga amaho jong eini sunga achen’uva, vnnoiyin nang sol kahi atahsan theina din abonchauvin pumkhat hileu kati ahi. 22 Eini pumkhat ihi banga amaho jong pumkhat ahina diuvin Nang man neipeh loupina chu aamaho kapetai; 23 Nangin nei-ngailut banga amaho ka-ngailut jeh a Keima neisol hi vannoiyin ahetdoh a, chu le chamkimdel’a amaho pumkhat ahi theina dinga asunguva kachen’a Keima sunga Nang cheng nahi. 24 “Pa, vannoi kisemdoh masanga jong nei-ngailut jeh a neipehsa hiche kaloupina chu Nangin neipeh mite hin amu theina diuvin Kei umnaa chun amahojong umleu kaseiye. 25 Vo Pa dih tah, vannoiyin nahet lou vangin Keiman Nang kahen, Nang sol kahi hite ho hinahetauve. 26 Nangin nei-ngailutna hiche ngailut chu asunguva achen’a, Keijong asunguva kachen theina din amaho hi naming kahetsah tan, kahetsah jing ding ahi” ati.

John 18

Jesu ajohdoh chule min amat

1 Hicheng hi asei jouvin Jesu aseijuite toh alhondoh-in, Kidron hohlam gal’a honk hat um na-a chun Ama le aseijuite aluttauve. 2 Hia chu Jesun aseijuite akikhoppi jing ahijeh-in amun chu ama mat sah a pang Judas jong chun ahei. 3 Hijeh chun Judas chun Thempu pipu ho le Pharisee hoa kona hung sepia loi khat le Houin ngah sepia ho chu ahinpuiyin, thaomei le mei sel den, manchah choiyin hikoma chun ahungtai. 4 Jesun achunga hung lhung ijakai ahesoh keiyin ahung potdoh-in ajah-uva, “Koi nahol’u ham?” atileh; 5 Amahon adonbut’un, “Nazareth Jesu chu,” atiuve, Ama ajah-uva, “Kei ama kahi,” ati. Ama matsah a pang Judas chu amaho toh dingkhom ahi. 6 Jesun ajah-uva, “Kei Ama kahi,” atitah chun amaho anung chon’un tol’a alhu mat jengui. 7 Jesun adong kit’in, “Koiba nahol’u ham?” atileh; amahon, “Nazareth Jesu chu,” atiuve. ahileh hite ho hi lhadoh jengtau,” atin; 9 hiche thu asei chu, “Nangman neipeh chengse lah a khat cha kamansahpoi,” kiti chu guilhunma dinga asei ahi. 10 Simon Peterin chemjam khat anei chu asatdoh-in Thempu chung nung sohpa asat jeng leh abilkol jetlam asat lhai; sohpa min chu Malchus ahi. 11 Jesun Peter jah a, “chemjam chu apaiya khum jengin, Pan eipeh khon chu kadontei ding hilou ham?” ati.

Thempulen ang’a Jesu akailut’u

12 Sepai loi le alamkaipau, Judate Houin ngah sepai hon Jesu chu aman’un, akan’uvin, 13 chuche kuma thempu chungnunga pang Caiaphas nupapa Annas henga akai lut masauve. 14 Mipi dinga mikhat thi aphajoi, tia Judate thumop chu hiche Caiaphas hi ahiye.

Peterin Jesu aseilep

15 Simon Peter le seijui dang khat’in Jesu ajuiye. Hiche seijui dang kitipa hi Thempu chungnungpa hetsa mi ahin, Jesu toh kilhonin thempu chungnung inpi tolsunga aluttai. 16 Pater vang chu lotpi polama adding dentai. Hijeh chun seijui dang Thempu chung nung hetsapa chu ahung potdohin, kotphunga ding nu-ngah nu jah aaseilep Peter chu ahinpui luttai. 17 Kotphunga ding nu-ngah nun Peter jah a, “Nang hi hiche mipa seijui khat nahilou haimo?” atileh; aman, “Kahipo,” ati. 18 Adap jeh a hikoma chu soh ho le Houin ngah sepai hon song meihol akitiuva din mun’a mei a oiyu ahin; Peter jong alah-uva dinga mei oiya kisanglum ahiye.

Thempulenin thu tampi Jesu adoh

19 Thempu chungnungin Jesu chu aseijuite thudol le athuhil umchan adodngtai. 20 Jesun adonbut’in, “Keiman vannoi jah aphongtah-in kaseiyin; Judate kikhop khomna jose Houthua kikhopna in le Houin a kahil jingin, guhthimin imacha kasei khapoi. 21 I-bol’a nei doh ham? Ajeh-uva kasei ja ho chu dodngin, ven, ipi kasei ahenauve,” ati. 22 Jesun hiche asei hin akoma ding Houin ngah sepai loi lah a khat’in a-ngeiphe abengin. “Thempu chungnung hitia chu kidonbut ngaiyem?” ati. 23 Jesun adonbut’in, “Kasei khel leh adih lou chu photchetna vetsahin; adih kasei leh i-bola neidenham?” ati. 24 Annas chun Jesu akikan pumin Caiaphas henga asoltai.

Peterin Jesu aseilep kit

25 Simon peter chu adingin mei a-oiyin ahi. Mihon ajah a, “Nang jong hichepa seijui khat nahilou haimo?” atiuleh; aman aseilep’in; “Kahipoi,” ati. 26 Thempu chungnung soh Peterin abilkol asat lhah pehpa inkote khat’in, “Hon sunga ama hitoh kamu tha nahilou haimo?” atileh; 27 Peterin aseilep kit’in, hichepet tah chun ah akhongtai.

Pilate ang’a Jesu

28 Mihon Jesu chu Caiaphas in’a konin gamvaipopa inpi lama akaitauve; jingpi matah ahi nalaiyin, miho chu akisuh boh dauva kal chuh kut an aneh theina diuvin gamvaipo inpia chun alutpouve. 29 Hijeh chun amaho toh kimuto din Pilate apotdoh-in, “Hichepa hi ipi thua nahehset’u ham?” atileh; 30 amahon adonbut’un, “Thilse abol lou hileh nahenga kahin kailut lou diu ahi,” atiuve. 31 Hichun Pilate’n ajah-uva, “Kipuiyun lang nang ho danthu dungjuiyin athu kitantau,” ati. Judah on ajah a, “Mi tha theina ding eikiphal peh pouve,” atiuve. 32 Jesun iti thia athi ding asei chu guilhunna dinga hiche hi soh ahi. 33 Pilate chu gamvaipo inpi lama akile kit’in, Jesu chu akou lut’in, “Nangma Judate lengpa nahim?” tin adonge. 34 Jesun adonbut’in “Nangman hiche hi nachama naseiha, mikhat touvin kachung thu naseipeh khah ham?” atileh; 35 Pilate’n adonbut’in, “Kei ho Judate mi kahibeh ong? Na nam mite leh Thempu pipu hon kahenga nahin kailut’uva chu, ipiba nabol ham?” ati. 36 Jesun adonbut’in, “Keima lenggam chu hiche vannoiya kon ahipoi, kalenggam vannoiya kon hileh Judate henga eikipehdoh louna dia eivengtup’a pang hon asat diu ahi; tunla Keima lenggam chu hichea kona kisemdoh ahipoi,” ati. 37 Pilate’n ajah a, “Achutile leng nahi ong?” atileh; Jesun adonbut’in “Nangin, Leng nahi,’ neiti. Atah chu kahettohsah theina dinga Keima hung penga hiche vannoiya hi hung kahi; koi hileh atah a kon tapouvin Keima ogin angai cheh-e,” ati. 38 Pilate’in ajah a, “Atah chu ipi ham?” ati.

Jesu tha dia thu alhuhsah

Pilate’in hiche hi aseiyin Juda hohenga agapotdoh kit’in ajah-uva, “Ama hi themmosahna ding achunga imacha kakholdohpoi; 39 chujongle kalchuh kut nikhoa mi khat kalhadoh peh tei diu chonna dank hat naneiyun; hijeh chun Judate lengpa hi lhadoh pen leng nadeiyum?” ati. 40 Chutah chun alesap kit-un, “hichepa hilouvin Barabbas joh bouve!” atiuve. Barabbas chu gucha michom ahiye.

John 19

1 Chujouvin Pilate chun Jesu amanin ajeptai. 2 Sepai hon ling lukhuh apheh-un alua akhuh peh-un, ponsandup asilpeh-ui. 3 Ahenga ahungun, “Judate lengpa hingsot’in,” atiuvin, Ama chu adengtauve. 4 Pilate chu agapotdoh kit’in ajah-uva, “Ven, themmosahna theiima achunga kamudoh lou nahetna diuva nahenguva kahin puidoh kit ahi,” ati. 5 Hiti hin Jesu chu linglukhuh khuh le ponsandup pumin ahung potdoh-e. Pilate’n ajah-uva, “Ven, Mihem hi,” ati. 6 Thempu pipu hole Houin ngah sepai hon amudoh tah-un, “Thingpel’a khenbeh-in, thingpel’a khenbeh-in,” tin asamtauve. Pilate’n ajah-uva, “Nang hon kaiyun lang khanbeh tauvin; kenvang Ama themmona imacha kamudohpoi,” ati. 7 Juda hon adonbut’in, “Keihon Dan khat kaneiyun, hiche dungjuiya hi ama Pathen chapa akihidsah jeh a thi dinga kilom ahi,” atiuve. 8 Hiche thu hiPilate’n ajahdoh phat’in akicha cheh kit’in, 9 gamvaipo inpia alut’in Jesu jah a, “Nangma hoiya hungkon nahim?” atileh; Jesun la adonbutpoi. 10 Pilate chun ajah a, “Neidonbut lou ding ong? Nangma lhadohna ding tha kaneiya, thingpel’a khetbehna ding jong tha kanei hi nahet lou ham?” ati. 11 Jesun adonbut’in, “Chunga kona kipe lou hile chun nangin kachunga thu nanei nanei louhel ding ahi; hijeh chun nakoma eipehdohpa themmona achungnungjoi,” ati. 12 Hichejeh tah chun Pilate’n Ama lhadohna ding aholtai; ahinla Judah on, “Hichepa nalahdoh leh Caesar jol nahilou chu Caesar douna thusei ahi,” tin asamtauve. 13 thu hicheng hi ajah phat’in Pilate chun Jesu chu polama ahinpuidoh-in, Hebrew paova, Gabbatha’ kiti song lhongnal laiya kido thutan touna muna atoutai. 14 Hichu kalchuh kut dia kigot ni sunkim don nidan som le ni lem ahitai. Pilate chun Judate jah a, “Ven, nalengpau hi,” ati. 15 Chutah chun amahon, “Thah’in, thingpel’a khenbeh-in!” tin asamtauve. Pilate’n ajah-uva, “Nalengpau thingpel’a kakhetbeh ding ong atileh; thempu pipu hon adonbut’un, “Caesar tilou keihon leng dang kaneipouve,” atiuve. 16 Chuphat’in aman Jesu thingpel’a khetbeh din amaho apedoh tai.

Jesu thingpel’a akhetbeh-u

Amahon Jesu chu akaiyun, 17 aman athingpel akiput’in, Hebrew paova, ‘Golgotha’ kiti, ‘ Lugumun’ kiti lai jonin apotdohtan ahi. 18 Hikoma chun Jesu thingpel’a akhenbeh-un, midang ni jong asih langto gel’ah akhaiyun Jesu alai lhai. 19 Pilate’in amain chan ajih-in thingpel chunga atah-in, “Nazareth Jesu, Judate lengpa,” tin asune. 20 Jesu thingpel’a akhetbeh nau mun chu khopi nai ahijeh-in, amin chan Hebrew pao le Latin pao chule Greek paova kijih chu Juda ho tampin asimsoh keiyui. 21 Hichea hin Judate Thempu pipu hon Pilate jah a, ‘Ama hi, ‘Judate lengpa,’ tin sutdan lang, aman, ‘Keima Judate lengpa kahi,’ tin aseiye, tin sunjon,” atiuve. 22 Pilate’in adonbut’in, “Kasutsa chu kasutsa ahitai,” ati. 23 Sepaihon Jesu chu thingpel’a akhetbeh jou phat’un aponsil chu alauvin, sepai khat cheh din hal li asouvin akihomtauve. Asangkhol chol chu akilah-u leh khui lou ahin, alua pat ato geiya kikhong lhung kei ahi. 24 Hijeh chun amaho khat le khat akihouvun, Pathen lekhabua, “Kaponsil chengse akihomun, Kasangkhol chol chang ding vang vetnan vang asantauve,” kiti chu gullhunna din, “Hiche hi bot-eh poute, koipen chang ding ham, vang santhou hite,” akitiuve. Sepai hon hitia chu abol’u ahiye. 25 Jesu thingpel phung koma chun Jesu nu le anu sopinu, Clopas jinu Mary chule Magdala Mary adding jingui. 26 Jesun anu le anu koma dinga ngailut seijui chu amun, anu jah a, chun, “Numei, nachapa chu kivet’in, ati. 27 Seijuipa jah ajong chun, “Nanu chu kivet’in,” atileh; hichea pat chun seijuipan amanu chu a-in’a chenpi din apuitai.

Jesu thi

28 Hiche jou hin Jesun ijakai akibulhitsoh tai, ti ahen, Pathen lekhabu thu guilhunna din, “Kadang achah-e,” ati. 29 Hikoma chu theitwi thuh bel khat’a kitung ahin, twichoppon theitwi thuh dimset’in achopsah-un hyssop molleh a atahuvin, akamtoh agah sutouve. 30 Jesun thietwi thuh chu achop’in, “Ijakai akibulhuttai,” atin; akaikun alhagao alhadohtai.

Jesu nah tenga asut’u

31 kigot ni ahitan, Choldo ni ma chu ni loupe ni ahi ding jeh-in, Choldo nia thingpel chunga thilong aumden louna din, thingpel’a kikhenbeh ho chu akengu heboh a along lah alhahna dingin Judah on Pilate henga athumtauve. 32 Hijehchun sepaiho ahungun Jesu toh kikhetbeh that e ni amasapa le khatjopa kengho chu aheh bongtauve. 33 Jesu ahinphah phat’un athisa ahitah chu amu’uvin, akeng te ni aheh bong tapouve, 34 sepai lah akhat vangin anah tenga agahsut leh thisan le twisih ahung longdoh pai jenge. 35 Nang hon jong natahsan theina diuva athilsoh hi amupa tah-in ahettohsah ahin, ahettohsah hi tahbeh ahin, asei hi atahmong ahi, ti ahechen khat aumnai. 36 “Agu khat cha kiheh bong lou ding,” tia kisei Pathen lekhabu thu guilhunna dinga thil hicheng hi soh ahi. 37 Pathen lekhabu mun kha man, “Asut pau chu avet diu ahi,” ati.

Jesu avuiyu

38 Hicheng nung hin Judate gin jeh a guhthima Jesu seijuiya anapang, Arimathea khoa Joseph chun Jesu long chu lah lhahna din Pilate henga agathum leh aman aphelpeh tan, hijeh chun ahungin along chu alalhan apoddohtai. 39 Amasa janlaiya ahenga hungsa Nicodemus jong ahungin myrrh le aloes kihal thao kilogram som thum ahinchoiyin ahi. 40 Jesu long adomlha lhonin, Judate thivui ngaidol’in, gim namtui anun lhonin, tupat ponnemin atom lhontai. 41 Jesu thingpel’a akhetbeh nauva chun honk hat aumin, hon sunga chun lhan kisemthah koimacha kivuina khah louhel khat aume. 42 Juda ho kigot nima ahileh, lhan chu anailam jeh-in Jesu chu chukoma avuitauve.

John 20

Jesu thodoh kit

1 Choldo jou ni masa ni jingkah kho athim nalaiyin, Magdala Mary chu lhanphunga ahung leh song chu tahdohsan ana-ume. 2 Amanu jong Simon Peter le Jesun a-ngailut seijui henga ahung lhaijel’in ajah lhona, “Pakai chu lhana konin apomangun hoilam alhut’u hitam akahettapouve,” ati. 3 Hijeh chun Peter le seijui dangpa chu apotdoh lhonin lhan lama ahunglhone. 4 ani lhona hung lhai khom ahi lhon vangin seijuidangpan Peter adalhan lhanphung ahung lhung masai. 5 Akuna lhansung agah vet leh tupat ponnem tol’a um chu amun, asung vang alutpoi. 6 Simon Peter jong ahunjuipeh-in ahungin, lhan sunga alut’in ahileh tupat ponnem tol’a um bou amun, 7 alu tomna pon chu tupat ponnem toh umkhom lou, kijel’a atumbeh a aum amui. 8 Hichun lhanphung lhung masa seijui dangpa jong lhan sunga alut leh amu chenin atahsantai. 9 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lekhabua thinaa kona thoudoh kit ding ahi, kiti chu ahetkhen loulaiyu ahi. 10 Seijuite ni a-in lama akile kit lhontai.

Jesu Magdala Mary henga akilah

11 Mary chu lhanpama adingin akap kap’e. Akapuma lhansung kuna agah vet leh, 12 Jesu long ajam nauva alulama khat akeng lama khat ponbang sil cheh Vantil ni atou lhon agah mui. 13 amanin ajah a, “Numei, i-bol’a kap nahim?” ati lhon leh; aman ajah lhona, “Amahon ka-Pakai apomangun, hoiya akoiyu kahetapoi,” ati. 14 Hichun aseiyin, agah kihei leh, Jwsu adin amun Jesu ahilam ahepoi. 15 Jesun ajah a, “Numei i-bol’a kap, nahim? Koi nahol ham?” atileh amanun honlei ngahpa chu ahisah-in, ajah a, “Pu, nangin napoh mang ahileh, ken kipoh tnege, hoiya nalupsah ham neihil’in” ati. 16 Jesun amanu jah a, “Mary!” atileh; amanu akihei loiyin Hebrew paova houhil tin an, “Robboni!” ati. 17 Jesun amanu jah a, “Neituh chah hih-in, ka-Pa henga kakaltou hih laiye; ahin kasopite henga chen lang ajah-uva, “keima ka-Pa, nang ho pa chule ka-Pathen, nang ho Pathen henga kakaltouve, tin aseiye gatin,” ati. 18 Magdala Mary chu achen seijuite henga chun, “Pakai chu kamutai,” atin chuleh thil dang amanu jah a aseiho jong chu agaseiye.

Jesu aseijuite henga akilah

19 Choldo jou nimasa ni, nilhah lamin Judate gin jeh a seijuite umna in kotpi chengse kikha khumsoh ahin, ahinla Jesu ahungin alah-uva adingin, ajah-uva, “nalahuva cham leng hen,” ati. 20 Hiche asei jou chun seijuite chu akhut te ni le anah avetsah-e. Seijuiten Pakai amu phat’un akipah lheh jengui. 21 Jesun ajah-uva aseikit’in, “Nalahuva cham leng hen,” atin; Pan keima eisol banga nang ho kasol nahiuve,” ati. 22 Hichu aseiyin amaho ahu alha khumin ajah-uva, “Lhagao kisan’un. 23 Nang hon michonset ho na-ngaidamu leh ngai dam chang diu, themmo nachansahu leh themmo chang ding ahiuve,” ati.

Jesu chule Thomas

24 Jesu hung kilah pet chun som le ni lah a khat, Thomas pengkop kitipa chu anaumpoi. 25 Seijui dang hon ajah a, “Keihon Pakai kamutauve,” atiuleh; aman ajah-uva, “Akhut phang te nia thingkil maha chengse kamua, thingkil maha ho chu kakhutjunga kakhoiya, anah kakhut tah a katham lousen tahsan ponge,” ati. 26 Niget jouvin aseijuite chu insunga aumun, Thomas jong alah-uva apange. Kot jouse akikha vang chun Jesu ahungin alah-uva adingin, “Nalah-uva cham leng hen,” ati. 27 Abanin Thomas jah a, “Nakhutjungin hikom hi khoiyin, kakhut te ni hi ven, nakhut hin lhangin kanah thamin, tahsan lel ding ahipoi, tahsan jengin, ati. 28 Thomas chun adonbut’in ajah a, “Ka-Pakai le ka-Pathen!” ati. 29 Jesun ajah a, “Neimu jeh a natahsan hiyah ong? Mu louva tahsan ho chu anun nom’ui,” ati.

Lekhabu kisutlo

30 hiche lekhabua kisun lou Jesun asiejuite mitmua melchihna abol tampi aum nalaiye; 31 akisun cheng jong hi Jesu chu Messiah, Pathen Chapa ahi, ti natahsan’uva hiche natahsan jeh-uva chu hinna nanei theina diuva kisun ahibouve.

John 21

Jesu seijui sagi henga akilah

1 hicheng nug hin Jesu amatah Tiberias dillena seijuite henga akilah kit’in, hiti hin akilahin ahi. 2 Amaho chu Simon Peter, pengkoppa kiti Thomas, Galilee gam Cana khoa Nathaniel, Zebedee chapa te ni chule aseijuite lah amidang ni jong ahiuve. 3 Simon Peterin ajah-uva, “Keima nga manin kiche tange,” ati. Adang hon ajah a, “Keiho jong nang to kilhon cheh tah tau hen,” atiuve. Hijeh chun apotdoh-un kong sunga alut’un, ahivangin hiche jan chun imacha amanpouve. 4 Khovah lhah lhah in Jesu vaokama adingin, seijuiten Ama ahilam ahepouve. 5 Jesun ajah-uva, “Gollhang, nga matsa nanei louvu ham?” atileh; amahon adonbut’un, “Aumpoi,” atiuve. 6 Aman ajah-uva, “Kongsih jetlama chun len sep leu chun namat diu ahi,” ati. Hijeh chun aseu leh nga atam mat behseh phat’un len chu akaijou tapouve. 7 Chuphat’in Jesun angailut seijui chun Peter jah a, “Pakai chu ahibouve,” ati. Simon Peterin Pakai ahibouve, ti ajah phat’in, dsagoh keova um ahijeh-in sangkhol aki-ah loiyin dil’a achom lhan, 8 seijui dang ho vang chu konga ahung kitol’un, tola kona gamla lou, tong ja ni tobang bou kilat ahiuvin, nga dim set len chu ahinkaipeh-ui. 9 Tolgo ahung geiphat’un, song meihol meiya kitih a nga kigou leh changlhah amu’uve. 10 Jesun ajah-uva, “Tutah a namat’u nga chu phabep hinchoiyun,” ati. 11 Simon Peter chu konga akaldoh-in nga len jeng dimset len chu tolgoa akaidoh leh, nga ja khat le som nga le thum ahin, achuti tam lheh vangin len chu a-ehpoi. 12 Jesun ajah-uva, “Hungun jing an hungneuvin,” ati. Pakai ahi ahetjeh-un seijuiho khat chan jong, “koi nahim?” tin adong ngampouve. 13 Jesu ahungin changlhah chu alan amaho apen, nga jong chuo bangman abol’e. 14 Hiche hi Jesu thinaa kona athodoh nunga seijuite henga akilah athumveina ahi.

Jesu chule Peter

15 Jingan aneh jouvun Jesun Simon Peter jah a, “John chapa Simon, hiche ho sanga hi nei-ngailut joh hinam?” atileh; aman ajah a, “Kakelngoite vah-in,” ati. 16 Ani vainan ajah a, “John chapa Simon, nei-ngailut’em?” ati kit leh; aman ajah a, “Heng’e, Pakai kalungset nangman nahenai,” ati. Aman ajah a, “Kakelngoite chingphan,” ati. 17 Athum veinan ajah a, “John chapa Simon, nei lungset’em?” atileh; thumvei jen chutia ajah a, “Neilungset’em? Atijeh chun Peter along gimtan, ajah a, “Pakai nangman ijakai nahenai; nang kalungset hi nahejinge,” ati. Jesun ajah a, “Kakelngoite vahin, 18 Kichentah a kaseipeh nahi, naneo laiyin nakong nakigah jin nadeina lam lama nachen, na-upat teng vang leh nakhut te ni najah a midangin nakong nagah peh ding, nadeilou lam lama napui ding ahi,” ati. 19 Hiche asei hi itobang dol’a iti thia Pathen achoi-at ding ham atina ahi. Hiche asei jou hin ajah a, “Neijuiyin,” ati.

Jesu le angailut seijui

20 Peter akihei leh Jesun angailut seijui chun ahinjui amui; hiche seijui hi ahi Jan anneh laiya Jesu ap’a ki-nung ngaiya, “Pakai, napedoh ding chu koiham?” tia donga chu. 21 Ama hi Peterin amudoh phat’in Jesu jah a, “Pakai, ama khu iti ding ham?” atileh; 22 Jesun ajah a, “Ama khu kahung kahsen umsah nom leng nang dia ipitiam? Nangin neijui thimin,” ati. 23 Hijeh chun athu hi sopite lah a akithangin hiche seijui chu thi lou ding in akiseiye. Jesun ama chu thi lou ding ahi, tia asei ahipon, “Ama khu kahung kahsen umsah nom leng nang dia ipi iti-am?” atijoh ahibouve. 24 Hichengse hettohsah a panga sundoh hi hiche seijui chu ahin, ama hettohsah hi atahbeh ahi keihon kaheuve. 25 Jesu thilbol adang dang tampi aum nalaiyin, khat khat’in kisun soh keileh, keima ngaiton sut ding chengse chu vannoi leiset jengin jong adolponte kati.

Solchah 1

Jesun Lhagao theng ateppeh

1 Vo Theophilus, thu masa chu Jesu thilbol le thuhil aboncha akipattil’a pat 2 alhensa Solchahho, Lhagao Theng jal’a thu apeh a, Ama laltouva aum ni gei thu ahin; 3 gim hesoh athoh jou kal nisom li sungin ahing monge ti hetchetna tampi toh thon Solchahho henga akilah jin, Pathen lenggam thudol aseijie. 4 Amaho toh aumkhompet’un ahilchah-in ajah-uva, “Jerusalema kon in potdoh louvin kasei najahsau Pa thutep chu ngah jo’uvin; 5 ijeh-inem itile Johnin twiya baptize achansah vangin nangho vang ni phabep jouleh Lhagao Thenga baptize nachan diu ahi,” ati.

Jesu van’a akaltou

6 Seijuiho akikhop khomsoh phat’un ajah a, “Pakai, tua hi Israel Lenggam nasemphat peh ding hi tam?” tia adoh-u leh; 7 Jesun ajahuva, “pan achamtah a atha neina’a gotsa akoi phat nikho chu nang ho het ding dol ahipoi; 8 hintin Lhagao Theng nachunguva ahung lhun teng thahat naneiyuva, Jerusalem le Judea gamsungsea jong Samaria le leiset kol kimvel geiya Keima het tohsah a napan dinguahi,” ati. 9 Hicheng hi aseiya amahon avet pettah-un lah touvin aumtan, amit mu’va konin meilhang khat’in atolmangtai. 10 Jesu hitia akitol manga amahon van lam avet vet pettahuvin ven, ponbangleh sil mi ni akom’uvah ahung ding lhonin, 11 amani chun, “Galilee gam miho, ibol’a dinga van lam navet vet’u ham? Hiche Jesu nakom’uva kona van’a kilatou hi, van lama akaltou namu bang banguva hung kit ding ahi,” ati lhone.

Judas khel seijui khat kilhenbe

12 Seijuiho chu Jerusalem komcha kilometer khat bang gamla Olive lhang kitia konin Jerusalem lama ahung kilekit tauve. 13 Seijuite chu Peter le John, Jacob le Andrew, Philip le Thomas, Barthomew le Matthew, Alphaeus chapa Jacob le gam ngailu Simon chule Jacob chapa Judas hicheng hi ahiuvin, ahung lhun’uvin aum nau indan chungnunga akaltoutauve. 14 Abonchauvin numeiho le Jesu nu Mary toh Jesu sopi pasal ho pumin akiloiyun ataojom jing uve. 15 Hitia aum laiyu hin sopite lah aPeter akipatdoh-in, (mipi akikhom jat chu ja khat le somni jen ahiuve) 16 “Sopite ho, Jesu manho hinlamkaiyah Judas thudol Lhagao Thengin David kam’a asei masah Pathen lekhabua thu chu guilhung tei ding ahin; 17 ijeh-inem itile Judas chu eiho lah a khat’a kisim’a, hiche lhacha mun jong chang ahi. 18 “Judas hin akhan gitlou man sum chun leimun khat achon, ahnla atumpi ahung pomin jalah tah a apoh jal’iin, asung alai jouse aleng cheh tai. 19 Athu hi Jerusalema cheng jouse het’in aumdoh tan, hijeh chun amaho paovin hiche leimun chu, ‘Thisan leimun’ tin an Akeldama asah tauve. 20 “Chujongle Labua chun: ‘Ama mun chu ong hen lang Koiman loda hen,’ akitin; Amavang: ‘Atohmun chu midang khat chang jo hen,’ akiti. 21 Hijeh chun eiho lah a Pakai Jesu avaikon availhun laiya eiho toh umkhom jing ho lah a mi, 22 John phat laiya pat i-lah-uva kona Jesu lahtouva aum ni geiya thudol hethemkhat chun athodoh thu hi eiho toh hettohsah a pangkhom ding ahi,” ati. 23 Chuphat’in mi ni, Justus tia kikouji Barabbas kiti Joseph le Matthias chu atungdoh tauve. 24 Chutah-in ataovun, “Pakai, nangman mitin lungthim nahesoh keiye, hiche te ni kah a hin lhengdoh tan, 25 koipen hin, ama mun kijot’a che mang Judas panna lhacha mun le Solchah mun hi lo le natim?” atiuve. 26 Chuin amani ding hin vang asan’u leh, vang kisep chu Matthias chunga achun, hijeh chun ama hi Solchah som le khat chutoh akisimthatai.

Solchah 2

Lhagao Theng hung kum lhah

1 Pentecost lhin nin abonchauvin mun khat’a aum’uve. 2 Chuin phulou helouvin van lama konin hui hattah gin bangin ahung gingin atou nau in chu apumin adimsoh jenge. 3 Hichun meikou bangin lei tampi ahung kilah-in achung chehuva aki-ngan aumden leh, 4 abonchauvin Lhagao Theng adimsoh keiyun lhagavin seidoh theina apeh bang cheh-in paochom paochomin thu aseipantauve. 5 Hichea chu vannoi chitin namtin’a kona hung khom Juda mi houva gunchu ho Jerusalema aum laiyu ahin, 6 hiche o chu ahung gin phat’in ahon ajang ahung lhai khom cheh-u leh ama ama pao cheh a athuseiyi akihettoh jengu chu adatmo lhah jengui. 7 Mihon datmo le kidang asauvin, “Ven, hechea thusei ho hi Galilee gam mi jeng hilou ham? 9 Eiho Parthia, Media, Elam gam mi, Mesopotamia gama cheng, Judea gam le Cappadocia gama cheng, Pontus le Asia gama kon, 10 Phrygia le Pamphylia, Egypt le Cyrene naiya Libya lhanga cheng, abang jong Rome a kona hung kholjin 11 Juda mik le Juda kisosah ihiuvin, Crete le Arabia hung kon jong auminm Pathen natoh nasatah aseiyu khu ipao chom cheh-in ikijah theiyui,” tiuve. 12 Abonchauvin datmo le lung kichi-ah tah-in khat le khat aki houvun, “Hiche hi ipi tin a hin tem?” atiuvie. 13 Midang hon vang ajontaiyun, “Hiche ho hi lengpitwi kham hiuva hi!” tin aseiyui.

Pentecost nia Peter thusei

14 Peter chu som le khat chutoh adding khomin, going tah-in japi lam ngan thu asetai; “Vo Juda miho le Jerusalema cheng te, nabonchauvin hiche hi heuvin lang kasei chengse hi lung nachangin ngaiyun. 15 Na-ngaito banguva hiche miho hi lengpitwi kham ahipouve, ajeh chu tu hi jingkah nidan ko bou ahinalaiye; 16 amavang hiche hi Joel Themgaova kona kiseia: 17 ‘Pathenin “Ni nunung lam teng hiti ding ahi,” atin; Tahsa mihem pumpi chunga ka-lhagao kabuh lhah a, Nachapateu le nachanu teuvin gaothu asei diu; Nakhangdong teuvin Themgao thilmu tampi amu’va, Na-upateuvin mang tampi anei diua hi 18 Chule kasoh pasal ho le numei ho chunga jong Hiche nikho laiya chu kalhagao ka buh lhah ding ahin, Hijeh a chu amahon gaothu asei diu ahi. 19 Chunglam van’a thil kidang dang kabol’a, Noileiset chunga melchihna tampi kabol ding; Thisanm meikou muthim lhang khalkiheh ding. 20 Nisa hung thim ding, Lha thisan banga san ding; Pakai nikho nasatah le kiphondohna ding Hung lhun masanga chute ding ahi. 21 Chuteng koi hileh Pakai minphah chan Huhhinga um ding ahiye,” tia’asei chu ahitai. 22 “Israel mite, hiche thu ho hi ngaiyun! Nang hon nahet banguvin, Nazareth khoa Jesu kit mipa chu Pathenin aphatsah photchetna nalah tau-uva thil kidang ho le datmo tin cheng chule melchihna tampi abolsah ahi. 23 Pathen in ahet masah a aontohsa dungjuija hiche Jesu pehdoh a aum chun nang hon Dan neiloute khut’a thingpel’a na khehbeh-un nathat tauve; 24 Ama chu thinan ahenhoi ahi loujeh-in, thi genthei nana hen chu Pathenin asut lhan, akai thoutai. 25 Ajeh chu David-in jong ama thudol asei chun: ‘Keiman kamasanga Pakai kamu jing in, Suh lingjou kahilouna din kajetlama apang jinge; 26 Hijeh chun kalungthim akipah-in, Kaleiyin thanop thu aseyie; Katahsaphe jeng jong hi Kinem’a um jing dina ahi; 27 Nangin ka-lhagao jong noimigama dalhapon natin, Namithengpa jong mon mangsah pon nate. 28 Hinna lampi chengse neihetsah tan Namaiya kipana lhingset’a neipeh ding ahi,’ ti. 29 “Sopite ho olmo louhel’in iphung bupiu David thudol hi najah-uva ka sei nga’e; ama athin avuiyuvin, avuikhuh chu tuni geiyin ilah-uva aum jing nalaiye. 30 Thengao ahijeh-in Pathenin achilhah lah a khat alaltouna atousah dia akihahselna chu ahe jingin, 31 ahet masah jeh chun Christa thodoh kit ding hi asei masan: ‘Ama chu noimigama akidalha denpon, Atahsaphen jong mon mangna amupoi,’ ati. 32 Hiche Jesu hi Pahtenin akaithoutai, keiho chengse hi hettohsah kahiuve. 33 Ama chu Pahten jetlama choisangin aumtan, Paa kona thutep Lhagao Then galah chu ahin bung lhan, nagn hon namu’va najah-u hi ahi. 34 Ijehinem itile David chu Van’a akalpon, hitjoh hin aseiye: ‘Pakai chun ka-Pakai jah a, Kajetlama tou jingin 35 Keiman namelmate chengse Nakengot chotpha kaneisah masangsen,’ ati. 36 “Hijeh chun Israel insung miten kihet cheh hen, nang hon thingpel’a nakhetbeh-u hiche Jesu hi Pathenin Pakai le Messiag a sem ahitai,” ati. 37 Asei ngai chengse chu alungu hem’a kidot abang jengin, Peter le Solchah dang ho jah a, “Ipi kabol diu hitam sopite?” atiuve. 38 Peter in ajah-uva, “Nachonset lung heiyun lang, khat cheh-in na chonset’u ngaidamna ding in Jesu Christa mininbaptize chang cheh-uvin, chuteng Lhagao Theng Pathen thilpeh hi nachan diu ahi; 39 ijeh-inem itile thutep chu nang ho le nachateiu chule gamla tah a um Pakai i-Pathenuvin akouh0o jouse dinga ahi,” tai. 40 Peterin Thudang tamtah-in jong ahettohsah-in tilkhouto thon ajah-uva, “Hiche khang gilouva kon hin kihuhhingun,” ati. 41 Hijeh chun asei jop chengse chu baptize achangunm hiche nikho chun mi sang thum jenin abetauve. 42 Amaho chu solchah ho thuhil’in jong, antheng jongin jong chule taovin jong gunchutah-in apangdet jing tauve.

Jesu tahsan ho hinkhom

43 Thil kidang le melchihna tampi Solchah hoa kona kiboldoh phat’in amitakip chunga kichatna achutai. 44 Atahsan ho abonchauvin thukhatseh kisauvin, ijakai neilhangin aneikhomun, 45 aneiyu athilkeo chengseu ajoh-un, a-ngaichat dungjui cheh-in akihom jiuve; 46 niseh le lung khatseh pun Houin a gunchu tah-in akikhom jiuvin, in tin’a changlhah helbal’in akikhomun, lung lhaisel le kipah tah-in an anekhom jiuvin; 47 Pathen avah choiyun mipi pumpi seiphat achangui. Hichun Pakaiyin niseh leh huhhinga umdoh ho chu aloi lah-uva abejing jin ahi.

Solchah 3

Houin kelkot’a Peterin elbai aboldam

1 Peter le John chu tao phat nilhah lam nidan thumin Houin a achetou lhone. 2 Chuin Houin kaiya cheho henga khutdoa thil thum dinga ahinpoh-uva ‘Kotkhah hoi’ kiti Houin kelkot bul’a kiseh leh kitousahji, anusunga kona elbaiya pengpa chu aumin, 3 amahin Peter le John Houin a lut kigo amun, i-khat khat apehna lhon din thil athume. 4 Peterin John toh ama chu avechang mel’in “Keini lam hinven,” ati. 5 Hijeh chun aman i-khat khat mu ding kinemin amani phatah-in avei. 6 Hichun Peterin, “keiman dangka le sana kaneipon, kanei hiche hi napenge, Nazareth Jesu Christa minin lam jot tan!” ati. 7 Hiti chun akhut jetlamin atuh-in akaithou leh, apettah chun akenghang te ni le akhochang dung jouse ahatdohin, 8 ama akichomin adding jangin lam ajot’in, amanitoh Houin a alut’in, avah len, akichom chomin Pathen avahchoi choi jenge. 9 Mipin jong ama ava le lea Pathen avah choi choi jeng chu amu cheh-uvin, 10 Houin ‘Kotkhah hoi’ kiti laiya kitousahjia khutdo pa chu ahi ahet doh phat’uvin hichepa chunga chu ipi thilsoh hitam, tin lung dongin akicha gamtauve.

Solomon hongchaa Peter thusei

11 Elbai kidamsah pan Peter le John akolchah jing phat’in mipin adat mouvin, Solomon hongcha kiti laiya chun ahenguva ahung lhai khom’uve. 12 Peterin amu phat’in mipi agah houvin, “Israel mite, ibol’a hiche thilsoh hi nadatmouva, keini thahat le houdih jeh a ama hi lam kajotsah thei lhona nagel’uva, neivet vet jengu ham? 13 Nang hon napehdoh-uva Pilate’n lhadoh dinga thu atan jouva jong a-angsung laitah a napaisau, alhacha Jesu chu i-pu i-pateu Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathenin achoi-at ahin, 14 nang hon Atheng le Adihpa chu napaiyun tolthatpa joh chu nalhadoh peh diuvin nathum’ui; 15 hinna Bulpi chu nathat’uvin, ahinla Pathenin Ama chu thinaa konin akaithou kittai, keihohi ahetoh kahiuve. 16 Ama min a tahsan vanga hiche namu’va nahetsahpau hi ama tahsanna chun ama hi adamthengsah hel jenga, hiche ama min’a chu nabonchau angsunga kidinsah ahitai. 17 “Tun sopite, nang hon jong navaipoteu banga hetoh louva nabol’u ahi kahenai; 18 chujongle Pathenin a-Messiah chun gim hesoh athoh ding thu Themgao jouse kamsunga ‘anaphondoh masah chu hitia hi guilhung ahitai. 19 Hichejeh chun chonset lung heiyun lang nachonset chengseu suhmanga aumna din hung kile kit’un, 20 chutileh Pakai angsunga konin lhagao haldoh kitna thei umdoh-intin, Aman nang ho dia lhendohsa akoi messiah Jesu chu ahinsol thei ding ahi. 21 Hiche Jesu chu Pathenin akhang khanga a-Themgao theng ho jouse kama ahinsei jing banga thil ijakai akiledohsah kit phat kah a van’a lahtouva umtei ding ahi. 22 Mose’n jong, ‘Pakai na Pathen’uvin keibanga hi nasopiteu laha kona Themgao khat natundoh peh diu ahi; ipi hileh aman nasei peh chanu aboncha na-ngaisoh kei diu ahi. 23 Koi hileh hiche Themgaopa thusei ngailou chu mipilah a kona kisumang ding ahi,’ ati. 24 Samuel a pat ama nunga thusei Themgao chengsen jong tu hiche nikho ho didng hi anaphon masah sau ahitai. 25 Nang ho hiche Themgao ho leh, Pathenin napu napauteu apeh a Abraham jah a, ‘Nangma chilhah vanga vannoi phungtin phatthei chang diu ahi,’ tia ateppeh hiche Kitepna chate chu nahiuve. 26 Pathenin amasaa nang ho dia alhachapa chu akaithouva, nagit louna chengseuva kona leheisoh keiya phatthei naboh diuvin nahenguva ahinsoltai,” ati.

Solchah 4

Hou vaipoloi ang’a Peter le John

1 Peter le Johnin mipi jah a thu asei nalai lhonin, Thempu ho le Houin ngah sepai lamkaipa chule Sadducee hon ahindel vuh-un, 2 mipi thu ahilnalhona Jesu jal’a thinaa kona thokitna aseiphong lhon chu athi mah ten jengun, 3 amani chu aman’uvin nilhah ahipai phat’in ajinga din mihenna in’a akhumtauve. 4 Ahinla athusei lhon jaa mi tampin atahsanin, amijat jong sang nga jen alhingtauve. 5 Ajing nikhon avaipoteu le upaho chengse le Danthu themho Jerusalema akikhomun, 6 (Thempu chungnung insung lhah jeng, Thempu chungnung Annas le Caiaphas toh John le Alexander ahiuve,) 7 amani chu alailunguvah adinsah-un, “Ipi tha neina neiya, kei min pan’a hiche hi nabol lhon ham?” tin adongui. 8 Chutah chun Peter Lhagao Theng adimset’in ajah-uva, “Japi vaipote leh upate ho, 9 tunia elbaipa thilpha kibolpeh chung chang a eikidong lhona, ama iti kihuhdoh ham, kiti ahileh, 10 Israel mipi leh nang ho nabonchauvin kihet chehun, Nazareth Jesu Christa, nang hon thingpel’a nakhetbeh-uva, Pathenin thinaa kona akaithou kitpa min kipana, hichepa jeh a chu ama damthenga na angsunguva ding’ah ahi. 11 Hiche hi, ‘Insa hon napaiyu Song, ‘Inning khomdet pen’a pang,’ kiti chu ahitai. 12 Chule koima dang’ah ‘huhhingna ‘aumpoi; ‘ijeh-inem iti le vannoiya mihem lah a huhhinga i-umna diuva kipea min dang him him aumpoi,” ati. 13 Mihon Peter le John hanje chu amu’uvin, lekha them lou, mimol ahi lhon aheuvin adatmo lheh jengui; amavang Jesu toh kiloisa ahi lhon ahenauve. 14 Aboldam lhonpa ma amani toh adin khom jing amu’u leh asuhsetna din imacha abol theipouve. 15 Chuin amani chu akouvun Hou vaipoloi kikhopnaa kona potdoh din asol’uvin, amaho achangin akihou khomun, 16 “hiche mi te ni hi iba ilo diu ham? Ijeh-inem itile ama ni jeh a melchihna dsoh hi la Jerusalema cheng jouse het’a kiphongdoh ahitan, eihon jong iseilep thie pouvin, 17 hijongleh athu mipi lah a akithejeh be louna dingin, miho koimacha jah a hiche min’a hi thu asei kit lhon louna din gihsal’u hite,” akitiuve. 18 Chuin amani akouvun Jesu min’a thu aseiphong thei lhon lou ding, mijong ahil thei lhon louhelna din akhah chah tauve. 19 Ahinla Peter le Johnin amaho adonbut lhonin ajah-uva, “Pathen thu sanga nang ho thu ngaijoh Pathen mitmua din jom, nang hon ngaitouvin; 20 keinin vang kamusa le kajahs alhon chu kaseida thei lhon louhel ding ahi,” ati lhone. 21 Thilsoh chung chang jeh a mihon Pathen avahchoi cheh-u leh, mipijeh chun talen peh na thieya thepmona imala amudoh pouvin, hijongleh amani chu nasatah-in agihsal kit leuvun alhadoh tauve. 22 Achunga damsah theina thil kidang kibolpehpa ma chu akum som li val ahitai.

Jesu tansanho ahanna diuva ataovu

23 Alhadoh phat’un Peter le John jong aloite henga ahung lhonin Thempu pipu ho le upahon ajah lhona agih nau thu chu asei peh lhontai. 24 Amahon ajah phat’un lung khat tah-in ogin khat’in Pathen akouvun, “Vo Pakai, van le leiset, Twikhanglen chule asunga um jouse Sempa nangma nahi, 25 Lhagao Thenga kona kapuluiyu nalhacha David kama ‘Ibol’a chiding namdangte lung hanguva, Mipin pannabei thil angaitou ham? 26 Leiset lengte akigol’un, avaipoteu jong akikhomun Pakai le a-Messiah dou din agouve,’ tia kiseisa chu 27 atahbehin hiche khopi sunga hin thao nanusa nalhacha theng Jesu dou din, Herod le Pilate, chiding namdang toh chule Israel mipi geiyin akikhomun, 28 bo dinga nakhut tah a nagontohsa le nalungthima na-ngaito chengse chu bol ding agatauve. 29 Chule tun Pakai, ami gihsal nau hi vetan, chujongle nalhachate hin hangtah a nathu asei ngamna diuvin lung ngamna pen, 30 nalhacha Theng Jesu min’a dammo veiset akiboldama, melchihna tampi akiboldoh a chule thil kidang dang akisodohna din nakhut hin lhangin,” atiuve. 31 Hitia chu ataovu leh aum nau mun chu ahung kilingin, amaho abonchauvin Lhagao Theng achangun lung ngamtah-in Pathen thu aseitauve.

Thil jouse neilhanga aneiyu

32 Atahsan loise chu lung khat she le hinkho khat’in aumun, koiman anei athilkeo chu amaa tuma sei louvin, abonchan akikop cheh-uve. 33 Thahat nasatah kengin Solchah hon Pakai Jesu thokit thu ahettohsah-un, achunguva phat theina lentah-in aume. 34 Ijeh-inem itile alah-uva khat cha jong alhasam aumpouve, lou le in neihon jong ajoh-un aman jouse chu ahin choi khom’uvin 35 Solchah ho kengbul’a akoiyun, mihon angaichat bep cheh-in ahoppeh jiuvin ahi. 36 Mi tilkouva pang ahi, tia Solchah hon Barnabas asah-u, Cyprus aping Levi mi Joseph chun 37 lou ching khat aneiyin agajoh-in sum chu ahinchouyin Solchah ho kengbul’a akoiye.

Solchah 5

Ananias le Sapphira

1 Amin Ananias kiti pasal khat hin ajinu Sapphira jong anomin anei thil khat ajoh-in, 2 ajinu het’in thilman akeh khat akikoiyin, akeh khat chu ahinchoiyin Solchah ho kengbul’a akoiye. 3 Hichun Peterin, “Ananias, ibol’a nalung sung Satan nalo dimsah a Lhagao Theng najoulhep’a, gam man akeh khat chu nakoiden hitam? 4 Najoh masanga nanga ahibanga najoh nunga jong nanga chu nathu thu hilou ham? Ibol’a hitobang thil hi nalungthima navop ham? Mihem hilouva!” ati. 5 Ananias chun thu hicheng hi ajah jah chun alhun athitai; hichea hin ajapha jouse chunga kichatna lentah ahung lhungtan ahi. 6 Gol-lhang ho adding doh-un along chu atom’uvin chule apodoh-un agavuitauve. 7 Nidan thum don nungin thilsoh umchan hepha louvin ajinu ahung lut’e. 8 Peterin amanu anahouvin, “Seitemin, hijat man a bou hi gam chu najoh lhon ham?” ati leh; amanun, “Henge, hijat ahinai,” ati. 9 Chuphat’in Peter ajah a, “Ibol’a nangnin Pakai Lhagao patep dia nagot lhon ham? Ven, najipa vuiho kotpi phung ahung geitauve, nang jong napohdoh pai diu ahtai,” ati. 10 Amanu jong alhu paiyin Peter kengbul’a athidentai. Gollhang ho ahung lut’u leh amanu athisan ahung toh-un, along chu apodoh-uvin ajipa koma agavuitauve. 11 Chutah chun Houbung pumpi le athilsoh ho japha chan chunga kichatna lentah ahung lhungtai.

Melchihna le thil kidang tampi abol’u

12 Mipi lah a melchihna le thil kidang tampi Solchah hon akhut tah-uvin aboldoh doh jengun, chujongle lungkhat tah-in Solomon hongchaa chun aum cheh-ui. 13 Midang koiman amaho jop dinga ngap chatapon, ahinla mipin aseipha jing nauvin, 14 hijeh chun mipilah a Pakai tahsan tahbeh ho pasal’in jong numeiyin jong abejingun, 15 Peter ahungle tengleh alebeh achunguva achuh khahna din, dammo veise jouse khosung lamlen dunga ahinpohdoh-un khunpeh chung le pheh dunga alupsah-ui. 16 Jerusalem kimvel khopi dunga mipi ahung kikhom’un, dammo veise jouse le lhagaoboh vop ho ahinpuiyun, abonchan aboldamsoh keiyui.

Solchah ho min abol gantheiyu

17 Thempu chungnung chu chu pet’a Sadducee loi lah a aloite chengse chutoh akipatdoh-in, athang tom behseh jengun, 18 Solchah ho chunga khut alhauvin, aman’un, lhangpi kihenna in’a akhumtauve. 19 Ahinla hiche jan chun Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in songkul kotkhah aongin amaho apuidoh-in ajah-uva, 20 “Cheuvin Houin a ga dingun lang hiche Hinna thudol hi abonchan gaseipeh tauvin,” ati. 21 Hiche ajah phat’un khovah lhah-in Houin a alutuvin thu agahiltauve. Thempu chungnung chunla aloi te chengse toh ahungin Israel chate Hou vaipoloi upa changse toh Houthua kikhopna abol’un, amihenho’u gakailut dingin songkul’a mi asol’ui. 22 Vaihom asol ho’u ahungu leh Solchah ho chu songkul sunga agamu tapouvin, ahung kile kit’uvin athudol aphongun, 23 “Songkul kaga lhun’un kotheh chengse phatechan akiheh-in songkul ngah ho jong kotpi phung dunga adding cheh-un, kot kahondoh phat’un la asunga koima kamupouve’” atiuve. 24 Athuseiyu hi Houin ngah sepai vaipopa le Thempu pipu loiyin ajah phat’un Solchah ho chu iti hiuva hichea hi ipi hungsoh hitam, tin alunggel’u abeihel tai. 25 Hichepet hin mikhat ahenguva ahungin, “ven, songkul’a namihen ho’u khu, Houin a adingun mipi thu ahil’uve,” ati. 26 Chuphat’in Houin ngah sepai vaipopa le vaipoloi chengse akon’un amaho agakailut’uvin, mipi akichauvin songa ase louna diuvin pumhat’in vang abolpouve. 27 Solchah ho ahinkailut phat’un Hou vaipoloi kikhopna adinsah-un, Thempu chungnungin amaho adongin, 28 “Hiche min pan’a mi nahil louhelna diuva hachang khama nakikhamu ahin, ahinla ven, hiche nathuhil’u hi Jerusalem nadipsoh hel’in, hiche mipa thisan phu hi keiho chunga lhut khum din neigouve!” atiuve. 29 Ahivangin Peter le Solchah hon adonbut’un, “Mihemho thu hilouva Pathen thu joh a kanun tei tei diu ahi. 30 Ipu ipateu Pathenin thinga nakhai sanguva nathasau Jesu chu akaithouvin, 31 Israelte achonset chengseu ngaidama aumna dia chonset lung heina apehna din ama chu Pathenin ama jetlama vaipo le huhhingpan achoisangtai. 32 Hiche thu ho ahetoh a chu Pathenin athua nung ho apeh Lhagao Theng le keiho kahiuve,” atiuve. 33 Ajapha chan alung hang beseh jengun Solchah ho chu thadoh jengdia akiloltauve. 34 Hichun Hou vaipoloi lah a Pharisee mi, amin Gamaliel kiti, Danthu hilthem, mi jousen ajasohkei, ama chu adingdoh-in Solchah ho chu phat chom khat polama soldoh dingin aseiyin, 35 chuin Hou vaipoloi jah a, “Hiche miho chunga hi ipi bol ding natiu ham kichih theiyun. 36 Ijeh-inem itile tu masngin jong Theudas kiti mi khat anaumin, ama le ama i-khat hidainnin akiseiyin, pasal phabep jen, ja li bangin ajop’uvin, ahinla ama atha phat’un anungjui chengse akithe chehsoh-in, imacha lou asoh tai. 37 Hiche nung hin leiset mi kisim laiyin Galilee mi Judas ahung kipan kit’in, mipi phabep geiyin akijuisah-e; ama jong hi amang thah tah, anungjui chengse jong akithecheh tauve. 38 Hijeh a chu tu hiche thua jong kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche mihoa kon hin kikangseuvin lang don dauvin, ijeh-inem itile hiche jong hi mihema kon le lunggel chule natoh ahile kisumang thou ding ahi; 39 Pathena hungkon ahivangleh nasuh mang joulou diu ahi, ajo leh Pathen kidoupi nahilo diu ahi,” ati. Gamaliel thun anungun, 40 Solchah ho chu akou lut’uvin, avoh juvun Jesu min’a thu asei louhelna diuvin hatah-in agihsal’un alhadoh tauve. 41 Solchah ho chu Hou vaipoloi kikhopna maiya konin achedohun, chuche Min jal’a hesoh genthei thoh a kiloma akibol’u chu akipah lheh jengui. 42 Niseh-in Houin le a-in tin’uva tang louhel’in thu ahil’un, chule Jesu chu Messiah ahi Kipana Thupha asiphong jingui.

Solchah 6

Mi sagi kipansah

1 Hiche lai chun seijuih mijat apunbe cheh cheh phat’un niseh a thil kihopnaa ameithaiho’u anah sah peh pouve, tin Greek pao tho Juda-numeiho chu Hebrew mite chunga aphun’un, akah-uva kinahna asodoh tai. 2 Chuphat’in som le ni chun seijui jouse akoukhom’un, “Keihon Pathen thu seiphong kangah-uva dokhanga ankong sem’a kapan diu adihpoi; 3 hijeh chun sopite, hiche kin’a kapansah diuvin, nalah-uva konin Lhagao le chihna dim mia nahettohsau sagi lhengdohuvin; 4 chuteng keiho tah vang taona le hill hang kin’a kipumpeh jo’uvinge,” atiuve. 5 Athu chu mipi maiya lung lhai aumin, hijeh chun tahsan le Lhagao Thenga dim Stephan toh, Philip le Prochorus, Nicanor le Timon, Parmenas le juda houva kilalut chiding namdang mi Antioch khoa hung Nicolaus alhengdoh-un, 6 amaho chu Solchah ho angsunga adinsah-u leh, Solchah hon ataopeh-uvin achunguva khut a-ngamtauve. 7 Hichun Pathen thu achaljah tan, jerusalema seijuiho mijat hapunin apungin, Thempu ho lah a tamtah jong tahsan thun anung tauve.

Stephan amat’u

8 Stephen chu lungset le thahat adamtan, mipi lah a melchihna le thil kidang lentah tah aboldoh tai. 9 Hichun akiminvo na banga chamlhat miho Houthua kikhopna in kitia konin mi phabep, Cyrene gama, Alexandria, Cilicia le Asia a hung kon ho akipatdoh-un Stephen chu akinelpiu leh, 10 aman chihna le Lhagao thu asei chu anel thei tapouve. 11 Chuphat’in amahonmi phabep, “Amah in Mose le Pathen taitomna thu asei kajauve,” tia sei dingin atlseuvin ahi. 12 Hiti chun mipi le upa ho, Danthu themho aban tilset’uvin, amaho achunga achu’vin, aman’un Hou vaipoloi kikhop naa akailut’un, 13 jouthua hettohsah-uvin, amahon, “Hichepa hin Muntheng le Danthu douna thu tang louhel’in asei sei jengin, 14 Nazareth Jesun hiche mun hi asuhmanga Mose’n eipeh-u chondan ho hi akheldoh ding ahi,’ tia asei jong kajauve,” atiuvin ahi. 15 Hichun Hou vaipoloi kikhopnaa tou chengsen Stephen chu avesoh keiyun ahileh amai chu Vantil maiso bangin amu’uve.

Solchah 7

Stephan akihonna thu asei

1 Thempu chungnungin, “Hichengse hi hiti mong ham?” atileh; 2 Stephenin adonbut’in, “Ngaiyuvin sopite le pate ho: Penna bulpipa Abraham chu Haran aching dia ache masang, Mesopotamia gama achen laiyin loupina Pathen ahenga ahung kilah-in 3 ama jah a, ‘Nagam leiset le naphung mite dalhan potdoh-in lang keiman kavetsah ding gam jonin chetan,’ ati. 4 Hijeh chun ama Chaldea gama konin achen Haran a achengtai. Apa thi nungin tua nachen nau hiche gamsunga hin akichon lutsah-in, 5 ahinla agam leiset halsi khat, kengpeh thol jeng cha jong ama din apepoi; cha anei lou vangin, agam chu ama le anunga achilhahpa apeh din thu anatep’e. 6 Pathenin hiti hin achilhah te chu mi gama gapem’uva, mihon sohna atohsah diu, genthei hesoh a abol diuvin aseiye. 7 Pathenin aseiyin, ‘Amahon sohna agatoh peh-u nam mite chu thu katan khuma, chujou teng Abraham chilhahte hung kitoldoh-uva hiche lai mun’a Keima kinbol’a eihou diu ahi,’ ati ahi. 8 Chuin Abraham chu cheptan ding kitepna thupeh apen, hijeh chun Isaac ahingin niget nin chep atanpeh-in, Isaac-in Jacob, Jacob’in penna pate somle ni ahingin chep atanpeh-e. 9 “Penna pate chu Joseph chunga athang thip’un Egypt gama ajoh mangun, ahile Pathenin aumpi jingin, 10 ahesoh genthei tin tanga konin ahinhuhdoh pehin, Egypt lengpa Pharaohang’a lungset le chihna apen, hijeh chun lengpan Egypt gam pumpi le ama insung pumpia vaipon asemtai. 11 Hichun Egypt gam punpi le Canaan gam pumpia nahiuve kel alhan, gentheina lentah ahung, lhungin, i-puteuvin neh le chah akimu joutapouve. 12 Hichea hin Jacob’in Egypt gama anneh aume, ti ajah phat’in i-puteu chu khatvei chan nan agah solpai jenge. 13 anivei chan na Joseph-in asopite akihetdohsah tan, Jacob insung chu Pharaoh geiyin ahetai. 14 Chuphat’in Joseph-in jong apa Jacob le a-inkote mihem som sagi le nga jen chu gakou din mi asol’in, 15 Jacob jong Egypt’a ahung suh tai. Hichun ama ahin i-puteu ahin athitauvin, 16 alongu chu Shechema alepoh-uvin, Shechem muna Abrahamin Hamor chatea kona dang kaa achohsa lhan’a chun avuitauve. 17 “Pathenin Abraham koma akihahsel’a a thupeh phat chu ahung lhinpai ding phat’in, Egypt gama mipi apungtel tul jengun, 18 Joseph hephalou leng chom khat hung letdoh geiyin apunguve. 19 Lengchompa hin ijat miteu heltah-in dohan abol’in, i-pu i-pateu chu achasen jouseu ahing aum louna din acham louvun polama apaidoh sah jenge. 20 Hiche lai tah hin Mose apengin Pathen din it aum lheh jenge; lha thum sungin apa insunga avah-un, 21 ama jong apaidoh phat’uvin Pharaoh chanun akilah-in achapa vah-in ahin kivahdoh tai. 22 Mose chu Egypt mite chihna jouse ahil’un, athusei jouse le antohna chan a pheltah ahiye. 23 “Mose chu kum som li alhin phat’in asopi Israel chate gavil ding alungthima aumdoh tai. 24 Mi khat hi adih loutah a kibol amun, ama chu akithopin aphu lahnan Egypt mipa chu athattai. 25 Mose gel’a chu Pathenin ama khut mangchaa ama hochu huhhingna apeh got ahi asopiten kihetnah tau atileh, amahon ahepouve. 26 ajingin ahenguva ahung kit leh mi ni akina lhonin, aman akah lhona chamna thu aseiyin, ‘Mi te ni, sopi cha hlhona ibol’a khat’in khat adih louva kibol nahi lhon ham?’ ati. 27 Ahinla a-inhengpa adih louva bolpa joh chun Mose chu asondoh-in, ‘Keiho chunga vaipo le thutana kon natun beh am? 28 Janhia Egypt mipa natha banga chu tha ding neigot ham?’ ati. 29 Hiche athusei jeh hin Mose ajamin Midian gama agapemin, hikoma chun chapa ni agahinge. 30 “Kum som li lhinin Sinai mol gamthip laiya Vantil khat hamboh lah meikongin Mose henga ahung kileh-e. 31 Hiche thil amu hi Mose’n adatmon, ga ve chen dia anailut leh Pakai o ahung gingin, 32 ‘Keima napu napate Pathen, Abraham le Isaac chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ ati. 33 ‘Nakeng te nia konin nakengchot te ni sut lhan, ijeh-inem itile nadinna chu muntheng ahi. 34 Egypt gama kamite kibolsetna kaven kamu chentai, chule apen gin’u kajan apuidoh diuva hung kumlha kahi; hijeh chun tun hungin Egypt’a kasol ding nahi,’ ati. 35 “Hiche Mose amahon apaidal’uva, ‘Vaipo le thutan a kon na tun beh am?’ atipau, hichepa tah hi Pathenin hamboh lah a ahenga hung kilah Vantil ban thahat’a ama ho vaipo le huhdoh din asoltai. 36 Amahin Israelte ahinpuidoh chun Egypt gama jong Twikhanglen san mun le gamthip noiya kum som li sungin thil kidang dang le melchihna tampi anabol’e. 37 Hiche Mose hi ahiye Israel chate jah a, ‘Pathenin nasopiteu lah a kei tobang Themgao khat natundoh peh diu ahi,’ tia sei chu. 38 Gamthip laiya Houbunga anapanga, i-pu i-pateu toh pang khoma Sinai mol’a Vantil toh kihouva, eiho pehson dia hinna Thupeh lapa chu ama hi ahin, 39 i-pu ipateu ama noiya alut nom pouvin, asondoh-un alungthimun pouvin, asondoh-un alungthimun Egypt lam angai cha jingun, 40 Aaron jah a, ‘Kamasanguva lamkai din Pathen lim tobang ho neisempeh-un, ajeh chu Egypt’a kona eihin puidoh pau hiche Mose chu achunga ipi soh hitam kahetapouve,’ atiuvin ahi. 41 Hiti chun amahon hiche lai hin bongnou lim asemun, hiche lai hin bongnou lim asemun, hiche koma hin kilhaina abol’uvin, akhut’a asemsau thi ho ja nan golnop abol’uve. 42 Hijeh chun Pathenin akihei mang khumin van’a ahsite hou din amaho chu apehd0h-in, Themgao ho lekhabua kisun bangin: ‘Vo Israel insung mi, kum som li sung gamthip laiya Sa thao le kilhainaa neihou louvu hilou ham? 43 Moloch houna ponbuh po leuvin, Rephan ahsi pathen limsemthu napo leuvin Hiche nasemsau thil ho hi houdin nago meu! Hijeh a chu Babylon kal’a katolmang diu nahiuve,’ akiti. 44 I-pu i-pateuvin gamthip laiya, Alim kigon namu bang bangin ponbuh san,’ tia Mose jah a thusei Pathenin avetsah hettosah na Houbuh chu neiyun, 45 hiche hi i-pu i-pateuvin alason’un, Joshua lamkainaa Pathenin i-pu i-pateu masanga chiding namdangte anodoh a amahon gam alo lai geiyun ahinpo lut’uvin, David nikho lai geiyin aume; 46 David chu Pathen angsunga lungset achanjeh-in Jacob Pathen Inmun amudoh din athume. 47 Ahinla in chu Solomonin asahpeh bouve. 48 Ahinvangin Chungnungpen chu khut’a kisa in’a achengpoi, hichea hin Themgaopan: 49 ‘Pakaiyin, “van kalaltouna ahin, Leiset kakengto ngapna ahi; Nangin itobang in neisah peh ding ham? Kacholdo mun ding hoikom ham? 50 Ijakai Keiman kakhut tah a Kasemsa hilou ham?” tin aseiye,’ ati. 51 “Milou chalet, lungthim le nabeng te nia cheptanlou ho tobang, napu napateu bangin nang hon Lhagao Theng nadoudal jing jengui. 52 Napu napateuvin Themgao koipen bolset louva akoiyum? Alhacha Theng hung masanga anaseiphong masa chengse athat’uvin, nang hon tuna ma najoh doh-un nathattauve, 53 chule Vantiltea kona Danthu kilahsaon nang ho nahiuvin, nit la nanit pouve,” ati.

Stephen songa aselih-u

54 Asei chengse ngaiho chu alungthimu atongkhan athimah cheh-un Stephen chu ha agoikhum cheh-uve, 55 Stephen vang chu Lhagao Thengin adim pai jengin, van lah agah vet leh Pathen loupina le Pathen jetlam a Jesu adin amun; 56 “Ven, van akihon’a Mihem Chapa chu Pathen jetlama ding kamui!” ati. 57 Chutah chun amahon hahohin ahoh-uvin anabeng akisip cheh un, ahonjangin adel lut’uvin, 58 khopi polama aleh doh-un songin aseptauve. Ahetoh a pang hon Saul kiti gol-lhang khat kengbul’a aponsil’u akoiyuve. 59 Mihon Stephen songa asepet’u chun aman ahin samin, “Pakai Jesu, ka-lhagao lan!” tin aseiye. 60 Hichun aboh khup’in going tah-in asamin, “Pakai, hiche chonsetna hi amaho chunga simdan!” ati. Hiche hi aseiyin akijamdap deltai.

Solchah 8

Saul’in Stephen athau hi aphat sah-e.

Saul’in Houbung abolgim

1 Hiche nikho hin Jerusalema Houbung chunga hesoh gentheina lentah achutan, Solchah ho tilou adangse Judea gam le Samariagama ajamchehsoh heltauve. 2 Hougut mi phabep’in Stephen chu avuiyun, hakan akauve. 3 Saul vang chun Houbung suhmangna din in tin’a alut’in numei pasal aman’in ajendoh doh jengin songkul’a akhum thu thui.

Samaria khopia Kipana Thupha Kiseiphong

4 Mi ajamcheh ho chu avah leuvin Kipana Thupha thu aseiphongin apangjo tauve. 5 Philip jong Samaria khopia achesuh-in miho jah a Messiah chu aseiphongtai. 6 Mipi hon asei chengse ajah uva melchihna abol ho amu phat’un lung khat tah-in Philip thuseiho chu lung lut cheh-in angaiyui. 7 Ajeh chu mi tamtah a konin lhagaoboh ho hapenin apengun ahung potdoh doh jengun, ;angthi ho le elbai ho geiya damdoh dodh jeng ahiuvin, 8 khopi sunga chun kipana tampi asohdoh tai. 9 Khopi sunga hin amin Simon kiti mitphel doithem khat aumin, Samaria jat mite chu mitpheldoi avetsah a ama le ama i-khat hiya kiseilen lheh ahin, 10 ama hi aneova pat alen geiyin lung lut tah-in athu angaiyun, “hichepa hi pathen tha hat chungnung kiti chu ahi,” atiuve. 11 phat sottah amitpheldoi chu amaho kidang tah a avetsah jingjeh-in lung khat tah-in angai nasauve. 12 Ahin Philip’in Pathen Lenggam le jesu Christa mina Kipana Thupha aseiphong tahsan chengse chu numei jong pasal jong baptize achansahtai. 13 Simon amatah jengin jong atahsanin, baptize achan jouvin Philip toh akiloiyin, melchihna le tha neina nasatah tah a thil kidang abol ho amu leh adatmo lheh jengin ahi. 14 Jerusalema um solchah hon Samaria khopin jong Pathen thu akisantauve, ti ajah phat’un ahenguva Peter le John asolpeh-un, 15 amani ahung suh lhonin amaho chu Lhagao theng achan theina diuvin ataopeh lhone; 16 ajeh chu Pakai Jesu min’a baptize chang bep ahinalaiyun, alah-uva khat beh jong Lhagao Theng chang loulai ahi. 17 Chunin Peter le Johnin achunguva khut a-ngap lhon leh Lhagao Theng achang tauve. 18 Solchah te ni khut ngap’a kona Lhgao Theng kipeh chu Simonin amun amani chu sumapen, 19“Ken jong koi hileh achunga khut ka-ngap chan Lhagao Theng achanna din hiche tha neina hi neipe lhonun,” ati. 20 Ahinla Peterin ajah a, “Nasumle nangma manthan, Pathen thilpeh suma chohjou dol’in nagel’in ahi! 21 Pathen maiya nalungthimput adih loujeh-in hiche thua hin namu jong aumpon, chan jong naneipoi. 22 Hijeh chun hiche nathilse gel’a kon hin lung heiyin, nalungthima hitobang nagel hi angaidam theina din Pakai henga taovin. 23 ijeh-inem itile cheikha khaveng vung banga kha adih louva kihen nahi kamui,” ati. 24 Simonin adonbut’in, “Nasei chengse hi khatcha kachunga achuh louna din nangmin Pakai henga kei khel’in neitaopeh lhonin,” ati. 25 Peter le Johnin Pakai thu ahettosah lhona aseisoh phat lhonin Jerusalema ahung kile kit lhonin, Samaria miho kho tamtah a Kipana Thupha asei phong peh lhone.

Philip le Ethipia mi nukisopa

26 Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in Philip jah a thu aseiyin, “Kipatdoh-in lang Jerusalema kona Gaza jotna lamlena khun lhanglama chesuh temin,” ati; alam len chu donlouva kikoithip ahitai. 27 Philip jong akipat’in acheleh ven, Ethiopia mi nukiso, Ethiopia lengnu Candace Semangpa, agou chengse chunga vaihom, Jerusalema Pathen hou dia ‘hung, 28 akile kit lamin akangtalai chunga atounaa Isaiah Themgao lekhabua asim’e. 29 Hichun Lhagaovin Philip jah a, “Chen lang hiche kangtalai khu lhonpin,” ati. 30 Hijeh chun Philip alhailut jeng leh Isaiah themgao lekhabu asimgin ajan, hichun, “Nasim chu nahet hinai?’ atileh; 31 aman, “Hoiya, mikhattouvin eihilchet lou leh iti kahet ding ham?” atin, Philip chu hung ‘kaldoh a amatoh toukhom din agah kouve. 32 Aman Pathen lekhabu asimna laimun chu hiche hi ahi: “Ama chu tha dinga kikai kelngoi bang le Kelngao nou amulvoupa ang’a paopoh lou bangin kam cheng khat jong keh louvin aum’e. 33 Kineosahnaa thu adih-in atanpeh pouvin, Ama khaggui hi kon asei ding hitam?Ajeh chu leiset’a kona ahinkho kiladoh ahitai,” kiti lai ahi. 34 Nukisopan Philip agah houvin, “Neihil chen temin, Themgaopan ama chung chang thua ha, midang khattou thua hiche hi asei ham?” ati. 35 Chutah-in Philip apaodoh-in Pathen lekhabua panin Jesua Kipana Thupha aseipeh tai. 36 Lampia ahung kijot jot lhon leh twi veina khat’a ahung lhonin, nukisopan agah houvin, “Ven twihi, baptize kachanmona ding ipi um am?” atileh; 37 Philip’in ajah a, “Nalungthim pumpia natahsan leh baptize chang theiyin nate,” ati. Aman, “jesu Christa chu Pathen Chapa ahi, ti katahsan nai,” ati. 38 Chuin nukisopan kangtalai chu angah din aseiyin, anilhonin akumlha lhonin twi lah a chun Philip le nukisopa alut lhonin, Philip’in nukisopa chu baptize achansah tai. 39 Twi lah a kona ahungkaldoh phat lhonin Pakaiya kon Lhagaovin Philip chu alhoh mangin nukisopan amukit tapon, ahivangin ache na lampia kipah tah-in achepaitai. 40 Ahinla Philip chu Azotus khopia akimudoh-in, chule aman Caesatea alhun kahsen achepeh-in Kipana Thupha asei phongpeh-e.

Solchah 9

Paul hinkho kikhel

1 Saul Chula Pakai seijuite gihsal le that din ahai let lut nalaiyin, Thempu chung nung heng a achen, 2 chuche lampia kai jouse chu koi koi hijongleh numei pasal amudoh chan kan’a Jerusalema ahinkai lut theina din Damascus khopia Houthua kikhopna in dudnga peh din lekha agathume. 3 Acheleh Damascus khopi ahin phah ding konin phot lot louvin van’a konin vah khat’in akimvel asalvah soh jengtai. 4 Hichun ama tol’a akileh lhan, ogin khat’in ajah a, “Saul, Saul, ibol’a nangin neibol set set ham?” ati. 5 Ahinla aman, “Vo Pakai nang koi nahim?” atileh; Aman, “Keima nabolset jing Jesu chu kahi; 6 hijongleh kipatdoh-in lang khopi sunga khun lut’in, chuteng ipi nabol ding kiseipeh nan nate,” ati. 7 Alhonpi miho chu paopoh uhsa beihel’in adding thip chet’un, ogin chu aja nauvin koima amupouve. 8 Saul chu tol’a konin ahung ding doh-in amit te ni ahasah vangin imacha amutapon, hijeh chun mihon akhut’in akaiyun Damascus khosunga apuilut tauve. 9 Nithum sungin khomu louvin aumtan, nelou donlouvin aumtai. 10 Damascus khopia hin amin Ananias kiti seijui khat aumin, Themgao thilmua mu aneinaa Pakaiyin ajah a, “Ananias,” atileh; aman, “Ven Pakai ka-um’e,” ati. 11 Hichun Pakaiyin ajah a, “Kipat’in lang, ‘Lamjangpet kiti khosung lamlen khu jonin, Judas in’a tarsua a lungkon Sual kitipa chu gaholin; ven, ama ataopet ahin, 12 aman Themgao thilmua mu aneina Ananias kiti mikhat hunga kho amukit theina dia achunga khut a-ngap ding amui’,’ ati. 13 Ahinla Ananias chun adonbut’in, “Pakai, hiche mipa thudol itobang tah aJerusalema name thengte ijat’a abolset hitam, ti mi tamtah a kona kijataa; 14 chule hichea nangma min pan’a tao jouse jong matna ding Thempu pipu hoa kona thu neina anei ahi,” ati. 15 Ahivangin Pakaiyin ajah a, “Chen, ama hi namdangte le leng ho, chule Israel chate angsunga kamin po le dia manchah a kalhen ahi; 16 ijeh-inem itile Keima min jal’a ijatvei hesoh genthei athoh ding jong kavetsah ding ahi,” ati. 17 Ananias chu achen insunga alut’in Saul chunga khut a-ngamin, Sopi Saul, Pakai, Lampia nahenga hung kilah Jesu chunk ho namukit theiya Lhagao Theng nadimsetna dinga eihinsol ahi,” ati. 18 Apettah chun amit te nia konin nga lip tobang ahung lup lhan ahileh kho amukittan, chuin akipatdoh-in baptize achangin, 19 an aneh le atha akilt kittai.

Damascus khopia Saul’in Thupha aseiphong

Saul chu nikho phabep Damascus khopia seijuite toh aumkhomin, 20 apet pet chun Houthua kikhopna in dung jousea Jesu kiti hichepa chu Pathen Chapa ahi, tin asamle tai. 21 Ahin asei japha chanin adatmo lheh jengun, “Jerusalema hiche min’a tao jouse subei hei hoi chu hichepa hi hilou hiya, chule amaho chu kanchom’a thempu pipuho henga akailut theina dinga hung hilou ham?” atiuve. 22 Ahinla Saul chu asei ahattou tel tul tan, Jesu chu Messiah ahimongtai, tin Damascus khopia Juda ho chu anelkhupsoh keiye.

Judatea kona Saul jamdoh

23 Nikho sot thimpi nungin Saul that din Juda ho akihousom’un, 24 athilgonu hi Saul’in ahedohtai. Saul thana din khopi dongkot jouse asun ajanin a-ngah-un, 25 ahivangin janin aseijuiten pollanga akhumun kulpi pang’a akhai lhatauve.

Jerusalem khopia Saul

26 Jerusalema ahung phat’in seijuite toh kiloikhom ding agon, ahinla amahon Saul chu seijui khat hi dia atahsan lou jeh-un akichauve. 27 Hichun Barnabas-in Paul solchah ho henga apuiyin, ajahuva itobanga lampia chu Pakaiamu’a, Pakaiyin ajah a thu aseiya, chule Damascus khopia chu aman itobang tah a hangsan’a Jesu min’a thu asei ahilchentai. 28 Hichejeh chun Saul jong amahotoh Jerusalema alut le apot len, hangsan tah-in Pakai minin thu asei len, 29 Greek chon’a chon Juda ho akihoupin akinel pin, hi jeh chun tha din agot lotauve. 30 Ahinla sopiten ahetdoh phat’un Saul chu Caesarea ahinpuisuh-un Tarsus lama asolmang tauve. 31 Judea le Galilee chule Samaria gam pumpi Houbunga vang chamna alengtan, akiphut det cheh cheh-in, Pakai gingin aumin, Lhagao Thengin lhamonin, panpin amija apungtel tul’e.

Aeneas kitipa kiboldam

32 Peter chu gamtin’a ava le naa Lydda a mithengte heng geiyin ahungtai. 33 Hichea chun Aeneas kiti mi khat amudoh-in, ama chu langthia kum get jen jalkhun’a kijam ahi. 34 Amapa jah a hin Peterin, “Aeneas Jesu christen nadamsah ahitai, kipatdoh-in lang nalupna kigot’in,” atileh; ama akipatdoh pai jenge. 35 Hichu Lydda le Sharon a cheng jousen amu’vin Pakai lama akiheisoh tauve.

Dorcas kichohing kit

36 Joppaa chun seijui numei amin Dorcas ahi tia Tabitha kiti, thipha bol le thilpeh a thalhingtah khat aum’e. 37 hiche lai hin amanu anan athitai; mihon asil jou phat’uvin indan chungnunga alupsahui. 38 Lydda hi Joppa komcha ahijeh-in seijuihon Peter Joppa aum ahet phat’uvin mi ni asol’un, “Lungset’in kinomsot louhel’in kahenguva hung jengin,” tin aga ngehsah-uve. 39 Hijeh chun Peter jong akipatdoh paiyin amanitoh akilhonin, ahung lhun phat’in mihon indan chungnunga chun apuitouvun, meithai jouse athinu kim’vela adingun akap-un, Dorcas-in ahin laiya akhuipeh-u sangkhol ho le sangkhollen ho chu Peter avet sah-uve. 40 Ahin Peterin amaho chu abonchauvin polama anodoh-in aboh khup’in ataovin, chuin along lam ngan akiheiyin, “Tabitha thouvin,” ati. Chutah-in amanun amit te ni ahasah leh Peter amun, athoudoh tai. 41 Chuin Peterin akhut apen akaidingin, mithengte le meithaiho chu akouvin amanu chu ahingin amaho apetei. 42 Athu hi Joppa gam pumpia akihesoh tan, mi tampin Pakai atahsanlo tauve. 43 Peter chu Joppa khoa savun sempa Simon in’a nikho tamtah anichonge.

Solchah 10

Peter le Cornelius

1 Caesarea chun amin Cornelius kiti, Italy sepailoi atiu sepai jalamkai khat aumin, 2 ama hi hougut tah, ama le a-insung mi aboncha Pathen gingte, miho thilpeh a hongphal tah, chule Pathena tao jing ahi. 3 Amahin nikhat nilhah lam nidan thum donin Themgao thilmua mu aneinaa hunga ajah a, “Cornelius,” ahinti kichentah-in amui. 4 Cornelius-in kicha tha-in mit lha louhel’in Vantil chu aven, “Ipi ham Pakai?” tia ahouleh, aman ajah a, “Nataona ho leh mi nakhotona ho chu het jing din Pathen angsunga alhung toutai. 5 Chule tun Joppaa mi sol’in lang Peter kiti Simon chu gapuisah tan; 6 ama chu Twikhanglen panga cheng, savun sem Simon in’a alhunge,” ati. 7 Ajah a thusei Vantil chu apotdoh phat’in Cornelius-in insung lhacha mi nil eh hougut tah, ama vengtup’a pang sepai ho lah a khat akouvin 8 thilsoh ijakai ahilchensoh phat’in amaho chu Joppaa asoltai. 9 Ajing nikhoa amahon Joppa khopi ahinphah ding kon’un sun nidan som le ni donin Peter chu inchunga tao dingin akaldohtai. 10 Peter agilkel’a an aneh nom phat’in, neh ding agotpeh-u leh agaochangin, 11 van kihonga thil phenghep hopkhat aning lia kikhit’a leiset’a hung kikhai lha amun, 12 asunga chun leiset’a ganhing namkim, avah le akithol tho chule chunga leng adimset’uve. 13 Hichun ahenga o-khat ahung gingin, “Peter, kipat’in that’in lang nen,” ati. 14 Ahinla Peterin, “Hithei hih hel’in te Pakai, keiman itih-in jong thilbol le atheng lou ho kane ngaipoi,” ati. 15 Ahinvangin o-gin chun anivei nan ajah a, “Pathenin asuh thengsa chu bohsah hih-in,” ati. 16 Hitobang hin thumvei akibol’in chuin thil chu van lama akitol toutai. 17 Peter agaochan’a thil amuchu ipi tin a hintem tia aki-ngaito pet tah-in ven, Cornelius misol ho chun Simon in ahol’un kelkot maiya adingun 18 ahinkouvun, Peter kiti Simon chu chukoma alhun alhun lou adongui. 19 Peterin agaochan thudol agel pettah hin Lhagaovin ajah a, “Ven, mi thumin naholui; 20 dingdoh-in kumlhan lang lung sa-ih louhe’lin amaho khutoh kilhonin, ajeh chu keiman kahinsol ahiuve,” ati. 21 Chuphat’in Peter chu miho henga ahung kumsuh-in, “Ven, nahol’u chu keima kahi, nahung lo nau jeh ipiba ham?” ati. 22 Amahon, “Sepai jalamkai Cornelius, midih le Pathen ging, Juda vaipi seiphat mi chun nangma a-in’a kousah a nathusei ngai dia Vantil Thengin ahil ahi,” atiuve. 23 Hichun Peterin amaho akoulut’in alhunsah tai. Ajing nikhon Peter akipatdoh-in amaho chutoh akilhonin Joppa khoa sopite phabep’in jong aki-lhonpeuve. 24 Ajingin amaho Caesarea khopi alhungun, Cornelius chun aphunggol ho le agol apai ngaitah tah ho akoukhomin ana ngah jinge. 25 Peter ahung lut phat’in Cornelius chun analamdot paiyin, akengphang bul’ah aboh khup’in chibai aboh tai. 26 Ahinla Petein ama chu akaiding loiyin, “Dingdoh-in keijong mihem kahibouve,” ati. 27 Hitia akihoupi pum hin insunga alut leh mi tampi kikhom agatoh-in, 28 hijeh chun aman ajah-uvah, “Juda min jatchom mi kiloipia ahenga kholai leh hi Dan toh akitolou nang hon jong nahecheh-ui; ahinla Pathenin mihem koima aboh le atheng lou kiti louna din eivetsah tai; 29 hijeh a chu eihung kisol’a lung sa-ih louhel’a hung kahi. Hichejeh a chu kadoh nahi, ipi thua neihung kou sahba ham?” ati. 30 Cornelius chun adonbut’in, “Tu phat gei hin ni li alhingtan, nilhah lam nidan thum don’a kainsunga katao pet’in ven, kama sanga ponbang leh sil mi khat ana dingin, 31 ‘Cornelius, nataona akisangin, mi thil napeh chengse chu Pathen angsunga akigeldoh jinge. 32 Joppaa mi sol’in lang Peter kiti Simon chu gakousah tan; ama chu Twikhanglen panga cheng savun sem Simon in’a lhung ahi,’ ati. 33 Hijeh a chu nakou ding kahinsol pai jengle, hitia nahung jeng hi apha lheh-e. Tua keiho chengse hi Pathen mitmua kikhoma, Pakaiyin ipi naseisah ding ham ngai dia um kahiuve,” ati.

Cornelius insunga Peter thusei

34 Peter apaodoh-in, “Tahbehin Pathenin mi le mi kah a lang kaina aneipoi, ti kahedoh tai; 35 chitin namtin lah a koi hileh Ama ginga adih bol jouse chu ama dia santhei ahicheh-e, 36 Aman mi jouse Pakai, Jesu Christaa chun Israel chate henga dingin chamna Kipana Thupha thu chu ahinthot’in, 37 Johnin baptize chandol lhang asap jouvin Galilee gama pat Judea gam pumpia athu athangsoh tai, ti naheuve; 38 Nazareth Jesu chu Pathenin Lhagao Theng le thahat abuh lhah khumin, Pathenin akivopi jeh-in Ama achelen Diabol bol gentheiya aumte adamsah-in napha atong lei. 39 Judea gamsung le Jerusalema thil hichengse abol hetoh a pang keiho kahiuve; ama chu thinga akhaiyun athat tauve. 40 Ahinla Pathenin Ama chu nithum lhin nin thinaa konin akaithouvin, akiphondohsah chu 41 japi heng ahilou vangin Pathenin hettohsah a pang dia alhentum keiho heng ahin; hiti chun thinaa kona athodoh nungin Amatoh kanekhom kadon khom’uve; 42 chule mipi henga Ama hi Pathenin mihing le mithi thutan dinga atun ahitai ti kasap leuva kahettohsah diuvin eithu lhah-uve. 43 Themgao jousen Ama thudol ahttohsah-u ahin, koi hileh Ama tahsan jouse chu Ama min jal’a chonset ngaidamna amu ding aseiyui,” ati.

Chidang namdang hon Lhagao Theng akisanu
