44 Peterin hiche hi asei nalaiyin thu ngaiho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng achutai. 45 Chidang namdang ho chung geiya Lhagao Theng kipe akibuh khum jeng chu Peter toh hung lhon cheptan mi atahsan loiyin adatmo lheh jenguve. 46 Ijeh-inem itile paochom chom thoa Pathen avahchoiyu chu ajah-u ahi. Chutah chun Peterin adonbut’in, 47 “Eiho chan banga Lhagao Theng changtaa hite ho Baptize channa ding twi kham theididng koiham?” 48 Hiti chun amaho chu Jesu Christa min a baptize chang din aseitai. Amahon Peter chu niphabep beh nichong dingin alhoutauve.

Solchah 11

Jerusalem Houbunga Peter thulhut

1 solchah ho le Judea gamsunga sopiten chiding namdangten jong Pathen thu akisanu hi ajatauve. 2 Peter Jerusalema agalhun touleh cheptan loiyin ama ana oimouvin, 3 “Ibol’a cheptan lou miho henga chea an nehkhompi nahim?” atiuve. 4 Hichun Peter akipanin aban chan ajah-uvah aseipeh-in, 5 “Joppa khopia katao leh gao kachangin, Thengao thilmua mu kanei na-a thilpheng hep hop khat van’a kona aninglia hung kikhai lhaa, keima komcha hung ki-nga kamun, 6 phatecha kavet chenset leh neh thei ganhing nam kim, chunga leng vachate kamui. 7 Hichun ogin khat hin kajah a, ‘Peter, kipat’in that’in lang nen, ati kajai. 8 Ahinla keiman, ‘Hithei hih hel’inte Pakai, thilboh le atheng lou imacha kakamsunga lut kha louhel ahi,’ kati. 9 Ahivangin ogin chun van’a konin nivei chan nan eihindohbut’in, ‘Pathenin asuh thengsa chu bohsa hih-in, eiti. 10 Hitobang hin thumvei ahung kibol’in van’a akitol toutai. 11 Hichun ven, hichepet tah ahi Caesarea kona kahenga hung kisol mi thum chu kalhunna in maiya ana ding tauve. 12 Lhagaovin ma lung sa-ih louhel’a amaho chutoh lhona kache din eiseipeh-e. Hicheng sopi gup ho jong hin eilhonpuiuvin, mipa insunga chun kaluttauve. 13 Mipa chun kajah-uva a-in a Vantil ding amun, ‘Joppa mi sol’in lang Peter kiti Simon chu gakousahtan, 14 aman nang le na-insung pumpi huhhinga naum na diu Thupha naseipeh dingu ahi,’ ati thu aseitai. 15 Ajahuva thusei kagah kipat panbep leh abul’a eiho chunga achuh bang chun amaho chunga jong Lhagao Theng achutai. 16 Hichun kenjong Pakaiyin, ‘Johnin twiya baptize achansah ahin, nang ho vang Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah diu ahi,’ ati chu kageldoh-e. 17 Chutia Pathenin Pakai Jesu christa itahsanuva eipeh-u thilpeh tobang chu amaho jong apeh leh, kei koi kahiya Pathen kakham thei ding ham?” ati. 18 Amahon hiche hi ajah phat’un aneldauvin, Pathen avahchoiyun, “Ahile Pathenin chiding namdang te jong hinna dia lung heina apeh ahita ong!” atiuve.

Antioch khopia Houbung

19 Thoh hahsa asoa Stephen kitha lo jeh a jamcheh chengse chu Phoenicia le Cyprus chule Antioch geiyin acheuvin, koima dang jah a seilouvin Judate henga Thu chu aseileuve. 20 Ahin alah-uva phabep Cyprus le Cyrene miho, Antioch ahung lhun phat’un Greek miho toh akihouvun Pakai Jesu aseiphongtauve. 21 Amaho chu Pakaiyin aban thahat’in ahu jingun, hijeh chun Pakaiya atahsan mitamtah akihei luttauve. 22 Hiche thu hi Jerusalema Houbungin ajatan, hijeh chun Barnabas chu Antioch geiyin asol’un, 23 ama ahungleh Pathenin alungset nau amun akipah lheh jengin, ama ho chu Pakaiya lunggil tah a um chah jing din atilkhouvin ahi; 24 ajeh ch Barnabs hi mipha le Lhagao Theng dimset chule tahsan det mi ahi. Mi tampi Pakaiya alutbe tauve. 25 Barnabas chu Saul hol din Tarsus a achen, 26 Saul amudoh phat’in Antioch a ahinpuiye. Kum khat lhingset amanin miho chu Houbunga akikhoppi ji lhonin, mi tampi ahil lhonin, hiche Antioch khoa hi seijuite chu ‘Chritian’ ahinsah masah pen’u ahi. 27 Hiche lai hin Themgao phabep Jerusalema konin Antioch a achesuh-ui; 28 chuin alah-uva amin Agabus kitipa chu akipatdoh-in Lhagao thahat’in vannoi pumpia kel lhah ding asei masan, hiche hi Claudius nikho laiyin aguilhunge. 29 Hijeh chun seijuite chu ajikham cheh a thil tokhoma Judea gama sopite thot dingin akiloltauve; 30 adongkhom’un Barnabas le Saul khut’ah Houbung upate agah thot’ui.

Solchah 12

Jacob athau Peter songkul’a akhumu

1 Hiche lai hin Herod lengpan Houbung mi konkhat chunga ban-gol khautah-inna atongin abolsetai. 2 John upa Jacob chu chemjamin athattai. 3 Amitha hin Juda miho along lhaisah amun, Peter jong amatbe kit’e, aphat hi cholsolou changlhah kut lai ahiye. 4 Peter amat chun songkul’a akhumin, mi li lia kiloi sepaiho chun kilhauva a-nga diduvin apedoh-in, kalchuh ku tkichai tang mipi ang’a puidoh dingin agoi. 5 Hiti hin songkul’a akhumtan, ahinla Houbungin ama din lung luttah-in Pathen henga ataopeh-uve.

Songkul’a kona Peter kilhadoh

6 Herod-in Peter chu puidoh dinga agotin jan chun Peter, a-ngah sepaite kah a a-ihmun, thih khao nin akihenin, kotpi bul’a jong a-ngah a pang sepaiho adding jingui. 7 Hichun ven, Pakaiya kon Vantil khat ahung kilah-in, akikhumna bom sung avahcahnsel’e; Vantil chun Peter pang abengin asukhangin, “kipatdoh loiyin!” ati. Chutah chun akhut te nia akihenna thih khao te ni chu akilhamtai. 8 Chuin Vantil chun ajah a, “Nakong kigahin nakengchot te ni kise loiyin,” ati. Aman chutin aboltai. Chuin ajaha, “Naponin kihiutup loiyin neihin juiyin,” ati. 9 Peter apotdoh-in ama chu ajuitai; hichea chun Vantil thilbol chu atahbeh a soh-in agelpon, gaochanga mu aneiyin agelbouve. 10 Vantil le Peter chun kotngah masa le ani na akhel lhon leh khopi sung lutna thih kotkha apha lhonin, kotkhah chu ama ni dingin acham tah-in akihong jengin, apotdoh lhonin khosung lamlen khat ajui lhonleh Vantil chung Peter adalhapaitai. 11 hichun Peter akhangdoh lap’in “Tua vang Pakaiyin avantil ahinsol’a Herod ban thahat le Judate kinepna chengsea eihuhdoh ahitai, ti kahedoh tai,” ati. 12 Ahetdoh phat hin Peter chu aminchom Mark kiti John nu Mary in’a ahungleh mi tampi kikhomin anataovui. 13 Aman kot pi nung chu akiu leh donbut din amin Rhoda kiti lhacha numei khat ahunge, 14 ahin Peter ogin ahi ahetdoh phat’in akipah behseh jengin kot honta louvin alhai lut’in kot po lama Peter din thu chu agaseiphong jo tai. 15 Ahinla mihon amanu jah a, “A-gol’a nahi,” atiuve. Amanun atah mong ahi thu asei tei tei vangin, amahon, “A-Vantil hiya chu,” atibep’ui. 16 Ahinla Peterin kot akiu kiu jeng phat’in agah hon’u leh ama amu cheh-un kidang asalheh jenguve. 17 Hichun Peterin athip behna diuvin khut ajap’in, Pakaiyin itobanga kidangtah a songkul’a kona ahin puidoh ham, ti thu aseiyin, “Hicheng thusoh hi Jacob le sopite gaseipeh tauvin,” atin, apotdoh-in munchoma achetai. 18 Khovah vah-in Peter chung change thusoh jeh chun sepaiho lah a boina lentah asodoh tai. 19 Herod chun Peter ahol’a amudoh jou lou phat’in a-ngah a pang ho thu atantai. Amavang chu Judea gama konin Caesarea achesuh-in chukoma aumdentai.

Heroh thi

20 herod chu Tyre le Sidon mite chunga along hang lheh jenge; hijeh chun agam miho loikhat ahungun, lengpa Semanga pang Blastus chu athu nun’un cham lensah din athum’ui; ijeh-inem itileh agam miteu chun Herod lengpa gama neh le chah akilah-u ahiye. 21 Akitepniuvin Herod chun lengpon chol akisil’in, laltouna atouvin, ajah-uva thu aseiye. 22 Hichun mipin asam’un, “Mihem ogin ahibouve,” atiuve. 23 Aman loupina chu Pathen pelouva aumjeh-in hiche pettah chun Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in adengin, lungin anen athitai. 24 Pathen thu vang achal jal’in akhatou cheh tai. 25 Barnabas le Saul vang chu kin achaisoh lhon phat’in aminchom Mark kiti John chu ahinpui lhonin Jerusalema konin ahungkile kit lhontai.

Solchah 13

Barnabas le Saul athensouva asol’u

1 Antioch khoa Houbunga chun Themgao le mihilphabep aumun; amahon chu Barnabas, Nigerkiti Simeon, Cyrene gam mi Lucius, gambih vaipo Herod toh seilet tha Manaen chule Saul ahiuve. 2 Amaho chu Pakai kinbol’a an a-ngol laitah-un Lhagao thengin, “Kakouna natong din Barnabas le Saul neipedoh-uvin,” ati. 3 Hijeh chun an ngol’a atao jouvun achung lhona thenso khut ngap abol’un asoldoh tauve.

Cyprus gama solchah te ni thuseiphong

4 Lhagao Theng sol’a konin Barnabas le Saul chu Seleucia ajonsuh lhonin, chua pat’in Cyprus lama akitol lhontai. 5 Salamis kho alhun phat lhonin Judate Houthua kikhopna in hoa Pathen thu aseiphong lhonin, akithopi lhon ding John jong ahiuve. 6 Twikol gamsung achotsoh-uva Paphos kho ahung gei phat’in Juda mi Temgao lhem, mitpheldoi them Bar-Jesu kitipa chu amudoh tauve; 7 ama hi twikol gamvaipopa, Sergius Paulus, milung chingtah chutoh kihe ahin, gamvaipopan Pathen thu asei lhon ngai dingin Barnabas le Saul chu akouve. 8 Hichea chun mitpheldoi thempa Greek paova amin Elymas jong atipau chun amani thusei adoudal len gamvaipopan atahsan louna ding aboltai. 9 Chuin Paul kitipa Saul chu Lhagao Theng adimset’in amapa chu ave changel’in, 10 “Vo thilpha jouse doudal, lhep lhahna le nambolna dimset, Diabol son, Pakai lampi dih heikonle ding nabol hi natat lou lai ding ham? 11 Tun ven, Pakaiyin nachunga khut alhatai, phat chom khat sunga nisa vah him him namu loudidng ahi,” atileh; apettah chun meijing le muthimin ahintomin, kho amulou jeh chun akhut’a kaile ding mi aholtai. 12 Hichun Gamvaipopan thilsoh chu amun Pakai thudol kihilna kidang asan atahsantai.

Pisidia gam Antioch khoa Barnabas le Paul

13 Paul le aloite ni chu Paphos a konin akitol’un Pamphylia gama perga kho alhungun, Johnin amani dalhan Jerusalema ahung kile kittai. 14 Paul le Barnabas vang achepai lhonin Pisidia gama Antioch kho alhung lhonin Choldo nikhon Houthua kikhopna in’a alut’in atou lhontai. 15 Danthubu le Themgao lekhabu akisim chaiyin Houthua kikhopna in vaihonpan miho asol’in ajah lhona, “sopite ni mipi tilkhouna ding thu nanei lhon leh sei lhonin,” agatisah-e. 16 Hijeh chun Paul adingdoh-in khut ajah-in aseiyin: “Israel mite le Pathen gingte jousen ngaiyun. 17 Hiche Isreal mite Pathen chun i-pu i-pateu analhengdoh-in, Egypt gama apemlaiyun achoi len lheh jengin, aban thahat panin ahinpuidohtai. 18 Kum som li tobang sungin pa naovah bangin gamthip noiya akhan chah-u aven, 19 chuin Canaan gamsunga mihem nam sagi asuhmang phat’in agam’u chu agoulo diuvin apen, 20 kum ja li le som nga geiyin achenguve. Hiche nung chun Samuel Themgao nikho lai geiyin amaho chu Thutan vaibol ho apen ahi. 21 Chuin amahon leng athum’u leh Pathenin Benjamin phunga Kish chapa Saul chu kum som li geiyin akoipeh-e. 22 Pathenin Saul chu apaidoh nungin aleng thudol’a hin Keiman kalung dei tah David, Jesse chapa kamudoh tai, aman kalungdei chan abol ding ahi,’ tin hettohsahnan aseitai. 23 David chilhah a kon hin thutep dungjuiyin Pathenin Huhhingpa Jesu chu ahinlhut tan ahi. 24 Jesu kiphondoh masang hin Johnin lungheiya baptize chan ding thu Israel mipi henga aseiphonge. 25 John chun atoh achaisoh ding konin, ‘Nang hon kei hi koiya neigel’um? Keima Ama chukahipoi; amavang ven, kanunga khat ahunge, kei hi Ama kengchot khao te ni sut lham dia jong kilom kahipoi,’ ati. 26 “Abraham chilhah sopite le nalah-uva Pathen ging miho, hiche Huhhingna thu hi eiho henga hung kithot ahitai. 27 Ijeh-inem itile Jerusalema ilengteu le avaipouteuvin Ama chu anahedoh pouvin, Choldo niseh le kisimji Themgao thuseiho hcu guilhunsah nan hekhen louvin Ama chu themmo achan’un, 28 athina thei lom themmona amudoh jou lou geiyun jong Pilate henga atha na din a-ngeh-uve; 29 achung chang thudol kisei jouse asuh bulhingsoh phat’un thing chunga akikhainaa konin adom lhauvin avuitauve. 30 Ahinla Pathenin Ama chu thinaa konin akaithouvin, 31 nikho phabep pi sungin Galiee gama pat Jerusalem lama alhonpi miho henga akilah jin, amaho chu tua hi mipi henga hettohsah a pang ahiuve. 32 Chule pu le pate henga hungsoh dinga kiteppeh thutep chu keihon kipah tah a kaseiphongu ahi, 33 hiche chu Pathenin achateu eiho henga aguilhunsah nan Jesu chu akaithouvin, athudol hi labu ninaa akisunin: ‘Nangma kachapa, Tunia kahin nahi,’ akiti. 34 Mon mangna mu louhel dinga Pathenin thinaa kona akaithou thudol chu hiti jong hin aseiye: ‘Keiman David kipe thonlou le atheng Phattheina kapeh ding nahiuve,’ akiti. 35 Aman labu munchom khat’a jong aseiyin: ‘Nalhentum lhachapa chu Nangin mon mang dia naphaldoh lou idndg ahi,’ akiti. 36 David vang chun ama khang laiyin Pathen toh akivuithan, mon mangna amutan, 37 Pathenin akai thou kitpan van gmin mangna amupoi. 38 Hijeh a chu hiche hi nahet cheh diu ahi sopite, Jesu jal’a chonset jouse ngaidamna thudodl nahenguva kaseiphongu ahin, Mose Danthua kona them nachan jou louna jouseuva chu 39 koi hile atahsan chan them chang’ah ahi. 40 Hijeh chun Themgaoho thusei nachunguva ahung chuh louna din ching theiyun: 41 ‘Veuvin nahsahmo ho, Kidang sauvin lang mangthah-un; Ajeh chu nanikho laiyun thil Hitobang thil hi min seipeh jong leu chun natahsan lou hel diu ahi,’ tia asei chu,” ati. 42 Akikhendoh phat’un mihon Choldo nikit jongleh ajah-uva hiche ho aseipeh kit diuvin a-ngeh-uve. 43 Houthua kikhopna in’a akikhendoh dodh-uvin Juda mi tampi le Juda houva kilalut ah hougut tampin Paul le Barnabas nung ajuiyun, amanin amaho chu Pathen lungset naa umdet jing din atilkhou lhone. 44 Choldo nikit’in akhothing hel tobangin Pakai thu kisei ngai didngin akikhomtauve. 45 Mipi kihonlel lul’a akikhop jengu chu Juda hon amudoh phat’un athangseuvin, Paul thuseichu ataitom’un anel kale tauve. 46 Ahinla Paul le Barnabas hangtah-in thu asei lhonin, “Pathen thu hi amasaa nang ho seipeh lou khoh ahin, nang hon napai manguva tonsot hinna chang dia kilom nakisah louvu leh, ven chiding namdangte henga kihei tauvinge. 47 Ijeh-inem itile Pakaiyin keiho hitia hi eiseipeh-u ahi: ‘Keiman nang hi chidnag nam dang salvah dia katun’a, Vannoi pumpia sochatna lampi dia katun nahi,’ tia asei ahi,” ati. 48 Chidang namdang hon hicheng hi ajah phat’un akipah-un Pakai thu kisei chu achoi-an’un tonsot hinna chang dia kigosadema um hon atahsan tauve. 49 Chuin Pakai thu hiche gamkol sungsea chun achalsoh tai. 50 Amavang Juda mihon hougut numei lal ho le khopi sunga lamkaiho atilseuvin, Paul le Barnabas abolset sah-uvin agamkol sunguva konin adeldohsah tauve. 51 Amanin amaho dounan akeng phanga leivui athin lhah khum lhonin Iconium lama ache lhontai. 52 Seijui ho vang chu kipana le Lhagao thengin adimsetu’ve.

Solchah 14

Iconium koa Paul le Barnabas

1 Iconium khoa Juda ho Houthua kikhopna in’a alut khom lhonin, hitima chun thu asei lhon le Judate le Greek mi tampin atahsan tauve. 2 Hichun Juda mi atahsang lou hon sopite dounan chiding namdang ho atilseuvin adsulung hangtauve. 3 Ahivangin ama ni sotpi anichong lhonin, alungsetna thu hettohsah a amani khut’a melchihna thil kidang tampi bolsah Pakaiya hangtah-in thu asei jom jing lhone. 4 Hichun khopi sung miho chu kehni akisouvin, abang Juda miho langa apangun, abang solchah te ni lama apangui. 5 Ahinla chiding namdang ho le Juda mi phabep’in alamkaiteu toh kithon amani chu nahsahmoa bol’a songa seding agouvin ahile, 6 amanin ahetdoh lhon phat’in Lycania khopi Lystra le Derbe chule akimvel gamsunga ajamlut lhontai; 7 hikom dunga jong chun Kipana Thupha aseiphong lhone.

Lystra khoa Paul songa aseu

8 Lystra khoa chun apen’a pat kengbai, itih a jong lamjot louhel, akeng chasah thei lou hel pasal khat atouvin ahi. 9 Amahin Paul thusei angaiyin, Paul’in avechangmel’in ahileh damsah theina kham tahsan anei chu amun, 10 oging tah in, “nakeng te nin ding jangin,” ati. Mipa chu ahung kichomdoh jengin avah le paitai. 11 Mipin Paul thilbol chu amu phat’uvin Lycaonia paovin oging tah-in, “Eiho lah a Pathen ho chu mihem lim’a hung kumlha ahitauve!” tin asamtauve. 12 Barnabas chu Zeus asah-un, Paul chu thusei lamkai ahijeh-in Hermes asah-uve. 13 Chule khopi maiya ahouin kisa Zeus doi Thempupan bongchal ho ahinkaiyin pahvui ho jong ahinchoiyin dongkot phunga mipi chutoh amani hounaa kilhaina gan tha din agouve. 14 Ahinla solchah te ni Barnabas le Paul’in ajahdoh lhon phat’in aponsil abottel jeng lhonin mipi lah a alhai lut lhonin apengjah lhontan, 15 “Miho, idia hiti ho hi nabol’u ham? Keini jong nang ho banga mihem kahi lhonin, hitobang pannabei thil hoa kona hi van le leiset chule Twikhanglen le asunga um jouse Sempa, Pathen hing jing henga nakiheina diuva Kipana Thupha kaseipeh lhon nahibouvui. 16 Aman khang masa laiyin chitin namtin hi Ama dei cheh a chon din alhan, 17 ahivangin Ama ipi ahichu hettohsahna beiyin akoidehpoi, ajeh chu thilpha aboljin, van’a konin gotwi napeuvin, muchi chivo gaphat, kumkihei chin nakoipeh-un, neh le chah napeuvin, nalungthimu kipa le thanopna adim jinge,” ati lhone. 18 Hicheng hi asei lhonin amani houna dinga gan athagot’u chu asutang nah nah lhone. 19 Hichea chun Antioch le Iconiuma kona hung Juda mihon mipi chu athu anun’un Paul chu songin asesah-un, athi ahitai, tin khopi polama akaidohtauve. 20 Ahinla akoma seijuite adin pet’uvin Paul athoudoh-in khopi sunga aluttai; ajing nikhon Barnabas toh Derbe lama ache lhontan ahi, 21 Hiche khopia chu Kipana Thupha aseiphong lhona, seijuitampi asemdoh jou lhonin Lystra le Iconium chule Antioch lama ahung kile kit lhonin, 22 genthei hesoh tampi thoh a Pathen lenggama ilut mong diu ahi tin tahsana pang det jing dingin seijuiho atilkhou lhon in alungu asuhal lhon’e. 23 Houbung jousea Houbung upa alhenpeh lhonin, an ngol’in ataovun, atahsanpau Pakaiyah upa ho chu apedoh doh jenguve.

Paul le Barnabas Syria Antioch a ahung kilekit

24 Paul le Barnabas-in Pisidia ajotpa lhoin Pamphylia alhung lhonin, 25 Perga thu aseiphong jou lhonin Attalia achesuh lhontai. 26 Chua konin kongin akitol lhonin, ahintoh chaisoh lhon hiche natoh tong dinga Pathen lungsetnaa akipehdohna lhon khopi, Antioch jonin ache lhontai. 27 Ahung lhun lhon phat’in Houbung mi abonchan akhom lhonin, Pathenin amani amanchah a atoh jouse aseidoh lhonin, chiding namdangte dia tahsan lam kihon thu asei lhon’e. 28 Antioch khoa seijuite toh sotpi aumkhomna lhon chu phat chomcha ahipoi.

Solchah 15

1 Judea gama konin mi phabep ahungun sopite chu, “Mose Danthu dungjuiya chepnatan louvu leh huhhingin umthei pouvin nate,” tin ahiltauve. 2 Hiche thudol’a chun Paul le Barnabas toh akihanel lheh jengun akinahso phat’un athu ngaito khom din Paul le Barnabas to midang phabep toh Jerusalema chea Solchah ho le upaho toh kihoutoh din alhengdoh tauve. 3 Houbung sol’a konin amaho acheuvin Phoenicia le Samaria ajot pepeh-un, chidnag namdang ho Pathena akiheilut thu aseipeh-u le sopite cheng akipah lheh-ui. 4 Jerusalem alhun phat’un Houbung miho le Solchah ho chule Houbung upahon analamtouvin, ama hon ajah-uva Pathenin amaho amanchah a na atoh chengse aseiyuve. 5 Hichea hin atahsansa ahivanga Pharisee loi hinalai mi phabep akipatdoh-un, “Amaho chu chep tanpeh a Mose Danthu anit tei diu ahi,” tin asei yui. 6 Solchah ho le Houbung upaho hiche thu ngaito ding hin akikhom tauve. 7 Tamtah a kholtohna anei nungun Peter akipatdoh-in ajahuva, “Sopite, masang chun nang ho lah a kona keima kama hi chiding namdangten Kipana Thupha ajah-uva atahsanna diuva keima Pathenin eilhendoh chu naheuve, 8 chule mei lungthim hesoh Pathenin ahenguva ahettohsah-in, eiho eipeh bangun amaho jong Lhagao Theng apei; 9 ei ho le amaho kah a dat neichom louvin tahsanin alungthimu asuthengtai. 10 Chuti ahileh ibol’a tua ipu ipateu leh eihon jong ipoh jou louvu namkoljon chu seijuite lengkouva naseuva Pathen napatep’u ham? 11 Keihon vang Pakai Jesu lungset vanga tahsan jal’a huhhinga eiho i-um diu banga amaho jong chute dinga katahsanu ahi,” ati. 12 Akikhom mipi chu athip chet jengun, Barnabas le Paul’in Pahtenin amani amanchah achidang namdangte lah a melchihna ho le thil kidang aboldoh ho asei lhon chu angaisoh keiyuve. 13 Amanin thu asei chai lhonin Jacob’in adonbut’in, “Sopite kasei ngai ta diuvin! 14 Simonin chiding namdangte Pathenin avil’a alah-uva kona ama min’a ding mi alhendoh thu aseitai. 15 Hiche hi Themgaoho thusei toh akitoh soh keiyin hitin akisune: 16 ‘Hiche nung hileh Keima hung kile kit’ing ting, Alhusa David houbuh chu kasah phat’a; A-in gem jouse kasah phat ding, Katundoh kit ding ahi; 17 Chutia chu mihem amoh chengsen Pakai ahol theiyuva, Kamin a kikou chiding namdang jousen jong ahol thei ding, atin, 18 khanglui laiya pat hicheng thil ho hetsah Pakaiyin aseiye,’ kiti ahi. 19 Hijeh chun chidang namdang ho lah a kona Pathen lama hung kiheiho lah a kona Pathen lama hung kiheiho chu bolgenthei dau hite, tin ka-ngaitoi; 20 amavang amaho chu lekha thot’u hitin, doi houna thil thenglou neh, jon thanghoi, alol kimeh a kithatsa le thisan neh a kona kitim them din hil’u hite; 21 ijeh-inem itile khanglui laiya pat Mose’in khop jouseah athusei ding anei jingin, Choldo nikho seh leh ama thudol Houthua kikhopna in jouse akisim jenge;” ati.

Houbung thalheng ho lekha thot

22 Solchah ho leh Houbung upaho chule Houbung pumpi lung gel’in alah-uva kona mi lhendoh a Paul le Barnabas toh Antioch khoa sol din pha asauvin, Barsabbas kiti Judas le Silas, sopiten ajabol cheh te ni chu alhengun, 23 aban’a kisei bang hin asun’un amani khut’a athot tauve; “Solchah ho leh Houbung upa, sopite chengsen, Antioch leh Syria chule Cilicia gama um chidang namdang ho lah a sopite chengse kasalam’ui. 24 Keiho lah a konin mi koi koiham kei ho thupeh louhel’in ahungun thu tampin nahung sulung jingun lung ling laovin nakoiyui, ti kajauve; 25 hijeh chun keihon lung khat tah-in mi lhendoh a amaho chu nahenguva i-ngailut tah-u Barnabas le Paul toh hinsol tha ding pha kasauve, 26 amaho hi i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa min’a ahinkho phal ngam cheh ahiuve. 27 Hijeh a chu Judas le Silas kahinsol’u ahin, amanin jong hiti amaho hi thuchangin seipeh nauvinte. 28 Ijeh-inem itile Lhagao Thengin jong keihon jong akhoh cheh ho tilou pohgih hahsa dang na chunguva koi lou ding pha kasauvin, 29 limsemthu houna doisa, hicheng hi neh dauvin, jon thanhoiya konin kikangse leu chun pha ding hi, damsel’uvin,” atiuve. 30 Amaho chu alhah doh phat’un Antioch khoa achesuhuvin, mipi akhop khomsoh phat’uvin lekha thot chu apetauve. 31 Miho chun asimu leh tikhouna thuho chu akipapi lheh jenguve. 32 Judas le Silas hi anilhona Themgao gel ahilhonjeh-in sopite chu thu tampin atikhou lhonin ahatsah cheh lheh lhon’e. 33 Chukoma chom khat set aum jou lhonin ahinsol ho henga dingin sopiten amani chu lung mongin alhadoh tauve. 34 Silas vang chu anichon ding joh aphat jeh-in aum den tai. 35 Paul le Barnabas chu Antioch khoa mi tamtah toh aum khom lhonin, Pakai thu ahil chenin aseiphong lhon’e.

Paul le Barnabas kikhen

36 Phat chom khat nungin Paul chun Barnabas jah a, “Hungin Pakai thu i-naseiphongna khopi jousea chekit hitin sopite chu itobanga iti nauvem gave hite,” ati. 37 Hichun Barnabas-in Mark kitipa John chu amani toh kilhona pui din angaitoi. 38 Ahinla Paul’in Pamphylia amani dalhaa na tohkhompi nom lou mi chutoh kilhon khom lou ding thilpha pen ahisah e. 39 Hijeh chun Paul le Barnabas akihanel ten lhon phat’in akikhenlo lhonin, Barnabas chun Mark akipuiyin Cyprus lam jonin kongin akitol’in, 40 Paul’in vang Silas akilhenin, sopiten jong Pakai lungsetnan alhadoh-un, ama jong akipatdohtai. 41 Paul chun Syria le Cilicia ajotpeh-in Houbung jouse atilkhoupeh-in ahi.

Solchah 16

Timothyn Paul le Silas akilhonpi

1 Paul chu Derbe kho le Lystra khoa ahunge. Ven, Lystra khoa chun apa Greek mi, atahsan Juda numei khat cha amin Timothy kit seijui khat aumin, 2 ama hi Lystra kho le Iconium khoa sopite jousen aseipha lheh jengui. 3 Paul’in Timothy hi kilhonpi ding adeijeh-in, chute dunga um Judah on apa Greek mi ahi ahetjeh-uvin apuiyin chep atanpeh e. 4 Hichun amahon khopi jouse achonsoh keiyun, Jerusalema Solchah ho le upaho kilolna chengse chu nit din miho apeleuvin ahi. 5 Hijeh chun Houbung ho chu tahsan lama ahat cheh cheh jengun, niseh-in amijat apun be be jenguve.

Paul’in gaochannaa Macedonia mi khat amu

6 Amahon Asia gamsunga thu asei diu Lhagao Thengin akham jeh-in Phrygia le Galatia gamkol sungse ajotsoh keiyun, 7 Mysia gam gal ahung gei phat’uvin Bithynia lut ding akigot’u leh Jesu Lhagaovin aphalpeh pouve; 8 hijeh chunMysia gam ajot paiyun Troas a achesuh tauve. 9 Hiche jan chun Paul agaochan naa mu aneiyin, Macedonia mi khat hi ahungna dingin ataovin, “Macedonia hung galkaiyin neihung kithopiuvin,” ati. 10 Paul’in gaochan naa mu anei jou jou hin Pathenin Kipana Thupha chu miho hil dinga eikouvu ahi, tin kagel’uvin Macedonia gama chelut ding kasompaitauve.

Christa dia Lydia hinkho kikhel

11 Troas a pat kakitol’uvin paljangin Samothrace kajon’un, ajing nikhon Neapolis kalhunguve; 12 hichea kon chun Macedonia gam kolsunga khopi minthang pen, Rome mite tolpi Philippi kalhung tauve. Hiche khopia hin nikho phabeppi kanichongui. 13 Choldo nikhon taona mun khat aume, ti kaginchat nau khopi dongkot polam vadung panga chun kacheuvin, katouvun numei hung kikhomho jah a thu kaseitauve. 14 Kathuseiyu ngaiya numei khat chu amin Lydia ahin, Thytira khopia hung kon, ponsandup joh a pang, Pathen hou khat ahi, Paul thuseiho lung luttah a angaina din Pakaiyin along kot ahonpeh tai. 15 Amanu hi-ainsung mite to baptize achan phat’in, “Pakai tahsan tah beh a neigel’u leh ka-in’a hung lhunguvin,” tin eijol’uvin, eithu nun tauvin ahi.

Philippi khoa Paul le Silas songkul lut

16 Taona muna chu kacheu le khonung thusoh ding seiya apute dinga phatchomna lentah mupeh lhagaoboh vop soh nu-ngah khat hin eitoh khauvin ahi. 17 Hiche nu hin Paul le keiho nung ajuiyin, “Hiche miho hi Pathen chungnung pen lhachate ahiuvin, huhhingna lampi nahung hil’u ahi,” tin asam sam jenge. 18 Hitobang hin nikho tampi sungin abol jinge. Paul’in athei chimjeh phat’in akiheiyin lhagao jah achun, “Hiche nua koon chun hung potdoh jengin, tia Jesu Christa min a kasol nahi,” atileh; hichepet tah chun lhagao chu apotdoh tai. 19 Aputeu akinepnau phatchom na aneidiu sum mu na ding abeitai, ti amudoh phat’un Paul le Silas chu aman’uvin kailhang mun’a vaipoho ang sunga akailutauve; 20 hitia hi thutan vaihomho heng alhut phat’un, “Hiche mi te ni hi Juda mi ahi lhonin, i-kho sungu asuboi lheh jeng lhontai. 21 Ama nin Rome mi eiho dinga jop thei lou le lah thei lou chondan sodoh dingin ago lhon’e,” atiuve. 22 Mipin ma amani anokhum jeng phat’uvin, vaipoten aponsil lhon ahoh lhauvin mol’a voh din thupeh aneitauve. 23 Mol’a tamtah vei avoh jouvun songkul’a akhum’uvin, songkul ngahpa chun kitup keiya a-nga din ahilchah tauve. 24 Hitobanga hil chahna aneijeh-uvin songkul ngahpan songkul sung nung lama akoiyin, akhochong lhon’a bul atuh-in ahi. 25 Jan khangkim donin Paul le Silas Pathen henga atao lhona la asah lhon le sohchang dang hon angaiyuve; 26 hichun photlot louvin lingnasa tah ahung kihot’in ahile songkul bul ahot kangsoh tan, apettah chun kotpi jouse akihong don tan, akihen nau bul jouse geiyin akilhamsohtai. 27 Songkul ngahpa ahung kin khah le kotkhah jouse kihongsa um chu amun, sohchang jouse jamdoh hitante, tin ama kithah din achemjam asatdoh jenge. 28 Hichun Paul’in going tah-in asamin, “Kithat didng kigo hih hel’in keiho ka-umsoh keinauve,” ati. 29 Chuphat’in aman meivah athum loiyin alhai lut’in, kichaa kithing thingin Paul le Silas angsunga alhu jengin, 30 chuin amani chu ahinpuidoh-in, “Put e ni, huhhinga ka-umna dinga kabol khoh pen ding ipi ham?” atileh; 31 Amanin, “Pakai Jesu tahsan le chun nang le na-insung mi huhhinga naum diu ahi,” ati. 32 Hiti hin ama le a-insunga um chengse jah a Pakai thu aseipeh lhontai. 33 Hiche nidanle le hin janlaiyin songkul ngahpan amani chu apuiyin, avoh nau maha jouse asop theng peh-in, a-insung mite le ama baptize achangtai. 34 Chujouvin amani chu ain’a ahinpuitouvin a-angsung lhona ankong aluipeh-in, Pathen atahsan jeh chun a-insung mite jouse to kipah thanom khom-uve. 35 Khovah phat’in vaipoten mi man sole ho asol’uvin, “Mi te ni chu lhadoh tauvin,” agatisah-ui. 36 Hichun songkul ngahpan athu sei chengsu hi Paul jah a aseiyin, “Vaipoten nangni lhadohna thu sei din mi ahinsoltai; hijeh chun tun hungdoh lhonin lang lung mongin ch lhontan,” ati. 37 Ahi vangin Paul’in miho jah achun, “Rome mi kihiya themmona beiya amahon japi maiya eivouva songkul’a eikhum’uva, tua guh thim’a iti tilhadoh diu ham? Hitheiponte, amahon eihung puidoh-u hem,” ati. 38 Mi man sole hon athu hi vaipote heng alhut’u le, Rome mi ahi ti ajah phat’un akicha cheh kit’un, 39 hijeh chun aheng lhona kiphat lam thu ahung seiyun, apuidohuvin khopia kona potdoh dingin ajoltauve. 40 Hiti chun amani songkul’a apotdoh-in Lydia avepa lhonin sopite to akimuto’uvin, atil khou lhonin apotdoh lhontai.

Solchah 17

Thessalonica thunoh boina

1 Amphipolis le Apollonia jotpaiya Thessalonica khoa ahung lhon leh hia chun Juda ho Houthua kikhopna in khat aum’e. 2 Achonna ngai banga Paul chu ahenguva alut’in, Choldo nikho thum sungin Pathen lekhabua konin mipichu akinelpi jin, 3 Messiah chun gin genthei athoh tei ding le thinaa kona atodoh tei ding thu ahilchenin phot chena aseipeh-in, “Nahenguva kaphondoh hiche Jesu hi Messiah chu ahitai,” ati. 4 Hichun alah-uva mi phabep’in dih asauvin paul le Silas ajop’un, Pathen ging Greek mi tampin chule numei lal ho lah a jop’a jong atamuve. 5 Chutah chun Juda miho athangseuvin, khopi sung lamlen dunga pananbei mithase phabep akhomun, khopi sunga boina lentah asosah-uvin, Jason in abulu’vin, Paul le Silas ahol’un mipi lah a kaidoh din ago’uve. 6 Amani amu lou phat’un Jason le sopite phabep pi khopi sung vaipote angsunga akailut’un, “Hiche ho hi vannoi akhup athal’a leh ho chu ahiuvin, hikom ahinphah-u ahitai, 7 Jason hin amaho alhunsah-in, ‘Jesu kiti leng chom khat aum’e,’ tin Caeasar thupeh chengse kal lhahnan abonchan na atongui,” tin asam’uve. 8 Hicheng hi ajah phat’un mipi le khopi sung vaipote jong anoh lheh jenguvin, 9 hijehchun Jason le midang hoa kilhadoh man alauvin amani chu alhadoh tauve.

Solchah ho Berea kho alhun

10 Sopiten kinloi tah-in ajan janin Paul le Silas chu Berea khoa asoltauve; alhun lhon phat’in Juda ho Houthua kikhopna in’a alut lhon’e. 11 Berea khoa Juda miho chu Thessalonica khoa ho sangin along lenjo’uvin, lung opkai louhel’in thu asangun, athilsoh ho chu chute mong nam tin niseh le Pathen lekha to avetoh jiuve. 12 Hichea hin mi tampin atahsan lo tauvin, Greek mi numei lel ho le pasal ho jong atahan atam’uve. 13 Thessalonica khoa Juda mihon Barea khoa jong Paul’in Pathen thu asei phong ahet phat’un chukoma jong mipi ahung tiles kit tauve. 14 chuphat’in sopiten Paul chu Twikhanglen pamlama asol pai jengun, Silas le Timothy vang chua aumden lhon’e. 15 Paul gathah hon Ahen khopi geiyin apuiyun, Paul’in Silas le Timothy chu ahenga hung loi ding adeina thupeh kengin ama ho ahung kile kittauve.

Athen khopia Paul

16 Paul’in Athen khopia Silas le Timothy a-nga pet’in khopi sunga limsemthudoi dimset’a kikoi amudoh-in alunng nalheh jenge. 17 Hijeh chun Houthua kikhopna in’a miho le Pathen ging ho toh akinel’in, kailhangdunga jong niseh leh ato phah chant oh akinel nel ji’e. 18 Hichea hin Epicurea loi le Stoic loi chihgut mihon Paul akinelpiuvin, alah-uva mi kon khat’in, “Hiche kamtam belbulpa hin ipi asei ding hi-nga na?” atiuvin, adang hon ma, “Gamdang miho hou, doi le kao asei ahitoh-e,” atiuve. Hiche hi ama Jesu le athodoh kit thu aseiphongjeh ahi. 19 Mihon Paul chu aman’un Areopagus molvum kikhopnaa apuiyun, “Hiche nasei thuhil thah hi kahetbe thei diu ham? 20 Ajeh chu kajah-uva nasei abang bang hi alamdang lheh jengin, hijeh a chu hiche ho hi ipi kiseina mong ham ti kahet chet nom’u ahi,” atiuve. 21 Athens kho mite le akhosunga cheng gamdang mi abonchauva ima dang gel louva thuthah thah seina le ngai naa phat amanjiu ahi. 22 Hichun Paul Areopagus lai lunga adingin miho adonbut’in, “Athen kho mite, ima lam jousea nang ho hi hougut tah nahiu kamui. 23 Ijeh-inem itile nahou mun chengu kavet le naa ‘Hetphah lou Pathen ding,’ tia kijih maicham khat kamu doh-e. Hiche nang hon het louva nahouvu hi keiman nahenguva kahung seiphong ahi. 24 Vannoi leiset le asunga um thil jouse sem Pathen, van le leiset Pakai chu mihem dem thu doiphung dunga apansapoi; 25 thil ngaichat nei banga mihem khutsoh a jen lun glhai thei jong ahipoi; Amatah-in mi jouse ahinsah, ahaitheisah a chule thil ijakai apeh joh ahibouve. 26 Aman mihem khat’a kona leiset chunga chang ding chitin namtin hijat asemdoh a, gamgi asekhenpeh cheh a aphat teppeh a achensah ahi; 27 amahon Pathen chu kinemtah a hol’uva amaikhah thei na diuva ahol ahin, ahinla Ama chu eiho koimacha dia jong gamla lou ahiye; 28 ijeh-inem itile: ‘Eiho Ama jal’a hinga, Chatloh, chule Amaa ihiuve,’tin nalah-uva chiguh sun hon aseiyui; ‘Tahbeh-in eiho ama chilhah ahiuve,’ tin aseinauve. 29 Eiho jong Pathen chilhah ihijeh-uva chu mihem lunggel le khut them man chah a sana ham, dangka ham, song ham a limsemthu tobang chu Pathen hinte tia igel lou diu ahi. 30 Het loulai khang chu Pathenin avet thim ahin, tun vang mutin’a mi jouse lung aheina diuvin thu apei, 31 ipijeh-inem itileh aman amilhendohpa amanchah a thudih a vannoi leiset hi thu atanna dinga nikho khat atepsa ahitan, hiche hi tahsan din amilhendohpa chu thinaa konin akaithoutai,” ati. 32 Thinaa kona thodoh kit thu ajah phat’un, mi phabep’in anuisat uvin, adang hon vang, “Hiche nasei hi ka-ngaikit nom’ui,” atiuve. 33 Hichun Paul alailunguva konin apotdohtai. 34 Mi phabep’in vang akilhonpiuvin atahsan tauve, alahuva hin Areopagus a kikhomji lah a mi Dionysius le Demaris kiti numei khat le adang ho jong ahiuve.

Solchah 18

Corinth khopia Paul

1 Hiche jou vin Paul’in Athens dalhan Corinth ajontai. 2 Hichea hin Claudius lengpan Judate aboncha Rome a kona potdoh dia thu apeh jeh a Italy gama kona ajinu Priscilla toh hung lhungtil, Pontus gama peng Juda mi amin Aquila kiti chu akimupin, aheng lhona achen, 3 pon in sem ahicheh jeh-uvinm akiveinau akitha khat ahijeh chun akom lhona apansan na atongkhom’uve. 4 Choldo niseh leh Houthua kikhopna in’a Juda ho l eGreek mite chu thu aseitohpi jin jol lut tei din agoji’e. 5 Macedonia gama kona Silas le Timothy ahung lhun phat’in, Paul chu thu seiphongin bou apangin, Juda ho henga Jesu chu Messiah ahidol ahettohsah-e. 6 Ahinla amahon adoudal’un, ataitomuleh, Paul’in aponsil ho athingin ajah-uva, “Manthaina naneiyu leh nang hon ma nakipoh diu ahi! Keiman themmona kaneipoi! Tua kalvang chiding namdang te henga kachei!” ati. 7 Hiti chun chua konin achen Pathen ngaisah tah mi amin Titus Justus kitipa in’a aluttai; ama in chu Houthua kikhopna in bantah ma ahi. 8 Houthua kikhopna in vaipo Crispus chun a-insung mi chengse toh Pakai atahsanin, chule athu ja Corinth mi tampin jong atahsanun baptize achangtauve. 9 Jan’a Paul’in Themgao thilmua mu aneinaa Pakaiyin, “kichat dan, umthim louhel’in seijom jingin; 10 ajeh chu Keiman ka-umpi jingin, koiman suhset dia nanokhum lou ding ahi; ijeh-inem iti le hiche khopi sung jenga jong mihem tampi kaneiye,” ati. 11 Hijeh chun Paul kum khat le lhagup alah-uva apansan Pathen thu ahil hil jenge. 12 Achaia gam gamvaipoa Gallio apan laiyin Juda ho apangkhomun Paul aman’uvin thutannaa ahinkailut’un, 13 “Hichepa hin chonna dan nagilouva Pathen hou din miho ajol lha lhai,” atiuve. 14 Hichea hi Paul pao akigot leh Gallio chun Juda ho jah a, “Vo Juda ho, namiheh nau hi suhkhelna ham khan gitlouna ham thu hileh kangaipeh ding nahiuvin, 15 nang ho Danthua le min ho thudol vang nang hon kivet tup tauvin, hiche hoa hin keima thutanin pang ponge,” ati. 16 Hiti hin thutanaa konin aban nodohtai. 17 Amahon Houthua kikhopna in vaipo Sothenes chu aman’un thutanna in mai laitah a avoh jeng vangun, Gallio chun donin aseppoi.

Paul Antioch khoa ahung kile kit

18 Paul chu nisot tah sopite toh aumkhomin, chuin amaho chutoh akilhan, Priscilla le Aquila toh lhonin Syria lam ajontai. Cenchreas khoa kitepna anei jeh-in sam akivoi. 19 Ephesus kho ahung lhun’un Paul’in amani dalhan, Houthua kikhopna in’a alut’in Juda ho toh thu asuitoh-ui. 20 Amahon nichong sot jep dia alho vangun anompon, 21 amaho toh akilhan, “Pathen lungdei ahileh nahenguva hung kit nange” atin, Ephesus khoa konin apotdohtai. 22 Paul Caesarea khopia akumlhan, Jerusalema achetouvin Houbung miho salam agabol’in, Antioch lama achesuh paitai. 23 Chukoma chomkhat aum nungin akipatdoh-in Galitia le Phrygia gamkol muntin akhol len, seijuite aphutdet len ahi.

Ephesus khopia Apollos thu lhangsap

24 Juda mi Alexandria peng, amin Apollos kiti khat Ephesus khopia ahungin, amahi thusei them le Pathen lekhabua themtah jong ahi. 25 Apollos chu Pakai lampi kihil themsa, Lhagaova gunchu tah ahin, Jesu thudol aseiyin kitoh chet’in ahilnan, ahivangin John baptize chandol chubou anahei. 26 Ama hi akipat’in Houthua kikhopna in’a hakattah-in thu aseiye; ahinla Prisilla le Aquilan athusei ajah lhon phat’in apui lhonin Pathen lampi chu kichentah-in ahilchen lhone. 27 Apollos chu Achaiiiia gama ache nom phat’in sopiten atilkhou’un seijuiten anasan theina diuvin phatseina lekha jong asutpeh-ui. Ahung lhunin lungset vanga atahsante chengse hatah-in akithopi; 28 ijeh-inem itile Jesu chu Messiah ahidol Pathen lekhabua konin phot chetna tampin Juda ho chu japi maiya anel khuptai.

Solchah 19

Ephesus khopia Paul

1 Apollos Corinth khopia aumpet’in Paul chun sahgam lam alhahpeh-in Ephesus khopia ahungle hikoma chun seijui phabep amun, 2 hiche ho jah achun “Natahsan’uva chu Lhagao Theng nachanu hinam?” atileh; amahon ajah a, “Lhagao Theng aum’e, tobon kija kha loulaiya,” atiuve. 3 Chuphat’in Paul’in, “Ipipen tah a ba baptize chang nahiuvem?” atileh; amahon, “John baptize chansah bangin,” atiuve. 4 Hichun Paul’in, “John chun lung heina dinga baptize achansah a, anunga hung dingpa, Jesu chu atahsan theina diuva miho aseipeh ahibouve,’ ati. 5 Hichu ajah phat’un amaho Pakai Jesu minin baptize achangun, 6 Paul’in achunguva akhut te ni a-ngap le Lhagao Theng achunguva ahung chun, amahon paochom chom thon gaothu aseitauve. 7 Abon’un mi som le ni tobang bep ahiuve. 8 paul chu Houthua kikhopna in’ah alut’in, kicha louhel’in lha thum sungin miho chu Pathen leng gam thu asuitohpin, jollut tei din agoi. 9 Ahinla mi phabep alouchal’a atahsan louvu toh chule mipi maiya chuche Lampi chu aseiset phat’uvin Paul’in amaho chu adalhan, seijuite apuidoh-in, niseh le Tyrannus kihilna in’a akihoulimpiji’e. 10 Kum ni sunga hitia hi abol lehAsia gama cheng, Juda ho le Greek mite geiyin Pakai thu ajasoh tauve.

Sceva chapate

11 Pathenin thil kidang seithei louhel hel Paul khut’in aboltan, 12 Paul ultheh pon le a-op tomna pon ho san achoiyun ana damlouho henga apoh lut’u leh anat nauvin alhauvin lhagaoboh jo jong apotdohjitai. 13 Hichun Juda mi vahvei doithemnaa kivah loiyin jong lhagaoboh vopte chunga Pakai Jesu min apan’un, “Paul’in aseiphongle Jesu jal’a kahahsel nahiuve,” atitauve. 14 Hitia bol ho chu Juda mi thempu pipu Sceva chapate ahiuve. 15 Ahinla lhagaoboh chun adanbut’in ajah-uva, “ken Jesu kahen Paul jong kahenai; nang ho koi nahiuvam?” ati. 16 Chuin lhagaoboh voppa chu achomin achunguva achuh jengle mi ni athajo paiyin, abonchauva athajosoh phat’in in’a kon chun sagoh keo le mapun ajamdoh tauve. 17 Athusoh hi Ephesus khopia cheng Juda mi jouse le Greek mi jousen ahesoh tauvin, akicha lheh jenguve; hijeh chun Pakai Jesu min aloupi cheh tai. 18 Atahnsan ho jong ahungun japi maiya atahsanu chu aphongdoh-un athilbol’u aseidoh tauve. 19 Mitpheldoi them tampin alekha jouseu ahinpo khom’un mitin mitmun ahalvam’uve; ahalvam sangsom nga alhinge. 20 Hiti hin Pakai thu hahattah-in akhang touvin ajousohtai.

Ephesus khopia thunoh baotam

21 Thilsoh hicheng kichai nung hin Paul’in alungthimin Macedonia le Achaia gam chotsoh a Jerusalema chepai ding. “Hiche kichai soh teng Rome kagamutei ding ahi.” Ati. 22 Ahivangin alhacha Timothy le Erastus Macedonia gama, asol’in, ama Asia gama chom khat aum nalaiye. 23 Hiche lai hin chuche Lampi thudol’a boina chu thuneo them ahitapoi. 24 Ijeh-inem itile dang ka kheng them Demetrius kiti mi khat hin Artemis doilim houna inlim dangkaa asemdoh a, dangka kheng themho dia kiveina asohdoh chu thil neocha ahipoi. 25 Hiche miho hi le asumkol veinau kibahpi chengse akoukhomin, “Mihem ho, hiche akiveinauva kona haodoh ihiunahecheh-ui. 26 Ephesus khopi sung goh hilouvin Asia gam pumpi chansah pai ding ahitan, hiche Paul hin mihem khut’a kisemthu ho hi Pathen ahipoi, tia mi aloi loiya tamtah ajol lhah a aheimang gam ahitai, ti mujong namu’uvin he jong naheuve. 27 Hichea hi ikiveinau manlou asoding kichat aumgoh hilouvin ipathen len nu Artemis houin geiya nahsahmoa hung kibol’a, Asia gam pumpi le vannoi pumpin ahou cheh Pathen len nu geiya suhjuma hung umtah bah ding ahi,” ati. 28 Mihon hichu ajah tah-un along hang lheh jengun, “Ephesus mite Artemis alen’e,” tin asam cheh-ui. 29 Hiti chun akhothingiin alingsoh jengun, mihon Paul toh hung jinkhom Massssedonia gam mi Gaius le Aristarchus chu aman’un japi lemkhomna in’a alhoh lut jengui. 30 Paul chu japi lailunga agalutnom vangin seijuiten aphal pouve; 31 Asia gam vaipo aloite phabep man japi lenkhomna in’a ahunglut louhelna din mi ahinsol’un ahung kham’ui. 32 Akikhom chengse chun ipi jeh a kikhom ahiu ahetchet loujeh-un aboi lhehjengun, abang in thu khat asamun, kimkhat man thuchom khat asam’ui. 33 Mipi phabep’in vang Judah on japi maiya ahinsot lut’u Alexander chu a ngoh-un, hijeh chun Alexanderin japi maiya akihonna seidin khut ajep’e. 34 Ahin mihon ma chu Juda mi ahi ahetdoh phat’un, “Ephesus mite Artemis alen’e!” tin o-khat tah-in nidan ni jen asam sam jengui. 35 Hichun khopi sung lekha sunpan mipi aphoh thip’in, “Ephesus kho mite, Ephesus khopia hi Artemis len nu le van’a kona hung lenglha song theng kikoi ahi kon ahetmoa nabol’u ham? 36 Hiche thil ho hi seitoh ahilou het’a thip beh a na-um’uva kholtoh louva jong chu namoh bol lou diu ahi. 37 Hichea nahinkai lut jengu miho jong hi houin choma la ahipouvin, Pathen nu taitoma jong ahipouve. 38 Hichejeh chun Demetrius le atoh khompi khut them hon mi khattou chunga lung lhai louna aneiyule kihehna in honsa ahin, thutan vaihom ho jong aum nauve, akiheh nom nom gakiheh tauhen. 39 Hiche kalval’a thudang nahol’u aum vangleh angaiyin khoppilen teng seitoh ding ahibouve. 40 Ajeh chu tuni boina thua hi mipi tilsea eiki-ngoh diu tijat kichentah a seithei ding jong i-umpouvin ahi,” ati. 41 Hiche hi aseiyin khoppi chu alhadohtai.

Solchah 20

Macedonia le Greek gama Paul kholjin

1 Khopi boina athip phat’in Paul’in seijuite akoukhomin, amaho atilkhou nungin akilhahpin Macedonia gam jonin akipatdohtai. 2 Macedonia gamkol sungse se achotsoh a tilkhouna nasatah anei jouvin Greek gama ahung lhungtai. 3 Hiche gama chun lhathum achamin, Syria gam jon’a achegot leh Judah on achanlhih jeh-un, Macedonia gam jot lhungkei kit din akigotai. 4 Hichun Beroea khoa Pyrrhus chapa Sopater chun alhonpin, Thessalonica khoa Aristarchus le Secundus, Derbe khoa Gaius le Timothy, Asia gam mi tychicus le Trophimus jong ahiuve. 5 Amaho hi anacheuvin troas khoa eina ngah-ui; 6 keiho vang cholsolou changlhah kut jouvin phillippi khopia konin kongin kakitol’un ni-nga lhin nin Troas khoa ahengu kalhungun, hikoma chun ni sagi kanichongui.

Paul’in Troas khopi avil chaina

7 Choldo nikho jou ni masa nia changlhah nekhom din kakikhop’u le Paul’in ajing nikhoa che ding agot jeh-in jan khangkim geiyin miho thu ahil hil jenge. 8 Chungnung indan kakikhop nauva chun meivah tampi akivah-e. 9 Hichea chu gollhang amin Eutychus kiti khat bangkot geiya tou ahin, Paul’in thu aseisot jeh chun golhangpa hi aihmut asoh behseh jengin, anaihmu lhutan, chungnung indan thumnaa konin alha mangin ahileh athisan agaphongdoh-ui. 10 Hichun Paul akumlhan golhangpa akoichah denin, “Tija hih-un, ajeh chu asunga ahinkho aum nalaiye,” ati. 11 paul akaltouvin changlhah ahehbal bal’in, anen, jingkah khovah lhah geiyin miho to akihoulimin, chuin apotdohtai. 12 Mihon gollhangpa chu ahingin akipuiyun seithei louhel’in along mongui.

Paul Troas apat Miletus gei konga akitol

13 Keihon kong lam kajon’un, Paul chu kong sunga lalut din Assos lama kakitol’ui; ijeh-inem itile aman hiche geiya chu kenglama che ding agot ahiye. 14 Paul’in Assos mun’a eikimupi phat’un konga kalalut’uvin Mitylene lang kajontauve. 15 Chua konin konga kakitol’un ajing nikhon Chios gal kalhungui; athai nin Samos kalhungun, athai nin Miletus kalhung tauve. 16 Ijeh-inem itile Paul’in ahithei leh Pentecost nikhoa Jerusalema lhun tei ding agot jeh-in, Asia gama umsot louna din konga kitol’a Ephesus khopi chu palam ajotpa ding agot ahitai.

Paul’in Ephesus upaho akihoupi

17 Paul’in Miletus khoa konin Houbung upaho kou din Ephesus khoa mi asol’e. 18 UPaho ahenga ahung phat’in Paul chun ajah-uvah, “Asia gam kahin chotlut’a pat hitih chan’a hi itobang nang ho toh kalhat khom umchan naheuvin, 19 Juda hon eichan lhih jinguva thoh hesoh tampi kachunga alhunvangin nun nemtah le mit lhi pumin Pakai kin kabol jing jin; 20 itobang tah a in beihel’a thil phachom ding chu japi lah hihen intin hijongle nang ho kahilji hitam! 21 Juda ho hihen Greek mite hijongle kibang cheh-in Pathen lama lung aheiyuva i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa atahsanna diuvin kahetsahji’e. 22 Chule tan ven, Lhagaova kigahna jeh-in Jerusalem lam kajonin, chukoma kahcunga ipi ahung lhun ding kahepoi; 23 khopi jousea kanchalna le hesoh gentheinan ei-nga jing bou Lhagao thengin eihetsah ahi. 24 Ahivangin Pathen lungset Kipana Thupha hettohsah ding Pakai Jesua kalah katoh ding kin hi kamolso poule kahinkho jeng jong hi imacha man din ka-it chapoi. 25 Nalah-uva chelae Pathen langgam seiphongle kahin, ahinla ven, nang hon kamai namukit louhel diu tan kahetai. 26 Hijeh a chu tunia kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, amangthah um jongleur chun mi kapopoi; 27 ijeh-inem itile nahenguva Pathen lungdei apumpia hetsah lou in mang kaneipoi. 28 Kichih thieyun lang nachin diuva Lhagao Thengin napeh-u kelngaohon chunga jong ching theiyun, Pathenin athisana achohsa a-Hobung chu ching them’uvin. 29 Kache nungle ngei giloutah tah nalah-uva hung lut’a kelngoihon hi adep louhel dingkahetai; 30 nang ho lah akona jongmi hung kipat’uva thu akaleh akalouva seiya seijuite phabep geiya apui manguva akijuisah diu ahi. 31 Hijeh chun kiging phauvin, kum thum sunga tang louhel’a sun le jan’a mit lhi puma nachang cheh-uva katilkhou jing chu geldoh jingun. 32 Chule tua hi nang ho khantousah thei le suh thengsa ho lah a gou chankhomsah thei Pathen le alungset thua nang ho kakhum lut nahitauve. 33 Koima dangka sana, nihchen ponsil kadeipoi. 34 Kei le kaloi ho ngaichat chan hiche kakhut te ni hin abol bulhit jing nang ho tah-in nahet’u ahi. 35 Pakai Jesu amatah-in,’Lah sangin peh nopnajo ahi,’ ati chu geldoh jinga na hatoh a alhasam chatmo ho kithopi theina dia thil ijakai najui diuvin kavetsahsoh tauve,” ati. 36 Paul’in thu hicheng aseiyin dilsun abonchauvin ataopitai. 37 Chutah-in abonchauvin akap-un, Paul akoiyun achop’uve; 38 ajahuva, amai amukit lou diu aseijeh tah jong chun na asa behseh jengun ahi. Chuin kong mun geiyin ahung thah-ui.

Solchah 21

Paul’in Jerusalem ajot

1 Upaho toh kakilhauvin jangkeiyin kongin kakitol’un Cos kalhungui; ajingin Rhodes kalhungun, chua konin Patera kalhunguve; 2 chuin Phoenica jotpa ding kong khat kamu’vin, kong chun katouvun kakitoltauve. 3 Cyprus twikol akimu phah phat’in veilam ngan kapel’un Syria lam jonin kakitol paiyun, konga thil solhah ding aumjeh-in Tyre khopia ka-ki-ngauve. 4 Seijuiho kaholdohun hikoma chun ni sagi kanichongui; Lhagaova konin amaho hin Paul Jerusalema ache ding ajadauve. 5 Nikho chujat kanichon jouvun kakipatdoh-uvin kholjin ban kamasot tauve; hichea hin seijuite chu ajite achateu pumin khopi kulpamgeiyin eihung thah-un, Twikhanglen pamchin’a dilsun kataovun, khat kaht’in kakilhauvin, 6 keiho kong sunga kakaldoh-un, amaho inlama akiletauve. 7 Twichung kholjin chainan Tyre a konin Ptolemais gei kaki tol’un, hikoma chun sopite salam kabol’un akom’uvah nikhat kanichongui. 8 Ajing nikhon kakipatdoh-un Caeasarea kalhungun, sagi lah a Philip Evangelist pu in’a kalut’uvin amatoh ka-um khom’uve. 9 Philip hin cha nu jinei loulai cheh li aneiyin, amaho hi gaothuseiyin apangui. 10 Nikho phabeppi chukoma ka-um laiyu hin Judea gama konin amin Agabus kiti Themgao khat ahungsuh-in, 11 kahengu ahinjonin Paul konggah chu alan akhut te ni le akeng te ni akikanin, “Lhagao Thengin hitia hi, Jerusalema Juda mihon hiche konggah neipa akan’uva chiding namdang ho khut’a apehdoh diu ahi,’ tin aseiye,” ati. 12 Hichu kajah phat’un keiho le chukoma um mihon Paul chu Jerusalema chetou lou din kaholtauve. 13 Ahinla Paul’in adonbut’in, “Ibol nahiuva kap’a kalung nasuhdoiyu ham? Ajeh chu kanchal ding keo hilouva Jerusalema Pakai Jesu min’a thi dinga kogosadema um kahi,” ati. 14 kathu nun joulou phat’un kahaiyun, “Pakai lunggot got himai hen,” katitauve. 15 Nikho phabep jouvin kakigouvin Jerusalema kachetouvun, 16 Caesarea konin seijui phabep’in eilhonpiuvin, amaho hin kalhunna dingpau, Cyprus twikol’a mi Mnason kitipa in’a chun eipuilut’uve.

Paul’in Jacob akimupi

17 Jerusalem kalhun’u le sopiten kipah tah-in eina sangui. 18 Ajingnikhon keiho toh lhonin Paul chu Jacob kimupin achen, upaho chengse jong akimkeiyui. 19 Amaho asalam soh phat’in Paul’in alhacha natohnaa kona chiding namdangte lah a Pathen thilbol chengse chu abonchan aseitai. 20 Amahon hichu ajah phat’un Pathen avahchoiyuvin ajah a, “Sopi, atahsan te lah a Juda mi sang ijat pang tam ti namui, abonchauva Danthua tom ngaitah ahiuvin, 21 nang hin chiding nam dan glah a cheng Juda mihon Moses Danthu apaiyuva, achateu chep tandaa chule puchon pachon adonda diuvin ahil’in asei lei tin min aseipeh-uve. 22 Ipi iti ding hitam? Nahunghi la ajah tei diu ahitan; 23 Hichea hin i-khat seipeh unge hichu bol’in; kitepna neisa mi li kaneiyun, 24 amaho hi puiyin lang acholamu topeh-in, nangma jeng jong amaho hitoh kisuthengin, chutile sam akivo thei diu ahin, chuteng nangma nasa tah-a chondan nit mi nahi, nachung change thu kithang jou ahidol mitinin ahet soh diu ahi. 25 Atahsan chiding namdang ho thudol vang hi limsemthu houna doithil neh lou ding, thisan neh lou ding, alol kimeh a kithatsa neh lou ding le jonthanhoi bol lou ding thua lekha ithotsu ahitai,” atiuve. 26 Chuphat’in Paul’in miho chu apuiyin, ajing nikhoa amatoh kisuh thengna kin abolsoh phat’uvin itih tah le kisuh thengna nikho kichaiya chule amaho mi khat khat dia chu kilhaina gantha itih a kibol ding ham, ti hetsah din Houin agalut’e.

Houin sunga Paul amat’u

27 Nisagi alhin ding konchan Asia gama hungkon Juda mihon Houin sunga Paul amudoh-un, japi atilseuvin achunga khut alhauvin aman’un, 28 “Israel mite, neipanhu’uvin, muntin’a mipi le Danthu chule hiche mun douna thu hil lepa ama hi ahi; hiche keo chu hilouvin Houin sunga Greek miho ahinpuilut’in hiche Muntheng phung ho asubohtai,” tin asamtauve. 29 Miho chun Paul le Ephesus gam mi Trouphimus khopi sunga akiloile amujeh-uva Houin sunga jong apuilut tei dia agin mou ahi. 30 Chutah chun khopumpi akithingun, mipi alhaikhom loiyun Paul chu aman’uvin Houina konin akaidoh-un, kotpi chengse akhah paitauve. 31 Mihon Paul tha dia agot lai tah-un Jerusalem kho pumpi boi thu hi sepai vaipipo kam ahung lhungin, 32 aman jong apettah chun sepai jalamkaiho le sepaihon apuiyin aselsuh jengu leh, mihon sepai vaippipo le sepaiho amuphat’un Paul avohda tauve. 33 Hichun sepai vaipipon anailut’in Paul amanin, thih khao nia kan din aseiyin, chuin, koihiya ipi asuhset ham ti akholtoh-e. 34 Ahin mipi lah a abangin thuchom asamun, phabep khat man thuchom beh asamui; hitia chu aboi behseh jeh-u chun ipi mong iti ham ti ahetdoh thei lou phat’in Paul chu kulpi sunga kailut din aseijotai. 35 Japi aphut deng dung phat’un kalbileiya alempet’in jong Paul chu sepaihon adop thobouvui; 36 ajeh chu mipin ahinjuipeh-un, “Sumangun!” tin asam jengui.

Paul’in akihouna thu a sei

37 Paul kulpi sunga akailut kon’un aman sepai vaipopa jah a, “Nahenga thu them khat sei theiying em?” ati leh; aman, “Greek pao nahet’em? 38 Nang hi Egypt mi, tu masang jep’a mihem sang li jen gamthip laiya loidoh a jelen gal bolsah chu nahilou ham?” ati. 39 Hichun Paul’in, “Keima Cilicia gam Tarsus khoa cheng Juda mikahin, khopi mai maiya mi kahipoi; nahenga kataove mipi jah a thu neiseisah-in,” ati. 40 Sepai vaipipon aphalpeh phat’in Paul kalbileiya adingin mipi akhutjap leh, athip chet phat’uvin Paul’in Hebrew paovin thu aseiyin:

Solchah 22

1 “Sopite le pate ho tua na angsunguva kakihonna thu kasei ding hi nei ngaipeh-uvi,” ati. 2 Paul’in a jah-uva Hebrew paova thu asei ajah phat’un ahathip chehuvin, hichun aman: 3 “Kei hi Cilicia gam Tarsus khopia cheng Juda mi kahin, hiche khopia Gamaliel khonung juiya, ipu apateu Dan dungjuiya kikheltah a them, tunia nang ho banga hi Pathen dinga tom ngaitah kahi; 4 hiche Lampi juiho chu thina geiyin kabolsen, numei pasal’in kakanin songkul’a din kapedoh doh jin, 5 athu hi Thempu chungnung le upa chengse ahetoh ahiuve; amahoa kona hi Damascus khoa um sopite gamat’a kanchal jenga Jerusalema hinpuiya talen matsahna ding lekha kipoh-in kachei.

Paul’in ahinkho kikhel asei

6 “Ddamascus kho kom kageiyin, sunkim don hin phulou helouvin van’a konin vah nasatah ahung vahin kakimvel asalvah soh jenge, 7 keila tola kalhutan, kajah a, “Saul, Saul, ibol’a neibolset set ham?” ti ogin khat kajai. 8 Kenjong kadonbut’in, ‘Koi nahim Pakai?’ katile, aman kajah a, ‘Nabolset set Nazareth Jesu chu kahi,’ ati. 9 Kalhonpi hon vah chu amu’vin kahenga thuseipa ogin vang chu ajapouve. 10 Hichun keiman, ‘Ipi kabol ding hitam Pakai?’ katile, Pakai chun kajah a, ‘Kipatdoh-in lang Damascus khopi sunga lut’in, hikoma chu natoh dia kigo chengse aboncha nakiseipeh ding ahi,’ ati. 11 Vah loupe behseh jeh-in kho kamutapon, kalhonpi hon khut’in eikaiyun Damascus khosung kaluttai. 12 “Damascus khoa chun Juda mihon aseiphat cheh-u, Danthu dudngjuiya Pathen ngaisah tah, Ananias kiti mi khat aumin, 13 ama hi kahenga ahungin kakoma adingin kajah a, ‘Sopi Saul, kho mutan,’ eitileh, hichepettah chun kamit akikeovin ama kamutai. 14 Chuin aman, ‘Ipu ipateu Pathen chun alunggot he ding le Adihpa mua akamsoh ogin ja dinga nalhen doh ahitai; 15 ijeh-inem itile nang man nahin mu le najahsah chu Ama dinga mitin henga nahettohsah ding ahi. 16 Hijeh chun tua ibol’a kho ngai ngai nahim? Kipatdoh-in baptize changing lang, nachonset soplhahna din Ama minin taovin,’ eiti.

Chidang namdang lah a thusei dia Paull kikou

17 “Jerusalema kakile kit phatin Houina katao le Themgao thilmun mu kaneiyin, 18 hichea chun Pakaiyin kajah a, ‘Kinloi tah-in Jerusalema konin potdoh loiyin, ajeh chu mihon Kei chung chang thudol nahettohsah hi asan lou diu ahi,’ ati. 19 Kenjong, ‘Pakai, amaho tah-in nangma tahsan ho Houthua kikhopna intin’a kalut’a kamatjia chule kavohji chu aheuve; 20 chule nathu hettohsah Stephen thisan kiso jong chun akoma kadidngin pha kasan, athat ho ponsil jouse kachoipeh ahi,’ kati. 21 Hichun Aman kajah a, ‘Chen, ijeh-inem itile gamla tah a chiding namdang ho henga kasol ding nahi,’ eititai,” ati.

Paul chule Rome sepai vaipopa

22 Thu hicheng asei athip nauvin, chutah-in a-o khoset’in lhang asam’un, “Hitobang mi chu leiset’a konin sumang jengin, ama chu ahing dia kilom ahipoi!” atiuve. 23 Chutitah chun kho asam’un aponsil’u aleh-un, van lama leivui akitunsah jengun ahile, 24 sepai vaipi pon Paul chu kulpi sunga kailut’a, ama douna chutobang tah akho asap jengu chu phot chetna dinga jep din asol’e. 25 Sepaihon savun khaova akan phat’un Paul’in akoma ding sepai jalamkaipa jah a, “Themmosahna bon um loulaiya Rome mi jep ding chu nang dia dan ngai hinam?” ati. 26 Sepai jalamkaipan hichu ajah phat’in sepai vaipipo henga achen a jah a, “Ipi bol kigo nahim? Ajeh chu hichepa khu Rome mi hibouva khu men!” agate. 27 Hijeh chun sepai vaipipo chu ahungin ajah a, “Rome mi nahi mong-em neiseipeh-in?” atileh; aman, “Kahinai,” ati. 28 Hichun sepai vaipipo adonbut’in, “Ken Rome mi hina hi sumtamtah a kichoa,” atileh; Paul’in, Keivang pen’a hisa kahitai,” ati. 29 Apettah chun achung thu kholchil kigo ho chu ahaiyun alhamkangun, sepai vaipipopa jong Paul Rome mi khat ahi ahetdoh a chule ama anakan jeng chu akichatai.

Houvaipoloi kikhopnaa Paul

30 Ajing nikhon sepai vaipipon ipijeh pen’a Judah on Paul aheh-u chu hetdohna din Paul akanna alhamin, Thempu pipu ho le Houvaipoloi chengse kikhomsoh din aseiyin, chuin Paul chu ahinpuidoh-in a-angsunguva adinsah-e.

Solchah 23

1 Paul’in Houvaipoloi chu avechangmel’in, “Tuni geiya hi Pathen angsunga lung sa-ihna beihel’a hing jing kahi,” ati. 2 Chutah chun Thempu pipu Ananias chun Paul koma dingho chu akam behpeh din asol’e. 3 Chuphat’in Paul’in jong ajah a, “Vo bang kiloibang, Pathenin nang nadenjoh ding ahi! Dan toh kikal’a keima deng dia mi nasol ham?” ati. 4 Akoma ding hon, “Nangin Pathen Thempu chungnung chutia nahouset jeng ong?” atiuleh; 5 Paul’in, “Ama Thempu chung nung ahilam kahetlou ahi sopite, ajeh chu, ‘Namite chunga vaipo chunga thuse nasei lou ding ahi,’ tinakisun nai,” ati. 6 Paul’in miho chu akehkhat Sadducee ahiuva akeh khat Pharisee ahiu ahetdoh phat’in, Houvaipoloi kikhopnaa chun ahinsamin, “Sopite, keima Pharisee chapa Pharisee kahin, mi thi thokit kinepna thu dol’a kathu kibol’a ahi,’ ati. 7 Paul’in chutia aseiphat’in Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho kah a kinel khenlotauve. 8 Ijeh-inem itile Sadducee loiyin mi thi thokit hihen Vantil hileh chule lhagao geiya aumsah louvu ahin, Pharisee loiyin vang aboncha aumsah-u ahinai. 9 Hiti tah chun apoh veng vung jengun, Pharisee loi lah a Danthem ho phabep adingdoh-uvin mipi anellun, “Keihon hichepa chunga thildih lou ima kamupouve, lhagao ahim Vantil ahim khattouvin ajah a thu asei hi hih ding ham?” atiuve. 10 Akihanelten phat’un sepai vaipipon Paul chu abotel diu ham ti akichan, sepaiho chu chesuh a alah uva kona pumhat’a Paul chu gakaidoh a kulpi sunga lhoh lut jeng din aseipeh-e. 11 Ajing nilhah-in Paul koma Pakai adingin, “Lung ngamin, Jerusalema kathu nahettohsah banga Rome khopia jong nahettohsah tei ding ahi,” tin aseiye.

Paul tha dia agot’u

12 Khovah lhah-in Judaten thilgon aneiyun Paul atha masangseuva anneh twidon abol louhel diuvin akihahsel’un akihan lho cheh tauve. 13 Hitia mi philna thil gong ho chu mi som li val ahiuve. 14 Amaho hi Thempu pipuho le upaho henga acheuvin, “keihon Paul katha masangseuva neh le chah bol louhel dia khoh tah a kihahsel’a kihan lho kahitauve. 15 Hijeh chun tun nang hon Houvaipoloi toh kithoa Paul thudol kholchil’a bol dingveh kisauvin, sepai vaipipon nahenguva ahin puina din gahetsah-un; hikom ahinphah kah a that dia kigosadem’a um kahitauve,” agatiuvin ahi. 16 Ahinla anachan lhih-u thilgon hi Paul sopinu chapan ajadoh-in, hijeh chun achen kulpi sunga alut’in Paul jah a agaseitai. 17 Chuphat’in Paul chun sepai jalamkaiho khat akouvin, “Hiche gollhangpa hi sepai ding khat aneiye,” ati. 18 Hijeh chun aman agollhangpa chu apuiyin sepai vaipipo heng alhut’in, “Sohchang Paul khun eikouvin hiche gollhangpa hin nakoma seiding khat aneijeh a nahenga eihin puisah ahi,” ati. 19 Sepai vaipipon ama chu akhut’in atuh-in munchoma apuidoh-in guh thim chan adongin, “Kakoma sei ding ipi naneiyem?” atile, 20 aman, “Jing teng Houvaipoloi kikhopnaa achung chang thudol kichen cheh a kholtoh idng banga Paul hi napuisuhna didnga nahenga ngeh ding tin Juda ho akiloltauve. 21 Hijeh chun athu’u lahpeh hih-in, ajeh chu mi som li valjen Paul atha masangseuva um’uva nangma thupeh ngah maiya um nahitauve,” ati. 22 Chuphat’in sepai vaipipon gollhangpa chu alhadoh-in, “Hiche neihung seipeh hi koimacha naseipeh louhel ding ahi,” tin agah chah tai.

Gamvaipo Felix henga Paul akisol

23 Sepai vaipipon sepai jalamkai ni akouvin, “Tujan nidan koa Caesarea che din sepai ja ni le sakol sepai som sagi toh, teng choi sepai ja nit oh gonsan koi lhonin; 24 chule gamvaipo Felix henga bitkeiya pui lhungna din Paul touna ding sakol ho jong ngaitopeh lhonin,” atin; 25 hiti chun athu dol hi lekha ajih-in: 26 “Lal chungnungpen gamvaipo Felix, Claudius-in salam kahinboh-e. 27 Hichepa hi Juda hon aman’un, atha ding kon’uvin sepai ho toh kakon’un, Rome mi ahi kahetjeh-in kagahuhdohtai. 28 Ahehnau ajeh kahet nompeh-in ama hi Houvaipoloi kikhopnaa kapuisuh leh, 29 thina thei le kanchahna thei ima abolset jeh a aheh nau kamupon, amaho Danthu dol’a aheh-u ahitohe. 30 Ama hi tha dia agot’uva achan lhih-u eikiseipeh phat’a khongai louhel’a nahenga kahinsol pai jenga, aheh ho jong nangma maiya aheh nau asei diuva kahil ahitai,” ati. 31 Sepaihon akiseipeh bangun ajan janin Paul chu apuiyun Antipatris alhut tauve. 32 Ajing nikhon sakol sepai chengse chutoh kilhon pai din adalhah thauvin, sepai dangse vang kulpi lama ahung kilekit tauve. 33 Caesarea ahung lhun phat’un lekha thot chu gamvaipo apeuvin, Paul jong akoma adinsahui. 34 Gamvaipon lekha thot chu asim jou phat’in hoigam poh mi ha ti adoh a Cilicia gam mi ahi ahetdoh phat chun 35 “Naheh ho ahung lhung teng nathu ngai nange,” atin, Herod inpi thutanna in’a kaiya hentup din aseipeh tai.

Solchah 24

Paul aheh nau thu

1 Ni nga jouvin thempu chung nung Ananias le upa phabep chule thusuitoh them Tertullus kitipa toh ahungsuh-un, Paul aheh nau thudol chu gamvaipo henga aseiyuve; 2 chuin agah kouphat’un Tertullus chun aheh nau thu aseipanin: “Lal chungnungpen, nangma jeh’in cham le lung ol’in ka-um’un, chule navaihom them jal’in jong hiche nam mi ding hin phatna tampi akisemdoh-e; 3 Ima lam jouse le muntin’a thilbol ho hi keihon kipah tah-in kasangui-pu Felix! 4 Hijongleh tampi seiya nangma phat suhmang din kadeipon, kathuu paltan’a kaseiyu hi lungset’a nei ngaipeh diuva kataotho ahi. 5 Ijeh-inem itile hichepa hi mi sunoh phah tah, vannoi gamtin’a Juda ho chohsea pang, Nazareth chon’a chonho lamkai pipu ahi ti keihon kamandoh-un, 6 houin geiya suh boh ding agot’jeh a kahin mat’u ahi; keiho Dan dungjuiya athu katan nomu ahin, 7 ahinla sepai lamkai Lysias hunga thahat san’a ka khut’uva kona ahung lhoh mang ahi; 8 aheh ho ma aanga ding din thu apen, nangman dongtoh le chun kahehnau hi adih adih lou abonchan hesoh keinan naete,” ati. 9 Juda ho jong chun ahunan asei chengse chu adih cheh-in aseiyui.

Felix ang’a Paul kihonna thusei

10 Gamvaipon thusei didnga akhasuh pha’in Paul’in adonbut’in: “Kum sotpi hiche nam mite chunga thutan vaihom nahi kahen, kipah tah-in keima kihonna thu seiyinge; 11 nangman nakhol chet thei ahi, keima Jerusalema Pathen hou dinga kache na hi nisom le ni aval hih laiye; 12 Houin sung hihen Houthua kikhopna in hijongle, kholai dung jeng cha jong mikhattou kakinahpi ham ahiloule jap katilset ham hijongle hiche ho hin eimandoh pouve; 13 tua eihehna jengu jong hi aphot chetna kichentah-in seithei pouvinte. 14 Ahin nahenga kaphondoh nom chu hiche ahi, amahon houdan loitum asah-u Lampi dungjuiya kapu kapateu Pathen houva, Dan thu le themgao lekhabua kisun jouse katahsan’a, 15 amahon jong dih asah cheh, midih hihen midih lou hileh mi thi thokitna aum’e, ti katahsan ahi; 16 hitia chu Pathen lam hihen mihem thudol hijongleh lung theng lung navah a um jing dinga kihabol kahi. 17 Kum phabeppi nungin kanam mite din thilpeh le thilto kahinpon kahung leh, 18 hiche kinbol’a Houin a kakisuh theng pet’a eihung mudoh-u ahin, hichea chu mipi kikhom jong aumpon, japi noh phahna jong aumpoi. 19 Asia gama hung kon Juda mi phabep vang aum’un, amaho chun hehna ding eineiyu leh hikoma nangma angsunga hung ding dol ahiuve. 20 Ahilouva Houvaipoloi kikhopna kadinpet’a chu ipi suh khel toh khel kachunga amudoh-um hiche ho hin seileu hiding ahi; 21 a-angsunguva kadinpet’a othong leuva kasei thil khatseh, “Tunia hi na-angsunguva mi thi thokit thudol’a kachung thu kikhol’ah ahi,’ kati chubou ahiye,” ati. 22 Ahin Felix chun hiche Lampi thudol chu ahetchetsa ahijeh-in thutan ding avochonin, “Sepai vaipipo Lysias ahung tengleh nathuu ngaito chen nange,” atitai. 23 Felix in sepai jalamkaipa chu Paul songkul’a ahen din aseipeh-in, amavang achamlhatdom theiya, agol apaiho jong ajenle nomchan alutsdah din ahil’e.

Mihenna in’a Paul ahen’u

24 Nikho ijat ham nungin Felix chu ajinu, Juda numei Drusilla toh ahungin Paul agakousah-in Christa Jesua tahsan thudol aseisah-in angaiye. 25 Paul’in thutandih le kitim them chule khonunga thupi tanna thudol adsei phat’in Felix atija jah tan, “Tun chetan, phat kanei kom khat leh hinkousah kit nange,’ ati. 26 Chujongle Paul chun sumguh apeh din agel’in phiveng vungin akousah-in akihoupi piji’e. 27 Ahinla kum ni jen alhin chun Porcius Festus chun Felix ahinkhel’in, Felix chun Juda ho dei abolnom jeh-in Paul songkul’a kihen nalaiyin adalhai.

Solchah 25

Caesar henga Paul’in achung thu alhut 1 Hiche gamkaiya ahung lhun kal nithum jouvin Festus chu Caesarea konin Jerusalema achetouve. 2 Jerusalema chun Thempu pipu ho le Juda lamkaihon ahenga Paul hehsetna thu anaseiyui; Festus chu a-ngeh-un, 3 ahinpui jeng khat leh lampia chanlhih a Paul chu thadohna didn, Jerusalema ahinpui dingin athum’uve. 4 Festusin adonbut’in, “paul Caesarea akikoiyin chule keimatah jong chu koma che ding kahi; 5 hijeh chun keito lhonin nalah-uva athu neidom chengse cheu hitin, hichepa hin suh khel tohkhel anei leh amahon aheh nom nomin heh-u hen” ati. 6 Festus chu alah-uva niget ham nisom ham anichongin Caesarea achesuh-in; ajing nikhon thutanna mun’a atouvin Paul gapui din aseiye. 7 paul ahung lhun phat’in, Jerusalema kona hungsuh Juda ho akimvel’a adingun, phot chetna apeh thei louhel hel’u thuse tamtah-in ahehseuvin ahi. 8 Hichun Paul’in akihonan thuaseiyin, “juda Danthu douna hihen Houin douna hileh, chuleh Caesar douna hijongleh keiman imacha suhset tohset kaneipoi,” ati. 9 Hichea hin Festus-in Juda ho lung lhaina abolnom jeh-in paul adonbut’in ajah a, “Jeruaselema chetouva keima angsunga hiche thudol ho hi nachung kikhol ding nadeiyem?” atileh; 10 paul’in, “Keima kathu kitanna ding sol Caesar thutanna mun’a ding kahi; Juda ho chunga bol khel ahi. 11 Keima bol khel nei kahiya, thina thei lom suh khel toh khel kanei leh thi ding kadapoi; amavang eihehna chengseu hi ima ahilouleh koiman amaho khut’a eipehdoh theiponte, Caesar henga kathu kalhuttai,” ati. 12 Festus chu avaibolpi chengse toh akihoutoh phat’in adonbut’in, “nangin Caesar henga nathu anlhutsa ahitan, Caesar henga nache ding ahi,” ati.

Agrippa le Bernice anga Paul

13 nikho phabep jouvin lengpa Agrippa le Bernice chu Festus vailhun din Caesarea ahung lhontai. 14 Caesarea sotpi anichon lailhonin Festus chun lengpa koma Paul thu chu apodoh-in, “Felix dalhah soh chang kihen khat aumin, 15 Jerusalema ka-umpet chun Thempu pipu ho le Juda ho upaten achung thu eihetsah-un, chule ama mochansah a athu tan din a-ngeh-ui. 16 Ahivangin akihehpa le aheh ho kimaitoa akinel’uva aheh apauvin akihonna thu asei masanga koi hileh moh pehdoh jeng chu Rome mite chondan ngai ahilou kaseipehin kanadonbut’e. 17 Hijeh chun abonchauva ahung kikhopsoh phat’un geisang louhel’in ajing nikhoma man thutanna amun’a katou mun kakijot’in mipa chu hinpuidoh din kaseitai. 18 Ahinla aheh a pang ho adindoh-uva athudol aseiyu chun ahehpauvin kagel bangin ima thilse abolpoi; 19 akinel nau chu amaho houthudol le Paul’in ahinga asei mithisa Jesu kiti khat thudol mai mai ahibouve. 20 Atanna je kahetvah loujeh-in ahehnau thuho jeh a hi Jerusalema chea kholchil ding adeiyem adei hih-em ti Paul kadonge. 21 Hichea chun Paul’in Kumpipa henga thu chaina a-nga dingin kihenan in’a koi din a-ngeh-in, hijeh chun Caesar henga kasol thei kah a koi dingin kaseitai,” ati. 22 Hichun Agrippan Festus jah a, “Hichepa thu chu keima tahin jong ngai leng kadeiye,” atileh, aman, “Jing tng jana veh ta chun,” atipeh-e. 23 Ajing nikhon Agrippa le Bernice loupe tah a sepai vaipo ho le khopi sunga japi lamkai ho toh thu ngaina inpia ahung lut phat’uvin Festus thusah-in paul ahinpui lut tauve. 24 Chutah-in Festus chun aseiyin, “lengpa Agrippa chule keiho toh umkhom chengse, veuvin hichepa hi Juda mi jousen, Jerusalema ahin, hikoma ho ahiuvin, ama ahinga hoisot louhel ding dol’a asap sap jenguva kahenga angeh-u ahiye. 25 Ahinla keiman amah in thina thei lom thilse aboldoh kamupoi, aman ma Kumpipa henga thu alhut tahjeh-in sol dinga thu kalhuhsah ahitai. 26 Hichea hi achung chang thudol’a Kumpipa henga sutding ima kichentah-in kahe theipon, hijeh a chu na-angsunguva kahinpuidoh ahi! Athu doh toh nunga sut idng kati ahiye. 27 Ijeh-inem itile akihehna thudol kichen a sun louva sohchang gahsol jeng chu kitoh din kagelpoi,” ati.

Solchah 26

Agrippa angsung Paul’in kihonna thu asei

1 Agrippan Paul jah a, “Nakihonan thusei theiyin nate,” ati. Chutah-in paul chun akhut ajah-in anoiya banghin akihonna thu aseiye: 2 “Lengpa Agrippa, Judahon eiheh na jouseu thua tunia nangma angsunga kakihonna thu sei dia ka-um hi lungnom kakisa lheh jenge; 3 ajeh chu Judate puchon pachon Dan jouse le akinel nohna nangin nahe themsoh keiyin, hijeh chun lung nengtah-in kasei nei ngaipeh-in tia tao kahi. 4 “Keima kaneocha lhah kanam mite lah a Jerusalema kachen a kanun kakhan aboncha Juda miten ahetsoh keiyu ahi; 5 amahon asei nom’uva ahileh phat sotpi sunga eihetsau ahijeh chun kahoudanuva chon kakhelpen tah a Pharisee mi kahin, 6 chule tua hi kapu kapateu henga pathen tepsa kinepna thudol’a kathu khol dinga hikoma ding kahiye. 7 Hiche kinepna thudol’a hi kaphungbul piu som le nijenin gunchu tah a sun le jan a Pathen ahouvu anahi. Vo lengpa hiche kinepna thudol’a hi Juda mi hon eiheh-u ahbouve. 8 Juda mi nang hon Pathenin mi thisa athodoh kit thudol hi natahsan ding hahsa nasah-u ham? 9 “keijengin jong kajo chan’a bol’a Nazareth Jesu min douna thil ijakai bol ding kagotsa ahi. 10 Hitobang hin Jerusalem khosunga kabol’in Thempu pipu hoa konin thu neina kalan, minthengte tampi songkul’a kakhumin, chule athau jong chun pha kasai. 11 phat atamjon Houthua akikhopnau in tin’a talen kamatsah-in, atahsanu ataitom teina diuvin ka-engbol’in, achunguva kalung hangten tun jengin gamdang miho khopi dung geiyin kagabol sen ahi.

Paul’in ahinkho kikhel avelsei kit

12 “Hitobanga amaho bol genthei ding chun Thempu pipu hoa kona thu neina kengin Damascus khopi jonin kachen, 13 vo lengpa, sumkim dontah-in lampia nisa sanga vahjo van’a konin vahkhat kamun, vah chun keima kimvel chengse le ka lhonpi ho chengse asalvah soh keiye; 14 hichun tol’a kalhunsoh phat’uvin Hebrew paovin kajah a, “Saul, saul, ibol’a neibolset set ham? Nang dia thihtul monghem lho chu bongchal’in apu mol-hem anungsai beh ahi,’ eiti. 15 Hichun keiman, ‘Pakaiyin, ‘Nabolset set Jesu chu kahi. 16 Hijongle thouvin nakengin pansan dingin, nahenga kahung kilahna jeh chu nangma kalhachaa pansah din gle nathilmu chengse le nahinmu kit ding chengse hettohsah a pansah dinga hung kilah kahi, 17 kasolna mi Israeltea kon le chiding namdang hoa kona khovah a ahung kiheidoh theiyuva Satan tha neinaa kona Pathen henga ahung kihei theina diu chule Keima eitahsan jal’uva chonset ngaidamna amutheiyuva, lhat thengsa ho lah a goulo chan anei theina diuva amit’u hasah dinga ahenguva kasol ding nahi,’ eiti.

Paul’in aumchan Juda mi le namdang ho aseipeh

19 “Hijeh chun volengpa Agrippa, van’a kona themgao thilmu kamu chu athua nu glouvin kaumpoi; 20 amasan Damascus khopia umho henga kaseiyin, Jerusalem le Judea gam pumpia jong, chiding namdang holah geiyin lung heiya Pathen lama akiheiyuva chule along heiyu toh kiloma natohpha atohna diuvin kaseipeh soh keiye. 21 Hichejeh a hi Judah on Houin sunga eimat’uva tha dinga eigot’u ahi. 22 Ahivangin tuni chan geiyin pathenin eikithopin, hkoma kadingin milen mineo hengah hettohsahna thu hi kaseiye; kasei hi Themgaoho le Mose’n hung guilhung dinga anaseisau chu ahin, 23 Christan hesoh genthei athoh tei ding, thinaa kona thoudoh maspen’a panga, Juda mi le chiding namdang ho henga khovah thuaphondoh dingahi,” ati.

Agrippan atahsan tei dia Paul taona

24 Paul’in hitia kihonna thu asei chun Festus-on othongin akouvin, “Vo Paul a-ngol nahitai; nalekhathem sang chun na-ngolsahjoh ahitai,” ati. 25 Ahivangin Paul chun, “Vo lalchungnung Festus, a-ngol’a kahipon, kicheh tah athu dih kaseijoh ahibouve. 26 Ijeh-inem itile leng Agrippan hiche hi ahet ahijeh a ajah angamtah a kasei ahiye; ajeh pentah chu athil hi ningkoiya kibol ahiloujeh-in ama hetlou um louhel din katahsan’e. 27 Lengpa Agrippa, Themgao ho natahsan em? Natah san kahei,” ati. 28 Hichun Agrippan Paul jah a, “Hiche chomkah cha sunga hin Christian hisah neigoi!” ati. 29 Hijongle Paul’in, “Phat chom hen sao leh tunia karhusei ngai chengse hi thihkhaova kakihenna ho tilouvin keima tobang hisoh keiyu leh tin Pathen henga kathum’e,” atitai. 30 Hichun lengpa le gamvaipo Bernice chule atoukhompi chengse akipatdoh-in 31 adalhah phat’un khat le khat akihou lhiuvin, “Hichepa hin thina thei lom hihen songkul’a henna thei lom hijongleh ima abol set atohset aumpoi,” akitiuve. 32 Hichea hin Agrippan Festus jah a, “Hichepa hin Kumpipa henga thu alhut lou hileh lhadoh thei ahitai,” ati.

Solchah 27

Rome khopi jon’a paul konga akitol

1 konga kitol’a Italy gam kajot diu akichet phat’in Kumpipa sepai lhentum lah a sepai jalamkai Julius kitipa khut’a paul le sohchang dang ho apedoh tauve. 2 Adramyttium a chun Asia gam kongkai mun jouse jotpa ding kong khat’a kalut’un, Macedonia gam Thessalonica khoa hung kon Aristarchus chutoh kilhonin kakitol’uve; 3 ajing nikhon Sidon kaimun kalungun, Julius chun Paul along set’in agol apai ho henga che angaichat chan apeh diuvin asol’e. 4 Chua konin keiho lam ngaa hui anun Jeh-in Cyprus twikol lesun sun’ah kakitol’uvin, 5 Cilicia le Pamphylia Twikhanglen thuh lai kagal kaiyun Lycia gama Myra kho kalhungtauve. 6 Hikoma hin sepai jalamkaipan Italy jon ding Alexandria kong khat aga mudoh-in hia chun eikhumtauve. 7 Nikho sotpi sungin olcha chan kakitol’un hahsa tah-in Cnidus kho kalhungvin, huiyin kajotna lam’uva chetheiya eilha lou phat’uvin Cretetwikol lesun sun’ah kakitol’un Salmone jon kajot’un, 8 twi pamchim chin kalhah peh-uvin, nah nah-in Lasea khopia kona gamla behseh lou kongkai munhoi kiti khat kalhungtauve. 9 Phat sottah kanichon nungun Thoidamna anngol phat jong akichaitan, konga kitol’a kholjin banjop dingla kachat aumtah jeh-in Paul’in miho athumop’in, 10 ajahuvah, “Miho, konga akitol’u hi toset ito tei didu thil le lo mai hilouva ihinkho diuva jong manthahna um ding kichat tijat aum’e ti kamui,’ ati. 11 Ahinla sepai jalamkai chun Paul thusei sangin kong lamkai pa le kong neipa thujoh alajoi. 12 Kongkai mun chu phalbi sunga umna dia aphat loujeh-in, mi atamjon Twikhanglena kitoldoh a ahithei chan a Phoenix lhun tei ding asom’ui; Phoenix chu Crete gama kongkai mun khat ahin, lhanglam lhum le sahlam-lhum angat ahi, hichea chu phalbi sunga cham ding atiu ahiye.

Twikhanglen chunga huise

13 Lhanglam hui olcha cha ahung nun phat’in mihon along ngaito bang molso thei din agel’un, kong khaopi alhauvin Crete twikol pamchin chin’ah atoltauve. 14 Ahivangin chom khat jouvin sahlam-niso hui kiti hui hattah twikol gam lama konin ahung nungsuh paiyin, 15 hui chun kong ahinsem khath phat’in anang joutapon, kamoh lhau le ei-lhoh lhoh jeng tauve. 16 Hichun Cauda kiti twikol neocha khat lesun sun’a ka lhaiyun nah changsal’in kong inneiya kong neochu kahendet nah nah-ui. 17 Kongneo chu kong innei kimvel’a chun akanbeh-un ahunan amangun, Libya twipam chin nel lah a kilenglut khante, ti gin nan pondal kipeina chu aloi lhauvin hui amoh lhohsah sah tauve. 18 Hui tahtah chun eisuh gim behseh phat’un ajing nikhon kong sunga thil le lo apai pan tauve. 19 Nithum nin kong manchah ho geiyin akhut’a uvin apai kit tauvin ahi. 20 Nikho tamtah sunga nisa mel le ahsite mel kimudoh louhel’a hui hattah tang louhel’a anun nun jeng phat’in kasochatna diuva kinepna jouse abeitai. 21 Phat sottah miho nelou chalouva aum nungun Paul alah-uva adingin, “Vo miho, nang hon kathusei na-ngaiyuva Crete a kona ihung kitoldoh lou diu, hitobang settona le manthahna hi itokhah lou diu dol ahi. 22 Hijongle tua jong nahenguva katao ahi, hang tah-in pang un! Ijeh-inem itile nalah-uva komacha athi amang na-um lou diu, kong innei vang mang ding ahi; 23 ajeh chu Amaa kahia alhachaa kapan Pathena kon Vantil khat tujan chun kahenga ahung kilah-in 24 “Vo Paul, kicha hih-in, Kumpipa ang’a nadin tei tei ding ahi chule ven nalhonpi chengse hi Pathenin nang napeh ahitai,’ eiti. 25 Hijeh chun hangtahin pangun miho, ajeh chu eikiseipeh bang banga chu hung guilhing tei dinga Pathen katahsan in ahi. 26 Amavang twikol gam sung khat A igalkai tei diu ahi,” ati. 27 Kakisuhtol kakitoutol’uva jan som le li lhin jan Adria Twikhanglen kagalkaiyun jankhangkim in kongtol hon gam leiset kinaiyah hitam ti agingmouve. 28 Hijeh chun thilgih khat khaovin akan’un twite na dia ale lut’u leh twi chu lam som ni thuh ate doh ui; phabep acheuva atekit’u leh lam some le lam nga atedoh-uvin ahi. 29 Song lah a kilenglut khante ti ginmo nan kong tom lam’ah konghenna khao li aleh lhauvin khovah loi nadin ataovui. 30 Kongtol ho chu jamdoh ding akigo’uvin, kong mai lama chu kong henna khao sep lha ding veh kisan twi lah a kongneo chu akhai lhauvin lungthim aboltauve. 31 Paul’in sepa jalamkai pa le sepaite jah-a, “Hiche kongtol ho hi kong sunga aumden louvu leh nang ho sohcha jou pouvin n ate,” atitai. 32 Hijeh chun sepai hon kongneo kikhaina khao ho chu asat tanpeh-un akitolmangsah tauve. 33 Khovah niso ding phat’in Paul’in an ne din asol’in abonchauva jah a, “Sei ding get ding helouhel’a nelou cha lou, tep lou don louva na-um kal’u tuni nisom le ni li alhingtai; 34 hijeh a chu anne dinga ka-ngeh nahiuve, nakihinso theina diuva natha nei dom nadiu vin, ajeh chu nalu chunguva samjang khat jeng cha jong mangthah louhel ding ahi,” ati. 35 Hitia asei jou hin changlhah chu alan mi jouse angsunga Pathen athangvah jouvin aheh bal’in anepantai. 36 Hichun miho ahung lung ngam tauvin amahon jong an anepantauve. 37 Kong sunga um chu mihing jani le som sagi leh gup kahiuve. 38 Mi jousen an anehva phat’un kong chu ajankhai domna din kong sunga suhlou chang chu Twikhanglen a aleh lut tauvin ahi.

Kongke

39 Khovah phat’in kongtol hon gam leiset chu ahetapouvin, ahin twilen pang ningkoi khat amu’vin, ahithei leh hikoma chu kong tol lut’a galkai din akihousomtauve. 40 Hijeh chun konghenna khao chengse alha lhauvin Twikhanglena aleh lut’uvin, chule kongkhe kanna khao asut lhauve; chutengleh huiyin aputlut theina diuvin ponjal atungdoh-un twiningkoi lam chu ajontauve. 41 Ahinla kong chu twikinong ni kisuhtonaa alut khan kong mong chu nel lei lah a akiphut lutdentan, achalbe thei tapoi, chuma leh twikinong chun hanuh a anuh jeh-in anung lama ahal hal’in aleng lhan akeh pan tai. 42 Sohchang ho chu akijap galkaiyuva ajamdoh thei louna diu tin sepaihon abonchauva tha ding thilgon aneitauve. 34 Ahivangin sepai jalamkai chun Paul ahuhdoh nom jeh-in athilgon u chu asutangin, twijap thei chan jap galkaiya tolgo anakai masa din aseiyin, 44 adang amohse chu khunpeh le konghalse pouva kitol galkai din aseiye. Hitia chu aboncha tolgo geiya kishinso na um ahi.

Solchah 28

Malta twikol gama Paul

1 Kakihonso phat’uvin twikolgam chu Malta akiti ti kahedoh tauve. 2 Koitoh kisamkai khah loulai agam mihon datmo tah-in eikhoto’uvin, go juh jeh a adap phat chun mei eitipeh-un eilamdot chehui. 3 Paul’in thingkang lom khat achomdah-in meiya atileh, meisa hul chun gulse khat ahungdoh-in akhut achun akikhaiden jenge. 4 Koitoh kisamkai khah lou agam mihon paul khut’a gul kikhai chu amudoh phat’un khat le khat akihou lhiuvin, “hichepa vang hi tolthat mong mong ahin, Twikhanglen setto naa ahindoh jeng vanga thudih chun ahing hoi lou dingsam ahiye,” akitiuve. 5 Ahinla Paul’in gulse chu meilhum sunga athing lhan a-ima aloudeh poi. 6 Agam mihon vang hung pom ding ham ahi loule phulou helouvin lhua thi didng ham, tin a-ngah jingui; sotpi chutia angauva imacha atilou phat’in along gel akhel’uvin Paul chu Pathen khat danin aseitauve. 7 Hiche kona gamla behseh lou mun khat’a hin twikol haosapu amin Publius kitipan loumin aneiyin, amahin thanom tah-in eisangun nithum sungin eivah gunset’uve. 8 Publisu pa chu khosih le eithit veiya dammoa lum ahin, Paul’in agaven, achunga khut angamin ataopeh-in aboldamtai. 9 Hitabong thilsoh aumdoh phat hin twikol gamsunga cheng ana damlou neichanin ahinpuiyun abonchan adamsoh keiyuve. 10 Agam mihon keiho jabolnan thilpeh tampi eipeuvin, konga kitol kagot phat’un kangaichat ding dol jouseu kong sunga eihung thah peh-uve.

Paul Rome khopi alhun

11 Lha thum jouvin Alexandria hung kon kong, ‘Pathen cha pengkop,’ tia kiminvo, phalbi sungsea chukom twikol gama nichong denpaa chun kakitol kit tauve. 12 Syracuse kaimun’a kaki-ngauvin nithum kanichonguve. 13 Chua konin kakitol velkil leuvin Rhegium kalhungun, nikhat jouvin lhanglam hui ahung nungin, ni ni lhin hin Puteoli kalhungu. 14 Puteolia chun sopite phabep kamudoh-un, akom’uva ni sagi nichong din eikouvui. Hitia chu Rome hung lhung kahiuve. 15 Rome a um sopiten kathuu ajah phat’un Appius kailhang le Jinlhun in thum geiyin keiho lamto din ahungun, amaho amu phat hin Paul’in Pathen athangvah-in along ngamtan ahi. 16 Rome kalhun phat’un Paul chu a-ngah a pang sepai chutoh ama changseh a cheng din phalna aneipeh tauvin ahi.
