Rome khopia Paul’in Pathen Thupha aseiphong

17 Nithum jouvin Paul’in khosunga Judate lamkaiho akoukhomin, ahung kikhopsoh phat’un ajahuvah, “Sopiho, i-nam miteu douna hihen ipu ipateu chondan douna hijongle imacha kabolset aum lou vangin Jerusalema pat Rome mite khut’a sohchanga eihung kipedoh ahitai. 18 Kachung thu akhol chil’u chun thina thei lom ima kabolset aumdoh loujeh-in eina lhadoh nom tauve. 19 Ahina Juda mihon aneljeh-un, ka-nam mite douna imacha sei ding kanei lou vangin Kumpipa henga kacham louvinthu kalhuttai. 20 Hichejeh tah a hi nang ho toh kimutoa kihoulimpi dia kakou nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile Israel kinepna ijeh a keima hiche thih khaova hi kihen’ah kahibouve,” ati. 21 Hichun amahon ajah a, “Keihon jong Judea gama kona nathudol lekha thot la kimu louva, hikoma sopite khatcha beh-in jong nagit louna thudol thulhut’a le houlima jong umlouva, 22 hi jongle la nalung ngaito mong mong nanga konin kajahbe nom nauve; ajeh chu hiche Houbih vang hi muntin gamtin’a seiset’in aumtin ahi ti kei hon jong kanaheuve,” atiuvin ahi. 23 Nikho khat ateppeh –un, apansatna ina’a chun mi tampi ahung kikhom’uve; Paul’in amaho chu jingkah a pat nilhah geiyin Mose Danthu le Themgaoho lekhabua konin hilchetna abol’in, Pathen Lenggam thudol ahettohsa-in, Jesu chu tahsansah tei din ajoltai. 24 Paul thuseiho chu abangin atahsan lou vangun abang vang anomtauve. 25 Amaho chu akihoutoh thei loud phat’uvin Paul’in anoiya thu khat hi asei jou phat’in apotdoh tauve; athusei chu: “Lhagao Thengin Isaiah Themgao kamin napu napateu henga phatah-in anaseiyin, 26 hitin: “Hiche mite henga hin chen lang gaseiyin, ‘Ja vang najah tei diu ahin nehetkhen thei lou diu, Mujong namu tei diu navet chen thei lou diu ahi. 27 Ijeh-inem itile hiche mite hi alungthimu amoh-in, Anabenguvin thu angaichimtan, Chutilou hileh amit’uva avet chet theiyuva Alungthim’uva ahetkhen them diu, Kadamsahna dia kahenga hung kilekit diu ahi,’ ati bang chun; 28 hichu kihet cheh-un, hiche Pathen mihuhhingna thu hi chiding namdangte henga kithot ahitan, amahon angai tei diu ahi,” ati. 29 (Paul’in hicheng asei jou hin Judah on ada lhauvin hanel’in akineltauve.) 30 Hikoma chun Paul’in inman akipeh-in kum ni sung in achengin, ahenga hung jouse lamdot’in 31 Pathen Lenggam thu aseiphongin, koima asunoh beihel’in phongtah in Pakai Jesu thudol ahil lhang lei.

1 Corinth 1

1 Pathen lungdeiya Christa Jesu solchah dinga kikou Paul le sopi Sosthenes-in, 2 Corinth khoa Pathen Houbung, Christa Jesua kisuthenga, atheng dinga kikou ho le muntin’a um miho, amaho le eiho dinga i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa min’a kikou chengse henga, 3 i-Pau Pathen le i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christaa konin lungsetna le chamna nahenguva hung lhung hen!

Lhagao thilpeh thangvahna

4 Christa Jesu ti nakigop jeh-uva nachunguva kipe Pathen lungsetna jeh chun nang ho jel’in phat jousen ka-Pathen kathangvah jing’e, 5 ajeh chu, Amato nakigop’u hin ima jousea, thuseina hihen hetna hijongle nahaosah-u ahitan, 6 nang hoa hi Christa thudol hettohsahna phudet’a aum banga, 7 i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung kiphondoh ding na-ang nauva Lhagao thilpeh chan khel nanei louna diu ahi. 8 Aman nang ho akhon ni, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa nikho geiya natuh chah jinguva monabeiya nakoi diu ahi. 9 Achapa Jesu Christa, i-Pakaiyu vanga kiloikhomnaa nakoulut’u Pathen chu kitah tah ahiye.

Houbung sunga loitum kisoa kikhentel

10 Sopite, nabonchauva nakinopto cheh-uva, nasei jouseu akitha khat’a, lunggel le ngaito kitha khat nahina diuva i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa min jal’a ka-ngeh nahiuve. 11 Ijeh-inem itile kasopite, nalah-uva kinah baotam alen chu Chloe insung miten kajah a kichentah-in eiseipeh tauve. 12 Kasei chu hiche ahi, nang ho amitakip, “Keivang Paul loi kahi, keima Apollos loi kahin, keima Peter loi kahi, chule keima Christa loi kahi” natiuve. 13 Christa chu kihomtel hitam? Paul la nang ho din thingpel’a akikhet beh pon, ole Paul min’a baptize chang ngap nahiuvem? 14 Cripus le Gaius tilou nang ho khat beh baptize kachansah loujeh-un kakipah-e, 15 hiche hi koima kei min’a baptize changa nakisei thei louna diu ahiye. 16 Stephanas insungmite vang baptize kachan sah nan, hiche kalval vang midang koima baptize kachansah kahepoi. 17 Christan baptize kachansah dinga eisol ahipon, Kipana Thupha sei phong dingjoh a eisol ahibouve, Christa thingpel thu chu ahomkeo ahilouna dinga chihna thujong kasei lou ahi.

Christa chu Pathen hatna le chihna

18 Thingpel thu hi amangthah ho dia ngol kai tah ahin, huhhinga um eiho din vang Pathen thahatna ahi. 19 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lekhabua kisun chun, “Keiman miching ho chihna kasuh manga, het themna neiho hetna moh kahisah ding ahi,” ati. 20 Miching hoiya uma, lekhathem hoilam ham? Tukhang minel them hoiyaba um ham? Pathenin hiche vannoi chihna hi ngolna ahisah lou ham? 21 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen chihnaa hin hiche chihna vannoiyin mangcha Pathen ahetdoh thei lou phat’in, ngol kai thua kigel hiche thu kisei phong tahsan ho joh huhhing ding hi pha asai. 22 Judaten melchihna a-ngeh-uvin, Greek mihon chihna ahol’ui, 23 Keihon vang thingpel’a kikhenbeh Christa chu kaseiphongu ahi; hiche hi Judate din kipalna ahin, chidnag namdang ho dia ngolna ahi; 24 ahinla Juda mi hihen Greek mihijong le akikoute dinga Christa chu Pathen thahat le Pathen chihna ahiye. 25 Ajeh chu Pathen dia ngol kei chu mihem chihna sangin achingjon, Pathen dia hatmona chu mihem hatna sang in ahatjo nalaiye. 26 Sopite nakikou dol’u chu vetem’un, tahsaphe dol’a chingtah jong nahipouvin, thahat tahbeh jong nahipouve; phunglun laiya mi jong nahideh pouvin ahi; 27 amavang Pathenin vannoiya mimol ho hi miching ho jumso dia alhendoh a, vannoiya mihatmo ho hi mihat ho jumso dinga Pathenin alhendoh ahiuve. 28 Pathenin vannoiya mi lhasamho le nahsahmoa kikoi ho alhen’a, aumsa thil ho imacha lou sosahna dinga aumlouhel thil ho geiya aumsah ahi. 29 Hitia hi Pathen angsunga mihing khat cha kiletsah thei louhel ding ahiuve. 30 Pathen vanga nang ho hi Christa to hingkhom nahiuvin Christa chu Pathena kon eiho chihna, them chamna, kisuh thengna le lhatdamna ahin, 31 Pathen lekhabua, “Akisonga chu Pakai vangin kisong hen,” tia kisun banga um ahi.

1 Corinth 2

Thingpel’a kikhenbeh Christa seiphong

1 Sopite, nahenguva Pathen thuguh phongjal dia kahung chun kamthem le chihna manga hung kahipoi. 2 Ijeh-inem itile nang ho lah a thingpel’a akhetbeh pau Jesu Christa tilou ima dang helou hel dinga kihan lho kahitai. 3 Keima nahenguva lhasam tah le kichatah chule kihot hot’a hung kahin, 4 kathusei le kathuseiphong chu chihna thugil tah akisei ahipon, lhagao le athahat phondohna joh ahibouve; 5 hiche hin natahsan’u chu mihem chihna vang hilouva Pathen thahat vanga ahijoh photchetna ahiye.

Pathen lhagao thuphondoh

6 Apilhingsa ho henga vang chihna thun jong kaseiji nauvin, amavang hiche leiset chihna le amang thah ding leiset vaipote chihna jong ahipoi; 7 amavang leiset um masanga Pathenin iloupina diuva gotsa akoi, kiselguh, Pathen chihna thuguh joh chu kaseijiu ahibouve. 8 Hichu hiche leiset vaipote khat chan jong ahepouve, ajeh chu heule loupina Pakai chu thingpel’a akhetbeh louhel diu ahi. 9 Ahinla Pathen lekhabua kisun: “Mit mukhah lou, naa jah khah lou, Mihem lungthima jong lutkha loulai, Pathenin ama ngailuho dinga agonsa chu,” tia kisei bang chun, 10 lhagao amangchan Pathenin eiho henga aphongdoh tai; ajeh chu Lhagaovin thil ijakai akholchil jin, Pathen selguh ho geiyin ahildohjie. 11 Ama sunga cheng mihem, lhagao tilou mihem umdol thil ho chu koipen ham ahea? Hitobang chun Pathen umdol thil ho chu Pathen Lhagao tilou koiman ahepoi. 12 Pathena kona manbei thilpeh eipeh ho’u ihet theina diuva vannoi leiset lhagao ikisanu ahipon, Pathen Lhagao joh ahibouve. 13 Hiti ho chun hilson chihna thu hoa seilouva, lhagaova kihilna dungjuiya Lhagao neiho henga Lhagao thudih kahilchet’uva kaseijoh-u ahi. 14 Tahsa lam mihemin vang Pathen Lhagao thil ho chu akisanjipoi; ajeh chu ama din hichu ngolna ahin, Lhagao dol’a phot chet ding ahijehin hejong ahe theipoi. 15 Lhagaova hingmi vangin ijakai aphochen theiyin, midangin vang ama chung thudol atan theipoi. 16 “Ajeh chu koiham Pakai lungthim hea, Ama hil thei ding mi chu?” akiti. Eihon vang Christa lungthim ineiyui.

1 Corinth 3

Pathen dia tohkhompi

1 Sopite, Lhagao chenna miho henga bangin keiman nang ho henga thu kasei theipon, tahsaphe mihem, Christa sunga cheng naosen henga sei banga kasi ahibouve. 2 Keiman noitwiya kavah-uva anham kapeh loulai nahive, ajeh chu nahe theihih laiyuve. Tujengin jongnahe thei hih laiyui, 3 ijeh-inem itile tahsaphe mihem nahi nalaiyuve. Nalah-uva kithangsetto le, khat le khat kinah kiphun aum laisea chu tahsa mihem hiya mihem chon chon’a chon nahiu hilou ham? 4 khat’in, “Keima Paul loukahi,” atia; adang khatman, “Keima Apollos loi kahi,” ati laisea chu namihem chon’u hilou ham? 5 Ahimonga Apollos chu ipi hiya, Paul chu ipi ham? Amani hi lhacha natong, amani jal’a natahsan’u ahin, koijoh ahilhona Pakai thilpeh nei cheh ahilhon’e. 6 Keiman kaphu ahin, ahin Apollos-in twi achap’a, Pathenin akhansah ahi. 7 Hichejeh chun aphutpa jong ima ahidehpoi; akhansah Pathen bou thupi ahi. 8 Aphutpa le atwichappa akibang lhonin, atohgim dungjui cheh a tohman asancheh lhon ding ahinai. 9 Keini Pathento tongkhom kahi lhonin, nang ho Pathen loulai, Pathen insah nahiuve. 10 Eikipe Pathen lungsetna dungjuiya, insa themtah banga abul kaphu ahitan, midangin achunga asahjom ahi. Asachanin iti asah kivet them hen. 11 Abul kiphutsa Jesu Christa tilou koiman abul dang phutdoh theiponte. 12 Koi ahin hiche abul kiphut chunga chun san an ashen, dangkan ashen, dong mantamin, ashen lang, thingin ashen, hampa ham changpol hamin sajong le, 13 min atoh cheh chu hung kiphongdoh cheh a, min atoh cheh chu meiya kipatep ding ahiye. 14 Mi khat natoh a-insah chu adin jou nah leh tohman asan ding; 15 mikhattou anatoh meiyin akahvam vangle tohman asan lou ding ama tah vang huhhing chang ding, mei pi pal galkaipa tobang hiding ahi. 16 Pathen Houin nahiuva nasunguva Pathen Lhagao achen chu nahet louvu ham? 17 Khattouvin hiche Pathen Houin chu asuhmang le Pathenin ama asuhmang ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile Pathen Houin chu atheng ahin, nang ho a-Houin chu anahiuve. 18 Koima ama kilhen lha hih hen; nalah-uva khattou tulai khanga dia chinga kigel aumle, achihna din ngoljo hen. 19 Ijeh-inem inem itile hiche vannoi chihna hi Pathen koma ngolna ahibouve; ajeh chu Pathen lekhabua akisunin: “Aman miching ho chu Ajonchih nauva amudohji,” akitin; 20 Chule avel’in: “Pakaiyin miching ho lung gel jouse Aboncha pannabei ahi ahenai,” akiti. 21 Hijeh chun koima mihemin kisonda hen; ajeh chu ijakai aboncha nang hoa jeng ahin, 22 Paul hihen Apollos hile, Cephas ahin, vannoi ahin, hinna hihen thina hijongle, tupet le khonung geiya aboncha nang hoa ahibouve. 23 Nang ho Christa mi nahiuvin, Christa chu Pathen’a ahi.

1 Corinth 4

Solchahho Pathen natoh

1 Keiho hi Christa lhacha, Pathen thuguh chingin min eingaitou hen. 2 Hichea neiching ding kihol’a chu tahsan um hiding ahi. 3 Keidin vang nang hon kachung thu nakhol diu hihen mihem thutan nikhoa kikhol ding hijongle, thu neochan bou kagel’e; keiman bon kachung thu kakikholsampoi. 4 Keiman kiphat lamna ding kahepon, hijongle themmona beihel kahi tina ahidehpoi, hichea kahcung thu khol chil’a pang Pakai ahi. 5 Hiti ahijeh a chu aphet tep phat, Pakai hung kahsen nang hon koima thu tandauvin, aman muthima kisel thiljouse khovah a a phondoh a, mihem lungthim ngaoto chengse jong aphondoh ding ahinai. Chutah le amitakip’in Pathena kona achan ding lom pachatna akisan cheh ding ahi. 6 Sopite, hichengse hi nang ho khohsah jal’a kei le Apollos pan’a nang ho kheldoh goa, Pathen lekhabua “Akisun kalval’in akichon ngaipoi,” ti hi keinia kona nakihil’uva, chule mikhat sonnaa mi khat chun midang khat anahsahmo louna dinga kasei ahi. 7 Ajeh chu koiham nang nachom khen a? Mia nalah lou ipi naneiyem? Nalah ahile ibol’a alallou banga hoithoa kiletsah nahim? 8 Tun nalung nau achimset’in, nahulhingsoh tauve; keiho beiya leng chang gam nahitauvin, keiho to leng ichan khom theina diuvin leng chang tahbah hileu chun kati tave! 9 Ipijeh- inem itile vannoi le Vantilte chule mihemte vetchan bep dia amangthah dia umsa mihem ho banga Pathenin keiho Solchahho hi anukhah pen’a eikoidan’uvin kagel’e. 10 Christa khohsah jeh a keiho a-ngol kahiuvin, Christa sunga cheng nang ho vang nachingui; kei ho kadoiyun, nang ho nahat’uve; nang ho gin le jabol nahiuvin, keiho mi not thap’in ka-um’ui! 11 Tugeiyin jong gilkel dangchah kathoh-un, nihchen ponsil bei, mi khut thah lhauna, chenna intum neilou kahiuve; 12 kakhut nin chol le nangin na katong gim’un, eihousete phat thei kaboh-un, min eibol genthei tengu kathoh ham ham’un, 13 min kallah a eihou tengule lungdamsel’iin kahouvun vannoi kithenhonna bang in ka-umdoh tauvin, tugeiyin mitin kilepnan ka-umdoh tauve. 14 Nang ho jumsona ding hilouva kasha tah kachate banga nang ho hilchahna joh ahicheng hi kahindut ahibouve. 15 Christa dinga nail’uva sangsom neijeng jong leu chun patampi naneipouve; ajeh chu Kipana Thupha jeh a Christa Jesu dinga kahinsa nahitauve. 16 Hichejeh a chu ka-ngeh nahiuve, keima umchan jom hiuvin. 17 Hiche dinga hi Timothy nahenguva kahinsol ahi, ama hi Pakaiya tahsan um kasahtah kachapa ahin, aman muntin le Houbung jousea kahilleji, Christa Jesu hinkhoa kachon namlhah aboncha nageldohsah diu ahi. 18 Nahenguva kei hi hung lou dia gel’a nalah-uva kiletsah hoitho mi na-um’uvin, 19 Pakai lungdei ahile keila nahenguva hungvah jel didng kahi; chutengle hiche mi kiletsah ho thusei mai hilouva atha neina geiyuva kahetdoh idndg ahi, 20 ajeh chu Pathen lenggam chu thuhomkeo ahipon, tha neina ahi. 21 I-ham naseiyu? Mol choiya nahenguva kahung ding ha, ngailut neiya lhagaova lungnemtah a kahungjoh ding ham?

1 Corinth 5

Chonchatvai jeh a thutanna

1 Nalah-uva jon thanhoi um kichentah-in akijan, hitobang jon thanhoi hi chiding namdangte lah jenga jong umji lou ahi; hichea hinmi khat’in apa ji jin aneiye. 2 Hitobang thilbol natongpa chu nalah-uva kona paidoh ahitheina dinga lunggimpijo talouva ibol’a kiletsah hoithojo nahiuvem? 3 Tahsaa ka-um lou vangin lhagaovin nalah-uva kalhan, nalah-uva lha mong bangin hitobang thilbolpa chung thu chu katan chaiyin, 4 i-Pakaiyu Jesu minin nang ho to kalungthimin ikihou khom’un, i-Pakaiyu Jesu thahat’in 5 Pakai nikho ni le alhagao huhhinga aumtheina din hitobang mi hi atahsa suhmangna dia Satan henga napehdoh diu ahi. 6 Nakiletsah-u hi aphapoi. Chol themchan changlhah lhon pumpi achansohji nahet louvu ham? 7 Cholsolou nahijeh-un, changlhah lhon thah nahitheina diuvin chollui chu then ngimsel’uvin. Ijeh-inem itile i-kalchuh kut’uva din Christa kelngoi tha’n akithattai. 8 Hichejeh chun chollui le gitlouna le thilse bolna chol mang louvin, cholsoloi, thenna le thutah changlhah joh-in kut bol’u hite. 9 Kalekha thotnaa chun jon thanhoi bol ho to nakivop khom louna diuvin kahinsuntai; 10 hiche vannoiya jonthanhoi bol ho le neipap kilose ho chule misumang ho le doihouho kati ahipoi, achutilou le vannoiya kona napotdoh diu ngai ding ahi. 11 Tua nakivoppi lou diuva kasut ho chu sopia kisimsa khattouvin jongthanhoi, neipap kiloset abol’a, doi ahouva, Pathen ataitoma, ju akham’a chule mi anambol le, hitobang mi chu kiloikhohmpi louding kati ahi. 12 Polam miho thutan ding ka-ilouna ham? Asunga umho thubou natan jiu hilou ham? 13 Polam mite thu Pathenin tannante. Pathen lekhabua kisei bangin, thilse bolpa vang nalah-uva konin paidoh jengun!

1 Corinth 6

Pathen tahsanlouho henga kihehlou ding

1 Nang ho koi nahiuva khat’in achom khat chunga thu aneitengle mitheng ho angsunga kiheh ding go louva mithenglou chiding namdang ho henga heh ding nangap chat jeng jiu ham? 2 Mithengten vannoi thu geiya atan diu jong helou lai nahiuvem? Chutia vannoi thubon natan diu ahile thu neocha tan dia kilommo nahiuvem? 3 Leiset hinkho thu titah louva Vantilte thu geiya itan diu nahet louvu ham? 4 Chutia leiset hinkho thudol’a thu tanding nei nahiule Houbung sunga pamse miho chu thutan dia natousah jengu leh iti am? 5 Najachatna diuva hiche hi kaseikhum nahiuve. Nalah-uva sopicha kah a thu chai thei miching khatbeh umlou hitam? 6 Chutia chu sopi khat chun sopi khat aheh a atahsanlou ho ang’a kiheh jenglhon ham? 7 Hitia khat le khat nakihehtosau sauvu hin apumthon nahiu aphongtai; dih hih jongle nathoh gimjoh-u phalou ham? Kitoh lou hijongle nakido jenguva phalou ham? 8 Hichea hi nangho adih louva kibolgim’a kitoh louva kichom gam, sopite geiya chutibol nahiuve. 9 Midih louvin Pathen lenggam alo lou diu ahi nahet lou laiyu ham? Lhep chatvaiyin um hih-un; jonthanhoi bol ho, doi houho, mito jong ho, pasal le pasal, numei le numei jongho, 10 gucha ho, neipap kilose ho, jukham ho, mihanse ho, michomhat ho khat chan jong Pathen lenggam alo louhel diu ahi. 11 Nang ho abang bang hitobang chu nahiuvin, hijongle Pakai Jesu Christa min le i-Pathen’u lhagaova kisop ngim’a kithensoa them kichansah nahitauve.

Natibah chengsen Pathen choianin

12 Keidin thil ijakai bolngai ahin, ahinla abonchan thilpha asohdoh deh poi. Keidia thil ijakai bolngai ahivangin imacha noiya lut pong’e. 13 Khattouvin an hi oisunga lut, oisung hi ankholna ahi tinte; ahinla Pathenin agoma asuh bei ding ahi. Mihem tahsa hi jonthanhoi bolna ding ahipon, Pakai ding joh ahi, chule Pakaiyin jong tahsaa ding agelnai. 14 Thinaa kona Pakai kaithou Pathen chun eiho jong athahat pan’a eikaithou diu ahi. 15 Natahsau chu Christa tibah khat ahi naheuve. Hichea hi Christa tibah chu kalah manga noti tibah a kasemdoh ding ham? Hithei naisai ponte! 16 Notinu toh kijopmatpa chu amanu to tikhat ahilhon helou lai nahiuvem? Ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun kichentah-in, “Amani chu tikhat hilhon ding ahi,” tin aseiye. 17 Hichea hin Pakai to kijopmatpa jong chu Amato Lhagao khat ahilhontai. 18 Jonthanhoiya konin jam’un; mihemin chonsetna abol adang jouse chu atahsa polam ahin, jonthanhoi bolpa vang chu ama tahsa chunga chonse ahi. 19 Natahsau hi Pathena kona naneiyu nasunguva cheng Lhagao Theng Houin ahi, chule nang ho hi nang hoa nahilou lam helou nahiuvem? 20 Nang ho man kipea chohsa nahitauvin, hijeh chun natahsauvin Pathen choianuvin.

1 Corinth 7

Kichen thua thukhoh ho

1 Lekha nahinsut thudol’uva hin, pasal’in numei amai louhel ding thilpha ahi; 2 Jonthanhoi atamtai, pasal’in numei, numeiyin jong pasal ji kinei cheh hen, 3 pasal’in numei chu achan ding lom pehen lang, hitobangma chun numeiyin jong ajipa pehen lung nachim lhonhen. 4 Numeiyin ama tahsa chunga tha aneipon, pasal’in aneijoi; chutobangma chun pasal’in jong ama tahsa chunga tha aneipon, numeiyin bou aneiye. 5 Phat chom khat taonaa nakipeh theina diuva nakidondauva nahung kivop khom kit loi diu nakinopto gel’u tilouvin khat le khat don louvin kikoi hihun, chutile kitimlel jeh a Satanin nalhep lhah lo diu ahi. 6 Hiche hi phatsah thua kasei ahin, thupeh dungjui ahipoi. 7 Mihem jouse keima tobang hicheh le kadeiyin, ahinla min Pathen Lhagao thilpeh ama chan anei cheh-ui, khat’in hitobang, achom khatman khutobang aneiye. 8 Jinei louho le meithaiho kasei ahi, amaho chu kei bangin umleu aphai; 9 amavang akitimjou lou diu le ji aneijoh diu ahi, moh huh sangin jinei aphajoi. 10 Jineisa ho chu thu kapeh nahiuve, (Keima hijo louva Pakaiahi) numeiyin ajipa ajamsan louhel ding ahi, 11 ajamsan tah bah jongle jinei louva um ding, ahiloule ajipa to kihoucham kit lhon hen, chule pasal’in numei ada louhel ding ahi. 12 Adang ho henga, Pakai hilouva, keisei ahi, sopi khatouvin a tahsan lou numei jia aneiya, numei chu amatoh chen khom jing ding anop le, ajipan da hih hen; 13 chule numei khattouvin jong atahsan lou pasal jia aneiya, pasal chu amato chenkhom jing ding anop le, aman pasal chu da hih hen. 14 Atahsan lou pasal chu numeinu to ahinkhom jeh a akithenso ahitan, atahsan lou numei jong chu sopipa t0 ahinkhom jeh a kithenso ma ahitai, chutilou hile nachateu chuboh diu ahin, tua vang akithenso ahitai. 15 Ijemtia atahsan loupan adalhah vangle dalha jeng hen, hitobang thua hin sopipa hihen sopinu hijongle akikan lou ahitai, ahinla Pathenin kichamdel dia eikouvu ahi. 16 Hijeh a chu ipi nahet em numei, pasal nahoidohsah ding hinam? Chule pasal’in ipinahet em, numei nahoidohsah ding hinam?

Pakai pehdol hinkho

17 Mitakip Pakaiyin chan ahoppeh dungjui le mitakip Pathenin akoudoh hungjui banga achonlou khoh ahi, hiti dinga chu Houbung jousea chondan kasem ahitai. 18 Cheptansa kikou koiham? Selmang dahen. Cheptan louva kikou koiham? Cheptan din gotda hen. 19 Cheptan jong ima ahipon, cheptan lou jong imachom ahidehpoi, Pathen thupeh nit bou thu ahi. 20 Mitakip akikou pet’a bang cheh-in um cheh hen. 21 Nakikouva chu soh nahim? Ima gel khoh dan, amavang nachamlhatdoh thei le hichu mangcha jon. 22 Ijeh-inem itile soh ahipet’a Pakai dia kikou chu Pakaiya chamlhat ahin, hitobangma chun chamlhat ahipet’a kikou chu Christa soh ahi. 23 Man pea kichosa nahitauve, mihem soh-in pangkit hih-uvin. 24 Sopite, amitakip akikoupet tobang cheh-in hiti chun Pathen angsunga um cheh hen.

Jinei loule meithaiho

25 Nu-ngah ho thudol vang Pakaiya konin thupeh kaneipoi, hijong le Pakai hepina jal’a tahsan tah a keiman kagel khat kasei ahi. 26 Pha kasha chu ahile tulai hesoh gentheina jal hin mihem ama aum bang banga aum jeng ding pha kasai. 27 Numeito kisomlhopsa nahim? Onthol ding gotdan; numeiya kona ongdoh nahim, numei holdan, 28 Jinei jongle chun achonsea vang nahipoi, nu-ngah jeng jong ajineiya chu chonsea ahipoi. Amavang jinei hon tahsa genthei hesoh athoh diu ahin, hichu kapeldohsah nom nahiuve. 29 Ahinla hiche hi kaseipeh nahiuve sopite, phat anaitai, tukal’in jineisa chengse jong jinei lou bangin, 30 akapte chu kap lou bangin, akipahte kipah lou bangin, thil kichohten jong imacha nei lou bangin, 31 vannoiya natong thilbol’an jong imacha bol louhel bangin um hen; ijeh-inem itile hiche vannoi hi alim-agong akitolmang jing’e. 32 Lungkham louva naum diu kadeiye. Jinei loupan Pakai jeng agel’in Pakai lung lhai ding bou agel’e. 33 Jineisan vang vannoi thil ho agel’in, ajinu lung lhai ding agel’in; 34 hijeh chun akikhenna aum’e. Numei jineilou nu-ngah chun Pakai kinbol ding jeng agel jin, tahsa le Lhagaova kithenso ding adeiye; ahin jineisa numeiyin vang vannoi thil ho jeng angaiton ajipa along lhaina ding angaitoi. 35 Hicheng hi nang ho khichahna ding hilouva naphat chomna diu le khen beihel’a Pakaiya kitup keicha naum jing theina diuva kasei peh nahiuve. 36 Koiham khat’in kitimatpi lou dia akiloipi agolnu akivoppidol kitoh lou asah a, akitimlel behseh a, ikhat aso tei ding le, kicheng lhon hen, alungdeiyin bol jeng hen, chonsea ahipoi. 37 Amavang koi hile along sunga dettah a dinga, kitim lelna neilou, alunggul se thununtheiya, alunggil’a pangdet’a agolnu kitimatpi louva koijou chu thilpha bola hi; 38 hiti hin agolnukichenpi pa jong thilpha bol ahinan, ahivangin akichenpi loupan thilpha cheh abol ahiye. 39 Ajipa ahin laisea numei chu akihen ahin, ajipa thi teng vangle a-ongthol ahitan, Pakai lungdei adei dei to kicheng thei ahitai. 40 Ahinla keima ngaiton vang achuti moh um jeng thei le nomsa jonte, ajeh chu keijong Pathen Lhagao change kigel kahi.

1 Corinth 8

Doi houna neh le chah

1 Doihouna kinei neh le chah thudol’a vang, ijakai hetna inei bukimsoh-un ihesoh keiyui. Hetna vang hin mi kiletsah hoithona apensah jin, ngailut nan vang mi akhantousah ji’e. 2 Mi khattou i-them khat hea akigel le ama chun ahet ding dol jeng jong akihet lou lai ahibouve. 3 Amavang koi tobang khat’in Pathen angailut le ama chu Pathen hetmi ahitai. 4 Doi houna kinei neh le chah thudol’a vang vannoiya limsemthu doi hi ima ahipon, chule Pathen khatseh tilou adang aumlou jong i-hesoh keiyui. 5 Ijeh-inem itile vanlaijol le leiset chunga Pathen kisah ho um’u hen lang, hiti chun pathen tampi le Pakai tamtah hijong leu, 6 eiho din vang thil jouse konna le eiho geiya Amaa ihiu Pa Pathen khatseh le thil jouse amavanga um eiho jong Amavanga hing Pakai khatseh Jesu Christa bou ahi. 7 Ahinla mi jousen hiche hetna hi aneipon, abang khat’in doihou lai umchan tugeiya achinjeh-un aneh achah-u chu doihouna kinei mongin agel’un, alung gelnau tha alhemjeh-in hichea hin akisuhboh lo jitauve. 8 Ahin anneh chun Pathen kom einaisah chom diu jong ahipon, ne hih jongleu hen kemchom lou nejongleu hen phatchompi deh lou ihiuve. 9 Hijongle hiche natha neinau hi alhasamte dia kipal lhuhna ahilouna din ching theiyun. 10 Ijeh-inem itile hetna neisa nangin doihouna ankong naum chu lhahsamna neimin namudoh le, lhasam tah ahivanga alung gel’a doihouna an neh ding katilkhou lou ding ham? 11 Hijeh a chu hiche sopi hetnaa lhasam, ajal’a Christa thipeh mi chu nang hetnan asuhmang ahitai. 12 Hitobang hin sopite dounan chonseuvin lang along gel’u hat lou chu suhnat peh leu chun Christa douna chonse nahiuve. 13 Hijeh chun kasopi kipal lhuh louna din, neh le chah a kasopi akipal lhuh ding le a-itih chan geiyin sa asan neh dange.

1 Corinth 9

Solchah khat tha neina jat

1 Chamlhat kahilou ham? Solchah kahilou ham? I-Pakaiyu Jesu mu lou kahim? Nang ho hi Pakai dia katohga nahilouvu ham? 2 Midang din solchah hi hih jong leng nang ho din kahi; ajeh chu solchah kahina mohor chu Pakai hinkhoa nang ho hinna hi ahi. 3 Hiche hi einelkal ho henga kakihonna ahi. 4 Nehna dingle donna dia thunei mo kahiuvem? 5 Solchah dang ho le Pakai sopite chule Cephas banga atahsan numei jia kipuile dia thanei lou kahiuvem? 6 Ahiloule kei le Barnabas hin natong louva kivahna thei tha kanei lhon lou ham? 7 Ama sum kisan’a sepai natong koiham? Lengpilei bol’a aga nelou koiham? Ahiloule kelngoi hon ching’a panga kelngoi noitwi nelou koiham? 8 Hicheng hi mihem ngaidol’a kasei hilou ham? Ahiloule hicheng hi Danthun jong aseihilou ham? 9 Ijeh-inem itile Mose Danthua chun, “Bongchal chang chilpet muh nakan lou ding ahi,” tin akisun’e. Pathenin bongchal ho akhohsah mong ham? 10 Hichengpi keiho khohsahna asei hilou ham? Ajeh chu keiho jal’a kisun ahi; ajeh pen tah chu loukaiyan kinepna neiya akaitei ding, chang chil’an jong chan akisan ding kinem’a achil ding ahi. 11 Keiin nang ho dia Lhagao muchi kitupeh a, nang hoa kon’a leiset thil kakisan lhon didng chu keini dia thupi tah ham? 12 Midang hon nachunguva thu anei theile keihon kahanei cheh joh lou diu ham? Ahivangin keihon hiche thuneina chu kamangpouve; Christa thudol Kipana Thupha imachaa kasuhmo louna diuvin ijakaiya kathoh ham ham jo’uve. 13 Houin lhacha kinbol hon Houin’a kona neh le chah akijon’uva, chule maicham phunga lhachasen jong maicham’a kitoh thil hoa chan aneijiu khu helou nahiuvem? 14 Hitobanga chu Kipana Thupha lhangsam hon jong Kipana Thuphaa kona kivah hingna anei diuva Pakaiyin thu alhuhsah ahi. 15 Ahinla ken hiche ho hi khat cha jong kamangchapoi. Hichengse chu hitia chu kachan theina dia jong kahinsut ahipoi; ajeh chu kakisonna hi khattouvin ahomkeo asosah sangin thileng keidin aphajoi. 16 Kipana Thupha seiphongle jong leng keidia kisonna ahidehpoi, kabollou khoh eikisekhum ahibouve; ajeh chu Kipana Thupha seiphong louva um hileng keidia iti khoh a khoh ding hitam! 17 Ijeh-inem itile keima lungchama bol’a kahile tohman kasan ding hitin, ahinla kachama tong kahiloujeh-in katoh ding lom kin eikisekhumjo ahi. 18 Ahile katohman chu ipiba ham? Kipana Thupha chu manbeiya seiphonga aum theina ding le hiche Kipana Thuphaa keiman katha neina kachan lom chu lhingset’a kangeh louna ding ahi. 19 Keima mi jousea kona chamlhat kahitah vangin mi tamcheh kalah lut theina din kei le kei mitin soha kisemdoh kahin, 20 Judate lah lut theina din Judate lah a Juda mi umin ka-umin, Danthu noiya um miho kalah thei nan, Danthu noiya ka-um lou vangin Danthu noiya umte bangin ka-umjie; 21 Danneiloute kaloilut theina din Dan nei loute henga Dan neiloute henga Danneilou bangin ka-umjin, amavang Christa Danthua um kahin, Pathen Dan mang lou kahipoi; 22 mi lhasamte kalah lut theina din alhasamte henga alhasam bangin ka-umjin ahi; hitia hi mi phabep kahuhhing theina dia mitin henga ijakai kahiji ahi. 23 Aboncha hi Kipana Thupha khohsah jal’a kabol’a, hichea chu chan kaneidoh theina ding ahi. 24 Lhaitet golseh mun’a khu mi jouse alhai cheh vanga mi khat’in bou hatman asanji nahet louvu ham? Hitia chu nasan theina diuvin lhaiyun. 25 Golseh bol jousen ijakaiya atibah chengseu atimhat jiuvin, hiche ho hin kem mangthei lallukhuh san na dia abol’u ahin, eihoa vang kem thei lou ahi. 26 Hitia chu lhaiya kahin, abidoi kicheh neilou kahipon, onghom lai khuttum’a sua jong kahipoi. 27 Midang henga thu kiseiphonglea ajo le kei ma lah louva ka-um louna dia katahasa hi kachup’a thua kanunsah ahi.

1 Corinth 10

Semthu doilim houjeh a gihsalna

1 Sopite ima hetoh louva naum diu kadeipoi, ajeh chu ipuipateu chu abonchauva meilhang noiya kijot’a, Twikhanglen pal galkai ahiuvin, 2 chule abonchauvin Mose nungjui ahiu hetnan meilhang lah le Twikhanglena baptize achangui; 3 abonchan Lhagao an thakhat anekhom’un, 4 abonchauvin lhagao twi thakhat adonkhom’ui; ajeh chu anung jui jing Lhagao songpia kon in twi adon’un, hiche Songpi hi Christa chu ana hi. 5 Ahinla alah-uva mi kon khat chunga Pathen alung lhai loujeh-in gamthip laiya alhukamtauve. 6 Amahon alung gul banguva thilse ilung gul louna diuva thilsoh hichengse hi eiho hilchahna soh ahitai. 7 Pathen lekhabua, “Mipi chu anne ding le twidon din atouvun ahinla lam din akipatdoh kittauve,” tia kisun bang chun alah-uva kon khat bangin limsemthu doi houdauvin. 8 Alah-uva mi phabep’in jonthan hoi apat jeh-uva nikhat sungseh a mihem sang som ni le sang thumin athi lo jeh-in jonthanhoi bol poute. 9 Alah-uva mi konkhat’in Pakai apatep jeh-uva gulsen achuh lihgam jeh-in eihon patep pou hite. 10 Alahuva abang bang akiphin jeh-uva misumang Vantil’in asuh mangjehin kiphin hih-vin. 11 Achunguva thilsoh hichengse hi vetkah dinga soh ahin, chule khang nu nunga mi eiho pho tangna dinga kisundoh ahiye. 12 Hichejeh chun koi hile adinga kigel’an alhuh louna din ching thei hen. 13 Mihem doulel lhepna na chunguva achukhapoi, Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, Nathan adoujou kalval’in lhepna anchunguva chuh sah ponte, chule lhepna chuto kilhon’a nathoh jouvuva nahoidohna diu lampi nasempeh diu ahi. 14 Hichejeh chun ka-ngai tahte, doihou jamsan’un. 15 Lung khomto mi nahijeh-uva kasei ahi, nang hon kigel toh-uvin. 16 Phatthei channa khon’a phattheiboh i-ngeh tengu, hiche hi Christa thisan donkhomna hilou ham? Chu le changlhah ihebaljiu khu Christa tahsa changkhomji ihilouvu ham? 17 Hichea hin changlhah pheng khatseh ahin, eiho tampi jong hi tahsa khatseh ihiuve; ijeh-inem itile ibonchauva changlhah pheng khat changkhom ihiuve. 18 Tahsa dol’a Israel khu veuvin; maicham thilto neho khu maicham thil changkhom cheh hilou ham? 19 Ipi kaseiyem? Doi houna kinei neh le chah chu ikhat ahi katia; ahiloule limsemthu doi khu ikhat ahi katim? 20 Katipoi, chidang namdangten kithoina aneiyu chu thilhaho apeh-u ahin, Pathen apeh-u ahipoi, hijeh a chu thilhaho to chan naneikhom diu kadeilou ahiye. 21 Nang hon Pakai khon le thilhaho khon’a nadonkop thei lou diu, Pakai dokhang le thilhaho dokhanga ankong na-umkhom thei lou diu ahi. 22 Ahiloule Pakai chu thangset sahna dia iphin lung hang diu ham? Ama sangin la ihatjo pouvin!

Ijakai Pathen loupina din bol’un

23 “Ijakai bolngai ahi,” akitin, ahinla aboncha khantouna ahidehpoi. 24 Koiman ama changseh phatna ding hol louvin midang phatna ding holjo hen. 25 Kailhang sajohna mun’a thil kijoh ipi hile hetchetna dia dongtoh le louvin nejengun. 26 “Ijeh-inem itile leiset le asunga um jouse hi Pakaiya ahi,” tin akiseiye. 27 Pathen tahsanlou min an nea nakouva nache nom’u le na-angsunguva aluichan chu hetchetna dongtoh le louvin nejenguvin. 28 Amavang, “Hiche hi doiphunga kithoina sa ahi,” atile, naseipeh pau jeh le lung gel’a hetchetna aumtah jeh-in neh dauvin, 29 nang lung gel’a hetchetna mai kasei ahi pon, khatpa joh a chu kasei ahi. “Iti keima chamlhatna chu mi dang lung gel maiyin atuh oh thei ding ham? 30 Keiman lunglhaisel’a kisanga, thangvah puma kasan chu kon eitaitompeh ding ham?” tin nate. 31 Hichea hinneuvin don jong leu chun nabol jouseu Pathen loupina din bol’uvin. 32 Judate hihen Greek miho hile chule Pathen Houbungmite dia kipal lhuh nan um dauvin lang, 33 keiman kachangseh a phatchomna ding hol louva, ijakaiya mitin lunglhaina kahol’a huhhinga aum theina diu kabol bangin bol’uvin.

1 Corinth 11

1 Keiman Christa umchan ka-jop bang hin keima umchan jom-uvin.

Houkhomnaa numei ponlu khuh

2 Keima neigeldoh jinguva nang ho kapeh kihilna chengse natuh chah jing jeh-uvin nang ho kaseiphai. 3 Hichea hin Christa mitin luchang ahiya, pasal numei luchang chule Christa luchang Pathen ahidol hinahet diu kadeiye. 4 Pasal koi hile lukhuh khuh puma taova ha, ahiloule gaothuseiya ham chun aluchang Christa i-asah lou ahin; 5 numei koi hile lukhuh louva taova ha, ahiloule gaothuseya ham jong chun aluchang ajipa i-asah lou ahi, ama nu chu alikiveltol nu tobangma ahibouve. 6 Numeiyin lukhuh akhuh lou ngal ding le asam kivotol hen, sam kivotol chu numei dinga jachatna ahile lukhuh akhuh a pha jeng ahi. 7 Pasal vangin Pathen lim le loupina aput jeh a lukhuh akhuh lou ding ahi; numeiyin pasal thupi na aphondoh ahi. 8 Ijeh-inem itile Pasal hi numeiya kondoh ahipon, numeijoh pasal’a kondoh ahibouve. 9 Chule numei khohsahnaa pasal kisem ahipon, pasal khohsahna joh numei kisem ahi. 10 Hijeh a chu Vantilte jal’a numeiyin ajipa noiya ahichu aluchanga achin ding ahi. 11 Ahinla Pakaiya hinkhoa hin pasal beiya numei ima ahipon, numei beiyin jong pasal ima ahipoi. 12 Ajeh chu pasal’a numei akondoh banga Pasal jong numeiya peng ahi, ahinla thil ijakai Pathena kon cheh ahiye. 13 Nang hon geltoh-uvin, numei lukhuh khuh louva Pathen henga ataoji chu kilom nam? 14 Pasal dia sam hoisao hi ama dinga nahsahmona ahi, thil umdol mongin jong nahil louvu hiya, 15 numei dia samsao hi thupina ahi umchanin nahil louvu ham? Ipijeh-inem itile samsao chu akhujol dinga kipe ahi. 16 Ahinla koitobang anel’a aumle, hiche thudol’a hin eihon chonna lhongpi mong ineipouvin, Pathen Houbungten jong aneipoi.

Pakai anjonna chonhoilou pho na

17 Hiche hilchahna kapeh diuva hin kaseipha pouve, ajeh chu phat jep jepna dia kikhom hilouvin setna cheh joh dia kikhom nahiuve. 18 Amasa penin nang ho Houbunga nahung kikhopji tengle loitum tuma nakikhenjiu thu kajan, tahjong katahsan thim thim’e. 19 Nalahuva lah thei tah miho ahung kiphondoh a hetdoh a aum theina diuva nasunguva lung gel ngaito chom jong um ding mong ahinai. 20 Ahinla mun khat’a nahung kikhop khom tengule Pakai jan anjon nehna dingdol ahipoi, 21 ajeh chu amitakip’in ama jan an cheh akineh masah jin, abang khat’in kel athoh jin, adang khatma akham avan aum’e. 22 Nehna ding donna ding in neilou nahiuvem? O-le Pathen Houbung chu nahsahmoa bol’a aneiloute jachatsah nahiuvem? Ipi kaseipeh diu ham? Kaseiphat diu ham? Hiche thua vang pahcha pouving’e.

Pakai anjon kiphudoh

23 Pakaiya kona kalah nang ho kapehson’u thuhil chu hiche ahi, Pakai Jesu apehdoh jan chun, aman changlhah alan, 24 phatthei aboh jouvin aheh bal bal’in, “Hiche hi nang ho khel’a pang katahsan chu ahi, neihet jingna diuvin bol’un,” ati. 25 Hitobangma chun jan anneh jouvin khon chu alan, “Hiche khon hi kathisan’a kitepna thah ahi, nadon chan’uva keima neigeldoh jing na diuvin bol’un,” ati. 26 Ijeh-inem itile hiche changlhah naneh-uva hiche khon’a nadon laiseuva ahung kit kahsea Pakai thina chu naphondoh jingu ahi.

Anea lom louvin Pakai anjon aneh

27 Hijeh chun koi hile alam louva changlhah chu nea ha, ahiloule Pakai khon’a kona don hamchu Pakai tahsa le thisan douna chonsea kisim ding ahi. 28 Mihem amacheh kikhol chil hen lang akikhol dungjuiyin changlhah chu nehen, khon’a konin jong don hen. 29 Ijeh-inem itile Pakai tahsa chu ipi kiseina ahi helouva nea don’a chun, aneh a adon’a kona achung thu akitan ahi. 30 Hichejeh a chu nalah-uva mi tamtah chatmoa na-chea ahin, aihmu mil’a jong atam lheh tai. 31 Eiho kikhol chil masa leu hen thutanna ichuh khah lou diu ahi; 32 hijongle vannoi to ithuu akitan tha louna din Pakaiyin eikholchil’uvin eigah chah tauve. 33 Hijeh chun kasopite, anedinga nahung kikhop tengule khat le khat ki-ngah khom’uvin. 34 Nahung kikhop tengule thutannanachuh louna diuvin, koihile agilkel’a chun a-in’a hin kineh hen. Thudang dang ho thudol vang kahung tengle sutoh nang ‘e.

1 Corinth 12

Lhagao Thilpeh ho

1 Sopite, Lhagao thilpehdol helouva na-um diu kanompoi. 2 Chidang namdang nahi laiyuva chu limsemthu doi paomo ho noiya kun’a, hiche ho chun napui mangjiu naheuve. 3 Hijeh a chu kahetsah nahiuve, Pathen Lhagao puihoi mi koiman, “Jesu gaosap chang hen,” atipon, chule Lhagao Thenga konlouvin koiman, “Pakai Jesu,” ati thei poi. 4 Lhagao thilpeh tampi aumnan, ahinla apea Lhagao khat bou ahi; 5 chule lhacha natoh tampi aumvangin Pakai khatseh bou ahiye; 6 chuma le natoh gotchom chom aumin, ahinla Pathen khatseh bou ahin, aman thil hichengsea chu na atohji ahibouve. 7 Amitakip hi japi phat touna dia Lhagao kiphondoh na hetna thilpeh khat cheh kipea ahi. 8 Ijeh-inem itile hiche Lhagaova kona chu mi khat chihna thu kipea, michom khat chu hiche lhagaoma maa kona chu hettheina thu kipea, 9 chom khat jong hiche Lhagaova kona hi tahsan kipea, hiche Lhagaova kon kit’a hi midang khat damsah theina Lhagao thilpeh kipea, 10 midangkhat chu thil kidang bol theina kipea, adang khatma gaothu seitheina kipea, mikhatma chu Lhagao le Lhagao dat khen themna kipea, khat jong paotin tang hetna kipea, khatma paotin tang ledoh jouna kipea ahin, 11 ahinla hichengse bol’a chu hiche Lhagao khatseh chu ahin, aman angaito le adei dungjuiya amichan cheh a ahoppeh ahi.

Tibah aboncha tahsa pumkhat

12 Tahsa pumkhat sunga tibah tampi aumin, tahsa tibah tampi ahivangin tipum khat bou ahi, Christa jong chuti ahiye. 13 Ajeh chu eiho Juda mi hiu hen Greek mi hijongleu hen, soh hiu hen chamlhat hijongleu hen, Lhagao khat’a dia ibonchauva tahsa khat’a baptize changkhom, Lhagao khat’a dia ibonchauva donkhom ihiuve. 14 Ijeh-inem itile tahsa hi tibah khatseh ahipon, tampi ahibouve. 15 Kengphang hin, “Khut kahiloujeh-in keima tipuma kahipoi,” tile hiche vanga chu tipuma hida deh lou ding ahi. 16 Chule bilkol hin, “Mit kahiloujeh-in keima tipuma kahipoi,” tile hiche vanga chu tipuma hida deh lou ding ahi. 17 Tahsa pumpi hi mit hita le hoiya khojahna um ding ham? Apumpin khojahna hita le hoiya gimnam jahna um ding ham? 18 Tua vang Pathenin tibah ho hi khat khat’a tahsa puma adeina laimun cheh a aphulut ahi. 19 Aboncha hi tibah khat seh hita le tipum hoiya umtan tem? 20 Tua vang tibah atam vangin tipum khat bou ahi. 21 Mit hin khut jah’a, “Nangma ka-ngai chatna aumpoi,” ti theilou, chukit le luchang hin kengphang te nijah a, “Nang ni ka-ngai chapoi, “ti thei lou ahi. 22 Chuti titah sanga tahsa pumpia um tibah hatmoa kigel chengse hi akhohjo a pang cheh ahiuve. 23 Eihon jong nahsah louva kigel tibah ho chu ikhohsah jo’uvin, itibah hoimoa um lai jouse jong ijemhoijo jiuvin, 24 hiche kijepna ho chu itibahhoi ho hin angai chapoi. Ahinla Pathenin tahsa pum hi asuton, alhasam tibah ho chu akhohsah cheh joi, 25 hitia chu tahsa pum sunga kikhenna aumdaa, hisanga chu tibah ho khat le khat akigel khoh to cheh na diu ahijoi. 26 Hijeh a chu tibah khat’in athohgim le tibah jousen athoh gimpia, tibah khat seiphat achan le tibah dang jouse jong kipah khom ihiuve. 27 Nang ho Christa tipum nahiuvin, khat cheh chu atibah nahiuve. 28 Pathenin Houbung sunga hi amasatah a Solchah ho, aninaa themgao ho, thum channaa mihil ho, chuban’a bolmo kidang bol ho, abankit’a damtheina lhagao thilpeh chang ho, thilphachom bol ho, vaipo them ho, paochom chom tho thei ho atun ahi. 29 Aboncha Solchah hiuvam? Abonchauva themgao hiuvam? Abonchauva mihil hiuvam? Abonchauva bolmo kidang bol thei hiuvem? 30 Abonchauva damsah theina Lhagao thilpeh neila hilouva ong? Aboncha pao chom thoa hi-ngal louva ong? Aboncha pao ledoh theila hilouva ong? 31 Amavang Lhagao thilpeh lencheh ho hadel’un. Lampi phachehjo kavetsah diu ahinalaiye.

1 Corinth 13

Ngailut

1 Keiman mihempao jouse le Vantilte pao tho thei jong leng, ngailut kanei loule sum-eng dah kivonging le khutbeh kibeng ging bep kahi. 2 Keiman gaothu sei dohna kaneiya thil imguh jouse jong seidoh a hetna jouse kanei thei, mol tolmang helna thei tahsan geiya kanei thei ahin, ngailut kanei loule imacha kahipoi. 3 Vaicha gentheite vahna kanei jouse kato thei, katahsa geiya meiya govam jeng dia kaphal ngam thei ahinan, ngailut ka nei loule phatchomna kaneideh poi. 4 Ngailut nan athoh hat jingin, hejong ahepin, athangsepon, akithang-at pon, akiletsahpoi; 5 alam louvin achonpon, ama chang phat chomna aholpon, alung hang baipon, thil phalou jat amelchihpoi; 6 thildih louva akipahji pon, thudih akipapijie; 7 imajousea athoh hat’in, imajousea atahsanin, ima jousea akinemin, ijakaiya athoh tun tun’e. 8 Ngailutnan beitih neiponte. Gaothu seidoh um jongle beiding, paochom chom tho um jongle hai ding, hetna um jongle bei ding ahi. 9 Ijeh-inem itile ihetnau le gaothu iseidoh nau hi bukim lou ahi; 10 abulhing chamkim ahung tengle akimlou chengse bei ding ahi. 11 Kachapan laiyin chapang thuseiyin kaseiyin, chapang lung gel’in kagel’in, chapang thil ngaiton ka-ngaitoi; pasal lhing kahiphat’in vang chapan lai thil jouse kapaitai. 12 Ajeh chu eihon tugeiya phatvetsunga lim kichen louva imu’u ahin, ajo tah le kimaitoa imudiu ahi; tu chan geiya kahet kimlou ahin, ajo tah le eihet kimsoh banga kahet kimsoh ding ahi. 13 Tun tahsan, kinep, ngailut hicheng thum hi um jing ahin, hicheng lah a ngailut athupipen’e.

1 Corinth 14

Paochom tho le gaothusei

1 Ngailutna del jingun, Lhagaothilpeh ho tup’un lang, ahideh-in Pathen thu seidohna ding hatup’uvin. 2 Paochom thoa thusei chun mihemte koma sei ahipon, Pathen henga asei ahi, ajeh chu koiman ahetpeh poi, aman Lhagaova thuguh asei ahibouve. 3 Pathen thu seidoh vang chun mihemte koma khantouna ding le tilkhouna chule lungmonna sei ahi. 4 Paochom thoa vang ama khantouna ding bou akisei ahin, Pathen thu seidohpa vang chun Houbung akhantousah-e. 5 Paochom thoa thu nasei cheh diu kadeiyin, ahinla Pathen thu naseidoh diu kadei cheh-e, Houbungin akisan’a khantouna anei theina dia aledoh aum loule paochom thoa thusei sangin Pathen thu seidohpa chu gamchengin aphachomjoi. 6 Tun sopite, nahenguva hunging paochom thon thuseiying, thu phondoh ham, hetna ham, gaothu seidohna ham ahiloule hilchetna ham mangin seipeh dau leng ipi naphatchompi diu ham? 7 Hitobang chun hinna bei thil ging thei, kuli ahim, selangdah ham akimut teng agin akicheh loule ipi kitho ahi kon iti ahetdoh ding ham? 8 Ijeh-inem itile sumkon mutgin akichet loule koi galkon dia kigo thei ding ham? 9 Hitobanga chu paochom thoa thu nasei tengu nasei cheng akicheh loule ipi naseiyu kon iti ahetdoh ding ham? Hui lhoh mang ding bep’a aseiyu ahibouve. 10 Vannoiya hin aging thei ogin atam lheh jengin, khat cha jong ajeh bei aumpoi. 11 Keiman hiche ogin chu ipi kiseina ham he hih leng aseipa dia keima pao helou kahitan, amachu kei dinga pao helou ahitai. 12 Hitobang hin nang hon jong aban’a Lhagao thilpeh hol nahiuvin, hichea chun lolhin chehna din Houbung khantouna ding ho hahol’uvin. 13 Paochom thoa thusei chun ipi kisei ham aledoh theina din tao hen. 14 Ajeh chu keima paochom thon tao leng kalhagao vang atao nan, kalung gil’a van aga aumpoi. 15 Ahile iti dingba ham? Lhagaova katao tengle lung gil’a katao tei ding, Lhagaova la kasha teng lung gil’a jong kasah tei ding ahi. 16 Nangin phattheiboh ngeh nan Lhagaovin tao le chun kikhopna mun’a um milham chun ipi naseila helouva nang thangvahnaa chu, “Amen,” iti ati thei ding ham? 17 Nangin phatah-in thangvahna sei jong le chun khatpa chun akhantoupi lou ahi. 18 Nang ho sei sanga paochom thoa thu kaseitamjoh jeh-in Pathen kathangvah-e. 19 Ahivangin Houbung sunga paochom thoa thu cheng asang sang kasei sangin mihil chah na dia kalunggil’a thu cheng nga seh sei kadeijoi. 20 Sopite, lung gel’in chapang hih-un, nunsetna lama chapangun lang, lung gel’in vang pilhinguvin. 21 Pathen lekhabua Danthu kisun: “‘Paochomhel tho ho, Michom beh ho kamsunga Keiman hiche mite henga thu kasei ding, Hijongle amahon kasei ngaipouvinte,’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye,” akiti. 22 Hichejeh a chu paochom tho hi tahsan loulai ho dinga melchihna ahin, atahsansa ho ding ahipoi; Pathen thuseidoh vang hi atahsansa ho ding ahin, atahsan loulai ho ding ahipoi. 23 Houbung pumpi kikhom hen lang amitakip’in paochom thoa thu aseipet’in milhamho ham atahsan lou lai hoham hung lut jengle, a-ngolgam dol’a namudoh lou diu ham? 24 Amavang mi jousen Pathen thu aseidoh pet’in atahsan loulai ham milham khat hung lutkha ta le, ajah chengsen asosol’a aboncha chu a-oimoa pang ding, 25 alungthim selguh jouse kiphongjal’a, chutah le amai tol’a asuh lut jenga Pathen chibai aboh ding, “Tahbeh mongin nalah-uva Pathen aum’e” tia aphonjal ding ahi.

Thil ijakai kitoh chet’a bol

26 Ipi iti dingba ham sopite? Nakikhop khom tengu amitakip, la sah dingnei jong, thuhil ding nei jong, thuphon ding nei jong, paochom tho ding nei jong, ledoh ding neiyan jong, aboncha chun khantousahna jeng hihen. 27 Koiham khat paochom thoa thuseiya na-umu le, mi ni ham, atam penin thum geiyin, khat khat’in kilhau hen chule mi khat’in akisei chu ledoh hen. 28 Pao ledoh ding aum lou vang le Houbung kikhopna ama chu umthim hen, ama changseh le Pathen henga seijo hen. 29 Gaothu seidoh ho jong chu mi ni ham thum ham geiya aseiyuva, adang hon aseiyu ageltoh diu ahi. 30 Amavang mi atou thim khattou henga thu ahung kiphondoh le amasapa chu thip hen. 31 Ijeh-inem itile mi jouse akitilkhouva aboncha alung mon theina diuva nabonchauva khat khat’a gao thu naseidoh theiyu ahi. 32 Themgao ho gaotheina chuThemgao ho thu noiya um ding ahi; 33 ajeh chu Pathen hi lungnoh phahna ding hilouva chamnajo ahibouve. Mithengte Houbung jousea chonna bangin, 34 Houbung kikhopna numeiho umthim beh-u hen, ajeh chu amaho hi thuseina kipelou ahiuve; chusangin Danthun asei bangin thua nungjo diu ahi. 35 I-khat khat hetnom aneiyu jongle a-in’uva ajiteu akidoh diu ahi, ajeh chu numei dia Houbung kikhopna thusei chu jachat um ahi. 36 O-le Pathen thu hi nang hoa kona hungjah doh pan ha, ahiloule nang ho komseh a bou hung lhung ham? 37 Khattou Themgaova kigel’a Lhagao thilpeh changa kibol aumle nahenguva kalekhasut hi Pathen thupeh ahi kihet them hen. 38 Koitobang khat’in anahsah loule ama nahsah louva kikoi ding ahi. 39 Hijeh chun kasopite, gaothu seidoh ding gut’un lang, chule paochom thoa thusei ding jong khamhih-un; 40 amavang ijakai hoitah le kitup keiyin kibol cheh hen.

1 Corinth 15

Thina kona Christa thokit

1 Sopite, nahenguva kaseiphong Kipana Thupha, nakisan’uva pansatna naneiyu chu kahetsahnom nahiuve; 2 nahenguva kathusei phonga chu napandet jingu le hiche vanga chu huhhinga um ding nahiuve, achutiloule mohseh a natahsan’u ahibouve. 3 Ajeh chu amasapen’a nang ho kapeh, kathulah chu ahile Pathen lekhabua kisei dungjuiyin eiho chonset chengse khel’in Christa athin, 4 ama chu avuiyun, chuin Pathen lekhabua kiseibangin nithum nin kaithouvin aumtai; 5 hichun Cephas henga akilah-in, chujouvin som le ni henga, 6 hiche ban hin sopite mi ja nga valjen henga khatvei lah-in akilah-in, alah-uva atamjo tugeiyin ahing nalaiyun, phabep vang athitauve; 7 abanin Jacob henga akilah-in, chule solchah jouse henga jong akilah-e; 8 Akhon nan aphat louva peng tobang kei henga jong ahung kilah-in ahi. 9 Keima Solchah ho lah a alhumpen kahin, Pathen Houbung kabolset jeh chun Solchah tiding jong kakilompoi; 10 hijongle Pathen lungset jal’a keima hiche hi hikha kahibouve, chule alungsetna hi kei dia ima pang lou ahipoi, amaho chengse sangin kaha toh gim cheh jon, keivang kahipoi, eiumpia Pathen lungsetna joh chu ahibouve. 11 Hijeh chun amaho hiu hen kei hileng hitia hi kaseiphonuva, nang hon chutima chun natahsantauve.

Mithiho thokit thudol

12 Christa thinaa kona kaithouva aumdol kiseiphong lea, itia nalahuva koi koihamin mithiho thokitna umlouva aseiyu ham? 13 Mithi thokitna aum loule Christa jong kaithouva umlou hinte; 14 chutia Christa kaithouva aum lou mong le kathuseiphongu jong moh ahin, natahsanu jong pannabei, 15 mithiho kaithouva aum loule Pathenin Christa akaithou lou ahin, akaithouva akiseijeh a Pathen douna hettosaha pang Pathen dia jouthua hettohsah a pang mia eikimandoh diu ahi. 16 Ijeh-inem itile mithiho kaithouva aum loule Christa jong kaithouva umlou ahin, 17 chutia Christa kaithouva aum loule natahsan’u jong phachom lou, tugeiya nachonset chengseuva um jing nalai nahiuve. 18 Chule Christa hinkhoa ihmu milsa chengse jong amangthah gam ahitai. 19 Chutia Christa to hingkhom dia ikinepnau hi tu hinkho sung mai maiya ding ahile, mi jouse lah a eiho hi voujang natna theipen ihiu diu ahi. 20 Tun vang Christa thina konin kaithouvin aumin, a-ihmu milsa ho thokit tei ding photchehnan apangtai. 21 Mihem khat jeh a thina aumdoh bangin, mihem khatjeh-in thina kona thokitna aumdoh tan, 22 Adam sunga pen jeh-in mi jousen athilon, hitobanga chu Christa sunga um jeh a mi jouse kicho hing ding ahiuve. 23 Hiche hi amichang cheh ama phat phat’a kilhah tho ding ahi; Christa hung teng amite hintin, 24 achaina hipaiya, Christan vaihom na jouse le tha neina jouse chule thahat tin cheng asuhmangsoh teng Lenggam chu Pa Pathen apeh ding ahi. 25 Ijeh-inem itile Pathenin agalte jouse ajoa akengto noiya alutsah masangsea Christan lengvai apoh tei ding ahi. 26 Suhmang ding gal nukhah pen chu thina ahi; 27 ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun, “Aman ijakai akengto noiya akoisohtai,” ati. Ijakai athu noiya kikoisoh lah a hi ijakai athu noiya koisohpa tah vang chu kisimtha lou ahi akichen’e. 28 Pathenin ijakai Christa thu noiya alutsah soh teng, Pathen chu abonchakei chunga ahitheina dinga, thil ijakai aboncha anoiya lutsahpa noiya chu Chapa jeng jong lut ding ahi. 29 Mithi ho dia baptize chanpeh ho, ahile ititauvintem? Chutia mithi ho kaithouva aum loule ibol’a amaho dia baptize chang hiuvam? 30 Chule keihon jong ibol’a nidan telchan’a kichat tijat kathoh jingu ham? 31 Sopite, i-Pakaiyu Christa Jesu hinkhoa kanei, nang hoa um kakisonna pan’a niseh a thijing kahi. 32 Mihem hina maiya Ephesus khoa gamsaho to kisat kahile kei dinga ipi phachom ham? Mithi ho kaithouva um lou mong ahile: “Neu hitin dontah tau hene, Jingteng eiho kithita ding’an,” kiti bang chun boltah tau hen. 33 Ima kipui chatvaisah hih-un: “Kivoppi phalouva Minunphat asusei,” akiti. 34 Lung dihtah pu’uvin chule chonset dauvin, ajeh chu abang bang Pathen hetna neilou na-um’ui; najahchat diuva kasei ahi.

Tahsa thokit thudol

35 Mi abang khat’in, mithi ho kaithouva iti uma, chule itobang tahsavou pua kikaithou diu ham?” tinte. 36 Lungthimbei! Nangin muchi natu chu athi loule akehdoh ngaipoi. 37 Nangin natu chu khonunga hung khangdoh aphung lhingset chu ahipon, suhlou chang hihen muchi dang hijongle muchi chang mai mai natulut hibouve; 38 Pathenin adei banga tahsa asempeh a amuchi jat dungjui cheh a tahsa apeh ahibouve. 39 Tahsaphea hing jouse tahsaphe jong akibangpoi; mihem’a achomin, gancha tahsaphe achomin, vachate tahsaphe achomin, nga hoa achom’e. 40 Van tahsa ho aumin, leiset tahsa ho jong aum’e; ahinla van’a ho loupina achomin, leiset’a hoa jong achomin ahi, 41 Nisa loupina achomin, lha loupina achomin, ahsite loupina jong achome. Ahsi khat loupina jong ahsi dang khat sangin achomin ahi. 42 Athi ho thokit jong hitobang chu hi ding ahi. Mon mang theiya kivuilut ahin, mong mang thei louva kikaithou ding ahi; 43 jum le ja thoha kivuilut ahin, loupina kikaithou ding ahi; longdamsa kivuilut ahin, thahat tah a kikai thou ding ahi; 44 tahsavou pua kivuilut ahin, lhagao tahsavou pua kikaithou ding ahi. 45 Chule Pathen lekhabua hitobang hin, “Mihem masa Adam chu tahsa hing khat ahidoh-in, Adam ninapa vang lhagao chohing ahi,” akiti. 46 Amasa chu lhagao vou ahipon, tahsavou joh ahin, aban’a chu lhagaovou ahi. 47 Mihem masa chu leiset leivuiya kon ahin, Mihem ninapa vang van’a kon ahi. 48 Leivuiya chengse chu leivuiya konpa tobang ahiuvin, van’a chengse jong chu van’a konpa tobang ahiuve; 49 leivuiya konpa lim ilo banguva van’a konpa lim jong ilo cheh diu ahi. 50 Hiche hi kasei ahi sopite, tahsaphe le thisanin Pathen Lenggam alo theipon, mon mang theiyin jong monmang theilou alo thei poi. 51 Ven, thuguh kaseipeh-ui, ibonchauva i-na ihmut milsoh lou diu, ibonchauva 52 sumkon gin nukhah pen’a chu mitphet kah, hai khat sunga ikikheldoh soh diu ahi; ijeh-inem itile sumkon hung ging ding chule mithi ho mon mang thei lou dia kikai thoudiu, eiho jong ikikhelsoh kei diu ahi. 53 Ajeh chu mon mang thei hin mon mang lou akivon’a, thi thei hin thi thei lou chu akivon ding ahi. 54 Hitia chu mon mang thei hin mon mang thei lou chu akivon’a, thi thei hin thi thei lou chu akivon teng le Pathen lekhabua kisun thu cheng; “Jo nan thina aval lhumtai, 55 Vo thina, najo na hoiba ham? Vo thina, hoiba ham namidena?” kiti chu guilhung ding ahi. 56 Thina midena chu chonset ahin, chonset thahatna Danthu ahi. 57 I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal’a jo na eipeuva Pathen chu thangvah-in um hen! 58 Hichejeh chun kasopi deitahte, dettah-in suhlong hoi hilouvin pangun, Pakai hinkhoa natoh jouseu chu pannabei ahilou nahetjehuvin, phat jousen Pakai kinbol nan thalhing jing jenguvin.

1 Corinth 16

Judea gam mithengte dia thilto

1 Mithengte dia sumto khom thudol vang chu Galatia gama Houbung ho kathu lhah banga nang hon jong nabol diu ahitai. 2 Kahung teng sumdon khom bol louna din Choldo jou nikhat ni le nang ho amichang cheh-in atojou kham dungyin sepkhen hen khol hen. 3 Kahung teng kilom nasahpen pen’u chu lekha sutpeh ing ting nathilto’u chutoh Jerusalem solnang’e. 4 Keima tah chea aphat jongle keima eikilhonpi nauvinte.

Kholjinna dia Paul thilgon phabep

5 Macedonia gam kachotsoh teng nahenguva hung nang’e, ajeh chu Macedonia gam chonle dinga kigo kahi; 6 kache na chan’a neithah le theina diuva ijem itile nahenguva phat chom khat ka-uma, phalbi sungsea bon kachamden thei ahi. 7 Ijeh-inem itile tuchunga hi palama jotpa ding kadeipon, Pakai phatsah ahile phat chom khatpi nakom’uva nichonding kakinem’e. 8 Ephesus khoa Pentecost geiyin nichong ing’e; 9 ajeh chu keima din natoh machalna din kot lentah-in akihongin, eidouva jong atam lheh jeng’e. 10 Timothy nahenguva ahungle nalah-uva kiphalam louhel’a alhah theina din vephauvin; ajeh chu keibanga ama jong Pakai natong ahi; 11 hijeh chun koiman nahsah mon bolda hen. Kaheng ahung lhun theina din lung mongin hinthah leuvin, ajeh chu kei le sopiten ama ka-anga jingo ahiye. 12 Sopi Apollos thudol vang, sopite to lhon’a nahenguva ahungna dia katem jing ahinan, tupettah a ding vang anompoi, akimandom teng hung nante.

Achaina ngehna le salam

13 Kigingphan, tahsan’a pang det’un, pasal umchan thon, hat’uvin. 14 Nabol jouse ngailut neiya kibol hihen. 15 Sopite, nang ho kangeh nahiuve. Stephanas insung mite hi Achaia gamsunga Pathen tahsan ga masa ahiuva, achamtah-uva mithengte kinbolna kipeh-u naheuvin, 16 nang hon jong hitobang miho le atohgimpi chengseu umchan najop theiyu ahi. 17 Stephanas le Fortunatus chule Achaicus te ho hilama ahungu kakipah lheh-e; ajeh chu amahon nalhin lelna jouseu abulhit’un, 18 ahungu hin kei le nang ho lhagao akidosah lheh jeng’e. Hijeh chun hitobang ho hi hethem’uvin. 19 Asia gama Houbung jousen nasalam’ui. Pakaiya hinkhompi Aquila le Prescilla, chule a-in lhona kikhom Houbung miten hatah-in nasalam’ui. 20 Sopite chengsen nasalam’uve. Kisopi chop thengin khat le khat kisalamto cheh-duvin. 21 Hiche salamna hi keima Paul khut tah a hung kon ahi. 22 Koi hile Pakai ngailu lou chu gaosap chang hen! Maranatha. 23 Pakai Jesu milungset nan umpiuvin. 24 Christa Jesu hinkhoa ka-ngailutnan nabonchauvin umpiuvin.

2 Corinth 1

Salam thu

1 Pathen lungdeiya Jesu Christa Solchah Paul le sopi Timothyn Corinth khoa Pathen Houbung le Achaia gamsung pumpia mitheng jouse henga, 2 i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christaa konin lungset le chamna hung lhung hen.

Genthei thoh nunga Paul’in Pathen athangvah

3 Pakai Jesu Christa Pa Pathen, hepina chengse Pa le lungmon konna Pathen chu phattheiboh chang hen. 4 Aman genthei hesoh kathotna chan’uva eilha mon’uvin, keihon jong Pathen’a kamu’u hiche lungmonna chun genthei hesoh toh kha jouse kalhamsah theiyui; 5 Christa thoh gentheina twikhanglen tobang chun keiho jong eichup jengu leh, Christa jal’a kakisun’u lungmon nan jong eichup diu ahi. 6 Keiho genthei hesoh thoh a eikilhau le, hichu nang ho lhamonna ding le huhing nachanna diu ahi; keiho eikilhamon’u l ekeiho thoh hesoh tobang nathoh nauva lung nengtah a nathoh jeh-uva Pathenin nalhamonsah theina diu ahiye. 7 Chule hesoh gentheinaa chan naneiyu l elungmonnaa jong chan nanei diu kaheuvin nang ho dinga kakinep nau adet jinge. 8 Sopite, Asia gam’a kachunguva hesoh gentheina hung chu hi helouva naum diu kanompoi; kathauvin ajo kalval’a genthei hesohna nasa tah-in eidelpha jeng phat’un hing din jong kakihol tapouve. 9 Keihon kachunguva hi thina dinga thu kitan ngap’a kagel leuvu ahitan, amale keiho le keiho kisong louva mithi ho kaithou Pathen’a kakisonna joh diuva chute ahibouve. 10 Pathen chun hitobang, thina khoh tah a kona chu eina huhdoh-u ahin, ei huhdoh kit diu ahinai, tukal’a jong eihuhdoh diuva kakinep nau hi, 11 nang hon taonaa neihu diu ahin, chutia chu mi tamtah-in eitaopeh nau donbutna eikipeu phattheina chengse jal’a chu mi tampin thangvahna anei diu ahi.

Paul kholjin kivoh chon

12 Kakison nau chu hiche hi ahi: vannoiya kachon namlhah-u le nang ho kabolnau hi tahsaphe chihnaa kabol’u ahipon, lung thengsel le lung navahpel’a Pathen lungset jal’a bol kahiu kahet themnau lung gil hi hettohsah a pang ahi. 13 Ijeh-inem itile keihon nasim thei diu le nahet diu tilou ima kasunpouve, nahet khongsoh diuva kakinepna chu, 14 keihon jeng jong neihet phol phah vangun, keihon nang ho kakisonpi banguva hi Pakai Jesu Nikho ni vang le neikisonpi dingu ahi. 15 Hiche ginchatna jal’a hi lungsetna avel vel’a nanei theina diuva nang ho henga hung masah ding kanatup ahin, 16 Judea gam’a neihung thah theina diuva nang ho hinhopaa Macedonia gam jot ding, chule Macedonia gama kona hinhopa kit ding kagot ahi. 17 Hiche bol kagot’a doi beiya lung linglao beh kahim? O-le tahsaphe lunggel’a, “Heng’e, heng’e,” moh tia, “Ahipoi, ahipoi,” moh ti ding kagot beh ham? 18 Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, nahenguva kathuseiyu chu, “Ahinai, ahipoi,” moh ti thei ahipoi. 19 Ajeh chu kei le Silvanus chule Timothy, keiho seiphong jal’a nasunguva cheng Pathen Chapa Jesu “Ahinai, ahipoi,” moh ti ding ahi pon, ama sunga chu, “Kanom nai,” tina umdoh jeng ahi. 20 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen thutep chengse chu amasunga hi, “Ahinai,” kitia; hichejeh tah a chu Ama jal le eiho jeh a choi-at ahichehna dia Pathen henga, “Amen,” kitiji ahi. 21 Christa hinkhoa dia keiho le nang ho gom’a eisudet’uva thao einu’va chu Pathen ahin, 22 Aman eiho mohor einamkhum’uva, lhagaova khamgahna chu i-lungthim sunguva eipeh-u ahi. 23 Nang ho kakhohsah jeh a tugeiya Corinth a kahung lou hi kahinkhoa ahetoh Pathen pan’a ka kou ahi. 24 Natahsan thu’uva kipuchansah kahipouve, nakipana diuva natoh khonpiujoh kahiuve, ajeh chu tahsanin nadingdet nauve.

2 Corinth 2

1 Lung phatmo sah dia nahenguva hung kit lou dinga kei le kei kiphatsah kahitai; 2 ajeh chu nasulung hangu leng, hiche kalung phatmo sah ho tilou chu konba eikipasah tan tem? 3 Hijeh a chu kahung teng le eikipasah dinghon eilung phat mosah louna diuva hiche hikahinsut ahi, ipijeh-inem itile kei kipana chu nang ho nabonchauva nakipa nauva kaginchat tahbeh ahiye. 4 Nang ho lung phatmosahna ding hilouva thalhingset’a nang ho dia ngailutna kanei hinahetdoh theina diuva, lung hesoh genthei tampi, lungkham chule mit lhi long longa hiche hi kahinsut ahibouve.

Doumah bolpa ngaidamna

5 Koiham khat’in lung phatmona aboldoh le kaima eilung phatmosah ahipoi, nabonchauva nabol khoh behseh louna diuva miphabep nalung himosah-u ahibouve. 6 Hitobang thua hi japin ama a-oimo chu phaset ahin, 7 nang hon ama chu lung gim behseh a, alhah lhop pailouna dinga na-ngaidam’uva natil khoujoh diu ahi. 8 Ama dia ngailutna nakicheh sah diuva ka-ngeh nahiuve. 9 Nangho imalam jousea thua nungte nahiu photchetnaa akipatepnau chu hetdohna dinga hiche hi kahinsut ahinai. 10 Nang hon mi khattou na-ngaidamu le kenjong ama chu ka-ngaidam thouve, hitia chu khattou ka-ngaidam le Christa angsunga nang ho jal’a kabol ahin, 11 Satanin eijotho louna diu ahi, ajeh chu eihon ama dohna lungthim ihaiyu ahipoi.

Troas a Paul lunggim

12 Christa Kipana Thupha seiphong dia Troas a kahung chun Pakai dinga katohna dingkot lent ah-in akihonge; 13 ahivangin kasopi Titus kamudoh loujeh-in kalungthim akicholdo theipon, hijeh chun miho kalhadoh-in Macedonia lama kahungtai.

Christa jal’a galjo

14 Christa hinkhoa galjonaa eikijotkhompi jinguva, keiho mangchaa Christa hetdohna le phondohna chu muntin’a gim namtui banga either chansoh-uva Pathen chu thangvahin um jing hen. 15 Pathen koma kei ho hi Christa dinga huhinga umsate heng le amangthah ding ho heng geiya jong gim namtui kahiuvin, 16 athi dingin thipo kanam’un, ahin gdin jong gim namtui kanamuva. Hicheng dinga chu akhomto soh thei koiham? 17 Keiho vang Pathen thu kiveina mang miho tobang kahipouve, lung thengseljoa Pathena kona Pathen angsunga Christa to hingkhoma thusei kahi bouvui.

2 Corinth 3

Kitepna Thah lhachaho

1 Keiho le keiho kiseipha pan kit kahiuvem? O-le konkhat banga nahenguva ding hihen nang hoa kon hijongle seiphatna lekha thot neilou khoh mi kahibeh-um? 2 Nang ho hikeiho dinga lekha thot, ka lunggil’uva kisun’a, mitinin asim’a ahet nahiuve; 3 keiho lhacha kapan’uva nang ho hiChrista lekha thot kichentah nahiuvin, songpheng chunga lekha twiya kisun ahipon, mihem tahsa lung chang’a Pathen hing lhagaova kisunjo ahi. 4 Hiche kisonna hi Christa jal’a Pathen henga kaneiyu ahi. 5 Keihoa kona bulhing dinga seithei, keiho chamin ima kahipouvin, kabulhin nau hi Pathena konjo ahin, 6 Aman keiho hi jih tho Danthu hilou Lhagaova kitepna Thah kinbol lhacha theiya eisem’u ahi; ajeh chu jih tho Danthu chun thina asodoh-in, Lhagaovin vang mi ahinsoi. 7 Thi lo na ding bep’a akin kibol songpheng chunga kijih tho Danthu jeng bon chubanga aloupia, amaivah loupina chu amolsuh suh ahi vanga, Israel chaten Mose mai avet chang ngam louvu le, 8Lhagaova dinga lhacha kinbolna chu ijat’a loupe da ding ham? 9 Themmo chan na dinga lhacha kinbolna bon aloupi le them channa dinga lhacha kinbolna loupina chun tamtah a akhokheljoh ding ahi. 10 Hichejeh a chu loupe tah akigel chu hiche hin aloupina adeh lhah phat’in aloupi thei tapoi. 11 Ijeh-inem itile aloupina molsuh suh bon athupi le tonsot’a loupe den jing jeng ding chu gamchenga thupijo ahi. 12 Hiche kinepna hi kanei jehuva hijat vei hi phongtah a hakatji kahiuve. 13 Amaivah molmang hel Israel chaten amu louna diuva ponlu kikhuhji Mose tobang kahipouve. 14 Ama ho chu alunggel’u atah jo cheh tai. Tuni chan geiyin Kitepna Lui asim tengulehiche ponlukhuh chu kihohdoh louvin aumden jing nalaiye; ijeh-inem itile Christa to hinkhom tengle bou kihohdohji ahi. 15 Tuni geiya hiche Mose Danthu chu asim tengu le alungthimu pon lukhuh kikhujol banga kikhu khumji ahi. 16 “Aman Pakai heng ajot lut teng ponlukhuh chu ahohdohji,” akiti. 17 Ahin Pakai chu Lhagao ahin, Pakai Lhagao umna chan acham-lhat aum’e. 18 Keiho maikhu lou chengse, phatvet’a kive banga Pakai loupina kimusah ho hi Pakai kisah Lhagao chun loupina khat’a kona loupina cheh lim khat’a eikheldoh-u ahitai.

2 Corinth 4

Leibel’a Lhagao gou kikhol

1 Lungset vanga hiche lhacha kinbolna kanei khah jeh-uvin keiho kalhadah hih hel’ui; 2 jachatna thilguh chengse kapai lhauvin, doha lungthima chon lou, Pathen thu seilep louvin Pathen maiya mitin vetchah dingin phongtah-in thudihin kachon’uvin, keiho le keiho kiseiphatna kabol’uve. 3 Ijentia ka Thupha seiphongu jong hi akikhu mang akisel ahijongle amangthah dia bou kikhu mang hiding ahin, 4 amaho chu hiche vannoi pathenin Pathen lim mong monga hung um Christa loupina Kipana Thupha khovah amu thei louna diuva atahsan lou nau lungmit asuhchot peh ahi. 5 Ijeh-inem itile keiho le keiho kiseiphongle kahipouvin, Jesu Christa chu Pakai ahije kaseijuva, chule Jesu jal’a keihojoh hi lhachaa pang kahidolu kaseiyu ahi. 6 Ajeh chu, “Muthim lah a konin kho hungvah hen,” tia Pathen ma ma chun Christa meiya Pathen loupije hetna khovah chu keiho lungthim ahinsalvah sah ahitai. 7 Keihon hiche leibel’a gou kachin’u hi thaneina chungnungpen chu keihoa kon hilouva Pathena hungkon ahije photchetna ahi. 8 Hoima lam jousea eikineh chintouvin, ahivangin eikisu ngem deh pouve; lung dongin ka-um’uvin, ahinla kalung lhadeh pouve; 9 eikinojam leuvin, ahivangin donlouvin ka-umdeh hih-ui; eikijep lhu-vin, ahinla eikisumang deh pouve; 10 Katahsauva hi Jesu hinna akiphondoh theina dingin katahsauva hin Jesu thin achu kapole jingui. 11 Thitheina katahsauva hi Jesu hinna akiphondoh theina din, kahin vangun Jesu jel’in athi dingin eikipedoh jinguve. 12 Hichejeh a chu keiho sunga thinan na atoh jinga, nang ho sunga hinna um’ah ahi. 13 Pathen lekhabun, “Katahsan jeh a thu kasei ahi,” ati bang chun, keihon jong tahsanna Lhagao chu kaneiyuva, hijeh a chu keihon katahsan’uva thu kaseiyu ahi; 14 ajeh chu Pakai Jesu kaithoupa chun Keiho jong Jesu to eikaithou thauva nang ho to eihin dinkhomsah diu kaheuve. 15 Lungsetna ahapunbe cheh a mihon Pathen loupina athangvahbe chehna diuva ijakai aboncha nang ho jal’a ahisoh keiye.

Tahsan’a hing

16 Hichejeh chun kalung lhapouve, kamihem tahsau po nung hi akem jing vangin, kasung lam’u hi ani nin athah cheh cheh jeng’e. 17 Ijeh-inem itile hiche jangkhai cha phat chom khat kathoh gim nai hin hachunga chungnungjoa tonsot’a ding loupina eisemdoh peh diu ahi; 18 ajeh chu mithei thil kakat pouvin muthei lou thiljoh kakatjo’uve; ijeh-inem itile muthei thil chu phat chom khat’a ding ahin, muthei lou thil chu tonsot’a ding ahiye.

2 Corinth 5

1 Ajeh chu hiche ponin tobang kaleiset in’u hikiphe lha jongle khut’a sah lou Pathen’a kon tonsot in van’a kaneiyu kahenauve. 2 Hiche ponin sunga kap le penga ka-umu hi khut’a sah lou van in’a chen kal ngah lel kahiuve; 3 hichea chu kachen tengu le sagoh keova eiki-imsah lou diu ahitai. 4 Ijeh-inem itile hiche ponin a kachen laiyuva hi pohgih hahsa pao kap a peng kahiuvin, hichu katahsan in hi paidoh jeng ding deina ahipon, van in’a chenjoh a hin nan thina aval lhum ding deina ahijoi. 5 Hiche dinga chu Pathenin eigontoh-uva khamgahna Lhagao geiya eipeh-u ahiye. 6 Hichejeh a chu lung ngam’a um kahiuvin, chule hiche tahsaa kachen laiseuva hi Pakaiya kon’a gamla tah a kihindal kahi kaheuve. 7 Ajeh chu tahsan’a khosa kahiuvin, mitvet maiya kahipouvin ahi. 8 Kalung ngamlo nau chu hiche tahsa in’a kachenu hi dalhaa Pakai in’a chen ding gam chenga deijo kahi tauve. 9 Hijeh a chu hikom in’a cheng ung, chukom in’a chensa jong leuveng Ama lung lhaisah dingbou katuppi pen’u ahi. 10 Ijeh-inem itile mitinin tahsaa athilbol pha le se tohman akisan chehna dinguva ibonchauva Christa thutanna masanga ikilah cheh diu ahinalaiye.

Kihouchamna kinbol

11 Pakai ginje kahetjeh-uva miho katemu’va thunun kagot’u ahin, Pathen dia vang hetsa kahiuvin, chule nang hon nalunggil’uva neihet diu kakinem’e. 12 Nahenguva hung kiseipha ki tkahipouve, mihem lungthim lam velouva maivet’a ki song ho chu nadeh jouna diuva kei ho neikisonpi theina diuva phat kapehjoh-u nahiuve. 13 Ajeh chu kangol’ule Pathen ding ahin, kachihule nang ho ding ahi. 14 Christa ngailutnan eituh khom jeng jeh-uva japi khel’a khat athitah jeh a, japi thisoh dol’a ki-ngaito ahin, 15 hijeh a chu ahing ho chu amahoding mai maiya hing hilouva, amaho dia thia thoudoh kitpa dinga chu ahin theina diuva amaho khel’a Ama chu thia ahitai. 16 Hichejeh chun tukal’a lhah koima tahsa dol’in kahetapouve; Christa jong tahsa dol’a kanahet nau um jongle tukal’in vang chutin hetapou vinge. 17 Hijeh a chu koi hi le Christa to hingkhom chu thilsem thah soh ahitan, atil’a kisem masa chengse kitolmang ahitai, ven thil thah asohtai. 18 Hiti ijakai hi Christa jal’a keiho le ama kihouchamna boldoh a, chule hiche kihouchamna dinga lhacha kin eibolsah-uva, Pathena hungkon jeng ahi. 19 Ijeh-inem itile Pathenin Christa hinkho sunga chu vannoi le ama kihoutohna asem’a, asuh khelna chengseu asimpeh daa, chule hiche kihouchamna thu chu keiho sunga eikhumpeh-u ahi. 20 Hijeh a chu keiho Christa dinga palai kahiuvin, Pathenin eimanchah-uva a-ngeh ahin, keihon Christa jal’a kathum nahiuve, pathen to kicham’un. 21 Chonset helouhelpa chu, Ama hinkhoa Pathen dihna ichan theina diuvin eiho khel’in, Pathenin chonsen asemtai.

2 Corinth 6

1 Amato tongkhom kahijeh-uva Pathen lungsetna namu’ chu mohseh nahisah louna diuva katem nahiuve; 2 ajeh chu Pathen lekha bun: “Lah phat chan nataona kasangin, Huhhing nikhon nangma kahui,” ati. Ven tu hi lah phat mong ahin, ven tu hi huhhing nikho ati. 3 Lhacha kinbolna hi nolnabei ahina dinga koima masanga kipal lhuhna dingkikoi lou ahi. 4 Ahin Pathen lhacha kinbol kahinauva keiho le keiho ijakaiya kipah chaa, lung dehat tah a hesoh genthei jou se le thoh hahsa, tosetna tin cheng, 5 eikivohna jouseu, songkul lutna ho gei, japi eikitilset pehna jouseu hi le, choldo lou, ihmu lou le nelou chalou kahiuvin; 6 lung thengsel le hetna, thoh hatna, khotona, Lhagao Theng vangin ngailutna giltah-in kaneiyun, 7 thudih le pethen tha hat’in kapngun, dihna galvonin kamangun, jel le vei kahongui; 8 jabolna hihen jumso na hijongle, seiphatna ahiya seisetna ahiya, thudih kaseiyu jongle jouseiyin eiki bol’uve; 9 suhmilsa kabah vangun kihedoh thouvui; athisa kabah vangun, ven kahing jinguve; eikibolgeh lheh kabangun, eikithat paipouve; 10 lunghem tah eikibahsah vangun kakipah jingui; vaicha lheh kabangun ahila mi tamtah kahaosah tauve;imacha neilou kabanguvin ahinla ijakai kanei kimsoh nauve. 11 Vo Corinth mite kalungthimu lentah a kihonga, nahenguva kambem bema thu kaseiyu ahi. 12 Nasunguva lungnoh phahna ima kibol lou ahin, nang ho kilhaset sum’a kisunoh phah lou nahiuve. 13 Chate henga thusei banga kasei ahi, keiho bol lethuh nan nalungu hong len’uvin.

Pathen hing Houin theng nahiuve

14 Atahsan lou ho to namkoljon khat pokhom hih-un, ajeh chu adih le dan dih lou ipia kikop theiya, o-le khovah-in muthim to ipi aneikhom beh am? 15 Christa le thilha ipia kihou theiya, 0-le atahsan le atahsan lou ipi chan kihom theibeh am? 16 Pathen Houin le doilim sem thu ipia kihoutoh theiyem? Ijeh-inem itile eiho Pathen hing Houin ihiuve. Ajeh chu Pathenin hitin aseiyin: “Keima alah-uva kachen’a ka lhat le ding, A-Pathenu kahiya, amaho kamite hidiu ahi. 17 Hijeh chun miho lah a konin hung potdoh-un, Amaho chu dalhauvin,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Thilboh chu tongkha hih-uvin, Keiman kalamto ding nahiuve. 18 Keima na-Pau hing ting, Nang ho kachate nahi diu ahi,” tin Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiye.

2 Corinth 7

1 Ngaitahte, thutep hicheng hi ineijeh-un tahsa le Lhagao suboh thei jousea konin kisuthengu hitin, Pathen ging’a then chamkimsoh a hin ding ngaitou hite.

Corinth Houngbung lungheijeh a Paul kipa

2 Nalung neihonpeh-un, koima adih louvin kabol pouvin, koima kasuse pouvin, koima kichungtoh lapnan kabol pouve. 3 Nang ho mosona dinga kasei ahipoi, ithiu le thisap ding ihin’ule hingsap dia kalunga kavop jingo thu kasei ahitai. 4 Nahenguva ngamtah tah a kasei ahin, kisonpitah tah ajong avumval’in kakipah lheh jeng’e. 5 Macedonia kahungu chun tahsaa choldona neilou kahiuvin, muntin, a gentheina jeng ahin, polama mito kinahna jeng lung sunga kichatna jeng ahi. 6 Ahivangin lung lhadaisa ho tilkhou kit thei Pathenin titus hung lhun chu tilkhou nan eineiyui. 7 Ahung mai mai jeh hilouva, nang hoa kona lungmon thu ahin lhut, itobanga neimu nom’uva, neigimpi dol’u chule neihuh nom dol thuu aseijeh ahiye. Hiti chun eikihapasah cheh jeng’e. 8 Lekha kahin thot chun nalunghemsah jengu jongle kakisih dehpoi; hiche lekha thot chun phat chom khat’a ding hijongle nalunghemsahu kahetdoh a chu nommo kasha ding sol ahitan, 9 tun vang kakipah tai; amavang nalunghemu kakipapi ahipon, nalunghemu chun lungheina asosah jeh ahi; Pethen deilama lunghemna chu natoh-u ahitan, kei ho jeh a manthahna ima naneipouve. 10 Pathen deiya lunghem chun lungheina asojin huhhinga nasodoh jin ahi; leiset thudol’a lung gim nan vang thina asodohji ahibouve. 11 Pathen deiya lunghem nan itobang tah a nachunguva na atoh ham ven, lunghanna, kichatna, nagichatna, tom ngaina, thu adih lama kitan ding deina asosah tai. Hiche thu dol’a chun themmonabei nahiu akichetsahtan ahi. 12 Hijeh chun lekha chu kahin thot jeng vangun, adih lou bolpa le adih bolpa jeh a kahin thot ahipoi, Pathen maiya keiho dinga itobang gunchu nahiu phondohna dingjoh kati ahibouve. 13 Hichejeh a chu eikitilkhou chom’uva ahi. Keiho cheng kitilkhouna chungvuma Titus lhagao nakidosah jehuva akipa jeh chun keiho jong kakipah chom lheh jenguvin ahi. 14 Ama koma chu nang ho kakisonpiuva ahile nang hon neijumso dauvin, ajeh chu nahenguva thutah jeng kaseiyu ahin, hiche Titus henga kakison nau chu atahje kiphonchen ahitai. 15 Itobangtah a thua nung dia kigosadema um nahiule kithing thinga gingkhen cha ama nalamtou ageldoh chanin nakhoto nau akhang khang jeng’e. 16 Nachunguva ijakaiya kakisonpi thei jeh-uvin kakipah lheh jengin ahi.

2 Corinth 8

Christian thilpeh

1 Sopite, Mecedonia Houbung ho kipe Pathen lungsetna hi nahet diu kadeiye; 2 ajeh chu gim genthei nasatah thoh a patepna atokhah vangun hitobang lah a hin akipanau achung chonjo nalaiyin, avaichat lheh vangun teptena val’in hongphal tah-in thil apejengui. 3 Hetoh a kasei ahi athauvin ajochan, akalval geiyin jong apeuvin, achamtah-uvin 4 mithengte dia lungsetna lhacha kinbolnaa chu pankhah tei deinan kahenguva a-ngeh-uve. 5 Hiche hi kaginchat kalval’u ahitan, amasan amaho tah Pakaiya akiphaldohuvin, chuin Pathen di bangin keiho henga akipedoh jengui. 6 Hijeh a chu hiche lungsetna kin anabol pansa Titus chun nang ho lah ajong abol molsoh dinga katilkhou jingo ahi. 7 Keihon katildoh-uva ijakaiya nahaodoh-uva tahsan, thusei, hetna lengailutna tilkhouna tin chenga nabulhin banguvin, hiche lungset thilpeh a jong hin bulhingsoh-uvin. 8 Chondan dungjuiya kasei ahipoi, na-ngailut nau atahbeh ahidol kholdoh teina di amidnag ho mi kithopinaa athanop dol’u kasei ahibouve. 9 I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa lungstna chu naheuve; haotah ahin, avaichatna chu nang hon nahaolo nadiuvin nang hojal’in amatah vai chan ahung umdoh tai. 10 Hiche thua hin kagel seipehung’e: ningkum chun nang ho mi kithopi nom le akithopi masapen nahiuve. 11 Tua hi natoh patsau chu nachaisoh ngal diu ahi. Nang ho mi kithopi tha nom nahiuvin, hijeh chun nathauvin ajochanin bulhitsoh jenguvin. 12 Mihem khat’in kithopina thilpeh apeh nomten le Pathenin apeh ding jet mong teptena aneipon, apeh ding jat bep chu asanpeh ahibouve. 13 Midang ho pohgih ngai janga nang ho pohgih punsah dingngaito kahipoi. Chamgol’a tetph chet ding ahijoi. 14 Tulai nang ho neival chu amaho lhahsam hunan kimangle nang ho nalhahsam tengu amaho neival’a kidit thei ding, hitia chu chamgaol’a kisutoh dingahi. 15 Pathen lekhabun: “Atam kilopan jong aval’in akilah dehpon, Lhomcha kilodoh pan jong lhasam chomin akilah dehpoi,” ati bang chu hi ding ahi. 16 Titus lungthim sunga nang ho khoto theina tilkhouna chutobang khumpeh Pathen chu thangvah-in um hen! 17 Nahenguva hung dinga ka-ngeh-u le nom’a ahitan, hiche jong hi achamtah a nahenguva hung dia kigosademsa anahitai. 18 Houbung tin’a Kipana Thupha asei phong jeh a minthangtah sopi khat jong titus ti kahinsol thauve. 19 Chutijeng goh ahipon, Pakai ama tah loupina dinga hiche thilpeh lakhom ding le keihon jong kakithopi nom’u vetsahna ding monga kalhonpi le diuva Houbung hon alhendohdau ahiye. 20 Hongphal tah a kitohdoh hiche thilpeh kabol lenauva hi koiman eidem louna diuva chingthei tah a thilbol kahiuve. 21 Thilpha bol katup’u hi Pakai mitmu maiya hilouva mihem mitmua jong ahi. 22 Keihon mun tamtah a aguncheje kaphottohsau isopiu khat jong amani to kahinsol thauve, nachunguva ginchatna lentah aneijeh a tujenga jong kitlkhoujah jeng’ah ahitai. 23 Titus vang hi nang ho dinga kapankhompi le katoh khompi ahin, isopite niu hi Houbung ho solchah, Christa loupina ahilhon’e. 24 Nang hokakisonpiu adih dol Houbungho maiya phot chet ahina din amani hi na-ngailut nau kichentah-in chansah-uvin.

2 Corinth 9

Mithengte dia thilto

1 Mithengte kinbol thudol vang hinahenguva lekha hinsut ding valjo din bon kagel’e. 2 Ajeh chu mi nakithopi nomjeu kahenai; hijeh a chu kisongtah a Macedonia mite henga jong ningkum’a apat nang ho Achaia miten thil ijakai gonsadema nakoiyu thu kasiepeh ahi. Natom nagi vauvin amaho geiya atildoh ahiye. 3 Nachunguva kakison nau chu thu hom keo ahilouna dinga sopi cheng hi kahinsol ahi; kasei jing bangin nepeh diu gonsademin um’uvin. 4 Macedonia miho to hung lhonin lang kigo louva na-um’u hung toh kha leu, nang ho jum ding katipon, chubanga kipaopi chu kajachat lo diu ahi. 5 Hichejeh a chu nakitepnau thilpeh chu gonsa koi dinga hiche sopite hi nahenguva hung masa ahiuve; thilpeh ding chu gonsan ana umle lhan lhaisel’a napeh-u kichen ding, cham louva kila hilou ding ahi. 6 Hiche thua hin alhom tun alhon at ding atam tuna tam at ding ahi. 7 Kisih pum le peh lou khoh man hilouvin mitinin along dei bang cheh a apeh ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile lung lhaisel’a pea chu Pathenin angailui. 8 Imalam joousea ijakaiya bulhingsoh nahiuva, ntoh theina diuva Pathenin lungsetma lhingset, aval hel’a jong napeh theiyu ahi. 9 Pathen lekhabua kisun: “Aman atheijal’in vaichate atoi. Ama dihna chu tonsot’a um jing ahi,” ati bangin. 10 Muchi tupa muchi pea, anne dingpa changlhah pea Pathenin muchi napeuvin tin, akhandohsah ding, anthem chan nau ga chu apunsah ding ahinai. 11 Keiho jal’a nathipeh chengseu jeh a chu mi tampin Pathen athangvah theina ding le phat tin’a hongphal tah a napeh jingna diuva Pathenin hahaova nahaosah diu ahi. 12 Ipijeh-inem itile hiche lhacha kinbolna hin minthangte ngaichat atokeo jong ahipon, mi tamtah a kona Pathen thangvahna avum val’a umdoh lo ahitai. 13 Hiche lhacha kinboln ale Christa jal’a Kipana Thupha tahsan thua nanun’u to chule ipi hile nanei chasun’u ama ho le midang ho geiya nakihoppi jeng jeh-uvin Pathen achoi-an tauve. 14 Pathenin nachunguva lungsetna nasatah aneijeh chun amahon jong lung gilten’a nataopeh diu ahi. 15 Athilpeh sei thei louhel jeh hin Pathen thangvah-in um hen!

2 Corinth 10

Antoh chunga Paul kihonna

1 Hiche hi keima Paul, kimaitoa kimu teng moh nem nem a, naum lou nauva hakat’a kithangpan, Christa nun nem le khoto na pan’a katem nahiuve. 2 Tahsaphe ngaichat kihol le dol’a eiseiho’u henga hakattah a thusei ding dol’a kagel hikahung teng kamanchah louna dinga nahenguva katao tho ahi. 3 Tahsaphe vou pua vah le vang kahi nauvin, amavang tasaphe dinga galsat kahipouve. 4 Ijeh-inem itile kagal manchah ho’u hi tahsa gal manchah maimai ahipon Pathen dinga thilbol theitah kulpi suhset theina manchah ahibouve. Jouthua kinelna joouse kadeh lhauvin, 5 Pathen hetdohna douna dinga insang bang kitouson son ho geiyin kaloi lhu’uvin lung gel ngaito nei jouse gal-hingin kaman’uvin Christa thun kanunsah-uve. 6 Nang ho thua nanun bulhinset tengule thua nung lou jouse talen pe dinga kidgosadem kahitauve. 7 Maikoh a thlho veuvin.
