Khattou Christa mia akigel le, amatah chun hiche hi gel kit hen, ama Christa mi ahibangin keiho jong kahiuve. 8 Nang ho suhmangna ding hilouva, nang ho sahdohna dinga Pakaiyin eipeh katha nein au hi kisonpi val jep jong leng kakisih deh poi. 9 Lekha thot hoa chun nang ho kichatsah go mai mai hidang’e. 10 Khatouvin, “Paul lekha thot ho hi anasa theiyin ahuham theiye, ahungtengle la tahsa kamsel dol, athusei pannabei ahibouve,” tinte. 11 Hitobang gelpa chun hiche hi kihet hen: lekha thot ho’a nakibol nau banga chu nalah-uva aki-um teng jongle nakibol diu ahithouve. 12 Amavang mi amachang kichoi sang ho to kibangin kakisei nom hih-un, tejong kakite nagp cha pouve; amaho le amaho akitekah tengule hetna beiya ngol’a ahitauve. 13 Keiho vang eiteppeh nau gamgi kalval’in kisongpou ving’e, hiche gamgi chu Pathenin eitedoh peh-u ahin, gamgi chun nang ho jong nahop’u ahi. 14 Koima cha hung masanga nahenguva Christa jal’a Kipana Thupha hinpo lu tkeiho kahiuvin, nakithang at piu jong leng gamgi kakhokal ddeh pouvin ahi. 15 Hijeh chun eikitep nau gamgi kal, midang toh na chunga kithang-at kahipouvin, kagamgi kol sunguva natahsan’u akhan jinga keiho tohna jong akikeh len chehna dinga kinemjo kahibouvui 16 Chutile nang ho kalpeh gamdanga jong Kipana Thupha kaseiphong theiyuva, midang gamsungatohna chunga kithang-at pi louva ka-um jingdiu ahi. 17 Pathen lekhabun, “Koi hile akisonga chu Pakaiya kisong hen,” ati. 18 Amale ama kiseipha chu imacha ahipon, Pakai seiphat chubou thu ahi.

2 Corinth 11

Paul chule Solchah lhemho

1 Ka-ngol hoi thim jeng jongle neingai them diu kadeiye; amavang nei ngai themsau jong ahinai. 2 Pathen tom ngaina pan’a nang ho dia tom ngai kahi, jipa khatseh Christa tokicheng dinga nu-ngah khat banga kitepna kabolpi kaholsa nahitauve. 3 Hichea hin gul’in lepthol dohaa Eve lhep lhah bang chun Christa dinga nalungput dih nau lenathen nau chu asuhchat vai ding kati ajai. 4 Mi khattou hunga keiho seiphong khah lou Jesu chom khat hung seiphong ham, nachan khah ngai louvu lhagao chang ham, ahiloule nasan khah louvu Kipana Thupha kisan ham aum le phaten ngai them’uvin. 5 Hiche solchah chungnung ho sanga noinung deh-in kakigelpoi. 6 Thuseiyin lhachom jong leng, hetnan kalhachompoi; hiche hi ima lam jouse ahithei lam cheh a kaseipeh sa nahiuve. 7 Choisanga naum theina diuva kakisuh nem’a lo beiya Pathen’a kon Kipana Thupha kaseipeh-u chu achonsea kahim? 8 Nang ho kinbolna dinga Houbung dang ho kachom’a na katohpeh nahibouvui. 9 Nalah-uva ka-um laiyin jong kalhahsamna jousea koima din tolou khoh kahipoi; ajeh chu Macedonia gama kona sopite ahungu chun kangaichat jose lhingkeiyin ahipouve, imalam jousea nang ho tolou khoh louva kihongdoh jing kahin, kakihondoh jing ding ahi. 10 Christa thutah kasunga achenjeh-in Achaia gamkol sungsea hiche kakisonna hi imachan eikhatan louhel ding ahi. 11 Ipijeh ham? Nang ho ka-ngailut lou jeh ham? Pathenin ahenai! 12 Keiho toh banga tonga kiseiya kisonna neiya kiseiho akison lo nau abei theina dinga ipi hile kabol banga hi kaboljom jing ding ahi. 13 Ijeh-inem itile amaho chu solchah lhem, lhep lhahna natong, Christa solchah banga kilep ahibouvui. 14 Datmo ding ahipoi, ajeh chu Satan bon Vantil vah tah limin akilep jin ahi. 15 Alhacha ho chu thildih kinbol lhacha bangin kilep jengu jongle datmo behseh lou ding ahi, ajeh chu atoh dungjui cheh-uva achaina amu diu ahinai.

Solchah hijal’a Paul thohna

16 Kaseikit ahi, koiman lungthimbeiyin eigelda hen; eigel’a aum jongle them kha tbeh kisonna kanei theina din hiti chun neila jenguvin. 17 Kasei vang hi Pakaiyin eiseisah ahipoi, hiche kisonna thudol’a hi mi-ngol thusei katho ahitai. 18 Mitamtah bon tahsanphe dol’a akison’u le keijong kisonga kahi. 19 Nang ho miching nahijeh-uva mi-ngol ho nangai them’u ahi. 20 Ajeh chu min soh a nahen’u ham, nathin lhah-u ham, natuh chah-u ham, nakhai sangu ham, na-ngeiphe abeh-u ham geiyin nathoh ham ham’uve. 21 Jahchasa saa kasei ahi, keiho kadoi lheh jenguve; mi-ngol thusei katho ahi, ahanga aumle keijong kahang’e. 22 Hebrew hiuvam? Keijong kahi! Abraham chilhah hiuvam? Keijong kahi. 23 Christa lhacha hiuvam? Mi-ngol thusei jeng inge, kei kahahi cheh-e! Hatah-in katong gim jon, songkul kalut tam jon, teptena kal val’in eikijep tam jon, atamjon kathideh chet chet’in, 24 nga vei jen Judah on som li vei jepna din khatvei lhan eijep’uvin, 25 thumvei Rome mihon mol’in eijep’un, khatvei songin eikisep’in, thumvei kongke katoh khan, Twikhanglen lailunga jan khat le sun khat kachamin, 26 Kakholjinna tamtah a gin’a gin ding jeng, twilet ding, gucha ho, keima mite, chiding namdang ho, khopi sung setto ding, gamthip laiya setto ding, Twikhanglen’a setto ding, sopi lhem ho gingin kamah thah-e. 27 Chol le nangin katongin, ihmu louvin ka-umin, gilkel dang chah kathoh-in, nelou chalouvin ka-um lhoiyin, ponsil lhasamin dap kathoh lhoiyin, 28 thil dang dang kiseita hih jongle niseh-in Houbung ho kalung gimpina hin eidelpha jing’e. 29 Alhasam koi kahu lou um a? Akisep lhu koi lalung natpi lou um am? 30 Kithang-at mon gding hijongle kalhahsamna hoa hibou kithang-at din gkahibep’e. 31 Tonsot’a vahchoi jing ding Pakai Jesu Pa Pathen chun jousei kahilou ahenai. 32 Damascus a Aretas noiya gamvaipo pan keima matna din Damascus khopi kulpi kot a-ngah jinge. 33 Ahinla bangkot’a chun bom khat’in eikhai lhauvin ama khut’a konin kajamdohtai.

2 Corinth 12

Themgao thilmu le Thuphon

1 Phachom hih jongle kakison tei ding angaiye, amavang Pakaiya kon Themgao thilmua kimu ho thuphon ho bou seiying’e. 2 Keiman Christa to hingkhom mi khat kahen, kum somle li ahitai ama chu can thum channa geiyin lah touvin anaumin, tahsa puma ha, tahsa pum hilou ham kahepoi, Pathenin ahenai. 3 Ken hiche mihempa chu kahen, tahsaphe pum ha, tahsaphe pum hilou ham vang kahepoi, Pathenin ahenai, 4 ama chu Paradise mun’a akilhoh toutan, hikoma chun tho thei louhel thucheng, mihem kama seidoh thei louhel agajai. 5 Hitobang mi hibou kison ping ting, kei le kei vang kalhahsamna ho tilou ima kisonpi pong’e. 6 Kithang-at nom leng, adih kasei idng jeh-in ngol hoi kahilou ding ahi; hijongle min eimua kathusei ajah to kitoh lou, achungnungjoa kachunga lung gel anei lou na dingin kithang-at pong’e. 7 Kahenga kiphongdoh thil loupe behseh jeh a kakichoi-at val louhel na dingin katahsaa hin eidot ding satan sole lhinghem khat eikipen, kakichoi-at louna dia eichum dingin aum’e. 8 Hiche hi eilah mangpehna din Pakai henga thumvei kataotai. 9 Ahivangin aman kajah a, “Kalungset hi nang dia lhinset ahi, ajeh chu lhahsamnaa thahat suh chamkima umjo ahi,” ati. Hijeh a chu Christa thahat keiya achen jing theina dinga kalhahsamnaa jongkipah thou a kisong sing kahi. 11 Hichejeh a chu lhahsamna tin cheng, bolsetna, hesoh gentheina, bol gentheinaho, chule doubolna ho geiya christa jal’a lunglhaisel’a kasanjoh ahitai; ajeh chu kahatmo kom le kahatjo jin ahi.

Corinth Houbung dia Paul lunggim

11 Ngol’a kanahitai; ahinla neiseiphat jeh-uva nang honneichuti chonsah-u ahi; ajeh chu imacha hi lou beh hijong leng chuche solchah minthanga kiseiho sanga chu noinungjo lou kahi. 12 Solchah khat kahina dol chu thoh hat to thoa nalah-uva melchihna ho, bolmo kidang kibol ho, chule thil kidang kibol hoa chu kichensah ahitai. 13 Ipipen tah a Houbung dang ho sanga kabolset chom’uvem, nahenguva kithopina ding ngeh louhel’a kakoiyu tilouva? Hiche kitoh louva kabol jeh vang chun neingai dam’uvin. 14 Ven, nahenguva hung ding kakigotna hiche hi thumveina ahitai; ahinla nang ho pohgih hahsa p edinga kigo kahipoi, ajehchu nanei nangau hol le kahipon, nang ho bou kakhohsah ahi. Chaten nu lepa dinga sum khol ngai ahipon, nu le pan bou chate sum akhol peh ding dol ahi. 15 Keivang chu nang ho dinga kimang jouhel ding kahiye. Keiman kangailut behseh jeh-uva lhasamjoa neingailut diu ham? 16 Nangho phgihsah lou kahidol’in kigel le, lungthim doha thuh tah a nan gho kamatdol’in nasei kit’ui. 17 Nahenguva kahinsol miho khattouva chu lungthim doha kabolnau umkham? 18 Titus chu kahinsol tha ahi; Titus chun nalung thim bol khattouvu ham? Ama le kei Lhagao khat’a kilhon khom kahilon louham? Keng kho khat lha khom kahi louvu ham? 19 Hichan’a hi nahenguva keiho kithen hon beh kahiuvem? Pathen maikoh a Christa kisonpia kaseiyu ahibouve; ngaitah te, aboncha hi nang ho sahdohna dingahi. 20 Ahinla kahung tengle kadei banga nachon louvu hung tohkha get ing ting, nang hon jong nadei banguva neimu lou diu ham, ti kakiphalam lheh jeng’e. Nalah-uva kinah, kithangset, lunghan, kitumsah, kiseiset, kihoulhih, hamhoitho, kitomona um thei ahi. 21 Chutile kahung kit teng ka-Pathenin nang ho maiya eideh lhan tin, masanga then louna lam, jonthanhoi pan’a huh le lop pan, lung kisih louho jeh a chu kaka lo ding ham tin kati ajai.

2 Corinth 13

Gihsal chaina le lemna

1 Hiche hi nahenguva kahung thumveina ahi. Pathen lekhabun, “Ahetoh mi ni ham thum h am jeh a bou thu tan dinga kikoi ding ahi,” ati. 2 Ani veina nalah-uva kaum chun masanga chonse ho hihen koi hi le kagihsal cheh ahin, tua nang hoa kona kagamlat vangin kagih nahiuve; ajeh chu kahung kit le kakhen louhel dingnahiuvin ahi. 3 Christan kei eimanchah monga thusei kahi photchetna nadei chan namudiu ahinai, nang ho dia ama chu lhasam deh ahipon, thahat tah ahibouve. 4 Ajeh chu lhasam tah banga thingpel’a akhetbeh vangun Pathen thahat nan ahinsah tai. Ijeh-inem itile kei Amato kahinkhom diu ainai. 5 Tahsan’a um mong nahi nah um nang ho kipatep’un, nang ho kikhol chil’uvin; nasunguva Christa Jesu cheng chu nakihetdoh louvu ham? 6 Keiho kathon louvu hi nahet diu kakinem’e. 7 Nang hon thilse nabol louna diuvin Pathen henga kataopeh jingui; keiho lolhin phondohna ding mai hilouvin, keiho lolhing lel dol’in umu jong leng nang hon thilpha nabol theina diu ahi. 8 Ijeh-inem iitle keihon thutah dou nan ima kabol thei pouvin, thutah chubou kabol’u ahiye. 9 Nang ho naat’uva keiho kalhahsam tengule kakipah jiuve; nang ho nachamkimsohna diuvin jong kataopeh ji nalaiyui. 10 Suhphatna ding hilouva sahdohna dinga Pakaiyin eipeh thaneina, hiche katha neina hi kahung tengle khoh veng vunga kamanchah louna dinga gal’a kona hiche lekha hi kahinsut ahi. 11 Tua lhah sopite, kipah tah nom’un, chamkimsoh keiyun, lungmongun, lung khat hiuvin, kcihamdel’un, chutile ngailut le chamna Pathenin naumpi jing diu ahi. 12 Thengsel’in khat le khat kibengchopto cheh-un, Mithengten nasalamui. 13 Pakai Jesu Christa lungset, Pathen ngailut, chule lhagao theng kithopinan nabonchauvin umpi jing hen!

Galatia 1

Salam

1 Mihema konle mihem vanga hilou, Jesu Christa jeh le athilah akona Jesu kaithouva Pa Pathen jal’a solchah keima Paul 2 le ka-umpi sopite chengsen Galatia gam Houbung ho henga, 3 i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christaa konin lungset le chamna hung lhung hen, 4 i-Pau Pathen lungdeiya hiche khang gilouva eiho huhdoh din Jesu Christa chu eiho chonset jal’in Ama akitoh doh jengin ahi; 5 i-Pau Pathen chu tonsot geiyin loupina chang jing hen: Amen.

Kipana Thupha dang aumpoi

6 Christa lungset jal’a nakoupauva kona tukah seha thupha chom khat’a nakihei jengu chu kadatmolheh-e; 7 Thupha dang chula aum sampon; mi phabeh vang aum’un, amaho hin nang ho suh ling laova Christa Kipana Thupha chu akaleh ahei ding agot’u ahibouve. 8 Hichea hin keiho hiuving lang van’a Vantil khat hijeng jongle nakiseipehsau Thupha tilou thupha chom seiphong aumle ama chu gaosap chang hen. 9 Kasei masah sau banga tua jong kaseikit ahi, “Natahsansau hilouva thupha chom dang khattouvin nahung seipeh khah-u le ama chu gaosap chang jeng hen.” 10 Tua hi mihemte lung lhaisah goa kahi, Pathen lung lhaisah go kahim? O-le mihemte lungdei hol mong kahim? Mihemte lungdei holna lai kahile Christa soh kahilou ding ahi.

Paul solchah a apanlona

11 Sopite, keiman kaseiphongle Kipana Thupha chu mihema kon ahilouje kahilchen nahiuve. 12 Mi hema kona kalah jong ahipon, koi man eihil jong ahipoi; Jesu Christa hung kiphondoh a konjoh ahibouve. 13 Malai Juda hou gut kahilaiye kachon nam lhah najauvin, Pathen Houbung chu tepte na kalval’a bolsea suhmang ding go kahin, 14 chu jongle kapu kapateu Houdan thua katom panjeh-in Juda hou thudol’a kakhang golpi tamtah kakho khelsoh keiye. 15 Ahinla ka-nu oisunga ka-um laiya pat eisepkhensa Pathen chun alungset jeh-in eikouvin, 16 chidang namdangte henga Achapa kaseiphong theina din kahenga aphongdoh tan, hichea hin katoh ding dol tahsaphe le thisan pu mihem kadongpai jengpoi, 17 kei sanga solchah hi masa Jerusalema umhohenga jong kachedehpoi, Arabia gama kaga chen, chuin Damascus khoa kahung kilekit bouve. 18 Kumthum nungin Cephas henga imahetoh din Jerusalema kaga chetouvin, amato nisom le ninga ka-um’e; 19 hichepet chun Pakai sopipa Jacob tilou solchah dang kamupoi. 20 Nahenguva lekha kahinsut hi, ven Pathen maikoh a jou kaseipoi. 21 Hiche nung chun Syria le Cilicia gamkol sunga kahungtai. 22 Hiche geiya hi Judea gama Christa Houbungte mitmua het lou lai kahi, 23 “Masanga suhmang dia eigopau chun tun khatvei suhmang ding agot tahsan chu kipah tah-in asei phonglei,” tibou ajah-u ahin, 24 chu le keima jeh a Pathen avahchoi choi jengu ahi.

Galatia 2

Solchah danghon Paul solchah dia asan’u

1 Kum som le li jouvin Titus kapui lhonin Barnabas to Jerusalema kaga chetou kitlhon’e. 2 Hichea chu Pathen thuphondoh jal’a chetou kahin miho jah a chun chidang namdang ho lah a Kipana Thupha kaseiphong thudol kahil chenin, lamkai dom dom ho vang chu atumbeh in kaseipeh-in, katoh masah le tulai katoh ho manlou aso lou nading ka-ngaitoi. 3 Chukoma ka-umpi Titus chu Greek mi ahivangin cheptansah tei ding agopouve. 4 Athudol hi alhema sopia kisemthu, Jesu Christa to ineikhomu jalena sumang dia mi ve-lhi dinga ilah-uva hunglut khaa, eiho sohchansah ding go ho hinpoh lut ahibouve. 5 Kipana Thupha tah ahidol hi nang ho chunga aum jingna din nidan khat jeng jong amaho noiya hi kikhumlut kha lou kahiuve. 6 Lamkai dom doma kiseihoa konin jong, ipi kihisah-u jongle ka-i aloudeh poi, Pathenin mihem maijan avepoi, ginle ja umdol’a kiseiho chun ima eibolpeh chompouve. 7 Chuti tah sangin cheptan ho henga Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga Peter kinganse banga chidang namdangte lah a Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga eikinganse amu’uve. 8 Ijeh-inem itile cheptan ho dinga Peter solchah a akisemdoh banga chidang namdang ho dinga keima solchah a eikisemdoh ahi. 9 Lungsetna eikipe aheuvin, Cephas le Jacob chule Johnin kapan khom’uva, kei le Branabas chidang namdang lah a chule amaho cheptan ho lah a natong dingin khut jetlamin eina sanguve. 10 Kageldoh jing ding adeiyu chule ken jong katoh nom jeh a hatah akagel jing vaicha gentheite ahiuve.

Antioch khoa Paul in Peter apho

11 Antioch khoa Cephas ahung chun kichentah a themmona anei jeh-in amaichangtah a kaphoh jenge. 12 Ajeh chu Jacob henga kona miphabeh hung masangin chidang namdangte to an anekhomin, amaho hung phat’in cheptan ho akichat jeh-in aki- nung khinin akitumsah tai. 13 Judate mi adang hon jong ama ajop thol’un, aphat lhem nauva chun Barnabas geiyin apui manglo tauve. 14 Ahinla Kipana Thupha kitah dungjuiya achon louvu kamudoh phat’in japi maikoh tah a Cephas kasosal’in, “Judate chilhah apeng nangbon Judate chondan banga um lou ibol’a chidang namdang te chu Juda te chondan thosah ham gao nahim?” kati.

Juda hihen Namdang hile tahsan jal’a huhhinga um

15 Eiho pendol’a Juda mi ihiuvin, chidang namdang chonse hoa kon ihipouve. 16 Ahinla Jeu Christa tahsan tilouva Danthu dungjuiya natoh vanga mihem them achanlouje iheuve; hijeh a chu eihon Danthu dungjuiya natoh vang hilouva Christa tahsan jal’a them ichan theina diuva Jesu Christa chu itahsanu ahi; Ijeh-inem itile tahsa a mihing koima Danthu dungjuiya natoh vanga them chang lou ding ahi. 17 Themchan teina dia kihabolnaa jong Christa sunga chonse ihiu akimudoh le Christa chu chonset lhacha ham? Ahinai saipoi. 18 Ajeh chu ken kaphetsa kasah phat kit le kasuh khel photchetna jo ahibouve. 19 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lama kahin theina dinga Danthu jeh a Danthua thisa kahitai. Christa to kikhetbeh tha kahitan, 20 Keima chu hinga ahipon, Christa joh keisunga hing ahibouve, tua tahsaphea kahin hi keima eingailua keijal’a kipedohjeng Pathen Chapa tahsan jeh a hing kahiye. 21 Pathen lungset hi moh kahisah poi, ajeh chu Danthu jal’a them kichang hile Christa thi chu pannabeiahi.

Galatia 3

Danthu natahsan ham?

1 Vo khopolou Galatia miho Jesu Christa thingpel’a kikhetbeh dol namitmu changtah-uva kichentah a kisundoh taa, kon najol lhah-u ham? 2 ‘Lhagao nakisanu chu Danthu dungjuiya natoh vang ha tahsan thu najah-uva kon ham?’ nanghoa konin kahet nom’e. 3 Iti chuti lungthimbei nahiuvem? Lhagao thua kipan’uva tua tahsaphea chaidoh ding nagot’u ham? 4 Hi chengpi hi mohjen seh a thoh gim nahiuvem? Tah ahile mohjen seh ahi-ngut’e. 5 Lhagao napeuva, nalahuva thil kidang ho boljipa chun Danthu dungjuiya na natoh jeh-uva abol ha, tahsan thu najah-uva kona abol ham? 6 Hichea hin, Abraham in Pathen atahsan in hichu ama din themchansah nan akisikpehtai,” tin akiseiye. 7 Chuti ahijeh chun mi atahsan chengse chu Abraham chatea kisimjoh ahidol nahet diu ahi. 8 Pathen lekhabun tahsan jal’a chidang namdangte themchan ding ahet masah dol chu Pathenin Abraham jah a Kipana Thupha anaseiphong masan “Nang jal’a chidang namdang jouse jong vangboh chang diu ahi,” anati. 9 Hijeh a chu tahsan nei chengse chu tahsan neipa Abraham vangbohchang khom ahiuve. 10 “Koi hile Danthubua kisun chengse nitjom jing lou chu gaosap chang ahi, “tia akisut jeh-in, Danthu dungjuiya natong chengse chu gaosap chang ahiuve. 11 Ijeh-inem itile Danthu dungjuiya chonjeh a koima Pathen anga them chang lou hel ding ahi; ajeh chu, “Tahsan jal’a them changpa bou hing ding ahi,” akiti. 12 Achujongle Danthu chu tahsan’a tobang ahipoi, “Danthu ho nitpa chun Danthu ho hinna anei ding ahi,” kiti ahibouve. 13 Danthua kisun chu, “Thinga kikhai sang tapou chu gaosap chang ahi,” kiti ahijeh-in, Christa chu eiho jal’in gaosap achangin, Danthu gaosapnaa koin eihung lhatdamtauve. 14 Hiche hi Abraham vang kiboh chu Jesu Christa jal’a chidang namdangte jong achan theiya tahsan vanga tepsa Lhagao chu ikisan theina diu ahi.

Danthu chule Thutep

15 Sopite, mihem ngaidol’a kasei ahi, mihem ngaidol mongin jong suhdetsa kitepna chu koiman isah louvin abolpon, koijong akoibe ngaipoi. 16 Thutep chengse chu Abraham le achilhah kipea ahi. Mi tampi kiseina banga, “Chule nachihlhah ho din,” kiti louvin, khatseh seina bangin, “Chule nachilhahpa din,” akitin, Ama chu Christa ahi. 17 Hiche hi kisei ahi: Pathenin asuhdet’a aphondohsa kitepna chu kum ja li le somthum nunga umdoh Danthun thutep chu man mo asosah a ason amang thei ahipoi. 18 Goulo ding chu Danthu jal’a ahile thutep jal’a hilou ahin, ahinla Pathenin thutepsa jeh a Abraham apeh ahibouve. 19 Danthu hi ipi ding ba ham? Suhkhel phondohna dia kikoibe, thutep kipe chilhahpa hung kah a ding ahin, Vantilte kimanga palaipa khut’a kitungdoh ahi. 20 Khatseh dinga thupo le ngailou ahin, Pathen chu khat ahi.

Danthu umdohna jeh

21 Achutile Danthu hi Pathen thutep to kikal ham? Ahinai saipoi; micho hing theina thaneiya Danthu kipe hile hiche Danthua chu them chan na um ding ahi. 22 Ahinla Jesu Christa tahsan jal’a atahsan chengse thutep chu akipeh theina diuva Pathen lekhabua thun ijakai chon set noiya akhumchah ahitai. 23 Tahsan thu hung lhun kah, ahung lhung ding tahsan kiphondoh kah a chu Danthu noiya ki hen kikhakhum ihiuve. 24 Hitia chu tahsan vanga them ichan theina diuva Danthun eina kaihoiyuva Christa henga eipui naiyu ahi. 25 Tahsan thu hung lhun kalvang eikaihoi nau noiya chu ihitapouve. 26 Ijeh-inem itile Jesu Christa tahsan jal’a Pathen chate nahiu ahitai. 27 Ajeh chu Christa sunggil’a baptize changsa nang hon Christa chu nakivon’u ahi. 28 Hiche a hin Juda mi le Greek mi kidatna, soh le chamlhat kikhena, pasal le numei kibahlouna aum tapoi, ajeh chu Christa sung gil’a nabonchauva pumkhat nahiu ahitai. 29 Hitia chu Christa mi nahijeh-un, Abraham chilhah nahiuvin, thutep goulo jong chu nang hon chan ding ahitai.

Galatia 4

1 Goulo dingpa chu thil ijakai neipa ahivangin aneo laisen soh to imachom ahipoi kati ahi. 2 Apan atep phat lhin kahsen akaihoi ho le in-ngah ho thu noiya bou aume. 3 Hitobanga chu eiho jong ipilhin masanguva vannoi leiset lekhajembul noiya soh chang inahiuve. 4 Ahinla phat alhinset phat’in Pathenin a-Chapa ahinsol lhan, Danthu dungjuiyin numei sunga ahungpengin, 5 Danthu noiya umho lhatdoh a eiho chalam thu ihina diuvin ahung’e. 6 Chate nahiu kichetna dinga Pathenin a-Chapa Lhagao chu i-lung sunguva ahinlha lut’a, “Abba hepa,” tia ikoujiu ahi. 7 Hiti ahijeh chun soh nahitapon, chapa nahitan, chapa nahijeh chun Pathen jal’a gouloa pang ding jong nahitai.

Paul’in Galatia mite akhohsah

8 Pathen nahet masnguvin aumdol monga Pathen hilou ho lhachan napangui; 9 tun vang Pathen nahetauvin, lamkhat’a Pathen het jong nahituvin, i-atile sonlel um lhasam tah Danthu lekha jembul lam’a kihei kit’a, abul lama sohna toh nom kit nahiuvem? 10 Nang hon nikho phabep le lha phabep chule kum kiheichin ho pou nanit jiuve. 11 Nang ho dinga katoh gimna jouse moh nahisah diu kati ajai. 12 Sopite, keitobang hiuvin, keijong nang ho tobanga um kahi; nang hon adih louvin neibol pouve. 13 Katahsa dammo jeh a Kipana Thupha kahung seipeh masah lo’u nahetsau ahi; 14 katahsa veiset chu nang ho dinga patepna ahijeng vangin thei le hot’in neibol pouvin, Pathen Vantil bang tah le Jesu Christa bang tah-in neisang jo’uve. 15 Chubanga nakipa nau hoilamba hitam? Hithei le namit chang te ni geiya kaldoh a neipeh nom leu jengu kichentah a kahettoh jing ahi! 16 Thutah kaseipeh jeh-uva nagal’u kahi ngap hitam? 17 Miho chun thilpha dinga natom ngaipiu ahipoi, pamse dinga bou nadeiyu ahin, hiti ho dinga chu natompanpi bol’u ahibouve. 18 Keiman ka-umpi pet maiya hilouvin thil ijakaiya thilpha ding jenga tompan ding aphai. 19 Kachate, nasunguva Christa lim le mel akigondohsoh masangsea numei naoso nat thoh banga kathohgimpi kit nahiuve. 20 Tugeiya na kom’uva um’a ka-oso chombeh a hou ding kadei lheh jeng ahi, ajeh chu nachung thu’u kalung agim’e.

Hagar le Sarah tekaha kihilna

21 Vo Danthu noiya um nom ho na seipeh-un, Danthu najah khah louvu ham? 22 “Abrahamin chapa ni aneiyin, khat sohnu sunga peng ahin, khat jalen nu sunga peng ahi,” tin akisun’e. 23 Sohnu sunga peng vang chu tahsaphe pen ngaidol’a peng ahin, jalen nu sunga peng vang thutep guiya peng ahi. 24 Hiche hi tekah a kihilna thei ahi; Numei te ni hi kitepna ni vetsahna ahin, khat nu hi Sinai molsanga hung kon ahin, hiche nu chate chu soh natong ding ahiuve, hiche nu chu Hagar ahi. 25 Hagar hi Arabia gama Sinai molsang lim’a um ahin, tuali Jerusalem vetsah apang, achate to soh chang ahitauve. 26 Jalen nu vang chu chunga Jerusalem lim’a um ahin, ama chu inu’u ahiye. 27 Ijeh-inem itile “Vo ching-a cha neilou nu kipah-in, Naoso nat thoh khalou nu kipa othongin kho samin; Ijeh-inem itile jipa luppi sangin, Don lou dailouva kikoinu chate atamjoi,” tin akisun’e. 28 Sopite, nang ho jong Isaac banga thutep chate nahiuve. 29 Chulaiya tahsaphe dol’a pengpan Lhagao lama pengpa asumang got banga tua jong chuti ahi. 30 Ahinla hichea hi Pathen lekhabun ipi aseiyem? “Sohnu chu achapato kaidoh than, ajeh chu sohnu chapan jalen nu chapa to gou lokhom theiponte,” ati. 31 Sopite, hichea hin eiho sohnu chate ihi pouvin jalen nua joh ihibouvui.

Galatia 5

Nacham lhat tuhchah jingun

1 Jalenna inei theina diuva Christan eilhatdoh-u ahitai. Hijeh chun dingdet jingun, soh namkol jona chun kihen oh kit tahih-un. 2 Ven, nahenguva thusei hi keima Paul kahi, nanghon chaptan thu najop’u le Christan imacha naphat chomsah lou diu ahi. 3 Cheptan thu jop chengse kahettohsah nahiuve, hitobang mi chun Danthua kisei chengse atohdoh ding abat nalaiye. 4 Danthu juiya themchan go ho chu Christaa kona kisat lhaa, lungsetnaa pul lha nahitauve. 5 Keiho vang Lhagao chun tahsan jal’a them chang dia kinem’a ei ngasah-u ahi. 6 Ijeh-inem itile Jesu Christa to hinkhomnaa hin chaptan le tan lou imachom ahipoi, ngailutnaa tong hat jing tahsan thupi ahi. 7 Nalhai toh lheh meu! Thutah na-ngai nauva koiham nasu tanguvah? 8 Hiche kijol lhahna hi nakoupauva kon ahipoi. 9 Chol themchan changlhah lhon pumpi achansohji ahi. 10 Pakaito hinkhomnaa imachan nasuhmo lou diuva nang ho hi kason lheh jeng nahiuvin, koi hijong le akhohpoi, nasumo pen penu chu athu kitantei ding ahi. 11 Sopite, keiman chaptan thu kaseiphong lai hile ibol’a eikibolse se ding ham? Kaseiphong tahbah hile Thingpel thudol hi kipal lhuhna hilou ding ahi. 12 Nang ho suling lao ho chu amaho kisumangsih seh leu kadei lheh-e. 13 Sopite, nang ho jalen dia kikou nahiuvin, hiche jalenna hi tahsaphe lama jaothauna mai din mang hih-un, khat le khat ngailut’a kijento nan mang jo’uvin. 14 Ijeh-inem itile Danthu jouse jong hi thugol khat, “Nangma naki-ngailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun,” kitia hi bukimsoh ahibouve. 15 Amavang khat le khat kiketto sao sao le kibahgamto sao sao nahi khah-u jong le nakisuhmang hel louna diuvin ching theiyun.

Lhagao ga le thasa natoh phabep

16 Kenvang, “Lhagaovin chon’un chutile tahsaphe lunggul chu namolso lou diu ahi,” kati ahi. 17 Ajeh chu tahsaphe lunggul chu Lhagao lama to kidouva, Lhagao lama chu tahsa phea to kidou ahin, nang hon nabolnom nom nabol louna diuva hicheng chu kidouto ahiuve. 18 Hichea hi nang ho Lhagaovin napuiyu le Danthu noiya um nahipouve, 19 tahsaphe lam natoh chengse chu kichentah a: jonthanhoi, thenlou, huh, 20 limsemthu doi hou, doichoi, kidou, kinah, thangthip, lunghan, kiloset, loitumsem, kilangkhen, 21 sumsel, jukham, eltol hitobang ho hi ahi. Kahilchah masah banguva kahilchah nahiuve, hitobanga chon ho chun Pathen lenggam alo lou dingu ahi. 22 Lhagao ga vang chu ngailut, kipa, cham, thothat, mi khoto, phat, kitahna, 23 nunnem, kitimthem hiti ho hi ahi. Hitobang ho doudal ding Danthu aumpoi. 24 Christa Jesu to hinkhom chengsen tahsaphe chu alunggul le angaichat chengse pum a thingpel’a akhetbeh-u ahitai. 25 Eiho Lhagaova hing ihiule Lhagaovin chon’u hite. 26 Ikiletsah louhel diu, khat le khat kiphin lunghang ahiloule khat le khat kithang settoa ium louhel diu ahi.

Galatia 6

Khat le khat pohgih kipohhu

1 Sopite, mi khattou suhkhel nei, athemmona kimandoh aum jongle Lhagao mi nang hon Lhagaova nunnema nasemphat diu dol ahi; kivephan. 2 Khat le khat pohgih kipoh hun, chuti chun Christa Danthu nit chamkimsoh-un. 3 Khattou ikhat khat’a kigel’a, atahbeh a la imacha hilou chu ama le ama jeng jong kijoulhep ahibouve. 4 Min ama ama natoh cheh kikholtoh hen, anatoh chu aphatnah le midang titah louva ama le ama jeng jong kipah chaa kichoi an thei ahi. 5 Ajeh chu mitinin ama ama pohgih cheh akipoh ding ahibouve. 6 Thua kihil’a mi chun ahilpa chu thilpha chengse chankhompi hen. 7 Nang ho kilhem chavai hih-un, Pathen chu nelpeh dan ahipoi; ajeh chu mihemin atu tu a-at ding ahi. 8 Ijeh-ienm itile tahsa dol’a tupan tahsaphea kona kemmang theiga alo ding, Lhagao dol’a tupan jong Lhagaova tonsot hina aloding ahi. 9 Thilpha bolna lama chimtih neipouhite, i-lhah dah louvu le aphatcha tohga ilo diu ahi. 10 Hijeh chun hungun aphat gomkom inei dungjuiyun mitin chunga thilpha bol’u hitin, ahideh-in eima insung mi atahsan ho chunga habol deh-u hite.

Achaina gihsalna le temna

11 Veuvin, keima kakhut tah-in nahenguva lekha jemkhou tah-in kahin sun’e. 12 Tahsa vet-hoisah ding go chengsen chaptan sah ding nagot hamu chu imacha ding ahi pon, Christa thingpel jal’a thoh hesohna apeldohna diuva abol’u ahibouve. 13 Cheptan mong hon jong Danthu anit pouve, chep natansah nom nau chu tahsaa hiche melchihna naneisah jeh-uva chu hoithonom ahiuve. 14 Kenvang I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa thingpel ti lou thildang ima song hih inge; ajeh chu hichea chu vannoi kei dinga, keima vannoi dinga kikhetbeh kahitai. 15 Ajeh chu cheptan le tan louvin koima ima asochompoi, thilsem thah hiding bou chu khoh ahi 16 Hiche Dan mang jouse, Pathen Israelte chunga chamna le hepina um hen. 17 Tukal vang koiman eisulunggim ta hih hen, ajeh chu kati chunga hi Jesu melchihna polea kahitai. 18 I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa lungset chun na-lhagaovu umpi hen, sopite: Amen.

Ephesus 1

Salam

1 Pathen lungdeiya Jesu Christa solchoh Paul’in Ephesus khoa cheng tahsan’a Jesu Christa to hingkhom mithengte henga; 2 I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christaa kon lungsetna nahenguva um hen!

Christa Lhagao vangbohna phabep

3 I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa le Pathen jal’a van muntin’a Lhagao vangbohna tin chenga vang eibohPau chau thangvah-in um jing hen; 4 Pathenin ngailutna jal’a Ama mitmua athengle nolnabei ihina diuva, Christa sunggil’a eiho hi vannoi kisemdoh masanga eina lhendohsau ahin; 5 Aman adeile atup duing juiya Jesu Christa vanga a-lamthu chapate ihi theina diuva Ama dinga eina chom khendoh-u ahi. 6 Hiche angailut tah achapa jal’a manbeiya eipeh-u thilpeh loupi chu i-vahchoi diu adoi ahi. 7 Christa thisanjal’a i-chonsetnau ki-ngai-dam’a lhatdam chang i-hitauve; alungset bulhing dungjuiya 8 ichunguva abuh lhah a, chihna le hetkhenna jal’a 9 Ama lungdeiya thil kiselguh chu eihetsah-uva, Christa sunggil’a athilgon masah dungjuiy 10 Leiset khang lhin’a phat ahung lhun teng Christa hong sunga chu thil i-jakai, vanmun jousea hihen leiset chunga hi jongle Ama sunga chu gopkhomsoh ding, 11 Ama hong sunga chu Pathenin keiho Judate eina lhendoh-uva eina gonsau ahin, agonsa dungjuiya thil ijakai hin na atoh cheh a, Ama ngaito le dei dungjuiya um jing ahi. 12 Christa hongsunga dia kinem jing keihon Ama loupina chu kavah choina diuva chuti ahi. 13 Ama jal’a chidang namdang nang hon jong huh hing nachan nau Kipana Thupha, thudih chu najah-uva, Ama vanga na tahsan’uva, tepsa Lhagao Thenga mohor kinamsa nahitauve. 14 Pathen vahchoina ding le amiten jalen i-muna dinguva, Lhagao Theng chu eiho goulo ding khamgahna ahi tai

Paul taona

15 Hichejeh hin Pakai Jesu natahsanu le mithengte chengse na ngailutnau kajah a pat, 16 kataochanin tang louhel’in nang ho ding kathang vah jinge. 17 Hichu I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa dinga Pathen, loupina Pa chun chihna leh Ama hetna phondohna thei Lhagao napeh theiyuva, 18 nakou nau kinepna hi nahet theina diuva nalungthim mit’u ahasah theiya, mithengte dinga goulo anei loupina thalhinje, 19 atahsan ei ho sunga natong athahat natsatje so-phah hoi ahi lou het theina ding ahi. Hiche athahat thilbol theina kidangtah hi 20 amanchah a Christa-a thiho lah a akaithouva, van gamsunga ajetlama atou sah ahi. 21 Hikoma chu Aman vaipo thunei jouse chung, thahat le piputna jouse chunga loupipen minchang ahitai. 22 Pathenin thil ijakai Christa kengto noiya akoi soh a, Houbung dinga Ama chu ijakiya ima jouse luchang ahisah ahitai. 23 Houbung chu Christa tahsa ahin, tahsa chu aluchang to akijop teng thil ijakai subukimpa chu bulhingset ding ahi tai

Ephesus 2

Thinaa kona hinna

1 Masanga chu nasuh khel nau le nachonset nauva thisa nahiuve; 2 hiche laiya chu hiche vannoi leiset khang um chan dungjuiya na chonuva, vanlai jol’a thunei vaipo ho nung juiya, tulai Pathen ngaisah loute lah a natong lhagao thusah a chon’a nahiuve. 3 Phat khat laiya Juda mi keiho jong hitobang chu kahiuvin, katahsapheu ngaichat lamjenga chon, tahsaphe lunggul le lungtup a chon kahiuvin, midang banga keiho jong lunghanna chate kanahiuve. 4 Ahinla Pathen he-pina bulhingset, ami-ngailut ning lhing sel’in eingailuvin, 5 suh khelna-a ithi laitah-un Christa to eicho hing khomtauve, lugnset vanga huhhingchang nahiuve. 6 Amato ei kaithou thauva, vangam, Jesu Christa hongsunga eitou sah-u ahi tai. 7 Hichu ahung lhung ding khanga Jesu Christa sunggil’a eikhoto nau lungsetna letset jeng chu eivetsah theina diu ahiye. 8 Ijeh-inem itile tahsan jal’a lungset man’a huh hing chang nahiuvin, hichehi nang hoa kona hilouva Pathen thilpeh ahibouve. 9 Natoh vanga ahilou jehhin kisonna thei jong ahi poi. 10 Eiho Pathen semsa ihiuvin, Pathenin ichonna diuva ana gon masah chengsea chu ichon theina diuva natoh pha chengse tong dia Jesu Christa sunggil’a kisemdoh ihiuve

Christa sunga pumkhat

11 Tahsa phea chidang namdang nahilaiyu, tahsa khut’a cheptan mihon cheptan lou nahi sah laiyu khang chu geldoh-uvin; 12 hiche laiya chu Christa to kimat lou, Israel lhangpi kiloikhomnaa pang lou, thutep jal’a kimu kitepnaa pangkhalou, hiche leiset’a hi kinepna bei le Pathen helouva um nahiuve. 13 Tua vang Jesu Christa sunga na umtah jeh-un masanga na gamlat vangun Christa thisan jal’a ngai dam nahitauve 14 Christa chu eiho kichamna ahi. Aman kikhena bang lai chu aphe lhan, kidouna chu atahsa phen asumangin, Judate le chidang namdang te pumkhat asotai. 15 Aman namnia kona Amato hingkhom dinga mithah khat asemdoha chamna asemdoh na dinga Danthu chu athupeh chengse le adan jouse toh asuhmangtha ahi tai. 16 Thingpel’a athi chun Christan kidouna chu atahsa tah-in asumangin, jat ni chu asuchamin, Pathen henga tahsa pumkhatseh asemdoh tai. 17 Hiti chun ahungin Pathen to kigamlat namdang nang ho heng le Pathen to kinai Judate henga hiche chamna Kipana Thupha hi ahung seiphong tai. 18 Hijeh a chu Christa jal’a chidang namdang le Judaten iloi niuva Lhagao khat’a Pa henga lut theina ineiyu ahi je. 19 Hichejeh chun nang ho maljin le khopem nahi tapouvin, Pathen mithengte chan khompi le a-insung mite nahitauve. 20 Jesu Christa chu inning song khomdet ahin, sholchahho le Themgao ho songset chunga nang ho kisadoh nahiuve. 21 Christa chun in kisa chengse chu aloikhomsoh keiya, Pakai Houin theng hi dinga akhantousah ahi; 22 Ama sunga chu nang ho jong adang chegse to kisakhom Pathenin Lhagaova chenna anei theina dia kisa doh nahiuve

Ephesus 3

Chidang namdangte dia Paul natoh

1 Hichejeh a chu chiding namdang nang ho jal’a soh changa kihen keima Paul, 2 Pathen lungset vanga nang ho dinga hiche kinbolna eikipeh hi najahsau ahi tan, 3 thil kiselguh kahenga kiphongdoh a kihetsah dungjuija paltan’a kahinsutsa jong ahitai; 4 simpou pou leu chun Christa selguh thil kahet themdol hetauvin nate. 5 Tulaiya Lhagaovin Christa solchah theng ho le Themgao ho henga aphondoh bang hin khang masa laiyin mihem chate akihetsahpoi. 6 Athuguh chu Jesu Christa jal’a Kipana Thupha hung lhun hin chidang namdang ten jong Judate to gou lokhomna le tahsan khat hikhomna chule thutep chankhomna aneitauve 7 Athilbol thei thahat le Pathen lungset manbeiya thilpeh eikipe dungjuiya hiche Kipana Thupha lhachaa eikipansah ahitai. 8 Mitheng te jouse lah a alhumpen kahi vangin Christa haoje akhona bei Kipana Thupha hi chidang namdangte henga seiphongna ding lungsetna hi eikipei; 9 hichu thil ijakai sempa Pathenin ama sunga tonsot’a akoi thilgon kiselguh chu mitin kamusah a, 10 tulaiya Houbung jeh a Pathen chihna jat chom chom ahidol hi vanlaijol’a vaihom thuneite hetsahna ding ahi. 11 Hiche hi i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa chunga kimolso tonsot’a gonsa thilgon dungjuiya um ahiye. 12 Ama itahsan jal’u le Amato ihinkhom jeh-uva lung ngamna le hanna neiya ahenga lut ngam ihitauve. 13 Hichejeh chun nang ho jeh a hesoh genthei kathoh hi lung thoi hih-un, hiche hi naloupinau joh ahibouve

Christa ngailutna het ding

14 Hichejeh a chu dilsua Pa henga taoji ka hin, 15 hiche Pa vanga hi vanmun jouse le leiset chunga phungtinin kiminvo na aneiyu ahi; 16 Aman aloupi haoje akhonna beiya kona thahat le thilboltheina a-Lhagao vanga nami-sung nunguva dia napeh theiyuva, 17 tahsan jal’a Christa chu na lungthim sunguva achen theiya, 18 hitia chu mithengte chengse to Christa ngailutna jaoje le saoje, chule asanje le athuhje het khen jouna na nei theiyuva, 19 hetna jouse khokhelsoh hel Christa ngailutna nahet theiyuva, ijakai chamkimsoh hel Pathen chamkimna nabulhin thei na dingu ahije 20 I-sunguva natong jing athahat dungjuija ithum sangule igel sanguva thil ijakai thahat tah a bolthei Pa, 21 Ama henga chun Houbung sung le Jesu Christa hongsunga akhang khangin tonsot geiyin loupina um jing tahen: Ame

Ephesus 4

Tahsa pumkhat

1 akai dia sohchang keiman na kikounau to kitoh a chon dia ka-ngeh nahiuve; 2 phat jousen nunnem in, chonnem jingun, thohhat to thon, ngailutnan khat le khat kingai themun; 3 Lhagaova pumkhat hina chu tuhchah jing din kihabol’un, cham nan kikan khom jingun, 4 nakikounau kinepna khatseh ahibangin tipum khat, Lhagao khat ahi; 5 Pakai khat, tahsankhat, baptize channa khat, 6 mi jouse Pa, ijakai chunga um, ijakaiya natong, ijakai ya umsoh Pathen khatseh ahi 7 Christa thilpeh tepte na dan dungjuija eiho mi khat cheh hi lungsetna thilpeh khat cheh eipeh-u ahi. 8 Hijeh chun Pathen lekhabua: “Ama chung sanga akaltou chun Gal-hing kiman tampi akaitouvin; Mihemte jong thilpeh Tampi apei,’ ati 9 “Ama akaltouvin,” kiti hi, ‘Leiset noinung geiya akumlhai,’ tilou adang ipi kiseina ham? 10Akum lhapa chu ijaki asuh bulhitsohna dinga vanmun jouse chungvum’a kaltoupa ma ma chu ahi. 11 Chule Aman miho thil apehho chu: abang sohchah hi na, abang Themgao hi na, abang evangelist hi na, abang Pastor hi na le mihil hi na ahin, 12 ama ho hin mithengte chu lhacha natohna lam le Christa tahsa sahdohna ding lama agontoh-uva, 13 eiho chengse hi tahsan’a pumkhat ihikahseu le Pathen Chapa ihet kahseu, mi kikhan lhit ihiuva chule Christa pilhin dung chan iphah kah seuva abol diu ahi. 14 Hichu ei ho chapang banga mi suhmangna dinga doha thuh a kipodoh ho le mihem lungthim gilouva kon kihilna lhem ho chu kipui chatvaisah a hui nung jousen amut ling le alhoh mang theibep tobang ihilouna diu ahi. 15 Chuti sanga aluchang hiya Christa chu thil ijakaiya ikhantouna diu va ngailut neiya thuttah isei jing diu ahi; 16 Amaa kona tahsa pumpi hi kitoh chet’a kisuto khoma kisolmat cheh, tahsa pumpi hi tibah dang chengse hin atuhmat soh keiya, atoh ding dol cheh abol’uva ngailutnaa asahdoh a akhantousah-u ahi je

Christa sunga hinkhothah

17 Pakai pan’a hiche hi seiya kahettohsah nahiuve: chidang namdang ten lung chatvai aput’uva achon bangun chon hih-un; 18 amaho kho pholouhel le alungtah behseh jeh-uva ahetnau lung thimsoh a Pathen hin naa chu kipaidoh ahitauvin, 19 jumle ja helouva um’uva acham cham’uva huh lam le thil theng lou tinchang to chule lop lam bolna dinga kipedoh ahitauve 20 Nang ho vang Christa chu hitobanga hi kihil nahipouve; 21 Jesu laigil’a cheng thutah banga Ama chu najah-uva chule Amaa kihila nahiule 22 nang hon masang chonna dol’a chon, joulhep ding ngaichatna lunggul’a ha set cheh cheh milui chu napai lhah-uva, 23 nalungthimu Lhagaova kisemthah a, 24 chule thutah dungjuiya adih le athenga Pathen lim banga kisemdoh mithah chu nakivon diu ahi

Hinkho thah a hin dol

25 Hijeh chun jou pailhan, nangho khat cheh chu aheng akomto thutah jengin kihou hen; ijeh-inem itile eiho khat cheh hi tibah khat ihi bouvui. 26 Lung hangkha tajong leu chun chonse hih-un; nalung han u chu nisan lhumkhum hih hel hen 27 Chule agilou pa chu mun ot hih hel’uvin. 28 Gucha chu gucha kit ta hih hen, chusangin alhasam ato theina din akhut tah-in napha tong gim hen. 29 Nakam’uva konin thuse khat cha potda hen, amavang ajah ho lung lhaina din khantou theina dinga akhoh dungjuija thupha potjo hen. 30 Lhatdoh nikhoa dinga mohor nakinam nau Pathen Lhagao Theng chu lung phatmosah hih-un. 31 Thukha jouse leh lungsat, lunghan, kinah, kitaitom, chule gitlounajouse nang hoa konin pai mangun. 32 Nang ho khat le khat kihepito cheh-un, lung nemun, Pathenin Christa sunggil’a na-ngaidam bangun ki-ngaidam’uvin

Ephesus 5

Khovah chatea hindol

1 Hichejeh chun Pathen sahtah chate nahijeh-un Amato bah ding ngaitouvin. 2 Christan eiho eingailut’uva eiho jal’a Pathen henga maicham thilpeh gimnamtui banga Ama akipehdoh jeng bang chun ngailutnan chon’uvin. 3 Mithengte umdol’in jong thule then louna jouse chule papset thudol nalah-uva kiphapoh hih hel hen; 4 chule jamo le thumotsei, tothanghoi hicheng jong chu umda hen lang, chusangin thangvahna thu kiseijo hen. 5 Ijeh-inem itile nang hon hiche hi nahetdiu ahi, koi hile jonthanhoi bol, thilthengloubol, chule papsea le doilim semthu houva chun Christa le Pathen lenggam sunga mun aneipoi 6 Koima thu homkeovin kilhep lhahsah dauvin, hiche ho jeh taha chu thua nung lou chate chunga Pathen lunghan hung chuji ahi. 7 Hiteho chutoh imacha kikop hih-un. 8 Nangho muthima na umsa nahiuvin, tua vang Pakai hongsunga khovah changkha nahitauvin, hijeh chun khovah chate bangin chon’un. 9 Ijeh-inem itileh khovah ga chu phatna jouse le adih chule thutah ahin, 10 Pakai lung lhaina ding chu pho toh-uvin; 11 muthima um tohga beiho chuto imacha kikop hih hel’un, amaho chu sosal’un phohsal jou’uvin. 12 Ijeh-inem itile amaho guthim natohho chu seidoh ding jongjachat umleo ahi. 13 Ajeh chu ijakai hi isosal’a iphonjal teng le khovah chun aphong doh jitai. 14 Ijeh-inem itile ijakai phong doh a chu khovah ahi. Hichejehchun: ‘Vo ihmumil khangin, Athi lah a konin thoudoh-in: Chuteng Christan nasalvah ding ahi,’ tin akiseiye 15 Hijeh chun iti nachon’um ching theiyun, lungthimbei ho banga um louvin, michingho bangin um’un; 16 phat hi kitup keiyin mangun, ajeh chu tulai nikho hi apha tapoi. 17 Hijeh chun lungthimbeiyin umdauvin, Pakai lungdei ipiham het ding ngaitouvin. 18 Lengpituiyin kham hih-un, hichea chun manthahna aum’e; chusangin Lhagaovin dimsetjo’uvin; 19 tumging to thon Lhagao lan khat le khat kihou limun, tumging tumin kitohdel’in Pakaiya nalunggil’in la sauvin. 20 Imatih chanin ima lam jouse a dingin i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa minin Pa Pathen thangvah jingun; 21 Christa ja nan khat thun khat nung uvin

Pasal ho le ajiteu

22 Numeiho Pakai thua nung bangin napasal teu thun nungun; 23 ajehchu Christa chu atahsa Houbung huhhinga le aluchang ahi banga, pasal chu numei luchang ahi. 24 Houbung Christa thua anun banga numei ho jong ima lam jousea apasal teu thua nung diu ahi. 25 Pasal ho, Christan Houbung angailut’a, adinga Amatah akipeh doh jeng bangin najiteu ngailu’vin. 26 Christan angailut Houbung chu twiya asilngim’a thua asuh thengna dinga abol ahi, 27 hichu Houbung hi Ama angsunga loupitah leh thengsel, nolnabei le avonkom beihela adinsahna ding ahi. 28 Hijeh a chu pasal hon ajiteu chu ama ho tahsa banga angailut diu ahi. Ajinu ngailupa chu ama kingailua ahiye. 29 Ajeh chu koiman imatih chanin atahsa ahokhahpoi, Christan Houbung abolna bangin, avah khangin ahebolji bouve. 30 Eiho hiChrista tahsa tibah ihiuve. 31 “Hichejeh a hi mihemin anu apa lhakanga ajinu akolchahjoh ding chule amani tikhat hilhon dinga hi,” akiti. 32 Hiche thu hi giltah ahin, keiman Christa le Houbung thudol’a bou ka sei ahiye. 33 Ahinla nang ho amichang cheh a ding jong ahin, hijeh chun mi ama aki-ngailut bangin ajinu ngailu chehhen, chule numeiyin jong ajipa jabolcheh hen

Ephesus 6

Chate le nu le pa

1 Chate Pakai jal’in nanu napa thun nungun, hichu adih ahi. 2 “Nanu napa jabol’in,” kiti hi thutep lah a thupeh masapen ahin, 3 “Naphat theiya leiset chunga nahinkho sotna dingin,” jong akati. 4 Pate ho, nachateu sulung hang hin-un, Pakai deiya gahchah le tilkhouna lamjoh a seiletsah jo’uvin

Sohho le Pakaite

5 Sohho, Christa thua nanun banguvin, kichat le kihot pumpum in lung jangkeiyin tahsa lama napakaiteu thua nungun; 6 mihem vethoiding maiya hilouvin, hinkhopumpin Christa soh hiuvin, Pathen lungdei chu tonguvin; 7 mihema hilouvin Pakai lama lunggel’a soh natong hiuvin; 8 ajeh chu soh hihen chamlhat hile thilpha bol chanin Pakaiya kona kipaman asancheh diu naheuve. 9 Pakaiya pang ho, sohho chu tobangma chun bol’un, hutum gihsal bol dauvin, ajeh chu ama ho le nang ho nagom’u va Pakai chu van’a aumin, Aman koima dat le langkaina aneilou na heuve

Agilou douna galvon

10 Achaina keiyin Pakaiya pansan athahhat athilbol thei nan kitilkhouvun. 11 Diabol lungthim gilou chengse masanga napan jouna din Pathen galvon lhingkeiyin kivon’un; 12 Ijeh-inem itile eiho thisan le tahsaphe to kibon ihipouvin, van mun tin’a lhagao gilou engse ho, hiche vannoi muthimvaipo ho, thu neiho, vaihom ho to kidou ihiubouvui. 13 Hijeh chun nikho phalou nia nadin jouva, akhonna geiya dingdet’a nanan jouna diuvin Pathen galvon lhingkeiyin pan’uvin. 14 Hijeh chun thutah chu konggah bang in kigah un, adih chu ompho bangin panin dingun; 15 cham na Kipana Thupha chu kengchot kisesa bangin gotsan kikoiyun, 16 hicheng chunga chun agiloupa thalpi meikong tobang chu nasuhmit jouna diuvin tahsan chu lum bangin kidal nan neiyun; 17 chu le huhhingna chu thih-lukhuh bangin kikhuh-un, Lhagaova kon Pathen Thu chu chemjam bangin mangun; 18 hiche na ding hin Lhagao mang chan ijakaiyin phat jousen tao jing un lang, chujongle tantih neilouvin phat jousen kiging jingun, mithengte din jong taopeh jinguvin; 19 chule keima din jong Kipana Thupha thugil hi paodoh a thu ka sei teng kichentah a het theiya kaseidoh theina dingin neitaokop jingun, 20 hiche dinga hi thihkhaova kihen’a leng palai kahin, hiche laitah a hi kasei dingdol lom hangtah a kaseina ding ahi

Achaina

21 Pakai hinkhoa lhacha tahsan um sopi deitah Tychicus-in keima umchan ipi kabol nahetnom chengseu nahetsah nauvinte. 22 Keiho thudol nahet nom chengseu hetsah ding le nalungthim til khou ding ngaitoa ama hi nahenguva kahinsol ahi. 23 Pa Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christaa konin ngailut le tahsan chule chamna sopite henga um jing hen. 24 I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa ngailut ho chengse chu kemthei louvin lungset nan umpi jingu hen

Philippi 1

Salam thu

1 Jesu Christa soh te ni Paul le Timothyn Philippi khoa um Jesu Christa tahsan mithengte le Houbung lamkai chengse, lhacha chengse henga: 2 i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa konin lungset le chamna nachunguva um hen.

Philippi khomite dia Paul taona

3 Nang ho kageldoh phat le ima tih chanin ka- Pathen kathangvah jinge; 4 Phat jousen thangvah to thon nang ho chengse dingin katao jing jengin, 5 Akipat nia pat tuni geiya Kipana Thupha kinbol thudol’a neikithopi jeh- un hitia chu kabol ahi. 6 Hichea hin nang ho sunga thilpha bolpa chun Jesu Christa nikho geiya amolso tei ding dettahin katahsan’e. 7 Nabonchauva thudol’a hitia lung kagel hi adih-e; ajeh chu kalungthim’a kavop jing nahiuve. Nanghon eikipe lungsetna thudol’a kabulput kahen lhahna hihen lang Kipana Thupha lama kihonna thusei le phudetna ding dol hijongle neichankhompi cheh-u ahiye. 8 Nabonchauva lung gil’a ka-ngailut nau kisei hi Jesu Christa lainatpina ka-ngaiyu eihettohpia Pathen ahijenge. 9 Hiche kataona lopen chu: ngailut naneiyu chu agil cheh cheh a, hetna gelkhenna aletsetna ding kati ahi. 10 Chutile nanghon thilpha datchilje nahet-uva, Christa nikho ni le thengsel le nolnabei nahi diu, 11 Jesu Christa vanga Pathen loupina le vahchoina dinga thildih ga chu nadim dingu ahi.

Keidin hin chu Christa ahi

12 Sopite, keima chung chang thusoh hi Kipana Thupha machal na joh ahidan nahet diu kadeiye. 13 Hichejeh hin kabulput kahen lhah hi Christa seijui kahijeh ahi Pretorian sepai ho le midang jouse henga aphongdoh tai. 14 Chu le kabulput henlhah hi sopite atamjon amun, hanlo na cheh-in aneiyun, gin bei hel’a thusei ding angamlotauve. 15 Atahbeh-in mi abangin thangset sum le kinahna bep’in Christa aseiphong leuvin, phabep’in vang thilpha deina aseiphongu ahinai. 16 Kon khat’ in jong Kipana Thupha panhuna thusei kahi ahetjeh uva ngailutna aneiyu ahi. 17 Kon khatsen vang kabulput henlhah na hi genthei kathoh be cheh ding dei naa lung theng louva Christa asei phongu ahibouve. 18 Ipijeh mong ham? Phat lhemna hihen atahbeh hijongle, ipi lam ahiya Christa chu kiseiphong thou ahin, hijeh chun kakipah-e, chule kakipa jing ding ahi; 19 Ijeh-inam itile nang ho tao kop jing jeh le Jesu Christaa kona Lhagao panpina jeh a hiche hi huhhinga kahung umna ding ahi kahei. 20 Kadei gilpen le kakinepna chu katoh dingdol kin pel louva kabol jing theiya, a-itih phat hihen tutah jeng hijongle hakattah a kapan ngam’a hinna hihen thina hijongle katahsa pumpia hi Christa choi-at nading hi ahipen’e. 21 Ijeh-inem itile keima din hin chu Christa ahin, thi chu hamphatna ahi. 22 Ahinla tahsaphea hin hi tohga pha sona joh ahile, hoijoh lhen kah ding kahepoi. 23 Ni kaha lhenjoh ding helouva moh lunggim kahi, kitel doh a Christa to umkhom ding kadei lheh jenge, hichu kei dinga gam chenga phajo ding ahi. 24 Ahin la tahsaphea kahin nah lai ding hi nang ho dia khoh jo nalai ahi. 25 Hijeh chun um nalai ing ting nabonchauva ka- umpia kipana le tahsan dol’a nakhan tou be na diuva kakithopi ding hi kaginchat’a kahet ahi. 26 Hichu nahenguva kahung kit teng keima jeh a Jesu Christa to nahinkhom nauva kisonna nanei be chehna dingu ahi. 27 Keima na henguva hung ing, hung mun, muhih jong leng, Kipana Thupha tahsan lam’a lung khat tah a napan khom’uva, Lhagao khat’a na din khom jing u kajah theina din nanun nakhan, nakhosah dol’u chu Christa Kipana Thupha to kitoh pou pou hen; 28 Nakidoupi-teu masanga kicha louhel’a napan’u chun amaho dinga manthahna ahi-dol aphotchetsah a, nangho dia huhingna ahije amusahding, hiche hi Pathena hungkon ahin, 29 Christa jal’a Ama tahsan mai hilouva Ama ding jong nathohgimpi diuva chan kipe nahiuve; 30 Hijeh a chu masanga thohgim’a gal kisat chu namu’ vin, tun jong najauvin ahi.

Philippi 2

Christa kineosah le choisanga aum

1 Christa to hinkhomnaa hi kitil khounaa, um dia, haldoh theina ngailut a um dia, Lhagaova kiloi khomna a um dia, dipdam le kilai natpina a um ding le, 2 Kakipana hi suchamkimun, lungthim kitha khat-in, ngailutna chu neicheh- in, thu khat kisauvin, lung khat hiuvin; 3 Moh hamhoitho le kiletsah man’a imacha bol louvin, lung nem heo chan khat’in khat chu ama sanga phajoa gel cheh hiuvin. 4 Koiman ama changseh ding mai gel louvin midang ding jong gelkhoh cheh hiuvin. 5 Jesu Christa sunga cheng lungput chu nang ho sung gil a jong cheng ding ahi. 6 Aman Pathen lim le mel aput jing jeng vangin, Pumhat’a Pathen to kibah ding agel naisaipoi; 7 Ama chamtah-in keohel’in akilhan, Soh lim le mel akivon jon, Mihem khat bangin mihem mel’in ahung kilah-in, 8 Thina chan geiyin achamtah-in akineosah-in, Thingpel’a thina chan geiyin thun anunge. 9 Hijeh a chu Pathenin Ama chu munsangpen chungvuma akhansanga, Min jouse sanga minthangpen apeh ahin; 10 Hijeh a chu van le leiset chule leiset noiya cheng jousen Dilsua Jesu min’a chibai aboh diu; 11 Chule lei jousen Pa Pathen loupina dinga Jesu Christa chu,’Pakai’ tia aphondoh cheh diu ahi.

Vah tampi banga vannoiya vah ding

12 Hiti ahijeh chun kadeitahte, sei na-ngai jing banguvin keima umpet maiya hilouvin, tu ka-umlou pet jengin jong kicha cheh-in ki thing thingin huhhing nachan nau molsona dingin na tongun. 13 Ijeh inem itile alungnachim ding deichat-na le toh nomna dinga nasunguva natong chu Pathen ma ma ahibouve. 14 Ima jouse phunchel louhle le kinel baotam louhel’in bol’un; 15 chutia chu hiche khang lamvai le vah koiho lah a hi nolnabei le themmona neilou, themmona bei Pathen chate nahiuva, vannoiya nisa banga navah theina diuvin, 16 Amaho chu hinna thu seipeh-un; chutile Christa Nikho teng kison-naa kanei theiya, kagimna le kacholna chengse hi moh ahilouje kichen ding ahi. 17 Natahsan jal’uva Pathena thilpeh le natohnaa hin kahinna thisan hi kisung lhahel jongle kakipah-in nabonchauva chunga kakitai piuve. 18 Hiti chun kipah-un lang keijong neikipa piu-vin.

Timothy le Epaphroditus

19 Nachung chang thuu kajah teng kitilkhouna kanei theina dinga nahenguva Timothy hinsol vah ding Pakai Jesu jal’in kakinem lheh jenge. 20 Nachung chang thuu lung thengsel’a gel khoh a ama tobang midang kaneipoi. 21 Ajeh chu mi- dang hon amaho ding jeng bou aki-hol’uvin, Jesu Christa thudol’a imacha agelkhoh pouve. 22 Timothy vang aphat chomje naheuve, ajeh chu chapan apa akithopi banga Ki-pana Thupha thua hi soh na tong banga keima eitoh hu ahiye. 23 Hijeh chun keima umchan ding dol akihet phat phat le ama hi hinsol ding kinem jing kahi. 24 Keima tah jong kahung loi ding hi Pakaiya konin kagingcha lheh jenge. 25 Ka-ngailutna kinbol dia na-solchah-u, kaseipai chanpi le toh khompi, sopi Epaphroditus hi na-henguva hinsol loi ding khoh kasa-tai; 26 ama dammo thu najah-u chu nommo asa lheh jengin, hijeh chun nabonchauvin namu nom lheh jenguve. 27 Ijeh-inem itile anan athideh chet jenge, ahivangin Pathenin akhoton, amaseh hilouvin keijeng jong lunggimna sangson kanei louna din eikhotoi. 28 Ama namu tengu nakipa kit theiyuva kalunggimna jong alhom dom theina dinga ama hi kahinsol loi jeng ahi. 29 Hichejeh chun Pakai jal’in Kipana tincheng to thon anasangun lang, hitobang mi hi jabol’uvin; 30 ijeh-inem itile aman keima neijen nauva abang khai jouse bulhitna din ahinkho geiyin atohdoh jengin, Christa ding natohnaa athilo deh chet jenge.

Philippi 3

Adih tahbeh

1 Kasopite, tukalse vang Pakai chunga kipah jingun. Nang ho dia aphat chomjeh-in kasutsa velsut kit ding kachimdehpoi. 2 Uichate chu kivet phat’un, thilse bol ho chu kivet phat’un lang cheptan lou khohsah ho chu kivetphet’uvin. 3 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen Lhagaova Pathen chibai boh a Christa Jesu jal’a kisonna nei, tahsaphea kisong lou eiho hi cheptan dihtah ihiuve. 4 Tahsaphea cheptan kisonpi ding hijongle kiphat lamna kaneipoi. Khattouvin tahsaphea cheptan chu akisonpi dingle ken kakheljoi. 5 Niget nia chep kitan, Israel chilhah, Benjamin phung Hebrew chilhah Hebrew mi, Danthu dungjuiya Pharisee kahin, 6 tompan jeh a Houbung bolsea pang, them channa dia Danthu lamdol’a nolnabei kahi. 7 Ahinla hitobang phatchomna kanei hi aboncha Christa jal’a pannabei thil’a kagel ahitai. 8 Ka-Pakai Jesu Christa hetna hin akhokhelsoh hel phat’in thildang jouse hi manthahna, imacha hilouva ka-ngaito ahin, Ama jal’a thil ijakai hi kapaidoh a, Christa chu kaphatchompi theina dinga adang hi eh tobanga kagela 9 Ama sunggil’a keima kakimudoh a, themchanna chu Danthu vanga kanei hilouva, tahsan jal’a Pathena hungkon them channa, hiche themchanna chu Christa tahsan vanga kanei theiya, 10 Ama le athokit thahatna kahet’a athohgimna chu kathoh khompia, athina banga chu kathi nom ahin, 11 kajo pou le thinaa kona jong katho doh ding ahi.

Abidol lam mano ding

12 Keiman kalahsa ahiloule chamkimsaa jong kahipoi; Christa Jesun keima eimat khah banga ken jong mat khah tei ding kagot joh ahibouve. 13 Sopite, keiman mankha taa keiya hisah mongin kagelpoi, kagel khat vang hi achesa thil jouse chu kasumil jin, masang lama thil ho kadeljoi; 14 Jesu Christa jal’a chunga Pathen kouna dungjuiya hatman sanna dia abidoi mun chu hadel’a del kahi. 15 Hijeh chun eiho apilhingsa sen hitobang hin lung gel’u hitin, ijemtia khattouvin thilchom agel jongle hijong chu Pathenin nahenguva phongdoh nante. 16 Hijongle eihon iphah sau chan geihin chon’u hite. 17 Sopite, nabonchauvin keima umchan jom’uvin. Navetkah diuva chon keiho umchan jop ho vechen’uvin. 18 Ijeh-inem itile mitampi achon nau hi najah-uva tamtah vei kaseisa ahitan, tua jong kap puma kasei ahi, amaho hi Christa Thingpel douva ahiuve. 19 Hijeh chun akikhon nau chu manthahna ahin, a-pathenu chu agilpiu ahi; akithang at nau chu jumna ahin, leiset thil ho jeng bou agel’uve. 20 Eiho vang igammi hinau chu van chunga hung kipan ahin, hichea kona chu Huhhingpa Pakai Jesu Christa hung ding kinemtah a i-ngau ahi; 21 Aman athilbol thei thahatna chu thil ijakai hi anoiya akoisoh a, eiho tahsa manmo hi Ama tahsa loupi tah lim’a akhel doh ding ahi.

Philippi 4

Tilkhouna

1 Hichejeh chun kasopi ngaitah le deitah te, kakipana le kalal lukhuh ho, hibang tah hin ngaitahte Pakai hinkhon dingdet jinguvin. 2 Euodia le Syntyche chu Pakai jal’a kihoutoh dinga deichom tah a ka-ngeh ahi lhon’e. 3 Ahi, kanamkoljon put khompi ginchat umtah nang jong ka-ngeh nahi, hiche numei ho hi kithopin, ajeh chu amaho ahiuvin, Clement ahin, adang dang katoh khompi chengsen Kipana Thupha thudol’a hatah a eitoh khompiu ahin, hinna lekhabu sunga hicheng min hi aumtai. 4 Pakai chunga kipah jingun, tikit leuvinge kipah-un. 5 Nachon nem’u chu mihem jouse het hihen. Pakai ahung naiye. 6 Imacha lungkhamna nei hih hel’un, ahin ima lam jousea taona le thumna mangin thangvah to thon nathum jouseu Pathen hetsah-uvin. 7 Chuteng hetna jouse kho-khelsoh Pathena hungkon cham nan Christa Jesu to nahinkhom nauva nalung thim’u le nalunggel jouseu ahonbit ding ahi. 8 Sopite, tukalsen vang ipi hile thutah dia kilompen, ja-thei doltah, adih dia ginchat pen, thengpen dia kilom, santhei doltah, thucheng ngei pen, ipi hile phatna dia lom auma pachat na thei aumle, hiti ho hi gel them’uvin. 9 Chule keiya kona nakihil’uva nalahsau, najahsau chule namusau chengse chu nang hon jong bol’uvin, chuteng cham konna Pathenin naumpi jing diu ahi.

Philippi mite thilpeh ho thangvah

10 Hitih nunga kaphatna ding nahin thah bol kit leuvu hi Pakai chunga hapan kakipah lheh jenge; nagot jingsau vang ahinan, phat kitup kom namu loujeh-u ahi. 11 Kalhahsam man a kasei ahipoi, ajeh chu keima hi kahi bang bep’a lung lhaiya umje kihil themsa kahintai. 12 Vaicha tah a umje kahen, neng jeng junga umje jong ka hei; ima jouse le ijakaiya oivaset a umje le gilkel tah a umje, ning lhingset le vaicha tah a umje thuguh kihil them kahitai. 13 Eihatsahpa Christa vanga ijakai bol thei kahi. 14 Ahinla kagenthei pet tah a neikithopiu hi nabolpha lheh-ui. 15 Kipana Thupha kipat til, Macedonia kadalhah chun nang ho tilou Houbung koimacha peh le lah thudol’a eikithopi aum louje Philippi mi nang hon nahet’u ahi. 16 AjehchuThessalonica khoa ka-umpet jeng jong chun ka-ngaichat hunnan avel vel’in neihin thot’uve. 17 Thilpeh chu kadei man ahipoi, nangho dinga aga apun ding joh chu kadei joh ahibouve. 18 Ijakai neipeh nau lekha hiche hi ahin, kaning lhingin, nang hoa kona santhei doltah, kikilhaina tobang thilpeh gimnamtui, Pathen lungdei lamtah kamun, kanei bulhingsettai. 19 Nang ho jong ka-Pathenin ahao dungjuiyin loupinan Jesu Christa hinkhon na-ngaichat chan’u subulhit nante. 20 I-Pau Pathen chu tonsot, tonsot geiyin loupi jing jeng hen: Amen.

Achaina lemna phabep

21 Christa Jesu hinkhoa hing mitheng josue salam’uvin, Kaumpi sopiten nasalam’uve. 22 Mitheng jouse ahideh chun Caesar insung miten nasalam’ui. 23 Pakai Jesu Christa lungsetnan nalhagaovu umpi jing hen.

Colossae 1

Salam

1 Pathen lungdeiya Jesu Christa solchah a pang Paul le sopi Timothyn 2 Colossae khoa um Christa sunggil’a mithengte le tahsan um ho, i-Pau Pathena konin lungset le chamna na chunguva um jing hen.

Colossae Christian ho dia Paul taona

3 Keiho phat jousen nang ho din kataovun, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa Pathen kathangvah jingui. 4 Ajeh chu Jesu Christa hinkhoa natahsanu le mitheng jouse na-ngailut’u ka jauvin, 5 nang ho dinga kinepna chu van’a kholsa ahitai, hichu Kipana Thupha thutah thudol’a chun najatauvin, 6 hiche nahenguva ahung lhun a pat nalah-uva aumdol bangin vannoi pumpia aga pung lheh jengin, najah niuva pat Pathen lungsetna chu thutah-in amachal jingin ahi. 7 Hitia hi nang hon kangailut tah-u le sohna katoh khompiu Ephras a kona nahetdoh-u ahin, ama hi Christa dinga keiho cheng thalhenga tahsan umtah le lhachaa pang ahin, 8 ama hin lhagao vin napeh-u ngailutna naneiyu chu eiseipeh-u ahi. 9 Hijeh a chu hiche kajah niuva pat chihna tincheng le Lhagao jal’a Ama lungdei lam hetna le datkhen dol nadimsetna diuvin nang ho din taopeh le thumpeh na tang louhel kahiuve; 10 hichu imalam jousea Pakai lung lhaina to kitoh a nachon theiyuva, thilphalam natohana jouse a naga theiyuva, Pathen hetna lama jong nakhan touvuva, 11 aman athahatna loupi tah a kona thil ijakai thoh hat tah a na thoh theina diuva kidang tah a nahatsah-uva kipah tah a 12 nang ho chengse khovah laiya leng amithengte to lengkhom dinga lomtah a gongtoh Pa chu nathangvah theina diu ahi. 13 Aman muthim khojin tha neinaa kona eihuhdoh-uva, a-Chapa deitah lenggam sunga eipuilut’u ahitai. 14 Achapa jal’a chu lhatdohna le chonset ngaidamna ineiyu ahi.

Christa amatah chule anatoh

15 Chapa chu mu theilou Pathen limpu ahin, thilsem jouse sanga masajo ahi; 16 ijeh-inem itile ama jal’a thil ijakai, van a hihen leiset chunga hijongle, muthei le mumo ho, laltouna ho le loinehna gam ho gei, vaihom thu neina ahin, thil ijakai hi Ama jalle Ama dinga kisem ahi; 17 chule Ama chu thil jouse masanga anaum jing ahin, thil ijakai hi Amato akijopmat teng ding det ahiuve. 18 Ama chu atahsa Houbung luchang, abul ahin, ima lam jousea amasat jingna din athiho lah a jong athoudoh masapen’e. 19 Ijehinem itile Chapa sunga hi Patheinin chamkimkeiya chenpha adei ahi; 20 ajeh chu Ama jal’a thil ijakai aboncha ahenga suhchamsoh a, Ama vangle a-Thingpel thisan jal’a leiset chunga um jouse le vanlaijol’a um jouse kah a chamna asem ahitai. 21 Masang laiya thilse nabol’uva lunggel’a nadou laiyun Pathena kona pamse nahiuvin, 22 tua vang Ama angsunga nolna beihel le boh beh lou, athenga dinsah dinga tahsaphe pua athina tahsa jal’a chu nakicham piu ahitan; 23 tahsan’a nadindet jinguva, dettah le longlouva, najahsau Kipana Thupha kinepnaa chu long louhel’a napandet jing dingu ahi. Hiche Kipana Thupha chu vannoi thilsem jouse henga kiseiphongsoh ahitan, keima Paul jong hiche lhachaa chu pang ka hi.

Houbung dia Paul natoh

24 Tun nang ho dinga hesoh genthei kathoh jouse hi kakipapi. Ajeh chu katahsaphea thohna hin atahsaa kisim Houbung thalhenga Christa gimgentheina bangkhai jouse asuh bulhit ahi. 25 Hiche dinga chu Pathen gouching kahiya, na henguva Pathen thu lhingkeiya seiphong dinga eiki-ngense dungjuiya keima lhachaa pang kahi; 26 hiche thuguh hi tonsot tonsot, akhang khanga ki-im ahin, tua vang amithengte henga kiphongdoh ahi tai. 27 Pathenin hiche thuguh thalhinje le loupije itobang lom ahi chu namtin henga hilchet ding adeitan, hiche kinepna loupipen nasunguva Christa achen hi ahi. 28 Amabou hi kaphonjal’uva mitin kathumop’uva, chihna top’a mijouse kahilchah-u ahi; ajeh chu amitakip hi Christa dinga pilhingsaa kadinsah nom’u ahi. 29 Hiche nadinga hi Aman kasunga eikhumpeh thahat tah a natong jing ahatna chu mangchaa kiseh tah a tonggim ka hi.

Colossae 2

1 Nang ho ding le Laodicea khoa um ho ding chule tahsaphea kamai mukha lou hel ho ding geiya itobang tah a kihabol kahije hi nahetdiu kadeiye. 2 Hichu alung thimu akilhep bi theiya, ngailtunaa akikankhom’uva, hetkhenna lhingset, neng jeng junga aneiyuva, Pathen selguh Christa chu ahetdohna diu ahi. 3 Ama sunga chun chihna le hetna gou jouse akisel’e. 4 Hiche hi koiman seithem’a nanel lhah louna diuva kasei ahi. 5 Tahsa hin nalahuva lha hih jong leng lhagaovin nang ho to kalhahkhomin, kigah chah tah a napan det jeu le Christa natahsanjeu kipah-in kaseijinge.

Christa sunga hinkho lhingset

6 Jesu Christa chu Pakai dinga nakisan’u ahitah jeh-in, Amato hingkhom’un; 7 Ama sunga jung khouvin, kisadoh-un, nakihil banguvin tahsan nan kiphutdet’un, thangvah nan bulhingset’uvin. 8 Koiman chihgut lekha themna le mihemte pehson doha lhep lhahna thei moh thu homkeiuva gal-hing banga nakai mang louna diuvin ching theiyun, hichu vannoi leiset chondan dungjui bou ahin, Christa-a tobang ahipoi. 9 Ajeh chu Christa sung, atahsa sunga chu Pathen, a-Pathen hina chamkimsoh a pansa ahin, 10 vaipoh thu neina jouse luchang Christa to na hinkhom tengu le nang ho jong chamkimji nahiuve; 11 Ama sunga chu nang ho khut’a kitan hilou, cheptan nahiuvin, tahsaphe pu tahsa chu ponse selhah banga napaiyuva, Christa dinga chep kitan nahiutauve. 12 Ijeh-inem itile baptize nachan’uva chu amato kivuitha nahitauvin, Pathenin Ama chu thinaa athodoh kit, hiche thokitna chu tahsan jal’a amato thoukhom kit nahiutauve. 13 Nang ho chonset’a thisa, natahsapheu jong cheptan lou nahiuvin, Pathenin Christa to nachohing khom’uva ichonsetna jouseu angaidamsoh ahitai. 14 Eidou dal’uva pang khut’a kisun kihilna lhongpi Danthu chu Christan anoi manga, hichu asumangsoh-in Thingpel’a akhetbeh tai. 15 Christan vaipoh thu neina jouse ahoh lhasoh-in, atahsa chun abonchan ajousoh-in, kichentah-in aphongjal’e. 16 Chuti ahijeh-in koiman anneh thu, donthei thu, kut thudol, lhathah nit dol ham le Choldo Nikho thudol hamin nachung thuu khol da hen: 17 hichengse chu ahung lhung ding thil ho lim’a um ahin atahsa tahbeh chu Christaa umjo ahibouve. 18 Themgao thilmu bang mukisaa, ale lama kichonnemsah, Vantilte ho pou chibai boh nom mi koimacha nasan diu kipaman chu lahmangsah hih hel’un, hitobang miho hi mihem lunggel lam jeng agel jeh-uvin huilhoh mang theibep ahiuve. 19 Amaho chu atahsa pumpi Pathen thilgon banga akhantouna dinga tuhgom’a kilmatsoh guchin thagui chengse kigopsohna aluchang chutoh kimat lou ahitauve.

Christa to hinkhothah

20 Vannoi leiset bulpi lhagao hoa kona ontholna dia Christa to thikhom nahitah-u le ibol’a leiset kihilna lhongpia pansat’a hing ding goa nahiuvem? 21 “Tham hih, tep hih, tongkha hih,” kiti ho chu. 22 Hicheng hin akimanchah teng mangthahji thilho aseidoh ahin, aboncha hi mihem thupeh le thuhil jeng ahibouve. 23 Hiche ho hin ki engbol’a hougutna le kichon nemsah chule tahsa tibah engtim’a kitimna jal’in chihna gong apun, ahinla tibah ho kitiman dinga imacha phachom louhel ahibouvui.

Colossae 3

1 Nang ho Christa to kaithou tha nahitah-u le chunglam Pathen jet lama Christa kitousahna mun’a thil ho jeng bou hol’un. 2 Leiset chunga thil ho hilouvin chung lam thil ho jeng gel’uvin. 3 Ijeh-inem itile nang ho athisa nahitauvin nahinnau chu Pathen sunggil’a Christa to kiseltha ahitai. 4 Nahin nau Christa ahung kilah teng, nang ho jong Amato loupi tah a nakilah khom diu ahi.

Hinkholui chule hinkhothah

5 Hijeh chun leiset chunga natibah chengseuva natong jonthanhoi, thenlou, huh, lungtup gilou, milim hou tobang papset hicheng hi that gam’uvin. 6 Hicheng jeh hin thua nung lou chate chunga Pathen lunghan achujin ahi. 7 Masanga nang ho jong hichenga hi ana chon’a ana hing nahiuve. 8 Tun vang lungsat, lunghan, mitthip, taitom, nakamsunguva kona thujahmo sei jouse hi aboncha napai mangsoh diu ahij. 9 Khat le khat thujouvin kihou hih-un; ijeh inem itile mihem lui chu achonna jouse pum’a ponse lelhah banga nale lhahsau ahitai. 10 Ama limtobanga Sempa chu kichentah a na hetna diuva tang louhel’a semthah jing jeng limthah chu nakivon joh-u ahi. 11 Hichea hin Greek hihen Juda hile, cheptan le cheptan lou, koito kisamkai khah lou le khosuh khotou helou, soh, chamlhat aum thei poi Christa chu imajouse hisoh a, ijakaiya umsoh ahitai. 12 Hijeh chun Pathen lhentum mitheng, angailute nahijeh-un lainatna, khotona, kineosah nunmen, thohhat hicheng chu kivonjou’vin. 13 Khat le khat kidemdaito cheh-un, khat’in khat chunga kiphinna anei jongle kingaidamto jengun; Christan nang ho na-ngaidam bangun nang ho ki-ngaidam’uvin. 14 Hicheng jouse chunga hin kikankhomna chamkimpen ngailutna neiyun. 15 Christaa hungkon cham nan nalung sunguva vai homhen, hiche dinga chu tipumkhat’a kikou nahiuve. Chule thangvah jinguvin, 16 Christa thu nasunguva dimset’in cheng jing hen, chihna tin chengin kihilto kithumop to’uvin, tum ging to thon, houlan, thangvah to thon Lhagao lan nalung sunguva Pathen din sauvin. 17 Chule ijakai nabol jouse thu lam ahin natoh lam ahin abonchan Pakai Jesu minin bol’uvin, Ama jal’in Pa Pathen thangvah jingun.

Hinkho thah le ule nao kinbol ding

18 Numeiho Pakai dia lomtah-in pasalte thun nunguvin. 19 Pasal hon numeite chu ngailuvin, nunbol dauvin. 20 Chate, imalam jousea nu le pa te thun nunguvin, ajeh chu hiche hi Pakai lung lhaina ahi. 21Pate, nachateu alungbei lo louna diuvin sulung hang hih-un. 22 Sohte, mihem mitvet maiya hilouvin, Pakai gin nan lung jangkeiyin imalam jousea tahsa lamdo’a pakaite thun nunguvin. 23 Ipi hile nabolchan’u chu mihemte dia hilouvin Pakai dinga bol bangin lung thim pumpin bol’uvin. 24 Ijeh-inem itile Pakai koma kona goulo ding kipaman nasan diu naheuve. Sohna natoh nau chu Pakai Christa ahi. 25 Ajeh chu thildih lou bol’an a thildih lou bol man asan ding ahin, hichea hin maipha vetna aumpoi.

Colossae 4

1 Pakaite, yan’a Pakai khat naneiyu heuvin lang sohte chu dih kei le jangkeiyin bol’uvin.

Tilkhouna

2 Tao nan phangdet jingun, hichea chun kiging jinguvin thangvah to thou’uvin. 3 Pathenin keiho dinga thu seiphongna ding kot ahondoh a, songkul’a eikihenlo na Christa thuguh seiphong theina dingin keiho din jong neitaokop jinguvin. 4 Chutile kasei ding dol chu kichentah a kasei thei ding ahi. 5 Polam miho koma chihna mangchan chon’un, phat chu kitup keiyin mang chauvin. 6 Nathuseiyu chu phat jousen onemheo le kitoh chet, thanop um jing hen, chule thu nadong jouseu kitoh chet’a donbut din kigosadem hiuvin.

Achaina salam phabep

7 Pakai dinga tahsan um lhacha le soh, sopi deitah Tychicus hin kachung chang thu nahetnom chan naseipeh nauvinte. 8 Ama hin kaumchan thuu nahetsah-uva nalung thimu atilkou ding deinaa nahenguva ama kahinsol ahi. 9 Amato lhonin tahsan umle dei umtah sopi Onesimus, naloipau hin hikoma thilsoh nahetnom chan nahil nauvinte. 10 Kasoh chanpi Aristarchus-in nasalam’ui, Barnabas inkopa Markin jong, ama thudol hi thupeh namusau ahitan, nahenguva ahung jeng khat le ana lamtouvin. 11 Justus Jesun jong nasalam’uve; chepten holah akona Pathen lenggam thudol’a kanatoh khompi hicheng hi bou ahiuvin, amaho hi kalungmonpi lheh jengin ahi. 12 Nang ho lah a mi khat Epaphras Jesus Christa soh, ama jong chun nasalam’ui; ama hi Pathen lungdei pumpia bulhingset’a nanun theina diuva nang ho dinga gunchu tah a tao jinga, nadindetna diuva thum jing ahi. 13 Ijeh-inem itile amahin nang ho ding le Laodicea a um ho chule Hierapolis a um ho dinga hatah a athohgima na atoh hi keima mongin kahettohsah ahiye. 14 Ngailuttah louthem Luke le Demas-in jong nasalam’ui. 15 Laodicea um sopite Nympha chule a insunga kikhom Houbung chu salam’uvin. 16 Hiche lekha hi nahenguva akisimjou teng Laodicea Houbung henga jong akisimdohna din ngaitouvin, chutobangman Laodicea kona lekha thot jong nang hon nasim’uvin. 17 Chule Archipus jah a, “Pakai vanga nangman lhacha panmun namu chu namolso theina dingin chingtheiyin,” tin hil’uvin. 18 Hiche salam thu hi keima Paul khut’a hungkon mong ahi. Kabulput hi geldoh jinguvin. Lungset nan umpi jingun.

1 Thessalonica 1

Salam

1 Paul le Silvanus chule Timothyn Pa Pathen le Jesu Christa to hingkhom Thessalonica khoa Houbung mite chunga lungset le chamna hung lhung hen.

Thessalonica mite tahsan le hinkho

2 Keihon phat jousen nang ho din Pathen kathangvah jingun, katao nauva tang louhel’in nang ho kamin phah jinguve. 3 Itobang tah a natahsan’u natoh a napoh doh theiyuva, ngailut jal’a iti natoh hat’uva, chule i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal’a nakinep nauvin itobanga nathoh hatsah-u chu i-Pau Pathen angsunga kageldoh jinguve. 4 Pathen ngailut sopi deitah le alhentum nahiu kaheuve. 5 Ijeh-inem itile nahenguva Kipana Thupha kahung lhut’a chu thuhomkeova ahipon, thahat le Lhagao Theng vanga ahin, kaseiyu chu chamkimsoh ahi; nang hojal’a hiche hin keiho itobang kahiu ahetsah chu nang hon naheuve. 6 Ajeh chu thu kisei chun gim genthei tamtah nahin pohlut peh vangun Lhagao Theng jal’in kipah tah-in nasangun, keiho le Pakai umchan banga umtei ding nago ham’uve. 7 Hijeh chun Macedonia le Achaia gam’a tahsan mite vetkah ding doltah-in naumdoh tauvin ahi. 8 Ijeh-inem itile nang hoa konin Macedonia le Achia gamsunga Pakai thu akiphonjal keovin akingapon, Pathen lam’a natahsan detjeu chu gamtin’a akithangsoh tan, hijeh chun keiho sei sei angaipoi. 9 Nang ho kahung vil’uva, nang hon neisan jeu, doilim semthu nahou nauva kona itobang Pathen lama nakiheiyuva, Pathen hing jing dihtah hou dia hungkihei nahiu mi tamtah-in jong aseiyuve. 10 Chule ahung lhung tei ding lunghannaa kona eihuhdoh-uva Jesu thinaa kona kaithouva umpa, Achapa van’a kona hung dingpa na-nga jeu chu aseiyu ahi.

1 Thessalonica 2

Thessalonica khoa Paul natoh

1 Sopite, nangho kahung vil’u chu mohjenseh ahilou nahenauve. 2 Nahetsau bang chun Philipi khoa hesoh genthei tah le jachat umleuva eikibol vangun ka-Pathen’uva kitilkhouna neiyin, Pathen a hungkon Kipana Thupha chu adouvah atam lheh jeng vangin nahenguva seidin kapangui. 3 Ijeh-inem itile ka-ngeh nau hi pannabei ahipon, athenglou jong ahipon, lheplhah na jong ahipoi. 4 Chuti malah Pathenin Kipana Thupha thua nganse lom eisah-uva eiphasah jeh-uva kaseiyu ahin, mihem lung lhaisah ding golouva, kalungthimu patep tohsa Pathen joh kalung lhaigot’u ahibouve. 5 Imatih chan’a pachat lhem thu mang lou kahiuvin, nahetsa bangun papset khu nan jong ima kamangji pouve. Pathen ahetoh a pang ahi. 6 Nang hoa hihen midanga kon hijongle mihema kona pachat kahol pouve. 7 Christa solchah kahi jeh-un pohgih hahsa pohsah jeng theiyu jong leng; ahinla minu them tah-in achate akhoukhah them bangin nang ho din nun nem tah kahiuve. 8 Ka-ngailut nau agil behseh jeh-in Pathen Kipana Thupha kachanpi nom keova ahitanpon, kahinkho geiyuva kahop nomi ahitai; ajeh chu nang ho ka ngai lu lheh jenguve. 9 Hijeh chun sopite, itobang tah a nang ho koima cha dinga pohgih kahilouna diuva chol le nang, a sun le jan’a na katoh-uva, nang ho Pathen Kipana Thupha seipeh ding kagot’u chu geldoh jingun. 10 Atahsan mi nang ho henga kachon nau athenje adihje chule nolnabei ahije ahetoh-a nang ho le Pathen nahiuve. 11 Pan achate abolna banga nang ho khat cheh kabol’u chu nang hon naheuve. 12 Katilkhouvun, kalhamon’un, aloupina le alenggam chan khompi dinga nakoupau Pathen lungdei dol’a nahin theina diuvin khat cheh-in kahettosah-uve. 13 Chujongle atahbeh monga Pathen thu ahijeh chun kathuseiyu chu mihem thu banga gel louva Pathen thua najah jeh-uvin Pathen kathangvah jing jengui; hiche thu chun atahsan nang ho lah a na atong jinge. 14 Ijeh-inem itile sopite, Jesu Christa to hingkhom Judea gama Pathen Houbung mite umchan jom nahitauve, ajeh chu ama hon Juda mite khut’a athoh banguva nanghon jong nagam miteuva kona nathoh gim’u ahitai. 15 Judamiten Pakai Jesu le Themgao ho athat’un, keiho einodoh jengun, achunguva Pathen alung lhai nai saipon, chu le mitin doumah chang ahiuve. 16 Chidang namdangte huhhinga aum theina diuvva thu kaseipeh diu geiyin eisutang go’uve; hichu achonset nau pilhin molsona ahitai. Hijeh chun akhon nan Pathen lung hanna achunguva achutan ahi.

Paul’in Houbung avil nomkit

17 Sopite, chomkhat ikikhen kangu hi, lungthim mit’a milmo nahivangun, ka-ngai lut’un namaiyu mukal ka-ngah lel lheh-uve. 18 Hijeh chun nahenguva hung din kakigouvin, ahideh chun keima Paul’in jong hung ding kagot loi ahitan, Satanin eisumo jiuve. 19 I-Pakaiyu Jesu ahung kit teng le a-angsunga keiho kinepna, kipana, kichoi-atna lallukhuh ding nang ho nahilouvuham? 20 Ijeh-inem itile nang ho hi keiho loupina le kipana nahiuve.

1 Thessalonica 3

1 Hichejeh chun kathoh jou loutah phat’un Athen khoa kachunga eidalhah diu pha kasauvin, 2 Christa Kipana Thupha jal’a Pathen kinbolnaa tohkhompi isopiu Timothy chu nang ho dinkhompi ding le natahsan thudol’uva natil khou diuvin kahinsol’uve, 3 chutile hiche thoh gim gentheinaa hin koiman nasuh lung ling lao lou diu ahi. Hiche hesoh genthei hi ithoh tei diu ahi nahenauve. 4 Ijeh-inem itile nakom’uva ka-um laiyuva hiche hesoh genthei kathoh diu hi kaseipeh masah dem nahitauvin, hitia chu hung lhung ahi naheuve. 5 Hijeh a chu lhepna chun lhem lha taleu chun katohna jouseu moh ahikhah ding hi kathoh jou lou phat’a natahsan’u hechen dinga nahenguva Timothy kahinsol jeng ahi. 6 Tun vang nakom’uva kona kahenguva Timothy ahung lhungin, natahsan’u le na-ngailut nau kipana thupha, phatjousea phatah-a neigeldoh jinguva keihon kamu nombang uva neimu nom’u thu ahin lhuttai. 7 Hichejeh chun sopite, hesoh genthei nan eichup jeng vangun natasan’u chun kakitilkhou lheh jengui. 8 Ajeh chu nang ho Pakai dia nadindet jeh-un tun keiho din jong hinlo aumtai. 9 Nang ho jeh le nachung chang thu’va i-Pathennu angsung kipana le thanopna hijatpi kaneiyu hitoh kitoh chet’in Pathen chu iti kathangvah tadiuvem? 10 Namaiyu kamu’uva natahsan’u lhahsam kabulhit theina diuvin sunle janin giltah-in katao jing jenguve. 11 I-Pau Pathen le i-Pakaiyu Jesun nahenguva kalampiu hinlhungjang hen. 12 Nang ho khat le khat ki-ngailutna le mitin na-ngailut nau chu Pakaiyin khantousah jing hen, nang ho ka-ngailut nau to bahsah hen. 13 Hiti chun nalungthimu phudet hen lang, i-Pakaiyu Jesu amithengte jouse to lhon’a ahung kit tengle i-Pau Pathen angsunga nolnabeiyin nakoiyuhen.

1 Thessalonica 4

Pathen lungdei hinkho

1 Sopite, tukalse vang Pathen lungdeilama iti chon ding dol keihoa kona nalahsau banga nachon theijuva, hitia chu nabol be chehna diuva Pakai Jesu jal’a kathumu’va ka-ngeh nahiuve. 2 Ijeh-inem itile Pakai Jesu vanga itobang thupeh kapeh-u nang hon nahenauve. 3 Pathenin nanghoa kona adei chu then ahin, hijeh a chu jonthanhoiya kona nakitim diu ahi. 4 Nang ho amitakip chun atibah cheh chu itobanga kitim thema, theng le jabol’a umsah ding nahet diu dol ahi. 5 Pathen helou chidang namdangte banga huh napat lou diu ahi. 6 hiche thudol’a hin koimachan asopi dohan bolda hen, masanga kaseipeh-uva chule kahttosahsau bang chun hitobanga chonho chunga hi Pakaiyin phu alah tei ding ahi. 7 Ijeh-inem itile Pathenin athenglou dia eikouvu ahipon, atheng dia eikoujoh-u ahibouve. 8 Hijeh a chu hiche jop lou chun mihem ajop lou ahipon, a-Lhagao Theng napepau Pathenjoh ajop lou ahibouve. 9 Kisopi, ngailut thudol’a hin nahenguva hinsut khoh angaipoi, ajeh chu khat le khat ki-ngailutje Pathena kona kihilsate nahitauve. 10 Chujongle Macedonia gam pumpia sopite abonchauva hitia chu nabolsau jong ahitai. Nahabol be chehna diuva ka-ngeh-u ahi, sopite. 11 Kangkhen cha umje kihil’un, nakin cheh kibol’in, kahilsau bangin nakhut cheh-in na ki tohgim’uvin. 12 Chuti bol leu chun polam mite sei phat nachan’uva, lhahsamna nanei lou diu ahi.

Pakai Jesu hungkit ding

13 Sopite, kinepna bei miho banga naum louna diuvin a-ihmumilte thudol helouva naum diu kanompouve. 14 Ijeh-inem itile Jesu athia athodoh kit itahsan jeh-un, Jesu tahsan’a ihmumilte chu Pathen in Amato ahinpui kit ding jong itahsan’ui. 15 Hiche hi Pakai thusah akona kaseipeh nahiuve, ipijeh-inem itile Pakai hungkit ni geiya eiho ahinga kidalha chengse hi itinama jong le a-ihmumilte sanga masajo lou ding ihiuve. 16 Ijeh-inem itile Pakai ama tah ogin to, Vantil pipu ogin to chule Pathen sumkon gin to kithoa van’a kona hung kumlha ding, chu tengle Christa jal’a thisa chengse thoudoh masa diu ahi. 17 Chujoutah le eiho ahing nalai amoh chengse hi amaho chutoh vanlaijol’a Pakai lamto dinga meilom’a ikitoltou dingu ahi; hitia chu imatih chan’a Pakai to iumkhom jing diu ahitai. 18 Hiti ahijeh chun hiti thu ho hin nang ho khat le khat kitilkhou jingun,

1 Thessalonica 5

Pakai hungkit ding kigingun

1 Sopite, aphat le achang thudol hi nahenguva hinsut angaipoi, 2 ajeh chu janlaiya gucha ahung banga Pakai nikho chu ahung lhun ding nang hon kichentah a nahetsau ahi. 3 Mihon, ‘Chamle lungmon aum’e,” atilai tah-u le numei naoso nat banga photlot louva manthahna chu achunguva hung chuphung jeng ding, koimacha hoidoh louhel diu ahi. 4 Sopite, nang ho vang muthima um nahitapouvin hiche nikho chun gucha banga nahinlap den lou diu ahi. 5 Ajeh chu nang ho nabonchauva khovah le sunlai chate nahiuve. Eiho hi janlai muthim lah a um ihipouve; 6 hijeh chun midang ho banga ihmu louvin, lung limgeh chan kihong jingu hite. 7 Ijeh-inem itile a-ihmua jong janin bou a-ihmun jukham ho jong janin bou akham’ui, 8 eiho vang sunlaiya limgeh ihiuvin, tahsan le ngailut ompho bangin kivon’u hitin, huhhing dia kinepna chu thih lukhuh bangin kikhuh-u hite. 9 Ajeh chu eiho hi Pathenin lungsat khum dinga ei lhenu ahipon, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal’a huhhing chang ding joh a eikouvu ahibouve. 10 Eiho hah jingu hen ihmu jongleu hen Amato ihinkhom jingna diuva Ama eiho khel’a thia ahitai. 11 Nang hon nabol ngai banguvin khat le khat hiti hin kitilkhou to’uvin kihuto’uvin.

Tilkhou le salam chaina phabep

12 Sopite, ka-ngeh nahiuve, Pakai jal’a nalh-uva mi phabep kikoiya, nalamkai diu le nahilchah diuva natong ho chu ja lomtah-in ja’uvin. 13 Anatoh nau jal chun ngailut nan hajan jabol’uvin. Nasunguva kichamdel’un. 14 Sopite, thase ho phohsal’un, lung lhachom tilkhouvun, alhasam kithopiuvin, mi jouse dia thoh hat dinga ka-ngeh-u ahi. 15 Chingtheiyun, koiman setna chu setna thuh louvin, chusangin phat jousen khat le khat din jong chule mi jouse din jong thilpha bol ding go jinguvin. 16 Ki pah jingun, 17 tang louvin taovin, 18 imalam jousea thangvah jingun; ijeh-inem itile hiche hi Jesu Christa jal’a nang ho dia Pathen lungdei lam ahi. 19 Lhagao chu pheltan dauvin, 20 gao thusei jong nahsah modauvin; 21 amavang ima jouse patep soh keiyun apha chu kolchah jingun; 22 thilse tapou peldoh soh keiyuvin. 23 Chamna bulpi Pathenin nang ho nasuthengsoh keiyu hen; i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hungkit teng nolnabei nahina diuvin nalhagao, nahinkhou, natahsau bitkeiyin koi hen. 24 Nakoupau tahsan umtah ahin, nabolpeh tei diu ahi. 25 Sopite, keiho din jong neitaopeh-uvin. 26 Kibengchop thengin sopite jouse salam’un. 27 Hiche lekha hi sopite jouse henga nasimna diuva Pakai thahat’a kathugah nahiuve. 28 I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungset nan umpiuvin.

2 Thessalonica 1

Salam
