1 Paul le Silvanus chule Timothyn i-pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa jal’in Thessalonica khoa Houbung henga: 2 Pa Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa konin chamna le lungsetna nachunguva um hen.

Christa hungkit teng thutanna

3 Sopite, natahsanu seithei louhel’a akhantou jeh le nabonchauva khat le khat ki-ngailutna apunjal jeh-in keihon tang louhel’a nang ho dia Pathen thangvah vah jeng ding hi akitoh lheh-e. 4 Nang hon thohgim le bolsetna hichengpi douva hi natahsan jom jeh-un Pathen Hou bung dang ho henga nang ho kaki thang-at pi lheh jengui. 5 Hicheng nathoh jeh-uva hi nathoh lo na pen’u Pathen lenggam dinga lah thei lom nahi diu, hichun Pathen thutan dihje photchetna aphondoh ding ahi. 6 Pathen dihtah chun nabol gen theiteu chu kitoh chet’a thohgimna apeh ding ahi; 7 hiche hi van’a kona Pakai Jesu A-Vantil thanei tah te to ahung kiphondoh teng Pathenin nang ho hi nathoh gimna jouseuva kona keiho puma eilhadoh diu, 8 meikou deuje ju apat’a Pathen heloute le i-Pakaiyu Jesu Kipana Thupha jop lou jouse chunga phu alah ding ahi. 9 Amaho talen mat ding chu tonsot’a thoh ding man thahna, Pakai angsung le aloupina thanei tah akona tolmang hel ding ahiuve. 10 Hiche hi amithengtea kona loupina le atahsan jousea kona jabolna kisan dinga Pakai ahung nikho le chuti ding ahin, keiho hettohsah tahsan nahijeh-un atahsan lah a nang ho jong napangui. 11 Hichea hin i-Pathen’uvin akouna to kitoh a nasan’uva, thilpha ding nadei jouseu le tahsan vanga natoh chu athahat’a amolso soh keina din tang louhel’in nang ho kataopeh jingui. 12 Hitobanga chu i-Pathenu le Pakai Jesu Christa lungsetna dungjuiya nang ho jal’a i-Pakaiyu Jesu min choi-at’a auma, nang ho Amasunga naum diu deina ahi.

2 Thessalonica 2

Danbei mihem

1 Sopite, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hungkit ding thudol le amato ikikhop khom diu thudol’a hi kangeh-u nahiuve. 2 Lhang kisam khat tou hihen, Lhagaova kon hihen, thu kithanga kon hihen, keiho lekha thot’a kondol’a kisei hijongle, Pakai nikho chu hung lhungsa dol’in gel’un lang lung ngaito kisuh noh phahsah le lung linglaovin um hih hel’uvin. 3 Imacha lamin jong koima kilhep lhahsah dauvin; ajeh chu Pathen doumah bolna hung lhung masa ding, mangthah dia peng dan bei agiloupa hung kiphongdoh ding ahina laiye; 4 amahin dou apat’a, Pathen min pu jouse le houdia kibol thil jouse chunga kichoi sanga, hitia chu acham cham’a Pahen houin geiya jong touphaa aneiya, hung kipathensah ding ahi. 5 Hiti jouse hi kaumpi laiyuva kaseipehsau chu nageldoh louvu ham? 6 Akitep phat tah a ahung kiphon dohna dinga tua ipin atuh kih ahi naheuve. 7 Ijeh-inem itile Danbei chun guh thimin na atong jinge; alailunga kona akilah mang kaha dinga bou atuhkih a chu ahen-oh ahibouve. 8 Danbeipa ahung chu kiphon doh tah le Pakai Jesu ahungkitna dinga hung kilah paiya akamsunga kikhong doh huiya athaa, asuh mang ding ahi. 9 Danbeipa hung chu Satan thahatna to hung kilhon ding, thaneina tin cheng le melchihna ho chule jouva bolmo kidang tampi bol theina to hung kilhon diu ahi. 10 Huhhing a aum na diuva adih ngailutna akisan loujeh-uva manthahna lut dia umsa ho chu melse tah a alhep chatvai diu ahi. 11 Hijeh a chu Pathenin achunguva joulhepna alhunsah ahin, hichea kon hin amahon thujou atahsan’un, 12 thutah tahsan louva thujouva nomsa chengse chu athuu kitan cheh ding ahi.

Huhhinga umdia lhendoh

13 Pakai dia sah tah sopite, ima-tih chan’a nang ho dinga Pathen thangvah hi kabol diu lomtah kin ahi; ijeh-inem itile thutah tahsan jeha Lhagao Theng jal’a Pathenin nang ho hi huhhing chang masa loi dia nalhendoh-u ahitai. 14 I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa loupina nachan theina diuva Aman nang ho hi, keihon Kipana Thupha kaseipeh-uva kona nakouvu ahi. 15 Hijeh chun sopite, kathuseiyuva kon hihen lang lekha thot’a kisun hijongle, ka hilsau chengsea chun dingdet jingun. 16 I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Amatah le i-Pau Pathen, tonsot lungmonna le lungsettah a ngailut kinepna eipepau chun 17 imalam jousea natoh pha le thupha seinaa nalungthimu tilkou hen lang phutdet jing hen.

2 Thessalonica 3

Keiho neitaopeh-un

1 Sopite, tukalse vang nang ho lah a banga Pakai thu hi gangtah a seiphonga choi-at’a aum na din keiho dingin neitaokop jingun. 2 chujongle mihon atahsansoh loulai jeh-un mihem gilou le engse hoa kona kahoidoh theina diuvin jong neitaokop jinguvin. 3 Pakai chu tahsan umtah ahin, aman naphut det’un tin agiloupa konin nachingtup jing nauvinte. 4 Pakai jal’a nang ho kaginchat jeh-uva natoh ngai bang natoh jingna diuva thu kapeh na hiuve. 5 Nalungthimu chu Pathen ngailutna le Christa thohhatna lama Pakaiyin kaihoi hen.

Natohna dia bat nei

6 Sopite, sopi koi hile akahleh akalouva chon, keiho hilchahna to kitoh a chon lou mi jouse chu nakiloikhompi louna diuva Pakai Jesu Christa min pan’a thu kapeh nahiuve. 7 Nakom’uva tong louva ka-umlouvu, keiho umchan itobanga najop’u nang hon na heuve. 8 Koima an manbeiyin kanepouvin, nang ho koimacha pohgih kahi khah louna diuvin gim genthei hahsa thoh-in sun le janin na katongu’ve. 9 Thuneina kaneilou jeh-u ahipoi, keiho umchan najom theina diuva nang ho vetsahna monga kabol’u ahibouve. 10 Ijeh-inem itile i-umkhom pet’uva koi hile natong nom lou chu anjong nehsah lou dia nang ho thu kapehsau ahitai. 11 Ahinla nalahuva kon khat akaleh akalouva chon, natong louva mi sinmo le bep thu kajauve. 12 Hitobang miho hin thip beh cha na akitoh-uva an akineh diuva Pakai Jesu Christa min pan’a thu kapeh-uva katilkhouvu ahi. 13 Sopite, nang ho vang thilpha bol nan chimtih neilou jen’un. 14 Hiche lekha thot’a keiho thu ngailou chu nang hon melchih-un lang, ajachatna din kivoppi dauvin. 15 Hijongle melma banga bol louvin sopi bangin hilchahjo’uvin.

Taokhum kha na

16 Chamna bulpi Pakaiyin imalam jouse le ijakaiya chamna napeu hen. Pakaiyin nabonchauvin umpiu hen. 17 Hiche salam hi keima Paul khut’a hungkon, lekha thot jousea melchihna a hitia kasutji ahi. 18 I-Pakai Jesu Christa lungset nan nabonchauvin umpiuvin.

1 Timothy 1

Salam

1 I-kinep nau Jesu Christa le Eihuhhinguva Pathen thusah a Jesu Christa Solchah Paul’in 2 tahsan jal’a cha dihtah Timothy henga: i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa le Pa Pathen’a konin lungset le hepi chule chamna hunglhung hen.

Thuhil lhemho doudalna, hilchahna

3 Mi abang bangin thuhil dih lou ahil louna diuva phoh tang dia Macedonia lam kajot kon’a ka-ngeh bangin Ephesus umdenin, 4 amahon semthu thusim ho pou le akhonna bei khanggui thusim aseiho’u chun miho lung lutsah hih-in, hiche ho hin tahsan vanga ki mu Pathen gou-thilho sangin kinel baotam na jeng bou asosah-e. 5 Ahinla hiche thupeh kipeh lo na lungthim theng tah le ngailut lunggel chule tahsan kicheh tah a hung kon ngailutna khantousah ding thu ahibouve. 6 Mi kimkhat hichenga kon hin akihei mangun avah koi leuvin mohkihoulim nan akimang gamtauve. 7 Akison nau jong kicheh lou, thusei jong kichen lou, hejong hekhen louvin Danthu hil’in apan nom’ui. 8 Danthu hi adoltah a mangpa dia thilpha ahi i-heuve. 9 Ijeh-inem itile hitin akimui, Danthu hi midih pa ding ahipon, Dan sukeh ho le hutuh lel ho, Pathen heloute le chonse ho, atheng lou ho le aboh ho, pa that ho le nu that ho, mihem that ho, 10 mito jonpan ho, ki-ngai-jong ho, mihem gumang ho, joubol ho, jouva kihahsel ho chule ipi hijongle adang adih lama kihilna to kikal jouse bol ho ding ahibouve. 11 Kihilna dih chu keima eikivopsah kipa umtah Pathen loupina Kipana Thupha dungjuija kihilna chu ahi.

Paul’in Pathen hepi athangvah

12 Keima tahsan theiya eigel’a lhacha eipansah, thahat eipea i-Pakai Jesu chunga kakipah lhehjenge. 13 Masang chun ataitom le abolse chule pumhat jengin kana pangin, ahinla hiti ho chu atahsan lou kahijeh a hetoh louva kabol ahijeh-in Patehnin eihepin, 14 Jesu Christa jal’in i-Pakaiyu milungset chu tahsan le ngailut pumin keidin alet lha jengin ahi. 15 Chonsete huhhing dinga Jesu Christa vannoiya ahung hi tahsan dinga lhingset thu ahi; choset ho lah a keima akhoh pen kahin, 16 Ama hintahsan’a tonsot hinna nei ding ho vetkah a pang dia Jesu Christan thoh hatna chengse chu amasapen’a kei chunga photchetna abol nom jeh a hita chu eihepi lheh jeng ahi. 17 Tonsot Lengpa, thi-tih neilou, mutheilo Pathen khatseh chu jabolna le loupina tonsot tonsto’in chang jing hen: Amen. 18 Sepai phatah banga hichenga chu gal nasat theina ding, masanga nachung chang thua kisei masa ho dungjuiya napan theina dia hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahi chapa Timothy. 19 Tahsan le hetkhenna pha nei jingin, mi bangin hiche hi anahsah loujeh-un tahsan asuhmang lo tauve. 20 Ama ho lah a hin Hymnenaeus le Alexander jong apangin, ama ni hi Pathen ataitom lhon louna dia hilchah ding in Satan koma kapeh doh tai.

1 Timothy 2

Taona thudo’a hilchahna

1 Amasapen’a ka-ngeh nahiuve, thumna le taona, midang taopehna chule thangvahna ho mijouse dinga, 2 leng ho le thunei vaihomte din neiyun, chuti le Pathen ging le gun che na puma chamdel le lung mongtah a hinkho iman thei diu ahi. 3 Hichu eihuhinguva Pathen mitmua santhei thilpha ahi. 4 Pathen chun mihem josue huhhinga aum’a thutah het theiya ahung um diu hi adeiye. 5 Pathen khatseh ahin, Pathen le mihemte kah a palai jong khat bou ahi- Mihem Jesu Christa chu, 6 Ama chamtah-in mi jouse lhatdoh nan a hung kipen, hettohsahna chu aphat cha um doh ahi. 7 Hiche dinga hi aseiphong dingle solchah dia eikipansah ahi tah kasei ahin, jou kaseipoi, thutah le tahsan thua chiding namdangte hil’a pang kahi. 8 Hichejeh chun muntin’a pasal hon lung hang lou hel le kinel baotam louhel’a khut theng dom’a atao diu kadeiye. 9 Hitobangma chun numeiho jong nihchen ponsil dol’in gingkhen le chinghtei tah-in amaho tah kivon’u hen; sampheh hoi le sana ham, twikohchang ham, ponsil hoi ham, thil mantam pen ham a kijem louvin 10 Pathen ginje phong doh thei numei umdol’in thilpha bol’in kijemjou’u hen. 11 Numei chu imalam jousea thua nungkhen chan thip beh chan kihiljou’u hen. 12 Mihil dingle pasal chuang tha nei din numei kangensepoi, chusangin umthim ngit nget jou’u hen. 13 Ijeh-inem itile Adam kisem masa chujouva Evi ahi. 14 Adam chu lhep lhah a um ahipon, numei nu joh lhep lhah a um’a, themmochangkha ahibouve. 15 Ahinla lung lim-geh leh kisuthenga, tahsan le ngailut neiya aum jom jing le numei chu acha neinaa jong kihinso jing ding ahi.

1 Timothy 3

Houbung lamkai gunchena

1 ‘Koi hile Houbung lakai nom chun natohpha adeichat ahi,’ ti hi tahsan theidol thu ahi. 2 Ahinla Houbung lamkai ding chu nolnabei, numeikhatseh jia nei, kitimthei, lung limtah, kitup tah, jin dotthem, mihil them, 3 ju nelou, mideng lou, nun nema doubol lou, sum ngailu lou, 4 a-insung phatea kipoh tupthei, ja umtah a achate athua nunsah thei mi hiding ahi. 5 Ama insung bon poh tupje helouvan Pathen Houbung iti apoh tup thei ding ham? 6 Ama chu tahsan thah hilou ding ahi, ajo le kiletsah jeh a Diabol themmo chan naa ama jong chuh lo ding ahi. 7 Seiset achan a Diabol thanga a-o khah lou na dinga polam mite sephat jong hi ding ahi.

Houbung lhachaho thepna phabep

8 Houbung lhacha ding jong migin ja um ma, kamtam lou, ju lop lou, alam louva sum veikan lou, 9 lung ngaito thengsel’a tahsan thua thilguh hetna nei mi hi diu ahi. 10 Amaho kipatep masau hen, nolnabei ahiule lhachaa pang diu ahi. 11 Ajiteu jong hitobanga chu migin ja um, jouva mi hehse lou, kitimthei, ijakaiya tahsan um mi hi diu ahi. 12 Lhacha ho chu numei khatseh jia nei hi cheh-u hen, achateu le a-insunga kitup’a po-them cheh hiu hen. 13 Ijeh-inem itile phatah a lhacha kinbol mihon din mun pha akisemdoh-un, Christa Jesu sunga um tahsan thudol’a hangtah-in apang ngam’ui.

I-houvu thuguh

14 Hunga nangma mu loi ding kinem’a hiche lekha hi kasut ahi. 15 Ijemtia kahung gei khat le thutah bul le khompi- Pathen insunga chu iti chon ding nahetna dia kahinsut ahi. 16 Pathen hou thuguh kiphongdoh aletdol chu hiche ahi: “Ama tahsaphen akiphongdoh-in, Lhagaovin them achangtan; Vantilte mit mun aum doh-in, Chitin namtin lah a seiphongin aumin, Vannoija min atahsan tan, Loupin lah touvin aum tai.”

1 Timothy 4

Pathen tahsan dailhah ding kisei masah

1 Ni nu nung lam le mi abang bang tahsan naa dailhauva jousei lhagao ho le thilha ho thuhil’a ahung lung lut diu thu, lhagaovin kichentah-in aseiye. 2 Hitobang phat lhem na ho hi alunggel’u kisou tahsa mijou hoa hung kon ahi. 3 Ama ho hin jinei ding akham’un, atahsan hon thutah hetna jeh a thangvah puma akisan diuva Pathenin asemsa neh thei dolchu neh ding ajadauve. 4 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen thilsem chengse aphasoh keiye, thangvah pum’a ikisan le imacha pai ding aumpoi. 5 Ajeh chu Pathen thu le taonaa kisuthengsoh ahitai.

Jesu Christa lhacha pha

6 Nangin nahinjuipeh thuhil pha le naki khou khahna tahsan thu ho chu sopite pe le chun Jesu Christa lhacha phatah nahi ding ahi. 7 Amavang thilboh, numei tehse ho loulimna ho chu pai mangin; natahsa tah-in hou ngaisahna lam’a kichuh themjon. 8 Ijeh-inem itile tahsa lama kichuna jong them khat thil phachom ahinan, Pathen houlam’a kichuhna hi tu hinkho ding hinhen, kho nung hinkho dinga hijongle aphat chom na thutep umsa ahi. 9 Hiche thu hi tahsan um, imalam jousea san dinga kilom tah ahi. 10 Hing jing Pathen, mitin huhhingpu, ahideh a atahsante huhhingpa chunga ikinep jeh-un itong gim’un ikiseh lheh jengui. 11 Thu hicheng hi pen lang, hil’in. 12 nachapan jeh chun koiman noise bol da hen, hisang chun thulam, chonchan lam, ngailutna le tahsa lam chule themna lam in atahsante vetsui theiyin umjon. 13 Kahung kahsen Pathen lekhabu simna lam le mi tilkhou lam, chule mihil lamin anaponthon. 14 Themgao hon thu aseiyuva upa hon nachunga thenso khut angap’uva nakipe Lhagao thilpeh nachan khahchu nahsah mon boldan. 15 Mijouse anga nakhantou akiphondoh theina din hichengse hi bol’in hiche hoa hin lung lut’in. 16 Nachung chang ahin, nathuhil ahin, kiging phan, hichenga chun pansan, ajeh chu hiti hinbol le chun nangma tah le nathuja ho nahuhdoh ding ahije.

1 Timothy 5

Midang bolpeh ding kinho

1 Upa chu phohsal hih-in, napa tobangin tilkhou thon; khangdong ho chu sopi bol’in, 2 nupi ho nubol’in, nu-ngah ho nanaote bangin thengsel’in i-lam jousea kaihoiyin. 3 Meithai tahbeh ho chu meithai jabol dol’in jabol’in. 4 Meithai chun tu le cha anei le amaho hin amasan a-insunguva Pathen hou ngaisahna kichuh-u hen, ahinvah dohho lungset thuh kihil masau hen; ijeh-inem itile hiche hi Pathen maiya santheidol tah ahi. 5 Meithai kicheh tah achanga um vang chu Pathena kinem’a sun le jan’a thumna le tao naa kipe jing jeng ahi. 6 Tahsa nop sahnaa kimang nu vang chu ahing laiya thisa ahi. 7 Amaho chu seiset achan louna diuvin thupeh hicheng hi pen. 8 Hichea hin koi hile amite ding ngaito lou, ahideh a a-insung mite ding ngaito lou chun tahsan ataitom ahitan, atahsan loupa sanga khohjo ahitai. 9 Kum somgup noiya mi hilou chu meithaiya sut thei ahi, pasal khatseh jia nei mi, 10 thilpha bolnaa seiphat chang, khou khahje themsa, jindot them, mithengte keng silpehsa, genthei hesoh kithopia imalam jouse a thilpha bolna kipum peh mi hi ding ahi. 11 Khangdong meithai ho vang pansah dan, ijeh-inem itile jinei ding adeichat tengu le Christa deimo lamtah-in aum doh jiuvin, 12 atahsan masah apailhah jeh-un themmo achanlo jiuve. 13 Chuche tilouvin jong thaset apan’un muntin’a akholai lengun, thaset keoseh hilouvin amuh them kamjauvun, sei ding lomlou thupou aseiyui. 14 Hijehchun khangdong nalai ho chun ji aneiyuva cha ahindiu, insung akiphouva melma chu thilse bolna phat adei banga apeh louhel diu kadeijoi. 15 Mikonkhat jong Satan nung juiyin akihei mang tavue. 16 Atahsan numei khattouvin meithai ho anei khah le hiche ho chu kithopi hen; chutile meithai tahbeh ho chu Houbungin akithopi thei ding ahi. 17 Upa lamkai pha, thu seiphong le thuhil lama hapan’a pang ho chu tohman ajat ni chan amu diu lom tah ahi. 18 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lekhabun, “Bongchal chang chilpet amuh som hih-in,” atin, chule “Natong’an tohman asan lomtah ahi,” ati. 19 Ahetoh mi ni le thum alhin loule upa khat kihehna chu la hih-in. 20 Midangin kichatnaa anei theina din achonse ho chu japi masanga solsal’in. 21 Pathen le Jesu Christa chule lhentum Vantilte angsunga giltah a kahil chah nahi, thupeh hicheng hi mangin lang phochen louvin thu tandan, chule lang neiyin jong ima bol hih-in. 22 Kintheng tong ding ahi tin koima chung a thenso-khut ngamloi hihin, midang ho chonsetnaa jong pandan, thenna din nangle nang kiging jingin. 23 Nagilpi nat jeh le nadammo veiset jing jeh chun twisih keo jeng don louvin lengpitwi them khat mangin. 24 Mihem phabeppi hi achonset nau kilang tah ahin, hichun thutan na mun alhut loi jengin, phabepse chonsetna vang, khonung teng akiphongjibouve. 25 Hitobang hin natoh pha jong kilang tah ahin, kilangdoh lou aum jongle kisel thei ahideh poi.

1 Timothy 6

1 Pathen min le kihilna hi taitoma aum louna din namkoljon po nalai soh chengsen leiset’a a pakai teu chu gin le jabol lomtah a anei diu ahi. 2 Atahsansa pakaiya neikha hon jong sopi ahi tah man’a nahsah moa abol lou diu ahi; chusangin hajen cheh jou’u hen, ijeh-inem itile atohgau akisan nau miho chu tahsan nei le ngailutna neimi ahitauve.

Kihilna lhem le hao dih

Hicheng hi hil’in lang tikkhouvin. 3 Mi khattouvin thuhil chom dang ahil’a, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa thudih chengse le hou ngaisahna thuhil’a lung lut lou aum le, 4 ama kichoisang bou, imacha la helou, kinel kalna ding thu hol le ding hivei aveiyin, hichea chun kithangset, kitaitom, phaloutah a, kiginmo asohjin, 5 kinah nah jeng leh manthahna hi thutah hepha talou mihem ho lunggel’a hung kon ahin, Pathen hou thu jeng jong sumkol veina nei ding ago’uve. 6 Ahinla lung lhaisel’a Pathen houlam’a gunchu hi, phatchomna lentah ahi. 7 Ijeh-inem itile leiset chunga imacha i-hin polut pouvin, imacha i-pohdohthei lou diu ahi. 8 Hijeh a chu neh le chah nihchen ponsil ineiyu le eiho dia lhingset ahije. 9 Hao lunggul ho chu mihemte suhgamna le manthah naa lhah mangsah hel thei ngolna tin cheng le kisuh khahna thei lung guljouse a lhah lut theina lhepna thangkol’a a-oh jiuvin ahi. 10 Ajeh chu sum ngailuthi setna jouse bulpi ahin, sum mu ding ngaitona kiha bolna lam’a mi kimkhat tahsan’a konin akihei mangun, amaho le amaho thoh natna tampin akisuh khah lojiuve.

Tahsa tah a tilkhouna

11 Vo Pathen mi, nangman hechengse hi jamsanin; adih, Pathen houlam, tahsan, ngailut, thoh hat, nunem hicheng joh chu hol jingin. 12 Ahetoh mi tampi angsunga phondoh phatah naphondohna dinga nakikouna bangin kipaman tonsot hinna san nadin tahsa kilhai tetna lam’a hatah-in pangin. 13 Thil ijakai hinsah Pathen le Pontius Pilate angsunga phondoh phatah neiya, hettohsahna bol, Jesu Christa jal’a hiche thu hi kapeh nahi, 14 nangman i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung kilah kit kahsen thupeh hi boh beh louhel le seiset na beihel’in ching jingin. 15 Nun nom jing, thanei khatseh, leng jouse leng le pakai jouse Pakaiyin achamtah a phat ahin phon doh ding ahi, 16 ama bou thi-tih nei lou, ngailut thei hoi hilou, khovah a cheng, ama chu koiman mu khah lou, mihemin mu jong mu thei lou ahin, ama jenga chun jabolna le thahatna tonsot geiyin um jing hen, Amen. 17 Tu hinkhoa vannoi leiset thil’a, hao ho chu ahoitho louna diuvin hilchah-in, kichetna bei gouva ki-ngai louva, imanchah diuva thil jouse eipe jinguva Pathen joh a ki-ngaiyu hen: 18 thilpha aboluva, napha tohna a atha lhin theiyuva, ahongphal’uva, mito chan kikop theiya aum’uva, 19 khonung hinkho dinga bul phatah gou akikhol’uva, hinkho tahbeh chu atuh chah jingna diuvin til khouvin. 20 Vo Timothy, nangma na kichinsah chengse chu hongtup’in; lam dih lou tah a hetna dol’a kisei, Pathen suhmilna le kinel baotamna chu peldoh jon. 21 Mi phabep’in hiche chihna chu aneidol’in aseiyun, tahsan lam’a abidoiyu asuh khel lo tauve. Lungsetnan umpiuvin.

2 Timothy 1

Salam

1 Christa Jesu sunga hina thutep dungjuiya, Pathen lungdeiya, solchah Paul’in, 2 Cha deitah Timothy henga: Pa Pathen le i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christaa konin lungsetna le hepina chule chamna nachunga um hen.

Thangvahna le tilkhouna

3 Lung ngaito thengsel’a pu le patea pat kahou Pathen chung nunga kipa thanop na kaneiyin, sun le jan’a thumna kanei chanin tang louhel’in nangma kageldoh jing jenge. 4 Namit lhi lon kageldoh jing jeh-in kakipa chamkim theina din nangma mu kal ka-ngah lel lheh-e. 5 Masanga napi Loisi le nanu Eunice sunga chenga tahsanna kicheh tah nasunga cheng chu kageldoh-in, hichu nasunga achen jing ding kaging chai. 6 Hijeh a chu nachunga thenso- khut ka-ngap jeh a Pathen thilpeh nachan chu meibanga na konsah kitna dinga kahin geldoh sah kit nahi. 7 Ijeh-inem itile meidoi-na dinga Pathenin Lhagao eipeh-u ahipon, thahatna le ngailutna chule kitim theina ding joh ahibouve. 8 Hichejeh chun i-Pakaiyu thudol hettohsahnaa jong meidoi hih-in, ama jal’a sohchang kei chung thua jong jahcha hih-in, chusangin Pathen songin Kipana Thupha thudol’a hahsa thoh jon. 9 Pathenin eiho na-tohho vang hilouva ama thilgon dungjui le alungset jal’a kouna thengsel’a eikouvuva, eihuhhingu ahibouve, hiche lungsetna chu vannoi khang kipat masanga Jesu Christa sunggil’a eina pehsau ahin, 10 tua hi eihuhhinguva Christa Jesu hung kilah a kona hung kiphongdoh ahitai; aman thina chu asubeiyin, Kipana Thupha jal’in hinna le thi-mo na chu khovah a aphongdohtai. 11 Hiche Kipana Thupha hi sei-phong ding le Solchah ding chule mihil dinga eikipansah ahi. 12 Hijeh a chu hichengpi hi kathoh gim ahin, ahivangin kajachatpi poi; Ijeh-inem itile katahsanpa chu kahetna, hiche nikho geiya chu chin dinga eikivop-sah jong hi ahonbit ding kasong lheh-e. 13 Keiya kona najahsa thuhil kicheh-a nanei, vettoh a juithei chengse chu Christa Jesu sunga cheng tahsa le ngailut nan tuh jingin. 14 Nakivopsah thilpha chu eiho sunga cheng Lhagao Theng panin ngah phan. 15 Phygelus le Hermogenes pumin Asia gamsunga mi jousen ei-nung ngatsoh hel’u hi nangman nahetsa ahitai. 16 Pakaiyin Onesiphorus insung mite chu hepi hen; aman kabulput hi jachat pi louhel’in kalung asuhal mat chet jengin ahi. 17 Rome khoa ahungin jong eihung hol hol jengin, eimudoh teiye. 18 Pakaiyin hiche Nikho chule Pakaiya konin hepina musah tei hen, Ephesus khoa lhacha kin abol chengse chu nangin phatah-in nahei.

2 Timothy 2

Jesu Christa dia sepai pha

1 Kachapa nangma vang Christa Jesu sunga um lungset nan pan-san, hat jingin, thaphan. 2 Ahetoh tamtah a kona kasei najahsa chengse chu tahsan um mihemho pe-sonin, chutile amahon midang ho ahil thei diu ahi. 3 Christa Jesu sepai phatah bangin genthei hahsa hi thoh gim-pin. 4 Sepai koima apansahpa lung-dei bolnom chun hinkhosunga ding lung gelnan akisumo ngaipoi. 5 Gol-seh bol min jong Dan dungjuiya abol loule koiman jo na lallukhuh asang theipoi. 6 Loubol’a pang na-tong gim mi chun agam ga-a chan anei masah pen ding ahi. 7 Kasei hi ipi ahi nagel toh ding ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin hetkhen na napeh ding ahinai. 8 Kipana Thupha kaseiphong dungjuiya David guiya peng, thinaa kona thoudoh Jesu Christa chu geldoh-in; 9 Hiche Kipana Thupha jeh a chu akhang gilou banga thih khaova kihen kahin, ahivang in Pathen thu chu akihen tang dehpoi. 10 Hijeh a chu lhen chomten Christa Jesu sunga kisel sochatna le tonsot loupina aneidoh theina diuva amaho dinga hichengpi kathohgim ahi. 11 Hiche thu hi tahsan umtah ahi: “Amato ithikhom’u le amato ihinkhom diu, 12 Ithoh lhumkeiyu le amato lengvai ipoh khomdiu, 13 Eiho tahsan bei hijongleu hen, Ama tahsan umtah ahi; Ajeh chu ama le ama akiseilep ngaipoi.”

Seiphat chang natong

14 Hiti ho hi miho geldohsah jingin lang, thu homkeova akinel baotam louna diuvin Pathen ang-sunga hilchah-in, hiche ho hin ima aphat chomsah pon, aja ho akhup athal’in achuh lo ji bouve. 15 Kipatep them changsa banga Pathen koma, din jouna din nang le nang kiha-bol’in, kijumso na beihel natong mi hinadin thutah chu jangkeiyin mangchan. 16 Houthu seisetna moh thuhom keova kihoulimna ho chu peldoh-in, ajeh chu hiche hoa tha-nom ho chu Houthu ngaisahmo na lam’a haltou cheh cheh jo ahiuvin, 17 chule athuseiyu jong chun masemon machal banga aneh chal tel tul diu ahi; hiche ho lah achun Hymenaeus le Philetus jong apang lhone’e. 18 Amaho hin thutah aho-khel’uvin, thokitna chu akichaisan aseiyun, mi phabep tahsan alehei-peh tauve. 19 Ahinla Pathen khom-phu chu dettah-in ading nai, “Pakaiyin amaa chengse ahe nai,” tin mohor akinam khumin; chujong le, “Pakai min minphah chan chu adihlouva konin kikhin mang hen,” akiti. 20 In lentah sunga khun sana le dangka bel jeng aumpon, thingbel le leibei ho jong aum’e; amaho chu abang sahlut dol aumin, abang sahlut lou dol aum’e. 21 Seisa thilse chengsea kona kithensodoh mi chu sahlut dol tah, akisuthengsa, Pakai dinga natong thei, thilpha bol dinga kigosadem ahitai. 22 Khangdonglai lunggul chengsea konin jamin, lung thengsel’a Pakai min pan ho chutoh adih tahsan, ngailut chule chamna holjon. 23 Ngolkai le lungthimbei ho kinelna chu peldoh-in, hichea chun kinahna asohdohji nahei. 24 Pakai soh natong chun doubol angai ahipon, chusanga mi jouse khoto them, mi-hil them, lungde-hat hiya, 25 lungnemtah a adouho chu apuijang joh ding ahi. Ijem itile Pathenin amaho chu thutah ahin hetdohna dinga lungheina phat apeh theiya, 26 Dia-bol’in amat’a alungdei lamtah a ahinga ahen nau thangkol’a kona hung toldoh thei diu ahi.

2 Timothy 3

Ninu nung nikhoa Mihem umchan ding

1 Ninu nung lam le phat hahsa tah ahung lhun ding hi hen. 2 Ijeh-inem itile mihemten ama chang cheh ki-ngailutna, sum homthona, nom ham hoitho, kichoisang, Pathen taitom, nuthu pathu ngailou lam’a lung lut’uva, phatna ngaisah lou le aboha um gam’uva, 3 khotona bei, hepina neilou, jouthua hehse hat, ti kitim lou, tuhngoi mo, phatna hotbol, 4 lepche, dingchanglou, kiletsah, Pathen ngaisah sanga tahsa nopsahna ngaisahho hidiu ahi. 5 Hou-ngaisah lim’a um’uva, hou-ngaisah-na tha neije la janom lou, hite hoa kon jong chun kihei mangin. 6 Ama-ho lah a kimkhat doha lungthimin mi intin’a alut jiuvin, chonset poh-gih jeh a lung ngaichatna tampin apui lon le numei ho chu gal-hing kiman bangin aman jiuvin, 7 hito-bang numeiho chula akihil jing vangun thutah hetnaa chu hung lut thei louhel ahiuve. 8 Jannes le Jambres chun Mose adoudal ihon banga hite ho jong hin thutah chu adoudal’uva, lungput sesa, tahsan thudol’a lolhing lel mi ahitauve. 9 Ahinla amaho sao tah chejou deh lou diu ahi, akisei te ni chunga thilsoh banga chu angolnau mitin koma kichenset’a kilangdoh ding ahi.

Paul’in Timothy athu lhah chaina

10 Nangin najuipehsa chu keima mihil chonchan, lungtup, tahsan thoh hat, ngailut, lungde-hat, 11 bolsetna chengse le gim hesoh ho chu ahin, Antioch le Iconium chule Lystra khosung dunga chu itobang tah a bolsetna kidang dang kachung-a hung lhung hitam, hichengsea kon jong chun Pakaiyin eihuhdoh soh keiye. 12 Chule koi koi ahin Christa Jesu sunga Hou-ngaisah-a hinnom jousen bolsetna athoh tei ding ahi. 13 Migilou ho le kilep them mihem ho chu phamo cheh cheh diu, midang alhep lhah banguva amaho min alhep lhah diu ahi. 14 Nang vang dettah a natahsan, nakihilsa chengsea chun ding det jingin, na-hil’a pang ho chu koi ahiu nahe nai. 15 Christa Jesu sunga tahsanna jal’a huhhingna napui-lut thei chih-na napethei Pathen lekhabu chu nachapan laiya pat nahetsa ahitai. 16 Pathenin hu alhakhum Pathen lekhabu chengse chu kihilna ding, kipho na ding, kipuijang na ding le adih lam’a kichuhna dinga pha-tah ahi. 17 Chutile Pathen mi chu kitoh chet’a um theiya natoh pha chengse tohna kigosadem’a um ding ahi.

2 Timothy 4

1 Pathen le mitin ahing athi thutan ding Christa Jesu maiya, chule ahung kilah kit ding le Alenggam pan’a guntah a kahilchah nahi, 2 thu chu seiphong len, aphat hihen aphat lou hijongle, lung nengtah-in miho chu hilto gomin athemmo nau hetsah-in, sosal’in, tilkhouvin. 3 Ijeh-inem itile mihon thuhilpha kicheh chu ngai thei louva, abilkol’u thahtun tun’a ama ama lung ngai-chat dungjuiya mihil akikhop khom diu phat hung lhung ding ahi. 4 Chule amahon thutah akona abil-kol ahei manguva, semthu thusim lam’a hung lung lutjo diu ahi. 5 Nang vang imalam jousea lung limgeh chan umin, hahsa thoh gimin, Evangelist na tongin, nalhacha na-toh chu bulhit molson. 6 Ije-inem itile keima hi eiki-katdoh ahitan, kapotdohna ding phat ahung lhungtai. 7 Golseh phatah kaseh joutan, kilhai tetna ka chaiyin, tahsan kamolsotai. 8 Tukal se-a vang keima dinga themchan na lallukhuh chu koisa ahitai, dih tah a thutan Pakaiyin hiche Nikho chu le eipeh ding ahi, kei keo hilouva ama hungkit ding ngailu jouse jong ahiuve.

Tahsa tah a hilchahna

9 Kahenga hungvah na din hung kihabol’in; 10 ajeh chu Demas chun tulai vannoi hi angailut jeh-in eidalhan, Thessalonica a achetai; Crescens chu Galatia lama achen, Titus ma Dalmatia lama achei; 11 Luke changseh-in eiumpi. Mark hinpuiyin lang hung lhonin, ajeh chu ama chu kei dinga lhacha kinbolnaa phachom tah ahi. 12 Tychicus vang Ephesus lama kasoltai. 13 Nahung teng Troas khoa Carpus khut’a kadalhah kasangkhol len le lekhabu ho, ahidehchun savun lekhabu ho chu hinpon. 14 Sumsan kheng Alexander chun giloutah-in eibol’in, Pakaiyin athilbol dungyuiyin lethuh nante. 15 Ama chunga hin nang jong hung kigingphan, ajeh chu aman ithusei hou’u hi hatah-in adoudal’e. 16 Kakihonna thu kasei masah pen chun koima chan eihupon, abonchan eidalhasoh hel’uve; hichu amaho themmon kisimpeh da hen. 17 Ahivangin keima jal’a thu kiseiphong chu lhingset’a akiphondoh a chidang namdangten ajahsoh keina diuvin Pakaiyin eidinpin tha eipen, chule Phaisameigeo kamsunga konin eihuhdohtai. 18 Pakaiyin thilse bol jousea konin eihuhdoh intin, van chunga A-lenggam sunga din eihuhhing nante. Loupina chu tonsot tonsot geiyin amaa hijing hen: Amen.

Salam chaina

19 Prisca le Aguila chule Onesiphorus insung mite chu salamin. 20 Erastus chu Corinth a aumdentai. Trophimus adammon Miletus a kadalhatai. 21 Phalbi masanga hung tei din hung kihabol’in. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Caludia le sopi jousen nahin salam’ui. 22 Pakaiyin na-lhagao umpin, Lungsetnan naumpi jingu hen.

Titus 1

Salam

1 Pathen soh natong, Jesu Christa Solchah a pang Paul’in Pathen lhenchomte tansan dungjui le hou ngaisahna dungjuiya thutah ahetnau to kitoh, 2 tonsot hinna dia kinepna, vannoi, khang kipat masang a pat jou seithei lou Pathen thutepsa, 3 ama dei phat cha athu hung kiphongdoh a, eihuhhingpau Pathen thupeh dungjuiya keima eiki-nganse chu: 4 kikop khom cheh tahsan dungjuiya chatah tah Titus henga: Pa Pathen le eihuhhingpau Christa Jesua konin lungsetna le chamna nachunga um hen.

Crete mun’a Titus natoh

5 Thil kibol bulhing lou chengse naboltup soh a chule khopi jousea upa ho napansah na dinga Crete a kadalhah nahi. 6 Pansah ding chu koi hile nolnabei, numei khatseh jia nei, achate jong tahsan neisa, seiset chang lou, vah thai lou, thua nung khen hidiu ahi. 7 Ijeh-inem itile Houbung lamkai chu Pathen gouching ahijeh a nolna bei, kicham sah lou, lungsabai lou, ju nelou, mideng lou, alam louva kilose lou mi hiding, 8 chusanga jindot them, thilpha dei, lung limgeh, midih, hougut mi, kitim them mi hiding ahi. 9 Thuhil kicheh mangchaa tilkhouna abol theiya chule adouho nelkelna chu alekhup theina dinga kihilna dunguiya ginchat umtah thu chu tuhchah mi hiding ahi. 10 Thua nung lou atam lheh jengun thu motsei seiya milhen chavai adim’ui, amaho chu cheptan ho lah a atamdeh-ui. 11 Amaho hi akam’u suhbing loiding ahi, ajeh chu alam louva phatchom ding holnan hil louhel ding thu ahil’un, miphabeh insung asucheh gamtauve. 12 Amahon laha khat athemgao ho’u khat’in: “Crete miho chu mijou jeng, Gamsa gilou tah, thase neh hatte ahi,” ati. 13 Hiche hettohsah hi a dih monge. Hijeh chun amaho tahsan kicheh mi ahina diuvin hatah-in phohsal’in. 14 Thutah pai manga. Juda miho thusim semthu le mihemte thupeh hoa chun lung lut dau hen. 15 Milung theng ho dia ijakai athengin, akisubohsa ho le atahsan lou ho din imacha athengpoi, alungthimu le alung ngaito nau bohsoh ahitai. 16 Pathen hedanin aphongdoh nauvin, atoh nauvin la ataitom’uve; amaho hi hot umtah le thu ngailou ahiuvin, natohpha ijat hile tongdia kiloma ahitapouve.

Titus 2

Thuhil kicheh

1 Nangin vang thuhil kicheh to kitoh chubou nasei ding ahi. 2 Upa ho chu lung neng tah, ima khohsah nei, lung limgeh, tahsan neiya kitimthem, ngailut nei, thohhat hiu hen. 3 Nupite jong chu jathei dol’a gingkhen cha hiu hen, jousei hat hilouva, jua kitimo hel hul’a sohchang bang lou diu thilpha hil’in pangjo’u hen, 4 nutil khangdong ho chi ajiteu le achateu ngailutje kisinsah-u hen lang, 5 Lung khaikhi them, atheng, insung minu pha, mipha, ajipate chengu thu noiya kunjel u hen lang, Pathen thu chu taitomin umsah dau hen. 6 Hitobang ma chun khangdong ho jong lung khaikhi them dia natilkhou ding ahi. 7 Nangman tah jeng jong imalam jousea vetkah theiya thilpha nabol ding, namihilnaa nakitahje, ja naum je, 8 nathusei kichehje chu kimusah-in, chutile eidouteu chu kijumsoa ichunguva thuse seiding aneilou diu ahi. 9 Soh ho chu ijakaiya apakaiteu thu noiya nungjel thei, nelkel louhel’a lung lhaisahjo hiuhen. 10 Ima guh a kiseldoh louvin ijakaiya tahsan thei mong ahi nau thilpha chu vetsahjo’u hen; chutile imalam jousea eihuhhinguva Pathen thuhil chu ajep hoi thei diu ahi. 11 Ijeh-inem itile mihem jouse huhhingna dinga Pathen milungset chu hung kilang doh ahitai. 12 Hichun hou-ngaisah louna le vannoi leiset ngaichat jouse pai manga, lung limgeh le adih chule Hou-ngaisah tah a tulai khanga hi ihin theina diuva eihilchah-u ahi. 13 Chule thanop umtah kinepna, Pathen nasatah le eihuhinguva Jesu Christa loupi tah hung kilah ding kat jinga ium diu ahi. 14 Christa chun gitlouna chengsea kona eisuh thenguva, tom ngaitah a thilpha bol ami lhentum tea eisemdohna diuva eiho khel’a ama kipedoh jenga eilhatdoh-u ahitai. 15 Hicheng se hi nasei ding, thu neina lhingset’a natilkhouva nahilchah ding ahin, koima chan nahsah mon nabolda hen.

Titus 3

Christian chondan

1 Amaho chu vaipo ho le thunei ho thu noiya um ding, sei ngaiya thilpha jouse boldinga kigosadema um ding geldohsah jingin. 2 Koima taitom louhel le koima kinahpi lou, chon nem’a, mijouse chunga nun nem dingin jong hilphan. 3 Ijeh-inem itile eiho jong masanga chu lungthimbei le seingailou, gamvasoh a lung gul le nopsahna ding tampi noiya sohbanga kihen, thilsea um, kithangset toa hing, hotna dim’a khat le khat i-nahiuve. 4 Ahivangin eihuhhinguva Pathen phatna le mihem ahepina ahung kilahdoh phat’in, 5 eihon adih a thil inabol’uva inatoh jeh-u hilouva, amihepi jal’a eihuhhinguva Penthahna twiya asil’a, Lhagao Thenga asemthah a, 6 hiche Lhagao Theng chu eihuhhingpau jesu Christa jal’a ichunguva leiset’a abuh lhah ahitai. 7 Hitia chu amilungset vanga them ichan theijuva, tonsot hinna kineppi dungjuiya goulo chu ichan theina diu ahi. 8 Hiche thu hi tahsan umtah ahin, nangman hiti thudol’a hin Pathen tahsante chu thilpha bolna lam jenga dettah a dindet theina diuva lung nagelsah ding kadeiye. Hiche ho hi mihemte dinga pha, thil phachomtah ahi. 9 Amavang ngol-hoi thudol le khanggui thusim kinel baotam, Danthu dol’a kinah hichenga kon chun kihei mangin, ajeh chu hiche ho hi phatchomna bei manthahna ahibouve. 10 Loitum sem mi chu khat vei nahilchah kal’in donda tan, 11 ajehchu hitobang mi chu lungthim sesa chonse ahin, acham chama them mo kichan ahi.

Tahsa tah a hilchahna

12 Nahenga Artemas hihen Tychicus hile kahinsol teng Nicopolis khoa kahenga hungding hung kihabol’in, ajeh chu hikoma hi phalbi sungsea cham dinga kagel lhuh ahitai. 13 Danthu them Zenas le Apollos chun ima lhahsamna anei lhon louna din hinsoldoh loi dingin lungthim giltah-in kithopin. 14 Imiteu jong chu angaichat’u kintoh din napha tohna dingin phat manchahje kichuh-u hen, tohga beiyin mohumdau hen. 15 Kaumpi chengsen nasalam’ui. Tahsan jal’a igolteu chu salamin. Lungset nan nabonchauvin umpihen.

Philemon 1

Salam

1 Chrita Jesu Jal’a sohchang Paul le sopi Timothyn, ingailut tah-u le itoh khompiu Philemon, 2 isopi nuu Apphia, i-sepai pankhom piu Archippus le na-insunga kikhomji Houbung henga, 3 i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christaa konin lungsetna le chamna nachunguva um hen.

Philemon lungsetna le tahsan

4 Katao chanin phat jousen nangma kageldoh jingin ka-Pathen kathang vah jinge; 5 ajeh chu Pakai Jesu lam le mithengte chunga ngai lutna le thasan nanei thu kajai; 6 natahsan jeh a kikhop khomna hin Christa jal’a ei ho sunga um thilpha jouse hi hetchetna aumdoh teina dinga kataoji ahi. 7 Na-ngailut thu dol’a hin hapan kakipah-in kakitil khou lhehjenge, ipijeh-inem itile nangma jeh-in mithengte lunggil jeng jong akisuhal lheh jengin ahi sopi.

Onesimus dia Paul taona

8 Christa jal’in angaidol’a nangma thupeh jeng ding ngam jongleng, 9 ngailutna jeh a ka-ngeh tho joh ahi; hiche hi palaiya pang tu jenga jong Christa Jesu jal’a sohchang Paul kahi. 10 Kasoh chan naa kahinsa, kachapa Onesimus dinga kangeh ahi. 11 Phat khat’a chu nang dinga amahi phachom lou ahin, tua vang nang le kei dinga pha chomtah ahitai. 12 Ama hi nahenga kahinsol’in, hichepa hi kakhotona lung laigil’a hung ahi. 13 Kipana Thupha jal’a kasoh chan na muna hi nangma khel’a lhacha kinbol’a eipanpeh dinga kakihen den nom lheh jeng ahin, 14 ahinla nangma lung hilounaa ima nacham louvin kabolsah nompoi, chutia chu nathilpha bol chu chamlouva hilouva, nachamtah a naboljoh ding aphai. 15 Ama hi tonsot geiya nanei theina dinga chomkhat dia nakoidoh jong hithei ahi; 16 soh maimai ahitapon, keidin soh sanga chung nung jo sopi deitah ahin, nang din vang Pakai jal le tahsa jal’a hahi deh ahiye. 17 Hitia chu nangin kei hi chan khopia neigel le kei khel’in ama hi analemin. 18 Aman na chunga suh khel anei ham, bat anei ham ahijongle, hijong chu kei chunga del din sim jengin. 19 Keima Paul’in kakhut tah a kasut ahi, keiman le peh kit nange; nangma tah-in kei neibat chu nasahna dinga kasei ahipoi. 20 Hiti chu ahi sopi, Pakai jal’in nangin keima neilung lhaisah jon, Christa jal chun kalung laigil suhal jingin. 21 Nasei ngai jing jeh a kahinsut ahin, Kasei kalval’a jong nabol ding kahei. 22 Chule kalhunna ding indan eina gonpeh-in, ajeh chu nataonau jeh a nang hodia eikipehdoh tei ding kakinem lheh jenge.

Salam chaina

23 Christa Jesu jeh a kasoh chanpi Epaphras-in nahinsalam’e; 24 katoh khompi cheng Mark, Aristarchus, Demas chule Luke hite hon jong nasalam’ui. 25 Pakai Jesu Christa milungset nan nalhagaovu umpihen.

Hebrew 1

Pathenin achapan thu aseitai

1 Masang laiyin a Pathenin phattamtah vei lamchom chomin ipu ipateu henga Themgao ho kamin thu anasei jin, 2 ninunung phat hin Chapan eiho henga thu ahinseitan, Chapa hi ijakai goulo dinga atun ahin, ama jeh a vannoi jong asemdoh ahi. 3 chapa chun Pathen loupi vah le alim tahbeh chu apodoh-in, thanei tah athu chenga thil ijakai hi atuh chah jing ahin, chonset’a kona suh thengna abol jou phat’in lal loupi chungnung pen jet lama atouvin, 4 Vantilte sanga gamchenga minphajo gou alojeh-in, amaho sangin achungnungjotai.

Chapa Vantilte sanga chungnungjo

5 Pathenin Vantilte koipen jah a itih a chu: "Nangma kachapa nahin, Tunia kahin nahi, " ati khah em? Chujongle: "Keima apa kahi ding, Ama kachapa hiding ahi, " atim? 6 chukit le ijakai sanga masapeh achapa vannoi leiset’a ahinpui ding chun aseiyin: "Pathen Vantil jousen Ama chu chibei boh cheh-u hen, " ati. 7 Chul vantilte chung thudol’a aseiyin: "Aman a-Vantilte chu hui asosah-in, Alhachate chu meikong asosah-e, " ati. 8 Chapa thudol’a vang: "Vo Pathen nalaltouna chu tonsot tonsot geiya um jing ahin, Kitahna tenggol chu Nalenggam tenggol ahi. 9 Nangin adih na-ngailun, Dan dih lou nahot bol’e; Hijeh a chu Pathen, na-Pathenin thao nanua, Naloite jouse sanga nachoi sanga olive thao nanu ahi, " atibouve. 10 Chule: Vo Pakai, nangman semtil’in Leiset bulpi naphutdoh-in, Chule van ho jong hi nakhutsem ahi. 11 Hiche ho hi mangthah diu ahin, Nang vang um jing ding nahi; abonchauva ponsil banga chulsoh diu ahi. 12 Aboncha hi ponlhe banga najeldoh a Ponsil banga nakheldoh ding ahi. Nang vang nabang nahi jingin, Nakum jong beitih um lou ding ahi. 13 Hichea hi Vantilte koipen jah a: "Keiman namelmate nakengchotpha kaneisah masangsen Kajet lam’a tou jingin, " ati beh em? 14 Vantilte chu abonchauva lhacha kinbol lhagao, huhhingna goulo ding ho jenle dinga hinkisol hilou hiuvem?

Hebrew 2

Hibang tah a nasa huhhingna

1 Hichejeh tah a hi ithujah chengseu hi lung nachang cheh a i-ngai diu, achutiloule ikimoh tolmang diu ahi. 2 Ijeh-inem itile Vantilte seidoh thu bon chubanga adet’a, asu-khel ho le angailou hon kitoh chet’a talen akisan’u le, 3 hitobang huhhingna nasatah hi nahsah mo leu hen iti isochat diu ham? Athu hi akipatnaa Pakai tah-in aseidoh a, ajahon eiho henga aphotchetsah-u ahin, 4 Pathenin jong melchihna tampi le thil kidang tampi, bolmo kidang tampi to thoa adei dungjuiya Lhagao Theng ahoppeh a ahettoh sahpi ahi.

Huhhingna po doh masapen

5 Iseiyu vannoi leiset ahung um doh got jong chun Vantilte noiya akoipoi. 6 Chusangin mun khat’a akihettohsah bangin aseiyin: "Mihem hi ipi hiya ama ding hibanga nagelpeh a, Mihem Chapa chu koiham hibanga navil jing? 7 Phat chom khat din Vantilte sangin noi nungjon nakoiyin, Leng bangin loupina le janna najemin, 8 Thil ijakai akengto noiya nakoisoh tai, " ati. Hichea ijakai aboncha anoiya akoina a hin imacha ama noiya lut lou aumpoi. Ahivangin tun thil ijakai hi anoiya lutsoh hel imudoh hih laiyui. 9 Imuu chu phat chom khat dia Vantilte sanga noi nungjoa akoi Jesu chu ahin, Pathen lungset jal’a mi jouse dinga thina atepkhah tei ding jeh-in thina geiyin athohin, hijeh chun loupina le jabolna lallukhuh-in akijemtai. 10 ijeh-inem itile ama vanga thil ijakai umsah-a, ama jal’a ijakai hinsah pan chapa tamtah loupinaa apui lut ding jeh a amaho huhhingna phutdohpa chun gim genthei athoh a asuh cham ding chu kitoh ahi. 11 Aje chu asuthengpau le asuh theng ho chu agom’uva Pa khatseh akon ahiuve. Hijeh a chu aman jachatna beihel’a amaho chu sopite ahisah a 12 asei chu: "Keiman kasopite lah a namin seiphong leng ting, Houbung ja lah a namin kavahchoi ding ahi, " atin. 13 Chukit le: "Keiman achunga katahsan kakoi ding, " ati. Chujongle: "Ven, Pathenin eipeh chapangte le keima hi, " atikit’e. 14 ajeh chu chapangte hi thisan le tahsaphe kikop ahiuvin, aman jong amaho tobangin alim’u ahung louvin hitia chu thina jal’a thina chunga thunei vaipo, hiche Diabol chu suhmang ding agot ahi; 15 chule thina kichat jeh a hinkhoa soh a kihen chengse chu lhadoh ding agot ahi. 16 ama chun vantilte ding akhohsahjo pon, Abraham chilhahte ahujotai. 17 Mipi chonsetna chengse akichulnam theina dinga, Pathen henga tahsan umtah le mihepi Thempu chungnunga apan theina dinga sopite lim le mel bang banga aumdoh ding hi kilomtah ahi. 18 Hichea hi ama tah-in gim genthei ahoth a lhep patep’a aumjehchun, lhep patep’a umho chu akithopi theitai.

Hebrew 3

Mose sangin Jesu achungnungjoi

1 Chuti ahijeh chun van kouna changkha sopi thengte, i-hou thu’uva solchah le Thempu chungnung Jesu chu gelkhoh-uvin, 2 Pathen insung pumpia Mose akitah banga ama jong apansahpa dinga kitah tah ahi. 3 Ijeh-inem itile in sanga, in sadohpa jabolna achanjoh banga Mose sanga Jesu chu gamchenga loupijo dia kilom ahitai. 4 Ajeh chu in jouse hi asadoh khat um cheh ahin, ahinla thil ijakai hi Pathenin asadoh-e. 5 Khonung thusoh ding kisei ding ho hettohsahnaa Mose chu Pathen insung pumpia tahsan umtah lhachan anapange. 6 Christa vang chu Pathen insunga Chapa thunei pen ahin, eihon i-hakat nau le ikison nau chule kinepna hi ituh chah jingu le ama insung ihidiu ahibouve. P athen mite dia choldo mun 7 Chuti ahijeh chun Lhagao Thengin aseiyin: "Tunia a-ogin najah-u le 8 Doumah bol nikhoa bang chun Nalung tahsah hih-un, Gamthip laiya kipatep nikhoa bangin: 9 Napu napa teuvin eipatep’un eideh-uve, Kanatoh kathilbol amu’uvin 10 Kum som li sungin. Hijeh a chu hiche khang mite chunga lung hanga, ‘Amaho hi lungthim chavai mong ahiuvin, Hijeh chun kalampi jouse ahepouve,’ kati ahi. 11 Hia chun kalunghan jeh a kihahsel’a: ‘Amaho kacholdoh mun’a lut louhel diu ahi,’ kati aihye. 12 Sopite, Pathen hing jinga kona pul lhahna dia nalah-uva mi koi hile tahsan louva lungthim gilou pu aum louna din ching theiyun. 13 Nalah-uva chonset lhep lhah a lungtah cheh cheh aum louna din, "Tuni’ kiti aum laisen nangho khat le khat kitilkhouto jingun. 14 Ijeh-inem itile abul’a pat’a i-hung kison nau chu akhon nigeiya ituh chah jing pouvu le eiho hi Christa to chan kikop ihitauve. 15 Hichea hin akiseiyin: "Tunia a-ogin najah-u le Doumah bol nikhoa bang chun nalung tahsah hih-un, " akiti. 16 Ja taa doumah bol’a chu koi koi ham? Egypt’a kona Mose vanga hung potdoh chengse hilou ham? 17 Kum som li sunga koi chunga lung hang ham? Chonsea gamthip laiya along lumden ho chung hilou ham? 18 Amaho acholdo mun’a lut louhel dinga ahahsel khum ho chu hiche thu ngailou ho chu hilou ham? 19 Hiti hin atahsan loujeh-uva alut thei louvu imutauve.

Hebrew 4

1 Hijeh chun kichau hite, achutiloule acholdo mun’a lut theina ding thutep um jeng jongle nalahuva khattou athon’a um khante. 2 Ijeh-inem itile eiho jah banga ama hon jong Kipana Thupha ajah-u ahinan, ahivangin athu jah-u chun amaho aphat chomsah poi, ajehchu ajahon tahsan’a asanlouvu ahi. 3 Atahsan eiho vang hi choldo mun’a chu lut ihiuve, hitia aseibang chun: "Kalunghan jeh-in kakihahsel’in, ‘Amaho kacholdo mun’a lut louhel diu ahi,’ kati, " akiti. Leiset bulpi khom kiphu til’a pat natoh thilsem chu akichaisa ahitah vangin. 4 Chuma le mun khat’a Ni sagi ni thudol aseiyin: "Chuin Nisagi lhin nin anatoh chengsea konin Pathen akicholdoi, " ati. 5 Chukit le hichea hin: "Amaho kacholdo mun’a lut louhel diu ahi, " ati. 6 Kipana Thupha ja masahon thu angai lou jeh-uva alut lou vangun, hichea lut ding chu mi aum jing nalaiyin, 7 chuin "Tuni" kiti nikho dang khat atep kit’in, athu hi khonungin David kama aseiyin, akisei masa bang chun. "Tunia a-ogin najah-u le Nalung tahsah hih-un, " ati. 8 Ijeh-inem itile Joshuan amaho chu acholdosah hita le, aman kho nunga nikho dang khat um kit ding thu hi aseilou ding ahitai. 9 Hijeh chun Pathen mite din Choldona khat aum nalaiye. 10 Ipijeh-inem itile Pathen jeng jong anatoh na akona acholdo banga Pathen choldo mun’a lut pa chu anatoh akona kicholdo ahitai. 11 Thu ngailouna jeh a lut louho umchan jop’a alut lou ium louna diuvin, chua lut’a choldo cheh din kihabol’u hite. 12 ijeh-inem itile Pathen thu hi hing jing le na tong hat jing, hemto chemjam sanga jong hemjo, hinna Lhagao gu kisuhtona le lhin, hicheng geiya sukhen theihel’a sun thei, lunggel le lungthim ngaito hetoh paijen jeng thei ahi. 13 Pathen maiya kilang lou thilsem aumpon, ichung thu i-lhutna ding pau mitmua chu thil ijakai hi asagoh keova kijam cheh ahibouve.

Jesu thempulen chungnung

14 Van mun jouse jotpaiya Thempulen, Pathen Chapa Jesu ineijeh-un iphondoh-u tahsan chu tuhdet jing u hite. 15 Ijeh-inem itile ihatmo lhahsam nauva eihu theilou Thempu chungnung nei ihipouvin, eiho banga imalam jousea lhep patepna tohsa, ahivanga chonsetna bei thempu chungnung ineiyui. 16 Hijeh chun panpi i-ngai kom’u le alungset vanga hepina le panpina ikilah theina diuvin hangtah-in lungset laltouna chu nailut’u hite.

Hebrew 5

1 Thempu chungnung jouse hi chonset jal’a thilto ho le kilheina gan tha ho Pathen koma tohdoh dinga, mihem ho thalhenga mihem te lha a kiladoh a kipansah ji ahi. 2 Amatah jeng jong lhahsam nan aumkimvel soh jeh chun imaheloute le lamvaite lung de-hattah a abol thei ahinai, 3 ajeh chu mipi dinga kilhaina abol lou akhoh banga amatah jeng dinga jong achonset nau jeh a abol lou khoh ahi. 4 Chule Aaron bang chun Pathenin akouna jeh tilouvin koiman hiche jabolna kintheng hi acham chamin akilah theipoi. 5 Hitobang chun Christa jengin jong Thempu chungnung hi-na ding hi achamtah a kichoi-at nan aneipon amavang ajah a seipeh pan: "Nangma kachapa nahin, Tunia kahin nahi, " ati. 6 Hitobangma hin mun khat’a jong aseiyin: "Melchizedek themput dungjuiya Nangma tonsot’a dia thempu nahi, " ati. 7 Tahsaphe pua aum lai nikhon thinaa kona ahuhhing theipa henga Jesu chu o-thong leu le mit-lhi pumin thumna le taona neiya, Pathena akipeh thengjeh-in ataona aki-ngaipehin ahi. 8 Chapatah ahijeng vangin thoh hesoh thoh-in thua nunje akihil them’e. 9 Ama achamkimsoh phat’in ama thua nungte jouse din tonsot sochatna bulpin apangin, 10 Pathenin Melchizedek themput dungjuiyin Thempu chungnung asahtai.

Tahsan’a lhahdah louna dia hilchahna

11 Hiche thudol’a hin sei ding tampi kaneiyun, ahinla nakolseh tah jeh-un ahilchet ahahsai. 12 Hitih chanpi hi mihil thei nahi diu ahitan, chutitah sangin khattouvin Pathen thubul kipatna lhongpi ho hil leu chun na-ngaikit nalaiyui, anham hilou bongnoitwi ngai nalaiyin naum’uve. 13 Ijeh-inem itile bongnoitwiya kivah nalai chu chapang ahijeh-in adih thudol’a hetna ima aneipoi. 14 Anham vang chu mi kikhan lhitsa ho ding ahin, amaho chu ahet thei nau mangchaa ase apha datkhenje themsa ho chu ahiuve.

Hebrew 6

1 Chuti ahijeh chun Christa thu bul kipatna lam chu dalhau hitin, philhinna ding lamjoh del’u hite; natoh thisa hoa kona lunghei ding bul phut kit louvin, Pathen tahsan thupou, 2 batize thua kihilna pou, thenso-khut ngap ham, thinaa kona thokit thu ham, chule tonsot’a dia thutan thupou velsei daute. 3 Hiche jong chu Pathenin pha asah le ibol diu ahinai. 4 Ijeh-inem itile khatvei khovah changsa ho, van’a kon thilpeh chu atep khah-uva, Lhagao Theng changkhasa, 5 chule Pathen thu phat dan tep khaa, khang hung lhung dinga thaneina hesa ahiuvin, 6 amaho hi alhuh tah-u le, amaho tumtah a Pathen Chapa chu Thingpel’a khen beh kit’a lhang phong tah a taitoma aumsah-u ahitan, lungheina dinga semphat kit thei hoi ahitapouve. 7 Ajeh chu Pathen kona phattheiboh achan jeh a leiset’in achunga ju-lha jing jeng gotwi adon’a, aphatchomna diuva lou kibolpeh ho dinga anche louhing ahinsep dohji ahin, 8 amavang ling phung ho le simbiling ho asepdoh le pannabei ahitan, gaosap anaiyin, achaina govam ding ahi. 9 Deitahte, hitia kasei vangun thilpha cheh le huhhingna nanei jeh-un nachung thu’va kagin chat nau aum nai. 10 Ajeh chu mithengte kin nabolsau chu nabol jingu ahin, Ama min ngailutna naphondoh-u ahitah jeh-in, hiche natoh nau asuhmil ding chu Pathen adih lou ahipoi. 11 Akhonna geiya kinepna chu lhingkeiya akihetdoh kahsea natompan ngai banguva nang ho khat cheh hi napan diu kadei lheh jengui. 12 Chutile nathaset lou diu, tahsan le thoh hat jal’a thutep gou lo chang ho umchan jom nahidiu ahiye.

Pathen thutep thonlou

13 Pathenin Abraham thu atep chun ama sanga len jodang aum loujeh-in ama changseh akihahsel’in 14 Keiman phatthei kaboh tei tei ding, punjong kapunsah ding nahi, " ati. 15 Abrahamin thoh hattahin thutepga akimutai. 16 Chujongle mihemten amaho sanga chungnung jo chu kihahselna aneijiu ahin, chule thu kichetna dinga kihahsel na chun akah-uva kibaona jouse asuh chaiji ahi. 17 Thutep goulo ding ho henga chu alung ngaito chu khelkit louhel ding ahidol kichentah a avetsah nom jeh a Pathenin kihahselna chu palai banga anei ahi. 18 Hitia chu hiche thilbol nia kona hi Pathen kikheltih neilou le itih a jou thei lou ahi hea, hite ni jeh a ama koma kisel eiho hin imasanguva kikoi kinepna chu tuh chah dinga nasa tah a kitilkhou ihiuve. 19 Hiche kinepna chu hinkho dia thihhat aiya ineiyu ahin, kichentah le dettah pondal sung lam geiya lut pai ahi. 20 Hikoma chu Melchizedek themput dungjuiya tonsot’a dia thempu chungnunga pang Jesu chu eiho thalhenga analut masa ahitai.

Hebrew 7

Melchizedek themput dol’a themputna

1 Hiche Melchizedek Salem leng pa hi Chungnungpen Pathen thempu ahin, Abrahamin lengho agatha ahung kilekit lam chun Melchizedek-in agalamton phatthei aboh-e. 2 Ama chu Abrahamin athil chomdoh jousea konin som a khat apen, amasaa Mechizedek hi ‘Kalengpa dih’ tina ahin, chujongle ‘Salem lengpa’ jong hin chamna lengpa kiti ahi. 3 Ama hi nubei pabei, khanggui thusim neilou, hinnikho kipatna le kichaina bei, Pathen Chapa tobang ahin, a-itih a thempua pang jing jeng ahi. 4 Lung gel’in ngaitouvin, ipului bulpiu Abrahamin athilchom hopsom a hop khat apehpa chu itobanga len hitam! 5 Abraham chilhah ahicheh vangun Levi chilhah thempu mun chang ho chun Danthu dungjuiya asopiteu hijongle miholah akon hopsom’a khat lahna ding thu aneiyu ahi. 6 Ahile Levite khangguiya kimatna bon neilou Melchizedek chun Abrahama konin hopsoma hop khat alan, chule thutep kisanpa chu phatthei aboh jenge. 7 Chule mineojon asanga lenjoa kona phatthei boh khat akilah uvin, khatjoh a vang hin akilahpa chu hing jing ahidol hettohsahna aum’e. 9 Chujongle Abraham jeh chun, hopsom’a hop khat kilahpa Levi jeng jong chun hopsom’a hopkhat apei tia sethei ai. 10 Ajehchu Melchizedek chun Abraham agalamto pet’a hi Levi chu apu Abraham taiguiya um nalai ahi. 11 Mipi dia Danthu kipeh lo na Levite themput dol’a chu chamkimsohna umthei hile Aaron themput dol’a kisei louva Melchizedek thempu chom dang khat umdoh khoh ngai ding ham? 12 Hiche achung chang thudol akikhel le Danthu jong kikhel teiji ahi. 13 Hiche achung chang thudol kiseipa hi phung chom’a kon ahin, hiche phunga kon hin koimacha maicham phunga lhachan apang kha hih laiye. 14 Akichen veng tai, ajeh chu i-Pakaiyu chu Judah phunga hung kon ahin, hiche phunga themput dol hi Mosen ima aseipoi. 15 Melchizedek tobanga chu thempu chom dangkhat akitundoh phat hin athu hi gamchengin akichen kit tai. 16 Ama themputna hi tahsaphe Danthu thupeh dungjui ahipon, mantih neilou hinkho khat tha neinaa konjoh ahibouve. 17 Ijeh-inem itile hettohsah nan: Melchizedek themput dol’a Nangma tonsot dia thempu nahi,” akiti. 18 Chujongle thupeh masa chu alhah sam jeh le aphatchom loujeh-in akinoi mangtai. 19 Ijeh-inem itile Danthun imacha achamkimsah lou phat’in, kinepna pha cheh khat ahung kipolut tan, hiche kinepna jeh hin Pathen kom anailut’uve. 20 Hiche hi kihahselna beiya ahipoi, adang ho vang chu kihahselna beiya thempua pang anahiuvin, 21 Ama vang hi ajah a kihahsel na to lhon’a kiseipeh-a “Pakai akihahseltai, Lung akhel kit lou ding ahi; ‘Nangma tonsot’a dia thempu nahi,’ tin,” ati. 22 Hiche dungjui hin Jesu chu Kitepna phajo phutdet’in apangtai. 23 Chule masanga chu thi nan asuhmoa aumden jing thei loujeh-uva mi tampi thempua anapang ahiuve. 24 Hichepa vang hi tonsot’a um jing jeng ahijeh-in themputna chu adang khat’a kichon thei ahipoi. 25 Ama hi hing jing ahijeh-in ama jal’a Pathen henga hung lut jouse chu amaho thalhenga taopeh a, abonchauva ahuhhing chamkimsoh thei ahi. 26 Chuti ahijeh chun chutobang thempu chungnun, athen a theng lepthol bei, boh beh lou le chonsete lah a kona kikhenhel, van mun ho jouse sanga chungnung joa kitung doh chu eiho dinga kilom mong ahi. 27 Thempu dang ho banga aman niseh le amasaa ama chonset then sona ding chule miho chonset then sona dinga kilhaina gantha atolou akhoh poi, ajeh chu amatah kilhai na gantha dia akitodoh jeh chun khat veiyin asubulhittai. 28 Danthun lhahsamna nei mihemte thempun anapansah jin, amavang Danthu nunga hung umdoh kihahselna tun vang tonsot’a dia chamkimsoh Chapa chu apansah tai.

Hebrew 8

Aphajo kitepna thah thempu

1 Akisei thulu chang pen chu: eihon hitobang thempu chung nung hi ineiyun, ama chu Van’a Chungnung pen Lalatouna jet lam’a atouve, 2 chukoma mihem tundoh hilouva Pakai tundoh ponbuh tahbeh, muntheng chungnung sunga achamtah a kin theng bol’a pang ahi. 3 Thempu chungnung jouse thilto hinchoi ding le kilhaina gantha toh dinga kitung ahin, hiche Thempu chungnung jong hin todoh thil khat aneitei ding ahi. 4 Ama hi leiset chunga um hile Thempu jong hilou ding ahi, ajeh chu Danthu dungjuiya Thempuho lah athilto hinchoi ding aumnauve. 5 Mose’n ponbuh ason ding kon’a akihilchahnaa, "Ajeh chu ven, molsang chunga nakivetsah lim dungjui banga ijakai nabol ding ahi, " ati banga chu leiset’a thempu ho hin van chunga thil um lim le ale thoa kintheng bol ‘u ahibouve. 6 Tun vang Jesu chu kintheng bolna pha chungnung achangtai; ajeh chu hiche hi ama palainaa kisemdoh kitepna pha cheh le thutep pha jo chunga kiphutdoh ahi. 7 Kitepna masa chu nolnabei hile ni lhinna pamun ding kihol khoh ponte. 8 Ahinla Pathenin miho chunga nolna amujeh-in aseiyin: "Ven, keiman Israel insung chung, Judah insung chunga Kitepna thah khat kasemdohna ding Nikho ho ahung lhunge’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye. 9 Hiche kitepna chu Apu apateu kakhuttah a katuh a Egypt gam’a kona kahin puidoh nikhoa Amaho to kasemdoh tobang chu hilou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amaho kakitepnaa aum jing pouvin, Kenjong amaho kadonlou ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye. 10 Nikho hijat nunga keiman Israel insung kakiteppiding Kitepna chu hiche hi ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye: Alunggil’uva Kadanthu ho peng ting, Hiche ho chu alungthim’uva kasut’a, Amaho dia a-Pathenu kahi ding, amaho kamite hidiu ahi. 11 Koi hile tolsung khat’a achenpi le Koi ahiya asopi jah a, ‘Pakai hen, tia Ahil lou diu ahitai. Ajeh chu aneopen’a alenpan geiya Abonchauva eihetsoh diu ahitai. 12 Ijeh-inem itile asuh khel nauva jong kahepia, achonset nau jong kageldoh kit lou ding ahitai. 13 Hichea ‘Athah’ kiti hin amasa chu aluisah tan, ipi hile luiya, tehse chu abei ding kon ahitai.

Hebrew 9

Leiset le van’a muntheng te ni

1 Kitepna masa jong chun kintheng bolna Danthu le leiset’a muntheng ananeiye. 2 Ijeh-inem itile houbuh akisondoh teng indan masapen’a chu thaomei khom le do khang chule Pathen um hetna changlhah to aumin, hilai chu "Muntheng" akiti. 3 Hiche ban’a Houbuh pondal dan ni na chu "Muntheng chung nung" akitin, 4 asunga chu gimnamtui halna sana maicham le kitepna thingkong-sana kitomkhum chu um ahin, kitepna thingkong sunga chu manna umna sana bel le Aaron tenggol pahmum chule kitepna songpheng ni chu um ahi. 5 Achunga chu Cherubim loupitah ni uma, alhaving hoa chonset ngaidam kinbolna mun chu ale lhon ahin, hiti ho hi achen achaiya tua seijou ahipoi. 6 Hitobang hin akisemin, hiche houbuh dan masa sunga chun lhacha kinbol molsoh dingin thempuho alut jing jiuve. 7 Asung nung dan nina avang chun kumkhat sungin thempu chungnung changseh khat vei bou, thisan choilou hilouva, amatah le mipin hettoh louva achonset na ho’u thenso dinga galutji ahi. 8 Lhagao Thengin kichentah a asei chu ahile, Houbuh dan masa adin laisea muntheng’a lutna lampi chu kilangdoh lou ding ahi. 9 Hiche hi tulai phat sunga thilsoh ding tekahna ahin, thil to kilhaina gantha kichoijia kitoh ho hin kilhaina neiho het khenna lunghtim umdol bangin asuchamsoh theipoi. 10 Neh le don chule twiya kisil theng thudol jatchom chom thubou ahin, kisemthah phat hung lhun kah a tahsaphe danthu jeng ahibouve. 11 Ahinla Chrita chun khut’a kisem jong hilou, hiche thilsem lah a pang lou, Houbuh lenjo le chamkimjo ding jal’in thilpha hung lhung ho thempu chungnungin ahung pangin, 12 kelchal ho le bongnou ho thisan vanga hilouvin, amatah thisan jal’in munthenga chun khat veiseh alut’in tonsot lhatdamna aphutdohtai. 13 Ijeh-inem itile kelchal ho le bongchal hi thisan, chule kella ho pumgo vutvam kithekhum chun tahsaphe bohna neiho chu asuh theng le, 14 tonsot Lhagao jal’a ama chamtah a nolnabeiya Pathen henga kilhaina gantha dinga kikat doh jeng Christa thisan chun Pathen hing jing lhacha kinbol dinga, athisa natoh chengsea kona, eihet khen nau lungthim ho hi gamchenga asuh thengjoh ding ahi. 15 Hichejeh a chu Christa chu Kitepna Thah palaiya pang ahin, Kitepna masa chung changa suh khelna neiho lhatdoh dinga athina jeh a akikouho tonsot goulo ding thutep chu akisan thei diu ahitai. 16 Ajeh chu Kitepna aum teng kitepna sempa thina phot chetna boltei ngai ahi. 17 Ijeh-inem itile Kitepna chun kitepna sempa hinlaisen ima thu aneipon, athi nungle bou kiphutdetji ahi. 18 Hijeh a chu kitepna masa jong thisan beiya kiphutdet lou ahi. 19 Hichejeh chun Mose’n jong Danthu dungjuiya thupeh chengse mipi aseipeh soh phat’in, kella ho thisan le twito, ponsandup le hyssop alan lekhabu le mipi abonchauvin athe khumin, 20 "Hiche hi Pathenin nang ho nathupehsau Kitepna jal’a thisan chu ahi, " ati. 21 Hitobanga chun houbuh le kintheng bolnaa kimang manchah jouse chu thisan athekhumtai. 22 Danthu dungjuiya ijakai chu thisan’a suhthengsoh hel ahimaiyin, hijeh chun thisan solouvin ngaidamna aumdoh poi.

Christa kilhaina gan akithan chonset asuhbei

23 Hitobanga hi van mun hoa thil ho lim vetsahnaa um thil ho jong suh theng tei ding ahin, ahin van thil tah tah ho dia kilhaina gantha phajo cheh ngai ahi. 24 Atah beh lim tobang khut’a kisa mun theng phunga Christa lut ahipon, amatah van’a lut’a tua hi eiho tha lhenga Pathen angsunga kilah jing dia um ahi. 25 Thempu chungnungin ama thisan hilou choiya kumseh a muntheng phung alut banga Christa amatah kikatdoh dinga lut matchet ji ahipoi. 26 Chuti hile vannoi bulkiphua pat aman hesoh genthei athoh matchet ding ahin, tun vannoi khag kichai kon hin chonset suhmangna din amatah kilhaina gantha din khatvei bou ahung kilahtai. 27 Mihemte dia khatvei thia chujou teng thutanna lut ding hi gotsa ahi, 28 hitobanga chu Christa jong mi tamtah chonset suhmangna dinga khatvei kitohdoh ahitan, chonset thua hilouva kinemtah a ama galdot jing ho huhhingna pe dia aniveina hung ding ahi.

Hebrew 10

1 Danthu chu thilpha hung um ding ho ale mai mai, alim tahbeh jeng jong ahiloujeh-in, kumseh a kilhaina gantha chu avel vel’a alha vangun kilhaina bol ho dingin imacha asubulhit joupoi; 2 asuh bulhit hihen, khatvei seh kisuh thenga chu kilhaina bol ho het khenna lungthim sunga chonsetna ho chu chin jingna um lou hel hile ibol’a tang louva ahinchoi jing diu ham? 3 Chuti tah sangin hiche ho chun kumseh-in chonsetna ageldohsah jotai; 4 ajeh chu bongchal ho le kelchal ho thisana konin chonset ngaidamna aumpoi. 5 Hijeh chun leiset’a ahung chun Christan aseiyin’ "Kilhaina gantha le thilto nadeipon, Keidin tahsapum joh neigonpeh tai; Ganpumgo thilto ho le chonset thensona thilto hoa jong Nalung lhaideh poi. 7 Hichun keiman kaseiyin: "Vo Pathen ven, Lekhabu sunga kachung thu jempia kisun bangin Nangma lungdei bol dingin kahunge’ kati, " tin aseiye. 8 Masanga chu Danthu dung juiya kitohji hijongle, aman aseiyin "Nangma kilhaina gantha ho le thilto ho, ganpumgo thilto ho le chonset thensona thilto ho chunga nakipah pon, lung jong nalung lhaipoi, " atin; 9 chujouvin aseipaiyin, "Ven, nalungdei lam bol din, hikoma ka-ume, " ati. Hiti hin ani channa chu tundohna din amasa chu asumangtai. 10 Hiche Pathen lungdeiya chu Jesu Christa tahsapum, a-itih a dinga khat vei akitodoh jeng jeh chun eiho eisutheng tauve. 11 Thempu jouse chu niseh a ding jinga kilhaina gantha thilto chu ato jing vangun hiche ho chun chonsetna ala mang thei dehpoi. 12 Jesu Christan vang chonset thensona din, a-itih a dinga khatvei, kilhaina thilto chu atoh-in, Pathen jel lam’a atoutai. 13 Chukelsen vang amelmate chu akeng chotpha akoipeh ding angah jinge. 14 Ijeh-inem itile Aman thilto khatseh a asuh theng ho chu tonsot’a dingin achamkimsah soh tai. 15 Lhagao Thengin jong eihettohsah nauve; ijeh-inem itile hiche jou hin aseiyin. 16 "Ni nu nung teng le keiman amaho to Kakitepna ding chu hiche ahi, ati Pakaiyin; ‘Alungthim’uva Kadanthu ho kakhumpeh ding, Hiche ho chu alung gil’uva kasut ding ahin, 17 chule achonset jouseu le Danthu asuh keh nau jouse Kageldoh kit louhel ding ahitai, " ati. 18 Chonsetna ho jal’a ngaidam umnaa chun chonset jeh a thilto ding angaitapoi.

Pathen naiyu hite

19 Sopite, Jesu thisan jal’in eihon muntheng phung jot’a, sung lhah ngamna ineiyui; 20 ajeh chu aman pondal banga amanchah atahsaphe eiho din lampi thah le ahing jing chu eihondoh peh tauve. 21 Ama Pathen insunga Thempu lenin ahung pangin; 22 hijeh chun lung dih tah le tahsan bulhingset’in chule het khenna lungthima thilse jouse kisop thengsel le tahsa kisil thengin nailut’u hite. 23 Thutep chu tahsan umtah ahijeh-in iphondoh sau kinepna hi dettah-in tuh det jingute. 24 Chule ngailutna le thilpha bolna lam’a khat le khat kisuh lip jing ding phate chan gel’u hite. 25 Mi kon khat’in akikhop nau donda achon nau banga bol louvin, Nikho chu ahung nai dol namu ahitan, hatahin kitilkhou to chehjo’u hite. 26 Ajeh chu thutah hetna kisan nung hin eihon chonset henasan boljom jing leu hen, chonset suh mangna ding kilhaina gantha kikhenlou ahitan, 27 doumah bol jouse bahgam hel ding le kavam hel ding tom ngaina meikong le thutanna ngah a kicha jinga um ding ahitauve. 28 Koi hile Mose Danthu nahsah lou chu mi ni hihen thum hile hettohsah jeh a hepina beihel’a kithat ding ahi. 29 Chuti ahile Pathen Chapa keng chotpha nei, akisuh thengna Kitepna thisan suhboh a chule lungsetna Lhagao daithang ho chun itobang khohjo cheh talen amat diu kilom nasah um? 30 Ijeh-inem itile: "Phulah chu kei kin ahi, Keiman lethut nange, " Chukit le: "Pakaiyin amite chung thu atan ding, " tipa chu koi ahi keihon kaheuve. 31 Pathen hing jing khut te nia chuh khah ding chu kichat umtah ahi. 32 Masanga khovah nachan nung geiyuva jong hesoh genthei hahsa tah thoh a napan laiyu nikho ho geldoh-uvin. 33 Hichea chun genthei thoh pum puma japi vetchah din naum’un, ahinla nang hon jong hitobang thoh ho chu nathoh piu ahiye. 34 Ijeh-inem itile songkul lut ho geiya nathoh piuva, chule apha cheh le a-itih a um jing ding gou nanei nahet jeh-uvin naneiyu kichom jeng jong kipah tah-in nathoh jo’uve. 35 Hiche hin kipaman lentah nasodoh peh jeh-uvin nakison nau chu paimang hih hel’uvin. 36 Ipijeh -inem itile Pathen lungdei bol’a thutep kisan na din thoh hat jing ding angaiye. 37 Ajeh chu: "Chomcha khat jou teng Ahung ding pa chu hunga Geisang lou dig ahi; 38 Tahsan jal’a kei dia midih changa chu hing ding, Anung chon vang achunga kahinkho kapeh lou ding ahi, " ati. 39 Eiho vang manthahna dinga nung chon ho ihipouvin, tahsan jal’a hinkho hoidoh a um ho ihibouvui.

Hebrew 11

Tahsan

1 Tahsan hi kinepna atahbeh a lah a, muthei lou thil ahisa koi ding hi ahi. 2 Hijeh a chu tahsan jal’a upate chu hettohsah a kipansahji ahiuve. 3 Tahsan na jeh a Pathen thusah a vannoi kisem le akilangdoh kha lou thil hoa kona muthei thil hung umdoh dol ihet’u ahi. 4 Tahsan na jeh a Abel’in Cain sanga Pathen henga kilhaina gantha thilto phajo atojeh-in, amidih hi na hettohsahna amun, Pathen jengin jong athilto ho chu ahettohsah tan, chule athi nung geiyin thu asei thei nalaiye. 5 Tahsan na jeh-in Enoch chu thina mulouvin atahsa akheldoh peh-in, Pathenin atasan akheldoh peh jeh-in koiman aholdoh joutapoi; tahsa kheldoh a aum masanga Pathen koma lung lhaina kimu ahi hettohsahna aum’e. 6 Hijeh chun tahsan beiya Pathen lung tohoi ahipoi; ijeh-inem itile Pathen aum je le ama holte chengse tohphat man apeh dol hi ama kom nailutten atahsan tei diu dol ahi. 7 Tahsan na jeh-in Noah chun kho nung thilsoh ding muphah lou thua hilchahna thu angaiyin, ama le a-insung huhhingna din kong innei khat asem’e, hichea hin vannoi themmo achanin, tahsan’a them channa jal’in goulo chu achangtei. 8 Tahsan na jeh-in Abraham chu potdoh a goulo dia akisan ding mun’a lut din akikou chun thun anungin, hoilam jot ding ahet lou vangin apotdoh jenge. 9 Tahsan na jeh-in tepna gamsunga hung kholjin bangin apem len, tepna gam alopi ding Isaac le Jacob chutoh ponbuh sunga acheng leuve. 10 Ajeh chu Abrahamin Pathen gontoh le asah doh bul dettah chu akat jing’e. 11 Tahsan na jeh-in athuteppeh pa chu tahsan umtah ahidol ahetjehin acha nei phat akilet tah vangin Sarah-in naovopna thei tha aneitai. 12 Hiti chun mithikonsa paa kon chun van’a ahsite jat le Twikhanglen kama neldi jat hel simsen lou chilhah apeng doh tai. 13 Amaho chengse hi tahsan ahitauvin, thutep chengse chu akisan man louvu ahitai; ahinla gamla tah a konin amu’uvin alem’un, chule amaho chu leiset chunga kholjin le khopem ahiu aphongdoh tauve. 14 Hichea hitobang thusei ho hin pugam pagam ahol dol’u aphondoh u ahibouve. 15 Amaho ahung kondoh nau gam chu geldoh kit hileu kilekitna ding phat gomkom jong anei diu ahi. 16 Tua la amahon aphajo cheh khat, van gam chu atup’u ahijeh-in, Pathen jeng jong amaho Pathen a kikou ding jahcha lou ahi; ijeh-inem itile aman amaho dinga khopi khat agonpeh ahitai. 17 Tahsan na jeh-in Abrahamin patep’a aum chun thutep changpa tahsan vangin achapa chang khatseh, Isaac chu kilhaina gantha banga todoh jeng din agoi. 18 Ama chule Isaac a kon ahi nachilhah kisim ding ahi, " tia kiseipeh ahin, 19 Pathenin athisa jong akaithou kit thei chu agel jon, tekah a seidin Isaac chu anung chankit nai. 20 Tahsan na jeh-in Isaac chun kho nung teng phatthei chang din Jacob le Esau phatthei aboh-e. 21 Tahsan na jeh-in Jacob-in athi ding konin Joseph chapate ni phatthei aboh gol’in, atenggol chunga aki-ngamin Pathen alhaiye. 22 Tahsan na jeh-in Joseph chun athi ding konin Egypt gama kona Israel chate potdoh ding ageldoh-in, ama gu le chang thudol’a thu apei. 23 Tahsan na jeh-in anu le apan Mose apen nungin lha thum asel lhonin, ama chu naosen mel-hoi tah ahidol amu lhonin, lengpa thu peh jong kicha louvin aum lhon’e. 24 Tahsan na jeh a Mose’n akhan lhit phat’a Pharoah chanu chapa kiti ding da ahi. 25 Chonset’a chomkhat nopsah sangin Pathen mite to gim hesoh thoh khom ding akilhenjoi. 26 Tohman san ding avetjoh jeh chun Egypt gama gou jou se sangin Messiah kihousetna chu thupijon agel’e. 27 Tahsan na jeh-in lengpa lung han ding ging louvin Egypt gamadalhan, mit muthei loupa chu amu bangin abol’e. 28 Tahsan na jeh-in kalchuh kut aphutdoh-in, cha peng masa sumang Vantil chun amahoa asuh khah louna din thisan chu athekhumsah-in ahi. 29 Tahsan na jeh-in Israel chaten Twikhanglen chu tolgo jot’in ajot galkaiyun, Egypt miten chutia bol agot’u le twiyin achup lih gamtauve. 30 Tahsan na jeh a Israelten Jericho khopi ni sagi avel’u le, khopi pal achimtai. 31 Tahsan na jeh a Rahab notinun gam ve-lhi ho lung monga alhunsah jeh chun thu ngailou ho to akisuh mang tha tapoi. 32 Ipi kaseibe ding ham? Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jepthah, David, Samuel chule themgao ho chengse thudol seisoh kei ding phat’in toh ponte. 33 Tahsan na jel’in lenggam tampi ajouvun, adih aphutdet’un, thutep akisan’un, Phaisameigeo kam asingun, 34 meikou laipi aphel mit’uvin, chemjem hem’a konin ahoidoh un, lhahsam na konin ahatdoh-uvin, galmun’a hatah ahiuvin, gamdang sepaite adeljam tauve. 35 Numei hon amithi sa ho’u thoudoh kit akisan’uvin adang ho jong thokitna phajo cheh aneina diuvin huhdoh a aum diu anom pouvin, hesoh genthei thoh-in aumjotaove. 36 Abang bang jong elbol le jepna thoh, bulput le songkul lut’in aum’uve. 37 Amaho chu songin asep’un, thing-at’in a-attan’un, chemjamin athat’uvin, kelngoivun le kelcha vun kisil’in avah leuvin, vaichat le bolset thoh, genthei hesoh bolset’in aum’uve; 38 vannoi leiset hi amaho umna hoi ahitapon, gamthip lai le mol le lhanga avah leuvin, songko dung le leiko dunga akisel’ui. 39 Mi hijat chu tahsan na jeha hettohsah a apan vangun thutep ga chu alopha pouve; 40 eiho beiya achamkimsoh thei louna diuva Pathenin ibonchauva dinga thilphajo cheh khat amu masah ahi.

Hebrew 12

Pakai migahsalna

1 Hettohsahna hijat pin meilhang banga eiumkimvel jehuvin einoh phahsah jouseu le ichunguva kaijing chonsetna hi pailhan, thoh hat tah-in imasanguva kilhai tetna lama hin lhaiyu hite. 2 Tahsan bulpi le kikhomna Jesu lam kat jingute; aman amasanga koisa um kipana jeh chun jum le jachatna nahsah louvin thingpel’a thina geiyin athoh-in Pathen laltouna jet lam’a atoutai. 3 Nahinkhouva nalhah dah-uva nalel louna diuvin, chonseten amadouna a thuse chujatpi aseiyu dou lhumkeipa chu geldoh jingun. 4 Chonset louna lam’a nang ho thisan long leuvin napang hih laiyuve. 5 Tilkhouna dinga nang ho chapate dol’a nakisei nau chu nasuhmil’u ahitai: "Kachapa, Pakaiyin nabolgimna chu isah louvin geldan, Aman naphosal teng jongle lung lhadeh hih-in; 6 Ijeh-inem itile Pakaiyin angailut chu abolgim’a, Chapa dia akisansa chu ajepji ahibouve, " kiti chu. 7 Bolgimna chu thoh tun tun’un, Pathenin chapate banga nasungse nau ahibouve; Pan chapa koipen gahchah louva akoiyem? 8 Chate louvin um leu chun chapa tahbeh hilouva bolamcha nahi diu ahi. 9 Hiche kalval’in jong tahsaphea eigah chah diuvin pate ineiyun amaho chu ijabol lheh-ui; achutile Lhagao ho thudol’a Pa koma chu ihinna diuva i-halut cheh joh lou diu ham? 10 Amaho chun aphasah lam lam’uva ni chom khat kahseh a dinga bou eigah chah jiu ahin, Pathenin vang eiho phatna ding, ama thenna ichan theina diuva eithoh gimsah jiu ahibouve. 11 Gahchah na hi apet tah le lung nopna ahipoi, lhaset nan akigel bouve; ahinla kho nung teng le hita bolgimna thoh ho ding hin them channa din cham nan ahung gadoh jin ahi. 12 Hijeh chun khut ngoi hon domsangun lang, khup ngoi ho jong ding janguvin; 13 Kengbaiya chu chatmoa um louva, adamjohna dingin nalampiu kisem jenguvin.

Pathen lungset donda jeh a gihsalna

14 Mi jouse to kichamna ding le thenna ding hadel’un, hiche tilouva chu koiman Pakai amu louhel ding ahi. 15 Koima Pathen lungsetna changlel aum louna ding le thingkha jung dondoh a tamtah asuhmo banga nasuhboh louna dingin ching theiyun. 16 An neh khat man dinga a-upat kijoh Esau banga alop’a le chonthanghoi bol naum louna diu vin ching theiyuvin. 17 Ijeh-inem itile kho nunga goulo tei ding adei chat vanga lunghei kitna ding mun anei tah lou jeh-in mit lhi puma ahol vangin vangbohna akipeh lou naheuve. 18 Ijeh-inem itile nang ho toh khah thei molvum, meisi pah lah lah lai, muthim lai, thimpi lah, chule khopihui lah a hungvah lut nahipouvin, 19 sumkon gin le thu kisei gin ki thong lah jong ahipoi; hiche japha ho chun ajah-uva thu chu akisei kit louna din ataojo tauve. 20 Ajeh chu, "Molvum dung chu gancha ho jeng jong atongkha chan songa selih ding ahi, " tia thu kisei chu athoh jouhel’u ahi. 21 Chule hiche thil hung kilah chu kichat um behseh jeng ahin, Mose’n jong aseiyin, "Keima kakichan kakihot hot jenge, " ati. 22 Nang ho vang Zion molvum, Pathen hing jing khopi, Van Jerusalem, Vantil asang sang lah hung lhunga, kipah thanom 23 le van’a kisun lutsah apeng masa chengse kikhopna, mi jouse thutan Pathen kom, them changsa ho Lhagao suh chamkimna mun, 24 Jesu palainaa kisemdoh Kitepna Thah a chu hung nahitauvin, hiche thisan kitheikhum na chun Abel thisan sangin thilpha jo cheh sei ding aneiye. 25 Ching theiyun thuseipa chu jopda khauvin nate; ajeh chu leiset’a thuseipa thujop louho bon ahoidoh jou lou le, van’a kona thuseipaa konin kiheimang leu hen ihoidoh louhel diu akichen jenge. 26 Hichea ogin chun leiset seh bou aholingsoh ahin, tun aman athu tep’in aseiye, "Keiman leiset keoseh hilouva Van geiya khatvei seh akaho ling ding ahi, " ati. 27 Hikoma, "Khatvei seh, " kiti hin thilsem jouse kiholingsah a kitolmang ding kichentah-in aseiyin, hitia chu suh ling theilou chengse umden ding ahi. 28 Hichejeh chun suh longhoi hilou Lenggam ikisan jeh-un thangvahna neiyu hitin, ginna le jabolna pumin alungdei lamtah-in Pathen lhachan pangu hite. 29 Ijeh-inem itile i-Pathennu chu mi kavamhel thei meikou tobang ahi.

Hebrew 13

Pathen lungdei tah a natoh

1 Kisopi ngailutna um jing hen. 2 Maljin lhunsah ding hailou jen’un, hitobang hoa hin abangin jong Vantilte geiyin alhunsah tauve. 3 Sohchang kihen ho chu toh kihentha bangin kigel’in lang, tahsaphea um jing nahi heuvin lang genthei hesoh thoh te chu geldoh jinguvin. 4 Kichen hi mi jousen jabol cheh hen, jalkhun jong kisuhboh da hen; jonthanhoi bol le mijito jonga chu Pathenin athu atan ding ahi. 5 Sum ngailut hinkhon kimang hih-un, nanei chengsen lung lhai jo’uvin; ajeh chu aman, "Keiman kadonda louhel ding, dajong kada lhah louhel ding nahi, " ati. 6 Hijeh a chu eihon kisongtah a isei theiyu chu: "Eipanpia chu Pakai ahin kicha ponge, Mihemin i-eilo ding ham?" ti hi ahi. 7 Nalamkaiteu nakom’uva Pathen Thu naseipeh teu chu geldoh-un lang, anun akhan’u phatah-in geldoh-uvin, atahsan’u chu tho’uvin. 8 Jesu Christa chu janhi tuni chule tonsot’in abang ahijinge. 9 Thuhil gotchom chom kilhoh mangsah loujen’un, lung hi lungsetna aphudet aphan, neh le chah a phu ding ahipoi, hiti neh le chah thua chonte chun phat chom nan aneideh pouve. 10 Houbuh a lhacha kintheng bol hon aneh thei lou nau maicham aneiyui. 11 Thempu chungnung hon chonset thensona ding gancha ho thisan chu muntheng chungnunga ahin choilut jiuvin, atahsapum ho vang chu polama agouvamji tauve. 12 Hijeh chun ama thisan’a mipi suh thengna dingin Jesun khopi kelkot polam’a thina athoh tai. 13 Chuti ahijeh-in ngahmun polam, ama henga potdoh-u hitin, ahouset nau chu gathoh hu hite. 14 Ijeh-inem itile hikoma hin eihon khopi det inei pouve, ahung lhung ding khopi joh chu i-hol’u ahibouve. 15 Hijeh chun Jesu jal’in vahchoina ho chu Pathen henga kilhaina bangin bol jingu hite, hiche hi ama min phongdoh ho kamsungsoh aga ahi. 16 Kikhoto them’a chule ima kikop del chu hai hih-un, hitobang hi Pathen lung lhaiselna kilhai na ahi. 17 Nalmakaiteu thun nungun lang athu ngaiyun, nang ho ding thua mopo ahijeh-un, nahinkhou avettup jing jengu ahi; hiti hin bol leu chun kipah diu ahin, achuti loule lungna diu, nang ho dia phachom lou ding ahi. 18 Keiho neitaokop jingun, ima lam jousea hoikom hijongle adih kabol nom jeh-un hetkhanna lungthim phatah neiya kigingcha kahiuve. 19 Nang ho henga dia eikilhadoh vahna dinga neitaopehna diuva atumbeh a kahin ngeh nahiuve.

Taokhum khana le salam

20 Chamna Pathen, tonsot kinepna thisan jal’a kelngoite ching minthang i-Pakaiyu Jesu thinaa kona hinpuidoh kit pan 21 alungdei lam bol dingin thilpha jousen navon kimsoh-u hen; Jesu Christa jal’in amasanga alung lhaina bol din ichunguva bol hen, Christa chu tonsot tonsot geiyin loupi jing hen: Amen. 22 Sopite, kitilkhouna thu hi angaije them dia ka-ngeh nahiuve, ajehchu keiman paltan’a nahenguva kahinsut ahi. 23 Isopiu Timothy alhadoh-u anaheuvin, ahungvah le nang ho vea kahung teng hinpui nange. 24 Nalamkaite jousen le mithengte chengse salam’un; Italy gam miten nasalam’ui. 25 Lungset nan nabonchauvin umpi hen.

Jacob 1

Salam

1 Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa soh Jacob-in gamtin’a kithecheh phung som le phung ni henga salam.

Tahsan le chihna

2 Kasopite, patepna tin chenga nachuh tengule kipanan geljo’uvin; 3 ajeh chu natahsan’uvin amolso tengle thoh hat asosah chu naheuve. 4 Ima lhahsamna beihel’a apumpia nachamkimsoh theina diuvin, thoh hatna natoh chun tong molso hen. 5 Nalah-uva chihnaa lhasam aum le it louhel le house louva peji Pathen henga thum hen, chutile kipe ding ahi. 6 Amavang athum’an lung opkaina beihel’in tahsanna jal’in bou thum hen, lung opkaina nei vang chu Twikhanglen twi hui mut lonle tobang ahibouve. 7 Hitobang mihem chun Pakaiya kona ima mu ding kiholda hen, 8 lungtho nei pasal, akiheina lam jousea lung det lou ahi.

Vaichat le hao

9 Sopi lhachomin choi-at’a aum chu kithang-atpi hen. 10 Mihaovin jong suhnem’a aum kithang-atpi hen, ajeh chu hao hi hampa banga pulloi ding ahi. 11 Ijeh-inem itile nisa hamvevua ahung sat teng hampa agop jin, pahcha ho apul’in, apahhoi jong amoljitai; hitobanga chu mihao chu akiheina lam jousea molmangji ahitai.

Patepna le lhepna

12 Lhepna thoh ham hampa chu anun nom’e; ijeh-inem itile aman athot doh tengle Pathenin ama ngailute peh dinga athutepsa hinna dinga lallukhuh chu akisan ding ahi. 13 Lhepna toh khapan, "Pathen in eilhem pate’e, " ti da hen; ajeh chu Pathen hi thilsen alhemjou pon, aman jong koima alhem patep poi. 14 Mi ama ama lunggul chun ajol lhah a akaimang jia lhep patep’a umji ahibouve. 15 Hiche lung gul phalou chu naovop banga avop’a, chonset ahindoh a, chonset chu apilhin tengle thina asohdohji ahi. 16 Kasopi deitahte, dohan lha hih-un. 17 Thilpeh pha chengse le thil-hoi chamkim josue chu chunga kon ahin, khovah Pa Pathena hung kumlha ahi, ama chu kikhel lou, ale jeng jong kihei mang lou ahi. 18 Athilsem chengse lah a aga masapen ihi theina diuva aman adei banga thutah a eihin’u ahitai.

Thujah a chule tohdoh

19 Hiche hi heuvin sopi deitahte. Mitin thu ngaiyin jangkhai cheh hen, thuseiyin ngai kham cheh hen, lungsat’in jong ngai kham cheh hen. 20 Ijeh-inem itile mihem lunghan hin Pathen din adih atong doh poi. 21 Hijeh chun thilboh jouse le git louna ho letset thil ho pai lhauvin, nahinkhou huhhung thei lung sunga kiphut lutsa thu chu lung nemin kisanjou’vin. 22 Ama le ama kilhem lhaa, thu chu moh ngai mai mai hilouvin atongjoh hiuvin. 23 Ijeh-inem itile thu chu ngaiya abol’a hilouv mi chu phatvet’a ahinkho umdol kivet mai mai tobang ahin, 24 ama le ama akiven, ache mangjin, apettah chun itobang ahi asumiljitai. 25 Amavang chamkimsohna Danthu chamlhatsah thei chu vechenkeiya hichu bol jinga, aja mai hilouva, sumil lou hel’a natoh a podoh jing jeng, hitobang mi chu athilbolnaa nun nom ding ahi. 26 Mi khattou hougut’a kigel’a, aleituh tang lou, alungthim kilhep lhah a chu ahougut jong chu moh ahi. 27 Chagate le meithaiho agenthei hesoh nau vil’a, vannoi leiset’a kona boh beh louhel’a ama le ama kihongdoh jing thei mi chu Pa Pathen dinga hougut theng le boh beh lou ahi.

Jacob 2

Langnei jeh’a gihsalna
