1 Kasopite, loupi tah i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa tahsan mi nahijeh un langnei, sihnei nabol lou diu ahi. 2 Ijeh-inem itile nakikhop nauva chun ponhoi lul tah sil’a sana khutjem kibu pasal khattou hung lut hen, chule ponse dildel kisil vaicha khutdo khat jong hung lut le, 3 nang hon ponsil lul kisilpa veuvin lang ajah a, "Nangma hikoma hin phatechan touvin, " tivuin; chule khutdo pa jah a, Nangma dingto, " ahiloule, "Hikoma kakeng khop dop a khun touvo, " tileu chun; 4 nalah-uva dat neiya thu gilou lamtah a vaihom nahilou diu ham? 5 Kasopi deitahte, ngaiyuvin. Vannoi leiset’a vaichate hi Pathenin tahsanna hao ding le ama ngailute dinga athutepna goulo ding lenggam chu chang dia alhendoh hilou ham? 6 Ahinla nang hon vaichate chu nahsah mon naboltauve. Thu tanna phunga nakailut’uva, nabol gentheiyu chu mihao ho hilou ham? 7 Nakikounau Min phatah taitoma jong amaho hilou ham? 8 Amavang Pathen lekhabua leng Danthu dungjuiya, "Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun, " kit banga bulhit na hiule, nabol pha jengui. 9 Dat naneiyu vangle chonset bol nahiuvin, Danthu sukeh dol’a themmo chang nahiutauve. 10 Koi hile Danthu apumpia nitsoh a kigel, ahivanga khatseh sukhel’a chu aboncha chunga themmo chang ahi. 11 Ijeh-inem itile, "Jonthanhoi bol hih-in, " tipa chun, "Tol that hih-in, " jong ati ahi. Jonthanhoi bolda jong le chun tol natha le Danthu sukeh nahitai. 12 Mihem jalensah ji Danthu a athu kitan ding miho bangin hiti chun thu seiyun, hitobang chun na tongun. 13 Ijeh-inem itile hepina neilou chu thutanna a hepina beihel’a kibol ding ahi, hepi nan vang thutanna ajoji mong ahi.

Tahsan le natohho

14 Kasopite, khattou tahsan neiyin kisei hen, natoh la nei hih le ipi phachom em? Hitobanga tahsanna chun ama ahuhhing thei lou ding hilou ham? 15 Sopi pasal ham sopi numei ham khat chu ponbei le nikho khat an neh ding lhasamin um hen, 16 nalah-uva khat chun, "Chamdel’in kile kit’in, lumsan lang vasettan, " ti hen, tahsa ngaichat thil ima pelouvin um le hichu ipi phachom em? 17 Hitobang hin natoh beiyin tahsan chu achangseh a athisa ahi. 18 Hichea jong hin khattouvin, "Nangman tahsan naneiyin, keiman vang natoh kaneiye, " tinte. Natoh bei natahsan chu neivetsah temin, kenjong tahsan jal’a kanatoh chu vetsah inge. 19 Nangman Pathen khatseh ahidol natsahsan ahi ong? Aphai tahsanin; ahinla thilha hon jong atansan’uva kihot hot jeng ahiuve. 20 Vo, pannabei mihem, natoh bei tahsan phatchom lou hi nahet nom mong em? 21 Ipuluiyu Abraham in achapa Isacc maicham chunga atodoh jeng jeh a hiche natoh chu them achanlo hilou ham? 22 Ajeh chu atahsan le athilbol chengsen na atoh khoma, tahsan chu natoh-in asuh chamkim joh ahi; 23 chule hichea hi Pathen lekhabu thusei; "Abraham in Pathen atahsanin, hichu ama din themchan nan akisimpeh tai, " kiti hi agui lhunge, chujongle ama chu Pathen jol kisah ahitai. 24 Hichea kon hin tahsan keoseh jal hilouva, toh molso jeh a mihem them kichansah dol namutauve. 25 Hitobang chun Rahab notinun lamthamho alhunsah a lamchom’a asolmang, hiche natoh jeh a chu them kichansah hilou ham? 26 Hiti hin Lhagao bei tahsa athisa ahibangin, natoh bei tahsan jong athisa ma ahibouve.

Jacob 3

Thuseiya lei

1 Kasopite, nang ho tampi mihil’in pan dauvin, ajeh chu mihil ho hi ichung thuu khoh cheh a akitan ding naheuve. 2 Ajeh chu eihon kisuhmona tampi itoh khajiuve. Thusei naa kipal lou mi chu pasal lolhingtah, atahsa geiya apumpia tuh tang thei ahiye. 3 Ithu’va anun theina din sakolte khu akamsunguva kamdal ivopeh-u le atahsa pumpia igot gotna kihei ahiuve. 4 Ven, kong innei ho khu, lentah ahiuvin, hui hattah-in atol ahivangin, ahehna neocha khat’a aheh pan adeina lam’a aheile ahibouve. 5 Hitobanga chu Lei jong hi tibah neocha ahivangin thil lentah a kichoisang ji ahi. Ven, gamkang iten len jongle meisi hal khat’in iti akahvamji hitam! 6 Lei hi meikou, adih lou dimset, vannoi leiset ahi; Lei hi itibah lahuva anakiphut lut ahin, tahsa pumpi hi asuhboh jia, khang lhum keiya, mei banga akah velkol’a hiche meikou hi Damun’a hung kon ahi. 7 Ganhing namkim, vacha namkim, tol’a kithol ho, twiya cheng ho ahiuvin vah-ngoi thei ahin, mihemin avah ngoi jiuve. 8 Leivang hi mihemte koiman avah ngoi joupoi, um thim thei lou thilse, thina gu dimset ahi. 9 Eihon hiche lei hi Pakai le Pathen thangvah nan jong imangun, chule Patheinin ama lim tobanga asem mihemte gaosap nan jong imang jiuve. 10 Thangvahna le gaosapna hiche kamsung khat’a hi hung kondoh khomji ahi. Kasopite, hiche ho ahitiji hi adol ahipoi. 11 Twisam phung khatseh kosunga kona twi lhum le twikha putkhomji mong em? 12 Kasopite, theichang phunga olive ga theiya, lengpiguiya theichang ga theiyem? Chitwiyin jong twitheng asemdoh theipoi.

Chunga kon chihna

13 Nalah-uva aching le hetna nei koi ham? Ama chun chihnaa hungkon nunnem nan a nun akhan le anatoh phan vetsah hen. 14 Amavang nalungthimu’va kithangset kilungdou, kichang chuna aumle nakichoiat lou diu thutah douna jong thujo nasei lou diu ahi. 15 Hitobang chihna chu chunga hungkon ahipon, leiset’a kon, Lhagao thudol hilou, thilhaa kon ahibouve. 16 Ajeh chu kithangset le kichang chuna umna chan’a kinahna le khansetna jong um tei ahi. 17 Chunga kona hung chihna vang chu amasan athengin, chuin kichamdel, kitohdel, nun nemheo, thu nungjel, hepina dimset’a ngailutna gadohji, phat lhemna le lang neina beihel ahi. 18 Chule themchanna ga chu chambolte dinga chamnaa kitu ahi.

Jacob 4

Vannoi to kihouthei

1 Nalah-uva gal kisat le kinah ho hi hoiya hungkon ham? Natibah dunguva kona nomsahna ding ngaichatna ho kisattoa hungkon hilou ham? 2 Nahagut lheh-un, neila nanei pouvin; thangset sumin tol na that jiuvin, ahinla nanei theideh pouve; hijeh chun nakinauvin, nakisat’uve. Nanei lounau hi Pathen henga nathum loujeh-u ahibouve. 3 Nathum vangun namu theipouve, ajeh chu natahsa nopsahna ding jenga nagot’uva nathum dol’u aphat loujeh ahi. 4 Jonthanhoi bol ho! Vannoi to kihouthei hi Pathen to kigalna ahi nahet louvu ham? Hijeh a chu koihile vannoi to kijol’a chu Pathen douva ama le ama kisemdoh ahi tai. 5 O-le Pathen lekhabua kisei, "Aman i-sunguva achensah Lhagao hi thengse ten’a ahol jing ahi, " kiti hi mohseh a nagel’u ham? 6 Ahin lungsetna apeh hi alenjjo cheh-in hijeh chun: "Pathenin kiletsahte chu adoudal’in, Anun nem ho chu lungsetna apejie, " ati. 7 Hijeh chun Pathen koma kipe lut’un, Diabol chu kidinte piuvin, chutile ama nakom’uva konin jamtante. 8 Pathen kom nailut’un, chutile ama nakom’u hung nailut ding ahi. Nakhut’u suthengun, chonseho; nalungthim suthengun, lungthoneiho! 9 Kisih-un, lunghem’un chule kap’un; nanuiyu chu ka-na chule nakipau chu lungkhamna soh hen! 10 Pakai mitmun kisunem’un, chutile aman nachoisang diu ahi.

Sopi chung thu tan

11 Kasopite, khat le khat kisei seto hih-un; koi hile asopi seisea ham, ahiloule asopi thu tan’a ham chun Danthu aseiset’a chule Danthu chunga thu atan ahi. Nangin Danthu chung thu natan vang le anit’a hilouva athu tanjoh nahibouve. 12 Danthu pea le thutan khatseh bou ahin, ama hin ahuhhing theiya, suh jong asuh mang thei ahi; naheng nakom chung thu tan’a pang nang koi nahim?

Kiletsah lou na dia hilchahna

13 Tun ngaitem’un, nang ho kimkhatsen, "Tuni ham jing ham le eiho khopi khatpen a cheu hitin kum khat gatham’u hitin, gakiveiyu hitin, sum veikan’u hite, " tin naseiyui. 14 Jing teng nahinkhou itobanga aum ding bon helou hel’uva. Ajeh chu nang ho hi twimei chomcha khat hung kilahjia mangkit loiji tobang bou nahiuve. 15 Hisanga chu, "Pakai lungdei ahia ihin nah-u le hiche hihen khuche hile bol’u hite, " natijoh diu ahi. 16 Tunla nang ho nahamhoitho na jouseu pi chu nakithang-at pi lheh-ui; hitobang kithang-atna ho hi phalou ahi. 17 Hichejeh chun thilpha bolje he naa bol lou mi chu achonse ahi.

Jacob 5

Mihao gihsalna

1 Tun mihao hon ngaiyuvin, nachunguva hesoh genthei hung lhung ding ho jeh hin kap’un lang maovun. 2 Nanei jouseu amon mang tan, naponsil jouseu lungin anetai. 3 Nasana nadangkau thih-eh souvin anehengsoh tan, hiche thih-eh chu nang ho douna hettohsah a panga, meikah machal banga natahsau jong aneh gam ding ahi. Nang hon la ni nu nunga din gou nakhol’uvin ne! 4 Ven, nalou laiyuva chang-at sum thalah ho doha nabol’uva tohman napeh louvu chun kho asamin, hiche chang-at ho khosap ogin chu Hatchungnung Pakai nabeng’a aluttai. 5 Nang ho leiset chunga nomsa le ninglhingin nachengun, kilhaina gantha nikhoa tha ding bangin nakivah thao cheh’uve. 6 Nang hon midihpa chu themmo nachan’un, nathat tauve. Aman la nadou thuh pouve.

Thohhat le taona

7 Sopite, Pakai hungkit kahsen thoh hat’uvin. Ven, loubol min ga pha manlu tah asodohna dingin leiset chun twilha masa le lha nukhah chu thoh hattah-in angah ngah jeng jie. 8 Nangho jong thoh hat jingun; Pakai hungkitna ding anai tah jeh hin, nalungthimu phutdet’uvin. 9 Sopite, nathuu kitan louna din khat le khat kiphun hih-un, ven Thutanpa chu kotphunga adingtai. 10 Sopite, Pakai min’a thuseiya pang Themgao ho hesoh genthei le thot hatna jouse chu vettoh a jui din kilah-uvin. 11 Ven, eiho athoh lhumkei ho chu nun nom ihiu ahi. Nang hon Job thohhat najauvin, achaina Pakaiyin ipi abolpeh jong naheuve; ajeh chu Pakai hi hepina le khotona dimset ahi. 12 Kasopite, ima jousea akhohpen chu: kihahsel hih-un, vanpan in jong kihahsel hih-un, leiset panin jong kihahsel dauvin, ipi pi hi jongle panin kihahsel hih-un; thutanna noiya nachuh khah louna diuvin "Henge" natiu le tijengun, "Ahipoi, " natiu jongle tijengun. 13 Nalah-uva hesoh genthei thoh um am? Ama chu taohen. Kipah thanom’a um am? Vahchoi la sahen. 14 Nalah-uva adammo um am? Ama chun Houbung upate kouhen, amahon ama chu Pakai minin thao nu’hen, taopeh-u hen. 15 Chutile tahsan jal’a taona chun adammopa chu ahuhdoh a, Pakaiyin ama akaithou ding, chonsetna abol khah jongle hichu ngaidam chang ding ahi. 16 Hijeh chun nadam theina dingun khat’in khat koma nachonset phongun lang, khat le khat kitaopeh to’uvin. Midihmi tao peh na chu nasatah a natong thei ahi. 17 Elijah chu eiho pendol banga mihem ma ahivangin, gojuh louna dinga lung luttah a atao le, kum thum le lhagup sungin leiset chunga go ajupoi. 18 Chuin ataokit le Vanin gotwi ahinpen leiset’in anche louhing ahinsepdoh tai. 19 Kasopite, nalah-uva thutah a kona lamvai aum a, ama chu khat touvin ahinlepui kit le, 20 hitobang chonse khat alamvainaa kona hinlepui kit a chu lamvaipa lhagao chu thinaa kona ahuhdoh a chule chonset tampi jong akhupeh ding ahi, hethem’uvin.

1 Peter 1

Salam

1 Jesu Christa Solchah Peterin Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia chule Bithynia gama kithecheh lhenchom sohchang ho, 2 Pa Pathenin ahet masah dungjuiya Lhagaova kisuthengsa, thua nung dinga Jesu Christa thisan kithekhum ho henga lungset le chamna nachunguva pung jal hen.

Hingjing kinepna

3 I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa, ahepina bulhin dungjuiya thina a kona Jesu Christa thodoh jal’a hing jing kinepnaa eihing thah kit’uva Pathen chu nun nom hen; 4 kemthei lou le boh beh lou chule 5 nang ho jong tahsan jal’a phat chaina teng phondoh dia gotsa kikoi huhhing na chu chang dia Pathen thahatnaa nakihongbit’u ahi. 6 Hichea hin phat chomkhat din patepna lamchom choma lung hem tah a nathoh tei diu hi jong le, hatah-in kipah tahnom’un; 7 hichun meiya patep nung jenga jong mangthei nalai sana sanga munlujo natahsan’u aphot chensah a, Jesu Christa hung kiphondoh teng vahchoina le loupina chule jabolna namupeh diu ahi, 8 Ama chu mu louva ngailua, tuchan geiya jong mu louhel’a tahsan’a seithei louhel’a hapa kipah a loupina dimset nahiuve; 9 ajeh chu natahsan lou na pen’u nahinkhou huhhingna nakimu’u ahitai. 10 Nang ho kipe ding lungsetna thudol gaothu anaseidoh Themgao hon hiche huhhingna thudol hi gunchutah a ahol’uva akholtohsau ahitai. 11 Koipen tah-in itobang dol’a itih phat laiya, asunguva cheng Christa Lhagaova kona, Christa thohgim ding le nunga aloupina ding ho chu ahettohsah masah a aphondoh ahidol, amahon akholtoh-u ahi. 12 Alhacha kinbol ho’u hi achang tum diuva hilouva, nang ho ding ahije ahenguva akiphongdohin, athudol hi tun van’a kona hinkisol Lhagao Theng jal’in Kipana Thupha nahung seipeh ho’uvin nahetsah tauve, hiche ho hi Vantilte jengin jong vetgun atup lheh jengui.

Hinkho thenga hing dia kouna

13 Hijeh chun kong kigah bangin nalungthim gil’in kigingun lungnemin Jesu Christa hung kiphondoh teng nakipe diu lungsetna a chun lhingset’in kinem jingun. 14 Sei ngai chate bangin um’un, masang na-ngol laiyu lunggul’a chonna chu jom hih-uvin, 15 chusangin nakoupau athen bangin nang ho jong nun le khan thengun, 16 ijeh-inem itile, “Keima kathenjeh-in nang ho jong thengun,” tin akisun’e. 17 Mi anatoh dungjui cheh a langneina beihel’a thutanpehji pa chu Pa nasah ngal’u ahile hikoma nakhopem sung seuvin ama chu ging lhumkeiyuvin. 18 Napu napateu hinpehson chonna homkeova kona mangthei sana le dangkaa kilhatdoh nahi louvu naheuve. 19 Nolna beihel le bohbeh louhel kelngoi nou Christa thisan lu tah a kilhatdoh nahibouvui. 20 Ama chu vannoi leiset bul kiphu masanga hetsa ahin, phat kichai kona hi nang ho khohsahna jeh a phondoh ahung um ahibouve. 21 Ama jal’a natahsan’u le nakinep nau chu Pathen koma aum theina dinga Christa thinaa kona kaithouva loupi sah Pathen tahsante nahiu ahitai. 22 Kisopi ngailut thengsel dinga thutah thua nunga nahinkhou nasuh thengu ahitah le khat le khat lungthim giltah-in ki-ngailuvin. 23 Nang ho hi tonsot’a um jing Pathen Thuhing jal’a athi thei hilouva thimo chilhah akona avel’a pengkit nahitauve. 24 Ajeh chu: “Tahsa mihing jouse hampa tobang ahin, Aloupina jouse jong hampa tobang ahi; Hampa agop jin, apah apuljitai; 25 Pakai thu vang tonsot’in aum jingnai,” akiti. Hiche thu hi nahenguva Kipana Thupha kiseiphong chu ahi.

1 Peter 2

Sopi hingjing le namtheng

1 Gitlouna jouse le doha lhep lhahna jouse phat lhemna ho le thangsetna ho chule kiseisetna jouse pai lhauvin, 2 naosen pengthah bangin huhhingna lama khantouna nanei theina diuvin, halpi beihel Lhagao bongnoi chu ngaicha jingun. 3 Ajeh chu nang hon Pakai mi khotona chu natep khahsau ahitai. 4 Chule Pakai, hing jing, Songpi, mihemten apai vanga Pathen dia lhentum manlu tah henga chun hunguvin, 5 nang ho jong song hing jing tobanga Lhagao in khat’a kisadoh a Thempu thengloi hiding, Jesu Christa jal’a Pathen santhei dol’a kilhaina Lhagao thilto toh ding nahiuve. 6 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lekha bua hitin akisun’e: “Ven, Zion a Songpi katun khu, Inning khompi lhentum manlu tah ahi; Ama tahsan chan chu Jum kimusah louhel ding ahi,” ati. 7 Hijeh chun nang ho atahsante din manlu tah ahin, athasan lou ho din vang: “Insa hon deimoa apaiyu Songpi chu Inning khompipenin apangtai,” akiti. 8 Chule: “Kisuh khahna Song, Kipal lhuhna Songpi asohtai,” akiti. Thu chu angai loujeh-uva kipal lhu ahitauvin, hiti dinga chu umdoh ahitauve. 9 Nangho vang nam lhentum, Lengpa dia thempu, namtheng, Pathen mite nahiuvin, hitia chu muthima kona ama khovah kidangtah a nakoudoh Pau phatna chengse chu naphondoh diu ahi. 10 “Phat khat chun Pathen mite nahipouvin, Tunvang amite nahitauve; Hepina chang lou nahiuvin, Tun vang hepina nachangtauve,” akiti.

Pathen lhachate hinin hingun

11 Deitahte, kholjin le sohchang bangin Lhagao to kigalto jing tahsepha lunggul jousea kona kihei mang dinga ka-ngeh nahiuve. 12 Chidang namdang ten nang ho thilse bol’a naseina jenguva jong nanun nakhanu chu phatsah-uvin, chutile natohphatna jouseu amu’va, athudol akikhol toh nikho le Pathen avahchoi diu ahi. 13 Pakai jal’in mihem phudoh thuneina jousea nungun; lengpa chu aboncha chunga vaipo ahin, 14 gamvaipo ho chu thilse bolte talen matsah ding le thilpha bol ho seipha dinga Pakai sol ahiuve. 15 Ijeh-inem itile thilpha kiboldoh chengsea lungthim beiho ngolna kasanmo hel’a lha ding hi Pathen lungdei lam ahi. 16 Jalente bang hiuvin, amavang jelenna chu gitlou khuna neilouvin, Pathen sohte bangin um’uvin. 17 Mi jouse jabol cheh-un, kisopitna ngailu’uvin, Pathen gingun, lengpa chu jaboluvin.

Christa thohna vetkah ding

18 In mun lhachate ijakaiyin naPakaiteu gingun athu’uvin nunguvin, mipha ho le anun nem ho keo jong hilouvin, milungkhohho thun jong nungun. 19 Ijeh-inem itile mikhattouvin Pathen ahet khen them jeh a athoh ding lom lou gim genthei hesoh athoh le hichu ama dinga vangbohna hijo ahi. 20 Ajeh chu chonsetna jeh-in min deng hen lang thip beh-in thoh thoh jeng leu chun ipi phachom am? Chusangin thilpha bolna chunga hesoh genthei thoh thoh leu chun hichu Pathen dia kipana ahi. 21 Christan nang ho dia hesoh genthei athoh a vetkah ding khat nadalhah peh-uva, nang hon ama khonung najui diu deinaa, hiche dinga chu kikou nahiuve. 22 “Aman chonset abolpon, Akamsunga jong doha lhep lhahna akimudohpoi,” akiti. 23 Houset achanin ahouse thuh pon, athohgim pet’in jong agihsalpoi; dihtah a thutanpa koma akipedohjoi. 24 Aman eiho chonset jouse atahsaphen apon, thingpel chunggeiyin apodoh-in, chonsetna jousea i-thiuva, themchanna a ihin theina diuvin aboltan, ama kijepna mahan eidamsah tauve. 25 Nang ho kelngoite banga vahcheh gam nahitauvin, tua nahinkhou vettuppeh Pa le na chingpau henga hung kilekit nahitauve.

1 Peter 3

Nupa-numeiho le pasal ho

1 Hiche bang chun numei jouse najipateu noiya kunjel’uvin, chutile thu ngailou ho jeng jong chu numeiho khanthem jeh a thu phalouva kihinsojo ding ahi; 2 nagin themjeu le nakhan themu, boh beh louhel chu vetsah-uvin. 3 Sampheh hoi le sana khi-o, leiset ponsil nihchen hoiya, polam thil’a kijem louvin, 4 Pathen angsunga manlu tah, chul thei lou, Lhagaova nunnem le lungnem, lungthimgil’a mihem giltah joh chun kijem’un. 5 Ijeh-inem itile masang laiya numei theng, Pathen’a kinem jing ho jong chu hitia hi anakijem ahiuvin, ajipateu thu thun anung’ui. 6 Sarah jong chu Abraham thun anungin, amapa chu Pakaiti geiyin aseiye; nang hon imacha ginglouhel’a amanu thilpha bol tobang chu nabol’u le achate nahiuve. 7 Hitobangma chun pasal hon jong numei ho chu alhasamjo, bel kehbai tobang ahi heuvin, jabol chansah-un lang, lungsetna hinkho naneikhomu jong ahijeh-in, chenkhompiuvin, chutile nataokhom nau suh noh phah a um lou ding ahi.

Adih jeh a hesoh genthei thoh

8 Achai nan nabonchan lungkhat hiuvin, kilainatto cheh-un, kisopi ngailut’un, kidipdap to’uvin, nun nem’un lang, 9 setna chu setnan thuh dauvin, houset chu house thuh hih-un, chusangin phatthei bohjo’uvin, ajeh chu phatthei boh lo dinga kikou nahibouvui. 10 Ijeh-inem itile: “Hinna ngailut ding deiya, Nikho phaho mu ding nom’an Gitlouna akonin alei tuh tang hen, Akamin jong doha lhep lhahna seida hen. 11 Ama chu agilouva konin kihei mang hen thilpha boljo hen. Chamna hol hen lang hichu jui jing hen. 12 Ajeh chu Pakaiyin midihte ave-lhi jingin, Atao nau angai lhi jing jenge; Thilse bolte Pakaiyin avesal jinge,” ati. 13 Nang ho thilpha bolna dinga tom ngaitah nahiule, kon nabolset diu ham? 14 Ahinla adih jal’in hesoh genthei thoh tahbeh jong leu chun anun nom nahiuve. Amavang hite ho ginna chun kicha loujen’un, lung jong lungkham hih-un. 15 Amavang nalungthim’uva Christa chu Pakai ahina bangin athengin geljingun, nasunguva um kinepna thudol chu adonga aum le kitoh chet’a donbut din phat jousen kigosademin um’uvin. 16 Lungnem le ginggeh chan bol’un, ima datkhenna pha neiyun, chutile Christa jal’a nachonphat nau seise ho chu athuseiyuva kijumso diu ahi. 17 Thilse boljeh a hesoh genthei thoh sanga, Pathen lungdei lam ahile thilpha boljeh a genthei hesoh thoh chu gamchenga phajo ahi. 18 Ajeh chu chonset jeh a nang ho dia Chritan hesoh genthei khatvei thoh a athoh a, midih lou ho dinga midih chun athoh a, nang ho Pathen kom na lhut theina diu abol ahin, tahsaphea thia Lhagaova hing ahitai. 19 Lhagaova chea, Lhagaova songkul lut ho henga thu agahil lhang lea, 20 Noah nikho laiya Pathenin lungde hattah a angauva, Kong innei kisui laisea Pathen thu ngailou lhagao ho chu agahil ahi; twisanglet’a kong sunga sohchaa chu mihem themcha, get seh bou ahiuve. 21 Tua chuche twisanglet lim’a kibol Baptize chan hin tahsaphe nen suhthengna hilouva, lungthim gelkhen themna phaa Pathen henga kitepna kisem’a, thinaa kona Jesu Christa thodoh jal’a nahuhhingu ahitai. 22 Jesu Christa chu van’a akaltouvin Pathen jetlam’a atouvin, Vantil jouse le thuneina, thahatna jouse ama noiya alutsoh tai.

1 Peter 4

Pathen lungsetna gouchingpha

1 Christan tahsphea athohgim bang chun nang ho chutobang din kivon’uvin, ajeh chu tahsaphea thohgima chu chonset’a kona ong doh del ahi. 2 Chuti ahijeh-in tahsaphea nahinna dingu phat um nalai sea jong hin, mihem lunggul lama hilouvin, Pathen lungdei lamjoh-in hungun. 3 Ijeh-inem itile khohsa louhel’a phat sotpi hi chidang namdangten atohnom lam jonthanhoi, huh, jinuh hat, nopsahna, julop, dan neiloule semthu doilim houlam’a kimang nahiuvin, hichu pha set tante. 4 Hichea hi nang hon amaho chonval manthahna chu najop lou phat’uva kidang saa natai pongjiu ahibouve. 5 Mihing le mithi thutan dinga kigosadempa ang’a amahon achung thuu akipeh lut diu ahinai. 6 Hichejeh a chu mithi ho jeng jong tahsaphea ahin laiyun, mihemdol’in athuu kitanta jong le, Pathen lama Lhagaova ahinna diuva Kipana Thupha agaseipeh ahiuve. 7 Thil jouse kichaina ding anai tai. Hijeh chun tao dingin lunglimgeh le kitim themin um jingun. 8 Imajouse chungvuma nang hon khat le khat ki-ngailutna giltah neiyun, ajeh chu ngailut nan chonset tampi jong akhujol theiye. 9 Phunchel louhel’in khat le khat kilhunsah to’uvin. 10 Pathen lungsetna Jatchom chom gouching phatah bangin, amitakip Lhagao thilpeh akisan cheh chu khat le khat kijento nan mang chauvin. 11 Koi hile thuseiyan Pathen thubou seihen; lhacha kinbol’an jong Pathenin apeh thahat dungjuiyin bol hen; chutile ima jousea Jesu Christa jal’a Pathen chu vahchoiya um jing ding ahi, Jesu Christaa loupina le thahat tonsot’a um jing jeng ahi: Amen.

Christian hijeh a hesoh genthei thoh

12 Deitahte, nang ho patepna dia nalah-uva meikou banga hung um chu, thil kidang nachunguva soh bangin datmo hih-uvin. 13 Chusangin ama loupina ahung kiphondoh teng le lhingset’a nakipana diuvin Christa thohgimna chu thoh khompijo’uvin. 14 Nang ho Christa min jal’a houset nachan’u le anun nom nahiuve, ajeh chu loupina le Pathen Lhagao nachunguva hung chua ahitai. 15 Nalah-uva koi hile toltha jeh ham, guhchat jeh ham, mi tohna chunga khut lhah jeh ham jeh-in thohgim da hen. 16 Amavang Christian hijeh a thohgim’a chun jachatnan neida hen, Christian min chun Pathen choi-anjo hen. 17 Ajeh chu thutanna ding phat hung lhunga Pathen insunga kipanding ahitan, eiho chunga akipat masah le, Pathena kon Kipana Thupha ngailoute akichaina ding chu ipi hitan tem? 18 Ajeh chu: “Midih dinga huhinga um ahahsat le Pathen ngaisah loule chonseten hoilam asuh diu hitam?” akiti. 19 Hijeh a chu Pathen lungdeiya hesoh genthei thoh ho chun hitobanga chu thilpha abol jinguva ahinkhou tahsan umtah Asempau khut’a apehdoh diu ahi.

1 Peter 5

Pathen kelngoihon

1 Christa thohgimna hetoh le ahung kiphongdoh ding loupina chankhompi chule na-upat piu khat kahijeh a nalah-uva upate ka-ngeh nahiuve; 2 nalah-uva Pathen kelngoi hon um chu chingphauvin, bol lou phamoa vetup hilouvin, Pathen deidol’in lung chamtah-in boljo’uvin, alam louva phatchom ding deina jong hilouvin, lung guttenin bol’un. 3 Nakichinsah ho chunga kipiput sah louvin, kelngoi honin avetsuiya, ajui thei din umjo’uvin. 4 Ajeh chu kelngoi Chingpipu ahung kilah teng le nang hon chul thei lou loupina lallukhuh chu nasan diu ahi. 5 Hitobang chun khangdong ho jong upate thun nunguvin. Nabonchauvin khat’in khat chunga din kineosahna chu ponsil bangin kivon’un; ijeh-inem itile: “Pathenin mi kiletsahte adoudal’in, Kineosate chu lungsetna apei,” akiti. 6 Hijeh chun Pathen ban-gol kha tah noiya kisunemsoh keiyun, chutile aman aphat cha nachoisang thei diu ahi. 7 Nalungkhamna jouseu Ama chunga sep lhauvin, ajeh chu aman nakhankho diu agel nai. 8 Lung limgeh-un, kigingphauvin. Nakidoupi Diabol chu Phaisameigeo kitumlet lut banga, koi hijongle val lhum jeng dia vah lea ahol ahi. 9 Nadoupau chu tahsan nan kidinte piuvin, vannoiya nasopite jousen jong hitobang hesoh genthei thoh hahsa hi athohsoh keiyu nahetsau ahi. 10 Lungsetna tin cheng kimsoh Pathen, Christa jal’a aloupina dinga tonsot’a dia nakoupauvin, chom khat gim genthei nathoh jou tengu le nasem phat’uva, nasuhdet diu ahi. 11 Ama chu tonsot geiyin tha hatna chang jing hen: Amen.

Salam

12 Kageldol’a tahsan umtah sopi Silvanus kamanchah a hichelekha thot chomcha hi kahinsut’a, Pathen lungsetna atahbeh ahidol hi tilkhouva kahettohsah nahiuve; hichea chun dingdet jingun. 13 Lhenchom nahipiu Babylon gama um nu le kachapa Mark-in nasalam’ui. 14 Ngailut nan kichopto’uvin, khat le khat kisalam’uvin. Christa to hingkhom jouse nachunguva cham leng hen.

2 Peter 1

Salam

1 Jesu Christa soh, solchah a pang Simon Peterin, huhhingpa Jesu Christa le i-Pathen’u dihna jal’a keiho to kibang cheh a tahsanna chang jouse henga: 2 Pathen le i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa nahet nauva konin lungsetna le chamna nachunguva lhingset’in pungjal hen.

Christian kikou le kilhen lo na

3 Ama loupina le aphatna chankhompi dinga eikoupau ihet jehuva, Pathen ngaisah a hintheina dia, thil ijakai aboncha a Pathen thahatna kona eipeh-u ahitai. 4 Vannoiya umsa tahsa lunggul manthahnaa kona jamdoh a, hichea kona chu Pathen hinna lim chu ichankhompi theina diuva, hiti thudol’a chu thutep chung nung pen manlu tah chu eipeh-u ahi. 5 Hichejeh tah chun najo chanin bol’un lang phatna chu natahsan’u belap sah-un, phatna chu hetna be lap sah un, 6 hetna chu kitim themna belap sah-un, kitim themna chu thoh hatnan belap sah un, thohhat na chu Pathen ngaisah nan belap sah-un; 7 Pathen ngaisahna chu kisopi ngailutnan belapsah un, kisopi ngailut chu ngailut nan belap sah-uvin. 8 Ijeh-inem itile nang hon hicheng hi bulhingset’a naneiyule, hichun i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa nahet nauva chatmo le ga beiya nakoi louhel diu ahi. 9 Hicheng neilou mi chu mitcho, khomu lou ahin, masang achonsetna chengsea kona kisop thengsa ahichu asumiljitai. 10 Hijeh chun sopite, nakikou nau le nakilhendoh nau chu kichetsahna din kihabol cheh kit’un; chuti bol leu chun itih chan ajong nakipal lhuh lou diu ahi. 11 Hiti dol’a chu i-Pakaiyu le huhhingpa Jesu Christa tonsot lenggam sunga lutna thei lhingset’a nanei diu ahiye. 12 Nang hon nahetsau le naneisau thutah achu dettah a pangdet hita jong leu chun hiti hohi geldohsah jing dinga kagot ahi. 13 Hiche pon-in tobang tahsaphea kahin laisea, hiti thudol hea nang ho geldohsah jinga, mit hah jinga umsah ding hi dih kasai. 14 Ajeh chu i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christan eihetsah dungjuiyin pon-in tobang hiche katahsa hi kadalhah loiding kahetai. 15 Kapotdoh nung teng geiya hiche ho hi nageldoh jing theina diuva kajochan’a na habola kabol ding ahi.

Christa loupina le agaothusei

16 Keihon i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa le ahung kit ding thu nang ho kahetsah-uva chu semthu thusim pou mangchaa seikahipouvin, alal loupina mittah a mua kaseiyu ahibouve. 17 Ijeh-inem itile aman Pa Pathena kona jabolna le loupina akisan’a, lal loupi chungnungpen a kona ahenga hung ging 0-chun “Nangma kachapa deitah nahin, nachunga ka lung alhai ta-ngeiye,” atipet tah chun 18 ama le keiho molvum theng chunga ka-umkhomuve, hiche ogin chu van’a kona hung ahi kajauve. 19 Hijeh chun Themgao thusei chu ginchatna dettah kaneiyun, nang hon jong khoh sah leu chun aphai, ajeh chu hiche hi munthim laiya khovah lhah geiya kivah tobang le nalungthim sunguva dia Jingvalpa vah tobang ahi. 20 Amasa hiche hi nahet diu ahi, Themgao thusei kisundoh jouse hi koiman achamtah a aledoh a ahilchet theidol ahipoi; 21 ajeh chu gaothusei khat cha beh jong hi mihem lungdeiya hung um doh ahipoi, Lhagao Theng cho-thouva mihemhon Pathena kona aseidohji ahibouve.

2 Peter 2

Themgao lhemho le mihil lhemho

1 Mipi lah a Themgao lhem ho anaum banga chu, nang ho lah a jong mihil lhem ho hung sohdoh diu ahi; amaho hin manthahna thuhil lhem ahinpoh doh-uva, amaho chodoh Pakai jeng jong aseilep diu, man gangtah a achunguva manthahna akilhut khum diu ahi. 2 Tampin ahuh nau nung ajuiyuva, amaho jeh a chu thutah lampi jeng jong taitom’a hung um ding ahi. 3 Jou thua kiloset sumkolveina nahin nei dingu ahi; ahinla masanga pat achung thuu kitansa chu akipel hih laiyin, asumang pau jong alulhu hih laiye. 4 Pathenin Vantil chonse ho jeng jong khen louhel’in Damun’a aleh lut jengin, hikoma chun Thupi tan ngah din muthim lah a thih khaovin ahen’e. 5 Pathen helou leiset, leiset masa, twisang alet khumsah a asuh mang chun khen aneipoi, them channa thuseiphonga pang Noah le adang mihem sagi chubou akhendoh-e. 6 Sodom le Gomorrah khopi te ni chung thu atan jong chun vutvam asosah jengin, Pathen ngaisah lou ding mite chunga thu soh vetkah nan asumangtai. 7 Huh lama kipe, chonseho jal’a hesoh gentheiya um midih Lot chu ahuhdoh-e. 8 Ijeh-inem itile hiche midih chu alah-uva chenga, danbeiya athilbol ho’u ani nia amua, ajah le them changa um ahinkho jeng jong hesoh genthei thoh a um ahitai. 9 Pakaiyin Pathen ngaisahte patep’a aum nauva kona huhdohje ahen, adih lou ho thutan nikhoa talen matsah dinga koije jong ahei; 10 ahideh chun tahsaphe lunggul lam jenga kipea chon ho, Vaipopa nah sah lou ho ahiuve. Amaho hi angol han’un, alung chamin achon’uvin, loupina changsa ho jeng jong taitom ding akicha pouve. 11 Ahinla Vantilte chu amaho sanga thunei le thaneijo ahi vangun, Pakai ang sunga amaho houset’a taitomna ima ahinlhut pouvin ahi. 12 Hiche miho vang hi lungthimbei, gamsa tobang, amangthah dinga mihem ngaiya pang mai mai ahiuvin, hetna beiya taitom ahiuve; hijeh a chu amanthahna diuva mangthah tei diu ahi. 13 Alam louva abol man’u adih lou akisan diu; sun chang laiya aning anop’a chonjeng hi lung nachimna ageluva, boh beh le nolna um ahiuvin, doha nalhep’uva nopsahna dinga nang ho to ankong aumkhomjiu ahi. 14 Amit’u la jongthanhoi na ding adimset’in, chonset bol la atang theipouve; hinkhoa dindetna beiho chu ajol lhauvin, sumselna lam jenga kihil themsa lungthim aneiyun, sapset chang chate ahiuve. 15 Amahon lam jang adalhauvin, lamhilouva akihei mang gam’un, athil dih lou bolnan sum deichaa Besor chapa Balaam lampi joh ajuitauve. 16 Ahinla Balaamin Dan asuh khel jeh chun pho na achangtan, Paomosa-nganin mihem paovin thu aseiyin Themgaopa ngolna chu asutang tai. 17 Amaho hi twi kangsa, twisamphung ho le khopi huiyin alhoh mangji meilhang ho tobang ahiuvin, amaho dinga muthim lhangkhal jing lai chu kikheh khol ahitai. 18 Ajeh chu amahon hamhoi tho nan, manlou pou aseiyun, vahthai ho lah a um, hung jamdoh nah nah ho jong tahsaphe ngaichat, huhna lama ajol lhajiuve. 19 Ajol lhah ho’u chu jalen din atepeh-un, amaho tah jongla kemmang thei soh a kihen joh ahi tauve, ajeh chu galjoupan ajosa chu soh a anei ngai mong ahinai. 20 Ijeh-inem itile i-Pakaiyu le huhhing pa Jesu Christa hetna jal’a vannoi leiset kisuhbohna tin chenga jamdohsa mihem chu, hichenga akihen-oh kit’a hicheng chun ajokit teng le aum chan’u chu amasaa sangin gamchengin akhoh cheh jitai. 21 Hi jeh chun ahet nunguva, amaho kipe, thupeh thenga kona akihei mang sangun, dihna lampi chu ahet’a ahet lou hel’u hile pha jotading ahi. 22 “Uiyin aloh anehkit jin, silngimsa vohcha bonlhoh lah a akibol kitji,” kiti paochamtuh hi amaho chung thua adih lheh jengin ahi.

2 Peter 3

Pakai hung ding tepna

1 Deitahte, hiche hi kalekha thot ni lhin na ahitai, lekha te nia hi, thoh hatna jeh a lung ngaito thengsel nanei theina dinguva geldohsah a kahinsuh thoujiu ahi. 2 Masang laiya Themgao theng ho thuseina le Pakai le huhhingpa thupeh solchahhoa kona najahsau chu geldohsah kitna ding jong ahiye. 3 Amasan hiche hi heuvin, ni nukhah teng mi jontai hatten jontai jeng apat’uva, ama tahsaphe lunggul lam jenga hung chon diu, 4 amahon, “Ahung kitna ding thutep chu hoi lamba hitam? Ajeh chu ipu ipateu la athisoh tan, thilsem jouse hi la semtila’ bep bep’in aum jingin,” atiu diu ahi. 5 Ijeh-inem itile amahon Pathen thusah a kona masang laiya pat van umsa ahile, twi lah a kon, twi jeh a leiset kisemdoh jong hi henasa kihetmo sah ahiuve. 6 Hichejeh a chu chulai vannoi leiset chu twisanglenin achup’a manghel ahitai. 7 Hiche Pathen thu ma maa chu tulaiya van le leiset jong hi Pathen hephalou te chung thu kitan’a kisuhmang nikhoa dinga kikhen’a, meiya halvam dinga kikheh khol ahi. 8 Vo deitahte, Pakai dia nikho khat hi kum sang khat tobang ahin, kum sang khat jong nikho khat tobang ahidol hi sumil loujenun. 9 Mi kon khat’in ngongkaiya agel vangun, thutep dol’a Pakai chu angongkaipoi; koima manthah ding adeilou jeh a abonchauva lung aheisoh manna diuva, nang ho jeh a, kho-ngaisot ahibouve. 10 Ahinla Pakai nikho chu gucha banga hung ding ahin; ahung ni le chun van ho chengse ging lul lul’a, kitolmang hel ding, thilbul chengse meikouva jol mangsoh ding, vannoi lseiset le asunga um na kitong jouse jong kavam soh hel ding ahi. 11 Hitobanga hi thil jouse hung kisumang ding ahitah jeh-in, itobang dol ham’a nakigot diu akhoh tai, nun le khan, thenna lam, Pathen ngaisahna, 12 Pathen hungkitna ding nikho ho ngah jingle sunai jinga naum diu ahi; ahung lhun nikho le van ho chengse meiya kouva vamhel ding, thilbul chengse jong meiyin akah a jolmangsoh ding ahi. 13 Eihon ama thutep, adih jenga umna, vanthah le leiset thah chu i-ngau ahi. 14 Hijeh chun deitahte, hicheng hi kat jinga naum nauva, ama henga nolna beihel le boh beh louva nahung mudoh theina diuvin, chamdel’a um din kihabol’un. 15 Chule sopi deitah-u Paul’in ama kipe chihna dungjuiya nahenguva ahinsutsa bang chun, huhhing channa dia i-Pakaiyu mi kho ngaisotje hi gel’uvin. 16 Alekha thot ho sunga chu hiche thudol ho asei ahin, asunga chun het hahsa tah tah jong aumin, hiche ho hi lungdet lou hon Pathen lekhabu dang abolna bangun ahilkon le jiuvin, amaho manthahna akiboldoh lo jiuve. 17 Hijeh chun deitahte, nang hon vang hemasauvin lang, kiging phauvin, achutilou le Danbeiho manthahna chun nalhoh mang thauva, panmundetsa chu nalhaso khah diu ahi. 18 Chusangin i-Pakaiyu le huhhingpa Jesu Christa lungsetna le hetnan khangtou jingun, Amaa chun loupina tu le tonsot kum khon um jing hen: Amen.

1 John 1

Hinna thu

1 Hiche hi semtil’a umsa, kajahsau, keihon mit’a kamusau, chule khut’a kathamsau chuche hinna thudol chu ahin, 2 hiche hinna chu ahung kilangdoh tan, chuche tonsot hinna, Pa koma um jingsa, keiho henga hung kilangdoh chu vechen’a hettohsah a, nahenguva kaphondoh-u ahi. 3 Keiho to ikiloikhom theina diuva kamusau le kajahsau chu nahenguva kaphondoh-u ahi. Keiho kiloikhomna hi Pa le Achapa Jesu Christa to kiloikhomna ahi. 4 Kakipa nau achamkimsohna dinga hicheng hi kahinsut ahi.

Pathen chu khovah

5 Pathen hi khovah ahiye, ama sunga muthim aum louhel hi keihon amaa kona kajah-uva, nahenguva kaphondoh-u thu kithot chu ahi. 6 Eiho amato kiloikhom’a kiseiya muthim sunga ivale vangule, jousei ihiuvin, thutah dungjuiya na tong lou ihiuve. 7 Ama khovah sunga aum banga, eiho jong khovah sunga ivale vangule, eiho khat le khat kiloikhomna nei ihiuvin, Acha pa Jesu thisanin chonsetna chengsea kona eisop thengsoh-u ahi. 8 Eiho chonset neilouva ikisei vangule, eiho le eiho kilhem lhaa, thutah chu isunguva um lou ahi. 9 Eihon ichonsetna jouseu iphondoh vangule, ichonsetna jouse ngaidam ding le then louna jousea kona eisutheng diuva, ama chu tahsan umtah le dihtah ahi. 10 Eiho chonse louva ikiseiyule, ama chu ijoubol’uva athu eiho sunga umlou ahi.

1 John 2

Eipanpiu Christa

1 Kachate, nachonset louna diu vin hicheng hi nahenguva kahinsun’e. Ahin khattou chonse jeng tajongle, Pahenga eisei champeh diu, dih tah Jesu Christa ineinauve. 2 Aman chu eiho chonset jouse thoina ahi, eiho chang jenga jong hilouva vannoi pumpi ding jong ahi. 3 Athupeh chengse init’u le ama ihetsau ahidol kichen ding ahi. 4 Khattouvin, “Ama kahetai,” atia, athupeh chengse la anit loule mijou ahin, asunga thutah umlou ahibouve. 5 Athu nit’a vang chu, hiche anitna jeh a chu Pathen ngailutnaa kisuchamkimsoh ahitai. Hichea hi ama sunga um ihiu iheuve. 6 Ama sunga um jinga kiseiya chu Christa chonchan banga chontei ding ahi.

Thupeh thah

7 Deitahte, nahenguva thupeh thah kahinsunpoi, semtil’a pat nanei sau thupeh lui chu ahibouve; na jahsau chu hiche thupeh lui thu hi ahi. 8 Muthim beisoh deh deh a, khovah tah beh hung vah pan thudol, nang ho le Christa sunga um thutah thudol thupeh thah jong nahenguva kahinsun nai. 9 Khovah sunga um’a kiseiya, asopi hotbol nalai chu tugeiya muthim sunga um ahibouve. 10 Asopi ngailua vang chu khovah sunga umah ahitan, ama sunga hin kipal lhuhna aumpoi. 11 Asopi hotbol nalai vang chu muthim sunga um, muthim sunga vah le ahin, muthimchun amit te ni achotsah jeh-in, hoilam ajot jong ahepoi. 12 Chate, Ama min jal’a nachonset jouseu ngaidam ahijeh a Nahenguva kahinsut ahi. 13 Pate, semtil’a pat ama chu nahetsau ahijeh a Nahenguva kahinsut ahi. Khangdong ho, agiloupa nanan jou phat’uva Nanghenguva kahinsut ahi. 14 Chapangte, Pa chu nahet phat’uva Nahenguva kahinsutsa ahi. Pate, Ama chu semtil’a pat nahetsau ahijeh a Nahenguva kahinsutsa ahitai. Khangdong ho, nathau aphat’a Nasunguva Pathen thu aum jinga, Agiloupa chu nanan jou phatu’va Nahenguva kahinsutsa ahitai. 15 Vannoi leiset le leiset sunga um thil ho ngailu hih hel’un; koi hile vannoi leiset ngailua chu Pa-ngailutna asunga um lou ahi. 16 Ijeh-inem itile vannoi leiset’a um chengse tahsaphe lung ngaichat le mit te nin jon lunggul’a amu, chule hinkhoa kimoh vahchoi-hiti ho hi Paa hungkon ahipon, vannoi leiset’a konjoh ahibouve. 17 Vannoi leiset le athil ngaichat lunggul abeikon ahitan, Pathen lungdei lam nol’a vang chu tonsot’a um jing ding ahi.

Christa doupa

18 Chapangte, nidan nukhah ahitan, Christa doupa hung ding najah banguvin, tun Christa douho tampi asohdoh tauve; hichea kon hin nidan nukhah ahi ihetauve. 19 Amaho hi ilah-uva kona potdoh ahiuvin, eiho lah a vang apang pouve; eiho lah a pang hileu iumkhom jing diu ahi; ilah-uva apan louvu akiphondoh theina dia potdoh ahitauve. 20 Nang ho vang Athengpa thaonu changkha nahiuvin, hijeh chun ijakai nahesoh keiyui. 21 Thutah nahet loujeh-uva nahenguva kahinsut ahipon, hiche nahet’uva, thujou ho hi thutah akon ahilou nahet jeh-uva kahinsut ahibouve. 22 Jesu chu Christa hisah louva seileppa, jousei ahiloule koi dangba hiding ham? 23 Chapa seilep jousen Pa aneilou ahin, Chapa phongdoh jousen vang Pa anei ahi. 24 Nang hon semtil’a pat najahsau chu nasunguva um jing hen; semtil’a pat najahsau nasunguva aum vang le, nang ho jong Chapa le Pa sunga um jing nahiuve. 25 Amatah-in eitep’u athutep chu tonsot’a hinna hi ahi. 26 Hicheng hi nang ho lhem lhaji ho thudol’a kahinsut ahitai. 27 Nang hon vang ama thaonu chu nakisan’uva, nasunguva aum jeh-in, nahil diu midang koima na-ngaicha pouve; amaa kona naneiyu thaonu chu thutah hiya, jousei ahilou jeh-in, ijakai thudol nahilsoh nauve. Hejih chun aman nahil bangun amasunga um jinguvin. 28 Chule tun chate, ama ahung kilah teng kisonna ineiyuva, ahungkit tengle maimohna ineilouna diuvin, ama sunga um jing jenguvin. 29 Ama chu adihje nahet’ulle, adih bol jouse hi amaa kona pengdoh ahidol jong nahet diu ahi.

1 John 3

Pathen chate

1 Veuvin, Pathen chate i-kisah thei na diuva Pan eipeh-u ngailutna hi iti natsat hitam! Chule hichu hijong ihitauve. Hijeh a hi Vannoiyin eihet louvu ahi, ajeh chu Pathen jong ahepouve. 2 Deitahte, tun eiho Pathen chate i-hitauvin, ahivangin ipi ihung hidiu akichen hih laiye. Ama ahung kilah teng le eiho jong ama to ibah diu vang iheuve, ajeh chu ama ahi na banga imu diu ahi. 3 Ama jal’a hiche kinepna nei chan chu ama atheng banga ama jong kisuhtheng ahi. 4 Koi hile chonset bol’an Danthu to kikal abol ahi, ijeh-inem itile Danthu to kikal chu chonset ahi. 5 Ama sunga chu chonset beihel ahijeh a chonset pomang dinga ama hung kilah ahi naheuve. 6 Koi hile ama sunga um jouse achonsepoi; achonse jousen ama chu mujong amukhah lou, het jong ahet khah louvu ahibouve. 7 Chate, koima kilhep lhahsah hih-un; koi hile thildih bol’a chu Christa adih banga ama jong midih ahi. 8 Chonset bol’a vang chu Diabol’a kon ahi, ajeh chu Diabol chu semtil’a pat hung chonse jing ahi. Hichejeh tah a chu Diabol natoh sumang dinga Pathen Chapa hung kilah ahi. 9 Pathen’a kona pengdoh jousen chonset aboljom jing poi, ajeh chu Pathen muchi chu ama sunga aum jingin ahi. Chujongle Pathen’a kona pengdoh ahi jeh in achonset jing ding chu ahitheipoi. 10 Hichea hin Pathen chate le Diabol chate umdol akichen’e. Thildih bol lou jouse le asopi ngailu lou jouse chu Pathen’a kon ahipoi.

Khat le khat ki-ngailuvin

11 Eiho khat le khat iki-ngailut diu hi najahsau semtil’a pat thu thot chu ahi. 12 Agiloupaa kon, asopi that’a pang Cain to ibah lou diu ahi. Ipijeh pen a aman asopi atha ham? Ajeh chu ama natoh chengse agilou jeng ahia, asopipa a jouse adih jeng ahijeh ahi. 13 Vo sopite, vannoiyin nahot’u le kidang sahih hel’un. 14 Ijeh-inem itile eihon isopiteu ingailut jeh-uva thinaa kona hinna galkai i-hi tauve. Angailu lou vang chu thinaa um jing nalai ahi. 15 Koi hile asopi hotbol tol that ahin tolthat lung sunga tonsot hinna aum lou iheuve. 16 Aman eiho dia ahinkho apeh jeng jeh hin, hichea hin ngailutna ihetauve; hijeh a chu eihon jong sopite dinga hinkho ito doh diu thil khoh tah ahi. 17 Khattou hinkhoa ning lhingin um hen lang chule asopi ngaichat neiya um amu nasan achung changa lainatpi da le, ama sunga chu Pathen ngailut na iti um thei ding ham? 18 Chate, eihon thuhom keo le kamsung jengseh hilouvin, natoh le thutah in ngailu hite.

Pathen ang’a kison

19 Hichea hi eiho thutah apang ihidan’u ihet’uva, ama angsunga ilungthima ikison diu ahi. 20 I-lung thim’un ei-oi mo tengu jongle, Pathen chu eiho lungthim sanga lenjoa ima jouse hesoh ahiye. 21 Deitahte, ilungthim’un ei-oi mo louvu le Pathen henga lung ngamna ineiyun, 22 hijeh chun thum inei tengu jongle athupeh jouse init’uva, a-angsunga alungdei lam jeng ibol jeh-un, amaa konin akisan jiuve. 23 Athupeh chu achapa Jesu Christa min’a itahsan’uva, aman eipeh-u thupeh banga khat le khat ikingailut diu hi ahi. 24 Koi hile athupehho nit’a chu Christa sunga um ahin, Christa jong ama sunga um ahi; hichea hin aman eipeh-u Lhagao jal’in ama isunguva aum i-heuve.

1 John 4

Pathen lhagao chule Christa dou lhagao

1 Deitahte, Lhagao tapou tahsan dauvin, lhagao ho chu Pathen’a kon hinam patep masauvin; ajeh chu vannoi leiset chunga Themgao lhem tampi asohdoh tai. 2 Pathen Lhagao chu hichea hi nahet diu ahi. Jesu Christa tahsaphe pua ahungna phongdoh Lhagao tapou chu Pathen’a kon ahin, 3 hitia Jesu phong doh lou lhagao jouse chu Pathena kon ahipoi, hiche tah chu Christa doupa, ahung ding najahsau chu ahin, tutah a jong hi vangnoiya um-ah ahitai. 4 Chate, nang ho Pathen’a kon nahiuvin, hiche ho chu nanang joutauve; ijeh-inem itile nasunguva umpa chu vannoiya umpa sangin achungnungjoi. 5 Amaho hi vannoi ya kon ahiuvin, hijeh achu vannoi thudol jeng aseiyule, vannoi athua nung ahi. 6 Eiho vang Pathen’a kon aihiuvin, Pathen hepan ithuu angaiye, Pathen helouvan vang ithuu angaipoi. Hichea hi eihon Lhagao tah le lhagao lhem ihetdoh-u ahi.

Pathen chu ngailut

7 Deitahte, eiho khat le khat ki-ngailu hite, ajeh chu ngailut hi Pathen’a kon ahi; hijeh chun ngailut neiya chu Pathen’a kona peng ahin, Pathen ahei. 8 Ngailut neilouvin Pathen ahepoi, ajeh chu Pathen hi ngailut ahi. 9 Chapa jal’a eihon hinna inei theina diuva Pathenin Achapa chang khatseh vannoiya ahinsol, hichea hi eiho sunga Pathen ngailutnachu kiphongdoh ahitai. 10 Hichea hi ngailut um ahi, eihon Pathen ingailut’u ahipon, amajoh-in eingailut’uva, eiho chonset thoina dinga Achapa ahinsol ahibouve. 11 Deitahte, Pathenin eiho chutia eingailut’u le eiho jong khat le khat iki-ngailut diu dol ahi. 12 Koiman imatih-in Pathen amukhapoi, eiho khat le khat iki-ngailut’u le Pathen eiho sunga uma chule amingailut chu eiho sunga chamkimsohji ahi. 13 Pathenin eipeh-u ama Lhagao jal hin eiho ama sunga i-um’uva chule ama eiho sunga aum iheuve. 14 Pan Chapa vannoi huhhing dinga ahinsol hi keihon kamu’uva kahet tohsah-u ahi. 15 Koi hile Jesu chu Pathen Chapa ahi phongdoh chan asunga Pathen um ahin, ama Pathen sunga um ahi. 16 Chule Pathenin eiho sunga ngailutna anei hi eihon iheuvin itahsan’uve. Pathen chu ngailut ahin, ngailut sunga um michu Pathen sunga um ahin, chule ama sunga Pathen um’a ahi. 17 Thupi tan nikhoa lungngamna inei theina diuva hichea hi eiho chunga ngailutna kisuchamkim ahi; ajeh chu hiche vannoiya hi eiho jong ama tobanga um ihiuve. 18 Ngailut sunga kichat aumpoi, ngailut chamkim chun kichat anodohji; kichat hin talen mat ding aneijeh ahin hijeh chun kichajing mi chu ngailut sunga achamkim theipoi. 19 Aman eingailut masah jeh a eihon ingailut’u ahibouve. 20 Khattouvin,” Pathen ka-ngailui,” ti hen, asopi hotbol le, mijou ahi. Ijeh-inem itile amusa asopibon angailut loule, amulou Pathen chu angailut thei lou ding ahi. 21 Koi hijongle Pathen ngailu chun asopi angailut tei ding thupeh Christaa kona ineiyu ahi.

1 John 5

Vannoi jousoh tahsan

1 Koi hileh Jesu hi Christa ahidol tahsan jouse chu Pathen’a kona peng ahi; chule koi hile ahingpa ngailua chun ahinsa acha jong angailui. 2 Eihon Pathen ingailutuva, athupeh chengse init’ule hichea hin Pathen chate ingailut’u iheuve. 3 Ijeh-inem itile athupeh chengse init’u hiche laitah chu Pathen ngailutna ahi, chule athupeh ho chu pohgih hahsa jong ahipoi. 4 Ajeh chu Pathena kona peng jousen vannoi hi anan jou ahitan, hiche vannoi nang joupen tah chu itahsan’u hi ahiye. 5 Jesu chu Pathen Chapa ahina tahsan mi chun vannoi ajo ahitai.

Pathen Chapa thudol hettohsah

6 Twisih le thisan jal’a hungpa chu Jesu Christa ahi, twisih keoseh hilouvin, twisih le thisan jal ahi. Hiche hettosah chu Lhagao ahi, ajeh chu Lhagao hi thutah ahi. 7 Ijeh-inem itile hettohsah thum aumin, 8 Lhagao le twisih chule thisan ahi, hicheng thum hi khat’a longkhom ahi. 9 Eihon mihem hettohsah bon isan’u le Pathena hettohsahna chu achungnungjoi, ajeh chu aman Achapa thudol ahettohsah ahi. 10 Pathen Chapa tahsan chun asunga hettohsahna anei ahin, Pathen tahsan lou vang chun Pathen ajousah ahi; ajeh chu Pathenin Achapa thudol ahettohsah, hiche hettohsahna chu aman atahsan tapoi. 11 Hiche hetohsahna chu Achapa sunga um hinna, hiche tonsot hinna, Pathenin eipeh-u hi ahi. 12 Koihile Chapa neiyan hinna aneitan, Pathen Chapa neilou chun hinna aneipoi.

Tonsot hinna hetna

13 Nang ho Pathen min’a tahsan chengsen tonsot hinna naneiyu nahetna diuva hicheng hi kahinsut ahi. 14 Eihon ipi hijongle ama lungdei lama ithum chan’u aman eingai peh jeh-uva, hiche hi eihon ama koma lung ngamna ineiyu ahi. 15 Ipi hijongle ithum chan’u eingaipeh ihet jeh-uvin, ipi tobang hileh akithum chan chu amaa kona ineisan ihetauve. 16 Khattouvin asopi chu thi lo hel theina chonset ahilou vanga chonset bol amu le taopeh hen lang hinso hen; thi lo hel theina hilouva chonse chubou kisei ahi. Thi lotheina hel’a chonset aumin, hitobang dia chu tao dinga kasei ahipoi. 17 Adih lou jouse chu chonset ahin, ahinla thi lo theina hel lou chonset jong aum’e. 18 Koi hile Pathena kona penga chu achonse jom jing poi, Pathena kona peng chun ama angah jingin, hijeh chun agiloupan atongkhapoi. 19 Eiho Pathena kona ihiuva, vannoi pumpi agiloupa noiya aum iheuve. 20 Pathen Chapa thutah ihet theina diuva thil hetkhen themna lungthim eihungpeh-u chu iheuve; eiho thutah, Achapa Jesu Christa sunga chu um ihiuve. Ama chu Pathen tahbeh le tonsot hinna ahi. 21 Chate doilim semthu hou lah a kihong phauvin.

2 John 1

Salam

1 Upa keiman lhentum Numei lalnu chule achate changse, thutah a ka-ngailut, kei chang hilouva, thutah heho jousen jong angailut ho heng, 2 eiho sunga um jing, tonsot geiya eiumpi jing diu thutah jal’in: 3 Pa, Pathen le Pa Chapa Jesu Christa konin thutah le ngailut jal’a lungsetna le hepina, chamnan eiumpi jing diu ahi.

Thutah le ngailut

4 Nachate konkhatse Paa kona ikisan’u thupeh dungjuiya chon kamun, kakipah lheh jengin ahi. 5 Chule tua hi hung tao kahi-lalnu, nahenga thupeh thah jong hinsun louva, khat le khat iki-ngailutto chehna diuva, semtil’a pat ineisau chu ahibouve. 6 Athupeh chengse dungjuiya ichon theiyu le hichu ngailut ahi. Semtil’a pat thu um najahsau bangin chonleu chun, hichu ngailut ahi. 7 Ajeh chu vannoiya hin doha mi-lhem lha tampi asohdohtai, amaho hin Jesu Christa tahsanphea ahung hi aphongdoh nompouve; doha mi lhemlha, Christa douva chu ama hi ahi. 8 Natohsa chu na-ngah louva tohga lhingset’a nasan na diuvin, nang ho ching theiyun, kivephauin. 9 Koi hile Christa thuhil’a um louva, akalval’a chon’a chun Pathen aneipoi. Thuhil’a um jing vang chun Pa le Chapa anei kop ahitai. 10 Koi hile hiche thuhil keng louva nahenguva hunga chu san dauvin, na-in’uva lhunsah hih-uvin, kam phan jong hou dauvin. 11 Ijeh-inem itile ama kamphaa houva chun ama toh gitlou jouse jong achankhompi ahitai.

Salam chaina

12 Nahenguva hinsut ding tampi kanei vangin, lekhapheng le lekhatwi maiya sut kanompoi, nakipa nau achamkimsohna dinga nahengu hungphah a kimaitoa kamchenga ikihoulim diu kakinem’e. 13 Lhentum nasopi nu chaten nasalam’uve.

3 John 1

Salam

1 Upa keiman thutah beh a kangailut, kadeitah Gaius henga: 2 Ngaitah, nahinkhoa phatthei nachan banga, ima lam jousea naphat theiya, nadam jingna din kataopeh jie. 3 Sopite phabep ahung uva nangma thutah a nachon hetsahjing banga, nathutah dol eihung hetsah-u iti kakipa hitam! 4 Kachate thutah a achon kajah a kakipa sanga chungnungjo kipana kaneipoi.

Gaius Pachat chan

5 Ngaitah, hetphah lou maljin hung hijongleu, sopite nabolna, natohna chu nakitah lheh jenge: 6 amahon jong ngailut nanei chu Houbung angsunga ahettohsah-uvin, Pathen deidol bangin amaho hi ajin nauva anathahson le chun pha lheh inte. 7 Ijeh-inem itile Christa min khohsah jal’a hungpot jeng ahiuvin, chidang namdangtea konin imacha akilah pouve. 8 Thutah a atohnau hi ikithopi theina diuva hite ho tobang hi ilem diu thil khoh tah ahi.

Diotrephes le Demetrius

9 Houbung henga thu them khat kahinsun’in, ahinla alamkaiyuva pang nom Diotrephes chun ei nahsah pouve. 10 Hijeh a chu kahung le athilbol, achonna, eiseiset nauva thu gilou asei jouseu kasosal ding ahi; hicheng abol jong hi achim hih laiyin, sopite chu alhunsah dan lhunsah dia go ho geijin aja da nalaiyin, amaho chu Houbunga konin anodoh jenge.

Demetrius phatseina

11 Ngaitah, ase jom louvin, apha chubou jomin. Thilpha bol’a chu Pathena kon ahin, thilse bol’an vang Pathen amu loulai ahi. 12 Demetrius chu mi jousen aseiphan, thutah-in jong aseiphai; chule keihon jong ama kaseiphauvin, kahettohsah nau thutah ahidol nangin nahenai.

Salam Chaina

13 Nahenga hinsut ding tampi kanei vangin, lekhatwi le lekhamol maiya sut ding kadeipoi. 14 Nangma muloi ding kakinemin, chutengle kimaiton kamchengin kihou nau hi te. 15 Nachunga cham leng hen. Goldei jousen nasalam’ui. Goldeite chu amin cheh-in panin salamin.

Jude 1

Salam

1 Jacob naopa, Jesu Christa soh natong Jude chun, Pa Pathen ngailu jouse le Jesu Christa dinga kikouva kikheh khol ho henga; 2 Hepina le chamna chule ngailutna nachunguva hapunin pung hen.

Mihil lhemho chunga thutanna

3 Deitahte, nahenguva ineikhom cheh-u huhhingna thudol lekha hinsut kagot pettah-in khatvei mi thengte kipedohsa, tahsan thua napot tho diu deina tilkhouna joh a, hinsut ding khoh kasajotai. 4 Ijeh-inem itile eiho lah a hin hitobang thudol’a achung thu tan’a themmo chang dinga koisa Pathen helou mi phabep guh thimin ahung lut’uvin, amaho hin Pathenin eipeh-u lungsetna chu huhna lamin aheidoh-un, chule ipipu le i-Pakaiyu Jesu geiyin aseilep tauve. 5 Khatvei chu nahetsau hitajongle, Pakaiyin mipi chu Egypt’a kona ahuhdoh a, anichan naa atahsan lou jeh-uva asuh mang hel thudol hi nang ho kageldohsah kitnom nahiuve. 6 Atha neinau panmun tuh det louva, apanmun dalhaa Vantilte jeng jong aman, ni loupi chungnung ni le athuu tan dinga tonsot thihkhaova ahen’a, muthim lah a akoi ahi. 7 Hitobanga chu Sodom le Gomorrah chule akimvel dunga khopi ho, alam loutah a huh le jonthanhoi lam a kipeuva, japi hilchahna dinga tonsot meikouva kihalvam’a achung thuu kitan talen kimatsah chu geldohuvin. 8 Hitobang hin hite hon mudih lou anei jeh-un tahsa asuboh-un, Pathen thunei vaipohna asan dauvin, loupina chengse ataitom jiuve. 9 Vantil pipu Michael jengin bon Mose long chung thua Diabol to akinel chun taitoma houset ding, chule achung thu tan ding angam pon, “Pakaiyin nahouse hen,” atijoi. 10 Amaho hin ahettoh lou ataitom jiu ahin, gancha ho banga atichunguva hetna ho hin amaho asuhmang gamjoh ahitai. 11 Achung’u thu akhoh-e! Amaho Cain lampi kijot’a tohman duchatnaa Balaam lampia cheuva, Korah-in doumah abolnaa chu mangthah gam ahitauve. 12 Amaho hi kidei golvah nabolnauva nolna um ahiuvin, kiphalam louhel hel’in akideitouvin, amaho le amaho akive tup’un, twi kotlou meilhang huiyin alhoh lonle, chavang laiya thingga bei, nivei thia ajung geiya kibotdoh tobang ahiuve. 13 Twikhanglen twi kinongsuh kinong tou tobang, achonthang nau twiphon banga hung phondoh bep ahiuvin, muthim lhangkhal kiheh leiloi kikoipeh, ahsi vah thai ho tobang ahiuve. 14 Adam’a pat khang sagi lhinna, Enoch chun hite ho chung chang thudol’a hi gaothu anaseiyin, “Ven Pakai chu amitheng asang sang to hunga, 15 Mitin chunga thutanna abol ding, chule Pathen helouten a-Pathen hetlou jeh-uva athilbol anatoh chengseu le Pathen hephalou chonseten ama douna thuse asei jouseu themmo ahinchan ding ahi,” ati. 16 Amaho hi phunchel le seiset hat, alunggul lam cheh a kihei, akamsunguva ham, hoitho seival val sei, phatchom ding deina mi maiya kamthem le ahiuve.

Gihsalna le tilkhouna

17 Deitahte, nang hon vang tu masanga i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa solchahten aseisau thu ho chu geldoh jing jengun; 18 ajeh chu amahon naseipeh-un, “phat nu nung lam le Pathen ngaisah lou, alunggul lam jenga chon, mi jontai hatte hung sohdoh diu ahi,” atiuve. 19 Amaho hi loitum sem ho, tahsa hing mai, Lhagao nei lou ahiuve. 20 Deitahte, nang ho vang natahsan’u thengtah chunga chun kisadoh-un lang, Lhagao Thengin tao jingun; 21 Pathen mi-ngailutnaa kihong jinguvin, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hepina jal’a napeh diu tonsot hinna chu kat jinguvin. 22 Kihol lel lung opkaina neiho chu hepiuvin. 23 Abang bang jong meikouva konin loidoh loiyun, huhhinguvin, abang jong kiphalam khen’a nahepi diu ahi; tahsaphe nen be-na ponsil nihchen geiyin theuvin.

Tao khum khana

24 Nakipal lhuh louna diuva nahongbit theiyu, aloupina masanga nolnabei le kipah thanom tah a napuilut theipau, 25 I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal’in, loupina le chungnun na thahat le thuneina jouse, phat um masang le tun, chule tonsot geiyin jong eihuhhingpau Pathen khatseh, amaa hijing jeng hen: Amen.

Henga Thuphon 1

Thu makai le salam

1 Thil hung sohvah ding ho, asohte hetsah dinga Pathenin Jesu Christa apeh a, a-Vantil asol’a asoh John henga ahetsah, Jesu Christa Thuphondoh chu, 2 Johnin amu chengse le Jesu Christa hettohsah thudol to Pathen Thu ahettohsah-e. 3 Hiche Themgao thuseidoh chengse hataha simphonga le ajahho chengse, asunga kisun nit ho chu anun nom’ui; ijeh-inem itile phat ahung naiye. 4 Johnin Asia gamsunga Houbung sagi henga; Lungsetna le cham nan unpiuvin, aum jing, asumsa chule ahung um dingpaa kon, alaltouna maiya lhagao sagi hoa kon, 5 hettohsah tahsan umpen, thinaa kona peng masapen, leiset leng jouse chunga vaihompaa konin. Eingailu’uva athisan jal’a ichonsetna jouseuva kona eisut lham’uva, 6 lenggam khat’a eisem doh-uva a-Pa Pathen kintheng bol dia Thempua eisemdoh pau, Ama chu loupina le vaihomna tonsot tonsot geiyin chang jing hen: Amen. 7 Ven, meilhang lah a ahunge, Mit jousen Ama amusoh keidiu; Ama teng’a sun ho geiyin jong amu diu, Ama jeh a leiset’a phungtin le namtinin Adip alai akidop diu ahi; hihen Amen. 8 Aum jing, aumsa, ahung um ding Hatchungnung Pakai Pahtenin, “Keima Alpha le Omega kahi,” ati.

Johnin Christa amu

9 Keima Jesu jal’a gim hesoh thotna le lenggam jeh le bolsetna jal’a nathoh khompiu, nasopiu John kahin, Jesu hettohsahna jal le Pathen thu jal’a Patmmos kisah twikol’a hi eikikoiya ahi. 10 Pakai nikho nin keima Lhagavin kana umtan, chuin kanung lama konin sumkon gin tobang ogin sangtah khat kajai; 11 hichun, “Nathilmu chu lekhabua sunin lang, Houbung sagi- Ephesus le Smyrna, Pergamum le Thyatira, Sardis le Philadelphia chule Laodicea henga thot’in” eiti. 12 Keijong kahenga thusei ogin chu vedin kakiheiyin, hitia kakiheinaa chun sana thaomei khom sagi kamui; 13 chule khomho lah a chun Mihem Chapa tobang khat, aponsil khophang te nia lenglhaa, a-opkonga sana khaopeh kivei, 14 aluchang le asam kelngaoi mul ban’a bang buhbang tobang, amit te ni meikong tobang hiya 15 akengto te ni chu, meilhum sunga kisoujolsa, sum-eng kinotval tobang ahin, chule a-ogin chu twi tamtah gin tobang ahi. 16 Akhut jet lama ahsi sagi achoiyin, akamsunga kon in hemto chamjam hemtah ahungdoh-in, chule amaivah chu sunlai nisa sat-ham pettah tobang ahi. 17 Ama kamu phat hin akhophang te ni bul’a kalhun, athi tobang in ka-umtai. Hichun aman akhut jet lamin eithamin, “Kicha hih-in, Keima akipatna le akichaina, 18 ahing jingpa, kanathin, ahinla ven, Keima tonsot tonsot’a dingin ka hing jinge; thina le thikhol khul kot-heh kaneiye. 19 Hijeh chun nathilmu chengse, aum ho hi le tu nung teng hung um ding ho hi sunin. 20 Kakhut jet lama ahsi sagi namu ho hi le sana thaomei khom sagi ho thuguh chu; ahsi sagi chu Houbung sagi sole ho ahiuvin, sana thaomei khomsagi chu Houbung sagi chu ahi.

Henga Thuphon 2

Ephesus Houbung henga thu thot

1 “Ephesus Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Akhut jet lama ahsi sagi choiya, sana thaomei khom sagi lah a vah le chun hitin aseiye, 2 “Keiman nanatohjouse le thohgim thohda nathoh jouse kahei; solchah la hilouva solchah kihisah ho jong napatep’in, ajou nau namandoh-in, hiti hin migilou ho chu nathoh nom hih hel’e. 3 Nangman thoh hahsa chu Keim amin jal’in nathoh thoh jengin nalha dah deh sampoi. 4 Ahnla amasa na-ngailutna chu nalha tahjeh-in nachunga demna kaneiye. 5 Hijeh chun hoikoma kisep lhu nahim, geldoh-in, chule lung heiyin lang, natoh masah chengse chu tong kit’in; chutia lung nahei loule nahenga hung ing ting nathaomei khom chu akitunnaa kona kachon mang ding ahi. 6 Hijongle Nicolai mi ho natoh keiman kathet ho chu, nangin jong nathen, phatna hiche vang hi naneiye. 7 Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen. Galjouva chu Pathen honsunga keh hinthing ga chu neh dia kapeh ding ahi.

Smyrna Houbung thu thot

8 “Smyrna Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Akipatna le akichaina, thia hingkit chun hitin aseiye: 9 “Keiman nathohgim hesoh navaichat kahenai, ahinla nahaove; Juda midan a kiseiyuva hila hi-ngal lou, Satan kikhopna hungkon hon taitomna aneiyujong kahei. 10 Nahin thot gimna ding ho hi kicha hih hel’in. Ven, nang ho patepna dinga nalahuva abang bang Diabol’in songkul’a ahinkhum ding, ahivang nisom bou nathothgim diu ahi. Thina geiyin thot-in tahsanin, Keiman hinna lallukhuh kapeh ding nahi. 11 Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen. Galjouva chu thi ni nan asuh nat louding ahi.

Pergamum Houbung thu thot

12 “Pergamum Houbung solle henga chun thitin sunin: ‘Hemto chemjam hemtah neipan hitin aseiye: 13 “Keiman nachenna mun, Satan laltouna chu kahei; Kei dinga tahsan um, kadinga hettohsah pha Antipas atha laiyu nikhon jong Keiya um tahsan nadalha pon, kamin natuh det jinge; Antipas chu Satan chenna mun, nang ho lah a athau ah. 14 Ahivang in na chunga demna phabep kanei ye, ajeh chuIsreael chate masanga kipal lhuhna ding koiya, doilim semthu houna sa nehsah a, chule jonthanhoi patsah dinga go Balak hilchah a Balaam thuhil choiya mi phabep naneiye. 15 Hitobang hin nangin jong Nicolai mi ho thuhilchoiya mi phabep naneiye. 16 Hijeh chun lung heiyin, achutiloule nahenga kahungvah jel’a kakamsung chemjam them’a amaho chu kasat gam diu ahi. 17 Angaina ding na thuseina neiyan Houbung hohenga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen. Galjouva chu selguh manna kapeh ding, chule che songval chunga chu minthan khat kijih ahi, akisanpa tilou koima ding in asimthei lou hel ding ahi.

Thyatira Houbunga thu thot

18 “Thyatira Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Amit te ni meikou pah lah lah tobang, akengto te ni sum-eng kinotval tobang Pathen Chapan hitin aseiye, “Keiman natoh josue le na ngailut je, natahsan le nalhacha natoh, chujongle nathot hatje, natohna jouse amasa natohsanga aphatjoh kahenai. 20 Ahinla nachunga cemna kaneiye, ajeh chu Jezebel kithemgaosah nu chu nacham lhan, aman kasohte jonthanho lam ahil’in, doilim semthu houna sa nehsahdin ajol lhai. 21 Ken amanu chu along heina ding phat kapen, hila aman ajon thanhoinaa konin lung aheidehpoi, 22 Ven, keiman amanu hi jalkhun chng se na kanei ding, hiche jonthanghoi thilbol josue a kona lung ahie louvu le ajonpi chenrsen jong thoh gentei chungnung athoh diu ahi. 23 Thina kaman a achate jouse kathagam ding, chuteng le Houbung jousen lung ngaito chengse le lungthim josue hethei kahi ahet diu, chujong le anatoh dung jui cheh-uva amitakip kalethuh ding nahiuve. 24 Ahila Thyatira a um amoh cheng, hiche thuhil jop lou, Satan thugil kiti helou chengse nachunguva pohgih dang koibe peh pouvinge. 25 Ahin nanei sun’u chu kahung kahsen tuhdet jingun. 26 Chule galjouva, kanatoh ho achaina geiya nit jing chu namtin vaipi chunga thu neina kapeh ding, 27 aman amaho chu kelngaoi chin bang thih tenggol’a achin’a, leibel kivochip banga abol ding, 28 Keman ka-Paa kona kalah thu neina jal’a am chu Jingvalpa kapeh ding ahi. 29 Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen.

Henga Thuphon 3

Sardis Houbung thu thot

1 “Sardis Houbung solle henga hitin sunin: ‘Pathen Lhagao sagi le ahsi sagi neipan hitin aseiye, “Keiman nanatoh josue kahen, amin’a hinga nahin, athisa nahibouve. 2 Khangin lang hah jing jengin, amoh cheng, athikon ho dindetsah-in; ajeh chu ka-Pathen mitmua nanatoh ho achamkimsoh kamudoh poi. 3 Hichejeh chun atil’a itobanga nakisan’a, iti najah-em geldoh jingin, nit phan, lung heiyin. Hijeh a chu nahajing loule gucha banga kahung ding, itih phat le naheng kahinsuh ding nahet lou ding ahi. 4 Amvang aponsil’u kisuh nen lou mi phabep Sardis a aum’un, amaho hi ponbang vamleh sil’a Keito kilhon le ding ahiuve, ajeh chu amaho chutidia limtah ahiuve. 5 Galjouva chu amaho kivonna ponbang vamleh a kivon ding, chule hinna lekhabua kona Keiman amin kathai mang louding, ka-Pa angsung le a-Vantilte angsunga ama min chu kasei doh ding ahi. 6 Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen.

Philadelphia Houbung thu thot

7 “Philadelphia Houbung solle henga thitin sunin: ‘Atheng le atahbeh, David kanglongheh neiya, aman ahon le koiman khah thei lou, aman akha le koiman hong thei lou, ama chun hitin aseiye. 8 “Keiman nanatoh jouse kahenai, ven, koman akha thei lou na-angasunga kot honsan kakoiye; tha them khat vang naneiyin, kathu nanit’in, kamin nasei leppoi. 9 Ven, Satan kikhpna pang ho phabep, acham cham’a Juda mi kihisah a, hila hilouhel, jousei ho chu kapehdoh ahin, ven keiman nang ka-ngailut hi ahetdoh theina diuva, na-anga sung, nakhophang bul’a boh khup’a chibai kahung bohsah ding ahiuve. 10 Nangin thoh hat dinga kasei nanit jeh a vannoi leiset pumpi chunga patepna ahung lhun’a, leiset chung cheng jouse akipatep phat teng le ken jong nang kahuhdoh ding nahi. 11 Kahungvah jet ding ahi, nalal lukhuh koman nalahpeh louna din nanei sun tuuhdet jingin. 12 Galjouva chu keiman ka-Pathen Houin khom’a kasem ding, hikoma kona chu potdoh louhel ding ahitan, achunga ka-Pathen min le ka-Pathen khopi Jerusalem thah, van’a ka-Pathen koma kona hung kitol lha, min kasut ding ahi. 13 Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen.

Laodicea Houbung thu thot

14 “Laodicea Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Amen, Hettohsahpa, Tahsan um, Atahbeh, Pathen thilsem jouse Bulpi chun hitin thu aseiye. 15 “Keiman nanatoh jouse kahen, vot la navot pon, sa la nasapoi. Navot le votngal’in lang, nasat le san gal le chun pha kasai. 16 Hitia hi lumheo bep nahiya, sa la san gal lou, vot la votngal lou nahijeh hin kakamsunga kona kakhondoh ding kon nahitai. 17 Ijeh-inem itil nangin, ‘Kahaove, sum kaneiye, imacha ngaichat kaneipoi,’ natin; nang tah chu adapen le khoto umpen, vaichatah le micho chu le sagohkeio nahilam nakihet poi. 18 Nahaona dia kakoma, kilha thengsel sana kichoh ding le, nakisil’a najamo kimudoh lou na dia nakhu jol ding pon bangle kichoh a, kho namu theina dia mitlou kichoh dinga kathu mop nahi. 19 Keiman kalungset chan kaphosal’a kaoblgimji ahi, hijeh chun tompan in lang lung heiyin. 20 Ven, kotkha bul’a ka dingin kakiu jinge, khattouvin ka-ogin ajah a kot eiho leh, ahenga kahung sung lhah a ama chu an kaneh khompia, aman jong eineh khompi ding ahi. 21 Galjouva chu ken jong kajoa ka-Pa to alaltouna katoukhom banga hi keito kalaltouna toukhomna thei thu kapeh ding ahi. 22 Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen!” tin aseiye” ati.

Henga Thuphon 4

Van’a Pathen houdol

1 Hicheng jou hin vetan, van’a kot khat honsa um kamun, chule kajah masat pen ogin chu sumkon gin tobang ahin, kahenga thu aseiyin, “Hilama hung kaltouvin, hicheng nunga soh tei ding thil ho chu kavetsah ding nahi,” eiti. 2 Apettah chun Lhagaovin kaumtan, hichun ven, van’a laltouna khat akidon, laltouna chunga chun koiham khat atouve; 3 atoupa chu jasper song le sardis song bangin alange, chule laltouna kimvel’a chun lhagui aumin, emerald song tobangin akimui. 4 Laltouna kimvel’a chun laltouna som ni le li akidon, laltouna ho chunga chun ponbang jeng kisil’a alua sana lal lukhuh jeng kikhuh, upa som ni le li atouvui. 5 Laltouna a kon chun kolphe avah lap lap’in, o-agingin, van akithinge; laltouna maiya chun mei kou jing jeng thaomei sagi aumin, hiche ho chu Pathen Lhagao sagi ho ahiuve. 6 Lalouna maiya chun Crystal song tobang, phatvet banga kimu, Twikhanglen aumin, chule laltouna lailung le akimvel’a chun, anung le amaa amit jeng amit jeng dimset ganhing li aum’ui. 7 Ganhing masapen chu Phaisammeigeo tobang ahin, ganhing ni na chu Bongnou tobang ahin, ganhing thumna chun mihem mai tobang aneiyhin, gang hing li lhinna chu Muvanlai lengpet tobang ahi. 8 Ganhing li ho chun lhaving gup cheh aneiyun, akimvel le anung lam amite jeng ahiuve; chule sun le janin choldo louhel’in la asauvin: “Atheng, Atheng, Atheng, Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung ahin, Aumsa le aum jing chule ahung um ding,” atiuve. 9 Hiche ganhing li ho chun tonsot’a hing jing jeng, Laltouna kitousah Pa chu achoi-at’a, ajabol’uva chule athangvah tengu le, 10 upa som ni le li jong chu laltouna kitousah Pa angsunga chu lhujiuva, tonsot’a hing jing jeng Pa chu chibai abohuva, laltouna maiya chu alal lukhuh-u aselhah-uva, hitia asei yuva: 11 “Ka-Pakaiyu le ka-Pathenu, Nangma bou loupina le jabolna chule tha neina changa lomtah nahi; Ajeh chu nangin thil ijakai nasemin, Nangma deiya kisem doh a um ahiuve,” Atiuvin ahi.

Henga Thuphon 5

Lekhajol le Kelngoinou

1 Laltouna Toupa khut jetlama chun, asung lam apolam, alangtoa kisun, mohor sagi jen jinamkhum, lekhajol khat kamui. 2 Chuin Vantil hattah ogin sang tah a samphong lea, “Hiche lekhajol mohorkinam ho sut lhaa lham jou dinga lom chu koipen ham?” ti khat kamui. 3 Ahinla van’a hihen leiset’a hijongle, leiset noi geiyin lekhabu chu ahongdoh theiya le avetheiya aumtapoi. 4 Hichun lekhabu phong doh thei le avetheiya akimudoh lou phat’in hakan kakaptai. 5 Hichea chun upaho lah akhat’in kajah a, “Kap hih-in, ven, Juda phunga phaisameigeo, David Jung chu hiche lekhabu phongdoh ding le amaohor sagi chu lhamla didnga galjousa ahitai,’ eiti. 6 Hichun ganhing li ho le upahon aumkimve’u laltouna lailunga chun Kelngoinou kithatsa lheh lheh khat ding kamun, ki le mit sagi gi aneiye; chule hiche ho chu leiset chun gpumpia hung kisol lha Pathen Lhagao sagi ho ahiuve. 7 Ama chu ahingin laltouna Toupa khut jetlama konin lekhajol chu alai. 8 Alah phat’in ganhing li ho le upa som ni le li chu kelngoinou angsunga chun abohkhup cheh-uvin amaho khat cheh-in akhut’uva selangdah khat le sana sumlheng dung’ah, mithengte taona chu, gimnamtui bangin akichoi cheh-ui. 9 Amaho hin lathah khat asauvin: “Lekhabu kilah ding le Mohor ho lhamlha hong din nangbou nakilom’e; Ajeh chu nangma kithatsa nahin, Nathisan’a phungtin le paotin tanga kon Mitin mitanga kona Pathen mi hi dinga nachohdohsa ahitan, 10 Nangin amaho chu i-Pathenu dia Thempu Lenggam’a nasemdoh ahitan, Hijeh a chu leiset chunga lengvai aph diu ahi,” atiuve. 11 Hichun kagah vet leh laltouna le ganhing ho chule upaho kemvel’a ding, Vantil tampi ogin kajan, amaho chu ajat sangsom jet tamtah sang jat alhinguve. 12 Amaho hin ogin sangtah-in aseiyun: “Akithatsa Kelngoinou chu Boltheina tha, haona, thahat, Jabolna, loupina chule Vahchoina kisan dinga lomtah ahi,” atiuve. 13 Chuin van, leiset chung, leiset noiya, Twikhanglen sunga, thilsem kiti jousen aseiyu kajah chu: “Laltouna chung Toupa le Kelngoinou, Tonsot tonsot geiyin vahchoina le choi-atna, Lopina le thunei vaipohna chang jing hen,” kiti ahi. 14 Hitah chun ganhing li hon, “Amen,” atiuvin, upa chengsen jong abohkhup’un chibai abohtauve.

Henga Thuphon 6

Mohor ho

1 Keima Kelngoinou chun mohor sagi ho lah a khat alhap lhah a ahondoh kamun, chule ganhing li lah a khat’in ogin sangtah a asap’a, “Hungin,” ati kajai. 2 Hijeh chun vetemin, sakol kang khat kamun, achunga toupan gophel khat achoiyin, ama chu lallukhuh khat apeuvin, galjouva jousoh peh din akondohtai. 3 Mohor ni na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in ganhing ni nan, “Hungin,” ati kajan ahi. 4 Hichun sakol chom, asan khat ahungdoh-in, achunga toupa chun leiset chung chamna alah manga, mihem khat le khat kithatona thu aneina akipen, chemjam lentah khat jong apeuve. 5 Mohor thumna alhap’a ahondoh paht’in, ganhing thum lhin nan, “Hungin,” ati kajai. Hichun vetemin, sakolvom khat kamun, achunga toupan thil tena khat achoiye. 6 Hichun ganhing li ho lah a kona hung ging tobanga kajah ogin khat chun, “Suhlou chang khai khat’in denarii khat amanin, sakolchang khai thumin denarii khat aman’e; hijongle thao le lengpitwi chu suboh hih-in,” ati. 7 Mohor li na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in ganhing li lhin nan, “Hungin” ati kajai. 8 Hichun vetemin, sakol engdang khat kamun, achunga toupa min chu “Thina” ahin, chule thikhol khul’in anung ahinjuipeh-e. Chemjam le gilkel, gamna hise chule leiset gamsaho mangchaa, leiset hop lia hop khat thatgam dinga thahat kipe ahiuve. 9 Mohor nga lhin na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in, maicham phung noiya chun Pathen thujeh le nettoh sahna jal’a kithatsa lhagao ho kamui. 10 Amaho chun going tah-in asamun, “Vo pipu, Atheng le kitah, leiset chung chengte chunga keiho phulaa thutan louva itih chan um ding nahim?” atiuve. 11 Amaho khat cheh chu poncho bangle apeuvin, asohchanpi chengseu le adopiteu, upaho kitha banga kithat ding ho akimsoh kahsea chom khat kho-ngai dingin akiseipeh tauve. 12 Mohor gupna chu alhap’a ahondoh phat’in ling nasatah kihot kamun, nichang khaodippon vom bangin avomtan lhachang pumpi jong thisan bangin asan jenge; 13 van’a ahsite chu huipi hattah-in theichang phung amut’a, apul lhah bangin tol’a apul lhatai. 14 Chule-van chu lekhajol kijel mang bangin amanghel tan, mol le lhang jose, twikol gam jouse pumin aumna mun cheh a koninakichon mangtauve. 15 Hichun leiset leng jouse le milen milalte, sepai lamkai pipu ho, mihao hole thahat ho, soh jouse le chamlhat ho geiyin songko dung le mol dunga songpiho khi kah dunga akiseltauve. 16 Amaho hin mol le lhang chule songpiho jah a, “Nei opkhum” un lang, laltouna Toupa maikoh le Kelngoinou lungsatnaa konin neisel mangun; 17 ajeh chu alungham nau nikho nasatah ahung lhungtan, hichea pang jou dding koi ham?” atiuve.

Henga Thuphon 7

Israel mi 144, 000 mohor kinam khum

1 Hiche nung hin leiset chung le Twikhanglen chunga chule thingphung khat cha chunga jong huianun louhelna dinga, leiset ning lia kon huipi tuh tang din, leiset ning lia Vantil li adin kamui. 2 Chuin Pathen hing jing mohor choiya, niso lama hung kaltou Vantil chom khat kamun, ama chun going tahin asamin, leiset le Twikhanglen suhsetna dinga thu kipe Vantil li ho jah a chun, 3 “Keihon i-Pathenu sohte chalpanga melchihna mohor kanamsoh kahseuvin leiset le Twikhanglen chule thingphung ho hi suse hih-un,” ati. 4 Chuin mohor kinamsa mijat kajah le, Israel phungtin’a kona mohor kinamsa chengse chu sang jakhat le sangsom li le sang li alhing’e. 5 Judah phunga kona mohor kinamsa sangsom le sang ni, Reuben phunga kona sangsom le sangni, Gad phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, 6 Asher phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Naphtali phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Manasseh phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, 7 Simeon phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Issachar phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, 8 Zebulun phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Joseph phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Benjamin phunga kona sang som le sang ni.

Namtin Vaipia kon Japi kikhom

9 Hicheng nung hin mipi kihon lel lul jeng, simjou lou, chitin namtin le phung tin’a kon, mitin mitang le paotin paotanga kon, abang jenga kivon’a, akhut’uva lusu na kichoiya, laltouna masanga, kelngoinou angsunga ding kamui. 10 Amahon ogingtah-in asam’un: “Hunhingna chu laltouna Toupa, I-Pathenu le Kelngoinouva ahi,” atiuve. 11 Laltouna le upaho chule ganhing li ho kimvel’a ding jing Vantil jouse, laltouna masanga chun amaiyu tol’a asulut’uvin Pathen alhaiyun, 12 asei cheh-un: “Amen, phattheina le loupina, Chihna, thangvahna jousea, jabolna Thuhatna thu neina jouse tonsot tonsot geiya I-Pathen’uva ahijinge, Amen,” atiiuve. 13 Hichea hin upa ho lah a khat’in eihin houvin kajah a, “Hiche ponabng jenga kivon ho hi koi hiuva, hoiya hungkon hiuvam?” tin eidonge. 14 Kenjong ajah a, “KaPakai nangin nahenai,” kati. Chuin aman kajah a, “Hite ho hi bolgen thei hesoh hahsa hinthoh doh a Kelngoinou thisan’a avon jouseu kisop bang ho vhu ahiuve. 15 Hijeh a chu Pathen laltouna masanga um’iva, asun ajan’a a-Houin sunga lhacha kin abol’u ahi; chule laltouna Toupa khun amaho hi ponbuh kison khum banga alekhu diu ahi. 16 Amahon gilkel dangchah athoh kit louhel diu, nisan jong san gtalou diu, asa jong thoh lou iddng ahiuve. 17 Ijeh-inem itile laltouna lailunga um Kelngoinou khu achinguva pang, hintwi nah dunga apuihoi le ding, Pathenin amit lhi jouseu atheh hulsoh ding ahi,” ati.

Henga Thuphon 8

Mohor Sagina le sana Lhengkong

1 Kelngoinouvin mohor sagi na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in van chunga nidan keh khat set athip chet’e. 2 Hichun Pathen masanga ding jing Vantil sagi chu kamun, amaho chu summon sagi apeuve. 3 Chuin gimnamtui halna sana lhengkong khat choiya, Vantil chom khat ahungin maicham phunga chun adinge. Ama chu, mithengte taona belap peh dinga laltouna mai, maicham phunga chu todoh dingin, gimnamtui tampi apeuve. 4 Hichun Vantil khut’a konin gimnamtui khu chu mithengte taona kilhonin Pathen angsunga akikhotoutai. 5 Chuin Vantil’in gimnamtui halna lhengkong chu alan, maicham phunga mei-al chu aham dimin, leiset chunga athe lhah le, van aginglul lul jengin, ogin akithongin, kol aphen, ling akihottai.

Sumkon ho

6 Sumkon sagi choi Vantil sagi ho chu sumkon mut din akigotauve. 7 Vantil masapenin sumkon amut le, thisan to kihal, gel le meikou ahung umdoh-in, leiset chunga alhai; hichun leiset chung hop thum’a hop khat akavamin, thingphung ho jong hop thum’a hop khat akavamin, chule hampa louhing jouse akavamsoh tai. 8 Vantil ni nan sumkon amut le, meikou alleng lung, molsang lentah tobang khat Twikhanglen lailunga akileh lut jengin, Twikhanglen hop thum’a hop khat thisan asoh-in, 9 Twikhanglen lailunga ganhing hop thum’a hop khat athin, kong ho jong hop thum’a hopkhat asumang tai. 10 Vantil thum nan sumkon amut le, kolphe meivah banga vah leng lung ahsi lentah khat van’a konin ahung lhan, luidung ho hop thum’a hop khat chung le teinah ho chunga achui. 11 Hiche ahsi chu amin Gamsai akisah-e. Chuin twihop thum;a hop khat Gamsai bangin akhatan, hijeh chun mihem tamtah hiche twikhat jeh chun athitai. 12 Vantil li nan sumkon amut le, nisa hop thum’a hop khat, lha hop thum’a hop khat, ahsi ho hop thum’a hop khat akivosen, abonchauva hop thum’a khat athimtan, sunlai jong hop thum’a hopkhat athimtan, janlai jeng jong hop thum’a hop khat athimtai. 13 Hichun kavet le vanlaijol’a leng le lea Muvanlai khat kamun, hichun going tah-in asamin, “Hiche Vantil thum sumkon mut dia kigo ho khun amut tengu le leiset chung chengte dinga, Ohe da na ahi, da na ahi, da na ahi!” ati.

Henga Thuphon 9

1 Chuin Vantil nga na sumkon amut le, van’a kona ahsi khat leiset chunga hung lha kamun, hi che chu akhonbei thamko kot heh apeuve. 2 Aman akhonbei thamko chu ahondoh le, tham ko sunga konin lhumpi kideng khu bangin meikhu ahung kitungdoh leng lung jengin, nisa le vanlaijol atimtai. 3 Chuin meikhu lah a kon chun khaokhopi tamtah leiset chung ahung dimtan, hiche ho chu leiset chunga aipi tha neina tobang apeuve. 4 Hiche ho hi leiset chunga hampa louhing le anche dong chule thingphung khat cha jong asuhset lou didu, achalpanguva pathen mohor kinamkhum lou mihem ho chubou asuhset diuva kiseipeh ahiuve. 5 Hiche ho hi hitobang thu neina kipeuva ahi. Chule hiche ho mihem bolgentheina chu aipin mi ade teng anat tobanga na ding ahi. 6 Hiche nikho lai le hin hiche mihem ho hin thina ahol tho diu, ahivanga amu louhel diu ahi; thi nom ten ten un tin, ahivanga thina chu akom’uva kona jamdoh didng ahi. 7 Hiche khaokhopite limso dol chu galsat dinga kigotohsa, sakolte tobang ahin, aluchunguva sana lallukhuh tobang jeng akhuh-un, amaichangu mihem mai tobang 8 Asam’u numei sam tobnag ahin, ahau chu Phaisameigeo ha tobang ahi. 9 Hiche ho hin thil a kisem ompho tobang cheh ompho aneiyun, alhaving gin’u galmun jon’a lhai sakol tamtah khotogin tobang ahi. 10 Aipi bangin mei aneiyun, eipi bangin jang aneiyui: ameiyuva chu lha nga geiya mihem suhsetna thei tha aneiyu ahi. 11 Hiche ho hin akhonbei thamkoa Vantil chu lengvaipon aneiyun, Hebrew paovin misumang tin an, apollyon ahi. 12 Da na masa akichaitan, ven, hicheng nunga hi da na ni hung nalai dingahiye. 13 Vantil gup nan sumkon amut le, Pathen angsung, sana maicham nin glia selki chengsea konin ogin khat kajan, 14 Vantil gup lhinaa, sumkon choipa jah achun, “Luipi lentah Euphrates dunga kihen Vantil li ho chu lhadoh tan,” ati. 15 Hichun mihem hop thum’a hop kkhat that dinga chuche nidan le nikho, lha le kum’a dia gotsadem’a um Vantil li chu akilhadohtai, 16 chule sakol galmi jat eikiseipeh chu sang ja ni jatni dol’in kajai. 17 Sakolte le achunga touho luchang tobang, akamsunguva konin meikou le meikhu chule kath jeng ahung kikhodoh doh jenge. 18 Meikou le meikhu, kath, gama hicheng thum akamsunguva hungkondoh chun mihem hop thum’a hop khat athat gamtai. 19 Ijeh-inem itile sakolte chu athahat nau akamsungu le ameiyuva um ahin, ameiyu chun gul bangin luchang aneiyin, hiche hoa chu mi abolgim’u ahi. 20 Gamna hichenga kithat lou, mihem amoh chengsen jong akhutsem athilsem’uva konin lung aheideh pouvin, kho muthei lou, kho jathei lou, vah le thei lou, sanaa kisem doilim ho le dangkaa kisem, sum-eng, thing, song pouva kisem doilim ho, chule thilha ho ahouvu jong atangdeh pouve. 21 tol athau, mitpheldoi achoi nau, jonthanhoi abolnau chule aguh chat nauva lung aheidoh pouve.

Henga Thuphon 10

Vantil chule Lekhajol neocha

1 Vantil chom, tha neitah khat, meilom’a kivon’a van’a kona hung kumlha kamun, aluchanga lhagui akiveiyin, amaichang nichang tobang ahin, akeng te ni chu meikou lom kitungdoh tobang ahi; 2 akhut’a lekhajol neocha phoh kehsa khat achoiye. Akeng jetlamin Twikhanglen achotphan, veilamin leiset chung achon’e. 3 Chule Phaisameigeo kitum bangin ogin tah-in kho asamin, hitia kho asap chun van-gin sagi ahung gingtai. 4 Vangin sagin thu asei chun keijong lekhaa sutdoh kagoi; “Van-gin sagi thusei chu melchih thon lang lekha sutdan,” eiti. 5 Hichun Twikhanglen le leiset chung chontoa ding Vantil kamu chun akhut jetlamin van lam asangin, 6 van le asunga um jouse, leiset le asunga um jouse, Twikhanglen le asunga um jouse Sempa, tonsot tonsot’a hing jing jeng Pa min panin akihahsel’in, “Phat sotta lou ding ahi; 7 Vantil sagi lhinna ogin phat, sumkon amut teng le, aman asohte Themgao ho henga aphondoh banga Pathen thilgon kiselguh chu hung guilhung ding ahi,” ati. 8 Chuin van’a kona ogin kaijah chun kahenga thu ahinsei kit leuvin, “Chen lang Twikhanglen le leiset chun chontoa ding Vantil khut’a phoh kehsa um lekhajol khu galan,” eiti. 9 Hijeh chun Vantil henga chun kachen lekhajol neo chu eipeh din kaseiye.
