Aman kajah a, “Kilah-in lang nen, na-oisunga thuh-in tin, nakamsunga vang khoiju lhum banga lhum ding ahi,” eiti. 10 Ken jong Vantil khut’a kon chun lekha jol chu kalan kaneh jeng le, kakamsunga khoiju lhumin alhumin, ahila kaneh jou chun ka-oisunga athuh cheh chuh jenge. 11 Hichun kajah a, “Nangman mitin mitang, chitin namtin, paotin paotang chule leng ho thudol’a gaothu naseikit ding ahi,” eikiti.

Henga Thuphon 11

Hettohsah

1 Hichun tenggol lheh lheh thil ten a mol-lhon khat eikipen, :Kipatdoh-in lang Pathen Houin le maicham khu tedoh-in, khukoma Pathen houho chengse jong simtoh-in. 2 Amavang Houin polam leitol khu khenni lang tedoh dan, ajeh chu iche lai khu chiding namdangte kipedoh ahitan, amahon khopi theng chu lha som li le lha ni sunga kengto chotpha anei diu ahi. 3 Chule kathu hettohsah te ni chu thu neina kapeh a, ama nin khaodip pon kisil’a, nikho sang khat l eja ni to somgup sunga gaothu asi lhon ding ahi,” ati. 4 Hiche te ni chu leiset Pakai ang’a ding jing Olive thingphung te ni le Thaomei khom te ni chu ahi lhon’e. 5 Hiche te ni hi khattouvin bolset ding agot jousea akamsunglhon’a meikou hung deujah jia, amelmate chu akahvam jengji ahi; amani bolset go jouse chu hitobanga hi kithat tei ding ahijenge. 6 Amani hi gaothu asei lai sungse lhon’a go juh louna dinga vanlaijol geiya khah chah jeng thei tha nei ahi lhon’e. Chu jongle amani hin twiho geiya thisan sosah theina tha anei lhon’e, chule adei phat phat lhon’a leiset’a jong gamna hise alansah nom nom lansah theina tha anei lhon ahi. 7 Hite ni hin hettohsah abolchai lhon teng l eakhonbei thamkoa hung potdoh sahem chun achung lhon’a gal abol’a, ajoa ani lhon’a atha ding ahi. 8 tekah a Sodom le Egypt kisah khopi lentah, a-Pakaiyu Thingpel’a kikhetbeh na khopi sung lamlen a chu along lhon kijam ding ahi. 9 Mitin mitang, phungtin, paotin tang le chitin namtin’a kon miten nithum le akeh geiya along lhon chu avet ve jeng diu ahi; along lhon chu lhan a vui ding nom lou diu ahiye. 10 Leiset chung chengte jouse amani chunga kipah thanomuva, khat le khat deichom thil kithot to ding ahiuve; ijeh-inem itile hiche Themgao te ni hin leiset chung chengte abolgim lheh jeng lhon’e. 11 Ahinla nithum le akeh nungin Pathen’a konin hinna hu ahungin asung lhon’a alut phat’in, amani mupha chan akicha lheh jenguve. 12 Hichun, “Hikoma hung kaltou lhonin,” tia ajah lhon’a thu sei van’a kon ogin nasatah khat aja lhonin, amelmateuvin avet vet pet tah-in van jonin meilom khat’in akitoltou lhontai. 13 Hiche pettah hin ling nasa tah akihot’in, khopi hop som’a hop khat achimtan, ling kihot chunmihem sang sagi athin, athimoh cheng atijat lot’uvin Pathen avahchoilo tauve. 14 Gamna ni na akicahitan, ven, gamna thumna chu hung lhung vahjet ding ahi.

Sumkon sagi lhinna

15 Vantil sagi nan sumkon amut le van’a konin ogin nasatah tah tampin ahinjomin: “Vannoi leiset chunga lengvaipohna chu I-Pakaiyule a-Christa chang ahitan, Aman tonsot tonsot’a lengvai apoh ding ahi,” atiuve. 16 Chutah chun Pathen angsung, laltouna tou, upa som ni le li ho chu bohkhup’in tol’a mai asulut’un Pathen alhaiyun, 17 aseiyuvin: “Vo Pakai Pathen Hachungnung, Aum jingsa le aum jing jeng, Keihon nangma kathangvah-ui; Ajeh chu nangin nathahat chungnung mangchan lengvai napotai. 18 Ipijeh-inem itile namtin vaipi along hangun, Hichun nangma lunghan ahung lhung paiye; Mithi ho thutanpeh phat, Nasoh Themgao ho, naming gangkhen cha um namithengte, Alen hihen aneo hijongle kipaman peh phat, Leiset sumang ho suhmang phat ahungtai,” atiuve. 19 Hichun van’a Pathen Houin akihongin,, chule a-Houin sunga um kitepna thingkong chu akimui; chuin kolaphen, ogin akithongin, van aging lul lul’in, ling akihot’in, gel len nasatah alhai.

Henga Thuphon 12

Numeinu le Dragon

1 Van’a melchihna lentah kha ahung kilah-in, nisaa kijem, akengto te nia lhachang um, aluchunga ahsi som le ni lallukhuh a kikhuh numei khat ahi. 2 hiche nu hi agaiyin, naoso nat thohgimin hapenin apenge. 3 Van’a melchihna achom khat jong ahung kilah-in, vetan, Dragon san, lentah, ameiyin vanlaijol’a ahsite hop thum’a hop khat ajep’in, leiset chunga asep lhai. 4 Chule nao aso lhah lhah le val lhum jeng din Dragon chu numei nu masanga ading jinge. 5 Chuin amanun naosen pasal khat ahingin, naosen hin namtin vaipi chung thih tenggol choiya vai apoh ding ahi. Hichun naosen chu akisalhah peh-in Pathen heng, alaltounana maiya akilhoh toutai. 6 Chuphat’in numei nu chu gamthip lama ajam mangin, hikoma chu nikho sang khat le ja ni to somgup geiya akivahna ding mun Pathenin agonpehsa ahi. 7 Hichun Van’a gal asoh-in, Michael le a-Vantilte chu Dragon to akisat tauve. Dragon le a-Vantilten jong asat thuh-uvin, 8 aivangin Dragon ahatjou tapon, akhon nan van’a amaho ding mun akiholmotai. 9 Chutah chun Dragon len, khangluipeh a gulpi, Diabol le Satan kiti, vannoi pumpi lhemlhapa chu leiset chunga akisonlhan, a-Vantilte jong ama pumin akisot lhah thai. 10 Chuin van’a konin ogin nasatah khat kajan, hichun aseiyin: “Akhon nan i-Pathenu huhhingna le tha neina, Lenggam, chule a-Christa thu neina akiphongtai; Ijeh-inem itile isopiteu hehsepa, I-Pathenu angsunga sun le jan’a amaho hehsepa chu akisonlhatai. 11 Amahon ama chu Kelngoinou thisan jal le Ahettohsah nau thu vanga ajou ahitai; Ajeh chu amaho hinkho geiya Itcha louhel’a thi geiya pang lhumkei ahiuve. 12 Hichejeh hin vanmun jouse le asunga cheng jouse kipah-un, Ohe, leiset le Twikhanglen ada nahiuve, Ajeh hcu lungsat chungnung neiya phat chomcha anei hea Lunghang tah a Diabol nahenguva hung kumsuh ahitai,” ati. 13 Leiset chunga akisot lhah amu phat’in Dragon chun naosen pasal khat hing’a numei chu anung adel le jenge. 14 Chuphat’in numei nu chu gulpi masanga akikhindal’a, kumthum le akeh geiya akivahna ding mun gamthip lama alen mang theina din Muvanlai lentah khat lhaving te ni apeuvin ahi. 15 Ahin gulpin akamsunga twi vadung long bangin alondoh dah-in, numei nu nung adelsah-in, lhoh mangsah din agoi. 16 Ahivangin leiset’in numei chuakithopin, hiti hin leiset’in kam akan, Dragonin akamsunga alondohsah twi chu achopkang hel’e. 17 Chutah-in Dragon chu numei nu chunga along hangtan, hijeh chun Pathen thupeh chengse nit’a, Jesu thu hettohsah nei, amanu chate amoh chengse chutoh kisat din akondohtai. 18 Chuin Twikhanglen neldi chunga agadingtai.

Henga Thuphon 13

Sahem ni

1 Twikhanglen’a kona sahem khat hung kaldoh kamun, ki, som, luchang sagi aneiyin, aki som chunga chun lallukhuh khat cheh aumin, chule aluchang ho chunga taitom min apui. 2 Sahem kamu chu lutnu to abangin, akeng te ni chu savom a tobang, akam chu Phaisameigeo kam tobang ahi. Dragonin sahem chu atha neina le alaltouna chule athu neina nasatah apetai. 3 Aluchang ho khat chu thi thei hel’a kimavo tobang ahin, ahinla akimavona chu damdoh kit’a ahitai. Vannoi pumpin kidang san aveuvin, sahem nung hcu ajuiyui. 4 Athu neina sahem apeh jeh-in mihon Dragon chu ahouvun, sahem jong chu ahouvun, “Hiche sahem ti kibang koi hiya, kon adouva akisatpi thei ding ham?” atiuve. 5 Sahem chu hamhoithona le taitom thuseina kam apeuvin, lha som li le lha ni geiya thilbolna ding thu neina apeuve. 6 Chuin Pathen taitom thu seinan kam akeh pantan, amin le achen mun chule van’a chedng jouse ataitomtai. 7 Mithengte to kisat’a abonchauva ajo na din thilbol theina apeuvin, phung tin le mitin tang, paotin tang le chitin namtin chunga thu neina jong apeutauve. 8 Chutah le leisetchung chedng, leiset bul kiphudoh til’a pat kithatsa Kelngoinou hinna lekhabua amin kisut lou chengsen sahem chu ahou diu ahi. 9 “Angaina ding na neiyan ngai hen! 10 Sohchang ding chu sohchang tei ding, chemjam hema lou ding jong chu chemjam hem’a lou tei ding ahi. Hichea hi mitheng dinga thot hat le tahsan ngai ahi,” ati. 11 Hichun leiset’a kona sahem chomdang khat hung kaltou kamun, hichun kelngoi ki tobang ki ni aneiyin, Dragon thusei bangin aseiye. 12 Hichun sahem masa thu neina lhingset’in aneiyin, sahem masa masanga thil abol’e. Hiche hin sahem kasa, thi thei hel’a kimavoa damdoh kit chu leiset le asunga chengte jouse ahousah tai. 13 Hichun thil bolmo kidang nasatah tah, mihemte mitmu changtah a, van’a kona leiset chunga meikou lenlhahsah geiyin abol theiye. 14 Sahem maiya thil bolmo kidang bol theina kipea chu leiset chung change jouse apui chatvaiya, leiset chung chengte chu chemjam’a kisat khaa, ahivanga hing nalai sahem lim sem ding aseipeh thu asei theiya, 15 sahem lim hou chun thu asei theiya, sahem lim hou lou jouse akitha theina dinga, sahem lim sunga hu khumlut peh theina jong kipea ahitai. 16 Sahem chun mihem jouse, aneo alen, ahao avai, jalen le soh, abonchauvin acham louvin akhut jetlam ham, achalpanguva ham a melchihna abol’e. 17 Hijeh chun chuche sahem melchihna, amin ham ahiloule amin mohor neilou chun imacha cho thei lou, joh jong joh thei lou ahi. 18 Hichea hin chihna angaiye. Lungthim’a hethem’an sahem mohor chu sutoh hen, ijeh-inem itile hiche hi mihem mohor ahin, mohor number chu jagup le gup ahi.

Henga Thuphon 14

Lhatdamsa 144, 000 lahsa

1 Ven, Zion molsang chunga Kelngoinou ding kamun, ama min le a-Pa min achalpanguva kijih cheh mi sang ja khat le sang som li le sang li to adding khom’e. 2 Chuin van’a konin twipi tamtah gin tobang le van-gin nasatah tobang ogin khat kajan, ogin kajah chu selangdah salhon aselangdah cheh asaigin’u to abange. 3 hiche ho hin laltouna mai le ganhing li ho chule upate masang chun lathah khat asauvin, leiset’a kona lhatdamsa mi sang ja khat le sang som li le sang li tilou koima hiche la chu kichuh thei lou ahi. 4 Hiche ho hi numeito kisuboh louhel, suhset lou na-ngah tobang ahiuve. Ache na chan a kelngaoinou nungjui ahiuvin, Pathen ding le Kelngoinou dinga aga masaa pang dinga, mihemete lah a kona kilhatdo ahitauve. 5 Akamsunguva thujou pot lam kihekha louhel, nolnabei ahiuve.

Vantil thum thupoh

6 Vanlaijol’a Vantil chom khat leng le le kamun, ama chun leiset chung cheng chitin namtin, phungtin, pao tin paotang le mitin mitang henga phonjal ding tonsot Kipana Thupha aneiye. 7 Aman ogingtah-in aseiyin, “Pathen gingun lang, alou, aloupina vahchoiyun, ijeh-inem itile aman thu atanna ding phat ahung lhung tai; van le leiset, Twikhanglen le twisamphung jouse Sempa chu chibai boh-uvin,” ati. 8 anina Vantil chom khat man anung juiyin aseiyin, “Ajonthanhoi lunghanna lengpitwi ji chitin namtin jouse donsah nu, Babylon khopi chungnung chu achimtai, achimtai!” ati. 9 Thum lhin na Vantil chonkhat man anung juiyin ogingtah-in aseiyin, “koi hi le sahem alim hijonle houva, achalpang ham, akhut ham a mohor kinam’a chun 10 Pathen lunghanna lengpitwi ju, imacha to hal louhel, gotsa kikoi chu adon khat tei ding, Vantil theng ho mang sang le Kelngoinou angsunga mei kou le kath a hesoh gentheiya kibol ding ahi. 11 Hitobang ho kibolgimna chun tonsot tonsot’a kitung cheng chung jeng ahin, chuche sahem le alim chibai boh ham, ahiloule amin mohor kinam khum ham chu sun le jan’a oltih nei lou ahitauve,” ati. 12 Hichea hin Jesu tahsan’a Pathen thupeh chengse nit, mintheng te din thot hat angaiye. 13 Hichun van’a hungkon ogin khat kajan, “pakai dinga thiho chengse chu tua lhah a anunnom ahitauve, tin sunin; ahiye, Lhaggaovin aseiyin, ‘Amaho chu atohgim nauva kona choldo ahitauvin, atoh phat jouseuvin anungu ajuiye,’ tin,” ati.

Vannoi leiset chang-at’a aki-at

14 Vetan, meibang lhang khat kamun, meilhang chunga chun Mihem Chapa tobang khat atouvin, alua lallulkhuh akhuh-in, akhut’in koite hemtah khat achoiye. 15 Chuin Houin’a kon chun Vantil chom khat ahungdoh-in, meilhang chunga tou pa henga ogingtah-in asamin, “Nakoite panin chang at tan, a-at phat ahung lhungin, leiaet chang akoijoutai,” ati. 16 Hijeh chun meilhang chunga Toupan akoite leiset chunga alamtan, leiset chung-at’in aki-at tai. 17 Van’a Houin sunga kon chun Vantil chomdang khat ahung potdoh-in, aman jong koite hemtah khat aneiye. 18 Chuin meikou chunga thu nei Vantil chom khatma Maicham phunga konin ahung potdoh-in, koite hemtah kichoipa henga chun ogingtah-in asamin, “Nakoite hemtah chu lamin lang leiset’a lengpiga ho khu aminsohtai at khomtan,” ati. 19 Hijeh chun Vantil’in akoite alamin leiset chung lengpiga boh ho chu a-at khom khomin, Pathen lunghan lengpiga hehna lentah khuh sunga chun asep luttai. 20 Khopi polam, lengpiga chilna mun’a chil’u len, lengpiga chilna mun’a konin thisan ahung putdoh-in, sakol kamdalgeiyin achuptan, kilometer jathum geiyin anal’e.

Henga Thuphon 15

Gamna kichaina nei Vantilte

1 Van’a datmo umtah le lentah melchihna khat kamun, gamna kichaina sagi neiya Vantil sagi ahiuvin, hiche hoa hi Pathen lungsat kichai ahitai. 2 Hichun meikou tokihal, phatvet tobang Twikhanglen, sahem le alim, amin mohor kinam nang jou chengse akhut’uva Pathen selangdah choiya, phatvet tobang Twikhanglen panga ding kamui. 3 Amaho hin Pathen lhacha Mose le Kelngoinou la asauvin: “Vo Hatchungnung Pakai Pathen, Nathilbol ho hi anasan akidange; Chitin namtin dinga Lengpa, Nalampi jouse adih-in akitah-e! 4 Vo Pakai, koiham nagging louva Namin vahchoi lou idng chu? Ajeh chu athenga nang bou nahi. Hijeh a chu chitin namtin hunguva Na-angsunga bohkhup’uva chibai naboh diu ahi; Ajeh chu nathilbol dihho akiphongdohtai,” atiuve. 5 Hicheng nung hin van’a hettohsahna Houbuh muntheng kihondoh kamun, 6 muntheng phunga konin gamna sagi neiya Vantil sagi ahungdoh tauve. Amaho chu tupat ponnem, abangleh-in akivon’un, sana pheh-in a-opkongu akiveiyui. 7 Hichun ganhing li ho lah a khat’in Vantil sagi ho chu tonsot tonsot’a hing jing jeng Pathen lungsetna demset cheh, sana lhengkong sagi apei. 8 Chuin Pathen loupina le athu neina jeh-in muntheng chu meikhu adimset jengin, Vantil sagin gamna sagi abulhitsoh masangsen koimacha muntheng phunga chun alut thei tapoi.

Henga Thuphon 16

Pathen lungsatna dim lhengkongho

1 Houin’a kona Vantil sagi ho henga ogingtah a thu kisei kajan, “Cheuvin lang Pathen lungsetna dimset lhengkong sagi chu leiset chung gabung lhauvin,” ati. 2 Hichun Vantil masapen achen leiset chunga alhengkong chu agasun lhan le, sahem melchihna neiya alim hou, mihem ho chunga netna hoisetah, uilut nat alangtai. 3 Vantil ni nan alhengkong chu Twikhanglen chunga asun lhan le, tolthi thisan bangin thisan asoh tan, Twikhanglen sunga um ganhing jouse athisoh tai. 4 Vantil thum nan alhengkong chu luididng jouse le twinah phung jousea asun lhah le, thisan asoh gamtai. 5 Hichun twipi jouse thu nei Vantil chun asei kajan, “Hicheng thu natan naa hin nadih-in nathenge, Aum jing le aumsa Nangma; 6 Mithengte le Themgao ho thisan asouvin, Adoh diuva thisan napeh hi achan diu lom tah ahi,” ati. 7 Chuin maicham phunga kona thu kisi kajan, “Ahinai, Vo hatchungnung Pakai Pathen, Nathutan ho hi akitah-in, adih cheh-e,” ati. 8 Vantil li nan alhengkong chu nichang asun khum le, mihemte chumeisaa ahugot dingin thu akipetai. 9 Mihem ho chu nisa save vun ahulgot gam phat’in, gamna ho chung geiya thu neipa, Pathen min geiyin ataitom’un, Pathen vahchoi din jong lung aheidoh pouve. 10 Vantil nga nan alhengkong chu sahem laltouna chunga asun lhah le, sahem lenggam sung athimsoh-in, anat thoh lel jeh-un, mihon aleiyu apet den’un, 11 anat thohgim jeh-u le ti-na ho jeh chun Van Pathen geiyin ataitom’uvin, anatoh athilbol’uva konin lung aheipouve. 12 Vantil gup nan alhengkong chu luipi len Euphrates a asun lama hung kon leng ho din lampi akihong doh tai. 13 Hichun Dragon kamsung, sahem kamsunga kona hungdoh, ephoh ho tobang lhagaoboh thum kamui. 14 Hiche ho hi thilha lhagao ahiuvin, melchihna aboljiu ahi; hiche ho hi cheuva, Hatchungnung Pathen nikho ni le galsat dinga leiset pumpia leng jouse gapuikhom agot’u ahi. 15 “Ven, gucha bangin kahunge, ponbeiya vah lea, asagohkeo akimudoh louna dinga hah jinga aponsil kivet phat jing mi chu anun nom’e” ati. 16 Chuin amaho chu Hebrew paova, “Armageddon” kiti laiya chun apuikhomsoh tauve. 17 Vantil sagi nin alhengkong chu vanlaijol’a asun lhah jeng le, Houin laltouna phunga konin nasatah-in o ahung gingdoh-in, “Akichaitai,” ati. 18 Chutah chun kol aphen, ogin akithongin, van aging lul lul jengin, leiset chunga mihem kilahdoh a pat jingpi jouse lah a jong um kha lou lai, lingpi nasatah khat ahung kihottai. 19 hichun khopi jouse achomsoh tai. Khopi lentah Babylon chu Pathen angsunga akigeldoh tan, alunghan na lengpiga ju-khon donsah dinga peh din aumtai. 20 Hichun twikol gam jouse jong akihomosoh tai. 21 Chutah-in gel len, khatseh agih dol jong talent khat to kibang hel, van’a konin mihemte chunga ahung lhan, hiche gamna hi anatsat behseh jeh-in mihemten gel lhah gamna jal hin Pathen ataitom tauve.

Henga Thuphon 17

Noti len nu le Sahem

1 Lhengkong sagi choiya Vantil sagi holah a khat ahungin kajah a thu aseiyin, “Hungin, twitampi chunga tou, noti len nu chunga thu kitan vetsah inge; 2 leiset leng hon noti nu toh jonthanhoi na leng piga ju chu leiset’a chengte jouse khamsoh ahitauve,” ati. 3 Hichun aman lhagaovin gamthip eipuitai. Hichea hin achunga taitomna min jeng kikun, alu sagi, akisom nei, sahem danthip khat chunga numei khat touva kamui. 4 Numei nu chun pon sandup le pon santhip asil’in, sana, khisong mantam jeng le twikoh changing akijemin akhut’a chun thet umtah tah thil ho le ajonthanhoi na nen demset sana khon khat achoiye. 5 Achalpanga chun selguh min akisunin, “Babylon len, noti jouse le leiset’a thil thet um jouse konna nu,” akiti. 6 Chule numeinu chun mithengte thisan le Jesu thu hettohsahte thisan adonkhamset kamui. Hiche nu kamu chu kidang kasa behseh jenge. 7 Ahin Vantil chun kajah a, “Ibol’a kidang nasah ham? Khuche numei le apolea, aluchang sagi, aki som nei, sahem thuguh khu keiman seipeh inge. 8 Namu sahem, anu umsa hiya, umtalou khu, akhonbei thamkoa kona hung kaltouva, manthahna vah lut ding ahin, chu teng leiset chung chengte, vannoi bul kiphudoh a pat hinna lekhabua min kisun lou hon, aumsa hiya, umta lou, hung kit ding, sahem chu amu tengu adatmo lheh jeng diu ahi. 9 Hichea hin lungthim le chihna angaiye. Aluchang sagi chu molsang dsagi ahin, hiche ho chunga hi numei ni kitousah ahi. Hiche ho hi leng sagi jong ahiuve. 10 Nga alhutan, khat aumnalaiyin, khat ahung hih laiyin, ahung tang le phat chom khat beh umtei ding ahi. 11 Aumsa hiya, umtalou sahem, sagi lah a khat chu get lhin na ahin, manthahna vah lut ding ahi. 12 Aki som namu ho chu leng som ahiuvin, lengvaipohna anei lou laiyu ahi, nisan kah khat sunga sahem chutoh thakhat tah a, lengte banga, thu neina aneikhom diu ahi. 13 Amaho hi doi kitha khat ahiuvin, athahat athu nei nau sahem chu apetauve. 14 Amaho Kelngoinou to kisat diu, ahivanga Kelngoinouvin amaho ajo ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile am apakaiho Pakai le leng ho Leng ahi; aumpi chengse jong koudodhsa le lhenchom, chule tahsan nei ho ahiuve,” ati. 15 Hichun kajah a, “Noti nu kitousahna twipi namu ho chu mitin mitang, lhangpi kikhom khom, chitin namtin le paotin paotanga mi ahiuve. 16 aki som namu le sahem chun noti nu chu ahot diu, achom keohel’uva, asagoh keova akoiyuva, atahsa geiya aneh chaiyuva, meiya ahalvam diu ahi. 17 Ijeh-inem itile Pathen thusei chengse guilhunsoh masangsea dinga, amaho chu lungdoi kitoh tah a alengvai neinau sahem apehdoh-uva, Pathen lungdoi atohdohna diuva, hi tobang lunggel chu Pathenin alungthim’uva akhumpeh ahi. 18 Chule nangin namu numei nu chu leiset leng ho jouse chunga lengvaipoa pang khopi len chu ahi,” ati.

Henga Thuphon 18

Babylon khopi chim

1 Hicheng nung hin Vantil thu nei tah khat van’a kona hung kumlha kamun, leiset hi aloupi nan asalvahsohjenge. 2 Ama chun going leng lung tah-in asamin aseiye: “Achimtai, achimtai Babylon len, Thilha ten chen nan aneitauve; Lhagaoboh jouse kikholna, Vacha bohjouse le thet um jouse kikholna asohtai. 3 Ajeh chu aman ajonhuhna lengpiga ju chu Chitin namtin jouse adonsah tai; Leiset leng jouse amanu to ajonguvin, Amanu nopsahna val’a konin leiset’a kiveihon ahaolotauve,” ati. 4 Hichun van’a kona thu kisei ogin khat kajan: “Hiche nua kon chun potdoh-un kamite, Ajo le amanu chonsetna ho changkhauvin natin, Ajo le athoh ding gamna ho thoh khauvin nate. 5 Ajeh chu amanu chonsetna ho Van geiyin akikhangdoh tan, Athemmona jouse Pathenin ageldohtai. 6 Amanun napeh bangin pethuh-un, Athilbol achonna dungjuiyin ajat nin lethuh-uvin. Chih tah a ahhalkhomna khon’a chun Ajat nin chih cheh-in halkhompeh-uvin. 7 akiloupisah a kinopsah val bangin Sugentheiyun lang sulung hem’uvin; Aman alungthim sunga ‘Lengnu banga toukahin, Meithai kahipoi, itih chan hijongle Lunghemna muponge,’ atijeh chun 8 Gamna jousen nikhat’in lhunden hen, Thi lunghemna chule kelle chah nan, Amanu meikouvin leolih jeng hen. Ajeh chu achung thu tan Pakai Pathen chu thanei tah ahi,” ati. 9 Amanu to jonga nom sakhom, leiset leng hon agovamna meikhu amudoh tengu le dip le lai akidop’a, amanu akacham diu ahi. 10 Amanu thoh genthei akichat jeh-un, gamla tah a dingun tin: “Ohe, ohe, khopi len, Bebylon khopi dettah, Nidan kha khat sungin nachung thu akitan chaitai!” atidiu ahi. 11 Leiset’a kiveimihon jong koiman athil’u achohpeh lou phat’in amanu chu lhase tah-in akauve. 12 Sana, dangka, song mantam, twikohchang ho, tupat ponnem, ponsandup, lungpon, ponsanthip, thing namtui mantam jouse, saiha le thing mantam a kisem thil ho, sum-eng, thih le songval’a kisem ho, 13 thingthal, eisanga, gimnamtui, thaonamtui, bego, lengpitwi le thao, changbongnal, suhlou chang bong le kelngoi, sakolte le kangtalai jouse, soh ho le mihem dang hinkho geiya chohpeh louva um gam ahitai. 14 “Nalhan angaichat, aga chu Nanga konin apotdoh tai; Na-ning lhin na le nahaona jouse kitolmang ahitan, Kimudoh kit louhel ding ahitai,” atiuve. 15 Amaa kona gaodoh kivei mihon, akhopi thoh genthei hesoh akichat jeh-un, gamla tah a dingin akacham’un, alhaset piuvin 16 aseiyun: “Ohe, ohe khopi len minthang, Tupat ponnem le ponsandup, ponsanthip’a kivon’a, 17 Nidan kah khatseh-in nei chujatpi amangheltai,” atiuve. Chuin kong lamkai jouse le konga kitol miho, kong tol ho le Twikhanglen a kivei miho abonchauvin gamlatah a adingun, 18 amanu kigovamna meikhu aveuvin, going tah-in asam’un, “Hiche khopi lem tobang ipi khopi um didng ham?” atiuve. 19 Chuin aluchunguva leivui akithe khum’un, kap le maovin kho asam’un: “Ohe, ohe khopi len minthang, Twikhanglen’a kitolle kong jouse Ama ninglhing jal’a haodohna Nidan kah khatseh sungin abeitai,” atiuve. 20 Vo van le mithengte, Solchah ho le Themgaoho, amanu cunga hin kipah thanom’un, ajeh chu nang ho din Pathenin amanu chunga thu atantai! 21 Hichun Vantil tha nei tahkhat hin sumhri song tejen songkhat alan, Twikhanglen’a aleh lut’in: “Hitobanga hi khopi len Babylon chu Tolse na kineiya kimudoh ki tlouhel ding ahi. 22 Nasung hi selangdah saiho sangin, Lathem ho lasah gin, theile mut themho mutgin, Nasunga kijakit louhel ding; Khut themna jatchom chom’a them Khut them ho jong kimudoh louhel ding ahi; Sumhei gin jong nasunga kija louhel ding ahitai. 23 Nasunga thaomei vah jong kimukit lou ding, Nasunga jineipa le jinei nu ogin kija louhel ding ahi; Kivei mi nanei ho chu leiset’a lamkai jeng ahiuvin, Mitpheldoi nachoi chun chitin namtin apui chavaitai. 24 Ijeh-inem itile nasunga hin Themgaoho le mithengte, Leiset chunga kithat ho jouse thisan akimudoh tai,” ati.

Henga Thuphon 19

1 Hicheng nung hin van’a kona hung kisei, mipi tamtah ogin tobang khat kajan: “Hallelujah! Huhhingna, loupina, tha neina i-Pathenu achangtai; 2 Ajeh chu Ama thutan jouse akitah-in adih cheh-e; Aman noti len nu chunga thu atanin, Ajonthanhoi jeh a leiset suchavai nu, Akhut’a thi asohte thisan phu Amanu chunga hin alatai,” atiuve. 3 Ani veinan asei kit’un: “Hallelujah ! amanu kigovamna meikhu chu tonsot tonsot’a din akitungdoh tai,” atiuve. 4 Chutah-in upa som ni le li ho, ganhing li ho chun, laltouna kitousah Pathen chub oh khup’in chibai aboh-un: “Amen, Hallelujah ‘!” atiuve.

Kelngoinou moupui golvah

5 Laltounaa konin ogin khat ahung kithongin: “Pathen soh, ama gingkhen, alen aneo nabonchauvin I-Pathenu vahchoi cheh-uvin,” ati. 6 Chuin mihonpi tamtah ogin tobang le twipi tamtah lon gin tobang, van ginthong tobang kajan: “Hallelujah! Hatchungnung Pakai i-Pathenun Lengvai apotai; 7 Kipah thanomin aloupina vahchoiyute; Ajeh chu Kelngoinou jinei golvah phat ahung lhungtan, Ajinu ding jong kigosadem ahitai; 8 Ajinu ding chu tupat ponnem thengsel, vamleuva Kivon dingin apetauve; Hiche tupat ponnem chu minthengte tohphatna ahi,” atiuve. 9 Chuin ogin chun kajah a, “Kelngoinou ji kipui golvah a kikou ho chu anun nom’ui, tin sunin,” eiti. Kajah a aseiyin, “Hicheng hi Pathen thu tahbeh ahi,” ati. 10 Hijeh chun keijong ama chibai boh din akengbul’a kaboh khuptai. Ahinla aman kajah a, “Bol hih-in; keima Jesu thudol hettohsah sopite lah a khat, nasoh natoh khompi khat kahibouve; Pathen bou chibai bohin. Ijeh-inem itile Jesu thudol het tohsah hi gaothu seidohna Lhagao ahi,” ati.

Sakol kang chunga Toupa

11 Hichun van akihondoh kamun, ven, sakol kang khat aumin, achunga Toupa chu tahsan le kitah akitin, tah-inthu atanin, gal abol’e. 12 Amitchang te ni chu meikou pah lah lah ahin, aluchanga lallukhuh tampi akhuh-in, min khat akisunin, Ama tilou koima danginahepoi. 13 Aponsil chu thisan kithekhum ahin, amin chu Pathen Thu akiti. 14 Tupat ponnem thengsel le vamleh kisil’a sakol kangte chunga tou, van’a sepaiten anung ajuiyui. 15 Akamsunga konin chemjam hemtah khat ahung potdoh-in, hichea chu chitin namtin asatgam sing, achunguva thih tenggol’a vai ahom ding, Hatchungnung Pathen lunghanna lengpiga chilna tobanga chu aman jong achil ding ahi. 16 Aponsil chunga akhelbuh laiya, ‘Leng ho Leng le Pakai ho Pakai, tin min khat akisun’e. 17 Hichun nichang chunga ding Vantil kha tkamun, vanlaijol’a leng lea vachate jouse jah a ogingtah-in aseiyin, “Pathen golvah lentah a hung kikhom’uvin; 18 leng ho tahsaphe le sepai lamkai ho tahsanphe, sepaiho tahsaphe, mihem jouse, jalen hihen doh hile, aneo hihen alen hile, atahsaphe hung neuvin,” ati. 19 Chuin sahem le leiset leng ho, asepaiteu hung kikhom’a, sakol chung Toupa le asepaite douna galbol goa kamui. 20 Sahem le sahem masanga datmo kidang melchihna tampi boljia, hotobang melchihna hoa hi sahem mohor kinam khum, alim houho chu pui chavaiji Themgao lhem chu aman’un, anigel lhon in ahing laiyin kath meikou deuje ju lah a a leh lut tauve. 21 Chule amoh chengse chu sakol chunga Toupa kamsunga kona hung potdoh chemjam chun athat gamin, vachate jousen atahsapheu chu achim avan aneuve.

Henga Thuphon 20

1 Akhonbei thamko hehna le thih khao akhut’a choiya Vantil khat van’a kona hung kum lha kamui. 2 Vantil chun khangluiya gulpi, Diabol, Satan Dragon chu aman in kum sang khat din ahentai. 3 Hiti chun akhonbi thamko sunga aleh lut’in, akandenin, kum sang khat kichai kahsea namtin apui chatvai louna din mohor anamkhumtai. Hiche nung hile phat chom khat dinga kilhadoh tei ding ahi. 4 Hichun laltouna phabep le achunga touva, thutan ding kipedoh ho le Jesu thudol hettohsah jeh le Pathen thu jeh a alu kitanho, sahem le alim chibai boh louhel, achalpangu le akhut’uva melchihna moho kinam lou ho lhagao kamun, amaho hi hingdoh a Christa to kum sang khat lengvai apoh khomu ahi. 5 Kum sang khat kichai kahsea vang chu mithi amoh cheng thoudoh lou ding ahiuve. 6 Hiche thodoh masaa pang kha chu anun nomin athenge; thi ni nan achunguva thu anei lou ding, Pathen le Christa Thempua panguva, Ama to kum sang khat lengvai apoh khom diu ahi.

Satan gal lel

7 Kum sang khat alhin teng Satan akihenna a kona kilhadoh a, 8 leiset ning lia cheng chitin namtin Gog le Magog, Twikhanglen neldi jat pi chu gal bolsah dial hem chavaiya puikhom dinga kondoh ding ahi. 9 Amaho chu leiset kho khongin ahung kon’un, mithengte Ngahmun le Pathenin a-it tah khopi chu aumkimvel tauve. Ahinla van’a konin meikou ahung leng lhan amaho chu akavamtai. 10 Chutah chun sahem le themgao lhempa kiselutna kath le meidil sunga chun miho lehm chavai Diabol chu asep lut tauve, hikom a chu amahon sun le jan, tonsot tonsot geiya gim hesoh chungnung athoh diu ahitai.

Laltouna kang phunga thu kitan

11 Hichun laltouna lentah, akang khat le achunga Toupa kamun, amasanga konin van le leiset ajam mangin, van le leiset din mun akihol motai. 12 Chuin laltouna masanga mithi ho alen aneo adinu kamun, chule lekhabu ho akiphongtai; hichea hin lekhabu achom khat, ahinna lekhabu kit chu akiphong doh-e; hiche lekhabu hoa kisun dungjuiyin mitho ho chu anatoh dungjui cheh-in athuu atan tauve. 13 Twikhanglenin asunga um mithi ho ahinleh doh-in, thina le thina gamin jong asung lhona um mithi ho ahinleh doh lhonin, amichang cheh anatohdungjui cheh-uvin athuu atanpeh tauve. 14 Chuin hina le thina gamchu meidil sunga aleh lut tauve, meidil hi thini na ahi. 15 Hinna lekhabu sunga amin kiholdoh louse chu meidil sunga aleh lut lut jenguve.

Henga Thuphon 21

Vanthah le leiset thah

1 Chujouvin Vanthah le leiset thah kamui; ajeh-inem itile van masa le leiset masa chu kitolmang ahitan, Twikhanglen jong aumtapoi. 2 Chuin aji ding pa henga dia kigosadem, jinei din gnu banga jijem, Pathen kom, van’a hung kitol lha khopi theng Jerusalem thah chu kamui. 3 Laltouna a kona ogingtah a thu kisei khat kajan, “Vrn, Pathen chenna in chu mihemte lah ahitai, Pathenin amaho achenpia, amaho amite hidiu, Pathenin amaho achen pia a-Pathenu hiding ahi. 4 Amit’uva kona amit lhi jouseu atheh hul peh ding, thina umta lou ding, lung hem na le ka-na, thohgimna jong umta louhel ding ahi; ajeh chu thil masa chengse kitolmangsoh ahitai,” ati. 5 Laltouna Toupan aseiyin, “Ven ijakai kasemthahsoh ahitai,” ati. Chujongle aseiyin, “Hicheng thu hi tahsan umtah, thutah cheh ahi, sunin,” eti. 6 Chuin kajah a, “Akichaitai, Keima Alpha le Omega, akipatna le akichaina kahi, Adang chah a chu hinna twinah a twi don ding manbeiyin penge. 7 koi hile gal jouva chuthil hichengse hi chang ding, keima a-Pathen kahiya, ama kachapa hi ding ahi. 8 Ahin meidoi ho, tahsan bei ho, thet um ho, tolthat ho, jonthanhoi bol ho, doichoi ho, doilim houho, chule jousei ho jouse kath le meikou dil deuje ju sunga chu um siu ahi; hiche hi thi ni na ahiye,” ati.

Jerusalem thah

9 Gamna nukhah sagi dimset, lhengkong sagi choi, Vantil sagi lah a khat chu ahungin kajah a thu aseiyin, “Hungin, Kelngoinou jinu ding mouthah chu setsah inge,” eiti. 10 Hichun Aman Lhagaovin molsang lentah khat chungvuma eilhoh touvin, Pathen kom van’a kona hung kumlha Jerusalema eilhoh touvin, Pathen kom van’a kona hung kumlha Jerusalem khopi theng chu eivetsah-in, 11 Pathen loupi nan akijemin ahi; avahje dan chu song mantam, jasper song le crystal val vah abange. 12 Apal chu lentah le sangtah ahin, kelkot som le ni ahin, kelkot ho chunga hcun Vantil som le ni aumin, chule kelkot ho chungma chun Israel phung som le ni min akisun’e. 13 Nisdo lama kelkot thum, sah lama kelkot thum, lhanglama kelkot thum, nilhum lama kelkot thum aum’e. 14 Khopi pal chu akhombul som le ni ahin, achunga chun Kelngoinou solchah som le ni min akiun’e. 15 Kahenga thuseiya chun khopi le kelkot ho chule apal te-na didng sana tenglhon khat achoiye. 16 khopi chu aning li kitoh a, adung avai kibang, Aman thil te-na tenglhon’a khopi chu ate le, kilometer sang ni le ja ni to som nga asaovin, adung avai, asandol kibangsoh kei ahi. 17 Chuin apal ate le tong ja khat le tong som li le li alhinge; mihem thil te-na chu Vantil’in jong aman ahi. 18 Pal chu jasper song jenga kigen ahin, khopi jeng jong chu phatvet then’a theng, sana thengseh a kisa ahi. 19 Khopi pal khombul song chu khisong mantam jatchom chom’a kijem ahi; khombul masapen chu jasper, ani na sapphire, athumna chalcedony, li lhina emerald, 20 nga lhinna sardonix, gupna sardis, sagi lhina topaz, som na chrysoprase, som le khatna jacinth, som le ni na amethyst song jeng ahi. 21 kelkot som le ni chu twikoh chang jenga kisem ahi, kelkot khat khat chu twikohchang khat cheh akisem ahi; kho pi sung lamlen chu phatvet banga lim kimudoh thei sana thengsel ahi. 22 Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung le Kelngoinou Houin a apantah jeh in kho pi sunga chun Houin kamupoi. 23 Pathen loupe nan asalvah jinga, Kelngoinou chu thaomei vah a apanjeh-in khopi chun asalvah ding nisa le lha jong angai chapoi. 24 Chitin namtin khopi vah a chu vah leuva, leiset leng jousen jong aloupi nau asunga ahinpoh lut diu ahi; 25 jan jong aumchom tah loujeh chunkelkot ho chu sun laiya jong kikhah chom lou ding ahitai. 26 Mihon chitin namtin loupina le jabolna asunga ahinpoh lut diu ahi. 27 Itina ma jong le aboh jouse le thet umtah thilbol’a, jousei ho, khopi sunga chu lut louhel diu, kelngoinou hinna lekhabu sunga amin kisunsa ho chubou lut diu ahi.

Henga Thuphon 22

1 Vantil chun Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna a kona hungput, crystal song val’a val, hintwilui dung chu eivetsah-e. 2 Luidung chu khopi lamlen lai lunga alongin apang langto gel’a hinthing akeh-in, lhaseh le aga jin jat chom chom ga somle ni aneiye; chujongle athingna ho chu ahitinnamtin boldamna ahi. 3 Gaosap changsa jouse beisoh ding ahi. Khopi sunga chu Pathen le Kelngoinou laltoina bouuma, asoh ten ama ajenle diu, 4 amahon amai amu’va, achalpanguva ama min um ding ahi. 5 Jan jong umta lou didng, thaomei vah le nisa vah jong angaichat louhel diu ahitai; ijeh-inem itile Pakai Pathenin amaho asalvah jing ding, tonsot tonsot geiya lengvai apoh diu ahitai.

Jesu hungvah ding

6 Vantil chun kajah a aseiyin, “Hicheng thu hi tahsan um le thutah jeng ahi, Themgao ho Lhagao Pakai Pathen chun ahungso loi ding thil asohte vetsah dinga a-Vantil ahinsol ahi. 7 “Ven, kahung loi ding ahi. Hiche lekhabua gao thusei ho nit’a chu anunnom ahi,” ati. 8 Thil hicheng jaa mua chu keima John kahi. Kajah a kamu phat’in thil hicheng eivetsah a Vantil chu chibai boh din akengphang bul’a kaboh khuptai. 9 Ahinla aman kajah a aseiyin, “Bol hih-in, keijong nang le nasopite Themgaoho, chule hiche lekhabua thu ho nit ho lah a nasoh natoh khompi khat kahibouve. Pathen bou chibai boh-in,” eiti. 10 Vantil chun kajah a, “Hiche lekhabua gaothu seidoh hi imchah hih hel’in, ajeh chu phat anaitai. 11 Adih lou chun adih lou bol jing hen, aboh a chun thilboh bol jing hen, midih chun thildih bol jing hen, mintheng chu theng jing hen. 12 “Ven, kahungloi ding ahi, mitin atoh dungjui cheh a peh ding keiya tohman chu kahinpoi. 13 Keima Alpha le Omega, amasa le anukhah, akipatna le akichaina kahi,” ati Jesun. 14 Hinna thingga neh theina le khopi kelkot dunga lut le theina dinga avon’u kisop theng ho chu anun nom’ui. 15 Uicha ho le doichoi ho, jonthanhoi bol ho, tol that ho, doilim semthu hou ho, chule jouva thilbol nom jouse polama um diu ahiye. 16 “Keima Jesun hicheng thu hi Houbunga um nang ho hettohsah dinga ka-Vantil kahinsol ahi; Keima David Jungpi, achilhah, jingvalpa vahtah chu kahi,” ati. 17 Lhagao le Mouvin, “Hungin,” ati. Ajapha chanin, “Hungin,” ti hen. Adangchah chan hungun; angaicha chanin hinna twi chu manbeiyin kilah hen. 18 Hiche lekhabua gao thuseidoh ho japha jouse henga kahettohsah ahi: koi hile hicheng belap a aum le, hiche lekhabua kisei gamna ho chu Pathenin achunga abelap peh ding, 19 hiche gao thusei hoa kona alamanga aum jongle, hiche lekhabua kisei Khopi Theng le hinna thingphunga kona Pathenin achan alahmang ding ahi. 20 Hiche thu hettohsah pan, “Henge, kahungvah ding ahi,” ati. Amen Vo Pakai Jesu hungin! 21 Pakai Jesu milungset’in mitin umpi jing hen!
